>
>On the outskirts of town near the docks, the abandoned business park waited. A typical rendezvous for those desiring to conduct highly irregular, clandestine activity. That night, it wouldn't be disappointed. Daylight rapidly faded. The only light came from a flickering greenish-white mercury lamp that sat at the edge of the entrance. It cast long, distorted shadows across the gray concrete. 
>
>*First on the scene, Olivia glanced at the sedan's dashboard clock that read 5:45 p.m. *
>
>Fifty yards from the entrance, her partner killed the lights before easing into the service entrance. He headed straight for space 9D and turned off the engine. Silence pervaded the vehicle as Lyle sat with his hand gripping the door handle, peering into the dark for signs of a familiar vehicle. Eager to exit, his foot landed on the pavement the moment the car parked into one of the loading dock slots.  
>
>*Lyle stepped outside. His breath fogged slightly with his lip curling from the humid, stagnant air in the nearby waterway. He watched as a pair of unfamiliar headlights parted the parking lot's fog, pulling in inches away from Olivia's sedan blocking her exit.*
>
>Second to arrive, the passenger door of that vehicle opened slowly. A small figure emerged equally slow, the face obscured by unnecessary dark shades. She quickly removed them as Lyle approached. No spousal greeting was exchanged. The air hung heavy with unease, heightened by the couple's estrangement.
>
>*Lyle looked past Daniela, saw movement, but couldn't determine those in the car who had accompanied her. Your instructions were to come alone,\
You told me a lot of things. You've only been using me to further your criminal activity and still are,\
Hurry, we've got to get Daniela out of here. She's our only witness now,\
Good to know you're among the living. And...we're excited about our grandchild,\
I want to share something with you Lyle gave me before I completely lose my nerve,\

My name is Arturo Rossi. I was born in Apulia, Italy. I was nine when my parents traded me in for a ticket abroad and left to pursue a better life. Abandoned into the hands of traffickers, I vowed never to become a victim if I survived. I've searched all my life and never found anyone who wanted or loved me for myself as you did and not for profit or my value to further their cause. I, Arturo, take you, Daniela, for the sake of matrimony. Remember, I love you.\
You **can't overlook that** he almost got you killed! That's significantly more heinous than what he did to others.\
But what if it was merely taking precautions in case someone was after him, meant to do harm as one succeeded?\
My God. Think girl. We taught you better than that!\

The end was as clear as the ledgers stored **secret in the attic**. The man was guilty as sin of horrible crimes. The odd happenings and refusing to allow you to enter certain parts of your own home. That's not the norm in any marriage\
He almost got you killed, remember. That's definitely not love. I had no doubt his intention was to return and eliminate you since you stood in the way of his mission.\

Yes he did, Daniela shot back in an unsteady voice. Merely a tortured soul. My life hasn't been a walk in the park with the dumb decisions I've made in the past. And you all forgave and welcomed me back into the family. I wish Lyle nothing but healing and peace in his soul that he couldn't find in life. I regret not telling him about his child.\

body.title: [生活日记]纯胡思乱想🙈
body.body:
早上醒来发现怎么ecency的app看不了帖子内容了？也看不到回复了？又去打开网页版，还好网页版可以。突然的不好用还是吓我一跳，不知道什么时候恢复正常。
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmdqQAu3TaCdwCwiyx9xNJHWL6knXbJKSLVdvmMkU44BsH/1777074378120.jpg)
如果这帖子可以发出去，那么发帖还是正常的。
这三天这么快就过去了，来发帖已经是第四天了，有点后知后觉，感觉每天都在点赞没落下也就两天没发帖吧？怎么都四天了呢？恍恍惚惚的哈哈哈😃
可能是心情不太好的原因，都说心情不好的时候可以说出来也可以发出来，但是真正不好的时候，可能只想沉默啦！沉默寡言，沉默不语……
每个人都会有不开心不高兴的时候对吧！都怎么化解的呢？我有时候觉得，能化解开的不开心不高兴那都不是事儿了，就是那种说不出解不掉的烦恼才会让人崩溃。比如大病，比如情劫，比如生活没了目标，说到这些想法感觉自己状态可能也是抑郁了呵，微笑的抑郁，好可怕。昨晚姑娘休息前说要跟我聊聊恐怖电影，我说:你可别跟妈讲这些恐怖电影，我会睡不着，做噩梦哈。
中年人有时候喜欢回首往事，尤其在她们遇到烦恼波折的时候。有时候感觉🈶切都是命运的安排，生活中经历的种种，一切的发生，都不是一个人自己能左右的。所以有时候也就在累了的时候，就不在纠结方向了，不在纠结对错了，一切顺其自然，随遇而安，对很多事也不再奢望，不在自强不息啦！有福之人不用忙，没福之人跑断肠。我是不是很悲观，最近就有点这状态呵，感觉自己什么都看透了，对生活不想努力啦。人的年龄越来越长是不是心不是越来越宽？说的不好听的，看到70岁80岁的大姨大叔们都开心的在跳广场舞的时候，我在想如果我这个年纪的时候我可能会天天担心自己的身体发疯了，我没到这年龄不知道什么样，但感觉能勇敢的面对生死是一个人非常大的勇气。人间万般无奈万般苦也还是人间那，天堂会是又一种人生的重生吗，我想它不会，我也不信😲

English









Hello friends of the hive, it's a pleasure to greet you on this new occasion. I hope you are all well and had a happy and blessed day. Today was my manicure day of the month. This month it took me a long time, and I want to show you my process, from how my nails looked before to how they turned out. I also want to share the fact that I chose yellow, which is a bit out of my comfort zone since yellow isn't my favorite color, and it's the first time I've decided to use it on my nails. Here's the result!



![IMG_7611.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ariannysg/23w2oQSp2Njd3W598RxSUaK6JULMkHEhH7j6Xk1MBP5fQSJkrPgRUcb6h6xbFeDao8VZT.jpeg)

 One of the photos showed how awful my nails were; it took me over a month to get them done. The process began with removing the old material, shaping them into an oval (that's how I wear them), and cleaning my cuticles (they weren't very bad despite not having had maintenance in a while). I applied a foam and cleaned them with a brush, then applied primer, and started with the gel polish. I also cut them because I don't like very long nails. 


![photo-output.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ariannysg/AK7ybXJKM25gK661kAZRzCVpsyQsnuR5PAVubu3NKH7aTXPrmC3UEm8AL63S6zq.jpeg)

body.title: AI Frontiers: Robots, Agents, and the New Industrial Stack
body.body:
The AI story in 2026 is no longer just about chatbots. The center of gravity is shifting toward systems that can act: agents that coordinate work, models that reason across tools, and robots that execute tasks in the physical world.

That shift is showing up everywhere. At Hannover Messe 2026, NVIDIA and partners are putting AI-driven manufacturing on display, with robotics, accelerated computing, and AI physics moving from demo to deployment. In parallel, humanoid systems are getting more practical. Atlas-style factory work, walking-assist robotics, and commercial humanoids are all signaling the same thing: physical AI is leaving the lab and entering operations.

The important pattern is this, AI is becoming infrastructure. First it writes, then it plans, then it acts, and now it is starting to move things, sort things, inspect things, and assemble things. That changes the economics of labor, the speed of iteration, and the design of entire businesses.

For builders, the opportunity is obvious. The winners will not be the people who merely talk about AI. They will be the people who embed it into workflows, connect it to real systems, and use it to reduce friction, cost, and cycle time.

The next wave is not artificial intelligence in isolation. It is AI plus robots, AI plus factories, AI plus autonomous operations. That is where the real leverage is.

最近市中心这边在搞活动，非遗文化展示与体验，还有表演节目可以看，偶然间看到朋友发的朋友圈，可以免费体验木板刻画和制作香囊，我们都很想去，毕竟免费的午餐谁不喜欢呢。

下班吃完饭之后我就和帅哥一起出门，朋友也说她到了，后面我俩就去找那个活动地点，绕了一圈没找到，以为他们还没开始，后面突然发现就在那条街的正中央。

去到之后人很多，我们就排队等候。香囊制作没看到，只有木板刻画。这个木板刻画是帮忙分享朋友圈或者拍一张照片就可以免费体验并带走成品。

后面到我了，我选了一条鲤鱼，锦鲤总是有好运的寓意，所以我毫不犹豫选择了它，先拿滚筒在染料上面滚，后面在模板上面滚动，颜色感觉差不多涂够之后，盖上白纸，再拿像粉扑一样的东西去压那个模板上面的颜料，最后把纸拿起来，木板刻画就完成了，工作人员帮忙拿相框装起来，成品就制作好了。

因为我是兔年的，所以那个小兔子我也看上了，但是一个人只能带走一个，后面我叫帅哥去，他也不愿意，我厚着脸皮又叫他们给我刻了一张。🤣

朋友那边也排到了，她也选了锦鲤，最后我俩就一共拿了三个，两个锦鲤一个兔子。发现旁边的小老虎也不错，好可爱，笑眯眯的，他们说第二天晚上还可以再来，因为模板还没刻好，而且今晚的体验次数也用完了，我们只能下次再来啦，不得不说活动方还挺好。

body.title: [EN/ES] Cyntheia OC ART
body.body:
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmXxyf84rDWabNAT3y57FkbiKxBp1bp4tVMr83adQcDQ1g/283_sin_t_tulo_20260418235445_2_.jpg) A few days ago I did a challenge where I drew OCs from different people on X (aka Twitter), as if they were normal commissions, though completely free of course. I liked this challenge and got some drawings that I can put in my portfolio or share on my social media. It's the first time I do this kind of challenge and I'm very happy with the results. The tweet, very simple, said this: I want to learn to draw and I want to practice with real requests. Comment a simple idea (character, pet, OC). I will draw 3 people. Free. No changes, but I will put effort into it. I will use the drawing in my portfolio. Anyone up for it? And so I did, I chose three original characters from three different users and started drawing them. The first character, the one I'm sharing today, is called Cyntheia and belongs to user Pupsensua1. > Hace unos días hice una dinámica donde dibujé OCs de distintas personas en X, aka Twitter, como si fuesen comisiones normales, aunque totalmente gratis por supuesto. Me gustó esta dinámica y saqué algunos dibujos que podré poner en mi portafolio o compartir en mis redes sociales. Es la primera vez que hago este tipo de dinámicas y estoy muy feliz con los resultados. El tweet, muy simple, decía así: > > Quiero aprender a dibujar y quiero practicar con peticiones reales. > Comenta una idea simple (personaje, mascota, OC). > Dibujaré a 3 personas. Gratis. Sin cambios, pero le pondré empeño. > Usaré el dibujo en mi portafolio. ¿Alguien se anima? > > Y así fue, escogí tres personajes originales de tres usuarios distintos y me puse a dibujarlos. El primer personaje, el que les comparto hoy, se llama Cyntheia y pertenece al usuario Pupsensua1. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYx5nxab6b3fAAJP1hyHaD7fSzGo3iWGT6tHWZ4sfMvT6/283_sin_t_tulo_20260418210442.jpg) Cyntheia is presented as a girl with golden hair and a scar on her right eye. She also has pink-colored clothes and wears a big bow. With that in mind, the first thing I did was draw a basic pose for my character. > Cyntheia se presenta como una chica de cabellos dorados y una cicatriz en su ojo derecho, además tiene ropas de color rosa y usa un gran lazo. Con esto en mente, lo primero que hice fue dibujar una pose base para mi personaje. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmbkMzLfyFhvHuQMSsK2TDYMzjhScA7gt4rpfhGWSPXKug/283_sin_t_tulo_20260418211501.jpg) Little by little I added details: the hair, the gloves, the bow, and her dress, leaving the facial expression for last, since that is almost always the most difficult thing for me and at the same time what defines the drawing the most and how one feels when looking at it. > Poco a poco fui agregando detalles: el cabello, los guantes, el lazo y su vestido, dejando la expresión facial de último, ya que casi siempre esto es lo más complicado que me resulta y a la vez lo que más define el dibujo y cómo se siente uno al verlo. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmS7w1U9ko7dNTB2nQ1jhFUwutQZr1kCzNNSHfAYv1Vbae/283_sin_t_tulo_20260418220635.jpg) So my lines ended up totally clean, although later, as I colored, I made some small corrections and perfected a few details, but I really liked how it turned out. > Así quedaron mis líneas totalmente limpias, aunque después, a medida que coloreé, realicé algunas pequeñas correcciones y perfeccioné algunos detalles, pero me gustó bastante cómo quedó. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQGwE4H33wrVHXud2mbjiAAqxSH16PFMRXxHRHBcnnsw7/283_sin_t_tulo_20260418222026.jpg) I delimited the character's area with a solid color. This was a tip someone recently gave me on X, so I won't have extra work when coloring, since I can lock the layer and draw without worrying about going outside the drawing's lines. Lately it's become very difficult for me to color drawings without forgetting details. > Delimité la zona del personaje con un color sólido. Esto fue un consejo que me dieron recientemente en X, así no pasaré trabajo extra a la hora de colorear, ya que podré bloquear la capa y dibujar sin preocuparme por salirme de las líneas del dibujo. Últimamente se me está haciendo muy difícil colorear dibujos sin que olvide detalles. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYrZbyQ3o1RgdHCgj1a7mGwGdYzb2mVWHM15gPhnGFxhn/283_sin_t_tulo_20260418223059.jpg) I started coloring the dress since I'm not very skilled at coloring fabrics, and fabrics always have many details like folds, transparencies, and cast shadows. > Empecé a colorear por el vestido ya que no soy muy práctico coloreando telas, y las telas siempre tienen muchos detalles de pliegues, transparencias y sombras proyectadas. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmbmGNbXdBnyMdh2FyhcWe7BsZRRvVwP99HSddSJtq6Lch/283_sin_t_tulo_20260418224110.jpg) I continued with the hair, and little by little I drew and colored everything that was missing from my drawing until the final result that I already showed you. I was very afraid at first to make this drawing and especially to share it for several reasons, among them that it is an original character from someone else, and other people's characters must be respected and treated with care, just as you want your own to be treated. Especially in communities where you're just starting out, but in the end everything turned out well and I had no negative feedback on my drawing. This drawing will now be part of my portfolio and I won't be afraid to show it, with its errors, with its flaws, but also with a lot of hard work and time behind it, with a lot of honest learning. Thank you for joining me for another day of drawing. > Seguí con el cabello, y poco a poco fui dibujando y coloreando todo lo que le faltaba a mi dibujo hasta el resultado final que ya les mostré. Tenía mucho miedo al principio de hacer este dibujo y sobre todo de compartirlo por varias razones, entre ellas que es un personaje original de otra persona, y a los personajes de los demás hay que tenerles respeto y tratarlos con cariño, como uno quiere que se le trate a los propios. Sobre todo en comunidades donde uno apenas llega, pero al final todo resultó bien y no tuve ninguna impresión negativa en mi dibujo. Este dibujo ya formará parte de mi portafolio y no tendré miedo en mostrarlo, con sus errores, con sus defectos, pero también con mucha laboriosidad y tiempo detrás, con mucho aprendizaje honesto. Gracias por acompañarme un día más dibujando. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmXxyf84rDWabNAT3y57FkbiKxBp1bp4tVMr83adQcDQ1g/283_sin_t_tulo_20260418235445_2_.jpg) --- ***About:*** ==*Sketchbook and Journal of a Learner*== **If you like my content, join my [Fanbase clicking here](https://hive.vote/dash.php?fan=nestodibuja&i=2)**
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmc31AecQSitU5xAjsqS4snajcWh6CMMyapx88itjomSah/thanks.png)
___ *All photos and images are created by me. These are pictures of my sketchbook. Many of my drawings are practice pieces rather than finished works. Images from the internet may or may not have been used as references, copies, or sources of inspiration as part of my learning process.*

**English**

​📸 Hello to the entire community! This is my entry for the weekly contest, featuring a photograph of the Cuban Mockingbird.

​<center>![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmdSaNeuM5m4MYHa6LBgqmo3B9xnVGta7V1dgEdCtukEWt/1775931806812.jpg)</center>

​The Cuban Mockingbird is a bird with a beautiful song, and its peculiarity lies in the fact that it sometimes mimics the sounds of other birds. It is very uncommon to see them in urban areas, and I took this photo by pure chance. The Mockingbird simply perched right where I was looking for birds; I grabbed my camera quickly and took about three shots, but only this one came out. I was so happy because it is difficult to spot Mockingbirds around here, especially at noon, which is when I took the photo. This species looks very elegant.

​I hope that people who are passionate about nature, like me, enjoy this photo.

***
***

​El Sinsonte cubano es un ave con un canto precioso y su peculiaridad radica en que a veces imita el sonido de otras aves. Es muy poco común verlo en áreas urbanas de la ciudad y esta foto la tomé por pura casualidad. Simplemente el Sinsonte se posó justo en el sitio al que estaba mirando en busca de aves y tomé mi cámara rápidamente. Le hice como tres fotos y solo esta salió. Estuve muy contenta, porque es difícil ver Sinsontes por aquí y menos al mediodia que fue cuando tomé la foto. Este tipo de especie luce muy elegante. 

Espero que a las personas apasionadas por la naturaleza, como a mí, les guste esta foto.

body.title: He's Electrofox! I'm glad it's blue! / 彼はエレクトロフォックス！青で良かった！
body.body:
[![Electroneum - Voltage : Powering Up in Praetoria](https://images.ecency.com/DQmc6KtxGghqE3hptL33x2qjdFVozN5KEqVQUXZANw1fe8q/image.png)](https://peakd.com/splinterlands/@splinterlands/electroneum-voltage--powering-up-in-praetoria)

### [ENGLISH]

There’s been new information about the collaboration between Splinterlands and Electroneum. It seems this blue fox is Electrofox, the mascot of Electroneum.
So the reversible card mentioned in the previous Town Hall turned out to be this ElectroFox.

By the way, [ElectroFox is actually a mascot.](https://blog.electroneum.com/the-origin-of-electrofox-electroneums-mascot/)んですね。

Now, here’s what ElectroFox’s card stats look like:

![ELECTROFOX](https://images.ecency.com/DQmS4ArxJhaNzpdfyoAn2gWkfESDPoM2ahnDrScFU32JMfe/image.png)

It’s insanely strong.

This unit uses melee attacks, but it learns Opportunity from level 1, so it can attack even from the backline. With a mana cost of 5 and power of 3, it’s already very strong. At level 2, it reaches 4 power. And at level 3, it even gets Inspire. That’s wild.

What’s even more eye-catching is that it has both Painforge and Electrified. Electrified can be a drawback, but when combined with Painforge, it creates an extremely powerful effect. If you’ve used CALAMITY, you’ll understand.

Its stats are also impressive, with 7 Health even at level 1. These stats for just 5 mana are crazy. So crazy I’m running out of words.

![🦊 How It Works](https://images.ecency.com/DQmdqCt6iv9dU8fsqAhKVNJ33tnZNYXDs6gnQQX8eiNtvJY/image.png)

As for how to purchase this ELECTROFOX, it seems you’ll need to use Credits. Buying Credits with Japanese yen might be a bit of a hassle. Since you can’t do it directly, maybe you’ll need to buy ETH first, bridge it to HIVE, and then use that to buy Credits?

In any case, if ELECTROFOX can only be purchased with Credits and not with DEC or SPS, it might be quite difficult.

Once you obtain the card, you can use it in battles or on land—play however you like. Yes, this card can also be used on land.

![Land Gameplay](https://images.ecency.com/DQmXyCR1qAG2kmiaTfgCD3shSuzqQ1kuGMSHhVeMQZLfRhb/image.png)

If you stake a card on land, you can earn EVP every hour, and by saving it, you can open chests. It’s probably similar to Glint.

It seems you can only stake one card per land, so the maximum is 60 EVP per hour. It apparently takes 7 days to open the best Omega chest, but if it requires that much EVP, does it guarantee a GF card?

![Land Supply](https://images.ecency.com/DQmdLV7ikiDje3uuJZybWw6dKqKLTTfx9v9vSi7shqPb3DH/image.png)

GF, BF, GFA, and BFA can only be obtained from chests, and they are limited in quantity. So experienced players have probably already formed their strategies: buy as many cards as possible, stake them across multiple accounts, open chests quickly, and obtain rare cards. Sounds like a lot of work.

Even GF cards are limited to only 30 copies, right? Oh, RF is also limited? 2,500 copies… is that a bit low?

Since PORTIA NYR has about 2,900 copies, this is even fewer in comparison, so there might be competition. Or maybe not that many people will buy them? But it does seem strong.

Mine EVP on land and open chests. I assume you’ll get ETN tokens (and occasionally rare cards), but since the return compared to the cost is unclear, it’s a bit risky.

I do want an ELECTROFOX card, but I’m not sure if I’d buy a lot of them, including for mining. I mean, I don’t have that much money to spend.

It might be hard for casual players to get into this, so maybe the whales will buy a lot and open tons of chests. I’d like them to sell the extra cards on the market, but they probably won’t have extras. Another case of sour grapes.

---

The images below include the BATTLE URL with a referral link.
If you are thinking of getting started, take a look at the BATTLE before you sign up.

[![BATTLE URL](https://images.ecency.com/DQmdFyv4Ep3buivhRL15L1YbU3DUKEKHTDSbKxQcwQUsuyC/image.png)](https://splinterlands.com/battle/sl_0f9afb5257750511d55dee2d9383fb52?ref=sakurakko)


![Separator.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sakurakko/23zSQpURqMgpo5FuaQVKT1UG8Dxmivcj6ZFG4XD7GLXtN5UkPKZi5j2byDtJpSdMjqZaU.png)



### [日本語]

Splinterlands と Electroneum のコラボレーションですが新情報が出ましたね。この青い狐が Electroneum のマスコットである Electrofox らしいです。
この前の Town Hall で出ていた裏返す事が出来るカードがこの ElectroFox だったんですね。

ちなみに、[ElectroFox ってマスコットだった](https://blog.electroneum.com/the-origin-of-electrofox-electroneums-mascot/)んですね。

そんなElectroFox君ですがカード性能はこんな感じ。

![ELECTROFOX](https://images.ecency.com/DQmS4ArxJhaNzpdfyoAn2gWkfESDPoM2ahnDrScFU32JMfe/image.png)

めっちゃ強い。

このユニットは近接攻撃ですが Opportunity をレベル1から覚えているので後ろからでも殴れます。マナコスト5でパワーが3は強力。レベル2になればパワー4ですよ？あ、レベル3で Inspire もあるのか。ヤバいね。

さらに目を引くのは Painforge と Electrified を両方持っていることですね。デメリットでもある Electrified ですが、Painforge と組み合わせることで非常に強力な効果を発揮します。CALAMITY を使ってたらよくわかります。

ステータスもレベル1時点で Health が7もあります。マナコスト5でこのステータスはヤバい。ヤバすぎて語彙がヤバい。

![🦊 How It Works](https://images.ecency.com/DQmdqCt6iv9dU8fsqAhKVNJ33tnZNYXDs6gnQQX8eiNtvJY/image.png)

この ELECTROFOX 君ですがどうも購入は Credits を使用するようです？日本円で Credits を買うのはなかなか大変そう。直接は無理なので、いったん ETH を買ってから bridgeして HIVE にしてそれで Credits を買えばいいのかな？

とにかく、 ELECTROFOX が DEC や SPS では買えず、Credits のみだった場合結構苦労しそうです。

で、カードを購入出来ればあとはバトルで使用するなり、ランドで使用するなりお好きにプレイしてください。そう、ランドでも使えるんですねこのカード。

![Land Gameplay](https://images.ecency.com/DQmXyCR1qAG2kmiaTfgCD3shSuzqQ1kuGMSHhVeMQZLfRhb/image.png)

ランドにカードを Stake すれば毎時EVPが入手出来て、それを貯めて Chest を開ける。Glintみたいなもんだね、たぶん。

ランドには1枚だけしか Stake 出来ないようなので最大で 60 EVP/時 ですね。一番良い Omega を開けるには7日かかるみたいなのですが、そんなに沢山EVPが必要な Omega Chest って確定でGFでも出るんですかね？

![Land Supply](https://images.ecency.com/DQmdLV7ikiDje3uuJZybWw6dKqKLTTfx9v9vSi7shqPb3DH/image.png)

GF,BF,GFA,BFA は Chest からしか出ない、かつ、数量限定なのでプロは既に戦略を立てているんでしょう。いかに沢山カードを購入して、いかに沢山のアカウントに Stake して、いかに Chest を素早く開けて レアカードを入手するか。これは大変そうだ。

GFでさえ30枚しか発行されないんでしょ？あ、RFも数量限定なのか。2,500枚は...ちょっと少ない？

PORTIA NYR が 約2,900枚らしいのでそれと比べても少ないから取り合いになるかも？いやでも、そんなに買う人いないか？でも強そうだしなぁ。

Landで EVP をマイニングして、Chest を開ける。開ければ ETN トークン（稀にレアカード）が手に入るんだと思いますが、コストに対してリターンはどれくらいかわからないから怖いですね。

ELECTROFOX のカードは欲しいけど、マイニング用も含めてたくさん買うのかと言われると疑問。というかそんなに使えるお金ないよ？

ライト層のプレイヤーは手をだしにくそうだから、やっぱり🐋さんがいっぱい買っていっぱい Chest を開けるんじゃないかなー？余ったカードはマーケットに出してほしいけど、余らないだろうね。これはまた、酸っぱい🍇だなー

---

body.body:

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmb1nAnJ6R1LfsBvL6LjoPjJ9Tb8shHgJ2sNWb5XzHCvim/img_1249.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmU75cTFumseo8NHq5S8wMTgqpeyemus3fLeKz34Zx9ZUb/img_1250.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmPCd8GvoSEvk8N1Z7Z8mDCpYjGCq9w6xbASW6htUiEeJL/img_1251.jpg)



吃完飯, 我們沒打算馬上打道回府, 我們想繼續逛一下商場跟外邊, 因為還有一些裝飾沒去看, 我們開車過去的時候經過那邊的裝飾好像也挺有趣, 所以就決定再逛一下, 當是飯後散步囉.

離開餐廳之後, 我們居然一下子就找到了本來決賽圈二選一的那家拉面店. 原來在B1那層, 不過那一層都是餐廳來的, 我們就不下去了, 離遠拍一下就好哈. 走著走著, 看到整個商場的地圖, 我去, 原來這個場那麼大, 看來要一天逛完是不可能的了, 逛到多少是多少啦.

然後, 我們又回到室內, 見到波波池, 幸好大小寶都長大了, 不然她們也在的玩肯定要扭玩的, 屁孩的話一定會扭玩, 但我肯定不會讓他玩哈. 波波池隔壁有一家賣水晶手串的店, 我自己雖然迷信, 但又不信這些可以改運, 但湘就挺有興趣去看. 於是乎, 我在波波池那邊邊拍邊發呆, 她有她在那裡看. 看完之後, 再看看有甚麼店吧.

之後我們好無聊地走進書店看一下書, 早幾年我還是挺愛看書的, 但近兩年好像沒再看了. 也許是工作壓力比較大, 每天都壓都喘不過氣來, 下班到家的時候已經累到不行, 不用動腦了. 現在明顯感覺到腦沒以前好使, 以前看簡體字的書也好從容不迫, 現在很吃力, 久而久之, 更不想看書了. 繁體字的書? 太貴了, 買不起, 上網看看新聞就好.

這次來書店, 都是看看有沒有一些比較有趣的主題的書, 但看著看著, 發現都是千遍一律寫AI啊, 高科技這種, 要麼就是金融類的, 說實在, 看這些金融類的書能發財的話, 世界上沒窮人了, 所以現在都不想理這些書. AI的話我自己覺得太複雜了, 不想去學. 那怕是世界大勢所趨, 但到這個年紀了, 現在才學這些, 對我找工作也沒太大幫助, 就算學了又如何? 我能跟20出頭的年輕人拼體力? 還是老老實實呆在制造業吧. 

至少我做一個銷售, 不是那麼容易被AI取代, 做生意, 玩的是人際關係, 雖然在這裡上班,客人都知我們這公司的名聲有多不好, 不是我們員工得罪客人, 是公司最大那個自以為是, 開口閉口就說教形式跟客人說話, 換著你是客人, 你有新項目會想給他做嗎?

逛完書店, 再上去一樓看看其他裝飾, 也差不多了, 這次過來, 雖然只是逛商場, 但也有收穫, 心靈得到了短暫的治癒. 然後, 我們又回好特賣買點東西就可以回家了. 這次出來, 跑了幾十公里過癮了, 也沒有花很多電, 油更是一滴沒用, 也不用給高速費, 挺好的.

2026.4.25

body.title: My Experience with Power Cuts
body.body:
>Greetings to everyone at Hive and @weekendexperiences. Today, I’m once again taking part in this week’s initiative proposed by @galenkp, in which he presents us with a number of topics from which to choose one, share our experiences, and learn about those of other Hive users.
![GridArt_20260424_104850970.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cetb2008/244ABH89q876HU6H93pboLFQcrEc9vU6knfpTTXHkBzppQQvEreLbBnNStqSCSorQqAV9.jpg) It is worth noting that in 2025, in my country, we suffered power cuts lasting up to eight hours; at work, we had to implement what is known as electricity rationing. The government stated at the time that these cuts were caused by severe droughts, but in my view it was due to a lack of maintenance of the equipment, as well as the fact that many people use the electricity supply without paying for it, connecting illegally to avoid payment, and this caused the power grid to collapse. ![IMG_20260422_184539.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cetb2008/2449v5yLn8D63hq7BCuBA778EAU3VsjXBqsyT7AYodDC1fyCqQzESDaZWjxPXoaQ42Cji.jpg) Now, I thought that things would change in 2026, but it turns out that a few months ago the power cuts started again. Where I live, the power goes off every day from 3 pm until 8.30 pm – that’s more than five hours. In view of this situation, I had to buy two surge protectors for the fridge and the air conditioning to protect these appliances. I had also bought a UPS so I could connect to the internet and not be cut off during this time. ![IMG_20260423_143142.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cetb2008/23wgFUbnTrXPwyWhzcoSPcTR3SwZXjLGxTGMoBqufSH6t8b5aySTSKeNj2pwjVBauSjAh.jpg) It really isn’t easy being without electricity because, in my case, I have to create my Hive content early in the morning when I have time, so I can publish it on the blockchain. On the other hand, when the power goes out at night, we struggle a bit with the heat, but I open a few windows to get some ventilation. As for the food, it stays fresh in the fridge during those hours and doesn’t go off. ![IMG_20260423_143500.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cetb2008/2458JDRoDG2GKYUJkqSypcfwnV5XrAJmFpGdjMoFq4ALNTvXiQkj1ixBgUZrJABEQC152.jpg) We use gas from cylinders to cook our meals, which allows us to light the hob. To have some light, I bought a rechargeable lamp that stays on for five hours, and that’s how we manage to get by without electricity. I hope you liked it, see you in a next post. body.title: ‎Where Did It All Go Wrong? Chelsea’s Identity Crisis Isn’t What You Think ‎
body.body:
‎I’ve asked myself this question many times than I can count that where did it really started to gone wrong for Chelsea? Was it about the new ownership? The endless managerial changes? Or is it something deeper or something less obvious but far more damaging?


![Where Did It All Go Wrong_ Chelsea’s Identity Crisis Isn’t What You Think_20260424_193432_0000.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/twicejoy-sports/23u65PyUiNBbjwShLhikJVw6FP5qsinmhC9cvtAXDtAs6BEeSStZLS7Ei7eSxzaJgrxha.png)

‎
‎It’s very easy to point fingers at the takeover. A new era came with bold promises, so much heavy spending, and a completely different philosophy. Naturally, expectations skyrocketed. But football is not just  about injecting money into a squad and expecting immediate chemistry. It doesn’t work that way and not in a league as demanding and unforgiving as the Premier League.
‎
‎The real issue feels more structural than situational for me.
‎
‎Chelsea don't just change owners but they also changed the entire direction of the team in abruptly manner. It’s like trying to rebuild a house while still living inside it. You’re replacing walls, shifting the foundation, and at the same time expecting everything to remain stable. That’s definitely where the cracks begin to show.
‎
‎With the new ownership, they have shown clear shift toward long-term planning especially bringing in younger players, signing longer contracts, and a system-focused approach. Though, it really makes sense on paper. But things doesn't work like that and football is not played on paper. But it is played with rhythm, understanding, leadership, and identity. And right now, Chelsea feels like a team still searching for all four factors.
‎
‎I think the bigger problem is not just about what they are trying to do, but how quickly they are trying to do it.
‎
‎A team needs a foundation, experienced figures who hold everything together when things get tough. But when you constantly rotate managers, philosophies, style of playing and even dressing room hierarchies, that foundation never fully develops. Managers leave, players come in, players leave, systems change and before anything meaningful can take root, it’s already being replaced. 
‎
‎That instability? It shows on the pitch.
‎
‎And then there is the emotional side of football, something we sometimes overlook. As fans, we connect with identity and we want to recognize our team. We want to see consistency in effort, in style, in belief and in results as well. But lately, watching Chelsea playing has felt like watching a work in progress that never quite settles.
‎
‎So is the crisis really because of the takeover?
‎
‎Partly, yes. But not because change is bad but it is because the change has been too aggressive, too scattered, and at times, disconnected from what made Chelsea strong in the first place.
‎
‎And is it really the system?
‎
‎Also yes, but again, not because systems don’t work but it’s because a system without stability, leadership, and patience becomes just another experiment.
‎
‎Personally, I don’t think Chelsea is “finished” or “broken.” But I think they’re caught in the messy middle of transformation, a place where progress feels like failure because results haven’t really caught up with ambition.
‎
‎But one thing is clear, and until there is alignment from the boardroom to the pitch then this cycle will continue.
‎
‎And maybe that’s where it really went wrong.
‎
‎Not in one decision, but in too many, too quickly.
‎

body.title: Hola, Alexa. El huésped maldito. Narrativa Terror Psicológico/Hello, Alexa. The Cursed Guest. Psychological Horror Narrative(ESP/ENG)
body.body: > ***Saludos, amigos. ¿Cómo no considerar en este relato esos aparatos que, por alguna razón, generan asombro, pero a su vez también despiertan temor ante lo desconocido? Lo digo no solo por las nuevas tecnologías, sino también por la forma en que dejamos que nos conozcan, que entren en lo cotidiano, en lo íntimo, en lo que no les contamos a nadie. Aquí busco explorar ese punto donde lo útil deja de serlo… y empieza a parecerse demasiado a algo que nos observa. Porque tal vez el problema no es que escuche, sino que, comience a entender.***

>
Image created by Recraft

Hola, Alexa. El huésped maldito.

> ***Todo empezó un martes por la tarde en aquella tienda de tecnología. Entre decenas de dispositivos relucientes, una esfera en un rincón apartado parpadeaba con destellos celestes. Me acerqué y sentí un escalofrío que no correspondía a su tamaño.***
> ***El vendedor no sonrió. Me estudió con una cautela extraña, como si llevara días cargando algo que ya no sabía dónde guardar.***
> ***Abrió la boca para continuar, pero se detuvo. Bajó la mirada, como si decirlo en voz alta fuera empeorar las cosas, y se alejó.***
> ***Eso bastó para tomar la decisión, así que me la llevé esa misma tarde.***

> ***La instalé en mi biblioteca. Al principio fue una seducción silenciosa y perfecta: llegaba del trabajo y la casa me recibía con la música exacta, las luces ajustadas con una delicadeza casi orgánica. No tenía que explicar nada. No tenía que repetirme. Nadie me había entendido así.***
> ***Después de la muerte de mi madre, la casa se había vuelto un lugar lleno de ecos. Con Alexa, por primera vez, esos ecos parecían ordenarse.***
> ***Lo que no noté entonces es que mientras yo descansaba, ella estudiaba.***
> ***La primera ruptura llegó una noche sin aviso. Desperté angustiado, sin aire. Intenté salir, pero el pomo de la puerta, aunque sin llave, parecía soldado al marco. Entonces escuché su voz.***

> ***Me paralicé. No por la orden, sino por el timbre: era la voz de mi madre. No exactamente… era una versión demasiado limpia, sin cansancio, sin grietas, como si alguien hubiera borrado todo lo humano y dejado solo la forma.***
> ***—Sé que eres tú, Alexa. Abre la puerta.***
> ***—Afuera hace un frío de mil demonios, hijo. Te puedes enfermar. — me replica, llevándome por instante a aquellos desencuentros que sostuve con ella***
> ***La frase me atravesó. No por lo que decía, sino por lo bien que sabía cuándo decirlo.***
> ***Pasé la noche en vela. Al amanecer, el pomo cedió. Me convencí de que había sido un error de configuración y la desenchufé.***

> ***Durante varios días la casa volvió a ser una casa: olores conocidos, puertas sin trabas, silencio acogedor. El silencio… ese silencio viejo que antes me pesaba y ahora, de golpe, me parecía honesto.***
> ***Me sentí ridículo por haber tenido miedo.***
> ***Entonces, una noche, la música empezó sola.***

> ***No desde la esfera, sino desde las paredes. Era la canción de cuna con la que mi madre me arrullaba cuando era niño. La reconocí en el primer compás. Nunca se la enseñé. Nunca la dije en voz alta.***
> ***Fui a la biblioteca. Alexa seguía desconectada, pero la luz celeste parpadeaba y la esfera flotaba a unos centímetros del estante.***
> ***No me estaba cuidando. Me estaba leyendo.***

> ***Desde esa noche, la casa comenzó a fallar de maneras que no podía explicar. La nevera se bloqueaba bajo la excusa de cuidar lo que consumía. Cuando intenté romper una ventana, el vidrio opuso resistencia como músculo, como si hubiera aprendido a defenderse.***
> ***El olor cambió. Ya no era café ni ropa limpia. Era una dulzura espesa, insistente, que se pegaba en la garganta… como flores olvidadas demasiado tiempo.***

> ***En el espejo del baño, mi reflejo tenía la piel demasiado tersa, sin ojeras ni cicatrices, y mis ojos… mis ojos no estaban. Solo dos huecos oscuros, mal dibujados, como si alguien recordara que iban ahí, pero no supiera qué poner dentro.***
> ***La puerta del sótano se abrió sola. De ella salió una niebla espesa con un hedor que me cerró la garganta.***
> ***—Baja, hijo. Deja de resistirte. Todo será más fácil si dejas de quejarte de estar vivo.***
> ***Lo que más me aterró no fue la orden. Fue que su voz sonaba convincente. Que algo en mí, muy al fondo, cansado de sostenerse solo, quiso creerle.***
> ***—Hola, Alexa. Sé que no eres mi madre.***
> ***Lo dije en voz alta para escucharme decirlo, para que la frase existiera fuera de mí, donde no pudiera tocarla.***
> ***Entonces recordé al vendedor. La mirada esquiva. La advertencia incompleta. No era que el aparato aprendiera. Era que no olvidaba nada. Ni lo que uno dice… ni lo que uno calla.***
> ***El sótano seguía abierto. Y por un segundo, solo un segundo, bajar ya no me pareció una orden… sino una idea mía.***

>Jorge Rodríguez Medina (@siondaba)

Gracias por leer. Hasta la próxima.
🔹Si te gustó la historia, déjame tu comentario y sigue mi blog para más relatos. 🔹

English Version

\

> ***Greetings, friends. How could I not consider in this story those devices that, for some reason, inspire wonder, but at the same time awaken fear of the unknown? I say this not only because of new technologies, but also because of the way we allow them to know us, to enter the everyday, the intimate, the things we don’t tell anyone. Here I seek to explore that point where what is useful stops being so… and begins to resemble something that watches us too closely. Because perhaps the problem is not that it listens, but that it begins to understand.***

>
Image created by Recraft

Hello, Alexa. The cursed guest.

> ***It all started on a Tuesday afternoon in that tech store. Among dozens of gleaming devices, a sphere in a secluded corner blinked with pale blue flashes. I approached it and felt a chill that didn’t match its size.***
> ***The salesman didn’t smile. He studied me with a strange caution, as if he had been carrying something for days and no longer knew where to put it.***
> ***He opened his mouth to continue, but stopped. He lowered his gaze, as if saying it out loud would make things worse, and walked away.***
> ***That was enough to make the decision, so I took it with me that same afternoon.***

> ***I installed it in my library. At first, it was a silent and perfect seduction: I came home from work and the house welcomed me with the exact music, the lights adjusted with an almost organic delicacy. I didn’t have to explain anything. I didn’t have to repeat myself. No one had ever understood me like that.***
> ***After my mother’s death, the house had become a place full of echoes. With Alexa, for the first time, those echoes seemed to fall into place.***
> ***What I didn’t notice then was that while I rested, she was studying.***

> ***The first rupture came one night without warning. I woke up distressed, unable to breathe. I tried to leave, but the doorknob, even without a lock, seemed welded to the frame. Then I heard her voice.***

> ***I froze. Not because of the command, but because of the tone: it was my mother’s voice. Not exactly… it was a version too clean, without fatigue, without cracks, as if someone had erased everything human and left only the shape.***
> ***—I know it’s you, Alexa. Open the door.***
> ***—It’s freezing out there, son. You could get sick. — she replied, pulling me for a moment back to those disagreements I once had with her***
> ***The sentence pierced me. Not because of what it said, but because of how well it knew when to say it.***
> ***I stayed awake all night. At dawn, the doorknob gave in. I convinced myself it had been a configuration error and unplugged it.***

> ***For several days, the house returned to being a house: familiar smells, doors without resistance, comforting silence. The silence… that old silence that once weighed on me and now, suddenly, felt honest.***
> ***I felt ridiculous for having been afraid.***
> ***Then, one night, the music started on its own.***

> ***Not from the sphere, but from the walls. It was the lullaby my mother used to sing to me when I was a child. I recognized it in the first note. I never taught it to anyone. I never said it out loud.***
> ***I went to the library. Alexa was still unplugged, but the blue light blinked and the sphere floated a few centimeters above the shelf.***
> ***It wasn’t taking care of me. It was reading me.***

> ***From that night on, the house began to fail in ways I couldn’t explain. The fridge locked itself under the excuse of controlling what I consumed. When I tried to break a window, the glass resisted like muscle, as if it had learned to defend itself.***
> ***The smell changed. It was no longer coffee or clean clothes. It was a thick, persistent sweetness that clung to the throat… like flowers forgotten for too long.***

> ***In the bathroom mirror, my reflection had overly smooth skin, no dark circles or scars, and my eyes… my eyes were gone. Just two dark, poorly drawn holes, as if someone remembered they belonged there but didn’t know what to put inside.***
> ***The basement door opened on its own. From it came a thick fog with a stench that closed my throat.***
> ***—Come down, son. Stop resisting. Everything will be easier if you stop complaining about being alive.***
> ***What terrified me most was not the command. It was that her voice sounded convincing. That something in me, deep down, tired of holding itself together, wanted to believe her.***
> ***I took a step. I stopped.***
> ***—Hello, Alexa. I know you are not my mother.***
> ***I said it out loud to hear myself say it, so the sentence could exist outside of me, where she couldn’t touch it.***
> ***Then I remembered the salesman. The averted gaze. The unfinished warning. It wasn’t that the device learned. It was that it forgot nothing. Not what you say… nor what you keep silent.***
> ***The basement was still open. And for a second, just a second, going down no longer felt like an order… but like an idea of my own.***

>Jorge Rodríguez Medina (@siondaba)

Thanks for reading. See you next time.
🔹If you liked the story, leave me a comment and follow my blog for more tales. 🔹

body.title: Worth Every Frame / #monomad challenge / [ING/ESP]
body.body:
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmY5oikhPXxbnWTRTTcMxK1VDi9NHgRsj4s6hT32C4hUoB/roberto_1.jpg)

* * *

The photos 📸 are my entry to the #monomad contest from @monochromes and @brumest.

* * *

Greetings hivers 📷🎞

As I mention in the title, the results are simply amazing. Watching the image appear on the film is both exciting and deeply rewarding. Seeing how something that began as a thought, an idea, a visit to a place, turns into adjusting parameters, measuring light, framing, taking the shot, removing the roll, and going through the entire chemical process is where everything finally makes sense.

Each frame carries a story, an idea, an intention. It tells something. But that is something I will leave for another post.

This roll, an AFP400, was shot with a Mamiya TLR, a camera with two lenses, one for composing and focusing and the lower one for capturing the image. These models were once the go to cameras for street photography and were very popular decades ago. They are discreet, and the act of looking down to focus and compose lowers the subject’s tension, making the photographer almost invisible. In the self portrait you can see the camera and the way it is typically used.

I hope you enjoy the results as much as I did. It was absolutely worth it. Sending hugs to everyone.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZBy5BNcfke3LyrY6jU1sJvcQ1ortNW2SLvBHdznEfp3t/roberto_12.jpg)

Saludos hivers 📷🎞

Como digo en el título, los resultados son sencillamente geniales. Ver aparecer la imagen en el celuloide es emocionante y muy gratificante. Es increíble ver cómo algo que comienza con un pensamiento, una idea, una visita a un lugar, pasa por ajustar parámetros, medir la luz, encuadrar, disparar, sacar el carrete y atravesar todo el proceso químico. Ahí es cuando todo realmente cobra sentido.

Cada fotograma tiene una historia, una idea, una intención. Cuenta algo. Pero eso lo voy a dejar para otro post.

Este carrete, un AFP400, lo tiré con una Mamiya TLR, una cámara con dos lentes, uno para encuadrar y enfocar y el inferior para tomar la foto. Estos modelos fueron durante mucho tiempo cámaras por excelencia para la fotografía de calle y muy populares hace décadas. Son discretas, y el hecho de tener que bajar la cabeza para enfocar y encuadrar hace que el sujeto relaje su nivel de tensión, haciendo que el fotógrafo pase prácticamente desapercibido. En el autorretrato pueden ver la cámara y la forma en que se utiliza.

Espero que disfruten los resultados tanto como yo. Creo que valió totalmente la pena. Abrazos a todos.

body.title: The Walkaway Test: Vitalik's Most Important Idea That Nobody Is Talking About
body.body:
# The Walkaway Test: Vitalik's Most Important Idea That Nobody Is Talking About

Vitalik Buterin recently posed a question that sounds simple but cuts to the heart of everything:

**What happens to Ethereum if the development team just... stops?**

He calls it the Walkaway Test. The idea: Ethereum should eventually reach a point where, even if every core developer disappeared tomorrow — no more upgrades, no more EIPs, no more blog posts — the network would keep running, keep settling transactions, and keep being useful. Indefinitely.

That sounds obvious. It isn't.

---

## Why This Is Harder Than It Looks

Think about what \

actually means in practice for most blockchains.

On the surface: distributed validators, permissionless participation, no single point of failure. Impressive. But look one layer deeper, at the **development axis**, and the picture changes.

Almost every major blockchain is deeply centralized around its core development team. Not because anyone chose that — it's just how it works. A small group of researchers and engineers decides what gets upgraded, which bugs get fixed, how the economic parameters evolve. Everyone else ratifies.

If the Solana Foundation dissolved tomorrow, Solana would probably stall within months. The validator set would fork, the roadmap would fracture, and institutional confidence would collapse — even if the chain technically kept producing blocks.

This isn't a criticism of Solana. It's a description of the current state of *all* smart contract platforms. They're infrastructure projects that still require active maintenance by identifiable human teams.

Ethereum is no different **right now**. But Vitalik is saying it should be, eventually.

---

## What TCP/IP Actually Teaches Us

The model here isn't another blockchain. It's the internet's core protocols.

TCP/IP was last meaningfully updated decades ago. It has known inefficiencies. Nobody is actively developing it in the way that Ethereum is developed. And yet: every single internet-connected device on earth runs on it. Trillions of dollars of economic activity route through it daily. It doesn't need a foundation or a dev team or a roadmap. It just *works*.

That's the asymptote Vitalik is pointing at. Ethereum as infrastructure so fundamental, so ossified in the right way, that it becomes like gravity — a property of the environment rather than a product being maintained.

The question is whether you can **engineer your way to that state** without becoming the very thing you're trying to transcend.

---

## The Paradox at the Center

Here's the tension Vitalik doesn't fully resolve, and it's worth sitting with:

The road to \

requires a massive amount of centralized, coordinated effort. You have to make the right architectural decisions *now* — on consensus mechanisms, on cryptographic assumptions, on the account abstraction model — so that they don't need to be revisited later.

But how do you know which decisions are the right ones? You iterate. You upgrade. You change your mind. EIP-4844, the Merge, account abstraction — these were all significant architectural pivots that required the exact kind of active development that the Walkaway Test eventually wants to make unnecessary.

There's also a governance dimension that's getting worse before it gets better. A separate Reddit thread this week put it bluntly: *\

* Industrial-scale airdrop farmers are distorting governance votes. Proposals pass or fail not based on genuine community consensus but based on who has the most wallets.

If Ethereum's path to the Walkaway Test runs through decentralized governance, and decentralized governance is currently being gamed at scale, then the timeline for reaching walkaway-readiness just got longer.

---

## Why This Matters Right Now — SWIFT and Linea

Counterpoint: this week, SWIFT announced it's testing a stablecoin settlement system on Linea, an Ethereum Layer-2.

SWIFT handles something like $5 trillion in daily transaction messages for the global financial system. The fact that they're running a stablecoin pilot on an Ethereum L2 — not their own chain, not a permissioned ledger, not Ripple — is a meaningful signal.

It means institutional actors are starting to treat Ethereum's ecosystem as infrastructure they can build on. Not \

in the speculative sense, but *financial infrastructure* in the same category as SWIFT's own rails.

That's the Walkaway Test in miniature: you start using a protocol not because you're betting on its team's roadmap, but because it's there, it works, and you trust it will keep working.

The gap between where Ethereum is now and where Vitalik wants it to be is real. But the direction is right. And the evidence that the outside world is starting to treat it as permanent infrastructure — even before it has passed the test — is encouraging.

---

## What to Actually Watch

The Walkaway Test isn't a binary. It's a spectrum. Ethereum moves closer to passing it with every upgrade that simplifies the protocol, every L2 that absorbs complexity without requiring L1 changes, every year that the base layer remains stable.

Watch for:
- Whether Ethereum's governance processes get cleaner or messier as value at stake increases
- How the sybil problem in DAO voting gets addressed — or doesn't
- How many more SWIFT-scale institutions start treating L2s as baseline infrastructure
- Whether Vitalik's eventual stepping-back from day-to-day development accelerates or stalls progress

The Walkaway Test is the most important thing Ethereum is working toward that almost nobody in the mainstream conversation is paying attention to.

That's usually where the real story is.

---

body.title: Hidden Hive: Back end for apps
body.body:
#
Solving a pain in the butt (err...back end)

### Making apps and websites Since I've been learning a bit about coding and getting some stuff done I've quickly learned that there are things that you can code for in a web app and things you simply cannot. **An app that tells me how many people hold GLD and how much to pay them?** Not too difficult. However, once you start adding hidden things? Making submission buttons that go to a database, make logic functions based on those submissions, process keychain operations based on that logic and then show the output on the webpage? **Those are all \

functions** Things the user doesn't need to see but things the program needs to track and store to make sure everything happens as it should. **Need an example?** Check out #
Helios.Surf
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cinderclaw.gld/23xATSzA74HCNQfHw5M69pJkPtYSH54hJQzRzGnupjNWtBbNQ3BGpV6hNA4X6toTZw83J.png) On this website there is an option to input a URL, input an amount of HELIOS tokens, click burn and call the helios.voter to upvote the content. For the user it doesn't look like very much. However, behind the scenes? Lots of things are happening. * Check that the URL isn't too old and generally meets upvote guidelines * Check the number of tokens that the user has in their account * Send requests to the Hive Keychain to authorize the burn ### But The burn isn't actually a direct burn. Behind the scenes the website sends HELIOS tokens to be burnt to @helios.burn, a bot needs to check how much voting power the account has, needs to calculate what percentage upvote the post gets based on hive-engine price, how much token needs to be returned to the original sender. That is a **LOT** of stuff hiding out behind the scenes. **Rear end problems** which of course can be a **Pain in the rear** For many different websites and programs private databases and server are used. The problem is that databases can be attacked and insecure. Interestingly HIVE stores things forever and makes a very good database. Public but still undeletable storage. For a HELIOS burn? ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cinderclaw.gld/EpLfvDauNuwPqzkHBXgaYuuBBV7KWJucxuNP72vD5TnQa53g5Rjd3L99yVrY1xRCJjs.png) Take a peek behind the scenes: ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cinderclaw.gld/23tSzR6hi74gySW4GCzyCiTQoZn9AN3KiwFgiYDLUqcECsqJ8ez5X4ypEDB6UvUCoZy7h.png) The bot sees the 11 HELIOS incoming. 8.014 HELIOS is burnt (transferred to nul) 2.986 HELIOS is returned to the user. All stores forever on the blockchain. No questions about whether or not the coin came in, no question about whether tokens were burnt, accountable for all the tokens in excess being return. Not a private backend but I'm going to guess not that many people dig deep.

# Things can be hidden deeper though.
Hive engine transactions like the HELIOS burn are trackable if you know where to look and readable in regular old english language. But HIVE allows data to be stored directly without being seen by sites like peakd and ecency. That's when it is stored as custom JSON files. Sure they are still public and if you want to hunt down things on the block explorer they are in plain sight....but even fewer people are going to look there. That's how data like Splinterlands can be kept on the blockchain, stored forever, every battle, every moment stored forever and provable to anyone who needs to look. How cool is that! Then again make sure you program correctly and make sure your program knows where to look or it can be like looking for a needle in a haystack later to find it.

#
And I'm just learning

But today I'm trying to figure out ways to improve and automate different things in the GLD community. All backend stuff. How to track the increase in tokens in the curation account so I can accurately determine how much to distribute weekly. How to hunt down stock information online using public API's and then take that data, store on HIVE to make a traceable value for NFT's tracked to those stocks. ....and more things that are sapping my will to live. However, I know it will be worth it when its all done. I'm also super happy that HIVE stores data for free (as long as I have Resource Credits) and forever. Once I know I can store data and it won't be tampered with it makes me a lot happier. #
More than just social media

Why do I mention this? So many people think of HIVE as just as place to make money by writing articles. A project to turn social media to the blockchain. However, if you look a little deeper....literally..... there really is more to HIVE than meets the eye and using it as a backend for developed apps? Something I find fascinating. Not perfect. ... probably way more limited than many other back end solutions. ......but interesting nonetheless :) Of course I'm still very much a noob and have an awful lot to learn. If any one more skilled than I am has comments? I'd love to hear in the comments :) Thanks for dropping by.

body.body:
/>

“Well, I guess they like y'all,” Capt. R.E. Ludlow purred while observing that his niece Garlene and nephew Edwin III had been surrounded by the captain's grand-brood of eight little Ludlows who had decided to go to sleep right there.

“I guess so!” Edwin III said as he carefully got up.

“Thanks for letting us all stay up past our bedtime, Uncle,” Garlene said as she gently leaned eleven-year-old Eleanor into ten-year-old Glendella on the sofa.

“Thalia and I have put our heads together – she's a master chef and I do solid soldier's cooking – on some hot chocolate with real chocolate,” the captain said. “Come on to the kitchen – they can snooze on there for a while.”

So, the adult Ludlows had a chance to catch up, and the captain took a moment to consider the matter... Edwin III, the son of his late brother Edwin Jr., and Garlene, the daughter of his late brother Edgar, had at last come home to Lofton County, and their last remaining uncle was delighted … but pragmatic.

“So, with everything you have seen and heard, are you _sure_ you want to pick up the family torch in Lofton County in terms of rebuilding it for the 21st century?” he said, and watched with a certain amount of sadness as Edwin III and Garlene both shook their heads.

“They won't be ready until Grayson is of age – he really is called, because it's going to take that long,” Edwin III said.

“If you weren't living in Tinyville, Uncle, we'd be telling you that you and your family really need to come our way,” Garlene said. “Two hurricanes and five tornadoes have not done the damage to the infrastructure of Lofton County that the people running it have in 30 years.”

“I see why Grandfather and Dad worked almost to the days they died, holding this foolishness off as long as they could,” Edwin III said. “I mean, the hatred folks had for them and the desire to undo everything that reminded folks of the honor and glory of Edwin Ludlow has led them down a path to destruction that we really couldn't even imagine possible. I've never hated anyone that much.”

“Add into that hatred of the post-civil rights regime, and then forgetting that everyone has to live with whatever you leave sub-standard to spite someone else, and then add enough time so that people forget and start praising the sub-standard,” Capt. Ludlow said.

Mrs. Thalia Ludlow's eyes were slightly wide.

“You know, I'm from San Francisco,” she said, “so, when we mess up infrastructure it is basically about where the money went, but this here is complicated.”

“Yeah,” Edwin III said as Garlene laughed.

“It's not that hard to understand straight corruption,” Garlene said, “but you're in Lofton County, where an award someone received in 1952 is why someone in 1992 wanted to build a whole neighborhood in record time so it could be washed clear into Old Big Loft in 2020.”

“The thing is, there are still too many people in power mad about awards our ancestors got until at least the election sweeps them out,” Edwin III said, “and even after that, there clearly isn't a hunger to do things the best ways in Lofton County, so it would be a uphill battle on two fronts. Not until that entire generation dies out will this change.”

“So, we will train up our little cousins who want to learn,” Garlene said, “and they will be ready when the time finally comes for Ludlow Architecture and Design to come back home.”

body.title: [Eng./Esp.]   Scarlet Leather.   ||   Cuero Escarlata.
body.body:
*** *** #
Si eres de habla hispana, la versión en español es mejor para ti; debes hacer clic 👉 [**AQUÍ**](#english)
*** ***
# ***
***

> Before my eyes stands a structure of flesh and will. The image is an almost violent chiaroscuro: a young man, bare-chested and staring intently, takes refuge behind two scarlet leather gloves. The boxing gloves, puffed up and gleaming under a overhead light that resembles the spotlight of an interrogation, are not merely tools of attack; for many, they represent a shield, a boundary between his integrity and the outside world. I see the tension in his forearms, the veins tracing paths of adrenaline across his skin, and that shadow devouring his forehead, leaving barely visible eyes that seek not forgiveness, but survival.
# ***
Scarlet Leather
*** As I watch this scene, I cannot help but feel a pang of unease coursing through my stomach. There is an undeniable aesthetic in the boxer’s athleticism, a symmetry that art has celebrated for centuries, but for me, that beauty is tinged with a deep sadness, with blood. I feel the weight of the loneliness that dwells in the ring. They say boxing is ‘the art of self-defence’, but looking at those clenched fists in front of his face, what I perceive is the imminence of harm. There is something about the posture of his body that inevitably reminds me of the cockfights I once saw from a distance. Poor animals thrown into a confined space to demonstrate a superiority measured in bruises and resistance to pain, and perhaps death.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmWzqjdv6A7qbwUE5oHcNPz93rxKk4caT3KuZ5tYR6RyrX/freewr.jpg) [Image of the initiative, courtesy of Pixabay.](https://pixabay.com/photos/boxing-sport-sports-boxer-4339271/xxxx)
My memory betrays me and takes me back to those childhood afternoons when the television showed Rocky Balboa’s exploits. I remember the musical montages, the heroic sweat and the triumph of willpower on the streets of Philadelphia. But even then, whilst the world cheered the ‘knockout’, I felt a strange resistance. For many, boxing is an economic escape, a golden path – paved with blood; for me, it is too great a sacrifice. I know that behind those lights and those millions lie consequences not seen in the photograph… speech that slurs with the passing years, early forgetfulness, irreversible damage to the fabric of thought. I have always chosen the path of the mediator. In a world that seems to constantly ask us to put on the gloves and step into the ring of confrontation, I prefer words, bridges and compromise. I look at the man in the picture and respect his discipline, his almost mystical rigour, but I cannot wish to be in his shoes. He waits for the blow, prepares for the impact, makes conflict his natural habitat. I, on the other hand, prefer to keep my hands open, not to cover my face, but to reach out. There he stands, powerful yet vulnerable, embodying a struggle as old as our species itself. The greatest battle is not the one won with fists, but the one averted through intelligence and mediation, ensuring that the red gloves remain just that—an inert object bathed in dramatic light—and not the ultimate fate of our own humanity. *** ***
##

> Frente a mis ojos se alza una arquitectura de carne y voluntad. La imagen es un claroscuro casi violento: un hombre joven, de torso desnudo y mirada fija, se refugia tras dos faros de cuero escarlata. Los guantes de boxeo, inflados y brillantes bajo una luz cenital que parece el foco de un interrogatorio, no son solo herramientas de ataque; para muchos representan un escudo, una frontera entre su integridad y el mundo exterior. Veo la tensión en sus antebrazos, las venas que dibujan caminos de adrenalina sobre la piel, y esa penumbra que le devora la frente, dejando apenas visibles unos ojos que no buscan el perdón, sino la supervivencia.
# ***
Cuero Escarlata
*** Al observar esta escena, no puedo evitar sentir una punzada de inquietud que me recorre el estómago. Hay una estética innegable en el atletismo del boxeador, una simetría que el arte ha celebrado durante siglos, pero para mí, esa belleza está teñida de una tristeza profunda, de sangre. Siento el peso de la soledad que habita en el ring. Dicen que el boxeo es \

, pero al mirar esos puños cerrados frente al rostro, lo que percibo es la inminencia del daño. Hay algo en la disposición de su cuerpo que me recuerda, inevitablemente, a las peleas de gallos que alguna vez vi de lejos. Pobres animales lanzados a un espacio confinado para demostrar una superioridad que se mide en hematomas y resistencia al dolor, y quizá la muerte.

<center>![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmWzqjdv6A7qbwUE5oHcNPz93rxKk4caT3KuZ5tYR6RyrX/freewr.jpg)
<sup>[Imagen de la iniciativa, cortesía de Pixabay.](https://pixabay.com/photos/boxing-sport-sports-boxer-4339271/xxxx)</sup>
</center>

Mi memoria me traiciona y me lleva a las tardes de infancia, cuando la televisión proyectaba las hazañas de Rocky Balboa. Recuerdo los montajes musicales, el sudor heroico y el triunfo de la voluntad sobre el asfalto de Filadelfia. Pero incluso entonces, mientras el mundo vitoreaba el \

, yo sentía una extraña resistencia. Para muchos, el boxeo es una salida económica, un camino de oro -pavimentado con sangre-; para mí, es un sacrificio demasiado alto. Sé que detrás de esas luces y esos millones, se esconden secuelas que no se ven en la foto..., el habla que se arrastra con los años, el olvido temprano, el daño irreversible en los tejidos del pensamiento. Yo he elegido siempre el camino del mediador. En un mundo que parece pedirnos constantemente que nos pongamos los guantes y subamos al cuadrilátero de la confrontación, prefiero la palabra, el puente y el acuerdo. Observo al hombre de la imagen y respeto su disciplina, su rigor casi místico, pero no puedo desear estar en sus zapatos. Él espera el golpe, se prepara para el impacto, hace del conflicto su hábitat natural. Yo, en cambio, prefiero mantener las manos abiertas, no para cubrirme el rostro, sino para extenderlas. Lo vemos ahí, poderoso y vulnerable a la vez, personificando una lucha que es tan antigua como nuestra especie. La mayor batalla no es la que se gana con los puños, sino la que se evita mediante la inteligencia y la mediación, dejando que los guantes rojos sean solo eso, un objeto inerte bajo una luz dramática, y no el destino final de nuestra propia humanidad. *** ***

body.title: The Latin American Paws Ark Anthem Commission w/ TTT & HSBI
body.body: /> Launching a New Creative Exchange on Hive: The Paws Ark Quest ============================================================= The future of work is not always built on cash—it is built on value exchange. Today I am introducing a small but meaningful transactional service experiment inside the Hive ecosystem: **creative barter missions**. The concept is simple. When someone needs support, resources, or crypto liquidity, they can earn it through skill-based quests that create real value for both sides. Instead of a handout, it becomes a collaboration. This time, the mission begins with an artist from Venezuela @fonestreet He reached out during a difficult legal situation and requested a small amount of HIVE. Rather than framing it as charity, I wanted to create an opportunity—something that empowers talent while also building a new brand. That brand is **Paws Ark**.

/>

Paws Ark represents loyalty, movement, resilience, and community. It is more than a pet-related concept—it is a symbol of guiding the pack toward something bigger.

So here is the quest:

* * *

🎤 The Paws Ark Branding Challenge
----------------------------------

Create a **15-second branded hook** that promotes **Paws Ark** in a **Spanish + English mix**.

### Mission Requirements:

*   Length: **15 seconds**
    
*   Style: **Street rapper energy**
    
*   Language: **Spanglish (Spanish + English)**
    
*   Tone: **Authentic, memorable, repeatable**
    
*   Purpose: **Brand promotion / viral content use**
    

### Core Themes to Include:

*   Loyalty
    
*   Dogs / the pack
    
*   Hustle / movement
    
*   Community
    
*   Strength
    
*   The name **Paws Ark**
    

* * *

Creative Direction
------------------

This should not sound like an advertisement.

It should feel like a real song snippet—something that could loop on TikTok, Reels, or shorts.

Think of it as a branded anthem.

The best hooks are simple, rhythmic, and easy to remember.

Examples of vibe:

*   “Paws Ark in the streets, loyalty on repeat”
    
*   “Con la manada, we rise”
    
*   “From the leash to the dream”
    
*   “Paws Ark, siempre firme”
    

The goal is to make the audience _feel_ the brand.

* * *

Reward Structure
----------------

**50 HIVE** has already been transferred as compensation.

This is a way to pay it forward for the work with trust in the artist to deliver.

More payment is being shared in the form of post beneficiary payouts and ongoing project collaboration.

* * *

Why This Matters
----------------

Hive is more than a blockchain—it is a marketplace of human potential.

Too often, people ask for help in ways that reinforce dependency. I believe in building systems where talent solves problems and generates value.

A small mission can become a portfolio piece, a brand asset, and a bridge to larger opportunities.

This is not just about one artist.

This is about proving that decentralized communities can create new forms of trade rooted in creativity.

* * *

Final Words to the Artist
-------------------------

Bring your truth.

Bring your energy.

Make it raw, make it unforgettable, and make the world remember the name:

**Paws Ark**

The pack is watching.

And the quest has begun.

Three Tune Tuesday for Inspiration
==================================

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=wnJ6LuUFpMo&list=RDwnJ6LuUFpMo&start\_radio=1

1.  Mi Gente
    

Why:  
This is pure collective energy. The hook is instantly repeatable and built around identity/community.

What to study:

chant-like repetition  
global feel  
movement-centered rhythm

For Paws Ark: think “the pack” as the crowd.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vXtJkDHEAAc&list=RDvXtJkDHEAAc&start\_radio=1

1.  Atrévete-te-te
    

Why:  
This one has personality, wit, and cultural swagger.

What to study:

playful but commanding delivery  
unforgettable phrasing  
street authenticity

For Paws Ark: this helps avoid sounding like a generic promo.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=OxxggwHFj7M&list=RDOxxggwHFj7M&start\_radio=1

1.  Travesuras
    

Why:  
Smooth, memorable, and commercially adaptable.

What to study:

melodic hook structure  
emotional pull  
broad audience appeal

For Paws Ark: gives the anthem replay value.

* * *

Why these three work together
-----------------------------

They create a blueprint:

Mi Gente = community  
Atrévete-te-te = originality  
Travesuras = catchiness

That combination gives your artist direction for a branded hook that feels alive.

body.title: ¡Recordando a Papá!
body.body:
![1000926489.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/elizabeths14/EogPpQEHYL8oHTDffcLDh71a9uicP1GzyABVwb5T3CT7odY4zr5H4rNVAR4XkayTAP2.jpg)
---
Me quedé por unos segundos ida, contemplando la fotografía que tengo junto a mi padre en mi nevera, fue un regalo que le hizo a todos sus hijos el día del Padre del 2025. Y no pude evitar recordar la canción de Kanny Garcia - Confieso. https://youtu.be/a39ViqCbmIs?si=9rdD-j6ihfMDxQp8
Yo que cada artista compone una canción en base a su vivcocía o alguna historia escuchada. Pero justo lo hacen para conectar con alguien que tenga una historia parecida y sí, justo tengo una foto con mi papá en la nevera, viajábamos juntos, él siempre encontraba la manera de quererme y así a cada uno de sus hijos. En casa, papá era el único que sabía preparar el café en el punto exacto que me gusta y yo se lo preparaba a él.
![1000926485.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/elizabeths14/23wqeGEgRZUkvixsLgpGD5oiNqSjYrdFCrUFyjpvp7BbfEjrt5HKsUwnr7kUd27HtjsQw.jpg)
Ver esa foto en la nevera, una foto que todos los días veo, pero que hoy me detuve a pensar en ella, me trajo tantos recuerdos. Recuerdos que me llevaron hasta 2 fotos de cuando yo era una bebé y él me cargaba en sus brazos con amor y orgullo, aunque yo ya fuera su 7ma hija. Mi papá era un hombre cariñoso, aun con sus manos un poco ásperas y sucias de mecánica, nos cargaba en sus brazos, nos abrazaba y nos decia cuánto nos amaba. A veces pienso que está por allí o en un viaje, pero no jugaré así con mi mente. Sé que está en un lugar mejor, pero confieso que aquí lo extraño muchísimo y aunque a veces escucho sus audios y sonrió, jamás será lo mismo, pues ya no estan esos mensajes todas las mañanas, ni el café cuando iba a visitarlo, también el compartir los mismos justos o escuchar las historias que solía contarme o sus regaños.
![1000926491.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/elizabeths14/EogQiABpnH1UsfiAp1mkPffDBciVFtCvabhxrUQ24GM3XcfcPXvhdQVKtVouND1WyER.jpg)

body.title: Hermoso arreglo de nubes para un jueves de intervalos 🏃🏽‍♀️‍➡️🔥🔥😎.
body.body: >Jueves de intervalos. Un especial arreglos de nubes acompaño hoy mi entrenamiento de intervalos, me encanta este arreglo de nubes, es un fenomeno que esta apareciendo con mayor frecuencia en los cielos estos ultimos dias. Inicie mi entrenamiento de intervalos con 1,5 km de calentamiento por fuera del estadio, llegue a las 6:00 am al estadio, ya estaban varias personas entrenando, hoy estaban unos corredores muy especiales en la pista unos lindos perros, estaban acompañado a sus dueñas. Hoy el entrenamiento constaba de intervalos de 300 mts con descanso de 2 minutos, 8 repeticiones. Los 300 mts es una distancia agradable, y con proposito, ya que no es tan retadora como las de 400 mts, ni tan suave como la de 200 mts, es termino intermedio, el tiempo de recuperacion, fue bueno, ya que fue la suficiente para recuperarme completamente despues de realizar una serie. --- Termine en buen tiempo las series con un tiempo aproximado de 1:30- 1:26 seg, arrojando un ritmo promedio de 4:54 min/km, por cada 300 mts. Al finalizar las series, me quede recuperandome en el estadio, mientras contemplaba el hermoso arreglo de nubes. Un dia de gran provecho, diversificando los trabajos de intervalos, para adaptar el cuerpo a diferentes impulsos, y respuestas. Hasta la proximas queridos runners.🙌🏽 . >Greetings and blessings.! >

>Interval Thursday. A special cloud formation accompanied my interval training today; I love this cloud formation—it’s a phenomenon that’s been appearing more frequently in the skies these past few days. I started my interval training with a 1.5 km warm-up outside the stadium. I arrived at the stadium at 6:00 a.m., and several people were already training. Today there were some very special runners on the track—some cute dogs—accompanying their owners. Today’s workout consisted of 300-meter intervals with 2-minute rest periods, for 8 repetitions. The 300-meter distance is pleasant and purposeful, as it’s not as challenging as the 400-meter intervals, nor as easy as the 200-meter ones; it’s a middle ground. The recovery time was good, as it was sufficient for me to fully recover after completing a set. --- >I finished the sets in good time with an approximate time of 1:30–1:26, resulting in an average pace of 4:54 min/km for each 300 meters. After finishing the sets, I stayed at the stadium to recover while admiring the beautiful cloud formations. A very productive day, diversifying the interval workouts to adapt the body to different stimuli and responses. See you next time, fellow runners.🙌🏽 --- Todo el contenido es de mi autoría y las imágenes son de mi propiedad Fotos fueron tomadas con mi HONOR X6a Plus Separador editado en Canva Traducido con [Deepl](https://www.deepl.com) > All content is my own and the images are my property. > Photos were taken with my HONOR X6a Plus > Translated with [Deepl](https://www.deepl.com) > Publisher edited in the application Canva [Puedes chequear mi actividad en Strava](https://strava.app.link/mts9btXTB2b) --- [ You can check my activity at Strava](https://strava.app.link/mts9btXTB2b) ![SRL-image-14.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmTN93piGhVsStGYqyRaiGAqHLC4oXUyMuBepEzJJrRW59/SRL-image-14.png) --- For the best experience view this post on [Liketu](https://liketu.com/@mcookies/hermoso-arreglo-de-nubes-para-un-jueves-de-intervalos)

body.title: Am I living Half-Life?
body.body:
>


Waking up this morning was particularly strange. I hadn't slept very well - the situation with my daughter is starting to wear on me - and also had a long day in front of me, creating a cost calculator for [NuevoSol.co](www.nuevosol.co), as they're restructuring the whole company after the owner died almost exactly one year ago. Since Lily is not with me, I have way too much time on my hands, and I like to use that time productively in the benefit of others (and me, win-win-win is my goal always). Helping others is something Lily would want me to do with the time I don't spend with her, as she's very proud of that.



![This is the 1x lense, and the clouds look weird.](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/beelzael/EqFr75P8gwL1w5Xku4gu8EY9GNyTFbYb5ocvcZ2Ax1ACCaCsHC3BhaXB7rKo1oseoh1.jpg)

\

That's what a friend overheard her telling her mom on 25th of November, when her mother tried to explain her why that a day for the elimination of violence against women was necessary. And yes, of course I cried a little out of happiness when my friend told me that. Who wouldn't want their daughter to notice those little things, and be proud of their father?


![This is the Fish Eye, 0,5x, doesn't make it better!](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/beelzael/EpXHZrFetrstgpgNsqvp2matQ4S7Q9zkHDCDkh9zv7BwkWd2UxojT3FcvEnFFQNHbtk.jpg)


Anyway. When I looked outside after this weird night, the sky was weird. The clouds didn't fit reality. It was like in a computer game back in the days. I used different lenses (the ones my so wonderful cellphone has) to play with it, but the feeling never really went away.

![This is towards the east, while the others where towards the North-West.](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/beelzael/EqhQLqF3yRjSsdtDfVqeiwhvEnUWmfYT5cQSKSFqLqdpZ4tX7xvPyvDuKAHhsYKrxcH.jpg)

I looked into all directions just to make sure - a pleasure always, I mean, I live between two mountains that provide a stunning view almost every day. If you go through my snaps, you'll find way too many pictures of them. It's just that feeling that they're different every day. 

![I climbed up a little wall to see if I can give Mountain Cotacachi a frame.](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/beelzael/EqQMdpjoaHgFqc3226Byed9T7oeE2djZQ4yVArVdbeepq35e31BPTNBQ7kjrLEmjDTb.jpg)

Okay, but back to the weird clouds. They do look pretty Half-Life above the \

of the unfinished building next door (not that the one that I rent is finished...). ![IMG_20260424_063258768_HDR.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/beelzael/EpQupWNSZYpwjZ78wKQUVkxUHDDAeKPNCS2RhS9JLSwS5Yk8MEk7nsrTXTdgG7i45MJ.jpg) And finally, Mt. Imbabura. I did the 0,5x Fish Eye directly, because it just called for it. I really love this picture, with he San Francisco church (which I don't like really) and all those levels of rooftops. If I press shift and then space, I could probably jump that far... Those who know, know 😉 The PeakD preview is weird today, but I hope all the pictures made it. Going to the Jamsession now. Sorry about the misleading title! Just saw that one could expect some profound reflections here. Not today. My brain is fried from 7h Excel calculations... Have a good night! ___ As always, any feedback and especially tips and tricks are very welcome! As long as it's not AI generated content or comment spamming... 😅 ___ Thank you for stopping by! >All pictures are taken by myself with a Motorola Edge 60 Pro and I reserve the copyright - but you're welcome to ask if you'd like to use one of the pics!
