body.title: Atrapando recuerdos fotográficos Toledo 2022 📷
body.body:
>

Con la tecnologia actual tener este montón de recuerdos fotográficos debería ser fácil, normalmente los imprimiría y colocaría ordenadamente en mis álbumes, pero ahora todos están acumulados allí dentro del móvil. 

La fecha marcada en el registro fotográfico indica 7 de enero 2022. La ciudad Toledo es  muy  antigua,  esta ubicada en una colina sobre las llanuras de Castilla-La Mancha, en España central. Allí convergen en diferentes épocas   monumentos medievales,  árabes, judíos y cristianos.  También  la antigua casa del pintor  El Greco.


![imagen.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmZQAsfmbh8TkmKUEYyjppF8ZuBfN4vhzaPVXZntsDruz1/imagen.png)

Cuando vi todo lo que tendría que recorrer y subir, mi hija me tranquilizo. Me contó que la primera vez que vino subieron  por las cuestas de los alrededores, pero que descubrió que existe una escalera mecánica y ella facilita  esta parte del camino, pero es solo para subir y poder entrar a la ciudad amurallada. Íbamos a entrar y darle la vuelta saliendo por las diferentes puertas que tiene la ciudad. 

Para allá arriba íbamos a caminar.  


![imagen.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmVnE9yWfPpECi2KhN1T72ZNyki3Vhe3Bx46ZAeTnByUDg/imagen.png)


![imagen.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmYMtzbQLpku9nTgCaYSh4Z9YX6r7y7hfUvi1fur6g2Zx7/imagen.png)


![imagen.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmfCERr9baxju9KbY8kHsoPHVjLHcfdxvjS2w6f4P2RDW8/imagen.png)


![imagen.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmUCRRtpvwtwJZ7NqVSGYT9Zzp3LZAyP9XZ5ZUCdtAiZtV/imagen.png)


![imagen.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmP8qfmK3wvHbUQuZVEfn5y8cB2Kij8ydbea2BTtkkDZcC/imagen.png)



![imagen.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmRPQXk41cTjeuyRPdZjfb3AQG3dZG9GEhQRxTfHaYj5AU/imagen.png)


![imagen.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmeacJx8a2fLrPY7vCeBMgtAVfkmrUsTna2BwsvV6JaUyj/imagen.png)


![imagen.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmaShig6AQT9k4FMYYodxPV3gft17giT7DjmstzZrDdcyt/imagen.png)


La vista desde allí arriba nos da un amplio panorama de toda la ciudad dentro de la muralla.  Candados en el puente, recuerdos de momentos, candados de amor de puentes históricos y zonas como la Cuesta de las Armas (cerca del Miradero). 

![imagen.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmdC6hQgRi8abgjAYNmt1pdffyNUZjdPpEDMxaDTv7GGV1/imagen.png)


![imagen.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmcVKsbASkAxfMQsAJffuZi9qwNa2HixPM2acBt8eUuYa2/imagen.png)


![imagen.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmc5EE8QusMzcSoKNJzcKyE8cU7LYDipAEYJyGQ2GTY2VN/imagen.png)


![imagen.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmfH4YhgDENz1r4gcpF48g1c8MT94NLQMNYLosNmitfyQt/imagen.png)


La estatua al ciclista Federico Martín Bahamontes, \

, esculpida por el artista Javier Molina como un homenaje a este gran deportista. ![imagen.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmZPideWGhYU21vvsrHyWqwKS6KuW1Vw3FSidKiF1hDqgb/imagen.png) ![imagen.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmcN46cHwv5v4KM7bPJqjNkpChqHESzHvzij5NUuvdre33/imagen.png) Ahora que vuelvo a mirar las fotografías el sol se observa en varias bastante fuerte y extraño. ![imagen.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmYtvAJ14qzn8WryHAH44zqe7KjSaqmNGXtw9oU9bnGT3b/imagen.png) ![imagen.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmZcjZmyVWheUgeJjqH6iGLvcaiGdFwgiaLgQ24nxcgS4C/imagen.png) Al lado del gran Cervantes en su Monumento ubicado en la calle Miguel de Cervantes de Toledo, provincia de Toledo, frente al Arco de la Sangre, al otro lado de la plaza Zocodover. Cervantes residió allí por bastante tiempo y es de donde era originaria su mujer. ![imagen.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmaMybZYkj9LRnHQHCZgjy96dYBhEmpKx84ZxyvC2sF4KT/imagen.png) ![imagen.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmRkL6LvRHMt36x1fzbZjyDPu2q2G8DAfALiagcWFhyHm6/imagen.png) ![imagen.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmNUSKVVnxSjUNTstwTprvntM8omaUHfLqAhiHoVibB123/imagen.png) ![imagen.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmTtTDLHrqm2Ne3xqbsNh57CDrHXTVtXLRf2Ru9ZwuYcPM/imagen.png) Un viaje de unos 45 minutos para conocer Toledo en tren te evita una larga caminata, pero no te detienes por mucho tiempo en los espacios. ![imagen.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmYqpkTLZ5vg1DKDExeS3YP9WCXpvEonTBkZVVNMn6xyrR/imagen.png) Alcázar de Toledo es una fortificación de carácter civil y militar, ubicada en una de las partes más altas de la ciudad. Fue residencia de Reyes y fortificación durante la guerra civil. body.title: Cicatrices de Oro: El Arte de Permanecer \
body.body:
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmevZZy58Rc22FTLVYvfoTfSLMbhRCmRtasx79kMxdWWHB/1777073531077.png)

<center> 🏺 🌸 🏺 🌸 🏺 🌸 🏺 </center>

El Kintsugi es un arte japonés antiguo que nos enseña que las cicatrices no son algo que debamos ocultar con vergüenza. Cuando una pieza de cerámica se quiebra, los maestros artesanos no usan un pegamento invisible para que parezca \

. Al contrario, usan una resina mezclada con oro puro. El resultado es una pieza que muestra sus grietas con orgullo, brillando más que antes.

<center> ✨ 🏺 ✨ </center>

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmPmjN1Fa7auWotRo3bfS9nwQdhu3ZbnK2NbMmFLHbrp8g/1777068305075.png)

CREADA POR NANO BANANA 2.0

​<center> ✨ 🏺 ✨ </center>

En un matrimonio de muchos años, las grietas son inevitables. No son necesariamente señales de fracaso, sino marcas de que hemos vivido, de que hemos sentido y de que hemos resistido. A veces, la rutina, los problemas externos o los malentendidos golpean la estructura de lo que hemos construido.

Al final, un matrimonio duradero es como esa vasija. No es perfecto, no es liso, ni está libre de marcas. Es una pieza única donde cada línea dorada cuenta una batalla ganada, una crisis superada y una decisión diaria de seguir eligiéndose.

Actualmente vivimos en lo que algunos sociólogos llaman la \

, donde la velocidad de la vida moderna a veces nos quita la paciencia necesaria para el delicado arte de la restauracion.

<center> 🏺 🌸 🏺 🌸 🏺 🌸 🏺 </center>

En la era de las redes sociales, estamos expuestos a una vitrina constante de relaciones que parecen no tener ni una sola grieta. Esto genera una falsa expectativa: creemos que si una relación se rompe, es porque \
, en lugar de entender que toda cerámica, por fina que sea, corre el riesgo de quebrarse y como consecuencia ante la primera fisura, se abandona la pieza buscando una nueva que \

, olvidando que lo nuevo también envejecerá y enfrentará sus propios golpes.\n\nEn la pareja reconstruir la confianza o sanar una herida requiere tiempo y silencio. Sin embargo, hoy queremos soluciones tipo \
. Si el dolor no desaparece en una semana, sentimos que la relación ya no sirve. Nos falta la paciencia artesanal para esperar a que el perdón \

y fortalezca la unión.\n\nAl final, lo que realmente nos define no son los golpes que recibimos, sino la forma en que decidimos volver a armarnos. Que nunca nos avergüencen nuestras grietas, porque son el mapa de nuestras batallas ganadas y la prueba de que fuimos lo suficientemente fuertes para no rendirnos. El amor que se restaura no es un amor \

; es un amor que ha sido honrado y que ahora posee una luz que ninguna pieza nueva podrá igualar jamás.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZkhLdrTwmYcuSEJfACGhxKiphj3CehWYCvRxaAjad2ME/1777073751274.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmUWSPiujsGYaAfBBKNMWReh2Sgu1GJZmsKN1b6EuDfSk7/1777073735350.jpg)

​<center> 🏺 🌸 🏺 🌸 🏺 🌸 🏺 </center>

\

​<center> 🏺 🌸 🏺 🌸 🏺 🌸 🏺 </center>

Valoro mucho tu tiempo y tus comentarios. ¡Sigamos construyendo historias con hilos de oro!

body.title: Community Challenge #6, Ai Level Up!
body.body:
## 🚀 Splinterlands AI Challenge: Let’s Level Up the Game Together 

![2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/spl-contests/23tv8fUXwP4TTaYn7hvh4dzm5PuFiSeUEEKwnok73qn343eLArjq338YhSwLtxED6PPhC.png)



## The Challenge

Use AI tools (like Grok, Midjourney, Flux, Leonardo, Kling, Runway, Luma, or any others) to improve **Splinterlands** in any way you can imagine.

I’ve been playing Splinterlands for a long time now, and one thing is crystal clear.. AI is evolving FAST. This feels like the perfect moment for our community to jump in and start using these tools to push the game forward in creative ways.

Whether you’re brand new to AI or already experimenting with it, this contest is for you.

👉 **The goal is simple:**
Take any part of Splinterlands and make it cooler, more engaging, or just plain better using AI.

---

## 🙌 Contest Credit

This contest idea was created by **JeremiahCustis**, the winner of our last contest \

. Huge shoutout for bringing this challenge to life 🔥

---

## 💡 Ideas to Get You Started

### 🎥 3D Animate Your Battles

Let’s be honest.. showing outsiders static battle screenshots isn’t exactly exciting.

Now imagine this instead:
Turning your battle into a short cinematic clip where monsters move, attack, and feel alive.

AI video tools are getting insanely powerful why not use them to:

* Create highlight reels
* Share epic moments
* Bring new players into the game

---

### 🎨 Redesign Old Cards

If you’ve been around since Alpha/Beta, you’ve seen how much the art has improved.

Some older cards still have charm, but they don’t match today’s quality.

👉 Your challenge:

* Reimagine classic cards with modern visuals
* Keep the original spirit
* Upgrade the style

Let’s see some glow-ups 👀

---

### 🧠 Create New Artwork & Concepts

What if AI could learn the entire Splinterlands art style?

Try:

* Generating brand new cards that fit the universe
* Reworking underused cards visually
* Creating concepts that could inspire future sets

Push the boundaries, this is where things get really interesting.

---

### 📢 AI-Generated Videos

AI video is one of the biggest game changers right now.

Use it to:

* Promote Splinterlands
* Create trailers or ads
* Tell stories from battles or lore

Let’s flood social media with content that actually grabs attention.

---

## 🏆 Prizes

* 🥇 **1st Place:** Conclave Arcana Pack
* 🥈 **2nd Place:** Escalation Pack
* 🥉 **3rd Place:** 2 CA Starter Packs
* 🎖️ **4th Place:** 2 Chaos Legion Packs

---

## 📜 Rules 

* Must use AI in your creation
* Must relate to Splinterlands
* Be creative, original, and have fun with it
* Any format is allowed (images, videos, concepts, etc.)

---

## 🔥 Final Thoughts

This isn’t just a contest, it’s a chance for the community to shape the future of how Splinterlands looks, feels, and grows.

AI is here.
Let’s use it.

Can’t wait to see what you all come up with 👀🔥

body.title: Fingerprint
body.body: /> Have you ever stopped to think that your fingerprints could disappear? No, I'm not talking about science fiction movies or police series. I'm talking about real life. Those unique lines we carry from before we're born, which we use every day to unlock our phones, make payments, open bank accounts, or register our identity, can become so faint that they practically vanish. I always believed that fingerprints were permanent and immutable for life. But I was completely wrong. I discovered this in practice when I went to update a document at a public department. When I got there, the employee asked me to place my fingers on the biometric reader. That's when I realized the problem: some of my fingerprints simply weren't registering. He asked me what had happened, and I replied that I had no idea. In fact, I never imagined that fingerprints could weaken like that. I had never imagined that something so personal and unique could disappear. We managed to register some digital accounts with considerable difficulty. Curious, I asked the person assisting me what might be causing this. He explained that digital technologies can weaken or become almost invisible due to various factors: * Chemicals, medicines and aggressive substances * Excessive wear and tear from manual labor or repetitive use. * Natural skin aging * Skin diseases * Burns or deep cuts I went home really worried, reviewing what I could have done wrong to make my hands so weak. It was only after a lot of research that I understood that most of the time it's nothing serious. Our skin simply reacts to daily life, holding our cell phones for hours on end, washing a lot of dishes, or suffering from natural dryness.

/>

Important tips for taking care of your fingerprints:

*   Moisturize your hands daily with a good hand cream, preferably at night.
    
*   Use gloves when washing dishes or using cleaning products.
    
*   Take breaks when using your cell phone, switch hands, or rest it on something to reduce friction.
    

In most cases, fingerprints reappear within a few weeks, once the skin is given a break. If the problem persists for a long time, as it did for me, it's worth consulting a dermatologist.

Ultimately, our fingerprints may not be permanent, but with a little attention and care they last much longer than we imagine.

Thank you for reading.

The minimum ALIVE Power to use our tipping bot is 1,000 AP (owned non-delegated stake plus incoming delegations) which allows you to send 10 tips per day, and we have 4 levels.

- Level 1: 1k AP = 10 tips per day
- Level 2: 5k AP = 20 tips per day
- Level 3: 20k AP = 30 tips per day
- Level 4: 100k AP = 40 tips per day


Use the command ` !ALIVE ` in a comment to send a tip, and do make sure to add a space just before and after to make sure it works correctly, the counter resets at midnight UTC.

Here is the full details of how our tipping bot works, [Announcement: The New ALIVE Tipping Bot Has Been Launched](https://wearealivetribe.com/hive-155221/@flaxz/announcement-the-new-alive-tipping-bot-has-been-launched)

body.title: I Was Once Made to Feel Powerless
body.body:
> Yes, I’ve often felt powerless when I try to make positive changes in my life, and I don’t know if this happens to you too, but every time I realize that something is good for me, it always clashes with the interests of someone very close to me or with the comfort of feeling secure with what I already have. I think I could write many examples about this, but the conclusion is always the same: once you realize that you are the master of your own life and learn to distinguish what’s best for you, people appear who, in the name of love or friendship, make the situation more uncomfortable for you. Of course, all of this happens because we’ve spent years putting others before ourselves, and without realizing it, we often make them dependent on us by saying “yes” to all their requests. But once the change begins, you realize the influence they have on your life. Today I’m a more mature person, and although I’m married, I’m with someone emotionally with whom I can make decisions that help me grow, and I only receive support and encouragement. But in the past, it wasn’t like that—many people made me feel powerless for wanting to change situations that could benefit me, and while that powerlessness lasted, all I did was postpone my own destiny. So many people say they love you, but if you disrupt their routine, they make you feel like a bad person—like someone selfish who doesn’t think of others—even though you’ve given them so much in the past. I’ve found myself in that situation a dozen times and put my emotional well-being on hold so as not to hurt those people; what a huge mistake! The ones with the problem were them—they used manipulation to keep me or others in their lives.
![IMG_20251018_142621.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jesuslnrs/EpnFjGBLqmcKGjXuMJknA5KuuVCirwns8v9AGDCqhwyZtbiX7EghfPQhALMYnYXueA4.jpg)
I learned the hard way to put myself first, even though I’m a devout Catholic and the Church’s teachings tell me to turn the other cheek. Once the change began, many people left, and at the time it hurt a lot, but later I understood that this is the reality of human relationships: people come into your life, fulfill a purpose, and then leave, and not just passing strangers—sometimes they’re friends of many years or even your own family members. The point is that no one can interfere with your personal journey, and I realized this a little too late, because in the end, that feeling of helplessness was something I imposed on myself. There are also situations and places that have left me feeling powerless in my efforts to improve my emotional and physical stability—though, now that I think about it, there are always people behind such obstacles. People who tell you that you can't do something, or that you aren't ready to take on a challenge—a challenge you know would improve your life—and many of them use their power to crush others. In my case, particularly in the realm of music, many people denied me opportunities through companies or academies. I came to feel utterly powerless, knowing full well what I had to offer, yet never even being given the chance to prove it; eventually, however—and precisely because I never stopped working on myself, day after day—things began to turn in my favor. In conclusion, that sense of powerlessness is merely a feeling that arises within us when we do not know which path to take; and while there are indeed people who lack the freedom to choose, those of us who do possess it are generally slaves to ourselves—whether due to ignorance, naivety, or immaturity. Personally, I have managed to come to terms with this. And yes, people still appear in my life who try to interfere in some way whenever I seek to make choices that will benefit me; however, their actions barely affect me anymore. It surprises me a little when the person involved is someone very, very close to me, but I no longer let myself be swayed. Once your journey toward all forms of stability has truly begun, there is definitely no turning back. 🙏 Thank you for reading and supporting my post! If you have ever felt powerless because you were unable to make positive changes in your life, feel free to share your experience in the comments below—or perhaps you might like to write your own post for this 306th edition of the Weekend-Engagement challenge. Have a wonderful weekend!
![IMG_20251018_135757_1.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jesuslnrs/EqBdCMTdvGjsPZmr9YhEuCe2jxaRmYGZSwJFyQEMtRuaX1jrxN7CFatZXrMwSaQ65D5.jpg)

body.title: The coffeeprontshop || special moment in Galerias
body.body:
>

 **A warm greeting to all of us coffee lovers in this community #cinnamoncupcoffee.**  

  
It's normal to go to a coffee shop with someone, but sometimes we can go alone. There are no excuses not to visit a coffee shop and spend a moment enjoying coffee, sipping on that longed-for cup, and feeling energized. 

In my city, there are many coffee shops and businesses that offer the drink of the gods; each visit is different, there are always new things. I've rarely visited a coffee shop alone, where I really enjoy my drink. 

I remember once, I was at the doctor's; I had left very early and had a little coffee at home, since I never leave without my morning dose, but I hadn't had breakfast. 


After my appointment, I headed to one of my favorite cafes since it was nearby. I walked a few blocks and found several tables occupied by very pleasant people. They seemed to be coming from a musical event because they were in high spirits, so I felt right at home.

 I sat down near them, ordered a cappuccino and a pastry, and my coffee arrived quickly. With each sip, I reflected on certain things in my life and hoped everything would go well in my medical exams. I observed the atmosphere; everyone was absorbed in their own thoughts, yet they offered smiles and kindness to other customers. They even sang an a cappella song for everyone, creating a wonderful moment. 

In the end, I didn't want to leave, and I stayed seated there alone even after finishing my breakfast.

Sometimes we think that being alone in a place is depressing, but there are dates alone with ourselves where we have a great time and connect with the moment in an amazing way, and while drinking coffee it will always be a great date.
 
<div class=\
> That's all for now, my adventurers. Thank you for reading.

> >! [Spanish,Here]> Un cordial saludo a todos los amantes del café de esta comunidad #cinnamoncupcoffee. Es normal que vamos acompañados,cuando visitamos una cafetería, pero en ocasiones podemos ir solos, no hay excusas para visitar a una cafetería y pasar un momento en compañía del café, en tomarse en tan anhelado taza de café, y sentirnos enérgicos. En mi cuidad existen muchas cafeterias y comercios que ofrecen la bebida de los dioses, cada visita es distinta siempre hay novedades. Pocas veces he visitado a solas una cafetería, en dónde disfruto mucho de mi bebida. Recuerdo una vez, que estaba en el médico hacia salido muy temprano, y tome poco café en casa, pues nunca salgo sin mi dosis matutina, pero no había desayunado. Al terminar la consulta me dirigí a una cafeteria que tanto me gusta aproveche que estaba cerca, camine unas cuadras y al llegar estaban algunas mesas ocupadas de personas muy agradables, al parecer salían de un evento musical porque estaban alegres, así que me sentí en sintonía. Me senté cerca de esas personas, ordene mi cappuccino y un pastelito, rápidamente me trajeron mi café, en cada sorbo pensé en ciertas cosas de mi vida, y que todo saldría bien en mis exámenes médicos, observé el ambiente que cada quien están en sus cosas, sin embargo dan su sonrisas y su amabilidad a otros clientes, dedicaron una canción a capela al público se hizo un momento maravilloso, que a la final no quería salir de tan lugar, que segui sentada allí sola a pesar de hacer consumido mi desayuno. A veces pensamos que estar solas en un lugar es deprimente,pero hay citas a solas con uno mismo que la pasamos super y que conectamos con el momento de una manera sorprendente y mientras tomamos café siempre será una cita genial. body.title: 改變投資方針
body.body:
先說明一哈，本題目與附圖沒有太大關係。腦子裡的構思是要說明這次改變投資方針，本來我是準備了900分要買一張#ecency的AI圖的，沒想到AI被我玩炸了。我連續提出了幾次要求，說要擬真圖，讓網紅@davidke20那個大胖子站在吉隆坡母雞便當赫赫有名的麥當勞十字路口前，看起來很迷茫未能決定去向，然後圖裡不要有其他遊客。

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmeALsbZCGTeZ6yYNCbyzwPe9zMsD3HqSVPXjNA9GetTrS/1777070900553.png)

可以想像AI在很努力的“想”🤣 @davidke20那個死胖子我知道是誰，但他絕對不是網紅啊？！還有還有，吉隆坡有名的麥當勞十字路口一點回來都是聞名一大堆遊客等著過麥當勞的薯條“斑馬線”，所以就算好憑空想像也很難弄一幅完整的無遊客圖出來。最後，直接給我退款了🤣

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmWVje1A8ZooNc78vASkTGs2HFPZsiHmBy9DRRTm699mHF/1777071000823.jpg)

之後我又改變了提問，將它簡單化也不行，結果AI還是陸續“思考”了很久，又退款給我🤣 最後，還是我的谷歌朱咪咪（Gemini)給我解決了問題。就有本文的第一張套圖。

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmVymFsQTBXRnuvuKKohT7YWvoD6i2tMECJ8DXEjMSVsL8/1777069101416.jpg)

大家好鴨！我是拉叔，沒想到一個套圖把我原來的作品改編了個大方向。正是本次要說的，改變投資方針。我拉叔原先一直支持著將賺來的HBD存起來。我也有想過，是不是應該將部份的Hive兌換回穩定幣，然後存起來拿年化20%的利息。我之前是有一筆小存款，後來因為“幫助”某網友直接“借”出去了。我心裡清楚知道那麼一“借”，就是把這個朋友借沒了。不過既然有心要幫助人，就英雄不問出處，我只希望那一筆錢錢能幫助他度過難關。

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmdvWp5h2QMLyfWyyNwc2NsJFcnTz6W8cwWiUbBf1tiuY2/1777069783177.jpg)

去年起，幣價瘋狂墜落，存款利息也從原來的20%降到15%，我個人是不會太過反對降息一事。畢竟大家都是為了本平台的生態系統付出。進來擼提賣的雖說是大有人在，但那也是生態系統的一部份鴨。我也不以為意，繼續存款。將心比心，15%還是相當可觀的一筆數目。再加上，我原來的五萬HP都已經代理出去給ASEAN Hive 做慈善用途了，對於我的點贊福利不多不少有財政收入的影響。

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmSqxUMUnRP652DN3y9uqSfmtKG9xnVGM9EejSjoGwLT61/1777069783246.jpg)

近幾個月來，歐神也有提到利息又再進行調整為14%，其實我心裡時候點不爽冇短時間內從20%調到15%已經是很大幅度的調整，我心裡的打算是少賺一點。說不定那天有用到錢錢時，我還可以拿這幾千刀出來。可是，沒想到才這麼幾個月時間，又從15%跳到14%……我是真的有點動搖了。

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmdSCrX5JTnCkBNnkYFDwdXrKN2vP4cbNdna9tWPFfeJjd/1777069783309.jpg)

昨天，就是這個小投資的最後一根稻草了。我平時是沒什麼注意這些小細節的，就是要弄個截圖給朋友看看，秀秀我的小小14%回酬才發現原來已經調整去12%年化。講真的，外面加密代幣投資項目還有那個給這麼少？法幣投資的也有不少超過10%的，而且是合法投資的，我是想了幾個小時都想不出理由要存款了。

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmbgNhwUdNyVtEk3kvHaVHEB1KMdvokEZvWKaDbhXrUxtg/1777069783371.jpg)

於是，把心一橫，全額提出存款。我不是不懂得感恩，我是思前想後了一輪，還是決定與其等收一份薄弱的利息，不如把錢拿出來。反正之前被套的，都算是解套了。我是不是應該買入一下Hive，把自己壯大一些些呢？

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmNZHmSX2u8ckztcjHSroUdouVyZeCCRwHJB4r3TmSafPY/1777069783439.jpg)

不寫了。心裡是有點不爽，不過我的下一個目的地就是十萬大關。給我幾天時間吧。

Basically, in the present time, our students are always searching for something modern. A few years ago, when students could not understand a topic, they would take advice from their parents. When parents could not understand that topic, they had to refer them to a teacher. 

However, today we live in a modern world and in this modern world, Google is there to solve all our problems.



https://img.leopedia.io/DQmNrNsDBbjmiY2sMkfjWp7J9iwgfqRqW8ZUBKZRPALo3XT/pexels-click-jeth-703137695-18530501.jpg 

[Source](https://www.pexels.com/photo/google-in-smartphone-18530501/)



Basically, Google is a teacher for all of us. If we ask Google about any knowledge of any person in the world, Google gives us the answer. But we can create the ability of our students to gain knowledge on various subjects from Google. We can use the Google search engine and get the solution to any educational or mathematical problem from there. body.title: Spontaneous Mushroom Hunt on Fungi Friday
body.body:
![1000000468.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/proto26/EoK6G7dQ58hRpa4vHu8zmX7GYva2k8epXyqZ7PzBVg4jHH9RPeC4AAJhN9Dy5Eyr7vG.jpg)

Today my sister came over for a visit and after an unfruitful search for a watering can at the store, she suggested we take a walk in the oak and cottonwood forest. We wondered whether it was too early for morels (mushroom hunters' biggest lie). In the past, I've had better luck a little later. The weather has also been weird lately. In either case, the walk would at least be pleasant. I really didn't think we would see anything.

![1000000476.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/proto26/23tmHnQYhhRpSVBHRGiHMrs9FcPyCJhH25cf161YF1Siy5eoTQm9iju3FeNDbFuovjiyd.jpg)

I was wrong. At first we spotted many small ones. It would almost be a crime to have picked them, like catching small fish. I thought they would all be like that but, clearly, they were in varying stages of development.

![1000000465.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/proto26/EoiWjQ8LBi1ox44iVAKDjJoZz7C1F7GR8dacPGK13Q43eRzz63bJcYkEG6YjCu7UV3i.jpg)

They blend in very well with the leaf litter. Every now and then, though, I would catch a glimpse of gold pushing through the leaves.

![1000000463.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/proto26/23u69YYhw2AXqRqA6pwePWkmm5kpriMiW5Gho5HSy4EfK3rByhWJ9LYZdYAvwj67tVMkR.jpg)

At first, my sister asked in astonishment, \

What I really like about my spot is that you can find them easily from the comfort of the path without much deviation. Soon, she also got the hang of it and contributed to finding many of them herself. The hunt went better with another set of eyes scanning. I told her she was developing her mushroom sense.

![1000000460.jpg](5)![1000000471.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/proto26/23u6BLag4LRbTBGubANsPkCYypF7PUJEEaM2qU6orX7ZBE8BUtJhufyxcgeXLakRVCqD2.jpg)

We found a twin pair, joined at the foot. While they don't really grow in clusters, where there's one, there's usually more nearby. This we found to be very true. We kept on finding four or five within a small area. 

![1000000466.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/proto26/EoCj4sGwQ2pbg4vocRdXDULQ2kBUGfMKLsPatMaoBXE9ZfpEiVULrqDgqNFmW52nedo.jpg)

Here, a morel mushroom grows near a mysterious yellow flower. There were a few of these around. There were more of a different yellow flower, one I'm more familiar with.


![1000000470.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/proto26/23uQrDp3fNA7SorHZm9C2LbRaDzv5UyBJtd3kvt3voxj2xxyjVv32v1zY532BGdTT3NxR.jpg)

It's the downy yellow violet. Does it look familiar? This is the forest variant of the viola that grows like a weed in lawns.


![1000000472.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/proto26/23wWyUqm8T9VJaYQYGSwGxQUZ55A5c9HHFR2dYha7Q57cqB7SPfL7ERL53F2xccinxzJG.jpg)

I saw that species, or a similar one, here too. They are usually a darker purple, but I've seen them mutate with completely white blossoms as well. Something about being in the forest, surrounded by nature, made me appreciate even the common purple version.


![1000000469.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/proto26/23tSUhUYfvoNPnr9qyL8u2g6PAU1nEhmG5ZuG2S8EAaN5rvcuBbtPNYiUfTBWpxkVEMeX.jpg)

I even spotted a woodland strawberry in bloom! These wild species have much tastier fruit, albeit smaller.

![1000000473.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/proto26/23wCBzQCpwkVTcDHsC935dgd46bfSRmofFXRCXpF2gT3mYsLUP8awqixpcoK2dWWpGZvx.jpg)

This specimen was the biggest one we found. It had a short stipe and a broad base that tapered up, reminding me if a Christmas tree. It also had more pits and wrinkles than any of the others. If this were a brain, it'd be the smartest.

![1000000464.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/proto26/23tby8qbXW5X8uxE28airZW6T56jjPwoj5KdiefLa6x6tdj7WbRvTm1vbgQUaEFyhmfp8.jpg)

Every time I thought to myself that that would be it, we found a few more. Unfortunately, having come straight from the store, all we had was a plastic bag. It's better to have a mesh bag like the ones store-bought oranges and onions come in so that the spores get released as you walk and the mushrooms proliferate. We harvested sustainably and didn't pick every single one. The animals like to nibble on them, too. Especially isopods and slugs. 


![IMG_0473.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/proto26/23tvgTfnJt8rwi44VsfyHdLBsNz3G6krvQvPH1LVMqwYPDpfwuxbxHMo43JVdsQbQjYTc.jpg)

Speaking of animals, we also saw this garter snake! It was startled as I picked a nearby mushroom but it didn't slither that far away. Its body was about as thick as my thumb! It watched and smelled us with its black-tipped forked tongue. 

Soon after, it began to rain so we hurried back to the car with our haul. My sister took the morels so that she could carefully dehydrate them at low temperature in the oven. We will be meeting next Fungi Friday to make a meal out of them. And pasta!

body.title: Música etíope: Shillimii
body.body: >En esta oportunidad comentaré sobre una canción folclórica de Etiopía titulada Shillimii; se trata de una canción interpretada por Daangaa H Qanani, una artista de la comunidad Oromo en Etiopía.
>Los Oromo son uno de los grupos étnicos más grandes de Etiopía, y su idioma (Afaan Oromoo) es la principal lengua hablada en la nación y también se la habla en Kenia.
>En cuanto a su música, suele incluir ritmos y melodías reconocibles que reflejan la historia y las tradiciones de la etnia.
>Por su parte, las letras de las canciones por lo general abordan temas relacionados con la cultura, los sentimientos, y la vida cotidiana de las personas de las comunidades.

>La canción comentada en particular evoca imágenes de la vida rural, la belleza de la juventud, y el contraste entre lo tradicional y lo moderno; parece hablarnos de la historia de una muchacha hermosa comprometida con un joven pretendiente y los preparativos para la unión.

>La pareja está dispuesta a enfrentarse a las malas lenguas, que pueden difamar a la novia con fines turbios dado pueden existir rivales interesados en malograr la relación, e incluso no les importaría desafiar las tradiciones con tal de defender su amor.

>Por lo visto la palabra shillimii se usa para nombrar una moneda de plata, parece es la palabra en lengua oromo para chelín (shilling), y aun si hoy en día la moneda oficial del país es otra, shillimii se sigue usando de forma simbólica en las canciones folclóricas.
>En este contexto hablar de la novia comparándola con una moneda de plata puede ser una forma de describirla como fuera de lo común y de gran valor para su pretendiente.
>La mención de la moneda también suele estar ligada a las negociaciones de boda o al regalo que el enamorado quiere ofrecer para demostrar que sus intenciones son serias.

>Por medio del siguiente video de YouTube pueden escuchar la canción:

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=V0DXodXb9Zc
>En el video podrán ver también los bailes y trajes típicos de los Oromo, los primeros desde mi punto de vista un poco extraños.

>En este otro video en la misma plataforma pueden encontrar la letra de la canción, tanto en el video como revisando en la descripción del mismo:

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=kr1gw\_EoADA
>Me despido esperando esta canción pueda gustar a algunos, puesto es una muestra de la música Oromo tal vez desconocida en su región.
>En otra oportunidad les comentaré sobre otras canciones de esta etnia, o también de otras canciones pertenecientes a una de las variadas culturas del mundo.

body.title: In search of my dream bike 🚲  Buscando la bicicleta de mis sueños
body.body: > Blessed day, friends of @cycling, Today is a good day for #CyclingChitChat, an initiative to chat about our lives, memories and adventures linked to bikes, so you can join in with the thought-provoking questions we’re given every week or simply share whatever you like on the topic. I’d like to take this opportunity to invite my friends @doriangel and @mamaemigrantefit to join us. A few weeks ago, one of the topics was to show off your dream bike. I got really excited when I read it, as I’ve been wanting a bike for several months and even promised to take part. The weeks went by, but as it’s never too late, here I am. I’d started saving up to buy a bike with the HBDs I’d earned and managed to save up 300, half the bike’s value at the time, but then a health issue came up and I had to spend it all. 😪😔. The bike I want isn’t your average, run-of-the-mill bike – mine is special 😁 – and I know you’re going to laugh when I say this, but it’s a model made by a Venezuelan motorbike brand called Bera, and they have an electric bike model 😂 in different colours. This type of bike can be ridden purely by pedalling, or with a little boost from the built-in battery. I want an electric one so I can cover long distances, as I see fit, without dying in the attempt. I think they’re really lovely, modern bikes, and it’s my dream to feel that freedom on two wheels again, but whilst I wait for the one I want, I’d like to share some photos of one of the bike shops and workshops in my area.

>  Bendecido día amigos de @cycling, hoy es un buen día de #CyclingChitChat, iniciativa para tener una charla sobre nuestras vidas, recuerdos y aventuras asociadas a las bicicletas, así que puedes unirte a las preguntas generadoras que todas las semanas nos dan o simplemente contar cualquier cosa que desees en torno al tema, aprovecho para invitar a unirse a mis amigas @doriangel y @mamaemigrantefit . Hace varias semanas uno de los temas era mostrar la bicicleta de tus sueños, yo me emocioné al leerla, pues tengo varios meses deseando una bicicleta y hasta me comprometí en participar, las semanas pasaron, pero como nunca es tarde aquí estoy. Yo había empezado a ahorrar para comprarme una bicicleta con los HBD que me ganaba y llegué a acumular 300 la mitad del valor en ese momento de la bicicleta, pero se me presentó un asunto de salud y tuve que gastarlos. 😪😔. La bicicleta que deseo no es una bicicleta normal y corriente la mía es especial 😁 y sé que te vas a reír cuando lo diga, se trata de un modelo que saco una marca de motos venezolana que se llama Bera y tienen un modelo de bicicleta eléctrica 😂 en distintos colores. Este tipo de bicicleta se puede usar a puro pulmón y pedal o también usar con un empujoncito que te da la batería que trae incorporada. Yo la quiero eléctrica para manejar grandes distancias según yo y no morir en el intento. Me parecen una bicicleta moderna muy bonita y es mi sueño volver a sentir la libertad en dos ruedas, pero mientras llega la que deseo quiero compartir imágenes de uno de los talleres y ventas de bicicleta en mi localidad.
![1001619573.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/santacruz.sports/Eo1vTqFSrfTwebVBNH9Qbd68EWVhSRY5hW6dyzuS79JngRavWNYKzPgHnycf9wtDEof.png)
[Source](https://beravirtual.com/producto/bera-bike/)
![20260206_115221.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/santacruz.sports/AKYMfL4GhGSqYyBR2VsX9VwqgKSojutdDZ25QRNB3HU12kt5pySvi7GMmmfUJHU.jpg)
![20260206_115141.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/santacruz.sports/AKAp9noWp5wU5Cxhzj28wBUoFXgmVPrbQnHbjhLsFNoPGWs8RHFKBPiEQaZz4Xu.jpg)
![20260206_115118.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/santacruz.sports/AK3eK78LMU4gBiTVhjgfgs7Xs4oM4DNY7mtDciSi6FKFzMtZ1kj3dmWLumXwCs4.jpg)

> This shop is very old; I think it was the first of its kind and it’s the first one I remember visiting as a child, and I’m nearly fifty now, so do the maths. Although it’s an old shop, it’s not a very pleasant place to visit; I feel it lacks charm, perhaps organisation; however, they have everything a bike lover could need. They sell wholesale and retail, stock spare parts and accessories, and offer repair and maintenance services. The day I went, they had several bikes for children and adults, and I particularly liked one: the purple one with a basket on the handlebars. It’s beautiful and reminded me of my first bike as a child. I still like this model, but not as much as the electric one. They don’t sell electric bikes in this sort of shop; to find the one I want, I’ll have to go to a motorbike shop 😆. I’ll sign off by thanking you for your time and support; I hope to return again with another story of bikes and miles.

> Este negocio es muy viejo, creo que era el primero que existió de este rubro y es el primero que recuerdo que visitada de niña y yo estoy cerca de cumplir medio siglo, saquen la cuenta por allí. Aunque es un local viejo no es muy agradable para visitarlo siento que le falta encantó, tal vez organización; sin embargo, tienen todo lo que puede necesitar un amante de las bicicletas, aquí venden al mayor y al detal, venden repuestos, accesorios y hacen servicios de reparación y mantenimiento. El día que fui tenían varias bicicletas para niños y grandes y me gustó una en especial, la de color violeta con su cesta en el manubrio, es hermosa y me recordó a mi primera bicicleta cuando niña, este modelo me sigue gustando pero no tanto como la eléctrica. En este tipo de negocio no venden las eléctricas, para encontrar la que deseo debo acudir a un negocio de motos 😆. Me despido agradeciendo su tiempo y apoyo, espero regresar nuevamente con otra historia de bicicletas y kilómetros.

body.title: Crossing Shadows on the Street. Entry for the ShadowHunters SMASh Contest-round 423
body.body:
Hello Shadow Hunters community, once again I’m posting in this community and doing so to take part in the ShadowHunters SMASh Contest, round 423.

---

## ShadowHunters SMASh Contest – Crossing Shadows on the Street

---

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmWaJg6QRXLejnFN2iaRb5LW6LXszmz5EghzZv5DAyyBjv/screenshot_20260424_185456_01.jpg)

---

While walking through the streets of the city, I stopped for a moment to photograph my shadow next to a post. It was one of those simple pauses, guided more by instinct than by planning.

I was focused on that image.

But just at that moment, a woman passed by my side. Almost without realizing it, her shadow entered the scene, crossing near mine and becoming part of the composition.

It all happened quickly.

What was going to be a photo of a single shadow turned into something more interesting. Two different presences, two paths, meeting briefly through their shadows without even interacting directly.

I found that detail beautiful.

---

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmeuRDPMAmtUKYpiwchB2jqhCUWTeBLLdi2TxRwBMBfHS2/screenshot_20260424_185501_01.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmXdWrBAaNpcQkcMM1rnpjMw64G5t16dg7is6hPYf24i5B/screenshot_20260424_185449_01.jpg)

---

Sometimes the street gives us these unexpected moments, where everything aligns for a second. Light, movement, and timing come together to create something unique.

I didn’t plan it, but I’m glad I captured it.

And this is what I share with you today for this contest.

---

Thanks to @melinda010100 for every call for this contest. 

Thanks for everything, and I declare that the images were taken with my mobile phone and the English translation is thanks to Google Translate.

---

Thank you for reading.
Special thanks to @bradleyarrow for supporting the community.

---
## 🇪🇸 Versión en Español
---

Hola comunidad Shadow Hunters, una vez más estoy publicando en esta comunidad y lo hago para participar en el ShadowHunters SMASh Contest, ronda 423.

---

## Concurso ShadowHunters SMASh – Sombras que se cruzan en la calle

---

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmWaJg6QRXLejnFN2iaRb5LW6LXszmz5EghzZv5DAyyBjv/screenshot_20260424_185456_01.jpg)

---

Dando un paseo por las calles de la ciudad, me detuve un momento a fotografiar mi sombra junto a un poste. Fue una de esas pausas simples, guiadas más por el instinto que por la planificación.

Estaba concentrada en esa imagen.

Pero justo en ese momento, una mujer pasó a mi lado. Casi sin darme cuenta, su sombra entró en la escena, cruzándose cerca de la mía y formando parte de la composición.

Todo ocurrió muy rápido.

Lo que iba a ser una foto de una sola sombra se convirtió en algo más interesante. Dos presencias distintas, dos caminos, que se encuentran brevemente a través de sus sombras sin interactuar directamente.

Ese detalle me pareció hermoso.

---

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmeuRDPMAmtUKYpiwchB2jqhCUWTeBLLdi2TxRwBMBfHS2/screenshot_20260424_185501_01.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmXdWrBAaNpcQkcMM1rnpjMw64G5t16dg7is6hPYf24i5B/screenshot_20260424_185449_01.jpg)

---

A veces la calle nos regala estos momentos inesperados, donde todo se alinea por un segundo. La luz, el movimiento y el tiempo se combinan para crear algo único.

No lo planeé, pero me alegra haberlo capturado.

Y esto es lo que comparto hoy con ustedes para este concurso.

---

Gracias a @melinda010100 por cada convocatoria de este concurso.

Gracias por todo, y declaro que las imágenes fueron tomadas con mi teléfono móvil y la traducción al inglés es gracias a Google Translate.

body.body: > Greetings everyone how are we are doing today! It another wonderful day and i welcome you all to my daily blog on the hl-w214e3. Should a person be made to pay for the opinion or belief they held in the past due to how controversial they were? An Opinion is your personal understanding of someone or something. It’s not something that everyone should agree with you on, it’s personal, Peculiar to you e.g if I makes a statement that says “ I like tall people “ it’s my personal choice it’s don’t mean that short people are bad or it’s a crime to be short , it’s just my opinion in the next few years to come it’s might change due to one thing or another , as I like tall people someone out there opinion might be that they like short people Since opinions are just your own choice understanding and preference then what is belief?

/> Belief is actually deeper, deeper than opinion, it’s a strong conviction about something or someone , you might have no prove and whether people believe the same thing or not it’s does not matter to you In the journey of life your opinion about something or someone can change easily, belief can also change but it takes time with a stronger conviction for a person’s belief to change Once upon a time I had this opinion that reading alone is better but when I tried reading with people ( joining group reading) it was also better , my opinion changed making me accepted that reading alone and with people is nice One thing that is constant in life is change . Change is inevitable. We humans grow every day we learn and unlearn each day . As people grow the way they think and act changes As we grow some of our beliefs and opinions change due to our level of intelligence exposure experience and education The way you must have thought as a child will not be the same way you will think as an adult Growth changes everything There is a verse in the Bible that says “When I was a child, I spake as a child, I understood as a child, I thought as a child: but when I became a man, I put away childish things.” Back to the question asked “should a person be made to pay for the opinion or belief they held in the past due to how controversial they were ? My Answer is No , no one should pay for his or her opinion or belief in the past Society can mould a person , religion can mould a person , friends and family can mould a person making the person to develop different views opinions beliefs and mindset different from previous life In conclusion In my own opinion the world should focus on who they are today and let bygone be bygone Thank you for the stopping and reading my blog today i really appreciate it and also looking forward for your engagements.

body.body:
<center>https://img.leopedia.io/DQmR5LzEaKAzRjdp5eFNsR8GcD8GTreWgUDFifAMWppNhj4/Portada-%20Nocturnal.png</center>

<center>To continue a week dedicated to the exploration and mastery of side-scrolling **action:**, **Steam:** joins the genre trend by giving away a **gem:** until **April 18th**, which stands out for its atmosphere and its handling of **light:**: **Nocturnal:**. For those of us who have followed the **independent:** scene closely for years, this title represents that type of **fortuitous encounters:** that only occur in the digital ecosystem; a game many of us discovered long ago in one of the Steam **demo festivals:**, being captivated by its premise, only to leave it in the inkwell of **oblivion:** until this moment, when we can finally enjoy the full experience at no **cost:** whatsoever.</center>

><center>Para seguir con una semana dedicada a la exploración y el dominio de la **acción:** lateral, **Steam:** se une a la tendencia del género regalando una **joya:** hasta el **18 de abril**, que destaca por su atmósfera y su manejo de la **luz:**: **Nocturnal:**. Para quienes llevamos años siguiendo de cerca la escena **independiente:**, este título representa ese tipo de **encuentros fortuitos:** que solo ocurren en el ecosistema digital; un juego que muchos descubrimos hace tiempo en uno de los **festivales de demos:** de Steam, quedando cautivados por su premisa, para luego dejarlo en el tintero del **olvido:** hasta este momento, cuando finalmente podemos disfrutar de la experiencia completa sin **coste:** alguno.</center>

# <center>[Nocturnal](https://store.steampowered.com/app/1634080/Nocturnal/)</center>

<div class=\

>https://img.leopedia.io/DQmdNC8CznuesEzTrxt2dNoaVfRmihjfHzpbm9qf8yAaE3N/nocturnal-1nn1b.png

[**Nocturnal:**](https://store.steampowered.com/app/1634080/Nocturnal/) is a 2D action and platforming **odyssey:** developed by the French studio **Sunnyside Games:** and published by Dear Villagers. Originally released on June 7th, 2023, the game presents itself as a technical action adventure with a **structure:** that rewards observation and **precision:**. The premise puts us in the shoes of **Ardeshir:**, a soldier of the Eternal Flame who returns to his home island, Nahran, only to find it consumed by a dark and lethal **mist:** that alters everything it touches. > [**Nocturnal:**](https://store.steampowered.com/app/1634080/Nocturnal/) es una **odisea:** de acción y plataformas en 2D desarrollada por el estudio francés **Sunnyside Games:** y publicada por Dear Villagers. Lanzado originalmente el 7 de junio de 2023, el juego se presenta como una aventura de acción técnica con una **estructura:** que premia la observación y la **precisión:**. La premisa nos pone en la piel de **Ardeshir:**, un soldado de la Llama Eterna que regresa a su isla natal, Nahran, solo para encontrarla consumida por una **niebla:** oscura y letal que altera todo lo que toca.

--- ###
A Reunion with the Past | Un reencuentro con el pasado
It is curious how a player's **memory:** works. I perfectly remember trying the **demo:** of this title at a Steam festival a couple of years ago. Back then, the fire **mechanic:** seemed like one of the most refreshing and tense ideas I had seen in a platformer, but among so many **releases:**, the title slipped off my **radar:**. Finding it again now, ready to be played from start to finish, feels like recovering a **narrative thread:** that was on pause. That spark of interest ignited by the demo can finally become a full **bonfire:** now that the final version is within our reach.
>
Es curioso cómo funciona la **memoria:** del jugador. Recuerdo perfectamente haber probado la **demo:** de este título en un festival de Steam hace un par de años. En aquel entonces, la **mecánica:** del fuego me pareció una de las ideas más refrescantes y tensas que había visto en un juego de plataformas, pero entre tantos **lanzamientos:**, el título se me escapó del **radar:**. Volver a encontrarlo ahora, listo para ser jugado de principio a fin, se siente como recuperar un **hilo narrativo:** que se quedó en pausa. Esa chispa de interés que se encendió con la demo finalmente puede convertirse en una **hoguera:** completa ahora que la versión final está a nuestro alcance.
###
Gameplay Analysis: Fire Management | Análisis de jugabilidad: La gestión del fuego
The core of **Nocturnal:** is the interaction with the **mist:**. This haze is not a simple aesthetic decoration; it is a **playable element:** that consumes your life if you remain in it without a light source. Your **sword:** is your survival tool: by lighting it in **braziers:** scattered across the map, you gain a limited time of illumination and fiery power.
>
El núcleo central de **Nocturnal:** es la interacción con la **niebla:**. Esta neblina no es un simple adorno estético; es un **elemento jugable:** que consume tu vida si permaneces en ella sin una fuente de luz. Tu **espada:** es tu herramienta de supervivencia: al encenderla en **braseros:** repartidos por el mapa, obtienes un tiempo limitado de iluminación y poder ígneo.
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=cWmxgy-o8Dg
This mechanic dictates a unique **pace:**. You must move with speed and **purpose:**, calculating how much fire you have left to cross a dark corridor or defeat **enemies:** lurking in the shadows. Combat becomes a dance of **resource management:**; you cannot simply mash buttons, as each hit from your ignited sword consumes part of that **energy:**. You must decide whether to spend your flame to burn **obstacles:**, activate ancient mechanisms, or land a critical blow on a **boss:**. It is a constant balance between **aggression:** and conservation that maintains tension at all times.
>
Esta mecánica dicta un **ritmo:** de juego único. Debes moverte con rapidez y **propósito:**, calculando cuánto fuego te queda para cruzar un pasillo oscuro o para derrotar a los **enemigos:** que acechan en las sombras. El combate se vuelve una danza de **gestión de recursos:**; no puedes simplemente machacar botones, ya que cada golpe de tu espada encendida consume parte de esa **energía:**. Tienes que decidir si gastas tu llama para quemar **obstáculos:**, para activar mecanismos antiguos o para asestar un golpe crítico a un **jefe:**. Es un equilibrio constante entre la **agresión:** y la conservación que mantiene la tensión en todo momento.
###
Artistic Direction and Sensations | Dirección artística y sensaciones
Visually, **Nocturnal:** is impeccable. The studio has managed to create an **aesthetic:** that uses dynamic lighting to highlight the protagonist's **solitude:** against the immensity of the mist. The warm colors of the **flames:** contrast beautifully with the cold, muted tones of the ruined **settings:**, creating a melancholy **atmosphere:** that fits perfectly with the story of a man seeking answers in a home he no longer recognizes.
>
Visualmente, **Nocturnal:** es impecable. El estudio ha logrado crear una **estética:** que utiliza una iluminación dinámica para resaltar la **soledad:** del protagonista frente a la inmensidad de la niebla. Los colores cálidos de las **llamas:** contrastan de forma hermosa con los tonos fríos y apagados de los **escenarios:** en ruinas, creando una **atmósfera:** melancólica que encaja perfectamente con la historia de un hombre que busca respuestas en un hogar que ya no reconoce.
|||||| |---|---|---|---|---| |https://img.leopedia.io/DQmUULotrcfQGGic3EmduSTzv3RBnL6sNj3mFvnJ9V93as8/1.jpg|https://img.leopedia.io/DQmZdVJBgZa5GGcrJ9PbNxkPhJ7v1jujo7FXtf7G1pA92z3/2.jpg|https://img.leopedia.io/DQmYDDQYDwkS56cNM4EXgXZV7X9HhiB9YUwJ5RkeR7FeEGw/3.jpg|https://img.leopedia.io/DQmRsU6iF6tmfnF8MMf9LsgaQKGncNizWtJNn1UzGx9ETdS/4.jpg|https://img.leopedia.io/DQmUQkWAnYQJFkq8sy9n9qfLjqg5aaWAH4huHDgx4QwDH9j/5.jpg|
Although the game is more linear than a traditional **Metroidvania:**, it maintains that spirit of **discovery:**. As you progress, you unlock permanent **upgrades:** that allow you to manipulate fire in new ways, letting you return to previous areas to collect **secrets:** or overcome challenges that were previously **impossible:**. The sense of **progression:** is constant and rewarding, reminding us why side adventures remain a pillar of modern **gaming:**.
>
Aunque el juego es más lineal que un **Metroidvania:** tradicional, mantiene ese espíritu de **descubrimiento:**. body.title: 'Three Billboards Outside Ebbing, Missouri': A Very Possible Reminder to Ourselves About Hate....
body.body:
>They say revenge is bad. At least where I’m from, there are even sayings explaining why it’s never a good idea. And yeah, sometimes, very rarely, doing less actually gives you more. All these ideas that might sound like empty, popular talk are perfectly reflected in Three Billboards Outside Ebbing, Missouri. A story where a mother, after going through something deeply cruel and unjust, grows tired of waiting and turns to revenge.

*\n\n*

>I wish it were as simple as I’m trying to explain it, but what really makes this film stand out is the richness of its writing. Every character matters. No one is there just to fill space. Each one plays a key role in understanding what’s happening. We’re talking about a single mother, a victim of domestic abuse, raising two teenagers. All of that builds the heavy, dark atmosphere surrounding the protagonist, played by Frances McDormand.

* ![5PXMGIYL3JBZLKN6KU6TS6FLVE.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/chris-chris92/23tbH9iCk6LMDnTNU7BdN3ja4upNJ1WfGoUMnFHceMcGRJG2sJCch93LKxLH3kTxqhVjb.jpeg) ![_99515223_043917383-1.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/chris-chris92/23wWrUSdzWCf4SeeLoy7ZBtGhDPtgCpXXg6irTJ4f8kafAghaxe1GrtbqKhDAxHKhnRb9.jpg) ![4333.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/chris-chris92/EonmR8V1Q3cTVxhZQaruEYJSmHFqf8VMdnbevFHnpdbXPEj6D2RAaMG4aMiEcXHRtQQ.jpg) ![4170.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/chris-chris92/48PwTxeoGtoMULmfksNB28KRgWvBzQq8BXS3hnmTN8DUg1Keyraz9VKBcTKUfvqFTA.jpg) Source *

>Not long after the film begins, we learn that her daughter was raped, neglected, and brutally assaulted. It all happened in a small town in Missouri, which makes the title hit harder. There are no witnesses, no leads, nothing that helps identify who committed such a horrifying act. Time passes, months go by, and despite the police department seemingly doing nothing, the story slowly reveals why the investigation hasn’t moved forward.

*\n\n*

>Between the slow bureaucracy of the police and the growing desperation of a mother who needs answers, the urge for revenge starts taking over. And right there, we as the audience are pulled into it. We don’t just watch, we judge. We question. At times, we even agree. We see how a strong personality, shaped by years of pain and hardship, begins to lose any trace of softness, replacing it with anger and a need for retaliation.

* https://youtu.be/TKVPrUggRyQ?is=1WAOwyZ6lXgH_6CF *

>Three Billboards Outside Ebbing, Missouri is powerful because it puts you in a position where you might actually agree with violence. But it’s not that simple. Nothing about it is. Every action has consequences. If you choose destruction, you can’t expect understanding or compassion in return. Fire only creates more fire. And sometimes everything spirals out of control. You lose track of where it all started, and even worse, why. So the real question is still there: does a cruel and broken system justify losing your own humanity?

*\n\nhttps://youtu.be/3aZ3r-84EQc?is=05WRr4wLEAC28GP0

body.title: 5 Minutes Free Writing - It's not that hard
body.body:
Good morning all, doing my 5 minutes free writing with prompt - It's not that hard. Hope you enjoy the story.


![images?q=tbn:ANd9GcQXetmE3IfPjLyGXqFk8-YiiVTB7XfKXvbaxXzJBsdadQ&s=10](https://encrypted-tbn0.gstatic.com/images?q=tbn:ANd9GcQXetmE3IfPjLyGXqFk8-YiiVTB7XfKXvbaxXzJBsdadQ&s=10)
[Source](https://encrypted-tbn0.gstatic.com/images?q=tbn:ANd9GcQXetmE3IfPjLyGXqFk8-YiiVTB7XfKXvbaxXzJBsdadQ&s=10)


Hard, an interesting word with multiple context when used in different situations. So when were told \

how our mind interpret the statement also largely depends on our experience or what we believe in. Today, let's take a look at some different scenarios of it's not that hard. 

When given a rock to smash against an egg and we were told it's not that hard, firstly, we will believe it's not that hard a task to accomplish. Firstly, we would all agree in term of material hardness, a rock is harder than an egg and force we need to apply to smash an egg with rock would not be a lot. 

Where else, right before an examination, if we had not been paying attention regularly in class for the semester, even when the teacher tells us, it's not that hard, without looking at the paper, we would not believe it, no physics, no measurements of material hardness, just by staring at the question and to pen down our answer on a piece of paper would consume as much energy as running 10km maybe. 

So it's not that hard really depends on the situation we receive the statement and the level of hardness varies individual to individual although they have the same value on a standard measurement system.

body.title: Bitcoin, Criptomonedas y Volatilidad en HIVEED🚀 [ESP-ENG]
body.body: /> * * * Por fin llegamos a las clases de criptomonedas. El inicio fue muy divertido, con una dinámica inesperada por los chicos, pero que les iba a enseñar un conocimiento primordial en este mundo; la volatilidad. Organicé el salón en un círculo pequeño, donde los chicos tenían que golpear globos sin dejarlos caer en el piso. Se comenzaba con un globo y se iban añadiendo más. Cada globo era una criptomoneda. La primera BTC, seguida de HIVE. Después entraban al juego ETH, SHIB, DOGE, DASH. Este fue el máximo de monedas que lograron manejar. Fue en ese momento en que una tocó el piso y se terminó el juego. Esto me dio el ambiente para explicarles, que las criptomonedas suben y bajan en precio. Algunas lo hacen más rápido, otras tienen más tiempo en el mercado, etc. Hasta el momento han sido dos clases y mi asombro es que a la mayoría los he visto muy interesados. Esto seguro se debe a qué les he contado historias asombrosas de gente que se hace millonaria. Sin embargo la advertencia es que la mayoría lo hizo con paciencia, esperando durante mucho tiempo. Aunque les conté la historia de Shiba, donde miles se hicieron millonarios en pocos meses, son cosas que pasan poco y tienen mucho que ver con la suerte. También hablamos del trading y de como es una profesión. La diferencia entre apostar y ser trader. Recalqué que quien quiere serlo debe estudiar y mucho, además de estar dispuesto a perder al principio. Bitcoin fue la protagonista. Quería que entendieran como inició todo este mundo. Además que vean en lo que Hive está inmerso y que puede ser la puerta perfecta para invertir en otros ecosistemas. Les dibujé una gráfica en la pizarra y les señalé los primeros precios, además de precios de los ATH. También les dije cuándo conocí bitcoin y a qué precio, con mi primera compra de $25 que llegaron a convertirse en 5 mil. Pero como nota más curiosa de una ganancia temprana, fue mi historia con DOGE, que tenía pocos dólares y cuando se triplicaron y llegué a tener ocho dólares en DOGE, los vendí por allá en 2019. Después Elon Musk se enamoró de eso y tuviera casi mil dólares, con una inversión de tres dólares aproximadamente. Estas historias les encanta y comienzan a tener ganas de invertir. Siempre les digo que estudien antes y que la mejor manera es publicando en Hive y ganando criptomonedas por sus talentos. Ya después pueden invertir esas criptomonedas. * * * English ======= We finally made it to the cryptocurrency classes. The start was a lot of fun, with an unexpected activity for the students, but one that was going to teach them a fundamental lesson in this world: volatility. I organized the classroom into a small circle where the kids had to tap balloons to keep them from hitting the floor. We started with one balloon and kept adding more. Each balloon represented a cryptocurrency. The first was BTC, followed by HIVE. Then ETH, SHIB, DOGE, and DASH entered the game. This was the maximum number of coins they managed to handle. At that moment, one touched the floor and the game was over. This set the stage for me to explain that cryptocurrencies go up and down in price. Some move faster, others have been in the market longer, and so on. So far, there have been two classes, and to my surprise, most of them seem very interested. This is surely because I’ve shared amazing stories of people becoming millionaires. However, the warning is that most did it through patience, waiting for a long time. Even though I told them the story of Shiba Inu, where thousands became millionaires in just a few months, those things rarely happen and have a lot to do with luck. We also talked about trading and how it is a profession—the difference between gambling and being a trader. I emphasized that anyone who wants to do it must study a lot and be willing to lose at the beginning. Bitcoin was the star of the show. I wanted them to understand how this whole world started. I also wanted them to see the ecosystem Hive is part of and how it can be the perfect gateway to invest in other ecosystems. I drew a chart on the board and pointed out the early prices, as well as the ATH (All-Time High) prices. I also told them when I first discovered Bitcoin and at what price, mentioning my first $25 purchase that eventually turned into $5,000. But as a more curious note on an early gain, I shared my story with DOGE. I only had a few dollars, and when they tripled and I reached eight dollars in DOGE, I sold them back in 2019. Later, Elon Musk fell in love with it, and that roughly three-dollar investment would have been worth almost a thousand dollars. They love these stories and are starting to get the urge to invest. I always tell them to study first and that the best way to start is by posting on Hive and earning crypto through their talents. Later on, they can invest those rewards. * * *

-Señor, ella desea té negro con leche, pero traiga la leche aparte, que ella se lo prepara a su manera. Esas eran las palabras de un amigo, quien a tono de burla, le decía a un mesonero cómo deseaba mi bebida luego de almorzar.

<center>https://images.ecency.com/DQmQbawRaSWHV7fHpcrkWMjx3CmSGnmiERagLFVNLKj4duz/2148555181.jpg</center>

[Source - Freepik](https://www.freepik.es/foto-gratis/vista-frontal-concepto-te-vertiendo-mujer_8399649.htm#fromView=search&page=1&position=6&uuid=4742696e-6d8e-460c-b084-821fd5ef40fa&query=hora+del+te)



Venía yo de vivir 6 meses en Trinidad & Tobago, un país que fuera colonia británica hasta 1969, pero que conserva muchas de sus tradiciones, como lo es tomar el te de las tardes. De hecho, como fui para esa nación en calidad de estudiante, aprender un poco de todo, más allá del idioma, era la consigna, y por eso, junto con la señora Rita, mi primera casera, adopté muchas de sus costumbres, entre ellas, el tomar té a su manera.

En mi casa materna, tomaba tés de hierbas que funcionaban para la digestión o para ayudar a dormir, pero no era usual hacerlo, más bien venían a resolver un problema, así que tomar una taza de té caliente, solo por gusto, no estaba dentro del ritual diario. 

<center>https://images.ecency.com/DQmZpnUE29WCy1UeHFoe2isBi1rjiv8oFrF68RGKjA5NjnF/5143286262985854171.jpg</center>

Para ese entonces, mamá tomaba un café en la mañana, y a veces, por las tardes cuando iba de visita a casa de alguna de sus amigas, pero los niños no eran incluidos, así que nos tomábamos jugos de frutas o gaseosas.

El té, venía siendo algo medicinal, y usualmente lo endulzaban mucho para que lo aceptáramos, pero ya luego yo decidí hacerme la valiente y retirar el azúcar, adaptando a mi paladar a tomarlo de la manera más natural posible.

Pero al irme a vivir en un país con tradiciones inglesas, tuve que volver a adaptarme, pues los desayunos en la casa donde alquilé una habitación, eran tostadas con huevos y té con leche, lo cual me parecía un tanto raro de mezclar.

Cuando entre la casera y yo se generó una confianza, ella empezó a invitarme a tomar el té a las 3 de la tarde. Era un ritual que había heredado de su madre, y que en ese entonces, ya realizaba sola, pues su hija mayor se había casado, su hijo emigrado y la única hija que le quedaba, prefería compartir con sus amigos, en lugar de estar a esa hora para acompañar a su madre.

Fue entonces cuando aprendí de ella a cómo disfrutar no solo de la bebida, sino también del ritual en sí, pues es un break tan personal, que aunque se haga entre amigas, significa un tiempo fuera de todas las actividades cotidianas, un bajarle a la ansiedad y poder compartir contigo misma un tiempo para no hacer más nada que tomar esta bebida.

<center>https://images.ecency.com/DQmaCTcRRaLmeHmiqXxqUDnS68PWicPVf4oLsNbpjDDZoiZ/5143286262985854173.jpg</center>

Quizás originalmente tuvo otro significado, pero para mi ese fue el que le di, pues era muy entretenido ver a la señora Rita con su pava eléctrica llena de agua caliente, colocar todo en la mesa del comedor: tazas con platito, cucharitas, una cajita con bolsitas de te negro, una jarrita con leche líquida y un pote pequeño con leche en polvo.

Su manera de prepararlo, que yo adopté por muchos años era: colocar la bolsa del té en la taza, agregar agua caliente hasta llenar los 3/4 de la taza y luego incorporar 1/4 de leche fría. Aunque ella colocaba una azucarera, ninguna de las dos le agregaba azúcar, y listo!

<center>https://images.ecency.com/DQmfUZCBSFFpjHtVEujnvg3kWhA5fJgoHZ5akV5tFB4GFXw/5143286262985854172.jpg</center>

La leche en polvo era opcional, en algunos casos, luego de colocarle leche líquida, le ponía una o dos cucharadas de leche en polvo para que no quedara tan líquido, y yo luego de probarlo, quedé encantada con el extra que le daba a la bebida, por lo que también lo hacía.

Al volver a Venezuela, mantuve por muchos años la costumbre, y mientras mamá tomaba café, yo lo hacía con el té. Con la crisis que se sobrevino muchos años después, el té negro ya no se encontraba, así que lo sustituía por cualquiera que fuera similar, inclusive el té verde, que todavía sigo tomando agregando 1/4 de leche fría, para recordar esos momentos de soledad y compañía con la señora que me alquiló una habitación en su casa, pero que quedó siendo mi \

para siempre.

<center>https://images.ecency.com/DQmapDaBHAmccS3hiBKm1q962yVu4WUSJfngZcJWc7k5Cm5/5143286262985854216_1_.jpg</center>

<center>https://images.ecency.com/DQmcMNxZLX3nyQd4z3z36B8GmMQ8e8PN44qLnocC8hsWu8u/separador_ingles.png</center>

-“Sir, she’d like black tea with milk, but please bring the milk on 
the side—she’ll make it her own way.” Those were the words of a friend, who, in a teasing tone, was telling a waiter how I liked my drink after lunch.

I had just spent six months in Trinidad and Tobago, a country that was a British colony until 1969 but which retains many of its traditions, such as afternoon tea. In fact, as I went to that country as a student, the aim was to learn a bit of everything, beyond just the language, and so, together with Mrs Rita, my first landlady, I adopted many of their customs, including drinking tea their way.

At my mother’s house, I used to drink herbal teas that helped with digestion or to aid sleep, but it wasn’t a regular habit; rather, they were taken to solve a specific problem, so having a cup of hot tea just for the pleasure of it wasn’t part of the daily routine. 

<center>https://images.ecency.com/DQmZpnUE29WCy1UeHFoe2isBi1rjiv8oFrF68RGKjA5NjnF/5143286262985854171.jpg</center>

Back then, Mum would have a coffee in the morning, and sometimes in the afternoons when she went to visit one of her friends, but we children weren’t included, so we’d have fruit juices or fizzy drinks.

Tea had always been something medicinal, and they usually sweetened it a lot so that we would accept it, but later on I decided to be brave and leave out the sugar, training my palate to drink it as naturally as possible.

But when I went to live in a country with English traditions, I had to adapt all over again, as breakfast at the house where I rented a room consisted of toast with eggs and tea with milk, which I found a rather odd combination.

Once my landlady and I had built up a rapport, she began inviting me for tea at 3 o’clock in the afternoon. It was a ritual she had inherited from her mother, and which, by then, she carried out on her own, as her eldest daughter had married, her son had emigrated, and her only remaining daughter preferred to spend time with her friends rather than be there at that hour to keep her mother company.

It was then that I learnt from her how to enjoy not only the drink, but also the ritual itself, as it is such a personal break that, even when shared with friends, it means a time away from all daily activities, a chance to ease anxiety and to spend time with yourself doing nothing but drinking this beverage.

<center>https://images.ecency.com/DQmaCTcRRaLmeHmiqXxqUDnS68PWicPVf4oLsNbpjDDZoiZ/5143286262985854173.jpg</center>

Perhaps it originally had a different meaning, but for me that was the one I gave it, as it was great fun to watch Mrs Rita with her electric kettle full of hot water, setting everything out on the dining table: cups with saucers, teaspoons, a little box of black tea bags, a small jug of liquid milk and a small pot of powdered milk.

The way she made it – which I followed for many years – was to place the tea bag in the cup, add hot water until the cup was three-quarters full, and then top it up with a quarter of cold milk. Although she would put a sugar bowl on the table, neither of us ever added sugar, and that was it!

<center>https://images.ecency.com/DQmfUZCBSFFpjHtVEujnvg3kWhA5fJgoHZ5akV5tFB4GFXw/5143286262985854172.jpg</center>

Powdered milk was optional; in some cases, after adding liquid milk, she would add a spoonful or two of powdered milk so it wouldn’t be quite so runny, and after trying it, I was delighted with the extra flavour it gave the drink, so I did the same.

When I returned to Venezuela, I kept up the habit for many years, and whilst Mum drank coffee, I did the same with tea. With the crisis that struck many years later, black tea was no longer available, so I replaced it with whatever was similar, including green tea, which I still drink today with a quarter of a cup of cold milk, to remember those moments of solitude and companionship with the lady who rented me a room in her house, but who remained my ‘Mommy Rita’ forever.

<center>https://images.ecency.com/DQmapDaBHAmccS3hiBKm1q962yVu4WUSJfngZcJWc7k5Cm5/5143286262985854216_1_.jpg</center>

body.title: Proteger tu identidad en Web3
body.body:
<center>
![1000926385.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/aliento/245cVwQ4Zu4bPtvd5XrXVNDnEjrZfptvU3Uhhr87o4nXQbKD3JxDesCgg2yADDQL8tfSg.png)

</center>

---

<div class=text-justify>

¡Saludos, comunidad!

Cuando hablamos de seguridad en Web3, muchas veces pensamos solo en llaves o accesos. Pero hay algo igual de importante y de cual no podemos dejar de hablar en este mes de abril: **tu identidad**.

Y no solo hablamos de quién eres dentro del ecosistema, sino también la información personal que decides compartir denteo y fuera de él.

<center>![17770716734297748330880250389947.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/aliento/EoEjFUZhAvvnHRTt412VSgak1mTBn2L3k6ZB41nHxxffMJKuXTRt4AzQunsucX3SMgw.png)</center>

#### En Web3, proteger tu identidad va más allá de tu usuario o cuenta, implica cuidar:

👉🏻 **Tus datos personales:**

Evita compartir documentos de identidad, números telefónicos o información sensible en espacios públicos o con personas que no conoces realmente.

Este es un error que lamentablemente, solemos ver en introducciones de nuevos usuarios o publicaciones donde hablan de temas relacionados.

👉🏻 **Tu privacidad:**

Se llama privacidad por una razón. No todo necesita ser compartido. Ser consciente de lo que publicas, también es una forma de protegerte.

Proteger tu privacidad es un derecho, pero también la privacidad de otros lo es. Así que tampoco publiques la prividad de terceros.

👉🏻 **Tu imagen (y la de otros):**

Tu imagen es parte de tu identidad digital. No debería ser utilizada sin tu consentimiento y lo mismo aplica hacia los demás.

Evita compartir o reutilizar imágenes de otras personas sin permiso, especialmente cuando se trata de menores de edad.

👉🏻 **Protección de niños y adolescentes:**

Si eres padre, madre, familiar o incluso parte de una comunidad, es importante ser responsable con el contenido que involucra a menores.

No se trata solo de lo legal, sino también de lo ético: proteger su identidad, su imagen y su entorno digital.
<sub>(Leáse: [Convencion de derechos del Niño y Adolescente](https://www.unicef.org/es/convencion-derechos-nino))</sub>

👉🏻 **Uso de inteligencia artificial:**

Hoy en día, muchas herramientas permiten usar imágenes para generar contenido e incluso es una \

. Pero antes de usarla, pregúntate: ¿Estoy cuidando mi identidad? ¿Sé cómo se utilizará esta información?
![17770716734297748330880250389947.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/aliento/EoEjFUZhAvvnHRTt412VSgak1mTBn2L3k6ZB41nHxxffMJKuXTRt4AzQunsucX3SMgw.png)
En Proyecto Aliento creemos que la seguridad en Web3 no es solo técnica, también es personal. Proteger tu identidad, tu privacidad y la de otros, es parte de construir un entorno más consciente y respetuoso. Antes de publicar o compartir algo hoy, haz una pausa: ¿Estoy protegiendo mi información? ¿Estoy respetando la privacidad de otros? Porque cuidar tu identidad, también es cuidar tu camino en la Web. --- || |:-:| |

En el contexto de trabajo, pueden acosarte o difundir rumores sobre ti que te perjudican, en el contexto de pareja o familiar, te pueden maltratar psicologica o fisicamente. \nHay contextos donde si dices sí, te humillan y si dices no, igual te humillan o te explotan. Hay tienes el caso de los japoneses que son explotados por sus jefes hasta el agotamiento, y que cuando se niegan les impiden obtener ascensos, aumentos de sueldo o los despiden. body.title: When Overthinking Stops You but Courage Moves You
body.body:
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmXQrcPbR813DYWr4nXnKajaTRE4Sc7XpQGVnaH1s6avPT/1777049952831.jpg)

Sometimes a strange thing happens in life.
A person sits quietly, thinking about something important. He plans, calculates, compares risks, and imagines every possible outcome. His mind works like a machine, analyzing every small detail. Hours pass, days pass, sometimes even years pass… and still he stands in the same place.
Meanwhile, somewhere else, another person who doesn’t think as much simply takes a step forward.
And surprisingly, that person reaches the other side of the river.
This thought came to my mind when I read a short line: “When the mind searches for the ocean, the mad one crosses the river.” At first it sounds poetic, but if you think about it deeply, it reflects a very real truth about human nature.
In our lives we often believe that intelligence alone will take us to success. We believe if we think more, plan more, and analyze more, then our decisions will become perfect. But life does not always reward perfect thinking. Sometimes life rewards bold action.
I remember a small example from my own surroundings. A young man from our village once wanted to start a small business. Many people advised him not to do it. They told him the market was unstable, money could be lost, and failure would be embarrassing. He listened to everyone, thought about it for weeks, and almost gave up.
Then one day he simply said, “Let me try.”
He started with very little money and almost no experience. At first things were difficult. There were mistakes, losses, and moments when he probably questioned his decision. But today that same small effort has turned into something stable for him.
Looking back, I realized something simple: if he had waited for the perfect moment, that moment would probably never have come.
This is the difference between thinking and doing.
Of course, wisdom is important. No one is saying we should act blindly in every situation. But there is a point where thinking becomes overthinking, and overthinking slowly becomes a cage. The mind keeps searching for a bigger and bigger ocean of certainty, while the opportunity in front of us quietly disappears.
The “mad” person mentioned in the line is not truly mad. It simply refers to someone who is brave enough to move while others are still calculating the depth of the water.
Life is full of rivers like that.
Sometimes it is the river of starting something new. Sometimes it is the river of expressing our feelings, changing our path, or trusting our own abilities.
Many people spend their entire lives standing on the shore, measuring the current and predicting the waves.
And a few people just cross.
Maybe the real wisdom in life is learning when to think and when to move. Because if we only think, we remain where we are. But if we gather a little courage and take that step, we might discover that the river was never as deep as we imagined.
And sometimes, the person people call “crazy” today becomes the one everyone admires tomorrow.
