body.title: FAROFA ¿Para hacer arepas? [ESP-ENG]
body.body: >¡Hola, querida comunidad de Hive Food! Hoy paso por aquí con un post diferente y con mucha curiosidad, porque quiero probar algo nuevo que me tiene bastante emocionada. Como muchos saben, vivir en otro país a veces implica adaptarnos a lo que conseguimos en el mercado, y aquí en Brasil hay muchísimos productos interesantes. Uno de ellos es la famosa farofa, un acompañante muy típico que forma parte de muchas comidas brasileñas.\n\n

>Hello, dear Hive Food community! I’m stopping by today with a different kind of post and a lot of curiosity, because I want to try something new that has me pretty excited. As many of you know, living in another country sometimes means adapting to what’s available at the market, and here in Brazil there are so many interesting products. One of them is the famous farofa, a very typical side dish that’s a staple of many Brazilian meals. ***

>Desde hace tiempo tenía la idea de experimentar con ingredientes locales para recrear sabores de casa, y justo una compañera de trabajo me dio una recomendación que no pude dejar pasar. Ella me comentó que ha usado farofa para hacer arepas y que, aunque no es un sustituto exacto de nuestra querida harina de maíz venezolana, el resultado queda bastante bueno. Según ella, las arepas salen ricas, con una textura diferente, pero igual de disfrutables.\n\n

>I’d been thinking for a while about experimenting with local ingredients to recreate the flavors of home, and a coworker gave me a tip I couldn’t pass up. She told me she’d used farofa to make arepas and that, although it’s not an exact substitute for our beloved Venezuelan corn flour, the result turns out pretty good. According to her, the arepas come out delicious, with a different texture, but just as enjoyable. ***

>La verdad es que conseguir harina de maíz aquí no siempre es fácil, y cuando aparece suele ser importada y bastante costosa. Por eso, esta alternativa me pareció interesante, sobre todo para quienes estamos en Brasil y queremos darnos un gustico sin gastar tanto. Así que decidí poner a prueba esta idea y ver por mí misma qué tal funciona.\n\n

>The truth is, it’s not always easy to find cornmeal here, and when it is available, it’s usually imported and quite expensive. That’s why I found this alternative interesting, especially for those of us in Brazil who want to treat ourselves without spending too much. So I decided to give this idea a try and see for myself how well it works. ***

>Les confieso que es mi primera vez usando farofa para hacer arepas, así que este experimento lo vamos a vivir juntos. Voy a compartirles el proceso, algunos tips que vaya descubriendo en el camino y, por supuesto, una opinión completamente honesta sobre el resultado final. La idea es que este contenido pueda ayudar a otros que, como yo, extrañan esos sabores tan nuestros y están buscando opciones más accesibles. Así que si sienten curiosidad o simplemente quieren ver cómo termina este intento, quédense conmigo en este post. Vamos a ver si esta mezcla inesperada logra acercarnos un poquito a nuestra querida cocina venezolana.\n\n

>I have to admit that this is my first time using farofa to make arepas, so we’re going to go through this experiment together. I’ll share the process with you, some tips I discover along the way, and, of course, a completely honest opinion on the final result. The idea is that this post can help others who, like me, miss those flavors that are so uniquely ours and are looking for more accessible options. So if you’re curious or just want to see how this experiment turns out, stick with me in this post. Let’s see if this unexpected combination manages to bring us a little closer to our beloved Venezuelan cuisine.
![Agregar un título - copia.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jennyzer/246bBGhEC9TtP8swjaNomKPg1UXPTxubmohfu2kPKMpurRaGnycqDvvy8bGpTYAo42yfG.png)
![5s4dzRwnVbzGY5ssnCE4wXzkeAEXyVtgk1ApQTwHMTp6y5PvEo1yennAPsP4d1LBcvF2DN3NXZV48rEfAv7dqbHwZ9WVDFeovGGCFS3NFrLH323BeNdzWpmKmaSHcNPhF6CspuXXhxaiNef2NqqCST3NFz7tDvYs9x8GsYq.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jennyzer/23tcNngg6kuZLr17voRDC8Nooj7bozWrLKoEWH9DLG2ogVpYdA2m37W8SwsE5b3RM1rRc.gif)
![Agregar un título - copia.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jennyzer/246bBGhEC9TtP8swjaNomKPg1UXPTxubmohfu2kPKMpurRaGnycqDvvy8bGpTYAo42yfG.png)

>https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jennyzer/23vhrytk8hK3ARH2ssoEP94fD8f4ye72CkhDeYejs486NhTSrT9tCnFMiMWgJBAVfN2fD.jpg¿Qué es la farofa? La farofa es una comida típica de Brasil hecha principalmente con harina de yuca (mandioca) tostada. Es seca, suelta y a veces un poco crujiente. Desde que llegué a Brasil he notado que los brasileños la usan mucho como acompañante de otras comidas, por ejemplo con arroz, frijoles, carne o pollo. También le pueden agregar ingredientes como mantequilla, huevo, tocino o verduras para darle más sabor. Les gusta mucho porque es fácil de preparar, combina con casi todo y le da una textura diferente a la comida. Además porque hay de diferentes sabores, unas de bacon, otras cebolla crujiente, incluso banana frita. Yo no la consumo mucho, la verdad, pero ahora me dio curiosidad y la voy a probar para hacer arepas, como mencioné al principio, está recomendación de mi compañera de trabajo, ha generado mucha curiosidad en mí. > What is farofa? > Farofa is a traditional Brazilian dish made mainly from toasted cassava flour. It’s dry, crumbly, and sometimes a little crunchy. Since I arrived in Brazil, I’ve noticed that Brazilians use it a lot as a side dish with other foods, such as rice, beans, meat, or chicken. They can also add ingredients like butter, egg, bacon, or vegetables to give it more flavor. They really like it because it’s easy to prepare, goes well with almost everything, and adds a different texture to the meal. Plus, there are different flavors—some with bacon, others with crispy onions, and even fried plantains. I don’t eat it very often, to be honest, but now I’m curious and I’m going to try it to make arepas. As I mentioned at the beginning, this recommendation from my coworker has really piqued my curiosity. *** #### PASO A PASO: > STEP BY STEP:

>https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jennyzer/Eoc91187WV59NDNwtDpXSmPut4vnUjp7BuTSjDXGXfvbdLpyxV5SSNieDJ9y2VvJ9BT.jpgSegún recomendación de mi amiga puede la farofa de la marca que quieran, blanca o amarilla, pero, dato importante; debe ser una farofa natural, sin ningún otro sabor agregado. Al tener la farofa el primer paso es colocar en un bol y añadir agua, no tengo cantidades exactas, pero no debe ser en exceso, al menos debe llegar al mismo nivel de la farofa, está agua se agrega para hidratar la farofa, dejen hidratar por unos 10 minutos. > As my friend recommended, you can use any brand of farofa you like, white or yellow, but here’s an important tip: it must be plain farofa, with no added flavors. Once you have the farofa, the first step is to place it in a bowl and add water. I don’t have exact measurements, but don’t add too much—it should at least reach the same level as the farofa. This water is added to hydrate the farofa; let it soak for about 10 minutes. ***

>https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jennyzer/23w2q3wwjGyasZQ4aNGRtUpJtx2x1DMc67Yw5yTFYc7cCdxHLyfqnb9CQeSqidW9GbRxE.gifComo segundo paso vamos a amasar, en este paso verificamos si necesita más agua y añadimos sal al gusto, como parece una masa de harina común para hacer arepas. ###### Obs: Estaba asombrada, no tenía mucha fe. > Next, we’ll knead the dough. During this step, we’ll check if it needs more water and add salt to taste, until it resembles the dough typically used to make arepas. ###### Note: I was amazed—I didn’t have much faith in it. ***

>https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jennyzer/EogPkfBzwWAbws6MaJEkcPGKmB2wDzY7Ksh1SnzgKnc5gGYEnZScFGscPwe6ATGy4AJ.jpgEn este paso dejé reposar unos minutos, solo para que la masa tomara más cuerpo, que estuviera más firme, también para comprobar si es como la harina, como saben al hacer arepas con harina de maíz, cuando dejamos pasar tiempo la masa endurece. > At this stage, I let it rest for a few minutes, just so the dough would firm up a bit and become more solid, and also to see if it behaves like flour—as you know, when making arepas with cornmeal, the dough hardens if you let it sit for a while. ***

>https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jennyzer/EoiUENRdQLuvr1MeNhFBJQ3wtLKxKABEZ46sETtRB3R7NdCTXQKybVRbw5EnugHA8JK.jpgAhora es tiempo de armar las arepas y cocinar, lo hice como normalmente cocinaría una arepa, calenté el sartén, añadí un poco de aceite, y coloqué mis arepas de farofa. > Now it's time to assemble the arepas and cook them. I did it just as I normally would: I heated the skillet, added a little oil, and placed my farofa arepas in it. ***

>https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jennyzer/Eoc67P1fmTFxu1VxgKc3PNfQU5nHTFv5LaaQWZ5MNydcxDj3E1GUKduge6SKT6ixPxD.jpgEn este paso noté que se cocinan más rápido que una arepa normal, así que deben cocinar a fuego medio, estar muy atentos a dar vueltas, a estar doradas en cada lado estarán listas. > Now it's time to assemble the arepas and cook them. I did it just as I normally would: I heated the skillet, added a little oil, and placed my farofa arepas in it.
![Agregar un título - copia.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jennyzer/246bBGhEC9TtP8swjaNomKPg1UXPTxubmohfu2kPKMpurRaGnycqDvvy8bGpTYAo42yfG.png)![Agregar un título - copia.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jennyzer/246bBGhEC9TtP8swjaNomKPg1UXPTxubmohfu2kPKMpurRaGnycqDvvy8bGpTYAo42yfG.png)

>Honestamente quedaron decentes, si bien no es nuestra arepa deliciosa hecha de harina de maíz con esa textura que amamos, está es una opción buena para matar un antojo a un precio accesible, una harina puede costar en Brasil unos 4$, mientras que una farofa cuesta menos de 1$ el kilo, la textura es diferente, es más cremosa, el sabor se acerca bastante, pero tiene un toque ahumado que no puedo descifrar, en resumen; me gustó y las volveré a hacer cada vez que no tenga para invertir en una harina.\n

>Honestly, they turned out pretty good. While they’re not our delicious cornmeal arepas with that texture we love, this is a good option for satisfying a craving at an affordable price. A bag of cornmeal can cost around $4 in Brazil, while farofa costs less than $1 per kilo. The texture is different—it’s creamier—and the flavor is pretty close, but it has a smoky note I can’t quite place. In short, I liked them, and I’ll make them again whenever I can’t afford to buy flour.
![IMG_20260422_175352.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jennyzer/23w2wed9vB5ZdqSnK6c1vKUzCytu79v7BqX5HmWiNbBWAkBRbCDxdemy6TfbuHALP5SaM.jpg)
![Agregar un título - copia.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jennyzer/246bBGhEC9TtP8swjaNomKPg1UXPTxubmohfu2kPKMpurRaGnycqDvvy8bGpTYAo42yfG.png)
![5s4dzRwnVbzGY5ssnCE4wXzkeAEXyVtgk1ApQTwHMTp6y5PvEo1yennAPsP4d1LBcvF2DN3NXZV48rEfAv7dqbHwZ9WVDFeovGGCFS3NFrLH323BeNdzWpmKmaSHcNPhF6CspuXXhxaiNef2NqqCST3NFz7tDvYs9x8GsYq.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jennyzer/23tcNngg6kuZLr17voRDC8Nooj7bozWrLKoEWH9DLG2ogVpYdA2m37W8SwsE5b3RM1rRc.gif)
![Agregar un título - copia.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jennyzer/246bBGhEC9TtP8swjaNomKPg1UXPTxubmohfu2kPKMpurRaGnycqDvvy8bGpTYAo42yfG.png)

>https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jennyzer/23vsSXeTpqgRrbXjhfyAGoLDyz4Qd7rt4MTy5BkCBBWqse1vrsU38gDqT3PTCYidfhAAv.gifEn conclusión, probar la farofa brasileña para hacer arepas fue una experiencia diferente y bastante interesante. No esperaba mucho al principio, pero la verdad es que el resultado me gustó. El sabor se acerca un poco al de las arepas tradicionales, sobre todo por lo tostado, aunque claramente no es lo mismo. No reemplaza una arepa hecha con harina de maíz, pero sí puede ser una opción decente cuando no tienes los ingredientes de siempre. Me pareció una idea creativa y útil, especialmente para quienes estamos en Brasil y buscamos adaptarnos con lo que tenemos a la mano. A veces toca inventar un poco en la cocina, y este tipo de pruebas valen la pena. No queda igual, pero se defiende bastante bien y puede sacarte de un antojo. Me gustaría saber tu opinión: ¿qué te pareció esta idea?, ¿la probarías? Y si estás en Brasil, dime si te animarías a hacer arepas con farofa. Gracias por llegar hasta aquí. > In conclusion, trying Brazilian farofa to make arepas was a unique and quite interesting experience. I didn’t expect much at first, but I actually liked the result. The flavor is somewhat similar to that of traditional arepas, especially because of the toasted taste, although it’s clearly not the same. It doesn’t replace an arepa made with corn flour, but it can be a decent option when you don’t have the usual ingredients. > I thought it was a creative and useful idea, especially for those of us in Brazil who are trying to make do with what we have on hand. Sometimes you have to get a little creative in the kitchen, and experiments like this are worth it. It doesn’t turn out exactly the same, but it holds its own pretty well and can satisfy a craving. > I’d love to hear your thoughts: what did you think of this idea? Would you try it? And if you’re in Brazil, let me know if you’d be willing to make arepas with farofa. Thanks for reading this far.
![Agregar un título - copia.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jennyzer/246bBGhEC9TtP8swjaNomKPg1UXPTxubmohfu2kPKMpurRaGnycqDvvy8bGpTYAo42yfG.png)

body.body:
Happy Friday, Actifit family! ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/7a461624-c425-41d3-996b-59f6259b051d.jpg) What an incredible day for outdoor activity! I managed to rack up 11,343 steps today while exploring some beautiful green spaces and enjoying the perfect spring weather. There's something truly special about combining fitness goals with nature appreciation, and today was a perfect example of that harmony. Morning Energy & Peak Performance Looking at my activity chart, I can see that my most active periods were around midday and early afternoon, with some impressive peaks reaching over 700 steps per hour. This is when I decided to take advantage of the beautiful weather and head out for an extended walk through the park. The fresh air, blooming trees, and scenic pathways made every step feel effortless and enjoyable. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/655f1a99-e068-4a82-9fb2-04b32189953a.jpg) The Beauty of Spring Walks The photos I captured today tell the story better than words can. <div class=\

> ***Hello #Needleworkmonday***. Happy Friday! I'm stopping by today to share this beautiful granny square, made with two colors. I love how eye-catching yet simple it is. Here are the details on how to make it.
ESPAÑOL

***Hola #Needleworkmonday***. Feliz viernes, hoy paso por aca para compartir este hermoso granny square, usando dos colores, me gustó por lo llamativo y sencillo a la vez. Paso a dar detalles para su elaboración.

---
#### Step by step//Paso a paso
---
#### Materials//Materiales:
---

> - Beige, white, green, and yellow cotton yarn. - Size 2 crochet hook
ESPAÑOL

- Hilo de algodón beige, blanco, verde, amarillo. - Aguja crochet Nº 2

![WhatsApp Image 2026-04-24 at 5.31.23 PM.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/multifacetas/23wgHutayH3FrfwfsNUw2LRpFew5atWuQxtmjmDEZPT6hxmifp5vKCUVcz3rxYjUnBTZB.jpeg) ---
#### Abbreviations//Abreviaciones:
---

> ch: chain(s). mp: half point. mpa: half high point. pad: double treble crochet. pat: triple treble crochet. aum: increases. dism: decrease. pa: high point. pr: slipped stitch.
ESPAÑOL

ch: cadena(s). mp: medio punto. mpa: medio punto alto. aum: aumento. dism: disminución. pa: punto alto. pad: punto alto doble. pat: punto alto triple. pr: punto deslizado.

---
#### Process//Proceso:
---

> #### Beige. - R1: Magic ring, 3 ch, dc, 2 ch, repeat seven times, fasten off. Tie off, cut yarn. #### Green. - R2: 3 ch, 4 dc, repeat in each space, fasten off. #### Beige. - R3: Pick up a loop, 1 dc inserted between the two dc of R1, repeat seven more times, sl st. - R4: Corner: 3 ch, 2 dc, 2 ch, 3 dc, 6 dc, repeat, sl st. Fasten off, cut, and weave in ends. Each square measures 6 x 6 cm.
ESPAÑOL

#### Beige. - v1: Anillo mágico 3 chs, pa, 2 chs,repetir siete veces, pr. Anudar, cortar hilo. #### Verde. - v2: 3 chs, 4 pa, repetir en cada espacio, pr. #### Beige. - v3: Tomar lazada, 1 pa insertando entre los dos pa de la v1, repetir siete veces mas, pr. - v4: Esquina: 3 chs, 2 pa, 2 chs, 3 pa, 6 pa, repetir, pr. Anudar, cortar y ocultar hilo. Cada cuadrado mide 6 x 6 cm.

body.title: 18 April 2026, Freewriters Community Daily Writing Prompt Day 3077: prevalence of lying
body.body:
/>  
[Pixabay](https://pixabay.com/photos/search/false/)

Though not always noisy, it is all around. Most of it is surface, almost innocuous. \

when someone hasn't even left. a smirk masking annoyance. One made only to prevent a fight. Though they develop a habit, these items don't sound like major falsehoods.

People lie for several causes. Other times it is terror. Worry about consequences, anxiety about losing anything, worry of being viewed differently. Sometimes it's merely convenience. The truth can be difficult, chaotic, and distressing; a lie can be quick and neat. Thus people select whatever feels most convenient right now.

However, it comes at a subdued price. The more lying becomes normal, the more difficult it is to separate fact from fiction. Trust starts to erode progressively, not all at once. You start doubting events you once took for granted. Words get smaller. Because it is present in the same space as everything else, even honesty begins to sound dubious.

There is also the sort of self-deception one uses. That one sinks deeper. Persuading yourself you are okay when you are not. Ignoring matters needing attention. When it clearly matters, acting something does not matter.

And possibly the fundamental problem is how usual lying has grown rather than that it exists.

![1000263828.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmTP3itufYFfuofmnseWe6zbTq5ZgbuxoDuNshZM4pXQ2T/1000263828.jpg)
# * #### Paso 2 **

>Luego pase a hacer la mezcla de azúcar y mantequilla,400 gramos de azúcar porque el resto es para más adelante,y la mantequilla,y mezcle todo bien. Después le agregué la mezcla de claras de huevo y removí pero no mucho,ya después le agregué las yemas y la vainilla y seguí mezclando pero poco a poco para que no se pierda el volumen.** > * #### Step 2 > Next, I made the sugar and butter mixture—400 grams of sugar, because the rest is for later—and the butter, and mixed it all well. Then I added the egg white mixture and stirred it, but not too much. After that, I added the egg yolks and vanilla and continued mixing, but little by little so as not to lose volume. ---
![1000263943.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmQpv5U926USyK3tXfMh4hCMukTUd2E6j37CTp854qEvmB/1000263943.jpg)
![1000263944.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmfKvxpaTqC5Me2E8pWpDasWXJ1p54cqFPL6EFJxns3X7j/1000263944.jpg)
![1000263945.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmYVWLsjd9pho9A5LhftCjMGhBhMvsAB4ABJZ64AnjowmY/1000263945.jpg)
# * #### Paso 3 **

>Ya aquí en este paso, coloque la harina,el cacao y el polvo de hornear en un colador para tamizar y que no se haga grumos,y al mismo tiempo agregué la leche y el café que es para que la mezcla de chocolate quede más oscuro y un poco amargo.** > * #### Step 3 > At this stage, place the flour, cocoa, and baking powder in a sieve to sift and prevent lumps, and at the same time add the milk and coffee to make the chocolate mixture darker and slightly bitter. ---
![1000263855.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmPL32rydP4zpw1fbURaFJnLGoYha252YSLsjF9CqDkoBN/1000263855.jpg)
![1000263856.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmXGHh5Mu7SPSXxWbcg3CTYQBkKVHT52j4mqm53hAsJrDV/1000263856.jpg)
![1000263858.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmaV54huvQjPLK82jy9M7XURqViCJLHjqTSXecYmYksypw/1000263858.jpg)
# * #### Paso 4 **

>Ya cuando tenía la mezcla de los ponquesitos lista,acomode los capacillos en el mode de ponquesitos,y entonces agregué la mezcla en cada uno dejando un límite para que cuando se estén horneado no se vayan a botar.Los coloque al horno en fuego medio como a unos 5-6 minutos.** > * #### Step 4 > Once I had the cupcake batter ready, I arranged the cupcake liners in the cupcake pan, and then added the batter to each one, leaving a border so they wouldn't overflow while baking. I placed them in the oven at medium heat for about 5-6 minutes. ---
![1000263869.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmPauRCthdfpWcfYQqe5HmGu4seswte5FjfNRzHFcNdGYA/1000263869.jpg)
![1000263868.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmXTPV7xas86Y1pQqGpQbLVW11fcuD8RLzTL74gZjK6A8T/1000263868.jpg)
![1000263876.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmdWMntgrKU7hs7Mqp239tjLYrDdSnzXww56gqdnZj2qFS/1000263876.jpg) ![1000263890.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmWPiU38PkZ8XV52aYbtjUUT9MPQ3s8NuboWt6u9Ty2GsU/1000263890.jpg)
# * #### Paso 5 **

>Cuando ya estaban los Ponquesitos listos los dejé enfriar,y mientras me puse a hacer la mezcla de la cubierta, entonces coloque en una olla la Maizena,la azúcar restante,la leche y el cacao y empecé a remover a fuego bajo hasta que se volviera una mezcla espesa. Luego pase a colocar en cada ponquesitos la cubierta de chocolate y luego chispas de chocolate.** > * #### Step 5 > Once the cupcakes were baked, I let them cool. While they were cooling, I started making the topping. I put the cornstarch, the remaining sugar, the milk, and the cocoa powder in a saucepan and stirred over low heat until it thickened. Then I spread the chocolate topping on each cupcake and sprinkled it with chocolate chips. --- #
Resultado/Result
 #
![1000263891.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmRBmRE62CndLa4Kn2GRQQuZ22z6A5VTXTQQNwNhwqq27a/1000263891.jpg) ![1000263890.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmWPiU38PkZ8XV52aYbtjUUT9MPQ3s8NuboWt6u9Ty2GsU/1000263890.jpg) ![1000263876.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmdWMntgrKU7hs7Mqp239tjLYrDdSnzXww56gqdnZj2qFS/1000263876.jpg)
# *

>Y así mismo amigos quedo lista está dulce elaboración de ponquesitos,espero les sirva la idea para empezar un pequeño emprendimiento o para hacer para merendar y compartir con amigos y familiares o para reuniones especiales. Gracias a todos por haberme acompañado en el día de hoy en este post 👋* # > And so, friends, this sweet cupcake recipe is finished! I hope this idea inspires you to start a small business, make cupcakes for afternoon tea and share with friends and family, or for special gatherings. Thank you all for joining me today for this post 👋 --- # *

body.body: ![Hive-Banner-Green-Rounded.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23tGM7REKBsvoBhPiEV5Fvb8tb333qQ8N9x2YfxaF9vWohE9Qf39RUEAn3LfysdgfbYpZ.png) ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23swY1SJijRvUyTXadQzZdxrbHPEg3bhwUH5Ha71Az1EVsufJ3GqtYTKCQcedWbhXumvs.png) ![IMG_20260422_101353228.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/24328yFLG2e2XAQ6fWjK4oWP4f1ESWdeR1GomFDsEh6yvXp6gveej1ZMZk3WWhDfA2k46.jpg) ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23swY1SJijRvUyTXadQzZdxrbHPEg3bhwUH5Ha71Az1EVsufJ3GqtYTKCQcedWbhXumvs.png) >I live naked and barefooted, very close to Earth and Nature, in an 18-acre, off-grid, clothing-optional, food-forest intentional community ([GaiaYoga Gardens](https://gaiayoga.org)), way out in the jungles of Lower Puna, far East Big Island, Hawai'i, and I have for more than 7 years now. Although there are many challenges, I love my life, and I'm immensely grateful to live where and how I do, on my own terms! I would not want to live any other way! 😁🙏💚⚡💥🔥✴️✳️❇️👣🌱✨🤙 ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-3.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23t6vW6aH5DR2YDkVqNYUx8BexWwy9N6Z5spVSE48QJrgFzyfjAip7syeyq3K4RmyypRS.png) ``` Hive Debt: 23.29% HIVE Fiat-Dollar Price: 0.062 USD HBD/HIVE-Backed Dollar Fiat-Dollar Price: 0.994 USD ALIVE SWAP.HIVE Price: 0.04528511 SWAP.HIVE HEARTBEAT ALIVE Price: 0.07144735 ALIVE BLURT Fiat-Dollar Price: 0.00121473 USD QORT Fiat-Dollar Price: 0.153255 USD VOI Fiat-Dollar Price: 0.000175 USD BTC/Bitcoin Fiat-Dollar Price: 77,585.15 USD BCH/Bitcoin Cash Fiat-Dollar Price: 456.63 USD LTC/Litecoin Fiat-Dollar Price: 56.61 USD Gold Fiat-Dollar Price: 4,706.00 USD Silver Fiat-Dollar Price: 75.84 USD Ranking for Our @aliveandmmb Witness Node: #130 (among all witnesses, including inactive)/#102 (among active witnesses only)/462.4k HP in votes/48 votes in total ``` ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-3.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23t6vW6aH5DR2YDkVqNYUx8BexWwy9N6Z5spVSE48QJrgFzyfjAip7syeyq3K4RmyypRS.png) Warm greetings all! 😁🙏💚✨🤙 My research, exploration, and experimentation with different AI agents and AI-agent-builder frameworks continues, with successes, setbacks, much greater understanding, and notably more clarity about what I'm attempting to implement on my Arch/Artix Linux systems. As with pretty much everything in the open-source and Linux-BSD communities, there are so many different ways to do things, and I'm still in the phase where I'm figuring out the best means of accomplishing my desired AI-agent goals, and there's still a whole lot to learn and explore. ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23swY1SJijRvUyTXadQzZdxrbHPEg3bhwUH5Ha71Az1EVsufJ3GqtYTKCQcedWbhXumvs.png) ![IMG_20260422_143855367_HDR.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23ycu84MEaEkAdCQMGALqkkBrZ66Dqo41fvn1qmij51FgcNAx5LVE6GpKxs7AqpHuv5CE.jpg) ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23swY1SJijRvUyTXadQzZdxrbHPEg3bhwUH5Ha71Az1EVsufJ3GqtYTKCQcedWbhXumvs.png) ![IMG_20260422_144009112_HDR.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23tvCUfT9Urh5bp48Nz7CpmqrNFXdCnkHyuzAF7PuvW5vuNNQVKgzPkKFSsWxB99mZpNP.jpg) ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23swY1SJijRvUyTXadQzZdxrbHPEg3bhwUH5Ha71Az1EVsufJ3GqtYTKCQcedWbhXumvs.png) Basically, in the simplest terms, it's a hierarchal multi-agent system that has a primary orchestrator/supervisor AI agent, that via a chatbot interface, is able to asset my typed or spoken input, and then effectively and efficiently organize and coordinate a plan of action for various specialized worker AI agents, or a multi-agent crew, to collaboratively work together to complete the goal or task at hand, with the whole system being able to learn, adapt, and improve as it progresses through time. That is a very advanced implementation, which is exactly why I'm still frying my brain, and researching like a mad man, to figure out how to do this in practical terms. ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23swY1SJijRvUyTXadQzZdxrbHPEg3bhwUH5Ha71Az1EVsufJ3GqtYTKCQcedWbhXumvs.png) ![IMG_20260422_144222564.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23vsC5VCXkBUGTbeEFwKEpmWfmehm3NvwAj7PdDJyMesPuvcDppgWERH41FKWWQhxQepG.jpg) ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23swY1SJijRvUyTXadQzZdxrbHPEg3bhwUH5Ha71Az1EVsufJ3GqtYTKCQcedWbhXumvs.png) ![IMG_20260422_144415408.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23vsDe6Bir3opdydv4H52oavybWZz7YCzRB4pp64EamrYpRw7GmcjcCvr5LUUkXDwSX6N.jpg) ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23swY1SJijRvUyTXadQzZdxrbHPEg3bhwUH5Ha71Az1EVsufJ3GqtYTKCQcedWbhXumvs.png) If we work with single AI agents, we are the orchestrator/coordinator/supervisor, but in a hierarchal multi-agent system, there is a special orchestrator/supervisor AI agent that handles information assessment, organization, coordination, planning, and task delegation to an assortment of specialized AI agents that excel in particular areas, like coding, troubleshooting, web searches, among many others. With the present frameworks, it's very easy for just about anyone to get individual specialized AI agents set up and running on their computers. Setting up hierachal multi-agent systems is a bit more involved, of course, though still very doable. ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23swY1SJijRvUyTXadQzZdxrbHPEg3bhwUH5Ha71Az1EVsufJ3GqtYTKCQcedWbhXumvs.png) ![IMG_20260422_144520291.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23xKrLtqwPNW4e3tmGVJHeWEsWUrVYwVvCnY8hcfWQxJc6TYhh3RHwEP7Q3kYxgHiLyMv.jpg) ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23swY1SJijRvUyTXadQzZdxrbHPEg3bhwUH5Ha71Az1EVsufJ3GqtYTKCQcedWbhXumvs.png) ![IMG_20260422_144602951.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23vsDf5k4L7Yw3nctYcvUdesrxuK3CWxbasVDLFwFdqaUxmpNDTibjxMPYtoAcm29w4tk.jpg) ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23swY1SJijRvUyTXadQzZdxrbHPEg3bhwUH5Ha71Az1EVsufJ3GqtYTKCQcedWbhXumvs.png) My present podman container-pod setup, while it does simplify many things, also adds another layer of complexity regarding interconnection and communication between containers in a pod, so I'm still figuring out whether this is the best way to go about things, or whether something simpler might also work. The tabs and tab groups in my browser are multiplying quite quickly in my focused researching frenzy, and the available space on my SSD is dwindling equally as rapidly, which means that I've got to get a handle on all this soon indeed, so that I may clear away all that is unnecessary. ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23swY1SJijRvUyTXadQzZdxrbHPEg3bhwUH5Ha71Az1EVsufJ3GqtYTKCQcedWbhXumvs.png) ![IMG_20260422_144935050.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23xVMJb9QR1fPQfatS5FKKaEUZaF7JfVy7P9Uh8Pc7zvzD6Qx421umk3zKUffWxeDXGwF.jpg) ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23swY1SJijRvUyTXadQzZdxrbHPEg3bhwUH5Ha71Az1EVsufJ3GqtYTKCQcedWbhXumvs.png) ![IMG_20260422_145205609.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23vsHsTFBDwvo28z8ebrxiNEn35x3jez57XREETJzXYY7kyBvoJ7ktpitS6TTknHZ44pV.jpg) ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23swY1SJijRvUyTXadQzZdxrbHPEg3bhwUH5Ha71Az1EVsufJ3GqtYTKCQcedWbhXumvs.png) One idea that I just had was to set up a few specialized AI agents, say for web searches, coding, and troubleshooting, and then to use them to help implement this hierachal multi-agent OS management system that I'm envisioning. I rather like that idea, as it would allow me to use the tools that I have available, to build increasingly better tools. Hrmmm... ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23swY1SJijRvUyTXadQzZdxrbHPEg3bhwUH5Ha71Az1EVsufJ3GqtYTKCQcedWbhXumvs.png) ![IMG_20260422_145224989.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23uEyoQrUcK6TKh4QttWMbLaCxPTkzHNZqyyXwb1e8y78es2trf3AVCL97wN3b4TZG9Wj.jpg) ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23swY1SJijRvUyTXadQzZdxrbHPEg3bhwUH5Ha71Az1EVsufJ3GqtYTKCQcedWbhXumvs.png) ![IMG_20260422_145346373.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23wC1UJubsrGHqSbNS4eoyjX4AbqRjBQCAWwuTbF9PaY5587jTnKSJ9wVZ6YHHvhVVzDS.jpg) ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23swY1SJijRvUyTXadQzZdxrbHPEg3bhwUH5Ha71Az1EVsufJ3GqtYTKCQcedWbhXumvs.png) Yesterday, Thursday, I left the Flow House, after finishing up my Hive-Blurt-'We Are Alive Tribe' tasks, by around 2:30PM, giving my attention first to some photography for my posts, and then to a a few small jungle-community tasks. Once all that was completed, I took a quick break up at the Flow House, then I traversed the property, to go assist in a work party down near Melekai's place, to dig out a future pond. We got a huge amount done, we moved some massive lava rocks, and I got a very good workout, by the time we finished. From there, I trekked across the property again, to take a shower, make myself some food in Wabisabi, and with that and my jar of leftover superfood fire coffee in hands, to head back to the Flow House to begin my evening Hive tasks. I got through all my notifications by just after 10PM, and after some asset management, and more AI-agent research, I went to bed by just after 12:30AM. I woke up just after 8AM, having slept fairly well, going to prepare my superfood fire coffee in Wabisabi, then returning to the Flow House to do more AI-agent research, and to write this post. It's now just before 1PM, so it's a very good time indeed to wrap this up, so that I may attend to my few other important Hive-Blurt-'We Are Alive Tribe' tasks, before preparing for a session that's scheduled for 1:30PM. I deeply appreciate y'all so very much! Until tomorrow's edition of these posts! ***Always forward, onward, upward, and whaleward, ho, together we go!*** 😁🙏💚✨🤙 ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23swY1SJijRvUyTXadQzZdxrbHPEg3bhwUH5Ha71Az1EVsufJ3GqtYTKCQcedWbhXumvs.png) ![IMG_20260422_145431967_HDR.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23tbnPUPg952Gp3DvWQRBEDFt9WtVVqF65RAsSh1FFUiLxicgz9fNhFbi2uSzpA9YwGYc.jpg) ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23swY1SJijRvUyTXadQzZdxrbHPEg3bhwUH5Ha71Az1EVsufJ3GqtYTKCQcedWbhXumvs.png) ![IMG_20260422_145625802_HDR.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23wMSHQsar4M1JeAjovUxmdSxYGXDXDY7JJtQfKQrqeKoC7BBHyrEEXerNs35fLqjPT52.jpg) ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23swY1SJijRvUyTXadQzZdxrbHPEg3bhwUH5Ha71Az1EVsufJ3GqtYTKCQcedWbhXumvs.png) ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-3.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23t6vW6aH5DR2YDkVqNYUx8BexWwy9N6Z5spVSE48QJrgFzyfjAip7syeyq3K4RmyypRS.png) ### 2026 Life Goals ``` 1.) Do regular integral practices again, alone or with others. 2.) Prepare regular batches of my medicinal teas collected from the land again. 3.) Make my plant nursery, and the gardens, beautiful again. 4.) body.title: My Birthday at Route 79: The Secret Lies in Their Pork Ribs and Grill  - Yaracuy [En-Es]
body.body:
![12.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/neruel/EoK5uPNbfsn6y8M27VUvHZwqMiwfyKJnnQRUnqaQWoGJHLNHnbRTtycJm6GR1uXqreJ.jpg)
On March 25th, to celebrate my 29th birthday, the plan was to visit a traditional Venezuelan restaurant called Route 79. This restaurant is located on the Cimarrón Andresote Highway, in Cambural, Yaracuy State, Venezuela—about 30 minutes from Barquisimeto. # For my birthday, I wanted to eat traditional Venezuelan food. At first, I considered Italian cuisine, but that option didn’t work out. The main reason I wanted local food was because I was craving carne en vara.
| | | | |---|---|---| |https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/neruel/242NeX5iFAZykecMhoPRLpfmwyVgz6VvqkK8bw3NzSokmvRTEHmrBCjwmsPAEuWccJFdY.jpg|https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/neruel/242hQ8dftoxN86YWuJnaUhBRQGN3Aeauh73sQ3Twf1d9bZ6iAk8uqvLcBn1Aed1a3FemQ.jpg|https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/neruel/23zknQtTcm8qxMY9y638kNfsdcqVvnjPmmYf2i69UzeCoeW8kEgi4PFg7XXkfembvNKiE.jpg|

> # We arrived at the restaurant after 1:00 p.m. (Venezuelan time). I found out about Route 79 through reviews and videos on social media. The building has a rustic, countryside-style design, with many decorative elements from the 1980s. The theme is very pleasant. #
![23.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/neruel/23y8siwcNf88CPMpFDbCu2QpacvqsZR5hyGG7JUEjKRV6VPFNn6q4YNu7egLvqRDET7gi.jpg)

> # In front of the restaurant, there was an area where they usually grill carne en vara, but it wasn’t operating that day (they only use it on weekends). The restaurant has two areas: an open-air space and an indoor area with air conditioning. We chose the air-conditioned section due to the high temperatures currently affecting Venezuela. # | | | | |---|---|---| |https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/neruel/23x171kJnXZKjGPsoZGB3645BPoGXPRnc2QKhmmgwKp95GvbtN4WaeBFawQm36h51T9qi.jpg|https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/neruel/23wqnaDSkujcXoZSUtvy8ym7YoB2NH63QGCTburKJhcLwFuFrzPmyEuSJ7sqsyp6TjvMn.jpg|https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/neruel/241tSVVG63JuFNhgVSfuFzfoaxMooaTccVHCYk14rWS1Acb7BqrzvRcAnvB7rpGLmHve1.jpg|

> # The waiter was very kind. He recommended where we should sit and suggested several dishes. He even apologized when he found out I wanted carne en vara, which wasn’t available that day. I went to the restaurant with my brother, my mom, and my uncle. # | | | | |---|---|---| |https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/neruel/23xAXW9PyCV1XSZF1buyRvtiJLsAPR6zY7ZXHQtS5ia1XaZZE9gWr7Uv6DPgUPoQHGtpi.jpg|https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/neruel/23xyRCqtr8wHkgZZPYH39HrgnPwUx7iLY6FJPHrXB5f3DZz33yMBjvViUdUqNCatGPcKw.jpg|https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/neruel/23xAa7ZeEuC2wtSRJNVWa84qN9VEtjHTFV1dH1VQijLSdop4Q3bRSGNJx1WWnX855Crh5.jpg|

> # At first, I was reluctant to try something different. However, the waiter recommended a cut of meat marinated for 48 hours and carefully grilled. He even brought a sample for us to taste at the table. He also suggested smoked pork ribs and the house grill platter called “Parrilla Route,” which we could see on the menu while we talked. #
![1.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/neruel/Eoc74qci2TbP1nVzwg5zxKMjEPBEoVsKDqwYeGCNDufoSLhb7hBpoNrFaTuFa7JW6Ef.jpg)

> # After tasting the 48-hour marinated meat, we decided to order 150 grams of that cut, along with smoked ribs and the house grill platter. For drinks, we ordered beer—since Zulia wasn’t available, we went with Solera. While waiting for the food, we talked about the experience and how my mom felt about returning to Venezuela during this period. She was surprised by how fast time had passed—after all, I had already turned 29. # | | | | |---|---|---| |https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/neruel/23vhwa2rQe4Wf16eK5CZKnpP2yYCuSfkQggHnUUDG6PDcUxcxjC51mt2or4qvWJXch6aU.jpg|https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/neruel/23xVCugc9AFe3CtqKs9sTtmhpr2ztjBmGnXUYjZfvoQs4ad56zdhHTer17vZWuUic98e3.jpg|https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/neruel/23wC7Z9t56cXwEdgv8oSoDws1RetrTL6ayaeSSeRHFdLWvaN4dqzdeexNJVFnrgUjnacD.jpg| | | | | |---|---|---| |https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/neruel/23tmBGQHMsNMt9fPSBCoE5MW1yjNbwaPfiKC1uR2G66s3SiSuAbDAopiLvzmfML8hh5DA.jpg|https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/neruel/23tveakCbSa1RNquNtRiMgYLGjfQLX58DPThEpP3zYiuuAqP3vP2jqDcaU3NyiQ7WaEMG.jpg|https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/neruel/23u62hpTaffQC9gAJKGQxayMeQGS4aZKTqU9LHht4FuzeFwCXnmV5z4BMFWKfRXjsPZG1.jpg|

> # Time flew by, and soon the waiter arrived with the grill, along with sauces, salad, and the portions of meat and smoked ribs. We were impressed by the size of the grill—it was huge, covering almost the entire center of the table. It was the first grill I’ve had in Venezuela that wasn’t overloaded with fried plantains (tostones) and boiled cassava. #
![13.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/neruel/EoEq61mxPKojj6oH8obSSwfcNWkYQSGo8chBb6RxHaRB9gxyN4DzF33twUsgo5AKsdg.jpg)

> # The variety of meats on the grill was abundant: it included chorizo, chistorra, pork cuts, chicken, and sweet arepas. The presentation was good, and the tower-style arrangement was impressive. It felt like a lot of food. It might not have looked perfectly organized, but it was definitely very appetizing. #
![5.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/neruel/EoChCXZjCsBZwtFmJpsrto2hYggAREmD1NGKXQKr8VDydceFRTwFXPjJsQBgs8aTbAL.jpg)

> # I really liked how the ribs and the 48-hour marinated meat were served. They were delicious and juicy. Both the pork ribs and the meat were incredibly tender and melted in your mouth. Deep down, I thought I should have ordered more of those cuts. #
![6.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/neruel/EoChcyXgu6EXQCZQ5AvaaEgAZR16vWPL1vd5pTzZMXEPMLzqmJFH1q8uDFFpcPSajeu.jpg)

> # Route 79 is one of those restaurants that wins you over with its service, its traditional Venezuelan food, and the way they prepare their meats. For my 29th birthday, it was the right choice. I truly enjoyed it, and I hope that if you ever visit Venezuela, you get the chance to come here and experience the flavors of the country for yourself. With love, Neruel. # Original content by @neruel. All rights reserved ©, 2026. Images: Samsung Galaxy A54. English translation and grammar correction: ChatGPT – DeepL – LanguageTool.
SPANISH VERSION (click here!)

> Mi cumpleaños en Route 79: el secreto está en sus costillas de cerdo y su parrilla - Yaracuy > > # > > El 25 de marzo, para celebrar mi cumpleaños número 29, el plan era ir al restaurante de comida criolla Route 79. Este restaurante se encuentra ubicado en la Autopista Cimarrón Andresote, Cambural, estado Yaracuy, Venezuela. Es decir, a unos 30 minutos de distancia desde Barquisimeto. > > # > > Para mi cumpleaños quería comer comida criolla venezolana. Al principio, pensé en comida italiana, pero esto no fue una opción. La razón principal de querer comer comida criolla era debido a la carne en vara. Tenía antojo. > > # > > Llegamos a este restaurante después de la 1:00 p. m., hora de Venezuela Supe de Route 79 por reseñas y videos en redes sociales. El diseño del edificio es rústico, pero también campestre. Hay muchos elementos decorativos de los años 80. La temática es agradable. > > # > > Frente al restaurante estaba un área donde ponen la carne a asar, pero ese día no estaban funcionando (entre lunes y viernes no las prenden, solo sábado y domingo). El restaurante tiene dos áreas, una abierta y otra cerrada con aire acondicionado. Elegimos la que tenía aire debido a las altas temperaturas que hay actualmente en Venezuela. > > # > > El mesero de este restaurante fue muy amable. Nos recomendó dónde sentarnos y cada uno de los platos que podíamos ordenar. Me pidió una disculpa al saber que quería comer carne en vara y no tenían disponible ese día. AL restaurante fui con mi hermano, mi mamá y mi tío. > > # > > Estaba un poco negado a comer algo diferente; sin embargo, el mesero me recomendó un corte de carne marinado por 48 horas y asado delicadamente. Trajo un corte para que lo probáramos en la mesa. También nos recomendó comer costillas de cerdo ahumadas y la parrilla de la casa llamada: Parrilla Route en el menú. Todo esto lo pude visualizar en el menú mientras conversábamos. > > # > > Probamos la carne que tenían 48 horas marinando y decidimos entre todos ordenar 150 gramos de ese corte y de costillas ahumadas junto a la parrilla. De tomar, ordenamos cerveza; no había marca Zulia, por lo que nos tocó optar por las soleras. Mientras esperábamos la comida, hablábamos de la experiencia y de cómo se sentía mi mamá al retornar a Venezuela por este periodo de tiempo. Ella se sorprende porque el tiempo pasa muy rápido y ya había cumplido 29 años. > > # > > El tiempo pasó y el mesero trajo la parrilla, junto a los aderezos, la ensalada y los trozos de carne y costillas ahumadas. Estábamos impresionados por el tamaño de la parrilla, ya que era inmensa. Cubría casi por completo el centro de la mesa. Es la primera parrilla que me como en Venezuela que no está llena de tostones sofritos de plátanos verdes y yuca hervida. > > # > > La proporción de cortes de carne en la parrilla era abundante; tenía chorizo, chistorra, cortes de cerdo, pollo y arepas dulces. La presentación era buena; además, la forma de torre impresionaba. Creo que era mucha comida. Puede que la presentación no se vea ordenada, pero al verlo provoca demasiado. > > # > > Me gustó cómo sirvieron la costilla y el corte de carne preparado durante 48 horas. Estaba delicioso y jugoso. Tanto la costilla de cerdo como la carne se disolvían en la boca fácilmente. Internamente, pensé que debí ordenar un poco más de estos cortes de carne. > > # > > Router 79 es uno de esos restaurantes que te envuelven por su atención, por la comida tradicional venezolana y la manera en la que cocinan la carne. Para mi cumpleaños número 29 fue la opción correcta. Lo disfruté; espero que puedas venir algún día a este restaurante y sentir personalmente el sabor de Venezuela. Con cariño, Neruel. > > # > > Contenido original de @neruel. Todos los derechos reservados ©, 2026. Imágenes: Samsung Galaxy A54. body.body:
> Happy Friday, citizens of Praetoria! We have reached the final weekend of April, and I couldn't let it pass without sharing my latest progress regarding Lands! In my previous posts, I mentioned that I was already planning to acquire a fourth plot of land to manage. Rather than simply buying another NFT, acquiring a plot in Splinterlands represents a long-term investment that requires constant analysis of resource prices—specifically identifying which resources are the most valuable and have the lowest production costs. Currently, the resource I am focusing on producing and accumulating the most is Stone, which—as you can see in the chart—has experienced a significant uptick over the last two months. > Feliz viernes ciudadanos de Praetoria! Estamos ante el último fin de semana del mes de abril y no podíamos dejarlo pasar sin compartirles mis últimos avances en lo que respecta a Lands! En mis publicaciones anteriores les había comentado que ya estaba planificando conseguir una cuarta tierra que gestionar, más que simplemente comprar un NFT más, adquirir una parcela en Splinterlands significa hacer una inversión a largo plazo que requiere de un constante estudio del precio de recursos, cuales son los más valiosos y tienen un menor coste de producción. Actualmente el recurso que más estoy trabajando y acumulando es piedra que como pueden ver en el gráfico ha tenido un repunte estos últimos 2 meses.
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bulkathos/23sweHqWsRui7mzsEevyHFFTZvT9P7GeCy53XkVwx7A1B86Y9SUTxBEPas3s7GK5zquC8.png)

> Let's start with the plot I’ve just received: it is located in the Great Lowlands territory—the very region where my two primary stone quarries are situated. The difference this time is that I am adding a plot dedicated to producing Grain, which will be used to support any future quarries I acquire on the market down the road. > Comencemos por la parcela que acabamos de recibir, se trata de una parcela en el territorio de Great LowLands, el punto donde tengo mis 2 principales canteras de piedra, solo que en este caso sumamos una parcela que producirá grano para las futuras canteras que consiga en el mercado más adelante.
![New Grain Plot.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bulkathos/Eo6BmAJJ96Aftmbfm1JsTtyXzBRPt5nYDq1Vt7AwQwoLeTxWrBg2LVPFFg2SBG6mkWt.png)

> This particular plot is going to take me quite some time to develop; it didn't come with any pre-existing buildings, so we will have to start practically from scratch. For the moment, I’m fine with that, as I need to carefully plan out the workers I intend to purchase. Since this plot's biome is *Plains*, I will need to either buy—or arrange to have delegated to me—workers from the Life and Dragon classes. > Esta parcela si que me va a tomar bastante tiempo levantarla, no vino con edificios por lo que tendremos que comenzar prácticamente desde cero. Por el momento me parece bien, ya que necesito planificar los trabajadores que pienso comprar, pues el bioma de esta parcela es plains así que tengo que comprar o conseguir que me deleguen trabajadores de la clase vida y dragón.
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bulkathos/23vsJNuwR3xWhtmAQTGzDZvhZD4DqXvdWdhJfZ29t3DH78fRbbRehnc3Nbn2ZaTWNN4hs.png) --- ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bulkathos/23wC5YzCTHziW2PuCubak9PGtXWURGpkmkjVmdQs8MEdfETEuXvurhUivxDwEcK8fEA1m.png)

> The first obstacle to overcome is activating the land itself; to do this, you need a *Power Core*—or, if you were fortunate enough to purchase one back when they were available, a *Runi*. My budget only allowed me to afford a *Power Core* at a price of 5,000; I had to sell off several in-game assets and various Layer 2 tokens to purchase it, but taking this step is absolutely crucial if you want to begin working on your land plot. > El primer obatáculo a superar es activar el terreno, para ello necesitas un Power Core o si lograste comprarlo en su momento, un Runi. Nuestro presupuesto solo nos permite costear en Power Coreen 5000 tuve que vender algunos activos del juego y varios tokens de segunda capa para comprarlo pero este paso es decisivo si quieres comenzar a trabajar tu parcela.
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bulkathos/Eo1vQku6QBZezUuJ6a14B1iUwJdNAdeW97B7nWEvuPqDDc5m6t6FEnMjSDi4XfYcJp6.png)

> Next, we slot the *Power Core* into place, and we are then ready to put our workers to work. However, this brings us to the second obstacle: ensuring you possess a sufficient quantity of *Dark Energy Crystals* (DEC) for each worker. If you want to utilize them at their maximum potential, you must keep in mind that each worker consumes 10,000 DEC to be locked in at the highest level. This means that you must hold 50K in DECs in liquid form if you wish to have workers producing at the maximum level on your plot. > Posteriormente colocamos el Power Core en su lugar y ya podremos poner a trabajar a nuestros trabajadores, pero aquí sobreviene el segundo obstáculo y se trata de tener la suficiente cantidad de Dark Energy Crystals (DEC) para cada trabajador. Si los quieres poner al máximo, entonces debes considerar que cada uno de ellos consume 10K en DECs si los quieres bloquear al máximo nivel. Eso significa que debes tener de forma líquida una cantidad de 50K en DECs si deseas tener trabajadores en el máximo nivel produciendo en tu parcela.
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bulkathos/23tbMAzMPsswdv9m6kdNHwP6icQ289RUzxZPPvCM8UEzxwewjiq9pSxNVLvyLg2cUWqN9.png) --- ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bulkathos/23tGZdjq5HsZNPiA8Tu7Aj4Pnf75oD2V4Z1umyBfyqFxCGKDSF7161wvdmKA4X2Jz5cFH.png)

> In my case, I only possessed max-level Dragon cards—specifically the regular foil versions—since my Gold Foil cards (which belong to the Life Splinter) are already locked in, working on a plot in the Hamford lands. As I currently hold only 10,000 liquid DECs, I was able to assign just one max-level regular Dragon card to the task. This constitutes a rather meager workforce for establishing a grain farm; however, given my limited resources, we can only wait out the necessary period—a little over a month and a half. This timeframe should be sufficient to acquire the required amount of DECs, as I anticipate having no trouble securing efficient, max-level workers. > En mi caso solo tenía cartas dragón al máximo nivel pero de lámina regular, ya que las doradas que son de clase vida ya las tengo bloqueadas trabajando una parcela en las tierras de Hamford. Como solo tengo 10K en DECs líquidos solamente pude poner a trabajar 1 carta dragón regular al máximo nivel. Es una fuerza laboral bastante pobre para levantar la granja de granos, pero en vista de que no tengo más recursos solo podemos esperar el tiempo de poco más de mes y medio. Es tiempo suficiente para conseguir la cantidad de DECs necesarios ya que creo que no tendré muchos problemas para conseguir trabajadores eficientes al máximo nivel.
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bulkathos/23x12W4vSABR5kpXLgc6Ztjrb1gjYERHW7ETC6LoToFPC1skeE9jmbt9917MFnaiR57Sw.png) --- ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQme1LPj6nViw7c3qT65KbYAdBoGft3yHdoJYLK6sBnUghW/land_making.gif)
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bulkathos/23tGc5TBZahtQxh1wAu15zaE7Js9Dn9f1qGMZHGYztPaXpZq9KyNyXsR8CGAsbkeFp4Sx.png)
# Plot Production/Producción de Parcelas

> While our second grain plot is under construction, we will continue to accumulate our primary resource: stone. However, before harvesting that output, we must first gather the crop from our grain plot in Hamford in order to feed the workers stationed at our quarries. > Mientras se va construyendo nuestra segunda parcela de granos, continuaremos acumulando nuestro recurso principal, que es la piedra, pero antes de recoger esa producción, debemos comenzar por recoger la cosecha de nuestra parcela de granos en Hamford para alimentar nuestros trabajadores en las canteras.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmcFHujouTofQbbYDEe2B64wTgEDriaBCre38aVvkU4VLe/cosecha_com_n_19_4_26.gif)

> With the harvest from that grain plot, we have sufficient supplies to collect all the stone produced this week in Bredaine and Oxborough—which happen to be my best plots, classified as Rare and Epic, respectively. Once my second grain plot is fully operational, I hope to possess enough capital to acquire two additional high-quality quarries in the Great Lowlands—specifically in the Oxborough region. > Con la cosecha de esa parcela de grano tenemos suficiente para recolectar toda la producción de piedra generada esta semana en Bredaine y Oxborough, es tas son las mejores parcelas que tengo, rara y épica respectivamente. Una vez que tenga la segunda parcela de grano produciendo espero tener capital suficiente para adquirir 2 buenas canteras más en Great Lowlands, principalmente en Oxborough.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmecUFHkdD7vwLaPwidkuwagLywsrS1kXD272gaKny1oNU/cosecha_rara_19_4_26.gif) --- ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmPb8gw3jj2JXiuH8piXCChamWrtZDZGGDGb7ubTh4sKfm/cosecha_epica_20_4_26.gif)

> We have now accumulated nearly 477K in stone resources; this is equivalent to 50K DEC in value. In other words, the stone alone could theoretically provide the DEC required to activate the workers for the second grain farm. However, I have other plans for all the stone I am currently stockpiling. For the time being, I will focus on accumulating DEC through the rental and sale of cards, as well as the sale of skins and totem fragments. I believe that within a month and a half, I will be quite close to reaching a balance of at least 40K DEC, given that I have already generated nearly 10K DEC to date by selling and renting out cards. > Ya casi tenemos 477K en recursos de piedra, eso es el equivalente en Decs a 50K en Decs, es decir que podríamos tener solo con la piedra el Dec necesario para activar los trabajadores para la segunda granja de grano. Pero tengo otros planes para toda esa piedra que estoy acumulando, por lo pronto iré acumulando DECs a partir del alquiler/venta de cartas, venta de skins y fragmentos de totems. Creo que en mes y medio ya estaré bastante cerca de tener al menos 40 K en Decs ya que en este momento he generado casi 10K en DECs vendiendo y alquilando cartas.
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bulkathos/23tGTqsDqwZpNpoh6KWp3XapHS3qoh4Txc1Y5R9UQV2GP8kXtXjSheuQ9fqR1h9VXKmyg.png)
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bulkathos/23tkjb2WkDjvStGX6oQK6dKcZhJjsDDCymUZatKiZTxbtRFV4QW7RSUZ8ZRCSdasqHdmi.png)
# My Foundations Pack Results for the Week/Resultados de mis packs Foundations en la semana

> We remain active in *Frontiers*! Last Monday, we obtained an Arcane Gold Foil card; this time, we hope to repeat that win—we’ve already accumulated 39 tokens and counting. But we can't forget about the packs that come with every daily reward. So far, I’ve opened 12 Foundation packs, and I’ll show you the results below. > Continuamos activos en Frontiers! El lunes de la semana pasada conseguimos una carta lámina dorada arcana, esta vez esperamos repetir premio, ya tenemos acumulado 39 fichas y contando. Pero no podemos olvidar los packs que vienen con cada recompensa diaria. Hasta ahora he abierto 12 Foundation packs y los resultados te los muestro a continuación.
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bulkathos/23tS32NHAbqwkKEXEF4gNpGXnXUKUaQh7Xg2iycCr1Nn5b9CwGWjKxELEgwfzSjGqa8HF.png)

> To date, we’ve acquired two Legendary cards. Although we’ve already maxed them out, we can put them up for sale to try and purchase the cards we’re interested in—primarily the Epic cards from the Water and Life Splinters. These Epic cards are widely used at the top tiers of the Gold League, and if I want to maintain my standing there, I need to acquire them as soon as possible. > Hasta el momento hemos conseguido 2 cartas legendarias que aunque ya tenemos al máximo, podemos ponerlas a la venta para tratar de comprar las cartas que nos interesan, que son principalmente las épicas de agua y vida. Estas cartas épicas son muy utilizadas en lo más alto de la liga de oro y si quiero mantenerme allí necesito tenerlas lo más pronto posible.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmWdNLxYoJFiBJWizXinU2bDMfsJEWfnLAmhjBR6VEjzJL/open_foundation_pack_21_4_26.gif)|![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmdLSTByCA8G7Kott18gHS6MeVKN1sEb2SuSytNgHWiDsf/open_foundation_pack_23_4_26.gif) --|-- --- ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmW4PJfod6p3UtcKg4ZqUeGzEDRSCqqnr3v66XxcEM9j56/open_foundation_packs_19_4_26.gif)|![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmUnVFfnbGZV1siRXrdgX893XFMVs1iV6nHDjfHYd29v3F/open_foundation_packs_20_4_26.gif) --|--

> The last Common card I still need to level up is Spinetail Fiend. This Death card is a melee unit, yet it lacks any abilities that would allow it to attack from the second row. However, when rulesets like Super Sneak, Equal Opportunity, or Maneuvers come into play, this card becomes incredibly important. That is why I was so pleased to pull several copies of this card over the past week; I am now just one copy away from reaching the maximum level. > La última carta común que me falta por subir de nivel es Spinetail Fiend, esta carta de muerte es melé pero no cuenta con habilidades que le permitan atacar desde la segunda fila. Pero cuando aparecen rulesets como super sneak, equal opportunity o maneuvers, esta carta gana mucha importancia. Por eso celebro que me hayan salido varias de estas cartas en la semana, ahora ya estoy a solo 1 copia del máximo nivel.
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bulkathos/23yTS9bM2xYvSuAWcydQiZmxDQ8EKPG6KCuckXSRTXYvdCo2Q4D5K4FV34uSFqXKyoRGo.png)

>\n\nNext up is the Wild Horse Tamer card. I previously owned a Gold Foil version of this card at Level 2, but—precisely to acquire the DEC needed to purchase a Power Core for my land plot—I had to sell it. Consequently, I am now practically starting from scratch with this card, although it is not one I use very often in battle. Finally, we have Lady Amara—another one of those Epic cards that I struggled significantly to obtain by opening packs. She gains a substantial amount of Health at Level 3, effectively transforming her into a sort of \

for those battles restricted to Ranged or Magic units only. > Luego tenemos a la carta Wild Horse Tamer, esta carta la tenía dorada en nivel 2 pero justamente por conseguir Decs para comprar el Power Core para la parcela tuve que venderla, ahora estoy prácticamente desde cero con esta carta, aun que no es una que use mucho en batalla. Por último tenemos a Lady Amara, otra de esas cartas épicas que me han costado mucho en conseguir abriendo packs, gana mucha vida en nivel 3 lo que la convierte en una especie de tanque mágico para esas batallas de solo rango o solo unidades mágicas.
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bulkathos/23yTUedPhm9K5gmB5Ef7ojkHiScvdqLSr7UhqoKAyFX7ZycitJGCWFfbSoXRLRv6A5noK.png) --- ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bulkathos/23ywgMy9FGDiUXs8cTgEC7rdXKbKjpub3NzgUamx8Nk6KXrs5ikM9vtzoohTmfosTRdqc.png)
![CA_sponsor_3-removebg-preview.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bulkathos/23uQg3JZZhaHueQ3ENG7eSxpfY8zpdMJ9njueZYmaxumfq5v5rfwBEMvwzzAY9o2MUZqy.png)

> Well, friends, that wraps up this Lands and Foundations report! The future looks quite promising for Splinterlands; we are seeing more and more how the Lands expansion is becoming increasingly integrated into the core game experience. I hope to see the introduction of new craftable cards—or, better yet, artifacts—that can offer strategic advantages on the battlefield. While we wait for that future to arrive, accumulating land plots and boosting our production remains the top priority right now on the continent of Praetoria. See you in the next Lands and Foundations report! Best regards! > Bien amigos, con esto cerramos este reporte de Lands y Foundations! El futuro parece bastante optimista en Splinterlands, cada vez vemos más como Lands se integra cada vez más en el juego principal, espero que aparezcan nuevas cartas crafteables o mejor artefactos que puedan ofrecerte ventajas en el campo de batalla. Mientras esperamos que ese futuro llegue, ir acumulando parcelas y aumentando nuestra producción es la prioridad hasta el momento en el continente de Praetoria. Nos vemos en el próximo reporte de Lands y Foundations. Saludos!

It never shows itself. It neither warns nor gives you time to get ready. It just happens, quietly, and then it's gone before you fully comprehend what it meant.

Sometimes it's a little thing. Sitting in a typical place, hearing a giggle that lingers longer than anticipated. Watching someone walk away and understanding without stating it aloud, that things will never be the same. Nothing significant, nothing forceful, just a change you sense more than you can put into words.

In some times, you could make things wait. Not because they are perfect, but because you can see that they are sliding even while you are still inside them. You work to retain them, to stretch them simply longer, but time passes for no one. It continues moving, steady and uninterested.

Then there are instances you only later recognize. They appear unremarkable, nearly unmemorable at the time.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmchohzrYc8QRPG6e6STBccgoNgb2TNa7BztCyQCXBUBEB/1777070569456.jpg)
[Picture Source](https://unsplash.com/photos/group-of-martial-artists-sitting-on-the-grounds-yYSY93clr4w)

Susan joined the karate team to learn how to defend herself in the cave of aggression. At first, her friends tried to discourage her not to join because they believed that it is very difficult to learn.

Two weeks into her training, Susan had found out that **it is not that hard** to learn. She has learnt the rudiments as fast as possible. She even exhibited her new found skills to the admiration of her friends.

Muchas veces decimos que la vida nos puede cambiar en un segundo, pero no lo creemos hasta que nos sucede. 

Mi amiga y yo salimos una noche con un grupo de amigas que ella creo con el objetivo de salir de la rutina y desconectarbos de los problemas por un rato.

Esa noche comimos, brindamos con una sangría y cantamos karaoke. Nos regresamos a media noche a casa. 

Al día siguiente fui a su casa y compartimos un rato, todo iba bien hasta que se escucharon los gritos de su papá llamándola. La mamá estaba convulsionando en el baño. 
Salí por ayuda y se la llevaron al hospital. 

Desde ese día no ha regresado y se encuentran unidos en pro de la salud de la mamá recaudando fondos para la cirugía que necesita, el diagnóstico un tumor en la parte frontal de cerebro. 

Ella es usuario de la plataforma #vivicakes y se encuentra paseando momentos muy difíciles con mucha fe. 

**English Version**

We often say that life can change in an instant, but we don’t really believe it until it happens to us. 

My friend and I went out one night with a group of friends she’d put together, with the goal of breaking out of our routine and disconnecting from our problems for a while.

That night we ate, toasted with sangria, and sang karaoke. We got home around midnight. 

The next day I went to her house and we hung out for a while; everything was going fine until we heard her dad shouting for her. Her mom was having a seizure in the bathroom. 
I ran out to get help, and they took her to the hospital. 

She hasn’t returned since that day, and they’re united in their efforts to support her mom’s health by raising funds for the surgery she needs—she was diagnosed with a tumor in the frontal lobe of her brain. 

She’s a user of the #vivicakes platform and is getting through these very difficult times with a lot of faith.

body.title: TAKE A BOW....GOD IS ABLE
body.body:
‎
Hello peeps.... please shift closer let's gossip about Joshua today in writing.

I'm pretty sure that you've forgotten already that Joshua stood at the edge of Jericho with a battle in front of him and questions inside him.
‎
‎The walls were still standing. The enemy was still armed. The future of Israel felt heavy on his shoulders. Then he looked up and saw a Man standing before him with His sword drawn. Joshua did what any leader under pressure would do—he asked the question that rises from a heart fixed on outcomes: “Are You for us, or for our adversaries?”
‎
‎And the answer shattered the way I often think about God.
‎
‎“No.”
‎
‎Not because the Lord was absent. Not because He was indifferent. But because Joshua’s question was too small.
‎


![IMG-20260412-WA0082.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/johnpetra/23yJR8JzSyxWa8xWLCgwpNej9qEFm14vUm3Xqg43Cn2DyMfuEzQZeGoXLd5jVGQ2rSRd7.jpg)

‎The Commander of the army of the Lord had not come to take sides. He had come to take over.
‎
‎That is the lesson that pierced me.
‎
‎There are moments when I come to God wanting Him to endorse my plans, validate my emotions, and strengthen my strategy. I want heaven to stand behind what I have already decided.
‎
‎ But Joshua 5:14 reveals something deeper and holier: God is not looking to be recruited into my agenda. He calls me to bow before His.
‎
‎Joshua’s response says everything. He fell facedown to the earth and worshiped. Before Jericho fell, Joshua fell. Before the victory came, surrender came. Before instructions were given, reverence was required.
‎
‎That is where real strength begins.
‎
‎The greatest danger is not the walls in front of us. It is the pride within us that still wants control. Sin trains the human heart to resist God’s authority, to crown self as commander, to demand that the Lord bless our will instead of breaking it. We do not naturally ask, “Lord, what do You want?” We ask, “Lord, will You help me do what I want?”
‎
‎But grace meets us where pride is exposed.
‎

![IMG_20260217_115505_678.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/johnpetra/23xKxj4SBWub96VKPrhQQRooxNUfA2T1C7LzgGrcWS7KXHZz4mAaVmrd4mJoTSv3ENiL7.jpg)

‎Joshua encountered the holy presence of God and learned that victory would never come through human confidence alone. In the same way, we need more than advice, more than motivation, more than religious language. We need redemption. We need Jesus Christ.
‎
‎Because the deeper battlefield is not Jericho. It is the soul.
‎
‎We have sinned against a holy God. We have gone our own way. We have treated His rule as optional. Yet the good news is that Jesus, the true and greater Commander, did not come merely with a drawn sword of judgment—He came bearing the cross.
‎
‎ He lived in perfect obedience where we rebelled. He died for sinners who deserved wrath. He rose again in power so that all who repent and believe in Him can be forgiven, cleansed, and made new.
‎
‎That is the turning point.
‎
‎Repentance is where we stop asking Jesus to serve our kingdom and finally surrender to His. Grace is where He does not destroy the sinner who bows, but saves him. Redemption is where the heart that was once hostile to God is brought into peace with God through the blood of Christ.
‎
‎So the lesson I learned when Joshua met the Commander is this:
‎Victory begins when surrender becomes complete.
‎
‎God is not a mascot for your ambition. He is Lord. He is holy. He is worthy to be obeyed. And when you fall before Him, you do not lose—you finally find the only place where true courage, direction, and peace can live.
‎
‎Maybe you are standing before your own Jericho right now. A crisis. A fear. A decision. A burden too great for your strength. Do not start by asking God to join your side. Fall at His feet. Ask what He says. Yield your heart. Trust His command.
‎
‎And if you have never truly surrendered to Jesus Christ, do not wait. Turn from your sin. Put your faith in Him today. The Commander who is holy is also the Savior who is merciful. In Him there is pardon for the guilty, strength for the weak, and hope for the broken.
‎
‎Bow low. Trust fully. Follow completely.
‎
‎If this spoke to your spirit, share it with someone who needs to stop fighting for control and start walking in surrender. Save it, return to it, and let it remind you that the battle is never won by those who merely make plans but by those who worship the Lord and obey His voice.
‎I remain your handsome friend John Petra.
‎
‎

Posted Using [INLEO](https://inleo.io/@johnpetra/take-a-bowgod-is-able--jvd)

body.title: Digital Art | Frannyalah, a gust of cold breath ❄
body.body:
>

![43.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/manuel2395/AKqZSXMeS6jKzrrBYYveeTz6EdZmJZnueWQEBb7c51p6Na7XSTn7zc5taEGhoyo.jpg)
Good afternoon, my dearest readers in the #hive art community! Happy Friday to everyone reading this post. I hope you’re all doing great and, of course, had an excellent and productive week. Your friend Manuel is here once again, thrilled to share a new artistic post on my blog. This time, I wanted to bring you an illustration with a slightly freer style; I let my inspiration be my guide this time. Basically, I came up with the idea of creating a sort of woman or maiden made of ice, whom I named (Frannyalah); It is said that Frannyalah is a kind of magical entity that dwells in the icy glaciers in some remote corner of our world, and legend has it that the slightest breath from her mouth is capable of freezing a person in a matter of seconds… I hope you like this idea, and here I’ll leave you with part of the process so you can appreciate it much better: >*Muy buenas tardes mis queridísimos lectores y lectoras de la comunidad artística de #hive, feliz viernes para todos los que se encuentran leyéndome por aquí en esta nueva ocasión, espero que se encuentren super bien, y que, por supuesto hayan tenido una excelente y productiva semana, por aquí los saluda una vez mas su amigo Manuel super feliz de poder compartirles un nuevo post artístico para mi blog. En esta oportunidad quise traerles una ilustración un poco más estilo libre, deje que mi inspiración fuese la guía esta vez, básicamente se me ocurrió crear una especie de mujer o doncella, del hielo a la cual llame por el nombre de (Frannyalah); se dice que Frannyalah es una especie de entidad mágica la cual habita en los helados glaciares en algún lugar recóndito de nuestro mundo, y cuenta la leyenda que el leve soplido de su boca es capaz de congelar a una persona en cuestión de segundos…espero les guste esta idea, y aquí los dejare con parte del proceso para que lo aprecien mucho mejor:* ###
PROCESS / PROCESO
![0.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/manuel2395/AJdFHPcsRPC3NVtZKQz8RkcEs1xDpZpfxxPZHihz1ea4EdaG1bLBv9TckP2uKCo.jpg)
I started with a sketch of the main character, who in this case is Frannyalah. My idea for her was to give her a very distinctive style, which is why I drew her with long, straight hair. It occurred to me that she could be sitting on a sort of large block of ice or glacier to better capture her essence. Once the sketch was finished, I continued with the painting process. For the skin, I opted for a base of blue tones ranging from medium to a slightly darker blue. At this stage, I used my airbrush to start creating volume, and then watercolor to blend and soften the edges. >*Empecé con el boceto del personaje principal, que en este caso sería la misma (Frannyalah), mi idea para ella era que tuviese un estilo muy particular, es por ello que la dibuje con una cabellera larga y lisa, y se me ocurrió que podría estar sentada en una especie de gran bloque de hielo o glacial, para así representar mejor su esencia. Al finaliza el boceto continúe con el proceso de pintado de mi obra, en el caso de la piel opte por una base de tonos azules de intermedio a un azul un poco mas oscuro, use en esta etapa mi pincel de aerógrafo para empezar a crea lo que seria el volumen, y luego la acuarela para mezclar y difuminar.*
![5.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/manuel2395/AK54Z4BeHZSxqw37Zv5uS6BAEoZKqWWuavoCs6Z5UowKz5s4HaVx1HKhy76fQ9m.jpg) ![8.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/manuel2395/AK54Z5cD9PCTtGuiPCofmN739fFcZTJvjTiwqTuUiC3z69SnTbm1zriJoBfNQzi.jpg) ![10.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/manuel2395/AK54Z5cD9PCTtGuiPCofmN739fFcZTJvjTiwqTuUiC41iG5JLkjkqvDvHXL7a2h.jpg)
When it comes to painting the hair, I used slightly lighter shades of blue, created long locks with my square-tip brush, and then used my bristle brush to add texture to the hair, giving it plenty of volume and shine. Then, for the eyes, I used shades of blue and white to achieve a somewhat pearlescent and striking look; and for the lips, for example, I tried to paint them slightly more open to represent or convey the idea that icy breath would be emanating from there. >*En cuento al trabajo del pintado del pelo use unos azules un poco mas celestes, cree una cabellera larga con mi pincel de punta cuadrada, y luego con mi pincel de cerdas fui creando lo que seria el relieve en el cabello, dándole mucho volumen y brillos. Luego para el pintado de los ojos use tonos azules y blancos para lograr una mirada un tanto perlada y llamativa; y para los labios por ejemplo trate de pintarlos un poco mas abiertos para así representar o dar la idea de que por allí brotaría el aliento helado.*
![13.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/manuel2395/AK54Z5cD9PCTtGuiPCofmN739fFcZTJvjTiwqTuUiC41iG5JM17wj1FzAvK9bd7.jpg) ![16.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/manuel2395/AK54YQMGCmfZvtcb8HRQMJzDRJJcA7j6PyAzPNySi4SoQfRmiJmVLRHUeHKT369.jpg) ![20.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/manuel2395/AK54YQMFz3uW9s5poQYVpgmF9DyDQjQqQcftm6nxs4GQ3biyvh6XsKogFQV3ckQ.jpg)
For the outfit, I used shades of purple as the main base color. In this case, I decided to create a dress that hugged her silhouette, and on top of that, using shades of lilac and light blue, I created a second layer of fabric that looked like a high-necked jacket, giving the character a really cool and eye-catching style. Finally, I focused on creating some ice blocks using light blues and grays, as well as a large ice block on which the character would be sitting. Right behind Frannyalah, I formed a sort of vast frozen ocean to add a sense of depth to the piece. >*Para la vestimenta use tonos morados como base principal de su ropa, en este caso se me ocurrió crear un vestido ajustado a su silueta, y justo sobre esto con tonos lila y azul claro cree una 2da capa de tela que fuese algo así como una especie de chaquea de cuello alto que le diese al personaje un estilo bastante genial y llamativos. Ya al final me enfoque de crear algunos bloques de hielo con azules claros y grises, así como también cree un gran bloque de hielo sobre el cual estaría sentada el personaje, y justo detrás de Frannyalah forme una especie de gran océano helado el cual diera un poco de perspectiva de profundidad a la obra.*
![21.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/manuel2395/AK54YQJL2473xPWUHHF5p6wVyHPLNVJQMGNo1yc1gDG14mCkzYFNqbspatA8EQJ.jpg) ![26.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/manuel2395/AL5rEMWdbaQeFmWXKhQszmoQWLTMGgbY46djvQwkEUpGSriM9xZLuvafoAcjGKd.jpg) ![30.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/manuel2395/AL2ynGMaCbDuBCpRi4nAmZy5Byn42CfCjsaf1sCz6AbGNSji6ttsB8b6LF8jvz9.jpg) ![35.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/manuel2395/AKzAc4pw58vZdczxqkwHGGdWmWAqBACAUDGrTvbHf4Hfo3ZcHEkQW4nXvrMX179.jpg)
###
MATERIALS / MATERIALES
- Sai Paint Tool Program - Huion inspiroy h610 v2 tablet >- *Programa Paint Tool Sai* >- *Tableta Huion inspiroy h610 v2*
![PROCESS.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/manuel2395/AJdFGfcZRqXV7WyiiYZQB49tkAdasW9YMCtFzXA6t9FbHt72A3KpPnrqK5kgJER.gif)
Well, folks, that’s all for today. Thank you so much to everyone for sticking with me this far and for reading. I hope you really liked the final result of my illustration, and if you did, please don’t hesitate to let me know in the comments below. With nothing more to add, I’ll sign off now. I send you all my best wishes and a big hug, and we’ll see each other again in the next post…see you later!😉. >*Bueno mi gente, esto ha sido todo por el día de hoy, muchísimas gracias a todos por haber llegado hasta aquí, por leerme, y espero que el resultado final de mi ilustración les haya gustado muchísimo, y si fue así por favor no duden en hacérmelo saber abajo en los comentarios. Sin nada mas que añadir, me despido, les mando un gran saludo y un fuerte abrazo a todos, y ya nos volveremos a ver en un siguiente post…hasta luego!😉.*
