body.title: Ficción: La Lola (ESP/ ENG)
body.body: > Desde que éramos pequeñas, ella siempre era el blanco de las burlas de todos. No solo de los niños de nuestra clase, sino también de los de otras clases, e incluso de los mayores del colegio. Pero desde muy pequeña, La Lola aprendió a defenderse porque no tenía otra opción: se defendía con la boca y con los puños, aunque su cuerpo delgado y desnutrido siempre acababa tirado al suelo. Decía que llevaba luchando desde que estaba en el vientre de su madre y que, cuando su madre la abandonó, supo que tenía que valerse por sí misma.

>o0o

Más tarde, cuando crecimos, seguían burlándose de ella, pero también la buscaban mucho —sobre todo los chicos mayores— para hacer cosas, cosas prohibidas que el resto de nosotras no hacíamos. Por aquella época, Cari y yo empezamos a desarrollarnos, y nuestros pechos incipientes parecían pequeños bultos bajo nuestras camisetas, mientras que La Lola tenía los pechos más planos que una tabla, tanto que a veces la ayudábamos a rellenar con papel de periódico los sujetadores que le había quitado a Petra, su abuela. Pero aunque era plana de pecho, La Lola era popular entre los chicos; siempre la buscaban, la llamaban y la invitaban a ir a Playa Escondida, que estaba tan escondida que poca gente sabía dónde estaba. Lola nos contaba que Manuel le había dado un besito, que Carlos quería algo más. Todo eso pasaba a escondidas de todos. Y la cuestión es que La Lola era la más femenina de todas: desde que era pequeña, caminaba contoneando las caderas de un lado a otro, agitando el pelo como si fuera un velo o una capa, y caminando como si llevara una corona en la cabeza; también movía las manos como si temiera romper algo, y sus ojos... los abría y cerraba, los giraba de un lado a otro, como si tuviera los ojos de una muñeca de plástico. Comparadas con ella, todas éramos chicas insulsas, sin gracia y descoloridas.

>o0o

\n\nPor eso, aquella mañana de abril, cuando encontraron su cuerpo boca abajo, con signos de violencia, entre las rocas de Playa Escondida, a todos nos tomó por sorpresa. El cuerpo desnudo de La Lola —sin el sujetador de su abuela, con el pecho plano y con varias heridas— sugería que, a diferencia de lo habitual, esta vez no se había defendido. La noticia de su muerte apareció en los periódicos: \

. Y todos dijimos que, si La Lola hubiera visto ese titular, se habría enfadado mucho porque nunca le gustó que la llamaran Simón y porque allí, en la foto de portada, junto a su cuerpo, estaban las dos bolitas de periódico, embarradas, que solía colocarse en el pecho.

* * *

* * *

* * *

**Versión en inglés**

<h1 style=\

>La Lola Ever since we were little, she was always the butt of everyone’s jokes. Not just the kids in our class, but those in other classes too—even the older kids in the school. But from a young age, La Lola learned to defend herself because she had no other choice: she fought back with her mouth and her fists, even though her skinny, malnourished body was always knocked down. She said that she had been fighting ever since she was in her mother’s womb, and that when her mother abandoned her, she knew she had to defend herself all on her own.

>o0o

Later, when we grew up, they kept teasing her, but they also sought her out a lot—especially the older boys—to do things, forbidden things that the rest of us didn’t do. Around that time, Cari and I started to develop, and our budding breasts looked like little lumps under our T-shirts, whereas La Lola had breasts flatter than a board, so much so that sometimes we’d help her stuff newspaper into the bras she’d taken from Petra, her grandmother. But even though she was flat-chested, La Lola was popular with the boys; they were always looking for her, calling her, and inviting her to go to Playa Escondida, which was so hidden that few people knew where it was. Lola would tell us that Manuel had given her a little kiss, that Carlos wanted something else. All of that happened out of everyone’s sight. And the thing is, La Lola was the most feminine of them all: ever since she was little, she walked swaying her hips from side to side, fluttering her hair as if it were a veil or a cape, and walking as if she had a crown on her head; she also moved her hands as if she were afraid of breaking something, and her eyes—she opened and closed them, turned them from side to side, as if she had the eyes of a plastic doll. Compared to her, we were all bland, colorless girls.

>o0o

\n\nThat’s why, on that April morning, when they found her body face down, showing signs of violence, among the rocks at Playa Escondida, we were all taken by surprise. La Lola’s naked body—without her grandmother’s bra, her chest flat, and bearing several wounds—suggested that, unlike usual, this time she hadn’t fought back. The news of his death appeared in the newspapers: “The body of the young Simón Rodríguez, alias La Lola, was found lifeless. Revenge or a settling of scores is presumed.\

body.title: Let’s burn Hive in an alternative and lazy way: Tutorial using github actions and my code.
body.body:
>

  I am sharing this script, since it can help people to simplify their lives if they want to spend vp in burn posts/comments like @buildawhale do. I know that auto vote already exists in the fanbase at hive.vote and as a new function in Peakd (peakd.com/me/autovote). But there are some limitations, at least for me. If I add buildawhale there, every time that they post, it will spend all the vp in my required threshold, which is 80% usually. So it will always vote, their post is always 9:00 AM my local time. I start working around hive at the same time, and I always see my VP at this threshold, but sometimes I want to vote for other people and still keep 80% or something around. So I created something that only votes at the times I want, which I usually don't do since I am with kids most of the time around 00 UTC.

  I was offering for some people in private to add their accounts to my script, but I think it is better to provide a GitHub repo, which can be forked to a private GitHub of your choice. And this way, I also don't see the posting key. GitHub has a nice function to store passwords and other parameters called secrets, which are encrypted. Posting keys can be stored there safely. Another cool function is GitHub Actions, so the script can be run on GitHub every day at the time chosen by the user. Sometimes it has some delays, for example, when I run mine at 11:50 pm UTC it gets sometimes 1h delayed. It is a free scheduler, so there is a public queue for that.

  What do you need to do for that? First, have a GitHub account. Create that at https://github.com/. After a successful login, you can access my repo: https://github.com/rantree-hive/auto_voting_baw. And click in the fork button.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gwajnberg/23wN1pSenPVQWQqVvMrwmG6NV6fGHyYVTyachaNrvJuvTekgE6SjgSCgxawjgPTrRWqnW.png) ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gwajnberg/23t8CfKPvXW7ZqtbopRQijE37LsW4tSvBgGkDWksnXaniVkphGmEXtBSWHVRNEbd5pvxo.png)

>How to fork a github repository.

  After clicking \

you will have this script in your personal GitHub repo. If I perform any update in my original repo, you will tell in your repo and you will choose to update it. Now the next steps is adding the parameters into the secrets of your newly forked repository. Go to \

>Settings of your copied repository to add secrets.

  Here you can add all the secrets that the program requires and the optionals if needed. The script requires at least one account to run, but you can add as many as you want. There are 3 mandatory secrets that should be added ACCOUNT_1_USERNAME, ACCOUNT_1_POSTING_KEY and ACCOUNT_1_VOTE_POST. The last one the input is 'true' or 'false'. If it is true it will vote the main post plus the burn comments. If you add 'false' it will vote only in the comments. That is an option that some people prefer when they don't want their voting trail followed in a burn. If you desire to add more accounts, just add 3 more secrets using the value for this other account and instead of 1 change for 2...3 ... and more numbers. Each secreted is added once.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gwajnberg/48FHdjNxADKGaqn8tHvVaZTEEnKeW5omfwbwDdyNGsymWxS2j3Fe31awcJMYxozWLT.png) ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gwajnberg/Eo6SF55xg8miG4rembL8xqM8bqSkL5sV61cYkixgUe46BCSA4nSkY7cn8ZMG1oen2R9.png)

>Secrets added

  It should run now automatically every day at 11:50pm UTC after you enable it. Go to actions, click on the left side at \
and Enable workflow. After that it is enabled, you can try it and run it before the chosen time. Just click \

. It should get a green mark. The default is to vote until the account's VP drops from 80%. You can always disable the workflow if you are just unhappy in the three dots.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gwajnberg/23tw9yBHU7x3kPfrpRWfhNT8yiXzNgy4QLWqePubZ5Tud5mGzzZzQ7WpHbhdp5tn6uMKp.png)

>You Can Always disable the workflow.

  You can also customise other parameters as a new secret, if you want to replace buildawhale, just add another username under TARGET_AUTHOR secret. Also you can choose a different Voting power as a minimum instead of 80%. If you want to use 90% just add a secret MIN_VOTING_POWER value as '9000' . Also you can change the voting weight with VOTE_WEIGHT. The default is 100%, if you want to change to 90% just go to 9000 value. And last not mandatory secret HOURS_BACK. The default is 24 hours ago, so the latest post of buildawhale but you can change for 48h for example, with the value '48'.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gwajnberg/23tcNa8AHR3fSzDVijB6SywKNGwPDwQneLZwVNZwS2dC2N42SbuRD573FyhSrLkB6atqs.png)

>Optional secrets

  The last parameter that you may be able to change is the UTC time, which is not possible to change through the secret. You would need to alter the code of .gitHub/workflows/hive_burn_voter.yml, you can edit any part of the code if you want and also check around. More specifically, line 5 of that script. That is the code for GitHub to start the workflow at that time. Right now it is -cron '50 23 * * *' , so the first is the minutes (50) and the second the hours (23 = 11). if you want to run at 5pm, replace the 50 with 0 and the 23 with 17. Easy right?

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gwajnberg/23tHbKgyTiw333EuLyAoThNDGsG8qSeL3XvA4JdfH4ca8vCHhYGJuZgZM1UgQx4YAdQYd.png)

>The workflow configuration file.

  Common questions answers: Your changes there won't reflect anything in my original repo, and my changes will reflect in your repo only if you want to synchronize it. Your posting key is securely encrypted at GitHub. They are only used in this same workflow file yml with the time. The script is simple; I am not capturing the secret anywhere and sending it somewhere. Even for you, the posting key won't be visible if you click to update the secret; you will be able to replace the value, but you don't know exactly what is being replaced. So if someone hacks your GitHub, they wouldn't see the posting key. Last but not least, please tell me any problems here, on GitHub, or via Discord.

[![](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gwajnberg/23wMS5Mk5RaoA6EdKv35TPtYzT2oppCtUWD6qwC5GUBMb877AgJ5rGzJeoTew2bGQJQWZ.png)](https://vote.hive.uno/@gwajnberg)
Banner created in canva

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gwajnberg/23u5tR8RSXuZFgpjQ6Eiqz8JMMjig1nLZFvxM1sFhvNmiGYA2snkPD7Z4TnmFxxRyih87.png)

  Estou compartilhando este script, pois ele pode ajudar as pessoas a simplificarem suas vidas se quiserem gastar VP em posts/comentários de destaque, como faz o @buildawhale. Sei que o voto automático já existe na comunidade do hive.vote e como uma nova função no Peakd (peakd.com/me/autovote). Mas existem algumas limitações, pelo menos para mim. Se eu adicionar o buildawhale lá, toda vez que ele postar, gastará todos os VP do meu limite necessário, que geralmente é de 80%. Então, ele sempre votará, mesmo que a postagem dele seja sempre às 9h da manhã, no meu horário local. Começo a trabalhar no Hive ao mesmo tempo e sempre vejo meus VP nesse limite, mas às vezes quero votar em outras pessoas e ainda manter 80% ou algo próximo disso. Então, criei algo que vota apenas nos horários que eu quero, o que geralmente não faço, já que estou com as crianças na maior parte do tempo por volta da meia-noite UTC.

  Eu estava oferecendo a algumas pessoas, em privado, a possibilidade de adicionar suas contas ao meu script, mas acho que é melhor fornecer um repositório no GitHub, que pode ser bifurcado para um GitHub privado de sua escolha. Dessa forma, também não vejo a chave de postagem. O GitHub tem uma função interessante para armazenar senhas e outros parâmetros, chamada de segredos, que são criptografados. As chaves de postagem podem ser armazenadas lá com segurança. Outra função interessante é o GitHub Actions, que permite que o script seja executado no GitHub todos os dias no horário escolhido pelo usuário. Às vezes, há alguns atrasos; por exemplo, quando executo o meu às 23h50 UTC, às vezes há um atraso de 1 hora. É um agendador gratuito, então existe uma fila pública para isso.

 O que você precisa fazer para isso? Primeiro, tenha uma conta no GitHub. Crie uma em https://github.com/. Após o login bem-sucedido, você pode acessar meu repositório: https://github.com/rantree-hive/auto_voting_baw. E clicar no botão de bifurcação.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gwajnberg/23wN1pSenPVQWQqVvMrwmG6NV6fGHyYVTyachaNrvJuvTekgE6SjgSCgxawjgPTrRWqnW.png) ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gwajnberg/23t8CfKPvXW7ZqtbopRQijE37LsW4tSvBgGkDWksnXaniVkphGmEXtBSWHVRNEbd5pvxo.png)

>Como fazer um fork de um repositório do GitHub.

  Após clicar em \

, você terá este script em seu repositório pessoal do GitHub. Se eu realizar alguma atualização no meu repositório original, você será notificado no seu repositório e poderá optar por atualizá-lo. Agora, o próximo passo é adicionar os parâmetros aos segredos do seu novo repositório bifurcado. Vá para \

>Configurações do seu repositório copiado para adicionar segredos.

  Aqui você pode adicionar todos os segredos que o programa exige e os opcionais, se necessário. O script requer pelo menos uma conta para funcionar, mas você pode adicionar quantas quiser. Há 3 segredos obrigatórios que devem ser adicionados: ACCOUNT_1_USERNAME, ACCOUNT_1_POSTING_KEY e ACCOUNT_1_VOTE_POST. O último deve ser 'true' ou 'false'. Se for 'true', o programa votará na publicação principal e nos comentários de divulgação. Se você adicionar 'false', o programa votará apenas nos comentários. Essa é uma opção que algumas pessoas preferem quando não querem que seu histórico de votos seja rastreado em uma divulgação. Se desejar adicionar mais contas, basta adicionar mais 3 segredos usando o valor da outra conta e, em vez de 1, substituir por 2, 3 ou mais. Cada segredo é adicionado apenas uma vez.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gwajnberg/48FHdjNxADKGaqn8tHvVaZTEEnKeW5omfwbwDdyNGsymWxS2j3Fe31awcJMYxozWLT.png) ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gwajnberg/Eo6SF55xg8miG4rembL8xqM8bqSkL5sV61cYkixgUe46BCSA4nSkY7cn8ZMG1oen2R9.png)

>Segredos adicionados

  Agora, após a ativação, o fluxo de trabalho deve ser executado automaticamente todos os dias às 23h50 UTC. Vá em Ações, clique em \
no lado esquerdo e selecione Ativar fluxo de trabalho. Depois de ativado, você pode testá-lo e executá-lo antes do horário escolhido. Basta clicar em \

. Ele deverá aparecer com uma marca verde. A configuração padrão é votar até que o VP da conta caia abaixo de 80%. Você sempre pode desativar o fluxo de trabalho se não estiver satisfeito com o resultado.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gwajnberg/23tw9yBHU7x3kPfrpRWfhNT8yiXzNgy4QLWqePubZ5Tud5mGzzZzQ7WpHbhdp5tn6uMKp.png)

> Você sempre pode desativar o fluxo de trabalho.

 Você também pode personalizar outros parâmetros como um novo segredo. Se quiser substituir `buildawhale`, basta adicionar outro nome de usuário no segredo `TARGET_AUTHOR`. Além disso, você pode escolher um poder de voto mínimo diferente de 80%. Se quiser usar 90%, basta adicionar o valor '9000' ao segredo `MIN_VOTING_POWER`. Você também pode alterar o peso do voto com `VOTE_WEIGHT`. O padrão é 100%; se quiser alterar para 90%, basta definir o valor para 9000. E, por último, o segredo opcional `HOURS_BACK`. O padrão é de 24 horas atrás, ou seja, a última postagem do buildawhale, mas você pode alterar para 48 horas, por exemplo, com o valor '48'.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gwajnberg/23tcNa8AHR3fSzDVijB6SywKNGwPDwQneLZwVNZwS2dC2N42SbuRD573FyhSrLkB6atqs.png)

>Segredos opcionais

  O último parâmetro que você pode alterar é o horário UTC, que não pode ser alterado por meio do segredo. Você precisaria alterar o código de .gitHub/workflows/hive_burn_voter.yml. Você pode editar qualquer parte do código, se quiser, e também verificar outras configurações. Mais especificamente, a linha 5 desse script. Esse é o código para o GitHub iniciar o fluxo de trabalho naquele horário. No momento, está configurado como -cron '50 23 * * *', onde o primeiro valor representa os minutos (50) e o segundo as horas (23 = 11). Se você quiser executar às 17h, substitua o 50 por 0 e o 23 por 17. Fácil, não é?

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gwajnberg/23tHbKgyTiw333EuLyAoThNDGsG8qSeL3XvA4JdfH4ca8vCHhYGJuZgZM1UgQx4YAdQYd.png)

>O arquivo de configuração do fluxo de trabalho.

  Perguntas frequentes e respostas: Suas alterações não serão refletidas no meu repositório original, e minhas alterações serão refletidas no seu repositório somente se você quiser sincronizá-lo. Sua chave de postagem é criptografada com segurança no GitHub. Ela é usada apenas neste mesmo arquivo YAML do fluxo de trabalho com o horário. O script é simples; Não estou capturando o segredo em lugar nenhum e enviando-o para algum lugar. Mesmo para você, a chave de postagem não ficará visível se você clicar para atualizar o segredo; você poderá substituir o valor, mas não saberá exatamente o que está sendo substituído. Portanto, se alguém invadir seu GitHub, não verá a chave de postagem. Por último, mas não menos importante, por favor, me informe sobre quaisquer problemas aqui, no GitHub ou via Discord.

body.title: Viviendo el sueño de los 15 años junto a mi princesa /  Living the dream I’ve had since I was 15, alongside my princess
body.body:
<center>https://images.ecency.com/DQmYGsyY1YAkGZXEB9FqsGoAAZNbL6CPHUCcMj4NfC2PkEq/1777060664294.jpg</center>


<center>https://images.ecency.com/DQmRYcGs1VqGhK8KafJeNUUQTJwNxasJgPrVN6tz2duhQFb/1777067380351.jpg</center>



<center>https://images.ecency.com/DQmc9MKbDRuptzNnAipp4ya7TpMLG5FBy3dJLSe5xnZPaih/1777069927092.jpg</center>









‎Saludos a la hermosa comunidad de motherhood estoy por acá para contarles un poco de como fue celebrar los 15 años de mi hija mayor.

‎Para nadie es un secreto que este evento es el más esperado por las jovencitas , es el comienzo de una nueva etapa , es dejar de ser una niña para ir convirtiéndose en una mujer .
‎
‎Para nosotros como padres  es ver cómo nuestra hija alcanza una madurez en su vida que le ayuda a tomar decisiones para su futuro, pero  también es el estrés y la emoción más grande que podemos vivir después de su nacimiento.

Pero el cuento no es ese , quiero contarles como fue todo el proceso de preparación y como quedó todo.**

‎
‎Primero quiero contarles que este evento no se hubiera podido llevar a cabo sin la ayuda de todos los que colocaron un granito de arena en este evento, desde mi madre , hasta los sobrinos que una vez cuidé como mis hijos , \

, me siento feliz de ver el amor que le tienen a mi hija todas las personas que me rodean, en realidad me quedo corta con la gratitud que siento.

‎Aun con todas las ayudas  que tuvimos mi esposo y yo  nos vimos muy estresados por los gastos que teníamos que asumir , Pero al final de todo el evento, nos dimos cuenta que todo valió la pena., Aun pagamos las consecuencias de los gastos extras Pero nada es más gratificante que ver y escuchar de mi hija lo felíz que fue ese día .
‎
‎Llego el día anhelado  todo comenzó con mi salida bien de mañana a comprar mi outfit pues lo que había mandado a hacer no me quedó como quería así que tocó ir a ver qué conseguía para ese momento especial, logrado el objetivo, luego fui por los accesorios de mi hija pues los que le habían mandado de afuera no llegaron y habia que resolver jejeje, como verán aún cuando tenía todo fríamente calculado siempre hay cosas que suceden y te sacan de tu control, Pero no quería estresarme más así que me tocó resolver.

Mi  amiga Morefi me ofreció su casa para vestirnos, ella consideraba que ese momento debía ser muy especial y que no debíamos estar tan agobiadas ocupandonos de tantas cosas y realmente fue una sabía decisión, aunque las llamadas por teléfono no pararon igual pudimos sentir más tranquilidad.
‎
‎ Otra de mis amigas fue quien maquillo a mi nena y como vivía cerca de ese lugar pues aprovechamos, está última también le regaló la decoración y montura de uñas, agradezco a estás grandiosas mujeres que me ayudaron a que mi quinceañera se viera espectacular.

>Hello to the wonderful Motherhood community. I’m here to tell you a little bit about how my oldest daughter’s 15th birthday celebration went.

>It’s no secret that this event is the one young girls look forward to the most; it marks the beginning of a new chapter, the transition from girlhood to womanhood.

>For us, as parents, it’s about watching our daughter reach a stage of maturity in her life that helps her make decisions for her future, but it’s also the most stressful and exciting time we’ve experienced since her birth.

>**But that’s not the story I want to tell; I want to tell you about the entire preparation process and how everything turned out.**

‎
>‎First, I want to tell you that this event wouldn’t have been possible without the help of everyone who pitched in, from my mother to the nephews I once cared for as if they were my own children. “I’m so grateful for that.” I’m happy to see the love everyone around me has for my daughter; in fact, words can’t begin to express how grateful I am.

>‎Even with all the help  my husband and I received,  we were very stressed by the expenses we had to cover. But by the end of the event, we realized it was all worth it. We’re still dealing with the financial fallout from the extra costs, but nothing is more rewarding than seeing and hearing from my daughter just how happy she was that day.
‎
>‎The long-awaited day arrived. It all started with me heading out early in the morning to buy my outfit, since the one I’d had made didn’t fit the way I wanted, so I had to go see what I could find for that special moment. Once I’d achieved that goal, I went to get my daughter’s accessories, since the ones that had been sent from abroad didn’t arrive and I had to figure something out, hehehe. As you can see, even though I had everything carefully planned out, there are always things that happen and get out of your control. But I didn’t want to stress myself out any more, so I just had to figure it out.

‎
>‎My friend Morefi offered to let us get ready at her house; she felt that the moment should be very special and that we shouldn’t be so stressed out trying to handle everything, and it really was a wise decision—even though the phone calls didn’t stop, we were still able to feel more at ease.
‎
>‎ Another friend of mine did my daughter’s makeup, and since she lived nearby, we took advantage of that. She also gave her the nail art and nail extensions as a gift. I’m so grateful to these amazing women who helped make my daughter look spectacular for her quinceañera.
‎ 



<center>https://images.ecency.com/DQmUfwGeXKtTiPUTXYzwD4Rj14kskUAgcve3RD1P9v5xia1/1777060850991.jpg</center>

<center>https://images.ecency.com/DQmRWEK8m5BX8EsBNQuhgeCroj5deA7ofGe1CLydomACeGm/1777060851077.jpg</center>

‎
‎ Cuando llegamos a casa de Morefi ella le tenía preparada una bata de baño a mi hija para empezar con su proceso de maquillaje. Luego mi querida Tatiana , comenzó a maquillarla  y allí comenzó todo .

>When we arrived at Morefi’s house, she had a bathrobe ready for my daughter so she could start doing her makeup. Then my dear Tatiana began applying her makeup, and that’s when it all began.

<center>https://images.ecency.com/DQmYRNCbC36Xqj21T8YqoJMbFKGvkZcmTTDfMs3BA551XsC/1777060812756.jpg</center>

‎
‎Mientras ellas estaban en ese proceso, yo estaba en el mío , yo no tenía maquillista Pero si tuve grandes amigas ocupándose de mi hija mientras  yo me ocupaba de mi  , así que eso fue de gran ayuda para mí.
‎ Al estar maquillada mi hija comencé con el proceso de peinado , que gracias a Dios ella no quería nada muy elaborado y como lo iba a hacer yo misma pues me resultó de esa manera , un peinado sencillo Pero bonito y que la hiciera sentir cómoda.
‎
‎ Mi quinceañera, maquillada y peinada se colocó su vestido, mientras yo seguí arreglándome, en ese momento mi querida amiga Morefi tuvo la genial idea de hacerle una sesión de fotografías que quedaron hermosas.

>While they were going through that process, I was going through mine. I didn’t have a makeup artist, but I did have some great friends taking care of my daughter while I took care of myself, so that was a huge help to me.
>Once my daughter had her makeup done, I started doing her hair. Thankfully, she didn’t want anything too elaborate, and since I was doing it myself, that’s exactly how it turned out—a simple but pretty hairstyle that made her feel comfortable.
‎
>‎ My quinceañera, with her makeup and hair done, put on her dress while I continued getting ready. At that moment, my dear friend Morefi had the brilliant idea of doing a photo shoot with her, and the pictures turned out beautiful.



<center>https://images.ecency.com/DQmfGKT3NCHqsfL2BZCqUUkxqbwzhFGmUi7dnAHh2pFMwyZ/1777060895326.jpg</center>

body.title: Unexpected Access
body.body:
Something unbelievable just happened, haha. Things that often feel hopeless come around in the most unexpected way. You will try harder and harder to crack something, but you will fail a thousand times on this, but suddenly, one unexpected hit will make it open, which will feel like a magical occurrence. 

Around 2022, I was first introduced to the security field specifically. So in the early days, everywhere I was poking was a security mindset. So, one day, I was storing all my personal data on my pendrive, I had zipped it into a password-protected file, almost 30GB of data. Seeing the importance of the data, I had set up a super complex password, a total of 18-character alphanumeric password with special characters. Three years passed, and I was never in need to open that stuff. Recently, due to a need, I sat down to explore that data, and guess what, I forgot the password. I clearly remember the possible combinations or common passwords I usually set. Even I had a notepad where I usually write down the passwords, that too in a zibberish way so no one else can get that and access everything easily, too many security concerns. lol. So I tried each and every password I could have ever come up with, and every one of them was incorrect. 


![dave-meckler-u1ebF25geyI-unsplash.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/minhajulmredol/23tvYD5Wb6nNbgd51hmZgxfL6rxJHDmbt7Wp2iB7CbZuytkM2LeDFreFZyixkrrLoHbML.jpg)
[📸 Dave Meckler](https://unsplash.com/photos/authorized-personnel-only-sign-hanging-on-chains-u1ebF25geyI)

Can you imagine the loss? It wasn't any random files and stuff, personal data for which I specifically purchased a pendrive and was storing, and ended up forgetting the password. I was sad and laughing at the same time. It was around February or March when I tried to access the data. 


Now, its 4.21 AM at the time of my writing this blog post. During 3.30 AM, suddenly I came across that pendrive, inserted in my laptop. Here we go again, a password prompt to access the stuff. Just a couple of hours ago, I took a strong cup of tea with coffee. So, I just guessed a different set of passwords depending on a few things from 2023 when I was backing up my data. And guess what, boom! I got access. It wasn't any normal pass, a proper strong pass, just a few random stuff that I had kept as a pattern, and out of nowhere it came to my mind today, and I just got the access.

![2026-04-25 03_23_09-Crack Me If You Can.zip (evaluation copy).png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/minhajulmredol/23tRv7QKmRERSMdaXE4ym6HYoouo1swAsKMHudBAMTyNB1hzsas7mupeyaG1t1VTwWB3t.png) 

Come on, I wasn't intended today for this, nor did I have any clue, or restored from any written place. Sudden encounter, sudden guesses, and boom. The most unexpected way to crack this one. Hahaha, funny stuff. Never will I keep such important stuff without documenting. 

**Time to sleep now....**

body.title: #Monomad Challenge - Diplomacy.
body.body:
### Good afternoon, #Monomad friends Here is my entry for the #monomad contest by @brumest and @monochromes. Diplomacy. Last weekend, I visited a cultural center housed in a restored historic palace that now hosts various free cultural events—though registration is required—which have become one of my favorite weekend activities. Also this past weekend, a play about the April 25 Revolution and the dictatorship was performed there. It is striking to realize that the times we saw “shaken” and rendered virtually nonexistent—or at best, residual—more than 52 years ago are now taking on an increasingly prominent role. There is even representation in the Assembly of the Republic by a recently formed party with more conservative, even somewhat radical, right-wing ideals. In recent years, we have seen a growing disinterest in politics among young people in Portugal. There is certainly a discrediting of the political class, obviously influenced by some residual but highly relevant cases of dishonesty and fraud. We cannot allow populist rhetoric to take root within our societies, for such rhetoric—which preys on fears and generalizes and stereotypes deviant behavior—leads to its constant and increasingly significant influence. Today, they already have enough members of parliament to be the third-largest political force in the Portuguese legislature. Diplomacy is a hallmark of democratic societies, yet it is increasingly neglected. These days, little attention is paid to the need for diplomacy; people jump straight to hate speech and aggression, failing to consider the immediate consequences that arise when we deny space to others and to dialogue and compromise. During my visit to the Palácio do Alegrete, I saw a metal sculpture in which the distance between the two parts is always equal. There is a gap between the two lines, and a zigzag pattern that represents the conversations and needs that must be met so that the common good of both sides—and sometimes more than just two sides—prevails, and confrontation is avoided. Nowadays, however, it seems that people are quicker to go on the offensive, and only after the rift has been created do they attempt to reconcile with the other side.

(NASDAQ: AMRK) is a leading fully integrated precious metals platform that offers gold, silver, platinum, and palladium bullion numismatic coins and related products to wholesale and retail customers via a portfolio of channels. The company conducts its operations through five complementary segments: Wholesale Sales & Ancillary Services (includes Logistics and Minting), Direct-to-Consumer, and Secured Lending. The company’s global customer base spans sovereign and private mints, manufacturers and fabricators, refiners, dealers, financial institutions, industrial users, investors, collectors, and e-commerce and other retail customers. A-Mark’s Direct-to-Consumer segment provides access to a multitude of products through its wholly-owned subsidiaries, JM Bullion, Goldline, and LPM. JM Bullion is a leading e-commerce retailer of precious metals and operates seven separately branded, company-owned websites targeting specific niches within the precious metals market: JMBullion.com, ProvidentMetals.com, Silver.com, Gold.com, GoldPrice.org, SilverPrice.org, BGASC.com, and BullionMax.com. body.title: Das Problem ohne Parkplatz
body.body:
Hallo Freunde,

wie klingen knapp 300 Euro pro Stunde für einen Parkplatz? Ich war kurz daheim und habe dummerweise keinen Parkplatz gefunden, also musste ich schauen wo ich parke und mein Auto auslage und bin am Ende wiedermal auf dem Gehsteig gelandet und schon hieß es eine Ordnungswidrigkeit für die 10 Minuten zu bezahlen. Ich hasse es in einem Viertel mit sehr angespannter Parkplatzsituation zu leben und mir jedesmal zu denken, wie zur Hölle soll das alles funktionieren. Und vor allem warum nimmt sich die Polizei immer wieder die Zeit um hier durchzufahren und Strafzettel auszustellen. Ich meine wenn es fast doppelt so viele Autos in einem Stadtteil gibt wie gemeldet sind, weil viele Firmenwägen und Fahrzeuge die auf andere zugelassen sind vor Ort sind. Dann wird das alles spannend, weil man mit weniger Parkplätzen kalkuliert. 

Und viele haben ein Auto das wo anders gemeldet ist, weil halt der Arbeitgeber es erlaubt das sie mit dem Auto heimfahren können oder zum Beispiel das sie mit einem Auto das noch auf den alten Wohnort gemeldet ist, umgezogen sind. Wir haben sehr viele Leute die teilweise hier leben und dann noch aufm Land vor allem im Osten, hier wird Geld verdient und im Osten wird dann langfristig gelebt. Mal schauen wo das alles noch hin geht. 

In dem Sinne, gehabt euch wohl.

body.title: New technology lays groundwork for large-scale, high-resolution 3D displays
body.body:
# New technology lays groundwork for large-scale, high-resolution 3D displays

**Source:** https://www.spacewar.com/reports/New_technology_lays_groundwork_for_large_scale_high_resolution_3D_displays_999.html

Researchers have developed a prototype display that uses projection to create large-scale 3D images with ultra-high definition. The new approach helps overcome the limitations of light-field projection, which can create natural-looking 3D images that don't require special 3D glasses for viewing.

\
said research team leader Byoungho Lee from Seoul National University in Korea. \

In The Optical Society (OSA) journal Optics Letters, the researchers describe how they combine two different light-field display technologies to project large-scale 3D images with almost diffraction-limited resolution. The new display is autostereoscopic, which means that it produces different 3D images so that the image can be viewed from various angles.

\

Combining technologies
Light-field displays work by reproducing light that is reflected from an object in a way that corresponds to the actual visible position. Because autostereoscopic light field displays produce different images for different viewing angles, they require a huge amount of information to be processed. This demand creates a tradeoff between resolution and the size of the displayed image because the hardware of the display gets overwhelmed by the amount of information required.

To overcome this limitation, the researchers designed a new optical configuration that combines a multifocal display with integral imaging. Typically, a multifocal display can generate a high-quality volumetric image, but it is technically difficult to implement on a large-screen system. On the other hand, integral imaging is better at enlarging images.

![Image 1](https://www.spacedaily.com/images/white.jpg)

In the new design, the multifocal display generates a high-resolution 3D, or volumetric, scene while the integral imaging technology enlarges it for viewing on a large screen. The information conversion between the multifocal display and integral imaging is all performed optically without any digital processing.

\

Large and high-resolution 3D images
After verifying the resolution of their prototype system, the researchers qualitatively confirmed that a volumetric image was reconstructed. The tests showed that the prototype can synthesize a volumetric image of 21.4 cm x 21.4 cm x 32 cm, which is equivalent to 28.6 megapixels and 36 times higher resolution than the original image.

\

The researchers are now working to optimize the optics and further reduce the complexity of the multifocal display to make the projector more compact. They note that because the system is a fusion of two different technologies, the performance of their proposed system will likely improve as each technology develops.

body.body:
![vrH3T7bh6zdS5ALN_P_20260312_132051.webp](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/diochen/images/vrH3T7bh6zdS5ALN_P_20260312_132051/vrH3T7bh6zdS5ALN_P_20260312_132051.webp) ![VnW9onrW74gRBBkd_P_20260312_132048.webp](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/diochen/images/VnW9onrW74gRBBkd_P_20260312_132048/VnW9onrW74gRBBkd_P_20260312_132048.webp) ![GzEsHuQQ8IqPbgBi_P_20260312_132058.webp](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/diochen/images/GzEsHuQQ8IqPbgBi_P_20260312_132058/GzEsHuQQ8IqPbgBi_P_20260312_132058.webp) ![YLWsBqrAA52Oonjv_P_20260312_124633.webp](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/diochen/images/YLWsBqrAA52Oonjv_P_20260312_124633/YLWsBqrAA52Oonjv_P_20260312_124633.webp) ![SlblrRBuiWZn80tT_P_20260312_130142.webp](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/diochen/images/SlblrRBuiWZn80tT_P_20260312_130142/SlblrRBuiWZn80tT_P_20260312_130142.webp) ![iwtP5DuiRn8PIanq_P_20260312_131115.webp](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/diochen/images/iwtP5DuiRn8PIanq_P_20260312_131115/iwtP5DuiRn8PIanq_P_20260312_131115.webp)
在社群媒體盛行的現代，打卡拍照早已成為日常生活的一部分，我常看見不少人，當他們走進一間新開的咖啡廳、或參加一場展覽，甚至只是路過一面色彩鮮明的牆面，都會拿起手機，捕捉畫面並上傳分享，說實話，我也是其中一員，閒暇時用打卡拍照來分享正能量，並記錄自己的生活，當然，我並奢望帶來高人氣，或所謂的流量，不過，我的生活越多人點讚互動，我越開心。 精緻美素食也是打卡拍照的好題材，因為它是一種兼具品味與生活態度的象徵，像我之前分享的果然匯蔬食餐廳，憑藉著柔和的燈光、簡約卻富有質感的用餐氛圍，再加上嚴選當季新鮮蔬果，透過廚師細膩的烹調技法，融合東方的烹調智慧與西方的擺盤美學，吸引素食者，也讓葷食者願意走進素食餐廳，號稱蔬食吃到飽的天花板，一餐價錢落在六百多台幣上下，各式精緻美的素食上傳到社群媒體後，讓不少素食愛好者趨之若鶩地跑去朝聖。 這家我吃過的素食吃到飽餐廳，沒有精緻美的素食，沒有設計感十足的裝潢及氛圍，沒有精美的裝盤擺設，有的是簡單健康的烹調方式及經濟實惠的用餐價錢，所以，我又過來打打牙祭了，市場上自己採買起來較貴的菇類及海帶，我吃了好幾回，平常愛吃的豆腐類食物，如油豆腐及豆皮，我也拿了好幾回，雖然較不健康，但是各式蔬食炸物也蠻好吃的，至於好吃的炒麵，太佔我肚子的空間，我就敬謝不敏了，去精緻美的果然匯餐廳吃一次的價錢，在這裡可以吃上四回，我還是喜歡這種接地氣的素食餐廳啊！
---
In today’s world where social media is everywhere, checking in and taking photos has pretty much become part of everyday life. I often see people pulling out their phones the moment they walk into a newly opened café, attend an exhibition, or even just pass by a colorful wall. They snap a few shots and upload them right away. Honestly, I’m one of those people too. In my free time, I like to share some positive vibes through photos and document my life. I’m not expecting to gain huge popularity or chase traffic, but the more likes and interactions I get, the happier I feel. Fancy vegetarian restaurants are also great for taking photos. They’re not just about food—they represent a sense of taste and lifestyle. For example, the 果然匯蔬食餐廳 I shared before has soft lighting and a simple yet stylish dining atmosphere that looks amazing in photos. On top of that, they carefully select seasonal ingredients and use refined cooking techniques, blending Eastern culinary traditions with Western plating aesthetics. This not only attracts vegetarians but also makes meat-eaters curious enough to give it a try. It’s even known as the “ceiling” of vegetarian buffets. A meal costs around NT$600+, and once those beautifully presented dishes are posted on social media, it easily draws a lot of attention and makes vegetarian lovers want to check it out for themselves. That said, not every vegetarian buffet I’ve been to is all about aesthetics. There’s another place I’ve tried; there is no fancy presentation, no stylish décor, no Instagram-worthy plating. Instead, it focuses on simple, healthy cooking and affordable prices. And honestly, that’s why I keep going back. Every time I visit, I load up on things that are usually more expensive at the market, like different kinds of mushrooms and seaweed. I go back for those multiple times. I also grab a lot of tofu-based foods like fried tofu and tofu skin, which I really enjoy. Sure, the fried items aren’t the healthiest, but they’re still pretty tasty. As for the stir-fried noodles, even though they look good, they take up too much stomach space, so I usually skip them. If I think about it, the price of one meal at 果然匯蔬食餐廳 could get me about four meals at this place. In the end, I guess I just prefer these more down-to-earth vegetarian restaurants. They feel more real and fit my everyday life better. --- For the best experience view this post on [Liketu](https://liketu.com/@diochen/another-visit-to-a-down-to-earth-vegetarian-restaurant)

body.body:
I think cohabitation can help some couples, but it’s not foolproof for a lasting marriage. And yes, it can also create risk, especially when expectations aren’t aligned. Whether the benefits outweigh the disadvantages depends less on “cohabiting vs not” and more on why you’re doing it and howyou handle it.

*Where cohabiting helps:*

*Reality check on compatibility.* You learn how they handle dirty dishes, money stress, sickness, in-laws, and bad moods at 7am. Dating is performance. Living together is behind the scenes. Lots of couples find deal breakers they wouldn’t see otherwise — finances, cleanliness, sleep habits, boundaries with family. Better to know before marriage.  
*Shared systems.* You practice conflict, budgeting, chores, and decision-making as a team. If you can run a household together without resentment, that’s a real foundation.  

I do support it for couples who are intentional about it. If both people treat it as “marriage prep” with clear timelines and conversations — not just “let’s save rent” — it can build depth.

*Where it’s not foolproof:*

1. *The “sliding, not deciding” problem.* Many couples drift into cohabiting for convenience, then drift into marriage because breaking up is harder once leases and microwaves are shared. They never actually chose each other again — they just didn’t leave. That predicts _less_ marital satisfaction later. Research calls this the “cohabitation effect.”  
2. *No legal backing = real risk.* This hits women more often, statistically. You might take on cooking, cleaning, emotional labor, even financial support, without the legal protections of marriage. If it ends, you could walk away with nothing, even after years of acting like a spouse. No alimony, no property rights, no next-of-kin status in emergencies.
3.  Sometimes one person thinks “we’re practicing for marriage” and the other thinks “this is convenient for now.” If you haven’t defined it, someone usually loses.  

*So do disadvantages outweigh benefits?*  
Not automatically. The disadvantage is _ambiguity_, not cohabitation itself.  

Practical take: If you’re going to cohabit, treat it like a contract, even if it’s not legal:
Do this if you cohabit why it matters.
Talk timelines-	“Are we testing for marriage? For how long?” 1-2 years max, or it becomes indefinite.
Don’t play spouse without commitment	If you’re doing 100% of wife/husband duties, ask why. You can share labor without losing yourself. Check legal realities -In Nigeria, cohabitation doesn’t grant spousal rights. Know what happens if someone dies, gets sick, or leaves.
Decide, don’t slide- Move in because you chose to, not because a lease ended. And decide on marriage vs breakup consciously, not by default.

My stance: I support cohabiting when it’s intentional, time-bound, and both people keep their independence. I don’t think it’s foolproof. Plenty of people cohabit and still divorce. Plenty skip it and have great marriages. The stronger predictor of lasting marriage is mutual, explicit commitment and how you handle conflict, not your address before the wedding.

For women especially: cohabitation shouldn’t mean surrendering autonomy. If you find yourself doing all the marital labor with none of the security, that’s not a “test” — that’s a bad deal. The benefits disappear if you you are the only one investing.

Existe una increíble variedad de historias, géneros y experiencias cinematográficas, desde comedias conmovedoras hasta dramas que invitan a la reflexión, pasando por épicas aventuras de ciencia ficción y escalofriantes thrillers. Es realmente fascinante ver cómo diferentes películas conectan con distintas personas, despertando diversas emociones y generando conversaciones mucho después de que terminen los créditos. A veces parece imposible elegir solo una, pero siempre hay una película que se queda grabada en la memoria, quizás por su brillante narrativa, sus personajes inolvidables o una escena en particular que te dejó sin palabras. Teniendo todo esto en cuenta, tengo mucha curiosidad: si tuvieras que elegir, ¿cuál dirías que es tu película favorita de todos los tiempos y qué la hace tan especial para ti?

body.title: Past and Growth
body.body:
Hello, everyone!

To start with, some people say things out of ignorance, some under pressure from things they are going through in life, or some utter words through anger, before they knew it, they had already aired it to the world to hear. I can't judge them. 



![IMG_20250511_120653_475.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/peckypeace/24241s4g6LCHudzZVuF4L34AaQR4bro7wj3ZFouozeJfmAXFhqcbvcapecvsdY9k5fo6C.jpg)


However, asides anything, we need to be careful of the words we say, as they can either make or break us now or in the future. People have lost jobs and opportunities because been honest and truthful too. Do you know that? Some people are straightforward and always truthful, but then, they are denied their favor because of airing the truth, and even some are arrested too for saying the truth. For example, Verydarkman, as we all know him as VDM, a known social media influencer, was attacked a few months ago for always saying the truth, going out of his comfort zone to speak for people, and to make sure people gain their rights and voices over themselves and stand firm in what they know. But this man was attacked, he was arrested too and they interviewed him. He is in his space making his own money as long as they are not blocking him on all the social media platforms.

In fact, some are being killed because of being truthful.

Speaking truthfully to society and expressing controversial views can be a double-edged sword; if you are not careful with your words, it may either make or break you.

# Should the person be made to pay for the opinions held in the past?


Well, we have human beings with different intentions either good or bad, and we are in a world where evil things take place. Take, for instance, a notorious criminal in society, well known by the people, who has been escaping arrest or being set ablaze. One day, if he is caught, they would definitely set him ablaze for causing damage in society. People would not talk good about him. If this person doesn't repent wholeheartedly and you're the environment, people would see him the way he was before.

Some people do pay for their speeches made wrongly in public, either spoken or written. Words carry weight, which can weigh you down and can spoil your reputation as a person, and make people question your character.

# When they grew to be better people, should they pay for those things?

If they are very bold and brave, the only way I think they can pay for their damages is to come up and apologize for the speeches made out whether it was intentional or not. 

Life is sweet but then, we need wisdom to travel through and overcome some stages.

_**This is my response to the Hivelearners featured contest week 214 episode 3**_

body.body:
> 

![Black Blue Futuristic Cyber Security Presentation.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lesiopm2/23uQGVC1U6BMJcct9H51TWMcZDiks29VwZei9zp2T9DTSQRbZoPb5d7RhXZVMBhodK2ht.jpg)

# 🔐 Cyber Security Daily News | 25.04.2026

Codzienny przegląd ciekawszych wiadomości ze świata cyberbezpieczeństwa, do poczytania przy porannej kawie, podzielony na kluczowe kategorie.

![2.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lesiopm2/23tvCUf8XA3Z2PXFQ8N9niw3s5FNTxp52CHaHCP6uXwbsfSA6sM5UsKUugh5Fuvcgp41H.jpg)

---

## 1. 📰 NEWS

### ***Zakończyły się ćwiczenia Locked Shields 2026 — 41 państw testowało odporność cybernetyczną w największym ćwiczeniu na świecie***

Centrum Doskonałości NATO ds. Cyberobrony (CCDCOE) podsumowało tegoroczną edycję ćwiczeń Locked Shields — uznawanych za największe i najbardziej wymagające ćwiczenia cyberobrony na świecie. W 2026 roku uczestniczyło 41 krajów, a ćwiczenia testowały zdolność do obrony w warunkach symulowanego, masowego cyberataku na infrastrukturę krytyczną fikcyjnego państwa. Locked Shields kładą nacisk na realistyczne scenariusze: ochronę sieci IT, systemów OT/ICS, mediów, komunikacji wojskowej i systemów głosowania. Wyniki ujawniają luki w koordynacji między sektorami i pokazują, które kraje mają najbardziej zintegrowane zdolności obronne. W tegorocznej edycji szczególny nacisk położono na obronę przed atakami z użyciem AI.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lesiopm2/Eo6DeTaSMRz9ra84jnVhe5ZZN45u1cbJRB8Swf3N6r3Ttp28JYwdVYaatECwJ5Ad8hu.png)

*Źródło: [CyberDefence24](https://cyberdefence24.pl/armia-i-sluzby/zakonczyly-sie-cwiczenia-locked-shields-kto-okazal-sie-najlepszy) [PL] | [SecurityWeek](https://www.securityweek.com/locked-shields-2026-41-nations-strengthen-cyber-resilience-in-worlds-biggest-exercise/) [EN]*

---

### ***Backdoor FIRESTARTER na zaporze Cisco w agencji federalnej USA — przeżywa reinstalacje oprogramowania i łatki***

CISA i brytyjski NCSC opublikowały wspólny alert po odkryciu niebezpiecznego backdoora nazwanego Firestarter na urządzeniu Cisco Firepower należącym do federalnej agencji cywilnej USA. Wyjątkowość tego złośliwego oprogramowania polega na tym, że przeżywa standardowe reinstalacje firmware'u i ponowne uruchomienia sprzętu — co czyni je wyjątkowo trudnym do usunięcia. Cisco Talos przypisało malware grupie UAT-4356, tej samej która w 2024 roku prowadziła kampanię ArcaneDoor. Dochodzenie wykazało, że hakerzy siedzieli w sieci od co najmniej września 2025 roku, zanim zostali wykryci przez system ciągłego monitoringu CISA. CISA wydała zaktualizowaną dyrektywę awaryjną nakazującą wszystkim federalnym agencjom cywilnym pilny przegląd urządzeń Cisco.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lesiopm2/23xAaBQ7KiQAKc5FWnd1vKFJoBCuYybUJ8XXUmZ1o4F2493ELhdBNNEpd3dfggxzLxhkt.png)

*Źródło: [CyberScoop](https://cyberscoop.com/cisco-firestarter-malware-cisa-warning/) [EN] | [The Hacker News](https://thehackernews.com/2026/04/firestarter-backdoor-hit-federal-cisco.html) [EN]*

---

### ***CERT Polska ujawnia podatność w polskim oprogramowaniu AdaptiveGRC (CVE-2026-4313)***

CERT Polska opublikował odpowiedzialnie ujawnioną podatność w AdaptiveGRC — polskim oprogramowaniu do zarządzania ryzykiem, zgodnością i ładem korporacyjnym (GRC), stosowanym przez organizacje w sektorach regulowanych. CVE-2026-4313 jest przykładem rosnącej uwagi badaczy na oprogramowanie wyspecjalizowane, które nieraz pozostaje poza radarem wielkich audytów bezpieczeństwa, a przetwarza wrażliwe dane z zakresu zarządzania ryzykiem organizacji. Producent wydał już poprawkę, a użytkownicy oprogramowania powinni jak najszybciej zaktualizować instalacje. CERT Polska regularnie prowadzi taki koordynowany proces CVD (Coordinated Vulnerability Disclosure), który chroni polskie organizacje przed tym, że luka zostałaby znaleziona i wyeksploatowana przez atakujących zanim producent będzie miał szansę zareagować.

*Źródło: [CERT Polska](https://cert.pl/posts/2026/04/CVE-2026-4313/) [PL]*

---

### ***Microsoft wdrozi passkeys Microsoft Entra na Windows pod koniec kwietnia — krok do logowania bez hasła***

Microsoft ogłosił uruchomienie passkeys w ramach Microsoft Entra ID dla urządzeń Windows — planowane na koniec kwietnia. Passkeys to forma uwierzytelniania kryptograficznego opartego na standardach WebAuthn/FIDO2, która całkowicie eliminuje konieczność używania haseł i jest odporna na phishing AiTM. Użytkownik loguje się przez biometrię urządzenia (Windows Hello) lub PIN, a klucz kryptograficzny nigdy nie opuszcza urządzenia. Zmiana jest szczególnie ważna w kontekście rosnącej skali ataków omijających MFA przez przechwytywanie tokenów — passkeys są z natury odporne na ten wektor. NCSC popiera tę metodę jako najbezpieczniejszą dostępną w codziennym użyciu.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lesiopm2/23wM4awDBYzDGctiNKvomS9s18Xj3CA3AeXAt3NJcBtxs2sov7MQNBUV1qCFJzmDpuUaF.png)

*Źródło: [CyberDefence24](https://cyberdefence24.pl/cyberbezpieczenstwo/ncsc-wskazalo-najbezpieczniejsza-metode-weryfikacji) [PL] | [Infosecurity Magazine](https://www.infosecurity-magazine.com/news/ncsc-backs-passkeys-new-era-of/) [EN]*

---

## 2. 🚨 INCYDENTY

### ***Skutki ataku na Vercel rozszerzają się — odkryto kompromitację większej liczby klientów i systemów zewnętrznych***

CyberScoop opisuje nowe ustalenia Vercela dotyczące zakresu niedawnego włamania na jego infrastrukturę. Firma po analizie blisko petabajta logów stwierdziła, że incydent dotknął więcej klientów niż pierwotnie zakładano, a ślady kompromitacji znaleziono też w systemach zewnętrznych partnerów. CEO Guillermo Rauch przekazał, że firma utrzymuje, iż liczba dotkniętych kont jest „mała\

produkują dziesiątki tysięcy deepfake'owych wideo w ciągu doby — z twarzami znanych polityków, celebrytów i prezesów firm — które są dystrybuowane przez sieci reklam w mediach społecznościowych. Cały łańcuch produkcji jest zautomatyzowany: AI sklonuje głos z 30-sekundowej próbki, nałoży twarz na gotowy szablon wideo i wygeneruje tekst skryptu zgodny z profilem ofiary. Ofiary deepfake'ów ponoszą realne szkody finansowe i wizerunkowe, a platformy walczą z tym zjawiskiem jak z hydra — jedno konto usuniętych, dziesięć nowych się pojawia. ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lesiopm2/EoEryD3VaLtbX34cXMTXvXAptyn4LZDuqDZR5ika558nU6LNwnJJnx8o5bvtMd9xyKe.png) *Źródło: [TrybAwaryjny.pl](https://trybawaryjny.pl/od-deepfakeow-gwiazd-po-fabryki-awatarow-jak-oszusci-przeksztalcaja-zaufanie-w-przemysl/) [PL]* --- ## 5. 🌐 DEZINFORMACJA, CYBER WOJNA ### ***Próba zamachu na kierownictwo rosyjskiego Roskomnadzoru — nowe napięcia wewnątrz rosyjskich struktur*** CyberDefence24 opisuje doniesienia o próbie zamachu na wysokich rangą urzędników Roskomnadzoru — rosyjskiego regulatora mediów i internetu odpowiedzialnego za cenzurę sieci. Agencja jest kluczowym instrumentem kontroli informacyjnej w Rosji — to ona blokuje strony, nakłada kary na platformy i nadzoruje implementację systemu izolacji RuNet. Incydent wpisuje się w rosnące napięcia wewnątrz rosyjskich struktur władzy w kontekście trwającego konfliktu zbrojnego i narastającej presji społecznej. Niezależnie od powodów ataku, zagrożenie bezpieczeństwa fizycznego urzędników odpowiedzialnych za kontrolę informacyjną jest bezpośrednio powiązane z napięciami w sferze cybernetycznej i informacyjnej Rosji. ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lesiopm2/23w2gVLYqLh5EPpSn3yk6dPaKg7TNhPKX3Ao3ztnxAQEVGrkmCoKC9M2rhoZMh8TqV1TX.png) *Źródło: [CyberDefence24](https://cyberdefence24.pl/armia-i-sluzby/proba-zamachu-na-kierownictwo-rosyjskiego-roskomnadzoru) [PL]* --- ### ***CBŚP inauguruje projekt TRIDENT — polska policja przygotowuje się na falę nielegalnej broni ze Wschodu*** Infosecurity24 opisuje inaugurację w Warszawie projektu TRIDENT — inicjatywy wartej ponad 6,6 mln zł, na czele której stoi Centralne Biuro Śledcze Policji, mającej na celu zwalczanie przemytu broni i materiałów wybuchowych z terenów objętych konfliktem zbrojnym. Projekt łączy siły krajowych i zagranicznych służb oraz angażuje CBZC w kontekście cybernetycznym — bo handel bronią coraz częściej odbywa się przez zaszyfrowane komunikatory, dark web i platformy kryptowalutowe. To ważny sygnał, że polskie służby traktują konwergencję zagrożeń fizycznych i cybernetycznych jako jedno wyzwanie bezpieczeństwa, a nie dwa oddzielne problemy. ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lesiopm2/23u6Fsk1NmcThZCyhz2Q8jMa1YQa9Vr5SPKhSN24r5rGCbjiQfeD4xuB6BtcniQzt2Ggx.png) *Źródło: [Infosecurity24](https://infosecurity24.pl/bezpieczenstwo-wewnetrzne/sluzby-szykuja-sie-na-fale-nielegalnej-broni-ze-wschodu-cbsp-inauguruje-projekt-trident) [PL]* ----- *📅 Zestawienie obejmuje artykuły opublikowane ogólnodostępnych serwisach w dniu 24 kwietnia 2026 r. ⚠️ Materiał ma charakter informacyjny i edukacyjny.*

¡Hola, querida comunidad! Espero que estén teniendo una semana productiva y llena de energía. Hoy quiero apartarme un poco de los libros y las pizarras para compartir con ustedes una experiencia que me llenó de inspiración en el patio de mi institución.

Acompañé a mis estudiantes a su sesión de Educación Física y lo que vi no fue una simple clase de ejercicios, sino una verdadera cátedra de vocación.

 La magia de la pedagogía en movimiento
A veces subestimamos esta área pensando que es solo correr o patear un balón, pero la realidad es que es un espacio vital para el desarrollo integral. Sin embargo, lo que hace la diferencia es quién guía el proceso.

Observar a mi colega en acción es un aprendizaje constante para mí. Tiene esa chispa especial para transformar un circuito de agilidad en una aventura donde la risa es la protagonista. Su metodología me demuestra que:

La motivación es contagiosa: Su energía es tal que hasta a mí me dan ganas de dejar el cuaderno a un lado y unirme a la dinámica.

Aprender jugando es posible: Los chicos no solo queman energía; están trabajando disciplina, trabajo en equipo y coordinación sin sentir la presión del \

.

Vocación: El motor de todo
Lo más valioso que me llevo de esta jornada es una gran lección de vida: cuando trabajas con amor, la excelencia surge de forma natural. Ella me ha recordado que, sin importar el área que impartas (ya sea matemáticas, lenguaje o deporte), si hay vocación, el esfuerzo se siente liviano. El compromiso y la entrega hacen que todo fluya con una armonía increíble, logrando que los estudiantes no solo asistan a una clase, sino que vivan una experiencia.

Y como dijo Sócrates\

¿Y ustedes? ¿Tuvieron algún profesor que les hiciera amar una materia que antes no les gustaba?
 
English 
Hello, dear community! I hope you’re having a productive and energetic week. Today I want to step away from the books and whiteboards for a moment to share with you an experience that filled me with inspiration in my school’s playground.

I accompanied my students to their Physical Education class, and what I saw wasn’t just a simple exercise session, but a true masterclass in passion.

The magic of active learning
Sometimes we underestimate this subject, thinking it’s just about running or kicking a ball, but the reality is that it’s a vital space for holistic development. However, what makes the difference is who guides the process.

Watching my colleague in action is a constant learning experience for me. He has that special spark to transform an agility circuit into an adventure where laughter takes center stage. His methodology shows me that:

Motivation is contagious: Their energy is so infectious that even I feel like putting my notebook aside and joining in the fun.

Learning through play is possible: The kids aren’t just burning off energy; they’re developing discipline, teamwork, and coordination without feeling the pressure of “duty.”

Vocation: The driving force behind everything
The most valuable thing I take away from this day is a great life lesson: when you work with love, excellence comes naturally. It has reminded me that, no matter what subject you teach (whether math, language, or sports), if there is a sense of vocation, the effort feels effortless. Commitment and dedication make everything flow with incredible harmony, ensuring that students don’t just attend a class, but live an experience.

And as Socrates said, “Education is the kindling of a flame, not the filling of a vessel.”

What about you? Did you have a teacher who made you love a subject you didn’t like before?

body.title: i lost my lentils, found a great big dollop of sadness, then made things alright again
body.body: that's a long title for a post, i know, but it's also the things i've been meaning all day to say. i'm not 100% convinced things happened in that order, though. it's just been a great big old day of grief, perforated at all the strangest moments by points of normality, of want, of being my now self again. and in a way, that made the grieving even stranger. sometimes things throw me more than i know to make sense of. you read something that folds and opens like a book, then you skyrocket somehow a decade or two into the past, and there you were. again and all along.

> i know i'm a past version of self by the way old music affects me. take the train today, and don't look back again? doesn't work that good, 'cause eventually train's done moving, and there you still are. anyway, i discovered myself there a little too keenly. had a good time of it right up until i didn't, went through an overwhelming sort of anger that turned afterward into grief, in spite of all the tremendous bouts of sunlight and warmth i consumed today. somewhere deep down, there's still a seventeen-year-old who's really cold. it got me into a funk, getting rocked back to that, in a way. but i guess the past wasn't done with me just yet. we're still somehow at an age where we think we're invincible and immortal, yet there they keep going, people around us. dying. to be perfectly honest, it frightened me more, the numbness with which i greeted the news, the way my friend seemed so distraught and upset about it, in a way i never could be. me, this uncomfortable boulder of numb. there's been far too much death in the past year, and i keep reaching for examples and stories. slowly, i'm learning more funeral jokes than i would like to tell. but i suppose there'll always be another easter to organize somewhere. until one day, there's not. imagine he still had easter chocolates left wrapped on some kitchen shelf somewhere that he'll never eat now.

>
<center> *the tag says forgotten, yet i reckon i keep weaving in and out, forgetting, but remembering parts of myself also.*</center>

\

a friend says. yet all i feel is used to it. i don't mind it. be pretty pointless to, but i do mind the version of me that had no familiarity with death, and realize i'll never be that person again. today, i suppose there's grief for all the things i wish i'd known i could tell myself ten years back. would've saved me a lot of trouble. and for not knowing death (but then again, also not knowing all sorts of happiness and loves). and for lost, loved boys, and all the lives they didn't get to live. i keep walking around today, thinking how we didn't know, how none of us could've guessed. how silly it would've seemed to any of us when we were small to say we'd die by '26. silly, strange, lost things. keep thinking how there's sun out, but death, and people whose lives will never come back from this, also. not me. not mine. but somewhere. and it still seems strange. besides, i've my own coat of deaths to gather around myself. it just gets heavy sometimes, remembering the coat of life and love and miraculous things i've got hanging in the corner, also. how tight you gotta hold that around yourself whenever death brushes past you. i think of all the stupidity, in many ways. all the ways in which it seems to me i'm only recently starting to live properly, being honest with myself. what a pity to not get to enjoy this bit that's just around the corner. what a pity to never eat lentils again. or forget, and have the cashier greet you with a silly, embarrassed smile when you come back for them. for stupid, two dollar lentils that will hopefully keep you warm and fed some not-too-distant day. little, ordinary miracles. a bowl of legumes. a good, sad, strange, infuriating book that's a tad too close to home. what wonder and luck, to get to begin again, pick up another book, know better even when there was no one to tell you, find a different way to breathe from the inside out.

body.title: Elaborando nutritivo menú de: Frijoles mixtos con picadillo de pollo, arroz, ensalada de tomate, para degustar en familia.(Esp/Eng)
body.body:
# Español 
# Saludos amigos amantes de la comida 💁☀️
¡Feliz día para todos!
Este viernes,  quise despedir la semana   laboral con un delicioso almuerzo compuesto por: Frijoles mixtos con picadillo de pollo, arroz, y ensalada de tomate. Los invito amigos, a que me acompañen a conocer las recetas que empleé para este espectacular menú, que tanto deleite al paladar generó en mis familiares, y en mi.¡Comencemos! 
#
<center>
![GridArt_20260424_133612404.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marydeluz/23uR784r9ZtZvVJE8nfTeyg6Qf7SSfyvVB6ZMqV5vmb2j34euXZoVBzic8TY3STtG982Z.jpg)
</center>
#
#
<center>
![GridArt_20260424_134440296.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marydeluz/23ydCEWZYocRQtt1Fkj2UrKePcvFdXYtLFxN74suSYMg1EaKNiDoQK9VMdeeT5yQK1SQi.jpg)
</center>
#
# ✨Ingredientes generales del menú, para cuatro comensales✨
#
<center>
![GridArt_20260424_133929604.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marydeluz/23u6HeUjRNZCtug1ThdcuWfUiSCnFyaXdfHxtC2XAbyzXGiQvsBMHVAyyEArEgihqGaZy.jpg)
</center>
#
.Especias: 4 cebollas medianas, 2 pimientos grandes, 5 dientes de ajo.
.Picadillo de pollo: 1/2 de libra
.Frijoles colorados cocidos: 1 lata de 425g.
.Arroz: 4 tazas
.Aceite de Soja 3 cucharadas 
.Pasta de tomate 3 cucharadas 
.Tomate natural: 4 unidades medianas 
.Sal: 1 cucharada distribuida en la cocción de los alimentos.
.Azúcar opcional: 1/3 de cucharada.
.Vinagre: 2 cucharadas.
.Agua: Suficiente en cada proceder.

# ✨Modo de confección✨ 
El primer alimento que elaboré fue el picadillo de pollo mixto con frijoles.
# ✨Picadillo de pollo mixto con frijoles
#
<center>
![GridArt_20260424_135057604.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marydeluz/23wX5ZhSGQFsn3xNG8vgxTQTjaQcc2pcpfBmasLviu1D3ZWnwkoYGWVo8noYx4QCuVom4.jpg)
</center>
#
Inicié el proceder preparando las especias de la siguiente forma: Lavé las cebollas y los pimientos, los despojé de sus partes no comestibles, y los corté en delgadas tiras. Lavé los dientes de ajo, le extraje su capa superficial, y los trituré sobre un recipiente.Ya teniendo las especias listas, comencé a cortar en rebanadas pequeñas el picadillo de pollo, para facilitar su cocción, pues se encontraba casi congelado. Seguidamente, abrí con ayuda de un abridor la lata de frijoles, y la coloqué organizadamente junto a los demás ingredientes para comenzar la cocción.
#
<center>
![GridArt_20260424_135356362.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marydeluz/23w2sGAbdLXUR52quXx1QLsWB2dfoYVKvmcDEK9Vm2pkyhkhVg9TfJM6fo4kioMNzq7vh.jpg)
</center>
#
En una sartén ingresé 3 cucharadas de aceite de Soja, 3 cucharadas de pasta de tomate, parte de las cebollas y pimientos preparados, y comencé a saltearlos por 1 minuto. Seguidamente, agregué al sofrito: las rebanadas de picadillo, los frijoles colorados blanditos, y continué salteándolo por unos segundos más. Luego, agregué al compuesto 1/2 taza de agua, 1/4 de cucharada de sal, 1 cucharada  de vinagre, 1/3 cucharada de azúcar, para equilibrar los sabores, y por último 3 dientes de ajo triturados.Integré todos los ingredientes con ayuda de una paleta, tapé el sartén, y puse a cocer el picadillo con frijoles, por 15 minutos. Apetecible a la vista y con un aroma  delicioso quedó el compuesto mixto.
#
<center>
![GridArt_20260424_135508475.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marydeluz/244UxXSTSzncdMxDTyYA2TN2rctGCyifFj4AbBSHuna4vdFk1JVKymqHaA9Qp2pma6Q3T.jpg)
</center>
#
Para complementar este  rico cocido de frijoles con picadillo, elaboré un esponjoso arroz condimentado.
# ✨Arroz
#
<center>
![GridArt_20260424_134736759.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marydeluz/23w2yoQK39JYYaSC4ENZZGxK2b7ttVvDaqMpXf3Z9dts5TaFCnvXcyBEi2Jwejuv1aJ7i.jpg)
</center>
#
Inicié el proceder midiendo 4 tazas de arroz, revisándolas y lavándolas. Seguidamente, incorporé en la olla: 2 cucharadas de aceite de Soja, los pimientos preparados, resguardados, y comencé  a darle sólo un leve salteado, pues no quería que reducieran su volúmen. Seguidamente agregué a la olla: el arroz, 4 tazas de agua, 1/2 cucharada de sal, y lo puse a cocinar por 6 minutos tapado. 
#
<center>
![GridArt_20260424_134837341.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marydeluz/23x1NDS3L1fNoq5KeRqoGoHz4znAEGgiYCQ3g1nzVSGP7JAXWZhqej1YiYHs4ChMFnWdL.jpg)
</center>
#
Colorido y con una suave textura, quedó éste rico arroz con pimientos, que logró combinar divinamente con el compuesto nutritivo de frijoles.
#
<center>
![GridArt_20260424_135757985.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marydeluz/242NsZMVC6nhmSfn4y4mj8v96G3t2zvQUupMa8fJbCqMyMp8wEDZN3W9txpghJLKAm6t4.jpg)
</center>
#
Los tomates de ensalada,fue el tercer alimento que empleé para el menú.
# ✨Ensalada de tomate
Inicié el  proceder lavando 4 tomates maduros. Seguidamente, con ayuda de un cuchillo, los  corté en delgadas rodajas, y proseguí su preparación impregnándolos de:  1 cucharada de aceite de oliva, un puntico de sal, y 1 cucharada de vinagre.¡Jugosos!, lograron la triada perfecta de la combinación. 
#
<center>
![GridArt_20260424_135947184.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marydeluz/242YGaSPqrRPKgtjTGA7vpEL1K4X8z8pJsjmRpL2GBftSoHymVmu2KwNMb3LguqaXJrKM.jpg)
</center>
#
Amigos, la combinación de hoy, nos encantó a todos los comensales presentes, en especial al más pequeño de ellos, mi primito, a quién lo motivé a degustarlo, realizando clones ilustrados del menú, con la nueva aplicación que estoy probando: Canva, pues, suele negarse  ante menuses novedoso, mixtos y con especias.
#
<center>
![GridArt_20260424_134224036.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marydeluz/23z7WXAvVUerxKRC8fdJbCS1MvaEBGFLfTsd2vZFfYv2mwJunG3Qqd3CMCGWtUfzUgU5V.jpg)
</center>
#
¡Un éxito total tanto la combinación degustada  cómo la ilustración!, pues lograron cumplir mis expectativas de un viernes familiar con un rico y variado sazón. Espero amigos, que les haya gustado los procederes que empleé para su elaboración y que se motiven a su futura confección para compartirlo en familia. Les deseo a todos un relajante y positivo fin de semana familiar.¡Abrazos!
Fotografías propias 
Ilustraciones creadas en Canva.
*** 
*** 
# English
# Preparing a nutritious menu of: Mixed beans with chicken picadillo, rice, tomato salad, to taste with the family.
# Greetings fellow foodies 💁☀️
Happy day to everyone!
This Friday, I wanted to say goodbye to the working week with a delicious lunch consisting of: Mixed beans with chicken picadillo, rice, and tomato salad. I invite you friends, to join me to know the recipes I used for this spectacular menu, which generated so much delight to the palate in my relatives, and in me.Let's get started! 
#
<center>
![GridArt_20260424_133612404.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marydeluz/23uR784r9ZtZvVJE8nfTeyg6Qf7SSfyvVB6ZMqV5vmb2j34euXZoVBzic8TY3STtG982Z.jpg)
</center>
#
#
<center>
![GridArt_20260424_134440296.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marydeluz/23ydCEWZYocRQtt1Fkj2UrKePcvFdXYtLFxN74suSYMg1EaKNiDoQK9VMdeeT5yQK1SQi.jpg)
</center>
#
# ✨General ingredients of the menu, for four diners✨
#
<center>
![GridArt_20260424_133929604.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marydeluz/23u6HeUjRNZCtug1ThdcuWfUiSCnFyaXdfHxtC2XAbyzXGiQvsBMHVAyyEArEgihqGaZy.jpg)
</center>
#
.Spices: 4 medium onions, 2 large peppers, 5 garlic cloves.
.Chicken mince: 1/2 pound
.Cooked red beans: 1 can of 425g.
.Rice: 4 cups
.Soy oil 3 tablespoons 
.Tomato paste 3 tablespoons 
.Natural tomato: 4 medium units 
.Salt: 1 tablespoon distributed in the cooking of food.
.Optional sugar: 1/3 tablespoon.
.Vinegar: 2 tbsp.
.Water: Enough in each procedure.

# ✨Mode of preparation✨ 
The first food I made was the mixed chicken picadillo with beans.
# ✨Mixed chicken mincemeat with beans
#
<center>
![GridArt_20260424_135057604.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marydeluz/23wX5ZhSGQFsn3xNG8vgxTQTjaQcc2pcpfBmasLviu1D3ZWnwkoYGWVo8noYx4QCuVom4.jpg)
</center>
#
I started the process by preparing the spices as follows: I washed the onions and peppers, stripped them of their inedible parts, and cut them into thin strips. I washed the garlic cloves, extracted their surface layer, and crushed them on a container.Having the spices ready, I started to cut the chicken picadillo into small slices, to facilitate its cooking, as it was almost frozen. Next, I opened the can of beans with the help of an opener, and placed it neatly next to the other ingredients to start cooking.
#
<center>
![GridArt_20260424_135356362.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marydeluz/23w2sGAbdLXUR52quXx1QLsWB2dfoYVKvmcDEK9Vm2pkyhkhVg9TfJM6fo4kioMNzq7vh.jpg)
</center>
#
In a frying pan I put 3 tablespoons of soy oil, 3 tablespoons of tomato paste, part of the prepared onions and peppers, and began to saute them for 1 minute. Then, I added to the sofrito: the slices of picadillo, the soft red beans, and I continued to sauté it for a few more seconds.Then, I added to the compound 1/2 cup of water, 1/4 tablespoon of salt, 1 tablespoon of vinegar, 1/3 tablespoon of sugar, to balance the flavors, and finally 3 crushed garlic cloves.I integrated all the ingredients with the help of a paddle, covered the pan, and put the picadillo with beans to cook for 15 minutes. Appetizing to the eye and with a delicious aroma was the mixed compound.
#
<center>
![GridArt_20260424_135508475.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marydeluz/244UxXSTSzncdMxDTyYA2TN2rctGCyifFj4AbBSHuna4vdFk1JVKymqHaA9Qp2pma6Q3T.jpg)
</center>
#
To complement this rich bean stew with picadillo, I made a fluffy seasoned rice.
# ✨Rice
#
<center>
![GridArt_20260424_134736759.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marydeluz/23w2yoQK39JYYaSC4ENZZGxK2b7ttVvDaqMpXf3Z9dts5TaFCnvXcyBEi2Jwejuv1aJ7i.jpg)
</center>
#
I started the procedure by measuring 4 cups of rice, checking and washing them. Then, I added in the pot: 2 tablespoons of soy oil, the peppers prepared, protected, and I started to give it only a slight stir-fry, because I did not want them to reduce their volume. Then I added to the pot: the rice, 4 cups of water, 1/2 tablespoon of salt, and I put it to cook for 6 minutes covered. 
#
<center>
![GridArt_20260424_134837341.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marydeluz/23x1NDS3L1fNoq5KeRqoGoHz4znAEGgiYCQ3g1nzVSGP7JAXWZhqej1YiYHs4ChMFnWdL.jpg)
</center>
#
Colorful and with a soft texture, there was this rich rice with peppers, which managed to combine divinely with the nutritious bean compound.
#
<center>
![GridArt_20260424_135757985.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marydeluz/242NsZMVC6nhmSfn4y4mj8v96G3t2zvQUupMa8fJbCqMyMp8wEDZN3W9txpghJLKAm6t4.jpg)
</center>
#
The salad tomatoes, was the third food I used for the menu.
# ✨Tomato salad
I started the process by washing 4 ripe tomatoes. Then, with the help of a knife, I cut them into thin slices, and continued their preparation by impregnating them with: 1 tablespoon of olive oil, a pinch of salt, and 1 tablespoon of vinegar.Juicy!, achieved the perfect triad of the combination. 
#
<center>
