body.title: Memín Negrín, the comic strip of my childhood (En/ Es)
body.body:
> Hi, my dear friends in your twenties!! 😀 I’m stopping by today to share with you those tales, stories, and comic strips that made all the difference in my childhood—they were the perfect companions. But, as I usually do, let’s go back to my childhood in the late ’70s and early ’80s, with a proper introduction. The first person from whom I received countless stories and tales was my grandmother; I think she planted in me that love for mystery and the inexplicable through her stories. I have a wide variety of them, ranging from legends to her own stories, family tales, and even stories about neighbors from that time. But since that would mean delving into a vast array of tales and stories, I prefer to share something more unique—a passion I cultivated when I learned to read and got my hands on the [Memín Pinguín](https://es.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mem%C3%ADn_Pingu%C3%ADn) comic books. I don’t remember how these comic books ended up in my hands; what I do know is that once I started reading them, they became addictive for me, and my parents would buy them for me at the city’s newsstands. These comics centered on the experiences of a young boy and his mother. I remember enjoying watching the antics of this boy and his friends, but I also saw the family love reflected in these characters, the values that Memín’s mother tried to instill in him. Likewise, the humanity imprinted in every comic strip of these characters, in every new edition, delighted me, as they conveyed all the emotions and feelings in each story, and that fascinated me; to me, these comics were very funny. I never saw it through any other eyes; I only saw it through the eyes of a little girl watching the story of a boy with his mom. Now, as I share with you about these characters, I’ve learned that for its time, this comic was a source of debate among people, due to the alleged “racism” it promoted, according to some; since the main characters were Black and of very humble origins. In my view, both then and now, it was one of the best comic strips I ever read. Because all I could see was a mother who gave everything for her son in an environment of extreme poverty, yet that didn’t take away their joy of having a beautiful love. I confess that, as a child, I cried, laughed, and had a lot of fun with these characters, and for that I thank them for the days they pulled me out of my loneliness as the only child I was until almost my teenage years. This comic was one of my best companions back then.
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/brujita18/23uFRcYS4f7KrH4rLxbnmS3s3GCUeJTwuiD7CiLuxWdy5a8ZQyqTLPYCZfSpW3xNCLgrP.png) [Source/ Fuente](https://cloud10.todocoleccion.online/tebeos-novaro/tc/2023/01/31/18/389784514_tcimg_40B385C0.jpg)
I thank you all for this new [The Silverbloggers Chronicles - Prompt #43 Favorite Childhood Story](https://peakd.com/hive-106316/@hive-106316/the-silverbloggers-chronicles-prompt-43-favourite-childhood-story), dear friends, blessed greetings!
# Es ¡¡Hola, mis queridos amigos veinteañeros!! 😀, hoy paso por aquí para compartirles esos cuentos, historias, historietas que hicieron en mi infancia la diferencia, la compañía perfecta. Pero, como siempre acostumbro, vamos a remontarnos a los años de mi infancia en los años 79-80, con su debida introducción. De la primera persona de la cual recibí infinidades de cuentos e historias fue de mi abuela; creo que ella sembró en mí ese gusto por el misterio, por lo inexplicable a través de sus relatos. De ellos tengo una buena variedad, desde leyendas hasta cuentos propios, de la familia y hasta de vecinos de aquella época. Pero como eso sería entrar a una gran variedad de cuentos e historias, prefiero compartir algo más único, un gusto que fui cosechando cuando aprendí a leer y pude tener en mis manos las historietas de [Memín Pinguín](https://es.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mem%C3%ADn_Pingu%C3%ADn). No recuerdo cómo cayeron estas historietas en mis manos; lo que sí sé es que cuando las empecé a leer se volvieron adictivas para mí y mis padres me las compraban en los quioscos de revistas de la ciudad. Estas historietas se centraban en las vivencias de un pequeño niño y su madre. Recuerdo que yo gozaba viendo las ocurrencias de este niño y sus amigos, pero también veía el amor familiar reflejado en estos personajes, los valores que la madre de Memín trataba de inculcarle. Así mismo, la humanidad impresa en cada historieta de estos personajes, en cada nueva edición, me deleitaba, pues me transmitían todas las emociones y sentimientos en cada historia y eso me fascinaba; para mí eran muy divertidas estas historietas. Nunca la vi con otros ojos, solo la vi con los ojos de una niña que veía la historia de un niño con su mamá. Ahora, para compartirles acerca de estos personajes, me entero de que para su época esta historieta fue motivo de debate entre las personas, por el supuesto \

que pregonaba, según algunas personas; al ser los principales personajes de color y de origen muy humilde. A mi entender, de ese tiempo y ahora, fue una de las mejores historietas que pude leer. Porque yo solo pude ver a una madre que daba todo por su hijo en un ambiente de pobreza extrema, pero que eso no les quitaba el gozo de tener un amor hermoso. Confieso que, como niña, lloré, reí y me divertí mucho con estos personajes y por eso les agradezco los días que me sacaron de mi soledad como niña única que fui hasta casi mi adolescencia. Esta historieta fue una de mis mejores compañías por esos días. Les agradezco a ustedes por esta nueva [The Silverbloggers Chronicles - Prompt # 43 Favourite Childhood Story](https://peakd.com/hive-106316/@hive-106316/the-silverbloggers-chronicles-prompt-43-favourite-childhood-story), queridos amigos, ¡saludos bendecidos!
![Añadir un título.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/brujita18/EpLjnqM8ptWQ4Du5t5CwS6WYp1eCBU7DpXt3ACNMACzh5nnshNkUPpfATytGxcHuqFx.png)

body.title: Where Silence Feels Like Heaven
body.body:
**Hello hive community 🤝**

  Traveling is not merely about covering distances. It is a profound way to rejuvenate the soul. A few days ago, I took a much needed break from the mundane hustle of life to explore these breathtaking valleys, where every sight does a unique story of nature's grandeur.

**1. The gateway to the heights 🛣️**

  Our journey began through these challenging jet enchanting mountain passes. Navigating across high bridges and winding roads makes one realize the sheer depth and magnificence All this world. This part led us higher into clouds, where every turn unveiled a mess mesmerizing vista.

![Photo No (550).jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmWZStFUT6GuuxhqfuazafC3G3wcsrgtfJNTf65zz6ar2W/Photo%20No%20(550).jpg)



   **2. The majestic vistas of the valley 🌲**
   
   As we ascended, the beauty of the valleys revealed itself in all its glory. The crystal clear blue sky and emerald green peaks leave one in absolute awe. I stood there for a while, soaking in the profound silence and peace that can only be found in the embrace of nature.

![Photo No (557).jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmXQT1Kn6Lr1iVjYF62Bjc12bhhkauySvzXzraYgqNbpHY/Photo%20No%20(557).jpg)


   **3. The Crystal waterfall 💧**

   The most memorable part of this trip was discovering the hidden waterfall. This cool, transparent water flowing through the rugged rocks felt like a divine gift. The rhythmic sound of the falling water created a natural symphony that instantly watched away every trace of fatigue. It is truly a masterpiece.

![Photo NO (561).jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmStWopaMqFraigFCir6Wipt56CAtcmMz4k8frA8t3Afzq/Photo%20NO%20(561).jpg)


   **Reflection 💫**
   This tour was more than just a getaway it was a journey of self discovery. Nature teaches us the importance of pausing to appreciate the immense beauty that surrounds us 🌍. 
I hope you enjoyed my photography and this small travelogue.

body.title: What's Do Natural Disaster Tell Us?//Mcgi Topic Review ( part 1)
body.body:
https://youtu.be/8BRqyAUjhW0?si=emy_6fThKUtwzjzP

Greetings everyone, and welcome to my blog. It is another wonderful opportunity to listen to the word of God through His servant, Bro. Eli Soriano.

First, I want to draw your attention to the events that took place during the time of Noah. Many Bible believers agree that the flood described then was global, not just limited to a specific region. When something is global in scale, it is often emphasized as a natural disaster.

A flood, generally speaking, can be classified as a natural disaster. However, some floods are local and may result from human actions—for example, when a dam breaks due to poor construction, causing destruction in nearby communities. Such incidents are typically considered man-made disasters because they result from human failure.

In contrast, during Noah’s time, there were no dams or similar human structures. Therefore, whether the flood was local or global, it would still be considered a natural disaster rather than a man-made one. For those who believe the flood was global, it strongly supports the idea that it was a large-scale natural event.

Now, how should we understand such a disaster? In Genesis 7:11, it is written that in the six hundredth year of Noah’s life, on the seventeenth day of the second month, “all the fountains of the great deep burst forth, and the windows of heaven were opened.” This description suggests a powerful and widespread event that sustained the flood and led to the destruction of all living things, except those preserved in the ark.

From a scientific perspective, this could be related to the movement and breaking apart of the earth’s tectonic plates. When these plates shift, they can trigger earthquakes and other large-scale natural phenomena, which may help explain the intensity and extent of the flood described.

**Thanks for reading.**

body.title: Act Like It
body.body:
Steve, a young man who was inspired to become a boxer, stood in the dark, all dressed like a boxer, in red boxing gloves and shorts. Not because he was afraid of light, but he wanted to focus on what stood before him as an opponent.

While others felt he wasn't fit for boxing following his recent knee injury, he was persistent and wouldn't allow the words from others to discourage him. Gad had told him something he held onto strongly and was ready to work with it.
\

he added.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmTGWC2xAEYiYrGktnHEM3Y3G4baL51XvGHeSmS6mhYrPi/1777064451564.webp)

[Photo source](https://ecency.com/hive-161155/@freewritehouse/a-picture-is-worth-a-thousand-words-td9lpz)

Steve stood there, his hands raised to his face in defense. He threw a few punches in the air and returned to defending. At intervals, he punched the mannequin standing before him hard and celebrated each perfect punch. When the mannequin dropped to the ground, he acted like the champion he envisioned becoming. Steve continued this for months, and he was lucky to join the tournament after a year, where he won three matches to qualify.

It wasn't an easy tournament for Steve, who was joining for the first time, but the resistance he had built by acting like a champion helped him stay strong. He didn't make it as the champion of the year, but came second, an astonishment to people, who realized he had made it this far as a new boxer.

‎It's with great pleasure that I'm welcoming everyone to my blog today, and I hope you're all doing well and enjoying your day.
‎
‎It’s another beautiful Friday, and comes with it the familiar excitement of Fungifriday, a moment I haven’t truly participated in for a while now. Not because I lost interest, but simply because I hadn’t come across mushrooms recently. Sometimes, nature decides when you get to be part of its little wonders.
‎
‎Earlier today, while exploring the Hive Blockchain, I happened to stumbled upon a Fungifriday post by @luchyl, and it instantly reignited that spark and that was all the push I needed. It's the post that reminded me that I didn’t have to wait for a perfect moment as I already had one saved without realizing it.
‎
‎
‎![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmbjSLCPrAtaxqXnVpxsVXUZxemEJPJcW9qFNbsawnAGYm/1777064532840.jpg)
‎
‎![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZJyvAwBkpTLHZCudAhxMWMhtvC1S5bhh2fbDfdh6BM1k/1777064533345.jpg)
‎
‎
‎![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmUs37bHzmqHivRMvCYSrfnsEhmuYXEdvKTJYqkr1rmFTL/1777064535673.jpg)
‎
‎
‎While working on the farm few days ago, I noticed something quietly beautiful on the walk track. Growing on a dead decay tree were clusters of mushrooms, thriving in a place that most would overlook. I remember stopping for a moment, taking it all in, and capturing a few pictures. At the time, it felt like just another simple moment, but it means more now.
‎
‎![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYYBuemCd1da8MS3TfuAmEd73bPYXm4N41UA7VYhAovtT/1777064534917.jpg)
‎
‎![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmNUKCJwxdaumvA1cWfaz6UrH41n4pWUkJJb5EVm8GSUKo/1777064534418.jpg)
‎
‎![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmXiPtmzexJ2rTdir6uf3EdwcSf9TnJjVP5EsU2E2WzeKT/1777064619566.jpg)
‎
‎
‎There’s something more deeply symbolic about mushrooms growing on decay life emerging from what seems lifeless. It reflects resilience in its purest form, and maybe that’s why I find them so amazing  and fascinating.
‎
‎So today, I’m finally sharing those pictures and reconnecting with this amazing community. Fungifriday is not just about mushrooms, but it’s about observation, appreciation, and storytelling through the nature.
‎
‎Though, I might have been away for a bit, but moments like this remind me that sometimes, all it takes is a little nudge and a memory to come back and share again.
‎
‎This is my contribution to @ewkaw initiative 
‎
‎**All pictures Are Mine**
‎
‎![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYaWnApEziAtLL5Zwv3ZNbDjRfSfG6h5njgTrpyasnE6y/1775569275821.png)
‎

body.title: Forget the past keh?
body.body: Although it is often said that we should always let the past stay in the past, I like how the world holds on to the past in people’s lives and thoughts, and I am not an exception. I know of some Nigerian music artists that even if they were to come to my city to perform for free of charge, I would still be scared and skeptical about attending such shows except security is very tight. Oh yeah I'm talking about life here. A typical example of this is Naira Marley and his crew. During the death of one of the crew members, they said a lot of unfearful things concerning the death of the guy, both on their social media posts and the songs they released during that moment when it was trending very thickly that they killed the guy. I love how Naira Marley is being dragged till this day anytime he speaks publicly both on social media posts and elsewhere. Should we do away with the past? ================================ I don’t know how others see it, but I strongly believe that a person’s life is defined by their past. Forget the religious talks of “forgive the past”; the past has a lot to say in one’s life. There was a recent trend that revealed a lot of truth in the Nigerian political sector. The newly appointed head official of the body to oversee the upcoming general election was traced back to his past posts on X and was found to have once been a very loyal supporter of the sitting president, which is not supposed to be so because such officials are meant to be non-partisan. The post that was dug up became a public revelation, suggesting that the official was appointed just to manipulate the results in favor of his boss at the end of the day. But, considering how corrupt the political system in Nigeria is, there has been a cover-up through denial by the President and the electoral body at large. You see why it is important to examine someone’s past life too? I had a friend, _maybe we are still friends till this day I don't know😅_, who boasted several times that she can't get married with someone she hasn't mingled with for at least a year. She made these boats from the ideas on the books she read and seminars she attended. She's the churchy type and such ideas and beliefs are always with people like that. Guess what? She married a guy she met for just 5months. Yeah, I was in school when I was given an invitation letter and I never expected the sudden invitation. I waited until everything had settled down before reminding her of the beliefs she had strongly held and spoken about several times. She did not stand by those beliefs. I spoke to her in a way that my words really got to her, even though she tried to brush off the conversation with laughter and jokes. Thanks for reading

body.title: Sometimes Pain Is Not Punishment… It’s Preparation
body.body:
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmbzFLg8wfyiUhp7BybXxCf2p9JZHhXDkLikqMfua7uEyn/1777065048038.jpg)
https://shorturl.at/yYbAx


I remember one night, I was just sitting quietly, thinking about why life becomes heavy without warning. No reason, no clear mistake… but still, pressure comes.
And honestly, I used to think… maybe I did something wrong.
But now I see it a little differently.
There is this story I once heard about a wise man and his student. The student asked a simple question, but it had weight: “Why does God test us?”
And the answer was not loud, not complicated… just deep.
He said something like this: when a person loves something deeply, they don’t destroy it—they refine it.
That line stayed with me.
Because if you look around, nothing valuable comes easy. Not respect. Not patience. Not even understanding yourself.
Everything comes after some kind of pressure.
Like… think about it. When life is easy, we don’t question ourselves. We don’t grow much. We just pass time.
But when things get hard, suddenly we start thinking, changing, adjusting.
It hurts, yes. No doubt.
But maybe that’s the point.
I’ve seen in my own life, the moments that broke me a little… those same moments shaped me the most. At that time, I didn’t understand anything. I was just tired. Confused. Even a bit angry.
But later, slowly… things started making sense.
Not fully. But enough.
There’s also something else people don’t talk about much. Not every test is about punishment. Some are about trust.
Like… you are being trusted with something difficult because you are capable of carrying it.
You might not feel capable, though. I didn’t either.
There were times I thought, “Why me?”
Now sometimes I think, “Maybe because I can handle it… even if I don’t feel like it.”
Still, I won’t lie and say everything becomes easy after understanding this. No. Life still hits hard.
But the difference is… now I don’t break the same way.
There’s a little more patience. A little more silence. A little more acceptance.
And maybe that’s growth.
I think what we really need to understand is this: not every pain is here to stay. Some pain is just passing through, doing its work, and leaving.
Like a strict teacher.
You don’t like them at the time. But later, you realize they taught you the most.
So yeah… maybe not everything in life is meant to be understood immediately.
Some things are meant to be lived through first.
And if you are going through something heavy right now, I won’t say “stay strong” like everyone else.
Just… stay present.
Sometimes that’s enough.

Nie jestem tak mobilny, jak niektórzy, ale mimo wszystko, zawód taki, że można zwiedzać i trochę nietypowo. Dzisiaj padło na Tarnowskie Góry, które są zupełnie inne niż miasta, które mam na co dzień. A wiecie co jest śmieszne, że byłem w nim może 2-3 raz w życiu. Ma swój niepowtarzalny śląski klimat, ale całkiem inny. Musiałbym tam dłużej pochodzić, podokumentować. Mam na to dużą ochotę, ale może uda się rowerem (nie mówcie @asia-pl). Najfajniejsze w tym dzisiaj wszystkim było, że mógł se poosprawiać po śląsku. With all the pros and cons, there’s one very strong upside — getting to explore. I’m not as mobile as some people, but still, my profession lets me travel and see places in a somewhat unconventional way. Today it was Tarnowskie Góry, which feels completely different from the cities I deal with on a daily basis. And the funny thing is, I’ve only been there maybe two or three times in my life. It has its own unique Silesian vibe — but quite a different one. I’d need to spend more time there, walk around, document it properly. *****
https://youtu.be/t62FzkjBf9A?si=m6bnb7VIpXym1EpA
*****
When I saw a mode like this on Blood Strike I was happy because the last time I saw something like this was on Call of Duty Mobile. I was curious on trying it to sew what Blood Strike's Search and Destroy would be like and honestly it's just the same thing which is nice but the nicer part about Blood Strike Search and Destroy is that there are new maps for the mode which gives it a fresh look.
On Blood Strike you need cash to buy your character skill/ operator skill which means you can't use them without buying and you also buy health like other modes and all these random criteria would make winning random and not just go one team's way.
For those who doesn't know, search and destroy is a mode where two team participate in, one teams tries to set a bomb and protect it till it goes off and the other tries to defuse. If there are 5 games in that mode to determine a winner, the teams would destroy or defuse till 5 points is used up and then they switch rools for the next 5 point.
By the way, I downloaded Call of Duty Mobile because I heard a new free legendary PP Bizon is out and I won't want to miss that gun, like the skin is beautiful as h*ll so I'd be grinding CODM for a while and delete it after grinding. Thanks for visiting 😊.

body.title: A's fail to secure sweep of Mariners Wednesday | Luis Severino on the mound to begin series vs Rangers
body.body:
![584d48ce0a44bd1070d5d46f.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/adhammer/AJg3BnVxoiM2NuNHqgzjQovf9NYMeSJ4EYmngpiJMp61Su8EWJJbQuCKSGUjh45.png)
[Src](https://www.stickpng.com/img/sports/baseball/major-league-baseball-mlb/oakland-athletics/oakland-athletics-a-logo)

Ah man, the A's almost had it Wednesday. They sort of blew it, but it wasn't as if the lead was all that large to begin with. They jumped out to an early lead but couldn't quite hold the Mariners off. Nick Kurtz came up very clutch in the top of the ninth with a solo shot that tied the game and forced the Mariners to bat in the bottom of the ninth. That was exciting! Josh Naylor ended up walking it off with the game winning single unfortunately. The sweep was soooo close, that would have been awesome. 

Cal Raleigh homered in each game of the series vs the A's, as did Munetaka Murakami in the series prior. Sheesh, hopefully the A's rotation can tone that down a bit. Another power hitter in Jake Burger of the Rangers also had a lot of success not too long ago against the A's, and the A's are set to face him all over again tonight down in Texas. In fact, Burger hit two homers against Luis Severino in the first game of that series, so hopefully Severino has a new approach against him on the mound tonight...

The A's are now barely over .500 at 13-12 which is respectable this early in the season and so far they seem to be a better team than they were a year ago.

The Rangers are also 13-12 though so this is a pretty big series in the AL West. These two teams went 2-2 against each other in their four game series only roughly a week and half ago. It was a well played, competitive series. This series is only three games though so no ties this time, there will be a distinct leader of the AL West by Sunday. Let's see how it goes. This is another early test to prove if the 2026 Athletics are indeed legit! 

# #GOATHLETICS

It's a super busy night for me as a sports fan. The NFL Draft continues for the NFL and my Titans, the Phillies play, the A's play, AND the Sixers are in the Playoffs...

But hey, life's good!

body.title: Parq of lovers(en/es)
body.body:
.


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmS2dcZMFqLji8kCeTfqryo2Ca9kbMbafaYhQXQ5Rdrdfp/1777063731881.jpg)

✍️✍️ENGLISH VERSIÓN ✍️✍️

✍️Hello Worldmaping friends!

✍️How good to meet again to visit places, visit important sites and fill ourselves with stories and new experiences!

✍️Today I propose a very important and interesting site in Havana's city geography, which more than a site is an area full of a lot of history. I am referring to the area where the Royal Jail of Havana was located.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmWPBU4NjGdPJApfYSogpXuDUvXBGVpyY4cdf8zPVxrWD6/1777061622503.jpg)

✍️Already with the fact that this penitentiary institution from the colonial era is enough for it to have relevance, since, among other things, our José Martí was imprisoned there as a child for his patriotic ideals. But that place is linked to even more painful events in the history of Cuba, since at one end there is still a piece of wall where the eight medical students were unjustifiably shot, for which I have already prepared a separate post. 

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmRAG8Ttz5o82EaSai4rRGvigaJBd9iToDEpbvwbBiHtNQ/1777061695814.jpg)


✍️The Royal Jail of Havana was demolished in the 1930s, but at the request of personalities of the time, including the city's historian, the chapel was preserved as a memory of the crimes and pain left by that macabre colonialist institution.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQf6KBgb9oRpnKFDBJH3xnWCRZ345JDwrwdbpuZycCQb7/1777061854034.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQsxpdNMMk6XJdd4BNDSaTZrFDYKJZmoGzHUHWb5S8WqC/1777061854679.jpg)

✍️But not everything is pain in the place, because feelings of love are always superimposed with actions to change the energies of those places full of so much drama. For this reason, in that same area a beautiful and peaceful park has been built which they named \

.
This park, like the Royal Jail of Havana, is located at the end of the Paseo del Prado, another emblematic site of the city, built relatively at the same time as that penitentiary institution.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmX35dNV4iEG4mdwFYxRtNWd93LLrPZwdxiHyUGS43Dmok/1777061957078.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmaMvTEuzq8YHQMArvHYsrhr9ZtiRw96eJF6C1sXyBTsvd/1777061957689.jpg)


✍️The park is spacious and shady, with interior sidewalks, benches for resting and two beautiful sculptural groups. One is a simple fountain with a slender naked woman emerging from the waters, lifted by two newts, which, as I once heard, means the island of Cuba saved by those mythological beings; and the other represents a strongly built Indian in a firm attitude defending a woman kneeling at his feet and leaning against his strong bare legs.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmchm2PhEbRUQttntg6Epjzgfpthov8NGrD77wFbWAxCYH/1777062093051.jpg)
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmchm2PhEbRUQttntg6Epjzgfpthov8NGrD77wFbWAxCYH/1777062339893.jpg)
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmNoN2wAUt86dMfUyUoELbsCivg4w8mF27LHZY8Dwc27ab/1777062093683.jpg)

✍️These two sculptural groups contrast in their whiteness with the intense green of the trees and grass. A very good idea to create this park, always fresh due to the proximity of the sea just a few meters away, where people from all over come to rest who perhaps only see a park where there was pain and blood before. But, as the poet said: only love turns mud into a miracle.


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmeoeXrPdN9u89MYgQDfqH5ps8SYdoZzcTzSxUXNLqLPRu/1777062596892.jpg)


✍️I invite you to visit the lovers' park, and with kisses and caresses contribute to continue changing the history of that place.

✍️Thank you for accompanying me to visit this interesting place.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQma8ZKcDUcsyPJCjiMzkJVrawKcLZLbdm3hh6doTiawrqG/1777062217871.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmThKG2VNkBT8D25U4mhMdwDGBvckiXvgkGDYwLBY1yD88/1777062218537.jpg)

✍️✍️VERSIÓN EN ESPAÑOL ✍️✍️

¡Hola amigos de Worldmaping!

>✍️¡Qué bien volver a encontrarnos para recorrer lugares, visitar sitios importantes y llenarnos de historias y nuevas experiencias!

>✍️Hoy les propongo un sitio muy importante e interesante de la geografía citadina habanera, que más que un sitio es un área llena de mucha historia. Me refiero a la zona donde estuvo enclavada la Real Cárcel de La Habana.

>✍️Ya con el hecho de que esa institución penitenciaria de la época colonial es suficiente para que tenga relevancia, pues, entre otras cosas, ahí estuvo preso siendo un niño nuestro José Martí por sus ideales patrióticos. Pero ese lugar está vinculado a hechos aún más dolorosos en la historia de Cuba, pues en uno de sus extremos aún se conserva un pedazo de muro donde fueron pasados por las armas de manera injustificada los ocho estudiantes de medicina, para lo que ya preparo un post aparte.

>✍️La Real Cárcel de La Habana fue demolida en los años treinta del pasado siglo, pero a petición de personalidades de la época, incluyendo al historiador de la ciudad, se logró conservar la capilla como memoria de los crímenes y dolores dejados por aquella macabra institución colonialista.

>✍️Pero no todo es dolor en el lugar, porque siempre los sentimientos de amor se superponen con acciones para cambiarle las energías a esos lugares llenos de tanto drama. Por eso, en esa misma área se ha construido un bello y apacible parque al que nombraron \

.
>Este parque, al igual que la Real Cárcel de La Habana, se encuentra al final del Paseo del Prado, otro sitio emblemático de la ciudad, construido relativamente en la misma época que aquella institución penitenciaria.

>✍️El parque es amplio y sombreado, con aceras interiores, bancos para el descanso y dos hermosos conjuntos escultóricos. Uno es una sencilla fuente con una esbelta mujer desnuda saliendo de las aguas, alzada por dos tritones, que, según escuché alguna vez, significa a la isla de Cuba salvada por esos seres mitológicos; y el otro representa a un indio de fuerte complexión en firme actitud de defender a una mujer arrodillada a sus pies y recostada a sus fuertes piernas desnudas.

>✍️Estos dos conjuntos escultóricos contrastan en su blancura con el verde intenso de la arbolada y el césped. Muy buena idea la de crear este parque, siempre fresco por la cercanía del mar a escasos metros del mismo, al que llegan a descansar personas de todos lados que quizás solo ven un parque donde antes hubo dolor y sangre. Pero, como dijo el poeta: solo el amor convierte en milagro el barro.

>✍️Los convido a que visiten el parque de los enamorados, y con besos y caricias contribuyan a seguir cambiando la historia de aquel lugar.

>✍️Gracias por acompañarme a visitar este interesante lugar.

This is a weekly overview of my personal sports betting/trading results on teams from the Belgian Jupiler League, documenting my journey toward long-term profit with some insights on my overall approach.

body.title: Should AI handle your payments?
body.body:
https://img.leopedia.io/DQmSjgBya7mp2YGt59vrRLKBrpV2ArfLfmHTXj3wXYg4MG1/1000171891.jpg 
[source](https://www.freepik.com/free-ai-image/digital-smartphone-technology-data-transfer-concept_418977030.htm#fromView=search&page=2&position=19&uuid=4715a901-220a-4bf0-a71c-153a1c1ff60b&query=AI+and+payments+AI+generated+) 
Many attention has been turned to the current global [war](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-war). I haven't looked into that for a while. The last [time](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-time) I checked, there was still a dragging between the US and Iran. While the Iranian IRGC regime still seeks dominance in the straits to control toll fees the US navy has on the other end created a blockade to lock [ships](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-ship) in.   

Maybe you should understand that Iran makes $500 million daily from the strait of Hormuz courtesy of [oil](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-oil) shipping activities. In just two [days](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-day), it means they are at a $1 billion [loss](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-loss-financial). Indeed, this is an [economic](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-economic) crash  

Let's look away from that and concentrate on the topic for today. The world's advancement continues and at a fast pace. WWW, [social media](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-social-media), [cryptocurrency](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/cryptocurrency), web3, AI and of course there are many other things still in-between. To [entrepreneurs](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-entrepreneur), the focus is how to blend and apply for better [profit](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-profit). While many still fear AI will take [jobs](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-job), I have something job seekers can also ponder upon at the moment   

We are focusing on [artificial intelligence](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-artificial-intelligence) and its impact.I wanted to focus on [payments](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-payment) and marketing but it will be just payment for today. The question is, would you [love](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-love) AI to handle your payments?. 

We are not much focused on your spending habits (although also something to consider a huge advantage of proper AI application) but rather talking of you becoming an automated entrepreneur. Here, payment is no actually because you want to but because you have to.   

Does it [sound](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-sound) fair? Or on the other hand, how long will entrepreneurs escape this automation? We are seeing each needed [stage](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-stage) gradually fixing itself in. Think [blockchain](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/blockchain) [technology](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-technology) coupled with what AI has to offer and you can imagine the needed shift.   
 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmQkqyTpFRXZbWQWpsDzUkhsEujUb2MRtPnVqUQPTgvYKE/1000171897.jpg 
[source](https://www.freepik.com/free-vector/holographic-display-isometric-neon-digital-futuristic-technology-user-interface-development-design_4102885.htm#fromView=search&page=7&position=23&uuid=4715a901-220a-4bf0-a71c-153a1c1ff60b&query=AI+and+payments+AI+generated+) 
AI will bring about [business](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-business) [transparency](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-transparency). Think of it this way, ‘when it is this date, pay [ALL](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-all-currency) my workers’. Does it make sense? It depends on the side; of course a big thumbs up for workers. Can AI integration be a game changer? How often do [companies](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-company-business) owe workers?   

At least I have heard some of my [friends](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-friend) complain such and the fact of the matter is, it is not that the [money](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-money) isn't there but a [greed](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-greed) mentality to keep profiting off staff salaries.   

AI integration will allow big company's [data](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-data) to be easily monitored. And well, [government](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-government) workers will even love it the most. All those salary wailing will be cut [short](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-short-selling). I haven't received my salary for the past three [months](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-month), how about gratuity and pensions? It is a matter of will they even allow AI to thrive this much for the fact that it seems private companies won't be the only set affected.   

To conclude, let me add, technology remains both a threat and an [opportunity](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-opportunity). I am imagining a future where delayed payments will be curbed. The question is, will workers start seeing value for artificial intelligence?.  

>This is an [article](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-article) covered by dani-EL; a broad niche [writer](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-writer). I write on faith, [life](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-life) facts and daily living, business and [economics](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-economics-social-science), small scale and daily businessing, [cryptocurrency](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/cryptocurrency) and [technology](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-technology). And yes, I do cover articles on financial [education](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-education) and [investment](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-investment) updates. And [note](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-note), if I happen to be a financial adviser to you, the [TOP](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-top-currency) financial advice should be ‘DYOR’ (Do Your Own Research), I can't afford to break your heart.

body.body:
## Hello music lovers! 🎶  
 
It's Music Friday and #newtunes here! 
A fresh selection of music featuring well-known, lesser-known, and even unknown artists who are trying to get a few minutes of our time. This week, I’m continuing to revisit all kinds of styles and genres that point to new - or old - trends that are making a comeback.

Is there even a future global hit among them? You won't know until you listen :)  

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmfURZfwVsNSyuU68AEmv4Kdt7D6pyyMyePSNLDd4Up8CV/nt.24.4.2026.logo.webp)

Eight songs for curious music lovers! If you like something, you can dig deeper to find more detailed info.
If you don't like, skip it. 
 
**Music4life!**  
 
<center>🎵 🎧 🎵</center>  
 
## A Place To Bury Strangers - Nature Of Your Heart

The American noise-rock/shoegaze/post-punk band A Place To Bury Strangers (APTBS) from New York continues to release singles from their latest rarities album, 'Rare and Deadly', released in early April. The album is a collection of demos, unreleased recordings, and song drafts from the period 2015–2025.
The song \

is impulsive and hypnotic, featuring distorted guitars and a dark atmosphere that blends beauty and horror. The video is based on footage from the film From The Brain That Wouldn't Die.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=1-d7dm5lW5E


<center>🎵 🎧 🎵</center>  
 
## The Babalooneys - Soup Surfer

The Babalooneys are a young rock band from Quebec, Canada. They’re a new name to me; this is the first time I’ve heard them. Since 2022, they’ve been playing 60s-style instrumental surf rock, featuring melodic guitar riffs, reverb, drums, and tenor saxophone. So far, they’ve released two EPs and their debut album, Late to the Party!, in June 2024.
The song “Soup Surfer” is a single and a preview of their new, second studio album, Goin’ For It, which will be released at the end of May this year. A revival of surf rock, which I like.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=5MrbAq2cVTA


<center>🎵 🎧 🎵</center>  

## Psychedelic Porn Crumpets - Born In The A.D's 

Psychedelic Porn Crumpets, an Australian rock band from Perth that has been playing since 2014, has been a frequent guest on #newtunes over the past year. Mainly because of their excellent latest, eighth album, Pogo Rodeo, from which they are now releasing singles.
The song \

is a typical track for them, featuring face-melting guitar riffs, powerful drums, garage-psychedelic energy, and humorous, raw lyrics that say that, even though you were born in the present, modern era, you still have a primitive caveman inside you.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=o8to6QF9nAQ


<center>🎵 🎧 🎵</center>  

## City of the Sun - Ciudad del Sol

City of the Sun is an American trio from New York. They’ve been playing since 2011; they started out as street performers, had a singer until 2014, and then switched entirely to an instrumental format. They’re a new band for me - I listened to them for the first time this week. Their sound is a mix of post-rock, flamenco, gypsy jazz, indie rock, American folk, and blues—very cinematic, emotional, and 'world music-style' instrumental rock. They’ve released three studio albums.
The song “Ciudad del Sol” is a single from their latest album, *Under The Moon*, released today. It features a desert-rock and spaghetti-western vibe with intricate guitar work, dynamic percussion, and a subtle sense of journeying through Mexican or desert landscapes.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=jGc-bMbULck


<center>🎵 🎧 🎵</center>
 
## Drill - Marijuana 

Drill, whose real name is Andrej Bučar, is a Slovenian rap/hip-hop artist, MC, lyricist, producer, promoter, and director from Izola. He has been performing since 2002 and as a solo artist since 2010. To date, he has released five albums.
The song “Marijuana” is a new single and music video, released four days ago, from his latest album, Momentum. The song is direct, street rap with a strong flow, a trap/hip-hop beat, and autobiographical and hedonistic themes. It talks about marijuana as part of a lifestyle.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ulkLlWH1kRw


<center>🎵 🎧 🎵</center>  
 
## Wet Leg - CPR

Wet Leg is a British indie rock band from the Isle of Wight; they’ve been playing since 2019 and have recorded two albums so far. They went viral on TikTok and were nominated for a Brit Award for their 2022 debut album. They’re known for their deadpan humor, sharp lyrics, catchy guitar riffs, and energetic, lively performances.
The song \

is from their second album, and the recording is from their performance at the Coachella 2026 festival - it’s energetic and fun, and I believe they’ll climb even higher on the music charts.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=7r52xlpmPX8



<center>🎵 🎧 🎵</center>

## Butthole Surfers - Imbuya (Official Video)

Butthole Surfers, the American cult experimental/psychedelic punk band, have, apparently, woken up. After twenty-five years, at the end of June this year, their eighth studio album, After The Astronaut, will be released.
The song “Imbuya” is the second single from the upcoming album, psych-sludge, a mix of psychedelic rock, industrial, punk, and abstract guitar chaos. The song is typical of them—chaotic and absurd—to paraphrase guitarist Leary, who says on YouTube:
>Imbuya was conceived and produced much like a fart after eating beans. A truly meaningless song. Kinda our thing.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=XIktP8BzhQA

<center>🎵 🎧 🎵</center>  
 
##  Derby Motoreta's Burrito Kachimba - Gitana - (En directo desde el Teatro Romano de Mérida 8/09/2025)

I already mentioned the Spanish band Derby Motoreta’s Burrito Kachimba in #newtunes about a month ago, when I first listened to them. Flamenco, stoner, Andalusian rock, and psychedelia. A few days ago, I came across another live recording, the song “Gitana,” from their second album 'Hilo Negro' (2021), recorded at the Teatro Romano de Mérida last year, with the video released this past March. Very passionate and dark, with psychedelic elements, flamenco rhythms, a groovy bassline, and incredible energy.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=K7rGBBOncxo


<center>🎵 🎧 🎵</center>
 
🎶 That should be all for today, thanks for your attention, and enjoy your weekend with new songs!

body.title: Hiking in Rio Brito [ENG/ESP]
body.body:
![1000468549.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/joanm897/AKAqTpH62vYkExmHRQAoj4H5opkkvmjcGHYxkAmvW8ys8zDR2hXQpmLm4G4vK1N.jpg)

Hello Worldmappin friends. It's a pleasure for me to share with you today a short trip I recently took with the folks at Full Caribe Tours to Río Brito.

>Hola amigos de Worldmappin. Es un placer compartir con ustedes hoy un breve viaje que realicé recientemente con la gente de Full Caribe Tours a Río Brito.

![1000468541.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/joanm897/23wMajcXeZABjN6ujYBikSBz8tCMugfRTqg7F2Z1wPnYaxLALhg8bECkT1dxnMBhipR7H.jpg)

The Brito River is a tributary of the Manzanares River. It's a magical and very peaceful place located just a few minutes from Cumaná, via Cumanacoa, about a 20-minute drive away.

>El río Brito es un afluente del río Manzanares. Es un lugar mágico y muy tranquilo, ubicado a pocos minutos de Cumaná, vía Cumanacoa, a unos 20 minutos en coche


![1000468540.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/joanm897/EoyQYkjKUMQ6SVuyXkRCvA1DifGSACvoEb9hTtQ8BpzMqo6A8f6mpJo1frFay29j9YH.jpg)

![1000357498.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/joanm897/23uFTQiHZcmZFvEjaRBGafw8iZsePshMmrAoUGvGcpj3fawX9Xr3yF3gu1Nk76G3tVrFR.jpg)

The trails are not difficult to navigate for someone without prior experience; however, it is recommended to go with a guide or someone who has hiked the trail before to avoid any problems. (2) Avoid going during the rainy season, as the rivers can rise rapidly.
>Los senderos no son difíciles de recorrer para alguien sin experiencia previa; sin embargo, se recomienda ir con un guía o alguien que ya haya recorrido el sendero para evitar problemas. (2) Evite ir durante la temporada de lluvias, ya que los ríos pueden crecer rápidamente.

![1000468524.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/joanm897/23ywijqJBrh4WiDfePxHSrYAfFpUrTNjxo8541a2fMPp67tFAMXB1a9pH5anS3x3p3JCJ.jpg)

![1000357509.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/joanm897/242rqFeaNHwoR1c5Pz9neLd5HyH9wY4eieq4NpYYjwzCKoMfrdwwTU2vMk1DeaSiuhgNP.jpg)

![1000468520.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/joanm897/EpQuLDkFHnNfrMP1EHRwHwmqP34anfzKB1cBKYD8LUpfAvaeLt3RgY9ziCM6BmCvT6c.jpg)

Upon reaching the river, you can enjoy a long trail with the help of local guides. Along the way, you'll find numerous pools of varying shapes and sizes, with crystal-clear water at a pleasant temperature.

>Al llegar al río, puedes disfrutar de un largo sendero con la ayuda de los guías del lugar. En medio del camino encontrarás muchas pozas de formas y tamaños, con aguas cristalinas y de temperatura agradable.

![1000468525.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/joanm897/Eq5CcVVM54xVHMqdkjpbAYg6u5GEKWPh5AGrZWGGhSsCAhDmnJ7Kq9ZR7sPwT4vugEe.jpg)

![1000468519.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/joanm897/EoGyNzBYpxtYjqvhR1XJLRBppgWtFLEMDJ3HpGcf3PDhVSxdsbE8XEgA1396zgCALxB.jpg)

I recommend bringing a liter and a half of water for hydration because it takes about 50 minutes to reach the first pool in the river.  Regarding hiking gear, personally, I recommend: (1) good quality hiking boots or athletic shoes, as you'll have to cross the river several times. 
>Recomiendo llevar un litro y medio de agua para hidratarse, ya que se tarda unos 50 minutos en llegar a la primera poza del río. En cuanto al equipo de senderismo, personalmente recomiendo: (1) botas de montaña o zapatillas deportivas de buena calidad, ya que tendrás que cruzar el río varias veces. 

![1000468538.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/joanm897/EpC9vaxGu78W8WNt2JEGP2XgYgRPC1tuQ2QZBatfmXFaiUNJv9wEgFi6QZJho9kF61d.jpg)


![1000468518.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/joanm897/EoGyTnYEbSTRSDTgaLv6HMXgdDNLBchHyps5o4PKjqBfkDt8eMFhgdmhuBD4G69X7DR.jpg)


![1000468517.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/joanm897/23tmG1BXRuyZmWzb192fA5StFmFCf1Sydhj7uUJ6ip57KUP5X6MSfSJBwHx3mCaTKuwVv.jpg)

body.title: Crash Landing on You – A Love Beyond Boundaries
body.body:
Seriously, Korean dramas have this magical way of drawing you in, and Crash Landing on You is not exception, this is the drama I've watched more than two times. From the moment I started watching it, I was hooked  and I think a lot of people would agree with me. This drama brings together Hyun Bin and Son Ye-jin in a love story that is both heartwarming and heartbreaking. The love that is beyond boundaries, against the complicated backdrop of the North and South Korean divide, Crash landing on you is not just a love story. It’s an exploration of humanity, sacrifice, and the power of compassion.

 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmX6hVS2hGbcd1PhtY6U5wfBKGkMdBkDuZgm6tPwzxqQ9o/1000207776.jpg 

Yoon Se-ri  a wealthy businesswoman from South Korea, she accidentally ends up paragliding into North Korea after a freak accident. That is where she meets Ri Jeong-hyeok, a North Korean army officer, who, despite the danger to his own life, decides to protect her and help her find her way back home. What starts off as a strange twist of fate soon blossoms into an unlikely love story, one that’s filled with moments of joy, tension, and emotional depth.

This drama shows that compassion and sacrifice can go a long way. What really stuck with me throughout the show was the lesson on compassion and sacrifice. Both Se-ri and Jeong-hyeok go through so much for each other, and it’s honestly inspiring to watch. At first, Se-ri seems like a bit of a self-absorbed businesswoman who’s used to getting what she wants. But as she spends more time in North Korea, she begins to see the world in a new light. Her journey is all about learning empathy and realizing that love isn’t just about what you can get, it’s about what you can give.

 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmX7b2fqLD3m3H1ZfaVTUA2QeDZnrvtCXR9T2sFg8GLCXz/1000207777.jpg 

Jeong-hyeok, on the other hand, is the embodiment of selflessness. He risks his own safety multiple times to protect Se-ri, and his actions remind us that sometimes the most loving thing you can do for someone is to put their well-being ahead of your own but can we really do it. The drama really highlights how love doesn’t always mean being together, sometimes, it’s about making the hard choices and doing the right thing, even when it hurts.

If there’s one scene that really stuck with me long after I finished watching, it’s definitely the goodbye between Se-ri and Jeong-hyeok at the border. By this point in the story, the two of them have been through so much together, and they’ve fallen in love. But the reality of the political divide between North and South Korea makes it impossible for them to stay together. So, when they have to say goodbye, the pain in that moment is palpable.

 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmZiKoh5AmQbLCCUC59uNp3QzDM8AAod8dfVgrsNUN9m4H/1000207779.jpg 


What makes it so powerful is that it’s not dramatic in the usual sense. There’s no grand speech, no over-the-top emotions, it’s just a simple moment where they silently exchange looks, both knowing that this is the end. Jeong-hyeok’s teary-eyed stare as Se-ri walks away is heart-wrenching, but there’s a beauty in their farewell, too. It’s a reminder that sometimes, love isn’t about being together, it’s about letting go when the time comes. That scene really stuck with me because, honestly, it reflects so much of real life. We can’t always be with the people we love, but we can still carry those feelings with us, even from a distance.

Seriously, watching this drama over and over again is not a mistake because Crash Landing on You is so much more than a typical romance. It’s a story about growing as a person, making sacrifices for others, and finding love in the most unexpected places. It reminds us that compassion and kindness can break through the toughest barriers, whether they’re physical or emotional. Watching Se-ri and Jeong-hyeok’s journey gave me a lot to think about because It’s got everything, heart, humor, tension, and a love story that will stay with you long after you’ve finished watching.

All images are screenshot from the movie 

**Thank for checking on my blog and have a wonderful day**

body.title: 😝 National Hairball Awareness Day! / ¡Día Nacional de Concientización sobre las Bolas de Pelo! 😎
body.body: > National Hairball Awareness Day is celebrated annually on the last Friday of April. This day aims to raise awareness about a common problem that many cats face weekly. ***Hairballs are caused by a cat's grooming habits and occur when hair accumulates in the esophagus or stomach, forcing the cat to vomit.*** > El Día Nacional de Concientización sobre las Bolas de Pelo se celebra anualmente el último viernes de abril. Este día tiene como objetivo crear conciencia sobre un problema común que muchos gatos enfrentan semanalmente. ***Las bolas de pelo se producen por los hábitos de acicalamiento del gato y ocurren cuando el pelo se acumula en el esófago o el estómago, lo que obliga al gato a vomitarlas.*** Although most hairballs are natural and don't pose a problem, they can cause blockages in cats, which can lead to serious health issues. Therefore, cat owners are advised to take responsibility for removing hairballs to ensure their cat's well-being. **All cats will develop hairballs, if not regularly, at least a few times throughout their lives.** This is perfectly normal. However, just because hairballs are inevitable doesn't mean they can't be successfully managed. The first step in addressing your cat's hairball problem is to learn a little more about them. > Aunque la mayoría de las bolas de pelo son naturales y no representan un problema, pueden causar obstrucciones en los gatos, lo que puede derivar en graves problemas de salud. Por ello, se recomienda a los dueños de gatos que se encarguen de eliminar las bolas de pelo para garantizar su bienestar. Todos los gatos tendrán bolas de pelo, si no con regularidad, al menos algunas veces a lo largo de su vida. Es algo normal. Sin embargo, que las bolas de pelo sean inevitables no significa que no se puedan tratar con éxito. El primer paso para tratar el problema de las bolas de pelo de tu gato es aprender un poco más sobre ellas. The scientific name for a hairball is ***trichobezoar.*** Some ancient peoples believed that animal hairballs could cure poisoning or even the plague. - Lions are known to expel very large hairballs. - Hairballs are most common when cats shed their winter coats. - Healthy cats will only have one or two hairballs a year. - Switching to a high-fiber diet for cats can help reduce the likelihood of hairballs forming. National Hairball Awareness Day was created by Hill's Pet Nutrition to highlight some of the possible solutions cat owners can use when their pets suffer from hairballs. > El nombre científico de una bola de pelo es **tricobezoar.** -Algunos pueblos antiguos creían que las bolas de pelo de los animales podían curar el envenenamiento o incluso la peste. -Se sabe que los leones pueden expulsar bolas de pelo muy grandes. -Las bolas de pelo son más comunes cuando los gatos mudan su pelaje de invierno. -Los gatos sanos solo tendrán una o dos bolas de pelo al año. -Cambiar a una dieta rica en fibra para gatos puede ayudar a reducir la probabilidad de que se formen bolas de pelo. El Día Nacional de Concientización sobre las Bolas de Pelo fue creado por Hill's Pet Nutrition para destacar algunas de las posibles soluciones que los dueños de gatos pueden utilizar cuando sus mascotas sufren de bolas de pelo. https://images.hive.blog/0x0/https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/thealliance/SszMQ6lq-thealliance20new20pagebreak.png ## Family Time!

body.title: Stay Inspired, The World Needs You
body.body:
<div class=text-justify>


 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmZ3Jq3rgnNDFf59pmzgU9VtSFYAuyaqrES8HjjTq1e7xo/IMG_5034.jpeg 

Yesterday evening, I couldn’t write because life seemed to happen in a way that demanded all of me.

My cousin texted me and said she wanted to end her life. At first, it didn’t feel real. But then she called, and I heard the exhaustion, fear and helplessness in her voice then I understood she wasn’t just messing around. She was crying, saying she was tired of everything going on around her.

So she runs this thrift business, but for months, sales have been slow. On top of that, she’s in debt. And recently, one of the people she owes started threatening her, saying he would get her arrested if she didn’t pay up. And here, that threat is not empty. We live in a system where things don’t always work the way they should, where power can be misused, and fear can be bought. 

To make it worse, it seemed like everything came crashing down at once as all the people she’d owed came asking for their money at the same time. There were no sales, which meant no solution in sight. She was overwhelmed and in that moment, she felt like ending it all was the only escape.

I didn’t think twice when I left my house immediately and went to hers. It was a thirty minute drive down there but I made sure I stayed on the phone with her, knowing very well that dark thoughts grow louder in isolation. I wasn’t going to let her face that alone.

When I got there, my heart dropped. This girl was holding a knife. I moved quickly, took the knife from her, and held her tightly, my eyes gleaming with tears. 

I didn’t have the perfect words or a speech prepared. But, I remembered those small reminders that tell me not to give up on myself and I spoke from that place. I told her this isn’t the end. She’s only 19 and there’s no way in the entire universe her story could end here, not over something like that, painful as it is, is still just a phase.

I told her there is more ahead. More life, more progress, more beauty. She softened into me and sobbed. We talked and cried. And eventually, made sure we took a small step toward easing the pressure. So I helped her send money to the person who was threatening her the most, just to calm that immediate storm.

I know it didn’t fix everything but at least, it helped her breathe again and that fixed my heart and fear. 
 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmYndYWQLe6fstrUARYah8dWNpP3Ua7BtLFnvjgCoCCExS/IMG_5030.jpeg 

Now that experience has stayed with me. I haven’t been able to get over it. It still makes me shudder. 
This experience made me realize how fragile we can feel when life piles up all at once and how easy it is to believe there’s no way out when you’re standing in the middle of the storm. But also, how important it is to show up for people even if it means just being presently available, nothing else. 

Suicide is not an option.

Life comes in phases. Heavy, overwhelming, and impossible to carry. But they pass. They always do. On the other side of those difficult seasons, I am a believer that there is something fluffy waiting. Might not be immediately but eventually.

So if you ever find yourself, or someone you love, in that dark place, hold on, reach out, speak to them and listen too. Sometimes, all it takes is one moment for someone, to choose life again. 


<sup>[img](https://pixabay.com/photos/cat-pet-kitten-cute-4912211/)</sup>

<sup>[thumbnail](https://pixabay.com/photos/cat-kitten-pet-kitty-young-cat-551554/)</sup>

body.title: CNF: The Girl They Thought I Was
body.body:
There's a common habit of every human being they don’t always ask who you are because they will decide it on their own. It began with a message from group chat to inbox. 

“Hey, you're Zoe, right? Let's meet up before coaching tomorrow?”

I couldn’t believe it because the text was from someone I barely know. Her name is Mehrun, we were studying in the same coaching center and for me she was just a stranger. We never spoke to each other in the class. Though I didn’t think much of it. That day I was busy, had plans with my family so I told her that it was not possible tomorrow.

Three days passed, got another message from her.

“Hey, are you coming earlier today?”

I was not doing it intentionally but I couldn’t go on time to the class as well. I had few things to do, and this felt off as questions arose in my mind \

Even though we are not friends. Like we barely exchanged any words even in the class.

A week passed but she didn’t stop.

Every other day I would receive messages from her.

“Are you free now? Let's meet”
“When will you come?”

To be honest I didnt get annoyed at all but persistent enough to make me curious.

I thought maybe she just wants to be friends, maybe none in the class looked friendly to her except me and I thought of every positive thing about this situation.

So one day, I made time for her. I woke up earlier, took a shower and got ready to meet her before the classes.

I reached earlier and saw her near the coaching center gate, she was waving at me and smiling. 

“Zoeeeee!\

You finally came!” she said.

“Well, how could I not? When you kept asking,” I laughed and replied.

She held my hand and said “Let’s go somewhere where we can chill together quietly.”

Without any doubts I followed her.

We walked for a while far from the coaching center, we reached to a place where I have never been to.

![](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/zoe01/23w2ipSVG5q1U9dsjQBi5wKjCWkRVjwKdKVDWzF4JcCnfNKCArBk8Mt3dD9ZLCjbq7F6U.jpg)
Then suddenly I could smell something familiar and I began to cough.

I realized in a while it's the smell of cigarettes.

It was the smoking zone.

Mehrun stopped and turned to me.

Before I could speak, she pulled out the packet of cigarettes.

“I didn’t like to smoke alone” she said.

Then I realized, all those messages and the efforts she made was not really about friendship.

“Here take one you will feel relaxed” she said. 

“Wait! wait! I have never smoked.”

She paused. “What?” She stared at me being surprised. “You're joking right? You look like you smoke, I can't be wrong.\

Is it because of my clothes?”\n\nShe replied confidently “Yeah that's obvious. Your hair is always messy, you wear Baggy jeans, lose tops, brown lipstick all of these made you look like a baddie. Apparently, that was enough.\

body.title: From another musical angle  - The Tale of Rod - ENG- SPA
body.body: > Being a wanderer wasn't what Rod sought, but it's what he ended up in after many years as a guitarist. Anyone might think he ended up wandering because he lacked talent, but that's not the case at all. It's true he's been in many bands, so many that he doesn't even remember the names of many of them anymore. His problem was that he never found chemistry with the others. And that gradually made him drift away from any group he joined. He still remembers his first band; he joined as an emerging guitarist just starting out. He was in it for several months and managed to play several of the songs the band already had before he joined. He did very well and stood out. But he noticed that he didn't like some of the members' qualities; he felt they had very high egos and didn't consider him a good musician. They never actually said anything to him, but he got that idea in his head, so after a few months he left the group. They tried to talk him out of it. They told him that what he thought was a bad idea he'd created in his mind. But he didn't listen to them and left. That was his first of many bands. In each one he went through, he noticed something different: some he found proud, others lacking in talent, and still others simply not the right fit. Sometimes he left bands for something as simple as the type of music each member liked.

> Ser un errante no era lo que Rod buscaba, pero fue a lo que llegó luego de muchos años siendo un guitarrista. Cualquiera pudiera pensar que terminado errante por no tener talento pero no tiene nada que ver. Es cierto ha pasado por muchas bandas, tantas que no se sabe el nombre de muchas ya. Su problema es que nunca encontraba química con los demás. Y eso poco a poco lo hacía alejarse de cualquier grupo al que entraba. Todavía recuerda su primera banda, el entró como un guitarrista emergente que recibe empezaba. En ella estuvo varios meses y logró tocar varios de los temas que ya la banda tenía antes de su entrada. Lo hizo muy bien y destacó. Pero notó que algunas de las cualidades de los miembros no le gustaban, sentía que ellos tenían el ego muy alto y no lo consideraban un buen musico. Ellos en realidad nunca le dijeron nada pero el se hizo esa idea en a cabeza así que al cabo de unos meses dejó el grupo. Ellos intentaron hacerlo entrar en razón. Le decían que eso que pensaba era una mala idea que el se había hecho en su mente. Pero el no los escuchó y se fue. Ese fue su primera banda de muchas. En cada una por las que fue pasando notaba algo distinto, a algunos los hallaba orgullosos, a otros que tenían poco talento, a otros que no eran las adecuados. Alagunas veces se fue de las bandas hasta por cosas tan simples como el tipo de música que le gustaban a cada uno.
![pexels-rdne-7502607.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nelsoncu/243MJ3Rw7LdLYnBBCd4h4FtvHJzjToVs5vDGbsXkYf1EbWAok3gL3P1XFdDVsXLWG1DMi.jpg) ...Free image from Pixabay...

> \n\nWhether for one reason or another, he always found a flaw, which prevented him from staying with a group for long. His talent grew, but his perception of others diminished, and he didn't see them as a good fit. This earned him the nickname \

He was known for never staying anywhere for long. So, little by little, many bands who learned about him preferred to simply hire him for a specific performance. They avoided offering him a permanent position because they knew he'd see something and leave. And they weren't wrong, because the few who dared to risk hiring him permanently realized that this was indeed how he reacted. Being a wanderer all the time didn't make Rod happy at all. He had always longed to be part of a band and build his future with them. He realized he'd been in the music industry for years and hadn't achieved much. In a way, he'd wasted his talent because he hadn't used it properly. Lately, he's been working hard to change things and finally find the perfect band, the one that best suits his vision. It took him a lot of work, but after searching specialized websites, he found a famous band looking for an experienced guitarist. On paper, they had everything he was looking for. So, after thinking it over, he decided to take action and contact them to see if he'd get lucky. When they found out it was him, and that he was offering himself, they were surprised. Of course, they accepted him into the band, but knowing his track record, they didn't expect him to stay. But the fact that he had requested it was a significant change for them. When he met them in person, he saw that what they had read on paper was true. They were a professional band, they had good discipline, so everything seemed to indicate that this was the band he had been waiting for and searching for.

> Sea por una cosa o por otra el siempre encontraba un defecto por lo que no podía estar con un grupo por mucho tiempo. Su talento crecía pero su percepción hacia los demás bajaba y no los veía indicados. Esto creó en el nombre del guitarrista errante. Era conocido por no durar mucho en ningún lado. Así que poco a poco muchas bandas que se fueron enterando de como era el preferían simplemente contratarlo para una presentación especifica. Evitaban ofrecerle quedarse porque sabían que algo les vería y se iría. Y no les faltaba razón porque los pocos que se atrevieron a arriesgarse a contratarlo fijo se dieron cuenta que en efecto así reaccionaba el. Ser errante todo el tiempo no hacia feliz para nada a Rod, el siempre ha deseado ser parte de una banda y construir su futuro junto a ellos. Se ha dado cuenta que lleva años en la música y no ha conseguido mucho. De cierta forma ha desperdiciado su talento porque no le ha dado el uso correcto. Últimamente se está esforzando mucho por cambiar las cosas y por fin encontrar una banda perfecta según lo que el busca. Le ha costado mucho pero luego de buscar en las paginas especializadas a encontrado a una banda famosa que está buscando un guitarrista experimentado. Tienen sobre el papel todo lo que el busca. Así que luego de pensarlo decidió pasar a la acción y contactarlos para ver si había suerte. Ellos al enterarse de que era el, y que el mismo se estaba ofreciendo se sorprendieron. Por supuesto lo aceptaron en la banda, pero no tenían esperanza que se quedara conociendo su historial. Pero al menos que el lo haya pedido para ellos era un cambio importante. Cuando el los conoció en persona vió que lo que decía sobre el papel era cierto. Eran una banda profesional, tenían buena disciplina así que todo parecía que aquella sería la indicada que tanto había esperado y buscado. ![pexels-rdne-7502117.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nelsoncu/242s3QPqyLhjm3ybz7LFuQ8YhhX3vqRCsy6VaC46byKRJYgJXx9QU2zAmpKb5tNS7oPAc.jpg) ...Free image from Pixabay...

> The first few days with the band were very productive. Rehearsals were perfect; everyone was professional. The chemistry between them was excellent, so Rod assumed he'd found his place. The problem was that after a while, Rod started seeing flaws in them. Some didn't have the personality he wanted; some were too cold or serious. Others, on the contrary, were too friendly. He also saw that some of their playing wasn't the best, so he taught them methods he considered better. He began to see faults in everyone that he hadn't noticed before. So he knew it: this wasn't the place for him. But in this case, he saw something. This band was the best he'd ever been in, the most experienced, and the most disciplined. If there was a band he was meant to move forward with, it would be them, so he had to choose wisely. He thought about it so many times that he finally realized something. He was the one with the problem. He had always demanded perfection, perfect chemistry, perfect skills. But he didn't realize that he himself didn't offer those qualities, and that's why they weren't compatible. He discovered that he had been wandering for so many years because of his own way of seeing things. So he changed his mind and decided to stay. That's how, after so long, he broke free from his wandering cycle. But his struggle doesn't end with this decision; he will have to keep striving to avoid falling into the same patterns again. But at least for now, he's on the right track.

> Los primeros días con la banda fueron muy productivos. Los ensayos eran perfectos, todos eran profesionales en lo que hacían. La química entre ellos era muy buena así que ya Rod daba por sentado que había encontrado su lugar. El problema es que un tiempo después Rod empezó a ver en ellos defectos. Algunos no tenían la personalidad que el quería, algunos eran demasiados fríos o serios. Otros por el contrario muy amables. También veía que la forma de tocar de algunos no era la mejor así que el le enseñaba métodos que consideraba mejor. Empezó a ver faltas en todos que antes no vió. Así que lo sabía, este no es mi lugar. Pero en este caso vió algo. Esta banda era la mejor en la que había estado, la que más experiencia tenia y más disciplina. Si había una indicada para avanzar seria con ellos así que debía elegir bien que haría. Lo pensó tantas veces que al fin se dio cuenta de algo. Era el quien tenía el problema. Desde siempre había exigido perfección, química perfecta, habilidades perfectas. Pero no se daba cuenta que el mismo no ofrecía eso, así que por eso no eran compatibles. Descubrió que había sido errante tantos años por su propia firma de ver las cosas. Así que cambió de idea y decidió que se quedaría. Fue así como luego de tanto tiempo rompió con su siclo errante. Pero sus lucha no acaba con esta decisión, tendrá que seguir esforzándose para evitar caer en lo mismo de nuevo. Pero al menos por ahora va por el camino correcto.
![pexels-rdne-7503250.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nelsoncu/243WXi7Suo4sH7R3CZrHCeAqbRVpCzSJxSbS1BtB4u7SyydtXJVBVpYKTmFxstuFEoj1z.jpg) ...Free image from Pixabay...

Tal cual lo lees así lo escribí. La versión en ingles fue traducida usando Google traductor.

> # We Talk Friday
>(WTF)


This is a semi-regular series that I will run on Fridays to hold discussions on a current topic from the week gone. The aim is to keep them light and conversational, though some might be heavier - regardless of the content topic itself though, just have some fun engaging and discussing with whoever happens to put in the effort in the comments section below. 

---



![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tarazkp/243ziEd4A4LtsdiqVBmYAdXhfBfSYRsrjqRBiTiVBC7UushXi9GjkqKc73wEphqwVoGBb.png)



---

# We Talk Friday Ep. 52: Are you Talking?

For something a bit different, *Let's talk Hive.*

I got a comment from a friend today about the comments I get on my posts and how it is refreshing to read them, because they are coming from real people who are actually putting in some effort. At least, most are. The problem with a lot of comments on Hive these days though, is that people aren't putting in effort to even read the posts, let alone comment on them. Instead, they pick a couple points out from the start, middle, or end, and then say something inane to make it seem like they give a shit. 

> Are you one of these people?

Then there are those who use AI to summarise and then formulate some kind of answer, with a response that is *well above* their own level of understanding. AI responses are like book reports - *impersonal.* Stop it please, it is pathetic. And if you don't have anything personal of value to add to the conversation, why comment at all? Getting rewarded? Sure - But what if I start just adding a comment of \

before I vote it? Would you prefer that? Or would it be better if I just ignore any comment that I feel doesn't add enough value? And the interesting thing is that I am quite happy to vote fun comments, as long as the people have built up some kind of rapport with me in the past. People have to remember that at least on my posts, I value authenticity, which means real people. I get that pretty much everyone does it at some level for a vote, but if you really don't care about anything else, just don't bother. Have some self-respect. > If it is not you talking, what is the point? Technology is meant to make our lives better, and in my opinion that means improving interpersonal communication and interaction. People talking to people, not machines talking to machines. If you don't have the experience to comment well, *get some.* Taraz [ Gen1: Hive ] --- **Be part of the Hive discussion.** - Comment on the topics of the article, and add your perspectives and experiences. - Read and discuss with others who comment and build your personal network - Engage well with me and others and put in effort **And you may be rewarded.** ---

¿Dónde sobre piensas? ¿Qué fue lo que rompió lo que una vez fue?

Escucho en mi mente tu voz diciendo que no sabes qué pasó.

Que yo no era así cuando me conociste.

Y un hilo se iba marchando, ese amor en desprecio.

¿Por qué en la amistad también se iba marchando? Doble felicidad y doble pérdida.

Y otra voz silenciosa que volvió los momentos de felicidad en el olvido, dejándolos pasar como si nada.

Dejando ambos lados en soledad voluntaria. 

Con caprichos, un alma solitaria que jamás volvió.

A la amistad, ni al amor. 

Solo en su estado de vivir el día a día en su verdadero yo.

Ese doble filo que ninguno comprendió y el orgullo se llevó.

Que en melodías viejas se conserva el comienzo de esa juventud dulce que se perdió.

¿Dónde andarán? 

¿Será un delito volver a sentir en letras lo que dio inicio a la escritura?
