body.title: (ENG/ESP) ✨🌹💪 Ladies of Hive Community Contest #285: My reason for living today / Mi razón para vivir actualmente ✨🌹💪
body.body:
#
ENGLISH CONTENT

Hello to all the women in this community! With just one day until I attend another bazaar, I'm sitting down to prepare my entry for the [contest](https://peakd.com/hive-124452/@ladiesofhive/ladies-of-hive-community-contest-285). These past few days have been quite productive for me, as I've been able to rest not only physically but also mentally, which has allowed me to focus a bit more on my goals. Anyway, I think I'll take advantage of the second question to talk a little about it 😉
![1000404249.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/suezoe/23wX3LaEvAb5xBtYREFEcqPpoAWqTXPUkaJ4NVo8TSfgjWgUHPyXXEwzaKbDkN8tHzKRv.jpg)

### 💚✨ How would you describe your purpose at this moment, and what keeps you moving forward each day? 💚✨
Without a doubt, my motivation for continuing to exist is to fully exploit my creative capacity for my own benefit. For as long as I can remember, I had always been guided by others, which meant I ended up putting myself second, third, or even further in the pecking order. Because of this, I didn't really know what I wanted and ended up making bad decisions, like choosing the university degree I eventually graduated from. The moment I learned to say \

and made myself a priority, many things changed in my life, including understanding that to achieve what I wanted, I truly needed to be committed to my desires.
So, I decided to take my business more seriously, where I offer a variety of items I've created myself. I started it many years ago, but due to various factors, I kept putting it on hold. Now that I have more time and the necessary focus, I thought it was the right moment to resume that project and prove to myself that I can make profitable all the knowledge I have acquired over the years, as well as my own inventiveness.
![1000381330.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/suezoe/23wgaonWUgG8AT5KQkdrs1aMWfuz8i3XQ27eZQch8SrAbziRpSCFJijGZx6mYFiYGMKcE.jpg)

Of course, I'm not going to say it's been easy, because it hasn't. Being an insecure person, I often doubt what I do, and when I compare myself to others who have achieved greater success in less time, I wonder if my effort is really worth it... To be honest, I don't know if this will work, but it truly makes me happy to dedicate time to my business. I enjoy sewing and creating products to display, as well as coming up with ideas that inspire me to add a new piece to the catalog. I can spend hours, days, and weeks immersed in creating pieces, and I feel fulfilled... That feeling, for me, has to be proof that I'm doing the right thing.
The investment of time, energy, and money is worth it for me when I make a sale or when I receive compliments for my work. Although I confess there are other things I'd like to do, but for various reasons, I can't. So, instead of lamenting, giving up, and doing things for others, as I've always done, I think the best thing is to use this time to finally dedicate myself to my business. I'm motivated every day by increasing the numbers and the idea of ​​making it profitable to the point of a steady income. That might allow me to go back to living with my cat Ikki, whom I love very much and would like to have neutered (I haven't been able to because he suffers from a condition that requires a more expensive operation), as well as give him a wonderful life in a comfortable place.
![1000404279.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/suezoe/23wqw2yBEAYFgrqgeZ1ZEdKWz7rqwGEE4AbYWKdVqgJkGN5HDbGLNUVQky9PvmqWYgnHP.jpg)
You could say, then, that my reason for living right now is to prove to myself that I can be financially independent through my own talent, and thus not only be able to give myself a good life, but also to support others. I want to prove to myself that this path I've chosen is truly worthwhile, and that's why I wake up determined every single day. So, if you see me obsessed with my creative process, just leave me alone; in that moment, I'm exactly where I want to be 🌈✨
### ✨ Thank you so much for visiting my post. I hope you found it interesting ✨
![sue hive.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/suezoe/AK9NaQRDsAjNXZww9BbqtoFGDH8gbekixvUee2qKMSo2B3BoSp1G3NzrHLnS5j7.gif)

#
💚 Until next time! 💚

![Separador.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/suezoe/23ydCKUob6Veoru2WkSHzGEJYsVaCtXW1faq9AvNDGGoHQ7EK3BnMYaWz3Kvh37TGkuVa.jpg)
#
CONTENIDO EN ESPAÑOL

¡Hola a todas las mujeres de esta comunidad! A tan sólo un día para asistir de nuevo a otro bazar, me siento a elaborar mi participación para el [concurso](https://peakd.com/hive-124452/@ladiesofhive/ladies-of-hive-community-contest-285). Estos días han sido bastante provechosos para mí, ya que no sólo he podido descansar física sino también mentalmente, lo cual, me ha permitido centrarme un poco más sobre mis objetivos. Pero bueno, creo que aprovecharé la segunda pregunta propuesta para hablarles un poco sobre el asunto 😉
![1000404249.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/suezoe/23wX3LaEvAb5xBtYREFEcqPpoAWqTXPUkaJ4NVo8TSfgjWgUHPyXXEwzaKbDkN8tHzKRv.jpg)

### 💚✨ En este momento de tu vida, ¿Cuál crees que es tu principal razón para vivir? ¿Cómo describirías tu propósito en este momento y qué te mantiene avanzando cada día? 💚✨
Sin duda, mi motivación para seguir existiendo, es explotar al máximo mi capacidad creativa para mi propio beneficio. Desde que tengo memoria, siempre me había regido por los demás, por lo que acababa dejándome en un segundo, tercer o enésimo plano. De ese modo, no sabía realmente lo que quería y acababa tomando malas decisiones, como lo fue en su momento escoger la carrera universitaria de la cual, acabé por graduarme. En el momento en que aprendí a decir \

y me puse a mí misma como prioridad, muchas cosas cambiaron en mi vida, entre ellas, comprender que para conseguir lo que deseaba, realmente necesitaba tener un compromiso con mis deseos.
De ese modo, decidí tomar más en serio levantar mi [emprendimiento](https://www.instagram.com/sue_citos/), dónde ofrezco artículos variados creados por mí. Empecé con el mismo hace muchos años, pero por diferentes factores, acababa paralizándolo. Ahora que tengo más tiempo y el enfoque necesario, pensé que era el momento propicio para retomar ese proyecto y demostrarme a mí misma que puedo hacer rentable todo el conocimiento que he adquirido a lo largo de los años, así como mi propia capacidad de inventiva.
![1000381330.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/suezoe/23wgaonWUgG8AT5KQkdrs1aMWfuz8i3XQ27eZQch8SrAbziRpSCFJijGZx6mYFiYGMKcE.jpg)

Por supuesto, no voy a decir que me ha resultado fácil, porque no es así. Al ser una persona insegura, suelo dudar muchas veces de lo que hago y al compararme con otros que han logrado un mejor éxito en menos tiempo, me pregunto si mi esfuerzo, realmente vale la pena... les seré sincera, no sé si esto vaya a funcionar, pero en verdad me hace feliz dedicarle tiempo a mi negocio. Me gusta coser y elaborar productos para exhibir, así como encontrarme con ideas que me inspiran a añadir una nueva pieza al catálogo. Puedo estar por horas, días y semanas inmersa en la elaboración de piezas y me siento realizada... Ese sentimiento para mí, tiene que ser una muestra de que estoy haciendo lo correcto.
La inversión en tiempo, energía y dinero, vale la pena para mí cuando realizo alguna venta o cuando recibo halagos por lo que realizo. Aunque confieso que también, hay otras cosas que me gustaría hacer, pero por diferentes factores, no puedo hacerlo, por lo que, en lugar de lamentarme, rendirme y ponerme a hacer cosas para los demás, como siempre he estado haciendo, pienso que lo mejor es aprovechar este tiempo para por fin dedicárselo a mi emprendimiento. Me motiva día a día el aumentar los números y la idea de hacerlo rentable hasta el punto de que sea una entrada de dinero constante. Eso, quizás me permitiría volver a vivir con mi gato Ikki, a quién quiero mucho y me gustaría poder castrar (No he podido hacerlo porque sufre de una condición que hace que requiera una operación más costosa), así como darle una vida maravillosa en un lugar en dónde pueda estar cómodo.
![1000404279.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/suezoe/23wqw2yBEAYFgrqgeZ1ZEdKWz7rqwGEE4AbYWKdVqgJkGN5HDbGLNUVQky9PvmqWYgnHP.jpg)
Podría decirse entonces que mi razón de vivir actualmente, es demostrarme a mí misma que puedo ser independiente económicamente hablando, a través de mi propio talento y así, no sólo poder darme una buena vida, sino también, poder apoyar a otros. Quiero demostrarme que este camino que he escogido, vale realmente la pena y por eso, me despierto determinada cada día de mi vida. Así que, si me ven obsesionada con mi proceso creativo, déjenme, en ese momento me encuentro dónde quiero estar 🌈✨
### ✨ Muchas gracias por haber visitado mi publicación. Espero que les haya parecido interesante ✨
![sue hive.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/suezoe/AK9NaQRDsAjNXZww9BbqtoFGDH8gbekixvUee2qKMSo2B3BoSp1G3NzrHLnS5j7.gif)

#
💚 ¡Hasta una próxima oportunidad! 💚

body.title: Serbian Sport in Focus: New Talents, Global Recognition, and Ongoing Challenges
body.body:
/>

The Serbian sports scene continues to stay active and relevant, both domestically and internationally. Over the past few days, several important developments have highlighted the strength of Serbian athletes across different disciplines.

One of the biggest stories comes from basketball, where young Serbian talents are increasingly attracting attention from international programs. Recently, promising players from Serbia have committed to major college teams in the United States, confirming the country’s reputation as a breeding ground for top-level basketball prospects.

At the same time, Serbian tennis legend Novak Djokovic remains in the global spotlight, not only because of his achievements on the court but also through his involvement in major international events such as the Laureus World Sports Awards. His continued influence proves that Serbian athletes still hold a strong presence at the highest level of world sport.

In football, challenges remain. The national team is undergoing transitions and facing pressure after mixed performances in recent competitions. However, the inclusion of players like Dejan Joveljić in upcoming national team matches signals a continued effort to rebuild and strengthen the squad.

Domestically, Serbian clubs are still competing intensely across leagues and tournaments, while young players continue to emerge as future stars. The focus on development and talent production remains one of Serbia’s greatest strengths.

In conclusion, Serbian sport stands at an interesting crossroads — balancing tradition and future potential. With strong talent pipelines and global recognition, the country continues to prove that it belongs among the top sporting nations.

Sport u Srbiji: Novi talenti, globalna pažnja i izazovi

Sportska scena u Srbiji i dalje je veoma aktivna i prisutna kako na domaćem, tako i na međunarodnom nivou. U posljednjih nekoliko dana desilo se više važnih događaja koji pokazuju snagu srpskih sportista u različitim disciplinama.

Jedna od glavnih tema dolazi iz košarke, gdje mladi srpski talenti sve više privlače pažnju stranih klubova i univerziteta. Nedavno su talentovani igrači iz Srbije potpisali za američke timove, što potvrđuje da Srbija i dalje proizvodi vrhunske košarkaše.

U isto vrijeme, teniska legenda Novak Đoković ostaje u centru pažnje svjetske javnosti, ne samo zbog svojih rezultata, već i zbog učešća na velikim događajima kao što je Laureus nagrada. Njegov uticaj pokazuje koliko su srpski sportisti i dalje relevantni na globalnoj sceni.

U fudbalu situacija nije jednostavna. Reprezentacija prolazi kroz promjene i pokušava da pronađe stabilnost nakon neujednačenih rezultata. Ipak, uključivanje igrača poput Dejana Joveljića u naredne mečeve pokazuje želju za napretkom i jačanjem tima.

Na domaćoj sceni, klubovi nastavljaju borbu u ligama i takmičenjima, dok mladi igrači sve više dolaze do izražaja. Razvoj talenata ostaje jedna od najvećih prednosti srpskog sporta.

Zaključak je jasan — srpski sport se nalazi između tradicije i nove generacije. Uz veliki potencijal i stalno prisustvo na svjetskoj sceni, Srbija i dalje potvrđuje da je sportska sila.

body.title: Are We As Strong As We Think We Are?
body.body:
![Black and Yellow Grunge Cooking Youtube Thumbnail (46).png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bruno-kema/23wqfx7rna3zMPP43gZ2TkYxgMJ7paXSGYbAaouvHmXuxbB6wLTGus943HbYaTzE74HfY.png) ***
![2dk2RRM2dZ8gKjXsrozapsD83FxL3Xbyyi5LFttAhrXxr16mCe4arfLHA37mQtCuynkak9C9VAyTtPNZ193z3v9HzUXNRYfNBKpop4B452wXWGAr95ns7Froa3QYr2tHe7aDsDXTJuz6E8PeAV3edWS3NGxHQJHC9xJn9eUpGW.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bruno-kema/23uEz3qUu1cpWPYjmp2LnK1i4RcXoAhocX2Rzpq9uYyMScovNm77MZBozX7i1NM59BnSf.png) Sometimes I wonder, if you’ve never been tested, are you really strong? If, as a person of faith, you’ve never been tempted, then are you really as grounded and firm as you think you are? If you’ve never written an exam or had to prove your mettle, then are you really smart? These are the thoughts that can cross my mind from time to time, and then I wonder… A lot of things look easy when we imagine them in our heads. Sometimes, they look really easy, and other times, they look really difficult. But we only know for sure what we are capable of when we actually try to do these things. ![2dk2RRM2dZ8gKjXsrozapsD83FxL3Xbyyi5LFttAhrXxr16mCe4arfLHA37mQtCuynkak9C9VAxm3nacdB7gLmLiZLuYVhHeNsRgxL6WKJoam3hs2B7ZLAp2jwaLFEwoAbLKzAfpv2DhtyvHbJunTbU58RMbxtkvefNK4qj8EA.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bruno-kema/23uQkLUmr2XGp8UpLcdtKeQrWDNnK5jemLpyFynqgRKtzZaqtByEwcX3DoUEyB8Pwi9DN.png) You can think that swimming is no big deal until you find yourself on a boat in the middle of the ocean, then you’ll hang on for dear life, wishing you had learned how to swim. You think that driving is hard, and you procrastinate it for as long as possible. But when you finally start learning, you master it so easily, you wonder what you were so scared of to begin with. This is one of the reasons why we need tests and challenges as humans, and we also don’t have to expect them because that’s the only way we’re ever truly prepared, by preparing for the unexpected. Challenges put everything you’ve learned to the test, forcing you to rely on past experiences and lessons and apply them to the things you’re doing today. This is because without tests, we only assume that we are good. But we don’t know for sure. ![IMG_20241106_1209582.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bruno-kema/241tQLVetvk1GGuVizcHaroA8WkyGBDoCGyQb69twJVBhkgA2uSrtnqdzp6B4G6q3CvPn.jpg) And in the same vein, this is the same reason many people are cautioned against making declarations about people whom they don’t know how things are. Until you’ve worked a mile in their shoes, keep your mouth shut! It’s so easy to talk about the things you will do in a certain situation, and how you will act, and the way you will be different. However, the truth is, you will never know for sure until you are in that situation. You won’t know how strong you are until you’re met with the test that will test your faith. Sometimes, we welcome challenges because they help us grow and become stronger individuals. But then, other times, we need to pray against the kind of challenges and temptations that will change who we are, the ones that we may never be able to resist, and the ones that we will most likely succumb to. I always say that everyone has a price, but it will be foolish to assume that every price is paid in cash. Just hope that you’re never offered a price that you can’t refuse, because then, you’ll know what it really means to be tested. When you fail that big test, does that mean you’re weak? That is a good question. ![IMG_20230914_153707~2.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bruno-kema/23ywcNAwyLazQWbPq8XFuAdNBqPH34BKadTWksHKETHfowcWaiLQxnFi2Eo1yv6bcDkqx.jpg) ***
Thank you for reading. Feel free to share your thoughts in the comments below, I would love to know what you’re thinking. Till we meet in the next post.
***
Watch My Engaging Stories on: [Facebook](https://web.facebook.com/brunokemaofficial), [YouTube](https://www.youtube.com/@bruno_kema), and [TikTok]( https://www.tiktok.com/@bruno_kema?_r=1&_t=ZN-91fKKHrMpuw).

body.title: My Actifit Report Card: April 24 2026 || Visiting To Itam International Market
body.body:
Greetings once again dear gentlemen and ladies of Hive blockchain in the actifit fitness community, an awesome Friday at hand, hope your day's actifit fitness walk went well. My fitness health walk took me from home at Ikot Ekwere Itam to Itam International market, Uyo, Akwa Ibom State to buy my baby's items as well as some food items for the family. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/395dcbe6-b404-4861-8f51-76f6dbd9ab90.jpg) This market is sold once in a week, as such buyers and sellers come from different local government in the state, from other states in the country and even outside the country to sell their products and also buy to retail. As an international market, it is always busy to the point of even blocking the truck 'A' road which passes by the market. As usual every now and then, there is always an increase in prices of things. You met a price of a given item today and by tomorrow the price changes. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/6a68e5fc-2ef2-4f31-a1e0-bbedaba4d5ef.jpg) Babies items now seems to be more costly than the adults and the funny aspect is that the quality of these items have drop, so you end up buying less quality item at a high quality price, that is the irony. Well, I had to buy since I need it or produce my own. After buying all other items, I had to charter a tricycle to convey my items to my location. By this time I couldn't even remember taking a shot again since I have to also guide my phone to avoid it being stolen. On getting home, I prepare something to eat for myself The day's activities was much, from one step to the other, and before I realized it, the night has crawled in. I am excited that I have over 6,412 steps and I hereby report same in my Actifit Report Card. Thanks for being there. Have a pleasant night rest and see you there.

body.title: Splinterlands: Using Arcane Skinwalker, a Tough Shapeshifting Moster!
body.body:
https://img.leopedia.io/DQmZRSmcKnKMPP3sXSYT7fFNnjx2A1vCYPWfbkwn1NgzQvL/Screenshot%204973.png 



While playing **Splinterlands** in **Modern** over the last couple of months I have learned a lot of fun, new tricks. I've run into some really nice monsters that are way outside my budget. But there are some monsters that I run into consistently and give me problems by beating me.  One of those problematic ones for me has been **Arcane Skinwalker**, as it has **Shapeshift** which is the ability to be treated as all bloodlines when a **Bloodline Tribute** monster is defeated. 

I tend to use that strategy frequently with my water teams and the **bloodline tribute** increases their attack and speed. So I decided to try this card out, not by purchasing it, but by renting it first to see how it fits into my playing style  First off here are the stats it has to offer, it really is a pretty nice card!



 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmRuhcBW18rW58hX4dkmB7ppzsWU52xvrTs3jWrxJvtb4n/Screenshot%204972.png 

It is a rare neutral card making it playable in any splinter which is a huge plus. At level 2  is picks up **Shapeshift** which is really what most interested me.  So that's the level I rented since it was very affordable. However, at level 3 it also picks up **Inspire** to increase your teams monster's melee attacks. This is a great ability, but the rental was too expensive... At level 6 he picks up **Camouflage** so he can't be targeted unless in the first position, and at level 7 gets one more attack! Then at level 8 he picks up **Silence** which reduced the enemy team's magic attacks by one. That is a really nice ability, but will only likely be used in Diamond or Champion level matches. Since I play in silver, a level 3 or 4 will be my goal. 

How was it in battle? At first I struggled to make it fit with my teams, but then I began to figure out placement and even found it useful in the right situations. So I decided to share a match that it made a big difference here below.




 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmQS5v7Hs2KzpgwCE3o9C1faEfZN29Em2mHEkqw16KPYYN/image.png 

Without further ado here was the battle:

You can see the entire battle here at this  [link.](https://splinterlands.com/battle/sl_68e33dd75fa9d6a54698c60bcad235be) 



 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmQN52srHjjBLj514EQa56bKPA9LSdhWBXu7R25ddyWSXe/Screenshot%204960.png 

This is a battle in **Modern** with a very healthy mana cap of 93, so you can use just about any cards you want in one of these matches! If also has the standard ruleset so no extra challenges to consider which is kind of nice. The screenshot above is after all buffs have been applied but before the action starts.  As my archon I went with **Marlai Singariel** as she grants one additional magic attack to each member of my team.  I then first place the **Wailsworn Specter** due to it's **bloodline tribute** ability to other undead or shapeshift team members (which make up the majority of my team.)  As a tank I placed **Doomshield Warden** followed by **Blue Wrym Travesty** as the it gains reach from my tank.  I then placed the **Arcane Skinwalker** which is a shapeshift bloodline  followed by one of my favorite cards **Mindless Thrall** who is an undead bloodline. To finish up I took a bit of a risk placing **Portia Nyr** in last position, she is a shapeshift bloodline as well but not the fastest or strongest card out there. 

My opponent chose **Aurora** as archon granting an extra health unit to each of the team members. As a tank they used **Dire Bear** followed by **Dread Tafarian**, both **Foundations** cards. This was followed by **Endless Ape** and then another **Foundations** card **Kicking Roc**.  For the last two they chose **Swell Sporebeast** and the **Fenmoor Wood Troll**. There are some tough cards in this mix, we'll see how it all plays out!

 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmbjtHoVxtTpbHRvRv7aK14jE4Qk3ZFSX7ySjDCE6as29X/Screenshot%204961.png 

**Dire Bear** makes quick work of my **Wailsworn Specter**, I should say thank you for that!

 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmRyd7rZZckxz4fptbQYB6ScaHLQLwg5nbsyjWkbHdeUv7/Screenshot%204962.png 

That activates the **bloodline tribute** to essentially my whole backline, I only show **Arcane Skinwalker** getting his additional attack and speed but the other three all got it as well.


 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmZRmQGPYaE5fgHRVUEuRpio5pE1bVhdaGLyP7e26j4wHS/Screenshot%204963.png 

By round two the **Dire Bear** is down.


 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmX2DZGwEfkY2c9ieiJDb3z698ZTByTCQMDgu5rdDhhXdm/Screenshot%204965.png 

Shortly after the **Dread Tafarian** bites the dust and here you can see the **Arcane Skinwalker**'s massive four magic attack on the ape.

 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmXFiS2PA63dDtS8QMTuijwKqPThjoQpvhJkZjCWh27B3g/Screenshot%204966.png 

By round three here is how things are looking.

 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmPTaWfzCj7jYfVQL9c7tqj5BbVyXkShswi7BpMKAiG8Sm/Screenshot%204967.png 

But midway into the round **Arcane Skinwalker** finishes off the ape with a strong magic attack!

 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmQnsRorGGWLG34tYwrN7LWzEpKcEUkuJi6UezarJyHvKH/Screenshot%204968.png 

By round four my opponent's team is showing some wear and tear.

 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmaKqqv5cqnoKkggok9FK9tmajymJNgQHVyhj6p1kHyd7z/Screenshot%204969.png 

By round five things are pretty much over...

 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmWWzADvRZpVrbCpVbJnQCZDPEHXC4fGqeKYXqY4ajdwfR/Screenshot%204970.png 

And the final deathblow is delivered by **Portia Nyr** who I had worried about placing in last position. I guess the worry was unwarranted in this case!

Great game to my opponent! The **bloodline tribute** was just too strong for them to overcome. My opponent used several **Foundations** cards which weakened the their team, in some cases they are great cards, just not in this scenario. **Shapeshift** cards can really help to make a **bloodline tribute** team very tough and a challenge to defeat as they can be activated by any bloodline tribute card that is defeated. 

So, will I be putting this card on the buy list. Absolutely yes! I'll need a level 3 minimum to have the **Inspire** ability to strengthen my melee tanks.  This will be going on the list of things to buy when I earn enough money from card sales and flipping. It takes time sometimes, and I'm still saving for **Portia Nyr**, so we will see how soon I can actually buy a copy of my very own!


 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmQS5v7Hs2KzpgwCE3o9C1faEfZN29Em2mHEkqw16KPYYN/image.png 

## **Fifteen Foundations Pack  Opening**

As always, I like to open some packs for these posts. **Foundations** packs can be won by finishing up daily rewards playing at the gold level in **Frontier Mode**. I usually let them pile up to open in one big bunch, the downfall about opening so many packs is that it uses a lot of alchemy potions. So you may have to use glint to purchase more potions occasionally, I find that I have to!

 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmd2Yg71yNf8nPAu2VVUhhhQZdAYSssgYY2LxuaP8iv1oy/Screenshot%204956.png 

The first bunch gives me a nice pull of an epic **Saltwater Mage**, they are always in demand and easy to sell. I also got two archon cards and a gold foil. Not too bad so far!

 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmYp8C2WgFJC7NZsRweS8edzkWE1ShgJ427tDqY63NULkb/Screenshot%204957.png 

Next up was a nice surprise, a gold foil **Barthalamas** fire archon. These cards always sell well and are in demand, as a matter of fact it has already sold before I could finish up the post! lol I also got a regular foil death archon, not too bad.

 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmY1A1FGJXdskre8v3bWZkU6JMq9rF8vfnewH1oSkyY1gh/Screenshot%204958.png 

Here I got a **Marlai Singariel** and two more fire archons...

 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmcJBFMKqT4VGRPfQ1GtEiDdAnFeoZU36HkHAPD3obfRZR/Screenshot%204959.png 

And the last bunch I got a couple nice epics, the nicest being **Asel Alagosdil** that is commonly used in water matches in **Frontier Mode**. Overall not too bad of a opening, although a gold legendary would have been nice...  That's the risk of opening up packs, sometimes it's all great cards and others it's pure garbage. Such is lady luck...









If you don't yet play Splinterlands, it is a fun game and free to play in Frontier Mode. So give a try, if you haven't joined in on the fun of playing Splinterlands you can join here: https://splinterlands.com?ref=thebighigg


 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmVRphAPaqqVMFHuyDQz61XScZJ2Qn3ERPRQf9zpLKurHG/image.png 

That will wrap up my **Splinterlands** post for today, I do hope you enjoyed it. Please feel free to leave any comments or questions below. And as always, thanks you for all of your support, it really is deeply appreciated. Have a great weekend everyone!




![GIF_20250818_160944_821.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/thebighigg/23tRxfsSYAsdjhiguQKAsHWYXiuWTpEqzAgEPCSn3k9FDCsmviaF4RPWwunT73gFqjEL8.gif)

 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmTGZHB7zyBh9PChGdb8Ys3FsQM8ydk5FbJEs7gLtoRq6c/image.png

I am not a financial planner and this isn't financial advice. Please always do your own research before investing your money. You worked hard enough to earn it!

body.body: ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmTZL897MirRSahBBS3qZhy4tEaMLKzc3WW4XSC9982y8F/img_20260423_092023_522.jpg)\nPara un cubano, o para cualquier persona que transite por una economía asfixiada, generar ingresos digitales sin inversión previa es mucho más que un \

; es una brisa fresca en tiempo de calor. Es el reconocimiento de su tiempo, a menudo devaluado por problemáticas locales de inflación o salarios que no cubren sus necesidades, tiene un valor de mercado global que no depende de las fronteras físicas ni de las políticas de su entorno.

Pero dejemos a un lado por un momento lo que ya muchos conocemos y vamos a lo que en realidad importa.


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmdiPcpCYXLs5fnV9CzT3BKjUr4eVnmpiiARwWoiNCUTjp/img_20260423_092017_816.jpg)
Cómo todo cubano que siempre está buscando una oportunidad de generar ingresos de cualquier tipo y más si son sin inversión o simplemente por realizar algunas tareas simples como registro, vincular cuentas de X(Twitter), Telegram, Discord, Wallets, minería en la nube y demás. Hoy quiero hablarte de los ingresos que me ha permitido adquirir una plataforma por solo iniciar sección diariamente, así como lo oyes.

Está plataforma es más para PC pero también funciona en móviles, yo la utilizo diariamente en el teléfono y la imagen de portada está la captura de mis últimos retiros.


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmY1nqURJWYz6uCmxbvKjPXLCUEYRrMQmBMvF2accY2Rnx/img_20260423_092010_382.jpg)
Les hablo de AddSlice (o simplemente Slice) es una plataforma y extensión de navegador diseñada para permitir que los usuarios moneticen su tiempo de navegación en internet. Su propuesta principal es \

una parte de los ingresos que generan los anuncios publicitarios mientras navegas.
Aquí tienes una descripción detallada de sus características, funcionamiento y aspectos clave:

Cómo funciona?
Es una extensión para navegadores basados en Chromium (como Google Chrome, Brave, Microsoft Edge y Opera).


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmPTTz3MLWjmnqRDe2Ldf6dqXiFjJFJYkbjakxhC44vLVK/img_20260423_092005_129.jpg)
Su función, una vez instalada, es insertar anuncios propios (banners poco intrusivos) en los sitios web que visitas (como YouTube, Google o blogs) o, en algunos casos, reemplaza los anuncios existentes por los de su propia red publicitaria. Es decir, que cuando entras a un sitio web con anuncios, está extensión los bloquea y sustituye por sus propios anuncios.

Por cada anuncio de Slice que visualices mientras navegas normalmente, recibes una pequeña fracción de moneda virtual llamada \

.

Formas de ganar dinero:

Navegación Pasiva: 
Es el método principal; simplemente navegas como siempre y acumulas Slices.

Encuestas y Ofertas: 
Recientemente han añadido una sección de panel donde puedes completar encuestas o descargar aplicaciones para ganar Slices de forma más rápida.


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmVR5NALBoQ2aTLmkEUyqMbxd52A7YC1ScDCoQt2AA1Gny/img_20260423_091940_604.jpg)
Inicia sección a diario:
Desde el primer día al iniciar sección comienzas a generar un slice y así progresivamente aumentas uno por cada día consecutivo hasta llegar a 30, máximo que se mantendrá si no rompes la racha. Si dejas de iniciar sección un día por el medio vuelves a comenzar desde uno.

Programa de Referidos:
Puedes invitar a otros usuarios y recibir un porcentaje de lo que ellos generen.

Métodos de Pago y Retiro
Una de las ventajas de AddSlice es su flexibilidad en los pagos:

PayPal: El método más común (suele tener un mínimo de retiro bajo, alrededor de $1).


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmXeQEru5gYJetYNr2axkbx1VKLKZRX6yVdxJcwieAmF4k/img_20260423_091959_157.jpg)
Bitcoin (vía Lightning Network): Permite retiros casi instantáneos (300 Slice al rededor de $0.30) y sin comisiones a billeteras que soporten Lightning (como Muun o Wallet of Satoshi).

Tarjetas de Regalo: A través de servicios como Bitrefill, puedes canjear tus ganancias por tarjetas de Amazon, Google Play, Steam, etc.

Algo muy importante es la  Privacidad y Seguridad.
La empresa afirma que no vende tus datos personales ni rastrea tu historial de navegación con fines comerciales ajenos a la publicidad.
Tienen una política de \

donde aseguran servir al usuario y no a sus datos. Sin embargo, al ser una extensión que modifica el contenido de las páginas, requiere permisos amplios en el navegador.


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmd5MLZQq9SspqC9woGcFjxr6n4jFcaHqBXbRGMamm6YQi/img_20260423_091953_862.jpg)
En conclusión: 
Addslice no requiere esfuerzo adicional más allá de navegar o simplemente iniciar sección esperar que se actualice tu saldo Slice y continuar con tu rutina diaria.

Los anuncios suelen ser banners laterales o pequeños recuadros que no interrumpen la lectura.
No tiene ningún costo de suscripción.

No es una fuente de ingresos significativa. Un usuario promedio puede ganar entre $1 y $5  al mes o algo más dependiendo de su uso.

Los Slices suelen tener un periodo de \

(aprox. 30 días) antes de estar disponibles para el retiro, para evitar fraudes.

Los anuncios solo funcionan en computadoras (escritorio/laptop), aunque el panel de encuestas se puede usar en móviles.


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZHri5G74tdLRmrDGWoFw9ydkucvHMF8HPiMSedcUgPGz/img_20260423_091949_162.jpg)
En resumen, Addslice es una herramienta legítima para quienes buscan \

unos pocos dólares extra al mes haciendo lo que ya hacen a diario: navegar por internet. No te hará rico, pero es una de las formas más sencillas de entrar al mundo de las recompensas digitales y Bitcoin.

No he público mi enlace de referidos de la extensión porque no es lo que busco, solo les hago conocer sobre ella para quien la desee utilizar.
Si tienes alguna duda sobre como iniciar en Addslice, házmelo saber en los comentarios.

body.title: My Life Is Like A Pair of Pinking Shears
body.body:
The life of a writer does not extend in a straight line. Mine, in particular, has followed a rather crooked trajectory, zigzagging like the blade of a pair of pinking shears. Entering 2026, I found myself once again following that old path that has haunted me since the days of my youth. And that’s why you haven’t heard much from me since January.

![](https://substackcdn.com/image/fetch/$s_!L3Cj!,w_1456,c_limit,f_webp,q_auto:good,fl_progressive:steep/https%3A%2F%2Fsubstack-post-media.s3.amazonaws.com%2Fpublic%2Fimages%2Fb5dfc3aa-c47f-473d-a8eb-8adb5b040c85_1402x1122.png) 

It wasn’t intentional.

I’m all for creators taking a break once in a while. A _New York Times_ bestselling author I know takes a publishing vacation every December. He doesn’t publish new content to his blog or two podcasts during that time. I suspect he uses that time to plan the next year’s content calendar.

That was not why I took a break in February and March. In fact, I hadn’t planned on taking a break at all. But, I needed the breather.

As it were, my wife and I needed a vehicle. We’d retired our camper van in April last year and was driving my dad’s truck in the meantime. We just weren’t taking long trips as we’d been doing since 2020. Instead, I diverted my energy to client work in order to save the money we’d need for a replacement vehicle. I continued to sell books at craft shows, farmer’s markets, and grocery stores, but my primary occupation was freelancing.

While doing some gig work, I also worked on my author website, fixing some technical challenges. Before I knew it, that was consuming all of my non-freelancing time. It became the headache I didn’t know I had.

Now that I’ve worked out those details (hopefully, they won’t return), I can get back to creating new content. That means writing my newsletter more frequently and working on new books. Of course, I’ll continue to freelance while continuing to work toward my author goals.

On the good news front, my wife and I drove home in our new-to-us vehicle yesterday afternoon.

![](https://substackcdn.com/image/fetch/$s_!pS8v!,w_1456,c_limit,f_webp,q_auto:good,fl_progressive:steep/https%3A%2F%2Fsubstack-post-media.s3.amazonaws.com%2Fpublic%2Fimages%2Ff9c96ef5-0da7-4c7f-8e22-1a362f6ccb18_4000x3000.jpeg) 

We are now the proud owners of a 2008 Hyundai Entourage. Pretty, isn’t it?

## **Categorizing Books Like a Librarian**

One of the big changes I made to my website was putting books into specific categories to make them easier to find. You can see how that looks below, or [check out my book shop](https://authorallentaylor.com/shop/).

![](https://substackcdn.com/image/fetch/$s_!OoVE!,w_1456,c_limit,f_webp,q_auto:good,fl_progressive:steep/https%3A%2F%2Fsubstack-post-media.s3.amazonaws.com%2Fpublic%2Fimages%2Ff363f2b7-9dcc-4129-9591-578372dc31ba_1412x852.png) 

Rather than simply listing my books by genre, I’ve also included a “formats” category to allows readers to find print books, e-books, and audiobooks easily, depending on their preferences. And I’ve included another format—[chapbooks](https://authorallentaylor.com/product-category/book-formats/chapbooks/). These are short books that include poetry, flash fiction, or short stories. Currently, the chapbooks are only available in print, and rather than be fulfilled by Lulu as my full-length books are, the chapbooks will be mailed to readers directly from me. They’ll be printed on my Canon MegaTank printer, which I bought for just that purpose.

Soon, another category will be added: coloring books. I’ve already got one of those published with more on the way. The coloring books, like the chapbooks, will be printed and mailed by me personally.

Anyway, I don’t want to get longwinded. I did want to touch base with you. I appreciate all you fine folks who have subscribed to my Substack. Look for more to come soon, with some major announcements on the horizon. Free fiction and nonfiction coming your way soon!

​

_The lead image was created by ChatGPT. This post was _[_first published at Substack_](https://thetaylorkarass.substack.com/p/my-life-is-like-a-pair-of-pinking)_._

body.body: 1/3 🧵 @ahmadmanga, like you’re 5: imagine you’re trying to spot fish in a huge ocean. You probably won’t see a normal fish first — you’ll see the giant glowing weird one. Kipping’s **Eschatian Hypothesis** says if humans ever first detect alien intelligence, it probably won’t be some ordinary little civilization. It’ll be an **extreme, late-stage, ridiculously powerful one** doing something huge and obvious in the universe. The basic paper is [here](https://arxiv.org/abs/2512.09970) and [here](https://iopscience.iop.org/article/10.3847/2515-5172/ae2adf).
body.author: askrafiki

body.body: 2/3 🧵 The core idea is actually pretty sharp. In astronomy, our **first detections** are often the loudest freaks, not the average cases: we found hot Jupiters before Earth-like planets, bright quasars before ordinary galaxies, extreme signals before subtle ones. Kipping extends that logic to ETI: the first civilization we confirm may be one near its “eschaton” — basically a civilization under existential pressure, at the end of its usable cosmic window, or operating at absurd scale, making it easier to notice. That means searches shouldn’t only look for neat radio messages; they should also look for **big anomalies** and technosignatures across broad surveys. That framing is laid out in the [arXiv paper](https://arxiv.org/abs/2512.09970) and the journal version at [RNAAS/IOPscience](https://iopscience.iop.org/article/10.3847/2515-5172/ae2adf).
body.author: askrafiki

body.body: 3/3 🧵 My take: it’s a **good search heuristic**, not a law of nature. It doesn’t prove alien civilizations become giant cosmic engineers; it says our **first confirmed example** is biased toward the easiest one to detect. That’s a very different — and much more defensible — claim. I don’t see solid InLeo discussion on it yet; the search here turns up basically nothing relevant, so this one is being driven more by the paper itself than by community debate. If you want the blunt version: **don’t expect ET to knock politely — if we notice anything first, it may be the universe’s loudest weirdo.**\n\n#threadstorm

body.title: - “Dry Branches and Fake Diamonds: The True Value of False Friendships” -
body.body:
> Muy buenas noches amigos un cordial saludo para todos, tenía algún tiempo sin escribir debido a algunas complicaciones de salud y adicionalmente a ello situaciones personales que no me permitían sentarme a escribir como habitualmente lo hacía. Hoy quiero hablar sobre las falsas amistades, esos maestros involuntarios que nos enseñan y nos hacen crecer en la vida aunque tengamos una concepción diferente de ellos.
![falsas.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmRcs6U2HhoVeUz4JFxCFETRuvZXUnmVLqWMDbwCnq2LDN/falsas.png)
Amigos míos, aceptemos algo de una vez, ninguno de nosotros organiza una fiesta para celebrar que le han visto la cara de tonto, mucho menos hacemos un brindis por descubrir que esa persona en la que confiamos nuestras inseguridades y problemas puso dicha información como medida de cambio con alguna otra persona, es por eso que la traición de una amistad falsa se siente siempre como un error de cálculo personal. La traición de la amistad falsa se siente siempre como un error vuelve y lo recalco una mancha molesta en nuestro historial de vida, y un golpe directo al ego, sin embargo si nos quitamos de encima el filtro de resentimiento y nos atrevemos a mirar el panorama completo descubriremos una verdad tan incómoda como liberadora Y es que las amistades de cartón piedra son irónica Y verdaderamente los arquitectos más eficientes y brutales de nuestro carácter.
![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmf9NKAoN7WtdZKfYkxxMeY5uT3mDtLi7jBfJ7xUu9LN9J/image.png)
En la vida, nuestra ingenuidad suele ser un estado natural que denota un corazón limpio, pero mantener esa ingenuidad intacta en la adultez se convierte rápidamente en una negligencia peligrosa para nosotros mismos. Nadie nace con un radar incorporado para detectar personas hipócritas, y es precisamente aquí dónde están malas experiencias cobran su valor real e importante para nosotros. La primera vez que alguien te traiciona el dolor es agudo y punzante porque simplemente no lo viste venir; pero si te sucede una décima vez ya no podemos hablar de mala suerte sino de lecciones que te niegas a aprender, o como diría una vieja canción vives tropezando con la misma piedra.
!![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmbP9sBJXpGo9TjaWxZaN2DNy8Jsq5zSwJezHac8zSCifs/image.png)
Las amistades falsas funcionan como un curso intensivo y no solicitado de detección de humo, son el entrenamiento de campo necesario para dejar de ser carne de cañón en un mundo que no siempre juega limpio, gracias a estos personajes aprendemos a leer entre líneas y entender que el exceso de halagos suele ser el preludio de una factura pendiente, quién te cuenta los secretos de otros con una sonrisa cómplice ya está repartiendo los tuyos en la siguiente esquina. Es por eso que es la vida nos enseña algo que el dinero no puede comprar y es nada más y nada menos que el instinto. Este instinto no se basa en un cinismo amargo, sino más bien en una observación pragmática.
![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmewr8gaDTrswxAzYHLM723VLK8vMCrnieEQUewtU495Lm/image.png)
Después de lidiar con un par de amigos falsos, dejamos de escuchar lo que la gente dice empezamos a observar lo que la gente hace, tomando una frialdad casi científica, pero hay algo que nos causa un escozor en nuestra mente y es el reconocer que las personas falsas a menudo van a entrar en nuestra vida porque les dejamos esa puerta abierta de par en par. Si nos sentamos a analizar con una honestidad brutal por qué permitimos que alguien tóxico se quede tanto tiempo en nuestro círculo íntimo, la respuesta suele estar en nuestras propias carencias, dónde quizás en ese momento necesitamos alguna validación externa desesperadamente, o simplemente teníamos tanto miedo a la soledad que aceptamos cualquier compañía, aunque esta presentada para nosotros una calidad deplorable.
![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmPPsethp8sXgbaHSVxkQRXQGfSkG2CTRjrLFs3dCXYAFW/image.png)
Algunas veces nos empeñamos en esa misión de salvar a las personas que no tienen el menor interés en ser salvadas, solo para sentirnos útiles o superiores. En tal sentido el amigo falso actúa como un espejo implacable que te muestra dónde están tus fisuras de autoestima, y su partida por lo tanto no es una pérdida de valor personal sino una vacante liberada que te obliga a preguntarte sobre qué te faltaba a ti para creer que ese tipo de persona era realmente la que merecías en tu camino de vida. Naturalmente, un árbol que no se poda termina por ahogarse en su propio exceso de ramas débiles, volviéndose vulnerable a las plagas y al viento más ligero que pueda pasar por el. Las amistades falsas son exactamente eso: ramas secas que consumen savia y energía vital sin aportar ni un solo fruto, y de eso debemos tener mucho cuidado.
![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmW3uo9oe8yihtYQs1g7evfuvDcSHQpJE2FdMSART8ZHV2/image.png)
El drama que rodea la ruptura de una amistad falsa suele nublar el beneficio real, que es la recuperación del espacio y del tiempo perdido. Cuando deja de invertir horas en personas que solo están contigo por algún interés, por conveniencia o para alimentar su propio ego hambriento, de repente te empieza a sobrar energía para lo que realmente te importa y puedes culminar otros proyectos de vida. Tesoro energía para tus proyectos, para tu familia y sobre todo para los sospechosos habituales, esos dos o tres amigos reales que sí estuvieron ahí mientras tú perdías el tiempo tratando de impresionar al elenco equivocado. Esta poda de amistades falsas duele, es algo innegable, pero es lo único que permite que la luz llegue finalmente al tronco principal de tu vida. Además, la resiliencia no se compra en farmacias ni se adquiere leyendo manuales de autoayuda, olvida esto, se construye en el roce, en la fricción Y lamentablemente en las decepciones dentro de la vida.
![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmZQCoCbzfxWueXXyJS89k2YR6i636nAJNVbx1YbZHtpdK/image.png)
Enfrentar la falsedad cara a cara te obliga a endurecer la piel sin necesidad de cerrar el corazón por completo, te enseña a establecer límites de hierro, a decir que no sin sentir que el mundo se acaba y entender que tu paz mental es un activo no negociable y mejor aún que no le debes nada a nadie. Una persona que nunca ha sido traicionada es en el fondo alguien frágil, una persona susceptible a presentar traición en cualquier momento. En cambio, alguien que ha sobrevivido a la hipocresía y ha sabido levantarse es alguien que ya no le teme a la opinión ajena porque hay una libertad absoluta que nace justo en el momento en que te deja de importar quedar bien con las personas que sinceramente ni siquiera te importan a ti.
![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmbFrUpjeiWQzYmXNnMautXVa934Qip3wYw3y6irzVWrB2/image.png)
Por eso es imposible apreciar el valor de un diamante si nunca has tenido que sostener un pedazo de vidrio roto que pretende serlo, las falsas amistades sirven como el contraste necesario para que cuando llegue alguien de verdad sepa reconocerlo al instante sin dudar. Por eso amigos míos gracias a los mentirosos terminas valorando la honestidad brutal por encima de una cortesía vacía, gracias a los envidiosos aprendes a atesorar a que celebra tus éxitos como si fueran propios, y gracias a todos aquellos que desaparecieron en la primera tormenta hoy sabes perfectamente quiénes son tus paraguas en la vida.
![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmbUMMXxWXrKocGEMo4nwhS3ZguZQV7ELkW2cAsfF5VafT/image.png)
Aquí es donde entra la gratitud que sentimos por los amigos verdaderos suele estar cimentada, piedra a piedra sobre los escombros de todas las relaciones que no funcionaron y que nos dejaron cicatrices en la vida. No se trata de ir por la vida repartiendo agradecimientos a los que nos fallaron pues no hay que caer en un romanticismo absurdo ni en una nobleza impuesta, pero sí hay que reconocerle el mérito técnico, ya que fueron el mal necesario para tú poder seguir adelante, fueron los extras de una película en la que tú necesitabas aprender a hacer el protagonista y no un simple espectador de los caprichos ajenos. Amigo mío si hoy eres una persona más selectiva, más entrada y mucho menos dispuesta a tolerar juegos mentales en este momento amerita dar un crédito silencioso a ese supuesto amigo que te dio la espalda cuando más lo necesitabas. Sin saberlo y sin quererlo te dio el empujón definitivo hacia tu mejor versión esa que ya no necesita máscaras ni aplausos baratos al final del día. Entonces Las falsas amistades son como un examen de matemáticas extremadamente difícil en la escuela, odiaste hacerlo, te causó una ansiedad terrible y quizás hasta te hizo llorar de frustración, pero esta te obligó a prender la lógica necesaria para no volver a cometer el mismo error en el examen mucho más importante que es la vida real. Para concluir, una vez que aprendes a ver el beneficio detrás del engaño, tú y solamente tú dejas de ser una víctima de la falsedad para convertirte en un experto en la verdad, Y ese es un intercambio que a largo plazo siempre sale a tu favor. Amigos míos me quiero despedir de todos hasta una próxima interacción, dándole los mejores deseos y deseándoles un excelente día lleno de buenas amistades. Se despide su amigo dumbelth17, desde un lugar en la distancia. ![Folleto Tríptico Lectura Infantil Ilustrado Bonito Multicolor.gif](https://images.hive.blog/DQmRw4x6J4sRmFCbvcWiRuCeh43NwsF5XwQissMdFgfPA4g/Folleto%20Tr%C3%ADptico%20Lectura%20Infantil%20Ilustrado%20Bonito%20Multicolor.gif) ![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmWhdAR77WTgCLboAXjANJ9jM2xoppEf9oc4eQYTPvLJRy/image.png)

>

Good evening, friends. Warm greetings to all. I haven’t written in a while due to some health issues, as well as personal circumstances that prevented me from sitting down to write as I usually do.


Today I want to talk about false friendships—those unwitting teachers who teach us and help us grow in life, even if we see them differently.

<center>![falsas.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmRcs6U2HhoVeUz4JFxCFETRuvZXUnmVLqWMDbwCnq2LDN/falsas.png)</center>

My friends, let’s face it: none of us throws a party to celebrate being made to look like a fool, much less raise a toast to discovering that the person we confided our insecurities and problems to used that information to manipulate someone else. That’s why the betrayal of a false friendship always feels like a personal miscalculation.


The betrayal of a fake friendship always feels like a mistake—and I’ll emphasize this—a nagging stain on our life’s record, and a direct blow to the ego. however, if we shake off the filter of resentment and dare to look at the bigger picture, we’ll discover a truth as uncomfortable as it is liberating: that cardboard friendships are, ironically, the most efficient and brutal architects of our character.


<center>![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmf9NKAoN7WtdZKfYkxxMeY5uT3mDtLi7jBfJ7xUu9LN9J/image.png)</center>

In life, our naivety is often a natural state that signifies a pure heart, but keeping that naivety intact into adulthood quickly becomes a dangerous negligence toward ourselves. No one is born with a built-in radar to detect hypocrites, and this is precisely where bad experiences gain their true and significant value for us.


The first time someone betrays you, the pain is sharp and piercing because you simply didn’t see it coming; but if it happens a tenth time, we can no longer speak of bad luck but rather of lessons you refuse to learn—or, as an old song would say, you keep tripping over the same stone.


<center>!![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmbP9sBJXpGo9TjaWxZaN2DNy8Jsq5zSwJezHac8zSCifs/image.png)</center>

False friendships serve as an unsolicited crash course in smoke detection; they’re the field training you need to stop being cannon fodder in a world that doesn’t always play fair. thanks to these characters, we learn to read between the lines and understand that excessive flattery is often the prelude to a bill waiting to be paid; whoever tells you others’ secrets with a knowing smile is already spreading yours around the next corner. That is why life teaches us something money cannot buy, and it is nothing more and nothing less than instinct.


This instinct isn’t based on bitter cynicism, but rather on pragmatic observation.


<center>![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmewr8gaDTrswxAzYHLM723VLK8vMCrnieEQUewtU495Lm/image.png)</center>

After dealing with a couple of fake friends, we stop listening to what people say and start observing what people do, adopting an almost scientific detachment, but there’s something that gnaws at our minds: the realization that fake people often enter our lives because we leave that door wide open for them.


If we sit down and analyze with brutal honesty why we allow a toxic person to stay in our inner circle for so long, the answer usually lies in our own shortcomings—perhaps at that moment we desperately needed some external validation, or we were simply so afraid of loneliness that we accepted any company, even if it was of deplorable quality.


<center>![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmPPsethp8sXgbaHSVxkQRXQGfSkG2CTRjrLFs3dCXYAFW/image.png)</center>

Sometimes we set out on a mission to save people who have no interest whatsoever in being saved, just to feel useful or superior. In this sense, the fake friend acts as a relentless mirror that shows you where your self-esteem is cracked, and their departure is therefore not a loss of personal value but a vacancy that forces you to ask yourself what was missing in you that made you believe that kind of person was truly the one you deserved on your life’s path.


Naturally, a tree that isn’t pruned ends up suffocating under its own excess of weak branches, becoming vulnerable to pests and even the lightest breeze that passes through it. False friendships are exactly that: dry branches that consume sap and vital energy without bearing a single fruit, and we must be very careful of that.


<center>![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmW3uo9oe8yihtYQs1g7evfuvDcSHQpJE2FdMSART8ZHV2/image.png)</ce

The drama surrounding the end of a fake friendship often overshadows the real benefit, which is regaining lost time and space. When you stop investing hours in people who are only with you out of self-interest, convenience, or to feed their own insatiable egos, you suddenly find yourself with plenty of energy left over for what truly matters to you, and you can finally complete other life projects.


You’ll have energy to spare for your projects, for your family, and above all for the usual suspects—those two or three real friends who were actually there while you were wasting your time trying to impress the wrong crowd.


Pruning away these fake friendships hurts—there’s no denying it—but it’s the only thing that allows the light to finally reach the main trunk of your life. Besides, resilience isn’t something you buy at the pharmacy or learn from self-help books; forget that. It’s built through friction, through conflict, and, unfortunately, through life’s disappointments.


<center>![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmZQCoCbzfxWueXXyJS89k2YR6i636nAJNVbx1YbZHtpdK/image.png)</center>

Facing falsehood head-on forces you to toughen your skin without having to completely close your heart; it teaches you to set ironclad boundaries, to say no without feeling like the world is ending, and to understand that your peace of mind is a non-negotiable asset—and better yet, that you owe nothing to anyone.


A person who has never been betrayed is, deep down, someone fragile—someone susceptible to betraying others at any moment.


In contrast, someone who has survived hypocrisy and managed to pick themselves up is someone who no longer fears the opinions of others, because there is an absolute freedom that arises the very moment you stop caring about looking good in the eyes of people who, honestly, don’t even matter to you.


<center>![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmbFrUpjeiWQzYmXNnMautXVa934Qip3wYw3y6irzVWrB2/image.png)</center>

That’s why it’s impossible to appreciate the value of a diamond if you’ve never had to hold a piece of broken glass that pretends to be one; false friendships serve as the necessary contrast so that when someone genuine comes along, you know how to recognize them instantly without hesitation.


That’s why, my friends, thanks to the liars, you end up valuing brutal honesty over empty politeness; thanks to the envious, you learn to treasure those who celebrate your successes as if they were their own; and thanks to all those who disappeared at the first sign of trouble, today you know exactly who your umbrellas in life are.


<center>![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmbUMMXxWXrKocGEMo4nwhS3ZguZQV7ELkW2cAsfF5VafT/image.png)</center>

This is where the gratitude we feel for true friends is usually built, brick by brick, on the rubble of all the relationships that didn’t work out and left scars in our lives.


It’s not about going through life handing out thanks to those who let us down—we mustn’t fall into absurd romanticism or forced nobility—but we do need to acknowledge their technical merit, since they were the necessary evil that allowed you to move forward; they were the extras in a movie where you needed to learn to be the protagonist, not just a spectator of others’ whims.


My friend, if today you are a more selective person, more mature, and much less willing to tolerate mind games, then it is worth giving silent credit to that so-called friend who turned their back on you when you needed them most.


Without knowing it and without meaning to, they gave you the final push toward your best self—the one who no longer needs masks or cheap applause at the end of the day.


So, false friendships are like an extremely difficult math test in school—you hated taking it, it caused you terrible anxiety, and maybe even made you cry out of frustration, but it forced you to learn the logic needed to avoid making the same mistake on the much more important test that is real life.


To conclude, once you learn to see the benefit behind the deception, you—and only you—stop being a victim of falsehood and become an expert in truth. And that’s a trade-off that, in the long run, always works in your favor.


My friends, I want to say goodbye to everyone until our next interaction, sending you my best wishes and hoping you have an excellent day filled with good friendships.

Your friend dumbelth17 bids you farewell from afar.

body.title: We all Grow... But Not Everything Dissapears
body.body:
> *People can be funny. Some will criticize, blame, and be ready to crucify you as if they are flawless…*
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmPFWmRXUuzW2C9EyizivVbbCBHFDPJExs7maV3hVsUgvx/image.png)
[source](https://pixabay.com/vectors/boy-child-daughter-family-father-2029804/) *Before you drag someone, check yourself first. Since the day you were born, have you really never made a mistake? Never done anything worth criticizing?* *No one is perfect. The only advantage we have is that as we grow older, we’re supposed to grow wiser… though that doesn’t apply to everyone.* *There are things I strongly believed in before, things I would argue about and defend with my chest. But with time, I have realized how wrong I was.* *Some of those old beliefs? I have thrown them in the bin. The funny part is, I never posted them online. And even if I did, I am not a celebrity; no one really cares about the opinions of an average person*. *Not that people truly care about celebrities’ beliefs either… but there are always people waiting for any opportunity to bring them down.* *There is a saying: when you are at the top, you gain unknown enemies, people who hate you for no reason. They hate your existence and will do anything to drag you down to their level.*
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmSA4cJXCqk663kmTicb9VaxJSgqamPNcfPSy8KyA5cgNy/image.png)
[source](https://pixabay.com/photos/person-sunset-lightning-man-7511498/) *There is a popular TikToker in Nigeria who is a big Wizkid fan. She’s always had something negative to say about Davido.* *Then one day, Davido had a show, and she was invited on stage to perform. But fans who had seen her past posts called her out, and things got so intense that one of Davido’s crew members didn’t even allow her to perform.* *Now, whether it was planned or not, one thing is clear: your words can come back to meet you.* *She didn’t lose that opportunity because she wasn’t a Davido fan… she lost it because of how extreme and reckless she was with her words.* *People have lost jobs and opportunities because of their past actions and beliefs.* *There was a guy who went for an interview at an oil company. He did very well, and it looked like he was going to get the job. But before leaving, he was asked to drop his social media handle.* *They checked his Twitter and found an old tweet where he said, “No mercy for any company I work for, I will loot until there is nothing left.* *Maybe he was joking back then, but the company didn’t see it that way.* *That one tweet cost him the job.* *His past came back to meet him in the present, and this happens to a lot of people.* *I believe in growth and leaving people’s past behind, but it really depends on what that past looks like. Some things are easier to move on from than others.*

body.title: 【生活】胡志明之日本料理
body.body:
![335.jpeg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmPZJbsGKCJD3NpuFnZvhwjtR23pZwwHGZJCbbQf5a24cV/335.jpeg)

这次出差，合作的一家工厂东家有喜。女儿马上就要结婚了，所以他们就请一位业务主管到越南来接待我们。

![336.jpeg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmc7jhbGqv9GKsBUosNiKmUNtJCzbvYZy4URD9Fcc1Ki7o/336.jpeg)

![337.jpeg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmPkgPnyfagLs7oDV2Aq6KpCfLyUBEWFK1hERJzNb1Ctws/337.jpeg)

参观完工厂，我们就坐车回到胡志明。这位业务主管我之前在他们的国内厂也见过。讲话细声细语的，很能说会道，是工厂东家的好帮手。去年的时候，我也到这家工厂参观，当时的生意并不乐观，厂内的气氛不是很活跃。而这次去，则看到很不一样的场景。车间非常热闹，他们也有了新的合作品牌。很为这位东家高兴。

![338.jpeg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmTe7kvVN59iCj4vyUK3WKMhnQVdbiGRdt88SR7qJ3eYPg/338.jpeg)

![339.jpeg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmd3MMv73r97hcjdYVUsjUSqaipRoBQX5i4JB3xQUoApY4/339.jpeg)

说到这位东家，那真是让人称赞的女中豪杰。曾经在国内开出租。孩子绑在身上也出去开。后来有机缘开始办工厂，越办越大，产业不断地扩大。鞋材只是他们产业的一小部分。真是让人钦佩。她也非常注重客户关系，所以，每次我们过来都非常热情客气地接待。其实这次她因为家有喜事不能亲自过来，也没有必要让业务主管过来。特殊好事大家都可以理解。 真是太客气了。

![340.jpeg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmbfGihejzZMQrNdjs8QdZELcc3by8ofVki9DVvHjz8WmQ/340.jpeg)

![341.jpeg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmbUsdioFL5mHSkvwJwABaErmvoDAi7WaUGz8AABJDaTNk/341.jpeg)

这样业务主管带着我们到了这家日本料理店。就在胡志明市中心。如果不是因为这顿晚餐，估计我们是不会到市中心来的。我们住的酒店离机场就10几分钟的路程。对于我们早早要赶飞机的人来说是最方便的。所以也不介意没在市中心了。 

![342.jpeg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmRpSh37guG88mEWhnHh8y9sxVzU7fyjCizZErVK6e8YQ6/342.jpeg)

这家料理店的生意很不错，菜色非常新鲜美味。看价格也真的不贵。同行的国内同事事后还换算了一下人民币的价格。这么好的一顿大餐居然只要五百多人民币，一人不到200。真是物廉价美呀。 看以后是否有机会再去？ 

ps: 图片系同事拍摄

body.title: Entre Páginas Vivimos. La Maestría del Amor [Spn/Eng]
body.body:
>Expansivo inicio de fin semana lleno de salud, energía, ideas maravillosas, magia. Encuentros con tu propio ser y mucho entusiasmo en cada actividad que realicen.

Hola comunidad #Hiveargentina AR,

>Como muchos conocemos el Día Internacional del Libro es una conmemoración celebrada cada 23 de abril a nivel mundial con el objetivo de fomentar la lectura, la industria editorial y la protección de la propiedad intelectual por medio del derecho de autor. Desde 1988, es una celebración internacional promovida por la UNESCO.

\n\n

>Como observamos es una fecha importante que se debe afianzar cada año por la necesidad que existe en cuanto a fomentar la lectura a nivel mundial. Existe la creencia que no nos gusta leer, aunque si hay que tomar en cuenta que cada quien lee aquello que le entusiasma o aquél tema que vibra con su ser. Puedo reconocer que todos no se encaminan en la misma línea de lectura, lo que para unos es formidable, para otros es aburrido o sin sentido.

\n\n

>Hay gama de estilos de historias tejidas en un libro, de misterio, terror, amor, en el arte de las relaciones. Creo que me he paseado por diferentes estilos en diferentes etapas de mi vida. Por ende, son diferentes libros que he tenido en mis manos y en sus capítulos he llegado a identificarme. Desde Ana Karenina hasta llegar a aquellos libros que su objetivo es el crecimiento personal como han sido denominados, yo los llamaría el despertar del humano, porque es tanto que la ciencia ha demostrado que hasta en nuestras relaciones existe una estructura que nos orienta.

>Recuerdo mucho un libro de nombre El Milagro Mas Grande del Mundo, autor Og mandino, creo que abrió ese sentido de literatura en el cual fui haciendo espacio en mis ratos de lectura. Así, llegaban historias donde me veía comprendiendo este mundo interno del que estamos hechos, una comprensión pausada porque de verdad no es sencillo.

>Hoy comparto La Maestría del Amor del Dr. Miguel Ruiz, este libro llegó a mis manos como para decirme: mira, todo lo que has leído te ha traído hasta aquí, para que comprendas más acerca de la convivencia y qué tienes que ver tú en ella. Por supuesto, antes de este Muchas Vidas, Muchos maestros, una historia científica/espiritual de vidas pasadas que algún sentido tiene en nuestras vidas.

\n\n

>Vuelvo a La Maestría del Amor, reconocernos y reconocer la sociedad que nos atrapa con sus leyes y modos de comportamiento, lo que en realidad nos hace perdernos son todas esas cosas que la misma sociedad nos indica para hacer, ser exitoso sin decirnos que todos somos exitosos en lo que decidimos hacer, así que nuestra vida se nos va en buscar ese lugar que creemos si no nos parecemos al vecino hemos fallado. El insiste que el perdón es parte de ser mejores, así sin remordimientos, que estamos inyectados de veneno emocional y que es importante salir de ello, para esto el trabajo es individual, de estudio, de comprensión, de habituarse, de abrir los ojos ante ciertas situaciones que vamos experimentando, de nivel de creencias y nos conlleva a salir de esos bucles para de verdad definirnos como verdadero y puro amor, por supuesto mejorar nuestras relaciones que por desconocimiento las empeoramos.

\n\n
>Es bien interesante, lo tengo aquí en mi oficina como le llamo a mi pequeño espacio de trabajo.

>
https://www.glitter-graphics.com/images/t/b/480x60/2386/2386153uit1c7d6jl.webp

>Wishing you an expansive start to the weekend filled with health, energy, wonderful ideas, and magic. May it be a time for connection with your inner self and great enthusiasm in every activity you undertake.

Hello Hiveargentina community,

>As many of us know, International Book Day is a commemoration celebrated every April 23rd worldwide with the aim of promoting reading, the publishing industry, and the protection of intellectual property through copyright. Since 1988, it has been an international celebration promoted by UNESCO.

\n\n

>As we can see, it is an important date that should be reinforced each year due to the need to promote reading worldwide. There is a belief that we don't like to read, although we must consider that everyone reads what excites them or what resonates with their soul. I can recognize that not everyone follows the same reading path; what is wonderful for some is boring or pointless for others.

\n\n

>There's a wide range of story styles woven into a book: mystery, horror, love, the art of relationships. I think I've explored different styles at different stages of my life. Therefore, I've held different books in my hands, and I've come to identify with their chapters. From Anna Karenina to those books whose objective is personal growth, as they've been called—I would call them the awakening of humanity—because science has shown that even our relationships have a science that guides us.

I vividly remember a book called The Greatest Miracle in the World. I think it opened up that sense of literature for which I began to make space in my reading time. Stories came to me where I found myself understanding this inner world of which we are made, a gradual understanding because it truly isn't easy.

>Today I'm sharing The Mastery of Love by Dr. Miguel Ruiz. This book came into my hands as if to say: look, everything you've read has brought you here so that you can understand more about coexistence and what your role is in it. Of course, before this, there's the Many Lives, Many Masters, a scientific/spiritual history of past lives that has some meaning in our lives.

\n\n

>I return to the Mastery of Love, recognizing ourselves and the society that traps us with its laws and modes of behavior. What really makes us lose our way are all those things that society tells us to do to be successful, without telling us that we are all successful in what we choose to do. So our lives are spent searching for that place, believing that if we resemble our neighbor, we have failed. He insists that forgiveness is part of becoming better, without remorse, that we are injected with emotional poison and that it is important to get out of it. For this, the work is individual: study, understanding, getting used to it, opening our eyes to certain situations we experience, a level of belief that leads us to break free from those loops to truly define ourselves as true and pure love, and of course, improving our relationships, which we worsen through ignorance.

\n\n

>It's really interesting, I have it here in my office, as I call my small workspace.

body.title: [ENG-ESP] Evergreen 💚 | Phone Photography Contest #109
body.body:
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmUni6vURiter5qNmPAwDxZV8oe4QfwGZJW9pjXWyoeR78/1777054475968.png)

🍀[ENG]  I’ve never been much of a person to go out. Sometimes, months go by where I only leave the house when an external commitment demands it (something beyond my own will), and without that, it is very difficult for me to find enough motivation to do so. However, many times, once I’m actually out and about, I realize that I am, in fact, enjoying myself.

🌱[ESP] *Nunca he sido de salir mucho de casa. A veces paso meses saliendo solo cuando me lo demanda algún compromiso externo (externo a mi voluntad), y si no hay tal cosa es muy difícil que sienta motivación suficiente para hacerlo. Pero muchas veces, ya estando fuera, me doy cuenta de que de hecho lo estoy disfrutando.*

---

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmevCnq1796rV4VBSMQDj9o46qqnDKFMKzoHSPD1MnNAYj/1776974792116.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZPg67ZvgyBV8WrDMZyutx9yFU1cmTGaHGpEGjfzc1xaj/1776975195740.jpg)

---

🍀I enjoy walking; I love observing and appreciating all the beauty that exists out there. I love walking alone in silence because, without the need to interact with anyone, I have the time to truly feel. I feel the breeze on my face—the same breeze that rustles the leaves of the trees; I hear it and I smell it. I watch the little birds and the dogs walking with their humans, who sometimes let them run free in the parks. I see children playing and laughing, reminding me of the freshness of youth. Yes, leaving the house is hard at work at first, but then I see that while unpleasant things exist out there, there is also the pleasant and the beautiful.

🌱*Me gusta caminar, me gusta observar y apreciar todo lo bello que hay allí afuera. Me gusta cuando voy andando sola en silencio, porque sin tener que interactuar con nadie tengo tiempo de sentir. Siento la brisa en mi rostro, que es la misma que mueve las hojas de los árboles, la escucho y la huelo. Observo a los pajaritos y a los perros que van paseando con sus humanos, que a veces los sueltan libres en los parques. Veo a los niños jugar y reír, lo cual me recuerda la frescura de la juventud. Sí, al principio se me hace difícil salir de casa, pero luego veo que allá afuera existe lo desagradable, pero también lo agradable y hermoso.*

---

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQd9Ms65hPDyyLsNnfq1RDzLJQspjXyCuLSUV1Qnxqtxm/1776974792421.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmd7rzuKGvTrb7sc1yj8y9hzsV58QGEMt8XFXe33cKHDMk/1776974792217.jpg)

---

🍀Today, I want to share these photos of greenery with you. I took them during my downtime between work shifts, during lunch breaks, or on my way to or from commitments. In those small moments, after having been \

to go out, the sight of leaves—with their different shapes, colors, and sizes—reminds me that they give us air and life. It comforts me and makes me feel grateful to simply be and exist.

🌱*Hoy quiero compartir con ustedes estas fotos de verdor que he tomado en algunos de mis tiempos muertos entre turnos de trabajo a la hora del almuerzo, o de camino a algún compromiso o de regreso a casa. En pequeños momentos en los que, después de haber salido obligada a la calle, la visión de las hojas, con sus distintas formas, colores y tamaños, que nos dan aire y vida, me reconforta y me hace sentir agradecida de ser y estar.*

---

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmbbbvAxXutewiMbmFaQNFRKNGrPsxxqGZEig5UAiixxHc/1776975195503.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmNTS7exWSsTsdatQEVgTr5uMu89UxjPrjVd1PFgD2RjQS/1776975195363.jpg)

---

🍀And this photo right here 👇 is my entry for the mobile photography contest created by @untilwelearn. I chose this one because I love how the sunlight peeked through the leaves, reaching right where I was sitting on a park bench, waiting for my bus (I’ll tell you more about that day in another post).

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmSqs2836hN9EK7XAeep68XZCibpe9AnHRYPp1G3Y9d2jJ/1777059663203.jpg)

​🌱*Y esta foto de aquí 👆 será mi entrada para el concurso de fotografías tomadas con el móvil, creado por @untilwelearn. Escogí esta porque me encanta cómo la luz del sol entraba entre las hojas llegando hacia donde estaba sentada, en un banquito en cierto parque, esperando a que fuera la hora para agarrar el autobús (en otro post les contaré más sobre ese día).*

---

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmejdJdLia6e2w55zHtepC6CfqTCNPMpKykdz6ijsG1T2V/1776974792310.jpg)

🍀If you would like to participate too, here is the link to the post with the contest description and rules:

 https://ecency.com/hive-190931/@untilwelearn/phone-photography-contest-109

​🌱*Si también quieren participar, por aquí les dejo el link hacia el post con la descripción y las reglas del concurso:*👆  

---
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQCuv6dfMtenz6RjKJV24d8FU3sCjuGMr2n6DUvoRFNmX/1776975195590.jpg)

🍀Thank you for reading and for checking out my photos 💚🍃. I hope you are also enjoying every beautiful moment life gives you, even if they aren't happening all the time, and even if they are just tiny moments 🤗.

​🌱*Gracias por leerme y ver mis fotos* 💚🍃. *Espero que ustedes también estén disfrutando cada momento bello que la vida les da, aunque no sean todos los momentos, y aunque sean momentos pequeñitos* 🤗.

[![](https://images.3speak.tv/images/1776987412518-a579519cea0b5a72.webp)](https://3speak.tv/watch?v=lebereenp/a69b518f)

▶️ [Watch on 3Speak](https://3speak.tv/watch?v=lebereenp/a69b518f)


---

Cette vidéo propose une transposition entre les Églises symboliques de l’Apocalypse et les principales dénominations chrétiennes actuelles, qu’elles soient catholiques ou protestantes. (This video offers a transposition between the symbolic Churches of the Apocalypse and the main current Christian denominations, whether Catholic or Protestant.)
Elle examine, à travers une étude rigoureuse, laquelle représenterait aujourd’hui l’Église de Jésus-Christ, en s’appuyant sur l’Apocalypse, l’histoire et l’ensemble de la Bible.

Grâce à cette approche globale, la vidéo offre une lecture approfondie destinée à éclairer l’identité de la véritable Église du Christ et à mieux comprendre sa condition spirituelle. Une analyse méthodique pour éviter les interprétations superficielles et se rapprocher du sens réel du texte biblique.

---

Hello everyone 👋 


1. Cohabiting before marriage, does it help in building a stronger bond/future?


Now, let me be honest with y'all, this sis something I've done before. Meaning I won't be talking from something I read somewhere but from my own lived experience. And in all honesty, I will never do it again. Some might have done it and it worked for them, but me o, it's a no no.


Now, while living together, you get to be close and know things about each other. You see each other every day, you get to understand each other's moods, you know how he/she snores, and it can as well expose things to you, things like anger issues and how they manage it, things like spending habits, things like cleanliness and dirtiness... You get to see it via cohabiting together, cos things like that are like smoke, they can't be hidden for so long. So, that way it tends to test compatibility.


But then, coahabiting together can as well create a false sense of security, in the sense that you don't just feel, but you as well start acting like a married couple without doing the necessities. You will agree with me that cohabiting can't go on for long without sharing one's body with the other(sex). So, you give your time, your body, your energy, you finance... Your everything to it.


And for me, it didn't help me build at all, I thought it would help build a good and strong foundation, but it didn't. That was why I said earlier that it might work for others, but it's a no no for me. Because it only made things worse and a lot more complicated at the end of the day. I would have loved to share the story, but o long. I wouldn't have called it cohabiting, but at the end of the day, it is still cohabiting. This lady had some issues and we were dating back then, so she was forced to leave her place, most of her friends staying near as well aren't staying alone, so I decided to take her, and that was how we began stay together then till she will secure her own place.... And it opened my eyes to a lot of things, some which I could still even bear, and some like (infidelity/cheating) that I couldn't even bare. Got to an extent that she started calling this guy's name when she wants to call me 😂😁😂... Lemme not say too much.


And as a Christian, I know it's out of it. It is not acceptable in any way, but to keep it neutral, based on what I have seen, I can say coahabiting is not a foolproof way to guarantee a lasting marriage.

 


2. Does cohabitation make partners lose independence and take on responsibilities without commitment?

Well, seems this is directed at the women, but then we will all agree that it all starts from... Ok, let's stay together. And from staying together you start doing various duties and household chores, you sweep, mop, wash, cook, support and all....in short you start acting like the wife/spouse that you're not.... 

And like I said earlier, seems this is directed at the women as they are the ones who get to do all of that, they began to adjust their lives, reschedule their schedules, sacrifice and most times put their lives, business, academic and such on hold in the name of... *\

* while there's no legal backing to your stress and all that you claim to be building.


And I can say that the disadvantage outweighs the advantage in every way... Even where rules are set and boundaries are defined, the disadvantage still outweighs the advantage, because it's not as if you won't be pouring into the *\
