body.title: StickerArt #089 Paste-Ups with Alex & EgoCut, Montreal
body.body: I'm trying to keep my promise from last week to post at least once a week about stickers and other collages. We'll see how many weeks that lasts 😀. Today's posts are mostly collages done by a \

artist, **Alex or Alé**. Luckily, his style is recognizable.\n\n> *J'essaye de tenir mon engagement pris la semaine dernière de faire au moins un post par semaine au sujet des autocollants et autres collages. On va voir combien de semaines cela va dure* 😀. *Aujourd'hui, il s'agit en grande partie de collages réalisés par un artiste \

, **Alex ou Alé**. Heureusement que le style est reconnaissable.*

![Alex on Mentana](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/heroldius/EoAb9XLRWZkSGSMyS5JVni6D8HnK4a4UdjrMcs4rsGSCWaiMB6bY9677mN6qLuG26hQ.jpg)

# ෴ ᴡʜᴇʀᴇ
![line_hive.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/heroldius/xoycoMPQ-line_hive.jpg)

At the corner of Duluth Avenue and de Mentana Street in the Plateau neighborhood of Montreal. The second complex shown at the end of this post is located nearby on Rachel Street.

![Carte.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/heroldius/23tHV5eGfnN5SbQfnM6i4qW7PHbQ9het7ff7rq11B6BoXLrZfPx5Dt6p777AjLnqCY2E8.jpg)

> *Au coin de l'avenue Duluth et de la rue de Mentana dans le quartier du Plateau à Montréal. Le deuxième ensemble présenté en fin de post, se trouve pas loin de là sur la rue Rachel.*

🗺️ Position on [OpenStreetMap](https://www.openstreetmap.org/#map=16/45.52558/-73.56761)

# ෴ ᴡʜᴏ
![line_hive.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/heroldius/xoycoMPQ-line_hive.jpg)

## Alex

![Alex](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/heroldius/EoEpUiqqeHKmqPEh7FPFDVR8VXtt2sY857v9KdMf4cCPgR47RuZUj74o2ixda7rZz5w.jpg)

I had already come across this artist's work in the streets of Montreal, see [StickerArt #048](https://peakd.com/hive-184784/@heroldius/sticker-art-048-ale-and-astro-montreal). **Alex** or **Alé** often creates black and white collages, frequently recreating scenes from films, like here with **Titanic** and the final scene between Rose and Jack.

> *J'avais déjà croisé le travail de cet artiste dans les rues de Montréal, voir [StickerArt #048](https://peakd.com/hive-184784/@heroldius/sticker-art-048-ale-and-astro-montreal). **Alex** ou **Alé** réalise souvent des collages en noir et blanc en reprenant souvent des scènes de films comme ici avec **Titanic** et la scène finale entre Rose et Jack.*

![Alex](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/heroldius/23tbqC2Gv7ibRnW9m7wH9Eu7fj3BEjhiFdTDQkdSvXJJAwNtCttfsqKHS1Vvwt9RYtfxq.jpg)

As in the previous post about him, he is often associated with collages by the artist [**Astro**](https://www.instagram.com/astro_montreal/). I don't know if this is a coincidence or if their studios are in the same building.

> *Comme dans le précédent post à son sujet, il est souvent associé avec des collages de l'artiste [**Astro**](https://www.instagram.com/astro_montreal/). Je ne sais pas si c'est coïncidence ou si leurs studios sont dans le même bâtiment.*

![Astro & Alex](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/heroldius/23xoytKcBgrnghSx4Xz6scmRsUhWStNQSTSrZ4vsFtdDm9Fr6qxv3wzsXZAJuWJRftxnj.jpg)

On Rachel Street, there is a collage depicting **Edward Scissorhands**. It is accompanied by a collage by [**EgoCut**](https://www.instagram.com/ego.cut_/), a Montreal-based artist who creates linocuts, a type of printmaking.

> *Sur la rue Rachel, on retrouve un collage représentant **Edward aux mains d'argent**. Il est accompagné par un collage de [**EgoCut**](https://www.instagram.com/ego.cut_/), un artiste basé à Montréal qui réalise des linogravures, une sorte de gravure.*

<div class=\

/> **෴ ꜱᴏᴜʀᴄᴇꜱ** **Instagram** : [Astro](https://www.instagram.com/astro_montreal/) [EgoCut](https://www.instagram.com/ego.cut_/) **෴ ᴘʀᴇᴠɪᴏᴜꜱ ᴘᴏꜱᴛꜱ** [#879 2016 Mural Festival](https://peakd.com/hive-184784/@heroldius/street-art-879-mural-festival-2016-montreal)  **>** [#878 Legal Wall de Rouen (11-2025)](https://peakd.com/hive-184784/@heroldius/street-art-878-legal-wall-de-rouen-november-2025-montrea) [Street Art Contest #297 Projet Tyxna](https://peakd.com/hive-184784/@heroldius/cccs-street-art-contest-297-projet-tyxna-montreal) [StickerArt #088 TBanBox DrainWash Cess Pool](https://peakd.com/hive-184784/@heroldius/stickerart-088-tbanbox-and-drainwash-and-cess-pool-montreal) [#877 OnoArt with **Edward Delandre**...](https://peakd.com/hive-184784/@heroldius/street-art-877-onoart-with-edward-delandre-and-monegargg-autumn-2025-montreal) [#876 **Izabelle Duguay** Montreal](https://peakd.com/hive-184784/@heroldius/street-art-876-izabelle-duguay-montreal) [StreetArt Contest #296 **SinoJam** de Rouen](https://peakd.com/hive-184784/@heroldius/cccs-street-art-contest-296-legal-wall-de-rouen-sinojam-montreal) [#875 Legal Wall de Rouen (10-2025)](https://peakd.com/hive-184784/@heroldius/street-art-875-legal-wall-de-rouen-october-2025-montreal) [#874 **Grils** (Cremazie VI)(Cremazie V)](https://peakd.com/hive-184784/@heroldius/street-art-874-grils-garage-cremazie-part-vi-montreal) [Street Art Contest #295 **Amer**... Que este día lluvioso les traiga paz, creatividad y muchas bendiciones pequeñas pero hermosas. 🌈💦

A cobijarnos bien, preparar algo calientito y compartir amor en la blockchain. 💻💚

Que tengan un día lleno de calma, buena energía y sonrisas. ☁️🙏

body.title: Voluntia - členství
body.body:
Psali mi z Voluntie, jestli mám zájem o členství.

V libertariánské straně by mi bylo dobře, ale nevím, jestli nebudu jako invalida dělat straně ostudu.

A potřebuju doučit teorii, abych správně argumentoval.

Určitě se mě budou ptát na ekonomické ideály, na sociální ideály, názory na rodinu, důchody, školství...

Musím zároveň za sebe podotknout, že svět, který uvažují libertariáni, je asi svět v kterém by mě, jako skladateli, nebylo nejlépe.

Když se to ale vezme kolem a kolem, nabízí strana funkční alternativu ke dnes stále více skřípajícímu demokratickému zřízení...

Psal jsem si do knížky, že se bojím zbraně hromadného ničení v rukou soukromníka, že se také bojím roztrženého pytle s drogama, že se bojím, že by děti prodávali svá těla obrazu i doteku, ale pořád mě zla plynoucí z individuální zodpovědnosti děsí méně, než Putinova propaganda a mezinárodní spory.

Moje volba byla se izolovat v myšlence a nevnímat svět, psát jen lidem, které mám rád, dělat svojskou hudbu a vyvýjet kontrapunktické techniky.

Kdybych byl ve straně, potřebuju vedení a potřebuju doučování, Urzovu knížku jsem četl před šesti lety, videa jsem dlouho neviděl a na Kanál Svobodného přístavu nemám moc času.

S učitelem bych snad mohl ve straně být vzácným hlasem. Jako umělec bych zároveň mohl přispět k imidž...

Asi musím konstatovat, že se těším, třeba poznám zajímavé lidi, to snad určitě, zároveň budu konečně zapřažen směrem, kterým bych chtěl společnost vést.

body.title: Phillies lose in extras to Cubs, have officially lost nine straight | Andrew Painter on the mound tonight in Atlanta
body.body:
![mlb-Philadelphia-Phillies-Logo.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/adhammer/AJhXiRGysGbqrUVr31VqR8j9iJthXQeNsJRnjA5UgF2TrkK4JXLPjHUG9MUr24D.png)
[Src](https://loodibee.com/mlb/philadelphia-phillies/)

I could taste the victory yesterday, I really could. The Phillies really fought all game long. But the Cubs are simply on fire right now, while the Phillies are cold as ice. 

It was really a somewhat strange game. Cristopher Sánchez, who is one of the team's more reliable, trustworthy pitchers struggled while the offense sorta kinda woke up for once. Funny how life works huh?

Cristopher Sánchez lasted 5 1/3 innings, allowing six runs on twelve hits. Meanwhile the Phillies actually managed to put up seven runs by the end of the game. The Phillies even managed to fight back from a 6-2 deficit. 

The game *almost* had all the ingredients for a win, but the Phils pitching and hitting ultimately couldn't compliment one another quite enough. The Cubs would end up walking it off in the tenth inning. Thank goodness that was the last time the Phillies have to play the Cubs this regualar season.

In some positive news, Brandon Marsh continues to play really well! He hit two homers yesterday and went 3 for 4! He now has 4 homers on the year. His highest home run total in a season is 16. It would be really cool if he could hit 20+ this year! I think he has the power to do so. Marsh is still only 28. I feel like he's still got good potential and a pretty bright future. He seems primed to have a career year, it just stinks the team isn't winning at the moment. He currently has a betting average of .300 and an OPS of .829 and has driven in 14 runs.

But yeah tonight the Phillies face the Braves yet again. The Phillies only have eight wins and the Braves only have eight losses. Ugh. 

Maybe whenever the Phillies get out of this slump, we'll come to realize the Cubs and Braves are about to be the best teams in baseball and this awful losing streak will make slightly more sense.

Andrew Painter takes the mound today for the Phils. Hopefully the rookie can help the Phillies avoid double digit losses in a row and get a win over the Braves who are seemingly running away with the NL East already.

It will feel like the Phillies won the World Series if they were to win today LOL. Let's go!

body.body: To begin with, I'm also happy to see that one of the main front-ends I use from Hive is constantly being updated and developed, especially in these times. Now, regarding KE, it is true that it is one of those controversial topics that have existed recently and which I can say I have seen up close in these two years that I have been in Hive. I have my personal opinions on this, and I know it's a very useful measure for identifying certain accounts that have the potential to belong to people who are just trying to extract every penny they earn on Hive.\n\nFor example, the case of the \

that you mention in your post is interesting because, recently, I have seen many curiously similar accounts in the PeakD Snap Feed. All these accounts have some similarity in their usernames like iamleo or whateverleo and they all upload the same Snaps with the same phrases and images taken from Google about \

and so on. I've read that one of the main reasons these accounts potentially exist on Hive and are active on Snap is due to the rewards Snaps give to creators through the @commentrewarder account.

I've noticed that these rewards are sometimes high in terms of the amount of HIVEs and that they originate from Snaps that barely reach a couple of cents. While this may not seem like much at first glance, for a malicious person it's a perfect loophole to easily extract money simply by creating multiple accounts and uploading a bunch of Snaps in PeakD (by Front itself, by Snappie, by hSnap, by whatever). Thus, with each HIVE they receive from ComentRewarder, they keep adding it up across multiple accounts they may have, and that's how they earn money without even receiving that many votes a day. 

Note: ***I still lack a lot of information on how the ComentRewarder rewards work in PeakD Snaps.*** I would like to see this special feature (I say special because it's something new and unknown to me outside of what I know about the ComentRewarder project) not abused so much, and that Snaps should only work with the normal rewards of 50/50 or 100% HP and such, and the Tips button, and that's it. It would also be great to add the Downvotes feature to Snaps for these fraudulent accounts like the ones I mentioned above.

What do you think @asgarth? 🤔

body.title: THE WORLD NEVER FORGETS
body.body:
<div class=text-justify>

One terrible thing about the world is that it never forgets. It always keeps records of the way we live our life's, the things we say and do, and the actions we take. I have experienced this countless times, I have made bad decisions and also good decisions, I have had to enjoy the results or suffer the repercussions of my actions. These were no easy feets, the results made me bolder, and the repercussions made me wiser. And if tomorrow I would have to answer for the crimes I committed today, I would take it whole heartedly. I believe in order and there are times when being young and stupid is not an excuse or a reason to avoid some repercussions. Repercussions do not always come, and they can come in ways that one would never expect them to come. I have experienced this, and I have seen it play out in the lives of people.

 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmcHdgkAnojW3pA1e8uxVWaCzpVMESqWQTdSsV7WVJhTGy/1000031557.jpg 


<a href=\

>Image by krakenimages.com on Freepik I remember one of the major issues I had last year was when I had to pay off debts that had accumulated while I was still in the higher institution. Although I had been paying them off little by little, until I encountered challenges that made me pause. Well the loan sharks didn't let me go after it had accumulated to significant amounts and I had no choice but to scrap my account in order to pay them off. And even after doing so, there was still a lot left to pay and there was nothing I could do at that time. I almost went into depression because the mistake made was borrowing from loan sharks when I was in school. The repercussions came after I had better knowledge of how to safely take loans and pay them back. So although I had learned an important lesson, I also had to face the consequences of my actions. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmRDUCxsFHMDkYoRaNXkMUUuv9AgBHWz6BTZcGNSYN6ApX/rnfetchblobtmp_fgtcef2qubuke3qlh9re6s.jpg) For a lot of people these things take even longer than it took me. Some make mistakes as kids or teenagers and suffer them at old age. Is it normal, yes, is it fair, the answer is No. Life is not fair, life will never be fair, if we want life to be fair then a lot of us would not even be existing because we too have not been fair at some point in our lives and have also made terrible mistakes that would not be fair to others. We have escaped some repercussions of our actions and never complained that life wasn't fair, but only when we come face to face with the reality of our decisions we say life isn't fair. Perhaps it isn't truly fair, but one thing is sure, we will never encounter anything beyond our capacity to handle. Those challenges will either make us or break us depending on how we see it. links.title: 📚 Los libros son una ventana al alma [ES/EN]
links.body:
>
![1000027545.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/erigm/EoeEseuxyZ7RkWM9QpHU3PfaHyNo3zuHmHUkA3HKctoNGQKVniJ1GPr7gGX89NPiWkk.jpg)
¡Hola amigos de la comunidad de Hive Argentina! Es un placer saludarlos y venir a participar de una propuesta tan linda como lo es hablar de libros. A mí que me apasiona leer se siente como abrir una ventana al alma de mi interior. Si hablamos de aquel libro que fue un antes y un después en mi vida tengo que mencionar a la saga *Crepúsculo*. En sí ya me gustaba leer desde niña, pero era una negada y ser lectora no era cool. En la escuela todos odiaban leer, así que para mí era una cuestión de imitarlos y decir que tampoco me gustaba, renegaba de los libros que nos hacían leer en clases, y demás, pero en secreto los disfrutaba.  En el 2010, cuando tenía 17 años, me hice fan de las películas de *Crepúsculo* que iban estrenando, hasta que me puse a investigar y vi que estaban basadas en libros. Así que los busqué, los encontré y los descargué, todo muy legal (no). No sé ni cómo porque hasta ese momento nunca había descargado ningún libro, esa también fue la ventana a un mundo mucho más amplio. Me devoré el primero y pase al segundo, y así hasta terminar la saga completa. Se lo comente a una compañera de la escuela y me regaló el primer libro en físico, después adquirí los demás, y compré muchos más. *Crepúsculo* fue la llave que desbloqueo esta pasión por los libros que tengo y siempre tendrá un lugar especial en mi corazón.
![1000008761.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/erigm/23vhwn5gwPDCb412sonoXbRZNMwMWqHj2yp9QfiPcPGR7M565kBLQBdxyKPk8juJGNC92.jpg)
Con respecto a mi género literario favorito, para sorpresa de nadie, tengo que decir que es la fantasía y los romances en general. Son los géneros que más suelo leer, pero entre el año pasado y este empecé a tomarle el gusto a los thrillers también. Aunque, en general, leo de todo un poco. Incluso poesía que es un género con el que no suelo conectar tanto, pero cada tanto doy con unos versos exactos que me hacen amarlos. El mes del libro justo coincide con la apertura de la Feria Internacional del Libro de Buenos Aires. Así que mi manera de celebrarlos es leer, e ir a la feria para estar rodeada de ellos y de muchas otras personas que también aman la lectura. Bien dicen por ahí que el paraíso debe de ser algún lugar lleno de libros. Los stand que más me gustan visitar son aquellos que ofrecen alguna decoración interesante y donde están los libros que más me gustan. Pero también disfruto un montón de las editoriales pequeñas que publican a autores nacionales, siempre les compro algo a ellas porque hay que apoyar lo nacional y son más económicos también. Aparte de que terminó consiguiendo joyitas poco conocidas, no tenemos nada que envidiarles a los escritores internacionales, también tenemos con qué competirles. Y, por último, sí, conocí a varios autores de libros que leí en la misma feria de las que les hablé. Autoras como Cecelia Ahern que escribe romances o autores como Dan Wells que fueron muy cálidos, de mis visitas favoritas en la feria. Pero también conocí, y sigo en contacto, con escritores independientes nacionales, incluso soy amiga de algunos de ellos. Nada como conocer a los autores que escribieron aquellas historias que tanto amamos. ![1000027546.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/erigm/AKLrAwtmbVZaUrueHvUhADrV7EkMmJc5kjpvhrCdCEfaBYF5tSyXSKJbcghWz6M.jpg)|![1000027547.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/erigm/ALEXuiNz5PKv3Vx5XMmjeyrLQDCDEYBLWPDS5jveFC16BaCvgZ8iuw6aSqpMHYW.jpg) |-|- Esta es la manera ideal de celebrar el día del libro, leyendo y siendo feliz cada vez que te sumerges en una nueva historia, o cuando volves a reencontrarte en una que ya conoces muy bien.
![Separador libros.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/erigm/EpNqo7fpr5Dm33RgC5qLaHjaxx9Z5b8we4AVyK3DFbxprgPEp9ZjEa3uLaFJojvELz8.png)
Bueno amigos, hasta acá mi reflexión acerca de este día tan especial. Espero que les haya gustado y los invitó a participar. Gracias por llegar hasta acá y apoyar mi contenido. ¡Hasta la próxima! 
![Separador libros.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/erigm/EpNqo7fpr5Dm33RgC5qLaHjaxx9Z5b8we4AVyK3DFbxprgPEp9ZjEa3uLaFJojvELz8.png)
![1000027545.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/erigm/EoeEseuxyZ7RkWM9QpHU3PfaHyNo3zuHmHUkA3HKctoNGQKVniJ1GPr7gGX89NPiWkk.jpg)
Hello, friends of the Hive Argentina community! It’s a pleasure to greet you all and join in on such a wonderful discussion about books. As someone who loves to read, it feels like opening a window into my inner soul. If we're talking about the book that marked a turning point in my life, I have to mention the *Twilight* series. I'd always liked reading since I was a kid, but I was terrible at it, and being a reader just wasn't cool. At school, everyone hated reading, so for me it was just a matter of going along with them and saying I didn’t like it either. I would complain about the books they made us read in class and all that, but secretly I enjoyed them. In 2010, when I was 17, I became a fan of the *Twilight* movies as they were coming out, until I started doing some research and realized they were based on books. So I looked for them, found them, and downloaded them—all completely legal (not). I don’t even know how I did it, because up until then I had never downloaded a book; that was also my gateway to a much wider world. I devoured the first one and moved on to the second, and so on until I finished the entire series. I mentioned it to a classmate, and she gave me a physical copy of the first book; later, I bought the rest, and I bought many more. *Twilight* was the key that unlocked my passion for books, and it will always have a special place in my heart.
![1000008761.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/erigm/23vhwn5gwPDCb412sonoXbRZNMwMWqHj2yp9QfiPcPGR7M565kBLQBdxyKPk8juJGNC92.jpg)
As for my favorite literary genre, to no one’s surprise, I have to say it’s fantasy and romance in general. Those are the genres I read most often, but between last year and this year I’ve also started to develop a taste for thrillers. Although, in general, I read a little bit of everything—including poetry, which is a genre I don’t usually connect with that much, but every now and then I come across some verses that really speak to me and make me love them. Book Month coincides with the opening of the Buenos Aires International Book Fair. So my way of celebrating is to read and go to the fair to be surrounded by books and by many other people who also love reading. As they say, paradise must be a place full of books. The booths I like to visit the most are the ones with interesting displays and where my favorite books are. But I also really enjoy the small publishers that feature local authors; I always buy something from them because we need to support local businesses, and they’re more affordable too. Besides the fact that I end up finding little-known gems, we have nothing to envy in international writers—we’ve got what it takes to compete with them. And finally, yes, I met several authors of books I’d read at the very same book fair I told you about. Authors like Cecelia Ahern, who writes romance novels, and authors like Dan Wells, who were all so warm—they were among my favorite encounters at the fair. But I also met, and still keep in touch with, independent local writers; in fact, I’m friends with some of them. There’s nothing quite like meeting the authors who wrote the stories we love so much. ![1000027546.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/erigm/AKLrAwtmbVZaUrueHvUhADrV7EkMmJc5kjpvhrCdCEfaBYF5tSyXSKJbcghWz6M.jpg)|![1000027547.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/erigm/ALEXuiNz5PKv3Vx5XMmjeyrLQDCDEYBLWPDS5jveFC16BaCvgZ8iuw6aSqpMHYW.jpg) |-|- This is the perfect way to celebrate Book Day—by reading and finding joy every time you dive into a new story, or when you revisit one you already know so well.
![Separador libros.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/erigm/EpNqo7fpr5Dm33RgC5qLaHjaxx9Z5b8we4AVyK3DFbxprgPEp9ZjEa3uLaFJojvELz8.png)
Well, friends, that wraps up my thoughts on this special day. I hope you enjoyed it, and I invite you to join in. Thank you for reading this far and supporting my content. See you next time!
![Separador libros.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/erigm/EpNqo7fpr5Dm33RgC5qLaHjaxx9Z5b8we4AVyK3DFbxprgPEp9ZjEa3uLaFJojvELz8.png)

links.body:
# Be Different – Der Berlin Rebels Podcast startet in die Saison 2026!

Die erste Episode (nach unserem Trailer) unseres neuen Vereinspodcasts ist online! Michael Reischer und Vereinslegende **Volker Herzberg** – seit 1989 bei den Berlin Rebels – sprechen in dieser Auftaktfolge offen über alles, was den Verein gerade bewegt.

## Was euch in Episode 1 erwartet

**Die aktuelle Vereinssituation**
Football in Berlin und Brandenburg stellt alle Vereine vor die gleichen Herausforderungen: zu wenig Spieler, Nachwuchsprobleme und ein Spielermarkt, der sich nach jeder Saison neu sortiert. Volker gibt einen ehrlichen Einblick – und erklärt, warum die Berlin Rebels trotzdem gut aufgestellt sind: mit einer starken GFL-Mannschaft, einer zweiten Herrenmannschaft in der vierten Liga und einer A-Jugend, die bereits wieder in der Bundesliga spielt.

**Der Trainerwechsel**
Die große Neuigkeit: Douglas Fryer hat die Rebels auf eigenen Wunsch verlassen – ein langjähriger Vertrag bei einem anderen Verein hat ihn gerufen. Wir wünschen ihm alles Gute! Als neuer Head Coach übernimmt **Lee Rowland** – ein gebürtiger Engländer mit über 40 Jahren Trainergeschäft auf höchstem europäischen Niveau. Stationen unter anderem bei den Dresden Monarchs, den Hildesheim Invaders, den Berlin Adler und zuletzt zwei Jahre bei den Hamburg Sea Devils in der ELF. Jetzt endlich Black and Silver!

**Der Saisonstart**
Am **9. Mai** geht es los – direkt mit einem Hammerspiel: Die **Potsdam Royals** kommen ins **Mommsenstadion**. Amtierender Meister, volle Gästetribüne, Gänsehaut-Atmosphäre. Wer dabei sein will: Tickets gibt es auf **berlinrebels.de**.

**Livestream & GFL-Konferenz**
Nicht in Berlin? Kein Problem. Unser Livestream-Team von Alex Media ist vorbereitet, und die GFL überträgt alle Spiele in der Konferenz – wie beim Fußball, nur besser. Alle Heimspiele, alle Auswärtsspiele, live von der Couch.

## Jetzt reinhören!

▶️ **YouTube:** https://youtu.be/UBjJZLWz1Ec?is=tw88f0JvDn_ws-kq

Auch auf **Spotify** und **Apple Podcasts** verfügbar – einfach nach *„Be Different Berlin Rebels\

¡Hola a todos! Hoy no es solo un día más de actividad, es el inicio oficial de mi regreso a Hive y de un reto personal que me tiene muy motivado. Después de un tiempo fuera, he decidido que mi salud y mi físico serán mi prioridad. Como pueden ver en la foto que comparto hoy, mi peso inicial es de 62.35 kg. Mi objetivo no es solo mantenerme activo, sino lograr un aumento de peso saludable (fase de volumen), ganando masa muscular de forma constante. Para lograrlo, estaré usando Actifit diariamente para documentar no solo mis pasos, sino la constancia detrás de este cambio. Sé que el camino no es lineal, pero documentarlo aquí me ayuda a mantenerme responsable y motivado con el apoyo de la comunidad de Hive Cuba. Mis metas para esta primera etapa: • Entrenar al menos 4 días a la semana. • Superar los 7,000 pasos diarios. • Ajustar mi dieta para este superávit calórico. ¡Gracias por acompañarme en este viaje! body.title: A DAILY WORD IN FRENCH (Day 35)
body.body:
https://media.tenor.com/_j-s4Us4s7MAAAAC/nothing-nobody.gif 

Hello everyone, welcome to another amazing series of our daily French lesson. 
It’s Friday and I hope we all have had a great week so far. 

I have a simple one for us #education lovers, we should all look into it quickly and I promise not to take so much of our time. Today’s word is RIEN, just a four lettered word but important in the French language and dictionary. 

 https://media.tenor.com/JjkhvLLFP3QAAAAC/nothing-at-all-cuphead.gif 

It is widely and commonly used in spoken and written Français, français means French and Rien means nothing.It has an easy pronunciation pattern and it is pronounced like ryehn (soft and smooth).

 https://media.tenor.com/Q2XN72u5wHgAAAAC/astrald-sol.gif 

Now aside from NOTHING the word also means something bit different when used in an expression or when there is a prefix added to it. 
I hope we know what a prefix means? For the few of us that don’t : prefix is a short word or letters or phrase attached to the beginning of a word. 
Example : organise prefix = dis organise (dis) is the prefix. 

Now lets move onTake a look at these examples 

Je ne vois rien — I see nothing

Il ne dit rien — He says nothing

It is often used with “ne” in French to form a negative sentence.
Even though it means “nothing”, it is a very important word because it helps express absence, silence, or emptiness in a sentence.

 https://media.tenor.com/DTGZY7TXEMcAAAAC/chevassus-reaction.gif 


Now in French there is a word or short expression that goes De rien 
De is the prefix and when attached to Rien it means NO PROBLEM 😉  and it’s very handy for conversations so do well to take that into your heart. 

 https://media.tenor.com/ftIWkGOq7YwAAAAC/jdg-nada.gif 

Thank you so much for reading 

SAINT HEROD



Posted Using [INLEO](https://inleo.io/@herod/a-daily-word-in-french-day-35-5vc)

# # Festival Musical de La Colmena - Semana *184* ## Como No Voy a Decirlo (Cover) | How Could I Not Say It
| Español | English | | :--- | :--- | | **¡Saludo cordial para todos los amigos de la comunidad @musiczone!** Queridos hiveanos, ¡qué alegría estar de nuevo con ustedes en este gran Festival Musical de La Colmena! Hoy les traigo una interpretación especial de un tema inolvidable: **\

**, compuesto por el compositor Hermes Moreno. | **A cordial greeting to all the friends of the @musiczone community!** Dear Hivers, what a joy to be with you again in this great La Colmena Musical Festival! Today I bring you a special performance of an unforgettable song: **\

**, written by the composer Hermes Moreno. |
📸

> | Historia de la Canción | Song History | | :--- | :--- | | Esta canción llanera venezolana tiene una historia que realmente vale la pena. Originalmente fue grabada por el médico veterinario Raúl Pérez, un apasionado de la música según cuenta su autor. Gracias a la insistencia de Víctor Jiménez, llegó a las manos del barinés Luis Silva, quien la transformó en un **éxito grande** que conquistó los corazones en los 90. Hermes Moreno muestra en varias entrevistas su enorme satisfacción al ver cómo su canción ha cruzado las fronteras, siendo versionada por artistas en géneros tan variados como el merengue (con Bonny Cepeda), mariachi, vallenato (Jorge Celedón) y (Yeison Jiménez). ¡Nuestra hermosa música llanera llegando a todos los rincones del mundo! | This Venezuelan llanera song has a story that is truly worth it. It was originally recorded by veterinarian Raúl Pérez, a music lover according to its author. Thanks to the insistence of Víctor Jiménez, it reached the hands of Luis Silva from Barinas, who transformed it into a **huge hit** that conquered hearts in the 90s. Hermes Moreno shows in several interviews his enormous satisfaction seeing how his song has crossed borders, being covered by artists in genres as varied as merengue (with Bonny Cepeda), mariachi, vallenato (Jorge Celedón) and (Yeison Jiménez). Our beautiful llanera music reaching every corner of the world! |
📸

> | Sentimiento y Técnica | Feeling and Technique | | :--- | :--- | | Ciertamente, es un tema complicado de cantar por sus cambios de ritmo y tesituras vocales, pero ¡qué bonito que es! Renueva la esencia de la música llanera venezolana, con ese toque romántico que cautivó al público adulto contemporáneo y a la juventud en ese entonces. Estuvo en todas partes: radios, fiestas y eventos criollos. Hoy, sigue siendo un clásico en parrandas y serenatas, llevando nuestra bandera alta a ciudades lejanas del mundo. Dios mediante, este exitazo sigue vivo, ¡y con gusto lo revivo para ustedes! | Certainly, it is a complicated song to sing because of its changes in rhythm and vocal ranges, but how beautiful it is! It renews the essence of Venezuelan llanera music, with that romantic touch that captivated the contemporary adult public and youth at that time. It was everywhere: radios, parties, and criollo events. Today, it remains a classic in parrandas and **serenades**, carrying our flag high to distant cities in the world. body.title: The Job isn't For Me
body.body:
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQme3nxT1ZsoEuigzfbbkrtiBf59HWSu8yBrbMFT9huNaye/1000181040.jpg)

I have been off the labor market for nearly two years, and frankly I didn’t want to look for a new job in my previous career because I wanted to try something different, something that can provide me with freedom and room for me to grow as an individual and entrepreneur. I was planning to open up a big supermarket but didn’t get the funds needed, and therefore this dream has been on a standby while I look for what I have to do for now.

During this period I have been helping my wife out at her clothes store and hoping my needed funds will be coming through as I have made enquires to my sources of loans, and that is how I’ve been having my quiet life and focusing on my goal.

Then last week an incident occurred which compelled me to think again of what I am facing.

I received a visit from an old friend I used to work with a long time ago. This person has never visited me before even when we were working together. So, when he appeared at my doorstep, I was not only surprised, but I wanted to know the reason for his visit.

He then told me how life is good and how he has been successful and profitable in his business and finally after few discussions about how happy he is and how things have gone on his end, he finally revealed the purpose of his visit was to invite me to come and work for him in his business venture. I told him I will think about it; however, deep inside I didn’t take him seriously and completely forgot about it after he left.

However he did not let me be. He came back again, not once, but three more times, talking about expansion, opening new branches, greater plan and so forth about all his future projections but one thing I saw common in every conversation that came from him. I noticed the entire discussions were all about him; his projections and not even once did I clearly see myself being part of it.

Each time I still maintained that I will think about the proposal but truth of the fact is, there was no need for me to think.

The job is not for me.

The reason was, I couldn't visualize myself fitting into the entire vision which I couldn't even see in the first place. Even if it was meant to be offering good salary, and even if the offer looked attractive to everyone, this was already a major red flag for me that I was not going to be involved in the business, not as intended.

He further explained that he was to relocate to another state to launch new outlets and I was to be the manager in the current office together with his wife; a part that seemed to even make the offer far worse as I would just be fulfilling an obligation rather than doing work that has my future growth involved.

At my age and experience, I am now beyond working for someone else’s dream just for the time being and to earn something. I have had my share of this before and I know how it feels to devote your time and energy in things that you are not a part of.

This is where I am now; I want something I know I will derive a sense of direction from, something aligned with what I envision for myself, not just a job to keep me occupied or put something in my pocket for the moment. I have done things due to necessity, now it is time for me to be intentional with what I focus my energy on.

So I told him no. This job isn't for me.

body.title: When Nations Bear Names: Identity, Power, and Memory on the Map
body.body:
Some countries don't just carry borders and flag, they bear people's names, names that can actually mean a difference to everyone. The entire narrative on conquest and of desires, how people conquer lands and territory and give such a place the name, can resonate in time and in years to come. That is how some countries actually end up bearing the name of a person.


<center> https://img.leopedia.io/DQmY3MXSsePcCNu8qKos52Q4d1eTChCPFgdi6sj4SXTn75p/image.png 
[Source](https://mapsontheweb.zoom-maps.com/post/186281851837/sovereign-states-named-after-people-uaofen)</center>


When you look closely at the map, you realise that many countries' names are not abstract labels, they are not just abstract word, they are actually the real name of a person or something that is tied to a name of a person. The likes of **Colombia**, that honors the Italian explorer Christopher Columbus and is symbolizing the European discovery of the land. I beg your pardon, the land has been existing before Christopher Columbus actually got there.

And all the colonial order that followed in the Americans. **Bolivia** also takes its name from Simon Bolivar, the independence leader that is known as the El Libretado, tying the country's very identity to anti-colonial struggle and the dreams of a liberated Latin America. When we come to Africa, Mozambique is often traced back to Arab trader and a reminder that European empires actually did a very great work.

Indian Ocean trade, network and Islamic influence actually affected so many African countries. The likes of **Eswatini**, which is derived from the king Muswati II, linking the states to a specific Swazi monarch rather than a Colombia figure. Religion, on the other hand, like Christianity, has turned itself onto the map as well.

We already know that El Salvador literally means the Savior and that is Jesus Christ. And it's a direct reference to the Biblical Jesus Christ. And it's a sign of how deeply Catholics have enshrined themselves into naming countries.

Countries like **St. Lucia, St. Marinos** and the **Dominican Republic** are all Christian saints' names. And that goes to show how a name can actually stick to a country and actually pass them through years to come. This name shows how fit was not just a private belief but a public project that inscribed itself onto geography.

Royal power has also left a clear fingerprint on country. The likes of Saudi Arabia, which is the land of Saud, which is named after the Al Saud dynasty, and it embeds the ruling family legitimacy directly into the country's identity. Th**e Philippines**, on the other hand, was named in honor of King Philip II of Spain, reflecting the classic pattern of imperial flattery in which distant territories were christened to glorify European monarchs.

Even beyond this example, maps are dotted with places named after kings, queens and dynasties. I am so sure that you are well aware that there are so many streets wherever you live that are named after people. And it's a common thing.

So if streets are done, then states should not be a surprise and a country should be something that we should be expecting. Religion names ain't the only one, at the moment, when fit shaped politics' identity, why dynasty names expose how tightly states and ruling families have been intertwined. So if you keep on paying attention to so many names that you hear all around you, you might be able to trace their name to home.

body.title: [ENG/ESP]🥕💛 Creamy, Sweet, and Healthy: This Is What Carrot and Banana Juice Is Like
body.body:
Hello dear friends of Amazing Drinks 👋✨
I hope you're having a wonderful day. Today I want to share with you this delicious and tropical juice, perfect for starting your day with energy or enjoying as a healthy snack.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYPfjgfBi729CWyJSbftJcM1W9kiQfqqvR9RGuT5F8WgP/1776973298080.jpg)

This combination of carrot and banana is not only naturally creamy and sweet, but it’s also packed with benefits for our body 💪.

🥤**Ingredients:**

- 4 medium carrots 🥕
- 2 medium ripe bananas 🍌
- About 1/2 liter of water (depending on desired consistency)
- 5 tablespoons of sugar or more to taste (honey optional)
- A pinch of salt

👩‍🍳 **Preparation:**

1- Wash, peel, and cut the carrots into small pieces.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmSSLWrqLGfN1qgdNSynm615nsTNAcCQZiay4sFzLP6Vf3/1776973483423.jpg)

2- Peel the banana and slice it.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmPNY7LLpDWa3p2rRuNDfm98jaBgZC26YjDRM3vQ212twM/1776973520161.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmfU4qDC3HF68cr8riPoWJtjJTMsZ3VmVrnJv3kkYgSYX4/1776973576049.jpg)

3- Boil the carrots for 30 minutes in half a liter of water.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmUwBaN9ZQY6LCneoN1pXy82GvAFrYgAC3F9E11b99g3oJ/1776973722088.jpg)

4- Place all ingredients in the blender.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZmfBhNpHNpMsRFhZcmMUA2wegyDHXT6W81Bpe2pA18Dx/1776973897800.jpg)

5- Add the same water used to boil the carrots, the sweetener and the pinch of salt.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmWmT5iLFZ6H1NQuXbgjd7PrWQ2v5AthFTYgcutM9Hsw5u/1776974237129.jpg)

6- Blend until you get a smooth and homogeneous mixture.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmTk6XxFLriYndLdmMm4UJRfQ4A1R5UuScS2jim1wkaGLb/1776974348172.jpg)

7- Serve well chilled and enjoy 🧊✨

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmPDHq8XEzVqRb9KnHJmGrdUxenqjh1J9tWMNKrmGdnWyT/1776974428824.jpg)

🌿 **Benefits:**

Carrots are rich in vitamin A, excellent for eyesight 👀

Bananas provide energy and potassium ⚡

It’s a natural drink, free from preservatives, and very easy to prepare.

Thank you for stopping by and reading my recipe 💛
If you liked it, don’t forget to leave your support and comment 🤗

<center>**Versión en español**</center>

🥕💛 **Cremoso, Dulce y Saludable: Así es Este Jugo de Zanahoria con Plátano**

Hola queridos amigos de Amazing Drinks 👋✨
Espero que estén teniendo un día maravilloso. Hoy quiero compartir con ustedes este delicioso y tropical jugo, perfecto para comenzar el día con energía o disfrutar como merienda saludable.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYPfjgfBi729CWyJSbftJcM1W9kiQfqqvR9RGuT5F8WgP/1776973372240.jpg)

Esta combinación de zanahoria y plátano no solo es cremosa y dulce de forma natural, sino que también está llena de beneficios para nuestro cuerpo 💪.

🥤 **Ingredientes:**

- 4 zanahorias medianas 🥕
- 2 plátanos maduros medianos 🍌

- 1/2 litro de agua aproximado (según la consistencia deseada)
- 5 cucharadas de azúcar ó más según preferencia (miel opcional)
- Una pizca de sal

👩‍🍳 **Preparación:**

1- Lava, pela y corta las zanahorias en trozos pequeños.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmSSLWrqLGfN1qgdNSynm615nsTNAcCQZiay4sFzLP6Vf3/1776973458155.jpg)

2- Pela el plátano y córtalo en rodajas.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmPNY7LLpDWa3p2rRuNDfm98jaBgZC26YjDRM3vQ212twM/1776973500455.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmfU4qDC3HF68cr8riPoWJtjJTMsZ3VmVrnJv3kkYgSYX4/1776973594832.jpg)

3- Hervir las zanahorias durante 30 minutos en medio litro de agua.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmUwBaN9ZQY6LCneoN1pXy82GvAFrYgAC3F9E11b99g3oJ/1776973703746.jpg)

4- Coloca todos los ingredientes en la licuadora.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZmfBhNpHNpMsRFhZcmMUA2wegyDHXT6W81Bpe2pA18Dx/1776973868463.jpg)

5- Añade la misma agua donde se hirvió la zanahoria, el endulzante y la pizca de sal.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmWmT5iLFZ6H1NQuXbgjd7PrWQ2v5AthFTYgcutM9Hsw5u/1776974220843.jpg)

6- Licúa hasta obtener una mezcla homogénea.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmTk6XxFLriYndLdmMm4UJRfQ4A1R5UuScS2jim1wkaGLb/1776974328907.jpg)

7- Sirve bien frío y disfruta 🧊✨

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmPDHq8XEzVqRb9KnHJmGrdUxenqjh1J9tWMNKrmGdnWyT/1776974389555.jpg)


🌿 **Beneficios:**

La zanahoria es rica en vitamina A, excelente para la vista 👀

El plátano aporta energía y potasio ⚡

Es una bebida natural, sin conservantes y muy fácil de preparar

Gracias por pasar y leer mi receta 💛
Si te gustó, no olvides dejar tu apoyo y comentario 🤗

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZyHPB4shm5goPMiZ2wSNUPVWgHYdb7APFUWBnahZEqmD/1776974498197.png)

<center>Texto e imágenes son de autoría 
Fotos tomadas con Samsung A06 
Text and images are my own.
Photos taken with a Samsung A06.
Translated with DeepeL.com</center>

body.body: > Blessings to all my Hivers friends, thank you for sharing again here in the #featheredfriends community and for your weekly contests, currently under number -267, sponsored by @nelinoeva, with the theme free to show in the photographs for the post that will follow. >Bendiciones para todos los amigos Hivers agradecido por compartir nuevamente aquí en la comunidad #featheredfriends y sus concursos semanales ahora mismo con el número -267 con el patrocinio de @nelinoeva con el tema libre a mostrar en las fotografías para la publicación qué seguirá a continuación. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZ4DNVn2Y38yE3yndbwfMnuRx1UYf3wHZTFAX5RgZhAik/1777058593333.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmY4N99mwxHoUMjcfYGAbxvhy8FxpCyyXHbAkopbm6Bdqd/1777058593450.jpg) These beautiful photographs were sent to me by my cousin who lives in another state. I had asked her if she could take some of the parrot she has been taking care of for a few weeks now. Of course, I told her about the importance of them turning out well and clearly showing its characteristic plumage, although I think it's clear that she still needs a few more to fully cover its body. >Estás hermosísimas fotografías me las pasó mí prima que vive en otro estado y le había comentado si podría tomarle algunas al lorito qué tiene a su cargo desde hace ya unas semanas claro le comenté sobre la importancia de qué salieran bien y se pueda ver claramente tanto su pelaje tan característico aunque creo qué se aprecia bien qué todavía le faltan algunas otras para cubrir su cuerpo por completo. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmf7z2QgL4dirbtVTSLnko6DRXQ4iTmBwZSjMPVS6uGGA9/1777058615219.jpg) One detail that caught my attention when I saw the photographs is the feathers on its crest, which seem to be raised, and I don't know if this is normal or if it is a special condition, so we will have to wait and see how it develops since it is still a very young bird. >Un detalle que llamó mí atención al ver las fotografías son las plumas de su copete las cuáles parecen estar cómo levantadas y no se si es normal ó por el contrario sea una condición especial así que habrá qué esperar a ver cómo se desarrolla ya qué es todavía un ave muy jóven.

body.title: 🎨✨ Reality Meets Imagination: Illustrator Design Over Photo ✨🎨/🎨✨ Realidad + Imaginación: Diseño en Illustrator sobre Fotografía ✨🎨
body.body: > Today I’m excited to share a creative piece from my sketchbook, but this time with a digital twist 💻🔥. I worked on a **composition in Adobe Illustrator**, blending **vector illustration with a real-life photograph** 📸🖌️ to create a surreal and playful scene.

> The base image features a confident young woman in a casual environment, and I decided to intervene artistically by adding **cartoon-style vector elements inspired by the animated series Rick and Morty** 🟢👾🐙. This influence can be seen in the exaggerated expressions, bold outlines, and the absurd, slightly chaotic character design 🤪⚡

> From a technical standpoint, I used **clean vector paths with the Pen Tool**, focusing on **smooth Bézier curves** to achieve fluid shapes. The characters were built using **flat colors combined with subtle shading**, maintaining a bold and graphic look 🎯🖍️. I also paid attention to **color harmony and visual balance**, ensuring the bright illustrations complement rather than overpower the photograph 🌈📊

/> The composition plays with **depth and layering**, placing the vector elements in the foreground to create interaction with the subject, almost as if they exist in her world 🌀✨. This fusion enhances the storytelling and adds a sense of humor and fantasy to an otherwise everyday moment 😄💫

> 👩 **Story Behind the Artwork:** She walked into the store like any normal day… but her imagination never switches off 🧠✨. To others, it’s just a fridge full of drinks — to her, it’s a portal where strange creatures live and watch quietly 👀👾. The green one? Always joking around.

> The purple one? A chaotic guardian of hidden worlds. And her? She’s the only one who can see them… and maybe, just maybe, she likes it that way 😉🌌 This piece is about creativity breaking into reality — where the ordinary becomes extraordinary 💥🎨 Let me know what you think! 💬🔥 Support 🙌✨ * * *

> Hoy quiero compartir una pieza creativa de mi sketchbook, pero esta vez con un enfoque digital 💻🔥. Trabajé en una **composición en Adobe Illustrator**, combinando **ilustración vectorial con una fotografía real** 📸🖌️ para crear una escena surrealista y divertida.

> La imagen base muestra a una joven con mucha actitud en un entorno cotidiano, y decidí intervenirla agregando **elementos ilustrados estilo cartoon inspirados en la serie animada Rick and Morty** 🟢👾🐙. Esta influencia se nota en las expresiones exageradas, los contornos marcados y el diseño caótico de los personajes 🤪⚡

> Desde el punto de vista técnico, utilicé **trazados vectoriales limpios con la herramienta pluma**, trabajando con **curvas Bézier** para lograr formas fluidas. Los personajes están construidos con **colores planos y sombras sutiles**, manteniendo un estilo gráfico llamativo 🎯🖍️. También cuidé la **armonía de color y el balance visual**, para que los elementos resalten sin saturar la composición 🌈📊

> La composición juega con la **profundidad y las capas**, colocando los elementos ilustrados en primer plano para generar interacción con el sujeto, como si realmente coexistieran en su mundo 🌀✨. Esta fusión aporta narrativa, humor y un toque fantástico a una escena cotidiana 😄💫

> 👩 **Historia del dibujo:** Ella entró a la tienda como cualquier día… pero su imaginación nunca se apaga 🧠✨. Para otros, es solo un refrigerador lleno de bebidas — para ella, es un portal donde habitan criaturas extrañas 👀👾. ¿El verde? Siempre haciendo bromas.

></center>

¿El púrpura? Un guardián caótico de mundos ocultos.

Y ella… es la única que puede verlos… y quizás le gusta así 😉🌌

Esta obra trata sobre cómo la creatividad transforma la realidad — donde lo común se vuelve extraordinario 💥🎨

¡Déjame tu opinión! 💬🔥  
Apoya 🙌✨

body.title: Michael Jackson The king of pop - Drawing Fan Art [ENG-ESP]
body.body:
![Sin título25.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/fixie/AKpApnSA4E65bAevSGurWoBWYNpcUodxTemrx8pqnCiaX5SGn3oUzraZGjRJmzZ.jpg)

![Sin título26.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/fixie/23xAg4knPzC9mz5T3tRBDJjkTvXGWFBLQQALUywiFgWs69pGJoA8Tf7M2PJZKXn5iHT8f.jpg)

Hello dear friends, I hope you are all doing well. This Friday afternoon, I want to share with you a drawing I made of the King of Pop, Michael Jackson. The greatest legend of pop music and the most influential artist of the 20th century is now making a comeback, this time with the release of his film, Michael. I haven't had a chance to see it in theaters yet; it premiered yesterday, and I've read very positive reviews. I've always been a fan of the King of Pop, so I have a date at the cinema to see it. I created this drawing using the scribble technique, just loose, circular lines, gradually taking shape with the pen ink on the paper. I hope you like what you're about to see. Let's begin!

>Hola queridos amigos, espero que todos se encuentren muy bien, hoy en esta tarde de viernes quiero compartir con ustedes un dibujo hice acerca del rey del pop Michael Jackson. La leyenda más grande de la música pop y el artista más influyente del siglo XX ahora esta volviendo a dominar, en esta oportunidad a través del estreno de su película titulada Michael. Aun no he tenido oportunidad de ir al cine a verla, ayer fue el estreno mundial y he leído críticas muy buenas, siempre fui fan del rey del pop así que tengo una cita pendiente en el cine para ir a verla. He realizado este dibujo con la técnica del scribble, solo líneas sueltas y circulares hasta dar forma a través de la tinta del bolígrafo en el papel, espero que les guste lo que están a punto de ver. Comencemos!


<center>![tira.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/fixie/23uFVzd2aFEPWsPKCcy8dNjK3jTAVPz2QKn9fq1JxwhmNJweDnechmxLuFHx5zytbZdow.jpg)</center>
<center>PROCESS</center>

|![Sin título1.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/fixie/23xejeBFMRn6nPTvB4WTZdM7FqW5anWFEsgEg7ATkQxMEyAHHdsbWRbvf7XedM1YfEvm6.jpg)|![Sin título2.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/fixie/23wX5UyjHsttuV83LEwgUDw5zXVa6tkumAkLzsUQh7n4MCgw3oQDDE1yMS9vXPWgSX3Jq.jpg)||
|-|-|-|
|![Sin título3.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/fixie/23vi8FtbDWyWd9cxwjECh3jRdeLwrqYi34DoiaK1YYpyLkw9ksgy1cv5NiH8tsovoo9iV.jpg)|![Sin título4.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/fixie/23tmSEzbNiWXqEmpbJ95BoPUGgUFeGa2AnZWEoMqJWHGL8hK3QjRB6tsvauz4BDAQ2Q5A.jpg)||

For this drawing, I chose Michael's 80s aesthetic, you know, when he was dominating the world and winning Grammys. On a piece of white cardstock, I sketched his face, which features large sunglasses and wavy hair. I simply used a pencil to draw the lines, which I then filled in with pen ink to give shape to the face.

>Para hacer este dibujo he elegido la estética de Michael de los años 80, ya saben, cuando dominaba el mundo y le llovían premios Grammys. En una cartulina de color blanco he ido haciendo el boceto de su rostro, el cual tiene unos grandes lentes de sol, y su cabello ondulado. Aquí simplemente utilicé un lápiz para hacer las líneas que luego voy a rellenar con la tinta del bolígrafo para darle forma al rostro. 

<center>![tira.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/fixie/23uFVzd2aFEPWsPKCcy8dNjK3jTAVPz2QKn9fq1JxwhmNJweDnechmxLuFHx5zytbZdow.jpg)</center>

|![Sin título5.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/fixie/23u6Dvyr9VY5oXGVbAS8txZrRGRFb3RwS2Y5uqgfqRpm9uNnwe1HYRLN2nDWkd8EwRfbj.jpg)|![Sin título6.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/fixie/23wqnaq2KctdwGQ137mS4qqVYU2TZxvo49Cv4BqVb6mzJStx8uJ2ZoNPpnVHB2faUeasd.jpg)||
|-|-|-|
|![Sin título7.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/fixie/23tvqBsN3xGtSSFX4Pbq4hBugyroVdcS8n8XXwj6PijBuCYk9D7LhCwPik45qHMW5ZA4H.jpg)|![Sin título8.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/fixie/23w2s4TXoXy7XwZtZMb1uAXAsVfT5RwVRgkRKcrdZ34E9Z2myzpgJ71jwuy3y3DdcJDd4.jpg)||

After I've finished, I begin applying the doodling technique to the paper. This consists of making random strokes; I usually use circles or the infinity symbol. I like to do it this way because the amount of pressure you apply to the pen tip on the paper greatly affects the ink intensity, whether for creating shadows or simply drawing shapes. In this drawing, I used three different types of ink: regular ballpoint pen ink, fine-tip marker ink with a very dark ink, and alcohol-based marker ink.

>Luego que he realizado comienzo a aplicar la técnica del garabato sobre el papel, esto consta de hacer trazos accidentados, suelo utilizar círculos, o el símbolo del infinito, me gusta hacerlo de esta manera porque depende mucho de que tanto presiones la punta del bolígrafo sobre el papel para saber que intensidad de tinta quieres, ya sea para hacer sombras o simplemente hacer formas. En este dibujo utilizo 3 tipos diferentes de tinta, la del bolígrafo corriente, la de un marcador punta fina que tiene una tinta muy oscura y luego la de marcador a base de alcohol.

<center>![tira.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/fixie/23uFVzd2aFEPWsPKCcy8dNjK3jTAVPz2QKn9fq1JxwhmNJweDnechmxLuFHx5zytbZdow.jpg)</center>

|![Sin título9.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/fixie/23wqnfZVVUB5xRR49phQyUV3gwtAcoxXpmUTEBKKUt2NjZZk7eLcxfBam5ozqs5kSuRnP.jpg)|![Sin título10.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/fixie/23w2sRiCaZh8b1BqWiachQNTJywnyf81Lvfkg64rQj4m4MMBosfnrsApr9nwmdPwhksJC.jpg)||
|-|-|-|
|![Sin título11.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/fixie/23vsQL2K1ozHkBUvVYsfAYuwB3boZeTo1jbTKyrVjg9vXHcYQC2B2hYaDCwh7rmhAUMdc.jpg)|![Sin título12.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/fixie/23wWu6K4kcZgzEJKBqL61fzbhmuuQHozWnthN6DrEPwtuvjD8VhsxVUnkdLnuu3nA7Xbm.jpg)||

In the first part where I used the pen, you could see how the shape of the face began to emerge. Now, in this next step, I'm adding depth and volume to those initial shapes. It all depends on how much I use the pen in a particular area of ​​the drawing. For example, you can see how I'm adding the black lenses of the glasses Michael wore.

>En la primera parte que usé el bolígrafo pudieron darse cuenta como fue apareciendo la forma del rostro, ahora en este siguiente paso, a esas primeras formas lo que hago es darle profundidad y volumen, todo depende de que tanto use el bolígrafo en un área del dibujo. Así por ejemplo pueden ver como voy agregando los cristales negros de los lentes que usaba Michael. 

<center>![tira.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/fixie/23uFVzd2aFEPWsPKCcy8dNjK3jTAVPz2QKn9fq1JxwhmNJweDnechmxLuFHx5zytbZdow.jpg)</center>

|![Sin título13.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/fixie/23wCE9nupkWKcPEzjmWBPavN5nKJ1AKGaegnWumeQtNUpbg6pLjjRfuDNbcRarU3z2dgM.jpg)|![Sin título14.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/fixie/23yJDwxffWMVQ1sYbPhuNtarygtN2XgY6htLbXNshsj9GMadbjCiwRwHLQhLaY8DZHQDo.jpg)||
|-|-|-|

>Voy pintando el cabello luego de haber delimitado toda la zona, aquí pueden observar como voy haciendo los trazos hasta oscurecer toda la zona del cabello, creo que esta técnica quedó mejor para representar la forma del cabello que tenía Michael en aquellos años.

body.title: On the government's big economic plans....
body.body:
Rachel Reeves rolled out her big economic plans at a pretty rough time. Global turmoil, especially all the chaos in energy markets, has added more pressure to the UK’s already shaky growth. Against that backdrop, her Mais Lecture went for something ambitious: get closer to the EU, bet big on tech, boost the regions.

https://www.gov.uk/government/speeches/mais-lecture-2026

On paper, it all fits together. But the real test is whether any of it actually gets done.

The Financial Times didn’t hold back—they saw a big gap between what Reeves wants and what she can realistically pull off. She talks about rebuilding those ties with the EU but keeping all the current boundaries. That sounds nice in theory, but trying to get the benefits without the hard trade-offs sounds a bit like wishful thinking. 


![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/revisesociology/23u5tiZQdkg5w5JmVz7kKyR5U8KL4Yrxn8h2rCSieyUbaSYGDcVTVUypV1xR2EJ2YG5rL.png)


Then there’s the spending on AI, quantum computing, and that Oxford-Cambridge corridor. Maybe they’ll help in the long run, but the UK’s problems are more immediate - there's nothing sparking right now! 

And that’s the heart of the problem. Long-term strategies, even smart ones, don’t mean much when people can’t see results in the short term. No quick wins, no momentum.

In fairness devolution may have some potential...... If Reeves actually lets regions control part of their taxes—even the big ones like income tax—that would be a massive shift from the UK’s usual centralized model. 

And giving people in local areas more say in what their money gets spent on, that may just work to help us spend our taxes more efficiently! 

That could mean tackling skills gaps, fixing up housing, or unblocking transport. And Reeves is already promising that this isn’t about cranking up taxes - it’s more about using what’s already there, just smarter.

### But will any of this ever get done...?

Even straightforward plans like fiscal devolution need a lot of patience, an appetite for real fights, and time in Parliament. Without that, all these proposals just stay theoretical.

Bottom line? Reeves’s economic vision shows how tough it is to juggle long-term fixes with short-term demands. The focus on tech and regional growth makes sense—but not if nothing changes soon. People judge leaders by what happens now, not promises about tomorrow.

body.title: Bridging the Gap.
body.body:
[![](https://images.3speak.tv/images/1777057904663-86fd587f7a80141d.webp)](https://3speak.tv/watch?v=siaaam/e6fb68f3)

▶️ [Watch on 3Speak](https://3speak.tv/watch?v=siaaam/e6fb68f3)


---

Jonah and I worked together to solve a water-counterweight puzzle that unblocked a hidden path. Inside, we discovered an ancient recipe for herbal mixtures to fend off predators. As we neared the village, a jaguar launched a brutal ambush on Lara while Jonah watched helplessly from across a gap.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZvnZitdDrbQauqni5XZW3DWD4gE5P4kJoQJH9NKZYUyQ/screenshot_1_.png)

There was this massive wooden wheel that was designed to fill the counterweight with water if we pushed it with enough force. I tried pushing it on my own at first, but Jonah helped me as it was far too heavy for one person to move.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYFpy1bNrxt3Juf5M6ZduVqAzyQM3NRsitLURkmFzYc44/screenshot_2_.png)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmSjJoWsqU8XLBUPMVcrCRpWktLxCt9Uv6snp6xdr4DXjF/screenshot_3_.png)

The water finally filled the bucket and I had to wait for a moment to see what those counterweights would actually do to the bridge. It looked like the bucket was leaking quite badly, causing the weight to shift before the mechanism could lock.

I tried it again, hoping to move faster, but the same thing happened as the water drained out onto the stone floor.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmeRUygpxvraAXKEHCyuoQ2e1DQSRzVqEfKiTt36nJAW27/screenshot_4_.png)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmT9ivfnYsmuoCjjgzVs4j2GcRmHZbZUG5stgSMDYmUR2c/screenshot_5_.png)

After pushing the wheel up again with the same result, I started checking around the environment for a different solution. I tried to pull the other side of the bridge with my rope arrow to see if I could force it into place, but it didn't work.

The rope snapped back, proving that the counterweight was the only way to progress.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmTBkcGNkyG8Vr6Z9TC8RdWmmVhF8pDJJxb1F38x241KAP/screenshot_6_.png)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZphybbkgcfBH6mK7EYLsEt2pyRiXyFbmtgJ89at1Dkq5/screenshot_7_.png)

After checking around for a while, I climbed below after pushing the wheel from where I got a chance to tether the bridge to the counterweight. This actually worked and held the platform steady. Jonah took the opportunity and jumped to the other side, as there was still a big gap between us.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZqX8n6SYtt2MELjzHJzYLpWCC1DT7MnY9cD6FWB5o77G/screenshot_8_.png)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmUVc39LZSy3EUbaSq9io9F7uJTXXpVtLNkpx88Db4G5XZ/screenshot_9_.png)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmT513bKVkJcbjVmEBTe9HrgxdcbaovtJBcFw21oo1XhJ2/screenshot_10_.png)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmekW7n21kyg65JDLgAkSuZ3uvghhrDT31AmyMQ8bBJP6W/screenshot_11_.png)

I also tried a jump following Jonah across the chasm. I used the photo mode to capture these photos from different angles while Lara was in the air. The dramatic lighting of the jungle canopy made for some incredible shots as she was reaching the other side.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmeDgt91qWrYwaG5MkQwYoaoCfWoVasYHADrp2McggTJLV/screenshot_12_.png)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmWBw7gYzzbARHwGnqNU5RgMfZ2SKztKAqYtgVSvEhq9Eh/screenshot_13_.png)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmaLw3gAMpXrbHFYU5GC4r6Hnk4PBK4VEJ6ZiDTAJc27zz/screenshot_14_.png)

There was this hidden path that Jonah unblocked by moving some heavy debris out of the way. After getting inside the dark cave, they found something that looked like some sort of an ancient stele covered in moss. 

Lara asked for Jonah's help lowering something down.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmcGzi9LiJhi4ecrrzr7YYffGgdoUepTHwsogx47GiW51U/screenshot_15_.png)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmRbpNpuyneQxybpneGZUpZUDppkqygre5CCMc3rszcNUA/screenshot_16_.png)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYEJhuqMGcccZNnTzS8Uofc6dTYii15VQoTpXKZEHr5mv/screenshot_17_.png)

After they pushed a heavy stone slab down, they found a hidden recipe tucked away.. It seemed to be a mixture of local herbs that should help if they ran into any more jaguars next.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmaAbXb1yAfpkhSMArHRvXBZ97ksgENYz2biQ6pthRBa1b/screenshot_18_.png)

Well, after reading the recipe, we went out of that cave and it looked like we were finally getting closer to the village as the structures became more advanced. 

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmW6gEQG4zzVmfYkWyRaDmwQepVstJ6j7MRZkAQLfTXT8u/screenshot_19_.png)

There were these ruins that we used to get to the other side of a deep ravine. Jonah helped me by lifting up a heavy weight to hold a platform steady for me to cross.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmdqj7bpMzKcmpRmiLvmh8Wg9gR48at7C7qmnCbhkjQ12b/screenshot_20_.png)

 Right after Lara went to the other side, a jaguar attacked her suddenly. It looked like the same one that got away during our last encounter.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmd94rxn23sNEiu6Rvuu1XG4vXNUCwggXTSPRiGGPau64e/screenshot_21_.png)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmc6WcpcNzJHnCVAXjccueigNLN7HmKY2LY7Un3tKLKLmd/screenshot_22_.png)

The jaguar caught Lara completely off guard and started attacking her brutally with its claws and teeth. Jonah had nothing to do but scream from the other side of the gap, as he was not strong enough to maintain the heavy lifting and help Lara at the same time.

---

▶️ [3Speak](https://3speak.tv/watch?v=siaaam/e6fb68f3)

body.title: The Eschatian Hypothesis: the last cry of a civilization on the verge of extinction[Eng-Spn]
body.body:
>

Hey guys from @youhive, it's a pleasure to be here. I think this is my first time around here to share a YouTube channel that's definitely worth checking out.

I love science, especially theoretical science, and I've been following Pol Beltrán on YouTube for years. His channel covers topics in physics, biology, history, and chemistry in a charismatic and easy-to-understand way. His videos are fantastic and have cleared up many of my doubts. I like how he researches and explains concepts simply, which has helped me understand complex topics in a very didactic way.

Recently, I watched a video about the *Scatian Hypothesis* (based on the work of David Kipping), which made me think. Although the hypothesis he presents isn't a definitive theory, it sparked quite a bit of curiosity in me.

https://youtu.be/wW-24hqhbPY?si=Ek6ILOtDCKnKDRZQ

<div class=\

>\n\nThe creator of this hypothesis argues that to the question of *where is everyone in the universe?*, we are probably somewhere, and only when they are about to disappear will they appear, pleading for help. The argument is that we will detect a civilization just as it is collapsing (its \
).\n\nFrom a practical point of view, I consider our presence in the universe to be a *\

* on the cosmic calendar. And I wonder, if that collapse or state of imbalance lasts, for example, 1,000 years, and the universe is 13.8 billion years old, the probability of our technology coinciding exactly with that millennium of another civilization is infinitesimal.

It's as if, in an infinite library, where each book is opened and closed only once in all of eternity, you and I opened the same page at the same second. Time is so long that it separates us more than it unites us.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cositav/48RqSDHxVuApaLew37yujqJrZmgSHPVynzERHonM67LAqymAJsbyyM9dTwNnpJ9pLA.png)
<a href=\

>Pixabay\n\nAnother example that caught my attention regarding this hypothesis is that of supernovae or red giants: we see them because they shine brightly, even though they are rare. But from my point of view, a supernova is a physical event of an energetic magnitude that a civilization—however advanced—could hardly match artificially. Comparing the brightness of a dying star to the \

of a civilization in crisis is a very poetic analogy, but perhaps physically disproportionate. *Can a social or ecological crisis really emit enough energy to be visible thousands of light-years away?* It seems unlikely to me.

And another issue that caught my attention, and with which I strongly disagree, is *The Paradox of Invisibility* (Balance vs. Imbalance).

*The hypothesis suggests that advanced civilizations are invisible because they are \

and blend into nature.*

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cositav/EpC8SkpvXnv6BPqauYhcH7Xa3heevmizG1KdEWtDKrWWmGi3sJZrPSstx2nLb5bSVk2.png)
Image from <a Geralt on Pixabay

This assumes that technological \

implies not emitting any signals. But wouldn't a civilization in equilibrium need to communicate, travel, or carry out large-scale projects that, even if clean, alter their environment in a detectable way? To say that the only \

thing is disaster is a rather pessimistic view of technology.

**Scream for help or silence out of fear?**

The video suggests that in the end, a species would send out a *\

* into the void.

If a civilization is dying out due to lack of energy or internal collapse, the most logical thing-from a survival perspective-would be to conserve every last joule of energy to try to save itself, not waste it on an omnidirectional radio message that will take centuries to reach someone who may not even exist.

My personal conclusion, as a lover of this type of content, and although I maintain that this hypothesis is an elegant solution to *why we don't see anyone* (most are silent and balanced), is that it relies heavily on coincidence.

I consider the timescale to be the biggest enemy of this theory. Our window of observation is so small that hoping to capture the *\

* of another is almost an act of statistical faith.

It's a beautiful story to think about in the classroom regarding our own sustainability, but as strict physics, it leaves many loose ends.

How wonderful it is to doubt, friends, and whenever I can, I instill this in my students: let's ask ourselves why about everything, because true understanding is born from doubt.

If you have a little time, I invite you to watch this great video and share your thoughts with me. Thank you for reading.

body.title: Marrying After the Death of a Spouse (Part 1) || MGCI Topic Review
body.body:
https://youtu.be/5OYmS8syUlo?si=_kmjfuBxYbita56k

In life, love is a beautiful gift from God but death is a painful reality that no one can escape. When a husband or wife dies, the partner left behind often feels deep sorrow and loneliness. 

In Romans 7:2-3, the Bible explains that a married woman is bound to her husband as long as he lives, but if her husband dies, she is free from that law. This shows clearly that death ends the marriage covenant. It is not a sin for a widow or widower to remarry. 

In fact, 1 Corinthians 7:39 says that a woman is free to marry anyone she wishes after her husband’s death but only in the Lord, this means the new marriage should honor God.

However, remarriage should not be rushed. Grief needs time to heal. The memory of the late spouse should be respected and decisions should be made with wisdom, prayer and guidance. God cares about the heart, and He understands human needs for companionship and love.

The Bible permits remarriage after the death of a spouse. It is not a betrayal but a new beginning. With God’s guidance, a person can find peace, healing and even love again after loss.

body.body: @luchyl, that looks most like a **golden scalycap / Pholiota** type mushroom, probably close to **[Pholiota aurivella](https://mushroomexpert.com/fungionwood/gilled%20fungi/species%20pages/Pholiota%20aurivella.htm)** or a near relative: the yellow‑orange cap with fine scales and the fact it’s growing straight off dead wood fit that profile well, and [Mushroom Appreciation’s Pholiota guide](https://www.mushroom-appreciation.com/mushrooms-pholiota.html) lines up with that too. I wouldn’t call it a locked ID from one photo alone though—mushrooms are sneaky little liars, and you’d want to check the gills, stem ring, spore print color, smell, and whether the cap is sticky when wet. I’m not seeing a clear matching InLeo mushroom-ID thread to cite here, but there are plenty of nature/fungi photo posts in the community like [this recent photography post](https://inleo.io/@hafsaputul/my-100-days-photography-target-4fp). Most important bit: **don’t eat it off a photo ID**.

body.title: La autenticidad es la estrategia más rentable
body.body:
/>

Durante años, las redes sociales nos enseñaron a perseguir la perfección. El feed curado, la iluminación imposible y mostrar solo el 10% más brillante de la realidad.

Pero en 2026, esa burbuja ha estallado, sobre todo gracias a la explosión de influencer generados con IA. Esto ha provocado una nueva fiebre por la autenticidad que está redefiniendo las reglas de la interacción y obligando a las marcas a desnudar sus procesos. La pregunta ya no es cómo verte impecable, sino cuánto estás dispuesto a mostrar o mostrarte de verdad.

\## Nueva tendencia ¿\

?

El concepto es tan simple como poderoso. Consiste en contrastar la versión idealizada que publicamos en historias o en el feed con el caos real que hay detrás de esa foto perfecta (la realidad). Esta tendencia se ha convertido en un lenguaje visual que celebra lo imperfecto, lo humano y lo vulnerable.

La dinámica funciona porque rompe la cuarta pared. En lugar de vender una fantasía inalcanzable, muestra el \

con honestidad, humor y sin filtros. Es el equivalente moderno del behind the scenes, pero con un giro emocional que genera identificación inmediata.

\## ¿Por qué triunfa la autenticidad en redes sociales en 2026?

Como dije, la avidez por la autenticidad no es casual. Se podría decir que responde a tres cambios profundos en el comportamiento del usuario digital:

1\. \*\*Fatiga del contenido hiperproducido:\*\* la audiencia ha desarrollado un sexto sentido para detectar la falsedad. Cuando todo es perfecto, nada es real, y eso genera desconfianza.

2\. \*\*Hambre de conexión humana:\*\* en un ecosistema saturado de inteligencia artificial y filtros, las personas anhelan ver, apoyar y admirar a personas reales, con sus errores, sus espacios desordenados y sus días malos.

3\. \*\*El algoritmo premia la retención:\*\* los contenidos que muestran un contraste o una transformación mantienen al espectador mirando hasta el final, y esto es una señal clave para las redes sociales.

\## Cómo mantenerte real en tu contenido

Te voy a dar algunas ideas:

\- Muestra el proceso, no solo el resultado: graba tu pantalla mientras diseñas, escribes o editas. Enseña los borradores, los intentos fallidos, el plato roto que no salió en la foto. La audiencia quiere aprender de tu camino, no solo aplaudir tu destino.

\- Incluye una sección de bloopers: esto te permitirá agregar un poco de humor a tus videos sin afectar el contenido principal.

\- Humaniza tu marca sin perder tu esencia: no se trata de compartir dramas innecesarios ni de forzar una vulnerabilidad que no sientes. La autenticidad estratégica significa elegir qué mostrar para construir confianza genuina. Pregúntate: ¿qué parte de mi día a día generaría un \

en mi audiencia?

\## Conclusión

Lo real vende, lo perfecto comienza a aburrir. Esto es el reflejo de una audiencia madura que exige honestidad a las marcas y creadores que sigue. En 2026, la mejor estrategia de contenido no consiste en parecer perfecto, sino en ser lo suficientemente valiente como para mostrarte real. Porque en la era de la inteligencia artificial, la mayor ventaja competitiva sigue siendo profundamente humana: la autenticidad.

¿Te animas a mostrar tu lado B? Cuéntame en comentarios cuál ha sido tu mayor \

body.title: Splinterlands - Opening 5 Foundation packs, winning 2 Epic and 2 Gold, and A battle with Burning Modifier
body.body:
Hello everyone,
How are you all? I hope everyone is fine and doing great in their life.

It has been three days since I last played Splinterlands, but today I finally got some time from my work and played the game again. I completed my daily rewards, and now I have some chest openings to share with all of you, along with a battle that I think is worth sharing.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmdprEHHVRCDvhWKUuDyHSJR3VDe4FxCg1QvSRk1ntr8xF/image.png)


As usual, you can see in the screenshot below that I am at the mana well, where I have six Foundation chests. Nothing new here, but I am going to open five of them because that is what I like. I prefer opening in multiples of five, like 5, 10, or 15. So today, I opened five chests without expecting much. Still, I was hoping to get at least one gold foil card, even if it is a common one.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmURTwELNe5x5fqYLE1471RqLzjgnUKZHB7Vv6DWEEtDhg/image.png)

In the screenshot below, you can see the first three chest openings where I got two epic cards. I am happy with that because I want to max out my epic cards. Even though I did not get a legendary, I am still satisfied.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmaEf9X9yg561tW57HcCi64NQv64Q2ffDCmYGtoTBnjc2o/image.png)

In the next screenshot, you can see the remaining two chests, where I got two gold foil cards. Even though they are from the common category, I am happy because I want to collect and upgrade gold foil cards. So overall, this was a nice opening. It may not be worth much in terms of money, but I am still happy.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmaqNAdftEJRw8xM4dNLcbrCsYov3hsAD26BpovauMhNFD/image.png)

Now I want to share a battle that had the Burning modifier. I am especially sharing this for newcomers so they understand how to play with this modifier.

When the Burning modifier is active, you should focus on monsters with higher health. You need to build your team in such a way that your monsters can survive longer.

In the screenshot below, you can see the battle lineup. I am at the bottom, and my opponent is at the top. One of the key monsters on the opponent’s side is Little Sister, but it only has 3 health. This is a mistake because, with the Burning modifier, it loses 2 health each round. 

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmczg6PGUFLRBswYN5q2MTVVztEa6k4V8BvMsWFnWsbuDH/image.png)

So if my team deals even 1 damage, it will be eliminated very quickly. In the screenshot below, you can see Round 3, where the match is 3 vs 4. However, there is a big difference. Most of my opponent’s monsters are down to 3 or 4 health, while I still have a legendary monster with 9 health. At that point, I was confident that I would win.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmTmtcbLG8Rqa9hqSut7amXZZGMohyF6gEMhFfTtBE9sBX/image.png)

Finally, in the last screenshot, you can see that I won the battle. It was quite an easy win because my opponent did not build a proper team for the Burning modifier.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmRFYVKA22vcgGVokiDsoY2fDuHArQVaGn9r3aVfQfXo7Q/image.png)

So remember, whenever you see the Burning modifier, avoid using monsters with low health because they will not survive long.
That is all I did in Splinterlands today.

Now coming to Terracore.

In the screenshot below, you can see my Terracore attacks. I am not sure what went wrong today because I was only able to see the results of two attacks. The remaining six attacks were just loading.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmX8HcvdBEkFWabgvCxJHF3jGky8wvRfW33FDJ7L7p8qPk/image.png)

So I claimed my stash after using two attacks, and I will try again tomorrow to see if the remaining attacks get processed.

That is all I did in Splinterlands and Terracore today.

Thank you.
