body.title: Menjemput Keadilan di Sela Reruntuhan dan Lumpur: Harapan Baru Pendataan Tahap II Korban Banjir Bireuen
body.body:
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmWfU6M6VGdQ3izDQhwfZmGezvgTJxJHQKYKqvAKzQkN6u/1777053596776.jpg)[sumber Rakyat Aceh](https://harianrakyataceh.com/news/miris-gegara-data-amburadul-korban-bencana-di-bireuen-desak-aparatur-desa-mundur/index.html)

Bagi masyarakat Kabupaten Bireuen, khususnya para penyintas banjir hidrometeorologi awal 2026, hari **Senin, 27 April 2026**, bukan sekadar tanda pergantian tanggal. Turunnya **Tim Verifikasi Pendataan Kerusakan Rumah Tahap II** ke desa-desa adalah simbol bahwa negara sedang berupaya \
harapan yang sempat terputus oleh birokrasi.\n### Pantee Lhong: Episentrum Duka dan \

TMK\nJika kita mencari potret paling kontras dari duka banjir kali ini, tengoklah **Desa Pantee Lhong**. Sebagai salah satu episentrum bencana, desa ini seharusnya menjadi wajah prioritas pemulihan. Namun, kenyataan di lapangan justru menyuguhkan \

: hampir **50% masyarakatnya dinyatakan Tidak Masuk Kriteria (TMK)** pada verifikasi awal.\nFenomena di Pantee Lhong adalah alarm keras. Ada paradoks yang menyakitkan ketika niat baik kebijakan negara terbentur oleh dinding tebal bernama kekakuan Petunjuk Teknis (Juknis) dan metode pendataan yang dingin.\n> *\
\nBencana alam menyisakan duka fisik, namun ketidakpastian administratif menyisakan luka batin yang lebih mendalam. Tahap II ini hadir untuk membasuh luka bagi mereka yang sebelumnya merasa \

:
 * Korban yang datanya hilang atau terselip saat uji publik.
 * Warga yang masuk kategori TMK namun fakta lapangannya sangat memprihatinkan.
 * Penyintas yang belum terdata sama sekali karena kendala teknis saat tanggap darurat.
Menempatkan kelompok ini sebagai **prioritas utama** adalah langkah yang sangat adil. Ini adalah upaya memastikan tidak ada satu pun korban yang \

birokrasi hanya karena urusan kertas.


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmehRn2NBjMYXmcRXuhPbb1ukDxiQyzog2poWkt7iciBkG/1777053826425.jpg)[sumber Realita.co](https://realita.co/amp/baca-48386-bupati-bireuen-pastikan-tak-ada-lagi-korban-banjir-terabaikan-di-pendataan-tahap-ii)
### Misi Penebusan: Akurasi Berbasis Kemanusiaan
Pendataan Tahap II ini harus menjadi sebuah **misi penebusan**. Keadilan bagi korban banjir bukan hanya soal bantuan yang cair, melainkan soal ketepatan dan martabat.
 1. **Melampaui Kertas:** Tim verifikasi harus mampu melihat sisa lumpur dan retakan dinding lebih dalam daripada sekadar mencentang kolom formulir. Klasifikasi Rusak Ringan, Sedang, hingga Berat/Relokasi harus dipotret secara jujur.
 2. **Menghapus Trauma Administrasi:** Jangan sampai warga merasa \

—sekali oleh air bah, dan sekali lagi oleh sistem pendataan yang kaku.\n 3. **Transparansi Lapangan:** Kehadiran tim secara langsung di tengah masyarakat akan menutup ruang spekulasi dan prasangka.\n> *\

*
> 

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQme96nQPmEns3eyGUL42JKC85VF651ahDgbrs9D5fzoG9R/1777053908002.jpg)[sumber bnpb](https://bnpb.go.id/berita/bimtek-enumerator-bantuan-stimulan-rumah-rusak-tahap-dua-wilayah-bireuen)

### Harapan untuk Bireuen yang Bangkit
Kita semua menaruh harapan besar pada pundak Tim Verifikasi yang mulai bekerja besok. Medan lapangan mungkin masih berat dan akses mungkin belum pulih sepenuhnya, namun setiap langkah mereka membawa harapan bagi warga untuk membangun kembali atap tempat berteduh.
Semoga pendataan Tahap II ini menjadi penutup yang manis bagi duka banjir Bireuen 2026. Biarlah proses ini menjadi bukti bahwa di atas puing-puing kerusakan, masih ada keadilan yang kokoh berdiri. Saatnya negara menunjukkan bahwa aturan dibuat untuk melindungi rakyat, bukan untuk membelenggu hak mereka.
**Mari kita kawal bersama agar Bireuen kembali bangkit dan pulih lebih kuat!**

Ayer en la tarde iba como siempre: rápido, enfocada, con la mente ya en la consulta que me esperaba en el policlínico del centro. Pero a veces, cambiar un camino cambia todo.


Tomé una calle diferente… y ahí estaba: una cafetería nueva que no había visto antes, D'Ask Café. No sé si fue el hambre o esas ganas inevitables de un buen capuchino, pero sin pensarlo mucho, entré.


Desde el primer momento, la experiencia empezó bien. Me senté y enseguida me atendieron con una amabilidad que se siente genuina, de esas que te hacen querer quedarte un rato más. Todo fluía rápido, pero sin perder el detalle.


Mientras miraba el lugar, algo me resultó familiar. El bartender y barista… sí, definitivamente lo había visto antes. Le pregunté si había trabajado en la cafetería de CEDES (esa que tantas veces mencioné), y cuando me dijo que sí, supe que había tomado una buena decisión quedándome.


Lo primero que pedí fue un capuchino. Y qué capuchino… desde la presentación ya prometía, con esa espuma perfecta y una canela generosa que se sentía desde el aroma. El sabor no decepcionó: cremoso, equilibrado, reconfortante. No llega a destronar al de Trovando (ese sigue teniendo mi corazón), pero créeme… se le acerca muchísimo.


Para almorzar pedí una hamburguesa con jamón y salsa especial, acompañada de papas fritas, y una piña colada virgen. Aquí viene la confesión: no soy muy fan de las hamburguesas, pero esta estaba bastante bien. Nada extraordinario, pero cumplidora, y con el hambre que tenía, la disfruté. Las papas no fueron las mejores que he probado, pero hicieron su trabajo: llenarme.


Ahora… la piña colada sí merece su momento. Deliciosa, cremosa, bien fría y con una presentación que te invita a sonreír antes del primer sorbo. De esas bebidas que repetirías sin pensarlo.
Al final, ese pequeño desvío en mi camino terminó siendo un gran acierto. Salí de D'Ask Café con esa sensación bonita de haber descubierto un lugar al que seguro volveré.


Y así, casi sin darme cuenta, llegué a la consulta: satisfecha, barriga llena… y el corazón contento.



# English Version 




Yesterday afternoon I was, as usual, in a rush, focused, already thinking about the consultation I had at the polyclinic in the city center. But sometimes, taking a different path changes everything.


I turned down another street… and there it was: a new café I hadn’t seen before, D'Ask Café. I don’t know if it was the hunger or that irresistible craving for a good cappuccino, but without overthinking it, I went in.


From the very first moment, the experience felt right. I sat down and was quickly attended to with a kind of genuine kindness that makes you want to stay a little longer. Everything moved fast, but without losing attention to detail.


As I looked around, something felt familiar. The bartender and barista… yes, I had definitely seen him before. I asked if he had worked at the CEDES café, the one I’ve written about so many times, and when he said yes, I knew I wouldn’t regret staying for lunch.


The first thing I ordered was a cappuccino. And what a cappuccino… from the presentation alone it already stood out, with that perfect foam and a generous touch of cinnamon you could smell before even tasting it. The flavor did not disappoint: creamy, balanced, comforting. It doesn’t quite replace the one from Trovando, that one still has my heart, but it comes very close.


For lunch, I ordered a hamburger with ham and a special sauce, served with fries, and a virgin piña colada. Here’s my confession: I’m not really a fan of hamburgers, but this one was pretty good. Nothing extraordinary, but it did the job, and with how hungry I was, I enjoyed it. The fries weren’t the best I’ve had, but they fulfilled their purpose, they filled me up.


Now, the piña colada deserves its own moment. Delicious, creamy, perfectly chilled, and with a presentation that makes you smile before the first sip. The kind of drink you would gladly order again.
In the end, that small detour turned out to be a great decision. I left D'Ask Café with that nice feeling of having discovered a place I will definitely return to.


And just like that, I made it to my consultation: satisfied, with a full stomach and a happy heart.

It’s constant movement: bending, lifting, running, reacting, handling a million things at once. That’s why Actifit didn’t fully capture my day – I didn’t always have my phone with me 📱💨 But my watch showed the truth – I was moving all day 💪 ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/59f79d8a-57ad-4bac-a037-a06e9856c3cb.jpg) After work I jumped on my bike and took a moment just for myself 🚴‍♀️🌿 Sunshine, silence, green paths… exactly what I needed after an intense day. It wasn’t about breaking records today. It was a workout for my mind and my heart ❤️ ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/d8e93c37-8d35-47c1-a6e6-8867dbfe20d3.jpg) And sometimes… those are the most important ones. Today wasn’t about numbers. It was about moving despite being tired… and finding a moment for myself ✨ ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/c9c2a348-cbde-4289-a7d7-0909ae3c91f6.jpg) #actifit #cycling #fitmom #activelife #healthylifestyle #fitnessjourney #bike #momlife #stayactive Actifit Report – dzień pełen ruchu (nawet jeśli licznik nie ogarnia 😅) ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/176aa2b2-cd58-4b06-bb8e-5ad35dcc97a3.jpg) Dzisiaj dzień, który idealnie pokazuje, że aktywność to nie tylko liczby… ale też życie w biegu 💛 🚶‍♀️ 5299 kroków 🚴‍♀️ 2 treningi rowerowe: łącznie 15,08 km 🔥 spalonych kalorii – zdecydowanie więcej niż pokazuje aplikacja 😄 ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/6fa3e9ca-625b-43ad-9739-b30a44bd6dfa.jpg) Poranek zaczęłam od pierwszej jazdy: ➡️ 8,93 km ➡️ 35 min ➡️ średnia 15,3 km/h Popołudniu dorzuciłam drugą rundę: ➡️ 6,15 km ➡️ 24 min ➡️ średnia 14,8 km/h ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/fc6b3ec3-2ec4-44d5-b9eb-9ffdaed51087.jpg) A między tym wszystkim… 8 godzin zastępstwa na maluchach 😅 I kto pracuje z dziećmi, ten wie – tam nie ma siedzenia. To jest ciągły ruch: schylanie się, podnoszenie, bieganie, reagowanie, ogarnianie miliona rzeczy naraz. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/6c38b05e-84b6-47dd-91d2-c050c98b0125.jpg) I właśnie dlatego Actifit dziś trochę „nie dowiózł” – bo nie zawsze miałam telefon przy sobie 📱💨 Ale zegarek pokazał prawdę – ruch był cały dzień 💪 Po pracy wskoczyłam na rower i złapałam chwilę dla siebie 🚴‍♀️🌿 Słońce, cisza, trasa przez zielone tereny… dokładnie to, czego potrzebowałam po intensywnym dniu. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/2824fda2-7081-4237-bb94-b57407b06f79.jpg) Nie był to trening na rekordy. ![(source:  tmdb.org)](https://image.tmdb.org/t/p/original/jPHEdzMoeb1cHezdp7qdiAucA5J.jpg)

In recent years, Disney has begun, like the Borg, to assimilate everything around it, and in this it has been excellently served by the Marvel Cinematic Universe, the most successful film series in history. When 20th Century Fox, one of Hollywood's giants, was acquired by Disney, one of the main arguments this move was that it would fulfil the wish of Marvel fans, namely that characters from the Marvel Cinematic Universe (Thor, Captain America, Iron Man and the rest of the Avengers) could appear in the same film as characters from the X-Men, to whom Fox held the copyright. Sony Columbia avoided the same fate largely thanks to having previously agreed to a deal whereby Spider-Man, a Marvel character to which Sony holds the rights, could appear in Disney's films, and the Avengers and co. could guest-star in Sony's films. And just how precious Spider-Man is to Sony, and how drastic that move was, is best illustrated by the fact that the famous comic about the masked spider-man who defends New York from criminals experienced two reboots in the previous two decades. The new series of Spider-Man films thus began in 2016 when the title character appeared in Disney's film *[Captain America: Civil War](https://peakd.com/hive-166847/@drax/film-review-captain-america-dawn-of-justice-2016)*. His first solo outing was Jon Watts's film *Spider-Man: Homecoming*, which, besides the expected success with audiences, also received very good reviews.

The plot takes place shortly after Peter Parker (Tom Holland), a 15-year-old New York high school student endowed with superhuman powers after the bite of a radioactive spider, participated in the spectacular internal clash among members of the superhero group the Avengers. There he made a deep impression on billionaire and superhero Tony Stark, alias Iron Man (Robert Downey Jr.), who decided to make him his protégé and prepare him for a future Avenger under the guise of an internship at his company. However, the young Parker is impatient and, despite his mentor's warnings, frequently dons his superhero suit and heads to the streets to help his fellow citizens and tackle all sorts of criminal scum. Because of this, he begins to have problems at school, as well as with his attempts to get closer to Liz (Laura Harrier), a student he has a crush on. His academic and romantic problems will, however, be overshadowed when during his anti-crime activities he gets in the way of Adrian Toomes (Michael Keaton), a small-time construction contractor who had previously got hold of remnants of alien technology after the Battle of New York, and who now turns them into weapons which he sells on the black market.

The crossover with the Marvel Cinematic Universe spared the creators of the third version of Spider-Man the need to torture viewers with a third \

of the popular character, and that just five years after *[The Amazing Spider-Man](https://peakd.com/film/@drax/capsule-film-review-the-amazing-spider-man-2012)*. Thus the screenplay could use an already established character and concentrate on a \

plot, and in doing so used the best elements from the comic book template, which were recognised in the first half of Raimi's *[Spider-Man](https://peakd.com/hive-166847/@drax/film-review-spider-man-2002)* from 2002. These are above all his human qualities, namely that, unlike alien deities and charismatic billionaires, he has to deal with ordinary human and teenage problems. The screenplay thus uses a strong contrast between Parker's superhero powers and glittering future with the Avengers on one side, and a rather prosaic and often unenviable present at school where he is surrounded by pupils who are more popular and successful than him. Such a situation is fairly fertile ground for humour, which the screenwriters use for a series of effective scenes, making *Homecoming* one of the most entertaining and \

of all Marvel films. The screenplay, on the other hand, also uses the reboot for a little more creative freedom in portraying long-familiar characters and situations, so most of Parker's classmates are from racial minorities, and Aunt May, played by the excellent Marisa Tomei, is not only portrayed but explicitly stated as an object of male desire. The most original thing about *Homecoming*, however, is the attempt to make not only the main character, but also the villain, \

. Thus Toomes, played by the ever-reliable Keaton (with several fairly explicit references to the character he played in *[Birdman](https://peakd.com/film/@drax/capsule-film-review-birdman-2014)*), is not an all-powerful cosmic entity or a megalomaniac who wants to conquer or destroy the world, but merely a small-time \

who opportunistically tries to earn a few bucks on the wrong side of the law.

A significant contribution to the good impression of *Homecoming* is made by Tom Holland, the young British actor who in the role of Peter Parker made an effort, and for the most part succeeded, in surpassing his predecessors Tobey Maguire and Andrew Garfield. The rest of the cast is also up to the task, especially Jacob Batalon in the role of Parker's friend Ned. Watts generally directs the film well, skilfully balancing action and humour, although the finale, which takes place at night, could be a bit more polished. The film's biggest shortcoming, on the other hand, is what in commercial terms could be its greatest asset – its firm connection to the comic book source material, but also to the Marvel Cinematic Universe. Many of the rather specific details will be hard to understand or unrecognisable to an audience that knows nothing about the original comics or hasn't watched Disney's film series, at least from *The Avengers* onward. Viewers who have had the chance to acquaint themselves with the preceding material will, however, be more than satisfied.

RATING: 7/10 (+++)

*(Note: The text in the original Croatian version is available [here](https://draxblog.com/2020/05/22/recenzija-spider-man-povratak-kuci-spider-man-homecoming-2017/).)*

A game that normally cost around 17 euros can now be claimed completely free of charge—and the best part is, this isn't just a temporary trial: if you claim it in time, it stays in your library forever. --- --- The title in question is *Nocturnal*, an action-platformer that might not have been on everyone's radar, but has managed to earn solid reviews from those who have played it. Developed by Sunnyside Games, it offers a fairly straightforward and compact experience—ideal if you're looking for something intense that won't eat up dozens of hours of your time. --- ![maxresdefault.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cocacolaron/23uFHNuzKaVbfvnLtQf3uDdicd6U7YyxRAVt4NfW1eZbugnFcXcNwz9nZWGxejnF2w2Wm.jpg) --- In *Nocturnal*, you step into the shoes of Ardeshir, a soldier returning to his home island after a long absence. What he finds there is hardly a happy homecoming: a mysterious fog has blanketed the entire area, bringing with it chaos and hostile creatures. Your mission is to carve a path through your enemies, utilizing both your sword and the power of fire—a tool that serves not only for combat but also for interacting with the environment. This fire mechanic is a key element of the gameplay. It isn't merely a visual flourish, but a central mechanic that fundamentally shapes how you explore and engage in combat. You can ignite objects within the environment, activate mechanisms, or clear away areas shrouded in fog. This adds an interesting strategic twist to the game's 2D platforming premise. --- ![tumblr_fdab344e0475604b677d3981f563e3b6_7316ab63_1280.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cocacolaron/23tkhgXJQZhXfmVxjZmcRKc1Eaf191Rknn6EbBm4W2uF1QMRQgxSrUMXHnvev5ZAy6ytD.jpg) --- Another noteworthy aspect is that this isn't a particularly long adventure. In fact, it can be completed in just a few hours, making for a rather concentrated experience. Yet, far from being a drawback, this actually works in its favor if you're looking for something quick, well-designed, and free of unnecessary filler. So, why is it free right now? These types of promotions typically have a clear objective: to attract new players and boost the franchise's visibility. In this instance, all signs point to this being part of a strategy to drum up interest in related future projects—such as a sequel that is already in the works. --- ![Nocturnal-Review-boss-fight-swords-coming-down.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cocacolaron/23w2cG4JT3qhbCWrAbYX4gLpNd8RkRbTeKTbaNrgb1g6dwugNqDipb2XmsuDCfvu6sT8K.png) --- That said, there is one important detail: the offer has a deadline. You can only add the game to your account for free until April 26th. After that, it will revert to its standard price, so if you're interested, you definitely shouldn't let this opportunity pass you by. This is truly one of those freebies that are well worth grabbing. This isn't just any random title or mere filler for your digital library; it is a highly-rated game with a distinct identity and intriguing mechanics. It may not be the biggest release of the year, but that is precisely why it presents a great opportunity to discover something unique without spending a single cent. --- ![fere.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cocacolaron/23t72fP53qkqH9CJiwQY7v6hyDMh8fJkLgxXoGosTZttpvciDsVZVACRtRfwDRrFp6E8L.jpg) --- If you have Steam, there is literally no excuse: claim it, add it to your library, and decide later when to play it. In a worst-case scenario, you’ll have wasted nothing more than a few seconds of your time. In the best-case scenario, you walk away with a little gem that you would normally have to pay for.

body.title: MCGI Topic Review | What Pleases God The Most?
body.body: > https://youtu.be/S5njWn_tsEk?si=EqdPpijW0ylLCRPp When it comes to what actually please God. A whole lot of people have misinterpreted it to a whole lot of things which is not true. Some people, they think what pleases God is actually our riches, our power or even our outward appearance. But that is not true because because the bible actually opened our eyes to see that God looks at the heart of a person. In 1 Samuel 16:7, it says, “Man looketh on the outward appearance, but the Lord looketh on the heart. This opened my eyes to see that actually what please God is when we have a sincere heart that loves God and wants to obey him. Whenever God sees a person that is trying to live honesty and faithfully before him, it actually pleases him. But that is not even all, another thing I have come to discover that pleases God the most is our faith. Yes when we have faith in God. In Hebrews 11:6, the Bible says, “But without faith it is impossible to please Him. When I am talking about faith, I mean trusting God even when life is actually very hard and when we do not even understand everything. The issue with a whole lot of people is the fact that we only remember God anytime we have problems. But having faith in God makes it in a way whereby whether you have problem or not, you are constantly in connection with God. Then the last one that I will like to talk about is the fact that God is always pleased with us when we obey His commandment and also show love to others. In Ecclesiastes 12:13, it says, “Fear God, and keep his commandments: for this is the whole duty of man. We should always love one another. We should always show the fruit of the spirit to people around us. It will certainly not be easy but that is actually what we are commanded to do as Christians and we are actually to do it.

body.title: Electroneum - Voltage : Powering Up in Praetoria
body.body:
⚡ **Electroneum - Voltage : Powering Up in Praetoria**

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/splinterlands/48WBJAD3skAAWQHYqNwsHQUXrvkVgbCkspmqrVzFZ9tGgER2zsfYL9AFyoYDi9EKEQ.png)

**Voltage**


This is the first official unveil of the **Electroneum x Splinterlands Voltage Event** — an early look at what’s being built and what’s ahead, as part of a new partnership introducing a powerful feature currently in development, with more details, features, and updates rolling out in the weeks leading up to launch.

⛏️ **Voltage Field Operations**
🛠️ **Status:** In development
☀️ **Target:** Before summer
📅 **Full details:** Rolling out over the next few weeks

---

🦊 **How It Works**

A simple gameplay loop:

Buy your **ElectroFox** card (purchased within Splinterlands using Credits)
Stake it on your Splinterlands land plot
Use an existing plot or purchase a **starter bundle** (details soon)
Earn **Electoneum Voltage Points (EVP)** over time

Then:
Spend EVP in the **Rewards Shop**
Unlock **Reward Chests** containing rewards, including ETN.

---

💰 **Real Rewards Loop**

💸 **$20,000 worth of ETN available at launch**
🔄 **All proceeds of card sales are used to buy ETN**
⛏️ **That ETN is added back into Praetoria to be mined by the players**

---

🎁 **Reward Chests**

Minor Chest — 300 EVP
Major Chest — 1,000 EVP
Ultimate Chest — 3,500 EVP
Omega Chest — 10,000 EVP

---

🎴 **ElectroFox — Land Gameplay**

Stake on land
Generates EVP passively over time
Does not interrupt normal land production
Only 1 plot per account can run Static Charge

**EVP Generation**
Level 1 → 5 EVP/hour
Level 2 → 15 EVP/hour
Level 3 → 30 EVP/hour
Level 4 → 60 EVP/hour

---

⚔️ **ElectroFox — Battle Gameplay**


![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/splinterlands/EokVxCQ8dsCgkKt7F9SkwoL2NeUGUY6ppNnze6J5MFrEXgyWBZpLeryT7TZacD7Te4d.png)


**Ability Progression**

**Level 1**
Opportunity — Targets the enemy unit with the least health



Electrified — Deals 1 damage to all allied units at the beginning of round 2 and each following round.



**Level 2**
Amplify - Increases damage of Retaliate, Corrosive Ward, Magic Reflect, Return Fire, and Thorns for all friendly units by 1. Does not stack.




**Level 3**
Inspire — +1 melee power to all allied units.



**Level 4**
Painforge — +1 power when damaged by Poisoned or Burning or hit by an ally.



---

🧩 **Built for Everyone**

We want this first Electronuem event to be simple:

No $SPS staking required
No $ETN staking required
Just get your Electrofox and land kit, then start mining!

---

📦 **Getting Started**

Players will have multiple ways to jump in:

🗺️ Use one of your existing land plots
or
📦 Choose from three package options:

A La Carte
Base Bundle
Premium Grain Bundle

👉 **Full bundle details are TBD and will be shared soon.**

---

⚠️ **Limited Supply**

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/splinterlands/23w2aJDzhThVFZzLjSZHMjSWUL6bUwyxRcMUKWm86MJSzHSUmxDLrz4uYPwMEfbGXB8JJ.png)

ElectroFox cards will be limited in supply, so early participation matters:

2,500 total Regular Foil cards

**Ultra-rare premium foils:**
30 Gold Foil (1 BCX each)
5 Black Foil (max)
3 Gold Foil Arcane (max)
1 Black Foil Arcane (max)

body.title: Win Money Solitaire Changes Earnings Midway Ruining Potential
body.body:
I have been covering games recently that players can earn a bit of money, so far crypto, for their efforts. This time with Win Money Solitaire I am offering more a heads up, skip this one, type alert. It seems that Bear Hug Entertainment on Google Play are helping make sure gamers cannot find this one as it is not available on Google Play (searching or on their profile). If you have it installed and were thinking of giving Win Money Solitaire a whirl, you might want to read this article first. There are changes and not for the better. Solitaire with Niceties Tacked On Win Money Solitaire is just solitaire. Klondike version. There is no variations outside that solitaire mode included here. If you are not a fan of klondike solitaire then you probably did not download Win Money Solitaire in the first place. Graphically, Win Money Solitaire is nice looking and features the basics of a good card game fans are accustomed to by now. Including, but not limited to, tapping cards and they automatically move for you. There is also an autocomplete and when you are unable to complete the round, Win Money Solitaire tells you clearly “no more moves”. https://youtu.be/h6b3Cdo66Lc

You May Want to Uninstall Win Money Solitaire

Reasons to uninstall Win Money Solitaire include the fact that the title is likely no longer correct. My time with Win Money Solitaire is off and on, I play when I remember I have it installed. Today, while recording the above embedded video, I noticed a SEVERE change in earnings potential. Namely there was a 66% drop in earnings. To get the lowest payout ($5) you must collect 6,000 gems. You are basically earning around $0.06249 per winning round of solitaire. Not bad, right? Much better than 5 to 20 satoshis every 15+ minutes playing other games. Current exchange rates put 20 satoshis between 1 and 2 cents. To make $5 you would need to win 80 rounds of solitaire in Win Money Solitaire. Not a great return on your time but if you are having fun and doing this occasionally, it is a nice surprise to see hit your PayPal account. Once I reached around 2,500 or so gems, and this is shown in the video, the payouts dropped to 25 gems per winning round. This now means you would have to win over 150 rounds of solitaire to reach the $5 payout. A SEVERE drop in earnings potential. Even if you are a fan of solitaire there are much better versions of it available on your devices app store. This is because you are still forced to watch ads after every round of solitaire, win or lose. That is A LOT of advertising for absolutely no payout for your time. As of this writing, even if you can find it, I cannot recommend Win Money Solitaire. Even Bear Hug Entertainment agrees since they have delisted it.

**English:**  
Have you ever started a project with lots of energy and then… poof!… your motivation disappeared? You're not alone. Motivation isn't magic: it's a skill you can train. In this article, I'll share 5 simple strategies to keep your motivation alive, day after day.

Las 5 Estrategias Clave / The 5 Key Strategies
----------------------------------------------

### 1\. Ten una visión clara / Have a clear vision

**Español:**  
Antes de empezar, pregúntate: ¿Qué quiero lograr y por qué?  
Cuando tienes una imagen clara de tu meta, es más fácil seguir adelante, incluso en los días difíciles.

**English:**  
Before you start, ask yourself: What do I want to achieve and why?  
When you have a clear picture of your goal, it's easier to keep going, even on tough days.  
Practical tip: Write your goal on a note and place it where you'll see it every day (mirror, desk, phone)

body.title: 🏆 TerraCore Dev Update — Treasury-Funded Leaderboard Rewards
body.body:
![cover](https://i.imgur.com/wbq2O7o.jpeg) Hello, Fellow Citizens! It's been a productive stretch on the TerraCore backend and we have a meaningful update to share today — one that directly changes how $SCRAP flows through the game economy. We've just shipped a fundamental rework to how daily leaderboard rewards are funded, and we want to be fully transparent about what changed, why we made the move, and what it means for you as a player.
## **What Changed: From Minting to Treasury** Up until now, every daily leaderboard reward cycle minted fresh $SCRAP tokens and distributed them to the top players. While this worked fine mechanically, it had a quiet side effect — it added a small but consistent drip of new $SCRAP supply to the economy every single day, regardless of what was happening with buybacks or overall token health. Starting now, that's gone. **Leaderboard rewards no longer mint any new tokens.** Instead, they draw from the `terracore` treasury wallet — the $SCRAP balance held by the game account itself on Hive Engine. > 📸 **[Screenshot needed: Hive Engine token balances page for `terracore` account showing SCRAP balance]**
## **How the Reward Pool Is Calculated** The math is simple and fully on-chain verifiable: ```javascript // Every reward cycle (once per day): const treasuryBalance = await fetchScrapBalance('terracore'); // live from Hive Engine const dailyPool = treasuryBalance * 0.0001; // 0.01% of treasury // Each player's share is proportional to their leaderboard weight: player.reward = (player.leaderboardShare / totalShares) * dailyPool; ``` Every 24 hours the smart contract queries the live $SCRAP balance of the `terracore` account on Hive Engine, takes 0.01% of that as the day's total reward pool, and distributes it proportionally to leaderboard participants based on their scores. That's it. No minting, no printing — just recycling existing tokens that the treasury has accumulated. > 📸 **[Screenshot needed: Leaderboard page in-game showing expected daily rewards]**
## **Why This Matters for the Economy** This is the part we really want you to understand, because it's more than just a technical plumbing change. The old system meant the leaderboard was a small but real source of inflation every day. New $SCRAP entered circulation purely as a game reward, independent of any economic activity. The new system ties reward size directly to the health and size of the treasury. So how does the treasury grow? Through buybacks. The TerraCore smart contract automatically converts SWAP.HIVE revenue from in-game activity into $SCRAP by purchasing it on the Hive Engine DEX. Every time that buyback runs, the treasury balance increases — and a larger treasury means a larger daily reward pool for leaderboard competitors. ``` Game Activity → HIVE Revenue → SWAP.HIVE → DEX Buyback → Treasury SCRAP ↑ ↓ Larger Daily Reward Pool ↓ Stronger Leaderboard Incentive ``` This is a real virtuous cycle. More players engaging with the game drives more revenue, which drives bigger buybacks, which builds a larger treasury, which means better daily rewards for the top competitors. The leaderboard now has real economic alignment with the game's overall health. > 📸 **[Screenshot needed: In-game marketplace or token stats page showing SCRAP price or market activity]**
## **Frontend & API Updates** We also updated the API and frontend to display accurate expected reward amounts. The treasury's current $SCRAP balance is now stored in the game database and surfaced through the API, so the leaderboard page can show you a real estimate of today's prize pool rather than a placeholder figure. If you check [the leaderboard](https://terracoregame.com) now, you should see reward amounts that reflect the actual treasury balance rather than a fixed number. > 📸 **[Screenshot needed: Leaderboard page showing the updated expected reward display]**
## **Sprint Development Cadence** One more thing worth mentioning — we're shifting into a sprint-based development cycle. What that means practically is that you may see several updates drop in a single day as we work through a focused batch of improvements together. We know frequent updates can feel noisy if there's no context behind them. Our commitment is simple: **every change that ships gets a post or announcement explaining what it is and why it matters.** No silent deployments, no mystery patches. If something changes in TerraCore, you'll hear about it here and in Discord. The leaderboard reward change is the first entry in this sprint. There's more coming soon — keep an eye on the Discord and follow us on PeakD to stay in the loop. > 📸 **[Screenshot needed: In-game view of the leaderboard rankings with player names and scores]**
## **Wrapping Up** This change is about building a healthier long-term economy for TerraCore. Eliminating daily reward minting removes a structural inflation source, and tying reward sizes to treasury growth through buybacks means the leaderboard prize pool gets stronger as the game gets stronger. We think that's a much better alignment of incentives — for competitive players who want meaningful prizes, and for token holders who care about supply dynamics. As always, if you have questions, feedback, or want to dig into the details, come find us in the Discord. We love hearing from the community and the best ideas for this game have come from conversations with players. See you on the leaderboard, Citizens.
--- *That's it for today, all the links are below be sure to follow us to hear what we are working on and follow the progress!* [Play Terracore](https://terracoregame.com) | [Check Out our Wiki](https://wiki.terracoregame.com) | [Follow us on Twitter](https://twitter.com/terracoregame) | [Follow us on PeakD](https://peakd.com/@terracore) | [Come join the Discord](https://discord.gg/terracore)

body.title: Jeder dritte Deutsche würde für bessere Krypto-Angebote die Bank wechseln/.One in three Germans would switch banks for better crypto offers.
body.body:
Kryptowährungen werden für viele Deutsche zunehmend relevant.


![43160.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmd2aSWZYEDYMSZyH1m8shUAuZP7xXdg5KA1YSotvNtf4S/43160.jpg)

Eine aktuelle Studie der Börse Stuttgart Digital zeigt, dass das Interesse an Kryptowährungen in Deutschland weiter zunimmt. Demnach planen 35 Prozent der Deutschen, in den kommenden fünf Jahren in digitale Assets zu investieren. Besonders auffällig ist die Wechselbereitschaft, denn jeder dritte Deutsche würde für bessere Krypto-Angebote sogar seine Bank wechseln. Für Finanzinstitute ergibt sich daraus ein deutlicher Anreiz, entsprechende Dienstleistungen auszubauen und stärker in ihr Angebot zu integrieren.

**68 Prozent der Befragten schätzen ihr eigenes Finanzwissen als hoch ein. Damit liegt Deutschland vor Spanien mit 67 Prozent sowie Italien und Frankreich mit niedrigeren Werten. Dennoch bleibt eine Hürde bestehen: Rund 60 Prozent geben an, dass ihnen Kryptowährungen zu komplex erscheinen.**

Trotz dieser Unsicherheiten ist das Interesse an digitalen Assets hoch. Ein Teil der Befragten hat bereits investiert, während viele weitere einen Einstieg planen. Besonders wichtig ist sind ihnen die Themen Vertrauen und Zugang. Hier zeigt sich ein klares Bild, weil die eigene Hausbank für viele als erste Anlaufstelle gilt.

“Der Zugang zu Finanzwissen und Kryptowährungen war noch nie so einfach. Doch die Ergebnisse zeigen, dass die Finanzkompetenz in Deutschland weiter gestärkt werden muss, insbesondere im digitalen Bereich”, so Dr. Matthias Voelkel, CEO der Boerse Stuttgart Group.

Ich zitierte aus folgendem Artikel...

https://www.btc-echo.de/schlagzeilen/jeder-dritte-deutsche-wuerde-fuer-bessere-krypto-angebote-die-bank-wechseln-229199/

Mein persönliches Fazit:

Die Bank wechseln muss ich gar nicht mehr ich habe mittlerweile durch mein Privatleben und Business Konten bei drei deutschen Banken . Die Konten meine Lieblings Börsen noch gar nicht mitgerechnet. Ich bin gespannt wann ich direkt mit dem Verrechnungskonto der Sparkasse direkt in Bitcoin investieren kann. In wenigen Monaten soll es ja soweit sein. 

Würdest du die Bank wechseln um einfacher in Kryptowährungen investieren zu können?

---

English 

Cryptocurrencies are becoming increasingly relevant for many Germans.

A recent study by Börse Stuttgart Digital shows that interest in cryptocurrencies in Germany continues to grow. According to the study, 35 percent of Germans plan to invest in digital assets within the next five years. The willingness to switch banks is particularly striking, as one in three Germans would even change banks for better crypto offerings. This provides financial institutions with a clear incentive to expand their services and integrate them more effectively into their portfolios.

68 percent of respondents rate their own financial knowledge as high. This puts Germany ahead of Spain at 67 percent, and Italy and France with lower figures. Nevertheless, one hurdle remains: around 60 percent say that cryptocurrencies seem too complex to them.

Despite these uncertainties, interest in digital assets is high. Some respondents have already invested, while many others are planning to get started. Trust and access are particularly important to them. Here, a clear pattern emerges, as many consider their own bank to be their first point of contact.

 “Access to financial knowledge and cryptocurrencies has never been easier. However, the results show that financial literacy in Germany needs to be further strengthened, especially in the digital sphere,” said Dr. Matthias Voelkel, CEO of Boerse Stuttgart Group.

I quoted from the following article...

https://www.btc-echo.de/schlagzeilen/jeder-dritte-deutsche-wuerde-fuer-bessere-krypto-angebote-die-bank-wechseln-229199/

My personal conclusion:

I don't even need to switch banks anymore. I already have accounts at three German banks for my personal and business needs. And that doesn't even include the accounts at my favorite exchanges. I'm curious to see when I'll be able to invest directly in Bitcoin using my Sparkasse settlement account. It should be available in a few months.

Would you switch banks to make it easier to invest in cryptocurrencies?

body.body:
![Young Moon and Sister Stars](https://apod.nasa.gov/apod/image/2604/GHR3777LunaPleiadi_101400_1024.jpg)

***

>Sunlit arms of a crescent moon seem to embrace the faint lunar night side in this dramatic celestial view from planet Earth. The single telephoto exposure tracking the sky was captured on the night of April 19, when a two day old Moon was near perigee in its elliptical orbit. On that date, the young Moon was also close on the sky to the lovely Pleiades Star Cluster. With the moonlight dimmed by clouds the Pleiades sister stars gather below the Moon's bright crescent, seen through a faint but colorful lunar corona. The lunar night side is illuminated by earthshine, sunlight reflected from the Earth itself. The Moon's ashen glow, also known as the \

tends to be bright in the northern hemisphere spring. And for now, the Moon's orbit takes it near the Pleiades stars each month in planet Earth's sky, though their close conjunctions are easiest to see when the Moon is near a crescent phase.

body.title: Movie review : Hive 2026
body.body:
![IMG_20260424_180053_296.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/henrietta27/EpnCp6D4z739bJ9nt87pX63qNRr4KCXWvM61bQKj4dVHwaGHtQ5Yzkiw53wzPTt44bp.jpg)

Hive 2026 is a horror and scary movie that involves children and new baby sitter. I just started the movie and it opens with a young lady who just got a job as a babysitter in a weird environment. Apparently the children are being controlled by some entity and makes them do things uncontrollable. A woman comes up to this young girl who is the new babysitter and advices her to leave this place because it has a way of keeping them in she advised her but there is something in the community that eats nannies and babysitters. Apparently that was weird to believe and she ignored the lady.


![IMG_20260424_180850_831.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/henrietta27/Eo8SNW8t9R2Wamzoe3XEB1KpWMgybM1Er83EYNq8uK3NMVU6uuxTjJnVJ8za6k6tMjf.jpg)

The whole thing was confused in at first because i think there is something controlling the children one we have not found out yet. And when the mother of the child came everything seems normal and she even tried to force the babysitter to stay back and even raise her salary. Despite the lady's plea That She Wants to Live and quit the job the woman who is the mother of the weird child threatening her to call and she would press charges against her and viewing her career and life or together. 


![IMG_20260424_180848_716.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/henrietta27/EoAafLzpAoWsbhCyKpw5pHDAgUk4Q546fcNFHC4CYmHtrnsAZFT9wR6h9EPDe52rkp8.jpg)

In the course of all that were happening the girl was still not lucky and was taken by the Hive mind. Her brother however continued the search to find his missing sister through a lady who has experienced the whole thing and knows the truth. 


![IMG_20260424_182404_690.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/henrietta27/EoiMvqGC73brNbq9EiJdefavqnrXk82xsKutrzf5TwqJ1G412FcsXVG7APoYbHPUc9F.jpg)

![IMG_20260424_182408_459.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/henrietta27/EoeFRd9ctEoi2xmXe4uMtmxjkmfkZ2ZpULHmv2JfhVKDg992zC9qZ6YxtCgioC9HXi5.jpg)

The babysitter'brother found a mean to entire the Hive mind through one of it passage to find his sister. It was a scary experience all together and a good watch. 

Notr:images used here were obtained as screenshots from the downloaded movie 


Thanks for stopping by my blog...

## Welcome to my Hebrew reading & language series. 
#

#### Exodus 18:12-16
#

<div class=pull-right>

<center>
![chabadjudge.jpeg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmYgE3v9N3yLsioKQ2dPDYnrg6pjziXjRfJnfJTYn6HCMG/chabadjudge.jpeg)
<a href=\

>*Settling Disagreements* We saw the arrival of Moshe's (Moses') wife and father-in-law last week as they told each other about things that had happened in each other's lives. Today, yee-t'Roh (Jethro) gets to see the multitudes that were saved and brought out from Mitsraim (Egypt). He had heard about it but now he sees the scale of the miracles El Shaddai (The Almighty) had done. We start with yee-t'Roh bringing his sacrifices to God and a burnt offering. The following day, Moshe sat as the people came for him to make judgement on issues or disagreement between each and his neighbor. I am guessing that this was a normal thing that happened. (Moshe forgot to delegate and is overworked?) Yee-t'Roh sees this process and asks why Moshe is the only one doing this job. Some of the people would stand in lines from morning until night time and not even be seen by Moshe. Moshe was the one who spoke to Elohim often and knew what God expects of his people. I am guessing that next week will include training for the 'customer service' department so that Moshe need not be spread so thin. ### Today's Reading # #### *English* # And Jethro, Moses' father-in-law, brought a burnt offering and sacrifices to God; and Aaron came with all the elders of Israel to eat bread with Moses' father-in-law before God. The next day Moses sat to judge the people, and the people stood around Moses from morning till evening. When Moses' father-in-law saw all that he was doing for the people, he said, \
And Moses said to his father-in-law, \

body.title: ApeCoin Explodes +59% The BAYC Token No One Expected to Pump.
body.body:
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmSwcq5APrRQe7aDcYeBVTm5CJSLGRKHt72kjVi9Z4YUn3/1777052253565.jpg)



![Bored Ape Yacht Club](https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1639762681485-074b7f938ba0?w=800)

ApeCoin (APE) has shocked the market with a massive +59.50% surge in 24 hours, rocketing from $0.0996 to $0.1965 and catching traders completely off guard. With trading volume exploding to 213.81M APE ($32.68M USDT), this rally marks APE's strongest performance in months, raising the question Is the Bored Ape ecosystem finally waking up?

    The Story Behind APE's Explosive Rally

ApeCoin is the governance and utility token of the Bored Ape Yacht Club (BAYC) ecosystem, one of crypto's most iconic NFT brands. Despite being backed by Yuga Labs and having celebrity endorsements, APE has been in a brutal bear market, trading **96.8% below its all-time high** of $39.40. But today's rally suggests something fundamental may be shifting.

    Why Is APE Pumping Right Now?

      1.Technical Breakout After Months of Compression

The 1hour chart shows APE decisively breaking above all three exponential moving averages (EMA 25, 50, and 100), signaling a major trend reversal after months of downtrend.

           Technical Setup
Clean breakout from falling wedge pattern (classic bullish reversal)
EMA(25) at $0.1208 now turning into support
Golden cross forming as short term EMAs cross above long-term
Massive volume spike 21.2 billion APE tokens traded
All moving averages bullish and rising for first time since December

This isn't just noise it's the first convincing technical signal that APE's prolonged downtrend may be reversing.

       2. Bitcoin Rally Lifting High-Beta Altcoins

Bitcoin led the bullish wave, gaining 7.24%. ApeCoin, showing a high beta characteristic, rallied in tandem, outperforming slightly. When Bitcoin pumps, high-risk altcoins like APE often experience amplified moves and today's +59% surge is textbook beta expansion.

            Why High Beta Matters
APE magnifies Bitcoin's moves (both up and down)
During bull runs, APE can deliver 3-5x Bitcoin's gains
This characteristic makes APE attractive for aggressive traders

           3. Short Squeeze Dynamics 

The violent price spike from $0.10 to $0.1965 in just hours suggests significant short liquidations. When leveraged short positions get liquidated, it creates a cascade of forced buying that accelerates price movements exactly what we're seeing here.

                  Evidence of Squeeze
Parabolic intraday move (97% peak gain from low to high)
Volume explosion (10x normal trading volume)
Immediate follow-through without major pullback

         4  ApeChain & Ecosystem Developments

While not directly announced today, APE has been building infrastructure that's finally gaining attention

                   ApeChain Launch
Dedicated Layer 2 blockchain for the BAYC ecosystem
 Enables faster, cheaper transactions for APE-based DApps
Gaming integrations and metaverse expansion planned for Q1 2026

            ApeCo Transition 
Yuga Labs' proposal AIP-596, approved in June 2025, dissolves the ApeCoin DAO and transfers assets and control to a new, centralized entity called ApeCo. The goal is to eliminate sluggish, noisy governance and accelerate development on ApeChain, BAYC, and Otherside.

               What This Means
 Faster decision-making and execution
More aggressive development on Otherside metaverse
 Potential for increased marketing and partnerships
Trade off  Reduced decentralization for efficiency

        5. NFT Market Showing Signs of Life

While the broader NFT market remains depressed, there are early signals of renewed interest
Increased whale activity in blue-chip NFTs
BAYC floor price stabilizing after 90% drop
Speculation about ApeFest 2026 event creating buzz

              6 Extreme Oversold Conditions

APE fell below $0.5 in 2025 and $0.30 in January 2026. In the third week of January, it fell below $0.2 and now trades at the $0.1 mark. Trading at $0.10 represented an extreme oversold condition anyone with long term conviction could recognize the asymmetric risk reward at those levels.

                Mean Reversion Trade
APE had fallen 99% from ATH
Risk/reward became attractive for contrarian traders
Dead cat bounce or genuine reversal? Today's volume suggests the latter

               What Makes ApeCoin Unique?

           The BAYC Connection
ApeCoin is intrinsically tied to one of the most recognizable NFT brands in history:
Celebrity holders: Eminem, Snoop Dogg, Justin Bieber, Steph Curry
Cultural cachet and mainstream recognition
 Gateway token to exclusive metaverse experiences

              Multi Use Case Utility
Governance Vote on DAO proposals and ecosystem direction
Gaming In-game currency for APE-powered games
Metaverse Primary currency for Otherside virtual land and assets
 Staking  Earn yields by locking APE tokens
 Payments Used for transactions within the BAYC ecosystem

               Self Sustaining Ecosystem
 DAO Treasury 47% of supply allocated to ecosystem development
Strategic Partnerships Animoca Brands, nWay Play, and others integrating APE
Metaverse Land SalesOtherside land sales drove previous APE rallies

           Price Targets & Technical Analysis

Current Price $0.1611  
24h High $0.1965 (tested and rejected)  
24h Low  $0.0996

         Short Term Targets 
First Resistance $0.18-$0.20 (psychological barrier, tested today)
Second Target $0.23-$0.25 (local highs from December 2025)
Major Resistance $0.30 (breaking this cleanly  FOMO mode)
Bull Target $0.50+ if momentum sustains into February

                 Key Support Levels
Immediate $0.1208 (EMA 25, recent breakout zone)
Strong $0.1126 (EMA 50)
 Critical $0.0996 (24h low  losing this invalidates rally)

Technical Indicators
The MACD histograms indicate positive market momentum
RSI likely approaching overbought (watch for cooling)
Volume confirmation essential for continuation

            Expert Price Predictions for 2026

             Bullish Forecasts
-With 90% supply unlocked, inflation pressure eases. If adoption improves, APE could target $0.21 short term and $1.89 by 2026
The price of Apecoin is expected to reach a high of $4.34 by 2026
 Once the NFT ecosystem wakes up, we could see a parabolic rally in APE token also. The short-term price prediction for ApeCoin is around 2x to 5x

            Conservative Forecasts 
 CoinCodex: $0.16-$0.23 range for 2026
DigitalCoinPrice: $7.92-$9.52 by late 2026 (extremely bullish scenario)

              Consensus
Most analysts agree APE has significant upside IF the Otherside metaverse launches successfully and gaming integrations materialize. However, execution risk remains high.

              Risks & Challenges to Consider

               Major Headwinds:

1. NFT Market Collapse
BAYC floor prices have fallen roughly 90% from their peak. Weakness in the NFT market directly erodes the cultural and financial prestige of the APE ecosystem. Until NFTs recover, APE faces fundamental demand issues.

       2. Centralization Concerns
The ApeCo transition fundamentally removes tokenholder governance rights, which may alienate the core community and increase reliance on Yuga Labs' execution. If Yuga fails to deliver, APE has no decentralized fallback.

         3. Inflation Pressure 
While 90% supply unlocked means inflation pressure eases, early investors and team members still hold massive bags that could dump on rallies.

         4. Extreme Volatility
APE is one of the most volatile tokens in crypto. A +59% rally can easily turn into a -40% dump if momentum fades.

           5. Execution Risk
Otherside metaverse has been delayed multiple times. If Q1 2026 launch disappoints, APE could crash hard.

            Bullish Catalysts

ApeChain gaining developer traction
Otherside metaverse successful launch
 ApeFest 2026 generating mainstream buzz
Gaming partnerships delivering real users
 NFT market bottom forming

             Investment Perspective

           For Short Term Traders
 Entry  Already overextended at $0.16 after +59% move
 Strategy Wait for pullback to $0.12-$0.13 for better risk/reward
Take Profit Scale out at $0.18, $0.23, $0.30
 Stop Loss Below $0.10 (invalidates breakout)

             For Long Term Holders
 Thesis Bet on BAYC brand recovering and Otherside delivering
 Entry Range  $0.10-$0.20 (DCA strategy recommended)
   Hold Target  $1.89-$4.34 by end of 2026 (if bullish scenario plays out)
Exit PlanIf APE loses $0.08, thesis is broken

               For Sidelined Investors
Wait for confirmation Need to see $0.20 resistance break with volume
Alternative  Wait for healthy pullback to $0.13-$0.14
Risk Assessment Only invest capital you can afford to lose APE is extremely speculative

                The Bottom Line

APE's +59% surge is NOT just a random pump. It's backed by
Strong technical breakout from falling wedge
Massive volume confirming real demand
Bitcoin rally lifting high-beta altcoins
90% supply unlock reducing inflation pressure
ApeChain and ApeCo developments maturing

However, APE remains a high risk, high reward play

Best Case Otherside launches successfully, gaming integrations deliver users, NFT market recovers APE hits $2-5 in 2026  
Base Case Consolidation at $0.15-$0.30, ecosystem grows slowly APE trades sideways  
Bear Case Otherside flops, NFT market stays dead  APE retests $0.05-$0.08

The sustainability of this rally depends entirely on whether Yuga Labs can deliver on promises and whether the broader NFT metaverse narrative recovers in 2026.



Are you bullish on APE's comeback story? Is BAYC dead, or just getting started?  Drop your take below!



Disclaimer
This analysis is for informational and educational purposes only and does not constitute financial advice. ApeCoin is an extremely volatile and speculative asset. The author may hold positions in mentioned assets. Always conduct thorough research and never invest more than you can afford to lose.

body.body: > Splendid start of the week. I am happy to see the evolution of all teams in action. My plan was to perform my battles in accordance of the strategy and hope for the best. I went first to the shopping center to get many warriors who will strengthen my collection. I love this section of the week when I get to spend the Glint token acquiring assets.

## A:/ It was a short adventure

How was your week fighting in Splinterlands?
I had a magnificent week so far. The entry in the past twenty hours were the shortest of the week.
My strategy is still holding strong. I am continuously learning to diversify my battle plan with earth warriors and light fighters.

It was an amazing game with Akane opening the series of combat with a victory. Oridum played both offensive and defense allowed the rest of the team to reduce the opposition actions.

body.title: [ENG-SPN] Pineda de la Sierra: School of Sanctuaries / Pineda de la Sierra: Escuela de Santuarios
body.body:
![P1240291.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/juancar347/EqQQ6ncUCDqMyQPGrBjqXvg6NuKvYBW4vGj1gRrmoxbHtMDTUdKHWzEE8vRd4Ckugik.JPG)

When speaking of trees, the first thing that came to mind for that contemplative Nobel Prize winner of German origin, Hermann Hesse, was to refer to them as ‘sanctuaries.’ Following this subtle line of reasoning, the area we are now exploring, the mysterious Sierra de la Demanda, must seem doubly attractive, especially if we consider its dense mountains, dotted with ‘sanctuaries,’ and the villages scattered around them, where medieval stonemasons gave life to stone, previously merely vegetative, creating another kind of sanctuary in those very places where, centuries or millennia before them, the Druids gathered sacred mistletoe with their delicate golden sickles.

![P1240265.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/juancar347/23zkzoB3LGvMVEkz1Fm5kLKuP68PPv2mJxDLEt7CN8bGaUqCLv6WxQ3jiBRLubAErpNeT.JPG)

In that sense, we could say, without fear of being wrong, although to err is human, that Pineda de la Sierra enjoys not only good health—even though some residents may have been seduced by the call of adventure to which Jack London always alluded in his novels, never to return—but also the implicit good fortune of having both types of sanctuaries within easy reach, which, in their own way—like the famous Frank Sinatra song—continue to exert their wonderful teaching influence.

![P1240281.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/juancar347/242YGftEPQdf5vfWwxiKKz2owU1W8P8X8XtNfnm72Xn7CemjeA7cEC8Bbk7kz7joLWvyP.JPG)

The Romanesque church of San Esteban Protomártir is a sanctuary for pilgrims, but it also constitutes one of the most imposing and harmonious examples of sacred architecture to be found, not only in Burgos, but also in the rest of Spain, a country that, even in times of violence and upheaval, sowed the roads with sanctuaries, perhaps in the same way as the romantic sailor in Antonio Machado's poem, who is said to have created a garden by the sea and become a gardener.

![P1240242.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/juancar347/23vhwKT2Qn9SLqq2wBGLTYeSMKU2HzZM5br3kgfqC49VH9y1M6mXudqZh2gWuBpCyyW25.JPG)

Cuando hablaba de los árboles, lo primero que se le ocurría a aquel meditabundo Premio Nobel de origen alemán, Hermann Hesse, era referirse a ellos como ‘santuarios’, de manera, que, siguiendo este sutil razonamiento, la zona donde ahora nos internamos, esa misteriosa Sierra de la Demanda, ha de resultarnos doblemente atractiva, sobre todo si tomamos como base sus tupidos montes, satinados de ‘santuarios’ y esos pueblos desperdigados a su alrededor, donde los canteros medievales dieron vida una piedra, vegetativa hasta entonces, elevando otro tipo de santuarios en esos mismos lugares donde los druidas, siglos o milenios antes que ellos, recolectaban el muérdago sagrado con sus delicadas hoces de oro.

![P1240232.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/juancar347/23xybiC8iYv9Mg3UPH8f7tJom917nfLQELAKAnkATL3i6Zbi2Po7iBYZUwP4pz3ZxGpgj.JPG)

En ese sentido, podríamos decir, sin temor a equivocarnos, aunque errar sea cosa de humanos, que Pineda de la Sierra goza, no sólo de buena salud –aunque algún vecino se haya dejado seducir por la llamada de la aventura a la que aludía siempre Jack London en sus novelas, para no regresar jamás- sino también de la fortuna implícita de tener al alcance de la mano ambos tipos de santuarios, los cuales, a su manera –como la famosa canción de Frank Sinatra- continúan ejerciendo su maravillosa labor de magisterio.

![P1240226.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/juancar347/23vsYipvJhz5iL2y21JSzoSwLHwnninFb6ofTWUqUJSwQtDtpsbQTNRVYERSdSnGHFARm.JPG)

La iglesia románica de San Esteban Protomártir, es un santuario para el peregrino, pero también constituye uno de los modelos de arquitectura sagrada más imponentes y armónicos que se puedan encontrar, no sólo en Burgos, sino también en el resto de una España que incluso en tiempos de violencia y convulsión, fue sembrando los caminos de santuarios, quizás de la misma manera que el romántico marinero del poema de Antonio Machado, del que se dice que hizo un jardín junto al mar y se metió a jardinero.

![P1240310.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/juancar347/242NsqGmfVpqetUozVWeVBWHN1RMgQT4EKxepurkBVLCTrFF3brTwc677aFuh9Gav86gH.JPG)

body.title: Jerome Powell Is Leaving Soon
body.body:
Alright, Jerome Powell is leaving the Fed on May 15. In three weeks. And his successor, Kevin Warsh, has just gone through a Senate hearing. He promised independence, but at the same time announced that he wants to change everything about how the Fed operates.

From how it measures inflation, to how it communicates with the markets. And as if that were not enough, a Republican senator is blocking his appointment.

## WHO IS KEVIN WARSH?

“And who is this Warsh, Christos?”

Kevin Warsh was a Fed governor from 2006 to 2011. In other words, he experienced the 2008 crisis from the inside. After that, he went to Stanford, to the Hoover Institution, while also managing venture capital investments on behalf of the legendary Stanley Druckenmiller.

But that is not all. Warsh has ties to Silicon Valley that go back decades. From his student years at Stanford, he has known Peter Thiel, Yahoo’s Jerry Yang, and Marc Andreessen. In fact, he has investments in startups ranging from crypto to artificial intelligence.

And to understand how big this is, Warsh and his wife, Jane Lauder, are estimated to have a net worth of around $192 million. Yes, you read that correctly. Powell, who until recently was the wealthiest chairman in Fed history, had a net worth of $19 million to $75 million. Warsh is on a completely different level. In short, he would become the first “tech bro” Fed chair.

## WHAT HE SAID IN THE SENATE

Now let’s move to the most important part. What did Warsh say at Tuesday’s hearing?

First of all, he stated clearly: “The independence of monetary policy is essential. The Fed must stay in its lane.” He added that the Fed is at greatest risk when it gets involved in social or fiscal policies, areas where it has no authority.

Trump never asked him to cut interest rates. At least that is what Warsh himself said.

But this is where things get even more interesting. Warsh does not simply want to take Powell’s seat. He wants to change the entire way the Fed operates. He literally spoke about “regime change.”

What does that mean? Two things.

First, he wants to change the way the Fed measures inflation. Right now, it uses core PCE, which shows 3%.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmPyKw3xxqTuycSB1JDfLG5mFm4cBQiX7Vgxddo4xrmM1H/image.png)


Warsh prefers the so-called trimmed averages. What does that mean? In very simple terms, you remove the extreme numbers, the very high and the very low, and look at what remains. Using that method, inflation appears closer to 2.3%. He even called the current core PCE “a crude estimate.”

Second, he wants to end forward guidance. What does that mean? The Fed would no longer tell markets where it intends to take interest rates. Warsh believes these projections do more harm than good, because markets react to what might happen instead of what is happening now.

Of course, there is one big “but.” Elizabeth Warren accused him of lacking independence. Senator Jack Reed was more sarcastic: “I must congratulate you on the way you circularly avoid answering questions without actually answering them.”

## THE TILLIS OBSTACLE

And this is exactly where Senator Thom Tillis enters the picture. A Republican. And he is blocking Warsh.

“Why, Christos? Isn’t he one of theirs?” you might ask.

Here is the story. The Department of Justice, under prosecutor Jeanine Pirro, has opened a criminal investigation into Jerome Powell. Over what? Cost overruns in the renovation of Fed buildings. Tillis, and Powell himself, say the investigation is politically motivated. They argue that Trump is using the justice system to intimidate the next chairman.

And Tillis is not backing down. He is saying: “Close the investigation first, and then I will vote for Warsh.” Pirro, on the other hand, said yesterday that the investigation is continuing and that she will appeal a court decision that blocked subpoenas against Powell.

Let’s also mention this. Republicans have a 12 to 10 majority on the committee. One dissenting vote is enough to block everything. And with Powell’s term ending on May 15, time is running extremely short.

body.body: I've seen an increasing number of posts and videos stating clearly that there's no AI content in them.\n\nAt present, AI creative writing still has an \

feel to it. It's getting better, but so far it all feels very formulaic, and the storylines tend to throw up inconsistencies and subtle differences to the real world. I am, however, deeply concerned that a lot of people default to using things like OneDrive, AWS or Google Drive to store their drafts, and that means AI's are getting trained on things that haven't even been published yet. How long before a human author has a book taken down or gets sued because a Google, Amazon or Microsoft AI published their hard work before they did ?\n\nTo me AI can be a useful research tool, and can produce cover art if a new author can't afford a real human artist yet, but the AI should never ever get involved in the actual writing or editing process.

body.title: Product Review: Butthole Super Soaker™
body.body:
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/edicted/23z7NWYTsRS2dCHkT6AAHXTK93wZ6dRKBn4urVoLGEeJZPeeFqf2xhU1SDG8bcK24oVw9.png)

### Wut?
Back in something like 2018 I wrote a post (which I can't find) talking about how it's a bit ridiculous that bidets are not the standard utility in American bathrooms.  Probably something about hating France and Freedom Fries.  I know not.

I mean clearly it's a cultural thing somehow?  I hear bathrooms in India are basically just holes in the ground that you squat over which, as an American, is pretty baffling to be honest. 

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/edicted/23xytVtCaS2PcLdtahmTGfJ9YNEBoii2iiQdoPGu3X1obedsYiLZZ85YAtnL3Q7T2Sy2J.png)

### Pretty simple concept
Why are so many people smearing their shit around with a piece of paper and thinking they cleaned it?  You would never clean any other actual gross thing with a dry paper towel and that's it.  Remember when Covid hit and the stores completely sold out of all cleaning products including random stuff like rubbing alcohol?  We were more worried about cleaning up an invisible germ than literal shit.  Pretty crazy when you think about it.  


![Coronavirus-toilet-paper-filled-panic-room.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/edicted/23wWnsiLxBdYC6CKLByct5gLc7WYxdhzGhyEEZ2GfGP9xfdztxazuQUHr6q42zZjbUXXV.jpg)


I heard that around that time a bidet company called Tushy somewhat leveraged COVID and the Toilet Paper Shortage of 2020 to sell their product.  We thought about buying one back then but never did.  Not the biggest priority during that crazy ass time.  But around six months ago I did just spontaneously buy one and was pretty surprised about multiple aspects of the thing... most of all the marketing. 


>### Welcome to a HOLE new you!

Hm yes so let the poop humor begin.  I open the box and am immediately greeted with a, \

title.  These cheeky assholes have got jokes it seems.  Then it lists like 20 aliases for the bidet including Bumhole Super Soaker, Bum Gun, Moon Magic, Booty Blesser, and Taint Tidier.  It's like they couldn't choose their favorite one in the writing room so they just splattered them all in there.  Okay then!

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/edicted/23wCJXNhDRipqgtegR5YcJjWnDdfKHRMP9mgLLHvChSkds4ahqCcs9ZhY5ayczr1kSk5S.png)

### The manual
The instructions for butting this thing together were even worse than the packaging.  Just absolutely littered with unprofessional poop and ass jokes.  Can't say I was put off by it as it's honestly kind of my speed but whatever.  It was still shocking to see a manual titled \

. 

In theory the install of this thing COULD be super easy and take like 5 minutes but I had to troubleshoot like three different problems that I thought I might not even be able to solve at first. 

### Problem one: stiff pipe water connection. 
If your toilet is connected to a water source through a rigid pipe this is not ideal because you have to add a T-joint to the connection to fork water pressure into the bidet.  You want a flexible connection so you can kind of jam that in there and fork the water to both the toilet and the bidet.  The Tushy website will offer you a \
one if you end up having this problem, but \

ended up just pissing me off because the shipping on the thing was almost the exact same price of the device itself.  Also they wanted my email address so I said fuck that and just bought it on Amazon Prime.  

### Problem two: Quick release toilet seat. 
We have this weird type of lid on the toilet that isn't the standard 2 plastic screws at the hinge.  Instead it's more of a solid bar that it snaps into.  I thought this was going to be a complete deal breaker and I'd have to give up, but when I took it entirely apart the screws were under it and I could barely make it work after cutting off some small plastic stabilizer tabs on the Tushy that were not compatible with what I was working with.  Seared them off with a razorblade; ended up working fine surprisingly. 

#### Problem three: the solid pipe connection was almost completely seized.
I honestly thought I was going to completely twist off the damn water pipe and flood my entire apartment.  Gonna throw out a guess that it took me over 20 minutes just to get the previous fixture off without breaking it by anchoring wrenches in a way that would not twist the entire pipe when trying to unscrew it.  This was definitely the most annoying a worrying part of the ordeal.  It was super awkward and hard to navigate with no space so close to the wall and a toilet and a bathtub. 

https://www.youtube.com/shorts/1nyLEpKemyI

### Success!
No more poop marker. 

### Cost
If you go to their website it looks like these things are relatively expensive.  Everything is over like $100.  The reason I bought the one I got is that it was $50, so less than half of the \

ones.  That being said the more expensive ones are also harder to install, mainly because you have to hook up a hot water line to adjust the temperature.  I'd say this isn't worth the extra money considering I was using this thing in the middle of the coldest winter I've ever experienced and wasn't really bothered at all. The one's on Amazon for $50 are the first one's that will pop up if you search for it. 

### Hygiene 
The device itself is a bit clever in certain ways.  When the water pressure is low it creates a self-cleaning effect that douses the entire thing in water.  Basically every time it gets turned on or off it will clean itself at least a little bit.  Other than that it's a pretty basic thing and it works so there's nothing more to say. 

### Live in my brain rent free.
There's a video game called Far Cry 4 where you as the main character talk to this radio operator about using a bidet to stay clean as an in game joke.  Oh shit I actually found it.  This is like the 4th time I've looked:

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=mkWIuuLCzp8

### Conclusion
Certainly the most interesting thing about this product is the aggressively unprofessional marketing tactics employed.  Seems like a perfect fit considering people are exactly comfortable talking about such things in a serious environment to begin with.  Get your own Butthole Super Soaker today using my affiliate link!  Just kidding I don't care.

Today, while clearing out a household, I came across a **42-year-old newspaper article** about gold. In the spring of 1984, the article discussed whether it made sense to buy in at $400 per ounce. With the benefit of hindsight, the answer seems almost obvious: Anyone who bought back then has seen their investment grow more than tenfold to this day. At the same time, however, the long investment horizon also shows that significantly higher returns could have been achieved on the stock market on average. The S&P rose 30-fold over the same period.

~~

Heute ist mir bei der Auflösung eines Haushalts ein **42 Jahre alter Zeitungsartikel** über Gold in die Hände gefallen. Darin wurde im Frühjahr 1984 diskutiert, ob ein Einstieg bei 400 Dollar je Unze sinnvoll sei. Mit dem Wissen von heute wirkt die Antwort fast offensichtlich: Wer damals gekauft hat, konnte sein Investment bis heute mehr als verzehnfachen. Gleichzeitig zeigt der lange Anlagehorizont aber auch, dass sich am Aktienmarkt im Schnitt deutlich höhere Renditen erzielen ließen. Der S&P stieg in derselben Zeit um das 30fache.

body.title: Power of productivity
body.body: />\n\nWhen I was young , I used to think, It's a very boring word \

. It sounded so mundane and mechanical!!

But a few months ago, I made an effort to make it my new personal philosophy. My new identity!!

Yes , I wanted to be one of the most productive people in the world!!

So , I started studying different methods of productivity and tried to apply them in my daily life!!

I learned a lot during that time .It was a new field for me altogether. A whole new world!!

For the first time in my life, I got familiar with the terms \

and many more!!

I read about the agile method , sprinting, and most of all, the importance of taking breaks during my productivity hours!!

I applied a new method ( it was new for me), the pomodoro technique. I also tried time blocking.

I also learned about how to plan my day and how to prioritise my tasks!! That was an amazing discovery!!

I read about high impact tasks and routine tasks. I also learned about maintenance tasks.

Being productive gave me a higher life satisfaction and a greater sense of achievement.

I noticed that I had started taking better care of my elderly mom as I was more sensitive to her emotional and physical needs!!

Productivity gave me a sense of purpose and a new meaning in life. It made me more realistic and practical!!

I was able to maintain a better to do list.I became more focused on results, and my planning skills improved considerably.

Now I realise that productivity is not boring at all. Instead, it's a new way of exploiting your time and energy.!!

In fact , it helps you enforce different routines like morning and evening routines.

It teaches you the importance of warm-up time and the significance of power hour!!

In short , I would like to emphasise the fact that productivity is one of the secrets of success and a fundamental habit of effective leaders!!.

There is no doubt about it as i have experienced it in my personal and professional life !! and had cultivated a lot of benefits from it.

body.title: Splinterlands game: Asel Alagosdil Card Review
body.body:
> Splinterlands is a very familiar name for those who regularly spend time in the world of blockchain gaming or NFT games. To win in this game, it is not only important to have expensive cards, but also to know the strategy of which card to use in which rules and in which position. Today, I will discuss with you a wonderful card of the Water element called Asel Alagosdil. This card is basically an Epic card, and its defensive power makes it different from all other cards. Below is a detailed discussion of various aspects of this card. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmNmd1ZhggGekf5XDNbijEJJJ8MNbeWi5yVJztVihWuLDM/1777052419992.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmPX8SXwq26KqRVpxYEEGhEj52xRmEqyXKimwztVfm7Ci2/1777052513456.jpg) Asel Alagosdil is a card of the Water unit with a mana cost of only 4. We know that it becomes quite difficult to win low-mana or medium-mana battles in the Splinterlands game if we do not have a good defensive card. Asel Alagosdil fills that niche. For 4 mana, you get a card with very balanced health and armour. Looking at the card's level 3 stats, it has a speed of 2, armour of 3, and health of 6. Although 2 speed may seem a bit low, its armour and health help it survive in battle for a long time. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmXrJjAUpESfWCCex74bDJrAtU2b7dVmcoseLYpSydGL8q/1777052435869.jpg) The biggest strength of this card is its Divine Shield ability. Due to this ability, the first time an enemy attacks this card on the battlefield, that damage is completely nullified. That is, the first attack does not reduce any of the card's health or armour. This is especially useful in matches where the opponent has very high-damage attackers. Nullifying a powerful attack means giving your remaining cards extra time to attack. Especially if the opponent uses sneak or opportunity attackers, you can create a strong wall by placing Asel Alagosdil in the back. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQy37ZWJ1BmQnDfupwug646XkjcEQKa2tSv3vkDq6ZhtJ/1777052448801.jpg) The card has a special icon called Untrainable next to Divine Shield. This means that this card cannot be trained by weapons in any way. Usually, there are some cards that give the ability to attack non-attacking cards next to it, but Asel Alagosdil cannot take that advantage. This may seem like a negative aspect of the card, but its other stats and low mana cost make up for this deficiency. It is primarily designed as a pure defensive card. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQme7fbaCybhjfq331g4g5ofX89bVRFowxjGs6Bs5zyujhh/1777052477908.jpg) If you think about increasing the level of the card, you will see that its effectiveness increases a lot with each level. At level 1, it has only 4 health and 1 armour. But when you take the card to level 3, its armour increases to 3 and health to 6. The current circulation of this card is over 4,800, which makes it a good collectible card. I currently have a max-level card of it that I use regularly in big tournaments. Considering the current market value of the card and its effectiveness, it should be in every gamer's deck. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmXrJjAUpESfWCCex74bDJrAtU2b7dVmcoseLYpSydGL8q/1777052498460.jpg) Positioning is very important when using the Asel Alagosdil card. Since it cannot attack on its own, it is usually not wise to place it at the front or in the tank position unless you have a special strategy. It is best if it is placed at the very end. Sometimes the opponent wants to quickly finish off the cards behind with a sneak attack. If Asel Alagosdil is there, he can block the opponent with his Divine Shield and Armour. Also, if the battle rules have Equaliser, this card becomes unbeatable because its health increases a lot, and it becomes almost impossible to kill it due to Divine Shield. I recently used this card in a 16 mana match. My summoner was Kellia Friendul, who increased the armour and speed of my cards even more. I put Asel Alagosdil at the very end and used some low-mana attackers in front. A strong sneak attacker from the opponent was repeatedly attacking my Asel Alagosdil, but it failed because the first attack was blocked by Divine Shield,d and the subsequent attacks took time to break 3 of its armour. During this time, the cards in front of me finished off the opponent's main damage dealers, and I easily won. In conclusion, Asel Alagosdil is a card that can silently bring victory to your team in the game of Splinterlands. It may not deal any damage itself, but the amount of damage it can withstand is beyond the reach of many expensive cards. If you like playing with the Water element, don't neglect this card. This card can be your trump card, especially in low-mana challenges. Hopefully, today's detailed analysis will help you improve your gameplay. Regular practice and proper use of the card will make you a pro player in this game. My references:-https://splinterlands.com/register?ref=mirzaiqi
