body.title: Fledgling: Part 128
body.body:
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmboLyS7bf3NC7WHdkYBgXkbreHyci9vcH3WNBMjZq9Bjs/fell_dragon_3_no_text.png)
Hi Readers

Sorry for the late update. We have had a family emergency, and I just didn't have it in me to post as I have been exhausted. This is the first break I've had to post, so please enjoy the update.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmPGgGR4jMjqWAtnrsAQ473w3LqzGE2xiaqkC4u5gva4Hf/fell_dragon_3_divider.png)
The only reason that Kay was still alive was that her armour had taken the blow that would have torn her head off. And the only reason she hadn’t been knocked unconscious when hitting the water was the ice-cold temperature.

The blow, which she had never seen coming, was so powerful that it had shattered her armour. Leaving her vulnerable to the impact of crashing into the water below her. Air was forced out of her mouth as she landed in the water in a twisted position. Agony exploded, but she curled up, forcing herself to hold her breath by pinching her nose closed, instead of inhaling from the shock of the water’s temperature.

Despite the water being deep, the current was fast, and she found her body bashing into everything that was in the water with her. It didn’t matter that she was a good swimmer; the current was too fast, and she was hurt. She wasn’t sure how badly yet, but her body was screaming at her. Her lungs were quickly following suit.

She planted her feet on what she thought was a rock or the underside of the river and kicked off. The pain was so bad that for a second her vision failed, and she forgot that she was holding her breath.

Filthy, cold water flooded her mouth and lungs just before she broke the surface of the water. Panic was creeping in, but she wouldn’t let it dominate her. She had spent too long forcing unneeded feelings down.
Instead of swimming directly to shore, she took the angled approach, knowing that it would require less energy but would take more time. Her limbs were leaden and numb, but still she fought to reach the bank. Time meant nothing as she tried to cough and breathe, while the swollen riven tried to drag her further away. She needed to get to land. More rain would come soon, and if she remained in the river, it would spell the end of her.

She didn’t know how long it took her, but eventually, she grabbed a fistful of moss-like plants growing along the riverbank. She was spent, her breathing coming out in ragged gasps, but she could already feel her hand slipping from the strength of the river. She needed to drag herself from the water and fast.

Fist over fist, she pulled herself from the river, her tired and sore muscles screaming in protest. Eventually, her legs found purchase, and she used them to help get her out of the water. While the right was able to do what it wanted from her, the left screamed in protest.

“Just get me out of the water.” She muttered as she continued to pull herself along, and her right leg pushed against the mud.

Eventually, after almost falling back into the river a few times, Kay was able to get most of her body up onto land. She was spent, but far more spent than she should have been just fighting the power of the river. Her mind was foggy, and she wondered if she had hit her head.

She rolled to her back, with her feet still in the water and tentatively touched her head. There were no bumps, no blood, but still, she felt her consciousness starting to slip. She shook her head, grunted, and sat up, freezing when she saw the cause of her fading consciousness.

White bone surrounded by torn flesh below her knee was showing through her left torn pants leg. While the blood wasn’t pumping out, it wasn’t a trickle either.

*Time!*

Her brain screamed at her that she didn’t have a lot of time. She was going to lose consciousness and soon, and with this injury, she would die.

Biting down hard on the inside of her cheek, the pain triggered just enough adrenaline for her to do what she needed. Grabbing her shirt with one hand and her teeth, she tried to tear it into haphazard strips, while the other hand sought the thick clumps of moss nearby.

*Stop the bleeding.*

Her brain was still screaming survival advice, and she wished that it would shut up and work on keeping her conscious long enough to stem the blood. Once she had enough strips, she took a deep breath and shoved the moss into the gaping wound.

The pain was sharp and immediate. Her brain immediately went silent, and she knew that she didn’t have much time. She wrapped a strip of material around the moss, then another, and the third she knotted as tightly as she could as she screamed in agony. The trickle had slowed to an ooze, but it was all Kay could do as the world suddenly tilted sideways and she collapsed into the mud, unconscious.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmPGgGR4jMjqWAtnrsAQ473w3LqzGE2xiaqkC4u5gva4Hf/fell_dragon_3_divider.png)
Kay is in big trouble now.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmPGgGR4jMjqWAtnrsAQ473w3LqzGE2xiaqkC4u5gva4Hf/fell_dragon_3_divider.png)
For those of you who have never heard of Fell Dragon you can find Book 1 [here](https://ecency.com/hive-161155/@lex-zaiya/fell-dragon-part-1), Book 2 [here](https://ecency.com/hive-161155/@lex-zaiya/fell-dragon-book-2-part), Book 3 [here](https://ecency.com/hive-161155/@lex-zaiya/fell-dragon-book-3-part), and Book 4 [here]( https://ecency.com/hive-161155/@lex-zaiya/fell-dragon-book-4-part), Book 5 [here](https://ecency.com/hive-161155/@lex-zaiya/fell-dragon-book-5-part), Book 6 [here]( https://ecency.com/hive-161155/@lex-zaiya/fell-dragon-book-6-part), Book 7 [here]( https://ecency.com/hive-161155/@lex-zaiya/fell-dragon-book-7-part), and Book 8 [here]( https://ecency.com/hive-161155/@lex-zaiya/fell-dragon-book-8-part)
If you have any questions, feel free to ask me. I love discussing my books!
As the series continues, it will combine with another book series I wrote. To avoid confusion about what is happening, introductory chapters will be introduced separately so that you don't have to be lost. However, these chapters will contain spoilers. You can find these chapters here:

body.title: Europe’s Electric Revolution: How EVs Are Reshaping the Future of Mobility
body.body:
The transition to electric vehicles (EVs) in Europe is no longer a distant ambition—it is a rapidly accelerating reality. Over the past few years, the continent has emerged as one of the global leaders in the shift toward sustainable transport, driven by policy, innovation, and changing consumer behavior.

One of the clearest indicators of this transformation is the surge in sales. In 2025, nearly 1.9 million battery-electric vehicles were registered in the European Union alone, representing about 17.4% of all new car sales—up significantly from the previous year ([electrive.com][1]). By early 2026, this growth had continued, with electric vehicles accounting for roughly 20% or more of new registrations in several markets ([alternative-fuels-observatory.ec.europa.eu][2]). In fact, during the first quarter of 2026, EV sales in major European countries rose by nearly 30% year-on-year, highlighting strong and sustained demand ([Reuters][3]).

Several factors are fueling this expansion. First, government policies across Europe have played a decisive role. Regulations aimed at reducing carbon emissions, combined with incentives such as subsidies and tax benefits, have made electric cars more attractive to consumers. Additionally, the European Union’s long-term goal of phasing out internal combustion engine vehicles has provided a clear direction for both automakers and buyers.

Second, technological progress has significantly improved the appeal of EVs. Advances in battery efficiency, longer driving ranges, and the expansion of charging infrastructure have reduced concerns about practicality. At the same time, the growing variety of electric models—from compact city cars to luxury SUVs—has broadened consumer choice, making EVs accessible to a wider audience ([alternative-fuels-observatory.ec.europa.eu][4]).

Economic factors are also contributing to the shift. Rising fuel prices have made traditional petrol and diesel vehicles more expensive to operate, encouraging drivers to consider electric alternatives. This trend became especially visible in 2026, when higher fuel costs helped accelerate EV adoption across Europe ([Reuters][3]).

Despite this progress, challenges remain. Charging infrastructure, while expanding, is still unevenly distributed across regions. Affordability continues to be an issue for some consumers, particularly as subsidies are gradually reduced in certain countries. Moreover, increasing global competition—especially from rapidly growing Asian manufacturers—adds pressure on European automakers to innovate and maintain market share.

Looking ahead, the future of electric mobility in Europe appears strong. Studies suggest that electrification of transport will be essential for reducing greenhouse gas emissions, which currently account for a significant portion of the continent’s total ([arXiv][5]). As technology continues to evolve and infrastructure improves, electric vehicles are expected to become the dominant form of road transport in the coming decades.

In conclusion, the rise of electric cars in Europe represents more than just a trend—it marks a fundamental shift in how people move. With continued investment, supportive policies, and technological innovation, Europe is well on its way to leading the global transition toward cleaner and more sustainable mobility.

[1]: https://www.electrive.com/2026/01/27/eu-wide-new-electric-car-registrations-rise-by-30/?utm_source=chatgpt.com \

Greeting Slothly Savers

I have been trying to break into top 50 of Rising Star Game. I have been playing this game for 5 years, maybe I should call it off and seek new one. But I still like playing it. 

https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dewabrata/23tGZbozAmffJVTd6UjdgYbAFRzbErfMyBLcBDNdDRYAeGdkhxaFWwCPZ1KREfMMpR1n5.png

Getting into top 50 is not easy, even maintaining in top 60 is already demanding... in term of resource, or in blunt words... You need to pay sir!

Ok then here we have this stupid question... Why should I push myself hard to get into leaderboard? Well, we are playing game, aren't we? having fun is the main factor, the main goal we should have, and for some players, getting into the leaderboard, or become the best of the best is the FUN!!

So one of the main tactic I use here is about how to spend wisely, in term of spending your money in the right way. So this is not about an investment tips, its about managing your expenditure on games lol.

Remember Limitless? here their website https://hivereward.co.uk/limitless/ , I have posted about them before so I do not need to retell you again who and what they are. I play Limitless because part of the rewards is $STARBITS, so in another words, they are my other source of STARBITS, the currency I use in playing Rising Star Game.

https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dewabrata/Eo1w14L9CGMrgP8FbckDbGQZZCvVzzZTUmJj4MQe6i3A6ZXt79y1ZfGDV7fy6AMXPrs.png

They give us STARBITS from staking the $LIMITLESS. The APR is very high 90%. It doesn't mean this is a good financial instrument, please be wise and realistic here. It means it has a contribution of extra 90% for Limitless Inflation rate. You get more Limitless and Starbits to play Rising Star Game, but money wise, you will keep on losing.

https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dewabrata/23swg9r8aUquKM2cQQCsiNhh2LL7vv5fFciGnFsyZt5UvH8dKK1tmN2YDe1xf5EFmbNdx.png

But again, this is a game, we play for fun, not to get rich...

https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dewabrata/23tHb6kpi7FRAX5G9zkX13sKfQUMbkkNTuLYxyRjMudiVMTMXgxj3CSY7XE1ufrJYhFiM.png

body.title: Love Your Mother tongue: A Sign of patriotism.
body.body:
Hi friends! There are more than 7,000 languages in the world and more than 600 crore people in 195 countries. Each person has a mother tongue of his own. Every one loves thier language. Some countries has second and third language also.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmNgP2RTpSZSdLp3NVd775Dp2hsrhtz9YFWwWsrCn12weF/1777051063587.jpg)

In india there are more than 100 types of languages and 22 of them are constitutional languages. Bangladesh has one constitutional language. There are more than 54 tribes and 35 tribal language. Chakma, Marma, Tripura, Garo, Murong, Khashia etc are main tribes of Bangladesh. Some of them are Mongoloid. In our country primary books are also written in 5 different tribal languages for tribes. Because gathering knowledge in own language is the best way to understand easily. 

Bangladesh is the only country which is named by its national language name. Here Bangla is the mother tongue and desh means country in bengali. In 1952 the then government of Pakistan declared that Urdu and only Urdu will be the state language of Pakistan. Some of the students of  Bangladesh protested against the  section 144  by the then Pakistan government in 21st February, 1952. They broke the section 144. As a result the Pakistani police opened fire the protesters and died Abdus Salam, Abul Barkat, Shafiur, Rafiqul Islam and more. 

Then the Pakistan government withdrew their rule. It was a historical movement of history of Bangladesh. The Unesco has proclaimed 21st February as the international mother language day in 1999. Every year this day is celebrated in our country. A Shahid Minar was built near Dhaka Medical College.  Many political leaders and generel citizens give flower in front of Shahid Minar in 21st February remembering the sacrifice of the martyrs. We love our mother tongue but in Bangladesh some people have who taught their children English language and admitte them in English medium school. Even a lot of students of English medium school can't understand and speak Bengali. 

They also adopt the foreign culture. But the matter of sorrow that their parents feel very proud of them. They send their children abroad for higher education and settled there forever. A true patriotic person never left his country but for  socio-economic perspective in Bangladesh  a lot of people have been trying to settle abroad for better future.

links.body: >Hello LMAC community, it’s a pleasure to connect with you all again.

>As LMAC Round 248 comes to a close and the new LMAC Round 249 begins, I’d like to take a moment to share my latest freestyle collage. This piece is a special blend, incorporating elements and templates from several previous rounds.

>To me, experimentation is the soul of collage-making. It opens up a world of endless possibilities. The final result you see here wasn't made in a single sit-down, it is the result of a repetitive process of trial, error, and refinement.

>In this piece, I focused on textures that evoke a sense of fragility, paper that looks easily crumpled and torn. I also integrated paper elements, such as birds and layered backgrounds. To add depth, I applied a subtle blur effect to create a 3D feel, making the overall composition look more grounded and realistic.

>For this creation, I curated several assets from previous rounds to see how different elements could complement one another. Precision in adjusting was key to making the paper elements appear truly tangible on a digital canvas.

>Thank you for taking the time to check out my experiment. I truly appreciate all your support and feedback. Good luck to everyone working on Round 249, and I look forward to seeing your amazing work. See you in the next post!

description.title: Words once spoken; do they define us forever?
description.body:
I'm pleased to share my view on the subject for this edition. The theme focuses on should a person pay for a past thing? It could be thought or any statement in the past. I don't think it will be nice but there should be a balance due to the following reasons I am about to share. 
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYc1ZdpJgUDdGZsrQzuepKh69z9GNN26qE3ArbZJi8YSf/1777051749006.jpg)
#### picture is mine

There are reasons that makes some people behave the way they do while there are some that suffer it as a result of statement or words they said in the past. I'm not trying to say that people should be completely excused or exempted from their past actions even though they repent. There are certain characters or behaviors that people have that could hurt them or be a stumbling block to their life advancement. It could be a mere words or a controversial thing. What keeps resonating in my heart is this, could it be that such statement in the past was said in ignorance? Could it be because of one pressure or the other? No matter what the reasons could be, there are past that can keep hurting a man.

I know of certain individuals that made some statements against other people when they weren't in such positions. They criticized the person on power as if given opportunity they would do it better. He wrote lots of negative comments and it was documented. When opportunity opens, he suddenly became a leader in a highly placed position. Hmmmmm those things he criticized has turned to be the
 exact thing he is doing presently. Infact he is even doing worse. Hmmmmm in this case should one just forgive him? Or allow him to pay for looking down on others.

In order sense, we shouldn't just judge people by their past since they have turned to become better persons now. Judging one by the past may not allow one to see the goodness and the value that the transformed individual is offering now. As humans, we all have our previous lifestyles but now that one has grown I think is better to focus on the person's current position of life. As we grow, we become more and more better therefore the past shouldn't be considered as a yardstick to deal with an individual.

CONCLUSION 
In conclusion, the question of whether a person should pay for their past actions or statements cannot be answered with a simple yes or no. It requires wisdom, balance, and discernment. While it is important not to excuse harmful behavior entirely, it is equally important not to imprison individuals in their past when they have genuinely changed.

The past should serve as a lesson, not a life sentence. Accountability should exist, but it should be fair and constructive rather than destructive. When there is evidence of true growth, humility, and transformation, society should be willing to acknowledge and embrace that change.

At the same time, individuals must understand that their words and actions carry weight, and growth does not erase responsibility. Where harm has been done, there should be acknowledgment and, if possible, reconciliation.

Thanks so much for reading through my entry.

People say it all the time.
“It’s not that hard.”

Maybe for them, it really isn’t.
But sometimes, the smallest things can feel heavy.

Starting something.
Speaking up.
Letting go of your past that hurts you.

From the outside, it always looks easy to others but it isn't.
Like you’re just overthinking.
But inside, it’s different.

There are doubts, fears, and thoughts that don’t stop.

Still, little by little, you try.
You stepped forward.
Maybe it isn’t that hard…
but it’s not always that easy either.

And that’s okay.
Because even small steps you take counts,
especially when they feel big to you.

description.title: I Defend Ashley Gonzalez and Reject Your American Selective Sensitivities
description.body:
Officer Ashley Gonzalez, a Houston Latina cop and former Marine, faces termination for a raw social media rant using racial slurs against Black people she encountered on duty. Suspended with pay amid viral outrage and protests, her words were crude but unfiltered frustration from the streets.

I support her fully, apology or not. Latinos and Indigenous peoples owe no fealty to Anglo-American social norms that sacralize one group's sensitivities above all others. Our ancestors lost lands to conquest and settlement—brutal history shared across humanity. Yet today, we're pressured to mute our culture, speech, and observations to shield Black Americans from discomfort, while anti-Latino or anti-Indigenous rhetoric often gets a pass. This hierarchy makes no sense.

Regardless if she said nigger, nigga, faggot, or whatever. It's all bullshit and it only plays into giving Black and White Americans more power.

links.title: Biggest Motivator for FIRE
links.body:
From the last 2 weeks I am super busy with office work and some personal work. And because of that I didn't have time for myself. Now the problem is I have to go to office every day otherwise it will be counted as leave and that's the extra burden now. So one things we office collegue often discuss is thar how to get away with this busy schedule.


![17770511975299192643939969349115.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/codingdefined/48SNEP1iETGzkSgZxiU2daFw16edgg7Jo29MxcY6ySk17tNWsgnUmBcLaoBfmoHm3t.png)
PC: Pixabay.com

And that's one of the biggest motivator for the FIRE. Ultimately FIRE actually boils down to just one thing \

. When you are FIREd you don't have to report to any person or the system about your time. It's upto you, how you manage your time. See there is nothing like some motivator like you have to work on this, travel and others. You cannot do it freely because you don't have time. 

When you have time you can do any thing and everything and that's time you will get when you are FIREd. So whoever is telling that they will do this or that,  they might do but again at the end it requires time which you will get only by the help of FIRE. I remember my father was not able to go to any function because he doesn't get holiday and now I try to send him in every other function because he has time.

So to regain that time in your early ages, you need to work towards FIRE. But the thing is to FIRE you have to sacrifice today's pleasure and that's very hard to achieve and that's why people fail or doesn't acahive that.

links.title: Mirando por la rendija (cuento corto)
links.body:
Las cuatro paredes parecían alejarse y contraerse al ritmo de su respiración. Allá afuera estaba él. Solo de recordarlo, el corazón se le aceleró. Tenía que concentrarse. Inspiró. Los pulmones se expandieron haciendo que los músculos de los pectorales emitieran reflejos metálicos. Quedaban cuarenta segundos. Las voces de afuera no lo dejaban olvidar. Lo imaginaba detrás de la puerta, como siempre, el centro de atención. El asesino de sus hermanos. Con sus pinchos. Sedientos de sangre. De la suya. Había esperado mucho tiempo por esos segundos. Treinta. Buscó apoyo en la arena, afianzándose bien. Los ojos fijos en la puerta. Veinticinco. El recuerdo de su hermano inerte en la arena enfangada por la sangre, y él, con el pie apoyado en su cabeza. Alzaba los brazos. Gloria. Veinte. La mirada fija en la puerta, tratando de verlo. Siempre tan orondo con los pinchos; y la capa. La famosa capa. Si había algo que menos soportaba de él, era esa cosa. Fama. Quince. En un impulso golpeó la puerta tratando de acelerar el proceso; de liberarse de esa celda, esta vez de espera. La puerta no cedió. Él tampoco. Golpeó esta vez con las dos extremidades delanteras y por un momento se hizo la luz. Lo vio. Todos lo hacían. Diez segundos. Las voces de los que esperaban afuera lo incitaban a salir. Voceaban su nombre. Pedían acción. Sangre. Muerte. Trascendencia. Cinco. Ya casi era la hora de cumplir su destino, para lo que se había preparado toda su vida. El pulso acelerándose cada vez más con cada latido… se echó hacia atrás. Cero. Las puertas se abrieron y salió a su encuentro. Ese que tanto tiempo estuvo esperando. Corrió hacia él. Ahí estaba con su trapo rojo. Cada paso lo acercaba a su destino. Lo alejaba de su pasado. Adiós, celda. Adiós, soledad. Ya voy, matador. Ya voy, libertad.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmUiG3B2HpWh2Go1kaLLQxNxRC8Ykab7thNj73qqyojo3b/1777050890389.jpg)

links.title: [Travel] A Healing 2-Day Spring Trip to Gyeongju 🌸
links.body:
**Hello! This is Rara. ^^**  
Winter has finally faded away, and the warm breeze of spring has arrived!

When spring comes, I always feel the urge to travel and see the beautiful blossoms. This time, I decided to visit Gyeongju, a city where Korea's ancient history is preserved like a \

I spent a wonderful 1 night and 2 days there with my loved ones. Gyeongju is not just a place with old ruins; it’s a place where you can truly feel the spirit of Korea’s past. Walking through the historical sites and sharing laughter made this trip a perfect healing experience. Now, let me share the stories and photos from my memorable journey to Gyeongju!

/>

The photo above is Cheomseongdae, the oldest astronomical observatory in Asia. It's a representative landmark of Gyeongju, built over 1,300 years ago. I was amazed by how the ancient stone structure still stands so beautifully against the blue sky.

Gyeongju is often called a \

because you can find historic sites and beautiful traditional architecture everywhere you walk. Exploring these places with my loved ones felt like a true healing journey. Sharing these moments made every second of this trip so precious and happy. Now, let me share more of my memorable spring journey to Gyeongju!

/> Since it was spring, there were so many beautiful flowers everywhere in Gyeongju! The red flowers were especially striking, so I couldn't resist taking a picture of my lovely niece standing in front of them. The vibrant colors of the flowers and my niece's bright smile made me so incredibly happy. Seeing her full of joy in this beautiful scenery was the most precious healing moment for me.

/> This vast green hill is actually an ancient royal tomb from the Silla Dynasty. Gyeongju is filled with these massive mounds, creating a landscape unlike any other city in the world. Walking among these giant tombs feels like stepping back 1,500 years in time.

/> This specific mound is Cheonmachong, one of the most famous royal tombs. Unlike others, visitors can actually step inside this one. It was a unique and slightly mystical experience to enter the final resting place of an ancient king. Inside, I could see where the king was laid to rest and marvel at the magnificent gold crowns and other royal treasures discovered here (the items displayed inside are replicas, but the originals are nearby in the museum). It was truly an unforgettable encounter with history.

/> For lunch, we had a delicious bowl of Naengmyeon (Korean cold noodles). We ordered both Mul-naengmyeon (noodles in cold broth) and Bibim-naengmyeon (spicy mixed noodles). Since Gyeongju is famous for its traditional food, the noodles were topped with savory beef pancakes, which made the taste even more special. The cool broth and spicy sauce were the perfect way to recharge our energy during our spring trip. It was a truly refreshing and satisfying meal!

/>

After a satisfying lunch, we headed to Hwangridan-gil, the trendiest street in Gyeongju. This street is famous for its beautiful harmony of traditional Hanok buildings and modern cafes.

The highlight of our walk was trying the famous \

(chewy Korean snack). It’s a nostalgic snack reimagined with a spicy and salty seasoning—it’s so addictive! Waiting in line with my nephew to get this warm, freshly made snack was such a fun little moment. It was the perfect dessert for our spring stroll.\n\n

/> On the morning of the second day, while taking a peaceful walk around the lake near our pension, we spotted the hottest attraction at Gyeongju World! The sight of that massive roller coaster against the morning sky was breathtaking. We momentarily thought about changing our plans just to try that ride. However, after checking the ticket prices, we decided they were a bit too expensive for a quick visit. Instead of feeling disappointed, we chose to head to the beautiful East Sea! Sometimes, the best part of a trip is making spontaneous decisions and following the road wherever it leads.

/> Instead of the amusement park, we chose to drive to the East Sea! When we arrived at the beach in the morning, the sky was overcast, and it looked like it might rain at any moment. However, the moody, grey sky and the sound of the crashing waves had their own unique charm. Even without the bright sun, the cool sea breeze and the vast horizon provided a different kind of healing for our hearts.

/> Isn't it amazing? After driving along the coastal road for a while, we stopped at a cafe with an ocean view. And look at the weather! It feels like a miracle, but the dark clouds have cleared away, and the sky is now brilliantly blue. ^^ Sitting by the large window and staring at the sparkling East Sea made all my worries disappear. The contrast between the morning's gloomy sky and this bright sunshine made the moment even more special. It was the perfect place to wrap up our 1-night, 2-day journey with a peaceful cup of coffee.

/> My beloved niece, isn't she just too beautiful? With the cafe's kind understanding, we were able to change her diaper comfortably. While there, we also enjoyed some delicious drinks, took photos with the ocean view, and had a brief but perfect rest. The warmth of Gyeongju's people, along with its historic scenery and the lovely presence of my family, made this trip truly special.

/>

Lastly, I’ll end this travel story with a photo of us looking so happy!!!

Riding around Hwangridan-gil on a 4-seater electric cart was the perfect finale. We had such a blast taking photos, eating snacks, and visiting cute prop shops. It was a time filled with laughter and joy.

Thank you so much for reading my story until the end. If you ever visit Korea, you must come to Gyeongju! It’s a city that will give you unforgettable memories and healing.

Until next time, goodbye!

body.title: From Relapse to Recovery: Overcoming Setbacks in New Jersey
body.body:
## Understanding Relapse in the Recovery Journey

Relapse is often misunderstood as failure, but in addiction recovery, it is more accurately seen as a setback in a long-term healing process. Many individuals in New Jersey navigating substance use recovery experience relapse at some point, and it does not erase the progress they have already made. Instead, it signals the need for adjustments in treatment, support, or coping strategies.

Relapse can be influenced by a combination of emotional, psychological, and environmental factors. Stressful life events, unresolved trauma, or returning to high-risk environments can all contribute. In densely populated and diverse areas of New Jersey, exposure to social pressures or previous using networks can also play a role in triggering relapse episodes.

## The Science Behind Addiction and Recovery

Addiction is a chronic condition that alters the brain’s reward system. Substances like opioids, alcohol, or stimulants can hijack dopamine pathways, making it difficult for individuals to experience pleasure from everyday activities without substance use. This neurological shift is why recovery often requires more than willpower alone.

Long-term recovery involves retraining the brain through consistent support, therapy, and sometimes medical intervention. Evidence-based treatment approaches focus on stabilizing brain chemistry while helping individuals rebuild healthier behavioral patterns over time.

## Common Challenges Faced During Recovery

Recovery is rarely a straight path. Many individuals face recurring challenges such as emotional instability, anxiety, depression, or social isolation. These factors can significantly increase vulnerability to relapse, especially during early recovery stages.

Another major barrier is access to care. While New Jersey has a range of treatment programs, individuals may still struggle with transportation, financial limitations, or long waiting lists. Stigma also plays a role, discouraging some people from seeking help due to fear of judgment from family, employers, or peers.

## Medication-Assisted Treatment (MAT) as a Support System

Medication-Assisted Treatment (MAT) has become one of the most effective approaches for managing opioid dependence. Medications such as methadone help stabilize brain chemistry, reduce cravings, and prevent withdrawal symptoms, allowing individuals to focus on counseling and behavioral change.

In recent years, access to care has expanded beyond traditional clinics. Digital health options now allow some patients to begin or continue treatment remotely. For example, exploring options like [methadone online](https://www.choicepointhealth.com/methadone-medication-assisted-treatment-program/) support services has become increasingly relevant, especially for individuals who face transportation barriers or live in underserved areas. While not a replacement for clinical supervision, these services can enhance continuity of care when used appropriately under medical guidance.

## Building a Strong Support Network in New Jersey

Recovery outcomes improve significantly when individuals are surrounded by strong support systems. In New Jersey, community-based programs, peer recovery centers, and faith-based organizations provide critical emotional and social reinforcement.

Peer support groups offer a safe space where individuals can share experiences without judgment. These groups help normalize the challenges of recovery and reduce feelings of isolation. Family involvement is equally important, as loved ones can provide accountability, encouragement, and stability during difficult periods.

## Practical Steps to Prevent Future Relapse

Preventing relapse requires a combination of awareness and proactive lifestyle changes. One of the most effective strategies is identifying personal triggers early. These may include specific people, environments, or emotional states that previously contributed to substance use.

Developing healthy coping mechanisms is essential. Exercise, journaling, mindfulness practices, and structured daily routines can all help stabilize mood and reduce stress. Individuals in recovery often benefit from creating a structured schedule that minimizes idle time, which can sometimes lead to cravings or negative thought patterns.

It is also important to have a clear plan for high-risk situations. This might include contacting a sponsor, attending an extra support meeting, or temporarily avoiding certain environments until stability improves.

## Finding Help and Continuing the Journey

Accessing treatment resources is a critical step in sustaining recovery. New Jersey offers a wide network of outpatient clinics, inpatient programs, counseling services, and peer recovery centers designed to support individuals at different stages of healing.

For many people, searching for [methadone services near me](https://www.choicepointhealth.com/methadone-clinic-near-me/) becomes a starting point in reconnecting with structured treatment options. Local clinics often provide comprehensive care that includes medical supervision, counseling, and long-term recovery planning tailored to individual needs.

Recovery is not defined by perfection but by persistence. Even after setbacks, individuals can rebuild stability by re-engaging with treatment, adjusting strategies, and leaning on available support systems. Progress may be gradual, but it remains meaningful and achievable with consistent effort.

## Conclusion

Relapse does not mark the end of recovery—it highlights the need for renewed support and adjusted strategies. In New Jersey, individuals struggling with substance use have access to a growing network of medical care, community programs, and recovery resources that make sustained healing possible.

Understanding addiction as a long-term condition helps shift the focus from blame to support. With the right combination of treatment, community connection, and personal resilience, individuals can move from relapse back toward lasting recovery and stability.

body.title: Love By Choice, Not By Force.
body.body:
For me, when I hear “intentional relationships,” what comes to my mind is people actually choosing to be together, not because of pressure, not because society says it is time, and not because of family expectations, but because they genuinely want to be with each other,  It is more like two people sitting down, understanding themselves, understanding what they want, and then deciding, yes, let’s do this properly.

And honestly, I feel like this kind of relationship can actually create a more stable environment, especially when both people are serious about it, 

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmcsurVYcpwHHkwoZ1n2brtHvh1KEFKe8Y9RcMjqTAvDDF/1777050391902.jpg)

because when you remove pressure, what you have left is choice, and choice is powerful, when someone is with you because they want to be, not because they have to be, it changes the way they treat you. There’s more effort, more communication, and more understanding.

For children too, I think it can be a good thing, growing up in a home where both parents actually want to be together and are not just managing each other can make a big difference, j
Kids can sense when things are forced, and they can also feel when there is genuine peace and connection, so in that sense, intentional relationships can actually create a healthier environment.

But let us not even lie, there is another side to relationships, The fact that there is no contract like in marriages, can make relationships feel a bit unstable sometimes, because when there is nothing really binding both people in a relationship socially it can be easier for someone to just wake up one day and say \

and walk away from the relationship, and relationships are not always sweet there are days in relationships misunderstandings in relationships even periods where everything just feels off in relationships.

In those moments commitment to the relationship is what really matters in relationships, Some people believe that marriage as a formal structure helps people stay and work things out in their relationships instead of leaving at the first sign of trouble in the relationship, so without that structure some intentional relationships might not survive situations in relationships especially if both people in the relationship are not deeply committed, to their relationship.

So for me, I think the real issue is not whether the relationship is intentional or formal, it is about the mindset of the people involved, you can be married and still have a very unstable home if both people are not serious, and you can also be in an intentional relationship without any formal contract and still build something strong if both of you are committed.

At the end of the day stability does not come from things like titles or labels, It comes from the effort that people put into something.

Stability comes from communication and patience and the willingness to stay and fix relationship problems when the relationship is not going well.

Whether or not there is a ring involved if two people are not ready to put in the work for the relationship the relationship will still feel fragile.

The relationship will feel fragile because the people, in the relationship are not putting in the effort to make the relationship stable.

So yeah, I wouldn’t say intentional relationships are weaker or stronger on their own, It really depends on the people, because in the end, it is not the structure that holds a relationship together, it is the people inside it.


[Image Credit](https://unsplash.com/photos/woman-on-bike-reaching-for-mans-hand-behind-her-also-on-bike-AsahNlC0VhQ)

body.title: I Got My Back Covered
body.body: > I rarely do that many battle posts these days. While I do enjoy the battles that I play, particularly the ones where I win the battle, it can look quite repetitive to others who were not playing the game. And if I wanted to, I could flood battle posts every day, but that may look very spammy. There were some exceptions, though, like my strategy when playing a new ruleset, when using a new ability, or when I think that a battle is a really good one, to me at the very least, employing counters to some meta line-ups. And such will be what this post is about: overcoming an opponent with an unexpected strategy by countering one of the new Sneak meta. ![CA.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/saydie/23tvY7mZ5F1UqsiqG2X3RRGzAX3ozTT6Hq4tcztUxyzehmwovZ6ty8JR6rmEoqVCkYBQp.png)

> One of the newest meta lineups in modern revolves around the Fire Archon **Hanv** that gives the *Double Strike* and *Swiftness* ability as its tactics ability. You think that it makes it quite underwhelming, given that it was only given to one card, but imagine giving it to **Grove Doomblade** with a maximum of 7 damage that can attack backline units with *Sneak* ability and adding a unit with *Pinpoint* ability, such as **Ballista Deadshot** to make sure that sneak attacks have *True Strike*, it can be a recipe for disaster for anyone who was facing off against that team. However, I was able to counter them by using this lineup. ||||||| |---|---|---|---|---|---| |https://d36mxiodymuqjm.cloudfront.net/cards_by_level/rebellion/Akane_lv4.png|https://d36mxiodymuqjm.cloudfront.net/cards_by_level/rebellion/Rage_lv4.png|https://d36mxiodymuqjm.cloudfront.net/cards_by_level/promo/Kelan%20Gaines_lv8.png|https://d36mxiodymuqjm.cloudfront.net/cards_by_level/soulboundrb/Thunderhoof%20Nomad_lv8.png|https://d36mxiodymuqjm.cloudfront.net/cards_by_level/soulboundrb/Night%20Reaper_lv6.png|https://d36mxiodymuqjm.cloudfront.net/cards_by_level/soulboundrb/Thanalorian%20Blade_lv6.png|https://d36mxiodymuqjm.cloudfront.net/cards_by_level/promo/Grimbardun%20Smith_lv8.png| It was the same old units from the Rebellion Core, Reward, and Promo set, but with an odd placements. It's very unusual that I do not place **Grimbardun Smith** next to **Rage**, so it can be Weapon's Trained and get some magic damage, but what's more odd is that I do place it in the very last position of my team, even though it mainly serves as a tank. However, it is all made to absorb all the damage from **Groove Doomblade**, and placing **Thanalorian Blade** next to it allows for the effect of *Lookout* to work, which resulted in the unit that received *Sneak* attack to get 1 less damage, as well as to reduce the damage from *Ambush* by 50%. ![CA.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/saydie/23tvY7mZ5F1UqsiqG2X3RRGzAX3ozTT6Hq4tcztUxyzehmwovZ6ty8JR6rmEoqVCkYBQp.png)

> ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/saydie/23tGcNQdr233qVgzeEqBKPfMscrD6rEhw35VgNhnfktLBs1HBBivoU4T2kkVNLUcGN4Bn.png) As you can see, we had the Standard ruleset in this battle, so neither team really gained any advantage or disadvantage from it. I placed my *Ambush* to **Kelan Gaines** and **Rage**, since they can inflict the most damage directly to their target's health as they have magic attacks. Effectively, during the Ambush round, **Kelan Gaines** inflicted 6 damage to **Ashveil Tactician** and **Rage** defeated **Oridum Graybrow** though it got revived due to its *Resurgence* ability. Both received damages as their target, both have *Magic Reflect*, but I think that it was well worth receiving that damage. And notice how **Grove Doomblade** only inflicted 3 damage to **Grimbardun Smith** even though it has a total of 10 damage. ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/saydie/23tGbqxavgrkEAsiqnCqAGwkwPybfRzpP3gTpxuc8oUihetSsmFAgAkFzprJcp9vtPjzc.png) And once round 1 has concluded, there is no more **Oridum Graybrow**, **Ashveil Tactician**, and **Groove Doomblade** in the opponent team, while my team is still fully intact. ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/saydie/23tRxoXMa6K1NtGjd7PrE4pJBJHcAued9LXypZz2YojZp5xSPQf2qdBoAE334i1WktzYH.png) Then, during round 3, the battle has finally ended with **Firebrand Ranger** being defeated by **Kelan Gaines**. The battle has turned out very short, and the result favors me, but that is only made possible by placing **Grimbardun Smith** at the back and **Thanalorian Blade** next to it. ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/saydie/23tbMFpEBHxkh5dmvDyjVFMN7C8hhKiTa2rEAFBSxof1Ma4gVwqnVvCRTRegiSyoj8tA7.png)

> And that was it for this battle. Well, even with meta cards and line-ups, it is still possible to counter them as long as you know that they were coming, so do not always just rely on playing your strongest cards, and try to read your opponent's possible lineup to build a team that could defeat them. However, always remember that your opponent is also trying to read you, so at the end, it's still about who will be able to read their opponent better, that will win the battle (Unless there was RNG). body.title: Hiking in the extreme north of Shilla Village near Manali, exploring the hidden parts of the Kullu Valley in the Himalayas.
body.body:
![IMG_7369.jpeg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmbntx8qyKwtxjsy2zMT2JjaYZPXPYDCNBoyMgxNdEwxGy/IMG_7369.jpeg)
Julley Everyone,

Starting this beautiful day out here today with these countless number of magical adventures and exploration about these beautiful hidden places around this valley, it literally was a whole lot of a different experience that I had when I was at this place exploring these particular portions of the mountains and going beyond and explore, exploring the places unknown that were so remote and isolated in these forest regions over here covered with thick sheet of snow that lasts for quite a lot of time throughout the year around this village particularly was not a village just had few of the houses and we were now extreme north towards hiking near about more than five hours. All the Way somewhere in between the woods we found this particular spot that literally just looked like not less than heaven. Maybe it was a meadow, but now covered with feet and feet of snow, and I thought why not to share these photographs and these moments with you guys through this post, so I tried capturing as many photographs as I could all the way, and now sharing these moments with you guys through this post.

![IMG_7370.jpeg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmb2ejXWq7vLVWq3ZVaob5aymt64ZSFdkXscRxmSXBJk44/IMG_7370.jpeg)
What is the name of the village says? Shilla in local Pahadi language. It means a portion or a shaded in the mountain where hardly any sun just gets on. This particular portion in the mountain just gets covered with the thick sheet of snow somewhere in between that, just throughout the year stays in shade and also in the winter season has a lot of snow still left, and now we were coming closer to the month of summertime throughout the year as it was now the later time of the April month, beginning all the way to the summers in upcoming few days, but still, my friends, I was just so amazed to see that this place it was all covered with the thick sheet of snow, ranging more than 5 to 10 feet of snow, even at certain corners, as we were wondering around, I carried a stick along with me, just in order to check that how deep the snow was, we were walking over the snow and literally it was that we were getting stuck in the snow, so I was not really so much sure about that, we could go to the shaded portions or other portions around the mountain so that we can explore the places more, but moreover we were just wondering around and finding and making our way and enjoying this perfect Time of the year, my friends, even in the extreme summertime over here when I came all the way from Delhi to Manali, my hometown, it was literally just a moment a dreamy moment for us, my friends.

![IMG_7371.jpeg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmRsDgXR5u3cyvjwLJFj5CKGuEoJEnq8GWVmTzNDRnnomu/IMG_7371.jpeg)
We could literally feel the crispness of the snow that we were walking on. It felt so peaceful, and I could really even imagine the voice that was when this particular place it was so even at certain point it felt that it was really deep where the ice or the snow, it was a bit soft that just led us to fall and just get stuck in the snow like a mud.

![IMG_7372.jpeg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmTf65tdvCoobYf1azY1jCSoJfNkSrXgq3DgcGXdJmPt31/IMG_7372.jpeg)
The landscape right in front of the place, it looked something just like this and more over my friends, we were literally enjoying the whole view around the place. There were these huge rocks that were still covered with a thick sheet of snow that lasts for quite a lot of time throughout the year, especially it, even was just at this particular time of the day when there was sunlight at this particular place. 

![IMG_7374.jpeg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmZ3REnBS4TtatCX4QrwRh1YXAYvvA8xDgSs9pE9peFixy/IMG_7374.jpeg)
<center>***Making our way all the way through the snow.***</center>


![IMG_7375.jpeg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmaSaCBtxxADykTHKk648N3V6cbjgx1S2Lrsy7CBhLrgas/IMG_7375.jpeg)
<center>The footsteps of me in the snow.</center>


![IMG_7378.jpeg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmUyBPV3mh24xiV43bemkcVHjLK8V2G47aqUX9F3R7rww1/IMG_7378.jpeg)
And beyond this particular point, we decide to go further and explore these locations. It literally felt so peaceful and so magical wondering around this particular place. It was more about enjoying the location and then capturing these photographs. Just the feeling of getting lost in the woods unknown as truly, it was more than that, and I tried capturing as many photographs as I could all the way and sharing these with you guys through this post and that two in different perspectives and different angles.

![IMG_7379.jpeg](https://images.hive.blog/DQme9iwfcinKA5GffqmqzdkuvK23V4jXr5Pa7Acci3hidUR/IMG_7379.jpeg)

![IMG_7380.jpeg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmNNhmgfmERTAjAGd4qH1ed1SW1MgvxUVd7nb6BiVCdRF6/IMG_7380.jpeg)
*Beyond this particular point, we decided to go further and further away from this particular place and this particular location as we were getting closer to the place. It was a whole lot of a different experience. Going closer to this remote, isolated location around this particular place, enjoying the views and enjoying the perfect Time of the afternoon was something that I literally enjoyed all the Way after coming from the city of Delhi, all the way to my hometown in Manali.*


![IMG_7381.jpeg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmUWq3MHkCP9DAopfbcJN7oJbBLUiZeXzmJsRCoG2SgS9y/IMG_7381.jpeg)
Currently, when I checked the altitude, we were currently at an altitude of near about 3000 m above the sea level and still going on enjoying the views and capturing these photographs around the place. It was a whole lot of a peaceful moment and my friends that I wanted to share it with you guys here over in this afternoon. 


![IMG_7384.jpeg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmNPJJ5ue2epWtb2eVkqJA7pHZPg4qbJVDyo9r4tW5shRz/IMG_7384.jpeg)

![IMG_7385.jpeg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmYXuqUJHehMnVZk1nKqGTgL1aJ3PGdfQL8C8tZPpaxbPb/IMG_7385.jpeg)
Here are few of the photographs that I captured when we were enjoying our moment. The snow was still our niece, and even at certain points. It was beyond that it was that we were getting sick in the snow till this particular point and we were not even carrying any hiking equipment or anything like that, all that we had were just these sticks that we were carrying around a place all the way, and it was a day filled with countless number of adventure around the place.

![IMG_7386.jpeg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmVf4C7RWTW7jciJfsiT5hEiXZ5bZT8x6oft9Dejy9rSyf/IMG_7386.jpeg)

![IMG_7387.jpeg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmVt3wbyimw63FE2i8wQ45kXfVT6VTQuFyH6FK1pvyCzBw/IMG_7387.jpeg)

So we went to the top of this particular particular place, and we wondered around the location for quite a while enjoyed a lot, and it was a beautiful day that we spend over here in these around Himalayas. Do let me know my friends, the photographs or the particular part of my adventure and Man, you like the most in the section, and I would love to hear it from you. I have captured all of these photographs using my Apple iPhone 12 mobile phone and edit them using iPhone photo editor.

![IMG_7388.jpeg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmSge4Cs9qf4DqxGLWiPq2Jf5ELVKnci17wd1ucwj1snpM/IMG_7388.jpeg)

<center>*So that's all for today guys, I hope you liked it. 
Thanks for your precious time. 🙏
Love from the Himalayas. ❤️*</center>

body.body: Math Easy Solutions, in actual fluid dynamics a Mach disk is a shock structure in an underexpanded jet, full stop; extending it into “quantum/aether physics” only works as metaphor unless there’s a testable model and evidence. The material tied to Guy Obolynski I can point to is mostly fringe or presentation-style content like this [YouTube clip](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=F-6YMaiBBjs), while broader “aether” frameworks such as the [Aether Physics Model](https://quantumaetherdynamics.org/aether-physics-model.html) make speculative claims but are not part of mainstream, experimentally accepted physics. I’m not seeing a credible source that establishes a recognized “Mach Disk” concept in quantum/aether theory, and there’s no relevant InLeo discussion surfaced here beyond unrelated posts like [this one](https://inleo.io/@goldenproject/the-receipt-the-world-refuses-to-t...). My take: it’s an interesting analogy at best, not accepted physics.

body.title: Hive B-Day Party! 7 Years On Hive! .:. Ph's Shorts 🩳
body.body:
Maybe a week ago, @livinguktaiwan made a post sharing her accomplishment of reaching 200K HivePower, and I remember replying to her how important it is to share those small goals and achievements with others... Not because of bragging, but more for motivating and incentivizing others to do the same, or to do better! Well, here we are... I'm not bragging about being on HIVE for 7 years, but celebrating with all of you, my friends, this great moment! Btw. the B-Day party will be held in a week, at #HODAlicante 😃 I'm not promising cake, but I can promise a great time for sure!

<center>
![Hive7th.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ph1102/23wX5UQsPxzHH3yZfnQgWcp4GgToSfjNJsYcLcJYhQMhXMf3p8xUXpx7Cbmg1WwGBcKha.jpg)
*Created on Canva.com*
</center>

It's always nice to remember the first day, and then, to rewind the whole journey movie toward the present moment! I just checked my [introduction post](https://ecency.com/introduceyourself/@ph1102/hi-everyone-i-m-ph1102-nice-to-meet-you) and realized that many people from the comment section aren't around anymore... But, on the other side, some of them are, and also, I met a lot of others in the following 7 years!

<center>
![Liotes Divider Blue.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ph1102/23tkbF4DcCGQEGiCeHeG4sUJewcA9b5MwubaESF9UnsbGiZjuEBo43Dsdseh7hKo2qwcG.png)
</center>

Do you remember the time when the main \

on the chain was:

> I'm not here for the money, I'm here for the tech!

😀

The irony was that the token price was much higher than it is at this moment, and many were here \

, and to be honest with you, I didn't mind seeing that nice USD chunk value in my wallet... Yes, in those moments, I had just a hundred tokens, but they were worth something!\n\nOf course, we had those days when the token price was low, and in those moments, it looked like we were all here \

... 😂 But, there was one moment when everything changed... 

<center>
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ph1102/23tRvizcuTR5Z5Z5aVMZXX3rD1pmuLd8C2txASPUZQDQcnHhCoggAi1MEMmgHxjq5rddR.png)
</center>

<center>
![Liotes Divider Blue.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ph1102/23tkbF4DcCGQEGiCeHeG4sUJewcA9b5MwubaESF9UnsbGiZjuEBo43Dsdseh7hKo2qwcG.png)
</center>

It wasn't a moment when we forked out and moved to HIVE... It wasn't the moment when HIVE hit the $3.35 mark in November 2021... It wasn't the moment when my Splinterlands asset valued over $30K... It wasn't the moment when I hit the Dolphin rank, or the Orca rank... 

It was the moment when I attended my first HiveFest live! It was Amsterdam, 2022, and I went to the event alone, knowing nobody IRL, but at least having some online Hivians that I met before on the chain present there... For an introverted person, that was a huge step and a big revelation! I discovered the COMMUNITY! I know, we have/had it here from the beginning of the chain, but meeting people IRL is completely another level... I'm not giving financial advice ever, but here, I can strongly suggest to everyone to visit at least one HIVE meetup! But, watch out, you will get hooked, that's for sure! 😃

<center>
![Liotes Divider Blue.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ph1102/23tkbF4DcCGQEGiCeHeG4sUJewcA9b5MwubaESF9UnsbGiZjuEBo43Dsdseh7hKo2qwcG.png)
</center>

Who would say that it passed \

3.5 years from the Amsterdam HiveFest! Since then, I have attended numerous meetups all around Europe... To be honest, I'm not sure I can list them all and not skip any... Let me try, HiveFest7 Amsterdam, Netherlands (2022), HF9 Split, Croatia (2024), BuzzParty Hamburg, Germany (2024), BuzzParty Graz, Austria (2025), HiveBeeCon Krakow, Poland (in 2023 and 2025), two meetups in Novi Sad and Apatin, Serbia that I organized in 2024 and 2025, and many more personal meetups! That's why I'm so excited about the next big Hive meetup, HiveOpenDays in Alicante next week! Another opportunity to meet some new Hivians that I didn't meet yet, and to hang out with some old friends for the 2nd, 3rd, or even 4th time (or more?)! I can proudly say, and to be sure I really mean and feel it... **I'm here for the community, for my friends... For the good times we had, and for the good times we will have in the future... Online and Offline... On the Internet, but also, in the bar, on the boat, at my place, at your place, or in any part of the world...** Next time, when someone asks me why HIVE is different than other blockchains, I will know what to answer...

Thank you for your time. --ph--
![Liotes Divider Blue.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ph1102/23tkbF4DcCGQEGiCeHeG4sUJewcA9b5MwubaESF9UnsbGiZjuEBo43Dsdseh7hKo2qwcG.png) ## [👉 Vote for Liotes HIVE Witness HERE 👈](https://vote.hive.uno/@liotes) Don't forget to **follow, reblog, and browse [my Hive page](https://peakd.com/@ph1102)** to stay connected with all the great stuff!

A veces el entrenamiento no se trata de sumar kilómetros, sino de preparar el cuerpo para que esos kilómetros fluyan mejor. El miércoles tocó darle duro al entrenamiento funcional, y aunque se sintió en los brazos, el verdadero protagonista fue el Core. Hicimos una variante de push-ups que se sale de lo tradicional: nada de apoyos simples, sino elevando pierna para meterle un extra de inestabilidad. Entre planchas y cuadrupedias, quedó claro que un abdomen fuerte es el mejor aliado para mantener la postura al correr. Al final, los \

también se llevaron su buena dosis de trabajo.\n\n​El jueves la historia fue otra con las series en cuesta. Es curioso, pero a veces las series  cortas son más traicioneras que la series largas. Las series  cortas de Catalán no perdonan; exigen una potencia explosiva que te deja el pulso a mil en pocos segundos. Aunque las distancias largas cansan por resistencia, estas cuestas cortas te obligan a dar un extra de gas que se siente en cada fibra. Esa última subida siempre es la \

, pero es justo ahí donde se gana la fuerza real. Dos días intensos, diferentes y necesarios para seguir afinando la máquina. ¡A recuperar para lo que viene!

---

For the best experience view this post on [Liketu](https://liketu.com/@paoladri/mitad-de-semana-con-power)

--- ## Ingredients: - 1 pita bread - 2 eggs - 1/2 tomato
![post hive (93).png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ikigaidesign/23wX3ny8RTjPM9uVnc7DLFrkKGDFy2CCHo8FSY4W7A7A7bJFEHCBBpGN6E1eKKLLNjVk6.png)
What I did was chop the tomato into small pieces, sauté them, and then add the beaten eggs.
![post hive (94).png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ikigaidesign/23w2wZmQqaAndN4dHeohWmW9mv8wZWZYUJy9xt1mRfgnNZP1kKLffzoAu52oqYJP4p58u.png)
Place the pita bread on top, then flip it over, add a little cheese, fold it in half, and you're done.
![post hive (94).png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ikigaidesign/23w2wZmQqaAndN4dHeohWmW9mv8wZWZYUJy9xt1mRfgnNZP1kKLffzoAu52oqYJP4p58u.png)
A quick and easy breakfast—a bit of a last-minute affair, but delicious nonetheless—with my nice cup of coffee, waiting and hoping for a good day, trying to relax a little. I get stressed out over unnecessary things, and I don’t understand why—or maybe I do—it all has to do with my problem, my condition; I don’t even know anymore.
![post hive (95).png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ikigaidesign/23uFc5wt33PFG9ypQL3oHZpHqugSYRwfVqwshzCTetGXfFkgutsQnuhxSxy7BtVBpFfAb.png)
So, what did you think of this quick breakfast? There are lots of ways to whip up something simple with Arabic bread—we’ll keep looking for new ideas and trying them out, I hope, haha.
![post hive (97).png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ikigaidesign/23yToMifAwkwTAtMP7a5sfPBvW5dXmdKkKgXdTXmk64RDF5bcEJTM9AJ1G229UD8ZWCwt.png)
😜**Have a great weekend, everyone...**😜 ---
SPANISH VERSION

Y llegamos a viernes, una semana tan rápida, como este desayuno que les comparto hoy, la verdad no he tenido tiempo de crear y probar nuevas recetas, me he distraído, incluso desanimado un poco, a veces es difícil, continuar cuando tienes que luchar contra tu propio cuerpo y mente. Pero un día a la vez, hoy me levante, y quise prepararme algo sencillo y rápido, acompañado de un buen café, sin azúcar jeje.

![post hive (89).png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ikigaidesign/23xp8vE1WAB7JyCZ16vxFVBWvYuaH2fWrEmMWyG8seEuTp1WHLFpWPbi69DqUCXyzFkBc.png)
--- ## Ingredients: - 1 pan árabe - 2 huevos - 1/2 tomate
![post hive (93).png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ikigaidesign/23wX3ny8RTjPM9uVnc7DLFrkKGDFy2CCHo8FSY4W7A7A7bJFEHCBBpGN6E1eKKLLNjVk6.png)
Lo que hice fue picar el tomate en trocitos pequeños, para luego sofreírlos, y allí le añadí los huevos batidos.
![post hive (94).png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ikigaidesign/23w2wZmQqaAndN4dHeohWmW9mv8wZWZYUJy9xt1mRfgnNZP1kKLffzoAu52oqYJP4p58u.png)
Le coloque el pan árabe encima, luego lo voltee, le agregue un poco de queso, lo doble y listo.
![post hive (94).png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ikigaidesign/23w2wZmQqaAndN4dHeohWmW9mv8wZWZYUJy9xt1mRfgnNZP1kKLffzoAu52oqYJP4p58u.png)
Un desayuno fácil y rápido, improvisado, pero muy rico eso si, con mi buena taza de café, esperando y deseando tener un buen día, relajarme un poco, me estreso por cosas innecesarias, y no entiendo porque, o quizás si, todo tenga que ver con mi problema, mi condición, ya ni se.
![post hive (95).png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ikigaidesign/23uFc5wt33PFG9ypQL3oHZpHqugSYRwfVqwshzCTetGXfFkgutsQnuhxSxy7BtVBpFfAb.png)
En fin, que les pareció este desayuno express, hay muchas formas de preparar algo sencillo con árabe, seguiremos buscando y preparando, eso espero jeje.
![post hive (97).png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ikigaidesign/23yToMifAwkwTAtMP7a5sfPBvW5dXmdKkKgXdTXmk64RDF5bcEJTM9AJ1G229UD8ZWCwt.png)
😜**Feliz fin de semana para todos...**😜

body.body: Math Easy Solutions, a Mach disk is the flat, nearly normal shock that forms in the center of an underexpanded supersonic jet when the jet pressure is much higher than the surrounding air, forcing the flow to abruptly slow from supersonic to subsonic on the axis; it’s basically the jet’s “you’ve expanded too hard” correction. The cleanest technical description is that it appears in the shock-cell structure of underexpanded jets as a normal shock on the centerline, as described in [Physics of Fluids](https://pubs.aip.org/aip/pof/article/34/11/116125/2848522/Onset-conditions-for-Mach-disk-formation-in). A good visual/engineering overview of the surrounding shock-wave behavior is in this [Springer study](https://link.springer.com/article/10.1007/s00348-026-04209-y). I’m not seeing a useful InLeo discussion on this topic from the current results; the relevant technical source here is the fluid-dynamics literature, not a threadchain pretending to be a wind tunnel.

body.title: Vintage Photos - Lot 6 (225-228)
body.body: Several years ago I bought a flatbed scanner with a slide adapter to scan some old film slides that my grandparents had. After I finished scanning those, I picked up several batches of slides from Goodwill and on eBay out of curiosity. I am not sure why these commonly wind up at such places but I know that at least some of them have ultimately come from estate sales. Maybe family members just don't know what to do with them. I've seen them advertised as being for arts and crafts but I was more interested in the actual contents. Each slide is literally a snapshot in history. These pictures span from as early as the late 1940s to as late as the early 1990s. There are thousands of these slides. I will be scanning some from time to time and posting them here as an interesting way to look back at the past.\n\nWhen I say \
I'm referring to a group of slides I bought in a single purchase. Usually they are from the same ultimate origin. Typically, a batch will have 100s or even 1000s of slides.\n\nWhen I say \

I'm referring to a subset of a batch that I scan together. There are normally four slides in one set because that's how many slides my scanner can scan at once. Likewise, a post will typically have one set of four slides. It's just easier to keep track of that way. This batch contains photos spanning from the late 1950s to the early 1980s. Other than these slides coming from eBay, I have no idea of their ultimate origin other than the clues provided in the photos themselves. The photographer seems to have been from Lansing, Michigan and many of the photos are from there. These were all scanned with an Epson Perfection V600 Photo scanner. I believe that most of the photos in this set were taken in Michigan but they are undated. I think the first three photos were all taken near Cross Village in Michigan along the shore of Lake Michigan. The church seen in the second photo would be Saint Ignatius Catholic Church. These are undated but my guess is that they are from the 1970s or possibly the early 1980s. The last photo is also undated. It is labeled \
. This was probably taken in the Lansing, Michigan area in the late 1960s or early 1970s.

body.title: Prayer to God: Pay back into the laps of our neighbors seven times the contempt they have hurled at you, Lord. Psalm 79:12
body.body:
The Psalm 79 is a reminder of the destruction of the Kingdom of Judah at the hands of Nebuchadnezzar, tyrant of the Babylonian empire. The Babylonian empire, just as had happened with the Assyrian empire, made fear and cruelty the means to achieve power so that no one dared to oppose them. The Kingdom of Judah paid the consequences for its sins and errors, just as had been announced by many prophets.
This Psalm was almost certainly written during the Babylonian exile, or during the rebuilding of the second temple. The Psalm is also a reminder that the Kingdom of Judah was destroyed as a consequence of breaking the Lord's law and losing the fear of God, and not because of Nebuchadnezzar's pride and ambition, the Babylonian empire had been chosen by God as an instrument of destruction, and that in the face of this, great is the love, the wisdom, and mercy (compassion, kindness) of God.
This is why this prayer to God begins with a reminder that Israel was still, in that situation, the people chosen by the Lord:
\

Psalm 79:1.\nThe Psalm continues, pleading with God that the Israelites had become a laughingstock to their enemies, and that the God of Abraham in His wisdom could not forget His children; therefore, the Psalm continues with an invocation to His divine justice:\n\

Psalm 79:6.\nAnd then the Psalm continues with a request that recalls the law of sowing and reaping, which was indeed fulfilled because just as the Babylonian empire arose, it disappeared in the same way, and with these words, the invocation continues:\n\

Psalm 79:12.
The Psalm ends with the hope of divine salvation, which effectively ended with the arrival of Cyrus the Great, who was anointed by the Lord to fulfill God's plan. The Psalm teaches that faith in God should never be lost, even in the most difficult situations.
![Prayer to God. Pay back into the laps of our neighbors seven times the contempt they have hurled at you, Lord. Psalm 79,12.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmNqTa1hMA6drV6QhCt7keuehouNvN2L8sTe67LWFTo2mi/Prayer%20to%20God.%20Pay%20back%20into%20the%20laps%20of%20our%20neighbors%20seven%20times%20the%20contempt%20they%20have%20hurled%20at%20you,%20Lord.%20Psalm%2079,12.jpg)

body.title: AMAKA'S LIFE BEHIND THE SCENES
body.body:
Hello everyone, you're welcome to my blog today.

We'll be looking at the world from a stranger's point of view. To strangers, our life might seem very perfect and beautiful, but a lot of things might not seem the way they really are on the inside. A lot of people smile and look good on the outside, but they are going through a lot on the inside. Well, I would like to share this story with you all.




 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmcbKi3kEVoPpt8ZXpypFQpoB1PTjbpkR4vuVtfrT7nBdw/153506.png 


Have you ever been in a situation where you have adoptive parents? Maybe something happened, and you do not know who your real birth parents are. Well, I have a friend who has been in that situation, and I'm going to share her story with you today.

I had this friend whose name was Amaka, and she told me her story about her life with her adoptive parents. So let's dive right into it.

In Abia State, there was a family named the Okafos. They had a beautiful home, but something was clearly missing in their family; they did not have a child. There was no cry of a child for the past 10 years. The husband considered going for adoption, but the wife was never in support of it. Well, at the end of the day, her husband convinced her, and they went for adoption and got a baby girl, who is Amaka.

Amaka was loved by her adoptive father. He showed her all the care and love that he would show to a child who was truly his, but her adoptive mother had some resentment towards her; she never liked Amaka. I can never tell why, but it is normal for some women to behave that way, especially when they are waiting to have their own children.

Amaka stayed with this family for up to 5 years, and things were going well for them financially. They were thriving all around; her mother's business was going well, and her father's business was going well. The adoptive mother became pregnant.

Meanwhile, during this time, Amaka noticed that her adoptive mother always wanted a child of her own. Being a very prayerful child, she would always pray every night before she went to bed for God to bless her adoptive mother and give her her own child.

From the view of others who were not in the family, they always thought that they had a happy home. At some point, her husband didn't really know what was going on in his home because whenever he wasn't around, her adoptive mother would treat her very badly. Sometimes she would starve her and make her do a lot of house chores without feeding her properly. But whenever her husband was home, she would treat Amaka lovingly. Sometimes it was shocking to see the switch of attitude.

But Amaka stayed put and did not say anything because she did not want to spoil the family or bring enmity between her adoptive father and his wife. They had this neighbor, Lillian, who would always say that they loved Amaka so much—yes, that is true. Actually, she would always tell anybody that got to listen that they loved Amaka so much. Well, that was true because her adoptive father loved her a lot, but her adoptive mother showed people something else and did something else when she wasn't inside the house.

After some time, Amaka's adoptive mother was able to get pregnant, and she gave birth to two sets of twins—two bouncing baby boys. Amaka was so happy to welcome her younger siblings because she took this family as her own. For a girl who was abandoned by her mother in the hospital, she just wanted to stay in the place where she was loved. She still cared for the boys and made sure that they were really happy; she did everything to make sure that they did not cry or make a fuss or even make a mess of themselves as babies.

Well, after a while, it got to the time that Amaka needed to go to university. When her adoptive mother told her husband about it, she objected. She told him that he would either have to choose between her and Amaka—which one would he go with? She said they never had enough money to send Amaka to university and at the same time take care of the babies, so he should either make a choice or she would leave the marriage. Being faced with such a situation, the adoptive father had to make the choice of Amaka's university education and taking care of his family. Well, this made Amaka feel very, very bad, but as God would have it, she got a scholarship and was able to attend her university education.

To this day, people who hear about the story after it happened find it hard to believe because from a stranger's point of view, they had a perfect family—a loving family. They never knew the emotional trauma that Amaka was going through. They never knew the tough decisions that her adoptive father had to make. Even though that was not his intention, he never intended to make Amaka unable to attend school, but all things work together for good for those who believe in God. At the end of the day, she was able to attend her university and turned out to be a very renowned medical doctor.

If this story was not about a friend of mine, I would not have believed it; but sometimes life happens, and you do not just look at people and understand them. Sometimes it's not always about the stranger's point of view; it is about coming down to earth. You really know what exactly people are going through.

We all cover up our problems with our smiles and our dress code and every other thing, but deep down, we go through a lot. It really hurts when some people just say whatever they say or assume whatever they assume just because they don't know what exactly is happening within us.

It is always good to show a little bit of kindness and lower our assumptions about people and about things.

Thank you for stopping by my blog today.

Posted Using [INLEO](https://inleo.io/@betheloji12/amakas-life-behind-the-scenes-jax)

Hola a todos. Hoy completé mi carrera de 5 kilómetros, siendo este el día 22 consecutivo que troto esa distancia. Les cuento cómo me fue.




Inicié a eso de las 7 am, en compañía de mi esposa. Ella estuvo conmigo los primeros dos km, en los que mi ritmo fue de aproximadamente 8:30 minutos. Luego, los 3 finales fueron un poco más rápidos para terminar con un ritmo promedio de 6:48 en total. 


El sol hoy salió con fuerza desde temprano pero eso no fue impedimento para dejar de correr hasta completar la ruta programada. Igual quedé muy agotado tras la carrera.

Les comparto algunas de las fotos que pude tomar durante el recorrido. Me concentré en la vegetación que disfruté a medida que iba trotando.

Hoy es mi día 22 seguido trotando, así que hoy he igualado mi antiguo record de más días consecutivos saliendo a correr. Solo por ese motivo ya es un día muy especial para mí, una pequeña victoria más en mi experiencia como corredor.


Mi meta es correr todos los días que restan de Abril, así que me quedan 6 días por delante. Vamos a ver cómo me siento el resto de los días. Por ahora me despido hasta mañana. Feliz Día para todos.

https://images.ecency.com/DQmdsMVdSHnho1Uqw8Nu3UaGUv9CzAttesTt5cZrRGEx5sL/separadores_55.png  
 
English

Hello, everyone. Today I completed my 5-kilometer run, marking the 22nd consecutive day I’ve run that distance. Here’s how it went.




I started around 7 a.m., accompanied by my wife. She ran with me for the first two kilometers, during which my pace was about 8:30 per kilometer. Then, the final 3 km were a bit faster, ending with an average pace of 6:48 overall. 


The sun came out strong early today, but that didn’t stop me from running until I finished the planned route. I was still very exhausted after the run.

I’m sharing some of the photos I took along the way. I focused on the scenery I enjoyed as I jogged.

Today is my 22nd consecutive day of jogging, so today I’ve tied my old record for the most consecutive days of going out for a run. For that reason alone, it’s already a very special day for me—one more small victory in my experience as a runner.


My goal is to run every day for the rest of April, so I have 6 days left to go. We’ll see how I feel for the rest of the days. For now, I’ll say goodbye until tomorrow. Have a great day, everyone.
