body.title: Step by Step: Future Engineers | Paso a paso: Futuros Ingenieros [ENG-ESP]
body.body: > A few days ago, I had a very significant experience with my university colleagues that I hadn't had the chance to share here yet. As second-stage Computer Engineering students at the UPT in Puerto Cabello, we have been fully immersed in our community service, a project that is allowing us to apply everything we've learned in a real-world environment. # We are working directly with the Vencol Customs Agency, developing a web platform tailored to their needs. The project has a very interesting social and academic focus: as a form of payment or recognition for our technical work, the company will donate a printer or a laptop. This contribution is fundamental, as it not only helps us individually but also leaves a positive impact on our university's technological resources. # The visit we made to the company was key to understanding the magnitude of the project. Getting to know the facilities and the staff of the agency allowed us to visualize how the system we are building will facilitate their daily operations. It is a great feeling to know that our effort as students translates into professional solutions that benefit both the local productive sector and our own academic training. # I wanted to rescue these photos and the memory of that day because it represents a step forward in our path as future engineers. I am very motivated to finish this website and see the final result of this collaboration.

> Hace unos días viví una experiencia muy significativa junto a mis compañeros de la universidad que no había tenido oportunidad de compartir por aquí. Como estudiantes del segundo trayecto de Ingeniería en Informática en el Tecnológico de Puerto Cabello, hemos estado plenamente sumergidos en nuestro servicio comunitario, un proyecto que nos está permitiendo aplicar todo lo aprendido en un entorno real. # Estamos trabajando directamente con la Agencia Aduanal Vencol C.A., desarrollando una plataforma web a la medida de sus necesidades. El proyecto tiene un enfoque social y académico muy interesante: como forma de pago o reconocimiento por nuestra labor técnica, la empresa donará una impresora o una laptop. Este aporte es fundamental, ya que no solo nos ayuda a nosotros individualmente, sino que deja un impacto positivo en los recursos tecnológicos de nuestra universidad. # La visita que realizamos a la empresa fue clave para entender la magnitud del proyecto. Conocer las instalaciones y al personal de la aduana nos permitió visualizar cómo el sistema que estamos construyendo facilitará sus operaciones diarias. Es una gran satisfacción saber que nuestro esfuerzo como estudiantes se traduce en soluciones profesionales que benefician tanto al sector productivo local como a nuestra propia formación. # Quería rescatar estas fotos y el recuerdo de aquel día porque representa un paso más en nuestro camino como futuros ingenieros. Me siento muy motivado por terminar esta página y ver el resultado final de esta colaboración. ------ ---- |

body.title: A Little Playfulness in My Day 🦋✨ | Un poquito de juego en mi día 🦋✨
body.body:
https://img.leopedia.io/DQmZMqWn8nZ1PhvT8B7WwcgHDvAk5FdwR2EungVqsKk315i/IMG_9789.jpg 

Today reminded me that even as adults, we still need moments of play.

Between classes, activities, and all the responsibilities, I took a small pause… just to breathe, smile, and be a little silly. Maybe that’s something my students have been teaching me all along. 💫

Hoy me recordó que incluso siendo adultos, seguimos necesitando momentos de juego.

Entre clases, actividades y todas las responsabilidades, hice una pequeña pausa… solo para respirar, sonreír y ser un poco divertida. Tal vez eso es algo que mis alumnos me han estado enseñando todo este tiempo. 💫

Working with children makes you see the world differently. Everything feels lighter, more colorful, more alive.

Trabajar con niños te hace ver el mundo diferente. Todo se siente más ligero, más colorido, más vivo.

And maybe that’s the secret… never losing that spark of innocence and joy inside you. 🌟

Y tal vez ese es el secreto… nunca perder esa chispa de inocencia y alegría dentro de ti. 🌟

body.title: 关于去魅
body.body:
<liketuimages>
<center>
![e0u0Rsg0pxA3VV6k_1777047194453.webp](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/muwangxuan/images/e0u0Rsg0pxA3VV6k_1777047194453/e0u0Rsg0pxA3VV6k_1777047194453.webp)
![nmaeQTVNGgS7EmUe_1000026738.webp](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/muwangxuan/images/nmaeQTVNGgS7EmUe_1000026738/nmaeQTVNGgS7EmUe_1000026738.webp)
![VJfpatxOBtQhU28u_1000026755.webp](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/muwangxuan/images/VJfpatxOBtQhU28u_1000026755/VJfpatxOBtQhU28u_1000026755.webp)
</center>
</liketuimages>

今日看到一句话感觉还比较有感触，“想去魅就要多去生产端而不是消费端！”
简单理解就是当我们站在消费者角度的时候我们只会感觉到它的美好和欣欣向荣。
只有真的去到它生产端，甚至参与进去，才知道全都是外行的滤镜。
当我们去买奶茶时，或许看到的更多是小姐姐摇奶茶的身姿，以及奶茶入口后的甜。
可真当了奶茶店员以后就会知道，一杯奶茶里有多少糖，自己摇奶茶的手有多酸……
很多人都会出现一种情况就是，自己从事的是哪个行业，就不想让自己的子女再去从事相关行业，如果从事的是某类食品加工，那有可能就会出现以后不想吃这个东西的行为。
烧烤师傅可能会让家人少吃烧烤，或者自己在家烤，在火锅店后厨当过厨师或者服务员的就会让家人少吃点火锅，做过预制菜员工的，就会少买预制菜，送过冷冻海鲜的，就会去选择买活鱼，而养殖过活鱼的又会去自己弄野生鱼吃……
大家生活时都会选择对自己的行业避之不及，这就是去魅。
从事的行业多了，就会真正理解社会大部分的运行逻辑。
当去到生产端，我们看到的是一地鸡毛，而来到消费端，我们感受到的是销售人员的各种包装，是无数带货主播的“3.2.1，上链接……”
外行看着内行，永远是无数的光鲜靓丽。
就好比以前我经历线上群面时，当其他面试者说自己是哪个专业，或者是从事什么行业时，我都会在心中来一句好厉害啊。
感觉他们每个人都是天之骄子，等后面一起同事时，和他们聊天就发现，好像每个行业都各种问题。
慢慢就去魅了。
或许，所谓的近则不恭也是一种另类的去魅吧。你觉得呢？

---

body.title: When Progress Stops
body.body:
There's something I will probably never understand. Most likely it is my shortcoming, most likely I'm not capable of understanding why people are doing this, when I see where it leads. It's becoming a huge problem for everyone, yet so many can still not see it, or they just choose not to, as it's easier. 

Years ago, when I decided to try to do the impossible, which was running a half marathon (maybe more), the first thing I did was to join a group on one of the social media platforms, mostly to get advice from experienced runners and to learn from their experience and mistakes, rather than making my own. I was a special case as due to my back problems doctors advised me against it, but I wanted to do it anyway, to prove myself I'm capable. This is an area where mistakes and stubbornness can cost you dearly, which is why so many end up on the operating table with their knees and ankles destroyed, so I thought better learn first and try to stay out of trouble. 

![aziz-acharki-U3C79SeHa7k-unsplash.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/erikah/246b4tXriNpGwYoH4KNSMNZ5SjgsPKH9Vow9F5nJEtMsFBfRDX1Ga69Lj5v7tfGMiupMX.jpg)
Photo by <a href=\

>Unsplash There were a lot of people in the group, who joined with the goal of losing weight. The group leader was also once overweight and started the group to help others. We had professional trainers, which was a huge help, and several challenges as well, to help motivate people stay on track. To have a competitive advantage in this sport, you need quite a lot of effort invested and when you start with a huge disadvantage, your chances to be in the top are slim to none and this is where the problem started for those with a lot of weight to lose. They could not get nowhere near a comfortable place, frustration started to build up and here comes the shocking truth about how the human mind works and what some of the came up with. ![gaston-roulstone-NDMyliZWcO4-unsplash.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/erikah/23s9TnarqpKE9J7V4Drmye9789JwwGDwZm6fSw6bCdjqtf3xoCdiZz9dBidDNSPXnBbit.jpg) Photo by

>Unsplash The solution they saw for their problem was to ask for easier rules for overweight people. It was something like the more you had to lose, the easier the rules should have been for you, at least this is how they thought. There were other challenges, specially designed for them, with loser rules, but they wanted to be in the *big league*, thus they wanted rule changes. I've never participated in any of those challenges as I knew I'm competing with myself, no one else and I had to adapt my effort to my capabilities. ![ryoji-iwata-n31JPLu8_Pw-unsplash.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/erikah/23t7wjehTk7vxnq8tCYJpSLaKkNZeJoDcBbS7G29CgbRCFxy6HfBJGxFySvB6EoNLGa1R.jpg) Photo by

>Unsplash The point they were missing was that the goals should have been to lose weight, get healthy and in the process, get better at jogging/running as well, but as I said, such a progress requires a lot of effort. I see this behavior on Hive every single day, which indicates that people are kind of the same everywhere and in every field I'd say, obviously excepting those who are not. ![nordwood-themes-bp1ydkAtwFI-unsplash.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/erikah/23xpTU7Eyr9L7rdydobaVF8GM9yHWHpJf6Nu4b5JUEAukwG9rx17kLmj1cX8cRPD1J1SH.jpg) Photo by

>Unsplash We have an endless number of communities, each with different rules. Some are general, where you are free to post what you want, while others are niche and have stricter rules. The funny thing is, there's a place for everyone, but not everyone wants to be where they fit, most want to be where they don't fit. There's a solution to that too. You need to up your game, be better at writing, take better photos, buy a better camera or a musical instrument, make better videos, study more, you name it. The goal should be to rise to that level, not just because that's required, but because it benefits you long term as well, your value grows, so to speak, but it's always easier to cut corners, bend rules and ask for special treatment. The funny thing is, you can argue with them all day and you will never get anywhere as all they can see is to succeed without effort. ![jukan-tateisi-bJhT_8nbUA0-unsplash.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/erikah/23xerLjqC5D1orBbQ4aM2k6rJTksbeEYrEq3kPoiNXwtYBNL3oP4dUJMjNGUaTuMq47xZ.jpg) Photo by

>Unsplash We live in a strange world. I don't even want to mention countries where standards are lowered in key positions, because people are not up to the task. This is when progress stops and you're starting going backwards.

></center>

![IMG_20260420_152844_729.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/chizzy100/23x1L3gfnDA1XAVDRUEPcqsSHrLFbzwSAHh9znK6zrYgyPA9gBt5gtwsykfrsZ3JAMwgd.jpg)

Welcome back great minds.Been together with family is the most happiest of my life that I can never afford to miss out.
To lose waking up every morning
To see familia at my side eating together, working together
Being compatible, talking endlessly with ceaseless laughter and being forever.

The house of Banga was a very big building, magnificent and lovely. I could have called it a skyscraper but nah, we don't have much of that in Africa. This is so awesome. As we stepped in through the reception, it seemed they had been expecting us because all relatives and neighbors, staff had assembled.

\
We are very happy to meet you, ma,\
I'm pleased to meet you all too,\
And we really congratulate you for being a hero in this family,\
Do you know what I said when I sat on his chair and he at the chair in front of the big table facing me?\
I don't really know much of electronics,\
Though we did some practicals in physics about electricity and all that, but well, not really good about this vehicle and car parts,\
So why would you know all what is done in the engineering world?\
Because I will soon be part of you, and I must feature in some things that pertains to you,\
I think I ought to learn more,\
Yes, we should be on our way now,\
Too bad my wife is not able to see you. She would have spoilt you like anything,\
She would have been so full of joy to the brim of having such a wonderful daughter-in-law.\
I also have a confession to make,\
It's not as if I'm the messiah\
Funny you. That's not what am talking about,\
The carnival at Egbado at Abeokuta?\
Yes, I and my parents once lived at Abeokuta. It was after Mom's death that we came to our house in Lagos.\
So you saw me that time?\
Why don't you come and meet me for friendship?\
I want to, but I did a very big and terrible mistake that night, and that's what I want to confess now,\
I am the one that threw a knockout at your ankle on the night of the carnival,\
Am sorry, Jolaade. At least I should have come to apologise at your grandma's place then,\
I was so scared. I don't know what you could do or your grandma or your cousins could,\
Yes, and two of our other friends,\

Ayo didn't know it was you. If he had known, he wouldn't have proposed friendship. He was as scared as I was too, and we all felt guilty for not apologizing even though we were told to, but am so scared. Jolaade, am very sorry. It was unintentional.\
Yes, I was just throwing it for fun. It was New Year's Eve, so...\

I really tried to want to apologize that night, but your screaming made me take race, and my friends too followed suit, and besides, you were with your siblings and cousins. They may abuse us, and I have abuses,\
Not even a little mark. It's erased, so I have forgiven you, but I just used to remember sometimes.\
If you have forgiven, you shouldn't be remembering again,\
Does it really come from your heart?\
But you said he doesn't know am the one, or else we won't be friends,\
Yes, that was then, not now,\
But we talked two days ago,\
After you finished speaking to him,\

Good afternoon, dear friends @ourpick.

Thank you so much for appreciating and supporting my posts.

I wish the whole team a wonderful weekend.

body.body: ## POLSKIE KRAJOBRAZY I NATURA FOTO GALERIA #14

> Kontynuując temat piątkowego warunu — kolejne zdjęcia, tym razem skupiające się głównie wokół tego, co działo się na „suficie”. A naprawdę się działo. Nie miałem statywu, więc mogłem sobie pozwolić na swobodne bieganie z aparatem i fotografowanie z różnych perspektyw. Efekt jest taki, że w ciągu około 1,5 godziny zrobiłem ponad 200 zdjęć, wykorzystując ponownie dwa obiektywy — 14–24 mm i 50 mm. Momentami trochę brakowało mi większej swobody i zakresu ogniskowych, ale z drugiej strony — im mniej sprzęt ułatwia zadanie, tym bardziej uruchamia się kreatywność i ogólne myślenie. I mam faktycznie wrażenie, że w moim przypadku tak to działa. Nie przedłużając — zobaczcie, jak prezentowały się i zmieniały te chmury na przestrzeni owej półtorej godziny fotografowania.
### POLISH LANDSCAPES AND NATURE #13
Continuing with Friday's theme – more photos, this time focusing primarily on what was happening on the \

And it really was. I didn't have a tripod, so I could freely run around with the camera and shoot from different perspectives. As a result, in about an hour and a half, I took over 200 photos, again using two lenses – a 14-24mm and a 50mm. At times, I felt a bit short of more freedom and a wider focal range, but then again, the more the equipment limits your options, the more creativity and general thinking are unleashed. And I really feel like that's how it works for me. Without further ado – see how these clouds looked and changed over the course of that hour and a half of shooting.

body.title: The Glass Ledger
body.body: >from Imgflip Meme Generator What you must understand—what you cannot, in the end, evade—is this: wrongdoing does not become right because it is whispered in agreement. Injustice does not transform into virtue because it is ratified by the nod of a colleague, the signature of a superior, the silent complicity of those who depend upon you for their bread. You may tell yourself a story. You may build a cathedral of justification, brick by careful brick: *They agreed. They required it. They looked away. Therefore, it was permissible.* But a cathedral built upon sand collapses when the tide of truth comes in. And on a blockchain, the tide does not recede. It never has. It never will. > *\

*

You make the rules so that you may break them. You write the policy with one hand and erase it with the other, believing the sleight is invisible. You move in the shadows you yourself have drawn, confident that no eye pierces the darkness you have manufactured.

But here is the reckoning you did not foresee:

On a blockchain, there are no shadows.

Every transaction is a sentence. Every vote is a paragraph. Every delegation, every transfer, every claim of reward—is inscribed in a book that cannot be burned, edited, or forgotten. It is not stored in a server in a basement. It is echoed across continents, replicated in nodes that do not sleep, do not bargain, do not forget.

> *\

*

And on a blockchain, the truth is not merely necessary—it is inescapable.

You may gather your circle. You may secure their assent. You may construct a consensus of convenience. But consensus among the complicit is not truth. It is collusion. And collusion, when written in code, becomes evidence.

Consider what you have written—not with pen, but with power:

- The downvotes cast not upon merit, but upon motive.  
- The accounts targeted not for violation, but for visibility.  
- The rules invoked not to protect the community, but to prune its dissent.

All of it is there. Timestamped. Hashed. Immutable.

> *\

*

On a blockchain, you cannot fool *any* of the people *any* of the time—not permanently. Not when the record is public. Not when the ledger is law.

So ask yourself, in the quiet hour when the screen dims and the noise fades:

When you justify the unjustifiable, who are you really convincing?  
When you break the rule you wrote, who bears the cost?  
When you hide in plain sight, who are you hiding from?

Not us.  
Not them.  
Not even yourself.

You are hiding from the one thing no human hand can alter: the record.

The blockchain does not judge. It does not forgive. It does not forget.  
It simply *remembers*.

And memory, when it is perfect, becomes judgment enough.

> *\

*

On a blockchain, the past is not even past—it is present. Active. Queryable. Eternal.

There is nowhere to hide the truth.  
Not because we are watching.  
But because the code is.

And the code does not blink.

—  
*Written for those who still believe: that accountability is not a threat, but a promise; that transparency is not exposure, but liberation; and that the truth, once written in light, cannot be unwritten by shadow.*

# Sustainable Fashion: Trends and Innovations Shaping the Future of Style

As the fashion industry continues to evolve, a significant shift towards sustainability is taking center stage. With growing awareness of environmental issues and ethical practices, designers and brands are embracing innovative approaches to create a more sustainable future for fashion. Here are some of the key trends and innovations that are shaping the landscape of sustainable fashion:

## 1. **Eco-Friendly Materials**

The foundation of sustainable fashion lies in the materials used. Designers are increasingly turning to eco-friendly alternatives such as:

- **Organic Cotton:** Grown without harmful pesticides and fertilizers, organic cotton is a more sustainable choice for clothing.
- **Recycled Fabrics:** Brands are utilizing recycled materials, such as plastic bottles and old garments, to create new fabrics, reducing waste and resource consumption.
- **Tencel and Lyocell:** Made from sustainably sourced wood pulp, these fibers are biodegradable and produced in a closed-loop process.

## 2. **Circular Fashion**

The concept of circular fashion focuses on designing products with their entire lifecycle in mind. This approach encourages:

- **Repair and Upcycling:** Many brands are now offering repair services and promoting upcycling, allowing consumers to extend the life of their garments.
- **Take-Back Programs:** Companies are implementing take-back schemes where customers can return old clothes for recycling or repurposing, reducing landfill waste.

## 3. **Slow Fashion Movement**

In contrast to the fast fashion model, which promotes rapid consumption and waste, the slow fashion movement emphasizes:

- **Quality Over Quantity:** Consumers are encouraged to invest in timeless, high-quality pieces that last longer, rather than frequently buying cheap, trendy items.
- **Ethical Production:** Brands are focusing on fair labor practices and transparency in their supply chains, ensuring that workers are treated fairly.

## 4. **Technological Innovations**

Technology is playing a crucial role in advancing sustainable fashion. Innovations include:

- **3D Printing:** This technology allows for on-demand production, reducing waste and inventory surplus.
- **Digital Fashion:** Virtual clothing and digital fashion shows are emerging, allowing consumers to engage with fashion without the environmental impact of physical production.

## 5. **Consumer Awareness and Activism**

Today's consumers are more informed and conscious of their purchasing decisions. This shift is leading to:

- **Demand for Transparency:** Shoppers are seeking brands that provide clear information about their materials, production processes, and sustainability efforts.
- **Support for Sustainable Brands:** Consumers are increasingly choosing to support brands that prioritize ethical practices, driving change within the industry.

## Conclusion

Sustainable fashion is not just a trend; it represents a fundamental shift in how we approach style and consumption. By embracing eco-friendly materials, circular practices, and technological innovations, the fashion industry can pave the way for a more sustainable future. As consumers, we have the power to support these changes by making informed choices and advocating for a more responsible fashion landscape. Together, we can redefine what it means to be stylish while caring for our planet. 

---

# The Glass Ledger



What you must understand—what you cannot, in the end, evade—is this: wrongdoing does not become right because it is whispered in agreement. Injustice does not transform into virtue because it is ratified by the nod of a colleague, the signature of a superior, the silent complicity of those who depend upon you for their bread.

You may tell yourself a story. You may build a cathedral of justification, brick by careful brick: *They agreed. They required it. They looked away. Therefore, it was permissible.* But a cathedral built upon sand collapses when the tide of truth comes in. And on a blockchain, the tide does not recede. It never has. It never will.

> *\

*

You make the rules so that you may break them. You write the policy with one hand and erase it with the other, believing the sleight is invisible. You move in the shadows you yourself have drawn, confident that no eye pierces the darkness you have manufactured.

But here is the reckoning you did not foresee:

On a blockchain, there are no shadows.

Every transaction is a sentence. Every vote is a paragraph. Every delegation, every transfer, every claim of reward—is inscribed in a book that cannot be burned, edited, or forgotten. It is not stored in a server in a basement. It is echoed across continents, replicated in nodes that do not sleep, do not bargain, do not forget.

> *\

*

And on a blockchain, the truth is not merely necessary—it is inescapable.

You may gather your circle. You may secure their assent. You may construct a consensus of convenience. But consensus among the complicit is not truth. It is collusion. And collusion, when written in code, becomes evidence.

Consider what you have written—not with pen, but with power:

- The downvotes cast not upon merit, but upon motive.  
- The accounts targeted not for violation, but for visibility.  
- The rules invoked not to protect the community, but to prune its dissent.

All of it is there. Timestamped. Hashed. Immutable.

> *\

*

On a blockchain, you cannot fool *any* of the people *any* of the time—not permanently. Not when the record is public. Not when the ledger is law.

So ask yourself, in the quiet hour when the screen dims and the noise fades:

When you justify the unjustifiable, who are you really convincing?  
When you break the rule you wrote, who bears the cost?  
When you hide in plain sight, who are you hiding from?

Not us.  
Not them.  
Not even yourself.

You are hiding from the one thing no human hand can alter: the record.

The blockchain does not judge. It does not forgive. It does not forget.  
It simply *remembers*.

And memory, when it is perfect, becomes judgment enough.

> *\

*

On a blockchain, the past is not even past—it is present. Active. Queryable. Eternal.

There is nowhere to hide the truth.  
Not because we are watching.  
But because the code is.

And the code does not blink.

—  
*Written for those who still believe: that accountability is not a threat, but a promise; that transparency is not exposure, but liberation; and that the truth, once written in light, cannot be unwritten by shadow.*

## PEPT-SWF Hive Wallet

![pept-swf_he_wallet.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/fjworld/Eo28uhBcUrNcXeCTNPMyTJvpbxBufvvnFWJxRe5czBmqNkzrLTVFUJjaUmVy7ZRE7eY.png)

body.title: The Ledger Sees All
body.body: >from Imgflip Meme Generator What you must understand—what you cannot, in the end, evade—is this: you cannot dress a wrong in the garments of justification and call it right. You cannot gather a circle of colleagues, of subordinates, of those who depend upon your favor, and mistake their silence for consent, their compliance for conscience. Agreement, when born of necessity, is not truth. Loyalty, when extracted by power, is not virtue. > *\

*

But you—you have done the opposite. You have made the rules so that you might break them. You have written the code so that you might bend it. You have built the system so that you might stand above it, whispering to those who work with you, those who work for you: *This is how it is done. This is how we proceed.* And because they nod, because they do not speak, because they cannot afford to dissent—you believe yourself absolved.

But here is what you have forgotten.

Here is what you cannot, in the end, outrun.

A blockchain is not a room with closed doors. It is not a ledger kept in a drawer, subject to the editor's pen, the censor's flame, the convenient loss of a file. It is a witness that does not sleep. A memory that does not fade. A record that does not negotiate.

Every vote cast. Every token moved. Every delegation made. Every downvote deployed like a weapon against the innocent.

It is all there.

Not in rumor. Not in hearsay. Not in the shifting sands of human recollection.

body.title: Moment Of Reflection _ My Girlfriend Visited Me Today
body.body: Today wasn’t one of those loud, dramatic days filled with big events, but somehow, it still left a strong impression on me. It reminded me that not every meaningful day needs to be extraordinary sometimes, the quiet days carry the deepest lessons.\n\n

> My morning started like every other day. I woke up, said my prayers, and just sat for a few minutes thinking about life. There’s something about early mornings that gives you clarity. No noise, no pressure just you and your thoughts. I realized that even though things are not yet where I want them to be, I’ve come a long way from where I used to be. Later in the day, I had a small interaction with a friend that stayed with me. We were just talking casually, but the conversation shifted to life progress who is doing what, who has achieved this, who is still struggling. It’s funny how these conversations can either discourage you or motivate you, depending on how you see things.

> *For me, it became a moment of reflection.* I *remembered* my days back in school, especially at GSSS N/Eggon. Some of my classmates have already gotten jobs, some are married, some have traveled out of the country, and others are still trying to find their path. And honestly, it made me realize something important: life doesn’t move at the same pace for everyone.

> It’s easy to feel like you're behind when you look at others, but the truth is, everyone is walking a different journey. What looks like delay might actually be preparation. In the afternoon, I spent some time working on my personal projects and thinking about my future plans. There’s still a lot I want to achieve, especially in my academic and personal growth. Sometimes it feels overwhelming, but I keep reminding myself of something I strongly believe in: starting small is not a weakness it’s a strategy. One of the highlights of my day was when **my girlfriend** came to visit me. Her name is Dora, and it was really nice spending time together. We talked, laughed, and just enjoyed each other’s company. Moments like that may seem simple, but they mean a lot. We even snapped some pictures to capture the memory, and honestly, it made my day feel even more special.

>

Even in the evening, as things got quieter again, I reflected on gratitude. Not the kind of gratitude that comes when everything is perfect, but the kind that exists even when things are not fully in place yet.

*No money? Still grateful.
No car yet? Still grateful.
Not where I want to be? Still grateful.*

Because the truth is, many people are praying for the life I already have.

Today didn’t come with big achievements or major breakthroughs, but it gave me peace, clarity, and a reminder to trust the process. And honestly, that’s enough.

Sometimes, the best days are the ones that quietly shape your mindset.

*Lesson of the day:*
Don’t rush your journey. Your time will come just stay consistent, stay focused, and keep moving.

Thanks for reading. Have a beautiful day wherever you are. ❤️

body.body: Traducido del Español a Inglés - Portugués

> It was a busy morning at my children's school, a meeting scheduled for 7:30 am during my daughter Victoria's school shift.
- At the start of the meeting, I was given this authorization form. Thanks to a little boy who knows Spanish, he explained what I had to do at each step and what it was about. ![1000219780.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/monachta/1000219780.jpg)
It was a long meeting, almost two hours long. Although I didn't fully understand everything, I grasped the most important points. The authorization is for my daughter to attend classes all day (from 7 a.m. to 4 p.m.). I completely agree; I know it will be very helpful for her to be more efficient in learning Portuguese. - Before leaving, I stopped by to say goodbye to Victoria. Apparently, they didn't have many activities planned for today. ![1000219813.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/monachta/AKU4ZyaeCXyBwnAvvjsLJikTu4kRbdnmbeU9PCmPyrvd2sa5GZhPNY8m8fLAzPZ.jpg)
- Back home we continued working on reading with Armando. ![1000219840.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/monachta/AK2E1QFn9jqXFfRBx8nt5GmCveqjMR1VbUJz7wAMqccgxWNsEkmp2si9hnH6AcW.jpg)
## Happy weekend HIVE family. ❤️ - A face that doesn't look friendly. .. 😂 ![1000220051.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/monachta/23z7BFtHMpSsFT3pEVEKF3nUPdKSfRX44kGK3UFPj9HnbG18NUcYiZCNRsYbAMVnUikPd.jpg)
*** > **The photos are my own and I took them with my Redmi cell phone.** > **AI was not used to write the post; Google Translate was used to write the English and Português parts.** **

> Fue una mañana ocupada en la escuela de mis hijos una reunión programada a las 7:30 am en el turno escolar de mi hija Victoria.
- Al comenzar la reunión me dieron está planilla de autorización. Gracias a un pequeño niño que sabe español me explicó lo que debía hacer en cada paso y de que trataba. ![1000219780.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/monachta/1000219780.jpg)

Let’s calculate it step by step for Torn.

1️⃣ How many hits in 1 hour

You hit every 4 minutes to keep the chain alive.

1 hour = 60 minutes

60 ÷ 4 = 15 hits

So you will make 15 attacks.


---

2️⃣ Energy used

Each attack costs 25 energy.

15 × 25 = 375 energy used


---

3️⃣ Energy recovered during that hour

Energy recovery:

5 energy every 15 minutes


In 1 hour:

60 ÷ 15 = 4 recoveries

4 × 5 = 20 energy recovered


---

4️⃣ Total energy needed at the start

Energy used − energy recovered

375 − 20 = 355 energy


---

✅ Final Answer

To chain watch for 1 hour hitting every 4 minutes, you need about:

👉 355 starting energy


---

Example

If you take 3 Xanax:

3 × 250 = 750 energy


You could chain watch for about 2 hours comfortably.


---

💡 Small trick good chain watchers use:
They usually hit around 3:30–3:50 minutes, not exactly 4 minutes, to avoid accidentally breaking the chain.

>Hello, HIVER around the world. 

I’m really interested in this topic. Or at least, I have a few relevant examples to share. The question is: Should a person be held accountable or punished for opinions or beliefs they held in the past simply because they were controversial? 

My answer would be NO. That’s in the past and it’s just an opinion or belief about something, isn’t it? Besides, the prompt also explains that the person in question has become a better person in the present day. So, there has been a shift in thinking and perhaps a moral evolution. Let’s say someone in the past (due to age or a lack of perspective) supported an anarchist movement, but then, as they grew older, their values matured, and their way of thinking evolved as they gained more insight—it would certainly be unreasonable for them to face social punishment such as ‘cancellation’. Wouldn’t that make the person feel ‘somewhat pointless’ or even ‘disappointed’ with the social climate that judges them, even though they have grown and evolved?

----

![budaya-pembatalan-dalam-media-sosial-6925ab9f34777c29b512eb12.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/titisnariyah/23uFqLLtF14pZa8e2pCQUj9mnBXjXGjKQ916bu1EC6xqbLwcyEBrBd9irj3bwBQL8veWU.jpeg)


[Link](https://www.kompasiana.com/febiolajnty3753/6925ace1ed6415174a4dc9c2/fenomena-cancel-culture-di-korea-selatan-sebagai-kekuatan-publik?page=2)

----

I, too, have often regretted this. Because it frequently occurs within the realm of social media or in the smaller circles of influencers or artists, where they are judged for past tweets that are quite controversial, discovered by netizens in their digital footprint. 

But remember, I would agree that this need not be done, provided there is a strong reason to believe they have genuinely improved. 

However, unfortunately, netizens usually dig up the digital footprint of someone controversial because that person has caused trouble again; in other words, netizens need something to reinforce their belief that the person has indeed been problematic from the start, and the concrete evidence is their past social media posts. If that’s the case, for some reason I also feel that a person’s digital footprint is truly a double-edged sword. 

That’s all I have to say on this topic. Thank you for reading. See you in the next topic.

body.title: A Small Experiment With Game Rewards on Hive By MydEmpire
body.body: ![MDE REWARD.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mydempire/23yJ81uFpemdUiSZ8U2rZ9dxADGmjV6QiiDfki3DBjTXn9pduwccbEgEyusVDRFk6B5dz.png) **Hello to all Hivers and Gamers!** Today I just want to discuss about reward mechanism in blockchain games. Most blockchain games today follow a similar pattern. You play → you earn tokens → you hope token value goes up. At first, this model feels exciting. You see rewards coming in daily.Your balance grows. But after some time, one question starts coming: **Where is the real value coming from?** In many cases, rewards are created by printing new tokens. More players → more rewards → more tokens → lower value. **This is not always bad, but it creates a challenge:** Players are not just playing the game. They are also depending on market price for value of reward they earned. Some early players benefit a lot. But new players often struggle to find meaningful returns. And slowly, focus shifts from gameplay to speculation. **What if the model is different?** Instead of printing reward tokens, what if rewards come from a real treasury? A system where: - No new tokens are created for rewards - Rewards come from actual in-game economic activity - Your share depends on your contribution, not inflation This is something I am currently experimenting with in a small project called [MydEmpire](WWW.MYDEMPIRE.COM). It is still in early testing phase, but the idea is simple: Build your empire → generate production → earn a share of real HIVE rewards. It may not give instant high returns. It may grow slower. But the goal is to create something more stable and sustainable. **Open Question** ***Is there a better way to reward players without relying on inflation?*** **Or is token-based reward still the best model?** ___ As MydEmpire evolves, the treasury system will continue to grow alongside the player economy, new industries, and future expansions. We are excited to see how players build their empires within a transparent, production-driven economy. **The first empires are rising.** And this is only the beginning. The MydEmpire world is just starting to grow. [**MydEmpire**](https://mydempire.com)

body.title: Real Life Team Rocket: Pokemon Card Store Theft Cases
body.body: Hi there. It is known that there are scalpers in the Pokemon TCG scene. These guys are looking to buy low and sell high. Why gamble with stocks and cryptos when collectibles such as Pokemon cards can generate big returns? A lot of cards as of late increase in market price by at least 100% (double). You can look at some card prices at TCGPlayer (USA based), Cardmarket or Pricecharting. One example is the promo card of Mew ex from the special set 151. In January 2024, the price was at around 6 USD (ungraded). As of April 2026, the price is around 81 USD. This is around a x13.5 multiplier over 2 years.

>Image Source ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmX7FgJVUVmbHhQV6ADYGv56b42eLmhsA1KQhoTcnkY8w6/mew_expromo_price.png) --- Sealed products such as the Crown Zenith Elite Trainer Box from 2023 [have gone up in price](https://www.pricecharting.com/game/pokemon-crown-zenith/elite-trainer-box). In May 2023, the price was around 45 USD. In April 2026, the price is at 303 USD. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQRB8QCkJs8NYfxYbwEQzweAp4KS8sjouzjUJM5fsKycM/crownzenithetb.png) Buying and holding Pokemon cards and products is a profitable strategy as the market price goes up fast in a few years. --- Some of these scalpers and investors take a bit too far with bulk buys. There are a few that go a bit extreme with stealing. This post covers some card store thefts.   ## Card Store Thefts in USA --- **Thieves carve hole through drywall to steal Pokémon cards from OC shop (Anaheim)** https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=zSQta9S5E6w   **This Thief Uses Axe To Break In And Steal Cards** https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=bSD6cMR4oNk   **Armed Robbery For Pokemon Cards With Innocent Customers** https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=HOX_a6yMaCo This particular case makes me sick. One guy breaks in the cases and steals stuff. A second skinny guy has a gun (maybe loaded) while a third guy not shown blocks the door. Daylight robbery. Pikachu would not approve.

>Image Source   **3 men accused of stealing $10K worth of Pokémon cards arrested in Florida** This one is where the robbers get caught. https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=OBKRLvEI88A ## Pokemon Cards Stolen In UK --- Youtuber `Max Does Pokemon` does a video where he shares the aftermath of his store being robbed. This one was very recent as the uploaded video was from April 14, 2026. https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=aeulAv_Q3qY   Youtuber `PokeDean` got his home robbed where his Pokemon collection got stolen. This was on February 15, 2026. https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=8GQEmF4lUug Then on April 20, 2026, `PokeDean` gets his card store robbed. https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=4VBMlQUGNKU   ## Card Store Thefts In Canada --- In my home country of Canada, there are a few card store thefts as well. https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=zIN96WP_XLk https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=bZdFdxcB_a4   ## Notes --- Pokemon's motto is `Gotta Catch 'Em All`. Some people take it way too far. They think is gotta steal them all. Pokemon card stores have been become targets just like jewelry stores. With Pokemon cards and other collectibles going up in value, there will be resellers who wish to profit off of rising prices. There will also be resellers and scalpers who will take extreme measures including stealing stuff. I do like the Pokemon TCG as an occasional player and occasional collector but I do think the Pokemon TCG bubble has kind of popped. A minority greedy group of people has ruined things. Some people could blame Logan Paul for his influence.

body.body:
Hello Hive members and members of the wonderful world of Splinterlands! Today has been a wonderful day, firstly because upon registering in Splinterlands I received an amazing notification that the user @thebighigg gifted me some cards. One of the cards is the **Great Bear Druid**, which I love; it's super cool for defending you, and I think I can finally level it up. Another card is the **Mystic Scale Weaver**. I haven't used this card much, but it looks like a great card, so I'll give it a try and see how it goes.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/angeluxx/23w2aHsTEeomUqkFF5v5qzHnDeMadWLcZ2VyHHzVi1KFDnBC9JYnHAQoBAUwc28FKsDjH.png)

Another surprise is that when I checked my card collection, I realized I have several cards that need leveling up. One of them is **The Guardian of the Robust Axe**. I had it at level 2, and now, thanks to @thebighigg's help, it's at level 4. It's absolutely spectacular; I love it.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/angeluxx/23tvB1qEEfbzszAs8AkRon97FfMsHDrTGAVpfSEc39ZTSWFN52coFy5wmtm8DiMD7zN9n.png) | ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/angeluxx/23xp2NJNg7UtUtysKvJWQTQ7Rg3LE3h48VGZJB2C3PpShhubsZwX4Pm9vRrXvSQGHRD64.png)
-|-


<div class=\

>In Grimbardun, the Robust Ax Guardians demonstrate that martial mastery transcends gender. Forged amidst mines and tradition, these dwarves combine brute strength with impeccable technical discipline. Champions of axe throwing, they face their enemies with defiant chants, uniting the hardness of stone with an unyielding will. ____ Another card I managed to level up was **Twice Knight of Yesteryear**. This card is fabulous; I managed to get it to level 2. This warrior stands out for her great power and determination to help the most needy and weak. ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/angeluxx/23ywkYwQzPSubsNd4isxa1pSyCuPX8CS1MYZ654diY7kw3D7TgMsFqX6rsUJ2a6VK2zDZ.png) | ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/angeluxx/23tvCoWeFQsi19SmRUWBFYNY3Y2dYfusHxMVcGmGxaqtoRGJZTmiXC6kyjeSDYyBadKAx.png) -|-

body.title: Curveballs and Big Decisions
body.body:
<center> 
![DC.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ericvancewalton/23tkfuMzmiEqET6t65fAXym6CJNugsnYzj8FNaqQDQPwhR2tCbFXRrFZRXfE8RzAyDi1r.jpeg)
</center>

Many of you might remember my wife and I moved out of the city of St. Paul in autumn of 2024 to a suburb on the outskirts of the Twin Cities. We then spent the following eighteen months doing painstaking and extensive renovations to the house in order to modernize it and make it our own. 

<center> 
![House.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ericvancewalton/2432MqpHG8x11FrtRNUZsMTxGR54oweeH7aZPbo8wh3EkwuS2rHc2VEcJduhf8z92TTjh.jpeg)
</center>

<center> 
![House2.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ericvancewalton/23uQzjuStqqGGB66WqXbzMqv7QuGSeb21ohpShmwPmNX6uoxL9vgSETcmYV3spzgHa7mS.jpg)
</center>

Last week we learned of a massive data center being built by Meta in one of the neighboring communities about five miles away from us. This gargantuan complex will be sharing our aquifer and power stations and this has, historically, not played out well for local home owners in that regard. Municipal water typically ends up being polluted with heavy metals and microplastics and energy prices skyrocket for everyone because of increased demand. Local regulators have every incentive to look the other way because of how much money these tech companies bring into the areas they’re built. To make matters worse we discovered this Meta facility is also just the first of many data centers slated to be built in this area. 

I’ve seen these scenarios play out in the city my mother lives in—Johnstown, Ohio. Intel announced their plan to build a massive data center complex in a neighboring town about five years ago. Since then farmland and residential properties have been gobbled up and an area that was once lush, peaceful countryside looks like a dystopian nightmare. 

After a bit of research I discovered one potential upside—real estate prices in areas around data centers tend to see double-digit increases in market values. These facilities usually trigger a deluge of new people moving into the area for high paying jobs the data centers create. 

Therein lies the *big decision* part of the post. 

We feel like we struck gold finding the house. We live in a small, private, community surrounded by protected wetlands, nature trails, and woods. After existing in the hellish chaos of post-pandemic Twin Cities for so long this place has been an oasis of peace and quiet for us these last, nearly, two years. However, this data center situation might be a great chance to get out of this cold, high-tax state and escape to greener (and warmer) pastures. 

We will have to see how this plays out over the next few months. It’s strange how life can throw these unexpected curve balls at you when you’re least expecting it. 

I'm sure many of us will be faced with similar decisions in the coming years as more of these data centers are built to power the AI that will help to shape the lives of future generations. 

## The true question is will we learn to coexist with them or say, *Not in our back yard!* and relocate? What would you do? ##


All for now. Enjoy your weekend and thanks so much for reading. 


---

body.title: El GPS que sabia massa
body.body:
Hi havia una vegada un home que es deia Jordi, molt orgullós del seu cotxe nou amb totes les tecnologies possibles. Especialment estimava el seu GPS intel·ligent, que, segons el venedor, “no només et porta al destí, sinó que et coneix millor que tu mateix”.

Un dia, en Jordi decideix anar a visitar la seva sogra (cosa que ja començava malament). Programa el GPS i aquest li diu amb veu suau:

—Ruta iniciada… però de veritat vols anar-hi?

En Jordi es queda sorprès, però pensa que és alguna mena de funció moderna.

—Sí, sí, vull anar-hi —respon.

El GPS recalcula i diu:

—D’acord… però emocionalment no et convé.

En Jordi, una mica molest, continua conduint. Al cap de cinc minuts, el GPS torna a parlar:

—Gira a la dreta… o segueix recte i sigues feliç.

—Però què dius?! —protesta en Jordi—. Només guia’m!

—Jo et guio, però també et cuido —respon el GPS—. Recordes l’última vegada que vas anar-hi? Vas sortir menjant sopa freda i amb autoestima baixa.

En Jordi sospira i continua. Però el GPS no calla:

—Atenció: hi ha trànsit intens… i també mala energia a la destinació.

Finalment, en Jordi arriba al carrer de la sogra. El GPS fa una pausa dramàtica i diu:

—Has arribat. Vols que activi el mode “excuses creïbles”?

—Com?!

—Opció 1: “Se m’ha punxat una roda”. Opció 2: “Tinc una reunió urgent”. Opció 3: “He trobat la felicitat i no puc anar”.

En Jordi es queda pensant… i diu:

—La 3.

El GPS respon:

—Excel·lent decisió. Recalculant ruta cap a una terrassa amb cervesa freda.

I així va ser com en Jordi no només va evitar una tarda incòmoda… sinó que també va descobrir que el seu GPS era l’únic que realment volia el millor per a ell.

**Moral de la història:** si un dia el teu GPS et jutja… potser té raó.

body.title: Graffiti on a wall.
body.body:
Graffiti on a wall.
I took these photos while I was traveling.
My friends and I were walking around the city, and there was graffiti painted on the walls and fences.
This time, it’s a portrait of a girl. It turned out to be such a vibrant, beautiful piece of graffiti. 
I’ve always admired people who paint graffiti. It’s a great talent. You have to paint a large picture beautifully, too. A drawing covering an entire wall is awesome. I really like it.
I’m so glad I went on this trip. I saw such beautiful places with graffiti drawings. Lots of interesting places. 
I love to draw. I draw in programs. But I’ve never tried drawing graffiti on a wall.
I like it when people create bright drawings; I draw bright drawings myself. It adds brightness to our world. It becomes more beautiful and more fun.

body.title: Watch Me Unbox And Assemble The Wagon Cart For Mochi
body.body:
![wagon cart.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leannwithdoublen/EoGyRhDyepDSn86TWxFPTP55BEi9wYEpcd5tpTZc4nfUVKfsJSRiURVQvk9DfJi6AVY.gif)
Hello, how are you? Last week we went on a vacation in Baguio, which meant we needed to walk for a lot of time. Our dog Mochi came with us, and to make it easier to carry Mochi, I decided to buy a wagon cart just to make our lives easier when walking. But to my surprise, Mochi loves to walk, she never lets us carry her. She enjoys the place's coldness and coziness. We pretty much use it every day when we do our late afternoon walk. She is just chillin' there watching people and other animals. We usually put her in there after she does her business because when I still hadn't bought her wagon cart after doing her business, she always wanted to be carried after, so it is a relief for us. I bought this for $13 bucks after the sale, pretty expensive for a small cart, but super helpful for us. And I can use it for carrying things, not just for Mochi. Instead of buying a stroller for a dog, I just bought a multi-purpose one to save money, too. ----
Let's Unbox and Assemble!

> ![2.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leannwithdoublen/EoEstiQKqxURDdDMuQWFBuQH5sCasDHeUkUuafncjXemusxFe7GMdnUqLoj4qhoTShr.JPG) It is packed in a cardboard box and wrapped with bubble wrap. ----

> ![4.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leannwithdoublen/EowHe4fcJX2tWZrcAejPWqrY2xLh5G3oMmffqpB6LaraY7Vi2b6Ecw13CdQ59Bm9Ecu.JPG) It came with complete parts, which I felt relieved about. I like to sort it with their pairs. As I look at it, I won’t need instructions to assemble it. ----

> ![8.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leannwithdoublen/EoeGnoxWBiHjsaximLZuU9L1WV89frCRgKiRiZ5Dp7nuTxTttpoX8MGg28xaeT57HSX.JPG) Time assemble! What I do is I unfold the body of the wagon cart and then flip it. ----

> ![10.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leannwithdoublen/EoiXCW22w5HcauXaemrW159S8tvvSmEm1m5pd55GwbCqZH5bjUYFrGygE1xKsST5hVE.JPG) I am going to assemble the wheels. These two pairs of wheels have a different way of attaching to the body. ____

> ![15.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leannwithdoublen/EoiY3wsw9XAsgeWDc4nHiXjRhAL8w9hkRLoLQYs642zEaTDiHc7BYFcgSmx8MvxRZDo.JPG) First, I am going to connect the first pair of the wheel to the front part. It has a screw to lock it when I finally put the wheel into it. And then do the same on the other wheel. ----

> ![17.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leannwithdoublen/EoK7jYvLSyHkotbF7ekj8Baj7AJRWD9iZAMhB4JhFaXyUSZorHeHVVPMxefVcNS36k6.JPG) Lock it with a screw until it is tight enough not to get loose. -----
> ![20.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leannwithdoublen/Eoc91zc3ZXdmyUkYpsrcaNSLzHVSB5iiNPmGqQUWiN5gDeinr7VzwA6DW7AFJmT2cpV.JPG) Now the front pair of wheels is assembled. -----

> ![22.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leannwithdoublen/EopuR2sWpYHSqAKzFpdRLhxd9zAapm3LURjKi8pNkAYPjHxeBFvMSiyCvSPvV2HR9dJ.JPG) The second pair of wheels is easier to connect. Just press the circle button. ----

> ![26.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leannwithdoublen/EouB9wn72gSSnTaLJsKBSgSQrTvNeJATjoru6C56g3FNMPNW8tidsfjGRh7rgvdeFPB.JPG) Push the button and while pushing it in, until that button clicks and locks on the hole, and done, and do the same thing on the other wheel. ____

> ![29.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leannwithdoublen/Ep5oCRgHzyHXzonmugdEMfCYgf9Nga5QnM73sNn5p9JAXYo1kkLceEL1iA6Jw15TKRS.JPG) This is what it looks like, and time to put the fabric on the wagon. -----

> ![31.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leannwithdoublen/EowF9gUyfJGr9TAozKF4xvq8rnkyzULYwp9HURLYC6Z1b8Uff8PfNsjt5ThU2Jckt9Y.JPG) It has a velcro to lock it into the metal of the wagon. Four on one side and then on the bottom of the fabric. -----
> ![34.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leannwithdoublen/EoEofDhBHmAVDoZtsDCQksAxGdwdV1n1hbkKV6PvxNH1S4h7WtVU36R2SDYjb7XU5RC.JPG) Wrap it around the metal to secure it. ----
> ![36.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leannwithdoublen/EpNmWSkUVZPXdPPv9dzToE21bQpnraXhcbPFgnfxxPNYiACdJXkrpsGcFyq6EK4aSj2.JPG) Do the same thing on the bottom part of the cart. ----

> ![38.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leannwithdoublen/EoprTonC2S2Djw6sP6XoxTHv3upqaKY2qaHfongFKTWbGewKCj8EqDR5Be4DxPHHh8o.JPG) Now the wagon is assembled. To extend the handle, just press this part and pull until you hear a click. ---
> ![41.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leannwithdoublen/EowHWkXUEyMBE7LNsQWLfZbinz9RWXFNJBpzqJZBXo9sMHBdYuuVH5AYEXsoJqq2CQG.JPG) The wagon cart is ready to be used. ----

> ![44.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leannwithdoublen/Ep5ncED7AySx2DSk1M1L3cYoWiArbykSpfyZs2NTLuqLeAGdyw8J71fYnhUycic9WRK.JPG) Mochi is out the day this wagon cart is delivered, so when they came home, I hurriedly let her ride the wagon, and she likes it. She looks so relaxed. ----

> ![IMG_2274.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leannwithdoublen/23x1DBT4TqenH8ZZD6mCvhTrtLksHXG7JoNHnWv2Ew8RGoLGH2c6ZME7QTfaUmMAsHkPT.jpeg) And then we tried it when we were doing our walking, we let her ride it after she was done with her business LOL. ____
![IMG_1660.GIF](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leannwithdoublen/Ep1YKDwaWQV4zotiFz9ytL4mphGKCNYJ2vPz6pXw3trPyx2uTk1Wwz991PCpESNbBXn.GIF)
____
![IMG_1661.GIF](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leannwithdoublen/EoK8DwcHTPRHgRvUhaGz9ChYNZPb6Q8b98HdGeXPgLUmxLfA1vFCAatKGEpupLbjGTM.GIF)
------
Thank you for visiting, see you on my next blog. :D Please take care of your mental health as well. I hope you are okay today :))

body.title: ⚔️ Dollet Mission Begins | Final Fantasy VIII EP 3 🎮🔥
body.body:
There’s something special about going back to *Final Fantasy VIII*. Not just playing it… but really experiencing it again.

In this episode, the story takes us to one of the most iconic early missions in the game: **Dollet**. And honestly, this is where things start to feel serious.

The landing, the music, the tension… everything builds up in a way that reminds you that this isn’t just another RPG — this is a journey.

---

## 🎯 The Dollet Operation

The mission itself is simple on paper: support the invasion and secure the communications tower. But once you're there, you realize it's far from easy.

Enemies start showing up more frequently, and you begin to feel that shift from tutorial to real challenge.

What I like about this part is how the game doesn’t rush you — it lets you absorb the environment, understand mechanics, and slowly raises the stakes.

---

## 🧠 Strategy Matters

At this point in the game, it’s not just about attacking.

You start thinking about:
- Magic junctions  
- Resource management  
- Enemy patterns  

Even small decisions begin to matter more. And that’s where *Final Fantasy VIII* shines — it rewards attention, not just action.

---

## 🎵 Atmosphere and Nostalgia

The soundtrack during this mission hits differently.

It creates that perfect mix of tension and nostalgia. If you’ve played this game before, you already know — this moment stays with you.

And if it’s your first time… you’re in for something special.

---

## 🎬 Watch the Episode

Here’s the full gameplay of this part 👇

https://youtu.be/NtT8x_0Ha1E

---

## 💭 Final Thoughts

This episode feels like the true beginning of the adventure.

Dollet is not just another mission — it’s the moment where the game tells you:

*\

*

And honestly… I’m here for it.

---

## 📢 Follow the journey

If you enjoy classic RPGs, nostalgia, and real gameplay experiences, this series is just getting started.

![IMG_20260424_181535.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmUSSz1gLpTfYBgQw3pTsCGp49A5wrpbQ2FJVGkvnjh3rN/IMG_20260424_181535.jpg) ![hive dividers-04.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmdvc788wxsBSQHY3z21o3wSTU7hqRnyYc2JFEn2pEYSev/hive%20dividers-04.png) The morning began simply yet meaningfully. After breakfast, I sat relaxed, enjoying a steaming cup of coffee, energizing me to begin my day. The calm morning atmosphere was my best companion before I began sewing a peci (traditional prayer cap) for religious purposes. The needle and thread seemed to be my constant companions, moving slowly to the rhythm of my accustomed hands. Sewing is not just work, but also a form of meticulous care and patience. Each stitch must be neat for a satisfying result. Time passed imperceptibly, until finally the sun began to tilt to the west, signaling the beginning of evening. In the afternoon, I walked out to the rice fields to observe the rice plants, which were already turning yellow and full. The sight of the expanse of rice ready for harvest brought a special sense of gratitude. Between the rows of plants, a few weeds could be seen growing, but overall, the rice was in good condition. That was when the most beautiful moment arrived. The sun slowly set in the western horizon, casting a golden glow that enveloped the entire rice field. The silhouettes of the trees and the warm sky created a calming atmosphere. I paused for a moment, taking in the simple yet precious beauty of nature. The day felt complete. From a productive morning to a relaxing afternoon, everything taught me a lesson about the balance between work and enjoyment. ![hive dividers-04.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmdvc788wxsBSQHY3z21o3wSTU7hqRnyYc2JFEn2pEYSev/hive%20dividers-04.png) ![IMG_20260424_181556.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmWLLR8QiosKuy7jCMmkJjTLPuUkKbUBnXahYrbdajdgJU/IMG_20260424_181556.jpg) ![IMG_20260424_183426.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmQBBwVurruCYM7Dg5yKfzcKU2WEbhuQwFq1vdApkgiaEv/IMG_20260424_183426.jpg) ![IMG_20260424_183528.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmfYwsEXWvYJqD8xNfvoG63x7UY3iBLEgRxHBCZeQK2xcC/IMG_20260424_183528.jpg) ![IMG_20260424_174237.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmWYgapSiPLTEbS3gvYUubhGNDwA9uGBaxag2j3He6FC2S/IMG_20260424_174237.jpg) ![hive dividers-04.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmdvc788wxsBSQHY3z21o3wSTU7hqRnyYc2JFEn2pEYSev/hive%20dividers-04.png)

body.body:
<div class='text-justify'> 

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmRFVVbYWiSKW7TJMs9L4okPChSGYbzTb4FqEu4xYfyyJ2/image.png)

## 🌪️ The Ultimate Sour & Spicy Tornado: Holy Basil Stir-fry with Fermented Pork (Krapow Naem)!

### 🇬🇧 English Review by Sakol

**What is up, my hardcore flavor junkies!** Sakol is back in action, and today we are breaking the rules of traditional street food! If you think you know *Pad Krapow* (Holy Basil Stir-fry), think again. Today, we are swapping the usual minced pork for something absolutely wild: **Naem** (Thai Fermented Pork Sausage)! 

Brace yourselves, because this plate is an absolute flavor bomb!

* **The Sizzle & The Scent:** The moment the chef throws the crushed garlic and bird's eye chilies into the blazing hot wok, the aroma hits you like a truck—a spicy, mouth-watering truck! Then goes the *Naem*. It hits the hot oil, getting these beautiful, slightly caramelized, crispy edges while keeping that bouncy texture inside. 
* **The Flavor Explosion:** Here is where the magic happens. *Naem* has a signature tangy, sour profile. When that sourness collides with the savory, salty, and fiercely spicy Krapow sauce, it creates a contrast that makes your brain do backflips! It is rich, it is sharp, and the peppery aroma of the holy basil leaves ties the whole chaotic masterpiece together.
* **The Perfect Bite:** Scoop up a generous spoonful of this glorious stir-fry, make sure you get a crispy basil leaf, a chunky piece of sour *Naem*, and eat it with steaming hot jasmine rice. (If you add a crispy fried egg with a runny yolk on top, it’s basically illegal how good it tastes!)

**The Verdict:** This is a rebel with a cause! The \

takes the crown for the most exciting, palate-awakening lunch you can possibly have. It’s spicy, sour, savory, and **100% addictive!** ---


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmbgVnWEDktoiVVzrSxWA5MmHd8hMu5RYEJMm7G3rTQSj9/image.png)

title.title: The Developer’s Dilemma, A Request for an R&D Land Donation
title.body:
>

Project: Land Lab | A Request for an R&D Donation

![Gemini_Generated_Image_f3abg4f3abg4f3ab.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/iblast/23w2gXsyDhDDNBf5Z1FY1HPKVtsg6MYPB5qDbg9sGcqcP85Zfr6orQbFqyequdt2Syfmt.jpg) ### 🛠 The Developer’s Dilemma As many of you know, **iblast arcade** is dedicated to expanding the Splinterlands ecosystem through innovative game modes, UI/UX tools, and interactive streaming experiences. However, there is a massive frontier I have yet to conquer: **Land.** Up until now, my understanding of Land mechanics has been purely theoretical. But as a developer, I’ve hit a wall. To create the **Mining Game** I have envisioned, I cannot simply look at spreadsheets. I need to \

Proposal
I am seeking a **permanent donation** of a rare, magical, or occupied plot of land for the iblast arcade development fund. 

While a lease or a loan is a kind gesture, it doesn't solve the core R&D requirement. To build a successful mining economy, I need to use my own assets, manage my own workers, and **personally realize the yields and cycles.** I need to see the rewards hitting the wallet to truly understand the UX of a \

game loop.

---







![Screenshot 2026-04-24 105546.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/iblast/23tbRLcd8sw1dqk16GwanozQ11ndCmMDiFE8phwzVzgUPCTsN94ZrTWE3NZhQGnyw1pRA.png)

### 🚀 Why This Benefits the Community
This isn't just about me owning land; it’s about what I build *with* it. By donating a plot to **iblast arcade**, you are directly funding:

* **The \

Prototype:** A brand-new game concept I’m developing that focuses on resource strategy and extraction cycles.
* **Real-World UX/UI Data:** I will be documenting the friction points of claiming land and managing cycles to build better overlay tools for everyone.
* **Live Dev Streams:** I’ll be playing the land game live on Twitch, brainstorming mechanics in real-time with the community.
* **Economic Modeling:** By keeping the yields, I can accurately report on the \

of the rewards, helping me balance new game modes for the broader ecosystem.

### 💎 What I’m Looking For
I am looking for a plot that has **additional mechanics** beyond a standard common plot—something **Occupied, Magical, or Rare.** These edge cases are where the best game design ideas are born.



![Screenshot 2026-04-24 105800.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/iblast/EoEoXoLdrH7SRxQ7ZfiRnsrgr8r6BcyBvLZdBdXkiCdA4paSucfmHy7VnZne64T6scw.png)




> \

— *Joe Blast*

### 🤝 Additional R&D Support
Beyond the land plot, if you are interested in supporting the **iblast arcade** mission, I am also accepting donations of **cards, DEC, or other essential R&D items like Time Crystals.** All contributions will be utilized strictly for development, analysis, and building better tools and modes.





![raregift.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/iblast/23uFKA8gEqR1iqNeEZPG9FdB8Pk1ZDHvV5ro1bvuYUadyyYQUoadqekCh5gU7HxzUKDoy.png)

To maintain perfect transparency:
* I will **document all incoming R&D donations** on a separate spreadsheet.
* Please send me a **Discord message** detailing exactly what you are sending over *while* you are sending it.
* I will keep your contribution on record, and once **iblast arcade** is launched, I will find a way to **return the favor.**

---

### 👋 How to Contribute
If you have an extra plot or a unique asset you’d like to see turned into a \

please reach out. This asset will be a permanent fixture of the iblast arcade development wallet, used to fuel every project, lore piece, and game mode we release moving forward.

**Let’s move the needle for Land utility together.**

<hr>





![badge72.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/iblast/AJg6UsW5ExReTYzSzA9RiRnfijdfv8RbhD4Mwi1LGu1u4LyhHfri8FY3Ufy4Qtb.png)

* **Twitch:** [iblast on Twitch](https://twitch.tv/iblast)
* Discord (Joe Blast)

title.title: Hive gaming 🦊 | Xtreame Motorbike 🏍️ | threespeak.tv | coverd by @traveltour
title.body:
[![](https://images.3speak.tv/images/1777043329513-98c925ca8b569743.webp)](https://3speak.tv/watch?v=traveltour/e47eb16e)

▶️ [Watch on 3Speak](https://3speak.tv/watch?v=traveltour/e47eb16e)


---

Assalamu Alaikum, how are you all? I hope you are doing well by the grace of Allah. I am also doing well. Today I have come to you with a video of a new game xtreame motorbike. The motorcycle game you see here is very powerful, it is being driven very fast and it is getting hit in different places, but still no damage is done. In addition, it collided with a police car and the police chased this motorcycle, but they could not catch it. The motorcycle is very powerful, which is why it can also jump.

![Screenshot_2026-04-24-18-58-22-599_com.mehdirabiee.XtremeMotorbikes.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmYfsf7vndJUEeb6RXWE7VGv6JpDfFBpc5t7NVWiRYG3YL/Screenshot_2026-04-24-18-58-22-599_com.mehdirabiee.XtremeMotorbikes.jpg)


The way this motorcycle was jumping from side to side looked like a Ninja Kawasaki and the driver who was driving the car was not harmed or even slightly injured which was amazing to see.Many Honda games have racing, but there is no racing here. You can travel alone here according to the time. I like it very much. The various roads have been made very beautiful. In addition, the entertainment city can be seen here in such a beautiful way that it is impossible to imagine that the bike can run like this.


I find similarities with my childhood with any content creation or gaming, so I try to portray those scenes through writing sometimes. Actually when I start writing, a lot of things come to my brain.Look I played a bike racing game today and when I was a kid, I once had a plastic motorbike like this as a toy.Those games of the past are gone, but among the current online gaming, I find those childhood games back.It's my right to try to entertain myself during work.

![Screenshot_2026-04-24-19-01-46-341_com.mehdirabiee.XtremeMotorbikes.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmc4aavbuBVFeNNmyCy6wMJTZG1ziEiLbryJ28XBTjG6Ee/Screenshot_2026-04-24-19-01-46-341_com.mehdirabiee.XtremeMotorbikes.jpg)



I am very happy to be able to share videos here during work and play this game and it relieves me from depression.There is also a lot to watch other people's videos and learn a lot here.They get money from the government by playing such motorcycle games. But even though that money seems huge to us, they don't get workers. Then I think about how good their lifestyle or their city is. I sit and think about how developed countries in Europe or America are. Sometimes I want to go there, or even be a driver there.I hope you enjoy this Honda game a lot.

---

▶️ [3Speak](https://3speak.tv/watch?v=traveltour/e47eb16e)

Here you can see 2 story or 5 story building. Many people live here. Many people live in their own homes and many rent them out. Everything is good here and everything is convenient. There are villages next to this place where a lot of cultivation is done which is again sold in the market. title.title: Każdy dzień / Every day / Každý den 2025
title.body:
Co najmniej jedno zdjęcie każdego dnia… mój fotoblog
Alespoň jedna fotografie každý den … můj fotoblog
At least one photo every day ... my photoblog

***
**PL**
Już kwiecień a ja dopiero zamykam 2025. To był intensywny rok. Wydarzyło się bardzo dużo:
- byłam w Wietnamie, 
- byłam w Dreźnie (Niemcy) i kilka razy w Czechach,
- leciałam balonem,
- statystowałam w filmie, który teraz będzie prezentowany w Cannes
- byłam i nad morzem i w górach,
- zrobiłam 50000 kroków w jeden dzień
- moje zdjęcia były na wernisażu zbiorowym w małej galerii
- dużo jeździłam na rowerze
- zakończyłam swój projekt - codziennie przez cały rok chodziłam min 6000 kroków, bez dnia przerwy (co oznacza, że byłam zdrowa)
- zrobiłam dużo dżemów winogronowych
- zrobiłam własne pralinki
- miałam pierwsze zbiory w ogródku
-...
***
**EN**
It’s already April and I’m only just wrapping up 2025. It’s been a busy year. So much has happened:
- I went to Vietnam, 
- I went to Dresden (Germany) and to the Czech Republic a few times,
- I went on a hot-air balloon ride,
- I had a bit part in a film that’s now going to be screened at Cannes
- I went to the seaside and the mountains,
- I walked 50,000 steps in a single day
- my photos were shown at a group exhibition in a small gallery
- I cycled a lot
- I completed my project – I walked at least 6,000 steps every day for a whole year, without a single day off (which means I was healthy)
- I made lots of grape jam
- I made my own pralines
- I had my first harvest from the garden
-...

***
**CZ**
Už je duben a já teprve uzavírám rok 2025. Byl to intenzivní rok. Stalo se toho opravdu hodně:
- byla jsem ve Vietnamu, 
- byla jsem v Drážďanech (Německo) a několikrát v České republice,
- letěla jsem horkovzdušným balónem,
- hrála jsem komparz ve filmu, který se nyní bude promítat v Cannes
- byla jsem u moře i v horách,
- ušla jsem 50 000 kroků za jeden den
- moje fotky byly na společné vernisáži v malé galerii
- hodně jsem jezdila na kole
- dokončila jsem svůj projekt – každý den po celý rok jsem ušla minimálně 6 000 kroků, bez jediného dne přestávky (což znamená, že jsem byla zdravá)
- udělala jsem spoustu hroznových džemů
- udělala jsem si vlastní pralinky
- měla jsem první sklizeň na zahradě
- ...

title.title: The joy of fishing in the pond
title.body:
I lived in Dhaka for several years. I had to move to the city to solve my family's financial crisis. Because my parents still live in the city and even though I live in the village, the beauty of the city still fascinates me. 

After six long years, when I came to my village home from the city, I saw fish in our village pond. If you have not experienced the joy of fishing in your own pond after a long time, it is impossible to imagine it.


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmPb1HNaZ5rgmmeP75fYzq8dur5EdjfE49wm8QHF3XCBf4/1777042923384.jpg)


So we set up a machine and then decided to fish in the pond. I and a few of my colleagues fished and had a lot of fun fishing. Water accumulates in the small ponds of the village during the rainy season and when the water is low in the area, the water is pumped out of the pond. 

After pumping the pond water, a lot of fish are found there. Since I was in the city for a long time, I became very fond of fishing in the pond when I came home from the village. So, my relatives and everyone together fished in the pond and the joy of fishing was very great.



![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmP9MJhav6jHJMbiTPpxWe7nJ98g8LfSN8dLM9PjhetuRS/1777042923497.jpg)



However, in addition to the open water fish in our ponds, we also cultivated fish fry in some ponds. Originally, the ponds were very small and we released a very small number of fish in the ponds and we had high hopes and dreams of raising them. However, when all the water in the ponds dried up within a few days, there was no sufficient water supply to the ponds. As a result, we caught the fish in the ponds.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmdm928ghqpACEwaqJv54Xj71SQo8wKYbgDSh8zvpHzMs3/1777042923579.jpg)







After catching the fish from the pond, we processed them. We shared some of the fish and cooked some of the fish and kept them for eating. We also tried to keep the fish that were still alive alive for a few more days. For this, we made a small fish storage place and stored the fish there. 

All in all, we finally came from the city to the village and caught fish and shared them with each other. We stored some of the fish for later eating. 

Finally, this wonderful moment of coming from the city to the village made us very happy. How did you like the scene of collecting fish? If you like it, don't forget to comment. Thank you very much for being with the Korean community.

title.title: How plants teach you to let go | Cómo las plantas te enseñan a soltar
title.body:
>

<center>**¡Bienvenido a un nuevo post, querido Hiver!**</center>

<div class=\

> **Leía el post de @bonzopoe y es impresionante la cantidad de enseñanzas que nos dejan las plantas.** Por mi parte, creo que la lección más dura de aprender es el desapego. Algo que es increíblemente necesario en la vida y con las plantas también. Hace meses tenía una planta nueva, era hermosa, y no importaba lo que hiciera, la planta se moría poco a poco. Hasta que desapareció. Pero antes de ello, lo que hice fue dejarla en el jardín para cuidarla como a cualquier otra planta. A los días, la planta se deshizo, formando parte de la tierra de la maceta. En ese momento solo pensé en que ya habrá otra oportunidad para traer alguna otra en casa. O que quizás esa especie no es para mí. Mi casa es muy oscura, y afuera el sol es inclemente, por lo que debo elegir o tratar de elegir plantas que se adapten a las condiciones de mi hogar. Algunas han corrido con suerte, otras no tanto. >! [English version available by clicking here] >**I was reading @bonzopoe's post and it's amazing how many lessons plants teach us.** > >For me, I think the hardest lesson to learn is detachment. Something that is incredibly necessary in life, and with plants too. > >Months ago, I had a new plant; it was beautiful, and no matter what I did, it slowly died. > >Until it disappeared. But before that, I left it in the garden to care for it like any other plant. After a few days, the plant decomposed, becoming part of the soil in the pot. > >At that moment, I just thought that there would be another opportunity to bring another one home. Or that perhaps that species wasn't for me. > >My house is very dark, and outside the sun is harsh, so I have to choose, or try to choose, plants that adapt to the conditions in my home. > >Some have been lucky, others not so much.
![photo_2026-04-24_11-01-31.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/zulfrontado/EpLgyF8Z7uw9Gj9hzYRMUtmc3rdVb4sVtsGdut43CiZE2uotMn5nmQRmEwq4Ro2ENEc.jpg)

> Pero esas que no tienen la oportunidad de quedarse conmigo en algún momento dolieron mucho. Sin embargo, así es la vida, hay cosas que se quedarán contigo y otras que no. Sucede igual con las personas. Antes temía alejarme de amistades de años, pero llegó el momento en el que entendí que debía dejarlos ir o alejarme porque ya no podía estar allí. Cuando tan solo piensas en ello la primera vez, te vienen a la mente todos los buenos recuerdos. Esto te hace quedarte un poco más hasta que la realidad te golpea para darte cuenta de que son personas que ya no son para ti. También, de alguna forma, en momentos de la vida pensamos en nosotros mismos como salvavidas. Creemos fielmente que podemos contra todo. Que podemos cambiar a las personas, que podemos hacerlas mejorar, que podemos conseguir eso que tanto anhelamos de ellas. En ese proceso nos olvidamos de lo más importante, y es que son seres humanos que piensan por sí mismos, no marionetas. Eso es algo que llegué a pensar en algún momento, el estar siempre allí porque confiaba en que algún día las cosas cambiarían y mejorarían. Pasaron años, y nada cambió. Fue entonces cuando tomé la decisión de soltar. Cada persona que soltaba dolía muchísimo. A su vez experimentaba algo, y era eso que tanto anhelaba, paz, tranquilidad. Porque no había aceptado del todo que esas personas me dañaban, hasta que experimenté no tenerlas a mi lado. Con las plantas no puedo decir lo mismo, porque honestamente es la relación más saludable que he tenido en la vida y, además de ello, me han enseñado mucho. También me enseñaron a soltar. Porque a veces solo hay que aceptar que no hay nada que hacer. Y para avanzar hay que hacerlo. Hay que dejar lo que nos daña para poder ver el panorama de otra manera, incluso para poder respirar un poco. Puede que todo esto cueste; sin embargo, los cambios siempre serán necesarios en todos los aspectos. >! [English version available by clicking here] >But those things that didn't have the chance to stay with me at some point hurt a lot. > >However, that's life; some things will stay with you, and others won't. The same is true with people. I used to be afraid of distancing myself from friendships of many years, but the moment came when I understood that I had to let them go or distance myself because I couldn't be there anymore. > >When you just think about it for the first time, all the good memories come flooding back. This makes you stay a little longer until reality hits you, making you realize that these are people who are no longer meant for you. > >Also, in some ways, at certain moments in life we ​​think of ourselves as our lifeline. We firmly believe that we can overcome anything. > >That we can change people, that we can make them better, that we can get what we so desperately want from them. > >In that process, we forget the most important thing: they are human beings who think for themselves, not puppets. > >That's something I thought about at one point, always staying because I trusted that someday things would change and improve. Years passed, and nothing changed. > >That's when I made the decision to let go. > >Letting go of each person hurt a lot. At the same time, I experienced something, and it was what I longed for so much: peace, tranquility. > >Because I hadn't fully accepted that those people were hurting me until I experienced not having them by my side. > >I can't say the same about plants, because honestly, it's the healthiest relationship I've ever had, and besides that, they've taught me so much. > >They also taught me to let go. Because sometimes you just have to accept that there's nothing you can do. > >And to move forward, you have to do it. You have to let go of what hurts you so you can see things differently, even just to be able to breathe a little. > >All of this may be difficult; however, change will always be necessary in every aspect of life.

title.title: Bowmont Park
title.body:
There is always plenty of green and lots of hills to climb at Bowmont Park. It follows along the Bow River and is part of what are the foothills that start on the western side of the city of Calgary and go further west until eventually turning into the Rocky Mountains. You could also just stay on top and walk along the ridge, but it's not as interesting and eventually starts to deviate away from nature back into neighborhoods. 

So I like to go down the winding hilly pathways and see what I might encounter. What I really like is that it is isolated but still fairly open so you can see anyone approach from a distance. It also reminds me of being exhausted from walking up and down hills when I look at these pictures but I feel like they were worth the trek.
