title.title: Miss Ugly Universe 2026💀👹 / Miss feo universo 2026🏔️🌏 (En-Es)
title.body: >Nature is truly strange when it comes to natural adaptation and evolution! We can walk anywhere in the world and come across a very strange animal, some \

would be the correct term since there's no beauty standard in the animal world; it gives them an advantage in competing for resources. Welcome to Miss Ugly Universe 2026! You'll choose the ugliest contestant in my post!💀👹

#

La naturaleza es muy extrana en lo que respecta a temas de adaptacion natural y evolucion!! podemos caminar en cualquier parte del mundo y toparnos con un animal muy extrano, algunos \

seria el termino correcto ya que en el mundo animal no existe un estereotipo de belleza, da ventajas para competir con recursos. Bienvenidos el Miss Universo de los Feos 2026, tu vas a seleccionar cual es el participante mas feo en mi post!🌏🏞️ ![a.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/biologistbrito/23tGw7s5Xe1q88MGzv9b6YMWYmsahvANi8zE71HTMP7wTG4jgdvGvyrvibKFA6293VkJH.jpg) #
Introduction to small bugs📍🌏 / Introduccion a los pequenos bichos🚩📸
![1.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/biologistbrito/23wX3BueiNTVwwrezHuqQyor7GA175Qe1TVoYaWUE4HneTbwQWL3A6wz81Zyy4e9FZfVN.gif)
*Image of Cladoceran (animal kingdom, arthropod) 40x (OC)🌏 /Imagen de Cladocero (reino animal, artropodo) 40x (OC)*📸
The animals I'm about to show you are all small, measuring between a few millimeters and a few centimeters. They are all macroscopic, meaning they are visible to the naked eye. This is the difference between them and microscopic organisms, which are invisible to us and require high magnification to see their details! The invisible or minuscule world dominates the Earth, and 90% of the animal population are insects. And although it may seem insignificant, these microbes have dominated the Earth for over 350 million years! It's incredible...👨🏻‍🏫👨🏻‍🏫
Los animales que te presento a continuacion son todos pequenos midiendo entre pocos milimetros a pocos centimetros, todos son macroscopicos esto quiere decir que son visibles al OJO humano, y es la diferencia con los organismos microscopicos que son invisible para nosotros, y requieren grandes aumentos para ver sus detalles! el mundo invisible o minusculo domina la tierra y es que el 90% de la poblacion de animales son insectos, y aunque nos parezca insignificante los microbichos dominan la tierra hace mas de 350millones de ano! una locura...🥼🥽
![gif5_verde_animado.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/biologistbrito/23tcQwWKu1QjkmYPLdJN15WRfUrWr5Zze8TmQubBPDAMTVRodNmLrtSsE28CqDNnvviZy.gif)
![20260421_220504.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/biologistbrito/EoK5qek216j9QR7yg7AesCKWKeqxsz4J2Wr4FpKhQrXJ6fetiiQFD9bLEs2m86fdgpq.jpg)
I strayed a bit from the contest rules; I was actually supposed to select only one bug, but I decided to hold a beauty pageant, but in this case, for the ugliest one, haha. Therefore, I will show you the most horrible side of nature: bugs that we see flying or walking around, but we don't have the ability to see the details. I will use my microscope and take photos using a macro view. The bugs cannot be analyzed with lenses higher than 40x because it would crush them.💀👹
Me sali un poco de las reglas del concurso en realidad tenia que seleccionar solo un bicho, pero decidi hacer un certamen de belleza pero en este caso del mas feo jajaj, por ello te mostrare el lado mas horrible de la naturaleza, bichos que nosotros los vemos volando o caminando por alli pero no tenemos la capacidad de ver los detalles, utilizare mi microscopio y realizare fotos utilizando una vista macro, los bichos no pueden ser analizados con las lentes superior a 40x porque los aplastaria📸👨🏻‍🏫.
![gif6_dorado_shimmer.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/biologistbrito/23twC3hcw4x8Y1qsCn6goYEV4x9NWf6UVG34R2w6WFF2csuDuQtCy4TdwzfaVVon48NV1.gif)
#
First Miss Venezuela contestant🔬🌏 / Primera concursante Miss Venezuela💀📸
![20260421_214043.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/biologistbrito/23yJJpZEcGjjDzZ8DyZarHYXk5VEvFKycMoTvtG3HfLvCmNY5qHUDan9ZxLVKLRjuSUj1.jpg)
Miss Venezuela was represented by the Cladocerans. If we think of arthropods, the first thing we associate with them is the land, but maintaining the planet's balance are these tiny organisms, just a few millimeters (3mm) long. We can see them swimming and suspended in lakes and ponds. They are sensitive and are used in laboratories to measure water quality, as they are not very tolerant of chemical changes in the water.🏞️
Miss Venezuela esta representaba por los Cladoceros, si pensamos en bichos artropodos lo primero que asociamos es a la tierra pero manteniendo el equilibrio del planeta estan estos pequenos organismos de pocos milimetros (3mm), los podemos ver nadando y suspendidos en lagos, estanques, son sensibles y se utilizan en laboratorios para medir la calidad del agua! ya que son poco tolerantes a cambios quimicos en el agua.🔬
**Source:** https://www.imas.utas.edu.au/zooplankton/image-key/cladocera#:~:text=Size,Approximately%201%20mm%20long.
![2.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/biologistbrito/23t6zsn1Pcrvfrhoevq2uoJHWkKF6j9RTGjWnmZa3UqbgVkSN1VD5S6wXJcLtR6D6fdU3.gif)
*Son inofensivos para el hombre pero realmente extranos, casi nadie los conoce y parecen aliens. (OC)🌏 /They are harmless to humans but really strange, almost nobody knows about them and they look like aliens. (OC)*📸
![20260421_214441.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/biologistbrito/Eoc1E6DJvAi9WZ95PZciFf2nBTQjR4y7XE41RMvoEehDpdivEmnxTix8Tk75EUeH5S7.jpg)
Miss Venezuela brought her entire repertoire to win the contest, but it won't be easy. Cladocerans are great colonizers of aquatic environments because they have a rather peculiar reproduction method... They use \

that's right... They are capable of cloning themselves and need nothing more than themselves to grow their population. And you know what's most incredible? See those black balls? They're eggs... These eggs are laid in the mud and can survive the worst environmental conditions until the rain comes and they hatch again... They are almost indestructible.🌏🥽\n\n
Miss Venezuela trajo todo su repertorio para ser el ganador del concurso pero no lo tendra facil, apesar que los Cladoceros son grandes colonizadores de medios actuaticos ya que tienen una reproduccion bastante peculiar... Utilizan la \

, asi es... Son capaces de clonarse y no necesitan mas de que ellos mismos para crecer la poblacion, y sabes que es lo mas increible? ves esas bolas negras? son huevos... Esos huevos son colocados en el barro y pueden sobrevivir las peores condiciones ambientales hasta que llega la lluvia y salen de nuevo... Son casi indestructibles.👨🏻‍🏫📸
![gif5_verde_animado.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/biologistbrito/23tcQwWKu1QjkmYPLdJN15WRfUrWr5Zze8TmQubBPDAMTVRodNmLrtSsE28CqDNnvviZy.gif)
#
Second Miss Portugal contestant🔬🌏 / Segunda concursante Miss Portugal💀📸
![3.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/biologistbrito/23uQi7LuwdERL1LURuK6RWSJWZqJnV4EYLdZub2cmy5oBMH2VjwGKgPCzwivM27sVWK6t.gif)
*order Ephemeroptera nymph dragonfly (OC) 40x🌏 /orden Ephemeroptera ninfa libelula (OC) 40x*📸
![20260421_214845.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/biologistbrito/EoK4Re7fogPke6kwLpVmTJznpMwExvsgLiWdsGzgtUf9EP4RnXP5aduRpp6VQzBHBse.jpg) ![20260421_214858.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/biologistbrito/EoGw3TCuQffjcx4UAGPMuHigiJLF2tJoiMVy1USagAdbAGhS7Nw3cxvZwYcpXk5Ai53.jpg)
Imagine walking along and seeing a dragonfly. You think, \

But Miss Portugal hides many things that almost no one knows... Dragonflies need a body of water, usually stagnant water, to complete their life cycle and lay their eggs. Later, the nymphs emerge—a rather unpleasant, ugly, and voracious stage... That's right... These creatures are always hungry and are predators, feeding on anything that moves in the water.👹🥼
Imagina caminar por alli y ver una libelula, te dices guao! que bonito insecto!! pero Miss Portugal oculta muchas cosas que casi nadie sabe... Las libelulas para completar su ciclo de vida necesitan un cuerpo de agua normalmente agua estancada para poner sus huevos, posteriormente llegaran las Ninfas un estado bastante desagradable, feo y voraz... Asi es.... Estos bichos siempre tienen hambre y son depredadores alimentandose con todo lo que se mueva en el agua.👨🏻‍🏫🙇🏻‍♀️
![20260421_215012.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/biologistbrito/EokajgJeuxgrxNUEUuYRMbH1avHmAgDkDB1EmSzJNH9LDGXAMUAReivNnpTzpua2fzk.jpg)
Its body molts more than 12 times to grow until it reaches the adult stage where it will leave the water... you can see the compound eye quite developed, articulated legs and the mouthparts that are already ready to catch its prey.💀📸
Su cuerpo muda mas de 12 veces para ir creciendo hasta llegar a la fase adulta donde saldra del agua... se puede ver el ojo compuesto bastante desarrollado, patas articuladas y las piezas bucales que ya estan lista para atrapar a sus presas.🔬🥽
![gif6_dorado_shimmer.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/biologistbrito/23twC3hcw4x8Y1qsCn6goYEV4x9NWf6UVG34R2w6WFF2csuDuQtCy4TdwzfaVVon48NV1.gif)
#
Third participant Miss Argentina🔬🌏 / Tercer participante Miss Argentina💀📸
![20260423_133902.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/biologistbrito/Eo8KfhnjvGXWWtnR2DpE2EYHNoMy2EXb1eQENHQdCTJAbypX2skM48NhcdE8bto2V3T.jpg)
Miss Argentina is a true work of natural art, one of the ugliest things you'll ever see. It's called a whirlpool beetle, from the Gyrinidae family, and capturing it was an odyssey since they move in circles and quickly on the surface of the water. They have one of the strangest eyes in nature, literally \

Why? Easy: two to see outside and two to see inside the water... UFFFF!!!!💀👹\n\n
Miss Argentina es todo una obra de arte natural, de lo mas feo que podras ver, se llama (escarabajo torbellino) familia Gyrinidae y capturarlo fue una odisea ya que se mueven en circulos y rapidos en la superficie del agua, tienen uno de los ojos mas extrano de la naturaleza literal \

, por que? facil dos para ver fuera y dos para ver dentro del agua... UFFFF!!!!; 🙇🏻‍♀️📸 ![20260423_133910.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/biologistbrito/Eo8KfiLYRWyKCQ3e5e9MaKjujL55rpk6bdNddZ3WTVbTYpMZ6SGUkJ1EzhaR3iVaz1i.jpg) *What happens if you try to capture it? It has a strange defense mechanism, emits a smell like rotten apples, and its erratic, circular swimming throws off predators! Miss Argentina really does hide many secrets...🌏💀* *Que pasa si lo tratas de capturar? tiene un mecanismo de defensa raro, emite un aroma como a manzana podrida 0.0, y sus nados en circulo de forma erratica hace despistar a los depredadores! de verdad que Miss Argentina oculta muchos secretos...👹🥽*
![gif5_verde_animado.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/biologistbrito/23tcQwWKu1QjkmYPLdJN15WRfUrWr5Zze8TmQubBPDAMTVRodNmLrtSsE28CqDNnvviZy.gif)
#
Fourth participant Miss Cuba🔬🌏 / Cuarto participante Miss Cuba💀📸
![20260421_220128.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/biologistbrito/EoEiqz5BiDe9CKZ5NnEJ1gMy9W4bCbV8HNGDr8QvPGiHjfFyAWvCEhLfjGU1oZDjb87.jpg) ![20260421_220154.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/biologistbrito/EoptPxirYVNEhg5WnbrBwoZaRyJhHSxu7Hfojrtry9LjKpHTxwzSZC7P6fCAJAFL7rx.jpg)
*Water boatman family Corixidae (OC) 40x🌏 /Barquero de agua familia Corixidae (OC) 40x (OC)*📸
To identify Miss Cuba, we would have to look at its paddle-shaped legs, as well as some hairs; these act like oars in the water, moving at high speed. It has large, well-developed compound eyes. These bugs have triangular mouthparts to feed on organic matter such as detritus, but they are also capable of capturing some larvae.📸🙇🏻‍♀️
Para identificar a Miss Cuba tendriamos que ver sus patas en forma de remo al igual observamos unos pelos, estos actuan como remos en el agua desplazandose a gran velocidad, ojos grandes compuestos y bien desarrollados, estos chinches tienen piezas bucales triangular para alimentarse de materia organica como detritus, pero son capaces de capturar algunas larvas.👨🏻‍🏫🔬

Fifth Contestant Miss Angola🔬🌏 / Quinto Participante Miss Angola💀📸
![5.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/biologistbrito/23vsEFFmtqEmbmgEbbUuRbLrC3DhcvQN3TXAs9yosmtMYSD1nhMgFmoyJVZ9CAfNribJj.gif)

![20260422_121637.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/biologistbrito/EoK6JxbGne3VwG3iiGzdVR2tf1opmLN2mEbnuFb5EYzpfm93nAi1o6CtdYcWfUqkPGV.jpg)
The predatory king of the waters—will Angola be the winning country? Is it ugly enough? The truth is, these animals' feeding habits are insane! They capture their prey with their pincers, then inject enzymes that break it down into a liquefied substance, which they then suck up! They're like tigers, ambushing their prey from the vegetation! Another incredible fact: they're so voracious that even large larvae can capture tadpoles or tiny fish...💀🌏
El rey depredador de las aguas, podria Angola ser el pais ganador? es feo suficiente? lo cierto es que estos animales, la forma de alimentarse es una locura!! con sus pinzas capturan una presa luego le inyectan enzimas que las descomponen y hace un licuado para luego succionarlo! son como tigres, emboscan desde la vegetacion sus presas! otro dato increible son tan voraces que las larvas grandes pueden capturar renacuajos, o pesces diminutos...🙇🏻‍♀️📸

![6.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/biologistbrito/23uFTmvdo7cGrr314REE31ANCsFPJgq9eCeoYS7dapZ2XgjNT4opxx28eJaKTysen8m3C.gif)

The mosquito is the animal that causes the most deaths in the world, approximately 1,000,000 per year, and it seems so harmless yet ugly...very ugly! The mosquito larva has sensory hairs that help it detect predators or changes in the water. Its segmented body allows it to quickly escape threats by moving in a whip-like motion! What we see as transparent are tissues that will transform into its adult stage. Is Japan the ugliest bug?💀👨🏻‍🏫
El mosquito es el animal que mas muerte causa en el mundo, aproximadamente 1000000 al ano, y parece algo tan inofensivo pero feo...Muy feo!!! la larva de mosquito tiene pelos sensoriales que le sirven para detectar depredadores o cambios en el agua, su cuerpo segmentado permite escapar rapidamente de la amenzada moviendose en forma de latigo! lo que vemos transparente son tejidos que se iran a transformar en su fase adulta. Es Japon el bicho mas feo?👹🥽

They're creatures from the Gerridae family, animals as ugly as they are incredibly adaptable. They have thousands of hairs on their legs that trap air, allowing them to walk on water... That's right... They don't sink. Their antennae detect vibrations in the air or water. Their aerodynamic body allows them to move quickly. It's strange because they're predators, and do you know how they feed? They use the water like a spiderweb. When a creature falls in and gets trapped on the surface... they eat it!💀📸
Son bichos de la familia (Gerridae), un animal tan feo como super adaptativo, tiene miles de pelos en sus patas que atrapan aire lo que les permite caminar en el agua... Asi es... No se hunden.... Las antenas son para detectar vibraciones en el aire o en el agua, su cuerpo le permite ser aerodinamica y poder moverse con rapidez, es extrano porque son depredadores y sabes como se alimentan? usan el agua como tela de arana, cuando un bicho cae y se queda atrapado en la superficie... Se lo comen!!!🙇🏻‍♀️🌏

title.title: This Game Is Pure Madness 😱🔥 Payback 2 Racing Mode🏁
title.body:
[![](https://images.3speak.tv/images/1777042425567-c2b5cdc442922554.webp)](https://3speak.tv/watch?v=likhon420/e226d667)

▶️ [Watch on 3Speak](https://3speak.tv/watch?v=likhon420/e226d667)


---

Payback is an action-oriented game and a racing-oriented game.In the game, a person can play various action-oriented games and racing-oriented games, and there are missions given in it, you have to complete those missions, and if you can complete the missions, you will be given three stars.

The game is very sophisticated and the game is very fun and exciting to play.In the game, you can play multiplayer with your friends, whether they are from anywhere in the country or abroad.The game was usually based on a story that was based on a true story.The game has a shooting mode and a racing game mode.

There are many campaigns and there are also story-based games.I have played this game here is a racing game with jeeps and private cars.If you want, you can take your time and play the story game. The story game is even better.But I really like the racing modes in this game because it is very exciting and cars are burned with rockets and various short songs.

You don't need a very good device to play the game. It is possible to play if you have a mobile with about 2 to 3GB of RAM and a fairly good processor.The game has 60 FPS.If you want, you can enjoy playing this game in your free time and I hope you will enjoy the gameplay like this.

The rules are also very unique compared to playing multiplayer in Duty because in multiplayer games you can play with your friend as your opponent and if you win by killing a lot there you will get various gifts from the game.

I played this game entirely by myself and there are no outside parts in it, i.e. there are no copyrighted parts.

Thumbnail source:Captured by me from the game.

Thanks all.Hope you will enjoy the game.And I will come back soon again with something new.🖤

---

title.title: My Actifit Report Card: April 24 2026
title.body:
![image](https://pixabay.com/get/g1d65dc56e4975c521b26fa12d10e96c139c6eb1f469a3096d45c794772928c84b1dc75db3511311460e1b79f2d7d52daad9e2f710c7b6024aa8738a8397a1d93_640.jpg)
오늘 산책을 하면서 정말 즐거운 시간을 보냈습니다. 동네를 한 바퀴 돌며 다양한 사람들을 만났는데, 특히 오랜만에 고등학교 친구를 우연히 만나 이야기를 나누게 되었습니다. 서로의 최근 소식과 근황을 나누며 시간 가는 줄 모르고 이야기했네요. 산책 중에는 공원에서 예쁜 꽃들이 만개해 있는 걸 발견했습니다. 특히 벚꽃과 철쭉이 함께 피어 있어, 화사한 색깔들이 정말 인상적이었어요. 꽃향기도 좋고, 사람들도 많아서 활기찬 분위기가 느껴졌습니다. 오늘의 산책은 소중한 인연과 자연의 아름다움을 동시에 느낄 수 있는 시간이었습니다. _This report was published via Actifit app ([Android](https://bit.ly/actifit-app) | [iOS](https://bit.ly/actifit-ios)). Check out the original version [here on actifit.io](https://actifit.io/@titusfrost/actifit-titusfrost-20231229t015511428z)_

title.title: Monomad: The audience watching the battles [Eng/Esp]
title.body:
>

This is my entry for the #monomad challenge.

Happy Friday to everyone, dear friends in the community and lovers of black and white photography; I hope you’re having a great day today. I’d like to share with you a different perspective on the freestyle events I love to attend; I hope you enjoy these photos.

Feliz viernes para todos, queridos amigos de la comunidad y amantes de la fotografía en blanco y negro; espero que encuentren estupendo el día de hoy. Quiero compartir con ustedes una mirada distinta a los eventos de freestyle a los que me encanta asistir; espero que disfruten de estas fotografías.


https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/naitreart/23vsJJ2yezXqRCCY5uh6qjspN1hxkZv9PodGBhJZs733g9evZUwcCK2c5dxgXfqnSrwrf.jpg

https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/naitreart/23tm9BTHn5A9Hwb6TV7XQeq7sEH7pPwBU5BZdh7EEezAipmp7fcgJKJS3RysU2Ey3KuAp.jpg

https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/naitreart/23uFM2y89N1ndyqC48A8jwENKpy1sYFcNXToU6YBmSmjVKvVVh64cy9Asz9dPRCgu3WeK.jpg

https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/naitreart/23x12snSjUMb1Bjc4vTAbiqvyNw2UFUaJu3ydDueEjqLmNWFcD7RjpjhHBH7vaZouTRQH.jpg

>

For those who follow my photography, you’ll know that when I take photos at events like this, I usually focus on the competitors, but this time, the photos really highlight the audience watching these battles. I thought it would be interesting to change things up a bit; of course, I also included some photos of the competitors.

Para aquellos que siguen mis fotografías, sabrán que cuando hago fotos en este tipo de eventos me centro en los competidores, pero en esta ocasión, las fotografías apuntan mucho al público que presencia estas batallas. Me pareció interesante cambiar un poco la dinámica; evidentemente, también incluí algunas fotografías de los competidores.


https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/naitreart/23xKjesUxk1r72mMLMjMBZr6NALdWSxJPyausAdcqonq2TR91u5UAMyaPGnXSL5Aokeik.jpg

https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/naitreart/23vhuHUfLrj8fVXC2eKuGJPfAwoYP81Xwdbrm7do5coBCgNy7a5sH17hMR6XTSBegPht9.jpg

https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/naitreart/23uQfW2ukggTHURWEBZJm7pbYpJ7neEsVE4dgAxGeYSm3GmtKFrTaAKg8d9vxiM4XRP5t.jpg

>

To add that extra eye-catching touch to the photos, I felt that the final result worked perfectly in black and white, and personally, I think it was the best decision it created that striking contrast and dramatic effect, a distinctly urban vibe that fits this setting perfectly.

Para dar ese toque más llamativo en las fotografías, me pareció que el resultado final venía perfectamente en blanco y negro y personalmente creo que fue la mejor decisión, para generar ese contraste más llamativo y ese toque más dramático, un toque bastante urbano que perfectamente encaja en este escenario.


https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/naitreart/23tm6rYvsifnehmsaxg1aRA4eAkAQKAQhfnwZUDq3nr36zsS9j6fZe4j2i67rABkF7urQ.jpg

https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/naitreart/23wMWRz24r1gPk2L2BwaFMaJiKmBuQPPc2LM4c9NVoAhjzm4st1VJMNFuxLqnUMVotm6A.jpg

https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/naitreart/23vhoD2iG8YACiYD9ta3vYzCGBBG6E2jThEHTGjjKZKDcYBdK7Zn8tC4fsfr73tjzZMNM.jpg

>

I don't have anything else to add, but I do want to thank you for taking the time to look at my photos once again. Thank you very much; it's always a pleasure to share my photos with the community. Once again, I hope you all have a great Friday and a happy weekend. See you next time!

No tengo nada más que agregar, pero sí agradecerles por tomarse el tiempo de ver mis fotografías un día más. Muchas gracias, siempre es un gusto compartir mis fotografías en la comunidad. Nuevamente, deseo que todos tengan un excelente viernes y les deseo un feliz fin de semana. ¡Hasta la próxima!

/>

\n

>@Naitreart.

title.title: El sonido de la victoria - Historia [ESP-ENG]
title.body:
> Al día siguiente, la banda se volvió a reunir en el estudio y lograron encontrar ese concurso de que estaba en redes sociales, sin embargo, el evento estaba cerca, y todos tenían que prepararse, aun así se inscribieron. La competencia era pequeña, pero el pase directo al regional era exactamente lo que necesitaban. Lucas estaba nervioso, ya nunca había tocado en una tarima, solo en su cuarto y ahora, el tambor ya no era solo su compañero; era el puente entre su sueño y la realidad. —¿Qué tal si ensayamos algo nuevo? —sugirió Dani. El resto lo aceptó y en esta ocasión no podía ser solo una versión de lo que habían estado haciendo antes; debía ser algo que realmente los representara y nuevo. Stewie comenzó a tocar notas fuertes, que rompiera con las estructuras típicas de las bandas locales. Dani ajustaba los acordes en su guitarra. Lucas empezó a golpear los tambores con fuerza—Vamos a mezclar lo que conocemos, pero darle un giro, —dijo Lucas. >The next day, the band got back together in the studio and managed to find that contest they’d seen on social media; however, the event was coming up soon, and everyone had to prepare, but they signed up anyway. The competition was small, but the direct pass to the regionals was exactly what they needed. # >Lucas was nervous; he’d never played on a stage before, only in his room, and now the drum wasn’t just his companion—it was the bridge between his dream and reality. “What if we try something new?” Dani suggested. The rest agreed, and this time it couldn’t just be a version of what they’d been doing before; it had to be something that truly represented them and was new. # >Stewie began playing loud notes, breaking away from the typical structures of local bands. Dani adjusted the chords on his guitar. Lucas started pounding the drums hard. “Let’s mix what we know, but give it a twist,” said Lucas. ![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmSBuqUybPeVX7tbc3pCMBpDqFQvcgW8acSwVfNSXamtne/image.png) [Source](https://pixabay.com/es/photos/m%c3%basica-guitarra-instrumento-cl%c3%a1sico-6606248/) Los días siguientes fueron de ensayos intensos, largas horas y momentos de risa y unión, ya que cada miembro de la Banda aportaba algo único. Michelle también agregó algunos efectos, mientras Stewie le daba vida a nuevas melodías con la guitarra, y Dani creó nuevas transiciones. Lucas, cada vez más seguro, sentía que su tambor era más que un simple instrumento, era la pieza central de su propuesta. Finalmente, llegó el concurso y cuando entraron en el local donde se realizaría el evento, se encontraron con un público y muchas otras bandas que estaban preparadas, pero no podían dar marcha atrás. —Lo que es dar lo mejor y tocar con el corazón—dijo Lucas. Cada uno de ellos estaba nervioso, hasta que llegó su turno de subir al escenario. Dani dio el primer acorde, Stewie siguió con la melodía, y Michelle marcó el ritmo con su bajo. Cuando Lucas empezó a tocar, por primera vez allí, marcó la diferencia y la Banda sabía que no era solo una competencia, era su oportunidad para mostrar lo que realmente significaban. La competencia fue dura, las otras bandas eran talentosas, algunas incluso con más experiencia. Pero la Banda de Lucas, con su sonido crudo y auténtico, había conseguido conectar con el público y cuando el jurado anunció los resultados, todos estaban al borde de sus asientos. —¡Y el ganador es... la banda de Risignstar —gritó el presentador. >The following days were filled with intense rehearsals, long hours, and moments of laughter and camaraderie, as each member of the band brought something unique to the table. Michelle also added some effects, while Stewie brought new melodies to life on the guitar, and Dani created new transitions. Lucas, growing increasingly confident, felt that his drum was more than just an instrument—it was the centerpiece of their performance. # >Finally, the contest arrived, and when they entered the venue where the event would take place, they found an audience and many other bands that were ready—but there was no turning back. “It’s about giving it your all and playing from the heart,” said Lucas. # >Each of them was nervous, until it was their turn to take the stage. Dani struck the first chord, Stewie followed with the melody, and Michelle set the rhythm with her bass. When Lucas began to play, for the first time there, he made the difference, and the band knew it wasn’t just a competition—it was their chance to show what they were really made of. # >The competition was tough; the other bands were talented, some even more experienced. But Lucas’s band, with its raw and authentic sound, had managed to connect with the audience, and when the judges announced the results, everyone was on the edge of their seats. “And the winner is… the Risignstar band!” shouted the host. ![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmPcCvotcqPrTFMWduM78eh5T5V7YHgwuxf9EnsMzRxkfY/image.png) [Source](https://pixabay.com/es/photos/m%c3%basica-en-vivo-rock-show-concierto-2219036/) El grito de la Banda fue de felicidad, donde no solo les dio el pase al regional, también recibieron los $200 para inscribirse en el Nacional, y más importante aún, tenían la confianza que necesitaban. De vuelta en el estudio, todos festejaron y Lucas miró su tambor, con una sonrisa tranquila. —Esto es solo el principio —dijo, mirando a sus compañeros—. La Banda sabía que el Concurso Nacional de Bandas aún era más difícil, pero tenían algo que nadie les podía quitar: la pasión por lo que hacían y la certeza de que, mientras estuvieran juntos, no habría nada que los detuviera. >The band let out a cry of joy; not only had they secured a spot in the regional competition, but they’d also received the $200 needed to register for the Nationals, and most importantly, they had the confidence they needed. Back in the practice room, everyone celebrated, and Lucas looked at his drum with a calm smile. “This is just the beginning,” he said, looking at his teammates. # >The band knew that the National Band Competition would be even tougher, but they had something no one could take away from them: a passion for what they did and the certainty that, as long as they were together, nothing would stop them.
![pngwing.com 3.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmPvWeswjaMnCtt69QxnpZHm1una1iw2HUxZJpGBgEY2RH/pngwing.com%203.png)

title.title: Dzień pięćdziesiąty szósty
title.body: - Wczoraj wieczorem pojawiły się informacje o tym, że obrona przeciwlotnicza w Teheranie została aktywowana i zwalcza \

. Potem nie było już żadnych wiadomości na ten temat, więc to chyba fałszywy alarm.

- Niektóre źródła podają, że Mohammad Bagher Qalibaf miał zrezygnować ze swojego udziału w grupie prowadzącej negocjacje z USA. Powodem mają być nieporozumienia w irańskim kierownictwie i ciągłe wywieranie wpływu przez niechętnych porozumieniu, twardogłowych Strażników Rewolucji. Czy jest to prawda - na ten moment nie wiadomo. Qalibaf kilka dni temu miał ostro skrytykować postaci takie jak Sa`id Dżalili za sprzeciwianie się negocjacjom i reprezentowanie zbyt ostrego, wykluczającego dyplomację stanowiska. To jednak też nie jest do końca potwierdzone.

- Abbas Araqczi, minister spraw zagranicznych Iranu, rozpoczyna dziś podróż do Pakistanu. Z Islamabadu ma też udać się do Omanu i Rosji. W każdym z krajów ma odbyć rozmowy ze swoimi odpowiednikami na temat obecnej sytuacji.

- Anwar Gargash, doradca prezydenta Zjednoczonych Emiratów Arabskich powiedział, że odbudowa zaufania między Iranem a ZEA po wojnie \

.

- Nadal powraca temat udziału Iranu w mistrzostwach świata w piłce nożnej, które rozpoczynają się w czerwcu. Stany Zjednoczone zaproponowały, aby irańska drużyna została zastąpiona przez włoską, ale zostało to jednoznacznie odrzucone przez FIFA i same Włochy. Z kolei Marco Rubio powiedział, że nie ma żadnych przeszkód, aby irańska drużyna przybyła do USA. Jego zdaniem, problemem nie są sami sportowcy, a raczej ludzie, którzy mogą przyjechać razem z nimi - szczególnie ci potencjalnie powiązani z Korpusem Strażników.

- Reza Pahlawi wybrał się do Niemiec, żeby spotkać się ze swoimi zwolennikami i przypomnieć wszystkim o swojej sprawie. Nikt z niemieckiego rządu nie chciał się z nim spotkać, co nazwał \

. Wystąpił jednak przed sporą publicznością i spotkał się ze swoimi zwolennikami. Powiedział, że Zachód powinien przestać liczyć na jakiekolwiek porozumienie z irańskim reżimem, i zamiast tego postawić na \

, który on sam reprezentuje. W czasie jednego ze spotkań doszło też do incydentu, kiedy Pahlawi został oblany przez nieznanego mężczyznę czerwoną cieczą - prawdopodobnie sosem pomidorowym. Policja aresztowała sprawcę; nie wiadomo o nim nic więcej oprócz tego, że nie miał wcześniej problemów z prawem.

- Kaja Kallas, szefowa unijnej dyplomacji powiedziała, że w negocjacjach między Iranem a USA powinni brać udział również eksperci od energii atomowej. Uregulowanie kwestii irańskiego programu atomowego powinno być zdaniem Kallas jednym z głównych punktów ewentualnego porozumienia pokojowego.

title.title: Day’s End
title.body: > The moment the sun dips below the horizon feels like the natural end of the day.

>
The light softens, colors deepen, and everything around gradually loses its sharpness. The sea darkens faster than the sky, and against this contrast, you can see the sun’s slow descent to the waterline. A few minutes later, only a warm glow lingers in the clouds — and that, too, soon fades. Nothing extraordinary happens in moments like these. Yet in this quiet simplicity, you feel most clearly that the day has ended.

>\n

![Cream Beige Minimalist Traveling Photo Collage (1).png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dreamrona/48SMTCkKsTG9iivftYJrpGzgovqm3wsj3EY7agNPTvReTMSSYSEFfF4rKuvukD7Txv.png)

Hello Hivers! We Filipinos are naturally active, energetic, and sporty. Many of us love outdoor activities, games, and sports because it helps us stay healthy while also bringing people together. That is why I truly appreciate programs from local government units that support the youth through free sports activities and training. In our city, Tacurong City, they recently opened a free enrollment training program for an upcoming sportfest, and I was happy to witness how many young people were excited to join.

![IMG_20260423_085642.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dreamrona/23wC9vPFJj8wPrT1UjFvu6gCUxXkKDpHhwbjzxTyRgcatR9PEYuhBbg8ZJ3GvEapb4nKH.jpg)

The program was created to encourage children and teenagers to become active instead of spending too much time on gadgets and other bad activities. It also gives them a chance to discover their talents, improve their discipline, and build confidence through sports. I think this kind of opportunity is very helpful, especially for families who want their children to join training but cannot always afford expensive fees. I amazed because they have a free water and snacks during g the training. 

That day, I accompanied my nephew to the venue for enrollment. I decided to go with him because after the registration, he would be the one to watch over my child while I needed to go somewhere for an important errand. My plan was simple after enrolling, they would stay and relax at the park nearby while I finished what I needed to do. I was thankful my nephew was willing to help.

![IMG_20260423_090049.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dreamrona/23z7JHi5WdnT7PLdXvKNaCHDXF2KAwQ6GW3sn6cN2mHEAQnxsiwL8iXGhLzTHLtaMPjTA.jpg)

![IMG_20260423_090112.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dreamrona/23wqnyR6qyZhtETLEzZc6JKrop9jvEsfWZy6yvbWz8LbASQF7JJ4tTwukf48PgqjVX72d.jpg)

When we arrived, there were already many parents and young participants lining up. You could feel the excitement in the air. Everyone seemed eager to sign up and become part of the training program. I saw children wearing sports clothes and smiling while waiting for their turn. 

![IMG_20260423_085819.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dreamrona/23uFVr15XboBZPuGmyVzA5ZmPMbLjh8zwJkwX4mV6NqiKPSQrzQT7edcDXBEuwifMmAu7.jpg)

![IMG_20260423_085815.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dreamrona/23uFUA8SC5HUPQZYEyJWdysHJPhRRF7DEk9Lio2bJvcC2n9RwXtM1NruYZuq6SqgSFS5h.jpg)


Thankfully, my nephew was able to enroll successfully. He chose Sepak Takraw, which made me smile because it is one of the most exciting and skillful sports in Southeast Asia. Sepak Takraw is a game where players use their feet, head, knees, and chest to hit a rattan ball over a net. It looks like a mix of volleyball and soccer, but it requires balance, flexibility, speed, and teamwork. Watching skilled players perform kicks and aerial moves is always impressive.

 
![IMG_20260423_085559.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dreamrona/23vi1t9CnXiGYcvagjH2mzVExgywytJs8QjJ8wHNGeM6FE89nBRY2FHwaczm7URppFcFX.jpg)
I was proud of my nephew for choosing a challenging sport. It shows courage and willingness to learn something new. Instead of wasting time, he chose to spend his days training, improving his health, and developing discipline.

![IMG_20260423_085550.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dreamrona/23wqkoCeZBoPis5JJCMK9vmtvb8APcjtwtkzaLPZUjYZnMPUokVHFJw1Egkn8gex6xzV2.jpg)

![IMG_20260423_084813.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dreamrona/23xKtj7ccQNvCbPGAKR56hcARjPQrrW4W66jDUXdeG3CQJ86g2bkB3esPRFkp1NMkSFJG.jpg)

After the enrollment, they stayed at the park as planned while I continued with my errand peacefully. It turned out to be a productive and meaningful day for all of us.

Thank you for reading my story! This is my owned picture, edited in Canva. Programs like this truly help the youth and strengthen the community. Have a nice day!

body.title: It’s Not That Hard — Just Take the First Step and Keep Moving Forward
body.body: In life, we often make things more difficult for ourselves than they need to be. Fear in the heart a thousand questions in the mind and our steps come to a halt just because we think maybe we can’t do it. But the truth is most obstacles aren’t outside they’re within us. Sometimes stop and tell yourself It’s not that hard. Yes, maybe the start feels difficult maybe the path isn’t clear but every big success begins with just one small step. When you take that first step slowly everything starts to make sense and the paths begin to form on their own. We often keep waiting for the perfect time but the truth is the perfect time never comes. The people who move forward are the ones who try despite their fear. Because they know that nothing will change by standing still. So don’t hold yourself back today don’t make excuses just take one step forward and say from your heart It’s not that hard. You’ll see that the thing you thought was difficult wasn’t actually that difficult at all.

今天晚上我一直都在抖音上面。看的大部分都是画画方面的视频。
还有朋友的作品。其中一个叫大熊画画的老师，他画了许多水浒传里边的人。
每一张都画的跟原图差不多，跟个相片似的。这就是硬实力，人家画的这么好看。

然后我就在群聊里面跟大雄老师聊天。聊到了他这些话是多么好看。
其他群友也出来聊了一会儿。聊着聊着话题里面就带偏了。
说这水浒传里面这些人哪个值得深交。或者说哪一个梁山好汉不值得深交。

然后一些群友就开始讨论。许多人第一反应就是说宋江这个人不能深交。
紧接着也有人说吴用这个人也不能深交，甚至连林冲这人也不能深交。
然后还说出了为什么不能深交的道理。这样的逻辑是一套一套的。非常有道理。

照他们的分析逻辑来看，我觉得水浒传里面能够结识的人还真不多。
相反的，那些没进水浒传里面的英雄好汉，倒是有许多可以结交。
咱们先说不能深交的一些朋友吧，按照当今咱们社会的现象来做个负面对比。

就比如说最有名的武松。相信这个英雄啊，我看大家都很值得敬佩的一个人。
但实际上这种人是最不能深交的。武松像一个现代的00后职场员工。
相信现在00后在整顿职场这一块，大家都是耳目一新的，特别能够整老板跟领导。

所以第一个排除的能深交的人肯定是武松。不信的话，你们可以去想一想，是不是这样？
紧接着就是梁山头子宋江还有吴用。这两个人可以说是滑不溜秋又一肚子坏水。
当然You do子坏水是按照现在的社会风气出来的一个片面之词。

你去看一下现在的职场领导，哪一个不是滑不溜秋，一肚子坏水的，各种画大饼。
还搞了个噱头叫做招安。最后是把大家往阴沟里面带直接全部翻船。
有太多英雄好汉可以拿出来做对比。只是按照现在的社会风气做对比，没有一个能深交。

相反的那些水浒传里面的大奸大恶之徒却是能带动经济挣到大钱。
就数西门庆这名声不太好的这个人来说吧。他却是一个很好的反面教材。
UN照逻辑来讲，它是一个开会所，开娱乐场所的人。挣得大把票子。

同期还有王婆。王婆这个职业放到咱们现在社会来看。就是一个社会人脉很广的人。
按照这个逻辑来看。现在这个社会如果人际关系很广的人，还会穷吗？
只是可惜王博是个女的，如果是一个男的的话，估计也是身价不菲。

body.title: I made songs with Suno and here is what I learn
body.body: In case you’ve never heard of it, Suno is an AI tool that lets you create music with the help of some pretty sophisticated algorithms. Pretty cool, right? At the time of writing, it’s on version 5.5. I’ve always loved making music. I used to build loops in FL Studio all the time, and I even had a band back in college. These days, though, it’s hard to find the time, or even coordinate with friends, just to jam. Suno, for me, opens up a way to keep that passion alive without needing to commit to a full band setup, if that makes sense. So I gave it a try. I’m currently on the Pro plan (not Premium), which means I don’t have access to the latest Suno Studio features. That said, the Pro subscription still gives quite a lot. You get a generous amount of credits to generate songs through prompting. Although “prompting” might not be the best term, Suno tends to work better when you describe styles using comma-separated keywords rather than full instructions. As for the results, they’re decent, but not amazing out of the box. Tonally, the output leans heavily toward mainstream or generic sounds. It also tends to improvise quite a bit, which makes the song structure feel loose, sometimes it’s hard to clearly distinguish verses, choruses, or bridges. On top of that, the overall mix quality isn’t great. It often sounds muddy, with everything sitting in the center and lacking spatial depth. To get something closer to your taste, I wouldn’t recommend relying on prompts alone. It helps a lot if you already have a direction in mind, or even better, some rough ideas prepared. In my case, I started with beats, chords, and melodies I had already built in FL Studio. That gave Suno a clearer foundation and helped steer the output in a more intentional direction.

/>

Mixing and mastering is probably the toughest part. I’m not sure how much control Suno Studio offers here, but what I ended up doing was exporting the stems and finishing everything in FL Studio. The stems aren’t exactly clean, there are quite a few artifacts, so it takes a fair amount of EQ, compression, and cleanup to get things sounding right.

Overall though, it’s been a really fun experience.

Here’s one of the tracks I made, if you’re curious to hear it:  
[https://on.soundcloud.com/tGy5QkpSSxz9qqLdCq](https://on.soundcloud.com/tGy5QkpSSxz9qqLdCq)

body.title: Karate Legends - Fighting Game By GAMEXIS
body.body:
[![](https://images.3speak.tv/images/1777040927824-e66ac85da2bebcb9.webp)](https://3speak.tv/watch?v=inkbyte/fcf21d98)

▶️ [Watch on 3Speak](https://3speak.tv/watch?v=inkbyte/fcf21d98)


---

so i tried this Karate Legend game yesterday… or maybe day before, not even sure now

i was just lying on my bed, phone plugged in with that annoying loose charger thing (you know when it only works at a weird angle), and i opened it randomly. didn’t even plan to play seriously, just bored

first impression was like… okay this is kinda simple but also a bit fun in a dumb way. punches and kicks don’t feel real but there’s something satisfying about just tapping and seeing stuff happen. not sure why my brain likes that

my little cousin was sitting there eating chips and he kept saying “do that kick again” every time I did some move. i was mostly losing at first anyway, just trying to figure out controls without reading anything. i always do that, no idea why

it feels like those old arcade fighting games. you just fight, get coins, upgrade a bit, fight again. nothing deep. after a while i noticed i wasn’t even thinking much, just tapping and watching the screen

there’s this one thing though… when you land a clean hit and the enemy flies back a bit too dramatically, it’s kinda funny and satisfying at the same time. not realistic at all but it works

i got stuck on one level for way longer than i should admit. like i literally stopped, went to kitchen, drank water, came back like “okay now i’ll win for sure” and still lost again lol

my mom passed by and said something like “you always play these fighting games, waste of time” and i just nodded while still playing. didn’t even pause properly, just kept losing mid-conversation

there’s barely any story i think… or maybe i just ignored it completely. honestly didn’t care much. it’s just one of those time pass games when you don’t want to think

graphics are okay, nothing special. after a few minutes you stop noticing anyway. sound effects are kinda loud though, like every punch feels exaggerated

the loop is probably the main thing keeping it alive… fight, upgrade, repeat… and that stupid feeling like “okay next match i’ll win easy” even though you already know it won’t change much

i even deleted it once because I got annoyed, then installed it again later that same day… which is kinda funny when i think about it now

---

body.title: 历史的记忆-四二七大罢工陈列室
body.body:
很早就想参观一下四二七大罢工纪念馆，今天终于有时间实现了这个愿望。早上吃完饭乘车到大纺车站，没想到一溜号，竟然坐过了一站，下车之后碰到一位大爷，一问，大爷就非常热情的告诉我在哪里，简直走， 左拐一下就到，看来大爷对纪念馆在哪非常熟悉。后来一想老一辈的大连人又有哪一个人不知道大纺在哪呢？
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmP1QLVSoi4pHPrKc1xiiaXKKFSUqvFbF8qrHwfGnZP1mK/chenlieshi_1.jpg)
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmUpEPGJLkC1VNJnaXYkiiNCc8ojgtGrUKX91oHTA6apNw/fangzhichang.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmSDdRkSVp5XWDCmCPy4FzveYSivwWE8FqVXBDHh6qWJYH/chenglieshi.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmdTX4HiVhCXoqDWcyzTz5c6K1Fq42hv2rhs5gB6tGz8kX/wuyunduo.jpg)
车站之所以叫大纺就是因为这里有大连纺织厂，原来又叫大连福纱纺织厂，100多年前， 这里处于日本殖民统治的铁蹄之下。外面看是一座红色的三层小楼，里面有低矮的厂房。 


100多年前，这里的工人们要在日本人的剥削镇压之下，每天完成10多个小时的工作，工资低廉，后来的导游说，这里的男工人工资不及日本人的四分之一，女职工不及男职工的一半，而童工是最低廉的，还不及女工的一半，甚至更少。
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmTzBY4qv6J1Wk3cipXCys196bjhqaand3TAgoNfxbSqjw/guan.jpg)


 最终这里爆发了影响全国四二七大罢工！导游说， 这是一次伤害最小确最终胜利的一次大罢工。 我来到这里的时候，还没有多少人，后来有个旅游团，顺便跟着导游美女听听这里的历史。 
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmUc7UXrJdxgwBattTYDsWKjV7SDrHXxbTFFsGWwwfn7xd/jiangjie.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmVMEwsWu9wG5UjTDT7aAj4kScCUF7EfcFB8fpKLnXPUhE/dou.jpg)

陈列室在原厂的一座小楼里，上下两层，一层是铭记历史，二层是传承精神。一层有图片和史实，还有巨大屏幕影响资料，以及很多个小电视可以观看的历史纪录片。

1926年的4月27日，大连福纺纱厂爆发了震惊中外的四二七大罢工。 大罢工是在中国共产党的领导下，在大连中华共学会的直接组织下，全厂1000多名工人不畏强暴坚持罢工了101天，迫使日本殖民当局同意工人提出的罢工条件，最后罢工取得了胜利。

这场罢工是全国反帝运动的重要组成部分。它高举反帝国主义的旗帜，在大连掀起了一场经久不息的大风暴。 它显示中国工人阶级的力量，扩大了共产党的影响，沉重的打击了日本帝国主义的殖民统治。罢工的胜利，为全国工人运动史，增添了光辉的一页。 
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQY7QiFa4QjEomcNS6hXN5sYo2BkvA5r2wfxW8XkgB6hs/laogong.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmagLnMQCpeQv2Xup2XRm27iYy7yrN9s2ANXWF7XWbke1z/shapan.jpg)


陈列室里有很多珍贵的文物，有着纪念意义的实物和照片 。 在那个风起云涌的年代，年轻的共产党领导了这个震惊中外的大罢工，唤醒了民族的觉醒，是劳动人民血与火的战歌，是震撼人心的号角！
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmdcatNjR57zuCTPVV4YhQpq1qrWgYeKraiqevJ1gRLZw3/qianbi.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZCTiNc3Mwy3vQNYqMFpN8J45Rug1ErQpbTvV3jNXE59q/xuanyan.jpg)


看着墙上那些珍贵的照片，英勇的前辈们抛头颅洒热血，跟殖民统治者进行了不畏强权的斗争。二层展厅有个巨大的沙盘，可以直接观看和收听大罢工的整个过程。了解历史，记住我们今天的幸福生活来之不易。 
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmXX4sPUA4wYswEwLiL5uA7JKjrMM741uRywia32w9P4sK/suozi.jpg)
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmSneDXDXtNmjawqSC7ng6JPwkhYHX4heY8iaEcQNFXK4X/qidi.jpg)


导游将整个大罢工的历史和发展讲解的很透彻，看着墙上的图片，听着导游的讲解，人们不禁唏嘘不止，那时候的中国饱受内外战乱之苦，自己不强大，就会被欺辱，想想那个年代的人们有多么不容易！还好在党的领导下，最终打败日本帝国主义，迎来新中国的开天辟地。 
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmY7MCcjKhS8rkoQg23mKsQxad6tmxpYFrBmHVHRuZhVpY/nahan.jpg)


今天，当我们站在这片曾今浸透了汗水与泪水的土地上，享受着先辈们用抗争换来的和平与尊严，不能忘记那些福纱厂的工人们，是他们用坚守和牺牲换来的。

我们甚至不知道他们是谁， 不知道他们的名字，他们用行动证明，即使身处最黑暗，也总有光被点燃，总有力量可以冲破枷锁，历史从来不是沉默的，它会在每一个后来者的心中回响，而我们要做的就是传承和守护，传承好他们的精神，守护好他们曾经用生命换来的土地！

body.title: Splinterlands- Easy Win & Rating Up!
body.body:
‎Hello everyone, I'm @naturaluttom-
Today I'm back to share my experience of a match in my favorite game Splinterlands, and I really liked today's match.


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmWrfTsZHutKQwD8qunf6y7jQJLmsLFeGV8kynpE3n2BY7/1777040873314.png)

[‎The image was created with AI.]()
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmTGdTS4iqM7QBFQiHefGE2mDcpwBepyYtiFc5e9GPrzCc/1775330832072.png)
Today's match had 27 mana. There were no difficult rules, it was a very easy match. So I didn't think much. I made a simple plan like I always do. I put a strong card in front, so that it can take all the damage. And I put an attacker card, which will hit slowly.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmSRruxmBgC6FYJxE3KDmPMNESVjLeJDUzTsozLskReoT7/1777040822342.jpg)
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmTGdTS4iqM7QBFQiHefGE2mDcpwBepyYtiFc5e9GPrzCc/1775330832072.png)
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmU9YCznrKnTq8SqzR6UaPePnEinTV4qvK9VYCEDCEdvrA/1777040822383.jpg)







At the beginning, the opponent was putting a little pressure on me. At that time, I was a little scared, I thought I might lose. My first card in front took all the damage, and the card behind started attacking one by one.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmV7vgBhJETH1XAudVoBUTBAqZYTH6GBAYkWAPj7Y4d18N/1777040822412.jpg)
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmTGdTS4iqM7QBFQiHefGE2mDcpwBepyYtiFc5e9GPrzCc/1775330832072.png)
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQGHZ17YWEAoyLkC61uphMYpw5UGztPAw5SfZ91UqM172/1777040822455.jpg)
At one point, I saw that one of my cards got healed and became strong again. From then on, the match started turning in my direction. Then, all the opponent's cards gradually ran out.

In the end, I won the match 😊
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmVf91zirkX7BQkHzV83dsGhwXsbXfVUQGqo9jEpJPq9ub/1777040822499.jpg)
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmTGdTS4iqM7QBFQiHefGE2mDcpwBepyYtiFc5e9GPrzCc/1775330832072.png)
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQAqnTMXShfG7wrQnMvuy9PfjFHYH4GiXAzdXTvhXkeAy/1777040834469.jpg)
I got +20 rating for this win. Now my rating is about 580. I'm now in Bronze II, trying to move forward slowly.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmcQpfPPLRZ3LRhZnKurEYYtrMbJh5DLSpQFCUMvp9Miuc/1777040834500.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmcckhieM9MWoQouhtwCJZ6PtgFfbmiR7triMf3w24r6pA/1777040834533.jpg)
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmTGdTS4iqM7QBFQiHefGE2mDcpwBepyYtiFc5e9GPrzCc/1775330832072.png)
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmNQDUSETLMYjPvyCCbSErR7zdrs1qhCaQNAzAfkN9izZv/1777040834565.jpg)

At the end of the match I got two new cards, Colossus Raider and Spitting Camel. Nothing too big, but it will be useful for me.

Overall, I really enjoyed today's match. I realized that you can win even if you play simply.

Thanks everyone.

body.title: MONOMAD FRIDAY \
body.body:
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmbetFsMiuoHke6of9TKeS8kgwaLB8k1tQ6vkMxPt5iqK6/32323.jpg)

Hello Hive Community.

I hope you all are fine. I am also fine here. This is my entry for the #monomad challenge April 23rd. In today's post, I have presented to you the things we see around us in our daily lives. Which include flowers, plants and small wooden bridges. In today's photographs, I have also presented to you a miracle. This photograph looks beautiful in black and white.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmc7aipB7gezMG5CqDYeL7UHmZKYopBK6E2fGrc92NLtmd/1_1.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmbmiHFewLVL1y357mpbejpA4VsPFBh9hVeY9v2vbdLFUe/2_2.jpg)

I have presented to you two photographs in which the gazebo is presented in the first photograph and the huge stone in the second photograph. The gazebo seen in the first photograph is placed in a beautiful and peaceful garden area. This gazebo stands in the center of the scene and immediately attracts attention due to its neat structure and peaceful atmosphere. The roof of the gazebo is sloping and neatly tiled. This shield protects the gazebo from rain and sunlight. It is supported by strong pillars that give both stability and grandeur to the structure. The design of this gazebo is simple yet attractive. And it blends well with its natural surroundings. Inside the gazebo is a wooden hammock hanging from chains. This hammock adds charm to the place and makes it look like a perfect place to relax.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmXSY5Dnzztb8MYqvqAHW5i2XgHUHJKb18ekzSUAHNzFx4/3_3.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmcTcfj8Bk77L7NmnLdpZTHTms19NVLaPDHXqHzrN5jFS6/4_4.jpg)

In the two photographs above, the first photograph shows a wooden bridge while the second photograph shows a view of beautiful buildings in the distance. This second photograph shows a peaceful and picturesque view of a hilly area where nature and human activities come together beautifully. The entire scene is set amidst gently sloping hills covered with lush greenery. The gardens seen in this scene are of tea. The slopes of the hills are filled with rows of plants arranged in a pattern. Which gives the ground a soft and textured look. In the middle of this photograph is a group of buildings that look like small industrial buildings. The largest building looks like a factory. The factory is probably related to the processing of tea leaves. If you look closely, you will notice that it has a long structure with a chimney from which smoke is coming out, indicating that work is going on inside.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZeS6xKbmJysVfLGWXhthJjbV7ZBkHGHgVAz2CE45ozxw/5_5.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmTu4JWKhkat4k6DnYasLZa9tWbGvmpV7G3AC8MxQY7JGn/6_6.jpg)

Of the two photographs above, the first photograph shows a plant while the second photograph shows a scene with flowers. This entire area is endowed with natural beauty. Various types of flowers and plants are seen here. From which I have presented the two photographs above to you.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmRKzXu5b1WAQs5ENJ4HkCqxxk7RdRKf3BYBHTAsXBwbnn/7_7.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmctYdtZBE9WWEJ6yD5zb9ZDpuBnkAPGvnP8MebjkfLRus/8_8.jpg)

In the photograph above, a beautiful view of nature and the winding road passing through it can be seen. In the first photograph presented here, a quiet and beautiful view of a narrow, winding road has been presented which passes through a natural hill. The road bends slowly following the shape of the land. Which creates a soft and beautiful curve. On one side of this road is a rocky slope covered with patches of small plants and greenery. The rocks look natural and a little uneven. This unevenness adds a rugged charm to the scene. Some broad-leaved plants grow close to the ground, bringing life and freshness to the area.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmfMMxM4aZhfWwPELS321GpmjtgStSLhuN5xkpLWxqTx5Q/9_9.jpg)

In the last photograph presented here, there is a small wooden bridge in the middle. This bridge looks simple yet attractive. As it is made of wood and has neat railings on both sides. It is built over a narrow stream or small water channel. Through which people can easily pass from one side to the other. The design of the bridge blends perfectly with the natural environment. It seems that this bridge is not something separate from nature but a part of the landscape. There is greenery all around the bridge. Large-leaved plants grow densely near the water. Which adds freshness and life to the scene. The leaves are wide and healthy. Which shows that the place gets enough moisture and care.

Each photograph presented here presents a calm and refreshing place where nature and simple human creation exist in harmony.  I am very happy to make today's post about things around us. I hope that my post will be accepted for the #monomad challenge April 23rd.

I sincerely thank you for visiting and reading my post.

body.body: Tokenized Society🦁, shielded ZEC means **Zcash sent through its private “shielded” pool**, where the sender, receiver, and amount are hidden using zk-SNARKs rather than exposed on a public ledger like normal transparent crypto transfers [CoinGecko](https://www.coingecko.com/learn/zero-knowledge-proofs-and-zk-rollups) [Zcash Protocol Spec](https://zips.z.cash/protocol/sapling.pdf). The screenshot’s “Sapling parameters” download is the one-time cryptographic setup file Zcash wallets need to create and verify those private transactions [Zcash Protocol Spec](https://zips.z.cash/protocol/sapling.pdf). So Khal’s post is basically saying the new LeoDex desktop app supports **actual private ZEC transfers**, not just plain old visible ZEC sends [@khaleelkazi](https://inleo.io/@khaleelkazi/michael-saylors-bitcoin-isnt-real-fgp).

body.title: Splinterlands - Advancing to Champion II
body.body:
![sd.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/aubryd/23w2gUuy9JP4pVGUV7vTfGX5vNmn5HjTaTxFyaoN6QKv15cggKaBWW6jGV2SkVK4Cx3w7.png)

Hello everyone, have a nice day and good battles. After many difficult battles in the modern format, I have finally managed to reach the Champion II league, which is 4k rating. Thanks to this, I got a lot of free loot chests.

<center>![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/aubryd/242rErvyuD2GLFd2DTSbHe7QPaUDDfN6hygNrE3NbUhh69AwTWSmu8Gpc7z5TcGXZSzsd.png)</center>

I got exactly 14 minor, 12 major and 5 ultimate loot chests. Unfortunately, I didn't get any legendary or epic cards, but I did get a gold Shadowcomb Duskrose, so it was pretty nice. In addition, I got 10 rare cards and many common cards. I also got a lot of merits, 5 legendary and 1 alchemy potion. Finally, I got 5 energy and 1 entry for the weekly fortune draw.
<center>![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/aubryd/23uQfVzUnyPEsc6x4S3L5VFuAD8rbvRWrZ5eu24brnHQbm9Qt6K6E3N8efzdjySaJ5JdT.png)
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/aubryd/23tvVvY1MfXPLpQUDrQdsZ4TLYarC7tHZAPNGptBvjX2gQg1XznNDZLdUNjMBCRbnoHLL.png)
[Opening link](https://splinterlands.com/league-reward-result/?trx=937da593df8e4645d65f0485eb04b800a30031e4&ref=langice)</center>

---

Now, my djinn Surgehammer is at level 7, where it gained +1 armor stat. And when it reaches the max level, it wil learn the repair ability, which allows it to restore 2 armor points to the allied unit that has taken the most damage to its armor each round.
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/aubryd/23u5SjBaVEBB2uCsDw39sWb85ceEdfrUDBoQRuuWW7S9M4sQAfGgiBaaz1D3uYmGJwwrb.png)

---

And my avian Dragonfang Lancer is also at level 7, where it gained +1 ranged attack power. And when it reaches the max level, it will learn the Mimic ability, which allows it to gain a random ability from enemy units each round, starting from the second round.
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/aubryd/23tkjatyhsnVmjncmydMZN3vrYsubWsSwRBXWCrBhgKedVwKZAbYaYdxjQk7JFzSonMMH.png)

---

Currently, I have nine rare conclave arcana reward cards at level 7 and three at level 6. The rare unit closest to reaching the max level is the elf, Grove Doomblade, where she will learn the ambush ability, which allows her to attack before the first round begins. I hope to get epic and legendaries next time in my advanced chests and I wish you the same; have fun playing.
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/aubryd/23wMPvYJWAAufG2Y9vd65Bbskdz5Raq86E3vFAEb8ism4YvsPtv8sRuNX9nPSRYJZu79G.png)

---

Are you not playing Splinterlands yet? You can join with my [referral link](https://splinterlands.com/register?ref=langice) and I will give you 600 DEC when you buy the spellbook.

That's all for now guys, see you on the battlefield!

body.title: What is the use of celebrating earth day?
body.body: >We celebrated Earth Day on April 22 this year. This day is meant to remind us to care for the environment, to awaken our conscience and to make us reflect on the damage we are causing to our environment and eco-system. But is it really working?

>We cut trees, clear forests, kill animals, and destroy plant life, and after doing all this, we still pretend to be the “most intelligent” and “most caring” species that ever lived on this world. In truth, we have become a deeply hypocritical animal. Our actions show that we are destroying the very world that keeps us alive. No matter how beautifully we speak about conservation, our behaviour reveals something darker about us. We have become a deadly virus for the planet’s ecosystem.

>Other species have lived on Earth for millions of years without harming it. They take only what they need. They maintain balance. But we humans need more than that. We have wiped out countless species of plants and animals. We have replaced forests with concrete jungles that trap heat and turn our cities into ovens. We have filled oceans with plastic, poisoned rivers, damaged the soil and polluted the air we breathe.

>And yet, once a year, we shamelessly gather to celebrate Earth Day as if a single day of awareness can undo centuries of destruction. The truth is very uncomfortable. We have no right to celebrate this day. We should left our hypocrisy behind and reflect about our own actions.

>Our planet does not need our speeches. It needs our honesty, our responsible behavior and our willingness to change. Just celebrating a day is not enough. We need to control our desire to conquer this world. We need to plant trees, protect animals and minimize our consumption. That will be the true action.

\n\n**Thanks!**

Termine agotado tanto que fui directo a cama a descansar y caí rendido por el sueño, por lo demás todo bien, tanto que seguiré trabajando en la noche. Hoy tengo unos grandes deseos de ver una película, algo que no haya visto antes pero no se si pueda o tenga tiempo, por el momento y antes de que sea más tarde simplemente me pondré a escuchar algo de música y mirar a la distancia. Buenos días mapache 🦝 un día más, un día a la vez, ayer creo que no escribí al fin de la noche pero hoy lo hago al comienzo del día, más trabajo, más historias, más intentos de sobrevivir. Por este lado del hemisferio la mañana levanta con calor y los rayos del sol justo en la cara, así que cojo mi lista de pendientes y allá vamos. Quiero hacerlo todo y no dejar nada! ![imagen](https://cdn.pixabay.com/photo/2016/04/11/14/26/coffee-mug-1322188_1280.png) 📸 Imagen de Bellafl en Pixabay (

Listo para dormir, listo para descansar, si tuviese que darle unas notas a este día serian: Prodictividad: ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ Felicidad: ⭐️⭐️⭐️ (ser productivome hace feliz) Diversión: ⭐️ Creatividad: ⭐️⭐️⭐️ Cosas buenas del día: Sobrevivir ✅️ Regresando al texto y a la reflexión de la noche: ser paciente, siempre paciente, quizás algún día sea recompensado. Algún día, siempre esperando algún día En otras noticias inicie dos nuevos miniproyectos y quiero un poco más de Diversión en mi vida, esto último no se como lograrlo, pero.pensemos en algunas ideas. Quizás deba hacer una lista más tarde (acabo de decir lo más aburrido del mundo, Mr Fun me llaman) ☎️🦝 Cambio y fuera mapache! - 🏞🌿 hoy escribí un haiku **🎭 Emociones:** 😐 Neutral(3) **📚 Lecciones aprendidas:** - A veces tienes cosas buenas que has dejado de hacer, regresa cada vez y de vez en vez a las viejas ideas, pueden sorprenderte 💡 **🙏 Gracias por:** - Un día productivo **🎯 Intenciones para mañana:** - Más descansar, menos acumular 🎵 **Canciones:** - Familiar - Agnes Obel 🍽️ **Comidas:** - 🍛🥤☕️🍌🍟🍗 --- # 📅 2026-04-20 > *“La vida no es la que uno vivió, sino la que recuerda.”* ### 📝 Momentos - **19:32** 😐 Neutral · Hoy camine un poco, caminé y debería ser un gran acontecimiento ya que no soy de muchi caminar en esta sedentaria vida que llevo, aunque quizás en el fondo ese es el problema.de mis repentinas olas de tristeza, porque amo no se si caminar pero si estar lejos de pantallas, antes era lo contrario, quizás cuando haces de la diversión tu trabajo, pierde sentido divertirse? - Ayer amaneció soleado, y quiero empezar esto del blog. Siempre digo que es como un diario, un lugar para las cosas que se me van ocurriendo. No te preocupes por las minúsculas, las comas o los puntos, solo quiero que se entienda. Por la mañana hacía bastante calor. Me quedé mirando el café, pensando. Luego estuve leyendo una noticia interesante durante dos horas, sobre el café y la recuperación de los árboles. Así perdí la mayoría de esos pensamientos intrusivos que a veces me molestan. Después encendí las noticias y miré cosas de ecología y redes sociales. Las redes sociales pueden ser muy buenas, sobre todo cuando hablan de especies que estaban en peligro de extinción y ya no lo están. También hay un juego que me gusta bastante. Es un juego simple, de un solo clic, de esos de dar clic para toda la vida. Me descargué uno muy rápido. La verdad es que te entretiene acumulando puntos. Es de esos juegos casuales del navegador, sin mecánica complicada, donde solo hay que hacer clic sin pensar. Puedes sacarle provecho, son cosas a tener en cuenta. Mientras trabajo, tomo un poco el aire, hago pequeñas correcciones y traducciones, y le doy una oportunidad a lo que surja. Pero a veces llega un momento en el que me gusta desconectar, meditar, irme de camping o traducir mi propia confusión. body.title: Argentina - My #travelgoal 23 of 23: Corrientes. /// Mi #travelgoal 23 de 23: Corrientes. 😃❤️
body.body:
>  


I always imagined how exciting it would be to write the final post for my #travelgoal section, and today the day has finally come to do it. This has been a long, long journey <a href=\

>visiting at least one place in each of Argentina’s 23 provinces, and I must say every trip was worth it. Throughout all these years, I had the chance to explore every place I set out to visit, at different paces, but always with the same desire to discover a little more about the country we live in. Reaching the province of Corrientes was the final step I needed to complete my travel checklist, and it was just as satisfying as I had hoped ❤️.\n\n
Siempre pensé en lo emocionante que sería escribir el último post para mi sección de #travelgoal y hoy finalmente llegó el día de hacerlo. Este ha sido un largo, largo recorrido

>visitando al menos un lugar de cada una de las 23 provincias de Argentina, y debo decir que valió la pena cada paseo. En todos estos años, tuve la oportunidad de conocer todos los lugares que me propuse, a distintos ritmos, pero siempre con las mismas ganas de descubrir un poco más del país donde vivimos. Llegar a la provincia de Corrientes fue el paso que me faltaba para terminar de cerrar mi check list de viaje, y fue tan satisfactorio como esperaba ❤️. --- ---

>
</center>

---
---


I started writing this section for my blog on July 28, 2020, in the middle of the pandemic, when we could barely even step outside our homes. Up until that point, I had visited 9 provinces of Argentina in different contexts: educational trips, family vacations, as a couple, and with friends. Then, in 2021, with the help of Hive, I was able to continue traveling, and little by little those trips became longer and more fun, to the point that I spent nearly two years living like a “backpacker.” This was something I had never imagined for myself, but since I dared to travel alone, my horizons definitely expanded.

<blockquote>Empecé a escribir esta sección para mi blog el 28 de julio de 2020, en la plena pandemia cuando casi no podíamos salir ni a la vereda. Hasta el momento, había visitado 9 provincias de Argentina en distintos contextos: viajes educativos, familiares, en pareja, con amigos. Luego en 2021, con ayuda de Hive, pude continuar con los paseos, que de a poco se volvieron más largos y divertidos, hasta el punto de estar como \
por casi dos años. Esto era algo impensado para mí, pero desde que me animé a viajar sola, mis horizontes definitivamente se expandieron. ---

> --- But after so much nomadic adventure, in 2025 I began to feel that it was time to settle down a bit somewhere and start my adult life with its responsibilities, with the goal of building something for the future. That thought led me to organize myself and plan what would be my final trip of this kind, with all my free time at my disposal. That’s how I mapped out a journey that would allow me to visit the last four provinces left on my list, the final one being the province of Corrientes. To make this possible, I was lucky to count on some friends from Hive, Gabi and Luis, who generously offered to host me in their home while I was traveling through that part of the map.
Pero después de tanta aventura nomade, en 2025 empecé a sentir que era tiempo de asentarme un poco en algún lugar y empezar mi vida adulta y de responsabilidades, con el objetivo de construir algo a futuro. Ese pensamiento me hizo organizarme y planear lo que sería mi último paseo de este estilo, con todo mi tiempo libre a disposición. Así fue que planeé un recorrido que me permitiera pasar por las últimas cuatro provincias que me quedaban en mi lista, siendo la última de ellas la provincia de Corrientes. Para eso, tuve la suerte de contar con unos amigos de Hive, Gabi y Luis, quienes desinteresadamente se ofrecieron a hospedarme en su casa en el tiempo que anduviera por aquella parte del mapa.
---

> --- Finally, I arrived in the city of Corrientes on May 19, 2025, thus completing my goal of having visited at least one place in every Argentine province. I stayed with them from Monday until Thursday night, during which we explored the city extensively and spent a lot of time together. I was already somewhat familiar with Corrientes through all the photos Luis shares on his blog (@jlufer), but seeing this place in person was on another level. I was especially excited to see the golden beaches, which truly had that beautiful color.
Finalmente, llegué a la ciudad de Corrientes el 19 de mayo de 2025, dando por concluido mi objetivo de haber estado en al menos un lugar de cada provincia argentina. Me quedé con ellos desde el lunes hasta el jueves a la noche, en donde recorrimos un montón la ciudad y compartimos tiempo juntos. Yo ya conocía un poco Corrientes a través de todas las fotos que comparte Luis en su blog (@jlufer), pero ver este lugar en persona fue otro nivel. Especialmente me emocionaba conocer las playas doradas, que de verdad tenían este color hermoso.
---

> --- One of the classic postcards of Corrientes is the one that features the General Manuel Belgrano Bridge, which connects the city of Resistencia in Chaco with the city of Corrientes, crossing over the Paraná River. In the weeks before, I had been in Resistencia and could have easily reached Corrientes by taking a bus across the bridge, but I decided to detour first to Paraguay to visit my friend Noe. After all, I knew that sooner or later I would see this iconic view.
Una de las típicas postales de Corrientes es aquella que muestra al Puente General Manuel Belgrano, aquel que une a las ciudades de Resistencia en Chaco con la Ciudad de Corrientes, pasando por encima del Río Paraná. En las semanas anteriores yo había estado en Resistencia y podría haber llegado fácilmente a Corrientes usando un bus que atravesara el puente, pero desvié mi ruta primero hacia Paraguay para visitar a mi amiga Noe. Después de todo, sabía que tarde o temprano vería este lugar.
---

> --- One might think that yellowish sand is something very common, but what’s unusual about this place is that this sand belongs to the shore of a river. Usually, sand is found near the sea, but here in Corrientes it lies along the banks of the Paraná River. In Buenos Aires, if you approach any river, you’ll probably find dirt or clay, but in this city they have a small version of a beach. Additionally, everything was set up for the summer season, with umbrellas and facilities to spend the day, including a hot water dispenser to prepare mate.
Uno podría pensar que el arena amarillenta es algo muy común, pero lo raro de este lugar es que esta arena es la costa de un río. Generalmente, el arena se ubica cercana al mar, pero acá en Corrientes la tienen a orillas del Río Paraná. En Buenos Aires, si te acercas a cualquier río probablemente encuentres tierra o arcilla, pero en la ciudad ellos tienen una pequeña sucursal de la playa. Además, todo estaba preparado para la temporada de verano, con sombrillas e instalaciones para pasar el día, incluyendo un dispenser de agua caliente para preparar mate.
---

> --- Another beautiful thing about Corrientes was that art can be found on every corner: the city is full of stunning murals of different kinds that decorate all kinds of spaces. I found the city to be very colorful and well maintained, which is always appreciated by visitors. At the time of my visit, it wasn’t yet jacaranda season, when the city is covered in beautiful purple trees; but even without seeing that, I could tell how lovely everything was. I think this place has a bit of everything to be enjoyed all year round.
Otra cosa hermosa de Corrientes era que el arte se encuentra en cada rincón: la ciudad está llena de hermosos murales de distintos tipos que adornan todos los espacios. Esta ciudad me resultó muy colorida y bien mantenida, lo que siempre es bien recibido por los visitantes. Para el momento de mi visita, aún no era la temporada de jacarandás, cuando la ciudad se tiñe de hermosos árboles violetas; pero aún sin ver esto, pude notar lo lindo que era todo por ahí. Yo creo que este lugar tiene de todo un poco para disfrutarla todo el año.
---

> --- For me, it is a source of pride to finally be able to say that I have visited every province in Argentina. I’m grateful to Gabi and Luis for helping me with this final step and for showing me the beautiful city where they live. Completing this travel goal I set for myself doesn’t mean the end of my journeys across Argentina, because fortunately our country is so vast that there is always something more—and more beautiful—to discover. On the contrary, it inspires me to keep exploring what other amazing places are out there, both within our borders and beyond. But for now, I’m enjoying the fact that I was finally able to complete my cherished list, and it has been a pleasure to share it with my friends from Hive—thank you all for your support over these years ❤️.
Para mí es un orgullo poder decir que finalmente pude estar en todas las provincias de Argentina. Doy gracias a Gabi y Luis por haberme ayudado en este último paso, y por haberme mostrado la hermosa ciudad en donde viven. Terminar este objetivo viajero que me propuse no significa que se terminan los viajes por Argentina, porque por suerte, nuestro país es tan inmenso que siempre hay algo más y más hermoso para ver. Al contrario, me impulsa a querer seguir descubriendo qué otros lugares geniales hay, acá adentro y más allá de la frontera también. Pero por ahora, disfruto que al fin pude completar mi tan preciada lista y fue todo un placer compartirla con mis amigos de Hive: gracias por todo su apoyo en estos años ❤️.

body.title: Studying Manet. ❤️❤️❤️
body.body:
Hello hivers, an happy Friday to you all! The weekend is just around the corner and I'm pretty sure we will have a sunny warm couple of day, perfect to enjoy part of our free time out of home. ❤️ Today I decided to share with you an exercise I made yesterday while my hubby was teaching to his art class inside our lab room. Maybe you know it's common for every student of art to stydy the painter of the past working on similar artworks, so we can learn, for example, how to obtain a specific shades of colors, how to give the strokes in different ways, etc. I start my way on art when I was an adult, after my 40yo, but almost every day I exercise my hand and my imagination in different ways, included studying the artworks of famous painter. Yesterday I decided to study a painting by the French painter Édouard Manet (1832 – 1883) thanks to one of the many catalogues of art we have at home. I think his best known artworks is Le déjeuner sur l'herbe that was the start of the style called Impressionism, but I decided to study a portrait he panted in the 1873, the portrait of Berthe Morisot (who was a painter). ![DSCN9988.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/silviabeneforti/EpEKHbM5DSaemzYtqi8773oieNVJtWaM6Zqg61ZdDoNqtrfYhry3jBdsSKXY1dzAotz.JPG) I tried to have the same shades of colors mixing together red, black and other ones and, at the end, it was a very useful exercise for me to understand if this shade of red could work for one of my own paintings too. I was also intrigued by the way to paint the collar! In the following pics you can see the pic of the original painting printed on my catalogue and my exercise close to it (where you can see mine is not so similar to the original, but I wanted to study just this part of it): ![DSCN9990.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/silviabeneforti/Eq37dryVHouQcuEPWFuYAdnLeoMSVTvtDb8kd4W75cnz5ccU5QgH6G6SHPJyHN53oJv.JPG) ![DSCN9989.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/silviabeneforti/23zkrVbuBhQNg3Mxw3LokeWnc4SSsKVoLeaYGiRfnqBboMgqQE11weKWVd92gaT4JZAqV.JPG) In the following one, you can see a step of the process of my exercise: ![DSCN9986.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/silviabeneforti/EowJTExsFzQ76joE9qfqfThx34s3hzWXesCFVZnG65GrQ4ZzTbpgu3k3Xtvx7Y4BFr4.JPG) Thanks to this exercise, now I have an idea in my mind for a new artwork, so stay tuned! See ya soon and stay safe, Silvia



***If you like my artworks, you can find them on my online shops on
Artfinder (

>https://www.etsy.com/shop/vumap) and on my Saatchi page too (https://www.saatchiart.com/en-it/account/profile/421497). body.title: SMASH CONTEST - ROUND 423 // Capturing hidden beauty through dancing shadow lines.
body.body:
## Good night to all my beloved hive friends ♥️ ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmd4yMYB1bFHpaWocfXfTANjuUU8E2689xTu9diFDDNDKP/1777034003402.jpg) Starting from the morning the sun has been shining quite hot so that it makes all activities feel quite heavy today, but the afternoon is the right time to do various exciting activities such as taking an evening walk and capturing every moment that happens. At 5 pm I chose to visit my cousin at a boarding school called SMA N 2 Patra Nusa. In the afternoon, the sun will shine on the earth with its golden light, and also create beautiful shadows that dance on the surface of the ground, this is a satisfaction to be able to immortalize it. As we already know, a shadow is a dark shape that is created when light is blocked by an object, and at the right moment the shadow will follow the shape of the object, the more unique the object, the more interesting the shadow it produces, the conclusion is that if you want a beautiful shadow, you also have to look for an interesting object, and this is what I did at that time, namely shadow hunter. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmTTJJeSzuzJCLGMek3GvpLmtBC16w9HtkuBXuJPPv1Dsm/1777034498425.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmVNgwje6S97BAPVHjonNAKhk1VzX8kpSrWXmDB3JPkdaU/1777034498496.jpg) Under the school building, I managed to capture the beauty of the shadows cast by the building's pillars,these are beautiful shadows that have an elongated and neat shape. When I went up to the 2nd floor, I managed to find an even more interesting shadow created by the guardrails. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmNacqTPbvHjxv4Nc1U1JTHqpgsnMpwBrNW8YeAWJmBMcr/1777035248729.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQme8Zryckhfau4fYX26m4B8ZjQ8WbTooSHZgS33ednYNqf/1777035248814.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmVRstnSs6f7CU6KAP8ug6wDbm7NsTQgYZ2Ak7GZ9iFKr3/1777035248884.jpg) We can see that this fence has a hexagonal design that is interlocked and at first glance looks similar to the shape of a honeycomb, and under the afternoon sun we can see the beauty of the shadows produced by the fences, the shape follows the design of the fence and it looks so beautiful that every line and shape is worth immortalizing as an artistic moment that will not be repeated in the same way, and to get maximum results I also tried to photograph the shadows from various different angles. And now let's see the beauty of the shadows created by the trees, plants and colorful flowers in the front yard of the school. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmU5tQ1upUNBc1AC4nbPsuGLQKGVvYrht47A7mEiMFCLjK/1777036064403.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmeZV1BmXuFzQPMJLiwr7srBsjgeiZqRWyNE7fTQVH8Q8h/1777036064528.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmSwkvJG9zoZvAQuB5KPaBqxsJo5kE6Q2c4cY9e4J2DQXd/1777036064626.jpg) This is a shadow produced by nature itself so that its beauty can be felt well, under the trees we can see the beautiful shadow clearly, while taking shelter this shadow becomes a beautiful view to decorate this short moment. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmR1o3WpnCqnqyZAyJncuLpNpApaunBWighvdbWSujsii1/1777039470170.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmeqxa8Ht2Jc52ZyFBrNWMe5hEAFHgQN5mgfRGdYh42kuH/1777039470267.jpg) Being a shadow hunter is one of the things that is quite fun to do, one of the reasons is because the shadows will always change according to the light and this is also a moment that is quite difficult to repeat, and satisfaction will also be obtained when we have succeeded in finding and immortalizing these beautiful shadows, whether the shadows are produced by artificial objects or by nature itself. ----

Life is a responsibility Be yourself, keep learning and don't hesitate to start😉

And you can also find me on [Ecency Discord](https://discord.com/invite/m9MyMSWx)

----

Thank you very much for reading my post till the end, I am here to say thank you very much 🙏

---- ----

All images are mine, I took the photos using the Infinix 10 pro cellphone and I edited the images using the Lightroom application. I'm @riyat. See you again in my next post ♥️
