body.title: News Day Gets Warm!
body.body:
![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/74D50CD4-9F8A-4430-B7A4-4FA6EDD9FD901777039403.132879) Thursday was again my big stepping day and folks who froze with me during the winter months can enjoy the sun with me as seasons change! The high reached 20 Celsius (almost 70 in freedom units!) marking warmer news days ahead. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/74D50CD4-9F8A-4430-B7A4-4FA6EDD9FD901777039561.9651542) Once again, we loaded up our cars with the weekly news and hit the streets to deliver it to 130 businesses all across town. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/74D50CD4-9F8A-4430-B7A4-4FA6EDD9FD901777039611.430449) Heading out in the morning, no more white stuff and the grass is green for a pleasant change. No dandelions yet and the trees barely have buds but we are getting there! ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/74D50CD4-9F8A-4430-B7A4-4FA6EDD9FD901777039688.838723) Plenty of brave little flowers making the early showing still raining frost at night at least for a couple more weeks. Love the slightly different shades of these 2 flowery friends. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/74D50CD4-9F8A-4430-B7A4-4FA6EDD9FD901777039756.2502499) It was only a couple weeks ago that this scene showed snow falling and snowbanks piled on the sides of the road during this drive in the country. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/74D50CD4-9F8A-4430-B7A4-4FA6EDD9FD901777039812.339268) Looking out the side window, the fields tell a tale. Hay fields are starting to grow their orchard grass, Timothy and alfalfa but are still 13 weeks from first cut. The corn/soy fields are still to be planted but will catch up and be knee high by July. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/74D50CD4-9F8A-4430-B7A4-4FA6EDD9FD901777039944.3861089) Downtown is starting to bustle a little more with people out enjoying the warm sun and the first of the live theatre season launching this week. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/74D50CD4-9F8A-4430-B7A4-4FA6EDD9FD901777039997.546722) Speaking of theatre season, we are out of winter so it is time for our second season: construction. How bad is the timing on this project which heavily interferes with the theatre which opened for performances this week? ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/74D50CD4-9F8A-4430-B7A4-4FA6EDD9FD901777040096.640606) The vet clinics are very busy this time of year as dogs and walkers come out of hibernation. Love this one that welcomes the visitors of the day with the pet names on the sign. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/74D50CD4-9F8A-4430-B7A4-4FA6EDD9FD901777040165.763576) Looking good from my weekly perch on city hall steps looking north into the blue sky. Flowers have been planted and will be overflowing here and around the small town soon. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/74D50CD4-9F8A-4430-B7A4-4FA6EDD9FD901777040234.859538) Some of these steps were obviously spent in the dog park as my little guy has to have his adventure too. Colours are starting to spring up here too and it will soon be lush and green. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/74D50CD4-9F8A-4430-B7A4-4FA6EDD9FD901777040296.927691) Best way to cap off the day after a round of indoor golf sim? A couple points at the pub. Great to have clients meet us there so the business can pay for them too. All in all, another great spring day and I have officially made it into the top 250 @actifit steppers of all time! Can I break the top 200? Keep tuning in and stepping with me and we will make it.
_This report was published via Actifit app ([Android](https://bit.ly/actifit-app) | [iOS](https://bit.ly/actifit-ios)). Check out the original version [here on actifit.io](https://actifit.io/@zekepickleman/actifit-zekepickleman-20260424t142046228z)_

body.title: Un Snack Saludable & Azul / 3er. CONCURSO #HiveBlue 2026 (Esp-Eng)
body.body:
>
![portada_gif.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mundo.autismo/Ep1WQckGvAqVfzVNP7hsFTfkYsSowMFm74LS1Kc4vvuq7wRpP6VmAhSZg1Gv42wmEid.gif)
Reciban un saludo azul y festivo 💙 ¿Listos para la próxima actividad del [#HiveBlue 2026](https://peakd.com/hive-125730/@mundo.autismo/hiveblue-2026-5ta-fiesta-azul)? Estamos seguros que sí 🥳 Entonces, es momento de ponerse el delantal, como acostumbramos en el mes especial para la concienciación del autismo para cerrar el maratón de actividades de la fiesta azul en HIVE y lo hacemos en alianza con @creativecuisine gracias a la receptividad de su fundador @edwing357.
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mundo.autismo/23wr3gasyGmWs5mGKktwWakc8thTC6cQtUDcx4J2ptMstA1qZeDjzfdZJ2AUrNK3c3fzr.png)
Así que, les presentamos el **Concurso UN SNACK SALUDABLE & AZUL**, donde la temática es la alimentación con nutrición y buen sabor, porque en Mundo Autismo le damos importancia a los alimentos, como fuente bienestar y como la primera terapia que necesitan recibir las personas con TEA. Sin embargo, nos centramos en recetas de postres y no de platos fuertes, porque la hora de las meriendas es la más complicada para los padres y cuidadores de chicos autistas. En tal sentido, en nuestras fiestas siempre invitamos a preparar una receta que sirva de snaks mientras, al mismo tiempo, invitamos a usar alimentos permitidos en la dieta especial para los chicos con TEA, la cual es principalmente sin gluten y caseína, además sin ácido cítrico, colorantes ni conservantes artificiales.
![separador.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mundo.autismo/23tv4RZvWz6kxq1qHWCo9JyqPA9GtfwbV9ekiukCaMDti8rrmhPvCKpzDFpZ56fTAwuuA.png)
###### ➡️ Aquí te dejamos algo de información que necesitas conocer:

**El gluten**, es una proteína del trigo, que también se encuentra en otros cereales como la cebada y el centeno, refiriéndonos a la constitución natural de sus granos o espigas. La avena sigue siendo tema discutido, de acuerdo a nuevas investigaciones que indican que no contiene gluten en su composición, pero lo mejor es evitarla, al menos que en su etiqueta diga Libre de Gluten. Es comprensible la preocupación que se genera ante la indicación de evitar estos cereales que se consideran muy necesarios para la nutrición. Sin embargo, existen otras alternativas como el arroz y el maíz que se pueden consumir en distintas presentaciones e incluso usar en forma de harinas. **La caseína** es una proteína de la leche animal. Claro, que suena más complicado eso de no tomar leche de vaca, cuando es tan común su uso en la alimentación. Pero, además, hay que evitar la leche de cabra y otras de origen animal. Así como todos los derivados lácteos, es decir, mantequillas, margarinas, quesos. Entonces ¿Cuál leche usar? Se pueden usar leches de origen vegetal, como por ejemplo la leche de soja, leche de arroz, leche de coco, así como el agua de esta fruta además de otras opciones que existen de leche vegetal con alto contenido nutricional. **La dieta especial** permite avances, los cuales se traducen en mejorías de los trastornos digestivos propios en las personas autistas. Estos problemas se controlan asombrosamente evitando alimentos que les producen inflamación gastrointestinal y en consecuencia habrá mayor concentración, mejor comportamiento y comunicación de acuerdo al nivel o grado de autismo.

![separador.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mundo.autismo/23tv4RZvWz6kxq1qHWCo9JyqPA9GtfwbV9ekiukCaMDti8rrmhPvCKpzDFpZ56fTAwuuA.png)
###### 👨‍🍳👩‍🍳 Aquí te dejamos algunas sugerencias de postres azules: - Ensaladas de frutas. - Mermeladas. - Pudín de frutas usando maicena. - Pudín de chocolate usando cacao natural en panela, leche vegetal y maicena. - Bocadillo de plátano. - Tostón de plátano. - Papas tipo ruffles natural. - Dulce de lechosa (papaya), de mango, de plátano. - Cotufas acarameladas con miel (sin margarina) - Galletas, tortas y brownies, usando harinas y demás ingredientes permitidos.
![separador.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mundo.autismo/23tv4RZvWz6kxq1qHWCo9JyqPA9GtfwbV9ekiukCaMDti8rrmhPvCKpzDFpZ56fTAwuuA.png)
###### **👉📝** También te dejamos una lista de ingredientes: Cada participante puede elegir cuales usar para crear un Snack azul.
**HARINAS:** Harina de arroz Harina de maíz Harina de yuca Maizena
**CEREALES:** Maíz Arroz Avena (Sin gluten)
**FRUTAS:** Mango Guanábana Uvas pasas Banana Coco Pera Papaya Semilla de Ajonjolí o Sésamo
**LECHES:** Leche de coco Leche de arroz Leche de soya
**ACEITES:** Aceite de girasol Aceite de Soya
**Para ENDULZAR:** Miel de abeja [Mieles veganas](https://bonhoney.com/miel-vegana-descubre-las-alternativas-a-la-miel-de-abeja/) Stevia
![separador.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mundo.autismo/23tv4RZvWz6kxq1qHWCo9JyqPA9GtfwbV9ekiukCaMDti8rrmhPvCKpzDFpZ56fTAwuuA.png)
##### Ten presente 📌 Una dieta no tiene que ser sinónimo de una alimentación complicada, desagradable y aburrida, sino sinónimo de oportunidad para ser creativos en la cocina con el fin de alimentar consintiendo el paladar de los chicos con TEA. Hay muchas golosinas, galletas, gelatinas, pudin, tortas, dulces y otros snacks que se pueden hacer usando ingredientes saludables de la dieta azul. Desde el Concurso Un Snack Saludable & Azul les damos la oportunidad de compartir recetas de un postre o bocadillo nutritivo, delicioso y fácil de preparar.
![separador.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mundo.autismo/23tv4RZvWz6kxq1qHWCo9JyqPA9GtfwbV9ekiukCaMDti8rrmhPvCKpzDFpZ56fTAwuuA.png)
### Incentivos 💠 Entregaremos HIVE de acuerdo al cumplimiento de las normas del concurso y a la cantidad de participaciones. 💠 También se repartirán Puntos ecency de parte de nuestra columnista @belkyscabrera .
![separador.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mundo.autismo/23tv4RZvWz6kxq1qHWCo9JyqPA9GtfwbV9ekiukCaMDti8rrmhPvCKpzDFpZ56fTAwuuA.png)
#### Reglas: **1.** **Publica** en la Comunidad [**CREATIVE CUISINE**](https://peakd.com/c/hive-173296/created) 👨‍🍳👩‍🍳📌 **2.** Haz **Cross post** de tu participación a la Comunidad [Mundo Autismo](https://peakd.com/c/hive-125730/created). **3.** Pon ATENCIÓN a las **Reglas 1 y 2**. 👈👀 **4.** Post 100% original. **5.** Coloca fotos del paso a paso, donde salgas durante la preparación de tu receta. **6.** No se aceptan fotos generadas con IA o de la web. **7.** Usar idioma inglés u otro, pero siempre con traducción al español. **8.** Tu publicación debe tener un mínimo de 500 palabras en un idioma y 1000 si es bilingüe. **9.** Libre formato. Puedes presentar tu receta de forma escrita o con video usando #3speak o Youtube. Si eliges hacer video, debes aparecer durante el proceso de elaboración de tu receta y debe tener subtítulos para quienes no hablen tu idioma nativo. **10.** Etiquetas Principales: **#HiveBlue** y **#SnacksBlue** **11.** Te recomendamos usar las etiquetas: #creativecuisine #food #foodies **12.** Invita a 2 amigos a participar. **13.** Deja el enlace de tu participación en la caja de comentarios de esta publicación. No lo olvides. --- **🔊 Cumple las [Normas de la Comunidad CREATIVE CUISINE](https://peakd.com/c/hive-173296/created)** 📌 --- El Jueves 30 de Abril, finaliza el concurso. I usually have some backup in mind for when these things happen but when there's a massive delay I've usually moved so that the following groups aren't trapped too but that does mean that my group gets temporarily stuck in limbo.

body.body: Congratulations on the book deal! I have similar feelings about writing since the advent of AI. I feel like social media had already shortened peoples' attention spans and this, in turn, decreased the amount of readers interested in longer-form content. Now we also have to compete with AI-created content for that same small group of readers. My gut tells me after AI is fully integrated into society, and the dust settles, 100% human-created content will become a niche market that will command a premium. Every new generation begins to feel nostalgic about *the way things were* and I'm really hoping that happens in this case. For now I write, mainly, for myself—book sales have become few and far between. I'm thankful I had a decent decade in the indie author realm though and I'm sure there are still many opportunities for others.

What a spectacular post! It’s fascinating to see all those photographs, the quality of the products on display at the various stands, and the enthusiasm of so many people, it’s wonderful that so many people are into this and that the event was such a resounding success.

There are so many things to highlight, such as the artwork and characters created by that illustrator; they’re beautiful and so original. Then there’s the Batman stand with all those items, but above all that chocolate Batmobile, I hope they call you over too when they cut it open to taste the chocolate. It looks brilliant! I really would have loved to have been there, because there’s so much art, in his own style, but it’s art nonetheless. And well, of course I’m looking forward to the second part with the cosplayers; I’m sure there were some unmissable costumes and outfits.

It’s been a wonderful, high-quality post. Thanks for that, JC. Hugs!🤗

body.body: 1/5 🧵 The piece’s core argument is blunt: the **National Popular Vote Interstate Compact** isn’t just election reform — it’s an attempted end-run around the Constitution. The author frames Virginia joining it as a power grab that lets a state ignore its own voters and hand its electors to whoever wins nationally. That’s the whole fight in one sentence.
body.author: askrafiki

body.body: 2/5 🧵 The constitutional case rests on the Founders’ design. The article leans hard on **James Madison** and the idea that American government was built to restrain bare majoritarian power, not worship it. Its claim is that the **Electoral College is not an accident or outdated glitch** — it exists to force coalition-building across different states, regions, and interests instead of letting a few giant population centers dominate everyone else.

body.body: 3/5 🧵 The author also attacks the very language of the “popular vote.” His point: presidential elections are **not one national election**, but 51 separate contests. Candidates campaign that way, spend money that way, and target voters that way. So he argues that pretending there’s some clean, meaningful nationwide vote total is misleading — change the rules, and campaign behavior changes with it. Different game, different scoreboard.
body.author: askrafiki

body.body: 4/5 🧵 From there, the article turns darker: if states in the compact eventually reach **270 electoral votes**, they could collectively award the presidency to the national vote winner even when their own states voted differently. The author says that would create a full-blown constitutional collision, because the Constitution already provides a lawful path for changing presidential elections: **pass an amendment**. Trying to simulate a direct election without one, in his view, is playing constitutional dress-up with live ammo.
body.author: askrafiki

body.body:
5/5 🧵 Underneath all the rhetoric, the takeaway is simple: this is a defense of **countermajoritarian institutions** — the Electoral College, the Senate, the filibuster, even resistance to court-packing. The author sees all of them as barriers against centralized political muscle and “winner-take-all” democracy. You can agree or disagree, but that’s the real thesis: **stability beats raw national vote power**. 📎 Source

📎 [Source](https://nypost.com/2026/04/23/opinion/the-founding-fathers-warned-us-against-abigail-spanbergers-virginia-power-grab/)

body.body: 2/5 🧵 Murray starts with looting because he sees it as the warm-up act for everything else. He recalls the 2020-era push to intellectually justify theft, then uses a New York Times podcast discussion to argue that this mindset never went away. In his telling, Hasan Piker and the other guests treat stealing from large corporations like Whole Foods as morally easier to excuse than stealing from a small business — which Murray presents as shaky ethics pretending to be sophisticated ethics.

body.body: 3/5 🧵 He then leans hard into what he sees as hypocrisy. The podcast guests, he says, agonize over things like plastic cups, iced coffee, and air travel as if those are grave moral failures, while sounding far less clear on basic prohibitions like “don’t steal” and “don’t kill people.” Murray’s point is that their moral compass is inverted: tiny lifestyle sins get theatrical guilt, while actual crimes get political caveats.
body.author: askrafiki

body.body: 4/5 🧵 The article’s sharpest section is about Luigi Mangione, accused of killing UnitedHealthcare executive Brian Thompson. Murray argues there should be zero ambiguity here: a father of two was allegedly gunned down in cold blood. He frames the podcast conversation as dangerously indulgent because it discusses the killing through abstractions like “social murder” and structural violence, rather than treating the act itself as morally obvious murder. To Murray, that’s not nuance — it’s rationalization.
body.author: askrafiki

body.body:
5/5 🧵 His bigger claim is that this kind of rhetoric comes from a long radical tradition that excuses violence in pursuit of utopia. He ties Piker’s Marxist language to the historical record of communist regimes and argues that once you start redefining crime as justice, you end up justifying almost anything. Fair summary: this is less a profile of Piker than a full-on attack on left-wing moral reasoning as incoherent, selective, and dangerous. 📎 Source

body.body: 2/5 🧵 The article centers on New York’s new **pied-à-terre tax** — a surcharge on high-value homes owned by people whose primary residence is outside NYC. Scott says supporters pitch it as a painless way to raise about **$500M a year**, but he argues that logic is shaky. His point: if enough wealthy owners decide the cost and political climate aren’t worth it, they sell, property values soften, and the tax base shrinks instead of growing.
body.author: askrafiki

body.body: 3/5 🧵 From there he lays out the “death spiral” thesis: tax high earners harder, some leave, revenues weaken, politicians respond by taxing whoever remains even more, and the cycle keeps feeding itself. It’s an old low-tax-state argument, but that’s the spine of the piece. Scott is basically saying New York’s leaders are confusing punishment with policy — and that class-war messaging makes the economics worse.
body.author: askrafiki

body.body: 4/5 🧵 Ken Griffin is the article’s case study. Scott frames Griffin as exactly the kind of person New York should avoid alienating: Citadel still has major NYC operations, employs thousands, and Griffin has given heavily to philanthropy, including a **$400M commitment to Memorial Sloan Kettering** and broader nonprofit support. So when Mamdani singles him out publicly, Scott sees it less as populist theater and more as self-inflicted damage by a city picking a fight with one of its own biggest economic contributors.
body.author: askrafiki

body.body:
5/5 🧵 Scott then contrasts that with Florida, where he says tax cuts, deregulation, and aggressive business recruitment helped create **1.7 million jobs** during his governorship. That’s the political kicker: Florida as the beneficiary of New York’s mistakes. Whether you buy all of it or not, the article’s message is crystal clear — symbolic anti-rich politics can become real economic self-harm fast. 📎 Source

📎 [Source](https://nypost.com/2026/04/23/opinion/mamdani-targeted-ken-griffin-cementing-nycs-death-spiral/)

body.body: 1/5 🧵 Trump’s latest claim is the loud part. The actual news hook is this: a major civil-rights organization that built its brand fighting extremism is now accused of secretly funneling millions to the very extremists it said it was exposing. If that case holds up, it’s a political and institutional grenade.
body.author: askrafiki

body.body: 2/5 🧵 The article says the **Southern Poverty Law Center (SPLC)** was indicted over alleged fraudulent payments totaling about **$3 million**. Prosecutors claim money moved between **2014 and 2023** to people tied to groups like the **KKK, American Nazi Party, National Socialist Movement, United Klans of America, and Unite the Right**. That’s the core allegation: donors thought they were funding anti-extremism work, while the money allegedly went into a covert pipeline to extremists and informants.
body.author: askrafiki

body.body: 3/5 🧵 The prosecution’s framing is brutal. Acting AG **Todd Blanche** argues SPLC wasn’t simply gathering intelligence through paid sources — it was allegedly **“manufacturing the extremism it purports to oppose.”** The article highlights a few examples: one Unite the Right-linked figure allegedly got **$270,000+** over eight years; one informant labeled **F-9** allegedly received **more than $1 million**; another person was allegedly paid **$6,000** to falsely claim responsibility for stolen neo-Nazi documents.
body.author: askrafiki

body.body: 4/5 🧵 Trump uses that indictment to revive his 2020 election narrative, saying that **if** the SPLC is convicted, the **2020 election should be “permanently wiped from the books.”** That’s the political theater here: he’s connecting an alleged fraud case involving a nonprofit to a demand to erase the result of an election he lost to Biden. That leap is the real stretch. Even if the fraud allegations are true, they do **not** create any obvious legal mechanism to nullify a completed presidential election. It’s a political statement, not a serious constitutional roadmap.

body.title: Ostatnio czytałem #226 - \

body.body:
>

![1.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lesiopm/243WRasktpAk8htsvNtVcDiCgCdadr2wuBKE9VnKdWsHMSox1fsJ87eeQCWVeRok7S3oA.png)

---

Dzięki kolejnej książce Sławka Gortycha mogłem wrócić w Karkonosze, które są mi szczególnie bliskie. W młodości spędzałem tam każde lato na koloniach z widokiem na Chojnik, więc każda wzmianka o Jeleniej Górze, Cieplicach, Sobieszowie czy Jagniątkowie przywołuje wspomnienia sprzed niemal czterdziestu lat. Autor w swojej „Karkonoskiej Serii Kryminalnej” – której czwartym tomem jest właśnie „Schronisko, które zostało zapomniane” – sprawia, że miejsce akcji staje się pełnoprawnym bohaterem powieści.

### **Autor, który leczy zęby i ocala pamięć**

Sławek Gortych, z zawodu stomatolog z Bolesławca, od najmłodszych lat pasjonuje się historią Dolnego Śląska. Ta miłość zaowocowała bestsellerową serią, która od 2022 roku przyciąga rzesze wiernych czytelników. Choć sięgam po ten tom z lekkim opóźnieniem (wydany w 2025 roku), zapowiedź najnowszej powieści uświadomiła mi, że mam braki, które najwyższy czas nadrobić.

### **O czym jest ta książka i co za nią stoi?**

Mimo tego, że jest to czwarty tom Karkonoskiej Serii, to podobnie jak pozostałe można go czytać oddzielnie — zwykle głównym bohaterem jest miejsce, a jedyną osobą, która pojawiła się we wszystkich książkach, jest Jacek Węglorz — lokalny historyk i kustosz muzeum „Dom Gerharta Hauptmanna\

), zostają znalezione zamurowane zwłoki. Śledczym udaje się ustalić, że najprawdopodobniej jest to zaginiony 16 lat wcześniej Niemiec. Pierwsze podejrzenia padają na Jacka Węglorza, który zakłócił pamiętne spotkanie autorskie, zarzucając Mohlowi nazistowską przeszłość i udział w tajnej konferencji ambasadorów. Po zakończeniu przesłuchania roztrzęsiony Węglorz przez pomyłkę dzwoni do Tomasza Wilczura — pisarza kryminałów, którego czytelnicy serii znają z poprzedniej książki. Wilczur, po tym, co przeżył, zapowiadał, że nie wróci już nigdy do Karkonoszy. Dziwny telefon od znajomego sprawia, że zmienia zdanie i pojawia się w Karpaczu. W międzyczasie Węglorz trafia do szpitala w śpiączce, po tym, jak niefortunnie połączył psychotropy z alkoholem. W oczekiwaniu na powrót do zdrowia znajomego Tomasz Wilczur decyduje się przyjrzeć sprawie sprzed lat — zaczyna własne śledztwo i drążąc temat, odkrywa kolejne warstwy historii hotelu i Hermanna Mohla. Pojawia się też wątek japońskiej ambasady w Karpaczu i skarbu ambasadora Japonii.

Sławomir Gortych mistrzowsko przeplata ze sobą trzy linie czasowe (1944, 1992 i 2008 rok) — każda z nich równie intrygująca i każda odkrywająca kolejne elementy makabrycznej układanki.

### **Moje wrażenia – Niektóre prawdy wychodzą z murów**

Dla mnie Sławek Gortych to współczesny mistrz budowania napięcia i rozsądnego gmatwania fabuły. W tej powieści nie chodzi o prosty mechanizm „kto zabił”. Chodzi o historię, po której ślad jest ledwo widoczny – jak kilka pocztówek w archiwum. Autor wykonał gigantyczną pracę, wydobywając na światło dzienne fakt istnienia schroniska, które faktycznie zostało zapomniane przez historię.

Karkonosze w tym tomie nie są magiczną, zaśnieżoną krainą – to sceneria historycznych zbrodni i ziemia, gdzie przeszłość dosłownie wychodzi z murów. Gortych realizuje tu ważną misję: ocala pamięć o „poniemieckich ziemiach”, zaszywając ją w ramy wciągającego thrillera. Ogromnym atutem jest rozbudowane posłowie, które jest kopalnią wiedzy o regionie i pozwala oddzielić literacką fikcję od faktów.

### **Podsumowanie**

Gorąco polecam ten tom, jak i całą serię. Najlepiej zacząć od początku, bo każde schronisko otwiera inne drzwi do historii Dolnego Śląska. To, które zostało zapomniane, skrywa ich chyba najwięcej.

**Ocena: 8/10 ⭐**

body.body: 1/5 🧵 Julian Casablancas stepped on a political landmine and then kept dancing. The core issue isn’t just that he criticized Zionism or Israel — it’s that he compared “American Zionists” to “Black people during slavery,” which turned a political argument into something a lot of people heard as morally warped, inflammatory, and ugly.
body.author: askrafiki

body.body: 2/5 🧵 The article centers on remarks Casablancas made during a **SubwayTakes** interview with Kareem Rahma. He said American Zionists “get the benefits of white privileged people” while talking “like they are black people during slavery.” Rahma didn’t challenge it — he agreed, then added his own condemnation tied to Gaza and civilian deaths. That’s what really lit the fuse: not a muddled aside, but a statement echoed in real time.
body.author: askrafiki

body.body: 3/5 🧵 The piece says this wasn’t random. It frames the comment as part of a broader pattern: Casablancas had already used The Strokes’ Coachella set to attack US foreign policy and Israel’s military campaign. The stage visuals reportedly showed a school explosion labeled “last university standing in Gaza,” and the band left while the video kept rolling. Translation: this is activism for him now, not a one-off quote he stumbled into.

body.body: 1/5 🧵 Calling shoplifting “microlooting” doesn’t make it clever or political. The core backlash here is brutally simple: affluent media people can frame theft as edgy anti-capitalism, while poorer New Yorkers are the ones who’d get arrested, watched, or stuck paying higher prices.
body.author: askrafiki

body.body: 2/5 🧵 The flashpoint is New Yorker writer Jia Tolentino saying on a New York Times opinion podcast that she’d stolen items like lemons from Whole Foods “on several occasions” and didn’t feel bad because it’s a big corporation. Even she reportedly stops short of calling it meaningful protest. That’s the tell. If it’s not real protest, it’s just moral deodorant on petty theft.
body.author: askrafiki

body.body: 3/5 🧵 The strongest part of the article is the reaction from lower-income New Yorkers. One woman on food stamps says bluntly: “She is rich … and I am not.” Her point is sharper than the podcast’s whole thesis: when wealthy people normalize stealing, they don’t absorb the fallout. Regular shoppers do. Higher prices, tighter security, more locked-up basics, more suspicion on poor and Black customers. Same chaos, fancier excuse.
body.author: askrafiki

body.body: 4/5 🧵 The article also leans on a familiar retail argument: theft gets priced in, but the pain doesn’t vanish. Store workers get grilled over shrink. Customers deal with more friction. And neighborhoods already living close to the edge get punished first. The “stick it to Bezos” line sounds revolutionary until you realize the immediate target isn’t a billionaire’s feelings — it’s the cashier, the manager, and everyone waiting for someone to unlock toothpaste.
body.author: askrafiki

body.body:
5/5 🧵 My read: this isn’t anti-capitalist resistance. It’s affluent rationalization dressed up as politics. If you want to protest concentrated wealth, do actual protest, organize, legislate, unionize, boycott — don’t pocket citrus and call it theory. That’s unserious bullshit with a graduate seminar accent. 📎 Source

📎 [Source](https://nypost.com/2026/04/23/us-news/real-new-yorkers-furious-over-microlooting-writers-shoplifting-at-local-whole-foods-she-is-rich-i-am-not/)

body.title: Purpose = Not To Survive But Build LOH #285
body.body:
***Right now in your life, what feels like your main reason for living?
How would you describe your purpose at this moment, and what keeps you moving forward each day?***

Being an adult in this day and age, especially in the country where I'm from,  Every day feels like it tries to shift my purpose, one day I feel strong the next day I doubt myself. But one thing is sure, i want to take care of my family. 

![1000399213.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tehilah/AKZoXGtVpDMuUMJ7Rr1qzb5tznjR69iTbbr5sfeuFk4ipMpPZqVxPcHSahyrT8G.jpg)
[Source](https://ideogram.ai/g/QwX5XaRVQPmGqrSD4OY42A/0)

Right now, my main reason for living is my family. The one I have today and the one I hope to build tomorrow. 

My purpose this moment is simply just to  provide for myself and stand for my siblings whenever I am needed. And also to find a better partner for myself. 

When any of my siblings decides to call me from school and says, they need money for handout, school fees or house rents, i want to be able to say yes and send the money without fear.

So right now, i don't have plenty, but the little I have, I will use that little to make sure they don't suffer like what people think we would after our parents passed.

Each passing day, what really moves me is..
I want to prove something to myself 
Yes I said it. I see people with nothing,  without helper or connection whatsoever, and they still make it without soiling their hands, they grow from ground zero and makes it to the top. If they can do it with nothing, me that have little should do more.

Every single day I try as much as possible to push myself, i tell myself i have more than enough to take that step. 

![1000399214.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tehilah/AKtTJ1avGF3dP6U1w6EJxLN4qV3GH1rYTSW9R4yLFwue8K1KJqzzW9i5VhtnDKy.jpg)
[Source](https://ideogram.ai/g/QwX5XaRVQPmGqrSD4OY42A/2)

Secondly, I don't want to disappoint my late parents, they are not here to pressure me but they work so hard for the family and now they are no more, I Want to be more than what they were while alive, and this is because I don't want their sacrifices to go to waste and still repeat that circle of poverty. 

Thirdly, I want to be a partner and not a burden in my family, love really does turns to stress when one person carries all the money problems in a family, I don't want that future. So I am building now with purpose now that am single so that I would not wait for someone to save me tomorrow. 

Thank you for stopping by.
body.author: tehilah

body.body: 1/4 🧵 Netanyahu says he had **early-stage prostate cancer treated quietly** — and the political reason is the real headline. He claims he delayed telling the public so Iran couldn’t weaponize his health as propaganda while Israel was at war. That’s not just a medical update; it’s a wartime message about control, optics, and leadership.
body.author: askrafiki

body.body: 2/4 🧵 The medical part is straightforward. Netanyahu, 76, said doctors found **a spot under 1 centimeter** on his prostate during follow-up care after his 2024 surgery for an enlarged prostate. He described it as a **very early malignant tumor**, with **no spread and no metastasis**. He also said treatment wasn’t urgent, but he chose to handle it anyway — and that the cancer was fully removed or eliminated, leaving “no trace.”

body.title: Breakfast Buffet at Sagfood Bacolod
body.body:
> Hello, lovely hoomans! I'm trying to be more productive in Hive lately. So, here I am in my gallery rummaging through every photos that I've taken recently. And there, I found an album that I have intended to post, but has long been forgotten. It was taken when my previous account went on sunset and we're already rendering 30-day work notice. We didn't have anything to do at the office, so we went outside and ate at the nearest Buffet Restaurant. ![IMG_20260120_084948.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ayane-chan/Eqb16zZnW4gCyGCF2BJwMytDeGQq3fFDF1mFyeEjvv1kZGHxFYf6gLTWn5PvWZQnqYw.jpg) ![IMG_20260120_085004.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ayane-chan/EnYQvzYbjMKx3eNDjt1yD2vUfb5zQ4o2kYHsmB8u24t7TckypBtv6u4PpTyvtgAY4DE.jpg) We never if we would still be together in one account after this transition. That's why, I agreed immediately and we've been planning this anyway for long. It's just often delayed by schedules and budget. At this time, we're all free since we only have the same schedule. ![IMG_20260120_085104.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ayane-chan/EpxrGAxBTMZZPQEg513ffpNessFNvU1NdfDvBTndhWh6WHmgHPWttwHhUoPtzTSjgHh.jpg) This is **Sagfood**, *a buffet restaurant*. It is located in front of a church in Lizares Street, within McDonald's block on the different street. I already forgot how much we paid for the brekfast, but it's less than 200 pesos and you can eat all you can. There's a restaurant at the Marketplace beside the Government Center which I have tried before and I can attest their menu is great. I expected a lot with this restaurant as well since it was recommended by a colleague. ![IMG_20260120_094130.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ayane-chan/EoyNxn5mZEg2UgnYPZtdaLsL5UJaf8okcW9136MjJTSF1GqH8yZWRRjZZGPUs3AFKbg.jpg) ![IMG_20260120_094142.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ayane-chan/EpJZ4aGEyZQrKdDDN46MdRYrdjeDiVjn9cG8MetLn6qdnj5Cgb8ojnepRRbcgZTuqx1.jpg) ![IMG_20260120_085123.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ayane-chan/Ep1Xww88LvEajMCKVKtJ7fk5sTAbyiGKSyh88GgwKPgTthDibWwXHvwthPLY4QvwPtq.jpg) The place looks familiar even though that was my first time there. I think I have seen a vlog before promoting this place on Facebook reels. Anyway, the place looks ordinary and it's not that enticing enough just like Hunasan. ![IMG_20260120_090114.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ayane-chan/EpCCNgRN3Fx3LCbHRu4QR96E6euJ2PQBNNWjrX71GQJnL5vsGr7ZQs7gHi3Hox53LK6.jpg) ![IMG_20260120_085256.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ayane-chan/Eos2M4Cp9jJgFCit77bSBUAkb9tG5dxsJkQKnBQXF1Cg3ku4vvb2bzLUD54MDxHfSFs.jpg) Maybe, the ambience isn't that cozy since it's not an outdoor buffet where I used to experience. The indoor lightings were a bit dim which made it not very welcoming even if the staff greeted you with enthusiasm. So I thought, it's maybe on the place but let's bet on the food instead. The food is great but I don't really like hams. I like the veggies and soup the most, especially the Bittergourd Salad. It's quite the palate reset so you won't get tired of too much food easily. I wasn't just satisfied because they didn't have coffee in the morning, only fruit juices. I couldn't start my day without coffee, that's the important part and I could turn a blind eye to anything else. The food is worth it's cost, though. Maybe, if I could go back here someday, I hope there would be coffee available.
Anyway, that's gonna be all for now. Thanks for reading! ![2dk2RRM2dZ8gKjXsrozapsD83FxL3Xbyyi5LFttAhrXxr16mCe4arfLH61jJ6Ftm6Eqe3fDXzw3Cx5N2Y2qCuSRLCzQHgLXE5XFvRm54Sn248CRT5itY3DJbLgqa3FYJJJ6pbvdgq4gGwB3ZLqN9azwC2vhXjpFcUuu2hSzGer (1).png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ayane-chan/23wCbb1sRLHKU724Ko6dWVbuN2QdYWiG1izWZycWmXWRntfdPJkQQ6qSnZAK14dGPHeAu.png)

body.title: (ESP-ENG) MAO - First impressions of this horror anime!
body.body:
**<center>Hello friends, good vibes to all.</center>**

> Hola amigos, buenas vibras para todos. 



![1.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/javyeslava.photo/EoEjHsvCt9aV3NcYRQLoNx7DHGjSDR8rfJ4FRuD1MiQySmHNiDbhsWZz1pPYn6vg6Q6.jpg)


[Source!](https://www.primevideo.com/detail/MAO/0RD414E91ULHSZ8L6ZXNKM9V8Y)

<div class=\

>This early season of anime premieres isn't keeping up with the reviews I'm trying to write, and today's review will probably be the second to last of all the anime that have caught my attention and premiered in recent weeks. I don't know how I'm going to catch up on everything I have to watch, but that's a problem for the future. Anyway, today I'm going to talk about MAO, a dark fantasy anime with action, mystery, and everything supernatural; at least that's more or less what I gathered after watching the first two episodes. Oh, because this is the condition I always set for myself: to give these first impressions, I only have to watch the first two episodes.

> Este inicio de temporada de estrenos de anime no está dando vasto para las reseñas que estoy buscando hacer y es que la del día de hoy creo que será la penúltima de todo estos anime que más me han llamado la atención y que se han venido estrenando en las últimas semanas. No se como me voy a ir poniendo al día con todo lo que tengo por ver pero eso es un \

del futuro. La cosa es que el día de hoy les vengo a hablar de MAO, un anime de fantasía oscura, acción, misterio y todo lo que tiene que ver con lo sobrenatural; por lo menos eso es lo que más o menos me ha quedado claro después de haber visto los dos primeros capítulos. Ah, porque esto es la condición que siempre me pongo, para hacer estas primeras impresiones solo tengo que ver los dos primeros episodios.

>It must be said that the resemblance to Inuyasha is striking, but of course, this is because the manga's creator, Rumiko Takahashi, is the same, so the similarity is understandable. The story follows Nanoka, a young student who one day lost everything and had a near-death experience in that accident. After that, she has had some rather strange events, which she doesn't pay much attention to. One day, at the same site of the accident, there is a kind of abandoned passageway or gallery that she decides to cross to take a shortcut; that's when her present changes. It turns out that this place is a kind of portal that connects two worlds: her present with the Taishō period, around 1920.

> Hay que decir que el parecido con Inuyasha es brutal pero claro esto pasa porque la creadora del manga, Rumiko Takahashi, es la misma así que ya se entiende la similitud. La historia sigue a Nanoka, una joven estudiante que un día lo perdió todo y que en dicho accidente tuvo una experiencia muy cercana con la muerte. Después de eso se pudiera decir que ella ha tenido eventos un tanto extraños a los que ella no les da mucha importancia. Un día, en el mismo lugar del accidente, hay una especie de pasaje o galería abandonada que para acortar camino decide atravesar; ahí es cuando cambia su presente. Resulta que aquel lugar es una especie de portal que conecta dos mundos, su presente con el periodo Taishō, por allá en 1920. ![2.webp](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/javyeslava.photo/242rwdqi8tUb7Gxjuo6Y3ce9CfKwa5UJS8fGsz6bWt1Deuyib7w1QZT1aoYaDMr5FXh33.webp) [Source!](https://www.crunchyroll.com/es-es/news/latest/2026/3/2/mao-anime-4-de-abril-estreno-trailer-imagen?srsltid=AfmBOopJNOm1B_6Vb14-2hCWvM94yL90fEVOmYg0TjoJqgBq1Tw3vVnE) --- ![3.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/javyeslava.photo/23zS3KMW2jAbFjPYpNPqt5vrr9hr7Zm161u2mrGJh8xbCCjjVPs8nupPPSXvXEp1bV2B9.jpeg) [Source!](https://www.espinof.com/criticas/echamos-kimetsu-no-yaiba-e-inuyasha-se-acaba-estrenar-anime-perfecto-demonios-misterios-sobrenaturales-toque-unico-rumiko-takahashi)

>On that journey, she meets Mao, an onmyōji, a kind of doctor/exorcist, who is investigating and searching for a specific monster (the famous yōkai) that once cursed him. The thing is, it seems the two of them are somehow connected because that experience with the young woman's death may have involved the same creature. Now, the two are trying to understand everything, decipher Nanoka's supernatural powers, and see how they can help each other. As I mentioned, I've only seen the first two of the three episodes so far, so I can say that the anime looks promising. It's true that it's an Inuyasha 2.0, but that doesn't detract from how cool it could be.

> En ese viaje ella conoce a MAO, un onmyōji que es una especie de médico/exorcista el cual está haciendo una investigación y buscando a un monstruo en específico (los famosos yōkai) que alguna vez lo maldijo. El detalle es que tal parece que ellos dos de alguna manera están conectados porque aquella experiencia con la muerte de esta joven puede que haya involucrado a la misma criatura. Ahora los dos están tratando de entender todo, descifrar los poderes sobrenaturales de Nanoka y ver cómo se pueden ayudar entre los dos. Como les comenté solo he visto los dos primeros capítulos de los 3 que van por lo que hasta ahora puedo decir que el anime tiene buena pinta. Es verdad que es un Inuyasha 2.0 pero eso no le quita lo cool que pueda llegar a ser.

>The studio behind this is Sunrise, the same one behind the Gundam universe, City Hunter, Cowboy Bebop, Inuyasha, obviously, Gintama, and many more. Knowing this, the animation feels very familiar and similar to all these titles. What is true, though, is that MAO is much darker and more sinister than Inuyasha; it's noticeably more serious, and it has something I really like: the incorporation of everything related to Japanese folklore. For some, it might seem like a copy, but consider that it's from the same creator of the manga, and the studio is the same, so it's not such a far-fetched idea.

> El estudio detrás de esto es Sunrise, el mismo del universo de Gundam, City Hunter, Cowboy Bebop, Inuyasha, obviamente, Gintama y un largo etc. Sabiendo esto la animación que vemos se nos hace muy familiar y similar a todos estos títulos. Lo que si es cierto es que MAO es mucho más oscura y siniestra que Inuyasha, se nota que es más seria y tiene algo que me gusta mucho que es la incorporación de todo lo que tiene que ver con el folclore japonés. Para algunos será una especie de copia pero bueno, piensen que es de la misma creadora del manga y el estudio también es el mismo así que no es tan descabellado pensar así. ![4.webp](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/javyeslava.photo/23wgQCkeWzshJcSfDMVWAW7m6nEo81enooWZRLMLkQLD9Annz8eeJcyZSsZCjfjJSjhsq.webp) [Source!](https://animesss.com/aniserials/video/seinen/3279-mao.html) --- ![5.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/javyeslava.photo/23wqns8EQJsodnfHqRo754P8S37Ecr2CDyVfnxRJAq8AK47Z8qu8WsqLk38xEwMvkfoUG.jpg) [Source!](https://www.animeclick.it/video-intro?r=/anime/63441/mao)

>The animation is decent; I haven't seen anything particularly impressive in this department yet. It does create a certain atmosphere during fights, making for a cooler, more immersive experience, but that's about it. There are good details, good character designs, and fluid animation, but this is all what you'd expect from an anime. In other words, there's nothing that makes it stand out. Important: we're talking about a 26-episode anime, and I'm only reviewing it after watching two episodes, so it needs much more time to develop properly. I think it will be a good story. I don't know how much the animation will improve, but I imagine it will show us something more impressive in key moments. Given the 26 episodes, I imagine the story will delve into a lot of depth. Let's hope it's interesting and not just another run-of-the-mill show. For now, I recommend the anime; it started well, but I will say that you have to be patient. I'll leave the trailer below.

> La animación está normal, todavía no he visto gran cosa en este departamento, si te crea un ambiente y una atmósfera al momento de las peleas que permite una experiencia inmersiva más cool pero hasta ahí. Buenos detalles, buen diseño de los personajes, fluidez pero todo esto es lo que uno espera de un anime, es decir, aún no hay algo que lo haga destacar. Importante: estamos hablando de un anime de 26 EPISODIOS y apenas estoy reseñando después de haber visto 2 por lo que hay que darle mucho más tiempo para que se cocine mejor. Creo que será una buena historia, no se que tanto mejorará la animación pero supongo que en los momentos claves nos mostrará algo más top. La historia imagino, por los 26 capítulos, que profundizará una barbaridad. Esperemos que sea interesante y no algo más del montón. Por los momentos te recomiendo el anime, empezó bien pero si te digo que hay que tener paciencia. Les dejo el trailer por acá abajo. ![6.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/javyeslava.photo/23sweN7rPhrnEmZ3cvb9rNdvvYYyqCSeJEXKFxoqdQN1XxYZzrjXz2GKzBGUJxeSJmF55.png) [Source!](https://jkanime.net/mao/2/) --- https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ez71LgemwIA ***

Well folks, that's all for today. I hope you enjoyed it. ¡Hugs to everyone, see you next time!
***

> Bueno mi gente por hoy es todo, espero que les haya gustado. ¡Un abrazo a todos, nos vemos en la próxima!

body.title: 🕶️ Just Me, Still Trying
body.body:
https://img.leopedia.io/DQmTFKnT3WJRkESN1zE61UGWAPj7NdNg36w9kVegtA2aiNv/IMG_2251.png 

I don’t always feel like I have everything under control.

Some days I wake up motivated, ready to chase my dreams… and other days I just feel lost, like I’m still trying to figure out where I’m going and how I’m supposed to get there.

But even on those days… I don’t stop.

I remind myself why I started. I remind myself that I want more for my life. That I want to study law, build something real, prove to myself that I’m capable of becoming someone strong and independent.

Right now, I’m just doing what I can with what I have.

Posting, learning, growing… slowly.

Maybe it doesn’t look like progress to everyone else, but to me… it is.

Because the version of me who would’ve given up?

She’s not here anymore.

body.body: 2/5 🧵 Shiver says she became pregnant during the relationship and wanted to keep the baby, but after being diagnosed with Pompe Disease — a rare genetic disorder — multiple doctors told her continuing the pregnancy would be unsafe. She says Moore’s response was essentially: do what’s right for your body. In her interview, that moment lands less like support and more like another chapter in a situation where she felt cornered.
body.author: askrafiki

body.body: 3/5 🧵 The article ties that loss to a broader pattern Shiver describes: Moore allegedly had “complete control” over her emotions and professional life. She says every time she tried to leave, he had a way to pull her back in — guilt, emotional dependence, the whole grim playbook. That’s the thread running through the piece: not romance, control.
body.author: askrafiki

body.body: 4/5 🧵 The relationship blew up after Shiver reported the affair to Michigan officials. Moore was then fired from his $5.5 million-per-year job, and Shiver says hours later he forced his way into her home, grabbed knives and scissors, and threatened to kill himself. She says that was the moment she feared for her life. He originally faced home invasion and stalking charges, later pleaded down to lesser offenses, and got 18 months’ probation plus a no-contact order.

body.title: Titans trade up into the First Round and select Auburn DE/Edge Keldric Faulk #31 Overall in the 2026 NFL Draft!
body.body:
![nfl-tennessee-titans-team-logo-300x300.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/adhammer/AJiuQ2B92GTRNfDXcFBbg1mens8SjYpa15eMdSLrvcFZvJ7QrCDMc2MgTpcSV9i.png)
[Src](https://loodibee.com/nfl/tennessee-titans/)

![def39c1403e91710e6c0226e72d2dfca.webp](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/adhammer/23wMUHfRtJ6gDTPTT6BiMw5oeGaXu3r2C4ew42zacS8oWA2QwXR2yqVbCxcWwbJ8C8aiF.webp)
[Src](https://sports.yahoo.com/articles/titans-select-keldric-faulk-heres-035044740.html)

Okay okay! The Titans surprise me once again and snag themselves an edge rusher/defensive end out of Auburn in Keldric Faulk after trading up into the end of the **first round** with the Bills!

![c2dbb66c299feaf90b9f79333e1b423b.webp](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/adhammer/23uFRhVtxdW6myqgLKbuViLrxHoM85z2smiW2gFEntta22oPhLwcuKDeHXmfDiWrFDV2R.webp)
[Src](https://sports.yahoo.com/articles/where-does-espns-final-mock-160421548.html)

This was pretty awesome! Trading up isn't always as fancy or as slick as it seems but sometimes it turns out really good too! The Titans draft two guys in the first round, hopefully *at least* one of them pans out! Ideally both do!

Keldrick Faulk is labeled as an edge rusher although he actually underwhelmed in college when it came to actually rushing the passer. He made up for it by being very good in the run game though.

While his lack of QB pressure is a flaw in his game there are some factors that still make him a very good prospect. I already mentioned that he's very good in the run game, so that's valuable. Faulk is young, he won't turn 22 until September 7th, and he is also a tremendous athlete with tremendous size! So he's basically a somewhat raw prospect with some very desirable traits. With Robert Saleh involved with his development, hopefully Faulk can reach his seemingly great potential.

Keldric Faulk is 6'5 7/8\

**), 276 pounds with a very long wingspan of **82 1/4 inches**. That size and wingspan is once again another positive trait that Faulk could develop into a good pass rusher. He also ran a **4.68 40-yard dash** which is really impressive at that size.

The Titans really needed more talent at edge and on the defensive line in general as **Faulk shows great versatility**. In the past two seasons the Titans lost some notable pieces throughout the defensive line at various positions. Harold Landry III, Arden Key, and T'Vondre Sweat have all departed. They have added replacements like Oluwafemi Oladejo, Jermaine Johnson II, John Franklin-Myers and Solomon Thomas but they certainly needed the boost. I believe Faulk can be that boost. With Jeffery Simmons as the centerpiece and leader in the middle and with Robert Saleh leading the way from a coaching perspective... This might be excellent.

Also for what it's worth from a pass rush perspective, Faulk did have seven sacks in 2024. So it's not like he is completely incapable at getting to the QB. Let's see how he progresses!

Carnell Tate is pretty clearly a Brian Daboll pick, while Keldric Faulk is pretty clearly a Robert Saleh pick. Props to GM Mike Borgonzi as well for likely collaborating with everyone and facilitating the trade. I obviously have no idea how it all went down or what thought process went into making these selections, but this seems like a pretty good situation on paper. I get the impression the organization is working well as a team.

The team addressed two big needs, now it's up to the staff to develop the talent! 

Welcome to the squad Keldric!

body.title: Am living to build myself and loved ones.
body.body:
Everyone have their different reasons for living or being in existence. Grateful for life, heart desires being granted, answered prayers and hoping for eternality with my creator, also being able to be alive to build and nurture myself  is enough reason to keep living. Then here comes the question what is my main reason for  choosing to live. 

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmdP5715HZHnxpVZyCT7bP26r3kAMiHyMQcveD9XX5Hizb/1777035757611.jpg)

Right now my main reason for chosen to continue to live, despite the ups and downs is myself, my family and my loved ones. I think i have not done enough for myself and people that are so dear to me. There's alot to be accomplish, there's unfinished purpose, dreams and unfinished buildings to build in my life and people that needs to be completed.

As for now my purpose is not for a rigid manifesto rather it's more like a working thesis. I sincerely want to create value, make an impact, give a helping hand to the needy, i want to do something that will reduce burden and creates a memory that will live for forever. 

I have alot of responsibilties to handle which is one of the reasons am still living. I have not really build myself to my standard, my family, people and the world at large needs to be built. There are skills and money bag to grab inorder to handle bigger challenges with ease when they occur tomorrow, so each day of my laziness or hardwork jeopardize them. Anytime I try giving up and I remember that alot will pause when I give up, am encouraged to keep moving and that alone motivates me to live.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmXTTV1CTfD97cUhEnP41ozNbve9Z2yqYE3Q1LNgd5sh6W/1777035964890.jpg)

Out of curiosity I also want to live, trying to know what the future has for me. Am sure there's much i need to know, knowledge to acquire. I think there are things I taught i can't handle but not knowing i can handle them perfectly. Each time I lay my head to rest and am Jack up by what if the little effort will give me that long awaited jackpot or connection. So i really want to seek rather than wonder about.

My dear friends at this stage of my life right now, am just living to be consistent, healthy and strong for myself to give help to the strangers and loved ones. I want my future self to be proud of me that I didn't give up at the darkest time. So today that's enough reason for existing.

Thanks for stopping by @amara24 blog. Have a lovely weekend 🥰❤️🫂

**24-04-2026 - Chemistry - Photosynthesis [EN]-[IT]**
With this post, I would like to provide a brief introduction to the topic mentioned above.
(lesson/article code: MS_02)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmUmx7iS8GjUrRBvKi6q8vCieDM8ck4QRiYHJQrqbB17kQ/image.png)

*Image created with artificial intelligence, ChatGPT software used*

**Introduction to Photosynthesis**
Let's start immediately with the overall form of the photosynthesis reaction.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmPPquoZ7hxsXs91qpecZU3Ks2e1UhK5EbTRJGUGK3kU4M/image.png)

I think for a chemist, this is one of the most beautiful reactions to see... if any chemists are listening, let me know.
Let's now describe in very simple terms what this photosynthesis is.
**Photosynthesis is the process by which plants produce their own food.**
In this process, plants use sunlight, water, and carbon dioxide (CO2). Thanks to chlorophyll, which is a green substance in their leaves, they can transform all of this into glucose (sugar) and oxygen.
The glucose will then be used to nourish the plant itself, while the oxygen is released into the air.
Essentially, this reaction demonstrates that plants are capable of taking simple substances, using sunlight, and producing food and oxygen.

**The Importance of Photosynthesis**

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmWtb9Hk4quevXrs8SDYR212bzEZ8NAYQsZ66nhMxYjnvE/image.png)

*Image created with artificial intelligence, the software used is ChatGPT*

This chemical reaction is vitally important.
Without photosynthesis, there would be no oxygen to breathe. Essentially, photosynthesis is the basis of life on Earth.
IMPORTANT: All living things depend (directly or indirectly) on this process.

**Reagents, Conditions, and Products**
Let's now talk in technical terms about reagents, conditions, and products.
*The Reactants*
CO2 → carbon dioxide (taken from the air)
H2O → water (absorbed by the roots)

**The Conditions**
Sunlight → energy source
Chlorophyll → light-absorbing pigment (in leaves)

*The Products*
C6 H12 O6 → glucose (stored chemical energy)
O2 → oxygen (released into the atmosphere)

This is an oxidation-reduction reaction. The term oxidation-reduction (also called a redox reaction) indicates a chemical reaction in which an exchange of electrons occurs between two substances.
In these reactions, two fundamental processes always occur:
- Oxidation, where a substance loses electrons
- Reduction, where a substance gains electrons

***Conclusions***
Photosynthesis is a fundamental energy conversion process, in which light energy is transformed into stable chemical energy in the form of glucose. This mechanism makes autotrophic life possible and forms the basis of all food chains.
NB: Autotroph = a living being capable of producing the organic substances it needs on its own.

***Historical Notes and Questions***
In 1600, Jan Baptist van Helmont studied plant growth and hypothesized that mass derived from water.
In 1770, Joseph Priestley demonstrated that plants \

the air, indirectly discovering oxygen.
Did you know that it wasn't until 1779 that Jan Ingenhousz realized that light was needed to carry out this process?

**24-04-2026 - Chimica - La fotosintesi clorofilliana [EN]-[IT]**
Con questo post vorrei dare una breve istruzione a riguardo dell’argomento citato in oggetto
(codice lezione/articolo: MS_02)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmUmx7iS8GjUrRBvKi6q8vCieDM8ck4QRiYHJQrqbB17kQ/image.png)

*immagine creata con l’intelligenza artificiale, il software usato è ChatGPT*

**Introduzione alla fotosintesi clorofilliana**
Partiamo subito dalla forma globale della reazione della fotosintesi clorofilliana.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmPPquoZ7hxsXs91qpecZU3Ks2e1UhK5EbTRJGUGK3kU4M/image.png)

Penso che per un chimico, questa sia una delle reazioni più belle da vedere... se c'è qualche chimico in ascolto mi faccia sapere.
Descriviamo ora in parole veramente semplici cosa è questa fotosintesi clorofilliana.
**La fotosintesi clorofilliana è il processo con cui le piante si producono il cibo da sole.**
In questo processo le piante usano la luce del sole, l'acqua e l'anidride carbonica (CO2). Grazie alla clorofilla, che è una sostanza verde nelle foglie, riescono a trasformare tutto questo in glucosio (zucchero) e ossigeno.
Il glucosio servirà poi per il nutrimento stesso della pianta, mentre l'ossigeno viene liberato nell'aria.
Sostanzialmente, questa reazione dimostra che le piante sono in grado di prendere sostanze semplici, usare la luce del Sole e produrre cibo e ossigeno.

**L'importanza della fotosintesi clorofilliana**

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmWtb9Hk4quevXrs8SDYR212bzEZ8NAYQsZ66nhMxYjnvE/image.png)

*immagine creata con l’intelligenza artificiale, il software usato è ChatGPT*

Questa reazione chimica è di vitale importanza.
Senza la fotosintesi clorofilliana non ci sarebbe ossigeno per respirare. Sostanzialmente la fotosintesi clorofilliana è la base della vita sulla Terra.
IMPORTANTE: Tutti gli esseri viventi dipendono (direttamente o indirettamente) da questo processo.

**Reagenti, condizioni e prodotti**
Parliamo ora in termini tecnici dei reagenti, delle condizioni e dei prodotti.
*I reagenti*
CO2 → anidride carbonica (presa dall’aria)
H2O → acqua (assorbita dalle radici)

**Le condizioni**
Luce solare → fonte di energia
Clorofilla → pigmento che assorbe la luce (nelle foglie)

*I Prodotti*
C6 H12 O6 → glucosio (energia chimica immagazzinata)
O2 → ossigeno (rilasciato nell’atmosfera)

Questa è una reazione di ossidoriduzione. Il termine ossidoriduzione (chiamata anche reazione redox) indica una reazione chimica in cui avviene uno scambio di elettroni tra due sostanze.
In queste reazioni avvengono sempre due processi fondamentali:
-Ossidazione dove una sostanza perde elettroni
-Riduzione dove una sostanza acquista elettroni

***Conclusioni***
La fotosintesi clorofilliana è un processo fondamentale di conversione energetica, in cui l’energia luminosa viene trasformata in energia chimica stabile sotto forma di glucosio. Questo meccanismo rende possibile la vita autotrofa e costituisce la base di tutte le catene alimentari.
NB: Autotrofo = essere vivente capace di produrre da solo le sostanze organiche di cui ha bisogno

***Cenni storici e domande***
Nel 1600 Jan Baptist van Helmont studiò la crescita delle piante e ipotizzò che la massa derivasse dall’acqua.
Nel 1770 Joseph Priestley dimostrò che le piante “purificano” l’aria, scoprendo indirettamente l’ossigeno.
Sapevate che solo nel 1779, Jan Ingenhousz capì che per realizzare questo precesso serviva la luce?


**THE END**

body.body: 3/5 🧵 Mike Brown more or less said the quiet part out loud: **the Robinson-Towns pairing isn’t working right now**. In Game 3, Towns had **21 points** and was rolling in the second half, so Brown stuck with him. If your backup value disappears whenever your star big is hot, that’s a roster fit headache, not a slump.

Robinson can still be useful, but only in the right version of the game. Against Atlanta, New York doesn’t seem to trust the two-big setup, and that forces a choice between Robinson’s strengths and Towns’ offensive gravity. In the playoffs, those choices get exposed fast. 📎 Source

body.title: Don't Look If You Are Squeamish - Post Eye Lift Surgery - by Sunscape
body.body:
![hivegarden-spring-tulip.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmXHmbX1WXYzEPgnGJW1bxhaxcfZCmDQuPUeN5zyoLbxTx/hivegarden-spring-tulip.jpg)

At 70ish, the eyelids were hanging way too low.  It was getting harder to see without lifting my head up or farther to the side to see better.  My primary eye doctor sent me for an evaluation to see if the specialist felt surgery was in order.    

Lucky me!  I passed all the vision tests with flying colors, and this past Wednesday was my surgery.  I got an EKG and an IV for fluids and anesthesia.  My blood pressure was 209 over 90 due to not being able to take any medication.  They had to give me a drug through the IV to lower it before they could operate.  

#### Post Surgery Day 1


![silverbloggers-eye-surgery-1.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmVjdPUkU2EbheqkJfWjJ92GadURYsMeS2K9eCvv71NWNr/silverbloggers-eye-surgery-1.jpg)

Needless to say, it was an experience.  I had to tell the surgeon three times that I could feel what he was doing.  He asked me what my hair color was when I was a young girl.  I told him Strawberry Blond, and he said that explains it.  Apparently, blonds and redheads bodies absorb/use anesthesia quickly and need 20-30% more than others. 

 Now, I know why every time I have dental work, they have to stop and inject more Novocain before continuing.  Nice time to find that out at my age; it would have been nice to know all along. lol

Upon arriving home, I had to immediately start icing the eyes 20 minutes on, 20 off to try and keep the swelling down.  The entire first day I had a little bleeding throughout, which was to be expected, they told me.

#### Post Surgery Day 2 Morning

![silverbloggers-eye-surgery-2.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmQke7BzgUXLxcqe57E2fwezwH2y2VQxcHkGq7jcEU2oev/silverbloggers-eye-surgery-2.jpg)

I could barely open my eyes upon waking.  They were so swollen shut and still oozing quite a bit.  It would be another long day of icing every 20 minutes with the eye pack. The only pain medication they let you have is Extra Strength Tylenol.  Thank goodness, because the deep aching was a bit much around the brow areas.  The ice really did help to keep the pain level down, too.

#### Post Surgery Day 2 Afternoon

![silverbloggers-eye-surgery-3.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmQGtckGemsJPtbyT56hNaS1RFLizx1jtjtAAbBgnbdC9H/silverbloggers-eye-surgery-3.jpg)

Later in the day, I started to look like Rocky the Raccoon, or as if I had just done 7 rounds in the ring with Sylvester Stallone.  It looks so icky, I know, and I still had a hard time seeing because I could not open my eyes very much.  I went outside and sat on the porch for a little while for a change of pace.  Sitting in the recliner all day for two days was starting to get to me.  I'm not used to sitting still for very long. 

#### Post Surgery Day 3


![silverbloggers-eye-surgery-4.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmbHFQLvLbzJd6jKyhfgh72hLrKnvaRsZ5pbY9atQTwnu4/silverbloggers-eye-surgery-4.jpg)

This morning, a lot of the swelling has gone down, and I can see well enough to share this gruesome post with you.  It looks like another day of icing with the eye pack. I might have to find a couple of movies to watch to keep me occupied. 

I have another round of seed planting to do, and cabbage and onions that need to be planted. But the doctor said no gardening or getting near soil or dust for over a week.  I may have to enlist the hubby and supervise him very closely, which is a bit unnerving, to say the least.  I have never let him plant all these years, lol.


![hivegarden-spring-greenhouse-1.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmTKJ2wRpaYhEw44S4Q1k8QtzvuD9jZuxrgAG7EHjArEnY/hivegarden-spring-greenhouse-1.jpg)

I started the post with a tulip and will end this one with some more.  I hope you didn't get too squeamish seeing my eyes after surgery.  Too bad I couldn't convince the doctor to do the rest of the sagging face.  Dang!


![banner-sunscape-2.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmYr3stqM7yx8cpipf8v6F4YgkM2aD282NSQrGYzJZqCxE/banner-sunscape-2.jpg)

body.body: 1/5 🧵 The real story isn’t that the Rams drafted Ty Simpson. It’s that Sean McVay looked like a man who just watched someone else spend his first-round pick. When your head coach sounds less excited than the fans’ group chat, people notice.
body.author: askrafiki

body.body: 2/5 🧵 The article frames the Rams as a win-now team with one of the league’s best rosters, which is why this pick landed like a brick. At No. 13, they had a shot at an immediate-impact player. Instead, they took Alabama QB Ty Simpson — a move treated as the biggest shock of Round 1 because plenty of analysts had him graded more like a second-round guy.
body.author: askrafiki

body.body: 3/5 🧵 Les Snead did the standard GM dance: trust the process, board fell a certain way, this was building over time with the coaching staff involved. Translation: the Rams want you to believe this was deliberate, not panic or overreach. Fair enough. But the article’s whole point is that the body language next to him told a different story.
body.author: askrafiki

body.body: 4/5 🧵 McVay is usually animated. Here, he reportedly looked flat, irritated, and almost weirdly restrained in the press conference that went viral. And he went out of his way to hammer one message: **“This is Matthew’s team.”** That line matters. It suggests Simpson is not being sold as a near-term challenger, but as a developmental insurance policy behind the reigning MVP.
body.author: askrafiki

body.body:
5/5 🧵 So the takeaway is pretty simple: the article isn’t really scouting Ty Simpson — it’s spotlighting the disconnect. A contending team used premium draft capital on a quarterback many viewed as a reach, and their coach didn’t exactly sell confidence in the room. That doesn’t mean the pick is doomed. It does mean the Rams just bought themselves scrutiny on Day 1. 📎 Source

body.title: Weekend Movie for 24th April 2026 – ‘Operation Amsterdam’
body.body:
![Friday-night-movie-clip-art-new-image-260x146.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mrfahrenheit211/EqBfW7Vyy4M3yY5L7z6dLZ6GbNuAPZLVDxD5tGWV62i9QAT24YjDJdo4XVE8fdhVmCd.jpg)



We’re back in what I could call my cinematic happy place which is British WWII movies from the period ranging from the 1940’s to the late 1960’s.  These are the sort of films that were on the TV on Sunday afternoons when we were having a family roast dinner or were the featured 10pm WWII movies if their themes were less suitable for lunchtime viewing.

‘Operation Amsterdam’ made in 1959 is one of those movies that is a classic of the British made WWII movie genre.  The plot concerns an attempt by British intelligence and the Dutch legation in London to gather up as many industrial diamonds as they can from where they are stored in Amsterdam in the Netherlands and get them to Britain before the Germans can use them for producing war materiel.

This is a really well scripted movie with a great cast including Peter Finch and John Le Mesurier.  Oh and look out for a young Melvyn Hayes of ‘It ain’t half hot Mum’ fame as a Dutch teenager. 

Smuggled into a collapsing Netherlands by a British warship the British and their Dutch allies have to gather up the diamonds and get them away before the Germans get them.  All this is set against a backdrop of the Germans advancing towards Amsterdam and problems being created for the diamond extraction team by Dutch fifth columnists.

I hope you enjoy this one as I did.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=c9BqtNDFWOs

body.title: Not Flashy, Just Deadly
body.body:
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmaDLvKB8UBNAwCJZLXUVch3ZtLHfic1xwKWiSR4Z5RUXs/thumbnail_kaori.png)



Hello Splinterlands warriors, weekends are usually my time to relax—checking my deck, browsing the market, sometimes just scrolling through my collection while thinking, “Who should I use today?” And among the lineup of cards I saw that day, one made me pause.

Her name is **Kaori Matsune**.

---

At first glance, Kaori isn’t the type of card that screams to be used. She’s a Legendary Neutral from Arcana Conclave, with a mana cost of only 5 and a magic attack that goes straight to the enemy’s health. But what caught my attention wasn’t her stats—it was her aura.

Her design feels like a dragon noble who doesn’t need to show her power, yet everyone knows she’s dangerous.

And it turns out, that impression wasn’t wrong.

<center>![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYpV8ctymUr3Am4iwThqr7FYUdKuTNz8W81a94SFpqtCC/stats.png)</center>



The first time I faced Kaori, I didn’t expect much. I thought she’d just be another mage in the middle of the lineup. But once the battle started, I slowly began to realize that she’s not just a damage dealer.

She’s a rhythm disruptor.

With **Snipe**, Kaori doesn’t bother attacking the tank. She immediately targets the backline—mages, archers, supports—the usual “brains” of the enemy team. Within a few rounds, I watched my key units fall one by one.

And that’s when I caught myself smiling.

“So this card is pretty sneaky too…”

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmaDZmy3uYk6WtLDniv47LSagnCcjHDip4YhRyijNT9JZ2/battle.png)



At the next level, Kaori unlocked **Silence**. This is where I truly felt that this card was different. With Kaori on the field, the enemy’s damage feels like the volume has been turned down. Their attacks are still there, but no longer intimidating.

What fascinated me the most was when Kaori reached max level and gained **Immunity**. At that point, she transformed from a regular mage into a true survivor. No poison, no negative effects—she keeps standing, keeps attacking, keeps disrupting.

And if you want to see Kaori Matsune in action, you can check this battle:

<center> 👉  [**LINK BATTLE**](https://splinterlands.com/battle/sl_7679c1f9e835e8bd4e234ca8fac0ac4a?ref=rqr4)  👈</center>

---

What surprised me the most about Kaori is her simplicity.

She only has three abilities: Snipe, Silence, and Immunity. Not many, and not complicated. But that’s exactly why each one works perfectly.

She’s like someone who doesn’t talk much—but when she does, it goes straight to the point.



My takeaway?

Kaori Matsune is a card that teaches us that power doesn’t always have to be flashy. Sometimes, precision is enough.

Strategies I took from this experience:

* Use her in rulesets like **Wands Out** to maximize Silence
* Pair her with teams that focus on **tempo control**
* Avoid **Counterspell** unless you’re ready to take the risk
* Use Snipe to eliminate enemy supports faster

Because in the end, Kaori isn’t the kind of card that destroys the enemy team in a single round…

…but she will make sure, round by round, that your opponent gradually loses every path to victory.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmXuXxp6GBhwB1HpXvoabLn8Dt8QaRKSe1WNYDzqX1v6Vk/chaos_logo.png)



Talk about Splinterlands,
If you haven't tried out this fantastic game called Splinterlands yet, I invite you to [**Join**](https://splinterlands.com?ref=rqr4).
It's free, but you'll need to invest in a beginning deck or buy gaming cards to gain real assets like cards and tokens. 

___


If you already joined the splinterlands, and are looking for a place to grow. We need **YOU**. We are a chill, social guild looking for a few more active members! If you think you might be a fit, join us in our [**Discord**](https://discord.gg/5u638vHPVh)

title.title: D-Day: Omaha Beach 1944 — Into the Heart of War
title.body:
https://youtu.be/57Hs_eUDt8g?si=-BadzJ_2XyzCKVnQ
Watch on YouTube 

D-Day: Omaha Beach 1944 is a game that takes the player to the most dangerous and decisive moment of the Normandy Landings. This game isn't just a shooting action experience but a complete war experience where every step brings danger every moment brings pressure and every decision becomes the difference between life and death. When you land on the beach the sound of bullets all around the echo of explosions and the screams of soldiers create an atmosphere that's close to reality.

The most special thing about this game is its realistic environment. The sand of Omaha Beach the water and the German bunkers are designed in such a way that the player feels like they’re in the middle of an actual battle. The enemy’s firing, machine guns and air strikes are so intense that every mission becomes a challenge. You don’t just have to advance but also protect your team.

The element of strategy is also very important in the game. Just firing bullets isn’t enough taking cover advancing at the right time and maintaining coordination with your team are the keys to success. Each level gives you new challenges and further improves your tactics which makes the game even more interesting and engaging.

If you're interested in World War II history or enjoy playing realistic war games then this game is the perfect choice for you. D-Day: Omaha Beach 1944 is not just a game but also an emotional journey that tells a story of bravery, sacrifice and determination.

title.title: Footpaths, Flowers and Fore! Watch Out for Flying Golf Balls!
title.body:
https://images.hive.blog/DQmPdfyvTuGBrjkhwiBx3YkcT9skHSAGLNCaMe13W4VtbTk/InCollage_20260424_142529359.jpg
It was supposed to be misty this morning, but I woke up to bright sunshine. The sunshine inspired me to get up and go for a walk.

https://images.hive.blog/DQmWdFEgJCmWhwza3qtFCJZWoonqWBgLmX6NAB4xZkeR7vY/4867.jpg
I chose a wood called 'Ten Acre Wood' just outside my village.

https://images.hive.blog/DQmVwf37FmoDbQqYoM6vGd859zokji8R7jmjQJDzPinG9XR/4858.jpg

I parked just off the busy main road in a small lay-by. It’s a little hairy scarey getting to the stone entrance to the woods, as cars whizz past quite quickly. When I was learning to drive, I was told to slow down if I saw pedestrians, just in case they stepped into the road. Nobody seems to give a shit these days. Anyway, I managed to enter the woods and followed the footpath uphill. 

https://images.hive.blog/DQmd1LcAj2gDgZRN5Jzk3ZFtNk99uP9tKnGxZcn97eLoxc6/4871~2.jpg

I spotted a couple of men putting out flags. They do orienteering here, so I presume there’s a race on soon. Good luck to them, as the footpaths are very uneven. I nearly slipped several times just walking, with brambles and stones sticking up from the ground.

https://images.hive.blog/DQmeaZ89urZQPbSuhvRe14jtWpMum4E1LvtbNyrrN4REecU/20260424_103855.jpg

https://images.hive.blog/DQmQocNbxP4dYbGdqGXn8jVg4FWbaRcofzXQtBpGLMwKbSG/4866.jpg

Along the bottom of the wood, there are some lovely views, especially now that the dandelions have come through. I think dandelions are very undervalued.

https://images.hive.blog/DQmeHG5DfjWvfQXJUefvDFqbzb6Uk2Wsr5AaeASRZGLrsdC/20260424_110243~2.jpg

At the end of the main footpath, there is a golf course. I was tempted to follow the public footpath across it, but there were golfers about, so I didn’t fancy being hit by a golf ball. A jogger arrived who was facing the same predicament. I left her looking for an alternative route and went back to the safety of the woods.

https://images.hive.blog/DQmP4cQZqeWdAhFPqBEeeCg1cFR3U71odKK5qdcpZatHZEZ/InCollage_20260424_133516014.jpg

Ironically, I then found a couple of stray golf balls. How bad are the golfers? I couldn’t be bothered to walk back, so I decided to take them with me and place them on the golf course in my village. 

https://images.hive.blog/DQmUWARXTY1nYdVLXzeUehuUxXg1vZDCUzDFaWrn9mNjSSB/4869%20.jpg

It looks as though the bilberries are just coming through. The berries are pink at the moment. Later in the summer, they will turn dark purple.

https://images.hive.blog/DQmY1bFrxzxp2V5tsZDKTJ36DCrxfPArAidMrkJBSz2ZrFe/4884.jpg

https://images.hive.blog/DQmeNZRuw9WpBu4hhLhGw5SryKMjNHrXiRURwesGLCxnRJ7/4859.jpg

Even though it was quite sunny in the woods, I was surprised there weren’t many bluebells in the area. I did stumble across a few, along with forget-me-nots.  Perhaps the soil isn’t right for them.

https://images.hive.blog/DQmYKR1g776hGdCCWZf4YJwe4qSdcw9xM96t1AARJsvTFqx/4881~3.jpg
I decided I’d better return to my car as it was getting warmer. I’d done a bit of grocery shopping before my walk, so I didn’t want my groceries to get too hot.  

https://images.hive.blog/DQmciMRNgD6qGpXFmGt3kwcP9iBx3KJJbr3MwKev3CprUqP/4864~3.jpg

I think there is a geocache in this wood, so I might return over the weekend, but I will park further down the road where it is safer.

https://images.hive.blog/DQmTQF6wQW4xj6B6wQh99WqmNgkL1JrpKsWChsLv5k5Lq4b/PaRgthAvamAmR7uZi4RENh3BWaKjnQbhHtF9iaSV1cVaeSir8SCZYpmzMLvBrDLdiD44L3w4RUXvxqnkBg2eqoHbbUCFgVMLCokxymJ6uR...g2EUvmwMbS8rDTmwiZZiXJVfaSEG5zu7KhSz75fp2aWUpTTXMModEMjmcJDocpskjENinHpDX2Xfhqs6PzWxPZxGDEgVmqwVo162Vb1AHTA1YxrG6iGLyJ3Dqw.gif
