title.title: From Elsewhere:  Video – A security guard speaks.
title.body:
![signpost--777x437.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mrfahrenheit211/23xAqCUkcWCYxdiRieDG2uiwrdLkP3oWMKKfWbFRQQNbnxtiamXnurdhm8rDJT2KjGbuq.jpg)



I hope that readers will take 27 minutes out of their time to watch this interesting and balanced video of a, presumably, straight man who has done door security at various gay venues.

It’s an honest appraisal of what this man, who goes by the handle of ‘ThatGearGuy’ saw during his stint as a security guard at gay clubs.

I find myself recognising some of the stereotypes that he mentions, the catty gays, the gossipers and backstabbers that can be found on the gay scene, the gays who indulge in dangerous practises involving drugs and sex, I think that anyone who has spent time on the gay scene has encountered people like that.  However it’s important to note that this is merely what he saw on the gay ‘scene’ the clubs, pubs and other venues that cater for gays and not the wider LGB community.  He also shattered the myth of the LGB and T communities being united as one, and talked about the internal communal hatreds against others in the LGB and T communities which are as he said, very prevalent. 

But what caught my ear and which is relevant to today’s trans debate is what he said about those who come into the ‘T’ category of LGBT.  He said that there was rarely trouble with those biological females who had ‘transitioned’ to appear more male but that wasn’t the case with those biological males who had ‘transitioned’ to give the impression that they were more feminine in appearance.  He said he had more trouble with the male to female transsexuals than other groups and it was members of these groups that threatened clubs with reputational damage over possibly false accusations of ‘transphobia’. This fear of reputational damage meant that members of this particular caste could basically get away with a great deal because the club owners didn’t want the aggro that would come their way due to an accusation of ‘transphobia’. 

He also touched on the issue of transvestites in gay clubs.  He saw them as many of us see and saw them which are men with a sexual fetish for cross-dressing and not individuals with some sort of hormonal imbalance problem.

Now I’ve run club nights that have attracted transvestites but I haven’t seen anything too much like what this man has seen.  My cross dressing punters turned up, changed, had some drinks, danced around their handbags and then changed and went home at the end of the night, I had very little trouble with these types as opposed to the full on transgenders who were much more ‘political’ and demanding.  However my experience might well have been an outlier and it’s quite possible that this man’s experiences with transvestites are more typical of clubs that attract transvestites.

What definitely perked my interest up is his assessment of sexual predation in minority sexuality communities and he particularly pointed out that trans individuals are over represented in sexual offences.  That is something that has been copiously documented elsewhere on places like transcrime.uk which is well worth a read.  I found myself in agreement with him when he said that there are predators who are attracted to the world of transgenderism not because they have any particular gender identity problem, but because it is through transgenderism that these predators can access potential victims.  Because society has deemed it right that those who call themselves trans have more leeway than others to operate in society because they are seen as marginalised.

He said that it might not be the case that being transgender means a greater chance of being a predator but that predators are more likely to be attracted to transgenderism for the reasons given above.  This does make sense as predators are more likely to go into areas where there is access to potential victims, which is what we saw with the Catholic Church where predators joined the priesthood in order to access potential victims.

Whilst I have little doubt that there are a lot of people who identify as trans whether they are transvestites or transsexuals are decent individuals there’s enough people in this group who present security and safeguarding concerns that it’s right to be worried. 

This video might well be worth a watch.  This man is a rational voice on the subject of trans and its interaction with the wider society. 

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=C91M4RkN7nE

# <center><u>English Version</u></center>

# <center><u>Quick Guide: Changing the Language on your Blood Pressure Monitor</u></center>

This post is a very brief explanation dedicated to one of my uncles, who asked for my help in setting a blood pressure monitor to Spanish. These health tools are also known as Blood Pressure Gauges, Sphygmomanometers (probably the least common name), or simply BP monitors.
Changing the language is actually very simple, but if you don't know how, you can spend hours trying without success. This video shows just how easy it is to do.

**<u>Device Specifications:</u>**

- **Brand**: \

- **Model**: BP118A (Made in China)
- **Power**: It can run on a 6V DC power adapter or 4 AA (1.5V) batteries, totaling 6V.

**<u>Note</u>**: In this case, I used a standard 5V cell phone charger and a cable that connects the device’s power port to the USB port on the charger (I believe the device comes with this cable).

----------

**<u>Step-by-Step Instructions</u>**

As soon as you plug it in, it turns on. Just follow these steps:

1- **Press and hold** the main function button for approximately 3 seconds. You will see the letters \
appear; it will be set to number 1 by default.\n\n2- **Press the small button** with the \

in a circle ⓜ. It will change to LAN 2, which corresponds to Spanish.

3- **Press the main function button** again to confirm and save the language.

4- **And that’s it**! (Done and dusted).

**<u>Available Languages:</u>**
    • LAN 1: German
    • LAN 2: Spanish
    • LAN 3: Dutch

I found it quite interesting that it doesn't include English, as that is usually the primary language for almost all devices.

If you own one of these monitors, I hope you find this information helpful.

### Much love to you all, God bless, and see you next time!
---


https://images.hive.blog/DQmTphUarKuYr5DZnpue1jqNXi6kg3s7koZrrYxYfaQvyGe/18.png

# <center><u>Versión en Español</u></center>

# <center><u>Guía Rápida: Cambiar idioma de Tensiómetro</u></center>

Esta publicación será una explicación muy breve, dedicado a uno de mis tíos, quien me solicito ayuda para colocar un tensiómetro en español.
Estas Herramientas de salud también tienen por nombres ***Monitor o Medidor de Presión Arterial, Baumanómetro, y Esfigmomanómetro*** (creo que es el menos conocido)

Es muy sencillo cambiarle el idioma, pero cuando alguien no sabe pueden pasar horas, invertirle mucho tiempo sin tener éxito, con este video se aprende lo fácil que es hacerlo.

**<u>Especificaciones del Dispositivo</u>**
* **Marca**: “Dr. Sents”.
* **Modelo**: BP118A (fabricado en China.)
* **Energía**: Puede Funcionar con un transformador de corriente DC de 6v o con 4 pilas AA de 1.5V, que hacen un total de 6 voltios.

**Nota**: En este caso lo use con un cargador común de celular de 5v y un cable que va del conector de corriente del dispositivo, hasta el USB que va en el cargador (creo que ese cable lo trae el dispositivo). A penas se enchufa enciende.

--------
**<u>Debemos seguir los siguientes pasos:</u>**

1- **Presionar y dejar presionado** el botón de función principal por 3 segundos aproximadamente. Saldrán unas Letras que dicen LAN, que esta estará por defecto en número 1

2- **Luego se debe presionar el botón pequeño** que tiene una “M” en un círculo ⓜ, cambiará a LAN 2, que corresponde al español.

3- **Para aceptar el idioma** se presiona nuevamente el botón de función principal.

4- **Listo el pollo.**

**<u>Idiomas que trae:</u>**

- **LAN 1**, es para alemán.
- **LAN 2**, es para español
- **LAN 3**, es para neerlandés, también conocido como holandés

Me llamó la atención que no contiene el idioma inglés, normalmente este es el principal que traen casi todos los dispositivos.

Si tienes un tensiómetro de estos, espero que esta información te sirva de mucha ayuda.

### Se les quiere mucho, DIOS los bendiga hasta la próxima

title.title: Embracing the soft side of life
title.body:
There’s something quietly magical about starting the day before the rest of the world fully wakes up. This morning, I rolled out my mat just as the sky began to shift from soft gray to warm gold, that in-between moment where everything feels suspended in possibility. Sunrise yoga has always felt like a promise to myself—a gentle reminder that I can begin again, no matter what yesterday looked like.
![1000024467.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jane911x/2432DAe4otxV129bewa1sGS337sT4k81MU37N1g9UYB4ckz6JYsGfDXtj1BGrwSKFk2KJ.jpg)
![1000024466.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jane911x/243M19PciaviM49xVtt2xQwVFdbxErHcKcePXRxGYEbgXuuTMX5zX28zfud6cxY9EFPNS.jpg)
What made today even more special was sharing it with my sisters. We arrived a little early, mats in hand, still a bit sleepy but excited in that soft, unspoken way. The air was crisp but not cold, carrying just a hint of morning freshness that woke us up more than any alarm could. There’s a different kind of energy when you move, stretch, and breathe alongside people who know you so deeply. We didn’t talk much during the session, but we didn’t need to. The connection was already there—in the synchronized inhales, the quiet smiles between poses, and the occasional wobble that made us laugh under our breath.
![1000024433.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jane911x/2449seeMGSd5zgCLxFS4Rv5YBSh5D93Xj6hdaA8PucVVgFcbMvdVC8EPtQwXxKyBUMjiY.jpg)
The sun turned out to be brighter than expected, rising quickly and unapologetically. It wasn’t the shy, barely-there sunrise you sometimes get. It was bold, warm, and energizing—casting long golden rays across our mats and making everything feel alive. I could feel the warmth on my skin as I moved through each pose, from slow stretches to stronger balances, grounding me in the present moment. Even the light breeze seemed perfectly timed, cooling us just enough between flows.

At one point, I paused in a pose and simply looked around—the glow of the sun, the calm rhythm of everyone breathing, my sisters beside me—and felt this deep sense of gratitude. It’s not often you get to feel so present without distractions.

By the time we finished, there was a shared sense of calm mixed with a light, happy energy. The kind that makes you feel like the day ahead holds something good. We rolled up our mats slowly, not quite ready to let go of the moment just yet.
![1000024446.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jane911x/23vsQDAmWhAYg2i9U5PDNWvN17xfQFh3BjUVgN7FWdikzexqdUstHo1UBNMRmP6ekQg1D.jpg)
Of course, no morning is complete without coffee, so we headed to a nearby café, still riding that post-yoga glow. The rich smell of freshly brewed coffee greeted us as we walked in, instantly comforting. Sitting down with warm cups in hand, chatting and laughing, it felt like the perfect continuation of the morning—simple, unhurried, and full of warmth.

From stillness to movement, to connection and conversation—it all flowed so naturally. If every day could start like this, I think I’d be just fine.

That's it for today's blog. See you in my next one!

Sending some love and light

With love, Jane

>Imagen creada con inteligencia artificial Gemini.
>La importancia de los recursos visuales

>El cerebro humano procesa las imágenes 60,000 veces más rápido que el texto. Elegir la imagen adecuada no es un detalle estético, es una herramienta de conexión.

\n\n*

>No uses imágenes por rellenar: Cada recurso visual debe reforzar tu mensaje. Si hablas de la calma en tu menstruación, una imagen con colores suaves y luz natural conectará más que una foto de oficina brillante.

y hace que tus lectoras te reconozcan al instante.

>Keywords): Son las palabras que tu lectora ideal escribe en el buscador (ej. \

>¿Dónde ponerlas? Asegúrate de que tu palabra clave aparezca en el H1 (Título), en al menos un H2 (Subtítulo) y en el primer párrafo de tu texto.

>Texto Alternativo): Cuando subas tu imagen, rellena la casilla de \

describiéndola brevemente con tus palabras clave. Esto ayuda a las personas con discapacidad visual y mejora tu SEO.

>check this out. But did you know that even the best writing in the world can go unnoticed if it isn’t presented well? Today we’re going to talk about image and visibility. Because in the digital world, we don’t just write to be read—we write to be found and felt.

>The human brain processes images 60,000 times faster than text. Choosing the right image is not an aesthetic detail, it is a tool for connection.

\n\n*

>Don't use images just to fill space: Every visual resource should reinforce your message. If you're talking about calmness during your period, an image with soft colors and natural light will connect more than a bright office photo.

\n*

>Visual consistency: Try to keep your images in a similar style (same filters or color palette). This creates your “personal brand” and makes your readers recognize you instantly.

\n\n

>White space: Don't overload the page. White space helps the image and text “breathe.”

\n*

>Alternative Text): When you upload your image, fill in the “alternative text” box, briefly describing it with your keywords. This helps people with visual impairments and improves your SEO.

body.title: La vida secreta de un objeto. 📀 The Secret Life of an Object.
body.body:
> https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carolinacardoza/23yTj8MFaSHF7xzmjk6Bu9Gh7Ph3hgTbFqjbrLTzqbTumu8YcjyvDb4UkU64eXiQSkyif.png

Hace unos días revisé el historial de [The Silverbloggers Writer's Block Terminator(The Silverbloggers Writer's Block Terminator | PeakD) y hubo una de las iniciativas que me puso a pensar por un buen rato SB Chronicles Prompt #10 - La vida secreta de un objeto. >A few days ago, I looked through the archives of [The Silverbloggers Writer's Block Terminator (The Silverbloggers Writer's Block Terminator | PeakD)], and one of the prompts really got me thinking for quite a while: SB Chronicles Prompt #10 - The Secret Life of an Object.
https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carolinacardoza/23tvcDoTSg4YjjdXJsR9wyp4iKctAZnnGjgH76CcfW3NHkcFKA48NVr6Xm2uGzkHkGzYK.png
Por un buen rato estuve dando vueltas por casa, hurgando en mis pensamientos, buscando ese objeto que durante las últimas décadas ha estado conmigo. Buscando y buscando pude darme cuenta la importancia que a veces le damos a las cosas; así que después de sentir un poco de nostalgia me di cuenta de lo mucho que hemos dejado en el camino. >For quite a while, I wandered around the house, rummaging through my thoughts, looking for that object that has been with me for the past few decades. As I searched and searched, I realized the importance we sometimes attach to things; so after feeling a bit of nostalgia, I realized how much we’ve left behind.
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carolinacardoza/241tZVHzFbwkJR6RSGtjdiVmyfdP9KawWpbDSFeyVDChM2nRnES3pCYwSfDrrFWtoQzMJ.png)
En 50 años me he mudado 3 veces y en cada trasteo he tenido que soltar cosas a las que solo yo le daba valor; pero entre tantas pude rescatar 2 que han ido conmigo desde hace muchos años: Los discos de acetato de Menudo y el cuadro de mis padres. Cada cosa tiene su historia y que bonito sentir que a pesar del tiempo los he sabido cuidar y conservar. >In 50 years, I’ve moved three times, and with each move I’ve had to let go of things that only I valued; but among them all, I managed to save two that have been with me for many years: Menudo’s vinyl records and my parents’ painting. >Every item has its own story, and it’s so nice to feel that, despite the passage of time, I’ve been able to care for and preserve them.
https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carolinacardoza/23x16oHeasx64FCFRvFWAQpmnYGK87Pm6k4wDquiJ66ZyVHV9vgr5P6LW6KU7fEHmRuiB.png
# El cuadro de mis padres. Tengo este cuadro desde hace 27 años, un día me lo traje a mi casa para hacer una restauración ya que la humedad en casa de mi madre lo estaba deteriorando y justamente había empezado por borrar la c ara de mi padre. La historia de este cuadro es algo que me encanta escuchar de boca de mi mama; ella cuenta que un día llego por aquellas montañas andinas “un señor” que dijo llamarse pintor. Ella muy emocionada le ofreció café y conversaron por un buen rato, ambos trataron de llegar a un acuerdo que los favoreciera a ambos ya que él solo quería trabajar. Lo cierto es que ella le entrego dos fotografías, una de ella y otra de mi papa y con eso el señor les hizo este cuadro precioso. ># My Parents’ Painting. >I’ve had this painting for 27 years. One day, I brought it home to have it restored because the humidity at my mother’s house was damaging it, and it had just started to fade my father’s face. >I love hearing the story behind this painting from my mom; she says that one day, “a man” who claimed to be a painter came through those Andean mountains. She was very excited and offered him coffee, and they talked for quite a while. They both tried to reach an agreement that would work for both of them, since he just wanted to work. The truth is that she gave him two photographs, one of herself and one of my father, and with those, the man created this beautiful painting for them.
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carolinacardoza/242hebhryFKfxzWoAkyXAgRY8YTwyjsvRbXNfzDkHq2oGk6PN48dBW1KUpscTwyPAg9Ck.png)
Yo crecí creyendo que mi mama había tenido ese vestido tan bello y esa cadena tan hermosa, pero con los años entendí que todo había sido la creatividad del artista que había puesto brillo a la cara de mi madre y por supuesto hizo de mi papa todo un galán con ese traje de corbata. >I grew up believing that my mother had actually owned that beautiful dress and that gorgeous necklace, but over the years I came to understand that it had all been the artist’s creativity—he had brought a glow to my mother’s face and, of course, turned my father into a real heartthrob in that suit and tie.
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carolinacardoza/23xKziKjmpkFM5vNnxe2qjmTpsoEg7Ch2SpNJervxEeo6TxAcT1avoG6i1qmdLGHrQBq3.png)
Yo quise traerme el cuadro para ver si alguien lo restauraba, pero me fue imposible. Fue mucho tiempo después que la tecnología hizo magia y creo una réplica idéntica, reconstruyo el rostro de mi papa con la foto original que le había dado mi madre al pintor y fue así como orgullosamente cumplí mi promesa de devolver el retrato de mis padres en su nueva versión, en un nuevo marco de madera que ahora engalana la sala de la casa materna. Pues bien, como nunca pude conseguir quien me reparara el cuadro antiguo, lo guardé para mi y lo llevo a todas partes, por eso es mi objeto favorito de toda la casa. >I wanted to bring the painting home to see if anyone could restore it, but it was impossible. It wasn’t until much later that technology worked its magic and created an identical replica; it reconstructed my father’s face using the original photo my mother had given the painter, and that’s how I proudly fulfilled my promise to return the portrait of my parents in its new version, in a new wooden frame that now adorns the living room of my mother’s house. >Well, since I could never find anyone to repair the old painting, I kept it for myself and take it everywhere; that’s why it’s my favorite item in the whole house.
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carolinacardoza/23xeoyo5RKZLCw21eD6mwPoXnTf1FQXbS1NrcPUzmYh6JAMHWrcyrdebK19MUWRiUKc97.png)
# Los discos de acetato del Grupo MENUDO. Estos discos también los conservo con mucho cariño, han ido conmigo desde que llegue a vivir a Caracas. Esta colección es algo que atesoro y es algo de lo que todos hablan cuando me visitan en casa. Recuerdo que cuando me vine a vivir a la capital, conseguí mi primer trabajo y por ende mi primer sueldo. Cada día pasaba por debajo de un puente donde se colocan diariamente los vendedores informales a vender cada cosa antigua. Yo pasaba y me gustaba ver, hasta que un día compré el primer disco, luego el segundo y el tercero y así fui haciendo de esto un habito. Y aunque en ese tiempo no tenia donde escuchar ¡no me importaba! Sabía que algún día también me iba a conseguir un equipo de sonido y me iba a disfrutar mi colección. Hoy en día los sigo escuchando y sigo disfrutando de las canciones de ese grupo de jóvenes maravillosos que marcaron una época. # The MENUDO Group’s vinyl records. >I also cherish these records dearly; they’ve been with me ever since I moved to Caracas. This collection is something I treasure, and it’s something everyone talks about when they visit me at home. >I remember that when I moved to the capital, I got my first job and, with it, my first paycheck. Every day I would walk under a bridge where street vendors set up shop daily to sell all sorts of vintage items. I would walk by and enjoy looking, until one day I bought my first record, then the second and the third, and that’s how it became a habit. And even though I didn’t have anywhere to listen to them back then, I didn’t care! I knew that someday I’d get a stereo system and enjoy my collection. Today, I still listen to them and still enjoy the songs of that group of wonderful young people who defined an era. ---
---

body.title: Being a light in a country where the electricity fails all the time|week 306
body.body:
>
![IMG_20260325_190456.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmPkgQE498QbBdZkTSmXtumUumy8Frfsx9Y4qB4uCLX1u3/IMG_20260325_190456.jpg)
Waiting for the electricity to arrive with the best attitude
Have you ever had to deal with a power outage? How does this affect your life, and how do you cope? Upon reading this suggestion, my face underwent a metamorphosis; I didn't know whether to laugh or cry. It was time to vent on this topic via Hive.But there was also instability in the 1990s and 2001. To this day, we continue to experience a major electricity crisis, which many people call sabotage, especially those who support the current government, who find countless excuses to cover up the negligence and lack of resources in this situation. Many producers and entrepreneurs have lost their businesses, while others continue to suffer the consequences to this day. There was a time when we spent days in darkness, and the government claimed that there hadn't been any electricity before—such a shocking, such an empty response. We got used to it since Cuba was doing the same thing, and well, that's the summer's fault. They told us, as business owners, to buy generators. Many know how expensive that is.
![IMG-20260423-WA0256.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmNtT9yN1URsQ4fy5fyWkzKT3sbQeXN6URgECo4X1ouesi/IMG-20260423-WA0256.jpg)
These days, they cut off our electricity for seven hours; on the best days, it's five. When that happens, I try to get out of my house as fast as I can. I go to a shopping mall and keep an eye on the community group chat for an announcement that the power is back on so I can return home. Imagine for a moment having an elderly person connected to a nebulizer, a baby, having to keep vaccines refrigerated, a business that depends on electricity, refrigerated meat, or simply the physical and mental health of the inhabitants of an entire country. It's not easy. I can go out, but some have no choice but to wait for electricity every day. The consolation is that they don't cut it off in the middle of the night; we've gotten used to making excuses. The worst part is that if we go out to demand our rights, they can take us to jail. They claim we're government saboteurs I'm signing off now, we're getting our dose of patriotism today from 11 in the morning until seven at night. All images are my property. My signature with Canva application. Translator DeepL

The catch is that propaganda works because repetition and identity cues can shape belief whether the message is smart or stupid, so “say it loud” is useful only if you also stay honest and grounded in reality, not just louder than the next guy [Neuroscience News](https://neurosciencenews.com/propaganda-psychology-28982/) [SAGE](https://journals.sagepub.com/doi/10.1177/00936502211032100). body.title: Ethereum Inflation, Supply, Staking and Other Key Metrics | Apr 2026
body.body:
How is the Ethereum network doing these days? 

In the last cycle ETH barely touched its previous ATH, while BTC has outperformed it by a lot. There was a small period when ETH did catch up a bit, but only for a short time and then fall off.  On the other hand, there is now more competition in the space like Solana, BSC, SUI etc that are taking market share.

Since the PoS update back in 2022 the inflation for Ethereum has been reduced by 90%, from 4.3% to 0.43%. Additionally, part of the ETH for transactions is burned, that pushed Ethereum into deflationary territory. Meanwhile, the share of staked ETH kept on growing drying up the liquid ETH supply. 

Let’s take a look. 


 


![01.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dalz/23uQLzypGCrSTUqABGh3DXarJ5o99Kj1mMw9qszxyeGXtpu5iDJQdAWcgTTWeWnMvLdor.png)





Here we will be looking at:
-	Overall Supply
-	Number Of Wallets
-	Active Wallets
-	Transactions
-	Fees
-	Staked ETH
-	Contracts

The data presented here is mostly gathered from [the etherscan charts]( https://etherscan.io/charts) and Dune Analytics. 
  
## Supply

The overall supply now looks like this:


 





![image001.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dalz/23swkfbdiLufWcVAouyPcHHnDeZA1zL51bxJD7vce9KfHyNLGdUAWU2WNxftmCLgsQE5X.png)






A steady increase in the supply from just above 70M in 2015 to close to 120M in 2022. After the transition to PoS in 2022, the supply has dropped a bit, and it is now around 117M. 


## Ethereum Supply After the Merge

The chart for the new ETH issued after the merge and the transition to proof of stake looks like this. 


 





![image003.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dalz/23swiWkb4cyhPb7zopwREz2JK97EqTYC8wrdFDZXGSKqLJfyzYKwgetdeKiqMKHo7fsi5.png)




*Note: This is data from ETHScan, there are some other sources that have different data on ETH supply and burns.*



At first the inflation went down and from September 2022 to March 2024 it has reduced the ETH supply for more than 400k ETH. 
Since May 2025 the ETH supply has been going down again, but at a very moderate rate and as mentioned, when we look at the big picture the ETH supply is almost constant in the last period.

The table for the yearly inflation looks like this.


 



![image005.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dalz/23uEx4BNEhF1icBUDYkw4PjjBez99QDw1jRf5rZA4ob5gvnvjbzRiAewxFSQq77Mo1bD2.png)






From more than 10% down to negative **-0.28%** in 2023. In 2024 the inflation is at 0.24%, still less than the 0.43% base inflation, while for the 2025 it has been almost at the same level with just a small negative of 0.06%.


## Number of Wallets
Now for the general network numbers.
Here is the chart for the total number of Ethereum wallets created.


 




![image007.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dalz/Eo1vt3yVHvigTn2cBReHREGmvgBhdavZVw7U8wJwJtboWgJ3qWgvGjRLBRMHTbZMzrw.png)








Ethereum now has **405M** wallets! The numbers of wallets keeps growing at a steady pace. 


When we look at the number of **new daily wallets created**  we get this chart. 

 



![image009.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dalz/23tknCPZnYgQ2FfJcf7JykJ1dPSEAzSHEp3eqXNVduhYMbPYhMioHpwkdvVjV9hePxs6Y.png)










This is starting from 2022.

Some sideways action here but still a relatively steady numbers up until 2025 since when it increased first to 200k then up to 500k per day. Maybe because the fees have dropped in the period and its cheaper to transact so more bots have emerged. 



## Active Wallets
How many of them are being used? 
Here is the chart.

 



![image013.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dalz/23tvAVVC9Mh34xJoWdZXkUVKbsX1nyq4k5r1ApxWswvZnDFtHiYyTwvJ7LaiUpe8CG38k.png)






We can see that there was an overall uptrend up until 2021, reaching around 700k active wallets. Since then, there has been a downtrend up to December 2023, when it started growing again, from 400k to 600k active daily wallets.
In the last period the number of active wallets has increased again and it has been very volatile, heating 1M at moment, and back to 600k again. 


## Transactions 
How about the number of transactions? Is the Ethereum network now more active after the merge? Here is the chart.


 


![image015.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dalz/EoCaua2dMRPsNcGxJbvLTt7PE9EVYfHW7bobZcNtaveg3LPHWwp5RvBn4AXTknW7ac8.png)






After a long period of when transactions were around 1.4M, in the last months they have spiked to 2M and above, even up to 3M at some point. Obviously Ethereum has increased its output and speed in the last period. An ATH in the number of transactions and reaching a new level of scalability while the fees remains low. 


## Fees
Here is the chart for Ethereum fees. Quite the ride.



 



![image017.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dalz/23tkozvFgQnZABCCU9moUYFB3Ru8sB6SgKB76M43E2hSRCibDq7RPSRXrB773cHXchZ9q.png)









At first there was a small increase in the fees back in 2017-2018 bull run. Then in the next bull run in 2021 a massive increase in the fees up to $100 at one point. A drop in 2022 in the range of 5 to 10 USD, and a further drop in the very last period to bellow one dollar. The current fees on Ethereum are the lowest since 2020. 

## Staking Ethereum

Staking a big topic in the Ethereum network since the PoS upgrade. Here in short will just check the share of ETH staked from the overall supply. Here is the pie. 

 





![image019.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dalz/23vru2ocfbifoJ5GnAaR3XJefjk8k2bVGPbFh9BfS591YfwsUccQ8R7XcYxPXhd8GV7fE.png)







A **33%** staked ETH from all the supply. The trend for the staked ETH has been constantly up in the last period. For a token of this size and market cap this is quite a big share.


## Number of Contracts

Here is the chart for the number of smart contracts deployed daily.

 




![image021.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dalz/23uFGqffSSVDUneuzwj6Y1mvcocjxHt58EwXXwRuf2QZRhYYYhANtZLcafKuq811mByRM.png)






There was a peak in the number of contacts back in 2023, and then a drop in 2024, from 1k to around 400 where it has been in the last one year or two. The numbers have been volatile, going from 100 up to 500. 




All the best
@dalz

body.title: [Eng./Esp.]   Comfort is turning us into useless people.   ||   La comodidad nos está volviendo inútiles.
body.body:
*** *** #
Si eres de habla hispana, la versión en español es mejor para ti; debes hacer clic 👉 [**AQUÍ**](#english)
*** ***
# ***
Comfort is turning us into useless people
***

> I often find myself staring at the screen, hoping the blinking cursor will solve the dilemma for me. **“It’s not that hard”**, I whisper to myself, whilst ordering takeaway simply because washing a couple of frying pans feels like a domestic odyssey. Technology has sold us a sanitised version of existence, where any trace of effort is perceived as a system error that must be corrected immediately.
![](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/amigoponc/23z73NuHivYjfUcujXirNPhzhQ1ZMFVPKNifDumpbhpbVqygN2SJ2cnqFN9u77EBwMri6.png) [Gracias a la aplicación Banana 2.0 por ilustrar mi publicación.](https://gemini.google.com/app)
We are losing, almost without realising it, our innate capacity for action. Before, necessity mobilised the body and the mind; today, it merely moves the thumb across the tempered glass. That frantic quest for immediacy, that sweet poison of ease, has turned us into passive spectators of our own lives. We have convinced ourselves that avoiding friction is synonymous with success, forgetting that it is precisely that resistance that keeps us awake and human. Doing things for oneself, feeling the weight of a tool or the genuine exhaustion after a walk, has become a strange act of rebellion. ‘It’s not that difficult,’ I repeat, but the inertia of the sofa weighs like lead. Absolute comfort acts as an anaesthetic that numbs the instinct to excel. By delegating our autonomy to algorithms, we are forgetting the taste of genuine achievement. It is not about rejecting progress, but about reclaiming our will. Because truly living requires a necessary dose of difficulty and, though we may be reluctant to admit it, regaining that vital drive, it’s not that hard. *** ***

> Come and participate, there's still time. You can find all the information daily in the [#Freewritehouse](https://peakd.com/c/hive-161155/created) Community. Specifically, today's prompt post:
# **
[PROMPT: «it’s not that hard»](https://peakd.com/hive-161155/@daily.prompt/24-april-2026-freewriters-community-daily-writing-prompt-day-3083-its-not-that-hard)
**
https://images.hive.blog/0x0/https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/daily.prompt/AJmudPPCWGA6FfcXPrAmdLk2CY4mxGWYvbsFs8KPohCx9wnhBrpjcwmEyvYmxqn.jpg Cover of the initiative.
*** ***
![](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/amigoponc/23swkfAXGs5WxHg49jyEWGAanWReDpMUQbxUB4FYX98iMaztGejMtj5HJUN6abwpCZhUN.png)

*** *** ### **
Dedicated to all those writers who contribute, day by day, to making our planet a better world.
** *** ***
![](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/amigoponc/23vhudAgmrPvXnYXzmsiD5366jktCLxdeWqxFQg2nCeezVK4yv7CJ9dQpSevYb8nEeqTR.png) https://images.ecency.com/0x0/https://images.ecency.com/DQmbdpsZFqtrcoLk94sUV8oHkjnx8PAdgfACMfJ9UpcriNF/perfil2026_hecho_con_clipchamp_2_.gif
*** *** ***

>
# ***
La comodidad nos está volviendo inútiles
***

> Me sorprendo a menudo mirando la pantalla, esperando que el cursor parpadeante resuelva el dilema por mí. **«It’s not that hard»**, me digo en voz baja, mientras pido comida a domicilio solo porque lavar un par de sartenes me parece una odisea doméstica. La tecnología nos ha vendido una versión esterilizada de la existencia, donde cualquier rastro de esfuerzo se percibe como un error del sistema que debe ser corregido de inmediato.
![](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/amigoponc/23z73NuHivYjfUcujXirNPhzhQ1ZMFVPKNifDumpbhpbVqygN2SJ2cnqFN9u77EBwMri6.png) [Gracias a la app Banana 2.0 por ilustrar mi publicación.](https://gemini.google.com/app)
Estamos perdiendo, casi sin darnos cuenta, nuestra capacidad innata para la acción. Antes, la necesidad movilizaba el cuerpo y el ingenio; hoy, solo mueve el pulgar sobre el cristal templado. Esa búsqueda frenética de la inmediatez, ese dulce veneno de lo fácil, nos ha transformado en espectadores pasivos de nuestra propia biografía. Nos hemos convencido de que evitar la fricción es sinónimo de éxito, olvidando que es precisamente esa resistencia lo que nos mantiene despiertos y humanos. Hacer las cosas por uno mismo, sentir el peso de una herramienta o el agotamiento real tras una caminata, se ha convertido en un extraño acto de rebeldía. «No es tan difícil», repito, pero la inercia del sofá pesa como el plomo. La comodidad absoluta actúa como una anestesia que adormece el instinto de superación. Al delegar nuestra autonomía en algoritmos, estamos olvidando el sabor del logro genuino. No se trata de rechazar el progreso, sino de reclamar la voluntad. Porque vivir de verdad requiere una dosis necesaria de dificultad y, aunque nos dé pereza admitirlo, recuperar ese impulso vital, it’s not that hard.
*** ***

body.title: Double-checking.
body.body:
<center>[TIME](https://time.com/archive/7122566/confessions-of-another-book-reviewer/)</center>
When it comes to books, I've had the opportunity to work as a proofreader. Recently, I'm doing this job again for a friend who is writing a book (about philosophical concepts), and I can say I had forgotten how tiring this function is. Although it's a pleasurable job for those who like to write, I believe it's more tiring because of the repetition of checking words (in a more general context) than the reading itself.
Maintaining heightened attention is just one detail, and it ends up being fundamental in this job. Minor errors can become major when they are not detected beforehand, even altering the functionality of the subjects being discussed within the text. Grammatical structures also need revision, because without standardized adaptation, the conception of the idea can be lost in the construction process and all its foundations.
I think a proofreader ends up doing much more than is asked of them, because when there is real commitment to the work, some professional horizons are crossed for the benefit of the work being \

. Personally, I also enjoy doing this work because I learn new words and practice the habit of reading more accurately. In short, it's the kind of work that brings different benefits to those who can see beyond.
Sporadic episodes remind me that working as a proofreader is something that, despite being practical, carries with it a whole methodical process that is very interesting for those people who like to write (especially). Now, I am having this opportunity again and who knows, in the future, I intend to do this more often. The art of writing is sensational, and when shared in this way it becomes even more functional and very immersive.
---
<center>**Verificando dos veces.**</center>
En lo que respecta a libros, he tenido la oportunidad de trabajar como corrector de pruebas. Recientemente, estoy haciendo este trabajo de nuevo para un amigo que está escribiendo un libro (sobre conceptos filosóficos), y debo decir que había olvidado lo agotadora que es esta tarea. Si bien es un trabajo placentero para quienes disfrutan escribiendo, creo que resulta más agotador por la repetición de revisar palabras (en un contexto más general) que por la lectura en sí.
Mantener una atención constante es solo un detalle, pero resulta fundamental en este trabajo. Los errores menores pueden convertirse en graves si no se detectan a tiempo, llegando incluso a alterar la funcionalidad de los temas tratados en el texto. Las estructuras gramaticales también necesitan revisión, ya que sin una adaptación estandarizada, la concepción de la idea puede perderse en el proceso de construcción y todos sus fundamentos.
Creo que un corrector de pruebas termina haciendo mucho más de lo que se le pide, porque cuando hay un verdadero compromiso con el trabajo, se traspasan ciertos límites profesionales en beneficio de la obra que se está \

. Personalmente, también disfruto de este trabajo porque aprendo vocabulario nuevo y practico el hábito de leer con mayor atención. En resumen, es el tipo de trabajo que aporta beneficios diferentes a quienes saben ver más allá. Algunos episodios esporádicos me recuerdan que trabajar como corrector de pruebas, además de ser práctico, conlleva todo un proceso metódico que resulta muy interesante para quienes disfrutan escribiendo (sobre todo). Ahora tengo esta oportunidad de nuevo y quién sabe, en el futuro, pienso hacerlo con más frecuencia. El arte de escribir es sensacional, y cuando se comparte de esta manera, se vuelve aún más funcional y muy enriquecedor. ---
**Checagem dupla.**
Em se tratando de livros, eu já tive a oportunidade de trabalhar como revisor de textos. Recentemente, estou fazendo esse trabalho novamente para um amigo que está escrevendo um livro (sobre conceitos filosóficos) e posso dizer havia esquecido como essa função é cansativa. Embora seja um trabalho prazeroso para quem gosta de escrever, eu acredito que seja mais cansativo pela repetição de checagens das palavras (num contexto mais geral) do que pela leitura em si. Manter atenção redobrada é apenas um dos detalhes, e que acaba sendo fundamental nesse trabalho. Erros mínimos podem se tornar grandes quando não são detectados previamente, sendo capazes de alterar até a funcionalidade dos assuntos que estão sendo discutidos dentro do texto. Estruturas gramaticais também precisam de revisão, porque sem uma adequação padronizada, a concepção da ideia pode se perder no processo de construção e todos os seus alicerces. Penso que um revisor de textos acaba fazendo muito mais do que lhe é pedido, porque quando há comprometimento real com o trabalho, alguns horizontes profissionais são cruzados em benefício do trabalho que está sendo “lapidado”. Particularmente, eu também gosto de fazer esse trabalho porque aprendo palavras novas e exercito o hábito da leitura com mais precisão. Em síntese, é o tipo de trabalho que traz diferentes benefícios para quem consegue enxergar além. Episódios esporádicos me lembram que trabalhar como revisor de texto é algo que apesar de prático, carrega consigo todo um processo metódico que é muito interessante para aquelas pessoas que gostam de escrever (principalmente). Agora, eu estou tendo essa oportunidade novamente e quem sabe no futuro, pretendo fazer isso com mais frequência. A arte da escrita é sensacional, e quando compartilhada dessa maneira se torna ainda mais funcional e muito imersiva. Posted Using [INLEO](https://inleo.io/@wiseagent/doublechecking-827)

body.title: Ghost Writer           ...Part 2            ...Finale
body.body:
*The secret to writing is to get your own pain. Shout it out till it hurts your throat. Weep it into your pillow - then write it down ...*


. ![writer.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/johnjgeddes/23tvZzCBJfEM2QQgP8td9CFFXbCHxAMHCqZUMfXAbRAN5oaWCXXHvaZZXswFAUGpJAbC9.png)


I was feeling really down—I mean, bad enough I was a struggling writer, but having to be mentored by a ghost? It was too tough on my ego and way too hard on my flesh. At least Harry could look back on an illustrious career and the mark he left on the literary world. *Me*? I took the L and completely failed. Hary's a winner and I'm a putz.

“You’re looking peeked lately, Kent.” I just shrugged. He gazed at me compassionately, “Maybe I’ve been pushing you too hard.” I slowly shook my head. “No, Harry—it’s not that—it’s me. I realized I’m a sham. You were right about me—I’m just a hack.” “Well, perhaps I was a little harsh, my boy—you’ve come a long way since then. You told me yourself how you’ve grown.” “Yeah, sure Harry—grown rich because of you. Face it—I’m a light-duty imitation of you. You’re the heart and soul behind the novel—I’m just your errand boy.”

Harry protested, but I’d made up my mind. I went into seclusion—took a small beach house in Florida on the Gulf coast and didn’t come back to New York for six months. Harry was waiting in the study when I got in. “Did you learn anything?” he asked. “Yeah,” I grimaced, “what a poor slob of a writer I am.” “You wrote in Florida?” “Oh sure—reams and reams—sentimental slop, I’m sure.” “Let me see it.” I opened my suitcase and tossed him my draft of *In the Cold Ground*.

He sat by the fire leafing through it and I went on up to bed—I was completely drained. The next morning, Harry was ecstatic. “You did it, Kent! I believe I’ve made a writer of you.” “What are you talking about, Harry?” “Your passion—the feeling in this book. It’s *you* Kent. It’s genuine, it’s deep and it’s real. Don’t you see? You just had to go and get your own pain. This is brilliant.” It turns out Harry was right. The novel rocketed up the bestseller lists, doing even better than *Cold As Death*. Harry was as proud as if I were his son.

One day, just before Christmas, he called me aside. “Our collaboration has been beneficial for both of us, Kent. You got me out of this house and opened up the world to me again. I’ve decided to move on.” “You mean you’re going to the light?” “Oh puhlease—not that rot! I’ve found another young writer to mentor. She’s delicious—even worse than you were. I’ve already thrown her book at the wall, so to speak.” “Gee, that’s great, Harry—who is she?” “Turns out she’s one of Hattie’s descendants—even looks like her—same auburn hair.” “Um, remember Harry—you’re dead.” “You don’t think I’d cultivate her for romantic purposes, do you? I’ll turn her into a Charlotte Bronte—she’s not like you, Kent, she writes romances.” “Sounds like another best seller’s in the making.”

Harry paused and his eyes grew warm. “Don’t worry, Boy, I’ll come back and visit. She’s quite an attractive girl, really and you two might just hit it off.” “So, you’re a matchmaker now, Harry?” “Just let me give you a word of advice—don’t build a house to suit her tastes.” “I won’t Harry. Actually, I’ve become quite fond of this one now, although it’s a bit big and lonely.” Harry winked. “I have a feeling it won’t stay that way long.”

To be continued…

body.body:
Full Metal Ox Day 1881
Friday 24, April 2026
Abundance Year Episode 1946
Noxsoma Life Camp:  

TGI Friday Fam. Are you ready for some weekend!?  

We begin the final week of April. This April has been undoubtedly a Month of Fools, by Fools, and about Fools. However, one of the Seven Truths of Noxsoma Life Camp is, “it is, what it is.” We have planned for, (so we tell The Trinity), and imagined, much worse. This vessel is equipped with “Doom Receptors.” But we also have “Doom Resisters,” so we exist within this simulatrix in a state of harmonic balance. 

Have you seen any of the “Cat-Fu” videos? They crack me up. Cat pix have come a long way. 

Some time ago Mind posed a wonder. What would American life have been like if film-making had been more equitable? What if Negroes, (we will use the term of the 1930s), started making films in the 1930s, or even earlier? Not in Hollywood, but maybe in Mississippi, Alabama, Kentucky, or Tennessee? What if they told their stories, not in tape-recorded “Slave Narratives,” but on film? There’s no doubt American culture would be immeasurably different. And no doubt, better, if only for the diversity of perspectives.  

But let’s also consider a Chinese perspective. What would 1940s era westerns look like when produced by descendants of Transcontinental Railroad workers?  

We can only imagine. 

Mind dropped this question on us shortly before the Artificial Intelligence explosion. “What does film-making look like when anybody can do it?” One answer is, they are short, and sharp, and karmic. Aside from the karate-cat videos, and the Iranian propaganda, there are some shorts that depict karmic situations. Bullies get their due, situation awareness clips, savior motifs, flirting, amazing feats of physical strength & discipline, (probably with a little ai added.) And self-defense scenarios, (which are really fearporn ads to get you into a dojo.) 

These shorts give you an idea of the level of values and morals and tech, from different parts of the world, cultures, and mindsets. Euro-American clips are what we’ve lived with for a hundred years.  Fighting, shooting, bombing, motorcycle chases, gratuitously and repeatedly. It’s the same shit. (It only took your boy half a century to get over it. That’s how deep it goes.) 

Anyway, this has been on my mind all week. Which reminds me. If you want to know, and/or experience how your humble vagabond would make a movie, check out my “epic” comic strip, de facto novel, right here, free for everyone, beginning May 1st. Written in 2013, it has everything an “American” movie would have. Meanwhile… 

Stay strong, stay safe, stay sane, stay savvy, stay serene, stay sovereign, stay subscribed.  

PEACE



We’re All Doomed

![1946.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmPH6TK6CqcdEa8GSXEeBiJ8yScWNbf6iRR48H2dhuZN2q/1946.png)

Decadence
Friday Meditation 
Ascended masters have given up on humanity. It all ends this weekend.                     
 
Today's Episode:   https://odysee.com/@Noxsoma:2/1881_full_4-24-26_1946_doomed:5?r=47k2ScJsm9Uex9eETqgCCA8q1fukdST9  
Channels: go to noxsoma.substack.com and subscribe. 

 We’re Doomed! (Just Not Yet). 
Your humble vagabond is very critical of “news journalists” that start their reports with, “what if?” Or, “imagine that” dot-dot-dot. This is not news, it’s imagination. Instead of reporting the happenings of the day, they literally invite us to “imagine” something. A scenario. The “if” is a dead giveaway. When “if” appears, whatever comes next is immediately fake. 

Your boy does this all the times. We are very clear that we are in “full fantasy mode.” That we are living in a simulation, and that everything is everything. Never, (in this case it’s the correct word), mistake what we do on this channel as “news.” 

We, The Trinity, have concluded, with all the cynicism, skepticism, sarcasm and irony that we can muster, that the human species is doomed. We may already be in hell, or on a prison planet. It’s a pleasant thought. Probably not “true.” But, “if” this is hell, it hasn’t been so bad. But fret not my friends, the end is coming. And your essence will return to the ether, just like Odo, from Deep Space Nine. 

While most of “philosophy” has contemplated the existence of a divine creator, Vagabond Philosophy contemplates the catastrophic errors of a corporeal creator. A mad scientist from another world who sought to please the slave population imported to this planet from their home-world, 450,000 years ago, to extract gold from the ground. 
This is as much a legend, or mythology as Jesus, Moses & Mithra. Only the spin is different. 
We’re not going to re-write Sitchin. If you know, you know. If you don’t know and want to know, check out any of the growing number of “Annunaki” channels on the net. If you don’t know and want to remain blissfully ignorant as long as possible, possibly to the end of what could be a very long and comfortable life, stop reading, (or listening), now. 
When INXS sings about a White boy hooking up with a Black girl and hinting that it’s “Original Sin,” (akin to bestiality), lead singer and co-writer Michael Hutchence (1960-1997), might have been closer than he was taught. Presumably by the Holy Bible. 

In Vagabond Philosophy, which draws from “alien intervention theory,” original sin was the decision to cross-breed the creatures of the Earth in order to create a “primitive worker.” Eventually, so we suspect from the chronicles, after 100,000 plus years of trial and error, it was finally decided that the alien colonizers would have to use their own species in creation of this creature. 

This is the long-story-short version. Original sin is creating a slave race through interspecies-breeding. It has been passed down to be understood as a prohibition against interracial reproduction. It’s not as simple as black & white either. But that’s another story. These are the roots of our philosophy, which we also call “Space Alien Philosophy.” 

It only sounds way-out because you haven’t yet, (unless you have), made the connection between Enoch, Jesus and Osiris as extraterrestrials, or human-alien hybrids.  

The trouble started where the trouble has continued, in the “Fertile Crescent.” “The Holy Land.” “West Asia.” 

So here’s the scoop. Creating humans was a catastrophic failure. Maybe not in Southern Africa where the workers were blissfully mining gold, but in Sumer, (modern day Iraq) and environs it was quite a different story. There was a lot of “original sin” going on, (if you get my drift), and the population was growing out of control. Annunaki aliens, as well as Annunaki born on Earth were copulating with the “hybrid women,” (likely used for domestic work, and not sent to the mines.) Until, after many generations, the “daughters of man” became comely and fair and attracted an army of “angels” from heaven, (or Mars, or some spaceship hovering above), who mated with them and begat monsters. (This story is chronicled in the Book of Enoch, and mentioned briefly in Genesis.) 

This incident, another echo of “original sin” caused more mayhem on the planet. These proto-humans, were basically wild. They still had those hominid genes being passed through the generations.  

The ruling elites, the “pure” Annunaki, could see disaster coming. Even if they wanted to they couldn’t stop what was coming, nor could they save their critters, pets, workers, or the giants that were causing all the chaos. The Noah story is framed that Noah and his family got the heads-up because of righteousness, but it was bloodline. That’s evident. But Noah wasn’t the only one. There were many more. As there are many more similar stories from around the world and through time. There are 200-300 flood myths from various cultures around the world. Those are just the stories that survived. 

After the cataclysm, which wasn’t only a single flood, (there were earthquakes, pillars of fire, thunder and lightening, blocking out of the sun), a “wrathful” God appears. 

Anyway, the bottom line is, humans are chaotic, irrational and dangerous. There are many factions, according to Vagabond Philosophy. Picture a circle. There’s a faction that just wants to wipe us out completely. This species is unnatural and should have never been created. There’s another faction that wants to keep us busy generating revenue, (which is why we were created), until we grind ourselves into a nursing home where they can siphon the last bit of wealth out of our vessel and burn the carcass to heat the building. (Everything but the oink.) Then there are factions that are still holding out hope that we can be domesticated to a level where we are not killing one another or other critters on the planet and destroying the land, skies, and waters. And there are factions in between.”Maybe we can get rid of these malfunctioning models, and the others will be able to thrive.” 

Vagabond philosophy says, “They want us dead. But some kind of alien morals keep them from just wiping us out altogether.” After all, we are their creations.   

This philosophy drives our psychology and subsequently our behavior. We do not believe in a god that  allows humans to fuck-shit-up, fuck others over, hurt, kill and destroy civilizations, then go to church, feign remorse, and be given absolution for their crimes against humanity. We exist in a simulation that wants this species wiped out, and are more than willing to allow us to do just that, as long as we don’t disturb the furniture. The alien overlords want humans gone, and they want us to do the dirty work, which we’ve been doing quite a good job at. 
This is why we’re all doomed. Doom isn’t coming. It’s already here.

body.body:
![](https://images.hive.blog/DQmPoxi68fbajpE9c525ZvH2E1aiWcc8NwMh2aDKsy126EL/PSL.PNG)

# <center>**<u>Peace be upon you all</u> ✨🌟**</center>

**Warm greetings to everyone.🤍🌸**

I hope you are all doing well, staying healthy, motivated, and full of positive energy, and your days are full of joy, peace, and little moments that make you smile. 🌟✨🌟


The 11th edition of the Pakistan Super League (PSL) has now entered a nail-biting stage. Only a few group matches are left before the playoffs. The fate of some teams has already been decided, but at least four teams are still fighting hard to qualify for the playoff stage.

## Top Performers So Far

### Peshawar Zalmi
Peshawar Zalmi has been the most successful team in this edition. They are unbeaten so far, having played 9 matches, winning 8 and drawing 1. With 17 points, they are comfortably sitting at the top of the points table and have already qualified for the playoffs.

### Multan Sultans
Multan Sultans are in second place with 12 points. They have played 9 matches and won 6 of them. They have also qualified for the playoffs, but their final position may still change depending on the remaining matches.

## Teams Out of the Race

### Rawalpindiz
Pindiz, a new team in PSL, had a very tough season. They are at the bottom of the table with only 2 points. Out of 9 matches, they managed to win just one game (against Islamabad United) and lost 8 matches in a row. It has been a rough tournament for them.

### Quetta Gladiators
Once again, disappointment for Quetta Gladiators fans. Gladiators won the PSL in 2019, but their performance has declined over the years. In the last 7 seasons, they have reached the playoffs only once. This season, they are second last with 6 points (3 wins and 6 losses in 9 matches). Another poor season for them.

## The Real Battle – Middle of the Table

Now comes the most exciting part of the tournament. Four teams are fighting for the remaining two playoff spots:

- Islamabad United  
- Hyderabad Kingsmen  
- Lahore Qalanders  
- Karachi Kings  

The last few group matches will decide which two teams qualify.

### Islamabad United
Islamabad United are currently in 3rd place with 9 points. They have played 8 matches (4 wins, 3 losses, 1 draw). They are in a strong position and can qualify by winning just one more match.

### Hyderabad Kingsmen
Hyderabad Kingsmen are in 4th place with 8 matches played (4 wins and 4 losses). After a poor start, they have made a strong comeback, winning 4 of their last 5 matches. Their chances of qualifying look good.

### Lahore Qalanders
Lahore Qalanders, the defending champions, are in 5th place with 8 points (4 wins and 5 losses in 9 matches). They have not performed well this season and have disappointed their fans. Their last match is very important, and although chances are low, they still have a small hope.

### Karachi Kings
Karachi Kings are also on 8 points with the same record as Lahore (4 wins, 5 losses). They are in 6th place. Like Lahore, they also need a strong finish and a bit of luck to qualify.

---

## Conclusion

The PSL 11 group stage is reaching its final moments, and the competition is getting more intense with every match. While Peshawar Zalmi and Multan Sultans have already secured their spots, the battle for the remaining playoff positions is wide open.

The next few matches will be very exciting and important for the teams in the middle of the table. Fans can expect thrilling performances, close finishes, and lots of drama.
Let’s see which two teams will grab the final playoff spots and move one step closer to the PSL trophy! 🏆
