body.title: Fungi Friday - 3 species of mushrooms I found last week that look so beautiful and fascinating
body.body:
![183357258.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ridor5301/EpCBuPFTD7w6LE8stRioMPbUEffJdckwuGsn2K8oPvxKXQDQo3c9pxfGrnRDs2tPGV1.jpg)
> Hello Everyone, today I am back to prepare some beautiful mushrooms that I will be featuring in the #FungiFriday Community hosted by @ewkaw today.

>On this occasion, I didn't go anywhere to look for mushroom species, because I had some mushroom species in stock yesterday that I had stored in a gallery that I found last Sunday in a palm oil plantation. And the first one I found was a mushroom species known by another name, Hygrocybe mucronella. At that time, I was walking in the palm oil plantation looking for mushrooms and I saw a pile of rotting and damp wood.

\n\n

>And at that time I accidentally saw this species of mushroom growing abundantly in the pile of wood. And at that time I immediately approached it to see it up close and it turned out to be truly very beautiful, and without waiting long I immediately took several different angles of photos and it looked very beautiful and graceful, and on this occasion I again show some portraits of this mushroom species, and you can see them below some portraits of this mushroom species.

![1000088275.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ridor5301/EoEpUXXxDLEfVYYHZ431zQ8Yt6Qd5TTnBHGE6AUtGsYzmYLiXVTCvHs5d5ZFR1Y4H7n.jpg) ![1000088261.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ridor5301/EoeERDMK92hvFqVX4h5zVGyBfXsejVtMaH9jM2QGB5hRdLA2q7XBZTdVMUncQxFVkdX.jpg) ![1000088274.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ridor5301/Eoc6UTPMPpQZ8Gaa8HtaXnVRHNLqqLWfjWkuUMiJ3qi3EEV8XBFSZs376BEHfMCuqHw.jpg) ![1000088262.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ridor5301/Eonk11ZqEyrKEcRJtv2CRmXtbNpkWZtCAKx8ZGSqRGEsxnrEQpeE3V2m7UwqFcD5Zmn.jpg) ![1000088279.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ridor5301/EoeDTj7TBsADZe7FtsTCp7TTLNVPpm5cS62BvHvRVMR3vkieuXMSh5Qt2p1PQT5SmY4.jpg) ![1000088267.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ridor5301/EoiUn2QRYGLxu95eTeSjwYRs8MoqjSg5LdZfzvBoeFohmrYvV48arPvEawMjAgxvDKT.jpg)

>This mushroom species typically thrives during the rainy season and prefers to grow in piles of rotting wood. Coincidentally, many of the palm oil trees in this oil palm plantation have been felled, which is why I discovered this mushroom species. Its thick, yellow cap with a red center seemed to have its own unique characteristics. I immediately took several different angles to see its interesting side.

>Hygrocybe mucronella is a species of agaric (gilled mushroom) in the family Hygrophoraceae. It has been given the recommended English name of bitter waxcap.....[Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hygrocybe_mucronella) ![1000088265.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ridor5301/EogNFrRXkZAdvSnCNzNDQvudUtxWM6ecNn85NcMn5MeDBD9ETann1kfbZgGUFDHQasa.jpg) ![1000088270.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ridor5301/Eoc6yCAnLEsdpz46isSkAb8LwJ3K3Zk3GQ4bUE5vqwepzxZdWmRJ8MNdSDcCjBsQcLq.jpg) ![1000088266.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ridor5301/EoK5meJqtMEQrYvxwm68wXL6VH7Esv9ueQDTK7ie8Jgqg5UGzLXA59q1fwUF4yqX8fm.jpg) ![1000088271.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ridor5301/Eonjzu3JcnD2UkCb9ShQwmAiy7HH1Tnzn7af1EyxnzoESbcr7LEcu7igFJiZz392c64.jpg) ![1000088264.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ridor5301/Eonk35tm4QMutzbFM2vddC6CZb8nTto68sJW5Av6Nw8iLAvGunCXdfK2vgUg94rrgWF.jpg)

>Then I went back around the oil palm plantation again to look for other mushroom species. And at that time I immediately walked and not long after I found a mushroom species known by another name, namely Mycena sanguinolenta, and the shape of its small hat looked like it had its own characteristics and its purple color looked so interesting and unique, and at that time I saw it growing well on a pile of rotten wood and at that time I immediately took several different pictures and it looked very beautiful and unique, and you can see it below.

>Mycena sanguinolenta, commonly known as the bleeding bonnet, the smaller bleeding Mycena, or the terrestrial bleeding Mycena, is a species of mushroom in the family Mycenaceae.....[Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mycena_sanguinolenta) ![1000114257.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ridor5301/EoiUGF1BX8nt4qiLPkajHJXQM6MjCWEXYswGsQ2SeA7yXp8AFGYndJXaicGGo7rBxPS.jpg) ![1000114258.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ridor5301/EogLpD74HbhKKvFhngUw7acFm4c2oVZfiaWjpCQp8h4NCBjVocQBzJKPV6NS5TDQzrk.jpg) ![1000114252.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ridor5301/EogLnLP77duwt4MvXjxr1bCBELEFSymVNB9JM3R8P9WyUBqtS62Uhah1xme1U8WTbjR.jpg) ![1000114250.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ridor5301/Eo6MSGZMUqQV9P6w1Cq5RoeZrnzRPLmS8MbxvEuj156hdZwcBhC5mBbQqoJtGzoXWMe.jpg) ![1000114248.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ridor5301/Eo8UL5NRmgRKpBsQe4gmDWByFfZU22Bqcs7nUXvPcg9hDScvSRsiJ3PtbKQbW9HkrV5.jpg) ![1000114253.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ridor5301/EokcgjQN2teWPin8ULho1eKv1vP7cZwqztEUQRFadVfg7qN1CKAu6Q8aW59h6c6SK6u.jpg) ![1000114255.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ridor5301/Eou7EM4RLt2S7k7msFgSJyzGZ1iFwFjean6J5LeE917bvCzHcwNjEzb75DTLP1daNg7.jpg)

>Then, after photographing the second mushroom species, I accidentally discovered a species of mushroom known by another name, Arcyria denudata. Its small, pink shape seemed unique. I saw it growing abundantly on a pile of rotting wood, and I immediately approached it, taking several different angles. It looked very beautiful and graceful, and you can see it below.

>Arcyria denudata, commonly known as carnival candy slime mold, is a species of myxomycete slime mold in the family Arcyriaceae.....[Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Arcyria_denudata) ![1000105690.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ridor5301/EokdYdXgt8HuonuH3tkg3zAQATvKg7RkqZnPVycCnpoS1iTTAzpc7UdHNFbQJpR6RG5.jpg) ![1000105694.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ridor5301/Ep3eHkbHopVnyoqA42bPuXBxMYT18bupVJYJA4KGyVAcoxeFSiFk4wXvbmuThkFjzyn.jpg) ![1000105691.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ridor5301/Eokd2PyautDpJCxdMuQB2vkiU2Efe5WCi6EjSSVoKwkyLJdS1UW8d6JHZU8ueBTwDzy.jpg) ![1000105696.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ridor5301/EowH1EN7VuBoxdKozz6ap4tM4v574U2jSC6QmEJdLkkmp2hK3qjhBsamY3VUVzLxsLg.jpg)

body.title: How an Assignment Writer is Redefining Modern Academic Success in 2026
body.body:
Academic life has changed dramatically over the past few years. Students are no longer limited to textbooks and classroom lectures; instead, they navigate a complex learning environment filled with digital tools, remote classes, and evolving expectations. Amid these changes, the role of an **assignment writer** has become more relevant than ever, helping students balance quality, deadlines, and understanding.

An assignment is no longer just about completing a task—it’s about demonstrating analytical thinking, originality, and clarity. However, many students struggle to meet these expectations due to time constraints, part-time jobs, or lack of guidance. This is where a professional **assignment writer** plays a supportive role, not just in delivering content but in helping students understand academic standards.

### The Shift Toward Personalized Learning

Education is moving away from rigid systems and embracing flexibility. Students now expect learning experiences tailored to their pace, strengths, and interests. A helpful example of this transformation can be seen in the growing trend of [hyper-personalized learning systems](https://uploadarticle.it.com/the-rise-of-hyper-personalized-learning-why-one-size-fits-all-education-is-dead/), where traditional methods are being replaced by adaptive educational models.

This shift has created both opportunities and challenges. While students have access to more resources, they also face increased pressure to perform independently. A skilled assignment writer can bridge this gap by offering customized assistance that aligns with individual academic goals. Instead of generic solutions, students receive structured and relevant content that supports their learning journey.

### Why Students Seek Professional Writing Help

There are several reasons why students turn to writing support services. Academic pressure is one of the biggest factors. With multiple assignments, exams, and extracurricular activities, managing everything efficiently becomes overwhelming.

Another reason is the complexity of subjects. Not every student excels in every field. For instance, a student strong in mathematics may struggle with literature analysis or research-based essays. An experienced assignment writer understands these differences and adapts writing styles accordingly.

Language barriers also play a role, especially for international students. Expressing ideas clearly in a non-native language can be challenging. Professional writers help refine these ideas into coherent and academically acceptable formats without compromising the student’s voice.

### Maintaining Quality in the Age of Automation

With the rise of AI tools and automated content generation, maintaining authenticity has become a major concern in academics. Many institutions are now focusing on originality, critical thinking, and human insight rather than just information delivery.

This concern is explored deeply in discussions around [automation versus authenticity in digital learning](https://digitalpress.it.com/automation-vs-authenticity-maintaining-high-editorial-standards-in-the-age-of-digital-learning/), where the importance of maintaining editorial standards is emphasized. While technology can assist in research, it cannot replace human creativity and contextual understanding.

A professional assignment writer ensures that content remains authentic, well-researched, and aligned with academic guidelines. They go beyond surface-level writing and focus on creating meaningful, plagiarism-free work that reflects genuine understanding.

### Skills That Define a Good Assignment Writer

Not all writers are the same. A reliable assignment writer possesses a combination of academic knowledge, research skills, and adaptability. They are capable of handling different subjects, formats, and citation styles, whether it’s APA, MLA, or Harvard.

Time management is another crucial skill. Meeting deadlines without compromising quality is essential in academic writing. Students often rely on writers during tight schedules, making punctuality a key factor.

Communication also plays an important role. A good writer understands the requirements clearly and ensures that the final output matches the expectations. This includes following instructions, maintaining tone, and structuring content logically.

### Ethical Use of Writing Assistance

One common concern surrounding academic help services is ethics. The key lies in how the assistance is used. When students treat the work provided by an assignment writer as a learning resource, it becomes a valuable educational tool.

Instead of simply submitting the work, students can study the structure, arguments, and references used. This approach helps them improve their own writing skills over time. Ethical use transforms writing support from a shortcut into a stepping stone for academic growth.

Educational institutions are also recognizing this shift. Rather than discouraging external help entirely, many educators now emphasize proper understanding and responsible usage.

### The Future of Academic Writing Support

The future of assignment writing is closely tied to advancements in education technology. As digital platforms evolve, writing services are also becoming more interactive and student-focused. Real-time collaboration, personalized feedback, and adaptive content are shaping the next phase of academic assistance.

Students are no longer looking for just completed assignments—they want guidance, clarity, and improvement. This demand is pushing every assignment writer to enhance their approach, focusing more on mentorship rather than just delivery.

Moreover, the integration of data-driven insights is helping writers understand student needs better. From analyzing performance trends to suggesting improvements, the role is becoming more dynamic and impactful.

### Balancing Independence and Support

One of the biggest challenges students face is finding the right balance between independent learning and external help. Relying entirely on others can hinder growth, while avoiding support altogether can lead to unnecessary stress.

A professional assignment writer acts as a guide rather than a replacement for student effort. By offering structured assistance, they enable students to learn more effectively while managing their workload efficiently.

This balance is especially important in competitive academic environments where both performance and understanding matter equally.

### Conclusion

Academic success is no longer defined by hard work alone—it requires smart strategies, adaptability, and the right support system. The growing demand for assignment writing services reflects the evolving needs of students in a fast-paced educational landscape.

Choosing the right assignment writer can make a significant difference, not just in grades but in overall learning experience. When used responsibly, writing assistance becomes a powerful tool that enhances knowledge, builds confidence, and prepares students for future challenges.

As education continues to evolve, the role of professional writers will remain essential, helping students navigate complexity with clarity and confidence.

body.title: The Geometry of Forbidden Stars
body.body: <center>\n\nThere is a unique kind of grief in a love that must remain unspoken and unacted—a feeling that lives in the quiet space between \

It is a heavy secret to carry, watching a life from the sidelines while your heart beats in a rhythm you are forced to ignore. This is a tribute to the love that exists in the shadows, built on the bittersweet foundation of what could be, but must never be.

The Geometry of Forbidden Stars

I stand upon a shore you’ll never reach,
With words that die like foam upon the beach.
A fire burning in a house of snow,
A secret current only I can know.

I map the distance with a steady eye,
And trace the limits of our separate sky.
For you are gravity and I am light,
Crossing for a moment in the night.

To love you is to breathe beneath the tide,
With nowhere left for honesty to hide.
Yet I must lock the door and lose the key,
To save the version of us that is free.

I hold your laughter like a stolen gold,
A story that can never quite be told.
I'll be the friend, the ghost, the quiet stone,
While carrying this ache all on my own.

For some are meant to walk, and some to fly,
And some are meant to simply pass us by.
I’ll love you in the way the moon loves day—
From half a world of silence far away.

This creative piece was composed with the assistance of AI, translating my personal reflections on unspoken love into poetic form.

body.title: Learn Creative Coding (#44) - Working with Textures in Shaders
body.body:
is the foundation of all GPU computing. What we did today with audio FFT data scales up to fluid simulations, physics engines, neural networks -- anything that benefits from massive parallelism.

But one step at a time. Today, go load a photo and make it weird :-)

## Allez, wa weten we nu allemaal?

- Textures in WebGL: `gl.createTexture()`, `gl.texImage2D()` to upload, `gl.texParameteri()` for filtering (LINEAR vs NEAREST) and wrapping (CLAMP_TO_EDGE vs REPEAT)
- In GLSL: declare as `uniform sampler2D u_texture`, sample with `texture2D(u_texture, uv)`. UV range 0-1, returns vec4 RGBA
- UV distortion: offset UV coordinates with noise before sampling. Small offsets (0.01-0.05) for heat haze, larger (0.1-0.3) for abstract warping
- Displacement mapping: use one image's brightness to offset another image's UV. Self-displacement uses the image's own luminance
- Pixel sorting approximation: shift UVs proportional to brightness above a threshold. Animate the threshold for sweeping effects
- Texture feedback: ping-pong between two framebuffers. Read previous frame, apply distortion, fade slightly, write new frame. Accumulates trails and patterns over hundreds of frames
- Palette textures: a 256x1 gradient image as a color lookup table. Map any computed value (noise, distance, iteration count) to the gradient for custom coloring
- Data textures: pack non-image data into texture pixels (audio FFT, particle positions, simulation state). The GPU reads them as colors but you interpret them as numbers
- UV animation: scroll (`uv + time`), rotate (2D rotation matrix centered on 0.5), zoom (divide UV by zoom factor). Combine for complex texture movement
- Post-processing from episode 43 (chromatic aberration, vignette, grain, color grading) stacks naturally on top of texture effects

Sallukes! Thanks for reading.

Proving God's existence is not something that is done by man but by the things he created. The bible teaches us that the natural things around us shows that God is powerful and he has wisdom. The order, beauty, and complexity of the universe point beyond themselves to a Creator. 

>“The heavens declare the glory of God; and the firmament shows His handiwork” (Psalm 19:1).

https://youtu.be/R5ISyOr6ucc?si=s52Oyk09rxkX48T0
Another biblical perspective is the inner witness within human beings. The Bible suggests that knowledge of God is placed within the human heart and conscience, making people aware of right and wrong. This moral awareness reflects God’s character and serves as a testimony to His existence. The bible explains that what may be known of God is evident within people, because God has made it plain to them.

body.title: How to prepare our delicious homemade food
body.body:
Hello hive food community! 🍯🍴




![Collage 2026-04-20 12-43-27.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/deborahstitches/AKDhdQStteMqqufoVusuwG2hXLJhq1T4rdye8WhRbFdbdfmEEn9bGT4oBBJCjWp.png)




I’m excited to be here—this is my very first post, and I’m looking forward to sharing, learning, and connecting with fellow food lovers. Can’t wait to explore all the delicious ideas and inspiration in this space! 😊





![IMG_1942.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/deborahstitches/23wX3nbXa3ciUSr2Famm2vn8ZgDcx1ZayqyswkCqoh3kMUrjXB3f6yA6EcELukDuhSZVf.JPG)




After many years apart since our school days, my friend called me one day and invited me over. I was happy to see him again, and he warmly welcomed me, saying he had really missed me—especially my cooking.
We spent time talking and catching up on old memories, laughing like nothing had changed. Before leaving, I decided to cook for him. So we went to the market together to buy the ingredients.
It was a simple moment, but it brought back our strong friendship and reminded us of the good old days.




Stewed &Chicken
Ingredients: Chicken, onions, pepper, tomatoes, garlic, ginger, seasoning cubes, salt, vegetable oil



![IMG_1934.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/deborahstitches/242DLeJxc4wbCz6Y4tJZSRuDrtn5gzyVEF9R7kyCaZRKC62rMXiDfh9mDpuvA2MFajVQm.JPG)

![IMG_1939.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/deborahstitches/23uQrdUuwtcBD9ewE6EuzawyTkyqFTM8hn3mu261uqXiVsEM7zVYLbmxaS5QQnysjK2gz.JPG)



Steps: Wash the chicken thoroughly and season with salt, seasoning cubes, onions, garlic, and ginger. Allow it to marinate for about 30 minutes. Place in a pot and cook until tender, adding a little water if needed. 



**Once cooked, fry the chicken for a golden look.**



![IMG_1935.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/deborahstitches/23xL16rfLzXdQWRE5wJZ2ydfQNZ2trXRwXYd3kanq2oXkhkR7bLPkAiz2Qd9td83DQ4tK.JPG)

![IMG_1936.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/deborahstitches/23uQr4eRf3dzPDg4V3rrmykzHc7kpVZKqjuLaS7ko1T9rQkYsKGz2uMtqdDJCFdAuuYkY.JPG)




![IMG_1937.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/deborahstitches/23xKou84fbcb42niMmRbAWCPwhV3kjZ1HQXuvzCNTzJqegn6mRXaRZ1FJtBMCuuFWDe7y.JPG)




**For the stew, blend tomatoes, pepper, and onions. Heat vegetable oil in a pot, pour in the blended mixture, and fry until it thickens and the oil rises to the top. Add seasoning cubes, salt, and a little chicken stock. Finally, add the fried chicken and allow it to simmer for 10 minutes so the flavors blend well.**





![IMG_1938.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/deborahstitches/23wqpoYBrcCDpJHFa8SX7NCi2gM6NxxDnxNG3eCeoixeTwQ2Q1vbbfMTw1WRDAcs68mco.JPG)







 Egusi Soup with Vegetables
Ingredients: Egusi (melon seeds), palm oil, bitterleaf or spinach, stockfish, dry fish, pepper, onions, seasoning cubes, crayfish



![IMG_1945.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/deborahstitches/23xKzW8jUvKyVVCLftxprMtjTq1MtiaT15hfE5M72EhwKbxxv9q1acCHH1TjbD4WqdFpR.JPG)

![IMG_1940.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/deborahstitches/23uQpMLtbZ5ZNwVm1RY7CpHhnFDkgyYXgyKjDvRRZuwiDXiRB8zGue1Jcz6gLhDgT4j12.JPG)

![IMG_1927.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/deborahstitches/23wCC4QNuYrSNLqt6ic65uEsgvByjX8EM2itHzJYRAjPff1G39GBCTwFfGoGx7VtrySXu.JPG)

![IMG_1946.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/deborahstitches/23tmDLts3idKXwrYjTh5vJySmzVcXvwMzMMhEeYoF387fFyWg4ZCCvjijm1khwJ2Gygdp.JPG)

![IMG_1925.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/deborahstitches/23u5xbEoCYXZc4j3n4LF5iyHZS46pepgzSmqRm3RWo8TDDSVeynjB77HGU8TWGWmywRfv.JPG)


Steps: Blend or grind the egusi seeds. In a pot, heat palm oil and add chopped onions. Mix the egusi with a little water to form a paste, then add into the oil. Fry gently while stirring to avoid burning.
Add blended pepper, crayfish, and seasoning. Pour in some water or stock and allow it to cook. Add washed stockfish and dry fish. Let it simmer until the egusi is well cooked and slightly thick.
Finally, add your vegetables 



![IMG_1933.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/deborahstitches/23uQp4XxvjnxuqXMzhLTHRxHs5SnD5Hz1kdLJ263u5DNSvhm856LkjJU3ivgMSdbXUCu7.JPG)




![IMG_1951.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/deborahstitches/242rsJfWvZmbL1ibEtH9tCJX6ti5T1616V6vVaCB9r5mXyjbHtEK2vtwpcyAe7pGRvo4i.JPG)

![IMG_1952.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/deborahstitches/EoGypJRLD2KxtxVtuAhMmd38sF6wHie7TdXJuSBYnuoNpPqSJAR2hu8aVefYLMkusHo.JPG)


stir, and allow it to cook for about 3–5 minutes. Taste and adjust seasoning if needed.




**Semovita (Swallow)**

Ingredients: Semovita flour, water
Steps: Boil water in a pot. Once it starts boiling, reduce the heat and gradually add semovita while stirring continuously to avoid lumps. Keep stirring until it becomes thick and smooth.
Turn the semovita with a wooden spoon until it is well cooked and stretchy. Add a little hot water if it becomes too thick, then cover for about 2 minutes.





![IMG_1953.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/deborahstitches/EorzJTeT63DcD3t3d8aJrkh8JJDA55PgMBy8AYwnHLiswwjywmU8S7Ut8aydEKUHMbr.JPG)

![IMG_1959.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/deborahstitches/2423uzmsAbag4qZvQaveV3PZZXAp3WiqV7UBuDocGqaJhBgDhWqfcoQicySvsA2cQjS6Y.JPG)





Serving
Serve the hot semovita with egusi soup and a portion of stewed chicken on the side. This meal is rich, nutritious, and perfect for enjoyment.

body.body: Latin Name|Observation date|Location| |------------|------------|------------| |Genus Kallitaxila| April 24, 2026 | Central Aceh Regency,Aceh, Indonesia | ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmSGHZ7oxQezK2kV4xMytrdnbtKorDqDDCSsxEa8fDRsRM/img_20260416_wa0050.jpg) What I photographed is a green leafhopper perched on leaves. Today my sister and I were cleaning the plants in front of the house again, and when I was watering one of the plants, I was suddenly surprised by an extraordinary discovery, namely a green leafhopper. This is not an insect that is easy to find because its shape is small and thin so it can stick behind the leaves, this insect is also green so it makes it easy to camouflage among the leaves around it. When I found this insect, I immediately tried to photograph it, but because its small size made it very difficult for me to photograph it, so I decided to use the help of a macro lens. When I was photographing this insect, suddenly a ladybug came, and I tried to photograph both of them simultaneously. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmR6Q1RnRxNiWNAV2DvqT2GF4YDQo7NiaWSTV3CPgWFJqt/img_20260416_wa0044.jpg) Using a macro lens, I was able to capture a satisfying photograph. From a close distance, we can see the insect's shape and characteristics more clearly. It even has transparent wings. body.title: What I Started Noticing When I Learned to Appreciate Small Things
body.body:
I didn’t always pay attention to appreciation. To me, it was just something you say, like “thank you” and move on. Nothing deep. Life was more about chasing the next thing, the next goal, the next improvement. I didn’t really stop to look at what I already had.

But something changed, slowly.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmak592zjCLPGTYMMSNwoXHABKSwTBKG3gxo91Rj46jpoH/1777031836203.jpg)[source](https://unsplash.com/photos/a-woman-sitting-on-top-of-a-white-couch-zUPOu58K3lA)

There was a time when things were not goingin the  the way I wanted it to be. Trying  but efforts is not giving the results, plans are not working, and I started feeling frustrated. It felt like nothing was enough. That was when my mother said something simple, “You are looking at what is missing, not what is present.”

At first, I didn’t take it serious. It sounded like one of those normal advice. But later, I sat down and really thought about it. I realized I had been ignoring a lot of small good things around me.

So I tried something small. Just noticing things more. Not big achievements, just little things. Waking up okay, having food, having people around me, even small progress in what I’m doing. It felt strange at first, like I was forcing it.

But over time, something shifted.

Then I started feeling a bit more calm. Not like all problems disappeared, no. But the weight felt lighter. Appreciation didn’t solve everything, but it changed how I was seeing things.

My father used to say, “If you don’t value what you have, even more won’t satisfy you.” That made more sense to me now. Because I noticed that when I appreciate small things, I don’t feel as empty or rushed.

Another thing I noticed is how it  affects people around you. When you show genuine appreciation, not fake, people feel it. A simple “I appreciate this” can change someone’s mood. It builds connection in a quiet way.

Of course, I still forget   sometimes. I still complain, still focus on what is not working. I’m not perfect at it. But now I catch myself faster.

The reward of being appreciative is not something loud. It’s not money or something you can touch. It’s more of a feeling. Peace, contentment, and a better way of seeing life.

And honestly, that kind of reward is something I didn’t expect… but I think it matters a lot.

title.title: My Actifit Report Card: April 24 2026
title.body:
![image](https://pixabay.com/get/gc18031ec381d95a15fa4c1c85ae97ca0612f3e4cba464758e6403f04f4e5bb4e75f36425633d3a864d9f0be4f4585477_640.jpg)
Hoy mi caminata fue realmente refrescante. Comencé explorando un parque que suele estar lleno de vida. Mientras paseaba, me encontré con un grupo de jóvenes que estaban organizando un taller de arte al aire libre. Estaban pintando murales y me contaron que es un proyecto comunitario para embellecer la zona y dar voz a artistas locales. Fue inspirador ver cómo se unían para hacer algo positivo. Más adelante, conocí a una señora mayor que estaba alimentando a las palomas. Me contó que venía al parque todos los días desde hacía más de 20 años. Su historia de conexión con el lugar y su amor por la naturaleza me hizo reflexionar sobre la importancia de tener un espacio en el que podamos sentirnos en paz. Además, el clima estaba perfecto, con un cielo despejado y una brisa suave. Pasé por varias tiendas pequeñas y cafés que solían estar cerrados, pero hoy, muchos tenían sus terrazas abiertas y la gente disfrutaba de buena compañía. En general, fue una caminata llena de momentos especiales y encuentros significativos. Sin duda, cada día en la ciudad ofrece algo nuevo. _This report was published via Actifit app ([Android](https://bit.ly/actifit-app) | [iOS](https://bit.ly/actifit-ios)). body.title: Bluebell walk at Priors Wood
body.body:
After the sakura blossom in early spring, the bluebells are the next gift from nature each year.  In UK, we are lucky that [half of the world's bluebells](https://www.nationaltrust.org.uk/discover/nature/trees-plants/a-guide-to-bluebells-in-the-uk) can be found here, and there are many bluebell walks around the country.  

![PXL_20260423_130310543.PORTRAIT~2.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/livinguktaiwan/23w2kgpcphypRkoqBxAtLhmVQrhJA9W8eBN8axuAdvnM5qALMwWL4cRDtgxgzybHoDF6A.jpg)

### Finding my way into the woods
Yesterday I set off on a 3km bluebell walk but ended up walking over 12km because we parked at a different spot, and couldn't find our way in and out of the woods.  Bluebells are found in woods, where they grow best in shades.  The woods I wanted to go is surrounded by private farmland, some give the public right of way, and some don't.  We had to find a way in without trespassing on private land. Some cows were grazing in the first piece of land we entered.  I was quite worried as we had to walk right next to them, I even took off my bright red wind breaker.... just in case!!!  It was only after we got to the edge of the field did I dare to take a photo of them.  I'd love to have done a close shot.

![1000056233.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/livinguktaiwan/244e5nbPRbErCDAdcFzdHDoQd3JBKJa2C6w2bYhkv9zrS7Nk7pqvCYtpxTwmpMGE31n4r.jpg)

<div class=\

> A farmer was prepping his land in the next field. Then we finally saw a sign for public footpath. https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/livinguktaiwan/EnqRCiWmKjX1998oMjAoc2uL6kkLogoTwLY449ak6SEhLdqhBDDG7s8DSEsvBKzj1qf.jpg \n

> https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/livinguktaiwan/23tbiCBSV29vLk4GMi8EtiD9PtYfdNtevWCeHCxBWTsiLSDEWYk1coQCVTACpkxgyb6Yx.jpg --- This was the first sign of the carpet of bluebell. It's always mesmerising to see them each year. But we weren't in the woods yet and still had to find a way in. I think we must have walked for 3 or 4 km on the periphery of the woods, but it wasn't too bad, as the countryside was amazing and it was a beautiful day. ![1000056346.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/livinguktaiwan/EorzMQVkbWoYXeaShQWSahGj53N2168vcMg3u766GdeYUnSbfHyAEDjwNsHxht3jxic.jpg) ### Priors Wood Nature Reserve After walking for over two hours, we finally found the entrance. This little path leads into the Prior's Wood Nature Reserve and the bluebells. At last!!!

>https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/livinguktaiwan/EoprP6pkPazWSMbHtNMuHji26dpqM5Cp4Fu4aedVagB41k7prPa8JsJPtoagNNZyAsk.jpg Someone from Avon Wildlife Trust who manages the area was there promoting their work. This is the first time I've seen them or similar organisation do outreach work like this. It's important that walkers appreciate and value nature when we are out and about. Later on during my walk, I saw some people had walked onto the bluebells damaging them, probably all because they wanted to take that IG photo. It was pretty sad to see it how people disrespect nature.

>https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/livinguktaiwan/Ep5mdE4a8tmSN38E8FbNNBYLjbj9sxUBN1j2pWpmFSw4PAMNuXb5jnz6hP9AkYYzaTs.jpg ![livinguktaiwan divider.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/livinguktaiwan/fuGLEHxS-livinguktaiwan20divider.png) ### Bluebells photo bomb Thanks to Avon Wildlife Trust, the walk is very well maintained, and the path circles around the woods. As I ventured in, I saw more and more bluebells. Initially, it was small patches dotted here and there, then they started to thicken on both sides. There were quite a lot of fallen trees around and instead of clearing them all away, it seems the Trust had placed some strategically to blend in with the environment. Some were placed to stop people from going down the slopes, others as a natural seat for that important photo. And some, well, they're just stunning where they are. Please enjoy the bluebells photo bomb. ![1000056348.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/livinguktaiwan/EoiVCiKs7zNDA8CfAvSkTtEZfeNGvXSPQUoDG58bNzGgFkHWULpcuCv9AruadwEZaVf.jpg) ![1000056269.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/livinguktaiwan/Eo6HYCtCCsuYUsvtsMpYKyxCZkCyoe3cbpFJ3pfdHAPuYfuEvWnxqRFsndGQpfHbRpF.jpg) ![1000056356.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/livinguktaiwan/Ep1VtEuVLuLFz5v8h9p1i9yZ59aKUa1ipfR2ABRPeTwgU1dhYy9Ttm1Qy4MYcXPvtaP.jpg) ![1000056292.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/livinguktaiwan/EorzQ2DyL1xCadWTTCZnjVgds5L8E3DkX6cDvGKasxuWhrQSwF2KXv8kGshPA3JaZcD.jpg) ![1000056357.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/livinguktaiwan/EokdaVkb7PUPWnHpTDTz4AotzWjPo6akZ6SCFqQ25nkt8NxdAUo7NvyW88kMpQGRnvD.jpg) ![1000056358.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/livinguktaiwan/EoiVfFLRksfXf1CmfGqfzuPjCRghSftxK9P4av8xfzNSx3tAtthTkfTjUU9TgF1Mdy4.jpg) ![1000056317.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/livinguktaiwan/EpQuHNvrwfMovoZPrBeiF42qci3ZELEKDnxm9xdaqtrGzdhs5piVejPzHBEEqR6ES9B.jpg) ### Getting out of the woods The sun started to set a little, and as it found its way through the trees, it layered a gentle shimmer of halo onto the already beautiful bluebells. I'd love to wait for the sun to set more, but it was time to find our way out of the woods and back to our car. ![1000056363.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/livinguktaiwan/EoeEPM9szot1G7EuErdcRbw4wYhLZSKsWWwwJZUn1XnhoGf2RseiktbZqG8AeQVGaiC.jpg) Getting back out was a little easier but we still had to walk across some farmlands again. This time, we managed to avoid the cows, but we might have walked through a private field. We only saw the sign at the exit. We did no harm, and the farmer who was ploughing his field on the other side didn't set his dogs on us 😅. Here's the home stretch after our 12km walk. Thank you for a wonderful day Bluebells. ![1000056334.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/livinguktaiwan/EnWGUr3gaBDQj6B5c5k4gnCWwjxnueYhT4ycxfNN2F77gMxNWMGnAd7WzhA3vfD2Wny.jpg) ![livinguktaiwan divider.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/livinguktaiwan/fuGLEHxS-livinguktaiwan20divider.png) ### HPUD Guessing Contest with 200 HP prize I am hosting a little contest to celebrate me breaking 200k HP. It closes in 5 days time on 29 April. If you would like to join in for some fun and a chance to win 200 HP, check out my post below. https://peakd.com/hive-122221/@livinguktaiwan/breaking-200k-hp-and-what-fell-into-the-water ---

body.title: Morning Run: New trails
body.body: > @steevc just finished a 6.09km run, that lasted for 44 minutes. This run helped steevc burn 434.0 calories. --- **Description from Strava:** I will be volunteering at parkrun tomorrow, so I felt I could run today even though it was going to be another easy one. I quite like running around the fields on the other side of the railway, but I had heard that the path I used was going to be closed for a while due to the building work. There is a new alternative so I thought I would check that out. I went down the wrong way to start with, but found it in the end. It was a nice morning for running and I saw another guy running over there. The fields are very open, so it is not great when windy, but today was fine and everything is dry. The fields looked like the crop had finished, whatever it was. There is a bit of farm track where they filled holes with large stones and that is not so nice to run on, but I had no issues. I was checking my heart rate again after adjusting the Garmin settings to match the ranges in Strava. I did better at keeping it in zone 2 nearly all the time. This route crosses our little river twice on small bridges. There were some ducks around. I came back over the other footbridge and down the High Street. I took a small diversion to explore a close I had not been down before, but I only just noticed on Google that it went a little further than I though. I have run along most of the roads in the village at some point, but there will be some more new ones soon. We will have a lot more houses and that may change the place a bit. Although this was an 'easy' run I still felt like I had been working. I have to focus on running slower as that pace is less natural to me. I am not super quicker, but it might be a normal pace for others. There is a 'repair cafe' up the road tomorrow, so I will have a look to see what is happening. I do not have anything that needs fixing, but it can be interesting plus I can get a coffee and cake there. Enjoy your weekend and run free. --- If you would like to check out this activity on strava you can see it here: https://www.strava.com/activities/18235274877 **About the Athlete:** *Older guy trying to keep fit, but still hope to go quicker.*

body.title: What Draft?
body.body:
![](https://images.hive.blog/DQmSaZ1UvNTkzw9UKgE2fTALjkx7kTwm8aRSRP2dH9iHdiw/PXL_20251008_234548794.webp)

---------------------

Probably the biggest news in sports right now is the NFL draft.  If you live in the US I guess.  The rest of the world is probably more concerned about the world cup.  I honestly don't know. I have been in 100% softball mode lately if you haven't noticed.  While I find the draft interesting, it really doesn't have much to do with me.  That is to say, I have zero control over it, and I don't really have an emotional investment in any of the players who declared, so I don't really find myself watching it. 

Yes, I do care about the Detroit Lions, but again, I have no control over who they pick.  I'm more concerned about how they play in December, January, and hopefully February versus who they do or don't pick in April.  I apologize to those of you who get really into the draft.  I mean do disrespect.  I'm sure @hanshotfirst will be doing a post pretty soon about who the Bears did or didn't pick.  I'm excited for him.  I love that he is so passionate about his hometown team.  I get it.  

That isn't to say I won't do a post about the draft, but this weekend while it is happening, it's not at the top of my mind.  I've got my niece playing a double header today in softball, and another game tomorrow before she gets to have a bit of a break and focus on her final exams.

Meanwhile, the MLB season continues to roll along.

Those damn Yankees are at the top of the American League and the AL East with 16 wins.  The closets team(s) behind them are the Cleveland Guardians and the Detroit Tigers in the AL Central each with 14 wins and 12 losses a piece.  Then we have Tampa Bay, Texas, and The Athletics with 13 wins each.  

Kansas City and Boston sit at the bottom of the AL with 8 and 9 wins respectively.  I hope for their fans sake they can turn things around.  Though I don't really mind seeing KC doing so poorly as a Tigers fan. 

In the National League, the Dodgers have fallen out of the top spot and conceded it to the Atlanta Braves.  The Blue Bombers still sit at the top of the NL West with 17 wins, but San Diego is close behind them with also seven wins.

The NL East belongs to Atlanta with 18 wins by a long shot.  The closest team behind them in that division is Miami with only 12 wins. 

Then we have the NL Central with The Cubs and Reds sitting at the top with 16 wins a piece.  Sadly, Philly and The Mets are the two worst teams in the NL East and the whole National League with only 8 and 9 wins respectively.  

Congrats to the Colorado Rockies for not being last!

That tight race in the NL Central should be exciting to watch unfold over the course of the season.  There isn't a big gap between the first team and the last team.  Then you have the other three teams slugging it out in the middle.  It's quite similar to the AL West.  I will definitely be watching both of those conferences closely.

\n​What I experienced today is a perfect case study for anyone looking to navigate the Web3 space safely. Here is a breakdown of the tactics I encountered and the lessons we can all learn to stay protected.\n​The Tactic: The \
Pressure\n​I encountered individuals claiming to have massive reach—some even showing screenshots of huge wallets or trending packages. The pitch is always the same: \

.\n​The Red Flag: A legitimate partner or whale who truly believes in a project will buy from the market to help the chart. They won't ask the Developer to send funds to a private wallet or an unverified bot.\n​The Tactic: The \
influencers who promised a 300k Market Cap in exchange for a free supply of tokens. They claim \
and demand a bag before they even start.\n​The Red Flag: Giving out free supply upfront is a recipe for disaster. If a promoter \

their free tokens at the first sign of a pump, they kill the momentum and hurt the community.
​Educational Corner: How to Stay Vigilant
​In a digital world that’s becoming increasingly sophisticated, vigilance is your best defense. Here are my rules for staying safe:
​Transparency is Key: If a promoter is real, they should be able to provide verifiable links to their previous work and communities. If they make excuses about why they can't show you proof, they are likely hiding something.
​Verify, Don't Trust: Never send funds or tokens to someone based solely on a Telegram chat. Use blockchain explorers to check if their \

wallets actually belong to them or if they are just sending you random screenshots.\n​Performance-Based Rewards: Only reward collaborators after results are visible on the chart. A real partner won't mind proving their value first if they are confident in their influence.\n​Protect Your Liquidity: As a Dev or an investor, your capital is your lifeblood. Guard it fiercely. Authentic growth is organic and takes time; anyone promising \

body.title: HivePostify.Cloud Security: From A to A+ and a Note for the Ecency Team
body.body:
First, I want to thank everyone who has supported HivePostify. This post has been delayed a few days due to a personal loss. A close friend (Nasir Aslam) lost his mother, and it hit me hard. Please keep his family in your prayers.


![1](https://hivepostify.cloud/uploads/posts/8f4dc4dfd16f6831fb227ea41e245a1e.webp)


---

### HivePostify.Cloud is now A+ on Security Headers

Over the last four to five days, I have been working on improving the security of [HivePostify.Cloud](https://hivepostify.cloud). Today, I am happy to announce that our security grade has moved from **A to A+**.

### Old Security

![2](https://hivepostify.cloud/uploads/posts/5f7cfd5240987897a36a47907d29bd07.webp)

### A to A+

![1](https://hivepostify.cloud/uploads/posts/8f4dc4dfd16f6831fb227ea41e245a1e.webp)


You can verify this yourself here:  
🔗 https://securityheaders.com/?q=hivepostify.cloud&followRedirects=on

![1](https://hivepostify.cloud/uploads/posts/8f4dc4dfd16f6831fb227ea41e245a1e.webp)

This is not just a number. It means we have properly implemented:

- `Strict-Transport-Security` with `preload`
- `Content-Security-Policy` with a strict allowlist
- `X-Content-Type-Options`
- `Referrer-Policy`
- `Permissions-Policy`
- `frame-ancestors` in CSP (replacing the old `X-Frame-Options` approach)

We are always improving. Things are never perfect from day one. They get better with time, and we are committed to that.

---

### A respectful note for the @ecency team

I want to be clear: I respect Ecency (@ecency Team) a lot. It is a great platform, one of the most important frontends on the Hive blockchain. It serves many users every day.

However, I have spent several hours over the last week or two doing basic security research on Ecency, and I am genuinely concerned. Even with simple, publicly available tools, I found several security weaknesses that could put users at risk.

A quick check on SecurityHeaders shows Ecency currently scores a **B**:  
🔗 https://securityheaders.com/?q=ecency.com&followRedirects=on


![3](https://hivepostify.cloud/uploads/posts/03550854a9723e9d259eab8819b7c417.webp)


Here are some specific concerns I noticed:

- `Content-Security-Policy` is missing entirely
- `Permissions-Policy` is not set
- `access-control-allow-origin: *` is set globally, which is a very broad CORS policy
- Missing `Cross-Origin-Embedder-Policy`, `Cross-Origin-Opener-Policy`, and `Cross-Origin-Resource-Policy`




![Screenshot 2026-04-24 123739](https://hivepostify.cloud/uploads/posts/dd6ad772fd206a8e4bc84d40df77473f.webp)


I will publish a more detailed report with proper analysis soon, but I wanted to raise this now because Ecency has a very large user base. Any vulnerability there is not just an Ecency problem; it could affect the broader Hive community.

I am not here to criticize. I am saying this because I care about the ecosystem we are all building together. The Ecency team is talented, and I trust they will take action on this.

---

### Final words

Security is never finished. We keep improving, and I hope every team on Hive takes it seriously. If you are running a Hive frontend or service, please check your headers and update them regularly.

Remember me in your prayers.

---

body.title: *El Secreto de la Finca \
: Un aroma que desafía al tiempo**
body.body:
¡Hola a todos en la comunidad!
Hoy quiero invitarlos a viajar conmigo en el tiempo, hacia las faldas de la Sierra Maestra en el oriente de mi Cuba. Quienes vivimos en esta isla sabemos que el café no es solo una bebida; es un ritual, una herencia y, a veces, el escenario de las historias más profundas.
Como escritora, siempre me ha fascinado la huella que dejaron los colonos franceses en nuestras montañas y cómo ese aroma a grano tostado se entrelazó con nuestra propia identidad. Este cuento nace de esa mezcla de historia y leyenda. Es un relato sobre la paciencia, el respeto a la tierra y un amor que, como el buen café, se cultiva a fuego lento y perdura a través de los siglos.
Espero que puedan disfrutar de esta lectura tanto como se disfruta una taza recién colada en una mañana de neblina.

![](Uploading... 1776920178689.jpg)
(Imagen de un cafetal Cubano,  tomado de la red)


EL SECRETO DE LA FINCA \

.

El año era 1890. En las faldas de la Sierra Maestra, el aire se espesaba con el aroma de los cafetales en flor, una alfombra blanca que parecía nieve caída del cielo tropical. Sebastián, el joven heredero de una vasta plantación de origen francés, no era el típico patrón de botas limpias. Le gustaba madrugar tanto como a sus jornaleros, obsesionado con la técnica del beneficio seco, aquel método que los colonos trajeron de Saint-Domingue y que convertía al grano cubano en el más codiciado de Europa.
Entre las hileras de cafetos conoció a Isabel. Ella no solo era la recolectora más rápida; tenía un don. Isabel no arrancaba los granos a puñados; seleccionaba solo las cerezas de un rojo carmesí profundo, el punto exacto de maduración que los expertos llaman \

.
—El café tiene memoria, Don Sebastián —le dijo ella una tarde, sin levantar la vista de su canasta de mimbre—. Si lo trata con prisa, le devolverá amargura. Si lo trata con respeto, le entregará su alma.
Sebastián, cautivado por la sabiduría empírica de la joven, comenzó a buscar excusas para supervisar el sector donde ella trabajaba. Los datos reales de la época dictaban una distancia insalvable entre sus mundos: él era el dueño de los secaderos y las grandes casonas de piedra; ella era la hija de la montaña. Sin embargo, el café fue su puente.
Una noche, bajo la luz de una luna que plateaba las hojas de los arbustos, se encontraron en el glacis, los grandes patios de secado. Allí, mientras removían los granos con rastrillos de madera para que el sol del día siguiente no los quemara desigualmente, Sebastián le confesó su plan: quería crear una mezcla única, un café que no fuera para exportar, sino para sellar una promesa.
—Dicen que el primer cafetal de Cuba nació en el Wajay —susurró él—, pero yo quiero que el último que se recuerde sea el que cultivemos juntos aquí.
El romance floreció entre el estruendo de las despulpadoras y el silencio de los senderos empinados. Se amaron con la paciencia que exige el grano: desde la siembra a la sombra de los árboles de guamá hasta el tostado final en cazuelas de hierro.
Años después, cuando los antiguos cafetales franceses del sudeste de Cuba fueron abandonados por las guerras, quedó una leyenda en la Sierra. Se dice que, en los días de neblina, todavía se siente un aroma dulce y terroso cerca de las ruinas de \

. No es solo el café silvestre que sigue creciendo entre las piedras; es el recuerdo de Isabel y Sebastián, quienes demostraron que, en esta isla, el amor y el café son la misma sustancia: oscura, fuerte y eterna.

Idalidia Zaragoza Avila 
Poeta y escritora cubana. Derechos Reservados de Autor.


Para mis lectores:
El café siempre ha sido el compañero fiel de mis madrugadas de escritura. Me encantaría saber:  ¿Y a ustedes, cómo les gusta su café? , ¿Tienen algún recuerdo especial que les traiga su aroma?.  Los leo en los comentarios.

body.title: Exquisite Sardine Croquettes / Exquisitas Croquetas De Sardina
body.body: > ***English Version*** ### **Exquisite Sardine Croquettes** Hello, friends of the community, today I bring you a new healthy menu. Sardines are a necessary food in our diet; it's preferable to choose them fresh, or if unavailable, we can use canned sardines, which are of very good quality. To prepare them, remove any entrails they may have; we should check that their color is bright and silvery. It's important to check the expiration date. >***Versión en Español*** >### **Exquisitas Croquetas De Sardina** >Hola, amigos de la comunidad, hoy les traigo un nuevo menú saludable. Las sardinas son un alimento necesario en nuestro complemento alimenticio; es preferible escogerlas frescas o, en su defecto, podemos utilizarlas enlatadas, que son de muy buena calidad. Para prepararlas, les retiramos algunas vísceras que puedan traer; debemos notar que su color plateado sea brillante. Importante ver la fecha de vencimiento. ![IMG_20260421_122409.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lanoican/242ruJPNf1QzN2HcFPweR7GAyxxoT6vU4DSM3Emyu3Zmc9ZzxeikuPmtvG2sYZ3pD34v5.jpg) ![IMG_20260421_122720.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lanoican/23zGgfBHecoMmF9KkhDQfRBbh8aGrMPRqAtVgwTNfys5Fgt8fAKH71qcUYoN2i2nvLUQG.jpg) We can prepare and eat them in different ways. For my lunch, I'm going to make them into croquettes; they're quick and easy to make, and I'll use essential seasonings that give them a special aroma. The garnish is also a healthy base. >Las podemos preparar y comer de diferentes maneras. Para mi almuerzo las voy a preparar en croquetas; se hacen de una manera rápida y sencilla, para su sazón voy a utilizar aliños fundamentales que le dan un aroma especial y la guarnición, es una base también sana. ![IMG_20260421_114807.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lanoican/Eonk3K5zV53HT6nT1WHbNPTqpbwpxMozAwJMw5JSvEwcJqbbsYsaQbjXJH9tXr5zurq.jpg) Here's my recipe; I'm offering delicious protein that cooks quickly. A menu for two. >Les dejo mi preparación; les ofrezco proteínas deliciosas que se cocinan en poco tiempo. Un menú para dos comensales. --- #### **Ingredients:** - 2 cans of sardines - 1 egg - 1 small bell pepper - 1/2 onion - 3 scallions (selected) - 3 sweet peppers - 1 packet of seasoning - Oil as needed - 3 tablespoons of all-purpose flour - Pinch of salt --- > #### **Ingredientes:** >- 2 latas de sardinas >- 1 huevo >- 1 pimentón pequeño >- ½ cebolla >- 3 tallos de cebollín ya seleccionadas >- 3 ají dulce >- 1 bolsita de condimento >- Aceite lo necesario >- 3 cucharadas de harina de trigo >- Pizca de sal ![IMG_20260421_113058.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lanoican/23xKvZg8YnnhN8JBHbFJaqv1Lp87Evc46egKmnKB5bVjJ2RZ5jBawzFRRac1gW3JP3Cds.jpg) --- **Preparation:** Open the cans of sardines and pour them into a baking dish. I'm using the ones packed in water this time; however, you can also use the ones packed in oil. (When I open the can, I discard all the liquid and rinse them.) >**Preparación:** >Destapamos las latas de sardina y las vertemos en un molde. En esta oportunidad yo estoy utilizando las naturales; sin embargo, pueden también utilizar las de aceite. (Cuando abro la lata, desecho todo el líquido y las enjuago). We cut the sardines in half and remove any remaining entrails and the small skeleton. We flake them slightly and set them aside. >Abrimos las sardinas por la mitad y les sacamos restos de vísceras y el pequeño esqueleto. Las desmenuzamos un poco y reservamos. ![IMG_20260421_114204_HDR.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lanoican/23xKvVrDXej6yUzevu747LFmuTmgYCzjduEZQweKjmkNDgJ1A7o9CBLU8AJwutXYnhivo.jpg) ![IMG_20260421_114342.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lanoican/EoptuuA8L44eBwuPe1v3WF1hjzFrs9HhEw55L7aEabS5KjPxfPUkgepAonZ32jpko83.jpg) ![IMG_20260421_114539_HDR.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lanoican/23xKxxUgyuKYcbJv1tqYShToCquAdfEeN5LsCd5ePrdfL1BRap8xRGus1gN9gPqqdPxyN.jpg) Chop the bell pepper, onion, chili pepper, and scallions, using the necessary amount. >Picamos el pimentón, la cebolla, el ají y cebollín, utilizamos la cantidad necesaria. ![IMG_20260421_113723_HDR.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lanoican/23xVPJiZqiF1UFuW8GPeSQYBXPFTnP9uDKMTZvCvmD47ZNqQbsKR2uncagXxMVQppQFRe.jpg) ![IMG_20260421_113741.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lanoican/EpNm3V2TbmBqTVLkphCidH8dWDqyeaNrMfoGZ8Gejrvb6oPx3HpkzQsswByvyJ5NSTc.jpg) ![IMG_20260421_113920_HDR.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lanoican/23xKxKTP5BL332SbCYPatpYb11tiKXAc6PA9DqbLKNUSc8XqmWHazBx95LRTQhRXs4Fbs.jpg) ![IMG_20260421_113930.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lanoican/EpNmsra1rB5MJ1MmAct69fcVoe1uz2z7xuau3KW3r2ZM4L2v53kJ8Yj5QcDEk8qSyyR.jpg) ![IMG_20260421_113510_HDR.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lanoican/23xp8vHcrUCMT5dovygzj8jcA6Z7e6AqSyPmSpvGhK36bgAm74rBtvW1XtKWYtXp8aVoE.jpg) ![IMG_20260421_113553.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lanoican/EogG7iDv3P79hJHv2g4sxJuZfgi3RuFqtZeBfGunUXp4WrurPLW1nK1uRe6V4wK2J1D.jpg) ![IMG_20260421_114030_HDR.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lanoican/23xAZuRZoykdxJZneLhVxJJ8gPnWnE7SCYSWSufYzr8e6yrWJcqxnYd58FkDz5jyb7KB9.jpg) ![IMG_20260421_114114.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lanoican/EogG4yNXpDBKaRCc3TyF697P4J9eJVEfaB8mxHyJxSqmQ5sjJPCEy1vwm9zsGq5RWwg.jpg) Once chopped, add it to the sardine. Then add the egg, salt, flour, a little oil, and the seasoning. Mix well to combine the flavors. >Una vez picado, lo agregamos a la sardina. Vamos añadiendo el huevo, la sal, la harina, un poquito de aceite y el condimento. Luego mezclamos para que se unan los sabores. ![IMG_20260421_114807.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lanoican/Eonk3K5zV53HT6nT1WHbNPTqpbwpxMozAwJMw5JSvEwcJqbbsYsaQbjXJH9tXr5zurq.jpg) ![IMG_20260421_114945_HDR.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lanoican/23y8vEyVhvT2gSikoJmWRBVGE3N7hp9K9xKEndFvfCUKV8bBQ5jhPYuAdfkJKFRo19XNw.jpg) ![IMG_20260421_114910_HDR.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lanoican/23y8wp6ptPpcyZc7pvsfqSgfLEzG9yDfJ8GSQZNrFAgVBCfC7tn8xd2igmshfsT6KaoHs.jpg) ![IMG_20260421_114857_HDR.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lanoican/23xek3sKm6WNpc8QWWHKJ5MU7k9FLiYCifWn2BhF8bdmV2HMnTNsfoXvsHHgqRTw87Pp9.jpg) ![IMG_20260421_115020_HDR.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lanoican/23xVPJiZs4zUtgcGwhwj82Ga217JhHL1VEAsorFu1G3xGaj8MduBGfgTjYpMNx9oyEdFm.jpg) ![IMG_20260421_114832_HDR.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lanoican/23xVPAcWrnHBcJ95TKg91PxsoPHmUaySR7tjAzTiU7kCzDMnp2D6oLSY4inUGWfCnyJsE.jpg) ![IMG_20260421_114848_HDR.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lanoican/23xyZHpxVABi8CstadKURES31Bs9bknHq35wuFz11J4rznjGXdx7vETqBo5yxzw9FgRSo.jpg) ![IMG_20260421_115108.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lanoican/EpLg3RSauYCbzhaBKGVNanxJNtcgDEyCsCUobdfRuMzsf2KhhPpx3B8wr8WUsGkk9a1.jpg) Finally, we proceed to make our croquettes. We pour oil into a pan, and when it's very hot, we fry our croquettes. When we take them out, we place them on paper towels to absorb the excess oil. >Finalmente procedemos hacer nuestras croquetas. Vertemos aceite en un caldero, y cuando este bien caliente freímos nuestras croquetas. body.title: 和朋友去吃凉皮
body.body:
上午在家看股票正闹心着，朋友夫妇喊我们一起去逛街吃午饭，那就出去赚赚吧。

![20260424_115617.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmUzWYwpFo9HuN5rPTo34YTmvh5K4yi9mQTwZiK5d1qwk6/20260424_115617.jpg)

我们约定在星摩尔聚集。我也特别喜欢星摩尔，不但好吃的宝藏店铺特别多，停车还不收费（三小时免费）。

今天的虽然依旧风很大，但是气温够高（23摄氏度），虽然我只穿了半袖，但风吹在身上一点也不冷，反而有种很舒服的感觉。

想起了小时候经常哼唱的一首歌：
>春风它吻上了我的脸
告诉我现在是春天
虽说是春眠不觉晓
只有那偷懒人儿才高眠

哎，已经搞不清现在到底算是春天还是夏天了呢，不过搞不搞清楚也没那么重要，不是吗？

说起这首我们小时候哼唱的歌曲，我查了一下，百度百科介绍如下：
>《春风吻上我的脸》是由狄薏作词、姚敏谱曲、姚莉演唱的华语歌曲，作为1958年电影《那个不多情》的插曲。

竟然是快70年前的歌曲，上个世纪的事情啦。好吧，我们听的和哼唱的应该是韩宝仪专辑《酒馆小唱2》收入的版本，也很久远就是啦。


在约定时间准时到达星摩尔，还是选择将车停在地上停车场，敞亮

每次来星摩尔都会想起好久没有去逛宜家啦

遇到一群可爱的小豆包，看起来应该幼儿园的小朋友，小小的真可爱

朋友夫妇把车停在地下停车场，我们到达时已经在大厅等我们啦
![20260424_114107.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmSdtTmCTGtJ7UbWyaWbzcpfikS1YU74tkoSxoEnS4cori/20260424_114107.jpg)

朋友强烈推荐一家叫西安里的餐厅，说他家的凉皮特别好吃

那就去看看喽，果然都是西安美食

吃完和朋友一起逛街

body.title: Shadows From The Farm. Shadows Hunters Contest Round 422
body.body:
Life is all about seasons. I have come to realize that and I am fully adopting that in my life. The ability to understand what season of life a person is at a particular time will help such a person in making the right decisions. Some people live their lives carelessly without thinking about what could possibly be the results of what they are doing now or what they did not do right. There is a need to be sensitive to issues like this. Well I am here again with my entry for the #shadowhunters SMASh contest round 422. It is my pleasurable fun to always participate in the contest. 

I was talking about life and its seasons. We are in the raining season now in my locality. The rain just began this month of April. So everyone who loves doing that has found themselves busy in one aspect of our community life. That aspect is farming. The return of the rains indicates the onset of farming season. These days we find ourselves in just one place everyday. Though we might have school works to do, we have to adjust our schedule because we are under obligation to assist our parents in growing the crops which we ourselves will eat. So this is my shadows from the farm.

body.title: Taking Over a Bridge.
body.body: > I navigated toward a mysterious light source, taking down several demons with stealth and talismans. After a rooftop battle with a Student of Misery and a successful archery session to clear a bridge, I received an urgent call from Rinko about Hannya. Finally, a vision of Erika appeared and pointed us toward a new building. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYEB5Fh7Au2sZrTrmFPFLYZhii3E34NFvyYg2zzS6xuq4/screenshot_1_.png) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmcvt4wzscEzfdFRBvPcwK7PjUWhwG7LK2YKH3bzSbAS8W/screenshot_2_.png) I started navigating around the dark alleys and decided to get to the source of the light first to see what was happening. On my way, I took down another rugged walker who was guarding a trapped spirit in the corner of a courtyard. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmRB9fiehScQX15ZkpibVbtdxQrfqWoGWyEcy2JERYcrd2/screenshot_3_.png) Then I found a rugged walker and a rain slasher guarding a street so close by that it seemed impossible to take them both down in stealth. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmTRgT1BXAdYszcaYssQcwLSH1wddjnmzZZPDsihD1AavA/screenshot_4_.png) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmWMs85fy2fCG7RFPALjerFBkakKqw31j69nVA9vME6QhK/screenshot_5_.png) I took down the rain slasher in stealth and the rugged walker didn't even notice me taking down his pal right behind him. I took this chance and took him down in stealth as well, ending the threat before an alarm could be raised. Akito tried a talisman during the encounter, though I don't know why he chose that moment to test his charms on a sure shot. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmNZAZw1e4M2wKCgHuM8xbvij12hAFpkKb9uDtCF1mMiUB/screenshot_6_.png) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZyRXrrWfMNkRRPjDe1Mgakk4rX31brPohsxWCMAoaZsS/screenshot_7_.png) I climbed on top of a roof from where I noticed some demons who were guarding a bridge in the distance. I tried to attack them from afar using my elemental powers, but the distance was too great and my shots failed to land with enough force to do any real damage. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmUNWAydBzqRZxnyDSDhXc44TzRskRCMBGCYfD7aMobyzJ/screenshot_8_.png) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmTXTv3m8cY8VnGBXn5M1aove8GL25XLUvRLtyctE1bpFq/screenshot_9_.png) Instead of being weakened, all the demons from the bridge saw me and started attacking me. One of the students of Misery jumped on the roof I was in, her movements fast and unnatural as she closed the distance. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmNcSyijWdcQdryPx6HEY2xfA16NmuBnFAJjmt3D35x7Up/screenshot_10_.png) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmVp9YKK99s42kz9FuFQLNnwcTqCWBg89rJQUYG4BkEFQ1/screenshot_11_.png) I switched to another roof where the student of Misery followed me with relentless aggression. I took her down easily once we were separated from the pack, as the other demons couldn't see me or help her from their position on the bridge. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmd2qsxAYj27xHttn8JJgGnD5H8EJ47VpAMjVS95Hf6q7d/screenshot_12_.png) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmWNLoLYKN1eXXEcZ3wt4hHCU8beRKyt7DT3h1cxVW3Lgi/screenshot_13_.png) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZHfWko5JniwdgGMHR36VUzYShrux5MAUzw3xBgYF39xu/screenshot_14_.png) Then I used my bow and arrows to take down the rest of the demons on the bridge. The arrows flew true, hitting their marks one by one until the path was finally clear. I just remembered my gear and asked myself why I was not using this fine equipment all this time when it was so effective. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmRApPPG1PrsCNTaS3DSBaT99bX8R8psjdgLsjjoSmNNgR/screenshot_15_.png) I jumped down on the bridge and I stopped there for a moment to check around the area. The silence was eerie after the sounds of the battle had faded away. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQma7LYe9PzqtG5Jj5R94Pi6FR8vxdMaSmsC6HdPFvPqyLq/screenshot_16_.png) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmNkB28pfW5knuNHHQShbZqGv9cmTChEvKdtLGZvVUJx3W/screenshot_17_.png) I was getting close to the source of the light and suddenly I heard a telephone ringing loudly in the distance. I went for it, following the sound to a glowing blue telephone booth standing alone on the sidewalk. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmXggY7CCPjj1Wgs9T1qj3nHq76x7rNNTX4C7NCJofgsZB/screenshot_18_.png) It was Rinko who called me to ask what was taking me so long to reach the objective. She mentioned that Hannya was going to get exactly what he wanted if I didn't hurry up and finish the task. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZ2GwWyMwi4o8hKwQ1QQNFTdidoATVS6gW2Krpnmwexr9/screenshot_19_.png) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYbQubHTg998GeDPwJSSoxzZ2AqvceQnL7oBd3zEssp7J/screenshot_20_.png) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYYY9R7j955CcbfaKgZH4854TKHfwGdnbAonWjGu3jN4R/screenshot_21_.png) After the call ended, we saw something that looked like Erika. She didn't speak, but she pointed towards a large building nearby and was clearly trying to tell us something important. Her ghostly figure flickered before she vanished, leaving us with a new direction to follow. We'll continue in another post. --- **Thanks for reading. If you like my post, please follow, comment and upvote me. All the in-game screenshots are taken by me, just the games logo is borrowed from deviantart.** --- ▶️ [3Speak](https://3speak.tv/watch?v=hrichakar/189bf24c)

body.title: Splinterlands: Unlocked Gold 3 along with 11 loot chests! 🔥
body.body:
>Just yesterday, I unlocked Tier 1 of the Silver League—even though, strictly speaking, I haven't yet played a total of 100 battles—but today, having reached another milestone, I have successfully unlocked the Gold League. And since there are still perhaps six days remaining until the season concludes, there is a possibility that I might break my previous ranking record this time around and set a new personal best. Furthermore, with every ascent to a higher league tier, I get to enjoy the exclusive welcome rewards associated with that new level. However, since these rewards are distributed in the form of chests, you never know exactly what you are going to find inside them. Nevertheless, as you advance to higher tiers, the quality of the chests improves; consequently, the likelihood of receiving better rewards also increases. Late last night, I reached Tier 3 of the Gold League—which has historically been my highest achievement across the last three seasons, and where I typically end the season—but this time around, given that there are still more than five days left until the season concludes, I will once again give it my absolute best shot to unlock the Gold 2 tier as well.

\n\n

>Upon reaching the Gold Tier, the number of my Welcome Loot Chests also increases—now totalling 7 Minor Chests and 4 Major Chests. However, despite this, I have yet to receive a single Legendary or Gold Foil card from these chests; nevertheless, whenever I open them, I invariably make use of Legendary and Alchemy potions. This time, however, I had no Legendary potions left, so for this particular loot opening, I utilized only the Alchemy potions. Using these potions doubles the probability of obtaining better cards, raising the chance from 1% to 2%. Even so, it remains a game of luck, as a 2% probability is still quite low; yet, there is no harm in trying. Therefore, make sure that you, too, utilize potions whenever you open these loot chests.

\n\n

>And as always, this time too I didn't receive any Gold cards; however, I did receive a common Thornmaw Berserker melee Attack card—of which I already possess multiple copies. In fact, I even have this card upgraded to Level 2, and I occasionally use it in my battles. At Level 2, in addition to boosted stats, it gains the Final Rest ability, which allows it to block any Rebirth, Resurrect, Resurgence, or Soul Siphon ability of an opponent's card once per battle. Furthermore, since its Health and Speed ​​stats are excellent, it serves as a strong asset to the team in both defensive and offensive capacities; however, despite being a melee card, it lacks special abilities such as Sneak, Opportunity, or Charge, meaning you cannot position it just anywhere you please. Aside from this card, I also received a total of 2 Entry Tickets, 4 Energy, approximately 900 Merits, as well as one Legendary and one Alchemy Potion. And with this, the journey toward unlocking the higher tiers of the Gold League begins; I am hopeful that this time around, I will succeed in unlocking the higher tiers of the Gold League before the current season ends. 😎

* * *

>Splinterlands isn't an easy place, but that's what makes it even more fun. A perfect strategy takes into account many factors, including stats, abilities, rulesets, mana caps, and more. That's why it's even more important to consider all these factors when developing a strategy. Add good cards to your deck, but also work on improving your strategies, and strive to win as many battles as possible!🔥\n\n

body.title: The Receipt the World Refuses to Throw Away
body.body:
I know a family friend that we grew up together back then. He once said something during one of these family holidays together that made everyone look at him in a very terrible way. Some didn't talk with him throughout the holiday, but I did anyway. He was a bit older than I am, and he was also this loud guy and wrong about almost everything he believed in then. I have never seen someone as bold as he was back then because he said everything with a full chest and probably no awareness because some of his words were so heavy with weight. Today, he is now a man and married, and it looks like a brand new person because he's now the most careful person I have seen, so quiet. I didn't ask him, though, but I believed that he had seen a lot of things about life and something in him had shifted. But assuming someone was able to record what he did back then and that person posted it on the internet, I believe many people won't really care about who he is now but rather what he said back then. And that is one of the problems we now have today because hardly will you see anyone that truly wants to sit with honesty. We as individuals now live in a time when growth is talked about in motivational talks, preched to us on Sundays. But at that very moment someone changes his pattern by growing and moving away from that which they once believed in, people will go as far back to find any little faults or mistakes from their past. They will demand a full payment by bringing out different receipts. And to me, this is a very deep contradiction that barely makes any sense until you get to know that accountability has quietly become a show of performance. And this performance definitely is in need of a villain so it can play out well. ![213739.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/goldenproject/213739.png) The brutal truth is that if we take a deep dive into the lives of some of these people that said some bad and terrible things way back, it is a reflection of where they grew up, what they saw, and what they were taught, which was normalized. But this is not an excuse anyway. I was just explaining it. And I must say, we have a very big difference between giving an excuse for an action and explaining what someone deliberately does. Some of these very harmful beliefs I grew up hearing from friends in school, neighbors, schoolteachers, and family members. I wanted to believe that those things were the right thing back then. But thank God for good parenting and some real-life experience that corrected my mind slowly. I have seen some old tweets of celebrities that came up trending, and what I will always keep asking myself is this, what are we actually doing if we continue to cancel everyone who once held a wrong belief? Will people stop if the punishment from what they once believed is severe? Will there still be honesty? And is this truly fair or growth? And rather than adjusting, people will just continue to conceal what they really believe in just to avoid the aftermath and it will continue to keep bad beliefs, problems, hypocrisy from plain sight instead of being fixed. ----- ##### 🔗 Apps which I recommend built by sagarkothari88 | | | | |---|---|---| | body.title: We may drift, but we won't disappear
body.body:
>


![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/rufajane/23xAc4Ju2nXWrpyeAQ3a8fNWdATVzgANerLRvkNS8idAvKebEekZZnX6Gx55eCTdKXsTj.png)

Now that I’ve written a blog dedicated to my family, this one is for you, my friends.

Dear friends,

I hope this message finds you well.

<div class=\

>https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/rufajane/23vi62EhK6KEoVNpeTjBo5Wfj4UJ1obUJUuiT3HkzGwteKSB4fPhWAmX42QCeidcftLpg.png It still amazes me how we’ve only been together for a year or two, yet what we’ve built feels like something much deeper, like a friendship that has lived far longer than time allows. Somehow, in such a short span, you became people I can’t imagine this chapter of my life without.

>https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/rufajane/23wMeXZbHuvMUw1TzWkTrArFDSjjuASPA8j1qiaqG5SuQkwm61d6fwmfMbuVYQeGBDmMB.jpg Thank you for being part of my most cherished memories. I know life will soon take us in different directions. We’ll chase different dreams, meet new people, and build new circles. And while that’s a beautiful part of growing up, there’s a part of me that holds on to what we have now because I know it’s something rare.

>https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/rufajane/EoptuFCP8ApFgwdbBziF52JFoau4sVMfEUf8vqufh1TuNGuqiduxiMCNK6KyzZUNtXu.png I may not always be beside you in the future, but please know this: I will never forget you. I wish all of you success not just in your careers, but in life, in happiness, and in becoming the people you dream of becoming. And I hope that one day, when time is kinder and our paths cross again, we’ll meet not as strangers, but as fulfilled versions of ourselves, proud of how far we’ve come. Please don’t forget me, the same way I could never forget you. You will always have a space in my heart. ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/rufajane/EoyQV2FavUdbmeefVrqyiwGX71LX3scJ9Lz4Jnuw8JnPrW68krdvX3rDdbbVGrayPzp.png) Thank you for teaching me what genuine friendship looks like. There was a time when I struggled to choose the right people... when I was surrounded by friendships that took more than they gave. But you changed that. You helped me grow. You showed me loyalty, sincerity, and the kind of connection that doesn’t need to compete or pretend.

>https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/rufajane/EogPGPXSN3VZR868rYP77M1AgR6gWirXCrMMQK92TmbZwQivXuXu252aqS9zJB5mkPC.png Because of you, I see friendships differently now with more light, more hope, and more understanding. In a few months, college life will begin. You’ll meet new faces, build new bonds, and create new memories. I truly hope the people you meet will treat you with the same care and loyalty that you’ve shown me because that kind of friendship is rare, and you all deserve nothing less. And even if our messages get buried under new conversations, I hope that sometimes, you’ll scroll back, read our old chats, and smile at the memories we once shared.

>https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/rufajane/23tvptzxT6vg69vnkYzvyisHAtwkXrKDoVsu4MH9bTzFkBTGSQo6ms94qVijtyzmmA1ZH.png --- I trust you. I appreciate you. And I carry our friendship with me wherever life takes me. Thank you for everything. Until we meet again. ![Gray and White Simple Fashion Sale Facebook Fundraiser Cover Photo.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/rufajane/EnYUGipUouu6yKzkTmc7tRdjcLxqjsxjsxkJXxLHFVemDL3w5NnmW83nAY3mnnAEXgm.gif)
