body.title: Il treno dei bambini [ESP/ENG]
body.body:
![Yellow Black Vintage Movie Presentation.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mairene1/23wqke1AKyMhRe7mP4XKKhgmTeUYbahXtKnvXfvCUrRHoDS5rjbBYeVER69TVmbsT6dKQ.jpg)
[Fuente](https://www.vogue.mx/articulo/el-tren-de-los-ninos-netflix)

Today I want to talk to you about a movie I recently saw that shook my heart, and contrary to what many might think upon reading the title \

or seeing the images, it is not a movie about war, it is more post-war but with all the sacrifices and difficulties that this represents.\n\n>Hoy quiero hablarles de una película que vi recientemente y que me sacudió el corazón, y contrario a lo que muchos pudieran pensar al al leer el titulo \

o ver las imágenes, no es una película sobre la guerra, es más bien post guerra pero con todos los sacrificios y dificultades que eso representa.

Overview/Resumen

Italy was mired in extreme poverty, disease, and suffering after World War II, but the Communist Party offered some helpful solutions, such as transporting mothers' children north by train. There, they would be taken in by foster families who would offer them a better quality of life temporarily. In this way, Amerigo was separated from his mother and arrived with Derna, a communist woman who welcomed him. There, he experienced abundance in every sense: affection, food, education, and entertainment. But when he returned south to his mother, he seemed unable to readjust, and this created conflict between mother and son.

>Italia está sumida en la pobreza extrema, la enfermedad y el dolor tras la segunda guerra mundial, pero el partido comunista presta algunas soluciones útiles como ofrecer ayuda a las madres trasladando sus hijos hacia el norte en un tren, allá los recibirían familias sustitutas para ofrecerles una mejor calidad de vida temporalmente, de esta manera Amerigo se separa de su madre y llega junto a Derna, una mujer comunista que lo recibe, allí él experimenta la abundancia en todos los sentidos: afecto, alimentos, educación, diversión, pero cuando retorna al sur con su madre parece que no puede adaptarse de nuevo y esto crea conflictos entre madre e hijo

Trailer

https://youtu.be/h_Zo5ayxSd0
[Fuente](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=h_Zo5ayxSd0)

My Opinion/Mi Opinión

Amerigo's mother is a complex character. She appears to be a tough woman, with a strong, stony character hardened by war. At times, she treats her son with reserve, but her love for him is undeniable. In some scenes, we see her sacrifices, such as giving him her food rations and maintaining an extramarital affair with a wealthy man who supports her financially. At other times, we see her lovingly tending to him, like when she warms his feet in the summer, and even when she separates from him by sending him north so he can have a better life. However, we later see a selfish attitude in her when she denies him the possibility of communicating with the family that took him in up north. This may seem questionable, yes, but we must consider that she is a woman who doesn't know how to manage her emotions. She has always been prepared to fight against hostility; she is defensive, and that's why she sees this family up north as a threat to the stability of her relationship with her son. >La madre de Amerigo es un personaje complejo, aparentemente es una mujer dura, con carácter fuerte y pétreo curtido por la guerra, a veces trata a su hijo con parquedad pero es innegable el amor que siente por él, en algunas escenas vemos parte de sus sacrificios como cederle su ración de comida y el hecho de mantener una relación extra marital con un hombre rico que la ayuda económicamente, en otras ocasiones la vemos dedicarse a él con amor, como cuando le calienta los pies en verano y hasta el hecho mismo de separarse de él al enviarlo al norte para que él tenga una mejor calidad de vida, no obstante luego vemos en ella una actitud egoísta al negarle a él la posibilidad de comunicarse con la familia que lo recibió en el norte, lo cuál nos puede parecer cuestionable, sí, pero hay que tomar en cuenta que ella es una mujer que no sabe lidiar con sus emociones, siempre estuvo dispuesta a lidiar contra la hostilidad, está a la defensiva y por eso ve en esa familia del norte, una amenaza para la estabilidad de la relación con su hijo.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mairene1/23tGdwVYchJHuP4hqSHLoQDjL21QqgdtEixT8DmV4k2sbK1Sbe8CQ4xMPh3j5CsbU3yPN.png)
[Fuente](https://www.vogue.mx/articulo/el-tren-de-los-ninos-netflix)

But we mustn't forget something crucial: this film portrays the true meaning of unconditional love. Antonietta is ultimately willing to separate from Amerigo completely to see him happy, prosperous, and fulfilled. To love means granting freedom of choice, and she understood this. That's why I can't judge her; on the contrary, I consider her a brave woman who had to fight alone during the war. There are even images showing her in the past trying to protect Amerigo from the bombings. Raising a child alone under those conditions is quite a challenge, as the child's father was in the Americas and nothing more was ever heard of him.

>Pero no hay que olvidar algo importantísimo, y es que esta película retrata lo que significa el verdadero amor incondicional, pues Antonietta está dispuesta finalmente hasta separarse definitivamente de Amerigo con tal de verlo feliz, próspero y realizado, amar significa conceder libertad de decisión y ella lo comprendió, por eso no puedo juzgarla, al contrario, la considero una mujer valiente que tuvo que luchar sola durante la guerra, incluso hay imágenes que la muestran en el pasado tratando de proteger a Amerigo de los bombardeos, criar a un hijo en esas condiciones estando sola es todo un reto, pues el padre del niño se encontraba en el continente americano y nunca se supo nada más de él.
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mairene1/23tbicF96StumYy6jDanGTczPPBXkAfU7zDAy9V4eeJBF9HYCK8wwWT8mXvC4UYR5Vboc.png)
[Fuente](https://cineymusica.com/el-tren-de-los-ninos-critica/)

The film has many nuances; it's not just about sacrifices and making you cry with emotion. It also has humorous scenes, like when Amerigo and his friend dyed a rat white to sell it as if it were a ferret or something. This shows that post-war children grew up tough and their cunning was sharpened by necessity, but the truth is that I laughed a lot at some scenes like that one.

>La película tiene muchos matices, no solo se trata de sacrificios y que llores conmovido, también tiene escenas de humor, como cuando Amerigo y su amigo tiñeron de blanco una rata para venderla como si fuese un hurón o algo así, esto demuestra que los niños post guerra crecieron curtidos y su astucia se agudizó motivada por la necesidad, pero la verdad es que me reí mucho con algunas escenas como essa.
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mairene1/23xerZCbuJgfBjzRBHMmEChaxzCJzLdGGvcBB9m2mNG6Aq9KdUV1J9Sqi2f6ZVqxKq3qE.png)
[Fuente](https://www.c5n.com/ratingcero/de-que-se-trata-el-tren-los-ninos-la-pelicula-que-esta-emocionando-todos-netflix-n183380)

And well, with nothing more to add for now, I'll say goodbye, but not before inviting you to enjoy this wonderful Italian film if you have the chance; it's available on Netflix.

>Y bueno, ya sin más que agregar por ahora me despido no sin antes invitarlos a disfrutar de esta maravillosa película italiana si tienen la oportunidad, está disponible en Netflix.
![Presentación Propuesta de Proyecto Portfolio Scrapbook Marrón y Negro.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mairene1/23wqwC8G3pmfAmUg1E61Zg3gUWbUypQbajqdteMGTFid9mWcYbLuHqe1kY7FxJ8zAiMM5.jpg)

body.title: Favorite childhood story (ESP/ENG)
body.body:
![Presentación Diapositivas Proyecto de Historia Vintage Scrapbook Marrón (1).jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/victor2356/23uFptqHsW6S32gageGjc1rBXLXXLLwwDCTzwxSpCk2MEWC1WNweEieD6wFsHvDSt1vBj.jpg)

This week's suggestion is very interesting: sharing stories from our childhood. My mother was always so busy that she almost never had time to tell us stories. However, I remember my grandmother telling me a particular story that I really liked. It was called: Onza, Tigre, and León. I don't remember exactly what it was about, but I know it was based in some way on the story of Hansel and Gretel, where the children are abandoned by their parents, but in this case, there were three. They were captured by a witch and weren't lucky enough to escape, but they became three guardian dogs: Onza, Tigre, and León. When someone needed their help, they only had to recite, \

and they would immediately come to their aid.\n\n>La propuesta de esta semana es muy interesante, contar historias de nuestra niñez... Realmente mi madre siempre estaba tan ocupada que casi nunca tenía tiempo para contarnos historias, sin embargo recuerdo bien a mi abuela contándome una historia en particular que me gustaba mucho, se llamaba: Onza, Tigre y León. No recuerdo bien de que iba esta historia pero sé que estaba basada de cierta forma en el cuento de Hansel y Gretel donde los niñosson abandonados por sus padres, pero en este caso eran tres. Ellos eran capturados por una bruja y no tuvieron la suerte de escapar pero se convirtieron en tres perros guardianes: Onza, Tigre y León y cuando alguien necesitaba su ayuda solo tenía que recitar; \

e inmediatamente lo ayudaban.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/victor2356/23xVPkhyskvZfRgV1gzYyabMttqa63nsC6qHoh8wUe5jNrxcPbhuatmEZUEn9vvkq5j5b.png)
[Fuente](https://pixabay.com/es/photos/la-familia-la-abuela-abuela-familia-4989137/)

However, I didn't always hear pleasant stories about talking heroes and animals. Across the street from my house lived a woman named Petra Paulina who loved to tell scary stories about ghosts and supernatural things, and to top it all off, she said that a woman appeared dancing in our yard after midnight. I won't deny it, I loved listening to ghost stories, but when that woman said they appeared in my own house, it stopped being fun.

>No obstante no siempre escuché historias bonitas sobre héroes y anmales que hablaban. Frente a mi casa vivía una señora que se llamaba Petra Paulina a la que le encantaba contar historias de miedo sobre fantasmas y cosas sobrenaturales, y para colmo decía que en el patio de nuestra casa se aparecía una mujer bailando después de la media noche. No se los voy a negar, yo amaba escuchar las hstorias de ffantasmas pero cuando esa señora decía que se aparecían en mi propia casa dejaba de ser divertido.

The thing is, this led to a funny anecdote. I was sleeping with one of my brothers in a room that opened directly onto the patio, and one night he woke up needing to urinate. The bathroom was in the patio, so he woke me up to go with him, but I was very sleepy and said no. Resigned, he went to urinate, but instead of going to the bathroom, he did it there among the trees in the patio. To encourage himself and try to overcome his fear, he whistled while swinging a clothesline with his other hand. Suddenly, he saw her... a woman dancing, waving her arms. My brother rushed back to our room, sweaty and pale despite the cold night air. When he told me what had happened, I was terrified. We even covered ourselves up to our heads with the sheets, unable to sleep until dawn. But when the sun finally came out, we both realized what had really happened. The supposed ghost was nothing more than my mom's long-sleeved dress hanging on the line, and when my brother shook the line, it started to move.

>El caso es que a raiz de esto surgió una anecdota graciosa, y es que yo dormia con uno de mis hermanos en una habitación que daba justo al patio, y una noche él despertó con ganas de orinar pero el baño estaba en el patio, así que me despertó para que yo lo acompañara pero yo tenía mucho sueño y le dije que no, de modo que él, resignado se fue a orinar pero no fue al baño sino que lo hizo allí entre los árboles del patio, para darse animos y tratar de deshacerse del miedo silvaba mientras con la otra mano tambolileaba una cuerda de ropa, y de pronto la vio... una mujer bailando, agitando los brazos, así que mi hermano salio disparado a nuestra habitación, estaba sudoroso y pálido a pesar del frío de la noche, y cuando me contó lo ocurrido me asusté, incluso nos cubrimos hasta la cabeza con las sábanas, sin poder dormir hasta que amaneciera. Pero cuando finalmente salió el sol ambos nos dimos cuenta de lo que había pasado en realidad, el supuesto fantasma no era más que un vestido de mi mamá de mangas largas que estaba colgado en la cuerda, y cuando mi hermano agito la cuerda este se empezó a mover.
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/victor2356/AK6VVU19rbbeeh8WnhLQHDVX531A3nbGeWyUe3b2Mq5QigqPAyvZQis3bgnRDce.png)
[Fuente](https://pixabay.com/es/photos/fantasma-ni%c3%b1a-cuadro-animaci%c3%b3n-7414335/)

I'm glad I was able to share my childhood experiences with you through the stories I heard. I hope more people will join the initiative. See you next time, God willing.

>Me alegra haber podido compartir con ustedes mis experiencias de la niñez a través de las historias que yo escuchaba, espero que más personas se unan a la iniciativa, nos vemos en otra oportunidad, Dios mediante.
![Brown Beige Cream Modern Illustration Coffee Project Presentation.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/victor2356/23u6FdQ2j9v8DRjnGY86szgGFgnNavrFjBHMZrFV9aDdSAH4iQ5F3XMeJj7iYpz2d18ok.jpg)

body.title: 🇨🇺 Cuando el polvo susurra (ESP-ENG)
body.body:
> 📗 Saludos, amigos de #hivecuba. Un placer reencontramos vía #ecency ***
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZV7gSx8szVuoo94J2tVTEmdspvVhfTHEaAXSk6UurFBK/1776953195904.jpg)
***

> 🇨🇺 Cuando el polvo susurra (ESP-ENG) El estimado @bradleyarrow ha puesto en marcha una idea fantástica. El mundo mejora cuando los seres humanos son solidarios con sus semejantes, o sea, cuando, en franco gesto de amor, son capaces de convocatorias como esta. ¿En qué consiste? Una fundación. Un proyecto. Iniciativa o como quiera llamársele, anclada en #Hive. @thebbhfoundation En los climas helados de ese pedazo de territorio canadiense donde vive este amigo y su novia (o esposa), la señorita @cathyarrow ha surgido la chispa. Esa chispa alimenta la brasa, al punto de prender el fuego que, como en los motores de vapor, pone en marcha, sobre las aguas profundas del inmenso océano, el buque de la esperanza. Hoy les presento a Emilio. Este cubano, hace unos años, en un traspiés nocturno, cayó desde los doce metros mientras cruzaba el puente colgante que lo llevaría a su hogar. Era de noche, lloviznaba, y las tablas del puente estaban resbaladizas por la humedad. Emilio caminaba despacio, como siempre, pero un cable suelto, que llevaba semanas sin repararse, le enganchó el pie derecho. Perdió el equilibrio. Sus brazos giraron en el aire buscando un punto de apoyo que no encontraron. Cayó de espaldas, directamente sobre las rocas del lecho del río, casi seco en esa época del año. El golpe se oyó a lo lejos. Alguien gritó. Él no. Él solo sintió un crujido seco, como de rama que se parte, y luego nada. ***
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmVCtm54e6i3juhWvmXtfitazX8DUYQgoNidrykpwKhkY4/1776953196331.jpg)
***

>

Cuando despertó, horas después, estaba en una cama del hospital provincial, con el cuerpo entumecido y un zumbido eterno en los oídos. Después de los análisis y estudios de rigor —placas, resonancias magnéticas, interminables esperas en pasillos de cemento frío—, el dictamen médico fue el más feroz.

Se fracturó las dos piernas, la cadera izquierda y tres vértebras lumbares. No perdió la médula de milagro, pero el cuerpo quedó hecho un rompecabezas.

Llegaron las cirugías. Una tras otra. La primera fue de urgencia, con anestesia local porque no había suficiente para general. La segunda, una semana después: colocaron placas de metal en la pierna derecha. Despertó en mitad de la noche, sin morfina, mordiendo una correa de cuero para no gritar. La tercera fue la más cruel: una infección en el fémur izquierdo obligó a reabrir todo. El cirujano, un hombre bueno pero derrotado por la falta de insumos, le dijo al oído: \

. Emilio cerró los ojos y asintió. Luego vino una cuarta, y una quinta. En cada una perdió un poco más de sí mismo. Entre venda y venda, entre fiebre y fiebre, empezó a mover los dedos de los pies. Luego los tobillos. Luego, con un bastón de guayabo que talló él mismo, dio un paso. Un solo paso. Lloraron las enfermeras. Lloró él. Y aunque el dolor nunca se fue. Emilio no tiene teléfono. Cuando oye hablar de internet no entiende de qué se trata y, aunque sonríe como quien escapa de una broma, se va arrastrando la carretilla pobre con que intenta ganarse la vida. Por esas calles de tierra, a veces esquivando el fango y otras pateando el polvo infinito de los días. Vive solo. En un cuarto pequeño con paredes desconchadas y techo de dos aguas, con tejas de zinc envejecidas. Le faltan las medicinas. El Estado le paga una magra pensión que apenas le alcanza para un litro de aceite, un jabón, dos libras de arroz y algo de sal. En días nublados, los dolores de las disímiles operaciones —primero de fracaso en fracaso, luego con la voluntad inquebrantable del paciente— son insoportables. A veces quiero pensar que esta fundación fue creada para ayudar a personas como Emilio. Porque la bondad no entiende de fronteras. Porque el frío canadiense y el polvo cubano pueden encontrarse en un solo latido: la certeza de que unidos podemos mover el buque hacia quien más lo necesita. Y estoy seguro de que así es. ***
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQme9xA2hidzN1yteqBbRG56hpsyUz1BBTW1ownDoB8MSVg/1776953196119.jpg)
***

> Por eso quise compartirles la historia de este desventurado vecino. Uno más, en un país donde la miseria gana terreno por días. El fuego arde y el océano es una ruta. ¿No será acaso que fundaciones como esta, gestadas en la ternura de un clima helado, existen para que historias como la de Emilio dejen de ser solo un susurro del polvo y se conviertan, por fin, en la razón misma del viaje? **© Marabuzal, 2026. All rights reserved.** ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmR4iAzr2GRzXZYx3kViUYm4hvGC4Cm72oqo1eUjTMnYKk/1776352087971.png) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmVDUKVA6YugQdRrhGACmnps8ddBkV8W6UwGEo9DwaNQxF/1768408479017.jpg)

> 📗 Greetings, friends of #hivecuba. It's a pleasure to reconnect via #ecency ***
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZV7gSx8szVuoo94J2tVTEmdspvVhfTHEaAXSk6UurFBK/1776953195904.jpg)
***

> 🇨🇺 **When the Dust Whispers (ESP-ENG)** The esteemed @bradleyarrow has launched a fantastic idea. The world improves when human beings are supportive of one another, that is, when, in a genuine gesture of love, they are capable of initiatives like this. What does it consist of? A foundation. A project. An initiative, or whatever you want to call it, anchored in #Hive. @thebbhfoundation In the frigid climate of that piece of Canadian territory where this friend and his girlfriend (or wife), Miss @cathyarrow, live, a spark has been ignited. That spark feeds the embers, to the point of igniting the fire that, like in a steam engine, sets the ship of hope adrift on the deep waters of the immense ocean. Today I present to you Emilio. This Cuban, a few years ago, in a nighttime mishap, fell from twelve meters while crossing the suspension bridge that would take him home. It was night, it was drizzling, and the bridge planks were slippery from the dampness. Emilio was walking slowly, as always, but a loose cable, which hadn't been repaired for weeks, caught his right foot. He lost his balance. His arms spun in the air, searching for a foothold they couldn't find. He fell backward, directly onto the rocks of the riverbed, almost dry at that time of year. The impact was heard in the distance. Someone screamed. Not him. He only felt a dry crack, like a branch snapping, and then nothing. ***
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmVCtm54e6i3juhWvmXtfitazX8DUYQgoNidrykpwKhkY4/1776953196331.jpg)
***

>

When he awoke, hours later, he was in a bed at the provincial hospital, his body numb and with a constant ringing in his ears. After the standard tests and examinations—X-rays, MRIs, endless waits in cold, concrete corridors—the medical diagnosis was grim.

 He fractured both legs, his left hip, and three lumbar vertebrae. Miraculously, he didn't lose his spinal cord, but his body was a jigsaw puzzle.

The surgeries began. One after another. The first was an emergency, with local anesthesia because there wasn't enough for general anesthesia. The second, a week later: they put metal plates in his right leg. He woke up in the middle of the night, without morphine, biting a leather strap to keep from screaming. The third was the cruelest: an infection in his left femur forced them to reopen everything. The surgeon, a good man but defeated by the lack of supplies, whispered in his ear, \

Emilio closed his eyes and nodded. Then came a fourth, and a fifth. With each one, he lost a little more of himself. Between bandages, between fevers, he began to move his toes. Then his ankles. Then, with a guava wood cane he carved himself, he took a step. Just one step. The nurses wept. He wept. And though the pain never went away. Emilio doesn't have a phone. When he hears about the internet, he doesn't understand what it is, and although he smiles like someone escaping a joke, he drags the meager wheelbarrow he uses to try to earn a living. Along those dirt roads, sometimes dodging the mud and other times kicking the endless dust of the days. He lives alone. In a small room with peeling walls and a gabled roof, covered with aged zinc tiles. He lacks medicine. The state pays him a meager pension that barely covers a liter of oil, a bar of soap, two pounds of rice, and some salt. On cloudy days, the pain from the various operations—first failed, then finally successful thanks to the patient's unwavering will—is unbearable. Sometimes I want to think that this foundation was created to help people like Emilio. Because kindness knows no borders. Because the Canadian cold and the Cuban dust can meet in a single heartbeat: the certainty that together we can move the ship toward those who need it most. And I'm sure that's how it is. ***
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQme9xA2hidzN1yteqBbRG56hpsyUz1BBTW1ownDoB8MSVg/1776953196119.jpg)
***

> That's why I wanted to share the story of this unfortunate neighbor. Just one more, in a country where misery is gaining ground every day. The fire burns, and the ocean is a route. Could it be that foundations like this one, born in the tenderness of a frigid climate, exist so that stories like Emilio's cease to be merely a whisper of dust and finally become the very reason for the journey? body.body: I Thought It Was Just a JPG to PDF Tool… I Was Wrong I’ll be honest — I didn’t expect much. When I first opened [https://jpgtopdf.com/](https://jpgtopdf.com/), I thought it’s just another basic converter. Upload image → download PDF → close tab. But after actually using it for a while, it turned out to be something completely different.

/> * * * Not Just a Converter -------------------- Most tools like this do one thing — convert JPG to PDF. This one? It’s more like a full mini “PDF workspace” in your browser. And I’m not exaggerating — the platform includes **30+ tools** for working with documents. That already changes how you approach file management. * * * What I Actually Used (Not Theory) --------------------------------- Here’s what stood out during real usage — not just clicking around. * * * ### Turning chaos into one document This is the obvious one, but still important. You can upload multiple images: * JPG * PNG * GIF * TIFF * even PSD And combine them into a single PDF. No installs, no limits, no weird steps. For me, this replaced the usual mess of: “file1.jpg / file2.jpg / final\_final2.jpg” * * * ### Editing PDFs without extra tools This is where it gets interesting. You’re not just creating PDFs — you can actually work with them: * merge files * split documents * delete pages * reorder pages * rotate pages * add watermark * compress files All inside one interface. Normally, you’d need 2–3 different tools for that. Here — it’s just there.

/>

* * *

Speed & Simplicity (This Matters More Than Features)
----------------------------------------------------

A lot of tools try to impress with features — but are slow or annoying.

Here:

*   no registration
    
*   no installation
    
*   works in browser
    
*   conversion takes seconds
    

That’s actually the reason I kept using it.

Because when you deal with files daily, speed matters more than “fancy stuff”.

* * *

Security (Important, but not overcomplicated)
---------------------------------------------

One thing I always check with these tools — what happens to files?

Here it’s simple:

*   files are automatically deleted in less than 60 minutes
    
*   GDPR compliance is mentioned
    
*   encrypted transfers are used
    

Not overhyped — just clear and practical.

* * *

Small Detail That Actually Says a Lot
-------------------------------------

The tool exists since **2008**.

That’s rare.

Most similar tools appear and disappear quickly.

If something has been running that long — it usually means people actually use it.

* * *

Where This Became Useful for Me
-------------------------------

No “corporate use cases”, just real life:

*   combining screenshots into one file
    
*   sending documents without attaching 10 images
    
*   cleaning up old folders
    
*   converting files quickly without opening heavy software
    

* * *

Final Thought
-------------

I’ve tried enough of these tools to know the pattern:

*   half of them are slow
    
*   the other half push you into paid plans immediately
    

This one is different.

Not because it’s “perfect”, but because it removes friction.

You open it → do the job → leave.

And honestly, that’s exactly what a tool like this should do.

body.title: Network Defect
body.body:
>

My wife is working from home as she is ill, which I find a little crazy these days. In the past if you were too ill to go to work, you stayed home and rested. Now, there is an unwritten rule that you are meant to work. Also when kids were ill in the past, it meant staying with the sick kid, now it is sitting them in front of a screen while continuing to work. 

>Isn't remote work awesome? 

Anyway, at some point and not during a meeting, she said she was having network issues, which has been thankfully pretty rare since I changed service provider a while ago. So I asked her if she had restarted her computer yet, while I checked my own connection - it wasn't working. Son I reset the router, and it worked again. The reset took about a minute to happen and then all is good. But I wonder if I hadn't been there, would that have happened. Unlikely. Instead of resetting the router, my wife would have connected to her phone connection instead and problem solved. But at the same time, this has happened many times previously, so why couldn't she troubleshoot it herself? 

> When there is someone else to take care of it, why would she?

---


![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tarazkp/23yx1VByB1Yg5WDoPQ7WVKa7F4GdjzkVebY5Dxwz8f1burR3ctWGRkeLcYEPskWqK5jyY.png)


---

This is normal in the workplaces, where people suddenly become useless toddlers whenever there is the slightest issue and are unable to take care of themselves, or take responsibility of anything that is not directly in their job description. Something they would take care of in the home suddenly becomes an insurmountable roadblock in the workplace, or outside of their capabilities. Even simple things like putting a coffee cup into the dishwasher is beyond many people. Instead, they pile them up in the sink until someone finally gets frustrated enough to do it for them. I find it pathetic. 

But I think that it speaks to how we have changed as a society. In the past we used to have broader job roles in the workplace and had to take care of more, as well as had to fill in for people who were ill, or help people out that needed a hand with something. Nowadays, there is the expectation that everyone has to take care of themselves in a very narrow role, but anything outside of that role falls into no man's land, grey area. And since it is everyone's responsibility, no one has to do it. Perhaps employment contracts should include clauses like \

. 

> Does *common courtesy* need to be contractually agreed to and signed upon?

Social contracts used to be enforceable through social repercussions, but now that we are so disconnected from each other, and so self-centred, that people don't care what others think of them. There is very little social \

in much of society now, so people throw litter on the ground, don't pick up after their dog, shout and scream at strangers, and generally behave like they are the only ones who have right of way. And when everyone believes they have right of way and entitled to do what they want, it causes a lot of *conflict.* A network effect is the state of something becoming more valuable the more people use it, like a social media platform. But socially, we are creating a state of network defect, where society is becoming *less valuable* the more people use it, because they aren't putting anything of value into the network. I believe that while the money is still spinning for now, social networks are losing their value the more AI content fills them. It looks like a lot of activity, but for individual users, it will start to become increasingly useless, meaning the network is losing utility. I think society is losing users in the sense that many people feel that they no longer have to add value to the network, so the network effect of building a strong society is becoming instead, dysfunctional. Society is contracting in utility because people are abusing the network. Entitlement is a big part of the abuse, where people expect to get what they want without having to do anything much for it. Much like how social respect is *earned,* people no longer feel they have to earn the advantages of being in society, and as a result, society is collapsing. This is being driven by all the various corporations and their tools that empower people to be increasingly selfish, but at the end of the day, the conditioned user still has *some chance* of changing their behaviour. But just like leaving dishes on the sink, once the first is left there, it is increasingly likely that the second will be, and then the third has an even higher chance. Pretty soon, the space surrounding the sink and in the sink is filled with dirty dishes, and no one wants to go through the arduous task of the clean-up. Society is becoming increasingly cluttered with the filth of humanity, and the more there is, there more there will be, until like extreme hoarders, we are buried under trash, surrounded by rats, faeces and dead bodies. And by that point, we will know that we have failed, that the problem is too big to solve, so we may as well keep on creating trash and sitting in our own filth. Someone else will clean it up. body.body: > ## 🎬 Technical Details - **Episode:** White Bear (S02E02) - **Series:** Black Mirror - **Year:** 2013 - **Director:** Carl Tibbetts - **Cast:** Lenora Crichlow, Michael Smiley, Tuppence Middleton.

>


## ⚖️ First Impression

This episode starts as a classic \

flick. A woman wakes up with amnesia, and everyone is filming her with their phones while hunters try to kill her. It feels chaotic and confusing, but that’s exactly the trap. When the twist hits at the end, it completely changes your perspective on everything you just saw. It’s a masterclass in narrative deception that leaves you feeling dirty for having cheered for the protagonist.

## 📖 Spoiler-Free Synopsis

Victoria wakes up in a house with no memory of who she is. Outside, the world has gone mad: most people are \
who do nothing but film her with their smartphones, while a small group of \
tries to kill her. She meets a woman named Jem, who explains that a mysterious signal from a transmitter called \

has turned the population into mindless spectators. They must reach the transmitter to shut it down before they are caught.

## 🎭 Analysis and Rating: Justice as Entertainment

The twist in this episode is one of the most famous in television history. We discover that Victoria isn't a victim, but a criminal who filmed the torture and murder of a child. Her \

is a Justice Park where her memory is wiped every night so she can relive the terror as a tourist attraction for the public.\n\nThis raises a brutal question: **Does a monster deserve a monstrous punishment?** The episode turns the mirror toward us, the audience. The people filming with their phones aren't \

; they are us, the society that loves to watch a public execution from the comfort of a screen.

### The Positive:
- **The Twist:** It is arguably the best \
moment in the entire series.\n- **Social Commentary:** It perfectly critiques vigilante justice and the \

taken to its most literal and violent extreme.
- **Tension:** The feeling of helplessness during the first 30 minutes is incredibly well-executed.

### The Disappointing:
- **High Stress Level:** It’s a very loud, screaming-heavy episode. It can be exhausting to watch due to the constant state of panic of the protagonist.

## 🏆 Fun Fact

- **The Symbol:** The \

shape or inverted fork symbol seen throughout the episode became the logo for the show and reappeared significantly in the interactive movie *Bandersnatch*.\n- **Original Script:** Initially, Charlie Brooker wrote this as a traditional zombie story, but he changed it at the last minute to the \
concept because he felt the zombie trope was too cliché.\n- **Real Locations:** The \

was actually filmed in a former RAF base, which adds to the cold, abandoned, and industrial feeling of the episode.

## ⭐ Final Verdict

A brutal, uncomfortable, and essential episode. It challenges your morals and makes you wonder who the real monsters are: the criminal or the crowd cheering for her suffering.

My rating: ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ 9/10

# REVIEW: Black Mirror - Oso Blanco (S02E02) ## 🎬 Ficha Técnica - **Episodio:** Oso Blanco (White Bear) - **Serie:** Black Mirror - **Año:** 2013 - **Director:** Carl Tibbetts - **Reparto:** Lenora Crichlow, Michael Smiley, Tuppence Middleton. ## ⚖️ Primera Impresión Este capítulo empieza como la típica película de terror y supervivencia. Una mujer despierta sin memoria y todo el mundo la graba con sus teléfonos mientras unos tipos enmascarados intentan matarla. Se siente caótico y confuso, pero esa es la trampa perfecta. Cuando llega el giro final, te cambia por completo la perspectiva de lo que acabas de ver. Es una genialidad que te deja con un sentimiento de culpa por haber empatizado con la protagonista. ## 📖 Sinopsis Sin Spoilers Victoria despierta en una casa sin recordar quién es. Afuera, el mundo parece haberse vuelto loco: la mayoría de la gente son \
que no hacen más que grabarla con sus móviles, mientras un pequeño grupo de \
intenta asesinarla. Conoce a una mujer llamada Jem, quien le explica que una señal misteriosa desde un transmisor llamado \

ha convertido a la población en mirones sin cerebro. Deben llegar al transmisor para destruirlo antes de que las atrapen.


## 🎭 Análisis y Valoración: La Justicia como Espectáculo

El giro de este episodio es uno de los más famosos de la televisión. Descubrimos que Victoria no es una víctima, sino una criminal que grabó la tortura y asesinato de una niña. Su \

es un parque de justicia donde le borran la memoria cada noche para que reviva el terror como una atracción turística para el público.\n\nEsto plantea una pregunta brutal: **¿Merece un monstruo un castigo igual de monstruoso?** El episodio nos pone el espejo a nosotros. La gente que graba con sus móviles no está \

; son la sociedad que disfruta de un linchamiento público desde la comodidad de una pantalla.

### Lo Rescatable:
- **El Giro Final:** Es, posiblemente, el mejor momento \
de toda la serie.\n- **Crítica Social:** Retrata perfectamente la justicia por mano propia y la \

llevada a su extremo más violento.
- **La Tensión:** La sensación de impotencia durante los primeros 30 minutos está logradísima.

### Lo Decepcionante:
- **Nivel de Estrés:** Es un capítulo de muchos gritos y llanto constante. Puede ser agotador de ver por el estado de pánico permanente de la protagonista.

## 🏆 Dato Curioso

- **El Símbolo:** El dibujo de la horquilla invertida que aparece en todo el episodio se convirtió en el logo de la serie y reapareció años después en la película interactiva *Bandersnatch*.
- **Guion Original:** Al principio, Charlie Brooker lo escribió como una historia de zombis tradicional, pero cambió al concepto del \

a último momento porque sintió que lo de los zombis estaba muy visto. - **Locaciones Reales:** El parque fue filmado en una antigua base de la fuerza aérea, lo que ayuda a esa sensación de lugar frío y abandonado. ## ⭐ Veredicto Final Un episodio brutal, incómodo y necesario. Desafía tu moral y te hace preguntarte quiénes son los verdaderos monstruos: si el criminal o la multitud que aplaude su sufrimiento. **Mi calificación: ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ 9/10** --- **Leave me your comment!** **¡Déjame tu comentario!**

body.body:
https://youtube.com/shorts/eh_v8rFfXkU?si=ZVgHnjEPGqLIE0aB

It was love at first sight.

I remember that moment well. I saw it in the advertisement for sale on the Internet - and that's it, there were no other options. I even asked the saleswoman not to sell it to anyone but me. She laughed then, and, to be honest, there was a reason, because no one except me was in a hurry to go for a rooster to the other side of the world. Well, okay, just in the Kiev region, but still 😄

We agreed that I would pick it up in a couple of days. Calmly, without haste.

But in the end... I couldn't stand it.

And on the same day, my friend and I went to pick him up somewhere outside Brovary. Road, time - all this has become unimportant. I had a feeling that I had to pick him up right now.

That's how we got Sultan in our family.

Of course, he has a character. And in such a way that it is immediately clear that he is in charge here. It's important to walk, looks down and generally behaves as if I live with him, not him with me. But that's the charm ☺️☺️.

There are animals that you just take care of. And there are those who immediately become your own.

Sultan is just like that.

body.title: ¿Las uñas necesitan descansar? 😳Do nails need to “rest”? 😳
body.body:
[![](https://images.3speak.tv/images/1777027820500-59dad69137df4330.webp)](https://3speak.tv/watch?v=babyalvarez9707/916baf89)

▶️ [Watch on 3Speak](https://3speak.tv/watch?v=babyalvarez9707/916baf89)


---

Mi clienta llegó después de más de 6 semanas… pasadísima de tiempo 👀💅

Por suerte, sus uñas estaban bastante bien y pudimos hacer el retoque sin tener que retirar todo el set.

Pero me dijo algo que me dejó pensando…
“el próximo mes me las voy a quitar para dejar que mis uñas respiren” 🤭

Y aquí es donde yo digo… nena, las uñas no respiran 😅

Están hechas de queratina, no tienen pulmones ni necesitan descansar de los productos.

Lo que sí necesitan es buen mantenimiento y tiempo adecuado entre servicios.

Al final eligió algo sencillo: un azul oscuro precioso, sin decoraciones ✨

Y este retoque tuvo un costo de 1200 pesos 💸💅

Pero dime tú… ¿tú también pensabas eso? 👀
My client came in after more than 6 weeks… way overdue 👀💅

Luckily, her nails were still in good condition, so we were able to do a refill without removing the whole set.

But then she said something that really got me thinking…
“Next month I’m going to remove them to let my nails breathe” 🤭

And that’s where I have to say… girl, nails don’t breathe 😅

They’re made of keratin, they don’t have lungs and they don’t need to “rest” from products.

What they really need is proper maintenance and the right timing between appointments.

In the end, she chose something simple: a beautiful dark blue with no decorations ✨

And this refill cost 1200 pesos 💸💅

But tell me… did you think the same thing? 👀

---

body.title: From Noise to Clarity: How 15M Curates Actionable Content for the Gaming Industry
body.body:
The gaming and iGaming industries move at a relentless pace. New tools, affiliate opportunities, compliance updates, and marketing strategies emerge almost daily, creating an environment where professionals are expected to keep learning just to stay competitive. Yet the sheer volume of information often becomes a barrier instead of an advantage. Endless webinars, long-form reports, scattered social media insights, and promotional content make it difficult to separate meaningful knowledge from background noise. As a result, many professionals spend more time searching for value than actually applying it.

That’s where[ https://15m.com/](https://15m.com/) introduces a different approach. Instead of adding more content to the already crowded landscape, the platform focuses on distilling expertise into concise, actionable episodes designed to respect time and attention. By limiting content to short, focused segments led by experienced industry professionals, it creates a structured learning experience that helps users quickly extract value and move forward with confidence. The emphasis is not on volume, but on relevance, clarity, and immediate usability.

The concept behind this model is simple but powerful: professionals don’t need more information—they need better-filtered information. In gaming and affiliate marketing, decision-making often depends on timely insights. Whether it’s understanding shifts in traffic sources, evaluating affiliate programs, optimizing retention strategies, or adapting to regulatory changes, the ability to act quickly can define success. Long-form content may provide depth, but it often lacks efficiency. Short, concentrated episodes that focus on a single topic can deliver clarity faster and encourage implementation rather than passive consumption.

Another important aspect of curated content is credibility. In an industry where promotional messaging frequently masquerades as education, trusted voices matter. Expert-led sessions help bridge the gap between theory and real-world execution. Instead of generalized advice, professionals gain access to practical perspectives shaped by hands-on experience. This makes the content not only informative but also actionable, giving viewers concrete ideas they can test in their own workflows.

Curation also means prioritizing relevance. Gaming professionals come from diverse backgrounds: affiliate managers, media buyers, product specialists, SEO experts, CRM strategists, and founders all seek different insights. A curated platform organizes knowledge into focused themes, allowing users to quickly find what matters to them. This targeted structure reduces the cognitive overload that often accompanies traditional learning platforms, where valuable insights are buried under unrelated material.

Time efficiency plays a crucial role as well. In fast-paced environments, professionals rarely have the luxury to dedicate hours to learning. Short-form, high-density content aligns with real working schedules. A 15-minute session can fit between meetings, during a commute, or before launching a campaign. This flexibility transforms learning from a scheduled activity into an integrated part of the daily workflow. Over time, these micro-learning moments compound into significant expertise.

Beyond convenience, curated content encourages continuous improvement. When knowledge is delivered in manageable segments, it becomes easier to build momentum. Instead of waiting for a large block of time, professionals can regularly engage with new insights. This consistency supports skill development and keeps teams aligned with industry evolution. In competitive markets, even small knowledge advantages can translate into measurable performance gains.

The focus on actionable insights also changes how information is consumed. Rather than absorbing abstract concepts, viewers are exposed to specific tactics, frameworks, and lessons learned. This practical orientation reduces the gap between learning and execution. For example, a discussion about affiliate partnerships may highlight negotiation strategies, performance metrics, and real-case pitfalls. A session on traffic acquisition might break down testing methodologies or scaling approaches. Each piece of content aims to deliver something immediately useful.

Clarity also comes from intentional content selection. Not every trend deserves attention, and not every tactic applies universally. Curated platforms act as filters, identifying what truly matters and presenting it without unnecessary complexity. This approach benefits both newcomers and experienced professionals. Beginners gain structured entry points, while veterans can quickly scan for advanced insights without wading through basic material.

In an industry saturated with noise, thoughtful curation becomes a competitive advantage. Professionals who access focused, relevant knowledge can make faster decisions, avoid common mistakes, and experiment more confidently. Instead of reacting to every new trend, they can prioritize strategies that align with their goals. This shift from reactive learning to intentional growth is what distinguishes effective knowledge platforms from traditional content hubs.

Ultimately, clarity is not just about shorter content—it’s about purposeful content. When expertise is distilled into concise, practical sessions, learning becomes more efficient and impactful. By emphasizing relevance, credibility, and time efficiency, curated platforms help gaming professionals stay informed without becoming overwhelmed. The result is a smarter, more focused approach to industry education—one that turns information overload into actionable insight and helps ambitious professionals move forward with precision.

---

# Friday a visit to the zoo Feeling fairly good this morning, going to be cautious what I eat today as I do not want another flare up or blockage, the Drs talked about my diet and seemed to think I was eating OK and that wasnt the root cause, just unlucky that the scarrign from previous surgeries was catchig and blocking me up occassionally, which apparent after having color removal surgery can be common, some are lucky and have no issues, some may have issues every few years, and then theres me every few months, but hey thinking positive and mayby I will slip into the not so often group :) Sharing a few shots from a visit to the Zoo, all be it last year, Mother nature is really teasing me this year, the days it has been moderately warmer around sunrise, and I could have headed out for a walk I have had something on such as Monday when it was 45F around sunrise, but I had my yearly colonoscopy that morning, so the only going out was to the clinic, but then today when I have nothing on and up early as usual its currently 28F with a real feel of 22 and far to cold for me to head out lOL But soon I will be out and about, I know I keep saying that but I have to be right about that one day :) I do enjoy visiting the little Zoo here, even though I wish that had more space for all the animals there, from what I have seen of the staff there, they are all dedicated and do a great job looking after all the animals Starting with a shot of a beaver, mostly they are sitting off to the side of their enclosure and hard to catch shots of, but I have been lucky enough to be there as they were being feed a couple of times, where they become less shy and are cool to watch

body.body:
![_DSC8789.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/travelshots/23u5WuiHWbSffeehFXsT4piESZaVNRp5ANfESwW7mRFbAQ9ATErBfBvr6SncPtxmXfzoy.jpg)

Hello everyone! It’s been a while since my trip to Scotland, and I’ve already shown you lots of photos of Edinburgh and the Forth Bridge. Now I’ve finally got round to editing my photos of Glasgow. So today I’m sharing some photos from my first stroll through this fascinating city. It was a cool, cloudy afternoon and it kept drizzling. This meant there were lots of puddles, which I used to capture reflections. When you come from Edinburgh to Glasgow, you immediately notice that this city has a completely different vibe. More gritty, more urban and less touristy. Despite that – or perhaps because of it – it’s very interesting from a photographic point of view. 

*Hallo zusammen! Meine Schottland-Reise ist nun bereits einige Zeit her und ich habe euch in der Vergangenheit schon viele Bilder von Edinburgh und der Forth Bridge gezeigt. Nun habe ich auch endlich angefangen, meine Bilder von Glasgow zu bearbeiten. Deshalb zeige ich euch heute Fotos von meinem ersten Spaziergang in dieser spannenden Stadt. Es war ein kühler, wolkenverhangener Nachmittag und immer wieder regnete es leicht. Dadurch hatten wich viele Pfützen gebildet, die ich für Spiegelungen nutzte. Wenn man von Edinburgh nach Glasgow kommt, merkt man sofort, dass diese Stadt einen ganz anderen Vibe hat. Roher, urbaner und weniger touristisch. Trotzdem oder gerade deswegen, ist sie aber fotografisch sehr interessant. *

Me explicó que vendía flores no solo para ganarse la vida, sino también para alegrar el día de las personas que pasaban. Compré un pequeño ramo de colores vivos y me sentí feliz de apoyar su oficio. Una de ellas me llamó especialmente la atención: era un mural vibrante que representaba la diversidad cultural de nuestra ciudad. Reflexioné sobre cómo cada rincón tiene su propia historia y cómo cada persona que conoces en el camino agrega algo único a esa experiencia. body.body:
>

‎The concept of time and it's significance, is quite disturbing. If it was a living being, I would have called it the most cold hearted being to ever walked the earth. Despite it's significance, it is one of the elements humans take for granted. We all act like it is on our side, like it is ours to own. We start making choices with permanent consequences, and yet we notice nothing till years have gone by and there is not left to change.
‎
‎When I look back at the choices I have made from 5 years ago, some of those choices are getting blurry. Lot of career related choices made in haste, for the sake of survival. Times when it felt like I was making the best decision but, I was only delaying the inevitable. 

‎![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQDkgRDaHXGDL4dfaXKHfvir6WJ1hzsB6Nx8SDYaL7wPZ/1777026493965.png)

‎If I have to travel back 5 years with all I know now, I will definitely do somethings better. Don't get me wrong, I am grateful for the lessons learnt from my past mistakes, it is what made me what I'm today but some of the consequences of my past choices, were so traumatic that it travels through time. Leaving behind thoughts of; how I wish I knew better.
‎
‎The ironic thing about choices is that, we do what we have to with the available information at hand at the moment, but when the consequences of it arrives, it doesn't really matter how much we knew, the pain feels the same regardless.
‎
‎One of the few choices I will gladly remake, will probably be related to my field of study. I never regretted studying the course I studied but at some point, I realized, I could have acquired more digital skill that would have helped me along the line. Despite having a mindset that is future oriented, at some point, I was satisfied with the skill I had learnt. Little did I know that, knowing too much doesn't hurt.
‎
‎In today's society, certificates are meaningless. It all depends on knowledge you have acquired and how you practice it. Theoretical knowledge is not enough to get things done because when actions are needed, theories are just theories. Learning had no limit, why didn't I see that? I learnt what I could but left out some important stuff, which would have gotten me some gigs now.
‎
‎If I was privilege to travel back in time to 2021, I would definitely think less and act more. Expand my areas of focus, it would have been stressful because I had a lot of things I was dealing with back then but with the knowledge of the world I have now, I will have it at the back of my mind; it is worth it.
‎

body.title: I am a watcher of the times || Soy un observador de los tiempos (Eng//Esp)
body.body:
>

Un observador de los tiempos

Soy un observador de los tiempos. Yo moldeo la realidad, la atrapo y convierto en palabras que se van registrando en mi diario. Mi cuaderno son mis ojos espirituales; esos que mueven el bolígrafo para revelar lo que sucede a mi alrededor.

Mi nombre es William y hago journaling para entender la vida. Basta con tener una taza de café al lado y mi cuaderno para desplegarme. Observo el entorno y anoto: una lección de vida, un detalle laboral, una experiencia vital, un chiste cotidiano.

>

I am an observer of the times.

I shape reality, capture it, and turn it into words that get recorded in my journal. My notebook is my spiritual eyes—the ones that move the pen to reveal what unfolds around me.

My name is William, and I journal to understand life. All I need is a cup of coffee by my side and my notebook to unfold myself.

I observe my surroundings and jot down: a life lesson, a work detail, a vital experience, an everyday joke.

* * *

>

¿Me fue mal en el trabajo? ¿Me dedicaron alguna palabra agradable? ¿Algo ocurrió que trastornó mi rutina? Todo es válido de ser registrado. Entonces, al final de la semana, abro este mismo diario y repaso los sucesos recientes. Hacer esto me ayuda a rastrear mi trayectoria y saber a dónde se dirigen mis pasos.

Con el descubrimiento de esta comunidad, puedo compartir parte de estas lecciones con ustedes. Espero que las disfruten y aprendan tanto como yo.

Soy un observador de lo tiempos, pero el título no indica soledad, porque comparto espacio con observadores como también lo son ustedes, pues el hecho de compartir sus vivencias los proyecta a ese espacio común a todos nosotros que es el del crecimiento interno.

Entonces disfrutemos juntos del momento. Escribamos de lo que nos gusta. Levantemos nuestras copas y bebamos todos de este néctar agridulce que es la vida. I am a watcher of the times.

>Did I have a bad day at work? Did someone say something kind to me? Did something disrupt my routine? Everything is worth recording. Then, at the end of the week, I open this very journal and review recent events. Doing this helps me trace my path and know where my steps are leading.

>With the discovery of this community, I can share some of these lessons with you. I hope you enjoy and learn from them as much as I do. I am a watcher of the times, but the title does not imply solitude, for I share this space with observers—just as you are, too.
>The act of sharing your experiences projects you into that common space we all inhabit: inner growth. So let’s enjoy the moment together.
>Let’s write about what we love. Let’s raise our glasses and all drink from this bittersweet nectar that is life.

Hay algo muy cierto en lo que compartes, pero también algo que se queda en la orilla.

Ese enojo del que hablas no aparece en el vacío; tiene rostro, un momento en el que ocurre y tiene una historia que contar. A veces nace en una frase que no se dijo a tiempo, en un límite que no se marcó, en un silencio que se eligió por evitar conflicto y luego se repite, como eco.

Y ahí es donde está el detalle: no solo pensamos el enojo, sino que también lo sostenemos por más tiempo del necesario.

No siempre es cuestión de soltar, amigo mío. A veces es cuestión de actuar, de decir lo pendiente, o incluso de aceptar que hay cosas que ya no se deben tolerar. En otras palabras, poner un para'o al asunto.

Porque, si bien es cierto, no todo pensamiento que vuelve merece otra oportunidad, sino que algunos solo piden una decisión definitiva.

description.title: What is a glass home elevator?
description.body:
![Glass home elevators modern design meets advanced technology (1).webp](https://waivio.nyc3.digitaloceanspaces.com/0e7904f20f317dcef455f4b2b9e073357e9d9739413581455460cf1d98c600b6)



A [glass home elevator](https://gauravsharma.blog2learn.com/88593380/glass-home-elevators-modern-design-meets-advanced-technology) is a modern residential lift designed with fully or partially transparent panels made from durable, safety-tested materials like tempered or laminated glass. Unlike traditional enclosed lifts, it offers a sleek and stylish appearance, allowing it to blend seamlessly with contemporary interiors while enhancing the overall visual appeal of the home.

These elevators are widely used in home elevators to ensure smooth and efficient movement between floors. At the same time, they serve as an architectural highlight, adding a luxurious touch to living spaces. Glass home elevators can operate on different drive systems such as hydraulic, traction, or pneumatic (vacuum), depending on the layout, space availability, and installation requirements.

One of the main reasons for their growing popularity is their perfect balance of design and functionality. Homeowners today prefer solutions that are not only practical but also aesthetically pleasing. Glass home elevators meet both needs by offering advanced technology, quiet operation, and space-saving designs. They are especially ideal for modern homes where openness and elegance are key design elements, making them a smart investment for comfort, accessibility, and long-term property value.

description.title: Mensaje diario de 5 minutos-No es tan difícil/ Daily 5 minute message- It’s not that hard
description.body:
> No es tan difícil esforzarse en lograr metas, solo hace falta programar y levantarse más temprano. Aunque el descanso resulta necesario también la felicidad por lograr metas nos produce felicidad infinita. No es tan difícil ser amable con las personas, sin llegar a que te vuelvan su esclava. Poner limites surgen de experiencias de vida. A veces los problemas surgen cuando deseas cumplir con todas las personas a tu alrededor y esto se vuelve complicado. No es tan difícil tener algunos minutos de felicidad al día con observar por unos segundo tu mundo alrededor encontrando y agradeciendo por lo que si tienes y menos por lo que no tienes aún. Darse cuenta que el tener eso que tanto deseas no te hará llegar la felicidad total. No es tan difícil dedicarse unos minutos para ti mismo, darse un cariñito especial y continuo. Ayer por ejemplo compre cocos y se que es algo que le encanta a mi hijo, así que se no fue tan difícil hacerlo feliz por un día. Cuando yo quiero ser feliz lo primero que veo es hacia mis hijos y agradecer su vida y luego me como un chocolate mi secreto para sentirme feliz el resto del día, que más puedo pedir.
***
Este texto corresponde a mi participación en el reto diario del amigo @latino.romano y @mariannewest [post](https://hive.blog/hive-161155/@daily.prompt/24-april-2026-freewriters-community-daily-writing-prompt-day-3083-its-not-that-hard) **ENGLISH VERSION** It's not that hard to strive for goals; you just need to plan and get up earlier. While rest is necessary, the joy of achieving goals brings us boundless happiness. It's not that hard to be kind to people without letting them control you. Setting boundaries comes from life experiences. Sometimes problems arise when you try to please everyone around you, and this becomes complicated. It's not that hard to find a few minutes of happiness each day by observing the world around you for a few seconds, appreciating what you have and being grateful for what you don't yet have. Realizing that having what you so desperately want won't bring you complete happiness. It's not that hard to dedicate a few minutes to yourself, to give yourself some special, ongoing pampering. Yesterday, for example, I bought coconuts, and I know it's something my son loves, so it wasn't that difficult to make him happy for a day. When I want to be happy, the first thing I look at is my children and thank them for their lives, and then I eat a chocolate bar. That's my secret to feeling happy for the rest of the day. What more could I ask for?
***
This text corresponds to my participation in the daily challenge of my friend @improv, @felt.buzz, @latino.romano and @mariannewest [post](https://hive.blog/hive-161155/@daily.prompt/24-april-2026-freewriters-community-daily-writing-prompt-day-3083-its-not-that-hard)

description.title: [ESP/ENG] Delicious and smooth mashed potatoes and pumpkin combining flavors.
description.body:
> Feliz viernes tengan todos mis queridos amigos, un gusto saludarles y compartir con ustedes una deliciosa receta de puré basada en papas y auyama, creo que todos en casa tenemos papas, ya que es un alimento versátil que utilizamos siempre en la cocina, siendo este un carbohidrato bastante consumido en mi hogar, Por otra parte tenemos la auyama esta es una verdura que normalmente se utiliza para hacer sopas pero tiene muchas otras alternativas dentro de la gastronomía, de esta manera quiero preparar un puré donde juntas hacen la combinación perfecta. > Happy Friday to all my dear friends! It's a pleasure to greet you and share with you a delicious mashed potato and pumpkin recipe. I think we all have potatoes at home, as they are a versatile food that we always use in the kitchen, and a carbohydrate that is quite common in my household. On the other hand, we have pumpkin, a vegetable that is usually used to make soups but has many other uses in gastronomy. So, I want to prepare a mashed potato where together they make the perfect combination.
![GridArt_20260423_220528747.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mariaser/AKYNaowH8kh4hpZoTwr8J2BrRxoajbsipq5FGxDsY2Mt63Y7V63vMBua3ortWUz.jpg)
Ingredientes: 1/2 kilo de auyama, 4 papas, mantequilla, sal, pimienta. > Ingredients: 1/2 kilo of pumpkin, 4 potatoes, butter, salt, pepper.
![GridArt_20260423_220014489.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mariaser/23wX1Fd1vaCVVCttyibhTQAqQQ9JeUi2XgiGJtEW6i9V2yYqMc2HCw6egmAvSbYi4QXyd.jpg)
Para comenzar vamos a lavar y pelar nuestras papas luego los cortaremos en trozos medianos, de igual manera vamos a retirar la corteza de la auyama y sus semillas para luego cortar trozos medianos al igual que las papas, llevamos los trozos a una olla con agua y agregamos un poco de sal, ambas pueden cocinarse juntas ya que tienen un mismo periodo de cocción. > To begin, we will wash and peel our potatoes, then cut them into medium-sized pieces. Similarly, we will remove the rind and seeds from the pumpkin and then cut it into medium-sized pieces, just like the potatoes. We put the pieces in a pot with water and add a little salt. Both can be cooked together since they have the same cooking time.
![GridArt_20260423_220100386.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mariaser/AK7xbLNYkzayiXXtX1nbxcmxXpwPwqGdJDZwKj6QSbaifdFVUgZNUfG6CVrx9Su.jpg)
Luego de dejar de cocinar por unos cuantos minutos las pinchamos con un tenedor y al tener las blandas las llevamos a un colador para extraer toda su agua, seguidamente agregamos las papas, las auyamas en un recipiente y comenzamos a triturar hasta tener una mezcla a la cual le vamos a agregar un poco de mantequilla y pimienta, trituramos dejándola en una consistencia cremosa y suave. > After letting them cook for a few minutes, we prick them with a fork and when they are soft we put them in a colander to remove all their water, then we add the potatoes, the pumpkins to a container and we start to crush until we have a mixture to which we will add a little butter and pepper, crushing until it has a creamy and smooth consistency.
![GridArt_20260423_220214792.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mariaser/AK6XkSMpoYxdfQPVpNKENv9tANa9rCDFjcj2voJJSTfQ2G8Xza2xdWAa3CjjP6T.jpg)
De esta manera podemos preparar fácilmente en casa, un puré combinando las papas y la auyama para darle textura y color a esta preparación, la cual es un perfecto acompañante para cualquier tipo de proteína en mi caso quise acompañarla con pollo. > In this way we can easily prepare at home a puree combining potatoes and pumpkin to give texture and color to this preparation, which is a perfect accompaniment to any type of protein; in my case I wanted to accompany it with chicken.
![GridArt_20260423_220311614.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mariaser/AK3fbX5NVosVqEkcyygrxDmxJ1ZV7ZEgyS7G4qJorirYJY1fEARENCajyEq1xaH.jpg)
![IMG-20210518-WA0013.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mariaser/23vsmbX5FEuYW4QJWvpf9gV1SsdcvFYWz2pdHSV6Rbh7pKEvx1MfBLag9bwed31NV4LFw.jpg)
Gracias por leerme y su valioso apoyo. Las fotos son de mi autoria @mariaser Traducido con Deepl traductor > Thank you for reading me and your valuable support. The photos are by me @mariaser Translated with Deepl translator

description.title: Shadow Hunting Smash 422 – A Real Experience from the Field 🌿
description.body:
Today’s Shadow Hunting Smash 422 took me somewhere quiet, raw, and deeply connected to nature. Walking into this rural homestead, the first thing that caught my attention wasn’t the structure or the tools around—it was the calmness. The kind of silence that speaks louder than noise.
Right in the yard, surrounded by dry soil and scattered shade, stood a thriving patch of white flowers. Simple, yet powerful. These plants didn’t grow in perfect conditions—no rich black soil, no advanced irrigation—just resilience and consistency. And that’s exactly what Shadow Hunting is all about: spotting strength where others might overlook it.
The shadows stretched beautifully across the ground, cast by nearby trees and the structure itself. They created a natural contrast, almost like a reminder that light and darkness always coexist. As I observed closely, I realized something—growth doesn’t wait for perfect conditions. It adapts.
Behind the flowers, there’s a modest mud house, a symbol of simplicity and survival. You can tell this place has stories—hard work, patience, and daily effort. The presence of greenery around it, especially banana plants and small shrubs, shows intentional living. Nothing here is accidental.
This post isn’t just about what I saw—it’s about what it represents. In the world of Shadow Hunting Smash 422, we’re not chasing perfection. We’re discovering hidden beauty, real-life strength, and moments that often go unnoticed.
Nature teaches quietly. Whether it's a flowering plant surviving in dry soil or a shaded corner providing relief from the sun, there’s always a lesson.
Takeaway from today: Sometimes, the most powerful growth happens in the toughest environments. Keep going, even when conditions aren’t ideal.

description.title: MARRYING AFTER THE DEATH OF A SPOUSE
description.body:
We see in the bible that marriage is something that is termed to be once in lifetime, which means once you're married you remain with your spouse till death. But you can marry again if your spouse dies. Scripture teaches that marriage is “till death do us part,” and once death occurs, the surviving spouse is free from that union. This understanding brings both closure and freedom, allowing the individual to move forward without guilt.

The apostle Paul clearly addresses this in his writings, explaining that a widow or widower is free to remarry if they choose. The bible teaches us that a married woman is bound to her husband as long as he lives, but if he dies, she is released from the law of marriage. This shows that remarriage after the death of a spouse is not sinful but permitted within God’s design.

body.title: Strategy Matters More Than Monster Cards in Splinterlands
body.body:
![BEST ACTION.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/aliakbar2/23wWyTy7S3Zn1JRWYZ8Rw3wRGK82gGQy7fzSvUFFYjSVKkqAXhFwPkKkCSniorso3ztrf.png)


In the Splinterlands game only monster selection is not enough. You also need to play with proper selection, positioning and strategy which can help you win battles. If you have all of these then you play good and interesting battles and there is more chance to win every battle.

There are many users who have more focus on buying strong monster cards that can help them win the battle But I think this is not true at all. You need to have proper balance when playing any battle.

No matter how good NFT cards you have until you play with correct positioning, selection and a proper strategy you cannot win battles. 

Remember that when you play ranked battles you can be randomly selected into any mana battle. For example sometimes a low mana battle, sometimes a mid mana battle and sometimes a high mana battle.

![Screenshot 2026-04-24 112818.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/aliakbar2/23t78nfVuywoSMpAqmsMpHC1E2WNRCg182HaNP4eyE56hyrnqXJPErxnSP4LnCXYFToia.png)

You have to select monsters according to that.

If you choose monsters with high mana cost they will not help you in low mana battles. That is why making a proper team combination is very important in which you should have proper attack, defense, tank, support, melee attack and ranged attack.

That is why you should select monster cards in a way that they work in low, mid and high mana battles.

Also I believe that you should have a different strategy for every mana battle.

For example in low mana battles you have fewer card selection options because mana cost is low and after selecting a few cards your mana becomes full. In this you should focus more on support and tank monsters and also have some attacking monsters so they can keep attacking continuously.

![Screenshot 2026-04-24 112909.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/aliakbar2/23yJEDw7anPdtPWXWVH7JbnrDfC5DJRgdekDFYXJENd94uC2BPf3RQfrdcawp64kMy9AQ.png)

Similarly in mid to high mana battles your strategy should be different. You should have two tank monsters in the front and then two to three offensive monsters especially those with ranged attack so that they deal good damage to enemy units every round.

And at the end you should have two or three support monsters who continuously provide health and other support to your allied units.

Also remember that in every mana battle monster selection plays a very important role and along with that you must also take care of best positioning where to place each monster and how to use it in strategy.

![Screenshot 2026-04-24 112901.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/aliakbar2/EorzPvTcBPm87modBfVHq9ay4gP7Ek8dJXhdYmvBhtGHpUfUvELLVMiQXQF5zAxjGAk.png)

Keeping all these things in mind you can easily win even very hard battles.

What do you people think about this, is having proper strategy and card selections are essential for winning a battle? Will be glad to see your answers in the comment section.


I hope you find this post useful and informative.. If you do, please remember to reblog it so that it reaches as many people as possible and that they can benefit the most from it. Also remember to upvote which will help me financially and grow my account.

body.title: Prediction Market Tools That Help Business Owners Make Smarter Decisions
body.body: Most business decisions still come from meetings, gut feeling, and static reports. The challenge is that markets are always changing, and those approaches often fail to keep up.  \nThat is where Prediction Markets come in. Instead of depending only on opinions, they turn those opinions into measurable probabilities by allowing people to trade on what they believe will happen in the future.  \nWith the rise of [<span class=\

>Prediction Marketplace Platform Development](https://www.hashcodex.com/prediction-marketplace-development), it is now becoming much easier for businesses to actually build these systems into their own decision-making workflows rather than just observe them from the outside. Let us now look at some of the key tools and platform types that business owners should understand.

>Prediction Market Tools Every Business Owner Should Know Within a prediction market system, several key tools work together to turn expectations into usable business insights. Each tool has a specific role in how predictions are created, updated, and applied. **Market Creation and Trading Tools** These tools handle the setup of prediction events and enable participants to buy or sell positions. They continuously update probabilities in real time as new information enters the market. **Data Aggregation and Analytics Tools** These tools collect data from multiple prediction markets and convert it into structured insights. They help businesses identify trends, compare predictions, and understand moving expectations across events. **AI-Based Prediction Tools** These tools use artificial intelligence to improve forecasting quality. They help filter noise, detect unusual patterns, and refine predictions based on historical and behavioral data. **Smart Contract Infrastructure Tools** These are mainly used in decentralized prediction markets. They automate trade execution, manage payouts, and ensure transparency by enforcing rules without manual intervention. **API Integration Tools** These tools connect prediction market data with business systems such as dashboards, CRM platforms, and analytics tools. This allows prediction insights to be used directly in daily business operations.

>How Prediction Market Tools Improve Business Decision Making Prediction market tools help businesses move away from decisions based only on assumptions and past reports, and instead depend on continuously updated expectations about the future. One of the biggest improvements is better projection accuracy. Since prediction markets combine insights from multiple participants, they often reflect real-time collective expectations rather than individual opinions. This helps business owners get a clearer sense of what is more likely to happen. These tools also improve the speed of decision-making. Instead of waiting for lengthy reports or analysis cycles, businesses can observe moving probabilities as new information enters the market. This allows leaders to respond faster to changes in demand, customer behavior, or market conditions. Another key benefit is reduced bias. Traditional decision-making is often influenced by hierarchy, personal experience, or internal opinions. Prediction market tools balance this by aggregating inputs from a wider group, which helps reduce the impact of individual bias. They also strengthen risk assessment. By showing probability ranges for different outcomes, these tools help businesses understand not just what might happen, but how likely each scenario is. This makes planning and resource allocation more structured and data-driven. Finally, prediction market tools improve strategic alignment. When teams can see shared probability signals, it becomes easier to align on priorities, expectations, and execution plans. This reduces disagreement and improves coordination across departments.

>Conclusion Prediction market tools are changing the way businesses think about the future. Instead of relying only on reports or personal opinions, they show what many people together expect to happen in real time. Different parts of this system like platforms, trading features, AI support, blockchain, and APIs that work together to make predictions more useful for everyday business decisions. When used well, they help leaders make faster and clearer decisions. There are still some challenges, like getting enough people to participate, understanding the results properly, and fitting these tools into existing systems. But these problems are becoming easier as the technology improves. Overall, prediction market tools are becoming an important part of modern business. Teams like **Hashcodex** can build smart systems that turn people’s shared expectations into useful insights, helping businesses make better and more confident decisions about the future.

body.title: Có thể nhận biết dấu hiệu thai làm tổ tại nhà không?
body.body:
Dấu hiệu thai làm tổ thường xuất hiện sớm nhưng mức độ nhẹ, khiến nhiều phụ nữ băn khoăn liệu có thể tự nhận biết tại nhà hay không. Thực tế, một số biểu hiện vẫn có thể quan sát nếu theo dõi kỹ cơ thể. Tuy nhiên, chị em cần hiểu rõ đặc điểm của từng dấu hiệu để tránh nhầm lẫn với các triệu chứng sinh lý khác.

▶️▶️▶️ Tham khảo thêm:

<https://thethaovanhoa.vn/dau-hieu-nhan-biet-thai-da-vao-to-an-toan-duoi-goc-nhin-san-khoa-20260122141147994.htm>

<https://www.deviantart.com/sonyasaran/journal/Vi-sao-khong-the-nhan-biet-dau-hieu-thai-vao-to-1325273135>

<https://portfolium.com/entry/dau-hieu-thai-dang-vao-to-xuat-hien-khi-nao>

## **Thai làm tổ là hiện tượng gì?**

Thai làm tổ là quá trình phôi sau khi thụ tinh di chuyển vào tử cung và bám vào lớp niêm mạc tử cung để phát triển. Đây là bước quan trọng đánh dấu sự khởi đầu của thai kỳ. Quá trình này thường diễn ra trong khoảng 6 - 12 ngày sau thụ tinh. Khi phôi bám thành công, cơ thể bắt đầu thay đổi nội tiết, từ đó xuất hiện các dấu hiệu mang thai sớm.

## **Có thể nhận biết dấu hiệu thai làm tổ tại nhà không?**

Có, nhưng không hoàn toàn chính xác. Một số dấu hiệu thai làm tổ có thể nhận biết tại nhà thông qua thay đổi của cơ thể, tuy nhiên các biểu hiện này thường nhẹ và dễ nhầm lẫn với triệu chứng tiền kinh hoặc rối loạn nội tiết. Cụ thể:

### **Ra máu báo thai**

Ra máu báo thai là một trong những dấu hiệu thai làm tổ sớm mà nhiều phụ nữ có thể nhận thấy. Hiện tượng này xảy ra khi phôi bám vào niêm mạc tử cung, làm tổn thương các mạch máu nhỏ. Máu thường có màu hồng nhạt hoặc nâu, lượng rất ít và chỉ kéo dài khoảng 1 - 2 ngày.

### **Căng tức hoặc đau nhẹ ở ngực**

Khi thai bắt đầu làm tổ, hormone trong cơ thể thay đổi rõ rệt, đặc biệt là estrogen và progesterone. Sự thay đổi này kích thích tuyến vú phát triển, khiến ngực trở nên căng, nhạy cảm hoặc đau nhẹ khi chạm vào. Đây là phản ứng sinh lý bình thường khi cơ thể chuẩn bị cho thai kỳ.

### **Đau bụng dưới**

Cảm giác đau âm ỉ vùng bụng dưới là dấu hiệu thường gặp khi phôi bám vào thành tử cung. Cơn đau thường nhẹ, không kéo dài và tương tự đau bụng kinh nhưng mức độ thấp hơn. Nếu đau tăng dần hoặc kéo dài bất thường, chị em cần theo dõi và kiểm tra sớm.

### **Chuột rút**

Trong giai đoạn thai làm tổ, một số phụ nữ có thể cảm thấy đau nhẹ hoặc xuất hiện chuột rút ở vùng bụng dưới. Đây là phản ứng khi tử cung bắt đầu thay đổi để tiếp nhận phôi. Cảm giác này khá giống đau bụng kinh nhưng thường nhẹ và không kéo dài. Nếu chuột rút kèm theo ra máu nhiều hoặc đau dữ dội, chị em cần thăm khám ngay để loại trừ nguy cơ bất thường.

## **Kết luận**

Dấu hiệu thai làm tổ có thể nhận biết tại nhà thông qua một số biểu hiện như ra máu báo thai, căng ngực, đau bụng dưới hoặc chuột rút. Tuy nhiên, các dấu hiệu này không đặc hiệu và dễ gây nhầm lẫn. Để xác định chính xác, phụ nữ nên thăm khám tại Bệnh viện Đại học Phenikaa, nơi cung cấp các phương pháp xét nghiệm và siêu âm chuyên sâu, giúp theo dõi thai kỳ an toàn ngay từ giai đoạn đầu.
