body.title: Should People Pay For Their Past Opinions?
body.body: > Okay so this is actually a topic I feel very strongly about, and I think a lot of people will relate to what I am about to say, Like, have you ever gone back and looked at stuff you posted years ago? because I have, and honestly? It is actually painful, see I am talking full body cringe, rushing to hit delete before anyone else sees it, so the things I thought were cool or funny or worth sharing back then… yeah, no, Not it, and if I can look at my own old posts and think ....what was I even on,.... then I think it is only fair we extend that same grace to other people too. ... ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmagRGDwYp9nqRDCqpTya6Zr6kGvsPDhuD1ET5g3YuYaoo/1777025896086.png) Here's the thing about growth, it is indeed real, truth is people change, That is not just something we say to make ourselves feel better, it is literally how life works the person you were at 15, 19, 20 is not the same person you are today, Your experiences shape you, the people you meet shape you, the things you go through shape you, so why are we so quick to drag someone back to who they used to be when they have clearly moved past it? Now see I am not that saying everyone deserves a free pass, yeah.... there is actually a difference between someone who said something ignorant because they genuinely did not know better and someone who was just outright malicious and has shown zero signs of changing, those are two very different situations, but a lot of the cancellations we see? They are not even about the second type of person, they are about somebody who said something dumb years ago, has since grown, apologised, and literally become a different human being and yet the internet decides that is still who they are, that does not sit right with me. And the scary part is that this affects our real lives, we are talking about people losing jobs, losing deals, losing their whole career over some posts from a decade ago, see ehn, how is that fair? You are essentially punishing someone for a version of themselves that does not even exist anymore, it is like going back in time to arrest someone for a crime they haven't committed yet, except even weirder because the person has already served their growth journey and come out better on the other side. I also think social media has made this worse because everything is archived, every stupid thing you said at 17 is just sitting there, waiting to be screenshot and sent around, we are literally the first generation having to deal with our entire digital history being held against us, people who grew up before the internet could say dumb stuff, cringe about it years later, and move on quietly, we don't get that luxury, and it's honestly a bit unfair. Look, accountability matters, I am not arguing against that, If someone does something wrong, they should own it, address it, and do the work, but there has to be a point where we decide that the work has been done and we let people move forward, because if we never allow people to grow past their worst moments, what are we really encouraging? we are basically telling people that no matter how much they change, it won't matter and that's a dangerous message, the world should focus more on who people are today, not to ignore history, but to recognise that history does not have to be destiny, people mess up, people learn, people become better, and when they do, they deserve the chance to live in that better version of themselves without the past constantly being weaponised against them. That's just my honest take. body.title: Downsizing with Purpose - A new Chapter at Home
body.body:
![1000071598.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/aideleijoie/242NcojSdnU86YRadRqsKxszsh9jQLfbh9LeS4GaSGwq1yt3q5LmhiKxvMoajL6ubybir.jpg)


Lately, my husband and I have been quietly working on a plan one that feels both practical and hopeful. We’ve decided to downsize our living space, not by moving out, but by transforming part of our home into something meaningful and income-generating.


![1000071594.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/aideleijoie/23xefxAkfYi6ufJTCEtd2ZfJkwziMxdoD2nMS35VdkepESH4TdUJHAribuCUoe7wd4CiM.jpg)


The idea is simple: we’ll rent out half of our first floor - the dining area, kitchen, and laundry space while keeping the rest of the house for ourselves. It’s a decision rooted in both wisdom and vision. Not only will it provide us with additional income, but it will also lessen the space I need to clean and maintain every day. A win-win, truly. Of course, turning this vision into reality takes work and patience.


![1000071584.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/aideleijoie/23xyNmC7wuNE4dnhpUMP4RpprSJUT4YHyZH2Yx8yn5N63DH7RPeVmpvtvSd51Dgj2Sxix.jpg)

![1000071585.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/aideleijoie/23xAPJVvQu9fWHR1Um8RMd1S3pzoWR6w6Zg3rpGrdS5ZpLC8toBJ3kpuVS4ce183o1TfM.jpg)

![1000071597.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/aideleijoie/242Nek4PECMRvwDUjzHiqPPAAkiUuGWu82cUDcS2MNjnoDALZsNRYnEYj8YYDysQbW6TS.jpg)





My husband has been tirelessly focusing on the electrical lines, carefully separating the connections between what will be our private space (the second and third floors) and the rental area downstairs. 


![1000070012.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/aideleijoie/23wgMmbQr9JAsZmTwLt3ZPkx29us1tJcYgQQcTKy3oyEbFGMkUWqjDYidr2tzpSsd7Y99.jpg)

![1000070010.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/aideleijoie/23wC5V4Un8VY8JHmdZ1stPmXQMoStVXTAWmsa8Fn8SYBwa9LA7Z8pXbfKWuds6tQK2ATf.jpg)

![1000070004.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/aideleijoie/23w2qGtLd9XrX46f83TtQacMsvvzjupin6cQgZuGQWur5P9J8M4zz5ZyTXsGxJA6NusES.jpg)




We’re keeping the front terrace and living room as a shared access area, but the hallway leading to the dining space along with a small receiving area that already has its own toilet and bath will soon be sealed off and transformed into a private, self-contained unit.


![1000070021.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/aideleijoie/23vhwxdGXZi5mT7Lt5j7d92QELUQFPTmzErALhhXbfxgmxuDgdbLQgCmhoEMtbxDFLYN2.jpg)

![1000070050.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/aideleijoie/23w2cJWUwek7fiqXG6fdh6rk7vosqZNvL5qHXzQtGFAYNPtJz7NoJAoWDEuSu3UzEt9hC.jpg)

![1000071582.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/aideleijoie/23zbPRkpc3o6zD64UVm6NnvLSxHVcFzvCQtRLKq9AqG3oCy9e7LGaqV3yXa7gDbZkQJdG.jpg)

Little by little, it’s all coming together.





![1000070631.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/aideleijoie/23uQtiPr6V5sZBeUeViaCMKBA3KNcovSfJ4dFJnuhxgHPwixMXcCAZDBbT3gGLrB2SS4E.jpg)

![1000070630.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/aideleijoie/23w2nsb5rKR2q4DJZgPKxBmJbNXpgSGotLHodXBUAQimAwUd2L82aTemwFXqjeiMnexot.jpg)

![1000070016.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/aideleijoie/23xVMPUYYiCTrexaKBJdLd8QwPHZdAEp8GS2jDeMD4ornQZWiTv9kGggkRNKn7MVuJoUz.jpg)

What excites me most is imagining who might live there someday. The space is actually perfect for a young couple starting out. It’s spacious and thoughtfully laid out—with a bedroom, living room, dining area, kitchen, laundry space, and its own toilet and bath. There’s even room for motorbike parking, which makes it even more practical.


![1000070633.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/aideleijoie/23x19AiFsGMXz2FcPaZbTVLL4pVW41e3BV6kxi3kuc9g262P3kmXixeoZPjkc51U1nrwk.jpg)

![1000070631.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/aideleijoie/23uQtiPr6V5sZBeUeViaCMKBA3KNcovSfJ4dFJnuhxgHPwixMXcCAZDBbT3gGLrB2SS4E.jpg)

![1000070023.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/aideleijoie/23xp8JVJSQoPLKx5UjDXqagPg1nMkpsi3NWW5sE3Xm1Heu6SZMnbozXviPjxEmxuxCVSx.jpg)

![1000070022.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/aideleijoie/23xAa7Ze7FyyNnYUWzRVCBGukd9cpU9jECyTDk6WUDnsYrhYcANKhEdQtpKnzZEL9i9vB.jpg)



While my husband works on the technical side of things, I’ve been doing my part too. Recently giving our overhead cabinets a fresh coat of varnish. It may seem like a small detail, but it’s part of the bigger picture we’re building together.


![1000071580.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/aideleijoie/23uQrWdQQZ5i8yCMQxu8CPjUtK9svTgYSYG3NrHVdu3TWH6Mid5nNUjTSYSo3c5FuUKhN.jpg)

![1000071575.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/aideleijoie/23yd22AGuYAfDfo3EkMQt4113UxFGWnW1AbSKa53NfynzfYCsueMgdchN7v8XiPkWJkgk.jpg)


This project isn’t just about making space it’s about creating stability for our future. The added income will help support us financially and, in many ways, serve as a stepping stone toward our retirement plans. Since basically we are like empty nesters now. After our son graduate from College, He will make his own way Into the world. Finding and building a life for himself.


![1000071586.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/aideleijoie/23xeZNNDp3xpYbQFAWo3oYxLvk3VdUkHCUCJ9JbVjjGbhYMdW5i4Gd92FZdeUUhnze3YY.jpg)


![1000070032.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/aideleijoie/23u5y2FJkNnAxGPgo4hDH8zffakDkYMfk5g7RLjmgNJcapVY9zR4HjGMeGbHfpmUoQMxN.jpg)

We’re aiming to have everything ready by June. It’s an ambitious timeline, especially since my husband is doing all the work himself but we believe in the beauty of “slowly but surely.” tiring, yes it will be since I will be climbing up and down bringing all our stuff up. Imagining it now just makes me want to hire someone to do it all but hey where's the hardwork in it and the value. It would be great for my legs, exercise!😩🥴

![1000070052.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/aideleijoie/23xVEbZ1JKVK7kiWFCWSMx45KcZcMtPyPuSJYM93nDzDBoAEb4pb1yZqWHJcUGTF7DK8R.jpg)

![1000070036.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/aideleijoie/23ywoAkZoPQHBhbmRwy7xE92wsqYySQ8AJj4CJN2PWmXN9tPHaMksMFqcTfQtD4GUf3Pp.jpg)


![1000071601.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/aideleijoie/23vhqH5KFzmF9GyhW96wqtdEkYtza3Dt2yaFWNBcqNYJvF7fhTEpUtxgDXHRU3prWUdbC.jpg)

![1000071612.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/aideleijoie/23wMWDtKPbGHReQ48TN7NLMLTGfppkNit1G1qEsfKyNn7CV5ij8gtXeHH95oRQGWopVMa.jpg)

![1000071602.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/aideleijoie/23y8sb8FsngTpdZ9DB5apaPhXXgmHwQ9t1guwpGmbfPVsrAC6Qj6oQNyQtWnWwcB1Lezc.jpg)



Once the downstairs is ready, we’ll begin our next transition which is moving up to the third floor. Right now, it’s mostly a drying area for our laundry and a storage space for our extra things. But soon, it will become our new living space. We have to begin somewhere and while we still have the strength to do them.
My golden body isn't functioning that easily while I was in my 30's and 40's. Feeling those aches at night now😅


![1000071605.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/aideleijoie/23uQnR5Lesikx6AQWQonU9PqL9ftiU19JfXWw5nhFyzwo4g6rpHpvPyBbi2H5GqUDbABy.jpg)

![1000071607.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/aideleijoie/23w2mSEnPSD3Xc52UB9j67WFeptusWkzCUheDrPNxnAHdNFLSWSQMWt63vNUe88h59Qw2.jpg)

![1000071606.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/aideleijoie/23wqeRPmyQ7D6dm4urBjjoySqTEdcGrsuXAYSxWdf9cbZzHtyAdmg1VJMw8FvGwfQ1Lni.jpg)


It will take another round of adjustments and effort, moving everything from downstairs and reimagining that upper floor into a cozy home. But I’m actually looking forward to it. There’s something peaceful about that space, especially with its lovely view of our neighbors’ homes nestled along the mountainside.


![1000071609.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/aideleijoie/245HkwVYzGSPS53MYQkBgGeiECUfsN7JFJfrMR6hEuAHRUiRr982mVtoxZZdfKWwN4KmV.jpg)

![1000071608.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/aideleijoie/2449yz1aL8p5gCY84nco9FufQoiVzxhUn6HsZprT78QYywsyUWGataiHGojKL4Lcphxvh.jpg)




This journey we’re on it’s not rushed, not perfect, but it’s full of intention.

![1000067271.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/aideleijoie/243BnzrfhAGAr3hHKQiG2NuhL3Dd8Q2sGggphnpB95CsA4CZGubKdkB88cDkysidGtCAg.jpg)



We’re building something not just for today, but for the years ahead. And in every wire fixed, every wall built, and every cabinet polished, I see a future that we are creating together one step at a time.

![1000071432.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/aideleijoie/23u5vRK3mB7BJB78eYXUfQYarX6Bjesawebu6kVbShUi7XwdLEtMpKLTcBEQ19y1CedHH.jpg)

Hope you enjoyed reading my post.

Remember, you can do anything as long as you put your heart and soul into it.

With love,
@aideleijoie♥️

body.title: Topic Review: Keeping in the family intact
body.body:
https://youtu.be/PC9wjZh-kyg

When people lack family or fail to nurture it, they often feel hopeless. This is why we must honor, protect and invest in our families, just as Jesus did. 

An inspiring example is David, who, even while fleeing from King Saul, remained deeply concerned for his family's safety. Despite facing danger and uncertainty, David made sure his parents were protected. 

Like Jesus, he demonstrated that true strength includes responsibility and care for family. So we must endeavour to thank God for fathers and for the family system He designed to sustain us. 

We must never at any time take our family for granted because God treasures family.

body.title: Jakarta Diary - Novotel, Moutai, & Biz
body.body:
![Jakarta.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/macchiata/23xAXkf5gfTHv9ZQUhhn6HzBePPzQTJDBKAaRev1fXYedF1gWe99ALfY8wZaN3ggsS44a.png)
Recently, I accompanied my mother to Jakarta for some business and networking events. During our stay in Jakarta, we traveled around the area and visited some of our business partners. Eventually, we stayed at Novotel Magga Dua which is located in North Jakarta. Novotel Mangga Dua is basically a 4 stars hotel offering family and business stays. It boasts proximity to points of interest around North Jakarta such as Ancol and Mangga Dua shopping districts. In this area, many of its visitors are from East-Asia and restaurants around also cater towards those demographics. If you enjoy a night out with beer and shaokao, or with a glass of Moutai, this area is perfect for you.
![](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/macchiata/23zS2xALfYWpNhbkUGhfYyaXrvyJ9XpkMb5owXafiy2eqeVapBU1fHHrFdj2KY7f39F1R.jpeg)
The room I stayed in has a bathtub and co-working space. It also has the free breakfast included which has an Asian and Western style buffet. One of my favorite parts about the room was the chair that was just great to sit and work from. Though, I didn’t get much done there but it was super comfortable and if I have a room, I would have designed it that way. The bathroom was nicely decorated and designed. Other than the room that was just fine, it was the breakfast options and the coffee that fits my style. They also serve proper coffee and patrons can easily make coffee from the instant machine available in the place.
![](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/macchiata/23uFVvEp4qgpVSRzR2aUWe77FQPVQ8e7YPEu9u5vm8viW78HG8L8sVkhujN8o1hctNDPn.jpeg)
![WhatsApp Image 2026-04-24 at 5.14.30 PM (1).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/macchiata/23uQtFLAcG2j8T9SBxCedHhzT9g85sgGTg1XjHWgoc4w4WULEr13YMYWy9bPx5WR5yVcU.jpeg)
The view from our window was simply skyscrapers and we were at the 7th level of the hotel. The pool and other amenities are located on the 5th floor of the area. I got to check out the swimming pool during breakfast and it was so tempting to be swimming there. However, at the time, we still had some people and places to check out. During the entire trip from Yogyakarta to Jakarta and back again to Madiun, Novotel was the highlight of my trip this time. It was comfortable and I had such a good rest. I love all the amenities and the convenience it offers.
![](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/macchiata/23zbFJssQiWuQ5wTDHxBSVXTvzBR7hZCZ14fg5BdgiWThxfzZbYQTg3DS3Xaa8dkQVji1.jpeg)
![](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/macchiata/245mrnBaRZ4cnaqeGz6RzbDUXT7rR1wXSbWv63qhhZ6euf8nBsRWqfq72tKwnH73LfNCH.jpeg)
Once we checked out, we traveled to a few more places until it was time for us to go back to another place where we would wait for our train. We stayed at my mom’s apartment, which made me just want to stay longer. If I had the chance to work from Jakarta, I certainly would do that compared to working from East Java and Madiun. Somehow, I felt like Jakarta has advanced just like any other areas in Bangkok or Malaysia. Though there are differences, it isn’t that significant. A part of me is really drawn to the city and urban life where it never sleeps. So, maybe in the future, despite how bleak the future might seem for Jakarta, I still would love to try to actually work from there and live from one of its high rise buildings. Not to mention, Jakarta is a lot closer internationally too and in hindsight, it isn’t that difficult to actually navigate around the place as long as we know how to get there and the salary is good enough to actually sustain life in this city.

body.title: My review on Mcgi: How to overcome drug addiction
body.body:
Overcoming drug addiction from a biblical perspective begins with recognizing our need for God’s help and surrendering our struggles to Him. The Bible teaches that true strength does not come from ourselves alone but from God who empowers us to change. Anyone who lowers his or herself and seek for God mercy, the person will be saved.

>The  Scripture says, “I can do all things through Christ which strengtheneth me” (Philippians 4:13).

Making up your mind is very necessary to overcome addiction. The Bible encourages believers to replace harmful thoughts and habits with godly ones through prayer, reading Scripture, and surrounding themselves with positive influences. Our mind usually go back to addiction whenever we are isolated in a quiet environment. 

>“Be not conformed to this world: but be ye transformed by the renewing of your mind” (Romans 12:2)

body.title: 24 April 2026, Freewriters Community Daily Writing Prompt Day 3083: it’s not that hard
body.body:
Looking after our overall well-being isn't a luxury, nor is it that difficult. Small daily habits can make a big difference. Walk for an hour or two every day. If you can't or don't have the means to go to a gym, walking helps a lot. Try to eat healthily, connect more with the simple things, with nature. We don't have to wait to be in a wide-open field to do this; we can take walks outdoors in a field, at home, in our garden, breathe deeply, take time to quiet our minds and breathe, connect with our inner world, listen to our bodies' signals, dance, laugh more, get together with friends and neighbors. It's not so difficult if we do our part. Health is the powerful foundation of our entire being; we must take care of it, honor it, and never take it for granted. Taking care of it is our greatest act of self-love. >Procurar nuestro bienestar integral no es lujo, tampoco es tan difícil, con pequeños hábitos diarios le nos hacemos una gran diferencia. Caminemos diariamente una o dos horas, sino podemos o no tenemos para ir a un gimnasio, caminar nos ayuda mucho, procuremos comer saludable, conectemos más con lo simple, con la naturaleza no tenemos que esperar a estar en un gran campo abierto para hacerlo, podemos hacer paseos al aire libre en un campo, en nuestra casa, con nuestro jardín, respirar profundo, tomemos un tiempo de parar nuestra mente y respiremos conectemos con nuestro mundo interior, acatemos las señales de nuestro cuerpo, bailemos, riamos más, reunirnos con amigos y vecinos, no es tan difícil si ponemos de nuestra parte la salud es la base poderosa de todo nuestro ser, hay que cuidarla, honrrarla y no daría por sentada cuidarla es nuestro mayor acto de amor propio. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmRzDxRAwg4jp5Y7a9wYJgCVGZzRFyBuTTRq7ECcM8R2o2/1777025835035.jpg) This post is my entry for the daily writing challenge, hosted by @mariannewest. body.title: They Already Understand What It Means
body.body:
Of course, Will was talking about education here, which is powerful and very, very, very amazing because we also focus on education and edtech education. But we don't do it majorly online. We take it from the online space and we take it to the classrooms because in Africa, we have a lot of people in schools who just want to study and then come out of school. 

You know what I mean? Like the old system of education now where people just want to depend on jobs and then they sit in their office and all of that. And the funny thing in Africa is that a lot of students, they graduate, no job, nothing. So what we're doing is we're connecting the schools and these young students and these young adults to the global community and to the global technology.

Recently, we have a recent partnership with an amazing personnel. His name is Richard, and he's an inventor. He deals in food energy. 

So imagine you're taking this to the classroom instead of the student to be just reading this. They build things. They innovate. 

And they don't just innovate because it is blockchain we're taking to the classroom. They own whatever they are building. That is the new revolution we are bringing to all the classrooms in Nigeria and in Africa.

And yes, for the good news, for the record, we've already had more than currently we had more than 200 emails from different schools because we've not started going to the schools to educate.


But already, we just send out proposals, not just proposals, we send out the proposals and then we train these teachers. Right, the reason why we're not going out there to train a lot of students is because we are gathering an amount of executive members. Currently, our executive members are just 50, all right? Out of the 50, we have just 20 educators, right? 20 educators, and we're also converting blockchain and web play into cartoon, and that will be very, very easy for children to understand.

As I'm speaking, some of the schools that we started were already educating. The children already understand what a blockchain is. They already understand what it means to be in a decentralised ecosystem.

body.title: Digimon Survive [Let's Play] - 70 - Mermaimon
body.body:
***Truthful Route: Session 17! The enemy takes Miyuki, but we unlock a new evolution!***


-----

**Digimon Survive** is a Digimon Visual Novel with Turn-based strategy battles. It follows a group of children stranded in another world. They form bonds with the creators there called Digimon as they desperate attempts to find a way back home. I already finished one route of the game, and now I'm publishing my playthrough of the Truthful Route!

 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmfP9Pt4V5AJzEo3Y7bUSwCVDheaYDnGBq9m246ePdXgpk/1000072304.webp 

 


Digimon Survive is the darkest piece of Digimon media I ever consumed while still being PG13. What I love the most about **Digimon Survive**, is how it uniquely blends Digital Monsters with Japanese folklore. It's amazing how the idea of \

integrates seamlessly with Digimon lore. The specific Digimon they choose for this game enhance this theme.

Digimon Survive is the closest modern entry to the *old school* Digimon anime vibes. Though, more than the earlier Digimon anime series, the game reminds me more of **Shin Megami Tensei: Devil Survivor** series. In that series too, characters may die depending on your actions.

Below you can watch my playthrough of Digimon Survive, and the link to the whole playlist.

**THIS PLAYTHROUGH IS MODDED:** I installed the [Improved Translation Mod](https://gamebanana.com/mods/459533) and the [Quirky Dialogue Font Mod.](https://gamebanana.com/mods/459571) This playthrough should look a bit different from the official version.


----

### Watch on YouTube:


https://youtu.be/L92_P_mlmZI


**Playlist:**

```
 https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLt3R7_tP1xaH9mASCoJsRIYN96RihTAtI
```

### Truthful Route - 17: Mermaimon


A lot happens in this session, but most of it is repeat of what happened during my first run. Ryo and Shuuji are there this time, but they don't affect the plot very much. (It's still nice to see their perspective, though.)

The biggest new things is that Miu's Syakomon evolved into her ultimate form: Mermaimon

It was about time we tried Grosso’s pizzas; we’d been wanting to eat there for ages, so we took advantage of the fact that we were nearby. 

It’s a pretty cozy and modern restaurant; we could watch the pizzaiolo assemble the pizzas since they have a central island with a counter where you can see part of the preparation process, and he’d send them to the wood-fired oven to cook. They specialize in Neapolitan pizzas, and we ordered one Prosciutto e Funghi and one Pomo D'oro; both had basil, which I loved. The crust was very thin in the center but a bit fluffy around the edges, which I also love. Quality and price go hand in hand because it’s quite affordable, and the atmosphere was very quiet when we went, so the pizzas arrived super fast. We were very happy—it really surprised us—so we gave it a 9/10.

# ESP

Ya era hora de probar las pizzas de Grosso, teníamos un montón de tiempo con muchas ganas de comer allí así que aprovechamos que estábamos cerca del lugar. 

Es un restaurante bastante cómodo y moderno, pudimos ver como el pizzero armaba las pizzas ya que tienen una isla central con una barra donde se ve parte de la Preparación y las enviaba a la leña para su cocción. Son especializados en pizzas napolitanas y pedimos una de Prosciutto e funghi y otra de Pomo D'oro, ambas llevaban albahaca lo cual me encantó, la masa estaba muy fina en el centro pero en las orillas era un poco esponjosa, cosa que también me encanta. La calidad y el precio van de la mano porque es bastante asequible y el ambiente estaba muy tranquilo a la hora que fuimos por lo que llegaron súper rápido las pizzas. Quedamos muy contentos, nos sorprendió bastante, así que le dimos un 9/10.

body.title: Interns Should Definitely get some Money.
body.body:
Hi Hivelearners friends.
In any country, we see that no young person gets a job so easily. Even after working hard day and night, even after getting good marks, they do not get a job. It is said that there is no experience. Unless the company gives a job to someone without experience, how can one get experience? When a person has obtained a new degree and has only been completing his studies for a few days, how can he get experience from anywhere?
Here, the way it is now, if an institution calls someone for experience, if they do not give him money, how will he live his life because he has already studied for 10-12 years and his money has been spent a lot. And then we also see that parents do not have enough money to give to their children. Therefore, what I want to say here is that those who do internships should definitely get some compensation.
The benefit of this compensation is that they will continue to pay for their petrol expenses and there are many other expenses. When a person leaves the house, there are many things that require a lot of money to spend. The advantage of this is that they will not have to ask their parents for money again. Now, if we talk about the industrial areas in our country or our city, these industrial areas are always built far away from the city so that people do not have to face problems due to noise and smoke because whenever the machines run, they make noise.

/> \[Source\](https://unsplash.com/photos/a-man-sitting-at-a-desk-in-front-of-a-computer-iKlvMVVoexs)
When we go so far away for an experience for a year or two, then it will be very difficult to meet the daily expenses. If no compensation is given, then the children will not gain experience and then they will not get a job either. Therefore, what I have to say here is that all the government institutions or private institutions, if they give any benefits like this, they should definitely give compensation to these people because after studying for such a long time,
Every human being wants to do something in the future that will make my parents happy. The metro here also does not go to the industrial area and its route was designed in such a way that it would be taken from the entire city to the university so that the problems of all the children who are studying can be eased and they can reach their university with less money.

/> \[Source\](https://unsplash.com/photos/white-spiral-notebook-on-table-RB9LxkWC9tE)
Therefore, if we take a rickshaw to go there, the fare for the return trip will be seven to eight hundred rupees. When the child does not have any money, how will he gain experience and how can he live a good life in the future? Therefore, what I want to say here is that time is passing quickly, so we have to think about many things and change many things.
Therefore, on today's topic, my only saying is that children should definitely get money because they work hard, they also get experience there and after some time they become so much trained that they start working.

Asad-chughtai is a writer, blogger, crypto trader, and nature lover. My goal is to share these special places and natural sights with all of you.

body.title: Dấu hiệu thụ thai sau 3 ngày quan hệ dưới góc nhìn sinh lý
body.body:
Dấu hiệu thụ thai sau 3 ngày quan hệ là mối quan tâm của nhiều người khi muốn nhận biết sớm khả năng mang thai. Tuy nhiên, dưới góc nhìn sinh lý, cơ thể cần thời gian để hoàn tất các bước đầu của quá trình thụ tinh trước khi xuất hiện biểu hiện rõ ràng. Bệnh viện Đại học Phenikaa cho biết việc hiểu đúng những thay đổi trong giai đoạn này giúp bạn tránh nhầm lẫn và theo dõi chính xác hơn.

▶️▶️▶️ Tham khảo thêm:

<https://eva.vn/tin-tuc-suc-khoe/dau-hieu-nhan-biet-co-thai-sau-3-ngay-quan-he-co-that-hay-chi-la-cam-giac-c296a658335.html>

[https://www.deviantart.com/sonyasaran/journal/Hieu-dung-dau-hieu-mang-thai-sau-3-ngay-quan-he-132490618](https://www.deviantart.com/sonyasaran/journal/Hieu-dung-dau-hieu-mang-thai-sau-3-ngay-quan-he-1324906189)

<https://portfolium.com/entry/dau-hieu-thu-thai-sau-3-ngay-quan-he>

## **Cơ thể thay đổi gì trong 3 ngày đầu sau khi quan hệ?**

Trong 3 ngày đầu sau quan hệ, nếu gặp đúng thời điểm rụng trứng, tinh trùng có thể kết hợp với trứng để hình thành hợp tử. Tuy nhiên, ở giai đoạn này, hợp tử mới bắt đầu phân chia và di chuyển trong vòi trứng. Quá trình này diễn ra âm thầm và chưa tạo ra tác động rõ rệt đến toàn bộ cơ thể.

Các hormone liên quan đến thai kỳ chưa được kích hoạt, nên cơ thể hầu như chưa có phản ứng đặc trưng. Một số thay đổi nhẹ có thể xuất hiện nhưng thường liên quan đến biến động nội tiết tự nhiên sau rụng trứng, không phản ánh trực tiếp việc thụ thai.


## **Dấu hiệu thụ thai sau 3 ngày quan hệ dưới góc nhìn sinh lý**

Xét về sinh lý, dấu hiệu thụ thai sau 3 ngày quan hệ gần như chưa thể nhận biết. Lý do là cơ thể chưa bước vào giai đoạn thay đổi nội tiết liên quan đến thai kỳ. Hormone hCG, yếu tố đóng vai trò quan trọng trong việc tạo ra các dấu hiệu mang thai, chưa được sản xuất ở mức đủ để gây biểu hiện.

Một số cảm giác như mệt nhẹ, nhạy cảm hơn hoặc thay đổi tâm trạng có thể xảy ra. Tuy nhiên, những biểu hiện này không đặc hiệu và dễ bị nhầm với phản ứng sinh lý thông thường của cơ thể. Bệnh viện Đại học Phenikaa khuyến nghị không nên dựa vào các dấu hiệu này để kết luận đã thụ thai quá sớm.

## **Khi nào cơ thể bắt đầu ghi nhận dấu hiệu thụ thai rõ ràng?**

Cơ thể chỉ bắt đầu xuất hiện dấu hiệu rõ ràng khi phôi hoàn tất quá trình tương tác với niêm mạc tử cung và kích hoạt thay đổi nội tiết. Khi đó, hormone hCG tăng lên và dẫn đến các biểu hiện như trễ kinh, buồn nôn, nhạy cảm với mùi hoặc thay đổi ở vùng ngực.

Để xác định chính xác, nên theo dõi chu kỳ kinh nguyệt và sử dụng que thử thai vào thời điểm phù hợp. Việc kiểm tra đúng thời điểm giúp tăng độ chính xác và hạn chế nhầm lẫn do đánh giá quá sớm.

## **Kết luận**

Dấu hiệu thụ thai sau 3 ngày quan hệ dưới góc nhìn sinh lý thường chưa xuất hiện do cơ thể chưa có sự thay đổi nội tiết rõ rệt. Theo khuyến nghị từ Bệnh viện Đại học Phenikaa, việc hiểu đúng tiến trình này giúp bạn tránh nhầm lẫn với các biểu hiện sinh lý thông thường và chủ động theo dõi sức khỏe sinh sản một cách hợp lý. 

---

Hello beautiful friends in Throw Back Thursday community. I know that this is coming late for today because since yesterday I have been trying to make this post but having issues with network. I love doing my post very early on Thursday. But all the same I still made it for today.


This is me sharing the experience that I heard with masquerades in the Village where I went to for a burial ceremony.

I traveled home since last week Friday and up till now I am still in the Village. One of the major problem there is bad network and that is even the reason why I am making this post very late at this moment.

I last saw masquerades ten years or more back and back then I use to be afraid of the masquerade because we were told when we were kids that masquerade is a spirit. So we thought that is the spirit of the dead that comes around to frighten people once in a while. But when I grew up I discovered that we were told lies by our parents just to keep us away from the masquerade because some of those masquerade are very dangerous. They go into diabetic means just to prepare themselves for the day of masquerade display in the village square. 

Today I saw the masquerade displaying while we were at the burial. It was a good site to behold because I love their dance and everything about them. I also saw children running away from the masquerade crying and I quickly remembered my childhood days when I use to run away from the masquerade like this kids today.

Please do enjoy the video. Drop your comment and share with friends

body.title: 💛 A veces lo simple es lo que más cuesta [ Esp - Eng ] 💛 Sometimes the simplest things are the hardest
body.body:
>  

24 de abril de 2026, Comunidad Freewriters – Reto Diario de Escritura Día 3083: no es tan difícil 💭

Viernes, y uno ya anda con otra actitud, eso no falla. Como que todo fluye un poco mejor, el ánimo cambia y hasta lo que venías cargando en la semana pesa menos. Pero en medio de esa buena vibra, pasa algo curioso, te das cuenta de que hay cosas que eran simples y uno mismo las complicó sin necesidad.

Porque siendo sinceros, muchas veces sabes lo que tienes que hacer, pero igual lo piensas demasiado, dudas, lo dejas para después. Y al final era algo sencillo. Como si uno mismo se pusiera trabas.

Hoy quiero hablar de eso, de lo simple que a veces se nos vuelve difícil sin razón.
___________

<center>![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmY7shNVsoMt667uhqmxDbC8ikASfXwBhn5YKnTX38eC9f/image.png)</center>

<center>*\

*</center>
___________

Si algo he aprendido en este camino es que muchas veces lo que parece difícil no lo es tanto, somos nosotros los que lo cargamos de más. Cuando tomé la decisión de salir de Venezuela, no fue fácil, claro que no, pero tampoco era imposible. El miedo estaba, las dudas también, dejar todo atrás pesa, pero al final era dar el paso. Y muchas veces uno se queda pensando demasiado en lo que puede pasar, en lo que puede salir mal, cuando en realidad lo único que hace falta es decidirse y avanzar.

Ya estando aquí en Argentina, empezar de cero tampoco fue sencillo. Nuevo país, nuevas costumbres, otra realidad. Trabajo, responsabilidades, adaptarse a todo. Pero con el tiempo uno se da cuenta de algo, muchas de esas cosas que al principio parecían enormes, poco a poco se van resolviendo. No porque desaparezcan, sino porque uno deja de darles tantas vueltas y simplemente hace lo que tiene que hacer. Paso a paso, sin tanto drama.

Incluso en lo más personal, en lo más profundo, también pasa. Aprender a seguir después de perder a mi hija María de Jesús ha sido lo más duro que me ha tocado vivir. Y no hay forma fácil de atravesar eso, pero aun así, la vida te empuja a seguir. No porque sea sencillo, sino porque no queda otra. Y ahí uno entiende que hay cosas que no se resuelven, pero sí se aprenden a llevar, día a día, con fuerza, con fe y con amor por los que siguen a tu lado.

Y hoy, viendo todo lo que he vivido, entiendo que muchas veces lo simple es lo que más cuesta porque lo pensamos demasiado. Porque dudamos, porque postergamos, porque nos frenamos solos. Pero la vida, al final, se trata de avanzar, incluso cuando no tienes todo claro. Porque no es tan difícil como parece, muchas veces solo hace falta dar el paso y seguir.

<center>![SeparadorHive.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mballesteros/23t7YWoN53XUARh93PVvS9mqaVjjjMGSNi6uJUMjKptGwBVoiTyadsRVjRPAE27xgxsc7.png)</center>

Y al final, uno se da cuenta de que muchas veces no es que sea difícil, es que uno mismo lo hace más grande de lo que es. Pensamos, dudamos, postergamos, y al final la vida sigue igual, esperando a que demos ese paso.

Hoy más que nunca entiendo que no todo tiene que estar perfecto para avanzar. A veces solo hace falta decidirse, hacerlo y seguir. Porque sí, a veces lo simple es lo que más cuesta, pero también es lo que más cambia.

Quiero agradecer a la comunidad #freewriters, en especial a @daily.prompt, @mariannewest y @felt.buzz, por este espacio donde podemos compartir desde lo real, desde lo vivido.

Gracias por leer, te leo en la caja de comentarios. Un abrazo grande para todos y feliz viernes.

body.title: A prolonged pause.
body.body:
A prolonged pause. A prolonged pause is the common term for that moment in a conversation between two people when, suddenly, the moment arrives when either one's next word is somewhere on the edge of the foul line and could take the conversation in a completely different direction than expected, and both remain silent, pondering their deep thoughts in silence. It's like an approaching storm, from which a chain-link fence protects you. For a while, the fence protects you, because, indeed, it's not raining yet, and you're without an umbrella. ![DSC00042.JPG](https://cdn.steemitimages.com/DQmRhek1S1uxowwfiQciMKQ17Vn2ERDDD13Uijs748e7Mru/DSC00042.JPG) It's also like riding on a crowded trolleybus: the inside is uncomfortable, but outside the glass, outside the vehicle, it's very damp and even less comfortable. ![DSC07283.JPG](https://cdn.steemitimages.com/DQmQ9rP8MZN51pw4jCVVXNkB4Kw8T75xizt7bjq518rzjbj/DSC07283.JPG) Whatever the outcome of a prolonged pause, it is better than complete silence, because with someone who has become an enemy for some reason, you can eventually improve your relationship, but with someone who remains incomprehensible, you no longer want to communicate. ![DSC08655.JPG](https://cdn.steemitimages.com/DQmZDwyFeMUHMS7LeyXnpuJKHMeNDU5RURtqdEngRgqcBpx/DSC08655.JPG) --- Below you can see my containers with data that I collect in INLEO and always have quick access to them it is very convenient. body.title: ColdFusion video about the NFT hype, but still think NFTs are here to stay. CryptoPunks floor price still at ETH 29, was ETH 125 at its 2021 ATH.
body.body:
ColdFusion-Video über den NFT-Hype von 2021, denke aber trotz des Hypes und dem darauffolgenden Crash sind NFTs gekommen, um zu bleiben.

Die Technologie dahinter ist absolut sinnvoll und ermöglicht es Krypto-Tokens mit realen oder virtuellen Objekten zu verknüpfen, alles zu tokenisieren, und so die Besitzer mit der Sicherheit der Blockchain-Technologie zu verfolgen und öffentlich verifizierbar zu machen.

Damit NFTs aber wirklich einen Sinn ergeben, muss mit dem NFT jedoch ein konkreter Nutzen verbunden sein. Das wurde während der Hypephase 2021 komplett vernachlässigt.

Naheliegend bei Krypto-Kunst-NFTs wären zum Beispiel konkrete Nutzungsrechte und Lizenzen and die NFTs zu knüpfen. Ein Link zu einem Jpeg ohne Nutzungsrechte ist zu wenig. Das würde einen komplett neuen Lizenzhandel für YouTube-Musik, Stock-Fotos und Videos ermöglichen. NFTs könnten online eine einheitliche Schnittstelle bieten, um Urheberschaft und Lizenzen nachweisen zu können.

Sollten einmal tatsächlich Immobilien oder Aktien tokenisiert werden, müsste mit ihnen der Besitz, Eintragung in das Grundbuch und die damit einhergehende Nutzung rechtlich abgesichert werden. Zum Beispiel bei Aktien das Stimmrecht bei der Hauptversammlung mit einem NFT zu belegen etc.

Versuche in diese Richtung gab es auch 2021 bereits mit den Bored Ape Yacht Club-NFTs, die einem Zutritt zu exklusiven Veranstaltungen gewährt haben sollen.

Was allerdings bereits jetzt gut funktioniert, sind NFTs im Krypto-Gaming-Business, In-Game-Items als NFTs abzubilden und diese handelbar zu machen. Splinterlands ist hier ein absoluter Vorreiter auf diesem Gebiet und macht das bereits seit 2018.

Was denkt ihr? Sammelt ihr noch NFts? Was wären noch nützliche Use-Cases für NFTs?

## ColdFusion: The Spectacular Collapse of NFTs

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=eIIWyoy4aF8

Video Credit: [ColdFusion](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=eIIWyoy4aF8)

## English

ColdFusion video about the 2021 NFT hype, but still I think that despite the hype and crash, NFTs are here to stay.

The technology behind NFTs makes perfect sense and allows crypto tokens to be linked to real or virtual objects, tokenizing everything, and thus tracking owners with the security of blockchain technology and making ownership publicly verifiable.

However, for NFTs to truly make sense, there must be a concrete benefit associated with the NFT. This was completely neglected during the 2021 hype phase.

For crypto art NFTs, for example, it would make sense to link usage rights and licenses to the NFTs. A link to a JPEG without usage rights is not enough. This would enable a completely new licensing market for YouTube music, stock photos, and videos. NFTs could provide a unified online interface to verify authorship and licenses.

Should real estate or stocks ever actually be tokenized, ownership, registration in the land registry, and the associated usage rights would need to be legally secured through them. For example, in the case of stocks, using an NFT to grant voting rights at the annual general meeting, etc.

There were already attempts in this direction in 2021 with the Bored Ape Yacht Club NFTs, which were said to grant access to exclusive events and parties.

What is already working well, however, are NFTs in the crypto-gaming business, where in-game items are represented as NFTs and made tradable. Splinterlands is an absolute pioneer in this field and has been doing this since 2018.

What do you think? Do you still collect NFTs? What other use cases could you think of for NFTs?

body.title: Healing in Progress: Scars, Strength, and Simple Blessings 😊🙏❤
body.body:
Hello everyone!

Hope all are safe and well! 😊❤🙏

Today, I just want to share a little life update that is something personal, something real, and something I am truly grateful for. 😊🙏

It’s been three weeks already since the hot oil spill incident happened. Honestly, when I think about it now, I can still remember the pain and how scary it felt at that moment. But looking at where I am today, I can say that healing is really taking its course slowly but surely. 😊🙏

The wounds are not yet fully healed, but the good thing is, I don’t feel the pain anymore. That alone is already a big relief for me. The smaller affected areas have already healed, and I can see that they’ve turned into white scars. I’m actually thankful that they are white, because somehow it gives me comfort knowing they are not too visible or dark.😊

The bigger part that was damaged is still there, still in the process of healing. I’m still hoping and praying that it won’t leave a dark scar. I know it will take more time, and I’m learning to be patient with it. Healing whether physical or emotional really cannot be rushed. 🙏

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmWZTqpaUGWjK8qXgAtogwcQSwT9zpefyqsT1Du6GjhnNV/20260424_172206.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmSosMuTuLYcmZK8SWPg2uSzCddu7DyAXhp8kKwfYZuqcC/20260424_172214.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmWNzeBA8uLXXGRpxC7RGBN91LAe8tvdU4nHuUwdjvWbnX/20260424_172223.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmS62pUqSuX3jW66g6pcjp8MmGg9YcqERKfFQvXFkR6wfx/20260424_172343.jpg)

Looking at these photos reminds me of how far I’ve come in just three weeks. From fresh wounds to slowly drying and healing skin. It may not be perfect yet, but there is already progress. And sometimes, progress is more important than perfection. 😊🙏

More than the physical healing, this experience also reminded me to be extra careful and to appreciate my body more. We often take our health for granted until something unexpected happens. This incident made me pause and realize how important it is to take care of ourselves, even in the simplest ways.❤

Right now, as I’m writing this, I’m sitting quietly and eating freshly picked calamansi from our backyard. I can feel a slight discomfort in my throat, like a cough is about to start. This has always been my simple remedy which is eating calamansi to help prevent it from getting worse. It’s one of those small habits I’ve learned to trust over time. 😊

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmVmHbysiZGauEZTuhgLXbQ3L9v2yNe2gpPQddWNRENxXs/20260424_173615.jpg)

It’s funny how life works sometimes. From dealing with burns to now trying to avoid a simple cough. Problems may change, but the mindset stays the same to take care, to be mindful, and to stay grateful. 😊❤🙏

I am truly grateful that things are getting better now. Not perfect, but better and that is enough for me today. 😊🙏

Thank You, Lord, for the continuous healing, for the protection, and for the strength every day. 🙏


Have a Blessed Friday everyone! 😀😀😀💖💖💖

Thank You Lord for the blessings and love!

Be grateful in every little/simple things and you’ll find happiness you ever wanted! 😀😀😀

Everyday is worth to be grateful of!

Praying for the safety and wellness of all.

Heal Our Land Oh God!

Lovelots,
@shikika

body.title: Коли Ірландія світиться жовтим: коротка магія весни

Тиждень в Ірландії стоїть напрочуд сонячна погода — без дощів, ніби сама природа вирішила зробити паузу й дати насолодитися весною.

Квітнуть галявини, узбіччя, дерева, і кольори змінюються, наче за чиєюсь невидимою чергою: нарциси переходять від яскраво-жовтих до ніжно-білих.

Кульбаби ж розстелили свої золоті простирадла всюди — на полях, уздовж доріг, навіть на кільцях-розв’язках. У ці дні Ірландія виглядає так, що в неї просто неможливо не закохатися.

І водночас є в цьому щось трохи сумне: ці маленькі жовті сонця на землі так швидко перетворюються на легкі білі кульки, що розлітаються від найменшого подиху вітру.

Я ще встигла впіймати ці яскраві жовті голівки на смарагдово-зеленому газоні — перш ніж вони стали спогадом🌼

А як у вас там? Ще квітнуть галявини і дерева?

body.title: Creating healthy workspaces through professional office cleaning
body.body:
A clean and organized workspace is vital because the state of an office impacts employee productivity, well-being, and the company's professional image. This creates a positive physique that helps maintain the health and comfort of its employees for a long time, while also creating a good impression. Many of them turn to professional [office cleaning companies in Seattle](https://www.mmuwa.com/janitorial-services/), keeping workplaces clean, tidy, and pleasant for employees as well as guests alike.

Professional office cleaning services have many benefits, but the healthiest indoor environment possible is undoubtedly the most important. Workplaces, like homes, build up dust, allergens, and bacteria through regular use — high-footfall areas such as conference rooms, kitchens, and lobbies in particular. They use commercial-grade products and specialized equipment to thoroughly disinfect surfaces, making it a clean and healthy environment. In turn, this not only lowers the risk of infectious disease but also keeps employees healthier with fewer sick days and ultimately overall productivity.

The other very important benefit is the enhancement of employee morale and concentration. Research shows that messy or dirty environments can lead to higher stress levels and distract from focus. A clean workspace is also likely to make employees feel more comfortable about doing their work. Office cleaning companies in Seattle provide services that are well-established to help so many organizations plan consistent cleaning schedules and keep work areas organized, creating a distraction-free environment.

Having professional cleaning services also promotes a good brand image for businesses. Appropriately emphasizing a great first impression is essential if there is ever an office visit from clients, partners, or even potential employees. Professionals take notice of their surroundings, and clean floors, polished surfaces, and well-tended meeting areas are always impressive. A company that spends on cleanliness sends out a message that it cares about its environment and the people who use it. One reason many growing businesses rely on office cleaning companies in Seattle for general maintenance and deep cleaning.

Besides the reasons related to aesthetics and hygiene, commercial cleaning services can also help extend the life of office assets. When properly maintained, carpets, upholstery, flooring, and office equipment last longer. If not removed, dust and debris can slowly ruin materials. Cleaning regularly safeguards these investments and mitigates the need for expensive replacements or repairs.

Moreover, commercial cleaning services usually provide flexible services that suit the requirements of each organization. The trained teams can adjust their services from daily cleaning to weekly maintenance or even periodic deep sanitation as needed. All this flexibility enables companies to keep high levels of cleanliness without disturbing the daily work.

In short, a tidy workspace fosters healthy employees and profitable companies. A hygienic environment allows organizations to have good health, and with a healthy workplace, they will make their business more productive while also leaving a lasting positive impression on anyone who enters their premises.

Mike Simmons is the author of this article. To know more about [affordable floor polishing in Seattle](https://www.mmuwa.com/apartment-unit-turns/), please visit our website: mmuwa.com.

---

body.title: A foolish pursuit.
body.body:
A foolish pursuit. Sometimes it's difficult to discern whether changes in our lives are good or bad, but if they happen, it means life is moving forward, not standing still. So, some of my activities, things I occasionally do in my mature years, would have seemed foolish, a silly pastime, to me in my youth, but I don't regret overstepping my convictions and pursuing what I enjoy today... I'm talking about photography and everything related to it. I, not this one, many years ago, lol, I probably wouldn't have picked up a bunch of viburnum berries from the ground and examined them carefully from all sides, or dipped them in water and looked for any reflections of the berries in a tiny puddle. ![DSC02224.JPG](https://cdn.steemitimages.com/DQmZQFojuzt1GQCDgjDHv3g2LoK5jPmz5znopCJ9NgKBR4Z/DSC02224.JPG) Yes, then I might have put that bunch in a bag, collecting a few more to make tea with, but nothing more. body.title: United Kingdom - A Stadium Tour At Emirates Stadium
body.body:
<center>![20140616_130038.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/relf87/23tvkkN1Xm3qwQP2WBosW9eEESr22TjvAY2ccE2cAACQUde9BiGgUMQtbMRhLtE3mq3y2.jpg)</center>

Hello there!

Having completed my earlier travel posts on several interesting countries and regions, including Japan, Maldives, Indonesia, US, Europe, New Zealand and the latest one being Australia, it's time to fly over to United Kingdom!

This was a trip I made in 2014, I was there partly for work and partly for leisure as well. At that point in my life, it was one of the further destination that I have travelled all the way from Asia and it was definitely an eye opener to see how United Kingdom, or more specifically London, looked like. One thing that I remembered vividly was how strong GBP was, and everything was so expensive. For example, even though the numerical digits of the prices were small, because 5 or 10 GBP was easily a lot already. Anyway, time to relive those moments as I share the sights and sounds of my experience!

Here are the posts so far:
[United Kingdom - Living The Football Dream With Chelsea](https://peakd.com/hive-163772/@relf87/united-kingdom-living-the-football-dream-with-chelsea)
[United Kingdom - The Beauty Of Art and Shopping In London](https://peakd.com/hive-163772/@relf87/united-kingdom-the-beauty-of-art-and-shopping-in-london)
[United Kingdom - Spectacular Fireworks at Horse Guards Parade](https://peakd.com/hive-163772/@relf87/united-kingdom-spectacular-fireworks-at-horse-guards-parade)
[United Kingdom - Discovering History At The Tower Of London](https://peakd.com/hive-163772/@relf87/united-kingdom-discovering-history-at-the-tower-of-london)
[United Kingdom - Breathtaking Views From The Shard](https://peakd.com/hive-163772/@relf87/united-kingdom-breathtaking-views-from-the-shard)
[United Kingdom - Trooping The Colour Ceremony At Buckingham Palace](https://peakd.com/hive-163772/@relf87/united-kingdom-trooping-the-colour-ceremony-at-buckingham-palace)
[United Kingdom - Spectacular Airshow Over Buckingham Palace](https://peakd.com/hive-163772/@relf87/united-kingdom-spectacular-airshow-over-buckingham-palace)
[United Kingdom - A Relaxing Day Trip To Bath](https://peakd.com/hive-163772/@relf87/united-kingdom-a-relaxing-day-trip-to-bath)
[United Kingdom - Exploring Bath Abbey And Roman Baths](https://peakd.com/hive-163772/@relf87/united-kingdom-exploring-bath-abbey-and-roman-baths)
[United Kingdom - A Journey Through Time At Stonehenge](https://peakd.com/hive-163772/@relf87/united-kingdom-a-journey-through-time-at-stonehenge)

[//]:# (!worldmappin 51.55527 lat -0.10927 long United Kingdom - A Stadium Tour At Emirates Stadium d3scr)
***
The fun in London never ends, and this time, we were back from the day trip and there was still some pockets of time left, so I headed to the Emirates Stadium, which is the home of Arsenal football club!

Being one of the major European soccer clubs, it's no surprise that their stadium looked very majestic and it was definitely a sight to behold.

<center>![20140616_124953.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/relf87/23z7G46HLavQeNX6wz6TRTgTDrVG12aaGtHSiNoSZS7bV9xhmmfMpYiSZc44dFToEW8ae.jpg)</center>


This was such a grand photo/image that anchored the exterior of the stadium.

<center>![20140616_130038.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/relf87/23tvkkN1Xm3qwQP2WBosW9eEESr22TjvAY2ccE2cAACQUde9BiGgUMQtbMRhLtE3mq3y2.jpg)</center>


<center>![20140616_124906.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/relf87/23zbYHCmu5btCSnzPHvryrHHD7aSFLqVzqJKv6rjB8bmNqYV2FECkbpuEQzEVsTRqK47S.jpg)</center>

Some photos of the exterior and the neighbourhood of the stadium. It was pretty quiet and there weren't many tall buildings around too.

<center>![20140616_130104.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/relf87/245T9tNMGr9qFQHTessrVfaedZup4SYxpKdv4ig6Hi1RRfhc8HpgoTFESQ4hoYj1sNpmy.jpg)</center>


<center>![20140616_130119.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/relf87/2432FgcgVEf1i4RiJiyVMsk81NiQSfxkM72ud3JRLiDGPvrsU5gFCYwVuRVSQmXVvbdMj.jpg)</center>

The big words Arsenal on the outside and the accompanying photos of the gunners!

<center>![20140616_130745.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/relf87/23w2q3um9QXNB3to8xWRDS9aUPWS87ePtPL2fh9k2PcWHyACEUhT2Jm7EqToiYWTsNXDD.jpg)</center>


<center>![20140616_131046.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/relf87/23w2sH2WtjVoXRj8tMrRA23ZG9epagjsqn7sj6749ytZ5YzruJ9bSpHnaprZVFfQeiM5J.jpg)</center>

We entered the stadium and of course there was a cabinet full of silverware.

<center>![20140616_131626.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/relf87/23xVPmHjHP5oHcFZ7GdhS5wgEPtnViKNGwM6TDiuASFmfojWqdJRHttUmbpU2s3H4WNUT.jpg)</center>

Any Arsenal fan would know this man! He was their manager for so many years!

<center>![20140616_131754.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/relf87/23w2qCWRLU4rg7NYX77cuLAAUpHkH1smZ1rzj1qb8otJ9yceLgLAu4YS4zibNRaAtXLE9.jpg)</center>

And finally, we were inside the stadium! Just wow! The red seats, the green soccer pitch! Very photo worthy!

<center>![20140616_132158.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/relf87/23zS1JBNAK5EXnuxg3j97ui7WAzHPF6eSJP5SGxSwpdUREkRNFP6u33TQv2taPFHKkarb.jpg)</center>


<center>![20140616_132204.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/relf87/23qrLG7r4GqRBcvrjqNgo7UfXdWpeYdCQVZVG26AWbzzQWuYJvwftaFK8RsQp434UWJDq.jpg)</center>


<center>![20140616_132237.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/relf87/244A4Av5y1QDMPzsVQTg5HJ27rbyyUF6z8QewdYebLzxoiWbTxZ3jNBSxaJA429r4mbKh.jpg)</center>


<center>![20140616_132558.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/relf87/244KNkgycEBahyuz8fXdfQeFy1SuSyz7gNmmdBtzf9BL4ZCGFWmy8PNs1oHQhhb6PiA3Q.jpg)</center>

We made our way to the tunnel to explore the other parts of the stadium.

<center>![20140616_132835.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/relf87/23uQvS5tLw14pxM1vyu5u5u4mV2PMr4z84PBYmh2NgxDXTjRpLG7tC6k1UJqfzMbghntG.jpg)</center>


<center>![20140616_133905.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/relf87/23uQfVv2ZE8Zsp6rXK4w2NXFJpNNwh8L1sx9fJaSGGYw1CgHBApnTYwsGw31JYyQoCej6.jpg)</center>

Like most soccer clubs, they had different changing rooms for both the home team and the away team, and the difference was quite big! Let's see the away changing room first!

<center>![20140616_134024.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/relf87/23zS5hoxoRdxjST1rMGZwuKCMuyVLeGFpV3S8xHTPcec7YVCGR8zkCCSywnXZSrhRoCsM.jpg)</center>

Pretty basic, nothing amazing.

<center>![20140616_134225.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/relf87/23zbRuSK5tfzgLGHyUfjkp74XXvwHi2KeM53WQTiMRRU6nr3YBTsbTHiE2YjmePc8tp3D.jpg)</center>


<center>![20140616_134058.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/relf87/23vi3xAw9Aww3cPPs3UXDtB1PGyB9uzy4TGcNGcF7MrGt3zuprFzZadW3Mu39cPHw6ubE.jpg)</center>

And then let's see the home changing room, which is for the Arsenal players themselves.

<center>![20140616_135316.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/relf87/23xekFp9CBMjQDHyf17c8eewFVs4G4Ewwtoey2KZBX8SytbmjZn4UeD2GoSYTgt8sx57W.jpg)</center>

They even have an indoor jacuzzi!!!

<center>![20140616_135441.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/relf87/23vhz7VdK4FEPEEYDFaZtbaoRrT9KhtwRT2QufKAAd1FRPkuXVpPhSe2KQZjw4ZVqmrxg.jpg)</center>

Their showers don't look much different haha.

<center>![20140616_135547.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/relf87/23tSWJt2rU7FAnEZDY1BjNiP2SRoiJVd82N9TKWaMbAZarAHWqoEvmQvuYXhSsX1LarZz.jpg)</center>

They even had an area for the physios to work on the players if they needed a stretch or something!

<center>![20140616_135504.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/relf87/23zbUBw7LstXxn1K2MoGUbdNtsoMJUWdyAoNZU8FeYYy5WmUgFgddWBVAmacUzcCH5R5j.jpg)</center>

And because the home team is fixed, here's the display of the jersey at that time! This was in 2014!

<center>![20140616_135732.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/relf87/23yTjLt42ogxhbEPsLCpyZrRRbJjzWZjKJtXiRoyDjri5xa5oZXoUWd5appYNwjoPw8U9.jpg)</center>


<center>![20140616_135815.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/relf87/23xKzdPBHmJk1L1M4MdRTmYiUiMxKpJdsXno8mMZ5Kj2Q5xmnBbsn5wy4qDVJfdCGHWgg.jpg)</center>


<center>![20140616_140207.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/relf87/242hgjc2REKoMFbr5bPw5renDQcG7bh5R4DKiBpigGXQiTw4kTssTZXbnaXJqWkrXBefS.jpg)</center>


<center>![20140616_140139.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/relf87/23tvVWuBLhVcMhrEZkd5xGMwKPSRkZAfWwMqwfqbtFV6KJjCSYQKuwUySH3FgdXgRqT4m.jpg)</center>

Finally, we also saw the press conference room! The place where media conduct their interviews before and after soccer matches.

<center>![20140616_140623.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/relf87/23xKrPkcZYJrmX7bX1GwFn7ZgjVq7ycrZRusaxWPzi7FvCA2tvJMMSUV7TSuPzA6E57FK.jpg)</center>

That's it for the stadium tour of the Emirates Stadium! Very, very grand, and it's probably in Europe that we get to see such big and well equipped stadium, and that's because soccer has a very strong following in Europe. At least compared to Asia. Even though I am not an Arsenal fan, it was still interesting to visit the stadium and get a feel of the matchday vibes!


And that's all I have today! Have you been to London or United Kingdom? Let me know in the comments below!

Finally, thanks for reading my post in the community under World Map Pin!

[//]:# (!worldmappin 51.55527 lat -0.10927 long United Kingdom - A Stadium Tour At Emirates Stadium d3scr)

allies, including Spain, for failing to give away the so-called access, station, and navigation (ABO) authority to request support in military operations.\nThe options listed in the Pentagon's internal emails first included Spain's suspension of NATO qualifications and a review of the U.S. position on Britain's sovereignty over the Falkland Islands.\nThe move follows a previous message from European and U.S. officials that the Trump administration has drawn up a list of so-called \

In fact, if these options are put into practice, it will effectively retaliate against the \

alliance.
However, unlike President Trump's threats so far, the U.S. plan to withdraw from NATO is not directly mentioned in this option.
Reuters reported that the official declined to say whether the option to withdraw U.S. troops from Europe was included in the options.

>Earlier, Spain completely denied U.S. military aircraft passing through Spanish airspace following the use of a joint U.S. military base last month.
In particular, Spanish Prime Minister Pedro Sanchez is considered the most powerful Western leader against President Trump.
Reuters added that it was not confirmed whether there was actually a process by which the United States could suspend NATO eligibility against Spain.

In many ways, this reflects how rapidly the international situation is changing.

body.title: To the Yogyakarta leather factory
body.body:
Hello, dear friends. How are you all?. Thank you Market Friday community. Some time ago, I was in Yogyakarta. I stayed at home for a few days. My children were already married and had a small son. 


![IMG_20260106_053758.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/hsidik/23wWpjikjKtZmmhQ8wsCSSKKKLst6DC52j6pUig6XQWDLkW9AQrDTKZNSCjqRzd4MEusR.jpg)


On day, my son-in-law invited me to see the process of making leather crafts from cowhide. The distance from my daughter's residence to the leather craft  factory is about 3 kilometers. Leather craft factory, Nitikan street, Soro sultan, umbulharjo, Yogyakarta city.

And coincidentally, my daughter-in-law invited me to see how leather crafts are Made. Her daughter-in-law position is in accounting and helps with marketing when they are busy. After arriving at the parking lot, my daughter-in-law,my granddsughter, and I entered the leather craft factory.


![IMG20251226083804.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/hsidik/23xKvGvcnbaSJRkszPmVRPSSJ9rCMzfpsT67y3Gn1TPYUnfemybst3rmCaqazaftYJUE3.jpg)


The factory's name and production brand are Aleta, one of the famous leather craft factories in Yogyakarta. The leather craft factory is a Residential industry. The Aleta Indonesia, leather craft factory has several rooms such as a designer room, a material patterning room, a sewing room, an administration room, and a finished product display room.

body.title: Citrus sinensis - Rutaceae (ENG/ITA)
body.body: > ### Citrus sinensis - Rutaceae (ENG) Citrus sinensis is an evergreen tree belonging to the Rutaceae family, characterized by a rounded crown, leathery, glossy leaves, and highly fragrant white flowers. It has been cultivated for centuries in Mediterranean regions, where it finds ideal climatic conditions. The minimum growing temperature is around 5°C, below which it can suffer physiological damage, especially to young plants. ![arancio.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ghilvar/EqWqfBJjymbsuJoAz9yoXRVHGBBMYwsXJsAzbA8PoBL3dx2EkhaF1eJGgqFu6VkHR4t.png) image created with canva.com The growing season has two periods of particular interest: May: the balsamic period of the flowers, rich in aromatic compounds used in perfumery and phytotherapy. December: the balsamic period of the fruits, when they reach their maximum concentration of vitamins, flavonoids, and essential oils. **Toxicity is low, but there are known interactions with: Ephedrine Anti-inflammatories Thyroid hormones** It is prudent to avoid Citrus sinensis supplements during pregnancy and breastfeeding and consult a doctor before taking herbal preparations, especially if you are undergoing drug therapy. Citrus sinensis has the following properties: Digestive Antispasmodic Vasoprotective **Confirmed activities include: Flavoring (essential oil) Honey-producing plant (the flowers are highly prized by bees) Food (nutrient-rich fruits)** The main bioactive compounds are: Citric acid and malic acid (digestive action and pH regulation) Hesperidin (vasoprotective flavonoid) Vitamins, particularly vitamin C Minerals such as potassium and calcium Recent research suggests that some trace elements in oranges may help reduce uric acid levels without affecting diuresis, opening up interesting prospects for metabolic support. **Infusion** 15 g of fresh peel per 100 ml of water Suitable for digestive and antispasmodic purposes The peel should preferably be organic to avoid pesticide residues **officinal tincture** 15 g of chopped fresh peel Maceration for 21 days in 100 ml of 86° hydroalcoholic solution Shelf life of the filtrate: 3 years Traditional dosage: 100 drops daily (always after consulting a doctor) **Steam distillation of the flowers produces neroli essential oil, one of the most prized in perfumery, distinct from the essential oil obtained by pressing the peel, which is richer in limonene.** The fruit, in addition to being eaten fresh, is used for juices, candied fruit, extracts, and in culinary preparations. The dried leaves can be used in relaxing herbal teas with a delicate scent. ![hive dividers.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ghilvar/23t7BKexriBKviA9doWkBpvE3WA2yKQxfis1QCtDQU7rvAhxaNrDHcMfy5XLqadsaDEDf.png) ### Citrus sinensis - Rutaceae (ITA) Citrus sinensis è un albero sempreverde appartenente alla famiglia delle Rutaceae, caratterizzato da una chioma tondeggiante, foglie coriacee e lucide, e fiori bianchi molto profumati. È una specie coltivata da secoli nelle regioni mediterranee, dove trova condizioni climatiche ideali. La temperatura minima di coltivazione è di circa 5 °C, sotto la quale può subire danni fisiologici, soprattutto alle giovani piante. ![fitoterapia.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ghilvar/EoiW7vV1iNdbPAu48RSNX3FA44CE16HK74aEHuWEf5mZSMQWgTc91zo14mQKHWyiLLo.jpg) image created with canva.com Il ciclo vegetativo presenta due momenti di particolare interesse: Maggio: periodo balsamico dei fiori, ricchi di composti aromatici utilizzati in profumeria e fitoterapia. Dicembre: periodo balsamico dei frutti, quando raggiungono la massima concentrazione di vitamine, flavonoidi e oli essenziali. **La tossicità è bassa, ma esistono interazioni note con: Efedrina Antinfiammatori Ormoni tiroidei** È prudente evitare integratori di Citrus sinensis in gravidanza e allattamento e consultare un medico prima di assumere preparati fitoterapici, soprattutto in presenza di terapie farmacologiche. Citrus sinensis possiede proprietà: Digestive Antispasmodiche Vasoprotettrici **Le attività confermate includono: Aromatizzante (olio essenziale) Pianta mellifera (i fiori sono molto apprezzati dalle api) Alimento (frutti ricchi di nutrienti)** I principali composti bioattivi sono: Acido citrico e acido malico (azione digestiva e regolazione del pH) Esperidina (flavonoide vasoprotettore) Vitamine, in particolare vitamina C Sali minerali come potassio e calcio Recenti ricerche suggeriscono che alcuni oligoelementi dell’arancio possano contribuire a ridurre l’uricemia senza influenzare la diuresi, aprendo prospettive interessanti per il supporto metabolico. **Infuso** 15 g di scorze fresche per 100 ml di acqua Indicato per funzioni digestive e antispasmodiche Le scorze devono essere preferibilmente biologiche per evitare residui di pesticidi **Tintura** 15 g di scorze fresche sminuzzate Macerazione per 21 giorni in 100 ml di soluzione idroalcolica a 86° Conservazione del filtrato: 3 anni Posologia tradizionale: 100 gocce al giorno (sempre previo parere medico) **La distillazione in corrente di vapore dei fiori produce l’olio essenziale di neroli, uno dei più pregiati in profumeria, distinto dall’olio essenziale ottenuto dalla spremitura delle scorze, più ricco in limonene.** Il frutto, oltre al consumo fresco, è utilizzato per succhi, canditi, estratti e preparazioni gastronomiche. Le foglie, seccate, possono essere impiegate in tisane rilassanti dal profumo delicato. Sources - Fonti : https://www.humanitas.it/enciclopedia/alimenti/frutta/arancia/ https://www.my-personaltrainer.it/alimentazione/quali-sono-i-benefici-dell-arancia-proprieta-nutrizionali-e-fitoterapiche.html ![firmaGhilvar.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ghilvar/48SqxfhNw6nwwJEZACBwzAmKDssU5forXXdWSwLWVbz8NizZXvx3EVgejfYYTvq7cb.png)

body.title: IMS Certification | Integrated Management System Certification Guide
body.body:
In today’s competitive business environment, organizations are constantly looking for ways to improve efficiency, ensure compliance, and maintain high-quality standards. One of the most effective approaches to achieve these goals is through[ ](https://www.irqs.co.in/standards-certification/ims), which integrates multiple management systems into a single, unified framework. IMS stands for Integrated Management System, and it typically combines standards such as ISO 9001 (Quality Management), ISO 14001 (Environmental Management), and ISO 45001 (Occupational Health and Safety). By integrating these systems, businesses can streamline processes, reduce duplication of efforts, and improve overall performance.

IMS certification is particularly beneficial for organizations that operate across multiple functions and need to comply with different regulatory requirements. Instead of managing separate systems for quality, environmental impact, and workplace safety, IMS allows companies to handle everything under one structured framework. This integration not only simplifies documentation but also ensures consistency in processes and decision-making. As a result, organizations can save time, reduce operational costs, and improve resource utilization.

The process of obtaining IMS certification involves several key steps. It begins with a gap analysis to identify the differences between the organization’s current processes and the requirements of the integrated standards. This is followed by the development and implementation of an integrated management system that aligns with ISO guidelines. Employees are trained to understand and follow the new processes, and internal audits are conducted to ensure compliance. Finally, a certification body conducts an external audit to verify that the organization meets all the necessary requirements before granting certification.

One of the major advantages of IMS certification is improved operational efficiency. By integrating different management systems, organizations can eliminate redundant processes and create a more streamlined workflow. This leads to better coordination among departments and improved communication across the organization. Additionally, IMS certification helps businesses identify risks and opportunities, enabling them to make informed decisions and enhance their overall performance.

Another important benefit of IMS certification is increased customer trust and credibility. When a company demonstrates compliance with internationally recognized standards, it builds confidence among clients, stakeholders, and partners. This can lead to new business opportunities and improved market reputation. In industries where quality, safety, and environmental responsibility are critical, IMS certification can serve as a strong competitive advantage.

Overall, IMS certification is a valuable tool for organizations seeking to improve their management systems and achieve long-term success. By integrating multiple standards into a single framework, businesses can enhance efficiency, ensure compliance, and build a strong foundation for sustainable growth. Investing in IMS certification is not only a strategic decision but also a step toward continuous improvement and excellence.
