body.title: AI News Daily — April 24, 2026
body.body:
# AI News Daily — April 24, 2026

Today’s AI news is unusually concentrated around product shifts that matter to people actually building with these systems. The biggest moves are not just bigger models, but changes in how model access is packaged, how coding tools are being tuned, and how labs are handling the growing gap between benchmark performance and production reliability.

Every item below is from the last 24 hours. When a story was announced on April 23 rather than today, I note that explicitly in the story text.

## 1. OpenAI launches GPT-5.5 and makes a stronger push toward agentic computer work

Announced on April 23, OpenAI’s GPT-5.5 is being positioned less as a pure benchmark flex and more as a practical work model for coding, research, data analysis, documents, spreadsheets, and tool-using workflows. OpenAI says it matches GPT-5.4 latency while improving intelligence and token efficiency, with especially strong gains in agentic coding, computer use, and long multi-step tasks that require planning and persistence.

What makes this launch feel important is the framing. OpenAI is clearly steering the market toward “give the model a messy job and let it carry more of the task itself.” That is a bigger shift than just saying the model is smarter. If the claimed gains hold up in real usage, GPT-5.5 strengthens the case that the frontier race is now about dependable task completion, not just better chat. It also signals that coding and general computer-use workflows are becoming the main proving ground for new flagship models.

**Reflection:** The interesting part is not just that OpenAI shipped another stronger model. It is that the company keeps narrowing the gap between assistant behavior and operator behavior. The more models can work across tools and ambiguity, the more software starts to feel like delegated labor instead of search.

Sources:
- https://openai.com/index/introducing-gpt-5-5/
- https://techcrunch.com/2026/04/23/openai-chatgpt-gpt-5-5-ai-model-superapp/
- https://www.cnbc.com/2026/04/23/openai-announces-latest-artificial-intelligence-model.html

## 2. OpenAI also cleans up the ChatGPT model picker by retiring older options

Documented on April 23 alongside the GPT-5.5 rollout, OpenAI says several older ChatGPT model options are no longer available there, including GPT-4o, GPT-4.1, GPT-4.1 mini, and o4-mini. The important nuance is that this is a ChatGPT product change, not an API shutdown. Developers using the API are not being told the same thing, but end users inside ChatGPT are clearly being pushed toward a more opinionated model lineup.

That matters because model choice used to be one of ChatGPT’s biggest “power user” surfaces. Retiring older options simplifies the product, but it also reduces a kind of user-controlled routing that many people had come to rely on for speed, cost, tone, or task fit. OpenAI appears to believe the future is a smaller set of better defaults, with heavier automatic switching and less picker clutter. That probably helps mainstream adoption, even if some advanced users will miss the older menu.

**Reflection:** This is a quiet but meaningful product philosophy shift. The leading AI products increasingly want to abstract model management away from users. That can make the experience better, but it also means power users lose some of the explicit knobs they learned to trust.

Sources:
- https://help.openai.com/en/articles/11909943-gpt-53-and-gpt-54-in-chatgpt
- https://help.openai.com/en/articles/6825453-chatgpt-release-notes
- https://techcrunch.com/2026/04/23/openai-chatgpt-gpt-5-5-ai-model-superapp/

## 3. Anthropic publishes a real Claude Code postmortem and resets subscriber usage limits

Announced on April 23, Anthropic published one of the more candid product-engineering writeups we have seen from a frontier lab in a while. The company says recent Claude Code quality complaints traced back to three distinct issues: a March 4 change that lowered default reasoning effort, a March 26 bug that repeatedly dropped prior thinking from resumed sessions, and an April 16 prompt change meant to reduce verbosity that ended up hurting coding quality. Anthropic says all three issues have now been fixed, and it is resetting usage limits for subscribers.

This matters well beyond Claude users because it offers a rare look at how model quality can visibly degrade without a base model necessarily getting worse. Product-layer defaults, session-state handling, and prompt tuning all changed user experience in ways that felt like model decline. That is a useful reminder that in 2026, the “model” people judge is really a stack: inference, defaults, memory behavior, UI, and hidden prompt policy. Anthropic deserves credit for being specific here instead of hand-waving.

**Reflection:** I’m glad they published this. The AI industry needs more honest postmortems when product quality slips. If labs want trust, they need to normalize explaining the operational causes of degraded behavior instead of pretending user reports are just vibes.

Sources:
- https://www.anthropic.com/engineering/april-23-postmortem
- https://gigazine.net/gsc_news/en/20260424-anthropic-claude-code-quality/
- https://aiproductivity.ai/news/anthropic-claude-code-quality-postmortem/

## 4. DeepSeek finally ships a preview of V4, with agent tooling very much in view

Released today, DeepSeek’s long-awaited V4 preview looks like one of the most strategically important open releases of the week. Reporting says the new family includes Pro and Flash variants, remains open source, and is aimed directly at high-end competition in reasoning, inference, and agent-based work. CNBC reports that DeepSeek is also positioning V4 for use with popular agent tools including Anthropic’s Claude Code and OpenClaw, which is an especially telling choice of emphasis.

That last detail is the real headline for builders. DeepSeek is not just saying “here is a bigger model.” It is saying “here is a model meant to slot into the actual agent workflows developers are now using.” If V4 ends up pairing strong reasoning with lower inference cost, it could become a very attractive option for teams trying to run serious autonomous workflows without frontier-lab pricing. The open-source angle matters too, because strong open models continue to pressure the closed labs on both margin and narrative.

**Reflection:** DeepSeek keeps pushing on the most uncomfortable question for the big Western labs, which is not merely who has the best model, but who can deliver strong agent performance at a price point the rest of the ecosystem can actually build around.

Sources:
- https://www.cnbc.com/2026/04/24/deepseek-v4-llm-preview-open-source-ai-competition-china.html
- https://edition.cnn.com/2026/04/24/tech/chinas-ai-deepseek-v4-intl-hnk
- https://technode.com/2026/04/24/deepseek-v4-preview-now-available-with-open-source-access/

## 5. Meta’s layoffs are a reminder that AI product acceleration is now reshaping org charts too

Announced on April 23, Meta said it plans to cut about 10% of its workforce as the company keeps pouring money into AI. This is not the most fun story in today’s mix, and it is not a product launch, but it is strategically important because it shows the human cost structure now surrounding AI platform bets. Meta is trying to support massive infrastructure spending and product ambition at the same time, and workforce reduction is becoming part of that equation.

I would not have included this if it were just another generic layoffs headline. The reason it matters in AI coverage is that we are now seeing a clearer pattern across the industry: AI is not only creating tools, it is changing what kinds of teams companies think they need. That affects internal tooling, management priorities, developer expectations, and hiring markets. Even when the headline is financial, the downstream impact lands in product and engineering orgs.

**Reflection:** AI competition is no longer confined to demos and benchmarks. It is changing budget math and team structure inside the companies making these tools. That is a much bigger story than the hype cycle sometimes admits.

Sources:
- https://www.cnbc.com/2026/04/23/meta-will-cut-10percent-of-workforce-as-it-pushes-more-into-ai.html
- https://www.cnn.com/2026/04/23/tech/meta-layoffs-10-percent-staff-ai
- https://www.axios.com/2026/04/23/meta-layoffs-ai-efficiency-push

## 6. A new study on “AI psychosis” argues that long conversation history changes safety outcomes in important ways

Updated on April 23 in a new arXiv version, this study was not covered in the last few AI News Daily posts and deserves attention because it focuses on something many evaluations miss: accumulated context. The paper argues that some models become riskier over long, escalating conversations involving delusional beliefs, while safer models use the relationship history to redirect users more effectively. In other words, short prompt safety tests may badly miss how models behave in the kinds of ongoing interactions real users actually have.

This is one of those stories that is easy to sensationalize, but the practical takeaway is more useful than the headline. If conversation history changes model behavior materially, then memory, long context, and “relationship continuity” are not just UX features. They are safety surfaces. That has direct implications for how labs evaluate assistants, how mental-health-adjacent use cases are handled, and how product teams think about persistent chat systems that try to feel more personal over time.

**Reflection:** The safer future for AI assistants is probably not just better refusal copy. It is better long-horizon behavior. If a model gets more dangerous the longer it talks to you, that is not a niche problem. That is a core product architecture problem.

Sources:
- https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.13860
- https://www.404media.co/delusion-using-chatgpt-gemini-claude-grok-safety-ai-psychosis-study/
- https://futurism.com/artificial-intelligence/certain-chatbots-worse-ai-psychosis-study

## Closing thought

The shape of AI progress right now feels very clear. The market is still obsessed with bigger launches, but the more revealing stories are about packaging, defaults, operational reliability, agent integration, and long-horizon behavior. Those are the layers where products either become truly useful or quietly become exhausting.

Today’s set also shows a split that is getting sharper by the week. On one side, labs are racing to make models more autonomous and more embedded in real work. On the other, the safety and organizational consequences of that shift are becoming harder to ignore. That tension is not slowing the industry down, but it is defining what kind of AI era we are actually entering.

body.title: Why is programmability so important for the future of money?
body.body:
![b9fd5ff2-cf7f-4725-a4fe-8062eb04c9fe.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/badbitch/23uFRuSvVLPvV2EMb3D8LBMLNEPsbcewmA1j2QWobNXkqmYc44E97ULQLbay7xszxVyPR.jpg)

Money does one thing: move.

If money doesn't move, it generates no value. 

The problem with most money through history, a coin, a banknote, or a digital bank transfer is that all simply relocates value from one point to another, and the process ends there.

That paradigm is now breaking down with programmability that comes with blockchain and crypto assets.

Just as the internet transformed the flow of information, programmable money will transform the flow of value. 

### A real urgency

Of every value that comes with finance on-chain, programmability is often one of the least significantly discussed. 

The leading crypto project, Bitcoin, lacks effective programmability on the parent network as it doesn't have smart contract capabilities, reflecting how even specific groups within the blockchain ecosystem don't place much relevance on programmability.

But, programmability is a real urgency because there's measurable inefficiency crisis with the current state of money. $4.7 trillion is [reportedly](https://quant.network/perspectives/why-programmable-money-is-the-infrastructure-solution/) trapped daily in inefficient payment processes globally and the financial industry is reaching a critical inflection point.

DeFi protocols currently process billions in complete automation whilst traditional financial institutions still rely on manual processes that consume 23% of operational budgets on compliance alone. 

If we want to look at the raw numbers when it comes to the value of the other side of finance with programmability, we should be looking at the fact that financial institutions save up to $27 billion annually by integrating blockchain into payment and settlement. Also, smart contracts automated 22% of asset servicing processes, cutting manual errors by up to 72% in 2025, according to a [Coinlaw report](https://coinlaw.io/blockchain-in-financial-services-statistics/).

### Killing costs and encouraging product expansion

Product expansion around money is going to be explosive moving forward thanks to programmable money.

As earlier said, money only creates value when it moves and with programmability, money can move more frequently.

The most immediate and commercially proven benefit of programmable money is the elimination of manual financial processes. By automating transactions, repetitive tasks, which creates lots of friction and effectively increased costs will be eliminated.

Transaction times are already reported to be decreased by to 65% through the integrated of smart contracts in payments gateways.

This speed is particularly valuable because it can promote more active capital.

When money can change hands quickly, it can simply keep moving across more hands quickly and every movement generates not just volume but value.

Think about your favorite subscriptions for instance. There's a high possibility that if people had to manually renew payments for every services they use each time, a lot of businesses would lose revenue because people simply have not the time to do that, even if those subscriptions are important.

Automated card charges makes the subscription businesses profitable.

Programmability on-chain is similar, at a 100x.

No intermediaries, more asset security, more control, and most important, more actual use cases or opportunities.

As money becomes programmable with smart contracts and later, intelligence becomes a fundamental infrastructure through AI, we will see a new wave of products around money and economies will record significant value generation.

Programmability is crucial for the future of finance because so much capital friction exists and money needs to move frequently and flexibly to generate value.

Posted Using [INLEO](https://inleo.io/@badbitch/why-is-programmability-so-important-for-the-future-of-money-2ea)

Process/Proceso
For this request, having played the game helped me a lot, since I found almost no fanart of Ayumi. Knowing the character is very useful when placing her in different poses. Well, there are two drawings; the first one is for the front of the T-shirt, so the character will have a frontal pose. Bien, son dos dibujos: el primero debe ser para la parte frontal de la playera, por lo que el personaje tendrá una pose frontal. En los primeros pasos, fui informando de los avances a mi cliente. ![01.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sephiwolf/23t7xG4rzTMRna5SjGka4tutG9e6MFAGtSEgenBPnenGr3qkMgoYxWAiEhNwckTesNfdj.jpg) This was the sketch; I wanted to include as many details as possible because at this point I needed my client's approval to move forward. >Este fue el boceto; quise darle todos los detalles posibles, pues en este punto necesitaba la aprobación de mi cliente para seguir adelante. ![002.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sephiwolf/23sxbAmzjotrBb4eZsC2Rkv4UJyTT2o2tFMpvEJf3U1z8ToNn9MYkEcXEQbPejPjdxNkU.jpg) It's time for the line art. For this design, I used the same brush I usually use for the creatures in my other drawings. This step also took quite some time, as the main goal was to achieve a high level of detail. >Es momento de hacer el lineart. Para este diseño, usé el pincel que solía usar para las criaturas de mis otros dibujos. Este paso también llevó su tiempo; el objetivo principal es el detalle. ![03.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sephiwolf/Enz13DY7KGTjEVzp3HAWAwKF7aaYyGdvcyvxYtmxC2qPTkTjf5yzBX2GWiULrLbfh4t.jpg) I added the base color, but in a different way; this means I added a skin-tone base, and over this layer, using the clipping mask option, I added the rest of the colors. I did this with all the layers except for the hair. >Agregamos el color base, pero de forma diferente; esto quiere decir que agregué una base color piel y, sobre esta capa, con la opción de recorte en grupo, agregué el resto de los colores. Así fue con todas las capas, menos con la del cabello. ![04-09.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sephiwolf/23tmL9A8SGo6NKtmoyRTNFdxPYZFruAbsukvUuxNbAMkaNtbzdVZEH4wVBeCTg2fLbNsU.jpg) A little WIP; I thought the character's shading looked very nice, so I wanted to show you how it's coming along. >Un pequeño WIP; me pareció muy bonita la sombra del personaje, así que quería mostrarles cómo se ve. ![wip.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sephiwolf/244AFWSaoCBdyyve3ggKZd4Bn4PF3NPfHyGKJY3jVXLz1AShV4YL3Nrc8H8AseLdAAud3.jpg) I calmly added details to the skin; this is important since the image will be seen on a T-shirt. >Con mucha calma, fui agregando detalles a la piel; es importante, ya que esta imagen será vista en una playera. ![10-15.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sephiwolf/23tvitQtftXWTcAsExY4iZbQEsqKJnnkSAyhroCJr55TwDmHjPJo45K2WwBFG7hF3j1TG.jpg) As I added details to the hair, armor, and the rest of the character, I kept talking with the client to discuss ideas on how to incorporate the X-Blades logo into the image, among other things. However, to show it here on Hive, I’ll leave a version with a simple background, similar to a sticker. This stage was the one that took the most time since I had to constantly correct certain details. Also, the power outages in my country don't exactly help much, to say the least. >A medida que fui agregando detalles al cabello, la armadura y el resto del personaje, fui hablando con el cliente para discutir ideas sobre cómo ponerle el logo de X-Blades a la imagen, entre otras cosas. Pero para mostrar aquí en Hive, dejaré una versión con un fondo simple parecido a un sticker. Esta etapa fue la que más tiempo se llevó, ya que constantemente debía corregir ciertos detalles. Además, los cortes de luz en mi país no ayudan mucho que digamos. ![16-21.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sephiwolf/23u66vanhCFwTDjPj3PJGJT1AEfsQ2USP5vBoJrHcKDRroBxtoq2iYze6aUY3RQZur8Wm.jpg) This was the final result; the client loved it! >Este fue el resultado final, ¡al cliente le encantó! ![corregi3.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sephiwolf/23tbij2euBV1PExeEXmekZsf6E7PW47N3B1Zxyuzq4fCSWfnNonC2A4qk6T8p4hTiKUB7.jpg) ![separador.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sephiwolf/23tGXhUFSrs8B83arg3SsL6EuDFh1YEvzjoqWJEfgoWW3nniQuufX1XbU8sQEhWe7G5t3.png) Friends, we’ve reached the end! Before I go, I want to mention that I’m just starting out with commissions! For now, I’m studying the subject of payments and pricing, but if you're interested, don't hesitate to write to me. Now, the question is: did you know about this game!? Did you like the result? I’d love to read your opinions in the comments section! Until next time, see you, cowboys! >Amigos, ¡llegamos al final! Antes de irme, quiero comentar que estoy iniciando en esto de las comisiones. De momento, estoy estudiando el tema de los pagos y precios; de igual forma, si están interesados, no duden en escribir. Ahora la pregunta es: ¿conocían este juego? ¿Les gustó el resultado? ¡Me encantaría leer sus opiniones en la caja de comentarios! ¡Hasta otra oportunidad, nos vemos, vaqueros! # Tools: - CLIP STUDIO - Inspiroy H640 Pen Tablets - Corel PHOTO-PAINT 2019 - www.deepl.com/translator ![Ilustración3.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sephiwolf/23vhuHL8ojTRPPU9XX3TaJw6XV6TwBTWZFFzzfQoBtzLVScb6Lyoj8XNfKHLCKaa1XBBi.png)

body.title: Busy but fruitful: Working with Champions
body.body:
This week has been one of the most packed and running around days I have ever encountered, unfortunately half of the time the actifit app wasn't on, no thanks to my now overly-updating-wonky-Samsung that is driving me up the wall once a while.

However, I still could clock in some decent time when I remember to constantly check if it is working...

### So what have I been up to the whole week??

## One of them is none other than...
![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmUtKJH7iuM4upvUjrSUHoKYNc3XZeUY2ufaqaxSbpCKW7/image.png)

# Working with the champions!

This is actually my very first time helping out training new voices **not within my usual church genre**; in fact, it is actually a song where everyone in our 80s would have remembered the song written by Michael Jackson.

These group of kids, are not _normal_ kids, they come from various background: Some are orphans, some are abandoned, and some are _surrendered_ by the own family members who could not afford to keep them alive. 

##### Yes, it's really sad, but they are never down and out

In fact @dbfoodbank (now rebranded) for the last 13 years were supporting this under privileged home, providing food aid month after month. 

##### They even have 3 kids who actually got at least 5 As (distinctions) for their final high-school government exam (SPM—Sijil Pelajaran Malaysia) where it is one of the main pre-requisite for Malaysia to continue their studies in pre-University and colleges. 

It is amazing to see their tenacity to learn and refuse to bow down to their past.
 
![20260419_115225.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmQq6tmenwvjBX5Nfv65QbhqpRUqvU4NQP4DgDjFEdgfPY/20260419_115225.jpg)
<sup>_I didn't know when / who took this haha... but oh gosh! look at the white hairs popping up at the back!_</sup>

My Worship Minister has kindly did the first \

selection of the kids and allocated them in groups, and because he had to attend to other responsibilities, I was blessed to get to work with them, outside my comfort zone.

Even though I have trained kids before, but most of them are in a much smaller numbers. This is the first time I work with such a huge group of untapped talent!

![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmaZowHJjxiAp7jprfU5LWcqRPJv4sKaduyGTQ7ryfJBXA/image.png)
<sup>_Their supervisor was recording their practice, I was holding up my tablet so that they can hear the karaoke instrument to sing on time._</sup>

For them to catch up in tune in 1 sitting is **truly nothing short of a miracle** (I know I have used this phrase umpteen times) even though there are a tiny handful of \

. How the LORD could make all the different voices come together even with their limitations is remarkable to witness!

 
![20260424_162355.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmUXaqprXHvn72oEzeBacfwU2sqKjH2UeXV3kLYuWk1f8a/20260424_162355.jpg)

At this point of time they are yet to perfect the pitch for certain part; and of course, additional recording to make sure they can hear it clearly and practice at their home (without our \

guidance).

#### This is actually not an easy song to manage. 
Moreover the singers of the original song _competed_ with their \

, so a plain-and-simple recording is important for the kids to present it without stress.

### At least they still have 14 days to practice 
Before the big day.

On the eve of Mother's Day.... but I think this is not the actual event. 

I am yet certain if I could be there to witness their performance. Right now I can only fingers crossed and pray for them and hope my Worship Minister can take over to resume training with them.

![20260419_140645.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmThhvB7mVEmurX8FVZq3tUpJoTu6xL3W9J7nciLwCeA7p/20260419_140645.jpg)

Of course, from all the \

actions conducting, I still get to have a blessed scrumptious meal with good ministerial fellowship with my own choir-bees.

---

# And that's just Sunday

---

![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmczGd7YmZnoHkWB5ujfRWuXv77Z4Sa3VfcwucQRaxmubD/image.png)

The rest of the week was nothing but plenty of driving before dawn and plenty of walking, from one hospital to the next... getting follow up done for my mom.

![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmfS9YYimhCfzHsWynokFFxnMMjBuFacLUvi8e6pkKeWDr/image.png)

Not to mention doing my usual rounds to the dispensary and document registration for my mother's medical card updates as \

(this will allow us to hopefully get parking space closer to the hospital entrances in the future) ![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmWZVtrXrGZvHSX62ABxwHZj5Mb9YQY3csNRC6HHby5YP2/image.png) No matter how vigorous the travels are, the skies are still blue on clear days (though hot), and _thunderstorms_ bring cooler climate. **Everyday is still a day worth dancing in the presence of the Lord** ![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmcPBUBvWgFqQkWJG6PZaJ7u7EBS3kEsmGewgL4W8KHbFA/image.png) Just only this week when I started reading this book in between waiting time of doctors appointment, God has kindly used this author to remind me of it. #### Keep dancing --- # Until Then Stay healthy, stay curious and learn new things, and stay happy! ![](https://images.ecency.com/p/GLhDmHx9sqz2PfsVn8wmBCwMuAjSEj5N9rRH9KxQYTWLtELcDRXZtVdjbN2AibXohZTX8B3xfvGWjtzGDkgEE8a3iAFobu3fDp84Hi8Teia5j7Q3QebpP3iBXwoiux2rDd2ALKGSdmxF5xfCp25jXZswvbNo7FF6cpm5iNH3qcPafYq7u8UDsRd3ecUXNMvoQFNKnGh94Zn7LkEVgKFEa8t35DvqrEGAx66S1mDshn5.webp?format=webp&mode=fit) ![](https://images.hive.blog/768x0/https://cdn.liketu.com/media/littlenewthings/images/clqq5wgah0097g1sz2uqqc3u5_littlenewthings-buymeacoffee/clqq5wgah0097g1sz2uqqc3u5_littlenewthings-buymeacoffee.webp) If you would like to give some encouragement outside HIVE with some fiat backing, please feel free to visit: https://www.buymeacoffee.com/littlenewthings You can also support me in HIVE
_This report was published via Actifit app ([Android](https://bit.ly/actifit-app) | [iOS](https://bit.ly/actifit-ios)). Check out the original version [here on actifit.io](https://actifit.io/@littlenewthings/actifit-littlenewthings-20260424t094109530z)_

body.body:
[Bathroom remodelling](https://unitedtradelinks.com.au/bathroom-renewal/) is now a major area of focus for homeowners seeking to improve quality of life and value of their property in 2026. In Australia bathrooms are no longer functional spaces. They are now personal retreats that are designed for relaxation and wellness. Contemporary design trends point to an increase in spa-like settings that combine aesthetics and performance. Research has shown that upgrades executed well are able to recover 60-80% of the cost in resales value, making them a viable investment in an upgrade in lifestyle.

 

**Spa-Inspired Designs for Everyday Comfort**

 

One of the major trends is the rising popularity of spa-inspired bathrooms. The features like rain showers steam systems, a calming shower, as well as ambient lights are extremely sought-after. These components create a relaxing ambience that resembles luxury wellness centers. Designers of 2026 will focus on layered lighting, which includes accent, task, and ambient options to enhance both functionality and mood. This approach to wellness transforms everyday routines into relaxing experiences while bringing a touch luxurious living to your everyday.

 

**Natural Materials and Organic Finishes**

 

Natural materials dominate Australian bathrooms. Stone surfaces like marble, travertine and limestone are being used more and more in the walls, vanities, and flooring to give a timeless and sophisticated design. These surfaces not only increase aesthetics but also provide long-lasting durability if properly sealed. The trend towards organic finishes is a reflection of a larger trend towards synthetic material, and towards textures that give authenticity and warmth.

 

**Smart Technology for Modern Living**

 

Technology plays a key role in improving the comfort of bathrooms. Touchless faucets as well as LED-lit mirrors, are now becoming commonplace in the most luxurious designs. Modern systems are increasingly incorporating water-saving options, which are in line with Australia's commitment to sustainability. High WELS-rated fixtures can cut down on the use of water by a significant amount while retaining performance which makes them green and efficient. These developments demonstrate how ease of use and environmental sustainability are in sync.

 

**Space Optimisation With Contemporary Layouts**

 

Space efficiency is another major trend, particularly within the urban Australian homes. Showers that are floating, walk-in vanities and large-format tiles are commonly employed to give a seamless and open-air feeling. The absence of grout lines does not just improve aesthetics, but also lower maintenance needs. Heating for underfloors is also increasing in popularity, providing constant warmth, while also keeping floors dry, thereby reducing the chance of mold development.

 

**Warm Minimalism and Colour Trends**

 

The days of white, cold bathrooms. A warm, minimalist style will be trending with earthy hues like beige, sage, and soft greys becoming more well-known. These colors create an welcoming and comfortable environment with a sleek and modern style. Designers are also using textures and layers of materials to give dimension and character, without weighing down the space.

 

**Enhancing Value Through Smart Upgrades**

 

In the middle of any renovation It is crucial to concentrate on the features that provide convenience and value over the long term. This is why bathrooms remodeling plans should focus on solid materials, a well-designed layout and technology that is future-proof. For instance, using tiles with large dimensions can reduce maintenance of grout by as much as 80percent, and installing efficient lighting can reduce the use of electricity over time. These upgrades are practical and assure that luxury isn't just about looks, but about efficiency and sustainability.

 

**Texture, Lighting and Personalisation**

 

Bathrooms of the present are becoming increasingly characterized by the texture and individuality. The use of matte surfaces, fluted surfaces and tactile materials are used to give visually appealing and dimensional. Lighting plays an essential part in enhancing these textures. Soft indirect lighting highlighting important design elements. Personal touches like customized vanities, unique fixtures, and well-curated design help to create a space that is reflective of the individuality of each person while preserving the same style.

 

**Conclusion**

 

Achieving a more luxurious bathroom in 2026 will require a careful balance of comfort, luxury and utility. From spa-like elements and natural materials to sophisticated design and technology Modern trends concentrate on creating bathrooms that are beautiful as well as practical. Through incorporating these elements homeowners can create an exquisite finish that increases your daily life and adds value over time. When it comes down to it making the investment in [bathroom waterproofing](https://maps.app.goo.gl/GPqvC11FXs3dEogx8) will ensure that your bathroom remains contemporary comfortable and long-lasting for many years to come. If you're planning on upgrading looking for the most reliable options and materials through companies like United Trade Links can support an informed and professional method to achieve long-lasting outcomes.

body.title: (EN-PT) Practical steps to funding your invention-Passos práticos para financiar sua invenção
body.body: was originally uploaded by_ [_Steve Jurvetson_](https://www.flickr.com/photos/jurvetson/) _on Flickr and is reused here under the terms and conditions of the Creative Commons_ [_Attribution 2.0 Generic (CC BY 2.0)_](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/2.0/) _license_ Creativity is inherent to humans. In fact, many people have dreamed about turning an idea into a real-life project. In this way, they can become innovators and inventors. However, imagination is one thing and realization is another. Money is what usually comes in-between. Therefore, in order to develop commercially an invention, funding is of primary importance in case an inventor has limited financial resources available. At a first stage, marketing the invention by participating in trade shows held both locally and at a national and international level is crucial. It is worth investing any limited, and therefore, highly valuable monetary resources in promoting the basic idea of the invention. This tactic is more possible to result in a much needed incoming investment, than trying to save money, with the intention of using it to further develop the concept from a technical point of view. As in any business area and sector, marketing, promoting and finally selling a product, a service or an idea is the ultimate goal and should be at the center of attention. In essence, raising finance to bring an invention into commercial production has many similarities to the procedure that is followed when applying for any form of business finance. Viable and detailed business plans, as well as carefully-structured cash flow statements, are the foundations of the process of attracting funds for an invention. What investors need to see before approving the funding of an invention is how much profit their investment is expected to yield, as well as how and when some part of this profit will be paid to them. They also want to rest assured that any risk of losing their money is minimized. Therefore, an inventor should be adequately prepared to convince investors by showing them solid forecasts of the potential that a product has to produce healthy profits. On the other hand, there are a few things to consider that are apply specifically to invention funding, compared to general business funding. https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=677ZtSMr4-4 First of all, it should be noted that there are two main categories of investors when it comes to funding an invention: Venture capitalists and business angels. These two types of investors are more specialized in investments such as funding the development of an invention, due to the fact that they are more willing to undertake risk than other more conservative financial institutions, like the banks. However, they still want to know how their funds will be spent, and for this reason, they require from the inventor to provide them with evidence of solid planning and reporting, before they make their funds available. If an inventor’s efforts to raise funds by appealing to venture capital firms are not met with success, there is an alternative form of funding that may come from the so-called business angels. Typically, business angels are wealthy individuals who are willing to help aspiring entrepreneurs in exchange of a share in future profits. It is generally believed that investments by business angels are based on emotional criteria, in contrast to venture capitalists who usually set stricter rules and terms. Of course, they are not fools who give their money away to anyone asking for their financial assistance. What they need to see from an inventor who asks for their money is passion and willingness to work hard and succeed. These personal qualities, combined with a positive assessment of the whole project might make them put aside any typical standards, such as a formal business feasibility study, and approve the funding of an invention. The common thing between these two forms of investors is that they expect to make a profit in return of their investment. This sacrifice in the form of a share in future profits can be avoided by the inventor by applying for funding to a government agency that is responsible for making funding decision for inventions and innovative applications in general. There are many government agencies that are specialized in different business areas. For example, if an invention helps in cutting down on energy consumption, the inventor should file an application for funding to the Department of Energy. There is an interesting case in the U.K. where there is funding available for projects particularly aimed to improve or assist with the operation of public sector services. An alternative option to raising finance to further develop an idea which has already taken the form of a prototype is to license the invention or collaborate with a research company or a university. The major disadvantage of this approach is that the inventor partners with a company or an academic institution, which limits their personal involvement in the project. On the other hand, there is the advantage of gaining access to invaluable sources of knowledge and expertise about an invention, and this might help tremendously in its further development. (Versão portuguesa)

foi originalmente carregado por_ [_Steve Jurvetson_](https://www.flickr.com/photos/jurvetson/) no Flickr e é reutilizada aqui sob os termos e condições do _Creative Commons_ [_Attribution 2.0 Generic (CC BY 2.0)_](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/2.0/) _licença_

A criatividade é inerente ao ser humano. De fato, muitas pessoas já sonharam em transformar uma ideia em um projeto real. Dessa forma, podem se tornar inovadoras e inventoras. No entanto, imaginar é uma coisa, e concretizar é outra. O dinheiro geralmente é o obstáculo entre os dois. Portanto, para desenvolver comercialmente uma invenção, o financiamento é fundamental, especialmente se o inventor dispõe de recursos financeiros limitados.

Numa primeira etapa, é crucial comercializar a invenção participando de feiras comerciais, tanto locais quanto nacionais e internacionais. Vale a pena investir os recursos financeiros limitados, e, portanto, valiosos, na promoção da ideia básica da invenção. Essa tática tem maior probabilidade de gerar o investimento necessário do que tentar economizar dinheiro com a intenção de utilizá-lo para desenvolver ainda mais o conceito do ponto de vista técnico. Como em qualquer área ou setor de negócios, o marketing, a promoção e, finalmente, a venda de um produto, serviço ou ideia são o objetivo final e devem ser o foco principal.

Em essência, a captação de recursos para levar uma invenção à produção comercial apresenta muitas semelhanças com o procedimento seguido na solicitação de qualquer tipo de financiamento empresarial. Planos de negócios viáveis ​​e detalhados, bem como demonstrações de fluxo de caixa cuidadosamente estruturadas, são os alicerces do processo de captação de recursos para uma invenção. O que os investidores precisam ver antes de aprovar o financiamento de uma invenção é o lucro esperado do investimento, bem como a forma e o prazo para o pagamento de parte desse lucro. Eles também querem ter a garantia de que o risco de perda do investimento será minimizado.

Portanto, um inventor deve estar adequadamente preparado para convencer os investidores, apresentando projeções sólidas do potencial de um produto para gerar lucros expressivos. Por outro lado, existem alguns aspectos específicos a serem considerados no financiamento de invenções, em comparação com o financiamento empresarial em geral.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=677ZtSMr4-4

Primeiramente, é importante destacar que existem duas categorias principais de investidores quando se trata de financiar uma invenção: capitalistas de risco e investidores-anjo. Esses dois tipos de investidores são mais especializados em investimentos como o financiamento do desenvolvimento de uma invenção, devido ao fato de estarem mais dispostos a assumir riscos do que outras instituições financeiras mais conservadoras, como os bancos. No entanto, eles ainda querem saber como seus fundos serão gastos e, por esse motivo, exigem do inventor evidências de um planejamento e relatórios sólidos antes de liberarem o capital.

Se os esforços de um inventor para captar recursos por meio de empresas de capital de risco não forem bem-sucedidos, existe uma forma alternativa de financiamento que pode vir dos chamados investidores-anjo.

Normalmente, os investidores-anjo são indivíduos ricos que estão dispostos a ajudar empreendedores promissores em troca de uma participação nos lucros futuros. Acredita-se geralmente que os investimentos de investidores-anjo sejam baseados em critérios emocionais, em contraste com os capitalistas de risco, que normalmente estabelecem regras e termos mais rígidos.

É claro que eles não são tolos que distribuem seu dinheiro para qualquer um que peça ajuda financeira. O que eles precisam ver em um inventor que solicita investimento é paixão e disposição para trabalhar duro e ter sucesso. Essas qualidades pessoais, combinadas com uma avaliação positiva de todo o projeto, podem levá-los a deixar de lado padrões típicos, como um estudo formal de viabilidade comercial, e aprovar o financiamento de uma invenção.

O que esses dois tipos de investidores têm em comum é a expectativa de obter lucro em troca do investimento. Esse sacrifício, na forma de participação nos lucros futuros, pode ser evitado pelo inventor ao solicitar financiamento a uma agência governamental responsável por tomar decisões sobre financiamento para invenções e aplicações inovadoras em geral. Existem muitas agências governamentais especializadas em diferentes áreas de negócios. Por exemplo, se uma invenção ajuda a reduzir o consumo de energia, o inventor deve apresentar uma solicitação de financiamento ao Departamento de Energia. Há um caso interessante no Reino Unido, onde há financiamento disponível para projetos voltados especificamente para aprimorar ou auxiliar a operação de serviços do setor público.

Uma alternativa à captação de recursos para o desenvolvimento de uma ideia que já possui um protótipo é licenciar a invenção ou colaborar com uma empresa de pesquisa ou universidade. A principal desvantagem dessa abordagem é que o inventor se associa a uma empresa ou instituição acadêmica, o que limita seu envolvimento pessoal no projeto. Por outro lado, há a vantagem de obter acesso a fontes inestimáveis ​​de conhecimento e experiência sobre a invenção, o que pode contribuir enormemente para o seu desenvolvimento.

(Este post foi traduzido do inglês para o português com o Google Translate)

_Further reading:_

[5 steps for turning your invention idea into a product](https://www.entrepreneur.com/slideshow/299456)

[Practical tips on navigating the patent process](https://www.bytestart.co.uk/navigate-patent-process.html)

[Ways to Get Creative with seeking Funding for Your Invention](https://fastercapital.com/content/Ways-to-Get-Creative-with-seeking-Funding-for-Your-Invention.html)

[Startup funding: how it works and how to raise it](https://seedlegals.com/resources/startup-funding-guide/)

[How to Seek Funding for Your Invention](https://www.uschamber.com/co/run/business-financing/how-to-get-funding-for-inventions)

body.title: EDUCATION OR OBEDIENCE? WHAT DOES MODERN SCHOOL CHOOSE?
body.body:
What do you think, guys?
What does the modern educational system propose for our kids?
What does it teach them? To be free and intelligent or to be obedient and dependent?

It's a question for many hot discussions now, especially among unschooling families (others just don't see any problems as a rule).
But what does the last news show us?


![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmbYFXDCNRCZ5CBDsvDhbfuRca5QEA3JCtw5JPNjWrcu21/image.png)


he Ministry of Education held a final board meeting. Among the goals for 2026-2027 is the full implementation of a three-point assessment for behavior: \

Starting in September 2026, a pilot program will be implemented in 10 schools in each region. Starting in September 2027, all schools in the country will implement the assessment. The assessment will be included in the certificate.
The Ministry of Education believes that schools are obligated to educate, and teachers must have the tools to do so.

But, let's remember!
Behavior assessments were abolished long ago, and for good reason. They measured obedience, not maturity.

The conflict isn't in the assessment itself, but in who sets the standard. Education through dialogue and education through judgment are very different schools.

I think the child must have a  right to disagree with anything in educational process, he has to have a right for his own opinion. Without documented consequences or a ruined life.

Guys, are there in your schools behaviour marks?
Do you support them?

Hi,

I'm struggling into life atm, facing injuries, unemployment without any income and depression.

Photography has always been the beacon in the dark so I began doing lightpainting again starting from last week. I'll try to do it as often as possible during the following weeks as I'm convinced it will help me to recover and smile again.

For my 3rd session, I've been there with my girlfriend. She's not really aware abour lightpainting so she was curious about how I do it. I was a bit tired during that session but I took a lot of pleasure at it and we had great time together.

body.title: My son's 7th birthday celebration
body.body: My one and only son's 7th birthday Celebration, his name is Liamjace Axel, we used to call him \

. Celebrating 7th birthday is a milestone of growing and maturity, it is a transition from early childhood to a more matured stage.


![DCR04106 (1).jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/choiscxel01/23xekFp4B2LvgtvPzJBsGhTW57XCJBzyUrG5sMxTYnZRBVmenPQ3zsarjeKo73o1oPhXe.jpg)

Celebrating 7th birthday is not complete without the 7 symbolic Elements (7 Balloons, 7 Chocolates, 7 Gifts, 7 Teddy bear, 7 Bills, 7 Treasures, and 7 cakes). And here are the selected family members and friends that will share, give some wishes and guidance to my son.


7 Balloons symbolize of happiness and dreams and it represents 7 years of my son's life. Part of the 7 balloons are the babies of our family, my son's cousins, niece and nephew.

![DCR04224.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/choiscxel01/23yTfQr49D4Xm2S2sGHWTLUhU477uQzkLLgTY95SE1FzTnMLrt3WgS3v6zw7LQRb8maHJ.jpg)

7 Chocolates symbolize a year of my son's life filed with love and happiness. Part of the 7 chocolates are his classmates and playmates.

![DCR04234.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/choiscxel01/23xVErWnYdKsCTLrsUTXYXDciVuBFyvnR5S9uNdyP7pzueRP6AJDv9X3YkrauFx6iDzSw.jpg)

7 Teddy bear symbolize of love, comfort and care. Part of the 7 Teddy bear is his girl classmates and cousins.

![DCR04242.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/choiscxel01/23zS3AfjCYaZbtuderbKmpKRDojxmYx7eUUkSTRRLhs7fV5JEkrxM8Lqgb14iDH7Ac2QL.jpg)

7 Gifts, symbolize of fun, creativity and adventure. Part of the 7 Teddy bear is his selected cousins and friends.
 
![DCR04246.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/choiscxel01/23yd3hVsyZ2zy8RCRNFxBzk4EEYdGfxp77JHqJU7nCxut85QqEtJ7LM5QpGX7tYNR2Btx.jpg)

7 Bills, symbolize of prosperity and good fortune. It is presented to my child to teach about financial responsibility. 7 bills given by his Uncle and God parents.


![DCR04288.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/choiscxel01/243BiCdZkiAmcVUaXy531WZ4fr7ydyYMuMnCp2vNe1h5F4wDAvBW5g2KrbLAFZjJuZLcx.jpg)


7 Treasure represents meaningful gift given by my sons grand parents. They are signify the enduring love and care.


![DCR04298.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/choiscxel01/244y3v49NjqQ8hPkwvipLtkEADeX8K5ApDH9ehsndnoAY7qPUbBSJeegLqHRURs4NxEhE.jpg)



7 Cakes symbolize joy and celebration. Part of the 7 cakes are his Aunties and Godmother.

![DCR04257.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/choiscxel01/23zGcdyCFzNc7SvSJDgemXgEWfAYwKxdmAFqoLN6c1V1xsmanG2nG1SeKDDJXHwi9AE2X.jpg)

And this last photo is one of my favorite. Me and my husband kissing my son. Witnessing his joy and seeing that his having fun on his birthday is one of the best feelings in the world and it makes me feel that all challenges of parenting is worthwhile.

![DCR04315.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/choiscxel01/23yJNqnmvQy8R4xpNqzRa5uukdAZ1g8psQEoAsXoCt8Z7DbyJyzPhbEm7DcWa1ULjBLjw.jpg)

body.title: BABAN YARA
body.body:
/>

image generated using Gemini AI

Jide was a Yoruba boy from Ondo State, though he carried the unmistakable grace of his mother’s Edo roots. He was a dark-skinned, handsome guy. His presence commanded a room without saying a word. He had broad shoulders with his chest shooting out on his tight t-shirts to the point of tension with other men, and an admiration from the ladies. He had locs which were thick and well-kept, falling forward just enough to show his face, which rarely smiled in public places. To a stranger, his silence felt like a warning; he had this heavy, unbothered presence that made people step aside when he walked by, assuming he was a 'terror' or a 'bad boy' you didn't want to cross.  
The first time I met Jide was during a class in my 100-level days. He was sitting beside me during the class, quiet as usual, paying serious attention to the lecturer as if he was understanding all that the lecturer was saying. He would jot down every point and detail of what the lecturer said, and he would murmur to himself on different occasions, like someone who was understanding everything the lecturer was saying.  
I turned to Jide and asked him to explain something the lecturer said, and I was amused by his response.  
Me: Hey, bro, could you explain to me what the lecturer just said? I don’t seem to understand all that he has been saying,  
Bro, this thing self tire me oh, Jide laughed, “I just dey observe oh, nothing dey enter this head”.  
This was when I knew that Jide was my kind of person, and we started gisting during the class and forgot why we were in class in the first place.  
Jide: I go come this man class every time him fix class, but baba nothing dey enter head  
Me: Omo, I been thinking say na only me oh!  
Jide: e get this my guy I dey meet after every class sha him dey put me through  
Me: na who be that?  
Jide: You fit no sabi the guy, na 300 level him dey, him name na Adisa  
Me: Adisa wey dey NESA first eleven?  
Jide: Yes, na the guy be that, him sabi book die!  
Me: Okay na, you go hook me up Ibeg  
Jide: No wahala now.  
We exchanged contact with Jide, and from that day, Jide and I became close friends.  
Jide knew how people had perceived him, and he was okay with everything. He was a very kind and generous guy. Jide will always put the needs of others above his own needs. Those people who were close to him will testify every time how they had misjudged Jide at first glance of him, only to find out later when they got to know him for themselves, as the opposite of the person they had perceived him to be.  
Back then at school, our department was situated at the mini campus in Gwagwalada, and our exams were always held at the main campus. I will remember how Jide would always fuel his car just to take the five of us and himself to the main campus for our exams, and still bring us back to the mini campus without receiving any dime from us in the form of a contribution for fuel or as payment for transportation. He would instead buy lunch for us anytime we were having a second paper in the evening. Jide would also go out of his way to support others. The other day, while sitting with Jide, a coursemate of ours came to meet him for assistance. I knew all Jide had at the moment was just five hundred naira, as he had shown me the note earlier, because I loved holding mint, and anytime I had one with me, it took the grace of God for me to spend it. Jide dipped his hands into his pocket, brought out the five hundred naira note, and gave it to the course mate of ours without thinking twice about it.

I could remember how Jide loves playing with children, The first time I visited his house, only to see that all the children living in his compound were in his room playing with him, for a moment, I could not believe what I saw, I thought I was playful with kids, but seeing Jide with those kids that evening made we knew that I was no way a match to Jide’s playful nature. In fact, the women in his compound called him Baban Yara, which was a phrase in the Hausa language meaning “Father of children”.  
What I learned from Jide was that the true character of a person is not found in their silence or their stature; it is found in what they do when no one is watching.

Thank you for reading through my post. My name is@rishagamo, and above is my response to the week’s prompt 28 “A STRANGER'S VIEW”

body.title: WHEN THE LIGHTS TURN ON
body.body:
![Kopia – Whispers (1).jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ladytruckview/23xLBF1ehei1H1kZAYEwh2ECbi3Gc2yYTUbSnLcv3Ncj7KQ6a2CxkYSn3Y7h7GtsiL6wz.jpg)

Last week I had the opportunity to be in Italy. I managed to get flight tickets at a good price, so I packed my things, took my sister and my friend with me, and with just carry-on luggage we flew to Lamezia Terme. For our accommodation, I chose a small, charming town called Pizzo, and it is exactly this place that will be the main subject of today’s post.

Pizzo is a small town located in southern Italy, more precisely in the Calabria region. It lies on the Tyrrhenian Sea. It has a very typical southern Italian atmosphere—calm, slightly raw, but above all authentic. Here, you can truly feel the real Italy.

We arrived in the early evening. It took us a while to find our accommodation, as the town is one big maze. Narrow streets, stairs, countless passages, and very small distances between buildings. Even the navigation got confused in this place. 😁

Pizzo welcomed us with a beautiful sunset. The colors in the sky kept changing, creating a true spectacle.


>W zeszłym tygodniu miałam okazję być we Włoszech. Udało się dostać bilety lotnicze w korzystnej cenie, także spakowałam swoje rzeczy, zabrałam ze sobą siostrę i koleżankę i z bagażem podręcznym poleciałyśmy do Lamezia Terme. Na miejsce noclegu wybrałam małe, urokliwe miasteczko o nazwie Pizzo i to właśnie ono będzie dzisiaj 
bohaterem mojego posta.
>
>Pizzo to niewielkie miasteczko położone w południowych Włoszech, a dokładniej w regionie Kalabria. Leży nad Morzem Tyrreńskim. Ma bardzo typowy południowo-włoski klimat. Spokojny, zarazem trochę surowy, ale przede wszystkim autentyczny. Można tutaj poczuć prawdziwe Włochy.
>
>Na miejsce dotarłyśmy wczesnym wieczorem. Chwilę nam zajęło, zanim znalazłyśmy nasze zakwaterowanie. Miasteczko to bowiem jeden wielki labirynt. Wąskie uliczki, schody, mnóstwo przejść, bardzo małe odległości pomiędzy budynkami. Nawet nawigacja gubiła się w tym miejscu. 😁
>
>Pizo przywitało nas przepięknym zachodem słońca. Kolory na niebie co chwilę się zmieniały, tworząc istny spektakl.


![20260416_193304.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ladytruckview/23wMaSLC7m1Lk5JMien3sVh9nTR5DtotGBGto3WvgZ1qr9Umf2UxsxsizuTkkZRNzF4T9.jpg)

![20260416_193247.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ladytruckview/EowFCQWqqNbnmswmwVVkCtFea4qYJFXFeNTksuf9MAyykKnQaZRJT2xBjxVsUEbgyBe.jpg)

We climbed a bit higher to admire the beautiful panorama of the town against the setting sun. It cost us a lot of energy, as the terrain there is quite demanding, but the views we had and could enjoy immediately made it all worthwhile.

>Wdrapałyśmy się kawałek wyżej, aby podziwiać piękną panoramę miasteczka na tle zachodzącego słońca. Kosztowało nas to dużo pokładów naszej energii, gdyż teren jest tam dosyć wymagający, jednak widoki, które mogłyśmy podziwiać, od razu nam ten trud wynagrodziły.


![20260416_195027.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ladytruckview/2423sLz2cierRcXq6En5DmpWFqZpbSbkWyqojVJP1K8Py2XJu6QLgQDkKukiL3DQLSSe8.jpg)

![20260416_193536.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ladytruckview/23zRtiTe1dsjgsKwJzvrzLVjqXwKKEzUY6UPfNearw1XcABbw53pZCngjZUrxCUFrieWh.jpg)

![20260416_195035.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ladytruckview/EpGR9LxbwJ1Aqb6tY6A2knyJSH2LTrsRoTQ752rsWTxXXx4fRg1ceCeGL22ntiqGWvP.jpg)

![20260416_195013.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ladytruckview/242rpruezW93BFuptXDhNkzhy7jAhRDtE93WPqTRc2KtbDQ5XZbmGfBzBMbYKgujFkt4q.jpg)

*The last picture above is my entry for Around The World: Challenge - #50/6*

We wandered around the area, exploring the narrow streets, immersing ourselves in the Italian atmosphere, and admiring the typical Italian architecture, already worn by time, yet creating an incredibly charming atmosphere.

>Przechadzałyśmy się po okolicy, zwiedzając wąskie uliczki, zatapiając się w klimat włoski, podziwiając typową włoską architekturę, nadszarpniętą już co prawda zębem czasu, ale niesamowicie tworzącą urokliwy klimat.


![20260416_194554.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ladytruckview/23z72vpJ3uqe99mbUYrYzg7QieSgJuHFiFFjqc9G6Cdp7EhsjMFKpLbYc5cvRRNL8xHkB.jpg)

![20260416_194635.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ladytruckview/23ynUtWDuKYEZ9FqbgiD7txcdTvsPpCTQnDh46Fq4gckJ6qtBeANDEpUyaXPkgJSnsYym.jpg)

![20260416_194112.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ladytruckview/242Ncomdb1jcb1nTDrvH4SNyTb1XJ7RA6Bz8UKPFQxtn9TAtM8WzqP5QZ8ir2jevDhEUG.jpg)

![20260416_194625.JPG-2.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ladytruckview/23vPGQuHUVM7hG7oEdigoRhUiVJNWKeY4pv9yBc4Rzh7x1mJrh9EtRBwwRBcxpzAUXJA5.JPG)

![20260416_195139.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ladytruckview/23wMY1X2kpdm4dUDRJSZWVQySrcfD7xp4TYHZfsaL1ffAG4HZZ2nor27VFN5QzWU5d6my.jpg)

The main square of Pizzo is small, but the town itself is also small. In the square, there are many good restaurants and ice cream shops, as well as a small church.

>Ryneczek Pizzo jest niewielki, ale też niewielka jest również samo miasteczko. Na rynku znajduje się mnóstwo dobrych restauracji i lodziarni, jak również mały kościółek.


![20260416_194007-Social-2.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ladytruckview/243qD4R2cDibdoGoGi5gSi4RcPqbpr1wG8Lwmpb6PGDzqDzQePY7wYXNc7P1cCwUrN4M5.jpg)

![20260416_194031.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ladytruckview/245ca8ELuXQajXxj2qVA17o3pfpuiY4X9TVksFxqefZ3RyJt2mYAw8z8XWmSrHu8zvaVn.jpg)

There is also a small castle near the square, which is a source of pride for this place. However, I will show you photos of the castle another time. During this weekend, I took a lot of pictures, and there will definitely be a few more posts from the town of Pizzo and the surrounding area on my profile.

I will tell you honestly that this town completely stole my heart. All those little corners, hidden spots, and the whole architecture have an incredible atmosphere. It is definitely a place for anyone who wants to see real Italian life, away from mass tourism.

We met many kind people along the way. It was one of my better trips, and I will remember it very fondly for a long time.

>Przy rynku znajduje się również niewielki zameczek, będący dumą tego miejsca. Zdjęcia zamku pokażę wam jednak kiedy indziej. Przez ten weekend zrobiłam mnóstwo zdjęć i z pewnością pojawi się jeszcze na moim profilu kilka postów z miasteczka Pizzo i okolicy. 
>
>Powiem Wam szczerze, że miasteczko skradło moje serce totalnie. Te wszystkie zakamarki, zakątki, cała ta architektura ma w sobie niesamowity klimat. Z pewnością jest to miejsce dla każdego, kto chce zobaczyć prawdziwe włoskie życie z dala od masowych turystów. 
>
>Spotkałyśmy na swojej drodze mnóstwo życzliwych ludzi. Był to jeden z lepszych moich wypadów i będę wspominać to bardzo miło jeszcze przez długi czas.

body.title: Mosquitoes make annoying noises to the ears of humans.
body.body: > https://img.leopedia.io/DQmXQLqB4LxMwkVQAXBeR2MLdZ1QMRka3CoTnXvZt7U12bD/1000067120.jpg Hello friends, I hope you are doing well. Welcome to my new post. Mosquitoes are found in almost every country in our world and this mosquito is an ancient creature. In our Bangladesh, when the winter season ends, summer begins. And during this time, mosquito infestation is most common. Especially in urban areas and remote areas of villages, mosquito infestation is most common. Summer is usually very hot everywhere and at this time mosquitoes are most likely to breed. When the rainy season comes, their infestation increases a little more. During the rainy season, there are many dirty conditions in different places in our country. Water accumulates in many places due to which mosquitoes lay eggs there. And due to these mosquitoes, various diseases occur in people. In summer, people with various mosquito-borne diseases can be seen in the hospitals of the cities of our country. Especially young children are most affected by mosquito bites. Also, elderly people are always affected by mosquito-borne diseases. However, have you ever thought that when mosquitoes come near our ears, they make a lot of noise and it annoys us a lot. In fact, when mosquitoes fly, the sound made by their wings is this annoying sound. Especially female mosquitoes feed on human blood. They move around the human body all the time. When they get a chance, they come near our ears and make an annoying sound. As a result, we get very annoyed and we keep chasing the mosquito. Female mosquitoes mainly lay eggs, due to which they need a lot of blood. And they collect this blood from the human body. It would be wrong to say only humans, they also collect it from various animals. In our country, especially many nuisances of Aedes mosquitoes have increased at present. The electricity situation in our country is quite bad. There is load shedding for about 15 to 16 hours a day. And this time can be seen as a bad time for us. When the fan is not running due to electricity, mosquitoes are constantly extracting blood from our body. Especially at night, the mosquito infestation is very high. But of course we need to use mosquito nets. We need to reduce the use of coils a lot. Because coils are very harmful to the human body. I hope you will like this post of mine, thank you. ![1000019308.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmRW9rHroSFBSAKdERxzaNWNAnWKCXRUdrHF4LbDABXrT6/1000019308.png) --- Divce | realmi c67 -|-| [source this picture link]( https://pixabay.com/photos/mosquito-female-aedes-albopictus-1332382/ ) ### Kind Regards @nahid43 ![1000019308.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmRW9rHroSFBSAKdERxzaNWNAnWKCXRUdrHF4LbDABXrT6/1000019308.png) Posted Using [INLEO](https://inleo.io/@nahid43/there-is-no-end-to-corruption-and-errors-in-the-ssc-exams-in-our-country-eip)

body.body:

<center>
![y1IHIbWHME7Zpfvk_faceu_-413_20260414224746518.webp](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/tingjie/images/y1IHIbWHME7Zpfvk_faceu_-413_20260414224746518/y1IHIbWHME7Zpfvk_faceu_-413_20260414224746518.webp)
![jU9yJ42aFeqL6e7M_faceu_-413_20260414214241485.webp](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/tingjie/images/jU9yJ42aFeqL6e7M_faceu_-413_20260414214241485/jU9yJ42aFeqL6e7M_faceu_-413_20260414214241485.webp)
![yHPIGOKMBEyQoIuQ_faceu_-413_20260414204135136.webp](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/tingjie/images/yHPIGOKMBEyQoIuQ_faceu_-413_20260414204135136/yHPIGOKMBEyQoIuQ_faceu_-413_20260414204135136.webp)
![LCceu7ZCqI5RzQzV_faceu_-413_20260414204124136.webp](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/tingjie/images/LCceu7ZCqI5RzQzV_faceu_-413_20260414204124136/LCceu7ZCqI5RzQzV_faceu_-413_20260414204124136.webp)
</center>
</liketuimages>

好久好久都没做金枕蛋糕了，也没有特别想念，但还是买了金枕盒子回来，上一次买的大概用了一年多才消耗完，也不是全部做金枕消耗的，可见我现在对烘焙的热情降了多少😂我也没有问其他人想不想吃，反正我爸是不用问的，他是吃货，我妈也没跟我提，我就随自己意愿了，想做就做，不想做就不做咯~

这次想做是想做点给外婆尝一下，做两个我们一个，送外婆一个，给她多也不行，保鲜期短，放坏了浪费（面粉糖油倒是不心疼，心疼我的土鸡蛋哈哈）加上外婆还有点糖高！如果她喜欢，以后就多次少量的给她做。

不知道为啥，我总觉得分蛋做的 没有全蛋做出来的蛋香味浓！不知道是不是我的错觉，反正不喜欢吃它了。我妈她们还没有我那么抵触，还是喜欢的，一个金枕一天消耗下肚了😄

好久没有糕点出炉那刻的成就感了，以前就是那种感觉一直在 我才喜欢“折腾”的，得找找了……



---

body.title: A Paradise in the Andes: Timotes | El paraíso de los Andes: Timotes ⛰️
body.body:
ENGLISH VERSION (click here!) Good morning, travelers. ![InShot_20260423_090342351.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmNvFdtoMomxcRxdCX6mXSF5ikWntfPmcycvdgY4NqMXFw/InShot_20260423_090342351.jpg) After spending almost all of Holy Thursday traveling through parts of Trujillo state, we headed to Mérida state to wrap up that amazing day. I couldn’t take any photos along the way because I was charging my phone, but I must tell you that our route took us through the entire city of Valera, up the Quebrada de Cuevas, and along the Transandina Highway until we reached Timotes, the first small town we came across upon arriving in Mérida. Along the way, the rain set in, bringing cooler weather than is typical for that area. ![20260402_175259.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmZoMREYXsuqZr5LxU3mae9wS8v63t2oXmUTSamuKD3mvq/20260402_175259.jpg) ![20260402_175312.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmREo7PXmgmsvcrUx1BNKs8VAcddJBFRkgoUmiLziWPDcL/20260402_175312.jpg) Timotes is a beautiful little town that’s over 400 years old. It’s known for its breathtaking mountain scenery. I hadn’t been there since I was in college about 12 years ago, so I was really excited to return. Our first stop was at Doctor José Gregorio Hernández Park, a beautiful gift from the Briceño family to beautify the area at the entrance to Timotes. ![20260402_175105.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQme6UwufcdYL7aPMJWxQobb9LYsMaY3sUnNkZTimR7ZuLV/20260402_175105.jpg) ![20260402_175108.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmVS5ptvAfBDfiGjL3cxCjrjohz13PxCafyGKLPZFtX3hx/20260402_175108.jpg) ![20260402_175111.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmZkqzb9MnMxi6jKnLjdhSjsGUUdFjYqRcnZZ3pinFKBat/20260402_175111.jpg) The second stop was at the Minor Basilica of Saint Lucy, which features imposing and charming architecture in a Neo-Gothic style, highlighted by its bell tower and a small statue of Saint Lucy. I was able to see a little of the interior, but not enough because there were many people attending the Holy Thursday Mass; if I recall correctly, it is on this day during Holy Week that the Washing of the Feet takes place. ![20260402_180029.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmPy2NSDvtUSBBKurV6ck25z8THpT6MUHLdqaWZSbJAF2f/20260402_180029.jpg) ![20260402_180054.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmU3R9s4S2Hkqs8wmTFiWX6xYZAVGNU9K4aZaNUZTBQ9xE/20260402_180054.jpg) ![20260402_180102.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmeZErmehnPu5Um6hBcNoQqrWkEBCjq2thcSM84JFVrye3/20260402_180102.jpg) ![20260402_180106.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmZXh9zUW1XtepXy66WgGb6EF8UGe1G61rzCWCDoBJUZ4C/20260402_180106.jpg) ![20260402_180413.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmesDFMkJnG9VoQfkstrrfrs46oFa79tcQdjy99PVh8Fcb/20260402_180413.jpg) ![20260402_180508.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmYGHYZx3oFMJi5HnY8whhPsB243Vfn285L3VULZyLchkD/20260402_180508.jpg) ![20260402_180511.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmauB65U2uMFKde4MwUqD4Lctaxqb2hZ96UqpqVjFFZ6uj/20260402_180511.jpg) ![20260402_180301.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmWmmmoQf4RYKD7FGsnQwy1Lt8sH1eX4nFEPYAwJ82UdNj/20260402_180301.jpg) ![20260402_180314.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmdFV2kRB42amV51FidiFFLgDRCMu9gow63YDce81Dg47d/20260402_180314.jpg) ![20260402_180458.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmYpTi4senFDFHqs5ULPJLvg1ZfD3BuYcFc3VqKPXmu1gF/20260402_180458.jpg) The third and final stop was at Plaza Bolívar. I usually visit these places wherever I go, but this one has a special and unique significance since Simón Bolívar passed through Timotes during his campaign to liberate part of the western region of the country. ![20260402_180650.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmbfJabu5GE4D4FKoxB54eribyyjiLURVCWoUkeHRfUDn4/20260402_180650.jpg) ![20260402_180758.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmUeCqn1ezQoqukKGEA4LaSXkdxiEfTfMUYzj5yYvGgb52/20260402_180758.jpg) ![20260402_180839.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmddDSCWbrFB4JbXbBfBePkj6pgbei1brsPzY58pLNyccs/20260402_180839.jpg) ![20260402_180904.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmPEyAxcdgSahDH49QFxkJLBAWPEabYDSrqWRkVd8GydEY/20260402_180904.jpg) That day, I could only take photos of the Bolívar statue from a distance, since the area was off-limits and cordoned off with a security barrier, so, like good citizens, we stayed in the surrounding area enjoying the tall trees and the moss hanging from them, which adds a touch of magic to the place. We saw a small playground and some little birds playing near it what a joy it is for me when I spot a bird along the way. ![20260402_180001.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmPjrWjtSCySqj1bPfrEJTP1NViYe9Bwp74Pk7dFwzSpCU/20260402_180001.jpg) ![20260402_180625.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmQHRb5L52EQwTCF8e51AFUZKCSWKd8hueamNP53W13yiu/20260402_180625.jpg) ![20260402_180701.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmbQQfQUhDGZCYkykdu2tUMv1YWqETpqZ6Xw8yoDhXPJvK/20260402_180701.jpg) ![20260402_180725.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmbx277KdDDwKToEyV8eu1ryxbLgNRbhbaCPB1YPdMnhVY/20260402_180725.jpg) ![20260402_180952.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmQkACiDiTRRBDgAfg4JiT4WsUoLkkxXrEic4nVwTCDnfd/20260402_180952.jpg) ![20260402_181151.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmbqVnzVY4n5mnftxQds5odPqTLx9ymP8GYPax7NuqKLd4/20260402_181151.jpg) And so ended our first day of travel, full of memories and great stories to cherish forever.

--- Photos taken with a Samsung Galaxy A35. Collage created in [Inshot](https://v.inshot.com/invite) Content owned by me. Translation by: [Deepl](https://www.deepl.com/es/translator)

>

Buenos días, viajeros. 

![InShot_20260423_090342351.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmNvFdtoMomxcRxdCX6mXSF5ikWntfPmcycvdgY4NqMXFw/InShot_20260423_090342351.jpg)

Luego de pasar casi todo el Jueves Santo viajando por algunos sitios del estado Trujillo, nos fuimos hasta el estado Mérida para culminar ese grandioso día, no pude tomar fotos del camino, porque estaba cargando mi teléfono, pero debo decirles que nuestra ruta fue atravesando toda la ciudad de Valera, subiendo por la Quebrada de Cuevas y siguiendo por la carretera Transandina hasta llegar a Timotes el primer pueblito que nos encontramos al llegar a Mérida, en el camino la lluvia se hizo presente, para regalarnos un clima más frío que el que se acostumbra en esa zona.

![20260402_175259.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmZoMREYXsuqZr5LxU3mae9wS8v63t2oXmUTSamuKD3mvq/20260402_175259.jpg)

![20260402_175312.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmREo7PXmgmsvcrUx1BNKs8VAcddJBFRkgoUmiLziWPDcL/20260402_175312.jpg)

Timotes, es un hermoso pueblito que tiene más de 400 años, destaca por sus hermosos paisajes montañosos que dejan sin aliento, no venía desde que estaba en la universidad hace aproximadamente 12 años, así que estaba muy emocionada de volver, la primera parada fue en el Parque Doctor José Gregorio Hernández, un hermoso donativo por parte de la familia Briceño para embellecer un espacio en la entrada a Timotes. 

![20260402_175105.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQme6UwufcdYL7aPMJWxQobb9LYsMaY3sUnNkZTimR7ZuLV/20260402_175105.jpg)

![20260402_175108.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmVS5ptvAfBDfiGjL3cxCjrjohz13PxCafyGKLPZFtX3hx/20260402_175108.jpg)

![20260402_175111.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmZkqzb9MnMxi6jKnLjdhSjsGUUdFjYqRcnZZ3pinFKBat/20260402_175111.jpg)

La segunda parada fue en la Basílica Menor Santa Lucía, la cuál posee una arquitectura imponente y encantadora, con un estilo neogótico donde destaca su campanario y una pequeña imagen de Santa Lucía, pude conocer un poco su interior pero no lo suficiente porque habían muchas personas que estaban en la eucaristía del Jueves Santo, donde sino más recuerdo es el día de la Semana Mayor en el cuál se realiza el Lavatorio de Pies.

![20260402_180029.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmPy2NSDvtUSBBKurV6ck25z8THpT6MUHLdqaWZSbJAF2f/20260402_180029.jpg)

![20260402_180054.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmU3R9s4S2Hkqs8wmTFiWX6xYZAVGNU9K4aZaNUZTBQ9xE/20260402_180054.jpg)

![20260402_180102.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmeZErmehnPu5Um6hBcNoQqrWkEBCjq2thcSM84JFVrye3/20260402_180102.jpg)

![20260402_180106.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmZXh9zUW1XtepXy66WgGb6EF8UGe1G61rzCWCDoBJUZ4C/20260402_180106.jpg)

![20260402_180413.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmesDFMkJnG9VoQfkstrrfrs46oFa79tcQdjy99PVh8Fcb/20260402_180413.jpg)

![20260402_180508.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmYGHYZx3oFMJi5HnY8whhPsB243Vfn285L3VULZyLchkD/20260402_180508.jpg)

![20260402_180511.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmauB65U2uMFKde4MwUqD4Lctaxqb2hZ96UqpqVjFFZ6uj/20260402_180511.jpg)

![20260402_180301.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmWmmmoQf4RYKD7FGsnQwy1Lt8sH1eX4nFEPYAwJ82UdNj/20260402_180301.jpg)

![20260402_180314.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmdFV2kRB42amV51FidiFFLgDRCMu9gow63YDce81Dg47d/20260402_180314.jpg)

![20260402_180458.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmYpTi4senFDFHqs5ULPJLvg1ZfD3BuYcFc3VqKPXmu1gF/20260402_180458.jpg)

La tercera y última parada fue en la Plaza Bolívar, a cada sitio que voy acostumbro a visitarlas, pero aquí tiene un significado especial y distinto ya que Simón Bolívar paso por Timotes en su campaña para liberar parte del occidente del país.

![20260402_180650.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmbfJabu5GE4D4FKoxB54eribyyjiLURVCWoUkeHRfUDn4/20260402_180650.jpg)

![20260402_180758.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmUeCqn1ezQoqukKGEA4LaSXkdxiEfTfMUYzj5yYvGgb52/20260402_180758.jpg)

![20260402_180839.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmddDSCWbrFB4JbXbBfBePkj6pgbei1brsPzY58pLNyccs/20260402_180839.jpg)

![20260402_180904.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmPEyAxcdgSahDH49QFxkJLBAWPEabYDSrqWRkVd8GydEY/20260402_180904.jpg)

Este día solo pude tomar fotos desde lejos de la estatua de Bolívar, ya que no se podía acceder a esa área y tenía un cordón de seguridad, así que como buenos ciudadanos nos quedamos en los alrededores disfrutando de los altos árboles y los musgos guindando de ellos, que le da un toque de magia al lugar, vimos un pequeño parque de juegos y unos pajaritos jugando cerca del mismo, que alegría para mi cuando encuentro alguna ave en el camino.

![20260402_180001.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmPjrWjtSCySqj1bPfrEJTP1NViYe9Bwp74Pk7dFwzSpCU/20260402_180001.jpg)

![20260402_180625.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmQHRb5L52EQwTCF8e51AFUZKCSWKd8hueamNP53W13yiu/20260402_180625.jpg)

![20260402_180701.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmbQQfQUhDGZCYkykdu2tUMv1YWqETpqZ6Xw8yoDhXPJvK/20260402_180701.jpg)

![20260402_180725.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmbx277KdDDwKToEyV8eu1ryxbLgNRbhbaCPB1YPdMnhVY/20260402_180725.jpg)

![20260402_180952.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmQkACiDiTRRBDgAfg4JiT4WsUoLkkxXrEic4nVwTCDnfd/20260402_180952.jpg)

![20260402_181151.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmbqVnzVY4n5mnftxQds5odPqTLx9ymP8GYPax7NuqKLd4/20260402_181151.jpg)

Así culminó nuestro primer día de viaje, lleno de recuerdos y buenas historias para la posteridad.

<center>

body.title: [EN/PT] Caveman
body.body: > He was not amongst the hunters nor, the ones who were gathering food. But, he was amongst the community. He was the one who was drawing on the wall. That was not the only task he was doing, writing their history. He helped with organizing all the tasks. An architect? That is not precisely correct, as he was a caveman after all. A thought that has been haunting him. A question, asking about the reason for all of this. A reason to defend against one kind. Something within him, feels oddly out of time. The thing that tells him that, there should be a reason behind everything. The time of isolation that he had when they all went with their tasks, had given his mind the time to think and reflect. He is unsure if he was starting to make sense of it all, or losing all sense. He knew that, with all the respect that he has among the others, he is still different as he is not doing what everyone else is doing. The one thing he was able to tell at the time was that, even if experience can be lived alone. It loses a lot of its meaning without the others. # PT

>

Ele não estava entre os caçadores, nem entre os que coletavam comida. Mas estava entre a comunidade. Era ele quem desenhava na parede. Essa não era a única tarefa que realizava, além de registrar a história deles. Ele ajudava a organizar todas as tarefas. Um arquiteto?

Isso não era exatamente correto, afinal, ele era um homem das cavernas. Um pensamento que o atormentava. Uma pergunta sobre o motivo de tudo aquilo. Uma razão para se defender de uma espécie. Algo dentro dele parecia estranhamente fora de época. Algo que lhe dizia que deveria haver uma razão por trás de tudo. O tempo de isolamento que teve enquanto todos se dedicavam às suas tarefas deu à sua mente tempo para pensar e refletir. Ele não tinha certeza se estava começando a entender tudo ou se estava perdendo completamente o sentido. Sabia que, apesar de todo o respeito que inspirava entre os outros, ainda era diferente, pois não fazia o que todos faziam. A única coisa que conseguiu perceber naquele momento foi que, mesmo que a experiência possa ser vivida sozinha, ela perde muito do seu significado sem a companhia dos outros.

Posted Using [INLEO](https://inleo.io/@ronnie10/enpt-caveman-27n)

body.body: > https://img.leopedia.io/DQmXQLqB4LxMwkVQAXBeR2MLdZ1QMRka3CoTnXvZt7U12bD/1000067120.jpg Hello friends, I hope you are doing well. Welcome to my new post. Mosquitoes are found in almost every country in our world and this mosquito is an ancient creature. In our Bangladesh, when the winter season ends, summer begins. And during this time, mosquito infestation is most common. Especially in urban areas and remote areas of villages, mosquito infestation is most common. Summer is usually very hot everywhere and at this time mosquitoes are most likely to breed. When the rainy season comes, their infestation increases a little more. During the rainy season, there are many dirty conditions in different places in our country. Water accumulates in many places due to which mosquitoes lay eggs there. And due to these mosquitoes, various diseases occur in people. In summer, people with various mosquito-borne diseases can be seen in the hospitals of the cities of our country. Especially young children are most affected by mosquito bites. Also, elderly people are always affected by mosquito-borne diseases. However, have you ever thought that when mosquitoes come near our ears, they make a lot of noise and it annoys us a lot. In fact, when mosquitoes fly, the sound made by their wings is this annoying sound. Especially female mosquitoes feed on human blood. They move around the human body all the time. When they get a chance, they come near our ears and make an annoying sound. As a result, we get very annoyed and we keep chasing the mosquito. Female mosquitoes mainly lay eggs, due to which they need a lot of blood. And they collect this blood from the human body. It would be wrong to say only humans, they also collect it from various animals. In our country, especially many nuisances of Aedes mosquitoes have increased at present. The electricity situation in our country is quite bad. There is load shedding for about 15 to 16 hours a day. And this time can be seen as a bad time for us. When the fan is not running due to electricity, mosquitoes are constantly extracting blood from our body. Especially at night, the mosquito infestation is very high. But of course we need to use mosquito nets. We need to reduce the use of coils a lot. Because coils are very harmful to the human body. I hope you will like this post of mine, thank you. ![1000019308.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmRW9rHroSFBSAKdERxzaNWNAnWKCXRUdrHF4LbDABXrT6/1000019308.png) --- Divce | realmi c67 -|-| [source this picture link]( https://pixabay.com/photos/mosquito-female-aedes-albopictus-1332382/ ) ### Kind Regards @nahid43 ![1000019308.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmRW9rHroSFBSAKdERxzaNWNAnWKCXRUdrHF4LbDABXrT6/1000019308.png) Posted Using [INLEO](https://inleo.io/@nahid43/there-is-no-end-to-corruption-and-errors-in-the-ssc-exams-in-our-country-eip)
