body.title: ‎Beyond Money: The True Foundation of Raising Good Children ‎
body.body:
‎Hi Hive,
‎
‎There is this common belief that raising good children is mostly just about financial stability, such as having enough money to provide the best schools, good clothes, and a comfortable life. While these things are very important part of it, but I have come to understand that they are not the true foundation of good child upbringing. Though I know that money can make life easier, but it cannot replace the deeper values and guidance that shape a child’s character.

 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmTgJsgLgkunSFjKKbpfRc5bphfkYubqM8oNJX92GnEWRu/IMG_20260323_071655_971.jpg 

‎
‎From my perspective, I see that what truly builds a child is not just what you give them materially, but what you instill in them each day. A child really needs that love, first love, genuine love, consistent love that reassures them how valued and blessings they are. When a child grows in an environment where they feel safe, heard, and appreciated, this give them the confidence that no amount of money can buy.
‎
‎Anothe main pillar is discipline. Discipline as it's been called, it's not about being harsh, but about teaching responsibility and accountability. A financially comfortable home without discipline can easily produce a child who lacks respect, patience, and self-control. And on the other hand, even in a modest home, a child raised with clear values and guidance can grow into a very responsible and respectful adult.
‎
‎Another factor is time which is also one of the greatest investments a parent can make. Many parents in today's world mainly focus so much on working hard to provide that they unintentionally become unavailable. Children do not just need provision but what they need is presence. Simple moments like talking, listening, correcting, and even playing together is what really create lasting impressions. These are the memories that really shape their mindset and emotional strength as well.
‎
‎Another important factor is the example parents set. Parents need to set a good example because they are the first teacher, so children learn more from what they see than what they are told from their parents. If they grow up watching honesty, hard work, kindness, and respect, then those values naturally become part of them going forward. But if all they see is a pursuit of money without integrity or balance, they may resort to grow up with a distorted sense of priorities.
‎
‎And another critical factor that really shape children good upbringing is moral and emotional guidance. Teaching a child how to treat others, how to handle failure, and how to stay grounded in tough moments is priceless. These lessons prepare them for life in ways money never can. Though financial resources may open doors, but it's character that actually determines how well they walk through those doors.
‎
‎Don't get wrong, I'm not saying that money is not important, definitely it is. Being able to providing for your children is part of your responsibility. However, it should not be mistaken as the only requirement for raising them well. A wealthy household without values can struggle, while a modest home filled with love, discipline, and guidance can thrive.
‎
‎In the end, good child upbringing is a mixture of many things, such as love, time, discipline, values, and guidance. Even though money supports the journey, but it does not define the destination. As a parents or future parents, the goal should not only be to give your children a good life, but to raise them to become good people as well.
‎
‎
‎![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYaWnApEziAtLL5Zwv3ZNbDjRfSfG6h5njgTrpyasnE6y/1775569275821.png)
‎

Posted Using [INLEO](https://inleo.io/@twicejoy/beyond-money-the-true-foundation-of-raising-good-children--cmt)

body.title: These Are My Two Favorite Modifiers
body.body:
This battle is one of those where the Modifiers just give you so much freedom and power at the same time. Shapeshift Happens Modifier lets every units act like they belong to all Bloodlines which is already crazy. This means you can use any single available unit for that battle which can be overwhelming but also as fun since you can do combos you normally cannot do. Then Born Again Modifier adds another layer because every units gets revived once which makes fights longer and more chaotic. Because of these two Modifier, damage and scaling becomes very important and some units can get really out of control if left alone. It becomes less about strict team rules and more about how strong your combo can get as the rounds go on.
https://img.leopedia.io/DQmfTNWWLKwSWbe3f1k9VdXRoUBPQWSBtSRW9Mi3VchwUJL/Cover.PNG 


# Battle:

https://img.leopedia.io/DQmSRKkbqsUs1aij67uTLi8WC2wS7FwRhgMWk7uqKQXYptF/Battle.PNG 
https://splinterlands.com/battle/sl_f03cde92d9e62fe732e618d86b1b8fda

In this battle, we have two modifiers to play around. Shapeshift Happens modifier unlocks the use of all units as long as you use an archon with Bloodline Dominion ability. Since all units have all the Bloodlines, they also benefit from your Archon's Bloodline Dominion ability. The second modifier is Born Again modifier allowing units to get revived once when they die. These two modifiers are very useful to me and it helped me create a very scary team that is not relying on Mundane Beast and Avian bloodlines. With the high damage units that I was able to pull from Fire element, this helped me win easily in the battle. Scavenger ability from Endless Ape also had a feast. Since units get revived after they get killed, Endless Ape was able to get double the stack for this battle.
https://img.leopedia.io/DQmSabQFJMXScdEzCiZPCGR1Jtv2cMVRCyokrsiD6DQgjb1/Shapeshift%20Happens.png 
Modifier 1: Shapeshift Happens: All units have Shapeshift (treated as all bloodlines). 
https://img.leopedia.io/DQmcv7GGzPW1rNdQ7yaoMzPMd1dRbRAdSP39NR6d9VfbRhu/born-again_60.jpg 
Modifier 2: Born Again: All Units have the Rebirth ability.



# My Lineup:

Because of Shapeshift Happens Modifier, I was able to get units I wanted from any other element. This lineup is very heavy on the damage and while I didn't use a lot of Mundane Beast and Avian units, its fine because the benefit that Elowen Sylphie gives is just Charge ability that allows melee units to attack from any position. It's not a deal breaker not to have this ability if the unit is not a melee units.

https://img.leopedia.io/DQmTQbZmMsXtJY2GEysF9qTXYfuMWPCGbtX4qPi3n1uywLQ/Archon.PNG 
Elowen Sylphie: Elowen Sylphie has Bloodline Dominion giving Avian and Mundane Beast the Charge ability. This also allows Elowen Sylphie to use units with Avian and Mundane Beast ability from other elements. Since there's Shapeshift Happens modifier, this applies to all units. Elowen Sylphie's second ability is Summoner Tactics giving Resurgence and Trample to up to 2 units.

https://img.leopedia.io/DQmVQfpr9oNMoPdtgZfgUCkA8cs8oPSKzc8nBK5tPwnfSRw/unit%201.PNG 
Drifting Manatee: Drifting Manatee is used as a simple front unit to absorb damage early in the battle. It does not deal damage but its decent armor and health helps delay the enemy attacks on top of the low 3 mana cost. The Dodge ability also gives it a chance to avoid hits which can be very useful especially against melee and range units. With Born Again Modifier, even if it dies early it still comes back once which adds more time for my damage units to work. It is not overpowered but it does its job well as a temporary wall.

https://img.leopedia.io/DQmQvyxQP238qjeFPkKr6s6eWUdBHQJtBGxGEsXaYYmDq55/unit%202.PNG 
Lioceros: Lioceros is a strong melee unit with good stats and Thorns ability. Even without Shapeshift Happens Modifier, since it has a Mundane Beast modifier, it gains Charge so it can attack from the back which makes positioning easier. Thorns is also very useful because enemy melee units will take damage when they attack him. With Born Again Modifier, Lioceros can come back once and continue dealing damage or reflecting damage through Thorns. It is a solid unit that adds both offense and defense to the team.

https://img.leopedia.io/DQmZaCXKkWSJHg15DpdHybbXbxirkooWBnXtaU4qWWgXSkw/unit%203.PNG 
Esper Shadowbeak: Esper Shadowbeak is one of the main damage units in this lineup because of its mixed attacks. It has both magic and melee damage which makes it very flexible in different situations. I gave it Resurgence and Trample so it can revive with full stats and possibly chain attacks after killing a unit. It has Avian Bloodline so, it can also use its melee attack from any position from Elowen Sylphie's Charge. This makes it very dangerous especially if it survives long enough to use all its abilities.

https://img.leopedia.io/DQmUtXfFNJ1rDt1CNGqHY1aUCGVFz34f44fyUYm2FX4grMr/Unit%204.PNG 
Forlorn Geomant: Forlorn Geomant is a pure damage unit with very high magic damage. Even though it has no abilities, the 5 magic damage is already enough to make it a threat. With Born Again Modifier, it can come back again when it dies which allows him to attack again with its high damage. It is expensive in terms of mana costing you 13 mana but worth it because of the strong damage output.

https://img.leopedia.io/DQmVM9krCCF5VGP5hxiUmVfvyGFS43PPj7KEXeTxwVWqu84/Unit%205.PNG 
Ballista's Deadshot: Ballista's Deadshot is another high damage unit with magic attack. Scattershot makes its attacks random which can sometimes hit important enemy units unexpectedly. Dispel is also useful to remove buffs from enemies which can reduce their advantage. With Born Again Modifier, it gets another chance to attack after dying which is very helpful. Even with lower health, its damage makes it a valuable part of the team. Like Forlorn Geomant, it costs 13 mana. I was able to use this unit because of Shapeshift Happens modifier which is nice.

https://img.leopedia.io/DQmXwP9bJ486cY5CJrQkwReRGxv2g6SvMSL8jHcrkE7hFXD/Unit%206.PNG 
Endless Ape: Endless Ape is one of the strongest units in this battle because of Scavenger ability. Every time a unit dies it gains more health which makes it stronger as the battle goes on. With Born Again Modifier, every unit dies twice which means double stacks for Scavenger making him very hard to kill later. I also gave it Resurgence and Trample so it can revive again with full health and armor along with the Scavenger stacks and deal more damage. body.title: The Breathtaking Evening Beauty By The Baihe River
body.body:
>

Beauty is everywhere, and the only necessary thing that beauty needs to reveal itself is an enduring mind that loves beauty and those eyes that quest for beauty everywhere. One of the most beautiful seasons of Beijing is the springtime, but the touch of spring is a little bit late in the northern mountain region of the large municipality. This location is from the most northwestern district of Beijing municipality, known as the Miyun district, and I have several travel stories of this district back in previous years, and this is my first visit to this amazing district full of so many natural scenic spots after the long winter. Even though I have passed by the same route several times, this evening's vibe is the most spectacular in this Miyn district so far, and I have not missed the breathtaking beauty of this place. 

It was my return time from a tourist spot in the deeper section of the district that I had visited that day, and I will let you explore that in my coming blogs, but today I am going to share some of the best evening clicks of Miyun city of the Baihe Riverside area on my way home. I have told many times that I use my bicycle for such travels, and this time my destination was around 30 km from my dormitory, so during returning time I was quite tired after cycling for a long time, and my destination was a mountain, so I was like exhausted, but I was not ready to miss the beauty with a halt there.


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmanfsK9R3UNksiKh8hwNYEx8mXLfqwhV8cguqBWB5p3cX/img_20260412_183419.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmfJbrnjR8Mzg96rB4kTqY2va5yG1sGoA8zsRq2UA6Q3Hw/img_20260412_183451.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmPmvjFQTATL3cAfuvNR3rdFeAUSDBmAqrsibVLt7761jT/img_20260412_183445.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmPjwQnREG1mW98QL86g6c8pAQT9cr5bWn1fV7Kzeg7rTe/img_20260412_183455.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmTdS3oSQSjdcrQATFEnHnEKbvrYaYmMvTMw8n7rH3Yuki/img_20260412_183408.jpg)



The beauty of the evening time was different that day with the light clouds in the sky that became completely orange with the setting sun rays during the sunset time, and it made the whole world to have golden views with that reflection from the clouds. Also, the golden grasses in the riverbed were giving the ground a different view with the fiery reflection of the sunlight on the water in the riverbed area. And the beautiful and traditional structure in the river bed makes the picture a complete art by adding the most brilliant object in nature.

I found very few people there enjoying the sunset beauty, but one person had given the completion of my shot with his appearance, which I found later. I have enjoyed the halting period there with this amazing beauty and a good rest that made me more energetic to cover the rest of my way to my dormitory. Really, it was a great memory filled with a beautiful sunset by the Baihe River.



![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmdzgqMSz8D6pe8rS6Bf2kzJwYkxnzpGMHSPc96VW5U5tH/img_20260412_183427.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmavVAgLHqLL6ticmCtKWWNXMLTRLq7A5w4js8sXYxsuBN/img_20260412_183431.jpg)


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmeaBZBWwY3PLYwKxZN7J1NbNrwo7EFbTiHaszdHWeitMM/img_20260412_183355.jpg)



I hope you enjoy my photos of Miyun's beautiful natural beauty of the Baihe Riverside area on a spring evening with such amazing views of nature and the sky. The soothing beauty of the surrounding is really great here with the ending touch of winter and starting of spring in this city area of the Miyun district. It is a great time to enjoy some outdoor activity like walking in this amazing area with warmer weather after the freezing winter. If you have any questions, let me know in the comments, and I will do my best to answer them.

Thanks a lot for your time and attention. I will catch up with you at the next one.

Wishing you a good day!

body.title: Forge skills in LAND
body.body:
The LAND lab is constantly evolving to provide players with more features and more items to craft, optimizing resources and avoiding item purchases from the market. Indeed, those who produce large amounts of resources also generate a surplus of items and cards beyond their own needs, exchanging them on the market and pocketing capital. This mechanism generates a passive income over time, a financial instrument that starts with a simple game. It's clear, however, that to reach certain levels, players will initially need to invest large sums of money to purchase everything they need.

![1000063776.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/claudio83/23u5ZX34D2JKe3bT2omT542rdxdNsz2L7MEXkWkuPP1VPwMZo2uqdNh43Hj6raqtaKBpM.jpg)

Recently, the Artisan Quarter introduced the ability to generate skills for the Thessok Hunter card, a card that works in LAND and increases stats to generate resources. Skills were reintroduced to the game a few months ago and are a fascinating addition, as well as being an NFT in their own right. As such, they can be bought or sold on the market like any other item.

To forge the skin, you need two resources: Aura and CINDER (the latter can only be obtained by burning cards).

<center>
Thank you for taking the time to read this post. If you haven't signed up to Splinterlands yet, I invite you to give it a try. You can use my [referral link](https://steemmonsters.com?ref=claudio83) </center>

# ITA

Il laboratorio di LAND si evolve costantemente per fornire ai giocatori più funzionalità e più oggetti da creare, ottimizzando le risorse ed evitando gli acquisti degli oggetti dal mercato. Infatti, chi produce molte risorse genera anche un surplus di oggetti e carte che va oltre il proprio fabbisogno, scambiandoli sul mercato ed intascando capitale. Questo meccanismo genera una rendita passiva nel tempo, uno strumento finanziario che inizia tutto da un semplice gioco. È chiaro però che per giungere a determinati livelli, o giocatori dovranno inizialmente investire grandi somme di denaro per acquistare tutto il necessario. 

![1000063776.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/claudio83/23u5ZX34D2JKe3bT2omT542rdxdNsz2L7MEXkWkuPP1VPwMZo2uqdNh43Hj6raqtaKBpM.jpg)

Di recente, nel Artisan Quarter è stato introdotto la possibilità di generare le skill per la carta Thessok Hunter, un carta che lavora in LAND ed incrementa le statistiche per generare risorse. Le skill sono state introdotte nuovamente nel gioco da qualche mese e sono una componente affascinante, oltre ad essere un NFT a tutti gli effetti. Come tale, è possibile quindi venderli o acquistarli sul mercato come un qualsiasi altro oggetto.

Per forgiare la skin è necessario possedere due risorse: Aura e CINDER (quest' ultima ottenibile solo bruciando le carte). 

<center>
Thank you for taking the time to read this post. If you haven't signed up to Splinterlands yet, I invite you to give it a try. You can use my [referral link](https://steemmonsters.com?ref=claudio83) </center>

body.title: El enojo que crece en silencio: cuando la razón alimenta la furia
body.body:
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmTfbViLF2jpzosYnvyXhSHm3xeSPjmcxGL3KvfsRsn5qt/1777020829360.jpg)

Versión en español


No todo enojo nace en un segundo. No todas las explosiones vienen del impulso.

Hay un tipo de enojo más silencioso, más lento, pero a veces más dañino: el enojo racional. No grita de entrada. No golpea puertas. Pero se instala en la mente como una idea fija, y desde allí gobierna tu estado de ánimo durante horas, días o incluso semanas.

¿Cómo se produce?
Este enojo no nace en la amígdala, el centro de las emociones rápidas. Nace en el neocórtex, esa zona privilegiada que usamos para analizar, comparar y razonar. Lo construimos pensando. Y lo alimentamos repitiendo mentalmente la misma ofensa, la misma injusticia, la misma frase que nos hirió. Es la rumiación emocional disfrazada de lógica.

¿Qué lo mantiene vivo?
Frases internas como \

. Interpretaciones repetitivas, falta de cierre del conflicto, y la ilusión de que si le damos suficientes vueltas al problema, este se resolverá solo. Pero no se resuelve: se enquista.

Y aunque por fuera parezca controlado, por dentro el cuerpo paga el precio: tensión muscular, insomnio, presión arterial elevada, dolor de cabeza, fatiga crónica.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmSZ9yt16rNzU5VdpunKTh43Lkm7DjJ8YQsR5Ez5RZR7oz/1777020848094.jpg)

No se trata de negar el enojo. Se trata de no dejar que la razón se convierta en carcelera de la paz interna.

Consejos sencillos para empezar a soltarlo:

1. Detecta la idea que gira en bucle.
2. Pregúntate: ¿otra vuelta más ayuda o hunde?
3. Cambia el foco: ¿qué solución puedo construir, aunque sea pequeña?
4. Respira conscientemente antes de decidir actuar.

El enojo racional puede ser útil si nos empuja a cambiar algo. Pero cuidado: cuando ya no hay acción posible, seguir pensando es solo veneno administrado en dosis lentas.

Muchas gracias por su atención y espero sus comentarios

English version

The anger that grows in silence: when reason feeds the fury

Not all anger is born in a second. Not all outbursts come from impulse.

There is a quieter, slower, and sometimes more harmful type of anger: rational anger. It doesn’t yell at first. It doesn’t slam doors. But it settles into your mind like a fixed idea, and from there it governs your mood for hours, days, or even weeks.

How does it happen?
This anger isn’t born in the amygdala, the center of quick emotions. It’s born in the neocortex, that privileged area we use to analyze, compare, and reason. We build it by thinking. And we fuel it by mentally repeating the same offense, the same injustice, the same hurtful phrase. It is emotional rumination disguised as logic.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmfDPu5kZL2xqZY7ZgJEvteNdChSGfvBW2HdgSqWqoUKZi/1777020867540.jpg)

What keeps it alive?
Internal phrases like \

Repeated interpretations, lack of conflict resolution, and the illusion that if we turn the problem over enough times, it will solve itself. But it doesn’t solve—it becomes ingrained.

And even if it looks controlled from the outside, inside the body pays the price: muscle tension, insomnia, high blood pressure, headaches, chronic fatigue.

This isn’t about denying anger. It’s about not letting reason become the jailer of inner peace.

Simple tips to start releasing it:

1. Detect the thought that loops.
2. Ask yourself: does another round help or sink?
3. Shift the focus: what small solution can I build?
4. Breathe consciously before deciding to act.

Rational anger can be useful if it pushes us to change something. But be careful: when no further action is possible, continuing to think is just poison administered in slow doses.

body.title: Journey of Growth
body.body:
People who can sit in silence with their thoughts, without panics are not indifferent to connection.They have just spent enough time with themselves to know what real connection feels like and they have decided that the temporary comfort of surface level company is not worth it. It may appear loneliness from outside; but inside, it is the need of the era. 

For my goals, continuous learning and growing is my hobby. I always tend to look out for improvements in myself - at least one thing a day. So, the story started four months ago, when I was introduced to ecency by my friend. Knowing that it will be beneficial for me by increasing my knowledge, interaction with society, and the most important, it also generates capital. A platform where I can express my thoughts while earning. What else one needs?

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmcnRtQatNFsUUKeYL4Guv3vHL71sXT4GpR46BeZ5Vio7m/1777021451073.jpg)

At first,I was nervous a little bit but published my first introduction to community.Community welcomed me open-heartedly.With time I got motivated and started putting more efforts in my work.

In these four months,I have learnt a lot.My communication skills have improved.I do read other point of views on different topics in different communities.Initially the challenge I faced was communicating less with others because I did not know how to interact.But I continued.I got rewards and my followers increased with time.It raised my hope a lot.

My goals are that I want to improve my writing as well as communication skills with continuous efforts and engagement with others.The people who can sit comfortably in their own company are not the ones who have given up on other people.They are the ones who have gotten specific about what they actually want from them.

I wish to work for the betterment of society.I have interest in fields of research. This platform matters for me a lot because here I have freedom of expression,growth opportunity and community support.

I also suggest others to work here and see for themselves.To express their opinions and share their qualities with this supportive community.

body.body:
>

‎The definition of marriage remains the same but the practice of it shifts based on the era. Before the world began to have a more elaborative understanding about marriage, it used to be an objective for people to achieve, it was considered as a milestone. Marriage was one of the key principle the society used in measuring people. A responsible and honorable man is meant to have his woman by his side and an unwed woman is considered a stigma to the society.
‎
‎It became a social contract both men and women were forced into. There intention regarding the union was second to the priorities of the society, matters of affection was just a mere emotion, both parties are on a race to win each other, most especially the men. This was the sad  reality of marriages or should I say the norm, yet people thrived and marveled in it.
‎
‎As time goes on, people started prioritizing their emotions, personal aims and objectives over societal needs. Thanks to education, people became more exposed to more way of life that is beyond traditional cultural practices. In so doing, perspectives were elevated, gradually people's attitude towards the practice changed. It wasn't suddenly but slow gradual process born out of enlightenment.
‎
‎People began to reason for themselves, rather than let society decide what is wrong or right for them. People realized, if I have to go into a forever contract, it better be what I want and deserve. Marriage metamorphosed to something different, it became more personal.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmXbBYQoFYi68LEa9eVMdZ1kwBg979K2zM5EKxb8FiaP6i/1777021646994.jpg)

‎After decades allowing society use marriage as a criteria to weigh people's value, people focused on developing themselves and by doing so, the measure of value changed. Slowly, everything that used to make marriage a do or die affair, was detached from it.
‎
‎Did it create a more stable environment for partners and children? it depends on who you ask. In those days, a lot of people's opinions were silenced, just to uphold societal standards. It wasn't as if there were no complains about how marriage was in those days but people had no voice. In today's environment, everyone can speak up for themselves, no more subjugation of a specific gender.
‎
‎Everyone has become the judge of their own lives. The only issue with this is that, the importance of cultural values has been diminished, which is one of the things that shielded people from getting involved in marital abominations, which has been normalized in today's society. It is not marriage that created a safe environment for partners and children, it is the values that was upheld, how people cherished dignity.
‎
‎Without those values, the concept of marriage is falling apart, it used to be like a binding spell that binds people together but now, it is just a play thing.
‎
‎

***
******

body.title: [카일의 수다#862] 떠도는 삶 속에서 빛을 찾다, Mr. 플랑크톤
body.body:
![IMG_8369.webp](https://images.hive.blog/DQmeEFBVVyCgL12V4Y5CEeHfGci8e4Gvs9EyWts8BPRcAzA/IMG_8369.webp)


넷플릭스에서 공개된 드라마 <미스터 플랑크톤>은 단순한 로맨스를 넘어, ‘존재의 의미’에 대해 묻는 작품같다. 
인생에서 어디에도 정착하지 못하고 떠도는 남자와, 안정된 삶을 원하고 있지만 내면의 결핍을 지닌 여자가 함께 여정을 떠나며 이야기가 시작된다. 이 과정에서 드라마는 인간을 ‘플랑크톤’에 비유한다.  

플랑크톤은 먹이사슬의 최하위에 있지만, 동시에 스스로 빛을 내며 바다 생태계의 근간을 이루는 존재다. 이 설정이 참 인상 깊었다. 우리는 종종 사회 속에서 작고 보잘것없는 존재처럼 느껴지지만, 사실은 각자 고유한 방식으로 빛을 내며 살아가고 있다는 메시지가 은은하게 전해진다.  

이 드라마가 특히 좋았던 이유는, “누군가를 위해 사는 삶”이 아니라 “스스로를 위해 살아가는 삶”을 이야기한다는 점이다. 주인공들은 모두 겉으로는 평온해 보이지만, 각자 깊은 상처와 결핍을 안고 있다. 그리고 그 외로운 사람들이 우연히 함께하게 되면서, 서로의 존재를 확인하고 조금씩 변화해간다.  

혼자인 사람들이 모여서 더 이상 혼자가 아니게 되는 과정. 그 흐름이 과장되지 않고 담담하게 그려져서 더 크게 와닿았다. 누군가를 완전히 구원하기보다는, 그저 옆에 있어주는 것만으로도 충분할 수 있다는 메시지도 따뜻하게 느껴졌다.  

그리고 이야기의 시작인, 진짜 아버지 찾기! 주인공이 끝까지 찾고자 했던 것이 ‘생물학적인 아버지’가 아니라, 자신에게 사랑을 주었던 ‘아버지라는 존재’였다. 결국 우리가 갈망하는 건 혈연이 아니라, 나를 진심으로 받아주고 사랑해주는 관계라는 사실이 마음을 아프게 하면서도 깊은 여운을 남겼다.  

배우들의 연기도 빼놓을 수 없다. 우도환은 이전 작품에서 보여줬던 강렬한 이미지와는 완전히 다른, 공허하면서도 인간적인 모습을 섬세하게 표현해냈다. 같은 배우가 이렇게 다른 결의 감정을 보여줄 수 있다는 점에서 다시 한번 인상 깊었다.  

<미스터 플랑크톤>은 화려하거나 자극적인 드라마는 아니다. 하지만 잔잔하게 스며들어, 마음을 울리는 드라마였다.

우리는 모두 어딘가를 떠다니는 존재일지도 모른다.  
그래도 괜찮다.  
플랑크톤처럼, 작지만 분명하게 빛나고 있으니까.

body.title: Overwhelmed by the Amount of Words ...
body.body: > ![_DSC0851.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/fermentedphil/23xxyRcV7YjiKwhSCmdTWrtateQTeuERqv6bWGcBJy8Lyg84CPHsj6qA4U1TkjKF1Q7sn.JPG) I have dreamt about being a published author. I have dreamt about being a writer. These have always driven me to write, to produce words, images, concepts, and dreamworlds. From an early age, I have always written things. I have boxes full of stories, always incomplete because I do not know how to sustain ideas, but always in words. My life has always been linked to words. I have published about 10 academic articles, a couple of fiction works (mostly poetry), and I am now busy with hopefully a massive book deal. But I am stuck in a weird situation since the advent of the age of AI. Have words become redundant? Everyday, I see news articles that promote peoples' initiatives to promote work that is free of the use of AI. And I can get behind this, but this is an interesting situation in which we find ourselves. I think AI has become a kind of mirror to our own fallibility, the seduction of words, the seduction of producing too many words. We have always appreciated writing, from wars being fought to protect works, to words leading to wars being fought. The written word has a cult like status since the dawn of humans. But I increasingly find myself feeling a strange redundancy that I have never felt. A few years ago, I challenged myself to post every single day. I wrote about 500 words on average every day. On top of that, I wrote my PhD and other articles. And this was all before the dawn of AI, or at least in my own life. Then everything just changed one day.

> ![_DSC0852.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/fermentedphil/23tv66tsdqZ7FcYnvpLDEtn26LApvWg1PTj6yGomHCE4hUGarEtPTj85AbBzZ2uPpS441.JPG) I am still writing poetry, I am trying to write these blog posts, and I am trying to write articles (post my PhD slump). But things just feel *different*. My words are not carrying living worlds any longer, it feels like a necessity to feed the machine. It feels like a slog to write if we can ask machines to create slop at the press of a button. I mean, how can we compete? There will always be those labels on food: organic; free-range; and so on. But are these labels true? We live in the age where these organic stickers will now read: AI-free; Human-made; and so on. We can also question the truth behind these terms. And in the publishing space, there are some high profile scandals of works being published that was AI produced. But what does this even mean? People will still buy products they know are not organic, not free-range. Chickens are raised in shocking conditions, but people will always buy the cheaper eggs irrespective of... Today, people will buy books, poetry, news, WORDS, without thinking twice. People are just like that. And this is something I do not see a lot of people writing about. The absolute strangeness of our life: before AI there was also slop, now, there is also slop, people will not change. But writers, or at least I, have changed. I have seen a clear shift in the way I am thinking and writing. I feel less confident. I feel less the need to write, to produce, in an age of instant slop. I feel that my words have become more scarce, costly, priceless, expensive (insert more adjectives here). In short, it feels like human-produced words are scarcer, and in my own mind, this is a strange shift in my mind: for so long I have tried to produce as much as possible. Now, in the AI-age, this need to produce withered away into something else: to produce something I am proud of. But I have so much still to learn... *All of this is my own writing in the strange age we find ourselves in (questioning everything). The photographs are my own, taken with my Nikon D300.*

오늘의 산책은 정말 즐거웠습니다! 도심의 분주한 거리에서 몇몇 친구들을 우연히 만났어요. 그들과 함께 카페에 들러 커피를 마시며 근황도 나누고, 서로의 일상에 대해 이야기했습니다. 산책 중에는 매일 보는 거리지만 오늘은 특히 꽃이 가득 핀 작은 정원에서 멋진 나비를 발견했어요. 나비가 꽃 위를 날아다니는 모습이 너무 아름다워서 잠시 멈춰서 바라보았답니다. 또, 공원에서는 아이들이 함께 놀고 있는 모습을 보며 저도 잠시 그 시절 추억에 잠기곤 했어요. 오늘의 산책은 이렇게 소소하지만 의미 있는 순간들로 가득했습니다! _This report was published via Actifit app ([Android](https://bit.ly/actifit-app) | [iOS](https://bit.ly/actifit-ios)). body.body:
It’s true, I always say the same thing: nature is always the greatest artist, and we can learn so much from it. I found the first species charming with its umbrella-like shape; it’s also a white colour that really stands out in the sun.

The second species, although toxic, is wonderful, especially the texture on the top, as if it had little holes. It’s beautiful; I’ve loved it. And the last one is where those brushstrokes seem to form the grain in the wood. Pure wonder. You’ve found some really good species, and nature always surprises us. Thank you so much, Luis!! A big hug!😃

>Es verdad, siempre menciono lo mismo, la naturaleza siempre es la mejor artista y de la cual podemos aprender mucho. La primera especie me pareció encantadora con su forma de sombrilla, además es de un color blanco que resalta con el sol.

>La segunda especie aunque sea tóxica es maravillosa, sobre todo la textura en la parte de arriba como si tuviera unos orificios. Es preciosa, me ha encantado. Y el último caso es allí donde esas pinceladas parece que forman las vetas en la madera. Pura maravilla. Has encontrado unas especies muy buenas y siempre la naturaleza sorprende. Muchas gracias Luis!! Un gran abrazo!😃

body.title: Sepia ❤️ Amonet (EN-ES)
body.body:
> --- ![Sepias.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23wMggNi84MjpfJJSCAZy4gb3rxnwYrPodRB9zGDVYn6Bj2E92j91zi4RDe2S8ewUhpwS.jpg) ![separador sencillo 2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/Eo8UGAXUZoPxi8Ny3bWhw7vRVQywdynrHRhAwwZtRqW9jnyK7CZ42782EyeJ1UKHQuv.png) When I was studying drawing and painting, one of the techniques we had to use, and with which we created some of our drawings, involved special pencils. They were like chalks or charcoal, but two of them were sepia shades: one lighter and one darker. They were like two shades of brown, and I also used black and white, plus something called a blending stump, which was used to apply over those pencils. I always liked that technique. And when I studied graphic design, one of the techniques I was taught was to use these kinds of colours to age photographs. I learnt how to age and restore old photos; it’s a lot of work, but I loved it. All of this led me to today’s design, to create a blend of both, and I loved the result.
SPANISH VERSION (click here!)

Cuando estudiaba dibujo y pintura una de las técnicas que debíamos usar y con la cual hacer algunos dibujos eran con lápices especiales, eran como tizas o carbones, pero dos eran colores sepias, uno más claro y otro más oscuro. Eran como dos tonalidades de marrón, donde también usaba el negro y blanco y luego algo llamado esfumino, que servía para aplicar sobre esos lápices anteriores. Siempre me gustó esa técnica. Y cuando estudié diseño gráfico, una de las técnicas que me enseñaron es usar este tipo de colores para envejecer fotografías. Aprendí a envejecer y a arreglar fotos antiguas, lleva mucho trabajo, pero me encantaba. Todo ello me llevó al diseño de hoy, a hacer una mezcla entre ambas cosas y me encantó el resultado.

![separador sencillo 2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/Eo8UGAXUZoPxi8Ny3bWhw7vRVQywdynrHRhAwwZtRqW9jnyK7CZ42782EyeJ1UKHQuv.png)
Process in pictures - Proceso en imágenes
|![1.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23tSmaRR6LqMU61SdkmHVPZ6hcLfG1mL4ecqgV8edyxhYKjvdiiyrDR3xjdDuefvJHytK.jpg)|![2.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23tmaqveGtnqTNeBukCA56PvqxoE2FQJVxJKnPkocPEu5c6QLNP1vXNuJoBPxBJ3Ye4Gm.jpg)| |-|-| |![3.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23uR3Ew8TN8fhixL1zy7Xs7V7iU6PKRJcneEBptPUwy28hB4eKjUNz3Hz2SscrWHnDPau.jpg)|![4.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23uFcDfS3y7kbiMiUkr8geAVQoLJJSQURBqf5hHsWroRoKpKXiRPzmyUu6P35i5puYrs2.jpg)| ||| |![5.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23tvistJYjTaiVjygmxuJdQooH3QqJ1pCjxhWvpnf5MHbk786Vv7ccnVb1NgeHRKHkZbx.jpg)|![6.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23vi3hEDRaArVZnSUvhNvHyvqm6mGroHg5BetHDMhWXGFTthtvAkoCXYvD7bQaytDDRcR.jpg)| ![separador sencillo 2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/Eo8UGAXUZoPxi8Ny3bWhw7vRVQywdynrHRhAwwZtRqW9jnyK7CZ42782EyeJ1UKHQuv.png) # Design process The design was created entirely in Photoshop CS6 without using AI, using 9 royalty-free images spread across 16 layers. I created the background using two sepia-toned images, placing one on top of the other and applying a darker colour blend to the second one. Then, on one side, I placed the text image, removing the black part and applying a hard light blend. Next, I positioned the image of the waves, having first removed the background, and the image of the trees; in both cases, I adjusted the tones via Image > Adjustments > Colour Balance and Tone > Saturation to give them sepia tones, and I used the spot light and darker colour blend modes. I split the first cave image in half and placed one part at the top of the design and the other at the bottom, erasing the centre and using the Spot Light blending mode. I placed the second cave image on one side of the design, erasing the edges and using the Darker Colour blending mode. I then worked on the image of the woman across two layers, erasing the background and using the ‘Spot Light’ and ‘Normal’ blending modes. I also used two filters: ‘Added Edges’ and ‘Diffuse Glow’ on the ‘Normal’ layer. With the sculpture image, I created five layers using normal and hard light blending modes; I placed them in different parts of the design, with one specifically overlapping half of the woman’s face, and added an added edges filter. Finally, I created an extra layer of the waves and placed it over the sculpture at the front using a darker colour blending mode. The animation is done completely in After Effects, working on the opacity of each layer and adding lights in the form of clouds for better contrast. I send you all a big hello and see you next time. Thanks for watching and reading this far. Amonet - AV Design
SPANISH VERSION (click here!)

# Proceso del diseño El diseño está realizado completamente en el programa Photoshop CS6 sin uso de IA con 9 imágenes sin derechos de autor distribuidas en 16 capas. Con dos imágenes en tonos sepias realicé el fondo, poniendo una sobre otra y a la segunda le puse la fusión de color más oscuro. Luego a un lado coloqué la imagen del escrito, quitando la parte negra y con la fusión de luz fuerte. Luego dispuse la imagen de las olas, borrando previamente el fondo, y la de los árboles, en ambos casos les cambié la tonalidad en imagen – ajustes - equilibrio de color y tono - saturación, para que tengan tonos sepias y usé las fusiones de luz focal y color más oscuro. La primera imagen de caverna la dividí a la mitad y puse una parte arriba del diseño y otra abajo, borrando el centro y con fusión de luz focal. La segunda imagen de caverna la dispuse en un lado del diseño, borrando los bordes y con fusión de color más oscuro. Luego en dos capas trabajé la imagen de la mujer, borrando el fondo y con las fusiones de luz focal y normal. Además, usé dos filtros: bordes añadidos y resplandor difuso en la capa normal. Con la imagen de la escultura hice cinco capas, con fusiones normal y luz fuerte, las dispuse en distintas partes del diseño y una especialmente topando mitad del rostro de la mujer y le añadí un filtro de bordes añadidos. Finalmente hice una capa extra de las olas y lo puse encima de la escultura del frente con la fusión de color más oscuro. La animación está realizada completamente en After Effects, trabajando la opacidad de cada capa y agregando luces en forma de nubes para un mejor contraste. Les envío un gran saludo a todos y hasta la próxima. Gracias por ver y leer hasta aquí. Amonet - AV Design

body.title: PHOTO TRIP - Czech Republic - Details and decorations of Brno's architecture
body.body:
##### Hello everyone to my photoblog!

Often, when walking around a city, we don't pay attention to the details and ornamentation of the architecture. Even when exploring a foreign city on a tour, we don't always do this. I'm constantly learning this when I walk around with my camera. Below are a few examples that caught my eye while exploring Brno's city center.

> <sub>**[ PL ]**</sub>
> ###### **Witam wszystkich na moim fotoblogu!**
> Często spacerując po mieście nie zwracamy uwagi na szczegóły i zdobienia architektury. Nawet podczas zwiedzania obcego miasta na wycieczce nie zawsze to robimy. Ja chodząc z aparatem cały czas się tego uczę. Poniżej kilka przykładów, które zwróciły moją uwagę podczas zwiedzania centrum Brna.

---

body.title: i249 NC 24, Drawing step by step /Rising Star
body.body: > Blessings to everyone reading this. I'm grateful you're here today to see a new drawing I've done. This one is of one of the lovely cards from the game. Today I'm continuing my series dedicated to microphones, specifically from the common section. These are interesting devices that I always enjoy painting. Today we have the one on card i249 NC 24. As you can see, this one has that flower vase shape; it's very cute. The prettiest thing about it is its purple color. I used that same color in a different shade to paint the outer background. I used a slightly stronger shade so that the purple of the microphone would stand out more. Okay, so I'm going to show you step by step how I made it. To begin, I first drew what would be the inner frame of the card. ![1.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dharma1/Eo2BM1YUX8DFWNfeohz4Vk9ME3yS9dLMFYP3Cg5hY6o2bivHU9gW4gW6bKid4Nuz7ne.jpg) After the frame, I drew the middle part, which is the part that most resembles a vase, and then I added the missing silhouette at both the top and bottom. With that, the sketch was ready to be filled in with details. ![2.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dharma1/Eo2BM1YUX8D3vMKbXv6QFwxmRmK4anfeFERPis1jiwgR4UXUJXUrYvd6DkmJjpir2Zy.jpg) ![3.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dharma1/Eo4JhGpWi9FtZQXpBGas75kmb5jxkQVqkXGd3LUJpe4mPdpUjxHnjSzqKZzw2Ra3AUo.jpg) The details I added were several internal divisions. These will help me fill in each area with paint more easily, since I won't go over the lines. See how it turned out. ![4.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dharma1/Eo4JhGpWi9G1Qom3vFp3XgZ3GoRhZuGSHxSkqbTGtMTvXW1g91LjzMty4bkcuHid55J.jpg) Now that the sketch is 100% finished, we can start painting. You can see the complete process in the following screenshots. If you notice, I used the same colors as in the original card on the microphone; that was thanks to Paint's eyedropper tool. Here's the process now. ![5.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dharma1/EoH3kMVd9pNBnbdG8KVFNF89ikTJWo7crvtUNWXQV9R5yt3UzbRhSosXtungZ6zcRwb.jpg) ![6.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dharma1/EowGC5f2a9QgNugiAMxzityNnJQ3QdDuRs5q1rZWK6wj6q1xfSbeb7dgMXdDsNN37vY.jpg) ![7.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dharma1/EpEHFdVWBVUMSKZZGs6wUAjNTZjZrvHUL5TFhWadtE7gqBJTKC2kUVucfnD1pvTXC7a.jpg) ![8.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dharma1/EpT3G5MBGz97KyuxbF9EW6eeAndk7Ci1fskMZAzPj9XsJEBiSKEbu7QQHhpUSYDdMkc.jpg) And to finish for today, here's the final result. See you in the next drawing. Blessings to all, and have a beautiful day. ![9.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dharma1/23xpAtRwdD7TFgYwuHDHAsZJxDduUWKtoZjkmDhd6Mg8F3FuZa2bzfU43torKf8d6FXUT.jpg)

body.title: El enojo que crece en silencio: cuando la razón alimenta la furia
body.body:
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmTfbViLF2jpzosYnvyXhSHm3xeSPjmcxGL3KvfsRsn5qt/1777020829360.jpg)

Versión en español


No todo enojo nace en un segundo. No todas las explosiones vienen del impulso.

Hay un tipo de enojo más silencioso, más lento, pero a veces más dañino: el enojo racional. No grita de entrada. No golpea puertas. Pero se instala en la mente como una idea fija, y desde allí gobierna tu estado de ánimo durante horas, días o incluso semanas.

¿Cómo se produce?
Este enojo no nace en la amígdala, el centro de las emociones rápidas. Nace en el neocórtex, esa zona privilegiada que usamos para analizar, comparar y razonar. Lo construimos pensando. Y lo alimentamos repitiendo mentalmente la misma ofensa, la misma injusticia, la misma frase que nos hirió. Es la rumiación emocional disfrazada de lógica.

¿Qué lo mantiene vivo?
Frases internas como \

. Interpretaciones repetitivas, falta de cierre del conflicto, y la ilusión de que si le damos suficientes vueltas al problema, este se resolverá solo. Pero no se resuelve: se enquista.

Y aunque por fuera parezca controlado, por dentro el cuerpo paga el precio: tensión muscular, insomnio, presión arterial elevada, dolor de cabeza, fatiga crónica.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmSZ9yt16rNzU5VdpunKTh43Lkm7DjJ8YQsR5Ez5RZR7oz/1777020848094.jpg)

No se trata de negar el enojo. Se trata de no dejar que la razón se convierta en carcelera de la paz interna.

Consejos sencillos para empezar a soltarlo:

1. Detecta la idea que gira en bucle.
2. Pregúntate: ¿otra vuelta más ayuda o hunde?
3. Cambia el foco: ¿qué solución puedo construir, aunque sea pequeña?
4. Respira conscientemente antes de decidir actuar.

El enojo racional puede ser útil si nos empuja a cambiar algo. Pero cuidado: cuando ya no hay acción posible, seguir pensando es solo veneno administrado en dosis lentas.

Muchas gracias por su atención y espero sus comentarios

English version

The anger that grows in silence: when reason feeds the fury

Not all anger is born in a second. Not all outbursts come from impulse.

There is a quieter, slower, and sometimes more harmful type of anger: rational anger. It doesn’t yell at first. It doesn’t slam doors. But it settles into your mind like a fixed idea, and from there it governs your mood for hours, days, or even weeks.

How does it happen?
This anger isn’t born in the amygdala, the center of quick emotions. It’s born in the neocortex, that privileged area we use to analyze, compare, and reason. We build it by thinking. And we fuel it by mentally repeating the same offense, the same injustice, the same hurtful phrase. It is emotional rumination disguised as logic.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmfDPu5kZL2xqZY7ZgJEvteNdChSGfvBW2HdgSqWqoUKZi/1777020867540.jpg)

What keeps it alive?
Internal phrases like \

Repeated interpretations, lack of conflict resolution, and the illusion that if we turn the problem over enough times, it will solve itself. But it doesn’t solve—it becomes ingrained.

And even if it looks controlled from the outside, inside the body pays the price: muscle tension, insomnia, high blood pressure, headaches, chronic fatigue.

This isn’t about denying anger. It’s about not letting reason become the jailer of inner peace.

Simple tips to start releasing it:

1. Detect the thought that loops.
2. Ask yourself: does another round help or sink?
3. Shift the focus: what small solution can I build?
4. Breathe consciously before deciding to act.

Rational anger can be useful if it pushes us to change something. But be careful: when no further action is possible, continuing to think is just poison administered in slow doses.

body.body: > I used air assassinations and sleeping darts to clear the guards surrounding the tax collector's mansion. After neutralizing the heavy soldiers and luring a spearman into a trap, I infiltrated the inner chamber. I assassinated Al-Anqa before he could escape and found letters linking the harbor blockade to the people's stolen coins. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmc7bTtHv1keJpbvX9cHMinNtEAb7nZnHnBr6hbKoydLEi/screenshot_1_.png) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmVAAkgHVC3TCzfZu2f68SLZzpa3ZKr7HJhBh5wSqww6Qo/screenshot_2_.png) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmefyyNBXWGpf2oAmBfVcVpc7icsGYYDjwBVs4QazWwQ4M/screenshot_3_.png) I went for the heavy guard who almost saw me last time to ensure he wouldn't sound the alarm. I waited for one of them to get on the move, away from his partner. body.title: 可怕的墨菲定律
body.body:
<liketuimages>
<center>
![n6DUXUg4nE3o5tUs_IMG_20260424_151202.webp](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/trina77/images/n6DUXUg4nE3o5tUs_IMG_20260424_151202/n6DUXUg4nE3o5tUs_IMG_20260424_151202.webp)
![FdyEpW3Ijo80dqOq_IMG_20260424_151356.webp](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/trina77/images/FdyEpW3Ijo80dqOq_IMG_20260424_151356/FdyEpW3Ijo80dqOq_IMG_20260424_151356.webp)
![7Ck0j1HLvIpNEXsN_IMG_20260424_082320.webp](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/trina77/images/7Ck0j1HLvIpNEXsN_IMG_20260424_082320/7Ck0j1HLvIpNEXsN_IMG_20260424_082320.webp)
</center>
</liketuimages>

备受瞩目的《全民阅读》会议在南昌召开，我们也有我们的阅读专题会。今天是书香校园建设专题会的筹备报道日，因为没能邀约到客户，我心里就隐隐不安，预感会被临时委派额外任务。果然，报道组已有固定安排，空缺的工作自然而然落到了礼仪组，而这份差事，要从我们组三位没邀约到客户的女士里选出一人。
 
谁也不愿主动接下，只能用抓阄的方式来决定。我很无奈，身体还处在恢复期，根本没办法长时间站立，便提议让另外两位同事抓阄，可现场一片沉默，没人回应，我也只能硬着头皮参与。
 
三个阄放在各自面前，其中一位同事迟迟不肯拿纸条，就等着我和另一位同事先出结果。我心里纠结万分，潜意识里想拿她的阄碰碰运气，可又暗自祈祷：千万别是我，别让悲剧发生。最终还是拿起了离自己最近的纸条，墨菲定律终究还是应验了，怕什么来什么，我成了那个“天选之人”。
 
即便如此，我依旧没有放弃，拉着其中一位同事商量，坦言自己身体尚未养好，实在无法久站，恳请她这次替我，下次有类似任务我一定主动顶替。可她全程冷漠无视，丝毫没有松口的意思。其实我没找另一位00后同事，是因为她脸上的皮肤问题还没痊愈，她本就不愿面对人多的场合，我也不忍心开口为难，只能试着和这位同事协商。
 
她却只轻飘飘地说礼仪都轮流安排，不会站太久。这位同事向来自我，上次还与怪同事开暖气的事大吵一架，指望她体谅我的难处，就是奢望。
 
没过多久，主管过来帮忙劝说，我也顺势提出事后请她吃饭，可她当着主管的面，一脸不情愿地推脱，说自己周五有事，儿子每周五都会过来，实在抽不开身。事已至此，我前后已经跟她商量了三次，不想再继续道德绑架，也不愿再多说一句，最终还是决定自己接下这份工作。
 
本以为只是承担一天的礼仪任务，可安排下来才发现，礼仪组分成了两组，其他人只需要在会议当天到场，而我被安排了两天，报道日和会议日都要全程参与。在自己小组内都没能得到照顾，我也彻底打消了找领导调换的念头。
 
约定下午两点抵达酒店，另外三位同事邀我一同出发，我随口问了句是不是各自开车，她们说打算打车，得知我开车后，便提出搭我的车一同前往。（明日再续）

---

body.body:
Hello friends.

I went to Mandalay to buy some necessary things.
When I arrived in Mandalay, I usually went to Maha Myat Muni Pagoda.
As a Buddhist, I usually go to pay homage to the most important pagoda in Mandalay.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmfH8fU5Btq1TnSbQFKhQJNoE3f7uWQBdjAeD6oLguCeKh/img_20260423_092607.jpg)

Last night, it rained a little in the village where I live.
It didn't rain enough to wet the ground.
However, I saw some puddles of rain near the Maha Myat Muni Pagoda in Mandalay.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZV9Bs7jeufvWZGqwpbr5UKNNEiuzK7Rs9YRKC7DdGa1S/img_20260423_092600.jpg)

I left my motorcycle at the place where I had parked it and went to visit the Buddha.
I saw reflections in the rain puddles on the road, so I turned on my phone camera and took a picture.
After that, I worshipped the Buddha and made a donation to gain merit.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmaKygPueKpcFfhwqjCiNNqvdH5jrCaoRUCcPf6nBm9pGF/img_20260423_092537.jpg)

Because of that, I was able to get a job, earn merit, and even get a photo to display in the Shadow Hunters Community.

မင်္ဂလာပါ မိတ်ဆွေတို့ရေ။

ကျွန်တော်သည် လိုအပ်သော ပစ္စည်းများ ဝယ်ယူရန် မန္တလေးမြို့ သွားရောက်ဖြစ်ခဲ့ပါသည်။
မန္တလေးမြို့ ရောက်သည့်အခါ ကျွန်တော် ဝင်ရောက်လေ့ရှိသည်က မဟာမြတ်မုနိဘုရားကြီး ဖြစ်ပါသည်။
ကျွန်တော်က ဗုဒ္ဓဘာသာဝင်တစ်ဦး ဖြစ်လေတော့ မန္တလေးမြို့၏ အထင်ကရ ဘုရားကြီးကို ဖူးမြော်ရန် ဝင်ရောက်လေ့ရှိခြင်း ဖြစ်သည်။

မနေ့ညက ကျွန်တော် နေထိုင်သည့် ကျေးရွာမှာတော့ မိုးအနည်းငယ် ကျခဲ့ပါသည်။
မြေပြင်များ ရေစိုနေအောင်တော့ မိုးမရွာခဲ့ပါ။
သို့သော် မန္တလေးမြို့ မဟာမြတ်မုနိဘုရားကြီး အနီးမှာတော့ မိုးရေအိုင်အချို့ကို တွေ့မြင်ခဲ့ရသည်။

ကျွန်တော်လည်း ဆိုင်ကယ်ကို အပ်နှံသည့်နေရာ၌ ထားခဲ့ပြီး ဘုရားဖူးရန် သွားခဲ့သည်။
လမ်း၌ မိုးရေအိုင်ထဲက အလင်းပြန်ပုံရိပ်များကို မြင်တွေ့ခဲ့ရသောကြောင့် Phone Camera ဖွင့်ကာ ဓာတ်ပုံရိုက်ယူခဲ့ပါသည်။
ထိုနောက်တော့ ကုသိုလ်ရရန် ဘုရားဝတ်ပြုပြီး အလှူဒါနပြုခဲ့ပါသည်။

ဒါကြောင့်သာပဲ ကျွန်တော်သည် အလုပ်ကိစ္စလည်း အဆင်ပြေ၊ ကုသိုလ်လည်းရ၊ Shadow Hunters Community ၌ ဖော်ပြရန် ဓာတ်ပုံလည်း ရရှိခဲ့သည်။

body.title: Crypto Cooking - The Omelette That Hits Hard Has Stilton & Leeks
body.body:
Cooking and cryptocurrency share some surprisingly spicy similarities… both demand the right ingredients, perfect timing, and just enough experimentation to keep things exciting.

One day we’re searing steaks, the next we’re stressing over staking! Ever feeling like balancing the heat in the kitchen is oddly like balancing yields in the crypto world? It's red or green!

How do you like your omelette? Everyone has their own answer to that question! Some like it simple, others like it precise, and a few of us prefer to treat it like an invitation to improvise.

Personally, I like mine a bit fancy. Not complicated for the sake of it, but creative in a “what can I save from the fridge before it becomes a science experiment” way.

Because I’m also a bit anti–food waste, my omelettes rarely start with a plan. They start with a scan of the fridge and sometimes that scan reveals something interesting!

Today we go with Blue Stilton, leeks, parmesan, and smoked bacon. Not a bad lineup at all to be matched with free range eggs! The secret is to cook with love and passion! 



![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmVsW1HYioECUv2Vdet5ZM2q2fUKm67WQG1rhgAHKxo6ad/image.png)


So into the pan it all goes, with no hesitation or overthinking. The bacon should go in first to render down and build that smoky base but I want a gooey result so all goes after the eggs! 

The leeks soften into it, picking the flavor. The cheeses follow, melting into pockets of salty richness that don’t really ask for permission. Eggs poured over the chaos and binding everything.

A few minutes on the heat, a careful flip, and suddenly you’ve got that golden color on both sides! I loke slightly crisp edges, soft center, and pockets of bold flavor doing their own thing.

No garnish needed! Just something warm and slightly unpredictable. The combo actually works really well because it hits the main flavor + texture + fat balance rules of a great omelette.


![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmZQazBRDFgGfcyZtEQD7MkEidGH32qH5RPBWfvEkWx8y9/image.png)


Each ingredient is doing a different job, and together they cover a lot of ground without clashing. It works because each ingredient plays a different role that keeps the whole thing balanced.

The Stilton brings strong, salty funk that cuts through the richness, while Parmesan adds deep umami and extra savory intensity. The smoked bacon gives a smoky backbone! 

The leeks soften everything with a gentle sweetness that stops it from becoming too heavy. The eggs act as the neutral base that is carrying the stronger flavors without competing with them. 

Whether it’s the kitchen or crypto charts... it’s all about reading the moment, trusting your instincts, and knowing when to let things ride. May your eggs fill your belly and feed your brain!  

[Crypto Cooking - Burritos, Blockchains & The Art Of Not Letting Things Fall Apart](https://www.publish0x.com/art-of-happiness/crypto-cooking-burritos-blockchains-and-the-art-of-not-letti-xywevxx \
)\n\n[Crypto Cooking - Searing Duck Breast And Riding Crypto Waves](https://www.publish0x.com/art-of-happiness/crypto-cooking-searing-duck-breast-and-riding-crypto-waves-xywkdzy \

)\n\n[Crypto Cooking: Fry-Up Done Right With Bacon Burgers & Lorne Sausages](https://www.publish0x.com/mind-puzzle/crypto-cooking-fry-up-day-done-right-with-bacon-burgers-and-xjydkjd \
)\n\n[Crypto Cooking - From Jacket Potatoes to Bull Runs](https://www.publish0x.com/art-of-happiness/crypto-cooking-from-jacket-potatoes-to-bull-runs-xokkqgd \

body.title: My little moussaka recipe // Ma petite recette de moussaka [EN/FR]
body.body:
<center>![moussaka.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/altheana/EppN74cACLGnCGCKKtbuz4mUtzSkA4M2tHpW8ZGuESH1jqbPezKBjNCki9YMRHY39kM.png)</center>

Hello friends and food lovers! I hope you're all doing great 😁

As you know, I love to cook! And even more so when @genesisledger asks me to make a particular dish; I always want to make him happy! 🥰

For a few weeks now, he's been talking about moussaka, that famous dish made with eggplant and ground meat.

I'd never cooked it before, but I followed a simple recipe (adapting it to my own taste) and I'm quite pleased with the result! I think @genesisledger is also quite pleased with the result; we really enjoyed it. 😋

It's a recipe that requires a bit of preparation time, so I recommend making it when you have at least an hour to an hour and a half to spare!

In short, here's the moussaka recipe for 6 people 👇

## Ingredients

<center>![1- moussaka.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/altheana/Eonn3A3mPHC5ryV7hp17mT4MKRmVo5BTStwBhoquCMmFciD7y39bnXh6v42x5TRw9VD.jpg)</center>

For the béchamel sauce:
- 50 grams of butter,
- 50 grams of flour,
- 500 ml of milk,
- salt and pepper.

For the rest:
- 2 medium-sized eggplants;
- 4 or 5 small potatoes;
- 400 grams of ground meat;
- 1 red onion;
- 2 cloves of garlic;
- 400 grams of chopped tomatoes (this also works with tomato pulp);
- grated mozzarella cheese;
- a little olive oil;
- salt and pepper.

## Preparation steps

I started by slicing the eggplants into rounds:

<center>![2- moussaka.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/altheana/EoGznsV1T4Yz3iyN7VFonTcNE9F5a8hQG52UzHg1f1xL5oZkCHeHUrqCDzJ6L6GCtUL.jpg)</center>

Then I began browning each round on both sides in a hot pan with olive oil. It only takes a few minutes per slice, but since there are quite a few slices, it can seem a bit time-consuming.

<center>![3- moussaka.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/altheana/Ep7tcpMFdWXsH6rADhZ6HRuCSh51QEHjN5wcPgMmxEVD1PbeJGvQBjcfB1cA8YQtVnG.jpg)
![4- moussaka.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/altheana/EpA2WKqghyDFmwFcyUwtnUXDCnauuQaHYwo8ynhBnXuFSWevJm68XRGUaQfayCPCGH3.jpg)
![5- moussaka.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/altheana/EoiVkhvNU5keeeskwtfAKnUpTioP479cuFtdU8wgs3ZRCW42vLWVRZBJ5RfhYLfYGB2.jpg)</center>

Meanwhile, I peeled and sliced ​​the potatoes:

<center>![6- moussaka.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/altheana/EogPpHn3RJZU6QsVX9r677i9cHE3dMUyEfQckDwGQhMCchPwngvBYZPNvc8iGDDbTtp.jpg)
![7- moussaka.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/altheana/EoeHG19SceJssxu646uAwo7iDUgoK1jkT1Dd2kG7Da8RyHsBMgGmpgeV6jm9yPqmFf1.jpg)</center>

Then, I browned them in the same way as the eggplant:

<center>![8- moussaka.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/altheana/Ep1WV63pkDRPpo8ufZk8w9NxkvBVfSBA2MjtzHnfLhdkg3mdGvZvEPBsuwDVNewZrk4.jpg)
![9- moussaka.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/altheana/Ep1Vshq5cT696iTfi1fiUGEoLJqTnwqX8Wky7VeXKRwKLv4zJov97j62qYLf27KS5Gw.jpg)</center>

After that, I chopped and sautéed the onion in olive oil:

<center>![10- moussaka.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/altheana/EoK4tBKteudfifgk6EVNabXbXUTet65ZxL8HteDFEYQKNtZP8YuCKqRZQkeBm5akGbR.jpg)</center>

Then, I chopped the garlic and added it to the onion after a few minutes:

<center>![11- moussaka.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/altheana/EoGzqbfEdypaqjBT4boZcrU7XH7aRCTPyT1UNktNUQ4EY5axb4ojh5bxT9VXb6EZvFi.jpg)
![12- moussaka.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/altheana/EorzNv9CNnaM8eadcc2WWeWdoV1eZC6MWbGa5zw8Xasaw63SvungRxX1QnRvD7J6A96.jpg)
![13- moussaka.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/altheana/Eoc713ymssVBxqTVN51PCrwzCkB8uim1sqwY6m144SCmwsCw94hEhg3g3FvQhdDmdSD.jpg)</center>

Next, I added the ground meat and cooked it for 6 to 8 minutes, stirring occasionally.

<center>![14- moussaka.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/altheana/EoCiCJFgWCnKDWgQfFtPhdGB7HNATprXpzCGNXdPeNzS4st9Rg7a8kCaQqpbMJ3TSDf.jpg)</center>

I added the chopped tomatoes:

<center>![15- moussaka.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/altheana/Eoc6cen1ukk6zJ5CEWccHy4SRFEFKR4UXp5u46TJzEJ3nkiUTxXMZ4n38tMd3fpwhYV.jpg)
![16- moussaka.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/altheana/EorzoNo9PsKoxPHd4SBr6AhCEqWJfNarMvZEdfXRCyUncN9ztoTfdN9U3b7stfGWvST.jpg)</center>

And 200 ml of water (half the can of chopped tomatoes):

<center>![17- moussaka.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/altheana/Ep1WxGdG8WFMtUrxxwV8BHbaKUMEpYWBX8opea3M2wp1YV7wR8MK1A61oLHu7j2pev6.jpg)</center>

Then, I added a little salt and pepper, mixed it all together, and let it simmer for about 20 minutes.

<center>![18- moussaka.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/altheana/EogNJgwVNZbHSd9qzce1njv4RwctGr3PV8G18dbSHAGPFFvFckaqgk8x1Wrju5KAByQ.jpg)</center>

Meanwhile, @genesisledger came to help me and made the béchamel sauce. I forgot to take pictures, but basically, you first melt the butter in a saucepan over low heat, then add the flour and mix. Next, you gradually add the milk, stirring constantly. Once the consistency is half-thick, you can add salt and pepper (and nutmeg if you have some).

<center>![19- moussaka.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/altheana/Eou8DfVYfgsoEWWLbWQ5ZntxGcvEF7XSjv6Hwx1pgecFBcNx7o9vfujDfn1jhvkDs8M.jpg)</center>

Then I moved on to assembling the cake.

First, I buttered my gratin dish:

<center>![20- moussaka.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/altheana/EoeGSBaymLD65DqDm66ZYHWLFejymAXc2QHjY79bY51tV9KXD31BJxWoSBbX8kHan1V.jpg)</center>

Then, I added a first layer of vegetables, alternating eggplant and potatoes:

<center>![21- moussaka.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/altheana/Eo6MkwT6DkUX1p1JNEgSmKD88QMVsf9imRx1M6kJhBpn1QCREAUQJUYHT7nUhQQyRfm.jpg)</center>

I covered it with ground meat:

<center>![22- moussaka.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/altheana/EoCk5w1h9Bv6fjuXojBNmKVQViRHWLXCTyHpLCJPYRNSF3v3VNukAE9AB81xrZjsGDt.jpg)</center>

Then, I added another layer of vegetables:

<center>![23- moussaka.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/altheana/Eo4E3Jb1bNAvogtZToUukCmk6jHcfnq8Nuyc3A7rHRugmxZT7HcNU4qHxoKH8Ak7sPr.jpg)</center>

And I poured a little béchamel sauce over it:

<center>![24- moussaka.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/altheana/EoK8DoKUSA8s9DjKMWrNf86GkAmzsgYr4UbPgUf9B4P9vePXCf79XscD3NHuJMJp9hC.jpg)</center>

I added more ground meat:

<center>![25- moussaka.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/altheana/EoCkXVQNGJTHLie6unhWZDyKVQ23dYFLMW3F8R4drVa8G3Hs7NTW28o8E5vx32KajG4.jpg)</center>

Then the final layer of vegetables (with only eggplant):

<center>![26- moussaka.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/altheana/EoAc7mbTVEbSPQRy9zJtb7mUSgxN1de63dU37biEi6ZAXnYhTwk6kMoSTJFwFeDj44f.jpg)</center>

More béchamel sauce on top:

<center>![27- moussaka.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/altheana/EoGznsrXDyoHi3JYu2sk7EF7zUGE2xzoRjQNuMv4ASY96dSQAQN3TPwnvEk1YafSaJB.jpg)</center>

And grated mozzarella, which I topped off with grated Emmental cheese.

<center>![28- moussaka.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/altheana/EoK7FGLkjpMN98E46Dc3ViN6LaCFhRTaDCnTdhU5JzFYDpT9aXu9bGXENPgem1Haxu5.jpg)</center>

I then baked it in the oven for 25 minutes at 180 degrees Celsius (350 degrees Fahrenheit).

And here's the result:

<center>![29- moussaka.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/altheana/EoAcDaNBqX9sgEnkVGrHxivVSyXhJBdonsZ83gwt7WvPtn5D67Nbu97s2BGsn3RAygL.jpg)![30- moussaka.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/altheana/23ydCEVVYB3nMPgvk8bwUiJtSm2KkV6kw9xx6443icqL78F7s4WrsG3ptMEvaD2r8WaT6.jpg)
![31- moussaka.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/altheana/Ep7wb9hA12bafnnHU1zi32zRLrwiTonjVvc9TMbm6pVKN1znMudLh9QncvzMXYtqgYb.jpg)
![32- moussaka.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/altheana/EpJa6yp7pG9C93eAChcjh23RNvn2Ez3SccfJqrTrigKVvQyoxcEXvpdgWnrnreqs2BS.jpg)
![33- moussaka.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/altheana/Eq38Z2wLgnYM4r4NEUi3ckhaXkfTwqGtriFu9s1aGvMaukdraWVLHUc3bAQ1DzxRV8F.jpg)</center>

A generous and beautifully browned moussaka, which I served with a salad of spinach leaves from the garden! 🥬

It was a real treat! The vegetables were perfectly cooked, almost meltingly tender. The cheese and béchamel sauce provide the richness you expect from a moussaka. 😋

It's a dish that transports you to Greece! ✈️

I think it's a recipe I'll be making more often!

Do you like moussaka? Have you ever had it?

I highly recommend trying it when you have the time to cook! It's a very convivial and delicious dish. 😁

See you soon, Johanna

PS: I used Google Translate to translate the English part.

_________________

<center>*Version en français*</center>
_________________

<center>![moussaka.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/altheana/EppN74cACLGnCGCKKtbuz4mUtzSkA4M2tHpW8ZGuESH1jqbPezKBjNCki9YMRHY39kM.png)</center>

Hello les amis et les foodlovers ! J’espère que vous allez tous très bien 😁

Comme vous le savez, j’adore cuisiner ! Et d’autant plus quand c’est @genesisledger qui me demande de faire un plat en particulier, j’ai toujours envie de lui faire plaisir ! 🥰

Cela fait quelques semaines qu’il me parle d’une moussaka, ce fameux plat à base d’aubergine et de viande hachée. 

Je n’en ai jamais cuisiné auparavant, mais j’ai suivi une petite recette (en l’adaptant à ma manière) et je suis assez satisfaite du résultat ! Je crois que @genesisledger est lui aussi assez satisfait du résultat, on s’est régalés.😋

C’est une recette qui demande un peu de temps de préparation, je vous conseille de la faire lorsque vous avez au moins 1h à 1h30 devant vous ! 

Bref, voici la recette de la moussaka pour 6 personnes 👇

## Les ingrédients 

<center>![1- moussaka.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/altheana/Eonn3A3mPHC5ryV7hp17mT4MKRmVo5BTStwBhoquCMmFciD7y39bnXh6v42x5TRw9VD.jpg)</center>

Pour la béchamel : 
- 50 grammes de beurre, 
- 50 grammes de farine, 
- 50 cl de lait, 
- du sel et du poivre.

Pour le reste : 
- 2 aubergines de taille moyenne ; 
- 4 ou 5 petites pommes de terre ; 
- 400 grammes de viande hachée ; 
- 1 oignon rouge ; 
- 2 gousses d’ail ; 
- 400 grammes de chair de tomates (cela fonctionne aussi avec de la pulpe de tomates) ; 
- de la mozzarella râpée ; 
- un peu d’huile d’olive ; 
- du sel et du poivre.

## Les étapes de préparation 

J’ai commencé par découper les aubergines en rondelles : 

<center>![2- moussaka.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/altheana/EoGznsV1T4Yz3iyN7VFonTcNE9F5a8hQG52UzHg1f1xL5oZkCHeHUrqCDzJ6L6GCtUL.jpg)</center>

Puis j’ai commencé à faire dorer chaque rondelle recto/verso dans une poêle bien chaude avec de l’huile d’olive. Cela prend seulement quelques minutes par rondelle, mais comme il y a pas mal de rondelles, c’est une étape qui peut paraître un peu longue.

<center>![3- moussaka.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/altheana/Ep7tcpMFdWXsH6rADhZ6HRuCSh51QEHjN5wcPgMmxEVD1PbeJGvQBjcfB1cA8YQtVnG.jpg)
![4- moussaka.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/altheana/EpA2WKqghyDFmwFcyUwtnUXDCnauuQaHYwo8ynhBnXuFSWevJm68XRGUaQfayCPCGH3.jpg)
![5- moussaka.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/altheana/EoiVkhvNU5keeeskwtfAKnUpTioP479cuFtdU8wgs3ZRCW42vLWVRZBJ5RfhYLfYGB2.jpg)</center>

En parallèle, j’ai épluché et découpé les pommes de terre en rondelles :

<center>![6- moussaka.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/altheana/EogPpHn3RJZU6QsVX9r677i9cHE3dMUyEfQckDwGQhMCchPwngvBYZPNvc8iGDDbTtp.jpg)
![7- moussaka.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/altheana/EoeHG19SceJssxu646uAwo7iDUgoK1jkT1Dd2kG7Da8RyHsBMgGmpgeV6jm9yPqmFf1.jpg)</center> 

Puis, je les ai fait dorer aussi de la même manière que les aubergines :

<center>![8- moussaka.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/altheana/Ep1WV63pkDRPpo8ufZk8w9NxkvBVfSBA2MjtzHnfLhdkg3mdGvZvEPBsuwDVNewZrk4.jpg)
![9- moussaka.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/altheana/Ep1Vshq5cT696iTfi1fiUGEoLJqTnwqX8Wky7VeXKRwKLv4zJov97j62qYLf27KS5Gw.jpg)</center>
 
Après cela, j’ai découpé et fait revenir l’oignon dans de l’huile d’olive : 

<center>![10- moussaka.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/altheana/EoK4tBKteudfifgk6EVNabXbXUTet65ZxL8HteDFEYQKNtZP8YuCKqRZQkeBm5akGbR.jpg)</center>

Puis, j’ai découpé l’ail et je l’ai ajouté à l’oignon au bout de quelques minutes : 

<center>![11- moussaka.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/altheana/EoGzqbfEdypaqjBT4boZcrU7XH7aRCTPyT1UNktNUQ4EY5axb4ojh5bxT9VXb6EZvFi.jpg)
![12- moussaka.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/altheana/EorzNv9CNnaM8eadcc2WWeWdoV1eZC6MWbGa5zw8Xasaw63SvungRxX1QnRvD7J6A96.jpg)
![13- moussaka.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/altheana/Eoc713ymssVBxqTVN51PCrwzCkB8uim1sqwY6m144SCmwsCw94hEhg3g3FvQhdDmdSD.jpg)</center>

J’ai ensuite ajouté la viande hachée et j’ai laissé cuire pendant 6 ou 8 minutes, tout en remuant. 

<center>![14- moussaka.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/altheana/EoCiCJFgWCnKDWgQfFtPhdGB7HNATprXpzCGNXdPeNzS4st9Rg7a8kCaQqpbMJ3TSDf.jpg)</center>

J’ai ajouté la chair de tomates : 

<center>![15- moussaka.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/altheana/Eoc6cen1ukk6zJ5CEWccHy4SRFEFKR4UXp5u46TJzEJ3nkiUTxXMZ4n38tMd3fpwhYV.jpg)
![16- moussaka.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/altheana/EorzoNo9PsKoxPHd4SBr6AhCEqWJfNarMvZEdfXRCyUncN9ztoTfdN9U3b7stfGWvST.jpg)</center>

Et 20 cl d’eau (la moitié de la boîte de la chair de tomates) : 

<center>![17- moussaka.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/altheana/Ep1WxGdG8WFMtUrxxwV8BHbaKUMEpYWBX8opea3M2wp1YV7wR8MK1A61oLHu7j2pev6.jpg)</center>

Puis, j’ai ajouté un peu de sel et de poivre, j’ai mélangé et j’ai laissé mijoter pendant 20 minutes environ.

<center>![18- moussaka.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/altheana/EogNJgwVNZbHSd9qzce1njv4RwctGr3PV8G18dbSHAGPFFvFckaqgk8x1Wrju5KAByQ.jpg)</center>

Pendant ce temps, @genesisledger est venu m’aider et a fait la béchamel. J’ai oublié de prendre des photos, mais en gros, il faut d’abord faire fondre le beurre dans une casserole sur feu doux, puis ajouter la farine et mélanger. Ensuite, il faut ajouter le lait petit à petit sans cesser de mélanger. Une fois que la texture est mi liquide/mi épaisse, on peut ajouter le sel et le poivre (et la noix de muscade si on en a).

<center>![19- moussaka.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/altheana/Eou8DfVYfgsoEWWLbWQ5ZntxGcvEF7XSjv6Hwx1pgecFBcNx7o9vfujDfn1jhvkDs8M.jpg)</center>

Je suis ensuite passé au montage. 

J’ai d’abord beurré mon plat à gratin : 

<center>![20- moussaka.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/altheana/EoeGSBaymLD65DqDm66ZYHWLFejymAXc2QHjY79bY51tV9KXD31BJxWoSBbX8kHan1V.jpg)</center>

Puis, j’ai ajouté une première couche de légumes où j’ai alterné aubergines et pommes de terre : 

<center>![21- moussaka.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/altheana/Eo6MkwT6DkUX1p1JNEgSmKD88QMVsf9imRx1M6kJhBpn1QCREAUQJUYHT7nUhQQyRfm.jpg)</center>

J’ai recouvert avec de la viande hachée : 

<center>![22- moussaka.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/altheana/EoCk5w1h9Bv6fjuXojBNmKVQViRHWLXCTyHpLCJPYRNSF3v3VNukAE9AB81xrZjsGDt.jpg)</center>

Puis, j’ai de nouveau fait une couche de légumes : 

<center>![23- moussaka.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/altheana/Eo4E3Jb1bNAvogtZToUukCmk6jHcfnq8Nuyc3A7rHRugmxZT7HcNU4qHxoKH8Ak7sPr.jpg)</center>

Et j’ai ajouté un peu de béchamel dessus : 

<center>![24- moussaka.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/altheana/EoK8DoKUSA8s9DjKMWrNf86GkAmzsgYr4UbPgUf9B4P9vePXCf79XscD3NHuJMJp9hC.jpg)</center>

J’ai ajouté de la viande hachée : 

<center>![25- moussaka.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/altheana/EoCkXVQNGJTHLie6unhWZDyKVQ23dYFLMW3F8R4drVa8G3Hs7NTW28o8E5vx32KajG4.jpg)</center>

Puis la dernière couche de légumes (avec que des aubergines) : 

<center>![26- moussaka.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/altheana/EoAc7mbTVEbSPQRy9zJtb7mUSgxN1de63dU37biEi6ZAXnYhTwk6kMoSTJFwFeDj44f.jpg)</center>

La béchamel dessus : 

<center>![27- moussaka.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/altheana/EoGznsrXDyoHi3JYu2sk7EF7zUGE2xzoRjQNuMv4ASY96dSQAQN3TPwnvEk1YafSaJB.jpg)</center>

Et la mozzarella râpée, que j’ai complétée avec de l’emmental râpé.

<center>![28- moussaka.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/altheana/EoK7FGLkjpMN98E46Dc3ViN6LaCFhRTaDCnTdhU5JzFYDpT9aXu9bGXENPgem1Haxu5.jpg)</center>

J’ai ensuite mis au four pour 25 minutes à 180 degrés. 

Et voici le résultat : 

<center>![29- moussaka.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/altheana/EoAcDaNBqX9sgEnkVGrHxivVSyXhJBdonsZ83gwt7WvPtn5D67Nbu97s2BGsn3RAygL.jpg)![30- moussaka.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/altheana/23ydCEVVYB3nMPgvk8bwUiJtSm2KkV6kw9xx6443icqL78F7s4WrsG3ptMEvaD2r8WaT6.jpg)
![31- moussaka.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/altheana/Ep7wb9hA12bafnnHU1zi32zRLrwiTonjVvc9TMbm6pVKN1znMudLh9QncvzMXYtqgYb.jpg)
![32- moussaka.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/altheana/EpJa6yp7pG9C93eAChcjh23RNvn2Ez3SccfJqrTrigKVvQyoxcEXvpdgWnrnreqs2BS.jpg)
![33- moussaka.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/altheana/Eq38Z2wLgnYM4r4NEUi3ckhaXkfTwqGtriFu9s1aGvMaukdraWVLHUc3bAQ1DzxRV8F.jpg)</center>

Une moussaka bien généreuse et bien gratinée, que j’ai servie avec quelques feuilles d’épinard du jardin en salade ! 🥬

C’était un vrai régal ! Les légumes étaient parfaitement cuits, un peu fondants. Le fromage et la béchamel apportent cette générosité qu’on attend d’une moussaka. 😋

C’est un plat qui fait voyager, direction la Grèce ! ✈️

Je pense que c’est une recette que je referais plus souvent ! 

Est-ce que vous aimez la moussaka ? Est-ce que vous en avez déjà mangé ? 

Je vous conseille vraiment de tester lorsque vous aurez le temps de cuisiner ! C’est un plat assez convivial et très savoureux 😁

À bientôt, 
Johanna 

PS : J’ai utilisé Google Traduction pour traduire la partie en anglais.

body.title: For Lou
body.body:
<div class=text-justify>

 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmTvb78ieeKZMCh3AmbDouAwhTsZH1WDGJ4MLtUYBg9oFa/IMG_5029.jpeg 


“Don’t look in the corner,” said Tom. “Just sleep.”

I laughed then. “But there is no thunder Tommy and I am grown now. Grown people don’t get scared of the corner,” I added curtly as I thought Tommy was just giving me one of those strange rules he occasionally made up just to keep me in bed.

“Just don’t look, Lou,” he said,  tucking me in.
“What’s in the corner?” I asked, squeezing the sheets tightly.
“Nothing,” he says quickly. Then, after a pause, “Just sleep.”
“I’m 12 Tommy. Stop treating me like a child.” 
“Yes miss assertive,” he says, kissing me on the forehead. 

****
Tommy was the only family I had. He was 10 years older than me. That means he was old enough to be my parent so they let him keep me after our mother passed. I knew nothing about my dad and I didn’t want to know because the one time I brought him up with Tommy, his countenance went sour and it lasted the entire day. I love Tommy so much but I don’t like that he’s refused to notice I am growing and no longer the scaredy cat I used to be. 

****

After Tommy left and shut the door behind him, I couldn’t sleep. Something had been forbidden and now it has become the only thing that mattered to me. I wanted to look in the corner so badly but I wanted to take it slow so I started with taking in the interior of my room which I am already very familiar with. In itself, it is ordinary. My bed is pushed against the wall, my window is narrow with half-broken blinds, and the wardrobe is placed on the opposite side of the room, along the left wall and it smells faintly of camphor. And the corner, just two pale walls meeting at a right angle, slightly darker where the light didn’t quite reach. I didn’t look, it’s all in my head. 

After thinking long and hard, I stole a quick glance. I could swear I saw shadows so I turned and lay on my side facing the opposite wall, very aware of the shadows behind me. The air in the room suddenly felt thicker as beads of sweat formed on my forehead. I shut my eyes. So much for being 12 and grown. 

When morning finally came, it seemed the rule still applied so I didn’t look but my mind was restless and something began to creak and turn. That side of the room, sunlight didn’t quite illuminate as the wardrobe blocked it out. 

I almost called out for Tommy but I wanted to prove to him I was grown up mentally. I trodded to the corner to confront whatever supernatural figure hid there. My heart racing, I flipped on the light switch and was startled. I held my breath, fixing my eyes on the beauties curled up in the corner in a box. 
 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmYndYWQLe6fstrUARYah8dWNpP3Ua7BtLFnvjgCoCCExS/IMG_5030.jpeg 

“Oh, you looked,” Tommy said huskily. 

I turned, a little frightened as I didn’t hear him walk in. “Why did you hide them?” I ask tearfully. 

“Happy birthday Lou,” He says and kisses my cheeks. 

“You’re so unbelievable,” I say, bewildered.
 
“I’m sorry. That’s just an epic big brother surprise method.” He adds, giving me a lopsided smile. 

I glance down at the kittens and back to Tommy. Clutching my chest, I mouth a thank you. I’d always wanted a cat and him getting me two orange young ones, were the perfect birthday present ever. 

My response to the freewriters [daily prompt](https://peakd.com/hive-161155/@daily.prompt/23-april-2026-freewriters-community-daily-writing-prompt-day-3082-dont-look-in-the-corner)
