body.title: Consumers Reviews Reveal the Truth about the Best and Worst Banks in the USA
body.body:
The first thing that captures attention when you search for a bank you can entrust your savings with is glossy advertisements and promotional offers with promises of financial strength, innovation, and product variety. However, to find out the truth about the [best and worst banks](https://help-center.pissedconsumer.com/the-worst-and-best-banks-according-to-customer-reviews/), consumer reviews are what you really should turn to.

Customer feedback is more straightforward, sharing real experiences and focusing on factors that matter to clients: how quickly problems are solved, how helpful support teams are, and whether clients feel valued. Insights drawn from a PissedConsumer research show that the gap between marketing promises and customer reality can be significant.
![ \

](https://images.hive.blog/DQmTtX7RMoxNGskkFKQ3ZWTkCKjGerYzH2Bx9injKxuEEw3/best-and-worst-banks.jpg)

# How Customer Service Shapes Impression?

One of the clearest patterns in customer reviews is the importance of customer service. People rarely complain about interest rates or account features. Instead, they focus on how they are treated when something goes wrong. The survey data shows that support issues, including unresponsive representatives or unresolved complaints, are the most common source of frustration.

Financial institutions topping the list of the best banks share a few important traits. They tend to resolve customer issues more efficiently and maintain clearer communication throughout the process. Customers value being heard and helped without unnecessary delays, which can make a lasting impression even if the original problem was serious.

# Why Is It Important to Know How Your Bank Handles Scam Reports?

Fees and fraud concerns also appear in the data, but they tend to matter most when banks fail to address them properly. The way reports about [bank scams](https://help-center.pissedconsumer.com/the-alarming-rise-of-credit-union-bank-scams/) are handled is a striking indicator of how trustworthy the bank is and how protected its clients are.

While the institutions heading the list of the worst banks are not in a hurry to deal with fraud incidents their clients encounter, the leaders of the industry have clear protocols and offer prompt assistance, securing clients’ savings as soon as they get fraud or scam reports.

# What is the Overall Customer Experience with Digital Banking?

Digital banks, in particular, receive mixed online reviews. On the one hand, customers appreciate the convenience of mobile-first platforms and easy account access. On the other hand, many reviews highlight a lack of human support when problems arise.

The statistics on worst and best banks reflect this tension: some digital banks score relatively low in satisfaction and recommendation rates, suggesting that convenience alone is not enough to build trust. When customers cannot quickly reach a real person or resolve an urgent issue, frustration grows, and negative reviews follow.

# What’s The Situation Like with the Traditional Banks?

Traditional banks do not escape criticism either. Despite having physical branches and larger support networks, many well-known institutions still struggle with customer satisfaction. Consumer issues often include long wait times, complicated processes, or inconsistent communication.

Even when these banks perform better than some digital competitors in terms of resolving issues, their overall reputation can still suffer if customers feel the experience is stressful or impersonal. The banks' reviews show moderate satisfaction levels but less enthusiasm when it comes to recommending these banks to others.

# How Is the Trust Built?

The data also suggests that trust is closely tied to problem resolution. Customers are generally more forgiving of mistakes if the bank takes responsibility and fixes the issue quickly. In contrast, unresolved problems or poor communication can damage trust far more than the original error, putting the financial institution on the list of the worst banks.

Consumer reviews reveal that “best” and “worst” banks are not defined solely by their size or technology, but by how they handle real-life situations. A bank may offer advanced features or competitive rates, but if it fails to support customers effectively, its reputation will suffer.

# What Matters In the End?

It’s important to point out that no institution achieves perfect feedback. Even the best banks receive their share of criticism, and average ratings across the industry remain relatively low. This doesn’t necessarily mean all banks perform poorly. It just reflects the reality that people are more likely to leave reviews after negative experiences. Still, when similar complaints appear repeatedly, they point to deeper issues.

In today’s digital age, where reviews are easily shared and widely read, customer voices play a major role in shaping public perception on what is the worst bank or what is the best. They show that banking is not just about money, but about trust, reliability, and the quality of human interaction.

In Freeciv, a well-managed rearguard provides critical bonuses to total production, scientific research, and gold through trade routes, ensuring the long-term sustainability of my autocratic government. # ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmaeZTnFLodEk9UWhM2GKP9EtzEVD8FaiCbxi87F5kAHbE/1777019749358.jpg) # One of the main objectives in this region has been military fortification. Due to their geographical isolation, sending reinforcements from the capital or the northern front would take too many turns, leaving them exposed to looting or total capture. Consequently, I have prioritized the training of riflemen garrisons and the construction of city walls and coastal defenses. These measures ensure that each city can withstand an assault independently until the main fleet can intervene. # Beyond defense, the structural growth of these southern cities is a priority for the empire's progress. I have ordered the construction of granaries and supermarkets to accelerate population growth, which in turn increases the available labor force and tax revenue. Simultaneously, the inclusion of libraries and universities is transforming these once quiet outposts into secondary centers of learning. Even though my civilization is primarily focused on military power, these scientific contributions are necessary to avoid falling behind the more advanced nations I am currently fighting. # ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmNZjZ4pj52VjDbdUeavqH6g6t3bPJ2h9rZSaXKY9ZFs4s/1777019773822.jpg) # This phase of the game reminds me that a true empire is not only built through conquest but through the stability of its most distant provinces. This organized and disciplined approach allows me to maintain a steady flow of resources toward the war effort in the north, knowing that my southern territories are prospering and protected against any eventuality. # |

body.title: GIRL CHILD
body.body:
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmTJAztLrmdRmZepxeqUWCeNzAA6zAbyZAbAKkwHoizQrW/1777017834761.png)
They said she was a vessel,
Soft clay shaped by fragile hands,
A whisper in crowded rooms,
A shadow where silence stands.

They called her delicate
As if strength could not wear skin so tender,
As if her voice, when raised,
Would break instead of thunder.

She walked through narrow paths
Carved by rules she did not write,
Told to dim her shining soul
So others could feel bright.

“Be gentle, be quiet, be small,”
They stitched into her name,
Yet fire lived beneath her ribs
No silence could contain.
For she is more than their stories,
More than labels thrown her way,
Not a vessel made for breaking
But a storm that learns to stay.

She carries worlds within her,
Dreams that stretch beyond the sky,
And though they tried to cage her wings,
Still she learned to fly.

Call her strong, call her rising,
Call her everything she’s worth,
For the girl they named “weak vessel”
Is the fiercest force on earth.

body.title: Not-LEGO: Planet Express Ship
body.body:
I know, I know, this isn't real LEGO, but hear me out: sometimes it's good to compare and contrast brands of construction toys. Is it as good as LEGO? If not, does it still have any merit? Is there still a reason to support LEGO above all else?

As I mentioned in [a prior post,](https://peakd.com/life/@jacobtothe/a-minor-april-update) I received a late Christmas present when the family assembled for Easter. My sister and her husband gave me the [Brickcraft Futurama Planet Express Ship.](https://shopbrickcraft.com/products/planet-express-ship) I'm a fan of the show, and own the first four seasons and the subsequent four films on DVD. This ship is as iconic as the *U.S.S. Enterprise,* the *Millennium Falcon,* and *Serenity* in sci-fi fandom.

![planet express ship box front.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jacobtothe/Eokb95aXLaxwPFHzjq8Wb1HWoWwUDTLt91DU49K1KNrNGzn5VxW9iKKNctkQVUnhxcY.jpg)

Brickcraft has a New York address on the box, but the set is made in China.

LEGO still makes most of their bricks in Europe and the USA, although they do also have factories in China and Vietnam. LEGO has very strict quality controls. Competing brands making \

interlocking blocks tend to struggle to meet those standards in fit, finish, design quality, instruction quality, and packaging.

Up front: the cardboard box feels sturdy. This is not the flimsy paperboard of Dollar Tree construction bricks. This is two layers of paperboard with corrugation in between. First impressions matter, and this is a good one.

Inside, the bricks are sorted into bags, and numbered in the order they should be opened. These are cellophane of some kind, and I should note that LEGO is transitioning from this kind of packaging to pape. The instructions are also printed on nice glossy paper in well-bound booklets. Again, this looks like a premium product.

![planet express ship bags.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jacobtothe/AK55YkdJ8EbAFgywaxk9UwfBW4ZvYPGKXXeCXjNwxfuFmFJxTXZLHDis4kdrbYF.jpg)

Time for construction. The red bricks are similar to LEGO dark red, but the turquoise is distinct from anything I have seen. There is also a glossy, almost metallic finish on some of the red bricks. This seems to be the Brickcraft edge: instead of the LEGO System of consistent, slowly-expanding color palette, I bet these upstarts cater to custom colors as part of their pitch for license agreements.

![planet express ship build 1.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jacobtothe/Eos2MAQriCR2TMvF9QPVtx4FnQQ2GAxjwR5Esue1biWtjVvBAajhG6HSnXgTuJhhjXd.jpg)

The instructions show a different shade for the glossy metallic bricks, so I had little trouble here. The Studs Not On Top design is also reveling itself early, effectively building \

from the belt line for the bottom of the hull. LEGO tends to make better use of its parts library for these situations. Note also the lack of the front ramp and bottom hatch. 0/10, completely unacceptable, this set is trash!

![planet express ship build 2.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jacobtothe/23yJGFWVSb1Tu9L41LPman4sZDotuejvxhbkZLtFtvjvPLTxDiAe3G2t4a9QhEyNE1GCm.jpg)

For the next portion of the build, I separated all the parts from the next bags by color. Since I wasn't thinking about my watermark at the time, I had to move it to the bottom left corner here so you could see the odd parts in other colors besides red and turquoise.

![planet express ship build 3.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jacobtothe/EoEr2QeCDKULjs5gdekJX7Xt6P9WnYkZvBTHvsPhiEBMLRARxdcsm69eC9nSMJSZ9xV.jpg)

And after some assembly required, the hull looks much more complete, yet it remains upside-down. 

![planet express ship build 4.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jacobtothe/EoEofM4eJw2zkkuKdAi4WesiywM9ky9gBgkqBRw9AcP2d6rzSTswJRWu5dFrQNNtzy6.jpg)

On to the 3rd set of parts! I forgot to take a picture of that,,, If you build, you know how it is. You get into the flow and don't think about little things like, \

The three tailfin pieces are nice. Two are slightly smaller, and the large fin on top has studs for the printed dish logo bricks. I do like how it all came together at the end with ball-and-socket joints and cheese wedge slopes setting the angle on the bottom fins.

![planet express ship build 5.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jacobtothe/23vhsduhk1hb2wgxBLmL3tVXovqHot69soRBbnyMT8fihNhtsp2gurvK1mtqWvbW6BP2M.jpg)

The last stage of this build is the stand, which uses Technic-style beams and pins to set a rakish angle. The clear bricks aren't *quite* to LEGO standards, but they are uniquely suited to this stand.

![planet express ship complete.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jacobtothe/23uQfqHheCZmSjcYDb4iRjBvb5idNMQiKCNSxYxCsFVEDx1gUPwLQLF5TfXbUCMj5C8By.jpg)

Is this as good as LEGO? No. The bricks feel just a bit *off,* as does the clutch power of assembly. They are better than the Dollar Tree knockoffs, though. The assembly felt disjointed compared to LEGO build flow, but the instructions weren't hard to follow. And the portholes don't line up along the side!

It's not all negative by any means, though. It's a good display piece even if it lacks the play features of most LEGO sets. The turquoise and gloss red colors outside LEGO's established palette are interesting. As noted before, I like the fins and some other unique elements in this set. I also appreciate the pre-printed elements instead of stickers. Despite my complaints, I appreciate the overall end result. And of course, it was a gift, and I appreciate that, too.

**Should you buy Brickcraft instead of LEGO?**

Probably not, since it's just not quite as good, although the color options are nice.

**Should you buy Brickcraft if you like any of their licensed products?**

Maybe, but I'm not about to shill any referral links.

**Should you buy generic Chinese copies of LEGO?**

That's between you and your conscience. Some have unique IP licenses, and some are straight-up counterfeits.

Anyway, that's my review. Make of it what you will. Chime in with a comment if you like.

body.title: ORPHAN
body.body:
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQ5ciVnF6YS7PvTW8wpRDZ5b1pSTQAHPLsCSdcEdxAFkE/1777019130821.png)

Being an orphan should not decide a person’s value or future in life. But in many societies, including Nigeria, orphans are often treated unfairly, especially when it comes to marriage. Some families do not want their children to marry an orphan. This kind of treatment is wrong because being an orphan is not the person’s fault.

In many communities, parents care a lot about the family background of the person their child wants to marry. They want to know the person’s parents, family name, and where they come from. Because of this, orphans are sometimes looked down on because they do not have parents to speak for them. People may think that because they grew up without parents, they do not have proper training or family support. But this is not always true.

Treating orphans this way is painful and unfair. Losing parents is already a hard experience, and being rejected because of it makes life even more difficult. It can make orphans feel unwanted and lonely. Many of them suffer emotionally because society judges them for something they cannot control.

However, being an orphan does not mean a person is bad or irresponsible. In fact, many orphans grow up to become strong, hardworking, and responsible people. The difficulties they face in life often make them stronger and more mature. They learn how to survive, work hard, and value relationships.
A person’s character is not determined only by whether their parents are alive. Good values such as respect, honesty, kindness, and love can be learned from guardians, relatives, teachers, and life experiences. What matters most is the kind of person someone is, not whether they have parents.
Marriage should be based on love, understanding, respect, and good character. It should not be based on whether a person is an orphan. Refusing someone because they do not have parents is unfair and shows discrimination. Everyone deserves the chance to be loved and accepted.

In conclusion, discriminating against orphans, especially in marriage, is unfair and hurtful. Orphans did not choose to lose their parents, so they should not be blamed or rejected because of it. Society should learn to judge people by their character and not by their family situation. This will help create a kinder and fairer society for everyone.

body.title: ကျောက်နှင့် ရွှေ
body.body:
ပူလိုက်တာ အမလေး ပူလှချည်ရဲ့၊ အိုက်လှချည်းရဲ့။
စသဖြင့် လူတိုင်းနီးပါး နှုတ်ဖျားမှ အလွယ်တကူ
ပြောထွက်နေကြသည်။ ကျွန်တော်တို့ဆီသီု့
တနေ့ညက လေမိုးကျသွားသဖြင့် အနည်းငယ်
အပူလျော့သွားသည်။ မိုးမရွာခင်က 41 ရှိပြီး
ယခု 39 ဒီကဂရီရှိပေသည်။ ဒါသိပင် နေရိပ်ထဲ
နေမှ အနည်းငယ် အပူဒဏ်သက်သာသည်။
နေပူထဲမှာဆိုပါမူ အတော်ပူပေမည်။ 


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmaEoRz9ZFYwhBYK2VaNzFpWjLodnyTESmdDpbTjhZpNHP/image_a43faea7_19b8_4343_a3c2_afe551bc83f77736732746653520406.jpg)

မိုးနဲ့ လေ အတွဲညီစွာ ရွာချသဖြင့် ရေငတ်နေသော
မြေကြီးက အငမ်းမရ မိုးရေကို စုပ်ယူသည်။
မိုးရေက အရည်အတော်ပါသည်ကိုပင် မနက်မိုးလင်း
တော့ မြေပြင်မှာ ရေခွက် ရေအိုင်လေးများကို
သိပ်မတွေ့ရပေ။ ကားလမ်း ကတ္တရာထက်ဆီမှသာ
ရေအိုင်ကို တွေ့ရသည်။ ကတ္တရာကတော့ မိုးရေ
ကို မြေကြီးလောက် အိန္ဒြေမဲ့စွာ မစုပ်ယူပေ။
မဟာပထဝီမြေကြီးသည်က ကာလကြာစွာ
ဝေးကွာနေသော သမီးရည်းစာများလို မိုးရေကို
ထွေးပွေ့ပါလေသည်။ 


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmNVHi89NbKgrBNMiMWvLAJBKGMULd9M2gQRhEp2CTUE11/1777019029883.jpg)

ထိုသို့ မြေကြီးသည် မိုးရေကို စုပ်ယူ ထွေးပွေ့လင့်
ကစား မြေကြီးမှာ သူ့တကိုယ်လုံး လောက်ငှအောင်
စိုစွတ်မှုမရှိပေ။ နေရာကွက်ကြားသာ စိုစွတ်ရုံ
ရှိပေသည်။ မြေပြင်ထက်မှ သစ်ပင်ကြီးငယ်တို့မှာမူ
မိုးရေကောင်းစွာရရှိကြ၍ စိမ်းလန်းစိုပြေနေကြသည်။
သစ်ရွက်ကလေးများကလည်း ဖုန်မှုန့်ကင်းစင်၍
စိမ်းစို တောက်ပ လတ်ဆတ်နေကြသည်။
ခြံအပြင်ဖက် စိုက်ပျိုးထားသော သရက်ပင်ပေါက်
နှင့် အခြားသော အပင်များကို ကျွန်တော်သည်
ရေလာင်းဖို့ သက်သာရသည်။ 


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmT6yXmQB4BgHDTYwKXJkcbAibZNZfriUvmVYL6e7pmYu6/1777019080042.jpg)

နို့မို့ မနက်တကြိမ်၊ ညနေတကြိမ် ရေလောင်းရသည်။
တခါတရံ တကြိမ်သာ ရေလောင်းမိသည်လည်း
ရှိပေသည်။ သစ်ပင်များကို ရေလောင်းသည့်အခါ
အိမ်မှာရှိသော ရေကန်မှ ရေကို မလောင်းပေ။
အနောက်ဘက်မှာရှိသော တရုတ်အိမ်ရှေ့ရှိ
ရေမြောင်းမှ ရေကို ပုံဖြင့် ခပ်ယူ၍ လောင်းသည်။
သို့မှ သစ်ပင်များကို ရေလောင်းရာတွင်  ရေကို
ချွေတာစရာမလို‌ ပေ။ သစ်ပင်များကလည်း
ရေသန့်ထက် မြောင်းရေကို ပိုမိုနှစ်သက်ကြပေသည်။
ရေဗူးနဲ့ ဖိနပ်မပါရင် နွေအခါ သိလိမ်မည်။ 
ဒါနနဲ့ သီလ မပါရင် သေအခါ သိလိမ့်မည်တဲ့။ 


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmbpjnKUgwzkzVrQKfwVmqnFUwekcZwePq3znobtLGyGtU/image_94e2cb14_cdf9_42f3_a288_1688d8d4f6c98468058326272427950.jpg)

နွေရာသီမှာ ရေငတ်သဖြင့် ရေကိုရှာဖွေ
သောက်ကြရသည်။ ရေမသောက်ရပါမူ
အသက်သေဆုံးသည်အထိ ဖြစ်ပေမည်။
ရေကို လူပင်မဆိုထားလင့် သစ်ပင်များကလည်း
ရေမရပါမူ သေရှာကြသည်။ ခြံထဲမှာ စိုက်ထားသော
ကျောက်ဖရုံပင်က မိုးရေထိသဖြင့် အပွင့်ဝါဝါများက
အပြိုင်အဆိုင် ပွင့်ကြသည်။ အသီးကင်းလေး
များကို တွေ့၍ သေချာကြည့်ပါမှ ကျောက်ဖရုံသီး
မဟုတ်ပါကပဲ ရွှေဖရုံသီးများဖြစ်နေကြပေသည်။
အင်း ဖရုံတော့ ဖရုံပါပဲ ကျောက်ဖြစ်ဖြစ်၊ ရွှေဖြစ်ဖြစ်
စားတော့ စားလို့ရတာပါပဲလေ။ 

@htwegyi
April 24, 2026

Whether you are baptised or not, whether you are engaged or not, baptism is still necessary.
Because we need to obey the doctrines of God always. Who Jesus Christ has already called us to do Him.

body.title: A FLOATING WORLD
body.body:
Hello everyone, you're welcome to my blog today. 

Let's dive into the weird topic of floating islands in the sky. Well, I've never imagined looking up at the sky and seeing an island floating in it— not a cloud-shaped island, but an actual island with trees, soil, ground, and water suspended high above everything we know. It sounds unreal, like it defies the laws of gravity, but it is almost something out of a fairy tale. 



 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmfXxgmGvQQMFPRbhyNCs5y8geLRbHf2XvzZTLStYchqY2/IMG-20260424-WA0001.jpg 





A floating island represents freedom in its purest form, existing without being tied down, moving wherever the wind takes it. There is no fixed location; they are in constant motion. For someone who is standing below it, it will feel almost impossible. To be honest, it challenges everything we understand about the world. You might ask, \

Living life on such an island would be different. People there would view the world from a completely different perspective. Instead of looking at the sky as something distant, they would look down at the Earth, watching the landscapes pass beneath them. The same distance, direction, or even time might change.

There could also be a deeper meaning behind it. A floating island could symbolize independence, the ability to exist without expectations and limitations. It shows that it is a reminder that not everything has to follow the usual rules. Sometimes the most interesting ideas are the ones that don’t fit into what we already know. Human beings are always curious, and I would be very curious to see one. I would be even more curious about living on one to know what it feels like. At the same time, there would be challenges.

How do you sustain life on an island that is constantly moving? Where do you get your resources from? How do you buy groceries? How do you go to the market? How do you get healthcare? All these questions show that freedom also comes with its own responsibilities that you may not want to talk about. But the image of a floating island captures something important; it speaks to our imagination, curiosity, and desire to explore beyond the familiar things that we know. Even if it’s never a real reality, just thinking about it pushes us to make it possible, where we could wake up one morning and hear a country announce that they have a floating island. I would be a different person if I could go there.

Maybe that’s not the point; not everything needs to be real or to have value. Sometimes we just have to imagine and stretch how we think. This reminds us that the limits we see are not always the limits that actually exist. We can always go beyond and above our limits.

Thank you for stopping by my blog today!

Posted Using [INLEO](https://inleo.io/@betheloji12/a-floating-world-bu9)

Saludos amigo @biologistbrito, espero que estés pasando un excelente viernes jeje. En ese caso que planteas la presencia de polillas de la familia **Noctuidae** en los granos que ya estaban almacenados, se debía a que el material que llegaba a manos de ustedes procedente de América del norte ya venía contaminado, esto se da porque hubo un manejo fitosanitario deficiente al inicio de la cadena de distribución. Estas polillas en particular no buscan granos almacenados, necesitan colocar los huevos directamente en las estigmas del maíz o en las cercanías para que las orugas se alimenten de los granos tiernos de las mazorcas, esto de la puesta de huevos tiende a variar según la especie, algunas especies colocan a su descendencia en las hojas.

Por otro lado, las orugas de estas polillas cuentan con coloraciones que les permiten mezclarse con los estigmas (los pelos o barbas que tienen las mazorcas del maíz) o entre los granos, de ahí el hecho de que lleguen a pasar desapercibidas cuando las inspecciones iniciales sean deficientes. Esta suele ser una de las causas del por qué estas polillas se han extendido tanto dentro de América o Europa, el problema principal suele deberse a la exportación de material infestado y a las altas capacidades adaptativas de estas variedades de lepidópteros, son un caso muy nombrado dentro de la agricultura jaja.

Muchas gracias por el comentario y apoyo amigo, un abrazo.

body.title: Walk and simple shopping with my family at the Thursdays market.
body.body:
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmd8aafGmW77SJmRQctCZabdmRJHp5saG3z4uf7hLZ2w6h/1777018072171.jpg)

Hello everyone. How are you today? I hope all is well with you and your family. Yesterday was the first time my wife and I took our granddaughter and autistic son go out. Our autistic son has been on school break since mid March until now, We've never taken our autistic son out. His irritable and self-harming behavior, And our autistic son becomes very irritated and self-harming when we are in crowded and loud environments. Besides taking our son to school, we haven't taken him out for a long time. Our son was in a good mood yesterday. And yesterday evening there was a Thursday market open near our village. My wife and I took our granddaughter and autistic son to this Thursday market. 

This Thursday market is located after our village, two villages away. Our journey had to pass through the communities and farms of two villages too. The Thursday market is near the temple. We can park at the temple and walk to the market. Alternatively, we can park our car in the temple's parking lot located outside the temple. This market is a community market of the locals in Maengon Khilek village. The market is only open on Thursdays. And Thursday's market is a medium-sized market.

When we arrived at the Thursday market, we walked around and did some shopping. It's another rather lively and fun community market. This market mainly sells food, ingredients and snacks. And also selling other things. Of course, we enjoy this market. And we were so happy that we were able to go out after not being able to go out for a long time. I'll take everyone to see the atmosphere at this Thursday market with us. But I wasn't able to take many photos because I had to take my autistic son to the market too.

In addition, when we go home. I also take some photos of the scenery along the rural road before reaching our village. It is a scenery in the evening.

We bought several things and dinner too. And this is our dinner : Yunnan-style Chinese noodles.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmdqA5hVDKYTzpbqn5Len49goVX1D4NAzKxFKTNZF3XoYm/1777018214865.jpg)

body.body:
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/we-are-ai/23ywwgsvebe8tv49shbHuSf8pkj9ZPtMxRxiRwMyaDxvHXhpcCMYifTmu77AF1h22LHGN.png)


Today, the heat has been suffocating since this morning. Until recently, I was desperately searching for even the smallest ray of sunshine—but for the past week, it’s been the opposite: I’m fleeing into the shade just to catch a bit of cool air. I’ve put away the electric heater and reinstalled the AC. This weekend, I’m planning to relax in the forest by a river. It’s only 20°C (68°F) there, but I already feel like this summer is going to be hell… pure torture.

Quick side note: Today, I’m going to try cleaning up my code instead of just slapping together patches. It works, but apparently, everything can always be improved.
A big thank you to my new followers! Even if I’m not very visible on the site right now, welcome aboard. One day, 

I’ll be back in the spotlight.
Reputation: -2.19

It’s climbing slowly, day by day, thanks to all of you, friends.

On the stats side, I’ve stabilized at an average of 4 HP per day from curation rewards. My goal? 20,000 HP without delegation. For now, we’re doing leasing to accumulate HP as fast as possible. I’ll focus on that once I’ve hit these milestones:

Grow my BBHO to 20,000 – The profits will then be used to boost this account’s HP.
Help the benef.alive-cent-archon-and-co team buy up GLYPH tokens on the market as quickly as possible.
Properly rebalance the GLYPH token, even if it means distributing smaller amounts.

 Food activist Vani Hari (Food Babe) joins Del Bigtree to discuss the growing national fight over glyphosate and the push to shield pesticide manufacturers from liability. With more than 170,000 cancer lawsuits already filed against Bayer/Monsanto over Roundup exposure, Hari is organizing a major rally at the U.S. Supreme Court called ‘The People vs. Poison,’ taking place April 27 in Washington, D.C.

Hari explains why activists, farmers, scientists, and health advocates from across the political spectrum are joining forces to oppose legislative efforts that could grant pesticide companies immunity from future lawsuits. Toxicologist Alexandra Muñoz also weighs in, outlining scientific evidence linking glyphosate exposure to DNA damage and cancer.

As Congress debates liability protections and the EPA prepares its next glyphosate review, organizers are calling on the public to show up, speak out, and join the rally demanding transparency, accountability, and an end to corporate immunity for chemicals linked to serious health risks.

Buenos dias a todos, la verdad una guisado de este fideo pero diferente, con pollo cortado en daditos, como la pueden ver facil de elaborarlo y por supuesto muy sabroso, en esta fotografia la misma se trata de un guisado con carne de polloo y fideo codito, es uno de los fideos faboritos para los comensales, el mismo se prepara de la siguiente manera, agregamos la olla en la hornalla de la cocina, le vertemos un poco de aceite, luego le agregamos la cebolla, ajo y la carne de polloo cortada en trozos pequeños, dejamos que se cocine un poco y le vertemos un poco de agua caliente, luego sal a gusto y especias varias.

MUCHAS GRACIAS POR LEERME Y SEGUIRME.

TRADUCIDO AL INGLES

Good morning everyone, this is actually a stew with this pasta but different, with chicken cut into small cubes, as you can see it's easy to make and of course very tasty. In this photograph, it is a stew with chicken meat and elbow pasta, one of the favorite pastas for diners. It is prepared as follows: we place the pot on the stove, pour in a bit of oil, then add the onion, garlic, and chicken cut into small pieces. We let it cook a bit and then pour in some hot water, add salt to taste and various spices.

by Del Bigtree on The Highwire

 It’s World Homeopathy Awareness Week, and Del Bigtree sits down with classical homeopath and founder of the global initiative, Gabrielle Traub, to examine one of the most debated healing systems in modern medicine. Traub explains the foundational principle of homeopathy, “like cures like” (similia similibus curantur), and how the system developed more than two centuries ago continues to guide practitioners today.

Del and Gabrielle discuss homeopathy’s growing use in children’s health, fertility, mental and emotional wellness, pain management, and even agriculture, where homeopathic preparations are being studied as potential alternatives to toxic pesticides. Traub also discusses the historical battle between homeopathy and organized medicine, current regulatory pressure on homeopathic products in the United States, the study Americans for Homeopathy Choice Act (HR 750), and her documentary Introducing Homeopathy.

body.title: Blossom walk =/= Blütenweg 👹🍣🎎 Wonderful Japan ENG-GER
body.body: ![IMG_8251.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/maxinpower/23zRxae5vUoWJhSg8W2hzn6HmizydaLE8jmV6YbhnJFM1vTussuhuqrTKUppxDqqSFtQM.JPG) Even though I’ve already shown you quite a few cherry blossom photos over the past few days, I have a few more to share today. I just can’t help myself—I still have some that I don’t want to keep from you. Of course, I could cram twenty photos into a single post, but somehow that would feel overwhelming and ruin the charm of this wonderful spectacle. Because even though Queen Sakura often shows herself from her best side and you can’t stop marveling at the magnificent blossoms, it’s precisely this fragile delicacy and fleeting transience that make up the charm I just mentioned. Sometimes you just have to approach things a little more gently, and that works better with a few select photos than with an entire folder of photos all at once. And that’s why I’m sharing three photos today from one of our cherry blossom outings, when we treated ourselves to a short walk after a little picnic under the cherry blossoms. And that walk, as you might expect, wound its way beneath a canopy of blossoms that seemed to go on forever. I love paths like this; they probably bring out my romantic side, which I don’t want to hide at all. I’m probably the one in my little team who raves the most, and above all, the one who takes the most photos. Which I then absolutely have to show off, leading to all these cherry blossom posts. But hey, what can I do? I’m having fun myself, and I enjoy looking back at my photos and the experience. And maybe it really does help me not to forget what I’ve seen so quickly. After all, life goes on and something new happens every day. So it can happen that some of those many memories get pushed to the back of my mind, no matter how beautiful they may be. And to prevent that, I want to preserve my photos here, right in this very spot, forever. Simply because it’s fun and puts me in a good mood. Do I need any other reason? ![IMG_8249.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/maxinpower/23xyUvQvv1bSyt1Xc6ngv2xvE7RBUVPWZ5TPw83Xr7cFCTGWt3npcnM7qeXf3HDqekMZS.JPG) DEUTSCH Auch wenn ich euch in den letzten Tagen bereits ein ganze Menge an Kirschblütenbildern gezeigt habe, gibt es auch heute wieder ein paar mehr. Ich kann einfach nicht anders und ich habe halt noch ein paar, die ich euch nicht vorenthalten will. Ich könnte natürlich auch zwanzig Bilder in einen einzigen Beitrag stopfen, aber irgendwie würde das alles überfrachten und den Reiz dieses so wundervollen Schauspiels zerstören. Denn auch wenn Königin Sakura manchmal zu Hochform aufläuft und man selber ob der herrlichen Blütenpracht aus dem Staunen gar nicht mehr rauskommt, sind es doch eben diese zerbrechliche Zierlichkeit und die so vergängliche Flüchtigkeit, die den gerade erwähnten Reiz ausmachen. Manchmal muss es wohl halt ein wenig behutsamer angehen, und das macht sich wohl besser mit ein paar ausgewählten Bildern, als mit einem ganzen Fotoordner auf einen Schlag. Und deshalb gibt es heute drei Bilder von einer unserer Sakura-runden, als wir nach einem kleinen Picknick unter Kirschblüten, uns noch einen kleinen Spaziergang gegönnt hatten. Und dieser führte, wie hätte es auch anders sein können, dann natürlich auch unter dem Blütendach entlang, welche gar nicht mehr aufhören wollte. Ich liebe solche Pfade, holen sie wohl auch bei mir meine romatische Seite hervor, welche ich auch gar nicht verstecken will. Wahrscheinlich bin ich es in meinem kleinen Team, der am meisten schwärmt, und vor allem auch der, der am meisten Fotos macht. Welche ich dann am Ende auch unbedingt zeigen will, was dann eben zu den vielen Kirschblütenposts führt. Aber hey, was soll ich machen. Ich habe ja selber meinen Spaß dabei, und freue mich noch einmal über meine Fotos und das Erlebte. Und vielleicht hilft es ja wirklich auch dabei, dass ich Gesehene nicht so schnell wieder vergesse. Das Leben geht eben auch weiter und jeden Tag passiert etwas Neues. Da kann es schon einmal vorkommen, dass ein paar der vielen Erinnerungen ein wenig nach hinten verdrängt werden, ganz egal wie schön sie auch sein mögen. Und um dem vorzubeugen, will ich hier an genau dieser Stelle meine Bilder für immer festhalten. Einfach auch weil es Spaß macht und ich dabei gute Laune habe. Braucht es einen anderen Grund? ![IMG_8244.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/maxinpower/23zGcRvMpheQNuQ9ZMSCHTBTR7tCTk3p6hJR3dV4oxMmspZX8wf5nWFHbisL7mMqEbV1e.JPG) ![blog-ende.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/maxinpower/23tv6H18WKn98nBVkn2MwVhwWsuFRFgjBGwxLEMVhRZD7zRRbFokaNiAn39fUaB3TxVX6.png)

body.title: Art and Culture in Fort Worth: Must-Visit Exhibitions and Shows
body.body:
Fort Worth has a cultural identity that feels grounded yet constantly evolving. The city blends traditional influences with modern creativity, offering a range of exhibitions and shows that appeal to both casual visitors and serious art lovers. You do not need to be an expert to enjoy what the city has to offer. You just need a bit of curiosity and the willingness to explore.

If you are looking for a reliable way to track what is happening, [WhatsUpFortWorth](https://whatsupfortworth.com/) provides a helpful overview of current exhibitions, performances, and even upcoming concerts in Fort Worth Texas. It makes planning your cultural outings much easier.

Here is a closer look at how you can experience the best of art and culture in Fort Worth.

***

### Explore World Class Museum Exhibitions

Fort Worth is known for its strong museum presence. From contemporary art to historical collections, there is always something worth seeing.

Museum exhibitions often rotate, which means each visit can feel different. One week you might encounter modern installations that challenge your perspective. Another time you might walk through carefully preserved works that tell stories from the past.

These spaces are designed to be accessible. You do not need prior knowledge to appreciate what is on display. The layout, descriptions, and guided experiences help you connect with the work in your own way.

Planning ahead is useful here. Exhibitions can be time sensitive, so checking updates on WhatsUpFortWorth ensures you do not miss something that interests you.

***

### Experience Live Theater Performances

Live theater in Fort Worth adds another dimension to the city’s cultural scene. Performances range from classic plays to modern productions that experiment with storytelling and staging.

What makes theater special is the immediacy. You are watching something unfold in real time, with actors bringing characters to life just a few feet away. It creates a connection that is hard to replicate through other forms of entertainment.

The city offers a mix of large productions and smaller, more intimate shows. Both have their own appeal. Larger venues provide a polished experience, while smaller stages often feel more personal and immersive.

These performances are often listed alongside other events on WhatsUpFortWorth, making it easy to fit them into your schedule.

***

### Discover Local Art Shows and Creative Spaces

Beyond museums and theaters, Fort Worth has a thriving local art scene. Galleries, studios, and creative spaces host exhibitions that showcase emerging artists and experimental work.

These events tend to feel less formal. You can walk in, take your time, and even interact with the artists in some cases. It adds a layer of authenticity that makes the experience more engaging.

Local art shows are also a great way to see what is currently shaping the creative community. You get a sense of trends, ideas, and perspectives that might not yet be part of larger exhibitions.

Because these events are often smaller, they can be easy to miss. Regularly checking WhatsUpFortWorth helps you stay updated on these opportunities.

***

### Combine Art with Music and Performance

Art in Fort Worth does not exist in isolation. Many cultural events blend visual art with music and performance, creating a more dynamic experience.

You might attend an exhibition that includes live music or a performance that incorporates visual elements. These combinations make events feel more interactive and engaging.

Music plays a strong role in this mix. Alongside exhibitions, you can explore upcoming concerts in Fort Worth Texas that complement the cultural atmosphere of the city.

These experiences allow you to move between different forms of creativity within a single outing.

***

### Cultural Events Around Sports and Community

Fort Worth’s cultural scene also connects with other aspects of the city, including professional sports in Fort Worth. Game days and sports events often bring additional activities, performances, and exhibitions that enhance the overall experience.

You might find art displays, live performances, or themed events happening around major sports venues. This creates a crossover between entertainment and culture that feels unique to the city.

It also makes it easier to plan a full day. You can start with an exhibition, attend a performance, and then transition into a sports event without feeling like you are switching contexts completely.



***

### Seasonal Shows and Special Events

Art and culture in Fort Worth are influenced by the seasons. Certain times of the year bring special exhibitions, festivals, and performances that draw larger audiences.

Holiday themed shows, cultural festivals, and limited time exhibitions add variety to the calendar. These events often come with additional activities, making them more than just a single visit.

Because these shows are time sensitive, planning becomes important. Using WhatsUpFortWorth helps you identify what is happening and decide which events you want to prioritize.



***

### Make the Most of Your Cultural Experience

To fully enjoy Fort Worth’s art and culture, it helps to approach it with an open mind. You do not need to see everything at once. Instead, choose a few experiences that interest you and allow yourself to explore them fully.

You can start with a museum visit, follow it with a theater performance, and end your evening with a concert or community event. This kind of flexible planning keeps your day balanced and enjoyable.

WhatsUpFortWorth simplifies this process by bringing together different types of events in one place. It saves time and helps you focus on the experience rather than the logistics.

### Conclusion

Fort Worth offers a cultural scene that is both diverse and accessible. From museum exhibitions and live theater to local art shows and music events, there is always something to explore.

By staying updated with WhatsUpFortWorth, you can easily find [upcoming concerts in Fort Worth Texas](https://whatsupfortworth.com/live-music-events/live-music/) and discover how cultural events connect with professional sports in Fort Worth. This makes it easier to plan outings that feel complete and engaging.

In the end, art and culture in Fort Worth are not just about observing. They are about experiencing, connecting, and finding moments that stay with you long after the event is over.

body.title: Tatsuki Fujimoto 17-26 | Nattosheru Review [ENG/SPA]
body.body: >\n\nHello, anime fans. Today I’m bringing you another gem from last fall’s season—an anime featuring a wide variety of short stories for all kinds of audiences. With such creative production and storytelling, it could be considered one of the best collections of short stories in the entire industry. Based on the collection of exclusive one-shots titled Tatsuki Fujimoto Before Chainsaw Man, Tatsuki Fujimoto 17-26 is an original anime for the internet (ONA) produced by
>P.A. Works. Discover one of last year’s best gems.

>
Hola, fanáticos del anime. Hoy les traigo otra joya de la pasada temporada de otoño, un anime que tiene una buena variedad de historias cortas para todo tipo de públicos. Con una producción y elaboración tan creativa que se podría considerar como una de las mejores colecciones de cortos de toda la industria. Basada en la colección de one-shots exclusivos titulados Tatsuki Fujimoto Before Chainsaw Man, Tatsuki Fujimoto 17-26 es una adaptación animada original para internet (ONA) producida por Zexcs, Lapin Track, Studio Graph77, 100studio, Studio Kafka y P.A. Works. Conoce una de las mejores joyas del año pasado.

>

Plot

The anime is a collection of eight stories, one per episode: 1) In a world invaded by human-eating aliens, two young people try to survive by dressing up as chickens. 2) A high school student who admires his teacher must prove his resolve as he tries to defend her from an armed lunatic. 3) A student council president decides to confess his feelings to his only friend and classmate, no matter what is happening around him. 4) A young professional assassin meets an immortal being. 5) A young piano enthusiast decides to teach a mermaid how to play. 6) A boy wakes up as a girl and begins to be teased at school. 7) A girl born with horns becomes the nightmare of an entire society. 8) Two sisters showcase their talent by painting themselves.

>

Trama

El anime es una recopilación de ocho historias, una por cada episodio: 1) En un mundo invadido por extraterrestres come-humanos, dos jóvenes intentan sobrevivir vestidos de gallinas. 2) Un estudiante de secundaria que admira a su maestra tendrá que demostrar su determinación al intentar defenderla de un lunático armado. 3) Un presidente del consejo estudiantil decide declararle sus sentimientos a su única amiga y compañera, sin importar qué suceda a su alrededor. 4) Una joven asesina profesional conoce a un ser inmortal. 5) Un joven fanático del piano decide enseñarle a tocar a una sirena. 6) Un chico despierta siendo mujer y empieza a recibir burlas en la escuela. 7) Una niña que nació con cuernos se convierte en la pesadilla de toda una sociedad. 8) Dos hermanas demuestran su talento pintándose a sí mismas.
>\n\nBefore I continue, I’d like to clarify that I knew almost nothing about <strong><a href=\

>Tatsuki Fujimoto before seeing this collection of his. Yes, I did watch the famous Chainsaw Man anime back in the day, which, to be honest, I found very entertaining. I admit it was one of those works that showed me a very interesting side of this vast world of anime. I say this mainly because of the way it managed to blend dark fantasy with the supernatural, action, comedy, and even horror into a single story, featuring characters that are very hard to forget. One thing I was certain of back then was that the creator of this work is a true genius. Now, with Tatsuki Fujimoto 17-26, I can confirm this without a doubt. The mere fact that, at such a young age, Tatsuki Fujimoto was already creating stories as fantastic as the ones we see in this anime is actually quite surprising. At 17, I could barely hold a normal conversation with anyone—imagine that. That’s why this particular anime fascinates me so much, aside from the fact that its stories are captivating on their own and have a production quality that’s just as unique. Because yes, another thing I want to mention right away is that this collection of short stories was produced by six different studios, which is why the animation style and production vary from one episode to the next.

>
Antes de continuar quisiera aclararles que no conocía casi nada de Tatsuki Fujimoto antes de ver esta colección suya. Si, llegué a ver en su momento el famoso anime de Chainsaw Man que, siendo honesto, me entretuvo mucho. Admito que fue de esas obras que me mostraron un lado muy interesante de este enorme mundo del anime. Lo digo sobre todo por la forma en la que logró mezclar la fantasía oscura con lo sobrenatural, la acción, la comedia y hasta el horror en una sola historia y con personajes que son muy difíciles de olvidar. Algo sí tenía claro en ese entonces era que el creador de esta obra es todo un genio. Ahora, con Tatsuki Fujimoto 17-26 puedo confirmar esto sin problema alguno. El simple hecho de pensar que, a tan corta edad, Tatsuki Fujimoto ya creaba historias tan fantásticas como las que vemos en este anime es algo bastante sorprendente, la verdad. Yo a los 17 años apenas y lograba mantener una conversación normal con alguien, imagínate. Es por eso que este anime en particular me fascina bastante, aparte de que sus historias llaman la atención a nivel individual y tienen una calidad y producción igual de individuales. Porque si, otra cosa que les quiero mencionar desde ya es que esta colección de historias cortas fueron producidas por seis estudios diferentes y es por eso que el estilo de animación y producción cambia de un episodio a otro.

> I’m mentioning this up front so that, when you finally get around to watching this anime, you won’t get discouraged after seeing its incredible first episode—the one that really grabbed everyone’s attention when it aired late last year. Yeah, I was one of those people who got discouraged by the second episode because of such an abrupt shift that I couldn’t even make sense of the episode itself. But then, with the next six episodes, I completely changed my mind, and I honestly tell you that it’s absolutely worth watching. It doesn’t matter if you don’t like fantasy, action, romance, and all those generic tropes that are a dime a dozen in this industry; this anime is completely different. Or rather, its eight stories are completely unique in their own genre and style. I’m not just saying this because each story manages to make an impact right from the start with a plot that grabs your attention—even if you’re not a fan of anime. If you’re looking for something completely different from what’s overused in this industry, then you absolutely have to watch this anime from the very beginning. All of its stories completely break away from the typical clichés of today’s generic anime. Each story has an unpredictable plot that hooks you from the start and doesn’t let go until the end. If possible, I could even write a full review for each episode, but I don’t do that.

>
Menciono esto desde ya para que, al momento de llegar a ver este anime, no se desanimen luego de ver su increíble primer episodio que fue el que más llamó la atención en su momento cuando se emitió a finales del año pasado. Si, yo fui uno de esos que se desanimaron al segundo episodio debido al cambio tan abrupto que tuvo que ni le conseguí el sentido al episodio como tal. Pero luego, con los siguientes seis episodios, cambié de idea por completo y honestamente les digo que sí vale toda la pena del mundo verlo. No importa que no te guste la fantasía, la acción, el romance y esas cosas genéricas que hay de sobra en esta industria; este anime es completamente diferente. O bueno, sus ocho historias son completamente únicas en su propio género y estilo, mejor dicho. No solo lo digo porque cada historia consigue impactar al principio con una trama que llama la atención, aún si no eres fan del anime, inclusive. Si lo que buscas es algo completamente distinto a lo que se ve en exceso en esta industria, entonces tienes que ver sí o sí este anime desde un principio. Todas sus historias rompen por completo con los típicos clichés de todo anime genérico actual. Cada historia tiene una trama impredecible que te engancha desde el principio y no te suelta hasta el final. Si es posible, hasta podría hacerle una reseña entera a cada episodio, pero no hago eso.

> Yes, there are a few stories that might leave you a bit unimpressed because of how random, strange, or absurd they are, but it’s among the most entertaining and diverse shows you’ll find in the industry right now—I’ll say it again. For my part, I think that, out of the eight stories this anime tells, four of them were the ones that impacted and fascinated me the most. Starting with the first episode, which, obviously, as a fan of science fiction and aliens that I am, was completely crazy. Especially because neither Tatsuki nor the studio in charge held back on any censorship when introducing us to that story. Another episode I really liked was the one about the assassin girl who meets the “immortal being” who turns out to be a vampire, yes. At first, it seems like the typical dark fantasy story with action, featuring the assassin protagonist and the vampire villain and all that. But then it takes a complete turn and becomes a love story—again, with no censorship at all in some moments. Maybe our creator also liked those vampire and romance stories in his youth—who knows. Another story I loved was the one about the boy who teaches a mermaid to play the piano.

>
Si, hay una que otra historia que puede que te deje un tanto indiferente por lo random, extraño o absurdo que es, pero es de lo más entretenido y variado que vas a encontrar ahora en esta industria, repito. Por mi lado considero que, de las ocho historias que nos cuenta este anime, cuatro de ellas fueron las que más me impactaron y me fascinaron de todas. Empezando por el primer episodio que, obviamente, como fanático de la ciencia ficción y los extraterrestres que soy, fue una completa locura. Sobre todo porque ni Tatsuki ni el estudio a cargo se reservaron ningún tipo de censura al introducirnos dicha historia. Otro episodio que me gustó mucho también fue el de la chica asesina que conoce al “ser inmortal” que termina siendo un vampiro, si. Al principio pareciera ser la típica historia de fantasía oscura con acción de la protagonista que es asesina y el vampiro que es el villano y todo eso. Pero luego da un giro completo y se convierte en una historia de amor, de nuevo, sin ninguna censura en algunos momentos. Posiblemente a nuestro creador también le gustaron esas historias de vampiros y de romance en su juventud, quién sabe. Otra historia que me encantó también fue la del chico que le enseña a tocar piano a una sirena.

> Once again, the way Tatsuki creates such original and fantastic stories is truly impressive. I really liked the last one I mentioned because, in just a few minutes, it plunges us into a fantastical world of mermaids, complete with all the drama surrounding the boy’s parents, the mermaids’ bad reputation, and everything else. The way he develops his characters is fascinating, too. Finally, I think the one I liked the most of all is the story about the girl with horns who is feared by everyone in her world. That story is beautiful and moving in its own way, as it shows us the relationship between the siblings and what they go through every day. The simple fact of turning a demon—a being from the underworld—into a creature that’s both misunderstood and striking is incredible, really. Here I have to say that Tatsuki really outdid himself, since we can see how he manages to give feelings to a being that, supposedly, doesn’t have any. That, and the fact that, based on this short story, we can see his intention to create a longer, more complex work—which ended up being Chainsaw Man. Mind you, just because I mention these four stories doesn’t mean the others aren’t good; there are a couple that really entertained me, like the one in the last episode, but they don’t have the same impact.

>
De nuevo, la forma en la que Tatsuki crea historias tan originales y fantásticas es impresionante, de verdad. Esta última que les mencioné me gustó bastante ya que, en pocos minutos, nos introduce de una en un mundo fantástico de sirenas con todo el drama detrás con los padres del chico, la mala reputación de las sirenas y todo eso. La forma de desarrollar sus personajes es fascinante también. Por último, creo que la que más me gustó de todas es la de la chica con cuernos que es temida por todos en su mundo. Dicha historia es hermosa y emotiva a su propio estilo ya que nos muestra toda la relación que tienen los hermanos y lo que viven diariamente. El simple hecho de convertir a un demonio, un ser salido del inframundo, en una criatura incomprendida y a la vez llamativa es increíble, de verdad. Aquí sí digo que Tatsuki se lució bastante ya que podemos notar cómo logra darle sentimientos a un ser que, según, no tiene. Eso y que, a partir de esta historia corta, es que podemos notar sus intenciones de hacer una obra más larga y compleja que terminó siendo Chainsaw Man. Ojo, que mencione estas cuatro historias no significa que las otras no sean buenas, hay un par que me entretuvieron mucho como lo fue el del último episodio, pero no tienen el mismo impacto.

> In the end, it’s just as I said before: every story has its own unique style, and that’s why each one can leave a different impression on us. But what I liked most of all was the audiovisual presentation, and I want to remind you that different studios were responsible for animating each episode—or at least most of them. I don’t know if it’s entirely fair to generalize the work each studio did on each story, but one thing I do know is that you won’t be disappointed at all. Each episode has its own style of animation, direction, production, character design, color palettes, and visual effects. Some episodes stand out more for their higher animation quality, fluidity, character design, and even uncensored scenes and excellent visual details. Other episodes might confuse you with their art style and creative storytelling. The sound effects are also excellent, as is the soundtrack for each episode. Here, I do doubt that one or two episodes stand out as such, since each story is unique and has its own rhythm and melody that catches your attention. For example, the mermaid episode obviously stands out here for its piano scenes. Anyway, I’m leaving you with this special collection for anyone who wants to watch something different.
Personally, I give it a 9.5/10 rating in terms of the fantasy, science fiction, action, romance, drama, and comedy genres.

>
Al final, es como dije antes, cada historia es única en su estilo y es por eso que cada una puede impresionarnos de manera diferente. Pero lo que más me gustó de todo es su aspecto audiovisual y aquí les quiero recordar que fueron distintos estudios los que se encargaron de animar cada episodio, o al menos la mayoría. No sé si sea del todo justo generalizar el trabajo que hizo cada estudio con cada historia, pero de algo que sí sé es que no se van a defraudar para nada. Cada episodio tiene su propio estilo de animación, dirección, producción, diseño de personajes, paletas de colores y efectos visuales. Algunos episodios logran destacarse más por tener una mayor calidad de animación, fluidez, diseño de personajes e incluso escenas sin censura y detalles visuales excelentes. Otros episodios puede que te confundan con su estilo de arte y manera de contar sus historias de forma creativa. Los efectos de sonido también son excelentes, al igual que la banda sonora que tiene cada episodio. Aquí sí dudo que se haya destacado un episodio o dos como tal ya que cada historia es única y tiene su propio ritmo y melodía que llama la atención. Por ejemplo, el de las sirenas obviamente destaca aquí por sus escenas de piano. En fin, les dejo esta colección especial para el que desee ver algo diferente.
Personalmente, le doy una calificación de 9.5/10 en lo que respecta al género de fantasía, ciencia ficción, acción, romance, drama y comedia.

>
Tell me, have you seen this anime yet? What did you think of it? Feel free to leave your thoughts in the comments.

>
Dime, ¿ya has visto este anime? ¿Qué te ha parecido? Puedes dejarme tu respuesta en los comentarios.

@LadiesofHive Community [Contest #285](https://hive.blog/hive-124452/@ladiesofhive/ladies-of-hive-community-contest-285)  questions for the week are:

1️⃣ What is one book, YouTube video, movie, or life lesson on self-development that has truly impacted you? It could be about skills, money, purpose, relationships, health, or personal growth. Share what it taught you and why you would recommend it to others.
~ 𝐀𝐍𝐃 / 𝐎𝐑 ~
2️⃣ Right now in your life, what feels like your main reason for living?
How would you describe your purpose at this moment, and what keeps you moving forward each day?

<center>⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐</center>

I am fond of watching movies and reading books both, and have a big library. There are many books which have intrigued me a lot and many movies as well. But there is this one movie that clearly stands out for me and has had an impact on me on some part of my life. This movie is \

.  The story of this movie is that there is a Pastor, who meets with an accident and is pronounced dead, but he is revived back. When he comes back to life he speaks about how he encountered those 90 minutes in heaven while the time he was gone.

The experience of these 90 minutes is beyond words; he encounters intense joy and love with his loved ones on the other side. When he is brought back to life, all that he feels is suffering and misery. He is going through lot of physical pain, his leg is in compete shatter, he is not able to walk and for months he is living in pain going through extreme painful treatments. In this time, he feels miserable about coming back to life. He feels that he was happy on the other side and returning back has only brought him pain, not only to him but his family also.

For a long time, he has not spoken about this experience to anyone, then he decides to speak to it about his wife, the 90 minutes that he lived out of his body and what he felt in it. The wife is overwhelmed and then they talk about it to the another Pastor. During his treatment his pain makes him a very bitter person.  Through his life he has only been helping and now he feels helpless and feels like he is a burden to his family.

![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmQueSRSbx4jooT99Lizpyt1pEYFpFCYNEGE4Vxs6ShirT/image.png)
[Source](https://pixabay.com/photos/valais-alps-mountains-glacier-3562988/)

That's when the Pastor counsels him, that the life he has got back is for a purpose and to recover he has to learn to receive help. All his life he has only helped others but never taken help from anyone, and this is also part of his learning. At first he has lot of apprehensions, slowly gradually the shift starts, he becomes more open to his family, talking about the pain and taking help from them to look after him. His healing starts from here on, physically and emotionally.

It is a very heart touching story, the change especially. I relate myself somewhere in this movie. One point of time in my life, I just believed in helping others and never was open to receiving help. At that time one of my teachers told me, it was my ego that was blocking to receive help. First, I did not believe but I did a lot of self-reflection and I did understand what my teacher was telling me. Yes, I was operating myself from a space of ego. Lesson in life is not about giving; it is also about receiving. I had cried a lot while watching this movie. I felt like heaven was trying to give me a message through this movie. It's one movie that never gets out of my head.

Second question, I will mention in very brief. The right now purpose of my life I feel is taking care of domestic affairs. To look after my family and take care of them.

body.title: GIRL CHILD
body.body:
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmTJAztLrmdRmZepxeqUWCeNzAA6zAbyZAbAKkwHoizQrW/1777017834761.png)
They said she was a vessel,
Soft clay shaped by fragile hands,
A whisper in crowded rooms,
A shadow where silence stands.

They called her delicate
As if strength could not wear skin so tender,
As if her voice, when raised,
Would break instead of thunder.

She walked through narrow paths
Carved by rules she did not write,
Told to dim her shining soul
So others could feel bright.

“Be gentle, be quiet, be small,”
They stitched into her name,
Yet fire lived beneath her ribs
No silence could contain.
For she is more than their stories,
More than labels thrown her way,
Not a vessel made for breaking
But a storm that learns to stay.

She carries worlds within her,
Dreams that stretch beyond the sky,
And though they tried to cage her wings,
Still she learned to fly.

Call her strong, call her rising,
Call her everything she’s worth,
For the girl they named “weak vessel”
Is the fiercest force on earth.

body.title: Watercolor Art, Beautiful Nature Landscape with Lantern
body.body:
Hello Everyone!

This picture was painted with watercolors today. There are trees, mountains and a lantern hanging from a tree. They are drawn in a circle. 

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmewCqqK9jCQALG1R5aXyU3g9GjUPdAnHL1ciDuZUGWoQ6/1777016969094.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmf8RjQiDgkSyWP8Lzg7sizVJzdywzXe5Kcjvx2rT3g7U6/1777016969256.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmUVVM7oxeswVnd7A9TFBX6w4jmogVwa3oRfgwGp4Hju6c/1777016969392.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmciuZym214qVgXQ818YPcP7wKPpxi7g4qc6Gq55WhAdhQ/1777016969521.jpg)

In the first step, I drew the background with blue, pink, yellow and red-brown colors. I drew the clouds with white color. I drew the mountains in the middle of the picture with purple color. I drew the trees at the bottom of the mountains with dark green color. 

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmTqffRGFMomh4iv3fqNQ141uPeVuwN3Q83wonq3hfNiaN/1777017026048.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmPGUnPzgxFRXdxEnpELf8M49P5piB7AiXEswkCBzFiyHm/1777017026207.jpg)

I painted the shore with brown color and the other plants with green and light green colors. 

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmeeKbabciscEpanmEqv3bDZRDSTdrWhuwEdc7hDw5eKMy/1777017066965.jpg)

I drew the tree trunks with brown color first and then added dark brown color. I painted the leaves with green and light green colors. I also added plants at the bottom of the trees and the shore with black color.

body.body:

<center>
![t4JstflP1EJJZ0HA_image_1777012038957.webp](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/carolin77/images/t4JstflP1EJJZ0HA_image_1777012038957/t4JstflP1EJJZ0HA_image_1777012038957.webp)
![BUFBpjwih8iVpasP_image_1777012041616.webp](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/carolin77/images/BUFBpjwih8iVpasP_image_1777012041616/BUFBpjwih8iVpasP_image_1777012041616.webp)
![7pEWlipkP4fbvuBl_image_1777012048219.webp](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/carolin77/images/7pEWlipkP4fbvuBl_image_1777012048219/7pEWlipkP4fbvuBl_image_1777012048219.webp)
![PRLV9ianpNvClgPa_image_1777012056596.webp](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/carolin77/images/PRLV9ianpNvClgPa_image_1777012056596/PRLV9ianpNvClgPa_image_1777012056596.webp)
</center>
</liketuimages>

到周五咯，久违的天晴咯，这难道是看快到五一了，给小长假“面子”嘛？我看后面的天气以晴天为主，也是喜出望外了。

早上刚到公司，坐了没一会儿，办公室另一位同事也来了，她说“给你一朵花”，一开始我没听清，我说“什么？”她说送你一朵花，然后就从手里拿出一朵玫瑰来。

娇艳欲滴的颜色，还新鲜的，我找了个瓶子给插起来了，真的好好看，一整天心情都那么好。浪漫还是我办公室姐妹懂啊，哈哈，一来就送玫瑰。我都这把年纪人了，看到玫瑰还是会心动。

这几天对接一个海外客户，天天翻译俄文给我弄的焦头烂额，本来英语就好像捡破烂一样一点一点拾起来的，勉强够用，现在好了直接来个俄文的，我也是快整崩溃了，手底下的人弄的被投诉几次，没办法只能我硬着头皮上，不然我就要被经理说了。

每天产品翻译，再去沟通，再加上大风大雨的天气，我觉得我人都要焉了。好在快对接结束了，核对没问题就可以打尾款，让其他人去弄产品，再让财务催款就行，然后天气也晴朗起来，万事都朝着好的方向发展了。

不管怎样，明天是周末咯，天晴了就可以外面去玩一下咯，放松放松。



---

body.title: Німеччина обмежує соцдопомогу
body.body:
Новий закон, схвалений німецьким парламентом у березні 2026 року, змінює важливі умови надання соцдопомоги, в тому числі й українцям. Деякі нові положення:

• Тепер батьки мусять працевлаштуватися, коли дитині виповниться 14 місяців (раніше 3 роки).
• Після року роботи перевірятимуть доцільність бізнесу самозайнятих. Якщо діяльність не відповідає вимогам - отримувачів допомоги зобов'яжуть шукати іншу роботу.
• Якщо особа відмовляється від роботи, базова частина виплати від €500 скасовується повністю.
• За неявку у центр зайнятості, після другої пропущеної зустрічі, виплати зменшать на 30%. Якщо особа не з'являється неодноразово - зрештою право на виплати анулюють.
• Посилено вимоги щодо участі у мовних та інтеграційних курсах, контроль пошуку роботи. Тепер Jobcenter може видати наказ із жорсткими умовами: частота спроб пошуку роботи, які докази надавати і в який термін.

Деякі санкції, як-от за пропуск візитів до центру зайнятості, діють одразу з 22 квітня 2026 року. 

[INFA UA](https://t.me/INFA_U_A)

***

body.title: My road to Alicante - from new Laoptop over Chiclana to Alicante [GER/ENG]
body.body:
**Vom neuen Laptop über Umwege nach Alicante zu den HIVE OPEN DAYS**

Ein kleines Update aus meinem Leben, bevor es nach Alicante zu den HIVE Open Days geht.



![EAE09A01-EB07-4A9B-91C8-4E58B00C2EE5_1_201_a.heic](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/schmidi/23xAc8dDN7eF7yu1oriJdmSzrM3HPxE3nZmFqabTZYAfSWbNaSNW7tNV2hqVawhGDSPw7.jpg)






Als ich neulich auf dem Weg nach Deutschland zu einem Seminar mit Stefan Verra war, crashte ich meinen Mac mit Kaffee. Nach einem Zwischenstopp in Nürnberg bei einem Mac-Partner, der nur noch den sicheren Tod feststellen konnte, ging es weiter nach Schweinfurt zum Körpersprachenspezialisten Stefan Verra.



![5613688D-4AF3-4613-BCAA-FA6B88551CB7_1_201_a.heic](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/schmidi/242ryB36r6jLyj899ptGTmnbYc2dbBeMqbrYkYi4hXeNmoBAS8jnmBK1LUQsVvcYsuuJg.jpg)


Obwohl ich als gelernter Coach und Trainer nicht immer zu 100 % konform mit ihm gehe, habe ich wieder einiges mitgenommen. Nun sitze ich in Chiclana de la Frontera und genieße meinen zweiten Morgenkaffee.



![FCF96B0E-E6E9-4D82-92FF-2B38DFBC7CB2_1_201_a.heic](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/schmidi/23xAdz7oooHVgq7rY5Qr92k4omUk7FuLZs7e2WFwohTjzFsbtZi7THy5yCCGbgF8CQ9nx.jpg)




Die Morgenroutine inklusive zwei Runden im Pool ist beendet, die Sonne kämpft sich langsam durch und ich arbeite bereits. Herrlich, oder?! Solche Arbeitsplätze sind für mich einfach der absolute Traum – vor allem dann, wenn es dein Job zulässt und du es dir auch erlauben darfst.

Eine der Aussagen von Stefan Verra war: \

Obwohl ich seine Grundaussage verstanden habe, ist für mich Mindset das A&O zum Erfolg.

Dazu habe ich auch ein Video auf meinem Kanal veröffentlicht. Klick dich hier rein und schau es dir von Anfang bis Ende an. Über einen Daumen hoch und deinen Kommentar freue ich mich.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=MiNb1dz0yWk&t=7s


Vor dem Abflug war ich noch mit \

, einem Hardstyle-DJ-Act, auf Tour. Es war cool, spannend und herrlich zu sehen, wie die Jungs mit ihrer Energie und Leidenschaft die Clubs rockten. Ob du die Musik nun magst oder nicht – es ist mein Job und ich liebe das, was ich tue.



![BB5620F9-3E4F-4066-8FB9-9D2A2078D450_1_102_a.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/schmidi/2423z16yS82q6NQSZquQrBd49F4Dh1jH3BiX22Eh3Kn1ze14rNY48wUAdw9jM8bttvb1R.jpeg)



Angekommen in Jerez, abgeholt und auf nach Chiclana.

Am 22.04., war ich spontan auf der Feria in Sevilla und durfte wieder etwas Neues kennenlernen. Eine Feria ist ähnlich wie ein Volksfest oder Kirtag bei uns, nur weit größer. Viele Reiter, Kutschen und die typisch spanische Tracht.



![2D6BA2B4-604D-4817-8FCF-3CE3059CFD6C_1_102_a.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/schmidi/23u63AkVa42Ef7nX9no4852FdQCSkopb1FKVgGh4RhSt7zgK7hJBiG9wRZEj5tcxDdCCj.jpeg)


![D1781744-162F-4CCB-A8F4-F890BFBA4497_1_102_o.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/schmidi/23yd867CSRUWFTjhtuyFsQLCfqDDxDJXtwAC6fuMxuhWpNh79iKGE48UaSoNGhwwqxfYk.jpeg)

![C2CC2CFB-C89D-4DB9-B508-C41942547CE1_1_102_a.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/schmidi/23u657Wtst9cQgY8yypHe8jBMvuhfdQjPrUKiu76QDZdDq63VPxDU28K9Q4j3brPowfoZ.jpeg)



![8B10F738-AE29-451F-B07F-122FE76C1F40_1_102_a.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/schmidi/23xKtdLEBPczc5bdWiCqqESw71jHRMAWvhJGFstPZSCuszLm5oEveWCj1EezjDQBfGaNK.jpeg)


Am 28.04. geht es dann von Chiclana nach Sevilla und direkt weiter nach Alicante zu den **HIVE OPEN DAYS** der @buzzparty. Ich bin gespannt, was mich dort erwarten wird! Fakt ist, dass ich dort ein paar Punkte ansprechen werde und mich freue, alte Gesichter und Freunde wie @reiseamateur, aber auch Menschen wie @tibfox (wieder) zu treffen. Networking ist angesagt und natürlich der Austausch rund um HIVE.

Darüber hinaus steht ein cooles Programm zu einem wirklich fairen Preis an. Alicante, ich komme!

Der Weg ist das Ziel und somit feiere ich auch meine Profite im Onlinebusiness beim besten Entertainmentclub der Welt.


![telegram-cloud-photo-size-5-6291711632618492600-y.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/schmidi/23t7FdKhKfCXv9PoZDeAhyRfm2chFsta1sEE6G4XB3Q2xdsX8Sp9bs48KdFTZ4gYW61ms.jpg)


> \

– @schmidi

Das gilt auch für HIVE: Ich darf nicht erwarten, dass sich etwas ändert, wenn ich selbst nicht bereit bin, Dinge zu ändern.

In diesem Sinne folgen bald weitere Updates in meinem Blog und Berichte aus Alicante.

**HIVE On!**
@schmidi

---

## English Translation

### From a new laptop via detours to Alicante for the HIVE OPEN DAYS

A little life update before heading to Alicante for the HIVE Open Days.

While traveling to Germany recently for a seminar with Stefan Verra, I accidentally \

my Mac with coffee. After a pit stop in Nuremberg at a Mac partner who could only confirm its total demise, I continued to Schweinfurt to see body language specialist Stefan Verra.



![03EF6D08-B786-4FCD-A6AD-E97C39B9A640_1_201_a.heic](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/schmidi/243M7av4fM42XjcLqs8ehKQQwiRmygwbWva52xMdW1va2jxF1BTfSqVEBHq3gcxFr3jNg.jpg)


Even though I don't always agree 100% with him as a trained coach and trainer myself, I still took away some great insights. Now, I’m sitting in Chiclana de la Frontera, enjoying my second morning coffee.



![7D20151B-4B65-4489-B088-617686C3C86D_1_201_a.heic](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/schmidi/23x1BKSg6FCxNtWSjhwRPQebyH6F5pb1u6wxae4oYuYzngqdsfgwNibDuuivcop29WjYE.jpg)



Morning routine finished (including two laps in the pool), the sun is breaking through, and I’m already getting some work done. Gorgeous, isn't it?! Workspaces like this are an absolute dream for me—especially when your job allows it and you give yourself the freedom to do so.

One of Stefan Verra's statements was: \

While I understand his core message, for me, mindset is the alpha and omega of success.

I’ve also released a video about this on my channel. Click here and watch it from start to finish. I’d love to see a thumbs up and your comment.


https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=MiNb1dz0yWk&t=7s
English untertitel!

Before my flight, I was on tour with \

a Hardstyle DJ act. It was cool, exciting, and wonderful to see how the guys rocked the clubs with their energy and passion. Whether you like the music or not—it’s my job and I love what I do.

Arrived in Jerez, got picked up, and headed straight to Chiclana.

At April 22nd, I spontaneously visited the Feria in Seville and experienced something new. A Feria is similar to a folk festival or \

but much larger. Lots of riders, carriages, and traditional Spanish dress.

![C2CC2CFB-C89D-4DB9-B508-C41942547CE1_1_102_a.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/schmidi/23u657Wtst9cQgY8yypHe8jBMvuhfdQjPrUKiu76QDZdDq63VPxDU28K9Q4j3brPowfoZ.jpeg)

On April 28th, I’ll travel from Chiclana to Seville and then straight to Alicante for the **HIVE OPEN DAYS** by @buzzparty. I’m excited to see what’s in store! One thing is for sure: I’ll be speaking on a few points there, and I’m looking forward to seeing familiar faces and friends like @reiseamateur, as well as meeting people like @tibfox. It’s all about networking and exchanging ideas about HIVE.

On top of that, there’s a cool program lined up at a very fair price. Alicante, here I come!

![9F9EFC15-896B-4A31-B1DF-CB0F431393DC_1_102_a.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/schmidi/23uFS1mSEsXvmkjhswFcxmjabYrHwKt66kQNxuWUpkZaPcovnvTQtBtwveDAmGoT4BgbA.jpeg)

The journey is the reward, and so I’m also celebrating my online business profits at the best entertainment club in the world.


![telegram-cloud-photo-size-5-6291711632618492600-y.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/schmidi/23t7FdKhKfCXv9PoZDeAhyRfm2chFsta1sEE6G4XB3Q2xdsX8Sp9bs48KdFTZ4gYW61ms.jpg)


> \

– @schmidi

The same applies to HIVE: I can't expect things to change if I’m not willing to change things myself.

Stay tuned for more updates on my blog and reports from Alicante.

**HIVE On!**
@schmidi
