body.body:
>In bestimmten Kreisen wird die Erfindung der sogenannten Deckelschere gefeiert, mit der sich feste Deckel leicht entfernen lassen.

Flaschendeckel, die sich vermeintlich nicht von der Flasche trennen lassen, daraus folgend Stimmungsmache bis
>hin zu großen Medienhäusern, die sich nicht zu schade sind, fragwürdigen

>Studien eine Plattform zu geben, die unter dem Mäntelchen der Wissenschaft gegen Tethered-Cap-Regelung trommeln, mit der die EU als erste Staatengemeinschaft weltweit Ernst gemacht hat gegen die Vermüllung der Meere.  

Lose Verschlusskappen, die Flüsse verstopfen und damit dafür sorgen, dass

schwimmt, sind zur Zielscheibe einer ganz bestimmten Kategorie von Zweiflern und Leugnern geworden. Während die eine Minderheit bereit ist, die schlechtere Handhabbarkeit hinzunehmen, weil der höhere Zweck das Mittel rechtfertigt, machen andere gegen die größte EU-Innovation der zurückliegenden 20 Jahre mobil.

> Misstrauen der Kommission

Tethered Caps seien reine Bevormundung, sie seien wirkungslos, sie kündeten vom Misstrauen der Kommission den Bürgerinnen und Bürgern gegenüber. Und, auch dieses Argument wird immer wieder genannt, sie vernachlässigten  die Art, mit der in Westeuropa traditionell mit Getränkeflaschen umgegangen wird. \

, heißt es dann ohne  Belege, werfe einen Flaschendeckel einfach weg, um dann mit einer offenen Flasche herumlaufen zu müssen. Sei eine Flasche dann leer, komme der Deckel in nahezu allen Fällen wieder auf den Verschluss, zumal in Deutschland. Hier sorge ein ererbter Ordnungssinn dafür, dass Flaschen zumeist komplett in der Natur entsorgt würden.

Als die EU-Kommission nach mehr als einem Jahrzehnt intensiver Beratungen zu Wegen, wie sich die Ozeane sauber halten lassen würden, auf die sogenannten \

kam, ahnten die Kommissare nicht, dass sich mit diesem Thema viele Verbraucher gegen eine sehr wohl begründete und wissenschaftlich fundiert vorbereitete Richtlinie in Stellung bringen lassen würden. Doch Populisten entdeckten sofort, wie sie der Unmut kanalisieren lassen würde. \
, zapfen bunter Blätter munter am Volkszorn. Nachrichtenmagazine bringen Ratgebertexte, <a href=\
>wie sich mit Tricks das Trinken aus den Flaschen neu lernen lässt. Und angebliche Demokraten brachten sogar das großzügige deutsche Petitionsrecht in Stellung,
>um eine Neuregelung der Neuregelung zu erwirken.

>EU-Recht  muss respektiert werden

Vergeblich, denn EU-Recht muss Recht bleiben. deshalb ahben sich die Dedckelfeinde inzwischen auf eine nee Strategie verlegt: Im Internet fordern andere auf,
>die fest verbundenen Deckel abzureißen. Als Begründung dient die Behauptung, damit zeige man, dass man sich nicht gängeln lasse. Einer solchen
>Erziehungsmaßahme müsse mit Trotz begegnen, wer sich sein Leben nicht fremdbestimmen lassen wolle.
, heißt es da. Und parallel wird daraus ein beispiel für Staatsversagen konstruiert: \
>Der Vorwurf ist eindeutig. Es gibt Wichtigeres - und um das zu demonstrieren, soll abgerissen werden, was <a href=\
>durch Ingenieurkunst auf Weltniveau formschlüssig mit der Flasche verbunden ist. Dass diese selbst von Frauen und Kindern mit wenig Kraft zu bewältigende Trennung
> gesetzwidrig ist, stört die Deckelrebellen offenbar kaum. Beinahe scheint es sogar, als motiviere sie die bisher kaum vorhandene Gefahr, entdeckt zu werden, noch zusätzlich.
>Doch bei den Behörden schrillen längst die Alarmglocken. Die als

ist als europäisches Recht Gesetz in allen Mitgliedsstaaten. Verstöße können zwar in Ausnahmefällen damit begründet werden, dass der Deckel beim Trinken gestört habe. Doch wo systematisch abgerissen wird, sollen künftig strenge Kontrollen  dafür sorgen, dass Tethered Caps nicht nur Pflicht in der EU sind, sondern auch Teil des Alltags aller ihrer Bürger.
>Svenja Prantl hat für PPQ mit Gernot Rohrmann vom Ordnungsamtaufsichtskontrollamt (OAAK) im sächischen Brand-Erbisdorfgesprochen. Der 39-Jährige hat mit der Ausgründung des OAAK aus dem
>Bundesblogampelamt (BBAA) im mecklenburgischen Warin im Zuge der

>Behördenansiedlungsoffensive die Führung über zentrale Leitstelle der knapp 10.800 Stödte und Gemeinden in Deutschland übernommen. Das OAAK soll in Zeiten hybrider Bedrohungen präsumtive Maßnahmen planen und durchführen, um die Rückkehr zur inneren Ordnung voranzubringen. 

Svenja Prantl: Guten Tag, Herr Rohrmann, willkommen bei uns! Sie leiten das Ordnungsamtaufsichtskontrollamt, kurz OAAK, und sind damit für die Koordination der Ordnungsämter in Deutschland verantwortlich. Seit kurzem stehen die sogenannten Tethered Caps, also fest mit Plastikflaschen verbundene Deckel, im Fokus Ihrer Arbeit. Warum ist das ein Thema für die Ordnungsämter? 

Gernot Rohrmann: Guten Tag, Frau Prantl, danke für die Einladung! Lassen Sie mich erst einmal den Hintergrund erklären. Die Tethered Caps sind Teil der EU-Einwegkunststoffrichtlinie, die seit 2024 vorschreibt, dass Deckel von Einwegplastikflaschen fest mit der Flasche verbunden sein müssen, um Plastikmüll in der Umwelt zu reduzieren. Stellen Sie sich vor: In Deutschland werden jährlich etwa 18 Milliarden Plastikflaschendeckel verwendet, die ein Gewicht von rund 36.000 Tonnen haben – das entspricht etwa dem Gewicht von 200 Passagierflugzeugen. Wenn diese Deckel verloren gehen, landen sie oft in der Natur oder im Meer und schaden der Umwelt. Unsere Aufgabe ist es, sicherzustellen, dass die Regelung eingehalten wird und Verstöße sanktioniert werden. 

PPQ: 36.000 Tonnen, 200 Flugzeuge. Das ist beeindruckend – oder erschreckend. Aber warum geraten gerade die Ordnungsämter hier in den Fokus? Ist das nicht eher ein Thema für Umweltbehörden? 

Rohrmann: Eine berechtigte Frage. Aber Ordnungsämter sind für die Durchsetzung kommunaler und staatlicher Vorgaben im öffentlichen Raum zuständig, und die EU-Richtlinie wurde in nationales Recht überführt. Ähnlich wie bei der Maskenpflicht während der Corona-Pandemie übernehmen wir die Kontrolle der Einhaltung, weil wir die Infrastruktur und die rechtlichen Befugnisse haben, unseren Beritt kennen und die Tricks, mit denen Vorgaben gebrochen werden. Umweltbehörden kümmern sich eher um langfristige Strategien, während wir vor Ort tätig sind, zum Beispiel vor Supermärkten, an Kiosken oder bei Veranstaltungen, wo Plastikflaschen konsumiert werden. 

PPQ: Nun gibt es aber Widerstand gegen diese Regelung. In rechtsnationalen und rechtsextremen Kreisen wird die Deckelpflicht als Symbol für EU-Überregulierung dargestellt. Bestimmte Kreise rufen dazu auf, die Deckel demonstrativ abzureißen. Wie gehen Sie mit solchen Protesten um? 

Rohrmann: Dieser Widerstand ist uns bekannt. Offen gestanden waren Nachrichten über die deckelfeindliche Bwegung der Grund, warum wir gesagt haben, das müssen wir jetzt ernst nehmen und bearbeiten. Das alles ist eine üble Methode Rechtsextremer. Deren Behauptungen und Fake News erinnern doch deutlich an die Aggressionen, die wir während der Corona-Kontrollen erlebt haben. Damals wurden unsere Mitarbeiter beschimpft oder sogar angegriffen, weil sie Maskenpflicht oder Abstandsregeln durchsetzten. Jetzt sehen wir ähnliche Dynamiken: Das Abreißen der Deckel ist ein symbolischer Akt, der oft mit verbalen Angriffen auf die EU oder unsere Arbeit einhergeht. Wir haben daher Schwerpunktkontrollen eingeführt, um gezielt gegen solche Verstöße vorzugehen. Wer öffentlich zum Widerstand aufruft oder Deckel mutwillig zerstört, riskiert Bußgelder von bis zu 500 Euro. In schwerwiegenden Fällen, etwa bei wiederholten Verstößen oder Sachbeschädigung, kann es zu Strafanzeigen kommen. Unser Ziel ist es, die Botschaft klar zu machen: Die Umwelt schützen wir gemeinsam, und niemand steht über dem Gesetz. 

PPQ: 500 Euro sind happig! Wie rechtfertigen Sie solche Strafen, wenn es doch nur um Plastikdeckel geht?

Rohrmann: Es geht nicht nur um Deckel. In einer Hinsicht haben die Deckelkritiker ja völlig recht - der feste deckel ist die feste Burg unserer Wertegemeinschaft. 36.000 Tonnen Plastikdeckel, die jährlich in Europa anfallen, sind ein Teil des globalen Müllproblems, auch wenn man sagen könnte, sie spielen angesichts der Gesamtmenge an Plastikmüll von

>16,16 Millionen Tonnenkeine große Rolle. Aber Studien zeigen, dass Plastikmüll bis zu 450 Jahre braucht, um sich in der Natur zu zersetzen, und Mikroplastik gefährdet Meereslebewesen und letztlich auch uns Menschen. Das geht bei Deckeln auch nicht schneller. Wer also die Deckel abreißt, trägt aktiv zur Umweltverschmutzung bei. Dazu kommt die ideologische Komponente: Viele, die sich gegen die Deckelpflicht wehren, leugnen den Klimawandel oder die Notwendigkeit von Umweltschutz. Das ist eine gefährliche Haltung, die wir nicht tolerieren können. Strenge Strafen sind ein Signal, dass wir solche symbolischen Akte ernst nehmen – genauso wie wir während der Pandemie konsequent gegen Maskenverweigerer vorgegangen sind. 

PPQ: Sie erwähnen die Corona-Zeit. Damals waren Ordnungsämter stark belastet, und Mitarbeiter berichteten von Anfeindungen. Wie schützen Sie Ihre Teams heute bei den Deckel-Kontrollen?

Rohrmann: Die Erfahrungen aus der Pandemie haben uns geprägt. Damals wurden Mitarbeiter beschimpft, bedroht oder sogar körperlich angegriffen, wie Berichte aus verschiedenen Städten zeigen. Für die aktuellen Kontrollen haben wir Maßnahmen ergriffen: Unsere Tethered-Teams sind in Zweier- oder Dreiergruppen unterwegs, um sich gegenseitig zu schützen. Wir bieten regelmäßige Deeskalationstrainings an, und in besonders angespannten Regionen mit vielen Deckelgegnern arbeiten wir eng mit der Polizei zusammen. Außerdem setzen wir auf Öffentlichkeitsarbeit, um die Bürger über die Notwendigkeit der Deckelpflicht aufzuklären. Prävention ist uns genauso wichtig wie Repression. 

PPQ: Sie sprechen von Prävention. Wie versuchen Sie, die Akzeptanz für die Deckelpflicht zu erhöhen, gerade in Kreisen, die sie ablehnen? 

Rohrmann: Akzeptanz schaffen ist eine unserer größten Herausforderungen. Wir setzen darauf, die Ordnungsämter im Land mit Handreichungen auf Dialog zu trainieren, ähnlich wie wir es während der Corona-Zeit gemacht haben. Damals gingen Mitarbeiter in Plettenberg oder Unna in den direkten Austausch mit Bürgern, um Regeln zu erklären. Jetzt organisieren wir Informationskampagnen in Schulen, Supermärkten und auf Social Media, um zu zeigen, warum die Deckelpflicht so sinnvoll ist. Wir erklären, dass die 18 Milliarden Deckel in Europa nicht nur ein Umweltproblem sind, sondern auch ein wirtschaftliches: Die Reinigung von Stränden und Gewässern kostet jährlich Millionen. Gleichzeitig versuchen wir, mit lokalen Vereinen oder Influencern zusammenzuarbeiten, um auch jüngere oder skeptische Zielgruppen zu erreichen und zu erklären - ja, das recycling wird mit festen Deckeln schwieriger. Aber zusammen mit der Industrie schaffen wir das. Gleichzeitig ich gebe zu: In rechtsextremen Kreisen ist der Widerstand ideologisch motiviert, da hilft oft nur die klare Kante des Gesetzes. 

PPQ: Abschließend, Herr Rohrmann: Wie sehen Sie die Zukunft der Ordnungsämter? Werden sie weiterhin solche polarisierenden Themen wie die Deckelpflicht durchsetzen müssen? 

Rohrmann: Ordnungsämter werden immer eine Schnittstelle zwischen Staat und Bürgern sein, und das bringt Konflikte mit sich. Ob es Corona-Maßnahmen, Umweltauflagen oder neue Verkehrsregeln sind – wir sind diejenigen, die vor Ort die Einhaltung sichern. Die Deckelpflicht ist nur ein Beispiel für die großen Herausforderungen, die auf uns zukommen. Merh Regeln, Richtlinien und strengere Auflagen bedingen auch mehr Konrtolle, soll der Staat nicht als Papiertiger dastehen. Mit dem Klimawandel werden Umweltvorgaben kpnftig natürlich automatisch immer strenger, und wir werden vermutlich noch mehr Kontrollen durchführen müssen. Dabei wollen wir aber nicht nur mit Personalaufwuchs zu einer Rückkehr zur regelbasierten Ornung beitragen, sondern auch unsere Rolle als Partner der Bürger stärken, nicht nur als Kontrolleure. Wenn wir es schaffen, die Notwendigkeit von Regeln wie der Deckelpflicht zu vermitteln, können wir gemeinsam etwas für die Zukunft erreichen. Aber eines ist klar: Wer die Umwelt mutwillig schädigt, wird mit uns rechnen müssen.

body.title: How to Apply Curing Compound for Concrete?
body.body:
**Introduction**

Curing is an important step in the process of making concrete, although it may appear to be solid and ready to use immediately after pouring and finishing. True strength will come to the concrete as it cures over time. 

Curing is necessary to achieve strength, durability, and long-term performance from concrete products and applications. One of the best ways to ensure that your concrete cures properly is to use a concrete curing compound.

Concrete curing compounds create a protective layer on top of the concrete after placement rather than relying solely on traditional water curing methods. Curing compounds lock in water within the concrete, allowing for adequate hydration of the concrete.

At the same time, curing compounds simplify the construction processes while providing you with quality results. Sakshi Chem Sciences Pvt. Ltd. carries a variety of high-quality concrete curing compounds designed specifically to improve the quality of your construction.

This article will explain how to properly apply a concrete curing compound and why doing so is crucial for achieving quality construction.

**What is a Curing Compound?**

Curing compounds are liquid chemicals that are applied to newly finished concrete surfaces. When applied, curing compounds will form an extremely thin film that reduces the amount of water that can evaporate from the surface of the concrete. The following are the benefits of curing compounds:

●Retaining water inside the concrete.
●Improving strength development.
●Reducing surface cracking.
●Increasing durability.

Curing compounds are especially useful when it is hot, dry, or windy due to the high rate of liquid evaporation.

**When Should You Apply Curing Compound?**

Timing plays a crucial role in effective curing.
The concrete curing compound should be applied:

●Immediately after finishing operations
●Once surface water (bleed water) has evaporated
●When the surface is firm enough to avoid damage

Applying too early can dilute the compound, while applying too late can reduce its effectiveness.

**Step-by-Step Process to Apply Concrete Curing Compound**

**1. Prepare the Surface**

Ensure that the concrete surface is ready for application by completing the following checks:

●Properly finished
●Free of excess water
●Clean and uniform

Do not spray directly onto standing water, as it will not allow for proper bonding of the compound to the Concrete

**2. Choose the Right Equipment**

For example:

●Low-pressure spray guns
●Hand sprayers for small areas
●Mechanical sprayers for larger surfaces

When sprayed, the compound can be evenly distributed over the surface, providing a consistent covering of the compound.

**3. Apply Uniformly**

In order for curing to be effective, the curing compound must be applied evenly over the entire surface.
The curing compound is uniformly sprayed over the surface of the concrete.

Consistent pressure must be kept while spraying to avoid over-applying or under-applying the compound.
A continuous layer of curing compound must be formed over the entire area of the concrete.

**4. Apply in Two Directions**

The curing compound should be applied in 2 directions for the best overall coverage.

●1st pass - horizontal direction
●2nd - vertical

By applying the compound in this manner, every area of concrete will be coated.

**5. Allow the Compound to Dry**

After application:

●Let the compound dry naturally
●Do not disturb the surface
●Keep dust and debris off the drying surface

After the compound has dried, it will form a protective membrane that contains moisture.

**Important Tips For The Best Results**

Maximize The Effectiveness Of Your Concrete Curing Compound By Considering The Following:

●Apply immediately after finishing work;
●Do not apply during high winds.
●Follow the manufacturer's recommendations for covering ranges.
●If the film is damaged, reapply.
●Use high-quality products to maintain consistency in performance.
●Small mistakes can likewise have a large effect on the strength and durability of your concrete.

**Common Mistakes to Avoid**

Improper technique can lead to several curing problems and should be avoided for the following reasons:

●Spraying too early or too late
●Applying too much material results in an uneven application
●Using a low-quality curing compound
●Being unaware of the effects of conditions such as wind or high temperature on the compound's evaporation rate.

If done, all of these can cause surface crack formation, problems with the strength and durability of the finished concrete.

**Conclusion**

Managing concrete's curing is an extremely important part of constructing solid and long-lasting concrete, and a [concrete curing compound](https://sakshichemsciences.com/concrete-curing-compound/)simplifies and enhances this process. The proper techniques for the proper use of a concrete curing compound and drying can have a significant effect in improving the performance and length of life of the cured concrete. Because what you will see in construction tomorrow depends on the care you have taken today, and therefore, with products from Sakshi Chem Sciences Pvt. Ltd., you will know that you are using only quality and dependable solutions to ensure you meet the required levels of strength and durability for every construction project you are involved in.

body.title: Motherhood: A Journey for All of Us, Different but Beautiful
body.body:
I’ve always had a bit of a complicated relationship with my cousin. I like her, but her attitude sometimes makes it hard to feel close. Growing up, her dad had more money than mine, and it seemed like she always thought everything would come easy for her. Meanwhile, the rest of us were just trying to get by. It kind of created this quiet distance between us, even though I never wanted that.


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmVKr3Qej1oCgK7xv2prPD7LrKbFA8L77Z1rLjwoLjKJic/1777016250472.png)


[Pixabay](https://pixabay.com/illustrations/child-sleep-to-dream-bedroom-dark-7717305/)

So when I saw on social media that she had just had a baby, I decided to put all the differences aside. I called her, congratulated her, and welcomed her into the world of motherhood. That is what you do, right? Offer support, be a good cousin. I even thought about going to visit her and help in whatever way I could. But when I offered, she turned me down. I respected her decision, of course, and kept my distance.
Fast forward three weeks later, I went to visit my uncle, and there she was. She had gone back to her mom’s house because, apparently, motherhood wasn’t exactly how she imagined it. After a warm hello to my aunt who happened to be her mom and uncle her father, she and her mom started sharing what happened during her labor, and I couldn’t believe what I was hearing.


She went into labor and gave birth at 9 AM, but things didn’t go smoothly. The placenta wouldn’t come out, and they tried everything to get it out, but nothing worked. It wasn’t until just before 5 PM that they finally got things under control. They were even preparing her for surgery when, suddenly, everything worked out. It was close, but thankfully, no surgery was needed.


Then, as we were talking, she turned to me and said, \
I was caught off guard for a second. I just smiled and said, \

And that’s the truth. Motherhood is sweet, but it’s not always smooth sailing. Everyone’s journey is different. My story is not her story, and her story is not someone else’s. We all have our fair share of struggles. But at the end of the day, it’s about the baby, the little one you get to hold in your arms, who makes everything worth it.

Sure, some of us seem to have an easier time of it than others, but that doesn’t make anyone’s experience any less valid. It’s easy to look at someone else’s life and think they have it all together, but the reality is we are all just trying to figure it out as we go. And the thing that unites us all, that really matters, is the love we have for our kids and the joy they bring into our lives.

So, yeah, my cousin and I might not always get each other. But I hope she realizes that the struggles of motherhood are something we all go through, in our own way. It’s a journey that teaches us so much, and even though it’s not always easy, it’s always worth it in the end.








**Thanks for checking on my blog and have a wonderful day**

![Untitled design.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/rookie2001/23tvYJPTvinyFAe1FfLQvtd8xoTMnN2CcEZA6rcDJe653ooQYSZN1Lkcghu2YcdUqHHvN.png)


Hello Everyone! Hope you all are doing amazing and welcome to another #Splinterlands post.

Today was one of those days where I decided to actually invest a bit more into #Splinterlands. Not just playing casually but like properly trying stuff. First thing I did when I logged in was purchase 2000 credits. I was thinking about it for a while and finally just went for it. I feel like if I want to progress faster, I cannot always just depend on small rewards here and there.


![purchased 2k credits.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/rookie2001/EnyoS2vGzHisDzYr9ce1W2MXQERDNozoqB5KdXKnumYR2vQQ2DQEX6ws5KYogS7FGnc.png)

After getting the credits, I went ahead and bought the Fortune Pass so I can enter the weekly fortune draw. Maybe I get something good, maybe not but at least I’m in the game now.


![weekly fortune draw.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/rookie2001/23tbEtALvsjgVpPwRa374ioZDrEqfPyVqwAJDZK42HKrrURF5BqukWhpcZFBSCeYKQdeU.png)

Then I also used 2000 glint points to purchase the Ranked Fortune Entry. This one actually made me think a bit before buying. Like should I save glint or use it here? But in the end I decided to buy it. Sometimes you gotta try things instead of just playing safe all the time.

![ranked fortune entry.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/rookie2001/23t76oPDaAcEGmYEkK2ZmF7zdWjgms29cAH5GLwoWsT8X5hb2iCwXPHPpEm2RQwZUtrfD.png)

![purchase successful ranked fortune entry.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/rookie2001/23tbP7Qe6X519uk1wBujD3Nq8MBcaVKrEzDrbqBzDVWSAAPuKYReQx1R162oFJUdRsXkq.png)

After purchasing the Ranked Fortune Entry, I played some Modern Ranked Battles. Won the first few, but then I came across a battle which was really tough. I did lose at the end but it was a really intense one.


![battle start.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/rookie2001/23swpgRnhgLkfBvcrRMJ4DbbnAhntguDYEVf42wLSCbu3NGpfC6AefUV1a9APCtT6AKtN.png)

The rulesets were quite simple. The mana cap was at 93 and you could only use Fire, Earth and Dragon element cards. I had good Earth element cards so I played them. I was pretty confident at the beginning because my team looked really strong.


![battle round 3.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/rookie2001/23t7BZbf7EUDFq4tRYzLpUHALHT1xWwDR4verHVCDQrWn52SumyRFQc2XkY7NT53AzaEL.png)

It was at the start of round 3 when I started to get a bit nervous because my frontliner/tank died. I also managed to kill my opponent's frontliner but still his team looked really strong.

![battle round 4.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/rookie2001/23tGZrKtTk3Lnh1a3qDX8AXEnZsmaWhXXV9ypwXPUHfe72S4LKKHpULKt3PMn55onnKvQ.png)

At round 4, the match got really intense. We both had 4 cards remaining.


![battle round 5.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/rookie2001/23tGY59GBABPEkiJjxkRiNHkF8bzJpgDW3tTURmXT1bDm46pQcWFAAdF9MGnVDK3khUWb.png)

It was at round 5 when I realized that I lost the battle because two of my opponent's cards had massive health. They were literally unkillable.


![defeat screen.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/rookie2001/EowEB6LDWkdaJJr5eE7RifE7n9Fs6DTmiF4qka4de8K6bkzcnP6gaHQPSaJkFiumdQm.png)

Not gonna lie, that loss hit a bit harder than usual. But it happens. You cannot win every battle. Even though yesterday and previous days were good, today reminded me that the game can humble you real quick 😅.

# 𝐂𝐎𝐍𝐂𝐋𝐔𝐒𝐈𝐎𝐍

Honestly, I do not regret anything I did today. I got more credits, Entered the Fortune system, Used my glint points for something meaningful and Faced a strong opponent (which is good for learning). Also now I’m kinda excited about the weekly fortune draw.
Overall today was a mix of excitement + disappointment. Which is honestly what makes this game fun.

If you win all the time… it gets boring.
If you lose all the time… it gets frustrating.

But days like this where you try something new, take risks and learn from a tough loss, those are actually important.

Anyway, that was my day in #Splinterlands. Please do give your reviews in the comments section below. I would really appreciate it :)

I'll be back with another one soon. So do follow me if you want to stay updated. Till then, Stay Happy and Stay Hydrated.

In this blog, we will look at what goes into building prop trading platforms that traders actually return to every day, and why design, behaviour, and real usage patterns matter more than it seems at first glance.  
**What is Prop Trading Platform Development?**  
[Prop trading platform development](https://www.hashcodex.com/prop-firm-solutions) means creating digital systems that allow firms to manage and monitor traders using company capital. These platforms support trading activities, track performance, and handle rules set by proprietary trading firms.  
The goal is to give traders a structured environment where they can trade efficiently while firms maintain full control. This type of development is important for firms that want to run funded trader programs.  
A well-built platform helps manage users, track results, and maintain consistency in trading operations across different markets.  
**Common Mistakes in Prop Trading Platform Development**  
Building a prop trading platform needs careful planning and a clear understanding of trader needs. Many firms focus only on basic features and miss important areas, which later affects user experience and daily trading activities. Here are the common mistakes:  
Poor user interface and navigation  
Lack of proper risk management features  
Ignoring real-time data accuracy  
Weak performance tracking systems  
Limited customization options for firms  
Not supporting multiple asset classes  
Inadequate testing before launch  
A good platform should avoid these issues by focusing on usability, accuracy, and flexibility. Fixing these early helps firms run better trading programs and keeps traders active and consistent.  
**How to Build Prop Trading Platforms Traders Don’t Quit Using**  
Building a prop trading platform that traders continue using requires more than basic features. It needs a clear focus on user behaviour, simple design, and consistent system performance so traders feel comfortable and stay active over time. Key Points to Follow:  
Keep the interface clean and easy to use  
Provide accurate and fast market data  
Include clear risk management controls  
Offer detailed performance tracking tools  
Allow flexible account and rule settings  
Support multiple trading assets and markets  
Focus on stable system performance  
Test the platform properly before release  
A strong platform keeps traders engaged by focusing on clarity, speed, and reliability. When firms build with user needs in mind, they create systems that traders trust and continue using daily.  
**Why Hashcodex Is the Best for Building Prop Trading Software**  
Hashcodex stands out in prop trading software development by focusing on practical business needs. Their approach helps firms build platforms that support daily trading, user management, and clear performance tracking.  
They provide systems that balance usability and functionality, making it easier for firms to manage traders and monitor activities. The platform structure supports smooth operations without adding unnecessary complexity for end users.  
Another advantage is their understanding of funded trading models and firm requirements. This helps in creating platforms that align with evaluation processes, account rules, and reporting needs across different trading environments.  
With a focus on consistency and long-term usability, Hashcodex builds platforms that traders continue using. Their solutions support firm growth while maintaining a stable and user-friendly trading experience.  
**Conclusion**  
Choosing the right development partner is key to building a reliable prop trading platform. A well-planned system should support daily trading needs, offer clear performance tracking, and adapt to firm requirements over time. By focusing on usability, accuracy, and long-term consistency, businesses can create platforms that keep traders engaged and active.  
This approach not only improves user retention but also helps firms manage operations better and build a strong presence in the trading market.

Looking ahead, the future of online connections will likely be shaped by innovation and user demand. body.title: The Best AI Image Tools for 2026, Compared and Evaluated
body.body:
AI Image Tools have become one of the most talked about categories in the creative technology space this year. What started as a small experimental trend a few years ago has now turned into a full industry, with new models launching almost every month. From social media creators and bloggers to ecommerce sellers and Web3 content platforms, these tools are being used to produce visuals faster and at a much lower cost than traditional design work.

In 2026, AI image generation has reached a point where the output often looks close to real photography or professional illustration. The models have improved in realism, text rendering, and style control, which has made them useful for marketing, product visuals, storytelling, and educational content. This article compares the leading [AI image tools](https://www.vhiz.ai/categories/ai-image-tools/) available today, explains how they differ, and helps readers understand which type of tool fits which type of work.

## What Are AI Image Tools and How Do They Work?

AI image tools are software platforms that create images from written prompts, reference pictures, or a combination of both. They rely on deep learning models trained on millions of images and text pairs. When a user enters a description, the system converts that text into a mathematical representation and then generates an image that matches the meaning of the prompt.

The core technology behind most modern AI image generation tools is called diffusion. The process begins with random visual noise, and the model gradually refines it step by step until a clear image forms. This is why modern tools can produce detailed portraits, landscapes, product shots, and illustrations from a single line of text.

Some platforms also support image to image editing, inpainting, outpainting, and upscaling, which expands their use beyond basic generation.

![Best AI Image Tools.png](https://waivio.nyc3.digitaloceanspaces.com/1f6fe362919cac84933f64bc2cca5a8fcb6752a9d42d3d45bf363a8ca53946ca)

## Why AI Image Tools Matter in 2026

Visual content drives most of the engagement online. According to reports from [HubSpot and content marketing studies](https://www.hubspot.com/marketing-statistics), posts that include strong visuals perform significantly better in reach, clicks, and retention. AI image tools have made it possible for small teams and individual creators to produce professional looking visuals without hiring a designer or photographer.

Some of the main reasons these tools have grown in popularity include:

*   Faster content production for blogs, ads, and social media

*   Lower cost compared to stock photography and custom design work

*   Access to unlimited style variations through simple prompts

*   Useful for ecommerce product visuals and marketing campaigns

*   Helpful for storytelling platforms, Web3 creators, and review based sites

*   Easier experimentation for concept art, branding, and design mockups

This wide range of use cases explains why both free AI image tools and premium platforms continue to grow in demand.

## Quick Overview of the Best AI Image Tools

Below is a simple list view of the top AI image generation tools covered in this article, along with their main strengths.

*   **Midjourney:** Known for artistic quality and strong visual style. Widely used by designers and illustrators.

*   **Google Gemini (Nano Banana 2):** Offers high realism and strong text rendering. Available in free and paid tiers.

*   **OpenAI GPT Image (DALL E based):** Excellent for readable text inside images and conversational editing.

*   **Adobe Firefly:** Built for commercial use and integrated with Photoshop, Illustrator, and Express.

*   **Ideogram:** Focused on typography and branding visuals with clean text output.

*   **Leonardo AI:** Popular for game assets, character design, and stylized art.

*   **Freepik AI Suite:** Combines multiple models in one platform for designers.

Each of these tools serves a slightly different purpose, which is explained in more detail in the following sections.

## The Best AI Image Tools in 2026 Reviewed

### 1. Midjourney

![Midjourney.webp](https://waivio.nyc3.digitaloceanspaces.com/f53dc090b6eeea98fa7dd05dd05c7104146dba74067f6ad9dc418ce638e0407f)

Midjourney remains one of the most recognized names in AI image generation. It is known for producing artistic, cinematic, and visually rich images. The platform is widely used by illustrators, concept artists, and content creators who want images with a strong creative style rather than plain realism.

It works through a web interface and also inside Discord. Midjourney supports detailed prompt controls, style references, and variations, which gives users flexibility when building consistent visuals.

**Best For:** Artistic projects, concept art, and stylized marketing visuals.

### 2. Google Gemini with Nano Banana 2

![Google Gemini.png](https://waivio.nyc3.digitaloceanspaces.com/13202438af01da0dc1b0a9bea0fcea9be38a95739f0a1abe5faf00afd5c7fad1)

Google Gemini uses the Nano Banana 2 model, which has become one of the strongest options in 2026 for realism and text rendering. According to multiple independent comparisons, including tests published by Zapier and EXPERTE.com, Nano Banana 2 handles complex prompts with high accuracy and produces clean results even in the free tier.

It is especially useful for users who want predictable quality without managing a credit based system, since Gemini uses daily limits instead.

**Best For:** Realistic photography style images, quick social media visuals, and general everyday use.

### 3. OpenAI GPT Image

![OpenAI GPT Image.png](https://waivio.nyc3.digitaloceanspaces.com/ed6416a30d69407db575c83394f29ce40d4d545e3c6909cf6f76a865282e1154)

GPT Image, available through ChatGPT, is often preferred when images need clear and readable text. It also allows conversational editing, meaning users can adjust the image by simply describing the change they want.

This tool is useful for posters, marketing creatives, quote graphics, and other visuals where accurate text matters.

**Best For:** Text heavy graphics, social posts, and conversational image editing.

### 4. Adobe Firefly

![Adobe Firefly.png](https://waivio.nyc3.digitaloceanspaces.com/3e70d66939d99d338017d04ff57ae8e4067fa2d8bbf15f83f5c18e2290c8db5b)

Adobe Firefly is built with commercial use in mind. It is tightly integrated with Photoshop, Illustrator, and Adobe Express, which makes it a natural choice for marketing teams and brands that already work inside the Adobe ecosystem.

Firefly focuses on features such as generative fill, background replacement, text effects, and image generation. Adobe also emphasizes licensed training data, which matters for brand safety and commercial licensing.

**Best For:** Professional marketing teams and brands working in Adobe software.

### 5. Ideogram

![Ideogram.png](https://waivio.nyc3.digitaloceanspaces.com/336eec4c251e8c2f652bb5720df2389bf35dce01dd1c7c4c8b46431d24129462)

Ideogram is a specialized AI image tool that stands out for its typography accuracy. Many AI models struggle with text inside images, but Ideogram consistently delivers readable text, including brand names, taglines, and poster layouts.

It offers a freemium plan and is commonly used for branding mockups, logos, and marketing creatives where text clarity is critical.

**Best For:** Branding, typography focused visuals, and marketing posters.

### 6. Leonardo AI

![Leonardo AI.png](https://waivio.nyc3.digitaloceanspaces.com/2edae8dba426f0d90823c7a69566dc0734d63bf22d9b508958de6b0c443d2652)

Leonardo AI is popular among game designers, illustrators, and character artists. It supports custom model training, reference images, and style locking, which helps users maintain consistency across a series of visuals.

It is often used for game assets, story illustrations, and stylized character design. The platform offers both free and paid plans.

**Best For:** Game art, character design, and consistent series based visuals.

### 7. Freepik AI Suite

![Freepik AI Suite.png](https://waivio.nyc3.digitaloceanspaces.com/d47d97ff4284823c956c654c395821b8a445fd575854041ffe3388676e4c7bb6)

Freepik has expanded from a stock asset library into a full AI creative platform. It now provides access to multiple AI image generation models inside one dashboard, including Nano Banana, Flux, and several others. Users can also upscale, edit, and generate variations of their images on the same platform.

This makes it practical for designers and content creators who want to test different models without managing separate subscriptions.

**Best For:** Designers who want access to multiple AI image generator tools in one place.

## How AI Image Tools Are Used on Content Platforms

AI image tools are not just used for standalone projects. They are also becoming part of everyday workflows on blogging, review, and Web3 platforms. For example, decentralized review and content platforms benefit from AI generated visuals because contributors can illustrate reviews, product comparisons, and travel guides without relying on paid stock images.

Similar use cases are seen across ecommerce blogs, educational sites, and social platforms where consistent visual output is needed at scale.

## What to Look for When Choosing an AI Image Tool

Different tools serve different needs, and the right choice depends on the type of work being produced. A few important factors to consider include:

*   **Image style:** Photorealism, illustration, anime, or branding focused visuals.

*   **Text rendering:** Important for posters, ads, and typography heavy work.

*   **Editing features:** Inpainting, outpainting, background removal, and upscaling.

*   **Pricing model:** Subscription, credit based, or free open source options.

*   **Commercial rights:** Not every free AI image tool allows commercial use.

*   **Ease of use:** Some tools are beginner friendly, while others need prompt experience.

*   **Platform integration:** Works with Photoshop, Figma, Canva, or custom APIs.

Checking these points before picking a tool helps avoid wasted time and budget.

## Common Mistakes to Avoid When Using AI Image Tools

Even the best AI image generator will produce weak results if it is not used carefully. A few common mistakes include:

*   Writing vague prompts that lack style, subject, or mood details

*   Expecting accurate hands and complex text without a specialized model

*   Ignoring licensing terms before using images commercially

*   Using only one model for every type of image instead of matching the tool to the task

*   Overediting AI output until the image loses its natural feel

Understanding these points helps users get cleaner, more usable results from AI image generation tools.

## Frequently Asked Questions

### What is the best free AI image generator in 2026?

Google Gemini with Nano Banana 2 is widely considered the strongest free option because it offers high quality output, good text rendering, and daily free limits. Bing Image Creator and Leonardo AI also provide solid free AI image generator tools with generous usage.

### Can AI generated images be used commercially?

Most paid plans from tools like Midjourney, Adobe Firefly, and GPT Image include commercial rights. Free tiers often have restrictions, and platforms like Recraft may retain image rights on free plans. Checking the current licensing terms of each tool before commercial use is always recommended.

### Which AI image tool is best for text inside images?

Ideogram and OpenAI GPT Image are the two strongest choices for readable text inside images. Google Gemini with Nano Banana 2 has also improved significantly in this area and handles short labels and captions well.

## Conclusion

AI image generation has moved from a niche experiment to a core part of how content is created online. The best AI Image Tools in 2026 offer realistic photography, stylized art, accurate typography, and flexible editing features, all available through simple prompts. Each tool reviewed in this guide has its own strengths, and the right choice depends on whether the focus is realism, branding, illustration, or open source control.

As content ecosystems continue to rely more on visual storytelling, AI image tools will keep playing an important role in how creators, businesses, and everyday users produce high quality visuals. Exploring a few of these tools based on the needs described above is the simplest way to find the one that fits a specific workflow.

body.title: What it takes to make dreams come true
body.body:
https://img.leopedia.io/DQmcFDMH1KPpytG2VE2WLEjzr3vrTY2gqYgxNGzaeHtUh8S/IMG_2912.jpeg 


Discipline is a funny thing. It can feel so hard or so easy. 

What does it all come down to?  

Why would building a daily habit be so hard?  

Speaking from years of experience of trying to figure this out, it’s all a matter of faith:  not neccesarily religious faith but belief in yourself, in the world, in cause and effect, and in meaning and purpose. 

For far too long, I thought I couldn’t do a damn thing right. Nothing seemed to work as it should and so I assumed putting in the work wouldn’t matter in the end. 

Now I realize that I was putting my energy into all the wrong things, things that weren’t meant for me, and forcing what didn’t need to be forced. 

I didn’t need to be everything that I thougt I wanted to be, only to pursue that route and enjoy the unfolding of a path I couldn’t have imagined. 

I didn’t need to worry about not being able to reach a goal. I needed to learn how to have fun doing the things I said I loved, or to find something else I could love more. 

I knew which direction I wanted to go, but it’s impossible to enjoy when you set the stakes so high. 

Set the stakes low. Follow the fun. If you want something at the top of the mountain but you don’t feel energy to climb the mountain, look for ways to make the climb feel more fun. And focus less on the final outcome and more on the tiny wins. 

The first time I realized that work didn’t have to feel like work and discipline didn’t need to feel like discipline was when I started self studying Japanese.  I got through a first year textbook in two months just cause I was fascinated by the idea of communicating through little drawing like characters. 

Then I got through the second year textbook in another 2 months. Then I reviewed for two months and entered a third year university class, after just 6 months of study. 

I was a little surprised. I didn’t understand why it was taking so long for everuone else to reach the same level of proficiency. 

This is where everyone tells me how good I must be at languages as if to make excuses for themselves but I am the same person who studied Spanish for 6 years and can’t make a sentence. I know it’s more about attitude and where your effort is placed more than anything. 

I know it’s about refining the fuel source rather than using more fuel. 

The main difference between me and them was that I wasn’t worried aboit a test and I couldn’t wait to learn more kanji. 

Last summer I went through a similar period of self study and started drilling hard on guitar.  I went from not being able to jam to having 3 shows that were 50% jamming. All I did was drill scales for 30 minutes a day, sometimes twice a day, for about a month. Then I practiced jamming every day for the same amount of time. 

Easy. 

Without the excitement it would have been hard as hell. It probably wouldnhave required 5-10 times the commitment. 

Without the belief that I could improve it would have been uphill from start to finish. 

Without the focus on practical steps, the results would have been far less impressive. 

But when everything on my end was put into place, the rest fell into place. 

Now it’s one year later and I am ready to start recording my first studio album after releasing my first live album. 

I know I need to focus on my songs but I’ve given myself 3 months to finish recording, which is more than enough so I want to get back to drilling guitar on the side. 

Two songs a month. 
+
30 minutes of drills every day. 

I can do that. I just need a plan and to excute it. 

As for the drills:

Week 1 : review my scales from last year and get my speed up to where it was

Week 2 : practice boring finger exercises at faster and faster speeds 

Week 3 : mix finger exercises into scales to increase my finger speed when moving between different note combinations 

Week 4 : Same. 

Week 5-8: focus on triads


Easy. 

It’s easy because I want it bad enough and I know it will work. 

Then as for my songs I’ll make a checklist for this month. Two songs a month and these songs are basically finished, with some parts recorded already. 

Checklist: 

1 Fix the lyrics at the end of song 1
2 memorize lyrics to song 1 
3 re-record vocals to song 1
4 backup vocals on song 1
5 bass for song 1
6 bass for song 2 
7 backup vocals for song 2
8 djembe for song 2
And if possible
9 get a headstart on songs 3-4

It’s starting to feel like a lot but if I can hit points #1 and 2 in one shot this week, I think 3-4 will take little to no time. Then I will spend 2 weeks on bass. Maybe I can tie the bass lines into my drills to kill two birds with one stone.  

In any case I’ll give myself 5 weeks for these because May is almost here and I have a lot going on in May. 

### You can hear three of the songs I’m working on as well as some of the jams from my live shows on all streaming platforms by searching “Resonance Experiments 1-2” or [click here](https://linktr.ee/ipluseverything) for the Spotify Apple and Youtube links 

Trailer for live album!:

A live album APPEARS!

https://youtu.be/mfEfye1duEQ

body.title: Hướng dẫn cách tra cứu bảo hiểm xe ô tô đơn giản, nhanh chóng
body.body:
Việc [tra cứu bảo hiểm](<https://geely.vn/tin-tuc/tra-cuu-bao-hiem-xe-o-to/https://geely.vn/tin-tuc/tra-cuu-bao-hiem-xe-o-to/  >) giúp bạn biết xe còn hạn hay không, tránh bị phạt khi lưu thông và chủ động khi có sự cố. Dưới đây là các cách nhanh – dễ – ai cũng làm được.



1.  Tra cứu bảo hiểm trách nhiệm dân sự (bắt buộc)

🔹 Cách 1: Tra cứu online qua hệ thống chính thức

👉 Truy cập hệ thống của

Cục Quản lý, Giám sát Bảo hiểm

👉 Thực hiện:

Nhập biển số xe

Nhập số giấy chứng nhận bảo hiểm (nếu có)

Nhấn tra cứu

➡️ Kết quả:

Thời hạn bảo hiểm

Công ty bảo hiểm

Tình trạng hiệu lực

🔹 Cách 2: Tra cứu qua website công ty bảo hiểm

👉 Nếu biết đơn vị bảo hiểm, bạn có thể tra cứu trực tiếp:

Bảo Việt

PVI Insurance

PTI

👉 Chỉ cần:

Nhập biển số hoặc số hợp đồng

1.  Tra cứu qua app điện thoại

👉 Nhiều hãng có app riêng:

MyBVLife

PVI Care

👉 Chức năng:

Xem thời hạn bảo hiểm

Xem quyền lợi

Yêu cầu bồi thường

1.  Tra cứu bằng giấy chứng nhận bảo hiểm

👉 Cách nhanh nhất:

Xem trực tiếp trên giấy bảo hiểm

📌 Thông tin cần chú ý:

Ngày bắt đầu – hết hạn

Biển số xe

Số hợp đồng

1.  Gọi tổng đài bảo hiểm

👉 Nếu không tra được online:

Gọi hotline của hãng bảo hiểm

Cung cấp biển số xe

➡️ Nhân viên hỗ trợ tra cứu

1.  Khi nào cần tra cứu bảo hiểm?

👉 Nên kiểm tra khi:

Mua xe cũ

Sắp đi đăng kiểm

Trước khi đi xa

Không nhớ hạn bảo hiểm

1.  Lưu ý quan trọng

✔️ Bảo hiểm TNDS là bắt buộc

✔️ Hết hạn vẫn chạy xe → bị phạt

💰 Mức phạt:

Khoảng 400.000 – 600.000 đồng

1.  Mẹo tránh quên hạn bảo hiểm

✔️ Lưu ảnh giấy bảo hiểm trong điện thoại

✔️ Đặt lịch nhắc trước 1–2 tuần

✔️ Dùng app để theo dõi

1.  Tóm tắt nhanh

👉 Tra cứu bảo hiểm xe:

Website cơ quan quản lý

Website/app hãng bảo hiểm

Giấy chứng nhận

➡️ Chỉ mất 1–2 phút

Kết luận

👉 Tra cứu bảo hiểm ô tô rất đơn giản:

Chỉ cần biển số hoặc số hợp đồng

➡️ Kiểm tra thường xuyên giúp:

Tránh bị phạt và đảm bảo quyền lợi khi có sự cố 🚗

body.title: Tại sao không nên mua xe ngập nước dù giá rẻ hơn rất nhiều?
body.body:
Xe ngập nước (xe “thủy kích”) thường được bán lại với giá rất hấp dẫn, có khi rẻ hơn 20–50% so với xe bình thường. Nhưng thực tế, đây là một trong những loại xe rủi ro nhất trên thị trường xe cũ.

Chi tiết thông tin: [https://geely.vn/tin-tuc/tai-sao-khong-nen-mua-xe-ngap-nuoc](https://geely.vn/tin-tuc/tai-sao-khong-nen-mua-xe-ngap-nuoc/) 

1.  Nguy cơ hỏng động cơ cực cao

👉 Khi xe bị ngập nước:

Nước có thể lọt vào buồng đốt

Gây hiện tượng thủy kích

➡️ Hậu quả:

Cong tay biên

Vỡ động cơ

Hỏng hoàn toàn máy

💰 Chi phí sửa:

Có thể lên tới hàng chục – hàng trăm triệu đồng

1.  Hệ thống điện dễ “chết” bất kỳ lúc nào

👉 Ô tô hiện đại phụ thuộc rất nhiều vào điện:

ECU (hộp điều khiển)

Cảm biến

Hệ thống dây điện

➡️ Khi bị nước xâm nhập:

Chập điện

Lỗi vặt liên tục

Khó sửa triệt để

📌 Đây là lỗi nguy hiểm và dai dẳng nhất

1.  Nội thất xuống cấp nhanh chóng

👉 Dù đã vệ sinh:

Mùi ẩm mốc vẫn còn

Da ghế, nỉ dễ hỏng

Sàn xe có thể mục

➡️ Ảnh hưởng trải nghiệm và sức khỏe

1.  Gỉ sét khung gầm

👉 Nước (đặc biệt nước bẩn):

Gây oxy hóa kim loại

Làm mục khung, gầm

➡️ Về lâu dài:

Giảm độ an toàn

Xe nhanh xuống cấp

1.  Chi phí sửa chữa “không đáy”

👉 Xe ngập nước thường:

Hỏng chỗ này → kéo theo chỗ khác

Sửa xong vẫn lỗi

➡️ Tổng chi phí có thể:

Vượt cả tiền mua xe

1.  Khó bán lại

👉 Người mua xe cũ rất “dị ứng” xe ngập nước:

Giá bán lại thấp

Khó tìm người mua

➡️ Mất giá nặng

1.  Nguy cơ mất an toàn khi lái

👉 Các lỗi tiềm ẩn:

Hệ thống phanh

Túi khí

Điện tử

➡️ Có thể gây nguy hiểm khi vận hành

1.  Vì sao xe ngập nước vẫn rẻ?

👉 Vì:

Rủi ro cao

Khó sửa triệt để

Giá trị thực thấp

➡️ “Rẻ trước – đắt sau”

1.  Khi nào có thể cân nhắc mua?

👉 Chỉ nên nếu:

Bạn có kinh nghiệm về xe

Mua để sửa bán lại

Giá cực kỳ thấp

➡️ Không phù hợp người dùng phổ thông

1.  Mẹo nhận biết xe ngập nước

👉 Một số dấu hiệu:

Mùi ẩm mốc trong xe

Ốc vít bị gỉ

Thảm sàn có dấu hiệu tháo lắp

Đèn, đồng hồ bị mờ


---

1.  Mức phạt chi tiết với ô tô

🔹 Vượt từ 5 – dưới 10 km/h

💰 800.000 – 1.000.000 đồng

👉 Không bị trừ điểm GPLX

🔹 Vượt từ 10 – 20 km/h

💰 4 – 6 triệu đồng

👉 Trừ 2 điểm GPLX

🔹 Vượt từ 20 – 35 km/h

💰 6 – 8 triệu đồng

👉 Trừ 4 điểm GPLX

🔹 Vượt trên 35 km/h

💰 12 – 14 triệu đồng

👉 Trừ 6 điểm GPLX

1.  Trường hợp nặng (gây tai nạn)

👉 Nếu chạy quá tốc độ gây tai nạn:

💰 20 – 22 triệu đồng

👉 Trừ tới 10 điểm GPLX

1.  Tóm tắt nhanh

Mức vượt tốc  Mức phạt  Trừ điểm

5 – <10 km/h  800k – 1 triệu  0

10 – 20 km/h  4 – 6 triệu  2

20 – 35 km/h  6 – 8 triệu  4

> 35 km/h  12 – 14 triệu  6

Gây tai nạn  20 – 22 triệu  10

1.  Lưu ý quan trọng

✔️ Có thể bị phạt nguội qua camera

✔️ Bị trừ điểm GPLX (hết điểm phải thi lại)

✔️ Không chỉ cao tốc, trong đô thị cũng bị kiểm tra rất gắt

1.  Mẹo tránh bị phạt

✔️ Luôn chú ý biển giới hạn tốc độ

✔️ Giảm tốc khi vào khu dân cư

✔️ Không “chạy theo xe khác”

✔️ Dùng cruise control (nếu có)

Kết luận

👉 Lỗi quá tốc độ:

Nhẹ: dưới 1 triệu

Nặng: lên tới 14 triệu, thậm chí 22 triệu nếu gây tai nạn

➡️ Nguyên tắc quan trọng:

Đi đúng tốc độ = an toàn + không mất tiền oan 🚗

body.title: Hướng dẫn hồ sơ, thủ tục cấp lại bằng lái xe bị mất
body.body:
[Mất giấy phép lái xe](<https://geely.vn/tin-tuc/mat-bang-lai-xe/https://geely.vn/tin-tuc/mat-bang-lai-xe/  >) (GPLX) là tình huống khá phổ biến. Tin tốt là bạn không cần thi lại ngay nếu đáp ứng đủ điều kiện. Dưới đây là hướng dẫn chi tiết, dễ làm.

1.  Mất bằng lái có được cấp lại không?

👉 CÓ, nếu:

GPLX còn thời hạn hoặc quá hạn không quá lâu

Không bị tước bằng

Thông tin còn lưu trên hệ thống

1.  Hồ sơ cần chuẩn bị

👉 Bao gồm:

CCCD/CMND (bản gốc)

Giấy khám sức khỏe (đối với một số hạng bằng)

Đơn đề nghị cấp lại GPLX

Ảnh chân dung (thường chụp trực tiếp tại nơi làm thủ tục)

1.  Thủ tục cấp lại bằng lái xe

🔹 Cách 1: Làm trực tiếp

👉 Thực hiện tại:

Sở Giao thông Vận tải

Hoặc trung tâm cấp đổi GPLX

👉 Các bước:

Nộp hồ sơ

Chụp ảnh tại chỗ

Nộp lệ phí

Nhận giấy hẹn

🔹 Cách 2: Làm online

👉 Qua:

Cổng Dịch vụ công Quốc gia

👉 Các bước:

Đăng nhập

Chọn dịch vụ “Cấp lại GPLX”

Điền thông tin

Đặt lịch hẹn

➡️ Sau đó vẫn cần đến chụp ảnh & nhận bằng

1.  Thời gian cấp lại

👉 Thông thường:

⏱️ 7 – 10 ngày làm việc

➡️ Có thể lâu hơn nếu cần xác minh

1.  Lệ phí cấp lại

👉 Theo quy định:

💰 Khoảng 135.000 đồng/lần

1.  Trường hợp phải thi lại

👉 Bạn sẽ phải thi lại nếu:

GPLX quá hạn:

3 tháng → thi lại lý thuyết

1 năm → thi lại cả lý thuyết + thực hành

1.  Lưu ý quan trọng

✔️ Nên khai báo mất sớm

✔️ Kiểm tra có bị giữ bằng không (do vi phạm)

✔️ Không cần hồ sơ gốc

1.  Mẹo tránh mất bằng

✔️ Lưu ảnh GPLX trong điện thoại

✔️ Dùng ví nhỏ riêng

✔️ Đăng ký GPLX tích hợp điện tử (nếu có)

1.  Tóm tắt nhanh

👉 Mất bằng lái:

Chuẩn bị CCCD + hồ sơ

Nộp tại Sở GTVT hoặc online

Chờ 7–10 ngày

Kết luận

👉 Cấp lại bằng lái xe rất đơn giản:

Không cần thi lại nếu còn hạn

Chi phí thấp, thủ tục nhanh

➡️ Quan trọng:

Làm sớm để tránh gián đoạn khi lái xe 🚗

body.title: Dấu hiệu, cách xử lý & lưu ý khi chìa khóa ô tô hết pin
body.body:
Chìa khóa thông minh (smart key) rất tiện, nhưng khi hết pin có thể khiến bạn không mở được xe hoặc không nổ máy. Dưới đây là cách nhận biết [chìa khóa ô tô hết pin](<https://geely.vn/tin-tuc/chia-khoa-o-to-het-pin/https://geely.vn/tin-tuc/chia-khoa-o-to-het-pin/  >) và xử lý nhanh gọn.

![chia-khoa-o-to-het-pin.jpg](https://waivio.nyc3.digitaloceanspaces.com/bb15d717c1159ac2b35aa46c54a6786174229eee38c4c7c1b2f9031948aef617)



1.  Dấu hiệu chìa khóa ô tô sắp hết pin

👉 Bạn sẽ thấy:

🔋 Bấm khóa/mở xe không nhạy, phải bấm nhiều lần

🚗 Phạm vi điều khiển ngắn hơn bình thường

⚠️ Xe hiện cảnh báo “Key battery low” (nếu có màn hình)

❌ Không nhận chìa khi bấm nút Start/Stop

➡️ Đây là dấu hiệu pin yếu, nên thay sớm

1.  Cách xử lý khi chìa khóa hết pin (khẩn cấp)

🔹 Cách 1: Dùng chìa cơ

👉 Hầu hết smart key đều có:

Chìa cơ bên trong

👉 Cách dùng:

Rút chìa cơ ra

Mở cửa xe bằng ổ khóa cơ

🔹 Cách 2: Đề nổ bằng chìa thông minh

👉 Khi pin yếu/hết:

Đưa chìa lại gần nút Start/Stop

Hoặc chạm trực tiếp vào nút

➡️ Xe vẫn có thể nhận tín hiệu và khởi động

🔹 Cách 3: Thay pin chìa khóa

👉 Loại pin phổ biến:

Pin cúc áo (CR2032, CR2025…)

👉 Cách thay:

Mở vỏ chìa (có rãnh nhỏ)

Lấy pin cũ ra

Lắp pin mới đúng chiều (+/-)

Đóng lại

⏱️ Thời gian: 2–5 phút

1.  Bao lâu nên thay pin chìa khóa?

👉 Thông thường:

1 – 2 năm/lần

📌 Tùy vào:

Tần suất sử dụng

Loại chìa

1.  Lưu ý quan trọng

❌ Không để chìa gần điện thoại, sóng mạnh

❌ Không để nơi ẩm ướt

✔️ Dùng pin chính hãng, chất lượng tốt

✔️ Thay cả 2 chìa nếu có

1.  Những lỗi dễ nhầm

👉 Không phải lúc nào cũng do pin:

Lỗi cảm biến xe

Hỏng chìa

Nhiễu sóng

➡️ Nếu thay pin không được → nên kiểm tra tại gara

1.  Mẹo tránh bị động

✔️ Luôn có chìa dự phòng

✔️ Mang theo pin dự phòng

✔️ Thay pin ngay khi có dấu hiệu yếu

1.  Tóm tắt nhanh

👉 Chìa khóa hết pin:

Dấu hiệu: bấm không ăn, xe không nhận

Xử lý: dùng chìa cơ → đề gần nút → thay pin

Kết luận

👉 Chìa khóa hết pin là lỗi nhỏ nhưng rất phiền:

➡️ Chỉ cần:

Nhận biết sớm + thay pin đúng lúc

👉 Là bạn sẽ không bị “kẹt xe giữa đường” 🚗

Impression-counting technology estimates audience size across each segment of the route using traffic-density models calibrated for Miami conditions. Dynamic QR codes on the LED display are generated per campaign, and scan volume, location and time are tracked so the client sees how many viewers moved from outdoor exposure to a digital landing step. body.title: It's not that hard... Dailyprompt 24 April 2026 [Eng-Spa]
body.body:
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmWqE75F3EHEgGaYgHd7MZa4s4zrPxFxw4BHGo6SJhsy2j/1777014071928.jpg)

[Source](https://pixabay.com/es/illustrations/transformaci%C3%B3n-emoji-misterio-857734/)

It's not that hard as people think to put yourself in someone else’s shoes. I believe it is simply a matter of cultivating a quality called empathy, which consists of learning to place ourselves in the position of another person. Personally, I really like the colloquial way in which this idea is often expressed through that literary image, “to put yourself in the shoes of the other.” There is a biblical phrase that warns us not to judge so that we will not be judged. Of course, I agree with it, but I must confess that I worry less about the possibility of being judged than about something that, in my scale of values, would be worse: the possibility of being unjust in my judgment of another person, of failing to evaluate their circumstances and then being far too severe in my judgments or criticisms.  

I think it's not that hard to try to understand the attitude of our neighbor, which does not mean, obviously, that we always agree with them. But I repeat: it's not that hard to try to understand, and I believe that from that understanding arises the possibility of respectful dialogue, where we contribute to one another. We always have much to learn when we do not barricade ourselves behind a rigid posture or criterion, for there is always something to learn and everyone has something to teach us.  

From empathy is where friendship, harmony, and the possibility of growing as human beings can best emerge, and where we can humbly help others to grow as well.  

***

I am always grateful for the initiatives of the #freewriters community on Hive to train our capacity for improvisation in literary creation and reflection, especially to @mariannewest.

***

Versión en Español

No es tan difícil como se cree ponerse en los zapatos de la otra persona. Pienso que es sólo cuestión de cultivar una cualidad llamada empatía que consiste en aprender a colocarnos en el lugar de la otra persona. En lo particular me gusta mucho la manera coloquial en que se suele decir a través de una imagen literaria esta idea, \

. Hay una frase bíblica que previene de no juzgar para no ser juzgado, por supuesto que estoy de acuerdo con ella, pero debo confesar que a mí me preocupa menos la posibilidad de ser juzgado que algo que en mi escala de valores sería peor, y esto es la posibilidad de ser injusto en mi juicio de otra persona, no evaluar sus circunstancias y entonces ser demasiado demasiado severo en mis juicios o en mis críticas.  

Yo pienso que no es tan difícil tratar de comprender la actitud de nuestro prójimo, lo que no significa, obviamente que siempre estamos de acuerdo con este. Pero, reitero no es tan difícil tratar de comprender y creo que de esa comprensión nace la posibilidad de un diálogo respetuoso, donde nos aportamos mutuamente, siempre tenemos mucho que aprender cuando no nos parapetamos en una postura o criterio, siempre hay algo que aprender y todos tienen algo que enseñarnos.  

Desde la empatía es desde donde mejor puede surgir la amistad, la concordia y la posibilidad de crecer como seres humanos y humildemente ayudar a las otras personas también a crecer.

***

body.title: Moving Forward: Kind Words, Open Minds, and Second Chances
body.body:
If there is one thing humans are bound to do, it is making mistakes because right from time, we've never been perfect and we can only keep striving to be perfect. And one thing I have learnt directly from my life and those closest to me, life has phases where the mistakes differ from another. Today, we could have so much figured out and the next, we are struggling with what to do with something another have it so easy to figure out. I believe perspectives, experiences and even the environment one lives in influences beliefs and opinions so it's definitely going to clash others. But what we can not excuse totally is one intentionally saying terrible things by mouth for whatever reason they might have. Even the Bible was so clear on being mindful of what you say because your words are powerful to destroy or make you, so it's not strange when that happens. The sad thing is, we know words have consequences but somehow, we can't put a control over our mouth when we say some things. We should understand that even though our opinions may differ, saying or sharing them with others shouldn't be done by terrible words. ![IMG_20260424_075627.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/merit.ahama/242Nx94N3pmuzcVny1YyBPfsFCnNJBjYWfgB5B1mTicpqDtTeHMqVKUYEdkcmszhd67QH.png) We can all air our views from our opinions and keep in mind that every other person has their own backgrounds, environments that has influenced their own opinions. If we understand this, we would have less trouble dealing with someone who have said terrible things to others. The Bible has stated clearly that how you use your words would have consequences, whether good or bad. But as humans, we are made to understand that there is a virtue called forgiveness especially when the person has shown remorse for their past mistakes or beliefs. I believe we would miss out on a great discoveries, talents or transformations if every person who have said terrible things in the past are not forgiven. I mean, it's in the past already and so long the person doesn't hold such opinion again, another chance could be given to such. I know it's a hard to forget the past but who we are today is what matters more than who we were yesterday, and tomorrow nobody knows. If more people will be more positive with their opinions, and more people be more forgiven for the ones said terribly, we would appreciate today. I mean, past thoughts are past thoughts for a reason. Why let all that spoil the greatness of today and make such person continue living in dispair of what they know they really messed up. Let bygones be bygones, there's more to explore.

</liketuimages>

我给自己定了一个小小的纪律，就是玩3D打印尽量做到每周能上传完成一个作品。

有时候吧，就是苦恼脑袋里没有想法，不知道做什么。做3D模型，毕竟还是一个需要不断脑海里有想法的事，然后在通过3D打印把想法实现。

最近，在无意中就发现，娃小时候玩的一个玩具。一个星星棒，透明的，立面还有块磁铁。可能当时是锻炼小朋友了解磁吸现场的，这样的一个棒子端头有个星星的造型。突然也是让我眼前一亮。为何不把星星萝卜塔加一个棒呢。

萝卜塔有很解压的玩法，并且发出的声音也是很解压。

就很想，那个拍拍棒，星星萝卜塔加上手持棒，可以上下抖动，发生拍掌活跃气氛的声音。把A跟B结合下，就可以产生C。这就是无意中的创意吧。

类似活跃气氛的东西，后来也了解到也叫应援棒。家里正好有一些粉色丝绸的耗材，打印出来可能是不是有小小女生会喜欢。

趁着这次，也研究了下如何做双色模型打印，在没有AMS的，有限资源的情况下。竟然成功了，打印了一个蓝色+橘黄色的组合。

做完这个，然后拍产品照，美图秀秀一下，最后上传模型数据和实物照片....

一个新的模型发布完成，也是轻松了一些，这周的目标又达成了！

---

body.body:
![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/39511cb0-9cab-4c64-a022-3194389e1fe8.jpg) Having a dog means walking every single day whether I want to or not. Luckily today was one of those days when it wasn't too hot, not too cold, and the flowers are out. Make's for a better walking experience. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/d0e4c9a1-f4d0-4576-aab4-f3238a4c3797.jpg) Living right next to a large park is also useful. It means that I have a nice place to walk the dog in the morning where he has lots of things to sniff. Sure it makes for a very slow walk but I think it is more interesting for the dog. Unfortunately I had to work today. Yeah, I know I'm trying to retire. But.... Two days a month isn't bad. *Mostly*. The bigger issue is that while I'm working I keep thinking to myself... Should I really be here. Is the pay really worth it? Is it time to just pull the cord and stop. I would think about that further but... I have to of my co workers going on vacation in the near future so I really shouldn't quit until they at least get a chance to take their vacation :) Anyways, after work it was time for yet another walk with the dog. My wife decided to tag along also. I will admit that I was really tired from my day. Still some fresh air and extra steps aren't a bad thing after a long days work. After that? Just time to have some dinner (nothing exciting) and watch some TV with my wife (nothing too exciting there either.). Still I managed a respectable 13K or so steps. I'm happy with that. Tomorrow? Probably time to get a different gym membeship closer to home so that I'm more motivated to do the work. But I'll see what happens. And that's it for today. Thanks for dropping by ::)

body.title: Called it – As I expected.  Epsom alleged attack story appears to be a nothingburger.
body.body:
![epsom_map_extent_000001.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mrfahrenheit211/23wghGSvxYjPfSZaBHmA4RNj7MdZvPZq7FQgZNmrH53b5DR26LnQHf1DyhHbkYs8kDkwk.jpg)
Picture shows:  A map of the Epsom area.


Like many others I initially gave credence to the story of the alleged gang rape in Epsom.  After all it’s not as if sexual attacks by migrants is unusual these days in Britain and gang rape is sadly one of those crimes that have often quite rightly been associated with this group.

But as time went on I began to wonder.  When the police came out with a statement intended to placate an increasingly restless public that contained a very unusual form of words I started to doubt the veracity of all or some of the initial story.  I’ve seen lots of police media statements in my time and I know that police forces often have to use careful wordcraft in order to not put themselves in future legal jeopardy or prejudice any trial that they are investigating.  This is why the police’s phrase in their statement that the have not found any evidence for the crime ‘as reported’ caught my eye.  It’s not a usual sort of statement, it’s one that they use when they can’t find evidence for a complaint but they are keeping the case open.

On April 19th I published an article about the progress of the case and considered reasons why it might be difficult for the police to obtain corroborating evidence for the complaint such as CCTV being unavailable or time consuming to view.  This article also posed the possibility that this complaint might be completely baseless.  I said:

“It could also be the case that the complainant has been less than honest with the police with regarding the claim and this is why no corroborating evidence for the attack has yet been found. Whilst said to be rare, these cases do happen. It’s silly to believe that all claims made to the police, not just about this case but about anything, are founded on a bedrock of solid truth. Not all men, women or even children for that matter tell the unvarnished truth when they make a complaint. A false complaint about anything, not just a crime such as that which has been alleged to have occurred in Epsom, could be made for a whole gamut of reasons. These reasons could range from a person voluntarily putting themselves in a situation that they later regretted, trying to hide questionable behaviour from a partner or a family, or being a person whether that be an adult or a child, who for reasons of mental illness or to gain an advantage or revenge against someone or just by being generally dishonest and self serving in character, is willing to be untrue even if the cost to others who may be innocent might be high.”

Well it seems that I may well have been correct. It appears that there has been no gang rape.  What appears to have happened is a young woman sustained some sort of accidental head injury which lead to the confused and untrue report of a sexual offence.

GB News said:

“Surrey Police will close an investigation into reports of a rape outside a church in Epsom that led to widespread public disorder.
A spokesman for the force confirmed that \

“

These things happen.  Someone falls over, possibly inebriated then wakes up confused and mixes false memories up with reality.  Whether this was an honest mistake by the complainant or whether the false complaint was made maliciously might be a future matter for the courts.

This case and the police’s initial, understandable, cageyness with the public was a major factor in the whipping up of a mob made up of both locals and outsiders that demonstrated quite vigorously outside of the police station and at various places where the mob believed that Dinghy Invaders were being housed, including I believe accommodation for vulnerable adults.

Yet again I have been proven correct when I’ve often said that ‘King Mob’ makes for a terrible and unjust leader.  I think that the various influencers who helped to stir up this mob need to take a long hard look at themselves and their part in all this.

But it’s not just the Mob that are at fault here.  There might not have been a mob had the police not lost so much public trust by their poor handling of cases similar to this.  It’s difficult to trust police when there’s been so many cases where the police have failed the public for example in Rotherham, Rochdale, Telford and many other places. It’s difficult to trust police forces when there have been so many examples of ‘two tier’ policing ranging from the regular examples of that which we see with the ‘Palestine’ hate marches that are treated with kid gloves, through to police attempts to silence those who bring to light examples of migrant related crime.  The police only have themselves to blame for the public not believing them when they say something.

This case has turned out to be a nothingburger but that doesn’t mean other similar cases are also false, the problem is without a trial it’s impossible to know which ones are true allegations and which ones are not.  We do have a migrant crime problem and in particular a migrant sex crime problem but the case in Epsom was not one of them.

If this case teaches us anything it’s that the atmosphere among the public at the moment is febrile approaching boiling point. The anger about migrant crime and the growing distrust of police is now so high that anything, including a false or mistaken report of a crime can kick things off.  This should worry us all as this is not a good position for a nation to be in.

https://www.gbnews.com/news/epsom-surrey-police-closes-investigation-reports-rape-outside-epsom-church-as-no-sexual-offence-occurred


Original piece on this case questioning the length of time of the investigation by me

# Learn AI Series (#46) - CNNs in Practice - Classic to Modern Architectures

### Solutions to Episode #45 Exercises

**Exercise 1:** Implement a multi-channel 2D convolution from scratch in NumPy.

```python
import numpy as np
import torch
import torch.nn as nn

def conv2d_multichannel(x, filters):
    \

c_out, c_in, kh, kw = filters.shape
    _, h, w = x.shape
    out_h = h - kh + 1
    out_w = w - kw + 1
    output = np.zeros((c_out, out_h, out_w))

    for f in range(c_out):
        for i in range(out_h):
            for j in range(out_w):
                patch = x[:, i:i+kh, j:j+kw]  # (C_in, kH, kW)
                output[f, i, j] = np.sum(patch * filters[f])
    return output

# Test: 3-channel input, 8 filters of 3x3
np.random.seed(42)
x = np.random.randn(3, 16, 16).astype(np.float32)
filters = np.random.randn(8, 3, 3, 3).astype(np.float32)

our_output = conv2d_multichannel(x, filters)
print(f\

)  # (8, 14, 14)

# Compare with PyTorch
conv = nn.Conv2d(3, 8, kernel_size=3, bias=False)
conv.weight.data = torch.from_numpy(filters)
x_torch = torch.from_numpy(x).unsqueeze(0)  # add batch dim
pt_output = conv(x_torch).detach().numpy()[0]

)
# Should be ~1e-6 (floating point precision)
```

The key insight: each output filter sums across ALL input channels. A single 3x3 filter applied to an RGB image actually has 3 x 3 x 3 = 27 weights (not 9), because it processes all three color channels simultaneously.

### On to today's episode

Last episode we built everything from the ground up -- hand-coded convolutions, stride, padding, pooling, receptive fields, the works. You now understand *exactly* what happens when a filter slides across an image. That knowledge puts you in a strong position, because most people using CNNs in practice have no idea what's actually going on under the hood.

Now it's time to see what decades of research produced when these ideas were scaled up. We'll trace the evolution from LeNet (1998) through ResNet (2015), build and train a real classifier on actual image data (CIFAR-10, not synthetic), and then learn the single most important practical technique in modern deep learning: **transfer learning** with pretrained models. Here we go!

## The architecture timeline

The history of CNN architectures reads like a series of \

moments, each one making networks dramatically more powerful. Understanding this progression matters because the ideas in these architectures (depth, skip connections, efficient scaling) show up everywhere in modern AI -- including in architectures we'll encounter later in this series.

**LeNet-5 (1998)**: Yann LeCun's handwritten digit recognizer. Two conv layers, two pooling layers, three fully connected layers. 60,000 parameters total. It worked beautifully for MNIST but was too small for real-world images. Still, this was the architecture that proved CNNs could learn visual features automatically from data -- a radical idea at a time when computer vision was dominated by hand-crafted feature engineering.

**AlexNet (2012)**: Alex Krizhevsky's ImageNet winner, and the paper that kicked off the deep learning revolution. Eight layers, 60 million parameters, trained on two GTX 580 GPUs (splitting the network across both GPUs was an engineering hack born from memory constraints -- each GPU only had 3GB). AlexNet didn't invent anything fundamentally new -- it applied LeNet's ideas with ReLU activations (in stead of sigmoid), dropout regularization (episode #40), and data augmentation at a scale enabled by GPUs. It won the ImageNet challenge by 10+ percentage points, absolutely shocking the computer vision community.

Here's what's wild: before AlexNet, the best ImageNet classifiers used carefully hand-engineered features like SIFT and HOG combined with SVMs (episode #20). AlexNet showed that a neural network learning its own features could obliterate years of manual feature engineering. Within two years, virtually every top ImageNet entry was a deep neural network.

**VGG (2014)**: Oxford's Visual Geometry Group made a deceptively simple observation. In stead of using a mix of filter sizes, they used ONLY 3x3 filters and just stacked more layers (16-19 layers deep). Two 3x3 convolutions have the same receptive field as one 5x5, but with fewer parameters and an extra nonlinearity between them. VGG's lesson: **depth with simple building blocks beats shallow complexity**. 138 million parameters -- large but effective.

```python
import torch
import torch.nn as nn

# VGG's key insight: two 3x3 convs = one 5x5 conv's receptive field
# but with fewer parameters and an extra ReLU

# Two 3x3 convs: 2 * (3*3*C*C) = 18*C^2 parameters
# One 5x5 conv:  5*5*C*C = 25*C^2 parameters
# Plus: the two 3x3 version has an extra nonlinearity!

C = 64  # channels
two_3x3 = 2 * (3 * 3 * C * C)
one_5x5 = 5 * 5 * C * C
print(f\

)
```

**GoogLeNet/Inception (2014)**: introduced **inception modules** -- parallel convolutions with different kernel sizes (1x1, 3x3, 5x5) concatenated together. The network learns which scale of feature is most informative at each spatial position. The real trick was **1x1 convolutions** acting as channel-wise dimensionality reduction, dramatically cutting parameter count. 6.8 million parameters -- 20x smaller than VGG with comparable accuracy. Clever engineering over brute force ;-)

**ResNet (2015)**: the **skip connection** revolution. Kaiming He and colleagues (the same He who gave us the weight initialization we discussed in episode #40) showed that adding the input of a block to its output allows training networks with 152 layers -- and beyond. Without skip connections, networks deeper than roughly 20 layers perform *worse* than shallower ones. Not because of overfitting, but because the optimization itself fails -- gradients either vanish or explode through all those multiplications (we diagnosed this exact problem in episode #40). The skip connection provides a **gradient highway** where the derivative always includes a term of 1, ensuring gradient signal reaches the earliest layers.

```python
# The difference skip connections make
# Without: x -> f(x) -- gradient must flow through f
# With:    x -> f(x) + x -- gradient always has a path through the +x

# This is why adding ONE line of code (+ x) to the forward pass
# changed deep learning forever
class ResidualBlock(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, channels):
        super().__init__()
        self.block = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(channels, channels, 3, padding=1),
            nn.BatchNorm2d(channels),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Conv2d(channels, channels, 3, padding=1),
            nn.BatchNorm2d(channels))

    def forward(self, x):
        return torch.relu(self.block(x) + x)  # THE magic line

# Stack them deep -- this works because of skip connections
blocks = nn.Sequential(*[ResidualBlock(64) for _ in range(20)])
x = torch.randn(1, 64, 32, 32)
out = blocks(x)
