title.body: >\nHello everyone! This is the 2208th compilation post of OCD's latest curation efforts. It has been known that OCD has been supporting leading niche communities under its <b><a href=\
>Community Incubation Program. However, there are still a lot of other niche communities not supported by OCD. This curation initiative will help in supporting those communities.

> This newest curation effort aims to encourage authors to post in appropriate communities even if those communities are not under the incubation program. This will also encourage users to explore more into the different communities in Hive.

How this Works

> OCD curators and community leaders will find posts from other niche communities and recommend them for an upvote. Unlike those communities in the incubation program where curation is focused, this curation initiative is spread out. This will help find undervalued posts from smaller communities that deserve support.

> This will highlight both the author and the community where the post is located. This way, smaller niche communities can focus on growing their subscribers and increasing the engagements within their respective communities. A small boost goes a long way.

title.title: Philippine spinach flower
title.body: > Today was a little different than usual. This morning I managed to capture a beautiful flower in full bloom amidst the lush green foliage that seemed to never tire of embracing the earth. It was the Philippine spinach, or Talinum fruticosum in Latin. I found this plant growing among other shrubs, not in a luxurious garden, let alone receiving any attention and care from us humans. But that's precisely where this flower's specialness lies, it exists amidst the dense greenery, simply and naturally.

> The flower's petals are purplish pink, adorned with bright yellow stamens. The color is very sweet and calming. A perfect color to brighten up the morning. Judging by its shape and color, I believe this plant would be just as beautiful as other ornamental plants in general. Unfortunately, to date, I've never encountered anyone cultivating this plant as an ornamental.

> After blooming, this flower only lasts a short time. When the sun starts to shine hot, the flower immediately wilts, lasting only half a day. Perhaps that's why people aren't interested in cultivating it.

> Hearing your daughter crying and always insisting to watch TV in the neighborhood made my husband more practical to do it himself to repair the TV..Our television got damaged when water slowly leaked and travelled at the back portion of the TV..that's caused so much damaged to the motherboard and other parts,it became moist and totally it didn't function anymore. >

And finally when my husband finished all doing the trouble shooting he sadly said he can't fixed it😭😭😭the motherboard need to be replaced and changed with a new..all the parts the need to be replaced maybe costs 3-5k..So we're deeply saddened for hearing that it cannot be fixed now..and maybe soon when we can buy some parts of it then hopefully it can be fixed..

title.body:
>
Greetings, fellow warriors of @Splinterlands!

I started my adventure for the day on Thursday afternoon, but the power went out, and I had to wait almost six hours for it to be restored. As soon as the lights came back on, I was ready to continue, since I only needed to win three more matches to get my reward.


It's so much fun when you start to understand the game mechanics and win. Of course, strategy doesn't always work in every situation, and sometimes it's just a matter of luck, but knowing how to choose your deck of cards and which combination to use to achieve victory is key. Here are some of my achievements.


![Captura de pantalla 2026-04-22 161803.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/arribaeltelon/23tbPi8ZGRMf5wYfZpmU6Vc7XpEZwXmea47ojSHp6mqo6MXo8zBPut1ZGWJ48LqvEP6xf.png)

I'm happy because I feel like I'm really learning; stumbling and suffering some setbacks, but climbing back up. Right now, I'm in Frontier Bronze II; I was stuck in III for a long time, but I'm finally understanding the game and progressing step by step.


![Captura de pantalla 2026-04-24 004151.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/arribaeltelon/23vrpoxZUv89WC7NGuajFkWhNYv8w3ov7PvQsJcWkNjAYKjTtrJsFBLiq567Ys6tEVfCD.png)

I log in every day to study the cards and improve my plays, even in Frontier mode. I think I'll make my investment soon and buy the Spellbook, now with the certainty that my win rate will be much higher.

Thanks for reading and following my progress in @Splinterlands. I hope to see you soon in the arena and have a great time!

title.title: Celebrating the International  Day of Book & Literature at Work.! 📚 || Poem Recital
title.body:
>

*Gusto en saludarlos queridos hivers, espero se encuentren muy bien, en mi caso dando inicio al 3er lapso en el liceo donde trabajo, en marco de la celebración del día Internacional del libro y del idioma, se realizo en mi trabajo una actividad muy hermosa con nuestros estudiantes, donde tuvieron la oportunidad de demostrar sus dotes poéticas en un recital de poesía que estuvo bastante nutrido y entretenido; además contamos con la participación de varios invitados especiales que dieron charlas en relación a esta fecha tan importante, resaltando el valor de la lectura más que todo en los jóvenes y la coordinadora de Lengua, que presento a los suyos.* *Poemas como Dreams, the road not taken, Azul, Open a Book, entre otros fueron recitados con mucho sentimiento que lograron trasmitir al público el mensaje presente en esa prosa creativa, destacando la coordinadora de cultura con una dramatización del poema Píntame Angelitos negros de forma extraordinaria. Adicionalmente se expuso una mesa con poemarios y cuentos de nuestros estudiantes, siendo en su mayoría inéditos. Y el discernimiento de fragmentos de la novela Don Quijote de la Mancha; cerrando con un juego didáctico donde dos equipos respondían interrogantes de acuerdo a la categoría que le saliera después de lanzar el dado.* *Como educadora y profesional me siento muy complacida como se desarrolló la actividad, cerrando la misma con la entrega de detalles a los chicos participantes. Y ustedes amigos? Como pasaron el día del libro y del Idioma?, hasta una nueva oportunidad.* ****

>

***It’s a pleasure to greet you, dear Hivers. I hope you’re all doing well. As for me, I’m kicking off the third term at the high school where I work. As part of the celebration of International Book and Language Day, we held a wonderful event at my school with our students, where they had the opportunity to showcase their poetic talents at a poetry recital that was well-attended and entertaining; We also had several special guests who gave talks related to this important date, highlighting the value of reading—especially among young people—and the Language Coordinator, who introduced her students.*** ***Poems such as “Dreams,” “The Road Not Taken,” “Azul,” and “Open a Book,” among others, were recited with great feeling, successfully conveying to the audience the message contained in that creative prose. The culture coordinator stood out with an extraordinary dramatization of the poem “Píntame Angelitos Negros.” Additionally, a table was set up displaying poetry collections and short stories by our students, most of which were unpublished. There was also a reading of excerpts from the novel Don Quixote de la Mancha, concluding with an educational game where two teams answered questions based on the category that came up after rolling the dice.*** ***As an educator and professional, I am very pleased with how the event unfolded, concluding with the presentation of small gifts to the participating students. And you, friends? How did you spend World Book Day? Until next time.*** ***

title.title: More Than Justo a Remake - What's New in AC Black Flag 🏴‍☠️ Resynced  [ENG/SPA]
title.body:
Assassin's Creed fans were finally heard—the Black Flag remake is officially happening, and it’s titled Assassin's Creed Black Flag Resynced. The world premiere trailer just dropped today on their official YouTube channel during a live showcase, where they also broke down all the upgrades compared to the original 2013 release.
![1000356851.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/danielcarrerag/23xAPJsSfprA1XWXA3ft3zG39n7ka2unQbGhLqTg3RoVs1yKTXG9V8hz8KU7PHm7XLAVo.gif)
Out of the entire series, this one is my absolute favorite. I played it years ago on PS3, and it’s definitely one of those games that leaves a lasting impression. I’ve been following the updates closely on social media so I wouldn’t miss a single detail regarding how faithful it stays to the original, what’s been added, and what’s been overhauled. Here’s what stood out to me the most: >#### Más que un simple Remake - Lo nuevo en AC Black Flag Resynced >Finalmente fuimos escuchados los fanáticos de la saga Asassin's Creed, el remake del Black Flag ya es un hecho y se llamará Assassin's Creed Black Flag Resynced. Hoy a traves de su cuenta oficial de YouTube, fue el estreno mundial de tráiler, en medio de un Showcase en vivo donde además se señalaron cuáles son las mejoras con respecto al primero juego salido en 2013. >De todos los juegos de la saga este es mi favorito, lo jugué hace muchos años en PS3 y sin duda fue uno de esos juegos que dejan huella. Estuve haciendo seguimiento en las redes para no perderme este showcase, y así conocer a detalle que tal fiel será con relación al juego original, y que cosas se agregaron y cuales se mejoraron. De todo lo que se presentó, esto es lo que más llamo mi atención: *** - First and foremost: it won't be an RPG 👏🏻👏🏻👏🏻. This fills me with excitement because it’ll be the classic action-adventure style, focusing on the story, combat, and world exploration instead of the stat-based progression mechanics adopted in Odyssey and Valhalla. >- Los primero y más importante: no será un RPG 👏🏻👏🏻👏🏻. Esto me llena de emoción porque sera el típico juego de acción y aventura, enfocándose en la historia, el combate y la exploración del mundo en lugar de mecánicas de progresión estadística que se adoptaron en el Odyssey y el Vahalla.
![1000356857.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/danielcarrerag/242hPoM9Z4RYvE3gKwSnUQCQ41ba6UDANaWvy6j7uFF1XzRFfkCA2CzuMVvKVPuNSLyH9.jpg)
- Thanks to today's technology, the graphics ✨ were rebuilt from the ground up and look spectacular 🤌🏻. They used the same engine as Shadows, with lighting and effects really standing out. It’ll feature a smooth 60 FPS for consoles and scaling for PC. >- Gracias a la tecnología actual, sus gráficos ✨ fueron mejorados desde cero y se ven espectacular🤌🏻. Se uso el mismo motor grafico que en el Shadows, resaltan la iluminación y efectos. Tendrá fluidez de 60 FPS para consolas y escalado para PC.
![1000356856.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/danielcarrerag/2449unxWbnFmHKBia2k5n2GrJCcRBs8VmpMwg5oVFRPjBbp587qtSshgy5UijpYhYUwUT.jpg)
- The combat system was redesigned, based on parries ⚔️, making it faster and featuring those signature executions I love so much 🤩. Now Edward (the main character) can crouch whenever we want 🙌🏻👏🏻, which really improves stealth. You can also dive wherever and whenever you want, we have Eagle Vision 🦅, and there’s more flexibility in missions; before, they were canceled if you were detected 👀, but now the world reacts and you have to adapt. >- Se rediseño el sistema de combate, basado en parries ⚔️, más rápido y con las típicas ejecuciones que tanto me gustan 🤩. Ahora Edward (el personaje del juego) puede agacharse cuando queramos 🙌🏻👏🏻 esto mejora el sigilo. También se puede bucear dónde y cuando queramos, tenemos visión de aguila 🦅 y flexibilidad en las misiones, antes se cancelaban si eras detectado 👀, ahora sí pasa el mundo reacciona y debes adaptarte.
![1000356853.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/danielcarrerag/23t7D8HzETKbEFb7fQJMiw4BnwGHTCkkdcTYLNEjM9ynHjT1Er9BrwNuM26vnieVvhEMD.jpg)
- Navigation ⛵ and the pirate life ☠️ were the main draw of the first game for me, and they’ve been upgraded in this one. The Jackdaw (the ship) will have new weapons 💣 and new officers, each with their own story arc and new missions that offer ship upgrades upon completion. >- La navegación ⛵ y vida pirata ☠️ para mí fueron el gran atractivo del primer juego, en este han sido mejoradas. El Jackdaw (el barco) tendrá nuevas armas 💣 y nuevos oficiales, cada uno con su arco histórico y nuevas misiones que al completar ofrecerán mejoras a la embarcación.
![1000356858.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/danielcarrerag/23wMYCjvT2hTyBhNYKiMh5g7TQ3BwSiTbymg6DQSG5UWyo5paUfmXg9LL7wrdTqmsmstT.jpg)
- Something that didn't just thrill me, but the entire fandom, was the sea shanties 🎶 while sailing. This new game includes 10 brand-new ones 🤩. I can already see myself just sailing for hours until I learn the new ones 💯; I hope they create a playlist on Spotify. >- Algo que no solo me encantó a mi, también a todo el fandom, fueron las solomas 🎶 mientras navegabas. En este nuevo juego se incluyeron 10 nuevas 🤩. Ya me veo solo navegando por horas hasta aprenderme las nuevas 💯, ojalá se creen la play list en Spotify.
![1000356854.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/danielcarrerag/243BTxQXBLTe7KxcKVGCPJsg9mzWkUF4EJViPEd1TNB3h85SpCkzo1cnPLV1y94AvjmzA.jpg)
- As for the story 📖, it remains the same as the original, but there will be new and unseen scenes 🆕, like one with Caroline, Edward's wife. There will also be new missions with Blackbeard 🏴‍☠️ and Stede Bonnet. There won't be a modern-day storyline, which is much appreciated, and it will be strictly single-player 1️⃣, without online modes or DLC. >- En cuanto a la historia 📖, se mantiene igual a la original, pero habrán escenas nuevas 🆕 e inéditas como una con Caroline, la esposa de Edward. También habrán misiones nuevas con Barbanegra 🏴‍☠️ y Stede Bonnet. No habrá historia en el presente, lo cual se agradece y será solo singler player 1️⃣, sin el online ni dlc. *** There’s plenty more this remake has to offer, but for me, these highlights are among the most important and exciting. It’s worth noting that it will be available 🗓️ starting July 9th at a price of $60 USD 💵, for PlayStation, Xbox, and PC. >Hay mucha más cosas que ofrecerá este remake, pero para mí estas que les comparto, están entre las más importantes y emocionantes. Cabe destacar que estará disponible 🗓️ a partir del 9 de julio con un precio de $60 USD 💵, para Playstation, Xbox y PC. Acá les dejo el vídeo del Showcase por si quieren verlo
https://youtu.be/PhQ3yQjUgAc?si=aVEmr6CA_AGRvDAa
*** Gif Made with VEO Images from [Ubisoft](https://store.ubisoft.com/ofertas/assassins-creed-black-flag-resynced-deluxe-edition/699e950e2f25b911ef69de9a.html?lang=es_AR&ucid=UWB-275107) Entertainment. All Rights Reserved.

title.title: El hogar del gusano / The worm's home
title.body:
<center>

Me encontré un gusano inmenso
y me dió pena verlo en el suelo 
lo traje a mi aposento
y lo dejé en un arbusto pequeño. 

Me senté en la silla de la sala
y cerré los ojos para que descansarán,
me dormí de forma exagerada
y me caí para atrás, en el piso quedé tirada. 

>I found a huge worm,
and I felt sorry for it lying on the ground,
I took it to my room
and placed it in a small bush.

>I sat down in the living room chair
and closed my eyes to rest,
but I fell asleep so deeply
that I fell backward and ended up sprawled on the floor.

![34672.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marpa/23xydLEKrsC9WfvJVt8aPsqUcZ5GPhFjPQCBtQ8FyHHnGj6UQyzGSf7uBzR9RMb5D3mNt.gif)

Me levanté con cuidado
y noté al gusano extraño,
saltó de dónde lo había dejado
y yo me fui hasta su lado.

Con mi pie lo detuve un momento 
hasta que el animal se quedó quieto,
lo tomé del suelo
y entendí que no debí traerlo. 

>I got up carefully
and noticed the strange worm,
it jumped from where I’d left it,
and I walked over to it.

>I held it down with my foot for a moment
until the creature stopped moving,
I picked it up from the ground
and realized I shouldn’t have brought it.

![34676.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marpa/23yncqEVaURoQgipNjiA2K86BpcaQ2s1GQ9bg1kv997t64oqu3idnNdVnmsoMgJrPkmoZ.gif)

Salí de mi aposento
y camine hasta un bosque bello,
dejé el gusano en el suelo
y él se enterró para mantenerse fresco.

Quería hacer el bien 
y de su ambiente lo saqué 
pero ahora, yo se bien 
que los animales en su hogar deben permanecer. 

>I left my room
and walked to a beautiful forest,
I set the worm down on the ground,
and it burrowed in to keep cool.

>I wanted to do the right thing
and took it out of its natural habitat,
but now I know
that animals should stay in their homes.

title.title: Portly Cannoneer Has the Same Appearance and Powers as Sniper in Dota 2
title.body:
![ChatGPT Image Apr 24, 2026, 10_24_07 AM.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/asgharali/23xAPgC31JUZvHApU6h9WGY8J8vYh1BpUYudJihZSwoq4dyCZRXPfTxpVG7HQcikU9WjC.png)
![Capture.PNG](https://i.imgur.com/uGB0GKX.png)


There was a time when I used to play Dota 2 with my friends with great passion. We get to gather in someone's house and do play dota 2 the whole night. We set up our PCs, connect all with modem and do play ranked matches.

It was quite strange in a fun way that we would start around 10 or 11 at night and continue until 6 or 7 in the morning, playing until the morning light came out. We were very fond of this game especially the battles we played with each other which were our favorite.

Now that I think about it Splinterlands is quite similar to this game. In Splinterlands you only have to run the simulator while in Dota 2 you have to play the whole game yourself. 

The purpose of todays writing is that there are some monsters in Dota 2 and Splinterlands that are similar to each other. Before this I also talked about PUDGE that matched a Splinterlands monster whose powers and abilities were very similar. 


In the same way today I want to talk about another monster that is quite similar and both perform almost the same role.

![Screenshot 2026-04-24 100130.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/asgharali/23t7ageRFuPhfpfgaEiXfQ4fuMTHRAJvGGp6aZ9cnXSbnXU51htxHCyuVWWGKzZe8DeQ8.png)
![Capture.PNG](https://i.imgur.com/uGB0GKX.png)

In Dota 2 there is a hero called Sniper who is very famous. In ranked battles he was often banned first because people were afraid of this hero especially because of his ultimate ability which could “snipe.” 

What happens in a snipe is that if a heros health is less than 50% and they come under his ultimate they can be killed in a single shot. If we look at his visual appearance he holds a sniper gun in his hand, has a big beard and stays in one position to take precise shots.

Similarly there is a monster in Splinterlands called Portly Cannoneer. If you look at its visual appearance you will find very little difference. It also holds a sniper type weapon, has a beard and is a ranged attack unit just like Sniper.


If I talk about its stats and abilities first of all its mana cost is 4 which allows you to easily select it in low, mid and high mana battles. Its health is 3 which is not very high but if you keep it in the backline it performs very well with its sniping ability. 

The best thing about it is its main ability shown with a red flag known as Inspire which gives +1 melee power to all allied units.

![Screenshot 2026-04-24 101937.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/asgharali/23vhTvCjKYhXazTceSN5CeSMcwXXEg4gimFpSm5TPyYxmAyzuWGe7GugRkU1bB2tAsLcU.png)
![Capture.PNG](https://i.imgur.com/uGB0GKX.png)

At level 1 its price is very reasonable. You can get it for just $0.02. If someone wants it they can buy it and gradually upgrade it. If I talk about its maximum level the price goes up to around $13 at level 10. 

At max level it also gains Return Fire and Fury abilities. Another major change is its ranged attack power which increases from one to three. He can deal +3 damage to enemy units every round.



After checking this monster it reminded me of the Sniper hero in Dota 2. Almost both have the same visual appearance and powers. And both are my favorite monsters thats why I thought to compare both of them. I hope you liked it.

title.title: ¡Nuestros nuevos huéspedes! 🐱[ESP/ENG]
title.body:
>
Bienvenidos! 🙋🏻‍♀️
¡Hola amigos!! Espero que estén super bien al igual que sus lindas mascotas, en esta oportunidad vengo a hablarles de unos nuevos huéspedes que nos han tenido tanto muy ocupados como muy entretenidos jajaja pues después de mucho tiempo volvimos a esto de cuidar temporalmente a animalitos necesitados hasta que consigan su propio hogar, y no se crean, no es fácil, menos teniendo mascotas ya en casa, ni hablar del cariño que desarrollas hacia los que cuidas para luego dejarlos ir a su nuevo hogar, es una clase de amor que va hacia otro nivel!. Esto fue una sorpresa por parte de mi pareja, un día llegando del trabajo me dijo que me tenía una sorpresa, una que me iba a alegrar mucho y pues la verdad siii jajaja al igual que él, amo cuidar de los animales, nos hace muy felices apoyarlos, ayudarlos, demostrarles que si pueden ser amados y cuidados como lo merecen, bueno, Palmerita y sus palmeritos (así les digo de cariño), llegaron cuando ella recién había dado a luz, tenían pocas horas de nacidos, al parecer no la querían con sus bebes en el edificio donde estaba, así que estaban buscando un hogar temporal para ella mientras sus bebes crecían un poco para darlos en adopción, en otro post les contaré más a detalle como es su historia y como hemos vivido este mes y medio con ella y sus bebes, ha sido toda una experiencia, una gratificante, llena de disciplina, amor y risas!. Me despido deseándoles lo mejor como siempre y pidiéndoles que en sus oraciones nos ayuden a conseguir un dulce hogar para estos gatitos, si estás en la Isla (Isla de Margarita), mejor aún!! Puedes difundir la información en tus redes sociales o si quieres adoptar solo házmelo saber en los comentarios, gracias por el apoyo ❤️.
ENGLISH

Welcome! 🙋🏻‍♀️
Hello friends!! I hope you and your lovely pets are doing great! This time, I'm here to tell you about some new guests who have kept us both very busy and very entertained, haha. After a long time, we're back to fostering animals in need until they find their forever homes. And believe me, it's not easy, especially when you already have pets at home. Not to mention the affection you develop for the animals you care for before letting them go to their new homes—it's a kind of love that goes to another level! This was a surprise from my partner. One day, coming home from work, he told me he had a surprise for me, one that would make me very happy, and it really did! Hahaha. Like him, I love taking care of animals. It makes us so happy to support them, help them, and show them that they can be loved and cared for as they deserve. Well, Palmerita and her little ones (that's what I affectionately call them) arrived when she had just given birth. They were only a few hours old. Apparently, they didn't want her and her babies in the building where she was, so they were looking for a temporary home for her while her babies grew a little before putting them up for adoption. In another post, I'll tell you more about their story and how we've been living with her and her babies for the past month and a half. It's been quite an experience, a rewarding one, full of discipline, love, and laughter! I'll say goodbye now, wishing you all the best as always, and asking you to pray for us to find a loving home for these kittens. If you're on the island (Margarita Island), even better! You can share this information on your social media, or if you'd like to adopt, just let me know in the comments. Thanks for your support ❤️.

title.title: “No Filters Needed: Aloe Vera Can Fix Your Skin Problems Naturally”
title.body:
![22412837-e945-4307-aa18-b8ad3f79c92a](https://hivepostify.cloud/uploads/posts/b053bd414a767e75307c6f8d147579b3.webp)


I just love plants that quietly do their own thing. Aloe vera is just one plant. It doesn’t fuss. Try to get your attention.
•Leaves are thick and green, and the space between two epidermises is filled with a transparent gel.
Hundreds of years ago, people have been using aloe vera to relieve their skin.
If you’ve dipped your fingers into the gel, you know what I mean. Aloe vera gel is great to the skin. It is good for calming skin and making skin feel smooth.
Aloe vera is really good, at its job. That’s why people love it so much.
It’s like something, not something that was manufactured in a factory. That’s a bit of why it’s so good for your skin.

What Makes Aloe Vera Special:
Aloe vera also contain natural compounds such as vitamins, enzymes, sterols, polysaccharides and minerals which when used topically has a calming effect on distressed skin and helps making your skin better.

Aloe vera is unlike skin products that contain chemicals. Those products can sometimes fix one issue. Then they can cause another problem. Aloe vera operates in a soft way. It makes your skin heal itself slowly instead of trying to fix it immediately.
That’s what’s great about taking care of your skin in a way. It works with your skin against you.

Why Aloe Vera Feels Different on Your Skin:
You’ll realize something, when you apply freshly extracted aloe gel on your skin. It absorbs fast, does not leave a film and the cool sensation on your skin felt almost instantaneously.
Aloe vera is unique because it is Light and moisturizes your skin well.
It gently cools your skin. Without being too cold.. or icy.
Soft enough for skin.It doesn’t clog your pores. It just sinks in. Quietly does its job.

How Aloe Vera Helps with Skin Conditions:
Acne and Breakouts:
Aloe vera soothes skin. Pimples don’t dry up. Instead helps your skin heal naturally. That means you will walk around with marks on your skin and less irritation over time. 

Sun induced skin inflammation :
Aloe vera is used  as a treatment option for sunburn relief. The cooling effect of Aloe  gel soothes burning skin. Makes It Feel Better Fast. 

Dry & Dehydrated skin:
If you’ve ever experienced dry skin, you know how a little moisture truly goes a long way in making your skin feel comfortable again. Aloe vera provides your skin with that hydration without blocking your pores.

Uneven Skin Tone & Dullness:
Aloe vera could also contribute to your skin looking more fresh and even if used on a regular basis. It won’t whiten your skin artificially. What it does do is enable your skin to naturally renew itself, and that can improve both your tone and how your skin feels.

Early Signs of Aging:
When your skin loses moisture it can begin to show lines. Aloe vera maintains your skin soft and plump. Your skin will become more resilient as you go.

Easy Way to Use Aloe Vera:
One of the best things about aloe vera is that it is simple to prepare. You don’t have to follow instructions or use multiple ingredients. 

✔️Fresh Gel Application
To use aloe vera, cut a leaf from the plant, scoop out the gel, and smooth it onto your clean skin. You can leave it on for 15-20 minutes or if your skin can take it, overnight. 
As a daily skin soother. Once your face is washed, you can apply aloe vera as a natural moisturizer as well. This is particularly useful on warm or humid days.

✔️ Combined with Simple Ingredients
For softness, aloe vera can be mixed with a little honey, for a refreshing sensation, with rosewater. No need for too many ingredients. Just the ordinary things that mixes really well with the aloe vera.

Why Herbal Care is Good:
However, what really distinguishes natural aloe vera is that it’s mild and consistent. It does not try to rush results, or shock your skin. Rather, it gradually cumulates enhancements over time.
In a way caring for your skin isn’t really about making radical changes. It’s about a balance that sustains.” Aloe vera lends itself so well to this concept because it: Has no unnecessary chemicals.
Shouldn’t cause a problem for your skin. You can use it continuously.

⚠️ Important: When using aloe vera!
Despite the fact that it’s natural, you still have to use aloe vera mindfully:
Test a small amount on a small area of skin first.
Just use the clear gel, not the yellow stuff from underneath.
It’s best to use less often than too much all at once.

Conclusion:
Aloe vera is definitely one of those things that actually does have-the-hype. It’s not the current flavour-of-the-month. It is a common favorite for a reason, it’s stood the test of time as a go-to natural remedy.
🌿✨Tired, irritated or unwell skin? You don’t always need to put something on it. Just put something on. And the solution – or at least some of it – isn’t in a bottle. It is growing in a pot next to your window 🌿✨

Кажуть, що таку випічку можна робити лище на Великдень. І як би вам вона не смакувала, порушувати таку традицію негоже. Але тим не менше, випікати можна протягом певного часу на сам Великдень і ще після. Тому, напікши таку смакоту ще в чистий четвер, до свята і на свято багато встигли роздати - батькам, хресним, хрещеникам, в церкву. І якось посмакували тільки подарованими вже нам, а свою може одну чи дві. Але ж як посмакували, мммммм. З насолодою, з гордістю щовийшла  така смакота, що і пригостити було не соромно.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmewXZmMLp5HXBrsi2Uts4b1fhCGEt3VBfZo42PaRarm9o/1777006831757.jpg)

Тому на тижні опісля Великодня ще раз зробили заміс. Звичайно, вийшло вже не так,  адже до Великодньої випічки і готуються заздалегідь, і замочують  ягоди, і цукати, готують домашні продукти. Цього разу ж трішки діставали що було в холодилтнику, а фрукти не замочили, бо трішки спонтанно вирішили пекти. 

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmdHfmdaG1N7DD7JT2wdL9VdMdAB4cXyE2M6bQgcWsBdJP/1777006831794.jpg)

Та все ж все вийшло напрочуд смачно. І як каже кожна господинька, один і той рецепт щоразу виходить інакший на смае, ще й в кожної хазяйки по свому смакуватиме. Хто зна чому, багато певне моментів. Та від того традиційна випічка стає тільки смачнішою і хочеться експериментувати в рецептурі для пошуку свого довершеного смаку в результаті.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmWpwUca2Rsg5sLCkaWCAj2E2VKFf8cqSJwZ1hmpLaxhBm/1777006831829.jpg)

title.title: A Red Dusk [ENG🇬🇧|ESP🇻🇪]
title.body: > Hello everyone. On this occasion, I want to share a few photographs of a very red and flaming sunset. I was at a friend's house, talking about various topics on her rooftop. The afternoon was fading, and suddenly we noticed that in the middle of the sunset, the sky was turning orange and then a deep red. The view was very clear and quite unusual. # The scene was impressive because you could see the moon in the sky, surrounded by these red clouds. It looked like a painting. I decided to stop the conversation for a moment to take several photographs of the sky. The result is, by far, striking. It is not every day that you get to see such a strong contrast between the darkness of the rising night and the intensity of the sunset colors. # Even though I didn't have professional equipment with me, I believe that the phone's camera managed to represent the atmosphere of that moment quite well. These types of experiences remind me why I like to keep an eye on the sky; sometimes nature offers a spectacle that completely changes the mood of a simple conversation among friends. The rooftop provided a perfect vantage point to appreciate the horizon without obstacles. # I hope you can perceive the intensity of those tones through these images. For us, it was a very pleasant surprise that turned a regular afternoon into something worth documenting. I am glad I was in the right place at the right time to capture this fleeting moment of beauty in the heights. # Without anything more to add, I bid farewell. Stay tuned for future posts! Until next time!

> Hola a Todos. En esta ocasión, quiero compartir unas pocas fotografías de un atardecer muy rojo y llameante. Me encontraba en casa de una amiga, conversando sobre diversos temas en su azotea. La tarde caía y, de pronto, nos percatamos de que, en medio del atardecer, el cielo se estaba tiñendo de naranja y luego de un rojo intenso. La vista era muy apreciable y poco común. # La escena era impresionante porque se podía observar la luna en el cielo, rodeada por estas nubes rojas. Parecía una pintura. Decidí detener la conversación por un momento para tomar varias fotografías del cielo. El resultado es, por mucho, impactante. No todos los días se logra ver un contraste tan fuerte entre la oscuridad de la noche que sube y la intensidad de los colores del ocaso. # Aunque no tenía equipo profesional conmigo, creo que la cámara del celular logró representar bastante bien la atmósfera de ese momento. Este tipo de experiencias me recuerdan por qué me gusta estar pendiente del cielo; a veces la naturaleza ofrece un espectáculo que cambia por completo el ánimo de una simple charla entre amigos. La azotea nos brindó un punto de vista perfecto para apreciar el horizonte sin obstáculos. # Espero que puedan percibir la intensidad de esos tonos a través de estas imágenes. Para nosotros, fue una sorpresa muy agradable que convirtió una tarde cualquiera en algo digno de documentar. Me alegra haber estado en el lugar y momento adecuados para capturar este instante fugaz de belleza en las alturas. # Sin más que agregar me despido, estén atentos a los próximos post. ¡Hasta la Próxima! ------ ---- |

title.title: Cabbage Salad with French Vinaigrette Dressing\\Krautsalat mit französischem Vinaigrette-Dressing
title.body:
Hello,my friends!
Today we'll make a simple salad with shredded cabbage and grated carrots. The real secret to this dish is the dressing. I'll be using a classic French vinaigrette dressing (vinaigre means vinegar). Vinaigrette dressing is great for any vegetable salad. Let's go, it's going to be interesting!


![1.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmZkpqiXpLD3eVHekgUvGE8Zzrb9GRLjeFVRKSfD7f5TVw/1.jpg)


Ingredients:
● Cabbage - 1/4 head
● Carrot - 1 pc
● Salt, herbs, and pepper - to taste

For the vinaigrette dressing:
● Olive oil - 6 tbsp (oil to vinegar ratio: 3 to 1)
● Wine vinegar - 2 tbsp
● Salt - a pinch
● Ground black pepper - a pinch

1.Grate the carrots and shred the cabbage into strips. Add a pinch of salt and press the cabbage and carrots with your hands until the juices are released.


![3.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmQJ58eoZo5T8XVzxMz1pUqzM71UBP9nnfqZU5QSKD5YSK/3.jpg)


2.Now let's prepare the vinaigrette dressing. It's best to do this in a small jar with a lid. Pour the wine vinegar into the jar, add a pinch of salt and black pepper, and stir until the salt dissolves. I used aromatic herb salt.



![4.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmbSbFaNcHw8uFfm647Fy71JDdtm7PpiMqNQNhgRAPDYd8/4.jpg)


3.Pour in the olive oil, close the lid tightly, and shake the contents. The mixture should become cloudy and opaque. Use 3 parts olive oil and 1 part wine vinegar. The vinaigrette dressing is ready. But it doesn't keep for long, so don't make it in advance; it will separate. It's not that hard to do this each time you make a salad or vinaigrette. I'll admit, this mixture is a bit too tart for me, so I added an illegal pinch of sugar to balance the flavor.



![5.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmadYwZghhxRhjDsRXPZSYqdvdvbpvyNRry2RSUfdxTooa/5.jpg)


4.Pour the dressing over the coleslaw and mix well.



![6.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmbqhAuSowcKBWqbTAZ2eZsQMB5ApPKJhVAgaKVPjuixDW/6.jpg)


5.Let the salad sit for a bit to allow the dressing to soak in.



![7.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmdQPpc85ABbwusD3kd1qv7wwUyHEmycd2NCg3uUG4zqui/7.jpg)


6.Serve the coleslaw with French dressing. It turned out pretty good, the dressing is fantastic! The French know a thing or two about sauces!



![2.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmbWisQcBkHSqbTi6YopCXFm71yRLbrS63JeW3M8QGob7R/2.jpg)


Shall we make it?

![3-poloska-1.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmYyhhAydYCgxXo6MZeZ3YC526qwyBdU2NCdMXtyoJGAXB/3-poloska-1.png)

Heute bereiten wir einen einfachen Salat mit gehobeltem Kohl und geraspelten Karotten zu. Das Geheimnis dieses Gerichts liegt im Dressing. Ich verwende ein klassisches französisches Vinaigrette-Dressing (Vinaigrette bedeutet Essig). Vinaigrette passt hervorragend zu jedem Gemüsesalat. Los geht's, es wird interessant!

Zutaten:
● Kohl – 1/4 Kopf
● Karotte – 1 Stück
● Salz, Kräuter und Pfeffer – nach Geschmack

Für das Vinaigrette-Dressing:
● Olivenöl – 6 EL (Verhältnis Öl zu Essig: 3:1)
● Weinessig – 2 EL
● Salz – eine Prise
● Gemahlener schwarzer Pfeffer – eine Prise

1.Die Karotten raspeln und den Kohl in Streifen schneiden. Eine Prise Salz hinzufügen und Kohl und Karotten mit den Händen ausdrücken, bis Saft austritt.

2.Nun bereiten wir das Vinaigrette-Dressing zu. Am besten geht das in einem kleinen Glas mit Deckel. Gießen Sie den Weinessig hinein, geben Sie eine Prise Salz und schwarzen Pfeffer hinzu und rühren Sie, bis sich das Salz aufgelöst hat. Ich habe Kräutersalz verwendet.

3.Gießen Sie das Olivenöl hinzu, verschließen Sie das Glas fest und schütteln Sie es gut. Die Mischung sollte trüb und undurchsichtig werden. Verwenden Sie 3 Teile Olivenöl und 1 Teil Weinessig. Das Vinaigrette-Dressing ist fertig. Es hält sich aber nicht lange, bereiten Sie es also nicht im Voraus zu, da es sich sonst trennt. Es ist nicht schwer, das jedes Mal zu machen, wenn Sie einen Salat oder eine Vinaigrette zubereiten. Ich muss zugeben, diese Mischung ist mir etwas zu sauer, deshalb habe ich eine Prise Zucker hinzugefügt, um den Geschmack auszugleichen.

4.Gießen Sie das Dressing über den Krautsalat und vermengen Sie alles gut.

5.Lassen Sie den Salat kurz ziehen, damit das Dressing einziehen kann.

6.Servieren Sie den Krautsalat mit dem Dressing. Es ist richtig gut geworden, das Dressing ist fantastisch! Die Franzosen verstehen was von Saucen!

Sollen wir es nachmachen?

![3-poloska-1.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmYyhhAydYCgxXo6MZeZ3YC526qwyBdU2NCdMXtyoJGAXB/3-poloska-1.png)



![U5duDCNw2pr2jpJvE8CRni125dys5tM_1680x8400.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmXaogGpoD7LJkEufiNxjF52VcPhQZJYsJet34fDwJyYUV/U5duDCNw2pr2jpJvE8CRni125dys5tM_1680x8400.png)![U5dr1BuE8ejAxctktpDvrzGctPnaMgF_1680x8400.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmVmydUTmF1ECe7u87FkCoJYcxT6Xo9spqJBWGi8G3ntXH/U5dr1BuE8ejAxctktpDvrzGctPnaMgF_1680x8400.jpg)

title.title: 「生活」紧张的备考
title.body:
<liketuimages>
<center>
![WzXNKDbuModZxZY0_1545cfce950fbc3272b4e2ae9439f1.png](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/mrspointm/images/WzXNKDbuModZxZY0_1545cfce950fbc3272b4e2ae9439f1/WzXNKDbuModZxZY0_1545cfce950fbc3272b4e2ae9439f1.webp)
![nzbAf2RjwPTC8mME_aaf1bd1bc24f3719b84747a04ec7ee.png](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/mrspointm/images/nzbAf2RjwPTC8mME_aaf1bd1bc24f3719b84747a04ec7ee/nzbAf2RjwPTC8mME_aaf1bd1bc24f3719b84747a04ec7ee.webp)
![tnVYsixUmXy5Sx55_IMG_6047.png](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/mrspointm/images/tnVYsixUmXy5Sx55_IMG_6047/tnVYsixUmXy5Sx55_IMG_6047.webp)
</center>
</liketuimages>

眼看着高考还有40多天，按理说我们老师本该觉得快要解放了，可我心里总惦记着，还有很多内容没来得及复习。

就拿现阶段的主题语境复习来说，我原本计划把十大高频热门话题，全部给学生梳理到位。但现实是，目前只完成了三个主题，还有七个尚未推进。

完成剩余七个主题后，我还想系统讲完读后续写的六大核心专题。再加上每周固定的考试与试卷讲评，还需要专门梳理各大题型的解题技巧。各项内容叠加下来，课时严重不足。

从现在算起，能用来系统授课的时间，恐怕不足二十节课。细细盘算下来压力十足，也真切体会到了高考备考的分秒必争。

说实话，这一届我教学做得格外扎实。相比往届，教学经验不断沉淀，知识体系整理得更系统、分类也更清晰。即便教材换了新版本，我的各类教学资料也在不断打磨完善、逐步成型，只为让学生学到更多干货，切实提升能力。

但客观来讲，这一届学生基础偏弱，整体水平和上一届差距明显。很多知识点反复讲解，学生的吸收效果却不尽人意。其实我早已竭尽所能，基础知识巩固、学习习惯培养、题型答题方法，日常课堂里一直在持续渗透。

即便如此，这带班过程我依旧格外疲惫。这一届干的特别充实，大量教学资料需要整合梳理，凡事总想做到尽善尽美，这也无形中加重了自身的内耗与负担。看来是得好好规划一番，把接下来这20节课高效用到极致，这样心里才会踏实，他们的备考复习才能更轻松。

今天在办公室备课，同事们闲聊打趣，大家都满心期待四十多天后的解放。都盼着高考结束后好好放松，去海边放空自己。一言一行里，全是迫切想要卸下备考压力、让身心彻底放松的心情，我也一样！

---

title.title: [ENG/ESP] A Thursday spent among landscapes and potential contracts.
title.body: > **Happy Friday, everyone. I hope you have a fabulous day, filled with positive energy and that special feeling that comes with the last day of the week, when you start to look forward to the rest that’s just around the corner. For many, it’s a day off, but for me, it’ll be a workday. Still, it’s nothing compared to what we went through yesterday, and that’s exactly what I want to tell you about today. Every Thursday, I have a routine of going to the Sunsol Ecoland hotel to chlorinate the main tank. It’s a job that’s become part of my week, almost like a technical ritual I know by heart. However, this Thursday, things took an unexpected turn. We were halfway there when we received an urgent call from the Sunsol Unik Hotel: they had an emergency and needed us to come immediately. There wasn’t much to think about; we changed our destination and picked up the pace. The weather was beautiful—one of those days that seem made to soothe the soul. The sky had a soft light, perfect for taking photographs, and that’s what I did. Capturing the urban and natural landscapes unfolding before us helped me dispel some of the worry that was beginning to creep in. Sometimes, simply stopping to look at your surroundings is enough to remind you that even complicated days have their beauty.**

> *Feliz viernes para todos. Les deseo un día fabuloso, lleno de buenas energías y de esa sensación especial que trae el último día de la semana, cuando uno ya empieza a saborear el descanso que se acerca. Para muchos es un día ligero, pero para mí será un día de trabajo. Aun así, nada comparado con lo que vivimos ayer, y justamente eso es lo que quiero contarles hoy. Cada jueves tengo la rutina de ir al hotel Sunsol Ecoland para realizar el clorado del tanque principal. Es un trabajo que ya forma parte de mi semana, casi como un ritual técnico que conozco de memoria. Sin embargo, este jueves las cosas tomaron un rumbo inesperado. Íbamos a medio camino cuando recibimos una llamada urgente del hotel Sunsol Unik: tenían una emergencia y necesitaban que fuéramos de inmediato. No hubo mucho que pensar; cambiamos el destino y aceleramos el paso. El clima estaba hermoso, de esos días que parecen hechos para calmar el alma. El cielo tenía una luz suave, perfecta para tomar fotografías, y eso hice. Capturar los paisajes urbanos y naturales que se abrían ante nosotros me ayudó a disipar un poco la preocupación que empezaba a asomarse. A veces, detenerse a mirar el entorno es suficiente para recordar que incluso los días complicados tienen belleza.*
![z.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/taniagonzalez/23yJGPHfNrX11vLy6GeAgyzAdrHz2QdG5RoWFzh1T3om52V7WBJehGpEDmFMQCWP63xCC.jpg) ![photo_2026-04-23_22-55-17.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/taniagonzalez/EoK5ph5UMPnSa6YkGSbLrGM38ZFxMWWUpaoyFAsfcYS6j6Q21Vjk5ZbXWv86uuhyNEJ.jpg) ![photo_2026-04-23_22-55-13.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/taniagonzalez/EptbTscZHnusATcVVQmEdwK71yjDCqGxtvCug91eTHiC1ZsQLQGbPhWAxqcPSQNQuCC.jpg) ![photo_2026-04-23_22-55-12.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/taniagonzalez/EpnCpmAvMjqqooUZ7Lm9eLVSzqtJyvaHZrsMYWdWyyMSYNpNnEfB3xaRWX5FnDASgx9.jpg) ![photo_2026-04-23_22-55-09.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/taniagonzalez/EpNnpmjAJPMTdYVo5b7yrt6gDoqspc8a5gnjZX9ShTpDbrSmYEowUEYWmZKst9m4xVj.jpg) ![photo_2026-04-23_22-55-08.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/taniagonzalez/EpGQEuapdJUo8mM8rsEsQqnMxAhMyxwXR345e9psJQDQ1zYjhxPnK6ogWfjGNMjCagb.jpg) ![photo_2026-04-23_22-55-07 (2).jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/taniagonzalez/EpxpnRLTt4bURuka5349VL12xfZuDKHMd4UaCc9Ggkx3j83XAjNsQ8wVjoe9AcCrymN.jpg)

> **When we arrived at the Unik Hotel, we went inside with the maintenance manager to assess the situation. One of the trench-type Dumes filters was malfunctioning; water was leaking out through the cover because one of the studs had broken due to the pressure. Apparently, the other filter was clogged, which caused the pressure to rise higher than it should have. The force was concentrated on the cover, the stud gave way, and that’s where the leak began.**

> *Al llegar al hotel Unik entramos junto al gerente de mantenimiento para evaluar la situación. Uno de los filtros dumes de trinchera estaba fallando; el agua se salía por la tapa porque uno de los espárragos se había quebrado debido a la presión. Al parecer, el otro filtro estaba saturado y eso hizo que la presión subiera más de lo debido. La fuerza se concentró en la tapa, el espárrago cedió y por allí comenzó la fuga.*
![z(1).jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/taniagonzalez/EpJYdDhA4di4HrqzZCgTtDGmoi39PTVva9VjrMpq42mN6UGF4uT7dshgxMD6rq6sNV6.jpg) ![y.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/taniagonzalez/EppKd87z6Fi13cKvYj5Hz9Xw8mBzy32wLYsDXU61J4uvUQSWJPpk6VwRnbCW2NvwUSV.jpg) ![photo_2026-04-23_22-54-51.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/taniagonzalez/EqWjuSEiJcDWyUDj8UoxRViLDmsEBZSgYa7L8Axij8ct9F588CY1oQH3T98LuQH5Pxf.jpg) ![photo_2026-04-23_22-54-50.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/taniagonzalez/Eq7LyHzUBnxMkwgShQRZz8N5S54hfQteb9tJ5rzFVkg4CMrC8kqJwXqPKMSj26hTwWP.jpg) ![photo_2026-04-23_22-54-49 (2).jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/taniagonzalez/EpXHyzgK1oMS5w7LEiSBAAuSgFx7xEndeHa5DCMGz5VdgWzSMBs1KxsehVhGu4otKsc.jpg)

> **The first step was to shut off all the valves and set up a bypass so that the other filter could operate on its own while we made the repair. That process, though it seems simple, requires precision, strength, and patience. It took us most of the day. We were only able to replace two studs because the hotel didn’t have any more in stock. From experience, we know that ideally we should replace them all, but due to the hotel’s occupancy, we were told that we could return in three or four days to finish the job. For now, with what we’ve done, they can operate without immediate risk. The work was intense. We had to loosen and tighten them over and over again until the water stopped leaking from the joint. It’s a physical and technical effort that demands concentration, but it’s also rewarding to see how, little by little, the problem is brought under control.**

> *Lo primero fue cerrar todas las llaves y realizar un bypass para que el otro filtro trabajara solo mientras hacíamos la reparación. Ese proceso, aunque parece sencillo, requiere precisión, fuerza y paciencia. Nos tomó gran parte del día. Solo pudimos cambiar dos espárragos porque el hotel no tenía más en almacén. Por experiencia sabemos que lo ideal es cambiarlos todos, pero debido a la ocupación del hotel, nos informaron que dentro de tres o cuatro días podríamos regresar para completar el trabajo. Por ahora, con lo que hicimos, pueden operar sin riesgo inmediato. El trabajo fue intenso. Había que ir soltando y apretando una y otra vez hasta lograr que dejara de salir agua por la junta. Es un esfuerzo físico y técnico que exige concentración, pero también es gratificante ver cómo, poco a poco, el problema se controla.*
![z.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/taniagonzalez/EonmYgUroej2okaksizB3sQ9JNbK56VeMNPhGPCPK1NR811UgY3dTnmToVKXczqiLJM.jpg) ![y.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/taniagonzalez/EoiWDFXCxSKcYArjgATBRNsDiefTYh4e98biNYwW6DE836VSWKEzkkdC3jzjyXoNyjS.jpg) ![photo_2026-04-23_22-55-07.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/taniagonzalez/23zbcoNx7gX8bq69TBfoRCen3VzvwrYLoAaFq9SdNZhkuBQs9fyKmAyuUcZiKojxXVbsg.jpg) ![photo_2026-04-23_22-55-06.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/taniagonzalez/23wgQ5aaEb2eABGkQacEKD6WVAVsjPVrAQAHTAEVpGCxrAhZz2bYF98pRBAiCnzGeqmB1.jpg) ![photo_2026-04-23_22-55-05.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/taniagonzalez/EowH7V2JvkvzrXa5bEw2X1F4ZUGo6PNZz4tTuTWtL3dYYat99qE5Jwpy64Mak2J87s3.jpg) ![photo_2026-04-23_22-55-00.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/taniagonzalez/EoyP5zEYaBpvQZPECLGzZ4rUHNfSQWzxGeRqAa9KnwvcJspiGT3Poy81VXgPR4LToaZ.jpg) ![photo_2026-04-23_22-54-59.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/taniagonzalez/EoATX84wtPG2BRfAxmFEQsKkW2gYkAfK4EkpdurSyDvWhsqb7sfBSV4SeqM19QZ8aPY.jpg) ![photo_2026-04-23_22-54-56.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/taniagonzalez/EoiVJrUceoPgADGXW73GS8fzrVLhh61BoGv2NQ3G7BAqG9X2kZGqVFBi8k5ztqssH4N.jpg) ![photo_2026-04-23_22-54-55.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/taniagonzalez/EpA2WS7187AnEUC1CwTihHrS4QXKcVaxu4P2v7bys6bBmusYMKha6VkiJQpHMz8BTT7.jpg)

> **When we were finally done, we left the hotel with the satisfaction of having defused the crisis. We were exhausted, yes, but our hearts were at ease knowing we had done our duty. Nothing compares to that mix of exhaustion and pride you feel after resolving a difficult situation.**

> *Cuando finalmente terminamos, nos retiramos del hotel con la satisfacción de haber atenuado la emergencia. Íbamos agotados, sí, pero con el corazón tranquilo por haber cumplido con nuestro deber. Nada se compara con esa mezcla de cansancio y orgullo que queda después de resolver una situación complicada.*
![z.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/taniagonzalez/EppKg4aYUoxrnLs8g9khDvDsSgfbTdJWT9W8gn81zr7vJB6qoFCciv64nzrXJbWoFDu.jpg) ![photo_2026-04-23_22-55-16.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/taniagonzalez/EqfGugDaPsGmPvNGab4J1g7wUfwVWjoXmmKPirQnRkYGvS2fZMfkxt3jXJJ1KsCXVL9.jpg)

> **Now I just hope this Friday goes more smoothly, that the day passes without any surprises, and that we can wrap up the week on a positive note. I’ll see you very soon in another post. See you soon. Bye.**

> *Ahora solo espero que este viernes sea más tranquilo, que el día avance sin sobresaltos y que podamos cerrar la semana con serenidad. Los veré muy pronto en otra de mis publicaciones.   Hasta pronto.   Chao.*

title.body: There is a Netflix show you might have heard of \

. The whole show revolves around the psychological perspective of the killer, mollester etc. How they were molested or treated in their childhood; how those moments shaped their doing. Although, it was cancelled later on, still one of the finest show. And I don't know, why we don't have shows like these. Our dramas can play a significant role, but we are still struggling with saas-bahu-nand crap. 

And, I don't find any shame in feeling sympathy with the criminal. They are humans too. We have all the right to hate the action, but hating the person, without even knowing them is not good. We don't know what they have been through, why they did such act etc. Knowing first hand from the family, only then we come to realize the situation. 

Moreover as you have mentioned, thiis whole corrupted system os the biggest reason behind all this, and at the center, there is economy. A better economy resolves almost two-third of the societal issues. And, tbh, I find society the biggest role-player in all of this doing. The lust for fame, wealth, and infinite wishes has blinded us all. 

>Also, sorry for getting side tracked, it happens with me that one conversation leads to another.

Humans are social animals and this shifting is the most beautiful thing, we are possessed with. Like we aren't doing a PhD research, so we have all the ground to keep going. 

Tbh, you are a gem in a world - especially in a country like us. Otherwise, we all hating all without any rational reasoning.

</liketuimages>

**Greetings to everyone.**

How many hundreds of insects and spiders roam around us, which we usually do not pay much attention to. Sometimes we avoid them out of annoyance, this is it. But today when a fly suddenly landed on my hand, why did I think, what would it look like if I looked at it a little closer?
​I took out my mobile phone and tried to take these pictures very carefully, from very close up. To be honest, after taking the pictures, I was surprised myself! The fly, which we consider to be just an annoying insect with ordinary eyes, could be so strange and beautiful under the lens, I never thought before.
​Zoom in on the pictures a little. When you look at the fly's eyes, you will be surprised, it seems like a thousand small mirrors are placed together! How perfectly the gray and black striped spots on its body are arranged. And looking at that transparent craftsmanship of the wings, it seems that this too was made by the hands of a skilled artist of nature.
​In our busy lives, we may overlook many things. These pictures reminded me that even the most ordinary things in front of our eyes hide a lot of extraordinary beauty, we just need to have the eyes to see.

​For those who love macro photography, how did you like this look of this fly? Please let me know in the comments!
​All pictures were taken with my own mobile phone.

Nator, Bangladesh. 🇧🇩

title.title: SPS Validator Node Update Fun...
title.body:
![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/497c9eae-5253-44bc-bdd7-4bd34a16deee.jpg) This week was definitely interesting, Splinterlands was making some updates to the SPS validator node software to introduce some new features. This was supposed to be a single hash breaking update where all the validator node operators are supposed to upgrade their nodes before April 28. It was supposed to be a single update from version 1.31 to version 1.40. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/6bac1956-6266-4a8f-9bb7-a701abf19bc2.jpg) Well, it didn't turn out that way. I have proactively upgraded to 1.40 and it ran fine for a few days. Then a whole bunch of 1.40 nodes started going down including my node. I had to replay the SPS chain from a snapshot and it turned out that 250 gigabytes of space I had on the node was not enough. I had done some deep cleaning of my Docker and freed up 166 gigabytes. After that my node was finally back up. Then Splinterlands released an update to fix the issue, so I upgraded to 1.41 ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/574181aa-82a8-4ff9-bee1-98945216b5ec.jpg) But that was not the end of it there were a few vulnerabilities that were discovered and I had to upgrade my node to 1.50 and then to 1.51. Hopefully this is going to be it for now, though there are a few more days before April 28. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/853f920d-65a6-4ad7-99b8-51b9928f5c34.jpg) At work we had a production deployment today which went smoothly. We have updated sixteenth containers some of which were Linux and some that are Windows 2022 Server. The Windows Server containers were upgraded about a month ago and each of them had 155 vulnerabilities. One critical vulnerability, eighty something major vulnerabilities and the rest were moderate. That is a lot for just one month, but that is like that with Windows every month. We just can't upgrade them on a two week cadence as we have to wait for a custom container image that our content management vendor releases on a monthly basis. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/f34b742d-c138-4fc0-bffe-28bdb07f54e3.jpg) But that is not all, I am finally getting a new laptop for work, so in between meetings and production deployments I am setting it up as well and there are a lot of development tools to setup. At least I got out today for a walk to the post office to mail a small box for my mother in law and to pick up some Adjaruli boats for the three of us. I also managed almost an hour at the gym in our office building. So I got some great steps and a weight lifting workout. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/dcf30a42-8368-4f0d-8b32-60541f2ab6cf.jpg) Tomorrow is back to the office in Seattle again, and we are going to do some AI work first half of the day and then I will have some time to work out at the gym. I am also driving our daughter to school and picking her up from school tomorrow. Today was nice as I got a ride from my wife to the train station on her way to drop off our daughter at school. https://img.leopedia.io/DQmYy9HP674hfvsKCptcFMMgUPUgbxwSungfbPsTWpPq4Q9/IMG_7051.jpg 
 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmPhkHXA4qBZGDvKmFRvzDZZErCxoeq3e9Z95KrVNozGzR/IMG_7050.jpg 

I’m still not giving up at the gym, and honestly, I’m starting to feel really good about myself. It’s not just about the physical changes — it’s about the confidence that grows every time I show up and give my best. Staying consistent hasn’t been easy, but every effort is worth it when I see how far I’ve come.

There were days when I felt tired, unmotivated, or even doubtful, but I kept going. And now I can feel that inner strength building up. Feeling beautiful is not only about appearance, it’s about knowing you’re doing something good for yourself, taking care of your body, and honoring your commitment.

Today I feel strong, confident, and yes… bonita. Because I didn’t give up. Because I kept choosing me, again and again. And that is the most beautiful feeling of all. 💖✨


Sigo sin rendirme en el gym y la verdad me siento muy bien conmigo misma. No se trata solo de los cambios físicos, sino de la confianza que crece cada vez que vengo y doy lo mejor de mí. Mantenerme constante no ha sido fácil, pero cada esfuerzo vale la pena cuando veo todo lo que he avanzado.

Ha habido días de cansancio, de poca motivación e incluso de dudas, pero aun así seguí. Y ahora siento esa fuerza interior que se va construyendo poco a poco. Sentirse bonita no es solo por lo físico, es saber que estás haciendo algo bueno por ti, cuidando tu cuerpo y cumpliéndote a ti misma.

Hoy me siento fuerte, segura y sí… bonita. Porque no me rendí. Porque sigo eligiéndome cada día. Y eso es lo más bonito de todo. 💖✨

title.title: From Wild Fruits to Fresh Shells: My Beautiful Mountain Life Full of Free Blessings Daily
title.body:
![Blue and Green Modern Golf Photo Collage Instagram Post.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dreamrona/AJha23xXUpwXiG1CFcUq8aPU1oepxof5uY1uo5jaTPR5NHKH9kkhxa4ahqp1viA.png)

Hello everyone! 
Living in the mountain has taught me that life here is simple and beautiful. Many people think that living far from the city is hard, but for me, it is a life full of blessings. If you know how to be resourceful and appreciate what nature gives, there will always be something to eat freely and something to be thankful for.

![Blue and Green Modern Golf Photo Collage Instagram Post (1).png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dreamrona/AK7y1G2A4nLxjTYLHaNKn2GBXHCfhrrt5aSgnjN9U4N9DZgc24enbnejaEs7Uve.png)

One of my favorite experiences happened when we were walking to the fishpond. The walk was quite far, but I honestly did not feel tired because the journey was so enjoyable. Along the way, we found wild strawberries and mulberries growing naturally. Seeing the children so happy while picking and tasting the fruits made my heart full. Their excitement and laughter made the long walk feel short.

![Blue and Green Modern Golf Photo Collage Instagram Post (2).png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dreamrona/AK9QtGBWw658ozg5ejozfDjXTjA9Df6qKEpEazfMJkf23ouKwSbmUT3YDZA3imW.png)

![Blue and Green Modern Golf Photo Collage Instagram Post (4).png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dreamrona/AKKSCJ4QkCyKe947EZp1PvESYEWJWkGWrD1eBanNZfFBATbh5TFgrqTpKAZFjoF.png)

As we continued walking, I enjoyed the fresh mountain air touching my face. It felt so refreshing compared to the busy and polluted places in town. We were talking, laughing, and sharing stories while walking together. Those simple conversations made the moment more special. In the mountain, even a long walk becomes a bonding experience.

![IMG_20260107_110450.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dreamrona/23xVEhMNDe3rjwHFqJwyWNKJrfWCXh4YX7orey28Au1uGN5k5LY7VrExo4Ksippd6j6bp.jpg)

When we finally arrived at the fishpond, I paused for a moment to admire the view. The tall trees standing proudly around us, the peaceful surroundings, and the strong sound of flowing water from the stream were truly relaxing. Every time I see places like that, I feel grateful because nature has its own way of healing the mind and heart.

![IMG_20260107_101203.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dreamrona/23xyLPnxdx8sfa33rhpovYNFjD364DzjktUft7V8Yn4wagRDkrYoApB4WaiNc6kXXnGPq.jpg)

![IMG_20260107_101218.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dreamrona/23u63AotWP4XKqRkpRK11qbwD5NR4M35JgScFH7oLLK2j6hLTTkA4CcGtmEmxJXoazPjJ.jpg)

Before going home, we gathered agihis, a kind of shell we found in the stream. Since I was young, this has always been one of my favorite foods.  It’s best also to eat after gave birth it gives more milk. It reminds me of my childhood days when life was simple and full of happy memories.

![IMG_20260424_074502.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dreamrona/23ydA5KRECziwurQfrDnTAvEDUt4ie31TM6aS935SGNY8YZFhYvTKauzgEyPj1Mazf9hL.jpg)

When I got home, I immediately cooked the agihis. I added tomato, onion, ginger, and lemongrass. The smell while cooking was so delicious and comforting. When it was ready, it became the perfect meal for us. Every bite tasted like home and childhood memories.

Experiences like this remind me that happiness is not always found in expensive things. Sometimes, it is found in walking far with family, picking wild fruits, breathing fresh air, and cooking food gathered from nature.

![Blue and Green Modern Golf Photo Collage Instagram Post (3).png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dreamrona/AKPkGsjMhfxdr8bVxsBS9DBWW3UTyNarkJeXn2f3H1abbzJZShz2LYkCwpyxUmf.png)

Thank you for reading my story, this is my owned picture, Edited in Canva. Life in the mountain may look simple to others, but for me peace, and blessings that money cannot buy. Have a nice day!

title.title: Land preparation, challenges with cultivating/Tilling of Farm space
title.body:
# Hello Hive 




Happy new day to us all, I hope that our nights was peaceful and restful. Today we are already up early in order to start the business of the day.




![3822.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/monica-ene/23yJNyU1q9ie4fqQfAG4nXvTmUtCxcNk2AjMPii5km3R1972AV5JRVEw8sSzFsoW4JhTy.jpg)


Having prepared a portion of our land to begin the farming activities for this year 
We are out on one of the greatest challenges of faming that we often face here.



Cultivating the land. Is the most difficult task that we haven't been able to find our way about it.  For every farming season , the land has to be cleared first and then the tilling with hoes or tractor before seeds can be planted. The challenge here now is that we don't often find labourers to till the ground. It is quite a laborious work to use hoes to till the ground.
Most people shy away from the task of cultivating the land and by this I mean preparing of the ridges. They would rather prefer to do other farm jobs. Over the years I have had my father who is burdened with the task of cultivating the land but now daddy is ageing and it won't be right to have him do such work again.  

![3837.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/monica-ene/Epdj9N6ftJkrDrafQnw1mdAm9Qm1CjtyZUt3GifuSG2V1vQUNsMfTFEnYyk41QmNpq1.jpg)


Going through the whole of this state, I have noticed that there are but a few tractor that engaged in cultivation of the land. Tractors 🚜 🚜 are heavy duty machine that would have done this job easily but there are only a few commercial tractors available for hire across the state and. Throughout the farming season,  it may be difficult to get one across to our farm to assist us with tilling the soil. The government hasn't done anything to boost agriculture in the state. If it were so they are meant to make available such machines for hire so that a lot of people can find it convenient to engage in farming . The hard labour around farming is what discourages people from engaging in agriculture as a career.


!

title.title: The Thai Chicken Basil by Nasi Kokoh BlokM
title.body:
>

Hello everyone..

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmS1EkMLq8raRGF1y39wJov6qTEnJBH9BHxbJmJKakFkjY/img_5864.jpg)



I haven't been to Blok M in a long time. The main reason is because it's so crowded. But if we have an appointment with friends, we usually prefer to go to Blok M because there are many things we can find there, including culinary delights. That's what happened a few days ago after Eid. My friend and I wanted to try a menu that was only available at the Blok M restaurant, so we had no choice but to go there. But unfortunately, the place still had a long queue so we had to turn back. We don't like waiting in line for too long.

------

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmWLhfQX9w1CREv69ZC9EbuUVoNNNDqrnexRcLGDaG3sY1/img_5868.jpg)

Not wanting to wait in line, my friend and I decided to find another restaurant that was quiet. We thought that since it was Eid al-Fitr, Jakarta would be quiet. In fact, the Blok M area of ​​Jakarta was incredibly crowded. It sapped my energy immediately. But since we were already there, we had no choice but to finish what we wanted: lunch.

After a long search, we finally found a restaurant whose menu caught our eye. I like dishes with vegetables, so we stopped at a restaurant called Nasi Kokoh.

------
<center>**The Thai Chicken Basil**</center>
-----
-------


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmd4vAtX2UQKM3bsPUzagiQXvKX8PPE4SHy5WdoEgH6h1C/img_5867.jpg)

There were so many menus displayed, I was interested in the Thai Basil Chicken Rice. The photo shown is very appetizing with sunny side up eggs, basil and ground chicken. That would make it easier for me to chew. As soon as it arrived, ah, my hunger immediately throbbed, I wanted to be immediately slaked with this menu.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYQLPjEtHb4r4iPgFb63sHQtXXg7eByYfrM7FuLFAHoNa/img_5869.jpeg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmeyqN6Kw6L5gBxwpi5LyggbYboSo4WvFxtgKSihfxC8or/img_5870.jpg)

It's a shame the basil was fried. Honestly, I'm not a fan of fried vegetables. I think it reduces their nutritional value. But since this isn't an everyday occurrence, willy nilly, I enjoyed the fried basil. It did make a difference.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmTShE2p4jrxfjuRKEyEWm9ShJWYQNakhMbgmMYSHCVS51/img_5871.jpg)

Also, this fried egg doesn't look like the fried eggs you're used to in restaurants. It's too dry. It actually tastes like my own fried egg. Hahaha.

**The Strawberry Matcha**
------

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmXCqyzVhoj7d7bdGbnHxJPhjN8fV7mPrLuyaHNTr2ziuz/img_5873.jpg)

This drink comes from a different restaurant, but it's located near Nasi Kokoh Resto. I didn't find any other interesting drinks there except for this Strawberry Matcha. It's a combination of strawberry juice and matcha. A combination that might confuse my kidneys, but oh well, they don't have any other juices available. So this became the best companion for my lunch this time.


What do you think?

-------

title.title: Unpaid Internships: An Organization's Pipeline to Free Labour
title.body: There are many ways in which young people are being exploited in our society today, but one of the most common is through unpaid internships. Ideally, internship programs are designed to equip students or young professionals with the mentorship and hands-on experience they need in their chosen fields, enabling them to transition or fit seamlessly into the corporate world. It serves as a bridge between the theoretical knowledge these young ones must have acquired in school and the practical expectations of working on real projects in a professional space. But many people still argue whether or not interns deserve any form of payment.

/> [**Image from unsplash**](https://unsplash.com/photos/a-group-of-people-sitting-around-a-white-table-dGfIJdxvTLY) The argument exists because a lot of us view internships as a form of exchange between the intern and the company, which is exactly a great way to look at it. Afterall, the benefits of internships are mutual for both parties. While the students are challenged to apply their skills to real-world projects, companies also benefit from their time, dedication, and fresh contributions. This is the exact reason a lot of people do not care if interns receive payment or not. However, when you take some time to examine the true nature of internships, it becomes clear how exploitative it is for organizations to operate on a zero-payment policy simply because interns are gaining experience with their help. First and foremost, a lot of internships run for six months, and during this period, Interns are expected to resume work daily at the same time as full-time staff. Their companies also require them to close at the same time. They are expected to be instrumental to the company's most important projects by coming up with ideas that will help grow the company and also speak positively about their experience on social platforms like LinkedIn, which helps promote the organization's reputation. So in reality, they are performing actual work, and thus, deserve some form of compensation. Supporting the idea that interns should not be paid makes it more difficult for individuals from poor homes to feel motivated or inspired to be exceptional at their work. It just encourages companies to remain dependent on free labour while downplaying the value of the work interns contribute to the workforce. Secondly, most interns learn by actively working. They are not spoon-fed as people are made to believe. Rather, they are assigned tasks alongside the regular staff and their work is later reviewed with feedback and corrections. This is a good reason interns should be duly compensated. I don't think that their pay should match that of full-time employees, but it should be enough to cover expenses such as transportation, feeding, and other basic necessities. For remote internships, I believe a stipend should be provided to cover the intern's data expenses and efforts.

/> [**Image from unsplash**](https://unsplash.com/photos/person-using-gray-laptop-computer-zMcBf-n6qrs) I understand that some organizations invest their resources in training interns, but seeing that many globally recognized companies still provide compensation regardless of the exposure, experience or credibility their big name gives to the intern, proves that payment for any work done is the right thing to do. I remember my friend who worked with an IT firm, and for the most part, he took on more responsibilities than an intern should. Often times, the senior staff passed down their extra work to him, expecting that he completed them in due time. He was also required to step in when a staff in his team was being lazy about a task, and he contributed one of the brightest ideas that led to the launch of the firm's digital product, which alone should be enough reason for interns to get paid. But he was only given an allowance for transportation in the course of six months and that proved how exploitative these systems can be. In conclusion, interns deserve to be paid for their time and effort because companies benefit heavily from their work. I mean, internships are not acts of charity neither can they be tagged as volunteering. The nature of the work simply proves that compensation is necessary. Besides, paying interns can also motivate them to produce better results, enable them support themselves without seeking additional jobs, and it increases the likelihood of them considering full-time roles within the organization, which in turn saves companies time and resources during future hiring processes. So, I strongly support that interns should be paid for the value they provide to organizations, alongside their contributions to workplace diversity and the development of a broader talent pool. * * *

title.title: Antonio Gades en la Habana(es/en)
title.body:
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZ9AZ9dUMkbyrWEadbfixgXjuLWycPFNb95eSQpgWYxhW/1777004038888.jpg)


VERSIÓN EN ESPAÑOL 

¡Hola!  

Saludos a todos en esta comunidad.

Cada vez que transito por el entorno de la plaza de la catedral en La Habana Vieja, me hago la misma interrogante: ¿por qué la escultura a tamaño natural del bailarín español Antonio Gades, modelada por el escultor cubano José Villa Soberón y fundida en bronce, no está ubicada en un lugar vinculado al baile o la danza en general?

Y estoy pensando en lugares bien emblemáticos de la ciudad en tal sentido, como por ejemplo, el Gran Teatro de La Habana Alicia Alonso (GTH).

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmfU2Aah9enkqzsNdPQM7CNa8auUacRcxQ3jxuJk7bfLyE/1777004246110.jpg)

La escultura es bastante realista, ya que está patinada con colores naturales, como hacían los griegos en la antigüedad clásica. De veras, parece un turista más recostado a una columna en el portal del Palacio Lombillo, en uno de los cuadrantes de la plaza de la catedral habanera.

Antonio Gades, además de ser un excelso bailarín de la música flamenca, fue un gran amigo de Cuba y de su proceso revolucionario, al que visitaba periódicamente con diferentes propósitos. Como el enamorado que siempre encuentra un pretexto para volver al reencuentro con su amada, que siempre lo espera pacientemente desde la lejanía.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmeKsi3UfoA59vfEWmH7wNAkCJ1G7XP9sEux7j3nPzToCS/1777004353540.jpg)

Hace años, cuando La Habana Vieja era un espacio densamente habitado por la masa itinerante de turistas, me hice un par de fotos junto a la estatua de este simbólico personaje de las tablas andaluzas. Fue prácticamente como una manera cubana de hacerme el turista, o para dejar solamente constancia de que estuve en ese lugar y no en otro.

Esta vez entré a la plaza por la parte del callejón del Chorro, y estaba totalmente desierta, vacía. Me dio la impresión de que era una fotografía de un tiempo congelado. Solo allá, recostado quietamente en una columna del Palacio Colonial del Conde de Lombillo, se veía la figura de bronce sin pulir del afamado bailarín, con su peculiar melena, su camisa metida por dentro del pantalón bien ceñido a la cintura y de patas acampanadas.

Me di a la tarea de observar una imagen fundida en bronce. Desde diferentes ángulos, descubrí que su mirada serena, pero escrutadora, pasa por encima del hombro del espectador como buscando algo en el ángulo de la plazoleta adoquinada donde se encuentran y se saludan la catedral y la calle Empedrado, muy cerca de la Bodeguita del Medio.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYvfV4VxSxm4wq3HH6QPdMvqGVfP9775rqSADe113qtXn/1777004427989.jpg)

Creo que este ambiente quizás es el que más prefería Antonio para disfrutar mejor de la estructura colonial y la arquitectura que dejaron como legado y memoria los de la madre patria en la isla. Saturado por el bullicio de las grandes ciudades europeas y de los teatros y plazas artísticas abarrotadas para verle bailar excepcionalmente, un poco de soledad en una mañana o en una tarde habanera podría ser bien relajante.

Sin embargo, más allá del romanticismo que puede sugerirnos un ambiente como ese, el rostro de gases refleja unas marcadas líneas de preocupación o de haber tenido algún tipo de desavenencia con alguien. Labios apretados y ceño fruncido, algo no estuvo bien.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmWhtb4CaRmmcD2eGaYpFRYps2NaSXyMW4yFas2MWrrEEm/1777004768565.jpg)

Contradicciones de la vida. Sobre el Gade de la plaza de la Catedral no se ha tejido ni to ni leyenda ni mito que haga que el público interactúe con él al Al Lenon del parque del Vedado no le dejan tranquilo los espejuelos, pero al bailarín español el bronce muestra la opacidad del bronce patinado por el paso del tiempo, la lluvia y el sereno.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmfVevXLn5vq3wbcwXR7MnXFz757MRfWZ6BNCJ96DqVgE3/1777004534166.jpg)

Es bueno que las plazas y calles de esta y otras ciudades acojan esculturas como estas que immortalizan el espíritu de quienes trascendieron en su momento en alguna esfera de la vida, lo que hace vivir al transeúnte la historia y la cultura de los pueblos.

Gracias por acompañarme en la visita a este personaje y nos vemos en la próxima oportunidad.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmeKsi3UfoA59vfEWmH7wNAkCJ1G7XP9sEux7j3nPzToCS/1777004613825.jpg)

ENGLISH VERSIÓN 

>Hello!  

>Greetings to everyone in this community.

>Every time I walk around the cathedral square in Old Havana, I ask myself the same question: why is the life-size sculpture of the Spanish dancer Antonio Gades, modeled by the Cuban sculptor José Villa Soberón and cast in bronze, not located in a place linked to dancing or dance in general?

>And I am thinking of very emblematic places in the city in this sense, such as, for example, the Gran Teatro de La Habana Alicia Alonso (GTH).

>The sculpture is quite realistic, since it is patinated with natural colors, as the Greeks did in classical antiquity. He really looks like just another tourist leaning against a column in the portal of the Lombillo Palace, in one of the quadrants of the Havana cathedral square.

>Antonio Gades, in addition to being an excellent dancer of flamenco music, was a great friend of Cuba and its revolutionary process, which he visited periodically for different purposes. Like the lover who always finds an excuse to return to the reunion with his beloved, who always waits patiently for him from afar.

>Years ago, when Old Havana was a space densely inhabited by the itinerant mass of tourists, I took a couple of photos next to the statue of this symbolic character from Andalusian scenes. It was practically like a Cuban way of pretending to be a tourist, or to only leave a record that I was in that place and not in another.

>This time I entered the square through the Chorro alley, and it was completely deserted, empty. It seemed to me that it was a photograph of frozen time. Only there, leaning quietly on a column of the Colonial Palace of the Count of Lombillo, could be seen the unpolished bronze figure of the famous dancer, with his peculiar mane of hair, his shirt tucked into his pants tightly fitted at the waist and with flared legs.

>I took on the task of observing an image cast in bronze. From different angles, I discovered that his serene but scrutinizing gaze passes over the viewer's shoulder as if searching for something in the corner of the cobbled square where the cathedral and Empedrado Street meet and greet each other, very close to the Bodeguita del Medio.

>I think that this environment is perhaps the one that Antonio preferred the most to better enjoy the colonial structure and architecture left as a legacy and memory by those of the mother country on the island. Saturated by the hustle and bustle of the big European cities and the theaters and artistic squares packed to see him dance exceptionally, a little solitude on a Havana morning or afternoon could be very relaxing.

>However, beyond the romanticism that an environment like that can suggest, the gaseous face reflects some marked lines of worry or having had some kind of disagreement with someone. Tight lips and frown, something was not right.

>Contradictions of life. On the Gade in the Cathedral Square, neither legend nor myth has been woven that makes the public interact with it. Al Lenon in Vedado Park is not left alone by the glasses, but for the Spanish dancer, the bronze shows the opacity of the bronze patinated by the passage of time, the rain and the night. 

I>t is good that the squares and streets of this and other cities host sculptures like these that immortalize the spirit of those who transcended in their time in some sphere of life, which makes the passer-by experience the history and culture of the people.

>Thank you for accompanying me on the visit to this character and we will see you at the next opportunity.
