title.title: The Sokonoi Tree: Healing, Strength… and a Lesson for Our Children
title.body: My awesome friends, have you heard about this wonderful medicinal tree. In our school, we recently planted a special tree.

/> Among the Maasai, it is known as the Sokonoi tree — a tree respected for its healing power. Our deputy, who comes from the Maasai community, shared something that stayed with me. He told us that this tree has long been used as traditional medicine, especially in fighting illnesses like malaria.

/> But beyond healing… It is also associated with strength. According to local knowledge, even animals that take it are said to become unusually bold — fearless, able to stand their ground without retreat.

/> Whether taken literally or as a powerful expression, one thing is clear: This tree represents courage. Scientifically, this tree is believed to be related to medicinal species such as Warburgia ugandensis (commonly known as the pepper-bark tree), known across East Africa for its strong medicinal properties.

/> And today, that meaning feels very real to us. Because in our school, some of our children are currently battling malaria. We see their weakness. We see their struggle. But we also see something else… Resilience. Like the Sokonoi tree, they continue to stand. They continue to fight. They continue to hope. But courage alone is not enough. Children need more than strength. They need: • Proper medication • Safe rest • A secure place to recover This is why our need for a dormitory has become urgent. When a child is sick, walking long distances is dangerous. Resting in unstable conditions slows healing. The Sokonoi tree reminds us of two things: Healing… and strength.

/>

But as a community, we believe we must go further.  
We must provide not just hope…  
But real support.  
If this story speaks to you, we invite you to stand with us.  
Because while nature gives us symbols of healing…  
It is people who make healing possible.  
What do you think is more powerful — courage alone, or courage supported by care?

#health #malaria #education #charity #africa

title.title: Aloo Tikki Recipe - India's Famous Street Food..
title.body:
____________________________________
# <center> Namaste 🇮🇳🙏🏻</center>
____________________________________


Hello Friends, How are you all ?? Wishing you all happy and prosperous life Ahead.

Today i would like to share the recipe of **Aloo Tikki Chaat** it is indian's famous Street Food, which is  made up potato patties or potato tikki with other chaat chutneys and spices. In this, chutney and spices are added according to a person's taste and flavor preferences. It is Delicious in taste as it is filled with sweet and sour chutney and spices. Making this chaat requires extensive preparation and is quite time-consuming. I only made it because I already had both chutneys ready. One thing is true: the joy found in street-side chaat isn't quite matched by the homemade version. Making aloo tikki usually requires a lot of time and ingredients, but I have shared a simple & Quickest recipe,  do try it as well & let me know how was it. 

![1000654529.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gargi/23wqw7PPpQMgN5hGv8iYF77V8Lyfc9WaTUBpzLmzKX5xZBETheShrDvfCEFyGre5TKoqp.jpg)



____________________________________
# <center> Timming 🕡</center>
____________________________________

|Preparation Time|10 Minutes|
|-|-|
|Cooking Time| 20 Minutes|
|Cuisine|Indian|
|Course|Street Food|
|Serving|2 Person|




____________________________________
# <center> Ingredients 📃</center>
____________________________________


• 5-6 Boiled Potatoes.
• ¼ Cup of White Peas.
• 2 tbsp of Green Chutney.
• 2 tbsp of tamarind Chutney.
• 2 tbsp of Curd.
• Pinch of Baking Soda.
• 2 tbsp of Cornflour.
• ½ tsp cumin powder.
• ½ tsp chilli powder.
• ½ tsp chaat masala.
• Salt to Taste.
• Mathri while Serving.


____________________________________
# <center> Process 👨🏻‍🍳</center>
____________________________________

![1000653701.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gargi/23wgMycGaeKkofrSo12qmqFRDbgHCufBwAg7dAed7R6i1dwv2iEqD4cqVu2QBp6yNpS6f.jpg)

Soak the peas overnight, then pressure cook them with baking soda and salt. After 5-6 whistles, check if they are soft and set them aside.

![1000625192.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gargi/23tmQYmRDDw5Dcc7aBB1VuMUwDniKjEc164d37KTmZVTFN7PZvRVFpJngnSU6cqbXojVg.jpg)

Take the boiled potato, you can use refrigerated Boiled potatoes , or you can boil fresh ones, but you must grate them to avoid lumps.



![1000653700.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gargi/23uQzddSisZnXpib8q9TBPKB8Eat3xNFDnGALAMJfuXhT18pAS8f85QmGAUfYV9Mp6jzh.jpg)

Now in a large bowl take  boiled and grated potato, add salt, Red chilli Powder & Corn Flour. Mix well making sure everything is well combined.

![1000625194.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gargi/23uQzpHLN47Nc1x8hgvkYmnvraE2dFsH2NDpXG12GN4UJSHnaLMsAXbPgmYsbc2mKeFmY.jpg)

To prepare the tikki, grease your hands with oil and pinch a ball-sized dough, shape in the patties, repeat the process with remaining material.

![1000625209.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gargi/23ynUoawhXnxtTv44He69wTTT8R5yfuAJDvhSxMm1pMxoZ18TAdBEemfGz6Qr8TwYzt7S.jpg)


Heat the oil in the kadai/ Pan. Now fry in hot oil, keeping the flame on medium.

![1000625210.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gargi/23vi4EbfQvrAwJnv9EppYE45v8ao7768zWCRo34J7rsqHwayR7DdCNjjyaKhoQs7aKx97.jpg)

Fry both the sides until they turn golden brown and crispy from both the sides.

____________________________________




![1000625198.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gargi/23xKxw6e43F5rZT8Pd4MX1A6j36sNtQqKS9eZ2sNAkKzEqevK8LyoMqCoLKt7gJxwgkD7.jpg)

Now to prepare the chaat, place the tikki onto the plate, crush it as shown in the picture.


![1000625189.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gargi/23zkta6bWyF7M72ZNHJ3tSFQGQTucg9894VRhqEiDCh94M2WS8iGb5hbGpiUAQ321PXT9.jpg)

Pour some white Matar/pea into it.


![1000625207.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gargi/23xAZpjWLiyhdtiFs7LkiYpCeMzw7UWYYWCupNHvnhevyJRFiKHPcoJNqkvAnj1zRfVvw.jpg)

Top with curd, green chutney, tamarind chutney, chaat masala.

![1000625199.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gargi/23wqpeqkeoGRUrxWAnpUicJKQUUnb6HzP4HkwJPac4qYSLvShuhTP2ivbC48K5DCG3MnP.jpg)

then Add salt and Red chilli powder, 

![1000625205.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gargi/23vi66zucaE8DjFZc6urW3iETNX4STd3Mu7t7gUNU7cQYo1h3tVcCpcGDhvDKxs5A3CwF.jpg)

Chaat Final preparation depends on a person’s individual taste; some like it sour while others like it sweet, so one can customize it according to their preference.


![1000625196.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gargi/23vsV3hSBtNNNsb1ZfhM1x56pnb8mRkjVF533SGW6Nno3iUHJRV214joqgaYhBWCTV5jq.jpg)

At the end, crush some mathri, add chopped onion(optional) and Garnish it with Green Coriander leaves.
____________________________________


It's Delicious and easy to cook recipe, try it. 'm sure you are gonna love it. Try this recipe and let me know how it is. For more indian cuisine stay connected to my blogs.

title.title: The Strait, The Ceasefire, and the Market's Embarrassing Optimism
title.body:
# MEMO: Re: The Strait, The Ceasefire, and the Market's Embarrassing Optimism

**TO:** Anyone still pricing in a peace deal  
**FROM:** Recent history  
**DATE:** April 24, 2026  
**RE:** You've been here before. You didn't learn anything.

---

Let's establish the facts as they actually exist, not as the S&P 500 briefly priced them on Wednesday.

Crude oil sat between $90 and $100 a barrel at midweek after spiking above $110 in early April when Iran's blockade of the Strait of Hormuz was at its most aggressive. Markets exhaled. Trump extended the ceasefire. The Nasdaq hit an all-time high. The Russell 2000 scored a new closing record. Everyone quietly concluded that the worst was over and rotated accordingly.

Then Thursday arrived. Asian equities opened lower overnight as it became clear that US-Iran talks were making little discernible progress, and the Strait — functionally — remained closed. Oil ticked back up. Software stocks imploded for unrelated reasons. The S&P gave back 0.41%. The Nasdaq shed 0.89% after touching yet another intraday record it couldn't hold.

This is the third time since late February that markets have run the same script: escalation panic, ceasefire euphoria, tentative normalization, fresh doubt. The price of Brent has essentially been a sentiment poll dressed up in commodity clothing. And the crowd keeps voting wrong.

---

Here is what markets appear to have decided is the base case: that a conflict involving the United States military, the Iranian Revolutionary Guard, the Strait of Hormuz — through which roughly 20% of global oil supply moves daily — and the active involvement of Pakistani diplomacy, Houthi missiles, and a US Navy blockade is a *temporary disruption*. A headwind. A \

as Barclays called it in a note, even as they acknowledged that crude would race past $100 a barrel if the strait closed for real.

The strait is *functionally closed right now*. It has been since the blockade intensified. Iran's foreign minister briefly declared it open on April 17, oil fell more than 10% in a day, markets popped. The declaration lasted approximately as long as it took for Tehran to walk it back.

There's a word for repricing a serious structural disruption as a transient one every time a ceasefire is announced. The word is not \

---

The historical parallel that keeps surfacing — and that nobody on the sell-side seems willing to press — is the tanker wars of the 1980s. From 1984 to 1988, Iraq and Iran attacked over 500 vessels in the Persian Gulf. The United States reflagged Kuwaiti tankers in 1987 and started escorting them through the gulf. Markets, after the initial shock, largely normalized. Oil didn't go to $200. The global economy bent without breaking.

The lesson most investors took from that episode: the Strait is always fine in the end.

The lesson they should have taken: the Strait was fine in the end *because the United States committed sustained naval power over four years*, took direct military casualties, and Iran was simultaneously being bled in a land war with Iraq and had no option but to eventually back down. The strategic context then was completely different from the strategic context now, and invoking it as precedent is lazy in a way that will eventually be expensive.

Right now, Iran has a \

government — Trump's own words on Wednesday, cited as justification for extending the ceasefire. A fractured government is not a government capable of delivering a durable agreement. It's a government that might agree to something Tuesday and have a different faction override it by Thursday. Which is roughly what's been happening on a fortnightly basis.

---

The Commodity Context analyst Rory Johnston — one of the few voices in this space who's been consistently precise rather than wishful — has been clear about the mechanics: even if the strait reopens tomorrow, the oil price relief would be immediate but partial. Supply chain bottlenecks, infrastructure damage, and production outages would keep Brent anchored in the $80–$90 range at best. There is no snap-back to $70 crude. That world is gone.

Markets are not pricing that. They are pricing a ceasefire that holds, a deal that gets done, and a return to something like normalcy by Q3. That's not analysis. That's hope wearing a Bloomberg terminal.

---

Meanwhile, Halliburton — the largest oilfield services company on earth, whose results are a direct readout of energy sector conditions — reported this week into a market that barely cared. United Rentals surged 23% after posting strong Q1 results and raising full-year guidance, which tells you where real capital expenditure is flowing: not into energy infrastructure bets, but into industrial and construction equipment rentals. Freeport-McMoRan printed revenues of $6.23 billion versus $5.73 billion a year ago, net income more than doubling to $881 million, and the stock fell 13%. Copper, the traditional proxy for industrial confidence, is apparently also just a headwind right now.

Bitcoin, for its part, has been sitting in the $77,000–$78,000 range all week with 58.1% BTC dominance and a Fear & Greed index at 46. The one asset explicitly designed to be indifferent to geopolitics is behaving exactly like every other risk asset — cautiously, without conviction, watching the same news feeds everyone else is watching. Some store of value.

---

What does a genuine resolution look like? The ceasefire expires. There is no extension. The US strikes Iranian infrastructure. Iran closes the strait for real, not functionally but legally and physically. Brent goes to $120. The Fed, which has been on hold while watching energy push core services inflation higher, suddenly faces a supply shock on top of a demand it can't read. Every earnings call guidance caveat from the past two weeks — ServiceNow's \

IBM's guidance freeze, Tesla's explicit warning of negative free cash flow — suddenly looks less like prudence and more like the opening paragraph of the actual story.

Or: a deal gets done. The strait reopens. Oil falls $15 in a week. Equities rip. Everyone declares the bottom was already in, forgets the three months of volatility, and buys the next dip.

The market is currently assigning high probability to the second scenario. It is doing so despite the ceasefire visibly fraying, despite Asian equities falling overnight on fresh talk-stalling reports, despite the fact that every extension of every ceasefire has come with a new caveat and a new deadline that then gets quietly missed.

History doesn't repeat. But it does send the same memo. Repeatedly. To people who filed the last one without reading it.

---

*Long crude. Short the consensus.*

title.title: HEALTHY ATTACHMENT RATHER THAN POSITIVE ADDICTION
title.body:
![images (2) (5).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/henrietta27/23xehwuSnsc2mgPBY7FrqBsEP2MfirLnQGKriWtUqnMXVzPv8DXb1czrUu6MhDehMAJT5.jpeg)
[SOURCE](https://www.pexels.com/search/drug%20addiction/) 

Is there really something like good addiction, are we sure that it is not this addiction that becomes something we cannot control in the long run. Instead of calling it a positive addiction I would love to see it as a better way to live healthy and to consistently improve our life in different methods. The word addiction just seems off but for the purpose of this prompt I would love to explain the various ways that doing some things in healthy manner can go a long way to improve your well-being. 

In this case, positive addiction can mean building meaningful relationships with people family or Friends, learning to become a better person in the present world or in the future, exercising so as to be healthy and to keep Fit, excelling in your career path, turning vegetarian so as to avoid the hospital and to be healthy, consistently leaving your life in a manner that pleases you. 

While I would love to turn it as a healthy attachment is because we all know addiction to be something that is negative such that it has been used to classify vices like hard drugs, sexual excapades, killing, stealing etc. The thing about addiction is that it is not a good thing because when you say you are addicted to something it means that thing has the power to control you as a per and you could feel lost with it. 

For instance, people who are addicted to drug at first can say that they were positively drawn to it because it can make them forget their worries and depression at that moment. However something that is supposed to help them at that moment becomes a thing that they cannot relegate to the background but keep coming back to. The fact that they have been deeply invested in this compulsive behavior has made a difficult for them to take their hands of its. 

In conclusion, it is worthy to Note that even healthy attachments can become a problem if you do too much. Take for instance, workaholics did not just happen in a day but it is something that happened when you become obsessed with working hard to achieve your life goes that you forget about other important and necessary aspects of life. 

This is my participation in the @hive-reachout community weekly contest, to join in check through this platform [link](https://peakd.com/hive-178437/@hive-reachout/hivereachout-weekly-prompt-96good-addiction-6ys) 
>For this prompt, tell me what you think about good addiction. Do you think there is a time we can say we are addicted to something positively?
If “yes,” how does one navigate that path in order to avoid going extreme?

Thanks for stopping by my blog...

title.title: Metal Eden on PS5 (this is Temu \
title.body: Yet another game that I probably wouldn't have heard of if it wasn't for my PS-Plus membership *Metal Eden* looked like something I might have a chance at enjoying, but the \

and the 3.5 or so out of 5 that it has on the PS Network were kind of letting me know what I already ended up feeling like after about an hour of playing this.

<center> https://image.api.playstation.com/vulcan/ap/rnd/202501/1516/5a59526a26d03ce67695c0856e6816a0e9a5f5e0127e4868.png
[src](https://image.api.playstation.com/vulcan/ap/rnd/202501/1516/5a59526a26d03ce67695c0856e6816a0e9a5f5e0127e4868.png)</center>

It's a first person shooter (FPS) with really fast gameplay, a kick ass soundtrack that never stops, and a sort of feeling like the waves of enemies are going to keep coming.  You have finishers, multiple weapons, and another ability that you can use so infrequently that it is just annoying that it is part of the combat.  

I didn't get far enough in the story for this to be the case, but this special ability is called \

and if at some point later in the game it is required in order to defeat something that would be super annoying because it has a rather long cooldown and this becomes even more annoying when things are constantly chasing you and certain trash mobs (that can still hurt you) seem to respawn endlessly until you kill whatever the main baddy in the room happens to be.

<center> https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/QpqSJdSFu6WAuumftkZonK.png
[src](https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/QpqSJdSFu6WAuumftkZonK.png)</center>

combat is fast and furious and you do fly around a lot.  You have a bit more mobility than you would in the one game that it seems *extremely similar* to and that isn't necessarily a good thing.  If you were playing on a PC and had the quick look capabilities that a mouse provides, perhaps the experience would have been better but between the flying all over the place, having enemies spawning from all over the place, and the fact hat you have to look around as well as aim with some level of precision makes me feel as though they tried to bite off a bit more than you can chew with this one, especially on a console. 

<center>   
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/whoisjohn/23w2esvkPZcpoB7EXxue6U9nywiBvUGsLPcr49KgaUkCQthhM21m5kb1PBwh2wnpAppcb.png)
[src](https://i0.wp.com/paulsemel.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/10/Metal-Eden-wall-run.jpg?resize=580%2C326&ssl=1)</center>

There is also quite a lot of wall-running and this seemed basically directly lifted from *Titanfall.*  I understand that these days it is probably extremely difficult to come up with a truly unique idea, not everyone is going to successfully come up with the newest hot thing or randomly hit it big by doing something crazy like make a dark RPG that centers around fishing, but some games, like this one, seems as though they were just a copy of a copy of a copy.

Everyone loves Doom it seems, but even Doom fans get tired of Doom so when you release a game that is essentially exactly the same thing as Doom but somehow more complicated, it's going to be a tough sell.

I wanted to like this because, and this will make me sound like a gaming pussy, modern *Doom* games are too tough for me haha.

I kind of enjoyed this for an hour or so, but then I found myself at a certain point where I was struggling with the aiming and movement at the same time and I just kind of got pissed off and said to myself \

Parts of it started being rather repetitive too due to lack of enemy variety, and this was very early on in the game.   I don't really even feel like I explored the level of weaponry that is available in the game and after 90 minutes or so, I no longer wanted to.  
<center> 
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/whoisjohn/23tv8RXX5aABLCuNvKn2pZAk5bLaitZgcYvoXenkRwkET6qZM8aEWvoHWYERULetXyNvn.png)
[src](https://i0.wp.com/paulsemel.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/10/Metal-Eden-01.jpg?resize=580%2C326&ssl=1)
<sub> getting Naruto'd is funny though, I will give them that </sub> </center> 


The enemies chasing you are pretty relentless and unless this changes later I didn't feel like your LOS (line of sight) was very good either.  This gets even more complicated when you consider that often the enemies could be above or below you and they don't appear to have the same issues that you do as far as tracking is concerned.   

While I didn't play long enough to truly know, the AI on the lessor mobs seemed relatively retarded as well.  If you had a platform that you can jump to, they just run endlessly into the wall even though there is a ramp on the other side.  It's funny until you realize that this is just quite bad programming.  

I don't think the difficulty balance is done very well either because they hit you up with some truly tough situations including the need to maneuver around some wall jumps that if mistimed will kill you, all while being fired upon from multiple sides.  Apparently you can slow down time to fire easier kind of like a lot of other games and if I am not mistaken this first came into being with *Max Payne*. 

<center> https://www.ps4blog.net/wp-content/uploads/2025/02/METAL-EDEN-1-R.jpg
[src](https://www.ps4blog.net/wp-content/uploads/2025/02/METAL-EDEN-1-R.jpg)</center>

In my opinion as a moderately talented but still casual gamer, this was too complicated and fast-paced to be entertaining, it was just kind of frustrating to play and the fact that it is a near direct ripoff of *Doom* makes it even more annoying.  I already have *Doom* so if I want to play *Doom* I will just go ahead and do that. 

How was your experience with this title?  Do you agree with me?  Am I an idiot noob that needs to \

title.title: Challenge #04863 -M114: Love of Perfection
title.body:
![rachel-kelli-EIYA7E626Xk-unsplash.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/internutter/23t86HE9om25GiwuF8GbXBE1VUdwBcHoiSmPF5BVkCv9E5o7egQSLk6A4FUc8zdHTqytb.jpg)

> A skilled Sculptor has created a beauteous statue of a woman. It is so beauteous that the sculptor has fallen in love with her. And so the Sculptor implores the Gods to bring her to life so that she might become the Sculptor’s wife. Boons from the Gods always come with a price, especially ones reflecting love. And it may be that the Beauteous woman will wish to sculpt the Sculptor into her vision of an ideally aesthetic form… -- [Deathshead419](https://internutter.org/bb/user/deathshead419)

Long has the story been told of an artist who made the perfect woman from marble...

Hogdudika could see her before he put chisel to marble. A vision of beauty that could plausibly make the gods envious. Perfect proportions, perfect grace, and perfect white skin. All he had to do was knock away all the marble that wasn't her.

Avery artist puts a piece of themselves in their work, and this was no different.

Hogdudika put in hours of devotion to the ideal female form. Every strand of hair. Every curve of her body, the way gravity could have worked on it if she were flesh instead of stone. He put her hair into a perfect style. He made her breasts the perfect shape and size. He formed her body to portray the perfect amount of body fat and muscle.

He devoted weeks to her wrists. Dedicated hours of daylight to each fingernail. Put months into the finest details of buttock, thigh, and pubis.

When he was done, she looked ready to take a breath and step off the plinth on which she stood. Alas, she was still stone. Cold, hard, silent, and unmoving.

His work was finished. She was perfect. Yet he was not done. He had spent so much of himself on her, he could not let her go. He gave her a name - Madara, and set her into the main chamber of his house. He spoke to her. Clothed her. Ate and drank while he could see her.

Like many creators, he had fallen in love with his creation.

He began to shun his bed, setting his pillow by her feet. When he woke up with neighbourhood street dogs licking his face and nibbling his extremities, that was when he knew something had to be done.

Those who had magic could turn flesh to stone or skin to bark, but could not do the reverse. They could not place life into lifeless stone.

\
\n\nSo Hogdudika turned to the gods. He took Madara carefully to the temple of Meridia, the mother moon goddess of love. \

He prayed in that manner until the Mother Moon rose high to shine down on the both of them.

A whisper came to Hogdudika's ears. _There will be a price to pay._

\

_Done and done,_ said the voice. A soft cracking noise heralded the emergence of a milk-pale woman from a thin shell of marble. Madara stepped down from her plinth, her pallor growing the blush of life.

Hogdudika was so happy that he didn't notice that the goddess had turned his body into clay.

\
she said. Her voice, of course, was perfect. \

Her shaping touch hurt, but doesn't all love?

title.title: How I Came to Love Birds in Germany / 自然が身近なドイツで鳥を好きになった話
title.body:
![1A19BD0F-C139-4C40-A2BE-F3128EC2C2DD_1_201_a.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/akipponn/EoCjWCruoQr57R7RhvH1vYGjHDQAUKivEAN2D3QTRx9s5NLe1MgQDyMoZmhirx6pTkw.jpeg)

Because of my child and Germany, I came to like birds.

My mother didn’t really like birds. It seems the reason was that they would leave a lot of droppings on the street and on the balcony. She also often said things like, “They carry germs.” Maybe because of that influence, I didn’t have any particular feelings about birds myself. I didn’t dislike them, but I didn’t especially like them either.

But after coming to Germany, that distance gradually started to change. I began living in an environment where nature feels much closer than when I was growing up in Tokyo. Especially after my child was born, I started learning more and more about nature together with them.

One day, when my child is still a toddler, I bought some bread and went out for a walk with her. We sat on a bench in a park and ate the bread. She dropped some crumbs. Birds gathered to eat them, and she became completely fascinated by the scene. As a side note, I still remember the name of the bread my child chose — “drei Käse hoch” (literally “three cheeses high,” meaning a little kid or mischievous small one). That bread is still sold at the same bakery, and whenever I see it, it reminds me of those days.

After that, as I gradually learned about birds together with my child, I realized that I had come to like them too. I feel comforted watching robins and great tits visiting our garden and balcony — “so cute, so round 😆” From the balcony, we can also see a tree where a woodpecker made a nest, and we watch small birds going in and out of it together. In winter, we hang bird food on the balcony and look forward to the birds coming.

Looking back, it feels like I unexpectedly discovered a new joy in life. I’m grateful for life in Germany and for my child. I wish I could have shown these lovely birds in Germany to my mother.

This growing love for birds has even led to something new: next month, I’m planning to offer a workshop at a Naturmarkt in a town called Augustusburg, in the same state. I’ll be making mobiles and accessories using leftover materials from a makerspace. The prototype has turned out quite nicely, and I hope to refine it over the next three weeks 😊

[https://www.instagram.com/p/DXbrw1TDQv1/](https://www.instagram.com/p/DXbrw1TDQv1/)

To make this drawing, I will be using digital tools, in my case Ibis Paint, but you can use any other tool or traditional materials. Just remember to make the sketch clear enough so that you can erase it when coloring. > Hola, hoy les comparto mi tutorial del elemental de aire. Ya este sería el último de los cuatro elementales; hemos dibujado el elemental de fuego, de tierra y de agua. Hoy es el turno del elemental del aire, y estaremos usando el mismo estilo simple y kawaii. title.title: Beautiful views along the way (Eng/Esp)
title.body:
> I took advantage of the fact that I had some free time after running an errand and stopped to watch the bus make its way through the eastern part of Cumana. The state capital has undoubtedly expanded into its outlying areas, and in this case, I was traveling from the community of The Peñon toward the city center.
![1000110002.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/saavedraa/245HcnGJyQBFG95BmNX4LTgkzWgqZJSZDr5c8Hyu32De4sVAbb8PaCfL6vXR2iyUZBaMU.jpg)
![1000109996.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/saavedraa/244e6CkKNv8nP1gEsDfsjyBypfQRYpXDasFSZS3w4m8kfi9v2mPRGpeuE478YEcJ2MWce.jpg)
I took the opportunity to snap a few photos. From this vantage point, you can see the hill, which rises approximately 169 meters above sea level, according to various sources found online. These rock formations have always intrigued me because, according to historical records, they were submerged in the sea during the colonial era. The Villa Cristobal Colon neighborhood, known simply as La Villa, is the first thing you come across, along with Plaza Gualberto Ibarreto; this area is very picturesque. Driving along Carúpano Avenue, we pass two shopping centers, both partially open. San Pedro signals that we are near the The Peñon interchange, which has a road leading to the former Toyota plant and also to the airport.
![1000109990.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/saavedraa/244oSfqixmarh5QY18aQWpkdEkzPCMrM3DYQ1MPVM2YxHk82SPTyzXmbCfHpFGsPqZmKr.jpg)
![1000110005.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/saavedraa/243q8XeDQmxN2wUz4nQBPLnW3VnidW4MeoJiKXkfUijyekqvYVecPV4f1xLn6fVgrL19m.jpg)
But since our destination is downtown, we continue on the same road. Soon we pass the Punta del Este Clinic, also known as Venesalud, followed by the Ipasme headquarters, the entrance to the Gran Mariscal neighborhood, the courthouse, and the CICPC headquarters, while across the street you can see the large Makro store and the Tourist Inn. From here, we enter the popular Caigüire neighborhood, where landmarks such as the stadium and the Antonio José de Sucre military district immediately come into view. At this point, Carupano Avenue is lined with shops on both sides, including a gas station that is usually crowded.
![1000109978.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/saavedraa/245caaJYprrTnNa6o3fuejsBp8DoF9Rre9zBapZMvNAPstzNLiBLGheim2qf7wzXTeqTn.jpg)
![1000110039.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/saavedraa/23rB5SY4N5bMxtkuDuUCWeNHw2eCVCSVxnUhkkT3UjL5UbdYkbZiUH8kv6PVrp8scTTHk.jpg)
![1000109975.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/saavedraa/242Y1gkoB5sEMFXhPBUzjxDJGAp2E42G1oyRpNNYqR3MH7Hwp8U5Jz7TBFs7njmXSzrAJ.jpg)
Salvador Allende Square, located across from the clinic of the same name, marks the point where Carupano Avenue forks: one road connects to Perimetral Avenue, which runs along the beach, and the other to Gran Mariscal Avenue. We continue along the latter, and I notice the La Inmaculada School; next comes the former headquarters of the University of Oriente’s rector’s office, the Santa Ana Church, and another very busy gas station.
![1000110047.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/saavedraa/245T9tjYeQj61bBW16kMYTLvLKXndFFeuXovuCjdfq95m3PwizZrVUa8VKcXWtXzLGd5Q.jpg)
![1000110040.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/saavedraa/23rz2bCFJiecoFEFJTnrgvLTS4xLrzrpSQjSNE4WmuLE2RLmAxcMyXPPfoEMdm83qfriQ.jpg)
![1000110046.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/saavedraa/23rB5eb2uvN5j4sCf48e4HpkvTFNBpsgs4N5dugkFzB5Uo723Bpn2v12A2L78KX6iCKky.jpg)
Jose Marti Square signals that I am near my destination; from here, you can access the Antonio Patricio de Alcala Hospital, another landmark on this route. The Gran Avenida Shopping Center marks the end of the avenue and the beginning of Bompland Street; from there, we head toward La Copita and emerge onto Montes Street, where the CANTV headquarters and the Antonio José de Sucre High School are located; we arrive at the center of Cumana. *** ***
## Versión en Español

> Aproveché que tras realizar una diligencia me quedó algo de tiempo libre y me detuve a contemplar el recorrido que hacia el autobús por la parte Este de Cumaná, sin duda la capital del estado ha crecido en sus zonas limitrofes y en este caso voy desplazándome desde la comunidad de El Peñón hacia el centro de la ciudad.
![1000110002.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/saavedraa/245HcnGJyQBFG95BmNX4LTgkzWgqZJSZDr5c8Hyu32De4sVAbb8PaCfL6vXR2iyUZBaMU.jpg)
![1000109996.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/saavedraa/244e6CkKNv8nP1gEsDfsjyBypfQRYpXDasFSZS3w4m8kfi9v2mPRGpeuE478YEcJ2MWce.jpg)
Aproveché la ocasión para tomar unas cuantas fotografías. Desde esta posición se puede observar el cerro, el cual tiene una elevación de aproximadamente 169 metros sobre el nivel del mar, según diferentes datos encontrados en internet. Siempre me ha llamado la atención estas formaciones rococas porque, según registros históricos, estaban sumergidas en el mar durante la época colonial. La urbanización Villa Cristóbal Colón, conocida simplemente como La Villa, es lo primero que aparece, además de la Plaza Gualberto Ibarreto, esta parte es muy pintoresca. Circulando por la avenida Carúpano pasamos por dos centros comerciales, ambos funcionando parcialmente, el San Pedro nos anticipa que estamos cerca del distribuidor El Peñón, el cual tiene una vía que comunica hacia la planta donde funcionaba la Toyota y también con el aeropuerto.
![1000109990.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/saavedraa/244oSfqixmarh5QY18aQWpkdEkzPCMrM3DYQ1MPVM2YxHk82SPTyzXmbCfHpFGsPqZmKr.jpg)
![1000110005.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/saavedraa/243q8XeDQmxN2wUz4nQBPLnW3VnidW4MeoJiKXkfUijyekqvYVecPV4f1xLn6fVgrL19m.jpg)
Pero como el destino es el centro, seguimos por la misma vía, pronto pasamos por la Clínica Punta del Este, también conocida como Venesalud, luego viene la sede del Ipasme, la entrada a la urbanización Gran Mariscal, los tribunales y la sede del CICPC, en tanto al frente se pueden distinguir la gran tienda Makro y el Parador Turístico. A partir de acá entramos al popular sector de Caigüire, referentes como el estadio y la circunscripción militar Antonio José de Sucre, aparecen de inmediato. En este punto, la avenida Carúpano deja ver locales comerciales de ambos lados, incluyendo una bomba de gasolina que por lo regular permanece congestionada.
![1000109978.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/saavedraa/245caaJYprrTnNa6o3fuejsBp8DoF9Rre9zBapZMvNAPstzNLiBLGheim2qf7wzXTeqTn.jpg)
![1000110039.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/saavedraa/23rB5SY4N5bMxtkuDuUCWeNHw2eCVCSVxnUhkkT3UjL5UbdYkbZiUH8kv6PVrp8scTTHk.jpg)
![1000109975.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/saavedraa/242Y1gkoB5sEMFXhPBUzjxDJGAp2E42G1oyRpNNYqR3MH7Hwp8U5Jz7TBFs7njmXSzrAJ.jpg)
La plaza Salvador Allende, ubicada frente al ambulatorio del mismo nombre, es la señal de que la avenida Carúpano se bifurca, una vía comunica con la avenida Perimetral, que va por la playa, y la otra con la Gran Mariscal. Seguimos el rumbo por esta última y observo la Unidad Educativa La Inmaculada, luego viene la antigua sede del rectorado de la Universidad de Oriente, la iglesia Santa Ana y otra bomba de gasolina muy concurrida.
![1000110047.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/saavedraa/245T9tjYeQj61bBW16kMYTLvLKXndFFeuXovuCjdfq95m3PwizZrVUa8VKcXWtXzLGd5Q.jpg)
![1000110040.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/saavedraa/23rz2bCFJiecoFEFJTnrgvLTS4xLrzrpSQjSNE4WmuLE2RLmAxcMyXPPfoEMdm83qfriQ.jpg)
![1000110046.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/saavedraa/23rB5eb2uvN5j4sCf48e4HpkvTFNBpsgs4N5dugkFzB5Uo723Bpn2v12A2L78KX6iCKky.jpg)
La plaza José Martí anticipa que estoy cerca de mi destino, por acá se accede al Hospital Antonio Patricio de Alcalá, otro sitio referencial en este recorrido, el Centro Comercial Gran Avenida anuncia el fin de la avenida y el inicio de la calle Bompland, de allí vamos rumbo a La Copita y desembocamos en la Calle Montes, donde está la sede de CANTV y el Liceo Antonio José de Sucre, llegamos al centro de Cumaná.   *** *** ✓Photos from my personal gallery, edited with Fotocollage. ✓Text translated with DeepL.

## 🔴 Clear Mind, Clear Direction

Lately I’ve been learning something important…  
not everything has to be complicated to work.

Sometimes it’s just about being consistent.

Showing up.  
Posting anyway.  
Answering messages even when I don’t feel like it.  
Trying again when something doesn’t sell.

Selling online has made me more disciplined than I ever thought I could be. It’s not about motivation anymore, it’s about direction.

I know where I’m going.  
Maybe I’m not there yet… but I’m moving.

And honestly, that’s what matters most.

Because every small action today is building the freedom I want tomorrow.

No shortcuts.  
Just real progress.

title.title: My third event
title.body:
Hi, guys!

Today is my third event, and I'm running out of things to be nervous about; my nervous system has completely shut down. So I'm at the point where I just want it all to be over so I can go home to pack up my bookcase and finally arrange my books, which have been sitting practically in the middle of the room for over a month now.

V. Last time, they delivered the wrong bookcase, and I had to wait another three weeks for a replacement. I hope it's okay this time. So today, my husband and I are heading to the festival first, and then home to pack up my new piece of furniture. Tomorrow will likely be a busy day of filming, because I've started to accumulate a backlog of things I've read but not filmed, and I don't like that trend.

I have two events, and it's good that they're happening right after each other; I won't have to wait; I can move straight from one to the other. So I'm determined to finish everything quickly and then head home. The weather is actually so terrible that I don't want to go anywhere at all, but everything was agreed upon a month before the festival.

I hope everything goes well and I'll definitely be invited to the next one. In fact, I hope that by the next festival, I'll be participating in events for more publishing houses; I really want to believe that.

So, the important thing today is that everything goes well. Wish me luck.

Have a great day, everyone!

title.title: No Such Thing As Good Addiction.
title.body: Talking about addiction, I can't say there's something like a \
* The fact that it already carries the name *\

* speaks a lot. Addiction in very simple terms is when something controls you, when you're in control of a thing that you do, then that's addiction. 





![1000971021.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marsdave/23tGXZL9dKEs7J62jHCq1eVCaMyWJ2FnSG2pKWfKjwaD34ADVcUKczpWnkfBvWf9WaWs4.png)





When you're doing something and you're so in it to an extent that you find it hard to stop, even when it's doing you a lot of harm. That's what we refer to as addiction, because it has gone out of hand and you've lost control over it.




The word addiction in itself carries weight, carries everything relating to harm, so there can't be anything good about what we refer to as an addiction. And we all know that addictions can be different. Addiction can affect us and different things that pertain to us, talk of health, relationships, mind, finance, goal and a lot of things.



![1000971020.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marsdave/23vsJF7gq1tGwXFV4CvGwaSrY3RhzwVQwAc5u5Qx5YGy17W63m61pfzG1VTzxmhY29rac.png)


And most of these things that later turn out to be addictions don't just turn out to be like that, they start from the little things, things we see as small and enjoyable. But along the line, they grow and began to demand more from us. And because they are already an addiction, something we've lost control over, we're unable to stop.






Now, most of the things that grew into addictions are habits. That is where the good and bad comes in, there are good habits and there are bad habits, but when a good habit grows into becoming an addiction then there's absolutely nothing good about it anymore. But when our habits are under control we can decide to stop, start, continue, or pause at anytime. Meaning it is not an addiction then and very much under control.


![1000971019.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marsdave/23swe9iiPiLokHdYJL6d59rQZb1AzSbnW7VTBB92Gyg5D2cuPS6yVAQMXazGNtN8nkaTv.png)



So, I don't think there's anything like a good addiction, the fact that the word addiction can now be used to describe such a thing already means the person involved has lost control over such habit. Maybe it would have been something like passion, something we have a strong passion for, but even if it's that, we will have control over it.



In conclusion, we should try as much as possible to build very healthy habits and make sure it does not turn into excesses thereby making us lose control over it. We can do things, enjoy, be passionate and such, but  not that we will lose control of such a thing.

```markdown
# 探索四季的魅力

自然界的四季变化为我们提供了无尽的灵感和美丽的景观。在这篇博客中，我们将深入探讨春、夏、秋、冬四个季节的独特魅力以及它们对我们生活的影响。

## 春天：万物复苏的季节

春天是新生的象征，随着温暖的阳光回归，大地开始复苏。树木吐芽，花朵竞相开放，整个世界都被生机勃勃的气息所包围。

- **特色景观**：樱花、郁金香、桃花
- **活动推荐**：春游、赏花、植树

## 夏天：阳光与活力的季节

夏天是热情洋溢的季节，阳光普照，万物繁茂。人们喜欢在海滩上嬉戏，享受户外活动。

- **特色景观**：海滩、绿树成荫的公园
- **活动推荐**：露营、游泳、烧烤

## 秋天：丰收与色彩的季节

秋天是收获的季节，树叶变换色彩，呈现出迷人的金黄和火红。这个季节充满了丰收的喜悦。

- **特色景观**：金色稻田、红叶林
- **活动推荐**：采摘水果、秋游、观叶

## 冬天：静谧与温暖的季节

冬天带来了寒冷的气息，但也有温暖的节日气氛。雪花飘落，世界变得银装素裹。

- **特色景观**：雪山、冰冻湖面
- **活动推荐**：滑雪、堆雪人、温泉

## 结语

四季的变化让我们感受到自然的奇妙与生命的轮回。无论是春天的生机，夏天的热情，秋天的丰收，还是冬天的静谧，每个季节都有其独特的魅力。让我们珍惜每一个季节，享受自然带来的美好体验。

---

希望这个主题能激发你的创作灵感！欢迎在评论区分享你对四季的看法和体验。
```

title.body: Ох, ми вчора не зважаючи на погоду, поїхали дивитись ділянку за 30-40 хвилин від нас. І прямо коли ми відкрили двері автівки, то я відчула насичене свіже повітря, і сказала, ось таким має бути запах. Думаю, що тепер вже купимо, сподіваюсь, що на днях. Далеченько трохи для дачі 25 км (ми і на майбутнє підбираємо, щоб коли дитина школу закінчить, то там вже був капітальний будинок), але ж я постійно порівнюю з тим, які відстані у маленькому містечку, і тут 30 хвилин до \
- це дуже багато. А коли я жила в Києві, то зазвичай за 30-40 хвилин відстані (відстань вимірюється в годинах і хвилинах :) ) знаходила собі роботу або домівку.

title.title: Spicy Mayo Dim Sum
title.body:
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmcS6FbVrSpeHYhEB7Yq8cUBmJip3PsgXTbXw3eCXo9Tmk/1777003217575.png)

Hi bloggers and food lovers! How are you all? I hope you’re all doing well. It’s been a while since I made this dish, Dim Sum. It’s a favorite of my whole family, and this time I made it again at my younger sister’s request. This dim sum is extra special because I topped it with spicy mayo sauce and torch them. Alright, let’s get started

**Ingredients:**

- dim sum wrappers
- 800 grams chicken breast fillet
- 250 grams shrimp
- 5 tbsp tapioca starch
- 2 scallions
- 1 egg
- 3 cloves garlic
- white pepper
- garlic powder
- 1 tbsp sesame oil
- 1 tsp oyster sauce
- 1 tsp salt
- 1/2 tsp sugar

**Instructions:**

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmWn8kv7cng1aBafxfQo4LkG22PWRFueVjA9Tum2sCdxny/1777003287116.jpg)

- Place the frozen chicken fillets into a food processor

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmNf6TV716pahTmy5B9YCvU7HqNLhSQtwV8V2MDEDfoWrP/1777003300070.jpg)

- Add the oyster sauce, white pepper, garlic powder, sesame oil, sugar, and salt

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmf7XWcTyhcT7oLxhW4wtqLPr8FuzUzUn2EAmQjDd2wHCj/1777003329575.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmTthq6ok8kUCpWik1dnhFtXkVn5dTfW3j5zwrCWQp9L4D/1777003329837.jpg)

- Process until smooth with chopper

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYdWZAekcr2Jq7ERFaC728tbQGj3XXQ8bKFuJCWvzXCWQ/1777003354357.jpg)

- Add chopped green onions and crack an egg into the mixture

- Process briefly

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmS5khAdoskMzpmr8VUFy5PEdvosc79yz3Lg8L36up12Kr/1777003378456.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmSfbVbeMnczahANkrWNoY8iBBCUnQFV2JGd8Pfkd74BQQ/1777003427497.jpg)

- Add shrimp and process briefly again—don’t over-process

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmcMXjyv2XYiBpjvWG7HxVEVj5QKn55FAqhjEVDaBB4tch/1777003440184.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmY2L4jyZtck9zZkSEcAGzcT7Wq4ihQStM3Fhw5fYJnQT4/1777003454407.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmd7w4nngF25wxMNos23xwSz9fkZjm8gxZCMZZnJpx6zc1/1777003454679.jpg)

- Add tapioca flour until the mixture thickens

- Prepare the dim sum wrappers

- Lightly brush water on top

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmU2RteJMmU5tDbYTjXq5EyLF8YjmyfGsrd5woDFYog3vo/1777003472574.jpg)

- Place the dim sum filling on the wrapper

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQV7xwULzqa64JfAZ3JsPAUnxRCtTSQHsAtYZKCRkBmoa/1777003507596.jpg)

- Shape the dim sum

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmaDs59nrsbLHGxvkaQGf614hjpfg6qW2TjHy7YTeXjtcN/1777003522164.jpg)

- Repeat until all the mixture is used up

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmPudoqdjMJuAovf7KQzPvRKkUsKvqxi7eq5KEamTL6Gto/1777003544194.jpg)

- Steam the dim sum in a steamer that has been brushed with sesame oil

- Steam the dim sum for 30 minutes

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmPYdX6frNPFD2Kk3bvtgzz31VMkHSAvVcJdoZvVVZcoo2/1777003560565.jpg)

- Top the dim sum with spicy mayo sauce

- Briefly torch until fragrant

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYF2eutpmN9j1NngTA6WEyhRQ6K7YLn8YC6eRTZarUieB/1777003586372.jpg)

- Sprinkle aonori on top

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmUQeBLJhQaBJ5ZdQdmtKtWFXeHpQjcFPGdb9N3mMGA16F/1777003615418.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmc33672mA59yRRkdjNFv2ijtDSCJbpHuikhjE2QZdSLWM/1777003616043.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmX8PFyeBn2sWpXq17iY3GH5FQfWXu8axGdkjnhkDNKgNh/1777003616205.jpg)

- Spicy mayo dim sum are ready to eat

title.title: 大锅熬菜
title.body:
<liketuimages>
<center>
![FgKeMtcQYWSI1aq7_4.webp](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/huigezi/images/FgKeMtcQYWSI1aq7_4/FgKeMtcQYWSI1aq7_4.webp)
![5PNPYGkDDtFhZzeu_3.webp](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/huigezi/images/5PNPYGkDDtFhZzeu_3/5PNPYGkDDtFhZzeu_3.webp)
![jBIOFU8ll6MuvIYS_2.webp](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/huigezi/images/jBIOFU8ll6MuvIYS_2/jBIOFU8ll6MuvIYS_2.webp)
![TEALJQy4HyBNWJpz_1.webp](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/huigezi/images/TEALJQy4HyBNWJpz_1/TEALJQy4HyBNWJpz_1.webp)
</center>
</liketuimages>

一个人在店铺，有锅碗瓢盆，就是不想做饭，每次都做的多，一个人吃不完，又不舍得扔，就是矛盾，买食材也花不少钱，一个人总是想凑合凑合，也做饭做腻味了，换换口味，就想这去吃常去的那家大锅熬菜兼早餐的店铺，去吃午饭大锅熬菜吧。

结果高高兴兴的过去，发现这个店铺倒闭了，听说是生意不好，其实价位不高，10块钱随便吃，河南人饭量大，一般都吃很多，想想也是，我都快一年没有来她这个店铺吃饭了，过完年以后，大多数人都出去打工了，谁还在农村县城吃饭呢，留守人员都是自己做饭吃吧

还是想吃大锅熬菜，这个倒闭的店铺向南走，北场村附近，还有一个卖大锅熬菜的，大烩菜，我也去吃过，距离也不太远，可是我实在不想去吃它家的，脏，我上次在他家吃出来一个大的塑料玩具，我没有让她赔偿，默默的给她，说，然后，默默的走了，不需要她的服务，告诉她注意卫生，我就走了，但是我不想再去了，她的态度是，可能拆封的时候掉进去的，然后就没有让后了。想吃，也不再去了，太脏了。

在刷抖音的时候刷到北干道附近有一个大锅熬菜，就骑车过去了，生意还挺好，有10块的，有20的随便吃，都是随便吃 ，20的肉菜更多，10块的就是正常的大烩菜，米，面，馒头，鸡蛋汤，都是免费吃，还可以回碗吃，是三个年轻人开的，看起来很干净，我就吃了起来，挺好吃的，味道也很好，我吃了一个大烩菜，一个鸡蛋汤，两个米饭，才十块钱，关键是也好吃，干净，以后还来这个地方吃饭吧

大锅熬菜的生意好起来，就是经济下行，大家都想省着点过日子，毕竟很多人吃不起饭，负债联盟群里，有个陌生大哥，会给我转10块钱，让我吃饭，每个人都不轻松，不是表面呈现出来的轻松，隔壁的女装店，已经两天没开张，没有卖一件衣服了，我的生意也不好，也就是开张而已。

马上五一了，需要一波流量，来驱赶内心的压抑，大锅熬菜，不就是我们小牛马的一生吗。真实现状。

---

title.title: Denominational Drama (And How To Avoid It)
title.body:
https://img.leopedia.io/DQmXu15GN6qesexQTH9HuTQBis4oYdmcTwMiYK2pH248QWS/fegeg.png 

I can admit it....

Catholics are laughing at Protestants every now and again!

Maybe @artgirl can confirm :)

So if you aren't aware, within Christendom there are over **45,000 distinct denominations**.  

Everything from Catholic to Baptist, to Calvinist to Pentecostal.  And about 44,996 others in between.  

Come to think of it, maybe even Muslims are laughing at us at times as well...I think they have two 'denominations' only....Maybe our new friend @bijoy12 can confirm?

Anywho, there is a reason I'm mentioning all this and it comes from a recent 'heated' debate of sorts within the [Kingdom Discord](https://discord.gg/D6cerBZuaW) between @waytruthlife13 @bookerman and yours truly.

And this will get people of other faiths smirking....

Each of us are from different denominations within the world of Christianity. And because of that, we have different views and opinions on doctrines.  Which at first glance, may seem odd because we all **read the same bible**...But alas, 45,000 opinions have created schism after schism, denomination after denomination...

And after the events of this week, I totally understand why.  I'm raising my hand and VERY guilty of pride!!!  But I think what @bookerman has been stressing over the past few months in our Discord anytime a doctrinal debate arises is.... 

Most of the stuff we as Christians argue about...**Isn't salvational.**

Now yeah, there are some denominations that preach another gospel, and that can get confusing for sure.  But generally, the majority believe, salvation is found through Christ and His sacrifice.

I think if we lead with that, everything else can be discussed with respect and patience.  But the kicker is, if we are discussing things to change someone's mind about the doctrines they hold true within their biblical view, it'll end up in a fight.

Now let me say this too, I'm not saying we need to all agree.  Far from it.  I think we need to remember who we should always be focused on, and let Him and the Holy Spirit do the work.

The thing about truth is, it always comes to the surface.  It can be examined, it can be studied, it can be picked apart....But truth always shines.  It just won't be you or I that 'discover' it....It'll always be the Holy Spirit guiding us into all truth which is and forever will be....

*The Way, The Truth and the Life* - Christ Jesus.

I think Christians can agree on that though, with certainty :)

Posted Using [INLEO](https://inleo.io/@jongolson/denominational-drama-and-how-to-avoid-it-csb)

title.title: ViernesDeEscritorio 24/04/2026
title.body: Nuevamente, es momento de un #viernesdeescritorio, ha sido una semana sin muchos altercados, hoy he querido darle un momento de atención a una herramienta que uso diariamente, sin ser un profesional de la edición, monto casi un vídeo al día en mi canal de YouTube, dos herramientas son las base para esta actividad, OBS Studio es la primera, ya he hablado de ella en otros post. OBS me permite grabar la pantalla de mi equipo personal, así como también la pantalla de otros equipos mediante el uso de una capturadora USB -> HDMI. También me permite realizar transmisiones en directo por Youtube, actividad que realizo casi todos los sábados, salvo uno que otro que mis compromisos personales lo impiden. La segunda es Kdenlive un editor de vídeo que me permite, unir mi Intro de los vídeos con la grabación del vídeo, recortar algo de ser necesario, colocar notas y transiciones. Una interface con que permite ver los Medios disponibles, línea de tiempo y reproducción de manera rápida y sencilla.
/> – Imagen Kdenlive Una serie de formatos preestablecidos para renderizar los vídeos y la opción de crear perfiles personalizados de formatos según necesida.
/> – Formatos de Exportación Mezclador de Audio que se puede regular por pista

> – Mezclado de audio En fin son una gran cantidad de opciones que requieren de tiempo para ir aprendiendo, pero colocadas de forma intuitiva, de manera que se puede aprender rápidamente. Kdenlive es una herramienta bajo el amparo del proyecto KDE, si bien se puede considerar una herramienta de este ecosistema, por si sola tiene vida y escena. Con QT como base se combina de manera perfecta con Plasma, para su uso en plataforma GTK yo recomiendo su uso con Flatpak. El proyecto se puede revisar en su [web](https://kdenlive.org/es/). Está disponible en la mayoría de los repositorios de las diferentes distribuciones, bases como Debian, Fedora, Arch, entre otras la tienen en sus repositorios directos para su instalación. Se consigue en Flathub y Appimage (este último directamente en la página del proyecto). title.title: Stewed beans (Eng/Esp)
title.body:
> Beans are an excellent choice for lunch, especially when served with rice—a combination that takes me back to my school days. I can still picture my classmates in the cafeteria, smiling as they enjoyed this delicious dish. The school cooks prepared them savory, while my mom at home used to add a touch of sweetness with sugar or brown sugar, so I enjoy beans both ways.
![1000111136.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yesenia.romero/242DA5EwaB3ubWWbk8Jdy5BYwNquGjcGXssKPXxbutVg8cUxjy1zedz3FGPoRBRxdm6Xt.jpg)
## Ingredients: - 200 grams of beans - 1 onion - 1 bell pepper - 4 sweet peppers - 3 cups of water - Oil - Salt to taste - 1/2 tablespoon of sugar
![1000111126.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yesenia.romero/23ynQJtq4jY2m5EtDCKkHSqzWmNTaSznmFT9HUQn6JF6R5ZZVd9wYRgG9FM4exKzydC9P.jpg)
## Preparation: I placed the beans in a container to soak for five hours; after that time, I changed the water and removed any impurities. Then I put them in a pot to boil with a pinch of salt. These beans tend to turn gray while cooking; I imagine that’s just their nature. Once they were ready, I drained the water and set them aside.
![1000111130.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yesenia.romero/241tLJoNqZzw2qAnnqhvyds1YkxAR7XxNn31jogoPfNMoKvj6f1DzpitEW3V3n8zptGQV.jpg)
Next, I removed the seeds from the sweet peppers and the bell pepper, then diced them. I peeled the onion and chopped it into small pieces as well. Then, in a skillet, I added a little oil and sautéed the vegetables. I stirred the beans and added the sautéed seasonings, then adjusted the flavor by adding half a tablespoon of sugar. I did all this while the pot was still on the stove, so that all the ingredients and flavors blended together.
![1000111133.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yesenia.romero/23vsNJnzgkR1uhDsw682aLVBVTmBa6nwcQPtc2JNMxwJYpP2RSCCWaNU2GgZ7cy9TrTfd.jpg)
Once the beans were ready, I immediately cooked white rice, using a ratio of three cups of water to one cup of rice. When it was ready, I served it, first the beans and then the rice on top, leaving it up to each person to mix it on their plate before eating. *** ***
## Versión en Español

> Los frijoles resultan una excelente alternativa a la hora de almorzar y más cuando se acompañan con arroz, una combinación que me traslada a mis días en la escuela, aún puedo recordar a mis compañeros en el comedor con una sonrisa en el rostro disfrutando este manjar. Las cocineras los preparaban salados y mamá en casa solía ponerles un toque dulce con azúcar o papelón, así que puedo comer los frijoles de ambas formas.
![1000111136.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yesenia.romero/242DA5EwaB3ubWWbk8Jdy5BYwNquGjcGXssKPXxbutVg8cUxjy1zedz3FGPoRBRxdm6Xt.jpg)
## Ingredientes: - 200 gramos de frijoles - 1 cebolla - 1 pimentón - 4 ajíes dulces - 3 tazas de agua - Aceite - Sal al gusto - 1/2 cucharada de azúcar
![1000111126.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yesenia.romero/23ynQJtq4jY2m5EtDCKkHSqzWmNTaSznmFT9HUQn6JF6R5ZZVd9wYRgG9FM4exKzydC9P.jpg)
## Preparación: Coloqué los frijoles en un envase a remojar por un lapso de cinco horas, pasado ese tiempo les cambié el agua y retiré las impurezas. Luego los monté en una olla a sancochar junto a un punto de sal. Estos frijoles suelen soltar un color gris cuando se están cocinando, imagino que es por su tipo. Al estar listos retiré el agua y los guardé.
![1000111130.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yesenia.romero/241tLJoNqZzw2qAnnqhvyds1YkxAR7XxNn31jogoPfNMoKvj6f1DzpitEW3V3n8zptGQV.jpg)
Después quité las semillas de los ajíes dulces y el pimentón, corté en cuadritos. Desconché la cebolla y también corté en pedazos pequeños. Luego, en un sartén, agregué un poco de aceite y puse los aliños a sofreír. Busqué los frijoles y les agregué los aliños sofritos, ajusté el sabor agregando media cucharada de azúcar. Todo esto lo hice con la olla en el fuego, así se mezclaron todos los ingredientes y sabores.
![1000111133.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yesenia.romero/23vsNJnzgkR1uhDsw682aLVBVTmBa6nwcQPtc2JNMxwJYpP2RSCCWaNU2GgZ7cy9TrTfd.jpg)
Una vez estuvo listo el frijol, de inmediato cociné arroz blanco, con la proporción tres tazas de agua por una de arroz. Cuando estuvo listo procedí a servir, primero los frijoles y arriba el arroz, dejando a gusto de cada quien la opción de revolver en el plato antes de comer.   *** *** ✓Photos from my personal gallery, edited with Fotocollage. ✓Text translated with DeepL.

title.body:
I was never going to tune into the two day event that was Wrestlemania but by gawd (Jim Ross voice) a lot of people did.   The crazy amount of money that people spend in order to go to these sorts of things is pretty nuts to me but I bet it really is a lot of fun to be there with the massive soundsystems and the pyrotechnical dislpays.

<center> https://i.ytimg.com/vi/74pOTdZNzZ4/maxresdefault.jpg
[src](https://i.ytimg.com/vi/74pOTdZNzZ4/maxresdefault.jpg)</center>

I did read over what went down at Wrestlemania and I at least knew who most of the people were other than the women.  I don't really think that the women's division is as popular as they make it out to be.  This I think is some sort of PC something or other that they feel they have to do.  In the past and when I thought WWE/WWF was in their glory days, the women were just kind of cartoon characters of sexuality and while I can get why some feminists out there might have a problem with this I don't think that very man (if any) women wrestling fans had an issue with it.  

<center> https://a57.foxnews.com/static.foxnews.com/foxnews.com/content/uploads/2026/04/1200/675/paige-brie-bella-wrestlemania-las-vegas-fox-news-001.jpeg?ve=1&tl=1
[src](https://a57.foxnews.com/static.foxnews.com/foxnews.com/content/uploads/2026/04/1200/675/paige-brie-bella-wrestlemania-las-vegas-fox-news-001.jpeg?ve=1&tl=1)</center>

That being said though, there is this one woman wrestler I know named Paige and there is a pretty fantastic film about her life and how she wanted to be a wrestler, was pushed down and told to go away over and over again and then through refusing to give up she eventually became the biggest female wrestling star in the world.  It is called *Fighting with my Family* and I highly suggest you check it out.  You don't have to enjoy or even appreciate wrestling to enjoy that movie. 

<center> https://imageio.forbes.com/specials-images/imageserve/69e59901a4fe14438ff149b8/WrestleMania-42/0x0.jpg?format=jpg&width=480
[src](https://imageio.forbes.com/specials-images/imageserve/69e59901a4fe14438ff149b8/WrestleMania-42/0x0.jpg?format=jpg&width=480)</center>

Apparently Roman Reigns won a belt of some sort but here is a little personal opinion about RR.  I've never liked him.  I think the WWE has been trying to push this guy for a very long time but the fans don't seem to really like him either.  They have tried to affiliate him with \

they have had guest stars promote him, the basically were trying to force people to become fans of him but despite the fact that he does everything he can to look like Jason Momoa, I just find him really basic.   

There is one guy that is a really big deal in WWE and that is Brock Lesnar 

<center> https://gsp-image-cdn.wmsports.io/cms/prod/bleacher-report/getty_images/2026-04/2272109744_large_cropped.jpg
[src](https://gsp-image-cdn.wmsports.io/cms/prod/bleacher-report/getty_images/2026-04/2272109744_large_cropped.jpg)</center>

You can't argue with the fact that this guy is a genuine genetic mutant.  He is not only huge and very strong, but he is a genuine real wrestling champion, he was the world heavyweight champion in UFC back when the heavyweight division was at its peak, and from the interviews I have seen with the guy he is a genuinely nice person and a fantastic father.   He also is quite introverted.

I think it was time for him to retire and that is exactly what he did at Wrestlemania 42

<center> https://athlonsports.com/.image/MjY6MDAwMDAwMDAxMTY1Mzc2/wrestlemania-42.jpg?io=1&profile=w2560&x=48&y=19
[src](https://athlonsports.com/.image/MjY6MDAwMDAwMDAxMTY1Mzc2/wrestlemania-42.jpg?io=1&profile=w2560&x=48&y=19)</center>

It was genuinely touching to see him take off his boots and gloves and leave them in the ring and have an embrace with long-time friend and hype-man Paul Heyman, who did almost all of the microphone work for Brock because that was the only thing his game was kind of lacking.  For as wonderful as he was at every other aspect of fighting, his mic skills just weren't very good.  But they made it work out because there aren't exactly a ton of 350 lb massive muscular dudes to choose from out there.

Brock will be a legend in the sport (and UFC too if you ask me) forever.   His departure from WWE is yet another blow to them as they seem to be kind of struggling to get any new talent to \

as far as the fans are concerned.  They keep bringing back old talent but the new blood for the most part is so irrelevant that I don't even know who any of these guys are.

No matter though I guess.  WWE is one of the most profitable sports leagues in the world, and it isn't even a real sport.  

Did you see it, are you a fan?  Do you have any favorites... do you know who Brock Lesnar is?  lol

title.title: Cochino frito con orégano, zanahoria, cebolla y pimentón [ESP/ENG]
title.body: # Cochino frito con orégano, zanahoria, cebolla y pimentón [ESP/ENG]\n\n<div class=\

>

Buenas noches amigo del buen comer y del buen paladar que hacen vida en la comunidad de @hivefood,espero que hayan tenido un excelente fin día. Sean todos bienvenidos a mi blog.


![10.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/241thZsbjLx9VTDbRwLp6dycafymusLHyYFv8RYkTFWv15Bvy43czNuNitoAHvUkhbGdp.jpg)

Hoy paso por esta comunidad con el fin de presentarles un delicioso cochino frito con orégano, pimentón, cebolla y zanahoria que prepare para degustarlo en el almuerzo junto a mi esposo. Les comento que muero por el cochino frito, es uno de los tipos de carne que mas m gustan, aparte de uqe se ha comprobado que el cochino es un tipo de carne blanca y que es preferible consumir cochino que carnes rojas.


![7.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/EokfaGY8S6yc6EZyXy6ErSqA7rnzKrBHuu65sqvgru6aopuDcrcvrKKocf1ArxNHEik.jpg)

Ahora paso a nómbrale los ingredientes y el paso a paso como lo prepare.

# Ingredientes:

* 400 gramos de carne (pulpa de cerdo)
* 1 zanahoria
* 1/4 de pimentón verde
* 1/4 de cebolla blanca
* orégano entero
* salsa inglesa, salsa de ajo
* aceite algusto
* sal y pimienta algusto
4 dientes de ajo

![1.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/23vsV3qWfRe6ki2z4YpygVUafNVM6wg8vQyFuwfJdjB1gue1No5gwtn9Uied6MC7ZqsV2.jpg)

# paso a Paso

1.Lo primero que hice fue cortar la pulpa de cochino en trozos para chicharrón, lavarlos y sazonarlos con orégano, salsa inglesa, salsa de ajo, ajo triturados, sal y pimienta al gusto, reservar.

![2.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/23yd5brqCGna6QEZiySYdtnNtU4mp3cBkidnfmZCdQGYTGyPWxKWqUEXatNMegEVUNHXa.jpg)

2cortar en juliana la cebolla, el pimentón y cortar en rodajas la zanahoria.

![4.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/23vhpyFrRm9YCR1ZDaKxcNmBwwEX4MERdBuZFBJAMmnZkF57zHwg2zKt8zbfLVF2iViQk.jpg)

3.buscar un caldero, agregarle una 1/2 taza de agua, colocar la pulpa Sazonada, la zanahoria, dejarla que cueza unos  cinco minutos, al mermar el agua colocarle el aceite al caldero, y el resto de los ingredientes, dejar que se cocine bien unos20 minutos mas, dejar reposar y seguir sofriendo, dando vuelta de vez en cuando hasta que transcurra el tiempo, apagar y emplatar.

![5.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/23vhsZ6TsXSyKLA4F9KGWjmPjkSrVe3Zhj1EL9nWEoLfBto4Tx3ZjMcYc7UvBZrjQXcjh.jpg)

Este delicioso almuerzo lo acompañe con una crema de apio y de bebida una rica limonada para refrescarnos del sol que esta bastante fuerte.

![8.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/EowJwwqcdD16x2knXkfXQjNvBG79vSEzz2VZ7RgcNAdPqN2r6fQ6BycZZuESnCtJcHu.jpg)

Este plato quedo muy delicioso con una textura impresionante, ya que el cochino es una carne muy blanda y ala vez jugosa. Con todo estos ingrediente que ustedes han podido observar hacen que la carne quede más jugosa. Esta preparación alcanza de 2 a 3 comensales.

![5.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/23vhsZ6TsXSyKLA4F9KGWjmPjkSrVe3Zhj1EL9nWEoLfBto4Tx3ZjMcYc7UvBZrjQXcjh.jpg)

![9.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/EogQGb8MyRATcUXzsLUgEmhtbYzAJS2dJLJyuX15DA1RDvS7YkuKvNFZP5VUAwLp3A9.jpg)

Hasta aquí mi contenido espero sea de su agrado y nos vemos en un próximo contenido, dios me los cuide.

* Fotos tomadas con Iphone 8 plus

<div class=\

>

# English Versión

# Fried Pork with Oregano, Carrots, Onions, and Paprika

<div class=\

>

Good evening, fellow food lovers and connoisseurs of the @hivefood community! I hope you’ve had a wonderful evening. Welcome to my blog.

![10.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/241thZsbjLx9VTDbRwLp6dycafymusLHyYFv8RYkTFWv15Bvy43czNuNitoAHvUkhbGdp.jpg)

Today I’m stopping by this community to share a delicious recipe for fried pork with oregano, paprika, onion, and carrot that I prepared for lunch with my husband. I have to tell you that I absolutely love fried pork; it’s one of my favorite types of meat. Plus, it’s been proven that pork is a type of white meat, and it’s better to eat pork than red meat.

![7.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/EokfaGY8S6yc6EZyXy6ErSqA7rnzKrBHuu65sqvgru6aopuDcrcvrKKocf1ArxNHEik.jpg)

Now I’ll list the ingredients and the step-by-step instructions for how I prepared it.

# Ingredients:

* 400 grams of meat (pork loin)
* 1 carrot
* 1/4 green bell pepper
* 1/4 white onion
* whole oregano
* Worcestershire sauce, garlic sauce
* oil to taste
* salt and pepper to taste
4 cloves of garlic

![1.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/23vsV3qWfRe6ki2z4YpygVUafNVM6wg8vQyFuwfJdjB1gue1No5gwtn9Uied6MC7ZqsV2.jpg)

# Step by Step
1. The first thing I did was cut the pork into pieces for chicharrón, wash them, and season them with oregano, Worcestershire sauce, garlic sauce, minced garlic, and salt and pepper to taste. Set aside.

![2.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/23yd5brqCGna6QEZiySYdtnNtU4mp3cBkidnfmZCdQGYTGyPWxKWqUEXatNMegEVUNHXa.jpg)

2. Julienne the onion and bell pepper, and slice the carrot.

![4.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/23vhpyFrRm9YCR1ZDaKxcNmBwwEX4MERdBuZFBJAMmnZkF57zHwg2zKt8zbfLVF2iViQk.jpg)

3.Take a pot, add 1/2 cup of water, add the seasoned meat and the carrot, and let it simmer for about five minutes. Once the water has reduced, add the oil to the pot, and the rest of the ingredients. Let it cook thoroughly for about 20 more minutes, then let it rest and continue sautéing, stirring occasionally until the time is up. Turn off the heat and serve.

![5.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/23vhsZ6TsXSyKLA4F9KGWjmPjkSrVe3Zhj1EL9nWEoLfBto4Tx3ZjMcYc7UvBZrjQXcjh.jpg)

I’ll serve this delicious lunch with a cream of celery soup and a refreshing lemonade to cool us off from the rather strong sun.

![8.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/EowJwwqcdD16x2knXkfXQjNvBG79vSEzz2VZ7RgcNAdPqN2r6fQ6BycZZuESnCtJcHu.jpg)



This dish turned out absolutely delicious with an amazing texture, since pork is a very tender and juicy meat. All the ingredients you’ve seen here help make the meat even juicier. This recipe serves 2 to 3 people.

![5.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/23vhsZ6TsXSyKLA4F9KGWjmPjkSrVe3Zhj1EL9nWEoLfBto4Tx3ZjMcYc7UvBZrjQXcjh.jpg)

![9.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/EogQGb8MyRATcUXzsLUgEmhtbYzAJS2dJLJyuX15DA1RDvS7YkuKvNFZP5VUAwLp3A9.jpg)

That’s all for now. I hope you enjoyed this post, and I’ll see you in the next one. God bless you all.

title.title: CULTURE AND IT'S PEOPLE..!
title.body:
A people's culture is the totality of who they are, what they believe in, how they socialize within themselves and with others, it robs off on how they see others and themselves. Also how they see the world at large, this includes their interactions with other people generally. How they get married, the kind of food they eat, their dance steps, attires and their dressings, the language or the kind of dialect they speak. Their artifacts, what they worship and believe in.

Therefore, a culture oriented set of people, do remind others about that, from time to time. This is typical of the Abriba and Ohafia people in the same **Neighborhood in the South Eastern State of Abia State,  Nigeria**.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmSvkyGndjJoERU5eLcVKjDUPSdo3ZCXDxoBr2L9vzRbpK/1777002909843.jpg)
**I don't know him...ooo, but he looks fascinating in his traditional style..😂, that's why I captured him**

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQm1beMKZMpAvGxFtegAA1q2xpraqEZGyic5oyagNSgfa/1777002910035.jpg)

**This Is The Abriba Cultural Heritage.
A set of wealthy ancient kingdom, in the Ohafia neighborhood. Abriba is in Ohafia local government area in the South Eastern State of Abia State, Nigeria**. 

They are predominantly for commerce and industries and other larger businesses of importation of different types of goods and services but majority is about importation of fabrics and the accessories, including many other businesses, like clothing materials and the already made clothes.
They are mostly found residing in Aba, the capital business hub in  Abia State, Nigeria.

 The Abriba people culturally grow rich and wealthy through the means of **Apprenticeships**. This is the act of a younger person serving a wealthy kinsman, a brother or any other indigenous person who is already an established trader in his field of buying and selling of a particular brand of goods for some numbers of years and after which the master will settle the young man with cash, shop filled with that same line of trade he learned under him and then  allows the young individual to be on his own and be properly and proudly establishing his own line of trade to prosper. This is how they grow and help one another to become masters of their own in life.

**Here, the indigenous people of Abriba were showcasing their rich  Cultural Heritage in their land of residence, Aba, in Abia State, Nigeria**

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmRwjuvsNgpG5qHJfY9mLBfiqVsrWsBCJ8CT1ikgDfg5YD/1776948307512.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQzUjD9U75zo2SDvbGRdcRcNLWD1fh7mJH5eKLBxyBrw7/1776948307765.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmY2zedFDDEqt4ksBFvR1tY5Mb4o9LAAFxdBrPF5JHPgSn/1776948307963.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmcC4pE5adRUmiHudtNFk2abbfNvqSeARcAFPQ55wmNbBx/1776948308239.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmNv86RBSeVFPXed9eRYtLEt9nEXm4kgtfyyNUorm4h9GN/1776948308423.jpg)

This is the cultural heritage of the Abriba people and their land. They appeared like this culturally on a certain day, to celebrate their culture and what they believed in,  to also interpret to everyone about their land and their origin. Abriba people is a tribe in the Ohafia Local Government Area of Abia state.

 I'm not from there, I'm from the same local government areas with them. Almost all tribes, languages and the cultural heritage and background of people from this ethnic group is regarded as the same thing. Only us that are original born of this heritage know the differences in our languages because the differences are very little likewise our beliefs, food, dressing, types of marriages, thinking, behaviors and thoughts. All these look alike, but are not.

 To every outsiders, we are the same people but we the owners of the land know that there are huge differences in our languages and the culture....Nooo, there are deep differences and we know it when someone from Abriba speaks compared with when another one from Ohafia speaks his or her language.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmSvkyGndjJoERU5eLcVKjDUPSdo3ZCXDxoBr2L9vzRbpK/1776947537222.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmeNg8tejiArrMeXQsd8v49MwRtXf3ZEtPzxe4t3DxS5UM/1776947537405.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmbvJo9BGEokaS2u9b2xzLNbQhUFeAigi8bfA9Y7yVd6RV/1776947537641.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmX99p7bwGm96CHsBhvUdSid36nJptPnPaMbUZvuwmjeqy/1776947537865.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYyLgfvFjPxwLkoHWadSXykuHktLEe7DTHToDozEAQg4T/1776947538092.jpg)

These pictures represent how men from Abriba living in Aba, Abia State of Nigeria appeared on a certain day they were celebrating one of their cultural heroes and heritage. Aba in Abia State is a different city entirely from their original land of birth, Abriba.

 But to show that this people have a united force in their culture, they closed down their shops, stores, warehouses and came out enmass to celebrate their land, and the people of Abriba, with this dressing or this particular attire, the food and the little god they believe is behind this huge celebration. 

You can see how every male son or child of Abriba dressed, this is a way of teaching their children, their younger generations their culture and their beliefs of their ancestry and their ancestral homeland, Abriba. Though in a far away from their own ancestral home land. This is how cultures are transferred from generations to other generations. The new generation is learning to carry on the tradition of their people.

 **Even people from this ancestral home living in diaspora joined celebrating the cultural tie of and from their ancestors and their ancestral home land, Abriba**

It gives joy and a kind of home coming, when you are celebrating the cultural view point of your own heritage, the land of your birth, where God has originally brought you from. But the fetish lifestyle of the ancient people had spoilt the sincerity and the free spirit it supposed to possess towards God Almighty, the original God and the Creator of heaven and earth. They changed it, to worship a lesser god.

Their ancestors were worshipping lesser gods or so to say, what they made with their own hands and regarded it as the original God. It's an error, very wrong because God is not happy with such practices and such a people. God will never want to be compared with hand made gods, or any lesser god.
God is always outstanding and the greatest of them all.

**That particular one day of their homeland original attire attracted me capturing them that day** 

They looked gorgeous, and their women and children were not left out. Every one of them were inclusively beautiful and it made it a colorful day to remember, I decided to share the sights with all of us here.

**This is the part 2 of my series, \

. Yet both the third and fourth series are coming on this same topic, stay tuned!**

title.title: I Left a Comfortable Life Then I Went Back
title.body: > # “ I am sorry to say, but I treat my kids as an investment” She wasn’t saying it in anger. It was emphasized to me once again and it was just pure fact, something she tried to hide from the rest of her children but slipped out. *I genuinely wondered if the rest of the children understood that fact*. I understood that long ago. The unspoken fact of our existence, so I left. I said goodbye to the privileged and comfortable life that I could have had then. ## I wanted to build something that didn’t have a price tag attached, something that wouldn’t warrant “ She does it because of my help and connections.” I lived with the humbler version of my family. We lived a simpler life without a price tag attached. We struggled so much but in hindsight, it was life worth living. There was no envy, no ROI, and family is just family. I learned what it felt like to mess up without being seen as less, to be sick without being seen as a business liability and to never have to carefully walk on thread when talking to a person. I was simply existing in my antics. ### Then, I ran out of money and needed help. I told myself it was going to be temporary. Take the money, once I am stable, return it back and to never seek her again. But life has that funny twist. Rather than leaving, I sank deeper. I am paying the interest from the money I borrowed though being part of the family. Now, I am suddenly managing their business, being the front face of the business, and getting told to network here and there. My actions became another line of item in the expense description. I was just a part of their quarterly business report and my action became an item in the invoice. ### “ Don’t forget to take pictures for invoicing,” she told me. I wasn’t used to all these. I used to exist with a mother who loves me dearly and never sees me as a ROI. I was used to a mother that would warmly welcome me with food and never criticizes the way I dress. I was used to a mother that lets me sleep as much as I wanted because she knows how hard I work. I was used to a mother that never rushed me and told all my secrets without the need to be analyzed or solved. These days, I miss my family events, the get together with my family, the birthday dinner and things that a normal family would do. It hasn’t been a year but it gets louder now that I wanted to leave once again. ### “ Whenever you’re tired, I am one call away. And be strong, you're working for *VOC*” said my sister on a call one time. My sister and I have words for it using colonial metaphors to describe our mother, VOC ( The Dutch East India Company that extracted everything from Indonesia and was the major colonizer in the country). It wasn’t supposed to be like that. ### And I was supposed to leave but..... Seeing how easy some of my siblings had it, how easy it is to make $4-5k grand a month and how easy it is to be stayed at luxury hotels, and felt like money is just papers, I felt conflicted & those blinded me again. ### Stupidly enough, I chose to be trapped. I wanted to take a breather in comfort because I know, if I leave everything behind once again, it’s going to get extremely hard to survive. It’s not that I am not capable of building something from 0 again. It’s just that I am still fairly exhausted. And I would sound really stupid to just strip away all the privileges I am experiencing right now. Then, going back to a life under poverty where climbing the ladder gets harder each day. She knows this well enough. She offers the payment plans. She maintains me just enough to feel comfort and for me not leave. Only for me to be reminded that freedom is expensive. And once again, I am being reminded of a goal I used to have, the kind of freedom I long for. ||| |-|- ![NTy4GV6ooFRmaCXZ8UYgPhoud1kjiNX8QokLEZtbBKLuLWQ9yt7K3o4PG7qiS2SfyUvr6dYces7DWJ8xfHhq8PVtQPrvofyP72KL3ppdRxeugWvBfxeBRgtHv4FSStZc4YZ6Tzt1Pm995NNPZRyGjU7WNd7xvdEv2qtUNXuG.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/macchiata/23t77FQVTCGtEBi1QzCfnjLFZ3BpB57ocvnKWNZbybVoNT2WGNztX9UKrTyCVdjXyPVch.jpg)|
