title.title: Laughs and throwbacks
title.body: Incluí al final el texto en español, ni idioma nativo... I know that in translation you English speakers will miss a few things. 😆

>scr
Hello friends from YouHive,
Thinking about the cartoons I used to watch as a child always brings back lovely memories, especially that magical moment of having my snack in front of the TV: the delicious toasted rolls my great-aunt Tita prepared for me, using

>a gadget she placed directly on the stove with the bread inside. And of course, the toppings—ham, cheese, both, guava jam with cheese (the famous pan con timba), or simply garlic and oil… 😁 I don’t know why I’m always thinking about food lately. Anyway, that toaster—they say—was a Cuban invention. It wouldn’t be a bad idea to go and look for one at a place here in Havana called La Cuevita, where they sell all sorts of handmade artefacts. And it wasn’t just bread; it came with yoghurt, lemonade, mango juice (Taoro), refresco prieto as she called it, or Materva. As I grew older, I lost interest in fizzy drinks. My grandmother always prepared delicious snacks around 10 in the morning. And curiously, those are memories of weekends, school breaks, or summer holidays in July and August, when I would watch cartoons at that hour. But Cuban gastronomy isn’t the subject of this post; I’m just setting the scene so you can picture little Anaraycita, lost in her thoughts in front of the TV. I didn’t even hear if someone asked me from the kitchen whether I wanted something else. Sometimes suddenly my Tita would appear in front of me and I’d jump: “Anaray, are you daydreaming?” 🤣 I’ve always had my little mental quirks, so to speak. 😂 And since we’re here… attention! At minute 7:40 😂 it looks like the cook is grabbing the gadget by the metal part with his bare hand. Don’t do that—you’ll burn yourself, that thing gets hot. Later on you can see the toaster seems to have lost one of its handles. By the way, at minute 7:52 the first piece of bread comes out. What was I going to talk about here? Ahhh… cartoons. Imagine, I watched so many. But there were three I preferred. I already spoke ages ago here on Hive about one—the saga of Elpidio Valdés. Today, however, I’m bringing the Russian cartoons that everyone from my generation watched. And this video with a top 10 seemed brilliant to me. (You can see the subtitles in English; YouTube translates this automatically)
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Ms-dO18eBtw

>YouTube I also had Russian storybooks, the kind where the figures popped up when you opened them. My mother brought some from there, I think, but others were sold in bookshops here, and my aunts bought those for me. I was born in 1980, in Kiev, though at three months old I came to Cuba without ever seeing the snow. From the list of cartoons I showed you in the previous video, my favourites are The Frog Princess, Fantito, The Bremen Musicians, The Three from Sour Milk, You’ll Pay for This (¡Nu, pogodí!), and Bolek and Lolek. And then,

>Tusa Cutusa, fierce animal… 😄 Another thing I loved was La Comedia Silente, narrated by Armando Calderón, known as the man of a thousand voices.
https://youtu.be/Z9AkxuYdL-8

>YouTube I think this was sometimes a bit too much for children 🤣 and I didn’t see it myself, but I believe the man once, in a fit of passion, said a phrase that has gone down in history—so much so that people here say it constantly. I won’t write it myself; I’ll just quote it. It’s true there’s no evidence of it, and it was even denied on TV in an interview programme. Still, from experience, some of us already know that when the river makes noise, it’s because it carries stones.
Without a doubt, the great milestone of Cuban television blunders was Armando Calderón in *La comedia silente*. On Sunday mornings, as part of children’s programming, Channel 6 would show a series of silent film shorts that Calderón narrated live — there were no prior recordings or delayed broadcasts back then. The man indulged in details and witty remarks with a creativity and ease worthy of admiration. In one of those scenes, something like the “war of the cakes” or “Songo hit Borondongo and Borondongo hit Bernabé,” almost suffocated by the speed the episode demanded, he concluded: “¡Esto está de pinga, queridos amiguitos!” (There’s no way to translate this, it’s too rude haha... “This is bloody brilliant, dear little friends!” 🤣). The phrase was instantly and forever embedded in popular language and is repeated left and right whenever things are heating up — which is to say, constantly.

>
</center>

Nah, no need to explain. Us Cuban kids might be kinda traumatised; take this one in, Dirty Rat. 🤣

<center>
https://youtu.be/B7w5nkyHolw
<sub><a href=\

>YouTube The rats want to destroy the school garden and they hurl nasty words at each other. Besides the rats being alcoholic, drinking “coronilla”, that phrase “cayeron en el jamo” is like saying they fell into the trap… this way of speaking we even ended up adopting. Lots of people imitate it really well, right @mdrguez? Mientes rata inmunda 🤣 (Liar, you dirty rat). Well, I’ve already drifted away from the Russian cartoons, which was my plan. There you can also see that with such content not everyone can remain entirely in their right mind, so I hope this serves as a revelation about me, for you, my dear readers. Thank you. See you soon. (Thanks, Avecilla, for proposing this initiative. I’ll try to take part even in the horror theme, though as always I can’t promise anything.)

>
✎ • ✐ ✎ •✐ ✎ • ✐ ✎ • ✐ ✎ • ✐

Entre risas y recuerdos

Hola amigos de YouHive,
Pensar en los dibujos animados que veía cuando era pequeña es algo que me trae siempre muchos recuerdos bonitos, y sobre todo aquel momento mágico de merendar frente al TV los ricos panecillos tostados que me preparaba mi tía abuela Tita, en

>un artefacto que ponía directamente en el fogón con el pan adentro y, por supuesto, lo que le ponía al pan, que podía ser jamón, queso, o los dos, o queso, o conserva de guayaba, o los dos (el llamado pan con timba), o aceite y ajo... 😁 yo no sé por qué últimamente siempre estoy pensando en comida... En fin, el tostador aquel -dicen-que es un invento cubano. No sería mala idea ir a buscar uno de esos a un lugar que hay aquí en La Habana que se llama La Cuevita, donde venden todo tipo de artefactos artesanales. Y bueno, no era un pan solamente; venía acompañado con yogurt o limonada o jugo de mango taoro o refresco prieto como le decía ella o materva. Yo de grande perdí mi interés por los refrescos de globitos. Mi abuela siempre me preparaba unas meriendas riquísimas sobre las 10 de la mañana, para resumir... Y curiosamente esos son recuerdos de fines de semana o de semanas de receso escolar o de vacaciones de verano enntre Julio y Agosto cuando yo, sobre esa hora, veía dibujos animados. Pero la gastronomía cubana no es el tema del post, solo estoy poniéndote en situación para que imagines a la pequeña Anaraycita, perdida en sus pensamientos frente al TV, yo ni escuchaba si me preguntaban desde la cocina si quería algo más, a veces de pronto tenía a mi Tita delante y pegaba un brinco: ¿Anaray, tú estas lela? 🤣 Siempre he tenido mis problemas mentales, como quien dice. 😂 Y ya que estamos... ¡atención! en el minuto 7:40 😂 parece que el cocinero está agarrando el artefacto por la parte de metal con la mano pelada. Usted no vaya a hacer eso que se va a quemar, esa cosa se pone caliente. Pero bueno, ya más adelante se ve que parece que el tostador perdió uno de los agarres. Por cierto en el minuto 7:52 ya sale el primer pan. ¿De qué iba a hablar yo aquí? Ahhh... los dibujos animados. Figúrate veía tantos. Pero había tres que prefería. De uno ya hablé hace ni se sabe cuándo aquí en Hive, de la saga de dibujos animados de Elpidio Valdés. Sin embargo hoy vengo con los muñequitos rusos que todos los de mi generación vimos. Y este video que tiene un top 10 me pareció genial.
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Ms-dO18eBtw

>YouTube También tenía los libros de cuentos rusos, esos que cuando los abrías salían las figuras hacia arriba. Mi madre trajo de allá algunos, me parece, pero otros los vendían en las librerías aquí, y esos me los compraban mis tías. Yo nací en el 80 y nací en Kiev aunque a los tres meses vine para Cuba sin ver la nieve. De la relación de muñequitos que les presenté en el video anterior, mis preferidos son La Princesa Rana, Fantito, Los Músicos de Bremen, Los tres de Leche Cortada, Me las Pagarás (¡Nu, pogodí!) y Bolek y Lolek. A ver,

>Tusa Cutusa, animal feroz... 😄 otra cosa que me gustaba mucho era La Comedia Silente que narraba Armando Calderón a quien llamaban el hombre de las mil voces.
https://youtu.be/Z9AkxuYdL-8

>YouTube Yo creo que esto estaba a veces un poco subido de tono para los niños 🤣 y yo no lo vi, pero creo que el hombre un día en un arrebato dijo una expresión que ha quedado para la historia, fíjate que aquí se dice constantemente. No la voy a escribir yo, la voy a citar. Sí es verdad que no hay evidencia de ello, además de que se ha desmentido en la propia TV en un programa de entrevistas. Aún así, por experiencia algunos ya sabemos que cuando el río suena, es porque piedras trae. 😄
Sin lugar a dudas, el gran hito de las pifias televisivas cubanas fue el de Armando Calderón en La comedia silente. Los domingos en la mañana, como parte de la programación infantil, pasaban en el Canal 6 una serie de cortos del cine mudo que Calderón iba narrando en vivo —no había entonces grabaciones previas ni trasmisiones diferidas—. El hombre se engolosinaba en detalles y ocurrencias con una creatividad y una soltura dignas de asombro. En una de aquellas escenas, algo así como la guerra de los pasteles o un Songo le dio a Borondongo y Borondongo le dio a Bernabé, casi asfixiado por la celeridad que el capítulo le exigía, concluyó: “¡Esto está de pinga, queridos amiguitos!” La frase se insertó en ese mismo instante y para siempre en el lenguaje popular y se repite a diestra y siniestra cada vez que la cosa está que arde —o sea, constantemente.

>
</center>

No, para qué contarte. Nosotros los niños cubanos puede que estemos un tin traumatizados; échate esto, Rata Inmunda. 🤣

<center>
https://youtu.be/B7w5nkyHolw
<sub><a href=\

>YouTube Y bueno ya me salí de los muñequitos rusos, lo cual era mi plan. Allí se puede ver también que con ese contenido no todo el mundo puede conservarse íntegramente en sus cabales, así que espero que esto sea una revelación acerca de mí, para ustedes mis queridos lectores. Gracias. Nos vemos pronto. (Gracias Avecilla por proponer esta iniciativa, voy a tratar de participar hasta en lo de terror, aunque como siempre no te prometo nada)

title.title: Chicken with sweet peppers in soy and honey sauce (Eng-Esp)
title.body: <center>![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/kristal24/EoK8kPdwBPNEZc9WCArQSQU8CGLffYFUM5ntnJ9RhBGbCqWwrJKhEtEHd8HXx7KLmwq.png)</center>\n\n* Good evening hivers, welcome back to my blog! Today, I'll explain how to prepare a delicious \

This recipe is VERY versatile; you can complement it with countless side dishes. In my case, I served it with: sweet potato puree and a mixed green salad... Let's put on our aprons and make this delicacy!\n\n>* Buenas noches hivers, bienvenidos de nuevo a mi blog... Hoy, les explicaré como preparar un delicioso \

. Esta receta es MUY versátil, pueden complementar con infinidad de contornos, en mi caso acompañé con: puré de batata y ensalada de lechugas mixtas... Pongámonos el delantal para realizar esta exquisitez!

<center>![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/kristal24/243WaQNgH1CE77rcB5Z9G8Nq65WZJd2HiPKbujgg4CNs923sWTVZuwJqiDfGXZdyPTAGV.png)</center>

* INGREDIENTS: sweet peppers, onion, chicken breast (cut into strips), black pepper, oregano powder, fine herbs, soy sauce, honey, corn starch, sesame seeds for decoration, mild olive oil and salt to taste.

>* INGREDIENTES: ajies dulces, cebolla, pechuga de pollo (cortada en tiras), pimienta negra, orégano en polvo, finas hierbas, salsa de soja, miel, fécula de maíz, semillas de sésamo para decorar, aceite de oliva suave y sal al gusto.

<center>![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/kristal24/23w2weBjCVJ5N7aj6nfsf6NknXcfUDnJCxF9wUVb55GZZHCQM8zz9bfFNX3MkuvC63dsF.png)</center>

<center>![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/kristal24/23tmWKFA3ha1KNobJve8ZHMMMWHK5AJkZesLHwxVLGa73Fj9jterP4VpsMY81s7A9V1Yr.png)</center>

<center>PREPARATION/PREPARACIÓN</center>

* We'll start by making our delicious sauce, which will be the base for a truly exquisite contrast! In a bowl, combine the soy sauce, honey, and cornstarch (adding a touch of water).
Whenever I make this recipe, I usually add a pinch of ground ginger; this ingredient provides a slightly spicy flavor that I'm sure you'll love!
Mix well and set aside for the final step.

>* Empezamos realizando nuestra apetitosa salsa, que será la base principal para disfrutar de un contraste MUY exquisito! Integramos en un bowl la salsa de soja, junto con la miel y la fécula de maíz (añadimos un toque de agua).
Siempre que realizo esta receta suelo colocar una pizca de jengibre en polvo, este ingrediente aporta un sabor ligeramente picantoso que estoy segura amarán!
Mezclamos bien y reservamos para utilizar en el paso final.

<center>![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/kristal24/23y922sNpJCJsEzagdBm18bhnHGhJe5wxEdkTbWywwg3DsH9WpnR7m6jw7SLgou3ZxG7K.png)</center>

* Cut the chicken breast into strips, season with black pepper, dried oregano, herbs, and salt. Add 1 tablespoon of olive oil to the pan and sauté until cooked through.
Add the sweet peppers and onion. Pour in the soy sauce and honey mixture and cook over medium heat. Stir gently and cook until the sauce has thickened.
The cooking process will take approximately 20 minutes.

>* Cortamos la pechuga de pollo en tiras, condimentamos con pimienta negra, orégano seco, finas hierbas y sal... Integramos 1 cucharada de aceite de oliva al sartén, sofreímos hasta comprobar que está listo.
Incorporamos los ajies dulces, junto con la cebolla... Colocamos la mezcla de salsa de soja y miel, cocinamos a fuego \

. Mezclamos con movimientos suaves, cocinamos hasta comprobar que la salsa tomó una textura espesa.
El proceso de cocción tardará aproximadamente 20 minutos.

<center>![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/kristal24/23wCG66duGmmT5XD9M9FbbxY33mSmiBDVvLYMyP1RQKmqkikeu6cMZb9bBJwXeVWPHmy4.png)</center>

<center>![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/kristal24/23wMckonDp5gy5VBjp5hFZmZzLVY56isbt9d44w9wYDNhLtV6o5k32MnHenqxqYMnTdcU.png)</center>

<center>![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/kristal24/23w2oUsUeYJwCeLYi8Qh9gBZG38GZnWQQLLfv98r3UR43hX8nwm86iLKjZdCBbsTmnU4r.png)</center>

* We add our succulent chicken to a deep plate... We garnish with sesame seeds; this ingredient will add a slightly crunchy texture that I'm sure you'll love!

>* Agregamos nuestro suculento pollo en un plato hondo... Decoramos con semillas de sésamo, este ingrediente aportará una textura ligeramente crujiente que estoy segura les encantará!

<center>![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/kristal24/23zS9Hy149gp2tyTRVeq6hWZHrBsavY17ACKy9tUpzNf4RafD9orvAgbUoY778Juk2U3F.png)</center>

* Friends, here's our healthy and nutritious dish, an excellent option for lunch or dinner with the family... A true delight!
I hope you enjoyed the process and are inspired to try this tasty recipe. Enjoy your meal... Sweet dreams!

>* Amigos, a continuación les presento nuestro saludable y nutritivo platillo, una excelente opción para almorzar o cenar en familia... Un manjar al paladar!
Espero que hayan disfrutado el proceso y se animen a realizar esta sabrosa receta. Me despido deseándoles buen provecho... Les deseo felices sueños!

<center>![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/kristal24/243WaQNgH1CE77rcB5Z9G8Nq65WZJd2HiPKbujgg4CNs923sWTVZuwJqiDfGXZdyPTAGV.png)</center>

* All photos are my own work
* Todas las fotos son de mi autoria

title.title: Chicken and Potato Stew (Eng/Esp)
title.body:
> Chicken stew is a classic dish because it pairs well with almost any side dish—whether it’s vegetables, arepas, rice, or pasta, among many other options—making it perfect for a delicious lunch. This time, I decided to add potatoes to the stew to create a creamy sauce, which I plan to use to flavor some white rice.
![1000111157.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ramisey/23zGj1f2raCCYZds12WMo3HMZi541KPW2WR4DHr3JwomguhDxmmXnRrfrUumwN7K6W76Z.jpg)
## Ingredients: - 5 pieces of chicken - 1 onion - 1 potato - 2 bell peppers - 7 sweet peppers - Salt to taste - 1 head of garlic - Oil - Water
![1000111144.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ramisey/23wMjFgq98cc8bdYnWrdp9gN6dxTSKKMMVuL5Hm256WW3asFGcGeU8QPQzUfQtYEumrEH.jpg)
## Preparation: I washed the vegetables, removed the seeds from both the sweet peppers and the bell peppers, and peeled the outer layer off the onion. Everything was cut into small cubes, including the potato, which I had also washed beforehand.
![1000111147.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ramisey/23tc1a7R9LfmXzp8LD1twrGotHjq2dV9ztTViyX8Jgz4efA186BA5xZSn9TjdU77qchoZ.jpg)
![1000111150.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ramisey/23tmHs9R5sgGqZTL59VHuRdxEnj6BAJdrGo3vUQSgEJzurcdBDi8VdzpcWfZi9K4VQ9RW.jpg)
The next step was to sauté the seasonings with the minced garlic. To do this, I heated a skillet on the stove with a splash of oil. Then I added the diced vegetables, stirring constantly. Once they softened, I added the chicken pieces, and a few minutes later, the splash of water and the salt. I covered the pan to trap the steam. While the dish was cooking, I set a pot with three cups of water on the stove so that, once it came to a boil, I could start cooking the rice.
![1000111153.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ramisey/23tH9cqGC2wdm7BCNGPypCEYF5NMZdUdzquTUcrWkfmxcUoa4inMLTJCkUPteFr3R5ARH.jpg)
In about ten minutes, everything was ready. The starch from the potatoes helped thicken the stew, which I love. Since all the ingredients were high-quality, this simple recipe for chicken stew with rice turned into a spectacular meal. *** ***
## Versión en Español

> El pollo guisado es un clásico en la cocina porque suele combinar con casi todos los contornos, ya sea con verduras, arepas, arroz y pasta, entre tantas opciones, se antoja perfecto para un almuerzo exquisito. En esta ocasión decidí agregar papa al guiso para obtener una salsa cremosa, con la cual pienso saborizar un arroz blanco.
![1000111157.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ramisey/23zGj1f2raCCYZds12WMo3HMZi541KPW2WR4DHr3JwomguhDxmmXnRrfrUumwN7K6W76Z.jpg)
## Ingredientes: - 5 piezas de pollo - 1 cebolla - 1 papa - 2 pimentones - 7 ajíes dulces - Sal al gusto - 1 cabeza de ajo - Aceite - Agua
![1000111144.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ramisey/23wMjFgq98cc8bdYnWrdp9gN6dxTSKKMMVuL5Hm256WW3asFGcGeU8QPQzUfQtYEumrEH.jpg)
## Preparación: Lavé los aliños, quité las semillas tanto de los ajíes dulces como de los pimentones, en tanto a la cebolla le quité la primera capa. Todo fue cortado en cuadros pequeños, incluyendo la papa, que previamente también fue lavada.
![1000111147.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ramisey/23tc1a7R9LfmXzp8LD1twrGotHjq2dV9ztTViyX8Jgz4efA186BA5xZSn9TjdU77qchoZ.jpg)
![1000111150.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ramisey/23tmHs9R5sgGqZTL59VHuRdxEnj6BAJdrGo3vUQSgEJzurcdBDi8VdzpcWfZi9K4VQ9RW.jpg)
El siguiente paso fue sofreír los aliños con el ajo triturado, para ello monté un sartén en la cocina con una medida de aceite. Luego introduje los cuadritos removiendo constantemente, cuando ablandaron agregué las piezas de pollo y a los pocos minutos la medida de agua y la sal. Tapé para aprovechar el vapor. Mientras la preparación seguía su curso, monté una paila con tres tazas de agua para, una vez que hierva, proceder a cocinar el arroz.
![1000111153.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ramisey/23tH9cqGC2wdm7BCNGPypCEYF5NMZdUdzquTUcrWkfmxcUoa4inMLTJCkUPteFr3R5ARH.jpg)
En unos diez minutos estuvo listo todo, el almidón que contiene la papa contribuyó a que el guiso quedara espeso, lo que me encanta. Al ser todos los ingredientes de calidad, esta sencilla receta de pollo guisado con arroz se transformó en una comida espectacular. *** *** ✓Photos from my personal gallery, edited with Fotocollage. ✓Text translated with DeepL.

title.title: Tipografía floral, nombres... Letra \
/ Floral typography, names, Letter \
(Esp/Eng)
title.body:
>

[Esp]

¡Saludos comunidad!

Hoy hice un borrador para poder elaborar este diseño y no cometiera tantos errores, al menos tener el boceto la idea plasmada. luego fui organizando y trasladando a mi libreta.

La pintura que sale de los bordes es intencional, quería un aspecto algo rústico - infantil. Me inspiré en mi hijo menor Adrián, como iré en orden alfabético (no siempre) comencé por la letra \

. Recreé mis flores de huevo que hacía en mis dibujos digitales, de hecho esto me ayudó mucho. Sé que en la práctica la creatividad estará mucho mejor así como cada diseño, este es mi primero para este cuaderno de lienzo blanco. Espero les guste. Adicional a eso, grabé todo mi proceso en vídeo, por si gustas ver.

> [Eng] Hello everyone! Today I did a rough sketch so I could work on this design without making too many mistakes – at least having the sketch meant I could get the idea down on paper. Then I organised it and transferred it to my notebook. The paint spilling over the edges is intentional; I wanted a slightly rustic, childlike look. I was inspired by my youngest son, Adrián, and as I’ll be going in alphabetical order (not always), I started with the letter ‘A’. I recreated the egg flowers I used to draw in my digital artwork; in fact, this helped me a lot. I know that in practice, the creativity will come across much better, as will each design; this is my first one for this blank canvas notebook. I hope you like it. In addition to that, I recorded the whole process on video, in case you’d like to watch it. ---
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=CBkzFgghmY8
[POV This card is for you #caligraphy #name #tipografia](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=CBkzFgghmY8)


https://images.hive.blog/0x0/https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/equipodelta/23x1YN1cVfkFGFUApsNEqcy14kxB39rxwAvrfhHpVnSeH2hL1EmizukyCqHNz4teH41nn.jpg # Materiales / Materials https://images.hive.blog/0x0/https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/equipodelta/23x1YN1cVfkFGFUApsNEqcy14kxB39rxwAvrfhHpVnSeH2hL1EmizukyCqHNz4teH41nn.jpg
![Snapshot.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/equipodelta/23zGefYuVjt5bBgsZnpTqTA1zroxwcC2HW5pqoq84Bg6XiNt8e4cwuLVyBFashbNG8Ywd.JPG)

> |||| |-|-|-| |**Spanish**|**English**| | Boceto, forma de letra | Sketch, letterform | | Libreta de arte | Art notebook | Marcadores acrílicos | Acrylic markers | Marcadores permanentes | Permanent markers | Bolígrafo y lápiz | Pen and pencil | Borrador, colores escolares | Eraser, school colours

https://images.hive.blog/0x0/https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/equipodelta/23x1YN1cVfkFGFUApsNEqcy14kxB39rxwAvrfhHpVnSeH2hL1EmizukyCqHNz4teH41nn.jpg
|||| |-|-|-| ![Snapshot_1.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/equipodelta/23yJM3cd9rwidCSA8sidt7uSi2J91iu2b5biFr3X8fkgDscfSDVq1XH1oiy1WJ5oEWiJo.JPG)|![Snapshot_2.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/equipodelta/23zkrdnyfpgcNf9knA4Eq1iHEVJwskitwRr9qmnFLXgdgyNdLhjdwCV72Z5xMcLsx1vft.JPG) ![Snapshot_3.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/equipodelta/23xL2eaCXQJUNGbbyW74ESau593vV4jfqBTFzvciswsUTh4cGobDVSArXZU7DRLR4dk3h.JPG)

> [Esp] Teniendo mi boceto ahora lo reproduzco en la libreta. La inspiración de mi hijo, flores, muchas emociones bonitas y el deseo de hacerlo y disfrutarlo. Confieso no ser buena con los tipos de letra y caligrafía, solo veo tipos de letras en el procesador de texto y trato de seguir el estilo y aunque hacía estas cosas en mi infancia, no es lo mismo, hace muchos años, es como volver a empezar. Aprender lo aprendido, seguir estudiando y perfeccionando. Lo bueno es que acepto mis errores, desaciertos y que a veces no quedan muy estéticos, pero igual me gusta compartirlos, porque así puedo ver cómo he ido evolucionando.

> [Eng] Now that I have my sketch, I’m copying it into my notebook. Inspiration from my son, flowers, lots of lovely emotions, and the desire to do this and enjoy it. I must admit I’m not very good at lettering and calligraphy; I only see fonts in word processors and try to copy the style. And although I used to do these things as a child, it’s not the same—it was many years ago—so it’s like starting all over again. Learning what I’ve learnt, continuing to study and perfecting my skills. The good thing is that I accept my mistakes and missteps, and that sometimes they don’t look very neat, but I still like to share them, because that way I can see how I’ve been evolving.
---
https://images.hive.blog/0x0/https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/equipodelta/23x1YN1cVfkFGFUApsNEqcy14kxB39rxwAvrfhHpVnSeH2hL1EmizukyCqHNz4teH41nn.jpg?token=7e431c7db164fa4bff1436ce826f5301151c488c57a5dd67 |||| |-|-|-| ![Snapshot_4.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/equipodelta/23xAa4cvfre1UggkEfaAZ9Nuzx6whefgL3r23cGZMJFfgnEJWYtDNoXA4gjiVSwKXdGoS.JPG)|![Snapshot_5.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/equipodelta/23yJJjmD2qiUaywpXC3cx87yeYRQEbhprQz3yuUAnnLWcenuGKUup4oCL5Vgj1EA4WTmm.JPG) ![Snapshot_6.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/equipodelta/23xyZZqTk2u3LyyeoZ7ekycGg25U5ApD6HoYjq4fcHYoQBtmAsN4Y5G8FfdQMA4uwaFky.JPG)

> [Esp] Mi niña interior es feliz cuando hago estas cosas. Mi hijo está animado quiere hacer los suyos propios así que lo motivaré, en cuanto pueda compro sus propios materiales. Luego de trasladar el boceto, de igual manera es volver a dibujarlo pero al menos ya tengo la idea plasmada de lo que haré. Comienza el vaciado de color, me preocupan estos marcadores, espero que sean duraderos, pues la opalina tiende a tragar mucha tinta.

> [Eng] My inner child is happy when I do these things. My son is keen to make his own, so I’ll encourage him; as soon as I can, I’ll buy him his own materials. After transferring the sketch, it’s essentially redrawing it, but at least I now have a clear idea of what I’m going to do. I start filling in the colour. I’m a bit worried about these markers; I hope they’re long-lasting, as opaline tends to soak up a lot of ink. ---

> [Esp] Hay otro tipo de marcadores que me encantaría adquirir, son los acuarela, ya lo había intentado con acuarelas de verdad una vez y no me salió como esperaba, sin embargo he visto que los marcadores de acuarelas son más fácil de usar por la punta y precisión. Al diseño continuo llenando de color, hubiera querido las flores se entrelazaran de otra manera, en el próximo diseño lo estudiaré mejor. Los marcadores color negro que tengo, tienen la punta muy gruesa para este diseño, tendré que adquirir algunos, mientras tanto usé un bolígrafo de gel para remarcar los bordes.

> [Eng] There’s another type of marker I’d love to get my hands on: watercolour markers. I’d tried using proper watercolours once before, but it didn’t turn out as I’d hoped; however, I’ve noticed that watercolour markers are easier to use thanks to their tip and precision. As I continued to colour in the design, I wish the flowers had intertwined differently; I’ll give it more thought for the next design. The black markers I have have a tip that’s too thick for this design; I’ll have to buy some new ones. In the meantime, I used a gel pen to outline the edges. ---
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/equipodelta/23x1WoriLEgtUuXtiuPFvDSbme6bzm4pnHvzeSUG7iJHaUhrSJVUcrX55dWB69ueUGs13.png) |||| |-|-|-| ![Snapshot_11.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/equipodelta/243BiQDrZfapjtcHpSnEPcEk45yDPJnFaJVsQ9uafbPe7J3r3Qb9K6TsNtyT6faL6FKqj.JPG)|![Snapshot_12.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/equipodelta/23z7J59EQyrYY7H5QQvJ9xZMJHPfnCPZarLiTC3tdMtZWhVBVhbK7wqskpTMJg1KST4G2.JPG)|![Snapshot_13.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/equipodelta/243zfeihRQ12DBHPHVDzR6Nf8XLEFtLG5fqYvE5CN2YcBGWMjUhDqe9PBGSk7SkvM9Q5s.JPG) ![Snapshot_14.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/equipodelta/243qHQzTp64WVnwEmNnjBif8Zq3ERYvhaxLb9QER3C9xVcZTZfkRyTJ5LTkTxPbUBTSMW.JPG)

> [Esp] Hay ocasiones en las que grabo mi proceso y eso me estresa porque me desconcentro mucho al estar pendiente si la cámara graba o no, si se ve bien o no, luego la edición, como son tantas horas, es un trabajo enorme, agobia un poco. Sin embargo, hoy no fue así todo fluyó de una manera muy bonita, relajada y hasta la edición no fue nada pesada, lo que si es que tuve que cubrir mi cara con el círculo rosa porque salía de vez en cuando, no era la idea. Al terminarlo, lógicamente lo mostré a mi hijo y le super encantó. Espero que a ustedes también. ¡Me encanta el arte!

> [Eng] There are times when I film my process, and that stresses me out because I lose my concentration completely, constantly worrying about whether the camera is recording or not, or whether it looks good or not. Then there’s the editing – as it takes so many hours, it’s a massive job and it’s a bit overwhelming. However, today wasn’t like that at all – everything flowed beautifully, in a relaxed way, and even the editing wasn’t a bit of a slog. The only thing was that I had to cover my face with the pink circle because it kept popping up now and then; that wasn’t the idea. When I finished it, naturally I showed it to my son and he absolutely loved it. I hope you do too. I love art!
---

title.title: People are never poor, people's brains are poor.
title.body: > https://images.pexels.com/photos/7203695/pexels-photo-7203695.jpeg [sourch]( https://www.pexels.com/photo/background-of-brain-inscription-on-rugged-wall-7203695/ ) We live in this world with many people around us in society. These people are endowed with different types of mentality and thinking. Among these people around us, there are many so-called people who are very poor, some people are middle class and some people are very rich. In fact, when people are born, they are not born poor, middle class or rich. There are many people who are born into a family after birth, the financial situation of the child born is determined according to the financial capacity of that family. However, in this world of wealth, we can never give any guarantee. There are many poor or middle class people who have earned a lot of wealth by working hard. Again, there are many people who have been born into very rich families but have wasted everything due to their own intelligence. And it is because of wasting this wealth that they have become middle class or poor families later on. Therefore, it can be said that being rich or poor is a matter of fate as well as the result of karma. In fact, no matter what kind of family a person is born into, no matter what their financial situation is, they can improve their financial capabilities if they want. But since everyone's thinking is not the same, everyone's financial situation cannot be the same. In fact, it is completely wrong for us to say that a person is poor or that person is rich. Because a person is never rich or poor, rich or poor is a person's financial situation and that person's brain or thinking. If we look around us, we will see many people who could not study well and whose family's financial capabilities are very poor, yet they work hard and make their situation and financial capabilities much better through clever thinking. In fact, people's laziness and thinking make people poor and financially incapable. If we think that we will work hard and achieve success in life at some point and become much more financially prosperous, then no one can stop us. Along with working hard for financial progress, if we work according to the thoughts that we will develop, it will be possible to improve in life and become financially prosperous. But many people around us are seen who only blame their parents and the environment and do not work hard to improve themselves and do not even think about improving themselves. In fact, these people can only blame others and constantly use their own fate as an excuse. If a person wants, they can try to change their fate with their own work and that attempt becomes successful one day or another. Because the French Creator helps hard-working and well-thinking people. There are some people who think of spending it as soon as they earn something and do not think of saving, these people cannot save in any way for life, as a result, they are very far from the path of becoming rich by removing the name of poor in life. If we want to go from poor to rich, we should not have luxury and emotions. No matter how much we earn, we must save half of it and forget about luxury and work hard. We must keep emotions aside and work hard constantly, following the reality. If we keep earning money, we have to constantly think about how to save that money and how to earn more by investing it. If we keep trying to earn in different ways, one day we will definitely go beyond poor or middle class life and become financially prosperous and successful. In fact, we need to change our poor or low thinking, if we can change our thinking to think high and become wise by gaining knowledge from different aspects, then only then can we actually become rich. Because to become rich, just as we need to be financially prosperous, we also need to be much more wise. If we can become wise by gaining experience from different aspects and become a right person with beautiful thoughts, then we will be truly rich and this knowledge will also help us become financially wealthy. Knowledge from different aspects makes us wise to create a lot of wealth and achieve success in life. Therefore, we should try to change our situation through our own knowledge and actions without blaming others, our situation and our fate. Posted Using [INLEO](https://inleo.io/@ainun37/one-should-never-be-friends-with-an-enemy-kw)

title.title: DIY Centro de Mesa Divertido, Tridimensional y hecho desde cero  (Eng-Esp)
title.body:
>

My first children's centerpiece truly put my creativity to the test, as I wanted to make it large, three-dimensional, eye-catching, and fun—incorporating a mix of materials. I had some printable images among my creative stationery resources, but the real challenge lay in CREATING A COMPOSITION using the various characters and elements from the video game. It isn't just about having resources at your disposal, but rather what you are capable of doing with those resources to create something truly distinctive; to achieve this, you must tap into your CREATIVITY and \
Today, I’ll show you how I crafted my very first children's centerpiece... Welcome!

>

Mi Primer Centro de Mesa Infantil, puso a prueba mi Creatividad, porque quise hacerlo grande, tridimensional, con combinación de materiales, llamativo y divertido. Entonces, entre mis recursos de Papelería Creativa tenía algunas imágenes para imprimir, pero el reto es CREAR UNA COMPOSICIÓN con los diferente personajes y elementos del video juego. No es solo tener recursos a tu disposición, sino lo que eres capaz de hacer con esos recursos para crear algo distintivo, para ello hay que usar la CREATIVIDAD y \

. Hoy te muestro cómo elaboré mi Primero Centro de Mesa Infantil... Bienvenidos.

![1.1.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yennysferm71/48Jdc6HvjB6pew5HdXs9aN2peHgYVa1d1oNS9XNdVnYPWSEFXdCuaxmkzd5fG7No79.png)
> * Inkjet printer * 180 gsm Glossy Photo Paper * Gold metallic cardstock * Scissors, craft knife, and ruler * Liquid silicone glue * Craft foam * Cardboard * CDs * Wooden sticks * Floral wire

> * Impresora de Inyección de tinta * Papel Fotográfico Brillante 180 gr * Cartulina metalizada dorada * Tijera, cúter y regla * Silicón líquido * Foami * Cartón * Cd´s * Palitos de madera * Alambre de floristería

![1.2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yennysferm71/48J9eLYqGki7w1dDQNumVFLnEwufu9D8YYiSave7fHzMzpwgPtEkcNbujgXY2kkdQf.png)

>

I printed the digital assets—featuring various characters and elements from the video game—on high-quality, full-color photo paper. It is important to make use of all the available space on the photo paper.

>

Imprimí los recursos digitales de diferentes personajes y elementos del videojuego, en papel fotográfico, a full color de alta calidad. Es importante aprovechar todos los espacios que se tienen en el papel fotográfico.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yennysferm71/23yThUx9jggbiRFk1zbzC2muxmKEJ9Qa9uABCxLFjwXRUTR5vkuehxdoR7D7kounoSFsn.png)|![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yennysferm71/EoAbeanBfhiLfNPTQi9dJSBXv1q4z8yaMcNKLNYMfsS2wnXXphmXXgFk3sasPDQHXqk.png)| |-|-|

>

For the straight lines of the cube shape, I prefer to use a craft knife and a ruler, as this ensures clean, precise cuts. For the other shapes—the various characters—I use scissors, making sure to leave a white border around each one; this creates a \

that looks great and really makes them stand out. Afterward, I adhere them using liquid silicone and then trim around them once more, leaving a second margin; through this two-step process, the figures truly pop and catch the light beautifully.

>

Las líneas rectas de la figura del cubo, me gusta cortarlas con cúter y regla, ya que se realizan cortes prolijos. Las demás figuras de los diferentes personajes, las corto con tijera, considerando en todas un borde blanco alrededor, para que se forme un efecto de sticker que se ve muy bien y lo hace destacar bastante. Posteriormente, las pego con silicón líquido y vuelvo a recortar considerando otro espacio, con estos dos actos se logra que las figuras destaquen y resalten cuando les pega la luz.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yennysferm71/23vi6Uir9kJt4pNbj4Aw3FkoofH6UCUG9nuLeXNufQFBtyk5X5UWffXy4GWtLquV4QkDn.png)|![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yennysferm71/23vi1zuickoxks83m2nGkEgzQs2HfV6dJir8GqhGQTAX6MuuDytQCqEZ681REoJCZbbuz.png)|![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yennysferm71/EonmuJegd2XygDLoxTvAzRtUR8vWTBx7z6Q4hLNgPmsJjiBo3nEfakDXjthtpyZbZwR.png)|![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yennysferm71/23wqq7Lg2ZsTAnQdh5ikdEf5AGWMRxQbBfUF2MBviBQXptoLf23HykRVesDKBgTEUEPnL.png)| |-|-|-|-|

>

Returning to the yellow cube from the video game—which plays a rather important role in the design I have in mind—I proceed to mark the fold lines on the reverse side. I crease them thoroughly using a ruler, as well as my fingers or any other tool to apply pressure.

>

Volviendo al cubo amarillo del video juego, el cual tiene un papel bastante importante en el diseño que tengo pensado, procedo a marcar por el reverso las líneas que forman los doblez. Se doblan bien usando la regla y también los dedos o cualquier herramienta para hacer presión.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yennysferm71/23wgU9GVrcwkkRxVf5Zxp8wqDVy82FYKU23ztvytrfw2RYnqeUADy497Vzt3tuDPeE1df.png)|![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yennysferm71/23w2sdnEsH2TMPdmskwuR4UKwuQjP7LWQhRX1qmXSxBc9XJiWwYDFmrmVC8AGAp5fBVN5.png)|![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yennysferm71/23zGnoyBgeAfA2YwwqRpsTmSx1RNw8GfVufogzGcRo1TwRmPR6Uu7nCMzUcQv8wbXvk4Q.png)|![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yennysferm71/23wgPhRwJevbTRoc4Q48GCzFUbiz4NkhGs6az8gVrWjem89QU4JJmchngVjaejp5wBvSQ.png)| |-|-|-|-|

>

Finally, the flaps are glued into their respective places until the cube is fully assembled and closed. I create the base—to which everything will be attached—from scratch, using green craft foam, cardboard, and black craft foam; with these materials, I will construct the iconic pipe or conduit through which the characters move in the video game.

>

Finalmente se pegan las solapas en sus respectivos lugares, hasta tener el cubo bien armado y cerrado. La base donde se fijará todo la creo desde cero, con foami verde, cartón y foami negro, con esto crearé el emblemático tubo o cañería donde se desplazan los personajes en el video juego.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yennysferm71/23vsSc7B6TGwDxvgyGAGAFwkVZgeeStZ8KZfWh4dtxPGz6ozyc85f5vNqNzuPw7CYys1W.png)|![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yennysferm71/23wMcNZaGk1ZKzWRvvAEdLVrRADJrESBxMVxZ113DCmxtPnDVSz5TyYfgaF446vaR7CcR.png)|![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yennysferm71/23yJ7xZjjyMjj7yfMyhBwRua5ZGshh7FEHWaCwZZSB2RG28cAu8Ug4br1pM8z69HNoQqV.png)|![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yennysferm71/23wMh6yjts7BXZrp9fWjySzTD6fUraKsDWRovWV6BQJ1ELCZTrJNwbpopa7ZUG2BeUdxc.png)| |-|-|-|-|

>

I glue the cardboard and the black craft foam together to form a cylinder, which we can also fill with material scraps or Styrofoam. I attach a ring to the back of the main character, which I made using gold metallic cardstock.

>

Pego el cartón y el foami negro, formando un cilindro, que también podemos rellenar con recortes de materiales o con anime. Al personaje principal le coloco un aro en la parte posterior, el cual hice con cartulina metalizada dorada.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yennysferm71/242DDzkDXPdYDaS63ys4upSjhyEqhJgxP7keisLzEvbE3h9JGT4DG6notUeZxTqtwde2P.png)|![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yennysferm71/23xAXpybRDszJef9C2jb4MCWa7ohbLBep6GTopqoVG8PPPNJjJ4FfVyPLVAkqHMPZHeDw.png)|![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yennysferm71/23tbq2oaZRiRo2UDNLoiZSjwEF7rJiKJirNE9jZ5UFp9KbzWTyFzfMyyjEzn5k7qMWYze.png)|![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yennysferm71/23uQnD15FvE2TGKXLiDdHpVCFQwTMqoydErdPS6dNR2XtcFXgW8sNdUJxRx54rPh23EP3.png)| |-|-|-|-|

>

I glue the characters and stars onto the golden cardboard ring. To assemble the pieces, I use wooden sticks, which I glue to the back of the main character. I also attach a piece of floral wire to position the cube atop the character, creating the illusion that it is floating. I insert the wooden sticks into the green tube mentioned earlier, and place the cube at the very top. I added coins to various parts of the cube to give it a fully visible, three-dimensional effect.

>

Pego los personajes y estrellas sobre el aro de cartulina dorada. Para armar las piezas utilizo palitos de madera que pego en la parte trasera del personaje principal. También le agrego un alambre de floristería, para colocar el cubo en la parte superior del personaje, y que de la sensación de que flota. Inserto los palitos de madera en el tubería verde anterior, y en la parte superior coloco el cubo. Añadí las monedas en algunas partes del cubo, para darle un efecto tridimensional completamente visible.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yennysferm71/23xp8U9oWbYCeGsyTKjznnAmgFEBPvz9kRVzc4XJ3y1exsLvJZddZcHvH3TPP5dkuh4jN.png)|![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yennysferm71/23wqkAzmz4xVEM7qCQ3Kx1ezpxWCmF7DJntPrWEQAnyVtkcugEYmLBDNxJYqgEm9Zr76K.png)|![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yennysferm71/23wWyKCvgGMQaQYMVDpLtRX7TG22U6qQKNSgfXJfecgapN8WRNRajmpU1kpGoDbYDtT9g.png)|![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yennysferm71/23wgPfw7vbbzgkH3zeSjoCd9K78vNgvVx2ojprVpei3618CjiYc1Ye8srhRP2T1N2z1AJ.png)| |-|-|-|-|

>

Using white craft foam, I cut out the shape of the clouds; then, I glue them onto blue craft foam and cut them out again—always leaving a border around the edge to make them stand out more—and attach both clouds behind the main character.

>

Con Foami blanco recorto la forma de las nubes, y luego lo pego y recorto en foami azul, siempre dejando un borde alrededor para que destaque más, y pego ambas nubes detrás del personaje principal.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yennysferm71/23xehjhL1aAGfvBhKKej8htsFsGXHAXyxwozrwntesSwiAeWUWTv2n4EvBELu5n261JDN.png)|![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yennysferm71/23xAeLsJjdPHGWMBdysVT1Ur5Bf12Gv8p1YtpWysArLZnbgdBo8jXZyjaDdPUXdW9URJf.png)|![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yennysferm71/23yThMaZfXRtmr5y3WSi1ucQHN2UVYQfrv7zVc8i1YTSaTG235sTunCWaUC4MeFeXHND9.png)| |-|-|-|

>

To give the design more stability—and ensure it doesn't risk falling over—I will create a base using two recycled CDs, which I glued together with liquid silicone and then covered with brown glitter foam.

>

Para darle más estabilidad al diseño, y que no corra el riesgo de caerse, le haré una base utilizando 2 cd´s reciclados, los cuales pegué con silicón líquido y luego forré con foami escarchado de color marrón.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yennysferm71/23vsL5eNCdBRyGtqV54L3hoj5t6jDiMSErcCUFBGZtXmVR1KB9uJ89CME1gkNFLzrwZHy.png)|![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yennysferm71/23wqnwteEBntqvJAx6GUuPrTmXLJ8LGkUv1cRfr5LFc8zPnZ4ascbm876Yz2rxhmRfrgE.png)|![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yennysferm71/23vsNTvrkn1biDfTaoL9zosuZMLUmoNYxmkMNGwXx1sdsftdcfNbP8yJPgMspZHTYd3Ep.png)|![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yennysferm71/23xp8m2cwY39CbgdryMbXzu8pNDd8ouQm1XxxcZ9zgQeGinWXJt5EfWWqQvWfhoWYGrW4.png)| |-|-|-|-|

>

I am now finishing up placing the characters on the base, along with the birthday boy's name, keeping the overall design style in mind.

>

Ahora termino de colocar personajes en la base, el nombre del cumpleañero considerando todo el estilo del diseño.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yennysferm71/23xp8m2cwY39CbgdryMbXzu8pNDd8ouQm1XxxcZ9zgQeGinWXJt5EfWWqQvWfhoWYGrW4.png)|![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yennysferm71/23ynaeVgoewKQP8roEHxgAbKuotU9r2pXqFgZftgnvHgtxj1DAfNLEP8iHE1KtfG6UFaA.png)|![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yennysferm71/23yJQerb7gwDNfHpyH7QyFB73YzdL5hnySddGj71wA4T2BnZnN3mMUP1wxDuUe2gsFSri.png)|![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yennysferm71/23ydEPNCWbyLaeNXTqxpUwNKzXCVt3boU6Uj9RzoewsoXJtaVuAL5Cy6DGoKmi6mCiL6L.png)| |-|-|-|-|

>

The three-dimensional effect of the yellow cube is everything in this design; it looks truly beautiful, and the gold around the coins makes them stand out tremendously, reflecting the light when it moves or if the light

>

El efecto tridimensional del cubo amarillo, lo es todo en este diseño, se ve realmente hermoso y el dorado alrededor de las monedas las hace destacar muchísimo, y refleja la luz cuando se mueve o si la luz se mueve.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yennysferm71/23zGwZ2P5bSJdrdxKZxnfJF6oJd3J2FCkG2FtUUTrE82naCjFoTyCDzgxNutKnKk7JbaG.png)

>

Here is how this children's centerpiece turned out; it is quite large, yet remarkably stable despite its size. The colors are incredibly vibrant, and the composition itself looks spectacular—it truly looks as though this character stepped right out of the video game and onto the table.

>

Así quedó este Centro de Mesa Infantil, está grande y realmente está muy estable a pesar de su tamaño. Los colores son muy vibrantes y la composición en sí ha quedado espectacular, parece que este personaje salió del video juego directa a la mesa.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yennysferm71/23yx66dQHKbX8UTEzekDf2V3gWwUZKwnXVCMuBLvgE1jddYfPxNM5A4aMz8QtYGuhHQ1z.png)

>

Here is a short video where you can get a good look at the complete design—or check out this GIF. I have to tell you, the photos and the video really don't do justice to how beautiful everything looks with those vibrant colors and the gold cardstock adding that extra touch of visual interest.

>

Aquí les dejo un video cortito donde pueden apreciar el diseño completo, en este gif. Les digo que las fotos y el video se quedan cortos para describir lo lindo que luce todo con esos colores vibrantes y la cartulina dorada haciendo más interesante todo.

![A GIF.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yennysferm71/23xAdz7pwoiJrhSiXqEb47oDQA9LU1mc8niJ9rDqGuYqczFrEL9MFoECAacyKjeDvXG3N.gif)

>

I hope you enjoyed it, and that it inspires you to create interesting and fun designs, using your creativity and enjoying the process. See you in the next post!

>

Deseo que les haya gustado, y que se motiven a crear diseño interesantes y divertidos, utilizando la creatividad y disfrutando el proceso. Nos leemos en la siguiente publicación.

---
![Banner Yennys (1).png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yennysferm71/23x1UDsh3wbxYNeRiZGBnoUBHoQ9rTPsHyZDG5vBsdAKvvh3dGMKDer72GHhDuo4CZszq.png)
I took the photos with my phone **Redmi Note 8** Apps I used: Canva Pro for Cover, Collage and Banners I used **Deepl Translator** My social networks: Discord: YennysYaneth#0189 Twitter: @yennysferm Instagram: @yennysyaneth

title.title: Wrestlemania is over and Brock Lesnar has retired
title.body:
I was never going to tune into the two day event that was Wrestlemania but by gawd (Jim Ross voice) a lot of people did.   The crazy amount of money that people spend in order to go to these sorts of things is pretty nuts to me but I bet it really is a lot of fun to be there with the massive soundsystems and the pyrotechnical dislpays.

<center> https://i.ytimg.com/vi/74pOTdZNzZ4/maxresdefault.jpg
[src](https://i.ytimg.com/vi/74pOTdZNzZ4/maxresdefault.jpg)</center>

I did read over what went down at Wrestlemania and I at least knew who most of the people were other than the women.  I don't really think that the women's division is as popular as they make it out to be.  This I think is some sort of PC something or other that they feel they have to do.  In the past and when I thought WWE/WWF was in their glory days, the women were just kind of cartoon characters of sexuality and while I can get why some feminists out there might have a problem with this I don't think that very man (if any) women wrestling fans had an issue with it.  

<center> https://a57.foxnews.com/static.foxnews.com/foxnews.com/content/uploads/2026/04/1200/675/paige-brie-bella-wrestlemania-las-vegas-fox-news-001.jpeg?ve=1&tl=1
[src](https://a57.foxnews.com/static.foxnews.com/foxnews.com/content/uploads/2026/04/1200/675/paige-brie-bella-wrestlemania-las-vegas-fox-news-001.jpeg?ve=1&tl=1)</center>

That being said though, there is this one woman wrestler I know named Paige and there is a pretty fantastic film about her life and how she wanted to be a wrestler, was pushed down and told to go away over and over again and then through refusing to give up she eventually became the biggest female wrestling star in the world.  It is called *Fighting with my Family* and I highly suggest you check it out.  You don't have to enjoy or even appreciate wrestling to enjoy that movie. 

<center> https://imageio.forbes.com/specials-images/imageserve/69e59901a4fe14438ff149b8/WrestleMania-42/0x0.jpg?format=jpg&width=480
[src](https://imageio.forbes.com/specials-images/imageserve/69e59901a4fe14438ff149b8/WrestleMania-42/0x0.jpg?format=jpg&width=480)</center>

Apparently Roman Reigns won a belt of some sort but here is a little personal opinion about RR.  I've never liked him.  I think the WWE has been trying to push this guy for a very long time but the fans don't seem to really like him either.  They have tried to affiliate him with \

they have had guest stars promote him, the basically were trying to force people to become fans of him but despite the fact that he does everything he can to look like Jason Momoa, I just find him really basic.   

There is one guy that is a really big deal in WWE and that is Brock Lesnar 

<center> https://gsp-image-cdn.wmsports.io/cms/prod/bleacher-report/getty_images/2026-04/2272109744_large_cropped.jpg
[src](https://gsp-image-cdn.wmsports.io/cms/prod/bleacher-report/getty_images/2026-04/2272109744_large_cropped.jpg)</center>

You can't argue with the fact that this guy is a genuine genetic mutant.  He is not only huge and very strong, but he is a genuine real wrestling champion, he was the world heavyweight champion in UFC back when the heavyweight division was at its peak, and from the interviews I have seen with the guy he is a genuinely nice person and a fantastic father.   He also is quite introverted.

I think it was time for him to retire and that is exactly what he did at Wrestlemania 42

<center> https://athlonsports.com/.image/MjY6MDAwMDAwMDAxMTY1Mzc2/wrestlemania-42.jpg?io=1&profile=w2560&x=48&y=19
[src](https://athlonsports.com/.image/MjY6MDAwMDAwMDAxMTY1Mzc2/wrestlemania-42.jpg?io=1&profile=w2560&x=48&y=19)</center>

It was genuinely touching to see him take off his boots and gloves and leave them in the ring and have an embrace with long-time friend and hype-man Paul Heyman, who did almost all of the microphone work for Brock because that was the only thing his game was kind of lacking.  For as wonderful as he was at every other aspect of fighting, his mic skills just weren't very good.  But they made it work out because there aren't exactly a ton of 350 lb massive muscular dudes to choose from out there.

Brock will be a legend in the sport (and UFC too if you ask me) forever.   His departure from WWE is yet another blow to them as they seem to be kind of struggling to get any new talent to \

as far as the fans are concerned.  They keep bringing back old talent but the new blood for the most part is so irrelevant that I don't even know who any of these guys are.

No matter though I guess.  WWE is one of the most profitable sports leagues in the world, and it isn't even a real sport.  

Did you see it, are you a fan?  Do you have any favorites... do you know who Brock Lesnar is?  lol

title.title: Brookies | #FoodieMood | Esp-Eng
title.body:
![1000526071.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/eugelys/244y1qz38YhGoGtFE5C9Wn4H1F2nkm4t49pzH7sSRQTWWUcgzTrcfPu8fw6E52PHkcX91.jpg)






<div class=text-justify> 

Les debía esta receta de *brookies, pues estuve revisando mucho material para hacerla; de hecho, compartí una receta de galleta de chispas de chocolate y dos de brownie, todas diferentes en busca de la mezcla perfecta para hacer brookies*. 

###### ¿Y al final qué decidí hacer?


Busqué una receta diferente, ya que viendo recetas en Instagram me encantó la de *Audrysaurus*, entonces me decidí, fui comprando los ingredientes e hice este *brookies*, que es un postre supremo.

***¡Y ahora prepárate para esta jornada foodie!***


>I owed you this *brookies* recipe, since I spent a lot of time researching how to make them; in fact, I shared a chocolate chip cookie recipe and two brownie recipes—all different—in search of the perfect combination for *brookies*. 

>###### So what did I end up making?


>I looked for a different recipe, because while browsing recipes on Instagram, I fell in love with *Audrysaurus*’s version. So I made up my mind, bought the ingredients, and made these *brookies*, which are an absolute treat.

>***And now get ready for this foodie adventure!***


------------------
#### <center>Ingredientes <sup>(Ingredients)</sup> </center>
------------------------------


<div class=\

> *Galleta de chispas de chocolate* * 115 g de mantequilla sin sal. * 1/4 de taza de azúcar. * 1/2 taza de azúcar morena. * 1 huevo. * 1 cucharadita de vainilla. * 1 y 1/4 de taza de harina todo uso. * 1/2 cucharadita de bicarbonato de sodio. * 1 taza de chispas de chocolate. *Brownie* • 130g chocolate oscuro. • 75g mantequilla. • 1/3 taza de azúcar • 1/3 taza de azúcar morena. • 2 huevos. • 1 cucharadita de vainilla. • 1/3 taza de harina todo uso. • 1/6 taza (23g) de cacao en polvo. • Nueces/ pistachos.

> * *Chocolate Chip Cookies* * 115 g unsalted butter. * 1/4 cup sugar. * 1/2 cup brown sugar. * 1 egg. * 1 teaspoon vanilla extract. * 1 1/4 cups all-purpose flour. * 1/2 teaspoon baking soda. * 1 cup chocolate chips. _____ ----- _____ ----- ----- *Brownie* • 130 g dark chocolate. • 75 g butter. • 1/3 cup sugar • 1/3 cup brown sugar. • 2 eggs. • 1 teaspoon vanilla extract. • 1/3 cup all-purpose flour. • 1/6 cup (23g) cocoa powder. • Walnuts/pistachios. ------------------ ####
Preparación (How to make it)
------------------------------ ##### *Masa para la galleta* >##### *Cookie dough* * Para hacer masa de galletas, empieza haciendo la mantequilla dorada; puedes ver cómo se hace [aquí](https://peakd.com/hive-120586/@eugelys/mantequilla-dorada-or-foodiemood-or-esp-eng). Luego que esté a temperatura ambiente, añade huevos, azúcar blanca y morena, e integra. Agrega la harina, luego las chispas de chocolate, y forma una masa. Reserva en la nevera. > To make the cookie dough, start by making golden butter; you can see how to do it [here](https://peakd.com/hive-120586/@eugelys/mantequilla-dorada-or-foodiemood-or-esp-eng). Once it’s at room temperature, add the eggs, white sugar, and brown sugar, and mix well. Add the flour, then the chocolate chips, and form a dough. Set aside in the refrigerator. ![1000526069.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/eugelys/23xAa7cMRZFcpEo5TdNEHSPLdFJSQzSPgzasdXsPWx2XVcGVij75uCuWnMoqJKBERo5QU.jpg) ![1000526070.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/eugelys/23zS1AV12amnQakXNFZRNqf817TcpV2hmECXWRpERvV5o5DPemy1e9YmuEShVaMxzdKou.jpg) ##### *Masa para el brownie* > ##### *Brownie batter* * Para preparar el brownie, derrite la mantequilla con el chocolate. Recomiendo usar chocolate oscuro, que aporta un sabor más profundo. Reserva esta mezcla hasta que esté a temperatura ambiente. >To make the brownie, melt the butter with the chocolate. I recommend using dark chocolate, which gives it a richer flavor. Set this mixture aside until it reaches room temperature. ![1000526072.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/eugelys/23xyRCuvxYdAXHuLjP4jttuvBUcL6a6knmofvQURwkeUoVK4oGUHEqjKmV5bjL7caGSGs.jpg) ![1000526073.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/eugelys/23wWuGXYTc8zp4ndEHoe59BBGKR6bYva6mQLbYyeNqDd99SRjcka1byqKqcyf9rzbxV8Q.jpg) * Coloca los huevos, azúcar blanca y morena, vainilla en el bol de la batidora y bate hasta que haya duplicado su volumen. También puedes hacerlo a mano, pero recuerda que tomará más tiempo. Luego añadirás esta mezcla a la mezcla de azúcar y mantequilla; agrega la vainilla. Agrega la harina e integra. > Place the eggs, white and brown sugar, and vanilla in the mixer bowl and beat until the mixture has doubled in volume. You can also do this by hand, but keep in mind that it will take longer. Then add this mixture to the sugar and butter mixture; stir in the vanilla. This is what boiled my blood the most: the milk. Please, just leave it alone. Because of people like them, I have to rely on packaged milk because I simply cannot trust non-branded options. At least with brands, we can file a consumer court case if they sell us something that could literally kill us.

By the way, you might remember I mentioned a robbery that resulted in a murder. The update is that the murderer was caught, and the police shot him in the leg. I know that in these 'encounters,' the police often do this even if it isn't strictly necessary, especially in cases with significant social media attention. Psychologically, a lost leg can be seen as an equivalent to a lost life.

It makes me wonder: why did he commit murder? Why the robbery? Was it narcotics? A gambling addiction? Or perhaps the influence of 'massage centers' and 'guest houses'? So many questions filled my mind, not in his defense, but to identify the flaws in our broken society. Some of these issues feel connected to me and my family as well. There are small, bad habits that, if not stopped early, can trigger a chain reaction.

As I write this, my mind is overwhelmed with thoughts about the flaws in the system. And don't even get me started on how I am trying to map this to Hive as well. When a system's design is flawed, we eventually witness a domino effect.

BRAIN FART: In zainab killer case, he was molested as a child too. 
Not defending him of course, just looking at route causes.

Also, sorry for getting side tracked, it happens with me that one conversation leads to another.

每次出门最恼火的就是回去晚了就只有外面吃，而我真的有点难为情，不想吃，回家现煮又要饿得呱呱叫，就只有下馆子。

然后丑丑选择吃撒子他也头大吧，我这不吃那不吃，我这吃不得那吃不得的。

他想吃的我不吃，其他的清淡的不想吃，每次吃了就口渴，所以也恼火。

最后他绞尽脑汁，去吃的正禾鲜牛肉汤锅，好吧，据说有点小贵，但是我真的也不感冒，六七为了不饿而吃吧。

周末还人挺多的，已经坐满了，我们还等了一会儿才入座，两个人点的套餐，看着没几个菜品少少的样子，结果两个人吃得饱饱的，各种部位的牛肉，笑死，然后我还点评哪个吃起来嫩，我就吃肉和萝卜，那个红烧的牛肉是真的咸，吃了几块我就没吃了，还好，汤锅没有我想象中的浓汤宝味道，还可以吃，就是牛肉吃着还是挺费牙的，现在牙齿可太不好了，感觉像个中老年人。

还送了我们两杯小甜水，百香果蜜，喝了一口，好甜啊，丑丑也觉得甜，两个人都没喝小甜水了，真的跟我待久了，丑丑对甜也很敏感了，哈哈哈，  丑丑还是受我很多影响，不咋个吃垃圾食品，不咋个吃甜，少吃冰，少了饮料，现在他可忌得好了呢，以前那是敞开了吃。

title.title: [ESP-ING] Visiting San Mateo Square
title.body:
width=472 height=49 border=0>
[//]:# (!worldmappin 10.21083 lat -67.41928 long d3scr)

> He pasado muchas veces por San Mateo y nunca había ido a la plaza de San Mateo, y es que pasar por allí no implica que uno entre donde está la plaza Bolívar, porque la carretera nacial o principal esta por otra vía, así que solo he pasado por esa carretera varias veces y nunca me había parado un momento para ir a conocerla pues siempre íbamos de afán. Mi esposo y yo fuimos a ver esta plaza y me trajo recuerdos muy bonitos de una plaza en Trujillo, de esas plazas bonitas, al llegar nos estacionamos cerca de una heladería y de verdad siempre una plaza debe haber una heladería, ventas de comida, esta heladería se veía muy bonita y nueva me gusta que alrededor de las plazas siempre tengan algunos que otros comercios que inviten a Los visitantes a disfrutar un poco dentro de la plaza, degustando algo.

> Esta es una de las plazas que he visto que está muy limpia y cuidada, para mí una de las mejores plazas, todas han estado limpias pero esta su piso brilla, se nota que la mantienen, además hay personas que cuidan de la plaza de que los niños, adultos y jóvenes no dañen sus espacios, de eso me puede dar cuenta al estar allí sentada, había una señora pendiente y otros señores también que trabajan allí todo el día. Los bancos de esta Plaza son de cemento y se nota que tiene un estilo moderno esta Plaza seguro estuvo en reconstrucción hace poco tiempo porque se nota que sus espacios están muy cuidados además tiene lámparas modernas y también faroles antiguos que le dan una especie de modernidad y a la vez algo de antigüedad. En el centro de la plaza hay una estatua de Simón Bolívar mirando hacia el norte, tiene una forma circular en el centro muy amplia y además el suelo que es de granito tiene una forma de estrella muy grande y esta misma forma de estrella da las salidas de algunas caminerías de la plaza, a un lado está como un anfiteatro donde habían un colegio haciendo un acto era como una especie de concha acústica grande.

> Por supuesto que esta Plaza también tiene una iglesia, la cual se construyó el 30 de noviembre de 1920, con la ayuda de todos los pobladores de aquel entonces, la iglesia San Mateo Apóstol tuvo una recuperación en el año 2021, este templo dicen que custodia a la virgen de Belén, por lo que es una de sus reliquias,, está iglesia reprewnta el casco colonial de la época , me gusto mucho como esta pintada, y los toques dorados de su columnas, me encanta que la calle este cerrada frente a la plaza, y esto lo convierte en un pequeño paseo, imagino que de noche se debe ver hermoso con las luces, y las ventanas coloniales muy cerca de este pequeño paseo.

> A otro lado de la plaza está un colegio llamado nuestra señora de Belén que es grande y tienen afuara unos asientos para los estudiantes que tambien embellecen el lugar, la calle cerrada junto a la plza hace que se vea mucho mejor, allí en la plaza hay unas banderas hizadas que representan el estado Aragua, la ciudad de San Mateo y Venezuela, se ouede divisar unas montañas que se ven al fondo de la plaza que uno puede sentir la naturaleza, me encantó esta visita la pasé genial.

width=472 height=49 border=0>
--- >! [ENGLISH] > >I’ve driven through San Mateo many times but had never been to San Mateo Square. The thing is, just passing through doesn’t mean you end up at Bolívar Square, because the main highway runs along a different route. So I’ve only driven along that highway several times and had never stopped for a moment to check it out, since we were always in a hurry. > >My husband and I went to see this plaza, and it brought back very fond memories of a plaza in Trujillo—one of those beautiful plazas. When we arrived, we parked near an ice cream shop, and honestly, every plaza should have an ice cream shop and food stalls. this ice cream shop looked very nice and new; I like that around the plazas there are always a few shops that invite visitors to enjoy themselves a bit within the plaza, sampling something. > >

> > >This is one of the squares I’ve seen that’s very clean and well-maintained; for me, it’s one of the best. All of them have been clean, but the pavement here shines—you can tell it’s well-maintained. There are also people who look after the square to make sure children, adults, and young people don’t damage the area. I could see that just by sitting there; there was a woman keeping an eye on things, and other men who work there all day. > >The benches in this plaza are made of concrete, and you can tell it has a modern style. This plaza must have been recently renovated because you can see that its spaces are very well-maintained. It also has modern lamps and antique streetlights that give it a sense of modernity and, at the same time, a touch of antiquity. > >In the center of the plaza there is a statue of Simón Bolívar facing north; it has a very wide circular base, and the granite floor is shaped like a very large star. This star shape marks the entrances to some of the plaza’s walkways. On one side there is an amphitheater-like area where a school was holding an event; it was like a large acoustic shell. > >

> > >Of course, this plaza also has a church, which was built on November 30, 1920, with the help of all the townspeople at the time. The Church of St. Matthew the Apostle underwent restoration in 2021; it is said that this church houses the Virgin of Bethlehem, making her one of its relics. This church represents the colonial architecture of the era. I really liked how it’s painted and the golden accents on its columns. I love that the street is closed off in front of the plaza, turning it into a small promenade. I imagine it must look beautiful at night with the lights and the colonial windows right next to this little walkway. > >

> > >On the other side of the square is a school called Nuestra Señora de Belén, which is large and has outdoor seating for students that also adds to the beauty of the place; the closed-off street next to the square makes it look much nicer. In the square, there are flags flying that represent the state of Aragua, the city of San Mateo, and Venezuela. You can see some mountains in the background of the square, and you can really feel nature there. I loved this visit; I had a great time. > >

La chiquita Galaxia es una perrita que deseamos de corazón se adapte a nosotros y nos acepte como su nuevo hogar. 

Ella vivía en el frente de un vecino del sector. El hace un tiempo la ayudó con un problema de garrapatas que tenía.

Ella desde entonces se quedó en su frente y lo seguía a todas partes. Pero no fue adoptada completamente. Seguía en la calle pasando hambre y frío. 

De un tiempo para acá sentí la necesidad de cambiar su vida. Se nota es una perrita muy leal. 

Le pregunté si me la podía traer y me dijo que si. Entonces desde hace par de días la cuidamos y confiamos que con nuestra presencia y entrega de amor nos elija como su familia. 

Galaxia es una perrita de un año aunque esté bien chiquita. No sé cómo lo haremos cuidar de dos perritas pero confío que será posible. .

**English Version**

Little Galaxia is a dog we truly hope will adjust to us and accept us as her new home. 

She used to live in front of a neighbor’s house in the neighborhood. A while back, he helped her with a tick problem she had.

Since then, she’s stayed in front of his house and followed him everywhere. But she wasn’t fully adopted. She was still on the street, hungry and cold. 

For a while now, I’ve felt the need to change her life. You can tell she’s a very loyal dog. 

I asked him if he could bring her to me, and he said yes. So for the past couple of days, we’ve been taking care of her, and we’re confident that with our presence and love, she’ll choose us as her family. 

Galaxia is a one-year-old dog, even though she’s very small. I don’t know how we’ll manage to take care of two dogs, but I’m confident it will be possible.

links.body:
![Ccats.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jlinaresp/AJg77BvCfCw3VQiyZQTDUPDgGDzHq28AhRjr4GgfrJV4FkuwSh9UoPZ84Hq6rR8.jpg)

----

**T**oday the rain returned to the Montalbán valley, and I also finished some pending tasks quite early. So the afternoon was perfect for spending some time selecting some of my unpublished photos taken during my most recent countryside excursions and experimenting freely with processing and editing them.

**T**he \
for this series of photos I'm sharing with you today begins with the RAW files, which I processed using the \

converter liberally, as well as sharpening adjustments, luminance curves, and some color intensity reductions. Only after this did I export to JPG, and that's where I started playing with the color channels, using fade layers, vignetting, and levels until I achieved the desired results. Obviously, in between all of this was the step of cropping to 16:9 and compositing the photos. But the truth is, I do this in a rather haphazard way, with a very noticeable empirical approach. Well, I'm not one to use presets or anything like that, so the intention here was to treat each photo according to its character and following my creative needs...

>**H**oy la lluvia hizo nuevamente acto de presencia en al valle de Montalbán y además terminé bastante temprano de atender algunas tareas pendientes que tenía. Así que la tarde fue muy propicia para invertir algo de mi tiempo en seleccionar algunas de mis fotos inéditas hechas durante mis más recientes excursiones campestres, y experimentar con mucha libertad procesándolas y editándolas...

>**L**a \
para esta serie de fotos que traigo para compartir con ustedes hoy, comienza desde los archivos RAW, los cuales procesé usando de manera muy generosa el conversor de \

así como el los ajustes de enfoque, las curvas de luminosidad y algunos descensos de intensidad cromática, y solo después de esto exporte a JPG y allí fue donde me dediqué a jugar con los canales de color, con capas de atenuación, viñetas y niveles hasta lograr los resultados que deseaba. Obviamente, en medio de todo esto estuvo el paso de recortar a 16:9 y componer las fotos. Pero la verdad, es que hago esto de manera anárquica y con un toque empírico muy notable. Pues no soy un tipo de usar presets ni nada por el estilo, así que la intención aquí era la de tratar cada foto según su carácter y siguiendo mi necesidad creativa...
