links.title: Television Review: The Ghost of Harrenhal (Game of Thrones, S2X05, 2012)
links.body:
![(source:tmdb.org)](https://image.tmdb.org/t/p/original/sFxTzfIpBTpIR1NJd474RFLbal2.jpg)

**The Ghost of Harrenhal (S02E05)**

Airdate: 29 April 2012

Written by: David Benioff & D. B. Weiss
Directed by: David Petrarca

Running Time: 54 minutes 


The fifth episode of *Game of Thrones*' second season, *The Ghost of Harrenhal*, demonstrates from its very first scene that this series operates under a dramatically different narrative philosophy than most conventional television. Where a typical show would build tension across an entire episode, saving its most shocking twist for a climactic final act, *Game of Thrones* instead places its most consequential event at the very beginning. The assassination of Renly Baratheon occurs within the opening minutes, a bold structural choice that immediately signals to the audience that the writers, David Benioff and D. B. Weiss, are more interested in exploring the consequences of cataclysmic events than in milking suspense from their mere occurrence. This willingness to upend conventional storytelling expectations is what elevates the series above its fantasy peers.

The event in question is unfolds in Renly Baratheon’s tent in the presence of Lady Catelyn Stark, who had been attempting to negotiate an alliance, and Brienne of Tarth, who was sworn to protect him. Both women are left utterly stunned when the perpetrator reveals itself to be a dark, spectral presence — the product of black magic secretly summoned by Melisandre, the red priestess in service to Stannis Baratheon. The shadow creature, born from Stannis's own seed and Melisandre's sorcery, cuts Renly down before either woman can react. Catelyn and Brienne, however, are immediately confronted with a more pressing concern than comprehending what they have witnessed: everyone in the camp naturally assumes they are the assassins. Forced to flee for their lives, the two women escape into the night. On the road, Brienne, wracked with guilt over her failure to protect her liege, swears her loyalty to Catelyn, on the condition that she be permitted to take personal vengeance against Stannis should the opportunity ever arise. It is a beautifully handled moment of character transition, as Brienne's oath transfers from a dead king to a living lady.

In the immediate aftermath, Renly's army disintegrates with startling speed. His bannermen, still nominally sworn to the Lord Paramount of the Stormlands — now Stannis, as the sole surviving Baratheon brother — flock to his cause. The Tyrells, including Loras and Margaery, flee southwards under the protection of Petyr Baelish, apparently losing both the marriage alliance as leverage and any remaining interest in participating in the conflict. Stannis, now commanding a vastly superior force, orders Davos Seaworth to command the naval attack on King's Landing, though he accepts Davos's prudent suggestion that Melisandre should remain behind. It is a rare moment of wise counsel being heeded, and it speaks to the unique bond between the rigid king and his smuggler-turned-knight.

Back in King's Landing, the news of Renly's death is received with delight by Cersei, but Tyrion is far less sanguine. He recognises that Stannis, having absorbed Renly's forces, now holds overwhelming superiority over the Lannisters on both land and sea. Tyrion's investigation into the queen's secret activities leads him to the Alchemists' Guild, where he discovers that Cersei has ordered the production of Wildfire, an extremely flammable and dangerous substance she apparently intends to use in the city's defence. Demonstrating his characteristic cunning, Tyrion orders that production continue — but under his direction, not hers. It is a quiet coup, executed with the subtlety that defines Tyrion's approach to power.

At Harrenhal, Arya Stark, serving as Tywin Lannister's cupbearer, becomes privy to the strategic conferences of the Lannister command. Her intelligence catches Tywin's attention, though he dismisses her as nothing more than a Northern commoner, entirely unaware that he is confiding in the daughter of his greatest enemy. The scenes between Maisie Williams and Charles Dance are among the episode's finest, charged with a tension that derives from the audience's knowledge of what Tywin does not know. Arya's words — \

— could serve as the series' unofficial motto, a chilling reminder of the fragility of power in Westeros. Her reunion with Jaqen H'ghar, now disguised as a Lannister man-at-arms, introduces a fascinating new dimension to her storyline. Jaqen explains that she saved three lives during the attack on the Northern prisoners, and that the Red God is therefore owed three deaths. She must name three men to be killed. She begins with the Lannister soldier who tortured prisoners for sport, and Jaqen obliges with brutal efficiency.

In Lordsport, Theon Greyjoy is given a ship called the *Sea Bitch*, with which he is expected to raid a fishing village in the North. He finds the crew dismissive of his lack of experience, but Dagmer (Ralph Ineson), the first mate, proves an exception — especially after Theon reveals his audacious plan to divert Northern forces from Winterfell. Back at Winterfell, Bran Stark tells of dreams in which the sea attacks the castle and his subjects drown, ominous portents that the audience understands in ways the characters cannot.

In Qarth, Daenerys Targaryen enjoys the hospitality of Xaro Xhoan Daxos and takes delight in watching her dragons learn to feed themselves and breathe fire. These creatures have become the talk of the city, and various factions vie for her favour, each apparently seeking to gain control of the dragons. One such figure is Pyat Pree (Ian Hanmore), a warlock who wishes Daenerys to visit the House of the Undying. Xaro informs Daenerys of Robert Baratheon's death and the subsequent civil war in the Seven Kingdoms, then makes his play: he asks for her hand in marriage in exchange for financing her campaign across the Narrow Sea. Jorah Mormont, however, fears that she would lose her independence by accepting, and volunteers instead to find a single ship sufficient to bring her followers once she lands in Westeros.

Beyond the Wall, the Lord Commander's troop reaches the Fist of the First Men, where they rendezvous with the experienced ranger Qhorin Halfhand (Simon Armstrong). He suggests that Mance Rayder's force, numerically superior and increasingly disciplined, can only be defeated by an assassination raid on Mance's camp. Jon Snow volunteers for the mission, eager to prove his worth.

*The Ghost of Harrenhal* is a very good episode, though, like its predecessor, its title refers to a storyline that is not the most important or consequential — at least at this stage. Arya's narrative is nevertheless fascinating, particularly her conversations with Tywin, which can be interpreted in myriad ways and showcase Williams delivering one of the series' most memorable performances. The relationship with Jaqen H'ghar, revealed to be a skilful assassin bound by a religion-inspired code of honour, is equally compelling.

Benioff and Weiss, in their script, wisely resolve the cliffhanger from the previous episode — the birth of Melisandre's shadow demon — in a practical, no-nonsense manner, immediately demonstrating what that entity can do. The assassination scene itself is not particularly well-directed, perhaps because it occurs in darkness, but its consequences are handled with far greater skill. The event drastically redraws the balance of power in Westeros, arguably making it the most consequential development since Ned Stark's execution. The script economically handles the various locations and subplots, ensuring that no storyline feels neglected.

Qarth, with its racially diverse population and exotic, Oriental-inspired costumes, offers a welcome respite from the dreary, cold, and grey aesthetic of Westeros. Yet, in an uncharacteristic return to the modesty of broadcast-era television, HBO chose to depart from Martin's source material by having the Qartheen women keep their breasts covered. It is a minor but notable concession to American network sensibilities.

Fans of history will appreciate the introduction of Wildfire, which is clearly inspired by Greek fire, the Byzantine secret weapon used to defend Constantinople from numerically superior foes in the early Middle Ages. This underlines the parallels between King's Landing and that real-life city, which was famous for its court intrigue and dysfunctional politics, marked by religious fanaticism and street violence.

Roy Dotrice, the highly respected British stage actor, appears in the role of Hallyne, the leader of the Alchemists' Guild. Dotrice, previously known for providing the voice for the audiobook versions of Martin's novels, was originally cast as Pycelle, but being in his late eighties, had to relinquish the role to Julian Glover due to ill health. When he recovered sufficiently, he was cast as Hallyne instead, a delightful bit of casting that rewards attentive viewers. The episode is also notable for featuring Snæfellsjökull, a glacier in Iceland, as one of the impressive locations that stand in for the unforgivingly cold areas north of the Wall.

In sum, *The Ghost of Harrenhal* is an episode defined by its willingness to upend expectations, to kill off major characters without warning, and to explore the messy, unpredictable consequences of political violence. It is not perfect — the assassination scene is visually murky, and the Qarth storyline has yet to find its dramatic footing — but it represents the series operating at a high level of craft and ambition. The episode's greatest achievement is in making the audience feel the weight of Renly's death not as a cheap shock but as a genuine turning point in the war for Westeros, one whose repercussions will be felt for seasons to come.




RATING: 7/10 (+++)

links.body:
#### <center>─── ❖ ── ✦ ── ❖ ───</center>  

 
 
# <center> ✦ ***The kitchen is part of the family*** ✦</center>

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmd1Vj2j97JczJVuhqhmCx8qQo6NUePxQWtaEHeGvjVjvV/nathan_dumlao_erpuu4wgqbm_unsplash.jpg)

 

#### 📸https://unsplash.com/es/fotos/persona-sosteniendo-cuenco-de-ceramica-blanca-con-sopa-eRPuU4WGqbM

I sit down to write these lines as a familiar aroma wafts from my kitchen, one I remember well despite the passage of time, despite the distances. It's the smell of the stew that used to simmer on Sundays, a blend of ingredients almost like something out of a chemical laboratory: smoked meats, preserves, vegetables, and spices. The funny thing is, I had completely forgotten the recipe, I barely remembered it, until the aroma filled every corner, and only with that scent lingering in the air could I feel the intense flavor on every one of my taste buds.

It's a flavor that reminds me of decades past, decades when the family was whole and together, not so scattered across the globe as we are now. A time when everything was simpler, when everything was closer and warmer, even though winter felt a bit more intense in that city than it does here.

I remember the months of November and December as the time when this smell covered the house, there we were all together, all the siblings, all around the table, all helping, all contributing something, but above all laughing, we don't laugh like before, there aren't as many of us as before, even so we all love each other: those who are here and those who have left.

It's incredible to think how a scent can unlock memories, how a scent can signify family. Here's my brother, my faithful confidant, my aunt with her warm hands and her time always ready to listen and advise with the wisdom of someone nearing a century, who has become a child again; here are my cousin and her husband, she smiling and concerned about everything, organizing everything from the moment she arrives; his wife, a new friend and new family, with the same tastes in sports and beer as I do.

Today the kitchen in my house was used again, not for coffee or simply reheating yesterday's leftovers, but to prepare a stew, one of my own recipes, one made with the love of generations. One I savored in childhood and that is linked to my moments of happiness. Today the kitchen smells of presence again, even though there are only five of us. Tonight we will sit at the table, give thanks and eat, laugh and tell stories.

There will also be sadness in the middle of dinner, I know it, the sadness of those who have left, the sadness for the fears of time. The questions that are there but no one dares to ask. Perhaps someone will cry when the wine mixes with the beer and the memories.

It had been a long time since I'd been with my family, not like this, not at home, not in a shared space, and certainly not for more than a day. This will be a week that promises to play with feelings and memories, and there's no better way to start it than with a dish of memories.

Perhaps I should learn that magic recipe, perhaps I should prepare it myself when loneliness feels most bitter, but I know that it has something that goes beyond ingredients and exact quantities, gram by gram. Instead, today I'm going to make that flan dessert, the one whose true quality you can only know when you unmold it, and which my aunt makes better than I do.

The flavors are anchored in time. It saddens me that I didn't acquire the knowledge and art of preparing them and can't pass them on to my children. So, to ensure they aren't forgotten, I'll ask my brother to write down the recipe, and I'll keep it somewhere safe. Perhaps when I'm gone, someone will find it, someone will prepare it and discover a unique flavor, not of memories but of novelty, and they'll begin to prepare it for their dinners, along with their family.

This little kitchen, with its oven that seems to hold more pots than it heats, has become a meeting place, it has become part of my family.


\

my aunt says.

My youngest cousin has grown up far away, so she doesn't know what we're talking about. She doesn't know that this dish she's tasting today, with its rich and delicious flavor, was born out of scarcity, from barely having enough to eat, but also from the desire to always have the family together.

#### <center>─── ❖ ── ✦ ── ❖ ───</center>  

 
 
# <center> ✦ ***La cocina es parte de la familia*** ✦</center>

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmd1Vj2j97JczJVuhqhmCx8qQo6NUePxQWtaEHeGvjVjvV/nathan_dumlao_erpuu4wgqbm_unsplash.jpg)

 

#### 📸https://unsplash.com/es/fotos/persona-sosteniendo-cuenco-de-ceramica-blanca-con-sopa-eRPuU4WGqbM

Me siento a escribir estas líneas, mientras de la cocina de mi casa sale un aroma conocido, uno que recuerdo bien a pesar del tiempo, a pesar de las distancias, es el olor del guiso que se cocía los domingos, con una mezcla casi de laboratorio químico de ingredientes: carnes ahumadas, conservas, vegetales y especias. Lo divertido es que había olvidado por completo la receta, lo divertido es que apenas lo recordaba, hasta que el aroma inundó cada rincón, y solo con ese aroma flotando en el aire pude sentir en cada una de mis papilas gustativas el intenso sabor.

Es un sabor que me recuerda décadas pasadas, décadas donde la familia estaba completa y junta, no tan dispersada por los confines del globo terráqueo como ahora. Un tiempo donde todo era más simple, donde todo era más cercano y más cálido, incluso aunque en aquella ciudad el invierno se sentía un poco más que en esta.

Recuerdo los meses de noviembre y diciembre como la fecha en la que este olor cubría la casa, ahí estábamos todos juntos, todos los hermanos, todos alrededor de la mesa, todos ayudando todos aportando algo, pero sobre todo riendo, ya no reímos como antes, ya no somos tantos como antes, aun así nos queremos todos: los que están y los que se fueron.

Es increíble pensar como un aroma puede destapar los recuerdos, como un aroma puede significar familia. Aquí está mi hermano, mi cómplice fiel, mi tía con sus cálidas manos y su tiempo siempre dispuesto para escuchar y aconsejar con la virtud de quien se acerca al siglo, y volvió a ser niño, aquí están mi prima y su esposo, ella sonriente y preocupada por todo, ordenándolo todo desde que llega, su esposa, nuevo amigo y nueva familia, con los mismos gustos en deporte y cerveza que yo.

Hoy se ha vuelto a usar la cocina de mi casa, no para un café o un simple calentado de las sobras del día anterior, se usó para preparar un guiso, uno de receta propia, uno hecho con amor de generaciones. Uno que saboreé en la infancia y que se ligó a mis momentos de felicidad. Hoy la cocina vuelve a oler a presencia, aunque apenas somos cinco. Hoy en la noche nos sentaremos en la mesa, agradeceremos y comeremos, nos reiremos y contaremos historias.

También en el medio de la cena habrá la tristeza, ya lo sé, la tristeza de quienes se fueron, la tristeza por los miedos del tiempo. Las preguntas que están y nadie se atreve hacer. Quizás alguien llore cuando el vino se mezcle con la cerveza y los recuerdos.

Hacía mucho que no estaba con mi familia, no así, no en casa, no en un espacio compartido, y mucho menos no más de un día. Esta será una semana que promete jugar con los sentimientos y con los recuerdos, y no hay mejor manera de iniciarla que con un plato de recuerdos.

Quizás debería aprender yo esa receta mágica, quizás debería preparármela yo cuando la soledad se sienta más áspera, pero sé que en ella hay algo que va más allá de ingredientes y de cantidades exactas gramo a gramo. Yo en cambio me brindo hoy a hacer el postre aquel flan que solo se puede saber como queda cuando se desmolda y que mi tía hace mejor que yo.

Los sabores con anclas del tiempo, me da tristeza no haber adquirido el conocimiento y el arte de su preparación y no poder pasarlo a mis hijos, así que para que no se olvide le diré a mi hermano que anote la receta, y la guardaré en algún lugar, quizás cuando yo ya no esté alguien la encuentre, alguien la prepare y le resulte un sabor único, no de recuerdos sino de novedad, y comience a prepararla en sus cenas, junto a su familia también.

Hay esta pequeña cocina, con su horno que solo guarda cazuelas más de lo que calienta se ha convertido en punto de encuentro, se ha convertido en parte de mi familia.

-Había veces que ni teníamos para un plato de lenteja -dice mi hermano y se ríe
-Eras muy pequeño- le respondo a él
-Aun así éramos felices- dice mi tía

Mi prima la más joven creció ya lejos así que no sabe de qué hablamos, no sabe que este plato que hoy prueba y que su sabor es tan delicioso y fuerte, se creó de la escasez, de apenas tener para comer, pero aun así, de los deseos de tener la familia siempre junta.

links.title: Color lavanda / Lavender color 💜(ES/EN)
links.body:
> Siempre llamativo el tema de los colores para sentir que nos expresamos a través de ellos. El columnista @emiliorios nos trae [Cromoterapia o la Importancia del Color -Elige una Imagen y Comparte tus Ideas- Conociendo al Usuario (ES/EN)](https://hive.blog/hive-131951/@emiliorios/cromoterapia-o-la-importancia-del-color-elige-una-imagen-y-comparte-tus-ideas-conociendo-al-usuario-esen) este aporte en varias oportunidades variando las imágenes y por supuesto el color. Un extraordinario paseo nos ha aportado nuestra amiga @purrix [Púrpura infinito 💜 / Infinite Purple 💜](https://hive.blog/hive-131951/@purrix/purpura-infinito-infinite-purple) sobre esas sensaciones que nos trae el color purpura en nuestros momentos. El color lavanda como ahora lo llamo yo, no era de mis colores favoritos y sin embargo esta muy relacionado con el azul que tanto me gusta. Varias veces en estos juegos de colores me ha tocado representarlo como una extraña coincidencia, como el que anda buscando sin querer algo.
ENGLISH VERSION (click here!)

The topic of color is always striking, as it allows us to express ourselves through it. Columnist @emiliorios brings us [Chromotherapy or the Importance of Color - Choose an Image and Share Your Ideas - Getting to Know the User (ES/EN)](https://hive.blog/hive-131951/@emiliorios/cromoterapia-o-la-importancia-del-color-elige-una-imagen-y-comparte-tus-ideas-conociendo-al-usuario-esen) on this topic, varying the images and, of course, the color. Our friend @purrix has shared an extraordinary exploration [Infinite Purple 💜 / Infinite Purple 💜](https://hive.blog/hive-131951/@purrix/purpura-infinito-infinite-purple) of the sensations that the color purple evokes in our moments. The color lavender, as I now call it, wasn't one of my favorites, and yet it's closely related to the blue I love so much. Several times in these color games, I've had to represent it as a strange coincidence, like someone searching for something without meaning to.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmWBx54xuvD4b8nL5tnMp8WxXtLXPb3x51K8uhCFe2sDNr/imagen.png)
Cuando mi hija me llevo en España a un campo de lavanda no sabía en verdad lo que mis ojos y mi olfato iban a percibir. La lavanda con esos tonos claros de púrpura con los sutiles azules y rosados se extendían más allá del horizonte que podía mirar. Su fragancia ya no era solo el detergente agradable y calmante de que la casa esta totalmente limpia.
ENGLISH VERSION (click here!)

When my daughter took me to a lavender field in Spain, I truly didn't know what my eyes and nose were about to perceive. The lavender, with its light shades of purple and subtle blues and pinks, stretched beyond the horizon. Its fragrance was no longer just the pleasant, soothing scent of a perfectly clean house.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmX4uxonjXYd1X5KLUf6Gz1jG3bNRuKYB4orDzMYaghPAy/imagen.png) Estos campos abiertos al publico en diferente localidades en España son visitados y disfrutados por cantidad de turistas, nosotros fuimos a Brihuega (Guadalajara). Cantidad de caminantes, familias merodeaban libremente por los carriles abiertos entre planta y planta. Su aroma me resulto muy calmante. Pero claro aquí hablamos de color más que de aroma, pero son nuestros órganos sensoriales que conjuntamente forman un todo y nos traen recuerdos y momentos.
ENGLISH VERSION (click here!)

These open fields in various locations throughout Spain are visited and enjoyed by many tourists; we went to Brihuega (Guadalajara). Many walkers and families strolled freely along the paths between the plants. I found their aroma very calming. Of course, we're talking more about color than scent here, but it's our senses that work together to create a whole, bringing back memories and moments.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmX4uxonjXYd1X5KLUf6Gz1jG3bNRuKYB4orDzMYaghPAy/imagen.png) Descubrir que existe un helado de lavanda fue todo un acontecimiento para mi, no sabía de su existencia. El helado de lavanda es un postre floral y aromático que se elabora mezclando leche o crema con flores de lavanda secas aptas para consumo. De verdad es delicioso aunque yo seguía pensando en el aroma para la limpieza. Pues si limpia la casa que limpie mi cuerpo también. Y aunque el color lavanda o purpura no estaba dentro de los colores que escogería en mi infancia, hoy en día puedo disfrutar de su gran belleza en tonalidades. Es como un color que me conociera en ocasiones vibrante, sobrio, creativo, lleno de expectativas por descubrir.
ENGLISH VERSION (click here!)

Discovering that lavender ice cream exists was quite an event for me; I had no idea it was even possible. Lavender ice cream is a floral and aromatic dessert made by blending milk or cream with edible dried lavender flowers. It's truly delicious, although I still associated the scent with cleaning. If it cleans the house, then it should cleanse my body too. And although lavender or purple wasn't among the colors I would have chosen as a child, today I can appreciate its great beauty in its various shades. It's like a color that knows me—vibrant, understated, creative, full of possibilities yet to be discovered.

links.title: Jardín Santa Rosa un lugar con 200 años de Historia [Esp-Eng-Pt]
links.body:
> **
ESPAÑOL
** Bendiciones abundantes y eternas para todos los miembros de esta comunidad @amazingnature. Encantado en saludarles y desearles feliz y Bendito día, deseo que la bendición de Dios abunde en sus vidas y tengan un excelente día. Hoy les comparto una nueva aventura en la ciudad de Carúpano municipio Bermúdez, mi visita esta vez tenía como objetivo el jardín Santa Rosa, este se encuentra ubicado al frente de la iglesia Santa Rosa en la plaza homónima y destaca por las variedad de plantas que posee ornamentales, frutales árboles madereros, la plaza cuenta con fuente, caminería bancos entre otros elementos, atractivos para los visitantes, pero mi objetivo era conocer algunas de las plantas que hay en este hermoso jardín, en el centro tiene una fuente y alrededor varias plantas, las plantas ornamentales están en los jardines frontales con jardines con forma de trapecio y hacia el lado derecho hay varios árboles de gran tamaño en uno de los laterales se observa un pozo de los deseos que está hecho con concreto y rocas, alrededor de él hay varias plantas de *Lirio* y una que se conoce como *Copa de oro* [Allamanda cathartica](https://es.wikipedia.org/wiki/Allamanda_cathartica) por su color amarillo y otra como *Copa de vino* [Allamanda blanchetii](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Allamanda_blanchetii), debido a su color. Según información de una señora residente de la zona ella ha sembrado varias plantas en esta plaza y ha notado una evolución y cambio de colores en la flor de copa de oro y copa de vino, al parecer se han mezclado ambas plantas y ha surgido una de color rosado claro, y otra con un rosado más oscuro, según la información y explicación de esta señora ella cree que que ambas plantas se unieron y como resultado dieron estos colores, tal como se observa en la foto, el color no es como un rosa pálido, también me explicó que cada año florece un color diferente, un año el amarillo, posteriormente la de color vino, rosada y este año floreció la que tiene un tono rosa pálido, es una explicación que ella ofrece de acuerdo a las observaciones que ha realizado en este jardín, su lugar de trabajo es cercano a la plaza y le permite hacer observaciones diarias y en eso se basan sus explicaciones de por qué han surgido nuevos colores en las flores.

>

**<center>ENGLISH</center>**

Abundant and everlasting blessings to all members of the @amazingnature community. It’s a pleasure to greet you and wish you a happy and blessed day. May God’s blessings abound in your lives, and may you have a wonderful day.

Today I'm sharing a new adventure in the city of Carúpano, Bermúdez municipality. This time, my destination was the Santa Rosa Garden. Located in front of the Santa Rosa Church in the plaza of the same name, it stands out for its variety of plants: ornamental, fruit, and timber trees. The plaza features a fountain, walkways, benches, and other attractive elements for visitors. My goal, however, was to learn about some of the plants in this beautiful garden. In the center is a fountain surrounded by various plants. The ornamental plants are in the front gardens, which are trapezoidal in shape. To the right, there are several large trees. On one side, there's a wishing well made of concrete and rocks. Around it are several *Lily*  plants, one known as the \
[Allamanda cathartica](https://es.wikipedia.org/wiki/Allamanda_cathartica) for its yellow color, and another called the \

[Allamanda blanchetii](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Allamanda_blanchetii) because of its color. According to a local resident, she has planted several flowers in this plaza and has noticed an evolution and change in the colors of the golden cup and wine cup flowers. It appears the two plants have interbred, resulting in one with a light pink color and another with a darker pink. According to her explanation, she believes the two plants combined, producing these colors, as seen in the photo. The color is not a pale pink. She also explained that a different color blooms each year: one year yellow, then wine-colored, then pink, and this year the pale pink bloomed. This explanation is based on her observations in the garden. Her workplace is near the plaza, allowing her to make daily observations, which form the basis of her explanation for the new flower colors. ![santa Rosa Jardín (4).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/virgilio07/Eou8j4D4PZqqm1Dmu2ruEWm6VqerrRnSx4fC3w7WKNNzsG44cMLFKxNnygH89fG4rtT.jpeg) ![santa Rosa Jardín (6).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/virgilio07/Eoke5jtLoGhtwNs4KEggSpQ2UoarSovi2V1GWjVqGRMuVH7d4cGP6ns73fV2S8xzjqb.jpeg) ![santa Rosa Jardín (7).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/virgilio07/Eokc5T7G8nhNbHBKcAFSp8KEpL8XCKKy3PdqoyQVCacECAeoTE1SqL4DE5pDAxFAM8N.jpeg) ![santa Rosa Jardín (10).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/virgilio07/EogNHpMuzvhhFCxTFjFdV5BGCdKtKKCLNtGMeFUbbQU3Qke4sVPjP1frTU1Ggn79MG1.jpeg) ![separador virgilio 1.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/virgilio07/48fPJW5oSR5NrT5insR3hayLh9ET1ifvCG8zGp4Rfk8EhMtUrcwakXhr5g3cRk6Y8x.gif)

> También hay una hermosa flor con forma de campana de color morado, su nombre es [Ipomoea carnea](https://es.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ipomoea_carnea), esta planta la he visto anteriormente en jardines y parques. Además de las plantas ornamentales señaladas, la plaza durante muchos años tuvo varios ejemplares de cedro, algunos ya fueron cortados dada la antigüedad que tenían y representaban un riesgo, el tronco podía ceder y desprenderse, lo interesante de este tronco de cedro es que según la señora tenía aproximadamente 200 años, la señora estuvo estuvo presente al momento de cortar el cedro y quién lo estaba cortando explicó que por la cantidad de círculos que se ven en el tronco, eso les indica la edad aproximada del árbol, los círculos de este tronco coinciden con que tiene 200 años, el tronco ya se ve de color negro y según esta señora corresponde también a la antigüedad que tenía el árbol, además del Cedro hay otros troncos de árboles que fueron dejados en la plaza para decorar y sirven también de bancos naturales. Avanzando en el recorrido por esta llamativa plaza y su colorido jardín se encuentran varias plantas ornamentales además de la copa de oro y copa de vino, hay Bugambilias e Ixoras, que son plantas por excelencia para el paisajismo y adornar los jardines, la Ixora tiene la particularidad de resistir los climas extremos y sus flores se pueden ver durante todo el año, lo cual las convierte en una de las más buscadas para mantener coloridos y hermosos los jardines, plazas y avenidas, las plazas en su mayoría cuentan con un pequeño jardín o algunas plantas que dan sombra brisa, fresca al lugar y también sirven de hogar para muchas aves e insectos, la Ixora de color rojo que también se conoce como coral roja, la Bugambilia presenta una tonalidad entre rosado y fucsia, terminado mi recorrido en este jardín, me dirigí hacia otra zona de la ciudad con la idea de explorar nuevos espacios y conocer las bellezas naturales de esta espectacular ciudad costera.

> There is also a beautiful bell-shaped purple flower called [Ipomoea carnea](https://es.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ipomoea_carnea), which I have seen before in gardens and parks. In addition to the ornamental plants mentioned, the plaza had several cedar trees for many years. Some have already been cut down due to their age and the risk they posed; the trunks could give way and break off. What's interesting about this cedar trunk is that, according to the woman, it was approximately 200 years old. The woman was present when the cedar was cut down, and the person cutting it explained that the number of rings visible on the trunk indicates the tree's approximate age. The rings on this trunk confirm that it is 200 years old. The trunk is now black, which, according to the woman, also corresponds to the tree's age. Besides the cedar, there are other tree trunks that were left in the plaza for decoration and also serve as natural benches. Continuing my tour of this striking plaza and its colorful garden, I found several ornamental plants besides the golden cup and wine cup. There were bougainvilleas and ixoras, plants that are quintessential for landscaping and adorning gardens. The ixora has the unique ability to withstand extreme climates, and its flowers can be seen year-round, making it one of the most sought-after plants for keeping gardens, plazas, and avenues colorful and beautiful. Most plazas have a small garden or some plants that provide shade, a cool breeze, and also serve as a home for many birds and insects. The red ixora is also known as red coral, while the bougainvillea displays a hue between pink and fuchsia. After finishing my tour of this garden, I headed to another area of the city with the idea of exploring new spaces and discovering the natural beauty of this spectacular coastal city. ![santa Rosa Jardín (1).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/virgilio07/EogNMe7HpdxJEbZd9yE2Ry2NRCfRZLnKUVfutCLF7rEsaq1utwHgqnhXV5PPiZ5SS36.jpeg) ![santa Rosa Jardín (8).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/virgilio07/EoK6JxbSmVdXG26ke92nqHYczo5pmmwyrHkX7BpY6sPdk4wiV9UNZYdg8arqeGoApbn.jpeg) ![santa Rosa Jardín (3).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/virgilio07/Eokd6JKig5raWiCv7VXn9kkN8QpQcpvsMaQwFh2B6vxHpEnVSfDtgg6PTsj5LXzqJZ6.jpeg) ![santa Rosa Jardín (9).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/virgilio07/EpCAKXmpoRsY9QkATNUSAZQMBqXiqdVXmiFXoahLpr7X56DnfyBHbC14Cqb3SyDgMZH.jpeg)

> **Portugués** Hoje partilho convosco uma nova aventura na cidade de Carúpano, município de Bermúdez. A minha visita desta vez teve como objetivo o Jardim Santa Rosa, que se situa em frente à igreja de Santa Rosa, na praça com o mesmo nome, e destaca-se pela variedade de plantas que possui: ornamentais, frutíferas e árvores de madeira. A praça conta com uma fonte, caminhos, bancos, entre outros elementos, que atraem os visitantes, mas o meu objetivo era conhecer algumas das plantas que existem neste belo jardim. No centro, há uma fonte e, à sua volta, várias plantas. As plantas ornamentais encontram-se nos jardins frontais, com jardins em forma de trapézio, e, do lado direito, há várias árvores de grande porte. Numa das laterais, observa-se um poço dos desejos, feito de betão e pedras. à sua volta há várias plantas de *Lírio* e uma conhecida como *Copa de Ouro* [Allamanda cathartica](https://es.wikipedia.org/wiki/Allamanda_cathartica) devido à sua cor amarela, e outra como *Copa de Vinho* [Allamanda blanchetii](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Allamanda_blanchetii), devido à sua cor. Segundo informações de uma senhora residente na zona, ela plantou várias plantas nesta praça e notou uma evolução e uma mudança de cores nas flores «copo de ouro» e «copo de vinho»; ao que parece, ambas as plantas se cruzaram e surgiu uma de cor rosa claro, e outra com um rosa mais escuro. De acordo com a informação e explicação desta senhora, ela acredita que as duas plantas se uniram e, como resultado, deram origem a estas cores, tal como se observa na foto. A cor não é como um rosa pálido. Ela também me explicou que, todos os anos, floresce uma cor diferente: num ano, o amarelo; depois a cor vinho, rosa e, este ano, floresceu a que tem um tom rosa pálido. É uma explicação que ela oferece com base nas observações que tem feito neste jardim. O seu local de trabalho fica perto da praça e permite-lhe fazer observações diárias, e é nisso que se baseiam as suas explicações sobre o motivo pelo qual surgiram novas cores nas flores. Há também uma bela flor em forma de sino, de cor roxa, cujo nome é [Ipomoea carnea](https://es.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ipomoea_carnea), uma planta que já vi anteriormente em jardins e parques. Além das plantas ornamentais mencionadas, a praça teve, durante muitos anos, vários cedros, alguns dos quais já foram abatidos devido à sua idade avançada, que representava um risco, o tronco podia ceder e partir-se; o interessante deste tronco de cedro é que, segundo a senhora, tinha aproximadamente 200 anos; a senhora esteve presente no momento em que o cedro foi cortado e quem o estava a cortar explicou que, pela quantidade de anéis que se vêem no tronco, isso indica a idade aproximada da árvore, os anéis deste tronco correspondem a 200 anos; o tronco já apresenta uma cor preta e, segundo esta senhora, isso também corresponde à idade que a árvore tinha; além do cedro, existem outros troncos de árvores que foram deixados na praça para decoração e que também servem como bancos naturais. Continuando o meu passeio por esta impressionante praça e pelo seu colorido jardim, encontrei diversas plantas ornamentais para além do copo dourado e do copo de vinho. Havia buganvílias e ixoras, plantas essenciais para o paisagismo e embelezamento de jardins. A ixora tem a capacidade única de resistir a climas extremos, e as suas flores podem ser vistas durante todo o ano, sendo por isso uma das plantas mais procuradas para manter jardins, praças e avenidas coloridas e bonitas. A maioria das praças tem um pequeno jardim ou algumas plantas que proporcionam sombra, uma brisa fresca e também servem de abrigo para muitos pássaros e insetos. A ixora vermelha é também conhecida como coral vermelho, enquanto a buganvília exibe uma tonalidade entre o rosa e o fúcsia. Após terminar o meu passeio por este jardim, segui para outra zona da cidade com a ideia de explorar novos espaços e descobrir a beleza natural desta espetacular cidade costeira. ![santa Rosa Jardín (5).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/virgilio07/EokexKzpRLDwc1BEQp6YVsKt1wEZmvgLTAi9Si2YPgcqQyMYpkHiSYWVvynckWiNhjA.jpeg) ![santa Rosa Jardín (2).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/virgilio07/EoiWcjYgNr1JX8ut4MmfpW5aeDLqXYegLmxrFcnp1718M76nV44xGM2xYF4YGchniyN.jpeg) ![separador virgilio.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/virgilio07/48KdAZ2oktyDRja9ez5m3v1qBY6PZfFU8sSGEE17ey9FUfktwmCJiLv2c2YiZggq73.png)

links.body:
![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/8A694841-5F9B-4782-9515-26E13F5E07101776996767.5203) ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/8A694841-5F9B-4782-9515-26E13F5E07101776996776.2411032) ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/8A694841-5F9B-4782-9515-26E13F5E07101776996781.5959768) ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/8A694841-5F9B-4782-9515-26E13F5E07101776996787.204443) ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/8A694841-5F9B-4782-9515-26E13F5E07101776996794.894537) ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/8A694841-5F9B-4782-9515-26E13F5E07101776996800.769522) ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/8A694841-5F9B-4782-9515-26E13F5E07101776996805.9357781) ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/8A694841-5F9B-4782-9515-26E13F5E07101776996811.157474) ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/8A694841-5F9B-4782-9515-26E13F5E07101776996815.7371001) ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/8A694841-5F9B-4782-9515-26E13F5E07101776996820.32205) “Where Do You Store Your Treasure?”😇 You never know what you might find buried right under your feet!😇 My friend @thebighigg likes to search with a metal detector, and I believe he has made some good finds over the years!👍😊 The old green bottle you see in the first photo was unearthed by the loggers just up Silvertops road!☺️ Interesting, that it would have stayed undiscovered forever, if not for the logging!😇 Liz tells me that down in town, the County is tearing up the pavement on several streets, running fiber optics. It’s making it extremely difficult to navigate your way through the city!🙄 “Silvertop, the potholes will just about swallow a car hole!”😬🥰 During the removal of the pavement, they discovered that someone buried a piece of farm equipment, and it eventually was covered up by the road!😳 I asked Chat GPT ……… “How could farm machinery be buried under a road?”🤔 “Silvertop, it really isn’t that unusual. Years ago when farmers had equipment break, sometimes they would dump the broken equipment in low spots in a field. They would cover them up with dirt or let nature take its course!” Large sections of the town of Everson are in a 100 year floodplain, and this farm equipment could have been covered with silt and mud over the years from the river flooding!” Eventually, the city comes in, paves roads, and no one is the wiser what’s underneath Lol!😇 One of Silvertop’s fellow Silvergoldstackers that has taken a break from posting, @summertooth, would drop a copper coin on hiking trails, hoping someone would be excited when they found it!🤗 The most exciting thing Silvertop has ever found, is in the second photo!😊 In June of 1882, the Denver, South Park Pacific RR started laying narrow gauge track up to “Alpine Tunnel”!😅 Workers on both the East portal, and the West, were rushing to open a railroad tunnel through the Continental divide in Colorado, at an elevation of 11,523 feet above sea level! This was to be the highest railroad tunnel in North America in 1882!☺️ On the way to the summit, small communities sprang up next to water tanks for the steam locomotives. One such town was called “Woodstock”. One winter day, a powerful avalanche came rolling down the mountain side, burying the town of Woodstock!😳 Bodies couldn’t be recovered till June of the following year, because of the deep snow!🙄 This is where Silvertop found this original 1882 railroad spike!😊 Now days, if I find anything it’s Cougar tracks!😇 Tracks are much safer, than meeting face-to-face with this powerful BIG Kitty!😺😳 Enjoy a hike my friends, you never know what you might find!🤗 Till tomorrow Silvertop Mike 😊

links.title: 😝Gathering Of Nations! / ¡Reunión de Naciones! 😎
links.body: > The Gathering of Nations takes place on the last weekend of April and is one of the largest pow-wows in North America. It is held at the ***Pow Wow Grounds at Expo NM/Tingley Coliseum and is also considered one of the most popular Native American events in the United States.*** > El Encuentro de Naciones se celebra el último fin de semana de abril y es uno de los pow-wows más grandes de Norteamérica. Tiene lugar en el recinto Pow Wow Grounds de Expo NM/Tingley Coliseum y también se considera uno de los eventos nativos americanos más populares de Estados Unidos . Each year, tens of thousands of people from over **750** tribes across North America flock to this three-day festival to watch thousands of Native American traditional dancers and singers compete for prizes and participate in other events. It is a transformative event for everyone involved and an experience that must be lived to be fully appreciated. This event began unofficially in 1983 at the University of Albuquerque in Albuquerque, New Mexico. The following year, the event adopted the name Gathering of Nations Powwow and was held at the New Mexico State Fairgrounds, on the horse track, for two years. > Cada año, decenas de miles de personas de más de 750 tribus de toda Norteamérica acuden a este festival de tres días para ver a miles de bailarines y cantantes tradicionales nativos americanos competir por premios y participar en otros eventos. Es un evento transformador para todos los involucrados y una experiencia que hay que vivir para apreciarla plenamente. Este evento comenzó de manera no oficial en **1983** en la Universidad de Albuquerque, en Albuquerque, Nuevo México. Al año siguiente, el evento adoptó el nombre de Gathering of Nations Powwow y se celebró en el recinto ferial de Nuevo México, en la pista de caballos , durante dos años. However, this venue proved too small for the event, which grew each year. Consequently, it was temporarily relocated to the University of New Mexico's basketball arena. In 2017, the event returned to the New Mexico State Fairgrounds and was held at the newly constructed Pow Wow Grounds, which included the Tingley Coliseum. One of the main attractions of the Gathering of Nations is Stage 49. This stage features traditional and contemporary artists performing rock, blues, country, hip hop, and other genres. It also includes traditional roving groups from across the Pow Wow Grounds. There is also a merchants' market offering the finest Native American crafts, jewelry, art, fine clothing, food, and much more. > Sin embargo, este recinto resultó ser demasiado pequeño para el evento, que crecía cada año. Por consiguiente, se trasladó temporalmente al pabellón de baloncesto de la Universidad de Nuevo México. En 2017, el evento regresó al recinto ferial estatal de Nuevo México y se celebró en el recién construido Pow Wow Grounds, que incluía el Tingley Coliseum. Uno de los eventos principales del Encuentro de Naciones es el Escenario 49. Este presenta artistas tradicionales y contemporáneos de rock, blues, country, hip hop y otros géneros. También incluye grupos itinerantes tradicionales provenientes de todo el recinto del Pow Wow. También hay un mercado de comerciantes que ofrece lo mejor en artesanías, joyería, arte , ropa fina, comida y mucho más de los nativos americanos. https://images.hive.blog/0x0/https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/thealliance/SszMQ6lq-thealliance20new20pagebreak.png ## Family Time!

> ![theallianceaddamsamily.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/thealliance/Eo1xNsyU9Q6SticGggzUC7xpkcWk5kDPPA4jxXtRSJGrwXNYeTqbZEsruByRn4MkSey.gif) Well hey there, did ya miss us? We missed you! So much, in fact, that we have rescheduled our 'Family Time' to Fridays and we hope to see you there! Join our lovely band of outcasts, normies, goofballs, pimps, degenerates, professionals and all things within and without and betwixt and between starting **6 pm CST/ 7 pm EST**. We always try to have a little fun and and if you're paying attention, a few smiles might just be shared. We like to smile. We like to laugh. We realize that life isn't all about the important things like #politics, #religion and #sex, no, it's about the time spent, the experiences had and memories made. Memories get passed on, experiences are shared and time - time is the currency we spend to acquire them. > Bueno, hola, ¿nos extrañaste? ¡Te extrañamos! De hecho, tanto, que hemos reprogramado nuestro 'Tiempo en familia' para los viernes ¡y esperamos verte allí! Únase a nuestra encantadora banda de marginados, normativos, tontos, proxenetas, degenerados, profesionales y todo lo relacionado con dentro y fuera y entre y a partir de **6 p.m. CST/ 7 p.m. EST**. Siempre tratamos de divertirnos un poco y, si estás prestando atención, es posible que compartamos algunas sonrisas. Nos gusta sonreír. Nos gusta reír. Nos damos cuenta de que la vida no se trata solo de cosas importantes como la #política, la #religión y el #sexo, no, se trata del tiempo invertido, las experiencias vividas y los recuerdos creados. Los recuerdos se transmiten, las experiencias se comparten y el tiempo... el tiempo es la moneda que gastamos para adquirirlos. It just may be worth your time to [visit the Castle](https://discord.gg/EpyXNyh) and come check us out. Unlike the 'Addams Family' shows, all of this is live, unrehearsed and not recorded before any audience. Funny things happen. Sad things happen. Smiles and tears get shared. Worries and hopes are passed around. Sometimes, we even eat #pizza, cake and ice cream. Sometimes, we watch movies. Sometimes, giant insects attack the microphones and we have to get out our silly swatters and smack 'em up so we have something to snack on because the popcorn got eaten already by little slugs that left slimy trails everywhere and made the sidewalks slippery so that the pancakes didn't get enough traction on our canoes to steer the spaceships. Exactly. > Puede que valga la pena dedicar tiempo a [visitar el castillo](https://discord.gg/EpyXNyh) y venir a vernos. A diferencia de los shows de 'La Familia Addams', todo esto es en vivo, sin ensayar y no grabado ante ninguna audiencia. Suceden cosas divertidas. Suceden cosas tristes. Se comparten sonrisas y lágrimas. Se transmiten preocupaciones y esperanzas. A veces, incluso comemos #pizza, tarta y helado. A veces vemos películas. A veces, los insectos gigantes atacan los micrófonos y tenemos que sacar nuestros tontos matamoscas y golpearlos para tener algo de comer porque las palomitas de maíz ya se las comieron pequeñas babosas que dejaron rastros viscosos por todas partes y dejaron las aceras resbaladizas para que los panqueques no tuvieran suficiente tracción en nuestras canoas para dirigir las naves espaciales. links.title: Visiting Carúpano Bay, a place to relax that offers beautiful views of the landscape (Eng -Esp)
links.body:
> **
INGLÉS
** Hello fellow travelers! It's a pleasure to greet you and wish you a happy and blessed weekend. I'm excited to share my trip to Bahía beach in the area known as Bahía de Carúpano. Located on the perimeter road very close to El Boquete, the landscape offers beautiful views and a walkway made of rocks, allowing visitors to stroll along the shore and observe this natural wonder. It's my first time visiting the bay, and I must say I loved the view; it's spectacular. I began my walk at a small cliff that also serves as a viewpoint and has a small concrete walkway where many people gather to admire the scenery and, most importantly, take beautiful photos. The view is breathtaking, offering views of the mountains, some institutions, residential complexes, and the beach with its beautiful blue color. In another photo, you can partially see the mountain and other buildings of this beautiful city, as well as a close-up view of the cliff and the rocks below. The rock walkway is definitely my favorite because it's wide and easy to walk on. The rocks, with their triangular, square, and circular shapes, also serve as chairs or places to rest and observe this beautiful landscape. I think that day the sky and the sea combined to create an enchanting scene. To be honest, I loved the view from this place, the vegetation, the breeze, and more. It was undoubtedly a lovely experience visiting this area of Carúpano.

> **
ESPAÑOL
** Hola, hola amigos viajeros es un placer saludarles deseando que tengan un feliz y bendecido fin de semana, me siento feliz de compartir mi recorrido por la playa Bahía del sector que se conoce como Bahía de Carúpano, este se ubica en la avenida perimetral muy cerca de el Boquete, el paisaje ofrece hermosas vistas y una caminería formada por rocas, la cual permite al visitante desplazarse por por la orilla y observar esta maravilla de la naturaleza, es la primera vez que visito la bahía y debo decir que me encantó la vista, es espectacular; el recorrido lo inicié en un pequeño acantilado que también funciona como mirador y cuenta con una pequeña caminería de concreto, en la cual muchas personas se dan cita para contemplar el paisaje y lo más importante hacer lindas fotos, la vista es espectacular y se observa la montaña, algunas instituciones, conjuntos residenciales y la playa con su hermoso color azul. En otra foto se aprecia parcialmente la montaña y otras construcciones de esta hermosa ciudad, también una vista cercana del acantilado y las rocas en la parte inferior, la caminería de rocas definitivamente es mi favorita, porque es amplia y cómoda para desplazarse, sus rocas con formas triangular, cuadrada y circular sirven también como una silla o descanso para observar este hermoso paisaje, creo que ese día el cielo y el mar se combinaron para crear un encantador paisaje, siendo honesta me encantó la vista desde este lugar, la vegetación la brisa y más, sin duda fue una linda experiencia visitar esta zona de Carúpano. ![Carúpano Bahía (1).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/belkyscabrera/EqhNL6FXUW6Fjkr27449aa4yQZ3xRV1VQFZyVvT31ke1FFoTkYDoPRBCvTZtC52gDf6.jpeg) ![Carúpano Bahía (2).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/belkyscabrera/EqHySEXRWEQV6CKxuY7hgQTJN7nPP1rxMuLrzDFsjdbTzCrdfvhh7ZqbAg6bLrQTTkV.jpeg) ![Carúpano Bahía (3).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/belkyscabrera/23z79rMgH7qbH4wGs68FwQvbroQZFaDnvaR2pbcCvLfvXY1AJ1YDQ4co3dncJ3STz56yZ.jpeg) ![Carúpano Bahía (5).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/belkyscabrera/EpT3dBXShVcnKUMV1S9uZR7gjbwRYQPoWRzDUBVeWqxSzxfXZj5cZ7TL33D8fjjkMHi.jpeg) ![Bahía C..png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/belkyscabrera/23xVH5ninW2VCN1PrBoM9DzS1f5ZwchYHSfSHLSPza4xEqSrHMzMKrRZvvyzbQ3GpaeCy.png) ![BAHÍA CARÚPANO.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/belkyscabrera/244e89T6839juGBtYvN3MS134UJzAdtjHSga11WmHCMBfD4jjyG3EvLo9ABvx3moYExDz.png) ![bahía b.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/belkyscabrera/244oSGCWXV1fWm7W9X65eZfb7kGe28UKaiU9UeALrcVyLoVL5JQWKc5Et7LSdrXp9V4SG.png)

links.title: Rising Star: Epic Cards Everywhere [ENG/SPA]
links.body:
> ![risingstar portada.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gaboamc2393/23wWtdN48ULWksQ6FvKGFGLBG1qeixv1CUovUpK2XdXByRbLPvmoUHcC8vL145cdeQyV3.png) ![divisores-14.webp](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gaboamc2393/23swrTdV5AEuKHZoNF1QASNfTZ29vt5hb4BJ92YAiRNkQGqiuWHNkbHGGWhKbsmgx7Zzz.webp) Hello, friends. Today I’d like to share with you another collection of cards I bought to boost my stats in the game. I always enjoy buying card packs just to try and get an epic or legendary card. I did all this while continuing to take music lessons, which is something I try to do regularly to keep my ego in check. >># Español >>Saludos amigos, hoy me gustaría compartir con ustedes una colección más de cartas que compré para aumentar mis números en el juego. Siempre me gusta comprar packs de cartas no mas para intentar obtener alguna épica o legendaria. Todo esto lo hice mientras continúo haciendo lecciones de música, que es algo que procuro hacer constantemente para reducir el ego. ![Captura de pantalla 2026-04-21 205122.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gaboamc2393/EoK4NpDebgAKXWBMqhasgDuh8a7Qnqf6bTKEegZSfAMP457ztw1tcZusoU3XCtimmhK.png) Well, getting back to the topic of buying packs, as you can see here, I was almost 500K STARBITS short of reaching a million, so I went to Hive-Engine and bought the STARBITS I needed, reaching the amount required for my purchases. >>Bien, volviendo al tema de las compras de packs, aquí pueden ver que me faltaban casi 500K de STARBITS para completar el millón, así que fui a Hive-Engine y compré los STARBITS que necesitaba, completando la cifra necesaria para mis compras. ![Captura de pantalla 2026-04-21 210049.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gaboamc2393/23tvCii3zKViZdysak8SzceUzQJj5MPd4LTZTxcV5NPV8GmbeRtai3WvDnXdxPoVvpi8p.png) ![divisores-14.webp](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gaboamc2393/23swrTdV5AEuKHZoNF1QASNfTZ29vt5hb4BJ92YAiRNkQGqiuWHNkbHGGWhKbsmgx7Zzz.webp) Well, that's how I started making my picks. Among the cards, the ones that stood out the most were the ones you see in the image below—at least in terms of design—which are my favorites; they look great. As for stats, they're very similar: they all have 115 in Fans, two have 90 in Skill, and one has 110, so they're relatively balanced overall. >>Bien, así fue como comencé a hacer mis compras. Entre las cartas de personas, las que mas destacaron fuero estas que ven en la imagen de abajo, al menos en cuanto a diseño, que son las que mas me gustan, se ven geniales. En cuanto a stats son muy parecidas, todas tienen 115 de fans, dos tienen 90 de skill y una 110, así que están relativamente balanceadas entre todas. ![Captura de pantalla 2026-04-21 210433.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gaboamc2393/23uQnVsvePeopT5rEJAq4RdPMj1tXzDZMs15RAg5eFBHqdBRn8jbVh9PZ9jUHfWyzxux9.png) |![Captura de pantalla 2026-04-21 210459.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gaboamc2393/23wMRrK7yCX1Nt5gtE6DZKsHz8fcnCi3uXkCyxhLitrxJKP2vBGjf3XTAWrxSpFUJZUZu.png)|![Captura de pantalla 2026-04-21 210611.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gaboamc2393/23vsFsLuFGrkc7HbLyMNedJXKWbMQdtgmm2JjD4CsgQ3jwZYMARwKGPvx1Y2jU1X1JQPK.png)| |-|-| ![divisores-14.webp](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gaboamc2393/23swrTdV5AEuKHZoNF1QASNfTZ29vt5hb4BJ92YAiRNkQGqiuWHNkbHGGWhKbsmgx7Zzz.webp) As you can see in the image below, I also got a couple of seasonal cards—the S124 Eggo—when I opened packs. This one is perfectly balanced too, so it won't boost my Ego too much. >>Como ven en la imagen de abajo, también obtuve en la apertura de packs un par de cartas de temporada, la S124 Eggo. Esta también está perfectamente balanceada, así que no va a aumentar demasiado mi Ego. ![Captura de pantalla 2026-04-21 210717.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gaboamc2393/23ycttWhB3AZvb78ubeKsH4QdRqPmZ9vD6zWyQKkQBrAvM93cJp4qy6d5zydD8zvqu4Ww.png) ![Captura de pantalla 2026-04-21 211052.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gaboamc2393/23ycttYJBbk2gNjaqdzUCtqiTa996DmRNdCYzshuwrsLSJSjXnLYtyccEXuSMCSSuPApw.png) ![divisores-14.webp](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gaboamc2393/23swrTdV5AEuKHZoNF1QASNfTZ29vt5hb4BJ92YAiRNkQGqiuWHNkbHGGWhKbsmgx7Zzz.webp) I got about four or five rare instrument cards, but the most notable ones are the ones below. My favorite is the R632, a really cool and colorful viola—it actually looks like an epic card. >>De cartas de instrumento obtuve como cuatro o cinco raras, pero las más destacables nuevamente pueden ver estas, que son las de abajo. La que más me gusta es la R632, una viola realmente genial y muy colorida, de hecho parece una carta épica. ![Captura de pantalla 2026-04-21 223940.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gaboamc2393/23uQjqeKwPzefotEVWfF72Fqj5UZYmYagXGpiQdZGtdaJRDM73a5YCqExpDWVFkciWBck.png) |![Captura de pantalla 2026-04-21 210647.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gaboamc2393/23wWpWfw9C12wsky52m7vXevnVzqf1uCZgukqRTGuGv5CyWYNWZmQvrzFta5gJYukwExy.png)|![Captura de pantalla 2026-04-21 211135.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gaboamc2393/23w2gkJEiQZEkTfHLuTooGxgF9TcLKMED8YTBUpaQnqVtpaQi42MpCCAFWbKM5SEJY5we.png)| |-|-| ![divisores-14.webp](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gaboamc2393/23swrTdV5AEuKHZoNF1QASNfTZ29vt5hb4BJ92YAiRNkQGqiuWHNkbHGGWhKbsmgx7Zzz.webp) I also got some really nice vehicle cards, the best of which was the R624 Mystic 2112. I also got an R673 60s Love Mobile and the R630 Touring Coach, which I already have several copies of in my collection. >>También tuve unas muy buenas cartas de vehículos, siendo la mejor la R624 Mystic 2112. También obtuve un R673 60s Love Mobile y la ya más que repetida en mi colección la R630 Touring Coach. ![Captura de pantalla 2026-04-21 223923.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gaboamc2393/EogMoXmJYYgBpPapPuUzodV79xQnzGKesMpk2n9ZXeReYP3k1SPePeoNZPijRk8AgrN.png) |![Captura de pantalla 2026-04-21 211203.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gaboamc2393/EoGwtMtLd8VnczxpgNWwcV5eJdzQndso25a1oPDMEEjewqeeNS4CnJhWCEn8y5GQf7h.png)|![Captura de pantalla 2026-04-21 211219.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gaboamc2393/EoeEQLbfocK6GxeidQGhW73YDTMxUjfjysReNsmenEVJ8b1icUbPb95p3i2E8cEPnxy.png)| |-|-| ![divisores-14.webp](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gaboamc2393/23swrTdV5AEuKHZoNF1QASNfTZ29vt5hb4BJ92YAiRNkQGqiuWHNkbHGGWhKbsmgx7Zzz.webp) Anyway, I got three great epic cards—all duplicates, but it’s always nice to have epic cards in your collection. Below are the three epic cards I got. >>Ahora bien, obtuve tres buenas cartas épicas, todas repetidas pero siempre es bueno tener cartas épicas en la colección. A continuación pueden ver las tres cartas épicas que me salieron. ![Captura de pantalla 2026-04-21 210340.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gaboamc2393/EonjUXmKmymJx22R79CWQAtTcv2AtnXVoPDT6MZ9CzMc48Z5bALEh3wuSBqkyKsks4R.png) ![Captura de pantalla 2026-04-21 224036.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gaboamc2393/EoGwUzZUidQVsyE6k44VKURhymaYSzjjvcJqnAfwn2tKQbWuZkpcjYgWMmRpnYLY7Py.png) ![Captura de pantalla 2026-04-21 233058.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gaboamc2393/23u5xNBrcM41A4D93Fm6rPvbrni1DrhUp99GwcZCVgJrYi8mGs4YPmFw7EhpDQNbUGELB.png) ![divisores-14.webp](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gaboamc2393/23swrTdV5AEuKHZoNF1QASNfTZ29vt5hb4BJ92YAiRNkQGqiuWHNkbHGGWhKbsmgx7Zzz.webp) Well, friends, that’s all for now. I hope you liked the cards you got. Please feel free to share your thoughts in the comments below—as always, I’d love to read them. With that, I’ll sign off for now...

See you next time!

>>Bien amigos, esto ha sido todo por ahora. Espero que las cartas que les salieron les hayan gustado, los invito a dejar sus opiniones abajo en los comentarios, como siempre estaré encantado de leerlos. Sin más que agregar, me despido entonces... >> >>

¡Hasta la próxima!

links.body: Sometimes there is just a tiny little thing that is missing and for whatever reason people just missed it.  I recall a teacher I had in college that nobody in the class could \

but then one day he was ill or something and his teaching assistant graduate student came in and I guess she was more able to understand the mind of being a student because she was one.   A lot of people got that missing link of information from her and now the subject didn't seem near as impossible as it was when just Dr. can't-explain-anything was lecturing us and getting increasingly upset as none of us were understanding.   \n\nThat could have been part of the coaching problem:  They were so far removed from actually doing the actions they were telling us to do that they could not longer remember what it was like to NOT BE ABLE to do them.

links.title: FC Partizan Between Tradition and New Challenges: A Time for Stability
links.body: /> Football Club Partizan has for decades been one of the pillars of Serbian and regional football. The black-and-whites are not just a club — they are identity, passion, and a story passed down through generations. However, in recent years it has become clear that Partizan stands at a crossroads between a glorious past and an uncertain future. One of the biggest issues surrounding the club is the lack of continuity. Frequent changes in management, coaches, and the playing squad leave a visible impact on results. Although Partizan continues to produce talented young players, the absence of a stable system makes long-term progress difficult. On the other hand, the youth academy remains the club’s greatest pride. Many top players who later built successful careers across Europe started their journey there. This is where Partizan’s opportunity lies — in combining youth and experience with smart club management. The fans, known for their loyalty, remain a powerful force. Regardless of results, support from the stands never fades. Still, it is clear they expect more — not only victories, but also a clear plan and vision for the future. For Partizan to return to its former glory, stability is needed at every level: from management and coaching staff to performance on the pitch. Modern football does not forgive improvisation — it requires strategy, investment, and long-term planning. The conclusion is simple: Partizan has everything it needs to succeed — tradition, a strong fan base, and talent. What is missing is organization and continuity. If that is put in place, the black-and-whites can once again become a dominant force, not only domestically but also on the European stage. Serbian text: Partizan između tradicije i novih izazova: Vreme za stabilnost Fudbalski klub Partizan već decenijama predstavlja jedan od stubova srpskog i regionalnog fudbala. Crno-beli nisu samo klub — oni su identitet, strast i priča koja se prenosi generacijama. Međutim, posljednjih godina jasno je da se Partizan nalazi na raskrsnici između slavne prošlosti i neizvjesne budućnosti. Jedan od najvećih problema koji prati klub jeste nedostatak kontinuiteta. Česte promjene u upravi, trenerima i igračkom kadru ostavljaju trag na rezultatima. Iako Partizan i dalje uspijeva da izbaci talentovane mlade igrače, nedostatak stabilnog sistema otežava dugoročni napredak. S druge strane, omladinska škola ostaje najveći ponos kluba. Iz nje su potekli brojni vrhunski fudbaleri koji su kasnije ostvarili velike karijere širom Evrope. Upravo tu leži šansa Partizana — u kombinaciji mladosti i iskustva, uz pametno vođenje kluba. Navijači, poznati po svojoj odanosti, i dalje predstavljaju veliku snagu. Bez obzira na rezultate, podrška sa tribina ne izostaje. Ipak, jasno je da i oni očekuju više — ne samo pobjede, već i jasan plan i viziju razvoja. Da bi se Partizan vratio na staze stare slave, potrebna je stabilnost na svim nivoima: od uprave, preko stručnog štaba, do same igre na terenu. Moderni fudbal ne prašta improvizaciju — potrebni su strategija, ulaganja i dugoročno planiranje. Zaključak je jednostavan: Partizan ima sve što je potrebno da bude uspješan — tradiciju, bazu navijača i talenat. Ono što nedostaje jeste organizacija i kontinuitet. Ako se to postavi kako treba, crno-bijeli mogu ponovo biti dominantna sila, ne samo u domaćem prvenstvu, već i na evropskoj sceni.

links.title: Swingers Is One of the Coolest Films of the Nineties, A Laid Back, Honest Look at Friendship, Dating, and Finding Your Confidence. It Is a True Cult Classic That Still Feels Fresh Today. (1996)
links.body:
Released in 1996, Swingers is the kind of movie that feels small on the surface but leaves a big impression. It is not built around action or major plot twists. Instead, it focuses on characters, conversations, and the awkward reality of trying to move forward after heartbreak. That grounded approach is exactly what makes it work.

![IMG_0678.webp](https://images.hive.blog/DQmXRrMmBpP5FDGuzSWL88seemo9KDZEh2W6jmBsXqg8ZsH/IMG_0678.webp)

The film was directed by Doug Liman and written by Jon Favreau, who also stars in the movie. Liman keeps things simple and natural, giving the film a loose, almost documentary feel at times. Favreau’s script is sharp, funny, and very real, especially when it comes to relationships and self doubt.

Jon Favreau plays Mike Peters, a struggling actor dealing with a recent breakup that he just cannot seem to get over. Favreau is excellent in the role because he does not try to make Mike overly cool or confident. He leans into the awkwardness and insecurity, which makes the character relatable.

Vince Vaughn plays Trent, Mike’s best friend, and this is the role that really put Vaughn on the map. Trent is smooth, confident, and always talking about being “money,” even when things are clearly not going as well as he pretends. Vaughn brings a ton of energy and charisma to the role.

The chemistry between Favreau and Vaughn is what drives the film. Their friendship feels real, with a mix of support, frustration, and honest moments. Trent pushes Mike to get back out there, while Mike struggles to keep up with Trent’s fast moving lifestyle.

The plot is simple and focuses on Mike trying to rebuild his confidence and move on with his life. That includes going out to bars, meeting new people, and dealing with the ups and downs of dating in Los Angeles.

What makes Swingers stand out is how honest it feels. It does not glamorize everything. There are plenty of awkward moments, failed conversations, and uncomfortable situations that feel true to life.

![IMG_0680.webp](https://images.hive.blog/DQmeNSbi9n8Ljooi2AUJvzwe7xqTZTvsNiMmbaGh1BKp8ES/IMG_0680.webp)

At the same time, the film is very funny. A lot of the humor comes from the dialogue and the situations the characters get themselves into. The answering machine scene is one of the most memorable and painfully relatable moments in the movie.

The supporting cast adds to the overall feel of the film. Ron Livingston appears as one of the group’s friends, and Heather Graham has a small but important role that helps bring the story full circle.

Doug Liman’s direction keeps everything moving without making it feel forced. The film flows naturally from one scene to the next, which adds to its authenticity.

The setting of Los Angeles also plays a big role. The bars, clubs, and late night diners give the movie a specific atmosphere that fits perfectly with the story.

Swingers is also about friendship as much as it is about dating. The way the group interacts, supports each other, and sometimes calls each other out adds depth to the film.

By the end, the film does not try to deliver a huge dramatic conclusion. Instead, it gives a simple and satisfying resolution that feels earned and realistic.

![IMG_0681.webp](https://images.hive.blog/DQmXk7XBVCvezJu6rdihw7w9vXefoQviNJm9RqisddJ1J5K/IMG_0681.webp)

Swingers remains an excellent film because it captures a specific time and feeling in such an honest way. It is funny, relatable, and full of memorable moments.

links.title: The Powerful Byzantine Kitty in Splinterlands
links.body:
<center>https://img.leopedia.io/DQmNfE6L2PtCgbumMY4b58yUE7BUcbME5cxx2g3G8SmLbdp/byzan.png</center>

Today I'm going to talk about one of my favorite summoners in Splinterlands, so join me on this brief journey of knowledge.

<center>https://img.leopedia.io/DQmWBQr6kDmjb9dbPcfq6afJUaRfHhh9obw4cugnUYTd7Zp/m.png</center>

This is Byzantine Kitty, a legendary summoner belonging to the Dragon Deck, and she will be one of your best allies in battles in Splinterlands, and today you'll discover why.

In Splinterlands, summoners are essential because their level determines the level of the cards you can use in battles, and Byzantine Kitty has 3 functions in battles:

- Increase the attack speed of allied cards by +2.

- Grant the True Strike ability to allied cards.

- Possess the Tank Heal ability.

Let's learn in detail how these functions work in battles.

### Attack Speed

Attack speed determines which card attacks first and also defines the card's chances of dodging an attack.

### True Strike

The True Strike ability gives the card a 100% chance to hit its attacks.

This ability is why I like the Summoner Byzantine Kitty.

### Tank Heal

The Tank Heal ability heals the allied card in the first position for 1/3 of its maximum health.

Healing abilities are very useful, so this ability will be a great help in battles.

Now that you know the benefits of using Byzantine Kitty in battles, let's see how it works in practice.

One of the advantages of using the Dragon Deck is that you can combine it with other Decks, which greatly helps to have more strategies for battles.

<center>https://img.leopedia.io/DQmURAYWR6rV8o7cLUfqphoYeGUEXaWogjktE1eV5M42NiP/mm.png</center>

## <center>[Watch The Battle](https://splinterlands.com/battle/sl_e585834cc59bcdb1b3e43b046105b4bd?ref=moonblast)</center>

This is the type of battle where the summoner Byzantine Kitty will be very useful, and I'm not saying that because of True Strike, but because it increases the speed of allied cards, which is very helpful in the Explosive Weaponry rule. True Strike was also useful in defeating the Djinn Oshannus because it has the Phase ability, meaning it can dodge spell attacks.

With my strategy, this battle was easy, and I managed to defeat all of my opponent's cards without losing any of my own.

## Arcade Colony

<center>https://img.leopedia.io/DQmeVhSb4SzdyDLvV8kzgZHxx6k28Qf7zRFm1ENJnTfcxxR/mmm.png</center>

Now I'll talk about the **[Arcade Colony](https://arcadecolony.com/)** platform. On it, you'll find the games: **[Splinterlands](https://splinterlands.com/?ref=moonblast)**, **[Moon Karts](https://moonkarts.arcadecolony.com/)**, **[StakeHouse Den](https://stakehouseden.arcadecolony.com/)**, and **[Genesis League Goals](https://goals.genesisleaguesports.com/)**.

*For those unfamiliar with Arcade Colony, it's owned by Invennium Corp. Arcade Colony is a platform for arcades and video games with a functional economy based on a governance token, \

.*

**Invennium Corp. is a 100% subsidiary of Splinterlands.**

Find more information about Arcade Colony in my post: **[Discover the Arcade Colony Platform](https://peakd.com/hive-13323/@moonblast/discover-the-arcade-colony-platform-lne)**.

## Acess The Game: [Splinterlands](https://splinterlands.com/?ref=moonblast)

<center>https://img.leopedia.io/DQmNMwhG6zdf6tcSMJBMuDya6e1Wy9xEHLoNjiZrcoqHEnK/mmmm.png</center>

links.body:
<center> 

### ❣️_Hola amigos de hive!_❣️ 

>### ❣️_Hello friends of hive!_❣️ 
</center>
<hr>
<div class=\

>
Siempre estoy buscando nuevas formas de preparar el pollo para no aburrirme, ya que es una de las proteínas que más consumimos en mi familia. Por eso hoy voy a compartir contigo un delicioso sudado de pollo con calabacín y pimiento rojo que te hará la boca agua. Es una receta fácil de preparar, llena de sabor y color, muy jugosa y perfecta para el almuerzo. Aquí tienes el paso a paso de esta sencilla receta.

> ``` I’m always looking for new ways to prepare chicken so I don’t get bored, since it’s one of the most commonly eaten proteins in my family. That’s why today I’m sharing a delicious chicken stew with zucchini and red bell pepper that will make your mouth water. It’s a simple recipe to prepare, full of flavor and color, very juicy, and perfect for lunch. Here’s the step-by-step guide to this easy recipe. ```
![Delicious rice with chicken and smoked bacon.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/theresa16/242YGDLFLKq3Zbup6niwCbywKn63CdpnCD5CXvfSJx5MESLmKjgUewZHta1LoVCPiqTXs.jpg)
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/theresa16/48a5mJrfDHAmwWoz38hgptfiWQnXDZdBjC7FvrycEqcnHCJdmNi4EnNSReLZSLbmQr.png)

> ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/theresa16/Eoc7ycrydiqgNLXy26MHX5MUTWbufyVz8oJPM92AJXxBikGVS1Z26bUFSNSFVjRaGZW.png) 01 kilo de pollo, 01 calabacín 02 cebollas, 01 pimiento rojo, 03 dientes de ajo, 01 cucharada de cúrcuma, 01 cucharada de orégano, 01 cucharadita de aceite de oliva, sal y pimienta al gusto. ``` 1 pound of chicken, 1 zucchini, 2 onions, 1 red bell pepper, 3 cloves of garlic, 1 tablespoon of turmeric, 1 tablespoon of oregano, 1 teaspoon of olive oil, salt and pepper to taste. ```
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/theresa16/48YA3dVucGUQ3j5STqMX3enFGLhvzgymiszf9aqeZzxzyW8oooVgCVPH9wwS7LPMkv.png)

>
Primero, lavaremos las verduras y cortaremos el calabacín en trozos; después, picaremos las cebollas, el pimiento rojo y el ajo en un procesador de cocina.

> ``` First, we’ll wash the vegetables and cut the zucchini into pieces; then we’ll chop the onions, red bell pepper, and garlic in a food processor. ```
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/theresa16/EoGw3TW7Zsh9Fur2rHpJAiqmdSuzueertKjK8HfR3y2CN49xiKhi2MLAqcG8JWx1MAE.png)|![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/theresa16/Eoc6VzgkG8XNd6FSSx2pUKtaeCxmnETfiCm5Gwki6MpZB6bFpCB5DFyBULAV84fHv6Y.png) -|-

>
Lava y corta el pollo en trozos; yo utilicé pechuga de pollo. En una olla, añade una cucharadita de aceite de oliva y, cuando esté caliente, añade el pollo y cocínalo a fuego lento durante cinco minutos.

> ``` Wash and cut the chicken into pieces; I used chicken breast. In a pot, add a teaspoon of olive oil, and once it’s hot, add the chicken and cook over low heat for five minutes. ```
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/theresa16/Eo6MoswCgFGxT7D6PJkPjhKNDwa2JgLaL3SBcqDy68kcYFiUAB8HpGW1YXFhgpFEx3n.png)|![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/theresa16/EoAbE2QGgfDhaZirbPUG4pUVKDXw9ma4vVY5EtVvp8Ft9GRXdHbV4ap4jEuRr2Tyc5W.png) -|-

>
A continuación, añade la cebolla picada, el ajo y el pimiento rojo, y sigue cocinando. Después, añade el calabacín y sigue cocinando, tapado y a fuego lento, para que suelte su líquido y se cocine hasta que esté tierno.

> ``` Next, add the chopped onion, garlic, and red bell pepper, and continue cooking. Then add the zucchini and continue cooking, covered, over low heat so that it releases its liquid and cooks until tender. ```
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/theresa16/Eo6MomZyCQQMrdJRcGTgfaommMKpZf3GJptC85pQMxHNuUyC2hropGTVQ4FqJEKozC7.png)|![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/theresa16/EoAbBGmFpywwZ93sKcY9Q3LqqvwXuT4hGmaMms689Ujw7eoa1AfhChpFGTPeTf8f7Kk.png) -|-

>
Pasados unos minutos, destapa la olla y sazona con sal, pimienta, cúrcuma y orégano. Remueve y deja que se cocine hasta que el líquido se haya reducido y la salsa haya espesado. Y ya está.

> ``` After a few minutes, uncover the pot and season with salt, pepper, turmeric, and oregano. Stir and let it cook until the liquid has reduced and the sauce has thickened. And that's it. ```
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/theresa16/EorxuXXKXipJbpRKsDcGZXMr7593TWUoAPsHdyHe7kKHPhdx4aR2ykVW4AhqezrhaVv.png)|![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/theresa16/EopsNTNqiQsNjqqT1DeFi3YhdQD9mcFnKCiYHCMbhGGetUeiGS7k56byazdaRQefUnM.png)|![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/theresa16/EpA2XJ8gnjgYwiGvD86XfJSm27okJUj3fpsgQDvZHZwcKopX7D1dUitU7v4Vwi2L2XT.png)|![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/theresa16/EpA14ZzU6nUM3itGHe6AYXvCyvUApAVTdj3gisE9Pn8UbzLpH4e8hH8Rht1Db4ySsZZ.png) -|-|-|- ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/theresa16/EoH1Pd6NLfPzh6Lw5qfrFpj9A8FUxRne5XThMnHVhnc3ZN27Q2LK7CaZhQBfFM6wPBM.png) ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/theresa16/EoCjYwvwFLr8xAPJQzcTj1P55SwhJXv6Ji8cZDsP3kSmfS9ZZt2uspjyAoWZchPpSBb.png)

>
Sírvelo caliente, acompañado de arroz, pasta o tu guarnición favorita. ¡Que aproveche!

> ``` Serve it hot, with rice, pasta, or your favorite side dish. Enjoy your meal! ```
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/theresa16/EoEsPfvjVNxAx2u2qEEqQxr7hpo3eznDzQPcDdTy8uU7wAnvL4uZgCLLnbggQmaSqqB.png) ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/theresa16/Ep7x5Toh1CokQH4tLidCV5h9pcyLqdwFY1AgQ5bgNceL61feEcYcDaHK8z4sKywYUHE.png) --- ![ggifupdate.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/theresa16/SD9NuiQZ-g-gif-update.gif)

links.title: My Actifit Report Card: April 24 2026
links.body:
![image](https://pixabay.com/get/g7b4d6119d44c7c1fe0377f20a1686bf90d8e8436518901ffcd5d1f0c107fdcc5871c25e49a5aed8bfae2e7788fea4b9fc977471f4845f81265a59398d337cc82_640.jpg)
Hoy decidí explorar un nuevo barrio de la ciudad que no había visitado antes. La caminata comenzó con un hermoso clima, el sol brillaba y había una brisa suave que hacía que todo fuera más agradable. Mientras caminaba, me encontré con un grupo de artistas callejeros que estaban pintando un mural vibrante en una pared antigua. Era fascinante ver cómo los colores cobraban vida y la energía que compartían entre ellos era contagiosa. Más adelante, me crucé con una señora mayor que vendía flores. Tenía una sonrisa radiante y me contó sobre las diferentes variedades que cultivaba en su jardín. Me compartió una historia sobre cómo empezó su negocio durante la pandemia, y cómo las flores le habían traído alegría tanto a ella como a sus clientes. El ambiente del barrio era una mezcla de culturas, con pequeñas cafeterías y tiendas artesanales que ofrecían productos únicos. Cada esquina tenía su propio encanto y me sentí inspirado por la creatividad y la vida que encontré en cada paso. Sin duda, fue una caminata que no solo ejercitó mi cuerpo, sino también mi mente y mi espíritu. _This report was published via Actifit app ([Android](https://bit.ly/actifit-app) | [iOS](https://bit.ly/actifit-ios)). Check out the original version [here on actifit.io](https://actifit.io/@titusfrost/actifit-titusfrost-20231229t015511428z)_

links.body:

![Pnz89X73aMGKet6y_ddd.webp](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/vero10h/images/Pnz89X73aMGKet6y_ddd/Pnz89X73aMGKet6y_ddd.webp)
