</liketuimages>

Some days feel like a gift, and today was one of them. All I needed was the sand beneath my feet, the rhythmic sound of the waves lapping the shore, and Luna’s tireless company.

Walking along the beach on Margarita Island has a unique charm, but when the clock strikes six in the evening, the atmosphere transforms completely. The sky began to turn shades of deep orange, violet, and gold, reminding me why this corner of the world is so special.

As the sun slowly bid farewell on the horizon, watching Luna enjoy the sea breeze and run freely along the shore was the perfect reminder of the beauty of simplicity. There was no rush, no notifications, no plans; just the two of us witnessing the sea swallow up the sun for a moment.

Margarita gives us incredible postcard views, but sharing them with her makes every color so much brighter. Sometimes, the best therapy is simply sitting in the sand and letting the sunset do the rest of the work.

Hay días que se sienten como un regalo, y hoy fue uno de ellos. No necesité mucho más que la arena bajo los pies, el sonido rítmico de las olas golpeando la orilla y la compañía incansable de Luna.

Caminar por la playa en la Isla de Margarita tiene un encanto único, pero cuando el reloj marca las seis de la tarde, la atmósfera se transforma por completo. El cielo comenzó a teñirse de naranjas intensos, violetas y dorados, recordándome por qué este rincón del mundo es tan especial.

Mientras el sol se despedía lentamente en el horizonte, ver a Luna disfrutar de la brisa marina y correr libre por la orilla fue el recordatorio perfecto de la belleza de lo simple. No hubo prisa, ni notificaciones, ni planes; solo nosotras dos siendo testigos de cómo el mar se tragaba al sol por un momento.

Margarita nos regala postales increíbles, pero compartirlas con ella hace que cada color sea mucho más brillante. A veces, la mejor terapia es simplemente sentarse en la arena y dejar que el atardecer haga el resto del trabajo.

links.title: Learning to pick your Battles
links.body:
I remember growing up in a very different world. Sometimes I wonder how we got here, how I got here—but then again, I suspect every generation feels that way at <u>some point</u>.


![e6549ca6-332a-459e-83fb-9f3ee04a185b.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/meno/23uEwtcFgobfyysR1gzaFNfPiUUkwK1ANozTgTm4CKu8FQPZPEEjCNunRmjVmTE4SywAZ.png)


One of the earliest memories that comes to mind is my mother’s voice, coaching me socially: *Don’t ever discuss religion or politics.* It’s bad manners, she said.

I often wonder if there are still parents out there giving that kind of advice, or if that strategy of avoidance has been completely left behind. I couldn’t really say how well it worked for most people, but for me, I think it did.

Not leading with religious beliefs as a kind of identity card allowed me to build friendships across different backgrounds without pre-judging anyone. And politics, at least from a kid’s perspective, were just phrases your parents repeated—things that felt less like ideas and more like inherited positions you were expected to carry.

Today, it’s **different**.

We wear our political views on our sleeve. We talk openly about religion. We debate uncomfortable topics without much hesitation. Maybe the pseudo-anonymity of the internet opened that door, but the shift feels deeper than that. It’s <u>cultural now</u>. These conversations—both productive and not—have followed us offline. They’re part of everyday life.

As I’ve gotten older, I’ve picked up a few lessons—things I find myself repeating like a mantra. Pick your battles. Conversations aren’t always about winning. Some people you can’t reach. Not all opinions are worth engaging with.

The list goes on...

There’s real value in stepping outside your echo chamber. In challenging your assumptions. In hearing perspectives that don’t align with your own. But there’s also a point where it stops being productive. Where it becomes less about understanding and more about endurance, more about egos.

Beating dead horses isn’t a virtue. It’s stupid.

And learning to recognize bad faith—dishonesty, deliberate misrepresentation, or just a refusal to engage with basic reality—isn’t cynicism. It’s self-preservation.

We like to pretend that more conversation is always better—that dragging every belief into the open is some kind of moral progress. But I’m not so sure anymore.

Not every discussion is honest. Not every disagreement is rooted in reality. And not every person is actually trying to understand anything at all. Some people are not even interested in letting you talk to begin with.

There’s a difference between engaging with ideas and feeding off conflict. One builds something within yourself. The other just burns time and energy while convincing you that you’re doing something meaningful. Meaningful to who? for what purpose?

So maybe the goal isn’t to speak more, or louder, or more often.

Maybe it’s to be a little more selective. A little more deliberate.

Because if everything becomes a battle, eventually you forget what was worth fighting for in the first place. 

-MenO

title.title: Ladies of Hive Contest #285: Life lessons to keep moving forward with purpose [ES/EN]
title.body:
>
![1000027524.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/erigm/48m9qT8qmmR7cotA6Q8Gq29VFZkk8Azfon9QSjkMV8gyoRdSBKgAt88NkD3wZYDGN3.jpg) Portada hecha en Canva
¡Hola queridas Damas de Hive! Espero que se encuentren todos muy bien. Hoy me paso por acá para participar de las preguntas semanales de la mano de @merit.ahama con temas relacionados entre sí. Gracias a mi amiga @naath por la invitación. ##### ***¿Cuál es un libro, vídeo de YouTube, película o lección de vida sobre el autodesarrollo que realmente le ha impactado? Podría tratarse de habilidades, dinero, propósito, relaciones, salud o crecimiento personal. Comparte lo que te enseñó y por qué lo recomendarías a otros.*** Soy una lectora asidua, aunque no leí muchos libros de desarrollo personal, pero sí los leo cuando llegan a mis manos. También me gusta consumir este estilo de contenido y, por supuesto, mirar las películas al respecto. No sé si pueda nombrar alguna cosa en específico, más bien siento que es un cúmulo de todas. Cada producción que consumo me deja algún aprendizaje importante.  Siento que de cualquier tipo de lecturas se puede sacar algo bueno. Eso es lo que hago yo, trato de buscar los mensajes y las enseñanzas en cualquier parte. De cada uno de ellos aprendí que hay que disfrutar de las pequeñas cosas de la vida, practicar la gratitud, ser consciente de que el cambio depende de nosotros y que a pesar de las adversidades, siempre se puede salir adelante y que estas suceden porque eran lecciones que debíamos aprender antes de llegar a donde de verdad queremos. Los aprendizajes que adquirí me dicen que todos los caminos conducen a Roma, lo único que cambia es cómo vivimos el trayecto y lo qué hacemos con eso. Nosotros somos los arquitectos de nuestras vidas y cada instante que vivimos es una oportunidad de seguir creciendo y mejorando en todos los ámbitos de ella. Me tomé muy en serio esto de que yo puedo crear la realidad que deseo con solo quererlo y creerlo, además de obrar en consecuencia para que suceda. Ahora estoy trabajando en ellos, tanto en temas de abundancia como mejorando mi autoconcepto y la manera en la que me relaciono con mi entorno.
![1000008760.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/erigm/EogNHpHhGroobU3XvrwtgdwBb6EFw7qMuzBW99KCtXgMh511QEUNi2Mh1ouy9WtTVDr.jpg)
##### ***En este momento de tu vida, ¿cuál crees que es tu principal razón para vivir? ¿Cómo describirías tu propósito en este momento y qué te mantiene avanzando cada día?*** Qué buena pregunta, no sé cuál es mi propósito real y por eso estoy acá. Siento que como almas y seres espirituales que somos, según mis creencias, vinimos a experiencias la vida con todas sus emociones, tanto las buenas como las malas, vinimos a cometer errores, enamorarnos, enojarnos, hacer lo que nos apasione, aprender todo el tiempo y vivir. Básicamente eso, vivir.  Si tuviera que escoger una razón para vivir diría que son las mismas ganas de experimentar lo que la vida tiene pensada para mí, sea lo que sea. También voy a nombrar a mis afectos, las personas que quiero y por las que me levanto agradecida todos los días por tenerlos en ella. Soy una esperanzada y una romántica empedernida de la vida, sé que así como sucede lo malo, también está lo bueno, y eso es lo que más pesa en mi balanza. Hay muchas cosas que quiero vivir y realizar, muchas metas que alcanzar y sueños por cumplir, ese es mi motor más grande para continuar cada día.
![Separador flores.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/erigm/23wgoZopiHNX1ebGWL5athK3UidSkfNjaiHUQLxsXxzCByxighLnHXwMdgiwbR6HWMpZn.png)
Bueno amigos, hasta acá mi reflexión acerca de estos temas. Espero que les haya gustado y los invitó a participar a todos los que me lean. Gracias por llegar hasta acá y apoyar mi contenido. ¡Hasta la próxima!
![Separador flores.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/erigm/23wgoZopiHNX1ebGWL5athK3UidSkfNjaiHUQLxsXxzCByxighLnHXwMdgiwbR6HWMpZn.png)
 
![1000027525.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/erigm/48m9qT8qmmR7cotA6SFhdyti1JAe1GCHEcXTWcAoT8sQSHFcnBb7KyXMfVeSunQvTv.jpg) Cover made in Canva
Hello, dear Ladies of Hive! I hope you’re all doing well. I’m stopping by today to take part in @merit.ahama weekly question on related topics. Thanks to my friend @naath for the invitation. ##### ***What is one book, YouTube video, movie, or life lesson on self-development that has truly impacted you? It could be about skills, money, purpose, relationships, health, or personal growth. Share what it taught you and why you would recommend it to others.*** I’m an avid reader, though I haven’t read many self-help books—but I do read them when I come across them. I also enjoy consuming this type of content and, of course, watching movies on the subject. I’m not sure if I can name anything specific; rather, I feel like it’s a combination of everything. Every piece of content I consume teaches me something important. I feel that you can take something positive away from any kind of reading. That’s what I do—I try to find the messages and lessons in everything. From each of them, I learned that we must enjoy life’s little things, practice gratitude, be aware that change depends on us, and that despite adversity, we can always move forward—and that these challenges happen because they were lessons we needed to learn before reaching where we truly want to be. What I’ve learned tells me that all roads lead to Rome; the only thing that changes is how we experience the journey and what we do with that experience. We are the architects of our own lives, and every moment we live is an opportunity to continue growing and improving in every aspect of it. I took this idea very seriously—that I can create the reality I desire simply by wanting it and believing in it, as well as by taking action to make it happen. Now I’m working on these areas, both in terms of abundance and improving my self-concept and the way I relate to my surroundings.
![1000008760.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/erigm/EogNHpHhGroobU3XvrwtgdwBb6EFw7qMuzBW99KCtXgMh511QEUNi2Mh1ouy9WtTVDr.jpg)
##### ***Right now in your life, what feels like your main reason for living?How would you describe your purpose at this moment, and what keeps you moving forward each day?*** That’s a great question. I don’t know what my true purpose is, and that’s why I’m here. I feel that, as souls and spiritual beings—according to my beliefs—we came here to experience life with all its emotions, both good and bad; we came to make mistakes, fall in love, get angry, do what we’re passionate about, learn all the time, and live. Basically, that’s it: to live. If I had to choose a reason to live, I’d say it’s simply the desire to experience whatever life has in store for me, whatever that may be. I’d also mention my loved ones—the people I care about and for whom I wake up every day feeling grateful to have in my life. I’m an optimist and a hopeless romantic when it comes to life; I know that just as bad things happen, good things do too, and that’s what tips the scales for me. There are so many things I want to experience and accomplish, so many goals to reach and dreams to fulfill—that’s my biggest motivation for carrying on each day.
![Separador flores.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/erigm/23wgoZopiHNX1ebGWL5athK3UidSkfNjaiHUQLxsXxzCByxighLnHXwMdgiwbR6HWMpZn.png)
Well, friends, that wraps up my thoughts on these topics. I hope you enjoyed it, and I invite all of you who are reading this to join in. Thank you for sticking with me and supporting my content. See you next time!
![Separador flores.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/erigm/23wgoZopiHNX1ebGWL5athK3UidSkfNjaiHUQLxsXxzCByxighLnHXwMdgiwbR6HWMpZn.png)

title.title: Red Soul
title.body:
>Hace mucho que no pintaba en digital, he tenido muy poco tiempo realmente y como he mencionado antes tambien he desarrollado una especie de aversión a la pantalla de la computadora, pero hoy en la mañana decidí intentarlo nuevamente y fluyo bastante bien… De hecho volví con un reto que para mi era bastante difícil y es que no es facil pensar en una combinación de colores diferentes, realmente no recuerdo si en el pasado ya he hecho un dibujo combinando estos dos tonos rojo y azul. Aunque es una combinación que en la vida diaria no me gustaría quise probarla en un dibujo y me encanto. > It’s been a long time since I last did any digital art; I’ve really had very little time, and as I mentioned before, I’ve also developed a sort of aversion to the computer screen, but this morning I decided to give it another try, and it’s going pretty smoothly… In fact, I came back with a challenge that was pretty difficult for me, because it’s not easy to come up with a combination of different colors. I don’t really remember if I’ve ever done a drawing combining these two shades of red and blue before. Although it’s a combination I wouldn’t normally choose in everyday life, I wanted to try it in a drawing, and I loved it. ![Corazón banner (1).png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/alexa.art/23uFgAbHNHepcyH3o8wH15M4pR8K7Jsf3tw4TsSj65zyY1UyQpKRK2L9tGpjABj48Qxzb.png)
**Proceso/Process**

>Realicé el boceto y aunque tenia miedo de agregar una mano, lo hice jaja. Tenia tiempo sin pintar manos y no son la gran cosa pero siempre las manos son un reto en todas sus formas, luego comencé a pintar con la paleta de color que elegí que en este caso en su mayoría eran azules pálidos / oscuros/ desaturados y rojo un poco mas brillante en todo el centro del rostro. En una nueva capa agregue mas colores hasta darle forma a toda la piel y rostro, luego mezcle los colores dejando una piel visiblemente mas limpia pero al mismo tiempo dejando algo de textura. > I did the sketch, and even though I was afraid to add a hand, I went ahead and did it, haha. It had been a while since I’d painted hands, and they’re not that great, but hands are always a challenge in every way. Then I started painting with the color palette I’d chosen, which in this case consisted mostly of pale, dark, and desaturated blues, with a slightly brighter red right in the center of the face. On a new layer, I added more colors to shape the skin and face, then blended the colors to create a visibly cleaner complexion while still retaining some texture. ![primer.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/alexa.art/23t77MJ7ob2f3GZ9wH5n4uKLNendQ2AZxJTUhNeQjjC8oQDjcSvZCrmqE1HCYGaJoZ5dz.png) Detalle bastante los ojos porque quería una mirada bastante profunda y con esos tonos rojos da un poco de miedo, me encanta. Luego pinte el cabello usado azules muy oscuros y dejando unas iluminaciones leves, para el fondo use un azul claro y pinte algunas manchas con un azul un poco mas claro, quise extender la parte roja del rostro hacia el fondo y tambien teñí de rojo en forma recta. Finalice agregando luces en el rostro para resaltar aun mas algunos de los rasgos faciales. > I went into a lot of detail on the eyes because I wanted a really intense look, and those red tones make it a little scary—I love it. Then I painted the hair using very dark blues and left some subtle highlights; for the background, I used a light blue and painted some patches with a slightly lighter blue. I wanted to extend the red part of the face toward the background, and I also added a straight line of red. I finished by adding highlights to the face to further emphasize some of the facial features. ![segb.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/alexa.art/23vhMQNroxxbZRU6nNk8EnNgVwbqtosMZP912NQiywTdtrn6FddB9otuBBzj5FYoLzYFH.png) ![Corazón banner (1).png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/alexa.art/23uFgAbHNHepcyH3o8wH15M4pR8K7Jsf3tw4TsSj65zyY1UyQpKRK2L9tGpjABj48Qxzb.png) **Tools:** - Photoshop CC 2022 - XP-PEN Deco Pro >**Herramientas:** - Photoshop CC 2022 - XP-PEN Deco Pro ![baner.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/alexa.art/EoCgE4NWYb7YZotU41QrqC6WVbLN7gJQg6xiqHtAmMVHmLWa3BFRcaEwX5igYv77MSB.png)

title.body:

![Trc4Q0rfJDyYEi6T_Image_1777000340937_990.webp](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/angelina6688/images/Trc4Q0rfJDyYEi6T_Image_1777000340937_990/Trc4Q0rfJDyYEi6T_Image_1777000340937_990.webp)
</center>
</liketuimages>

昨天早上，娃儿们终于如愿以偿的出去研学了，也就是所谓的春游。
 
这个春游时间一拖再拖，再往后延了两个星期之后，昨天终于出去了。
 
前面几天看天气预报，昨天和今天都是雨，多云或者晴天，结果昨天早娃背着一书包的零食和吃的喝的兴高采烈的去学校旅游大巴车之后，还没过一会又开始飘那个蒙蒙细雨。
 
我也是上班的时候下了楼我发现飘了雨我才用回家拿了雨伞，当时我就在想，心里直打鼓，这不会也下了小雨，娃出发到一半又被大巴车给拖回来说不出去研学了吧？那学生们该得多失望。盼了好久的春游不会就要又要取消了吧？
 
后来，但是这个雨呢真的是蒙蒙细雨，就一点点，也不是很大。好在到了上午 10 点钟差一点，9 点半多的样子，雨就停了。然后整天基本上都是阴天，太阳在中午的时候偶尔出了一会。到下午和晚上也没有再下雨。
 
上班的时候看到班主任和研学的教官和老师在班级群里分享了很多孩子们研学途中的趣闻和照片视频。看得出来他们都非常开心。其实一群孩子出去玩，地点不是最重要，最重要的是不用上课，不用在学校一直坐着不动，可一群娃出去玩，这就是他们最开心的。
 
而且研学前后一两天学校没有布置作业，你说这怎么能不让人兴奋呢？想想我以前小学初中的时候出去春游也是兴奋的头一天晚上久久不能入眠呀。果然不管什么年龄段的孩子，什么时代的孩子。都是喜欢春游出去玩的。

---

title.body: >Unsplash 上次提到聚餐的事，去的餐廳是一間叫做秀蘭小館的江浙菜，聽家裡常上館子的朋友說，這間店提到媽媽的第一印象都是有名很貴，似乎是很早以前就出名的一間餐館。 後來回家後才查了一下，這間餐廳大有來頭，原本只是一間小吃店，後來卻因古龍辭世前，從醫院溜了出來吃了這家店，寫進了最後的專欄之中，所以看到專欄的人開始上門光顧。 後來政商名流、明星藝人、文壇人士，店門口常常有車上下人是正常狀況。我看網路的新聞資料寫著，一排名人的名字，也不難想像這間店在當年，有名很貴的印象惠存在那些阿姨的腦海中。 聽說創店的老闆娘早就不做了，現在是他教出來的廚師掌廚，自己則是世界各地跑，偶而才會回來試口味，不過這篇新聞也是8年前的，現況如何我就不太知曉。 我自己對江浙菜不熟悉，但我個人的感覺是，吃過後卻沒有很驚豔的感覺，我期待的菜飯也沒有其他餐館吃的油香，也許是沒點到比較特色的菜，也可能單純是這間餐館沒有在我的喜好範圍內。 --- For the best experience view this post on [Liketu](https://liketu.com/@azazqwe/3he9gq)

title.title: We Try to Enter Wenjie's Laboratory in DEATHLOOP but We Fail
title.body:
![333.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/venapboyz/23w2HKurxAC7Jfe4AxStkgMRG32e4kRHiDA141XP1FEihftK9LW5HhQ3dmdx3XQHNVQaK.gif)


Hello gamers, how's everyone doing? Hope you're all doing great. We're back with more DEATHLOOP and this time I went in with one clear objective in mind — push forward in the main story and start actually taking down the Visionaries one by one. Because, as we've talked about in previous posts, the whole endgame of breaking the loop requires eliminating all eight of them in a single day, and the only way to figure out how to do that is to start learning each one individually. So I decided to go after the first one on my list: Dr. Wenjie Evans, in her laboratory over at The Complex. And let me tell you, it did not go the way I expected.

**The Largest Zone I've Had to Cover So Far**

![1.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/venapboyz/23uFHBNCvrWS9Lx1whnrNNqzmddiCxaeQLK4oVh2ebYjT5qTdiX3UxTeUH96Lt94oSiBw.jpg)

The Complex is not a small area. When I dropped in and started moving through it toward Wenjie's lab, I quickly realized this was a completely different scale compared to what I'd been navigating in previous runs. The place is massive — multiple levels, interconnected buildings, long outdoor stretches, tight indoor corridors, and an enormous satellite structure looming over the whole thing. It's the kind of map where you can feel the size of it before you've even scratched the surface of what's actually inside.

Wenjie's laboratory specifically sits within a section of The Complex that's only fully accessible during the afternoon, and it's structured across several separate annexes connected by outdoor paths and interior walkways. There's a green building, a blue building, a red section, all linking back to a central chamber with that giant satellite structure dominating the middle of everything. Just getting from the entry point to the actual lab without getting spotted or overwhelmed takes real navigation skills because the place is absolutely loaded with Eternalists patrolling every corner. It's the kind of area where rushing in without a plan gets you killed fast, and I learned that the hard way a couple of times before I started moving more deliberately.

**The Deployable Turrets Became My Best Friends**

![0423 (1)(1).jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/venapboyz/23vhTwFL6Xd49o5oD48kmuAWbGGe1DeMvQSxJb32UXeKgTEKTRQKuARPx6SWyUBtRXjQw.jpg)

Here's where I found my groove, at least for a while. One of the mechanics in DEATHLOOP that I've been sleeping on a little is the ability to hack turrets and flip them to your side. These things are spread all over The Complex and Wenjie's lab is no exception — the place is absolutely bristling with security cameras and deployed turrets that, by default, are working against you. But once you pull out your Hackamajig and flip them, they become yours. And having a turret covering a corridor or entrance while you push deeper into a building is genuinely a game changer when you're trying to manage multiple enemies at once in a confined space.

I started using them strategically — hack the turret in an annex first, then push forward knowing the hallway behind me was covered. It slowed my pace down but made each room feel a lot more manageable. The cameras were just as important to deal with early because letting one spot you in that lab is basically inviting the entire place down on your head all at once. So the pattern became: move in, neutralize cameras, hack any turrets I could find, clear enemies carefully, advance. Slow, methodical, but it was working. At least until I got deeper in.

**The Wenjie Clones Are an Absolute Nightmare**

![0423 (1)(2).jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/venapboyz/23tkjqsRAMScA3DqceHEYJuGaeCa3ByMSSENDXrNFq9MMDB31niNEc4TmSDHk19YZi7MA.jpg)

And this is where the whole run fell apart. Here's the thing about Dr. Wenjie Evans that the game doesn't fully prepare you for the first time you push seriously into her lab — she doesn't exist as a single target. She's everywhere. Multiple clones of Wenjie are scattered throughout the different annexes of the laboratory, and each one of them is armed, aggressive, and more than capable of putting you down if you're not careful. You push through a door expecting a regular room and suddenly you're face to face with two or three versions of the same scientist who all immediately decide they want you dead.

![0423 (1)(6).jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/venapboyz/23tGcDd4TR9ibdENkZo9LiiKRLCVP3Bmwmj1ASe11NmsTX1kidb3wzt27xgQXhG4Udbiv.jpg)

The clones are no joke. They're not regular Eternalists that go down in one clean headshot and call it a day. Each Wenjie clone takes punishment, dishes it back hard, and when there are multiple of them in the same room — which happens constantly in that lab — the situation escalates from manageable to completely out of control in about three seconds. I burned through ammunition faster than I expected because of them. I'd clear one room thinking I was making progress, move to the next, and there would be more. And more after that. The lab is genuinely stacked with them across every level and every annex, and dealing with that while also managing the regular Eternalists patrolling the space and keeping an eye on the exits for any sign of Juliana makes for one of the most chaotic environments I've been in so far in this game.

What makes it even more complicated is that you can't just eliminate one clone and call Wenjie dead. That's not how it works. She's a Visionary, and as a Visionary she doesn't go down until every single copy of her in the lab has been eliminated. Each clone you kill leaves behind a clue pointing toward where the next one is hiding, which turns the whole thing into a sequential hunt through a building that is actively trying to kill you the entire time. It's a clever design, genuinely. But in practice, when you're low on ammo, your turret allies are getting overwhelmed, and three Wenjies have just cornered you in a stairwell, clever design stops feeling like a compliment.

**Next Mission: Try Again**

![222.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/venapboyz/23xKkBAm5kseQMyCQs64f7Zwf37b7Lpc6kZYPrjq6HGXaJQEXPQgK6o3X5VXFb3noxTtP.gif)

So yeah, this run ended in failure. Clean, decisive failure. The Wenjie clones got the better of me and I ran out of lives before I could push through to eliminate them all, which means the loop reset and I'm back to square one for this particular attempt. And honestly? I'm not even that frustrated about it. That's kind of the beauty of DEATHLOOP's structure — a failed run is never really wasted because you come back knowing more than you did before. Now I know the layout of the lab better. I know where the clones tend to cluster. I know which annexes are the most dangerous and where the turrets are positioned. I know I need to go in with significantly more ammunition and probably a better loadout than what I had this time.

The next attempt is going to be more prepared, more deliberate, and hopefully more successful. Wenjie is going down eventually, it's just a matter of figuring out the cleanest path through that lab without getting buried under copies of her before I reach the end. So gamers, stay tuned because this story isn't over. See you in the next post!

### ESPAÑOL

Una semana de intensidad necesaria, hoy volvimos a hacer series, salimos a correr desafiando al clima, salimos a correr con el plan de que si llovia paralizabamos el entrenamiento donde estuvieramos.

Sin embargo, no llovió y logramos hacer el trabajo correspondiente, 3 Kilómetros de Calentamiento, 8 x 400 m con 1: 30 minutos de descanso, y luego 1 kilómetro  de enfriamiento.

Cambiamos el lugar de las seriea en otro lugar del parque donde esta una zona demarcada con un camino de tierra el cual mide los 400 km y simula el ovalo de una pista, me encantó entrenar alli porque el terreno es mas suave que en la zona de la laguna que es donde transcurren la mayor parte de nuestros entrenamientos.

Afortunadamente no llovió pero la humedad que sentia era terrible, en cuanto a mi, las dos ultimas series me costaron bastante pero supongo que es parte de la carga del dia martes con la series de 800.

Al terminar abrace un arbol para llenarme de energia y soltar el estres del dia.

La recuperacio de las series fue rapido cosa que me parece muy favorable pprque es un indicador de que el cuerpo sw esta adaptando a este ritmo.

### Seguimos sumando kilómetros de salud y bienestar


### ENGLISH

It was a week of intense training. Today we did interval training again; we went out for a run despite the weather, planning to stop training wherever we were if it rained.

However, it didn’t rain, and we managed to complete the workout: a 3-kilometer warm-up, 8 x 400 m with 1:30-minute rest intervals, and then a 1-kilometer cool-down.

We moved the interval training to another part of the park where there’s a marked-off area with a dirt path that measures 400 meters and simulates a track oval. I loved training there because the terrain is smoother than in the lagoon area, which is where most of our workouts take place.

Fortunately, it didn’t rain, but the humidity felt terrible. As for me, the last two sets were quite tough, but I suppose that’s part of the workload from Tuesday’s 800-meter sets.

When I finished, I hugged a tree to recharge my energy and release the day’s stress.

Recovery between sets was quick, which I find very encouraging because it’s a sign that my body is adapting to this pace.

### We keep racking up kilometers of health and well-being

Yeah, that's right! good music is all it takes to put a smile on our face. But... and this is a big but, first you have to take into account a few things to truly be able to extract from music what can eventually draw and put a big smile on your face: ¡You have to have a soul!

A wise soul, conscious and generous with everything that happens around you in the now, in the current moment, in the present, in your present and in the present of the whole world. Because it is only in this very present that things happen. And therefore, you necessarily have to be attentive and focused to each and every detail of what is happening in this **infinite instant** that we call the **now.** Because everything else may or may not happen. That's the real [moral](https://youtu.be/SM3IQFgP-d8) of this story.

https://youtu.be/37eC56K6HIE
https://youtu.be/LqirJAVvfOU
https://youtu.be/UtXP2-5IC2E

<div class=\

>

So yeah, forget about endlessly chasing that eternal mirage of a *possible* future. That intangible concept and fragile, insubstantial, vaporous and impalpable chimera that others have instilled in you and made you believe it exists.  Because in my eccentric and now veteran opinion, there is no such thing as the future, but rather a constant, sequential and permanent **present.** The only fragment and segment of the authentic reality and figment of your own imagination with the enough solidity and reliability as to be able to put a smile on your face at any given moment in whatever you do.

Although of course, if you want, you can completely disregard everything I've said in this post. Because I'm certainly an old chap now, and it's very likely I see things quite differently than you do. But well, anyway, the only thing I really wanted to do in this post was to share an unorthodox \
of an excellent movie that I believe you should watch and I'm simply offering some of my philosophical thoughts on the matter.\n\nBecause, as that old proverb says: *\

* so I suppose there's more than one way to do a [movie review](https://hive.blog/trending/hive-166847) too. And I have chosen this somewhat more extravagant way of doing it because I suspect that it is always possible to gain a greater understanding of things when we learn to see them not only with our own eyes, but allow ourselves the time to view them from different angles and perspectives.

Different angles and perspectives, like the ones you could find if you just dare to click on the image below.

title.title: The Camden Market Free Art Man vs. Nature
title.body:
by @jompiy on Black Ivory 
View my bio on Blurt.media: https://blurt.media/c/blackivory [![The Camden Market Free Art Man vs. Nature](https://blurt.media/lazy-static/previews/4a9d2200-c384-40ac-81f5-9780f582725d.jpg)](https://blurt.media/w/rFBYnft3QxuwAxb59Z1qQb) 
 
 Wind is almost as bad as rain for The Camden Market Free Art Man. This video was recorded 1st June 2025, which was windier than normal. My paintings keep blowing into the road and tourists unless I can find something to hold them down. The tall buildings and high street make my area a bit of a wind trap, so now, if the weather forecast says it's going to be windy, I don't go. Kizzie helped collect a few that blew away, took one and did an interview. I've seen her a few times at Camden. She sits with Zombie on the other side of the bridge. Like me, she comes to Camden Market, if only for its atmosphere. I've been going to Camden fairly regularly since I was about 14. Before we moved to London.  
Another of the interviewees in this video suggested we paint on the streets of Camden together. I said I was up for it, but didn't heat back. She also is sometimed over with Zombie. The guy who sells his paintings on the street, next to Camden Town tube station paints live on the street. I don't think it would work for my display, although if I had a helper to do the interview, there might be some time and space for it. 
 ***
[**Check out today's video..!**](https://blurt.media/w/rFBYnft3QxuwAxb59Z1qQb)

title.title: Celebrando mi tercer aniversario en Hive:  Arte con las Manos y el Corazón【 🇪🇸 - 🇺🇸 】
title.body:
> Saludos, gente linda de #HiveDIY. Hoy es un día especial para mí en Hive ya que estoy de aniversario N°3 y como las veces anteriores sólo hablaba de cómo ha sido mi experiencia en la plataforma y dándole las gracias a ciertos usuarios, por eso este año para celebrar quiero hacerlo diferente y compartirlo con ustedes Hoy les traigo un paso a paso de una manualidad en forma de pastel de cumpleaños para celebrar a lo grande este cumpleaños de Hive. Espero que les guste, lo hice con mucho cariño. Al final también les dejo el video tutorial del cual obtuve la idea para que se guíen mejor si no me entienden. > Greetings, lovely people of #HiveDIY! Today is a special day for me on Hive because it's my 3rd anniversary, and unlike previous years when I've only talked about my experience on the platform and thanked certain users, this year I want to do something different and share it with you. > > Today I'm sharing a step-by-step tutorial for a birthday cake craft to celebrate Hive's birthday in style. I hope you like it; I made it with lots of love. At the end, I've also included the video tutorial where I got the idea, so you can follow along if you're having trouble understanding.
![sep.2026.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/pannavi/23tbPXTf1bvy4jaGNjptgQFy5gWYhWKJKS8g2jUuibSPhe56BuNS1C7amKtxLNKAEqeKn.png)

▹𝙼𝚊𝚝𝚎𝚛𝚒𝚊𝚕𝚎𝚜 ▫ 𝙼𝚊𝚝𝚎𝚛𝚒𝚊𝚕𝚜◃

![sep.2026.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/pannavi/23tbPXTf1bvy4jaGNjptgQFy5gWYhWKJKS8g2jUuibSPhe56BuNS1C7amKtxLNKAEqeKn.png)
![1.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/pannavi/EoK6kJzNDSkbqiJGUgY5gzTRwCJCaoDiHNdRey75uCFWffLwqX8raJe42iSGpsRzynx.jpg)
Para esta manualidad necesitaremos los siguientes materiales: * Cartón Corrugado * Lápiz y marcador * Tijera * Regla * Papel crepé o papel de seda * Botella de refresco de plástico * Pistola de silicón * Pega blanca Y como extra para el decorado puedes usar escarcha de colores, lentejuelas y foami. >For this craft, you will need the following materials: > >* Corrugated cardboard >* Pencil and marker >* Scissors >* Ruler >* Crepe paper or tissue paper >* Plastic soda bottle >* Hot glue gun >* White glue > >And as an extra for decoration, you can use colored glitter, sequins, and craft foam.
![sep.2026.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/pannavi/23tbPXTf1bvy4jaGNjptgQFy5gWYhWKJKS8g2jUuibSPhe56BuNS1C7amKtxLNKAEqeKn.png)

▹𝙿𝚊𝚜𝚘 𝚊 𝙿𝚊𝚜𝚘 ▫ 𝚂𝚝𝚎𝚙 𝚋𝚢 𝚂𝚝𝚎𝚙◃

![sep.2026.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/pannavi/23tbPXTf1bvy4jaGNjptgQFy5gWYhWKJKS8g2jUuibSPhe56BuNS1C7amKtxLNKAEqeKn.png)

> Lo primero que hice fue recortar el centro de la botella, no importa si te queda desprolijo, luego le darás la forma adecuada con la tijera recortando mejor los bordes. > The first thing I did was cut out the center of the bottle; it doesn't matter if it looks messy, you'll give it the right shape later with scissors, trimming the edges better.
![IMG_20260420_152816.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/pannavi/23w2sDAjdN7h8sBMrcvYrEd91gpYaDZsy2dPt35qZ81S9EPgCBbjGDt4nx7BxESwg23NQ.jpg)
Ahora que lo tienes así, puedes recortar mejor los bordes superior e inferior. Si lo deseas, puedes trazar una línea con un marcador para guiarte, yo lo hice al ojo por ciento y por donde vi que quedaba bien. > Now that you have it like this, you can trim the top and bottom edges more neatly. If you want, you can draw a line with a marker as a guide; I did it freehand, just eyeballing where it looked best. |![IMG_20260420_154430.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/pannavi/EowJVRE22noHGv4gw44aEy86KWCqpTjvNHMx9NLY3JbiM1cPZwTtedoFC31Nnk7VvZa.jpg)|![IMG_20260420_154802.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/pannavi/23tSd3qz8cBw7AhZkBg9LpFnkHJTJRwqjRB7ayvjb8MAnMy7ZFMKLrMXk1ZQ1RdJzGuZR.jpg)| |-|-| Como no tenía quien me ayudara a tomar la foto, tuve que tomarla así, primero piqué un lado, luego el otro y quedó de esa manera, todo prolijo. Luego al ojo por ciento también hice un doblez que para marcarlo bien me ayudé con la tijera. >Since I didn't have anyone to help me take the photo, I had to do it myself. First, I cut one side, then the other, and it ended up like this, all tidy. Then, just eyeballing it, I also made a fold, using scissors to help me crease it properly. |![IMG_20260420_154849.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/pannavi/EoK8DwEkEL8kfmnrXXkMSWYEJihZQwgySAHfZpSi6g5ho57SVyLAoVprtGoFumtAbQV.jpg)|![IMG_20260420_155004.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/pannavi/Eo4E3QVjRKmiqeadSq31KxqNLzTo72V5yYYfvVh3xHpFVeigTXnQiAWy8yqaBw57rsz.jpg)| |-|-| Primero doble un lado y guiándome por mi instinto doblé las otras dos puntas haciendo la forma de un triángulo o en este caso un pedazo de torta. > First, I folded one side and, guided by my instinct, I folded the other two points, making the shape of a triangle, or in this case, a piece of cake.
![IMG_20260421_102653.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/pannavi/Eoke1w2NcUjxirbpX6J5sjvp7nkJoVPxJqj2S44F3KnNX8xPsq1xnoZRpa234M5etyJ.jpg)
Otro detalle es que yo no tenía cartón corrugado. Si tú tienes la oportunidad de comprar para hacer esta manualidad, puedes usar el color que más te guste. Yo usé el color natural del cartón ya que le quité una capa para obtener el corrugado. > Another detail is that I didn't have corrugated cardboard. If you have the opportunity to buy some for this craft, you can use any color you like. I used the natural color of the cardboard since I removed a layer to create the corrugated effect. |![IMG_20260421_110023.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/pannavi/EpLgR2a7CqEW3QxCxFqFA3mkWMsJv2ks9AHFAm3QXigxGUq8n6YamcTMH1X7x6yXuuC.jpg)|![IMG_20260421_110031.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/pannavi/EpXJvGoJAW7CHCxpj1Kfp8hNxrkYWGZcH29Z9x8xFUHkKcnUAVTMTST65ns5nHLhFRR.jpg)| |-|-| Luego de eso, usé de plantilla el plástico doblado en forma de triángulo para sacar una base y una tapa. Cabe destacar que para este paso debes recortar uno con el lado de una cara y el otro con el lado posterior para que no obtengas dos piezas iguales. > After that, I used the folded plastic triangle as a template to cut out a base and a lid. It's important to note that for this step you should cut one piece along one side and the other along the other side so you don't end up with two identical pieces. |
![IMG_20260421_110925.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/pannavi/Eo6Mqr6Xm7jDVvWBNSLXj9w6PzCDJ7L2dK9qHk6n2fH89rF9TKgFxpHoyurjUxMg5rP.jpg)
Aquí puedes ver mejor a lo que me refiero, marca un lado por la parte lisa y el otro por la parte corrugada. También necesitarás tres tiras de cartón corrugado. Yo las hice todas de 2 cm, pero puedes variar esta medida de acuerdo a lo grande que vayas a usar el plástico. > Here you can see better what I mean; mark one side on the smooth side and the other on the corrugated side. You'll also need three strips of corrugated cardboard. I made mine 2 cm wide, but you can adjust this measurement depending on the size of the plastic you'll be using. |![IMG_20260421_112022.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/pannavi/EonmQgD3sWfSiqhcqL3GQHH1YWt88auUfDs8t1sT6UJjtcvzpUu53YUaKdySbJjx4Dx.jpg)|![IMG_20260421_112224.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/pannavi/EoEsUHVh2UJtMwY5iwhaGRR8soeiyVxnMjmLJ86zMtTKFoMRYp6gTyra7VFrdBXEhcn.jpg)| |-|-| |![IMG_20260421_112602.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/pannavi/EoK7GSpqfkvohi7KJR8SMTWUDH53nFZ2RT9tg3jksrRd7Jpsb3EWvJizCXho4F4dDhf.jpg)|![IMG_20260421_112923.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/pannavi/EowJTfm1dAkFEr75AQUe7PcvVbgrHCgTyxBUCruPzqnCjG1sk3SrYxiKkgSqVNgksqt.jpg)| Con ayuda de la pistola de silicón vas a pegar por la orilla la primera tira de cartón corrugado, por todo el borde del primer triángulo con el lado liso hacia adentro y haces lo mismo con el otro con el lado corrugado hacia adentro. Luego con cuidado mides la base del triángulo que en este caso es el lado que tiene el corrugado hacia adentro. Si calza bien, lo pegas con silicón caliente. Para la parte superior, sólo lo usarás de tapa, no hace falta que lo adquieras al plástico. Una vez ambas partes colocadas, toma la tercera tira de cartón corrugado y la pegas en el centro. Yo lo hice al ojo por ciento, pero puedes medirlo para hacerlo más exacto. >Using a hot glue gun, glue the first strip of corrugated cardboard along the edge of the first triangle, with the smooth side facing inward. Do the same with the other triangle, with the corrugated side facing inward. > >Then, carefully measure the base of the triangle, which in this case is the side with the corrugation facing inward. If it fits well, glue it in place with hot glue. For the top part, you'll only use it as a lid; you don't need to buy the plastic one. > >Once both parts are in place, take the third strip of corrugated cardboard and glue it in the center. I did it by eye, but you can measure it for more precision.
![IMG_20260421_125331.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/pannavi/Eou8BhjAF3Xpb2BHWdNaNaAzQAvQHX7MYFQdKn8QMCQJonBcVnnPdfxYFph3PcK1r9p.jpg)
Para hacer la especie de decorado de la torta como si fuera el glaseado azucarado tomaremos un poco de pega blanca y haremos tiras de papel con el papel de ceda o papel crepé. Yo usé ambos, si tienes de colores similares, sería mejor porque hacen más contraste. En mi caso usé lo que tenía. > To create a sugared frosting effect on the cake, we'll use a little white glue and make strips of tissue paper or crepe paper. I used both; if you have similar colors, that would be better because they create more contrast. In my case, I used what I had on hand. |![IMG_20260421_125406.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/pannavi/Ep3bvgUMmxF5K2bQbpHBwf9kwP6SCyUupXoHyjd3EKs5pSwCzY71W14KJbkUnR1xB8G.jpg)|![IMG_20260421_130123.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/pannavi/EopsWQY41sxMDsCPeJTHDHfYK5VmUbVMhYLTGSoAt3aVzJPWk7q4tzJaerjzodYTyHt.jpg)| |-|-| Yo hice cada tira de papel como de 2 cm, pero puedes hacerlas más pequeñas y la idea es pegar un poco el borde con pega blanca y dejar un espacio para recortarlo de forma fina como si fueran pestañas. > I made each strip of paper about 2 cm wide, but you can make them smaller. The idea is to glue the edge a little with white glue and leave a space to trim it thinly, like tabs.
![IMG_20260421_130949.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/pannavi/EowH1MwZga6jFPhesoT4ZGnZxvYB2qiYxsTZhp2gJA58nPmYuVfZZc187SDZdz2ENRS.jpg)
Una vez listas las tiras, sólo queda empezar a pegar en la parte trasera del pastel, sin importar que sobre salgan un poco los bordes porque luego los vas a recortar. Haces esto con la parte de atrás y con la tapa. Quedando de la siguiente manera: > Once the strips are ready, simply start gluing them to the back of the cake. Don't worry if the edges stick out a little, as you'll trim them later. Do this for both the back and the top. It should look like this: |![IMG_20260421_135224.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/pannavi/EogNNdZTdTdPZTASqxET7cdtMTYVYboCUjdXBzPHq2dQgiRqaPyG54krezrBQqcC5uy.jpg)|![IMG_20260421_135425.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/pannavi/23wCDgMxdYJKw2VdkYTyX9xZvcjMSqfQzpDe8vkck8LNbTqqez8BcxEDrRL7zNMKFvRgL.jpg)|![IMG_20260421_135553.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/pannavi/EprUYsM53Hg8FifakZGoe3zx2j59sMqzxzrgNGgC8mqmj5nLqLi8U5ZDTmiA6XFR5Vi.jpg)| |-|-|-| El resultado de esta parte fue el siguiente: > The result of this part was the following: |![IMG_20260421_144206.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/pannavi/Eos1rrYwffYwbn5nfBzNmPhWYKvjc8qE8VSq4bcbKp6QdF6GLoLSSH8JJ6EVUC9tEKw.jpg)|![IMG_20260421_144234.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/pannavi/EoeGpemeXJVc9nDQLrVbCkvfY7puufS9zseCVKUgpc83CSjgCGnNqpEJtphn8EtRL1u.jpg)| |-|-| ![IMG_20260421_144726.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/pannavi/Eou9G5at3Zc4EXHEXqzQE3phRANQnK5bQLbgnthAo9zKJ7dK7r73xsrJKgsuUUQTtEe.jpg)|![IMG_20260421_144838.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/pannavi/EpCBKQUTxfDCPTRTHYB8cibHLdEDrKDqaJdTDLAvGiTj3kn7jcCC7R6ePRCXfgBmhrP.jpg)| Ya allí se corta el excedente del papel y se le da forma con las uñas o los dedos para alborotar el papel y que quede como un betún en la torta. Para el relleno usé otro trozo de papel crepé y lo pegué por dentro con pega blanca por los lados del cartón corrugado para que no se viera la pega. También decoré con algunas lentejuelas y las letras las hice en foami. Para la vela usé un palito de papel, pero también puedes usar un popote; le pegas un papel amarillo para simular la flama y listo, queda como resultado el siguiente: > There, the excess paper is cut off and shaped with the nails or fingers to fluff up the paper and make it look like frosting on the cake. > >For the filling, I used another piece of crepe paper and glued it inside with white glue along the sides of the corrugated cardboard so the glue wouldn't show. I also decorated it with some sequins, and I made the letters out of foam. title.title: Jueves de TBT: Graduación de mi hermana ❤️🌟 [ENG/ESP]
title.body: >Greetings to everyone in the Top Family community! Today, I’m here to take part in this TBT Thursday. As always, I’ll be leaving the link at the end of this post for anyone who wants to join in. With that said, let’s get started.

>Today’s TBT photo and the story behind it is of my sister Claudia, from her graduation as a Senior Radiology Technician from Arturo Michelena University. In the photo, you can see four people, and from left to right, my sister is the one on the far right (the first one). This is one of the few photos we were able to keep in the family because, although we had the foresight to bring equipment to photograph and capture the moment, unfortunately that equipment was damaged, and we lost most of the footage from that day. That is why the photos that remain from that day are mostly of her posing with her classmates. These were images that they gave to her. It was a real relief, since we were worried we wouldn’t have a single photo from that day.

\n\n

>I remember that my sister worked very hard throughout her time studying for that degree. She worked and studied at night so she could afford her education. That fact is still something I admire greatly, and at the same time, I feel a little sad because I couldn’t help her enough with it. The truth is, I was working too, but what I earned didn’t allow me to be a constant source of support. So when the day of the ceremony arrived, we wanted to be able to pay tribute to her. We ended up with three family photos, and that at least brings me some comfort because I can keep that memory forever. She looked so beautiful, with her hair done, her makeup, and her big smile. That year was especially hard, but we got through it all. This is my memory; without further ado, thank you so much for reading.

![1832371o8cmlh50ee.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carminasalazarte/23tSWEzpvPAaKUpZno2jJE3UyTfYMwJHSZH4faRStZiSH9ywjKJNQEz6ppR8cYKoeQdjj.gif) >

>Saludos a todos en la comunidad de Top family, el día de hoy bueno por acá para participar en este Jueves de TBT. Como siempre estaré dejando el enlace al final de esta publicación para todo aquel que desee participar. Dicho esto comencemos con ello.

\n\n>

>La imagen de TBT del día de hoy y la anécdota detrás de ella es de mi hermana Claudia, del momento de su graduación cómo Técnico Superior en Radiología de la Universidad Arturo Michelena. En la fotografía se alcanzan a observar cuatro personas y en el orden de izquierda a derecha, mi hermana es la que está al extremo de la derecha (la primera). Esta es una de las pocas fotografías que nosotros pudimos conservar en la familia ya que, aunque se tuvo la previsión de llevar un equipo para fotografiar y capturar el momento, lamentablemente ese equipo sufrió un daño y perdimos la mayor cantidad de la información de ese dia. Es por ello que las fotografías que quedaron de ese día son en su mayoría, de ella posando junto a sus compañeros de estudios. Estas fueron imágenes que ellos le pasaron a ella. Fue algo bastante bueno ya que nos asustó no tener ni una sola fotografía de ese día.

\n\n>

>Recuerdo que mi hermana se esforzó mucho durante el transcurso de tiempo que estudió esa carrera. Trabajando y estudiando en la noche para poder permitirse la carrera. Ese hecho sigue siendo algo que yo admiro mucho y al mismo tiempo, siento un poco de tristeza porque no pude ayudarla lo suficiente con ello. La verdad yo también trabajaba pero lo que ganaba no me permitía ser un sustento constante. Así que cuando llegó el día de la ceremonia, queríamos poder rendirle tributo. Nos quedaron tres fotografía familiares y eso al menos me alivia porque puedo guardar ese recuerdo para siempre. Ella estaba muy bonita, con su peinado, maquillaje y su gran sonrisa. Ese año fue especialmente duro, pero todo se superó. Este es mi recuerdo, sin más que decir, muchísimas gracias por aquí.

[Concurso de Jueves de TBT](https://ecency.com/hive-192096/@lanzjoseg/concurso-tbt-una-foto-una-historia-un-dia-de-esos-tdxcq4) ![Thank You for stopping by_20251222_235935_0000.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carminasalazarte/EqQRuBXhDFu9VJKoUi9KYBHi1fizexq9zibK9463CkCj7BCiSq9HsujVhAP8Vem6kgg.png)

</center>
</liketuimages>

那天装满了箱子回家之后，我又去多多买菜买了一堆东西。帅哥说想吃那个圣女果，在沃尔玛那里13.9元900g，我觉得太贵了没有买。

多多买菜那里卖7.9一公斤，我直接毫不犹豫地下单了。我很爱吃豆青，又买了一公斤豆青，还有那个橙子也很便宜，6.99有五六斤，看到皮蛋也很便宜，平均一块钱一个。胡萝卜1块多一斤，也买了一袋。

天气热又想吃开胃菜，又买了一包芋苗酸🤣一下子又花了大几十。

上次叫帅哥买了一瓶耗油，结果去到自提点说不见了，给退款，当时5块钱买的，退了之后再下单就恢复原价10.9元了😭然后含泪又买了一瓶耗油，是那种可以挤出来的，做饭也方便一些。

拼多多逛完之后，小姐妹又给我推荐了沃尔玛的小程序，说可以线上下单，还有优惠活动啥的，我就扫码进去，又加了一个群，跟着指引又下了沃尔玛的app。

打开登录进去，又发现买9块钱的东西可以送一个饮料，0.1元就可以买到，然后刚好又看到了那个4.0的小绿瓶子纯牛奶，我就又决定再买一个酸奶，点了之后发现运费要6块钱，还要打包费。🤣

9.9元买的东西要花差不多18块钱，后面我为了不出运费，又凑单到了29元，就减免运费了，最后一共买了两桶那个1kg的酸奶，两打12杯一打的酸奶。

等我下班之后去自提点拿了多多买菜的拎了一身汗回到家，发现家门口又放了一大袋，那个沃尔玛的也配送到家了。🤣

最近购物真的好疯狂，冰箱已经全部装满了我的零食和菜。

title.title: The fastest humanoid robot in the world.
title.body:
The fastest humanoid robot in the world.


https://cdn.steemitimages.com/DQmYStgvKWxboXakg4NNRTdXQdxnq7kNb8m4MFcbBMWPhJu/image.png
https://cdn.steemitimages.com/DQmcM9vDyChXWWfaBhnqxXD5scZn7pnHcZrWiwyZ8HMwmbX/separador%201.png

> The Chinese Startup presented a new demonstration of its H1 humanoid robot, reaching a speed of up to 10 m per second, which is approximately equivalent to 36 km/h, this number places the robots very close to the speed of a high-level human athlete, something that until recently seemed far away for this type of machines. To put it in perspective, that speed corresponds to a 100m race in about 10 seconds, a performance that almost falls within the range set by Usain Bolt.


The most impressive thing is that this advance did not come from a radical change in the hardware, but mainly from improvements in the software and control systems, the H1 already existed, but now it becomes much more efficient, coordinated and fast, showing that the evolution of robotics is increasingly linked to the intelligence that controls the body and not only in the physical structure of the machine.


With its 62 kg and approximately 80 cm legs, the robot was designed with a focus on dynamic performance, being able to handle rapid movements and maintain stability even at high speeds. This type of control requires an extremely high level of precision because at each step the system needs to adjust balance, force and direction in real time.


https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=zoMDadPQLKA
https://cdn.steemitimages.com/DQmcM9vDyChXWWfaBhnqxXD5scZn7pnHcZrWiwyZ8HMwmbX/separador%201.png

> Any mistake can result in a fall and that makes this achievement even more relevant, if we analyze the recent history, the jump is even more evident, at the beginning of 2024, this same model reached close to 3.3 m/s, now it exceeds 10 m per second, an increase of more than 200% in a short time, this type of evolution shows that the pace of development in humanoid robotics is accelerating significantly, but speed alone is not the final goal, it is a indicator, a sign that these systems are becoming more stable, more efficient, and more capable of operating in real environments.


Because running fast is not just a matter of speed, it is a matter of control, balance and responsiveness and all of these are essential elements so that humanoid robots can perform more complex tasks in the future, but not all evolution is linked to speed because in many scenarios the challenge is not to move faster, but to survive in environments where humans cannot enter.


https://cdn.steemitimages.com/DQmcM9vDyChXWWfaBhnqxXD5scZn7pnHcZrWiwyZ8HMwmbX/separador%201.png

title.title: Animal Haven at Bastian Food Garden
title.body:
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmVwmL3AvsWeHCn5gMcFyLBds9HXQACpoZ4M4eFu6D5fg2/1776926990472.png)

‎Hello Worldmappin Community! ❤️✨
‎
‎Today I want to share our visit to the Bastian Food Garden. 
‎
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYdmfRgaszNtWDS23yLtEnjma5LjTEFLeVV7GPJFs2UzP/1776927046821.jpg)
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmbLKk2sErKEWRK1erxyMCDWnriPLpEmDcUTA8VxHgDpLJ/1776927047056.jpg)
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmdoXCRZrhPRdmAS67hs423C4B7MCL83XfeXcFyiMoVJ8t/1776927047236.jpg)
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmWizhNLa8U9kFTd1jd3CjfrFRoKatB7tYkhrT7LAvrpyM/1776927047398.jpg)

‎We went there around 10:30 in the morning just to eat some snacks.
‎
‎We chose this place because aside from good food, we know they have animals that you can watch after eating. 
‎
‎Since we have kids with us, we knew this would be a place they would surely enjoy.
‎
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZVHVp4kdpFRUhtUwtpVWtXKJ1NPHAn6fAV6RXZFtEAMG/1776927091064.jpg)

‎When we arrived, we were the only customers there! Haha. 
‎
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmUdMSME7vqu9vmokJzcdriqit5AWTjUvUcY3oJ5YwrogM/1776927594481.jpg)
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmRrW3745TkG4sYXLpAAZadkr1eKZJ3LsgochJP7gAVLs9/1776927594763.jpg)
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmRbyp6eg2HR2B9qCdES1Lje3cE8vLrDV9zoFHqCUGttd2/1776927594978.jpg)
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmPacoQ8uJ7jJ8RHSRYKDcekfVtTbqYujSmwPA5AT42iG7/1776927595173.jpg)

‎I don’t know why there was no one else eating, but I can guarantee you that their food is really delicious. 
‎
‎Actually, this place is very special to us. This is actually the venue we chose when we got married! 
‎
‎They have a function hall here where we held our wedding reception, so coming back here brings back good memories.
‎
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmaHastvtTc2aNKPQUgFXExUeStzWxtuVi4dp4xgmjUbvV/1776927675126.jpg)
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmcdooHPBrihvsmSJPsRauCjBGkWwcpJUyKk9foyCHEGQ1/1776927675322.jpg)
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmWTkqHWRBk6RmCmEW8rixi4aoHqiWqT6qXwG7Zcyr1WTR/1776927675572.jpg)
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmPkhVkk6nZgsPcGw6kMvFbABas7cEywGwCD5f6YBWjtSV/1776927675809.jpg)
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmXVDViAfjMcBFfbwwk11PxLXWmpy6gB9H6oGjqrg9Pq9h/1776927676042.jpg)

‎For our meal, we just ordered a medium-sized Lomi. 
‎
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQDprJgT8rTc2LeQEQn1CTnBfJ9N5XkrFAoF7Dp1dVg3Q/1776927711155.jpg)
‎
‎It was just the right amount and enough for the four of us.
‎
‎It was hot, tasty, and really filling.
‎
‎After we finished eating, my son Aiden and I walked around the area, excited to see the animals in their cages. 
‎
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmSiY43b5mUKiogEdjh5LLjexFzCTge2fQdVVRLdFAf6CK/1776927755718.jpg)
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmTsBwBh2iy5EYebp12NibM8X26Y3kZMRjaUMGLFrHjkMF/1776927755899.jpg)
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmUJuzjNbqbGUaC2fN7Lt3Sx2ZoHMXBeACY2VeiLpgySjZ/1776927756115.jpg)
‎
‎I remember that in the past, this place had turtles, ostriches, and many other kinds of animals. But now, it seems they focus more on chickens and birds. 
‎
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmWeu4r56P3geF3bRKW4V7ad3F625pputYZ5wtcxaXsAhr/1776927788853.jpg)
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmVzdSAK5ChzJXtAjSPppEPc8nmXWhjigi1wJ72oSNHjpB/1776927789010.jpg)
‎
‎Those were the only animals we saw during our visit. 
‎
‎There was even a sign about the Philippine crocodile, but we didn't see one. 
‎
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmedHkxrBfVGej7AinyJYSj6kAGu4o5dYqc7PiurUH23wZ/1776927823944.jpg)
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmbmtw8pX5nj8GzCEZXyJh3UD2tX8DYpa3yANApgGWAT4c/1776927824230.jpg)
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmbMmD2FQvhTDRPwynw74WpUp2qDuqfdyAvnd8W6RRCQRN/1776927824487.jpg)
‎
‎Maybe it was hiding underwater? Or maybe it’s not there anymore. I wasn't able to ask anyone around, so we just continued our walk. Haha.
‎
‎Even though there were fewer animals than before, we were still amazed by what we saw. 
‎
‎I discovered that there are so many different kinds of chickens here. 
‎
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmfPFSuJXQaDpaeuecHMLBwuQ5QuxL14zB1FVes19qTSrE/1776927871713.jpg)
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmPSLbPSgbBaED1FRMxyMJQSZMBH5KrafypjXfcLe7Wt4h/1776927871872.jpg)

‎There was this one that looked so cute and fluffy, and also one with really big and thick legs and feet! Haha. 
‎
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmUyFs62pH2wyXauDNYfgbr1wjkaJSfJrRkgQb3ymRkndR/1776931043181.jpg)
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmNUJK9JzdpKjvwPBnnNaaD3fkXw7SHpF3ni5rAhu2nqLs/1776931043389.jpg)
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmaNLugpZKpYuWjaRo6df41Hv75Qaj2LgjD96oNQxYiKdr/1776931043574.jpg)

‎There was also another one that looked like it was wearing a hat with a feather on top of its head. So unique!

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmPphhrbEJeG4XrRaUiRM6ThCMtawtGzpU1scToficpgw9/1776931100570.jpg)
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmf3ymuWy2vgHkjtSoTE8JrdmFzA4HGeWFaBDj5Kre2saT/1776931100813.jpg)
‎
‎We also saw two kinds of eagles: the White-breasted Sea Eagle and the Serpent Eagle. They looked so strong and majestic.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZCVHdLxgycZ9LdjNiyq6c1yzjkk1G4QHGYRjgWoE91MS/1776931170809.jpg)
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmUKj2vDh9cR1YknVCXqPN2mAgyCubDL5neu5M7u41cSUw/1776931171003.jpg)
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmagQotWXjXud3m9BQ83S4AVVXAYRtPvnZYgstgVB8A8oz/1776931171276.jpg)
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmWPv1XrLREVs4VJVS2y42EvHVQnuEYkpufV8nCzkBvjrX/1776931171476.jpg)
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmdntDn5scxcxVstsJSb9BGf8cAtdnm7po4BsBgCMJ5vzu/1776931171702.jpg)

‎But what I enjoyed the most was seeing the Peacocks! 
‎
‎I didn't expect to see them here. There were 4 pairs of them. The first two were already displaying their beautiful, colorful tail feathers. 

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmfE7S1a8RBsMopg25zgfPDtL75XPXpMu8P8ZwjnCmdsuo/1776931334024.jpg)
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmRih4gdhApwcKVJ4LHMytX1RybXwPb6cWBpbeVTyQuf7x/1776931334218.jpg)
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmUopzVU8Q5ftQ6GLj2HkJfCwcvioExpqgSLPbBJUPNVVL/1776931334447.jpg)
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYHzFWffuW5VhXCou9ya3ehwtWASaE9WWFRqxd7fQfJKP/1776931334616.jpg)
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmSDPuFpK22EJubYhgK13Q8Fg5UWCAJEyUuQZbaEYSSybc/1776931334889.jpg)

‎They looked so amazing and proud. 
‎
‎And guess what? There was also a White Peacock! 

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmTQgoDYLHDmnvD1sg9QQeoq1azckWETt3Fct7YvLALd96/1776931427753.jpg)
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmNnXpYaZPi6Tr4objVTxYq98jbyZCEkUS9NxCafdSBFJq/1776931427885.jpg)
‎
‎It was my first time seeing one in person. 
‎
‎I am used to seeing the colorful ones, but this white one looked so pure, clean, and innocent. Hihi. 
‎
‎The fourth one was just calm and didn't open its feathers, but it was still nice to see.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmRcknQ7ZitW5GRkdWJ9EQB39rESanLNAxj5AW2x3EEuws/1776931500182.jpg)

‎Before we left, we saw these two peacocks acting like they were fighting or competing with each other. 
‎
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmPzKVU4RFL8zqeNd9CG2R2jqeEfdTj7fpxeN7TwV5nBRg/1776931522563.jpg)

‎It was funny because they looked the same, like they were looking in a mirror! Haha.
‎
‎There is also a playground here that kids will surely love, but because the weather was so hot, nobody wanted to play there. It was really burning hot!
‎
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmNLo5JNuixH1YSdSfEp65vxeGs2gqWKEhCgNuq6iN6suD/1776931550900.jpg)
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmcpFLPH31MvFh1oyioEYyAHkMwDiyXinczaajRfoom6y8/1776931551137.jpg)

‎Overall, it was a nice and simple experience at the Bastian Food Garden. Good food and nice animals to see. 

Hope you enjoyed our virtual tour!
‎
‎Until our next family bonding...
‎
‎**Thanks for the visit! Have a lovely day. Buh-bye. 💗🌸**
‎
‎*All images used in this post are my own unless stated otherwise.*

title.title: A Colorful Bloom Under the Sun
title.body: >Living here in Malaybalay City, I’ve always appreciated how nature adapts to the changing seasons. Now that summer has arrived, the heat is intense, and rain has become scarce. Yet, despite the dryness, something beautiful continues to thrive—Bougainvillea. When I visited my mother’s house recently, I was welcomed by a burst of colors from these vibrant plants. It’s amazing how Bougainvillea blooms even under the scorching heat of the sun. While most plants struggle during dry days, this one seems to shine even brighter. What many people think are flowers are actually bracts—thin, paper-like leaves that come in stunning shades of white, red, orange, and pink. The true flowers are those tiny white centers hidden inside. This unique feature makes Bougainvillea stand out in any garden. Using my Nikon D3100, I captured a few moments of these beautiful blooms. Each shot reflects not just the plant’s beauty, but also its resilience. From soft white bracts in pots to bold red and orange clusters spreading across branches, every angle tells a story of life flourishing in harsh conditions.There’s something inspiring about seeing these flowers bloom without much water. It reminds me that sometimes, growth doesn’t require perfect conditions—just the strength to adapt and continue. As the sun continues to shine over Malaybalay, these Bougainvilleas stand as a symbol of endurance and natural beauty. Truly, even in the hottest days, life finds a way to bloom. ![NIKON D3100.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dondononardem/EpzzcqxHbNbvKRWPcZiE8vbUscWmUT2d3jvgrDnHk1KF6p7LjdKbZRpy4wg6gevjanZ.png)

title.body:

<hr>

![1000417711.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mirel0510/2423zKU7EBNRiuKn89j7qK3CLy9F1fS5Mfu7BJniDACM46PuV8uo3i4hbpUidMkjwLs4e.jpg)

![1000417712.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mirel0510/2432Q8QCnDYB6GQwyCkNTxJqimrhCSd7APZ5yxicubikjcBXBD9fYRzApcTissk1QWcxU.jpg)

A veces los cambios de planes resultan mejor que el plan original y eso nos pasó en nuestra última salida familiar. Ese día le dije a mi esposo que quería ir a una caminata familiar para celebrar el día mundial de concienciación sobre el autismo, durante el mes de Abril se hacen actividades para las familias azules y yo quería asistir a esta porque nos quedaba cerca. 

Mientras nos alistamos para salir nos dimos cuenta que la hora pautada para la caminata era muy temprano y el sol estaba en todo su esplendor, justo estás semanas el calor ha estado tan intenso que decidimos mejor cambiar la salida para un día de cine, créanme que mi emoción fué enorme pues es uno de mis planes favoritos, disfruto demasiado de ir a una sala de cine y aún más si voy con mi hijo pues no solemos llevarlo mucho, de hecho está fue su segunda vez y lo mejor de todo es que pudimos disfrutar de la segunda película de Mario Bros.

Todo resultó favorable pues el cine quedaba en el mismo centro comercial del punto de encuentro de la caminata y nos quedaba lejos y al menos pudimos disfrutar un poquito de la actividad, lo mejor de todos es tanto mi hijo como nosotros tuvimos un día muy divertido y la cara de felicidad mi príncipe no tiene precio.

Aún queda una actividad más por el mes dedicado a la concienciación del autismo así que en esta oportunidad si quiero asistir y contarles como nos fue.  Gracias por llegar hasta aquí, nos vemos pronto ☺️

<div class=\

> Sometimes changes of plans turn out better than the original plan, and that’s exactly what happened on our last family outing. That day, I told my husband I wanted to go on a family walk to celebrate World Autism Awareness Day. Throughout April, there are activities for “blue families,” and I wanted to attend this one because it was close to where we live. As we were getting ready to leave, we realized that the scheduled time for the walk was very early and the sun was already blazing. The heat has been so intense these past few weeks that we decided it would be better to change our plans to a day at the movies. Believe me, I was thrilled because it’s one of my favorite things to do. I really enjoy going to the movies, and even more so when I go with my son since we don’t usually take him very often. in fact, this was his second time, and best of all, we got to enjoy the second Mario Bros. movie. Everything worked out well because the movie theater was in the same shopping mall as the walk’s meeting point—it wasn’t too far for us—and at least we were able to enjoy a little bit of the activity. Best of all, both my son and we had a really fun day, and the look of happiness on my little prince’s face was priceless. There’s still one more activity left for Autism Awareness Month, so this time I do want to attend and tell you all how it went. Thanks for reading this far—see you soon ☺️

title.title: Memories of my school life as a student!!
title.body:
Greetings students. How are you? Today I want to write a post for you about school memories. Currently you are students and at one time I was also a student. I enjoyed school life very much while I was a student. 

Everyone has some school memories in their student life. So today I want to share a story with you about the best school memories.


https://img.leopedia.io/DQmUixzh2q4XFxTnBYx1ACtAbiuHatjT2AMNRULQ6FvsCLZ/pexels-niloy007-28856897.jpg 


[Source](https://www.pexels.com/photo/joyful-school-boys-posing-with-bicycle-outdoors-28856897/)


Basically, my school memories were a little different. When I first enrolled in school and started going to school, I enjoyed going to school a lot more. Because at that time, I made new friends and played sports with my friends at school. Playing sports at school was a lot of fun. 

However, before that, when I started going to school, I used to take my bicycle to school. When I went to school with my bicycle, I would lock my bicycle in the bicycle garage. I would lock the bicycle very neatly and using a bicycle locker, we friends would lock about three to seven bicycles together. It was a really happy day and when the bicycles were locked, we would reach school with our school bags and cars.


 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmbRELPHu5CVkgb8TNP1atxeqKyahctHzoBhkuaPDPL7g1/pexels-srijit-mudi-31301853-36560484.jpg 


[Source](https://www.pexels.com/photo/black-and-white-portrait-of-schoolchildren-in-line-36560484/)



I remember one thing very clearly. When I used to reach school and after a while we were asked to sing the national anthem. Then all of us students, teachers and other assistant teachers used to stand in a row. After standing in a row, we all tried to sing the national anthem together. 

I especially liked one thing. When I was in the second grade, the teacher invited me to sing the national anthem. Then I stood in front of everyone and started singing the national anthem with two of my friends. For the first few days, I was very scared of singing the national anthem and my heart was pounding. However, later when I started singing the national anthem, all my fear went away. However, I used to forget the lines of the national anthem sometimes. When I forgot the lines, the teacher would point out my mistakes and I would correct the mistakes and start the national anthem again.


 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmcrZSKRitnoCRVPcNUr21bifABVzvQ9vvkNwPbtrmDArZ/pexels-srijit-mudi-31301853-36560464.jpg 


[Source](https://www.pexels.com/photo/children-playing-on-a-slide-in-black-and-white-36560464/)



Just as I was interested in studies in school, my interest in other subjects like sports was intense. I used to play sports all the time and through sports, I developed a good relationship with my friends. 

When I crossed class 2 and then my friends started increasing. As the days went by, the number of friends increased. 

After a class in school, when the teacher was not present in the classroom, we started playing sports with our friends. There are various types of sports equipment in our school campus. We used to play very well using all those sports equipment. Especially there was a swing system in the school yard. We used to skip classes and go to the swing and play and we liked it a lot. 

I liked playing football with my friends the most. We both girls and boys used to play football together. One day I played football with many girl friends and they could not catch me. Finally, they forcibly took that football away from me and I still feel very happy when I remember that day. 

 However, finally, when I was sharing the wonderful stories of school life, I went back to school life. I am happy to share the wonderful stories of school life with you. Did you also play with friends in your childhood like me? If you have any school life stories with childhood memories, then definitely don't forget to write to us. Thank you very much for being with the education community. Thank you very much for reading my story today.


|![6C2W1azD1rBs8i8QXbP2Ja5uHwpQX53BQMq7j8X23t5MDAePfynV2og.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmfMGEWgLGsy8JijqGo72yDUomtkctj4hXuoaMv9Mg3aLt/6C2W1azD1rBs8i8QXbP2Ja5uHwpQX53BQMq7j8X23t5MDAePfynV2og.png)|![2k7TU6R7D8hFGyjkSsQhgsENDTXpozuXV85wts44LCsny2SjDmAPMk6AYe.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmQaqiJExmoBgHb71wqsYvbCXPGb1wzM84srK1SLNAPwFo/2k7TU6R7D8hFGyjkSsQhgsENDTXpozuXV85wts44LCsny2SjDmAPMk6AYe.png)|![8hHVpauQQYxe1XRgmBVcaxhzdz742SbSsPzbrg3TfXoaN9BCyG67Nbyr4QW.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmQJLxGFrYHR91PqvpGfgDS6Rb9hHXZeACAVCP9Pi5VvAY/8hHVpauQQYxe1XRgmBVcaxhzdz742SbSsPzbrg3TfXoaN9BCyG67Nbyr4QW.png)|![2k7TU6R7D8hFGyjkSsQhgsENDTXpoyvbsCdLfHGADR73Y3m17emRZpz83Y.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmUF8MENNGVUUMeBsoxZz2Pt3PNC4PEVvzT7Fvycz3k73J/2k7TU6R7D8hFGyjkSsQhgsENDTXpoyvbsCdLfHGADR73Y3m17emRZpz83Y.png)|

title.title: Deliciosas galletas de Cambur y chispas de chocolate🥰
title.body:
> 


![Lomo de Res con papa (8).png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/milagrosmhbl/AKAp9eWHdgckGskjj5p2hW7cYeXEwU3d9aXkQLDNVyQ4fe2KYtAZWc5iyJru2D9.png)

​Hola, hola mis comelones de @hivefood. Espero estén genial. Hoy les quiero mostrar cómo salvé la merienda de mis pequeños en pocos minutos y, lo mejor de todo, con una opción más saludable. Por supuesto, no podía dejar de compartirles la receta de estas deliciosas galletas 🥰, así que aquí les voy 👇.
​
> Hello, hello my fellow foodies at @hivefood! I hope you're doing great. Today I want to show you how I saved my little ones' snack time in just a few minutes and, best of all, with a healthier option. Of course, I couldn't miss the chance to share the recipe for these delicious cookies with you 🥰, so here we go 👇.

​INGREDIENTES / INGREDIENTS:
​✔️ 2 Cambures maduros / 2 Ripe bananas
​✔️ 1 Huevo / 1 Egg
​✔️ 1 cucharada de Miel / 1 tablespoon of Honey
​✔️ Polvo de hornear / Baking powder
​✔️ 1/2 Taza de harina de trigo / 1/2 Cup of wheat flour
​✔️ Vainilla / Vanilla
​✔️ Lluvia de chocolate / Chocolate sprinkles


![IMG_20260423_201132_742.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/milagrosmhbl/EpLfWHkyCJCBL5wZ4Wd2AKvhR5nHezEmbn5VAiNdq1S2KYZfqKVyJYFvPs3fPBG7rSC.jpg)

​Okey, vamos a comenzar pelando y machacando los dos cambures (o bananas, como lo conocen en otros países).
​
> Okay, let's start by peeling and mashing the two bananas.


![IMG_20260423_201236_211.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/milagrosmhbl/23vi5t4jDbrkmSvQA1cZ3g6xenwHy1Pcvra3K6AgSGvapCp1b5fXrCDVwM6CBLwQibtyM.jpg)

​El siguiente paso es agregar el huevo, la vainilla y el polvo de hornear para integrarlo todo.
​
> The next step is to add the egg, vanilla, and baking powder to integrate everything.


![IMG_20260423_201314_417.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/milagrosmhbl/23vi47GyYemFCaBTRyPFoUFBTuevMaCPzZNoUj5ET13w2gRxGEa458pX8wnf87PLSreib.jpg)

​El paso final es agregar la harina. Yo pretendía poner una taza completa, pero me di cuenta de que con solo media era suficiente; luego le agregué la miel.
​
> The final step is adding the flour. I intended to use a full cup, but I realized that half a cup was enough; then I added the honey.

![IMG_20260423_201351_433.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/milagrosmhbl/EorzpanyRgSz6sqxu6tkaEu3cig4SqZv3DDgepFd8va8haQi23a2JFshh2CDQTckemZ.jpg)

![IMG_20260423_201537_300.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/milagrosmhbl/23w2sLXxjvGFPSpzKNX8PZtp5Y9zhZgswYodJ44JW1vnSxKByct3Y7CaN4jrexuVFbXuA.jpg)



​Al tener la mezcla lista, el último ingrediente es la lluvia de chocolate (unas dos cucharadas aproximadamente) y mezclamos todo.

> ​Once the mixture is ready, the last ingredient is the chocolate sprinkles (about two tablespoons), and then we mix it all together.


![IMG_20260423_201721_920.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/milagrosmhbl/242Nqe37UjuK92v568HoUZDRJL7q8FTTZiGSquFHzLcFMRbhHcN1L4ahzdC8MbbywKeeY.jpg)

​Luego, agregamos porciones medianas a nuestra bandeja previamente engrasada y enharinada para llevarla al horno por 15 minutos a 180°C.
​
> Then, we place medium-sized portions on our previously greased and floured tray and bake for 15 minutes at 180°C.


![IMG_20260423_201946_153.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/milagrosmhbl/23wC9LnbTb93AeQ4qogQ9gSmuAmehk5YSEqiEsfQNsPBXrHEmcbUyGL7zigKGovMKGtyW.jpg)

​Pasado el tiempo, quedaron estas lindas y deliciosas galleticas que además tienen un olor DELICIOSO 🤤🤤🥰, ¡así que no dejen de hacerlas! 🥰
​
> When the time was up, I had these cute and delicious cookies that also smell AMAZING 🤤🤤🥰, so make sure to try them! 🥰


![IMG_20260423_204038_085.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/milagrosmhbl/EoAbiHAxqFr6L998ihozGZyJtWHfJZWfjZsanpQqKPSdnKLZJi4sqGjS5BQwdrbiHbP.jpg)

![IMG_20260423_204141_268.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/milagrosmhbl/23vi3hCGP57Yc8KSJczfxDmpTbn72cpQ64dbFpwYrMUHoiN1VCUGNWizzrqksUXHKih1F.jpg)

![IMG_20260423_204130_072.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/milagrosmhbl/23ynZ2XyXqk2BLxjAXkGpmfAzDWBF4yo6SyPbFoWus72dwh5LjwHBkxcMdP3xF9jCr3LA.jpg)

title.title: 伊朗上空的孤勇者
title.body: 時間回到一個多星期前，我們辦公室幾個同事聊到航班的問題，那時候剛好各大航空公司開始加燃油費，而我的一位同事出發西班牙在即，她本來是在杜拜轉機的，因為便宜一點，現在倒好，她不敢在杜拜停了，改了直飛，結果更貴。 我們談到直飛的航線是怎樣的，原來現在的航班都是穿過高加索或是阿拉伯半島進入歐洲，完美避開伊朗及伊拉克一帶，為了更形象化，我立即打開了一個即時航線網站看看，大約就是這樣：
/> 看，西奈半島的飛機密密麻麻的像排隊一樣，然而中間的伊朗及伊拉克幾乎中空，哎？等一下﹗這個時候，我發現了一架飛機正在伊朗的東南面，機頭直插伊朗中心，那麼大膽的嗎？就只有你敢在伊朗上空﹗我當然要查一查是誰︰
/> 這是一班北歐大西洋航空由新德里開出往倫敦的航班，但機師卻不知為何那麼大膽直插伊朗上空，難道他老婆要生孩子了？難道他媽進了醫院？還是他看不開想挑戰命運？實在是不得而知，但我肯定他這一路肯定很順暢，不會堵飛機。 由於第二天我又坐飛機了就沒有再關注這航班，反正沒有新聞就代表沒事吧，再事後，我找回這航班的飛行路線，卻發現不一樣了。

/>

怎麼回事？路線不一樣了？沒有經過伊朗了？難道當中有不可為平民所知的大秘密，卻被我無聊發現？順帶一提，這路線的白色部分代表「ESTIMATED」，那就是說從印度洋一直到地中海的那一段都只是預計航線啊。那實在是太有趣了，到底當中發生了什麼？

有沒有熟識航班的朋友能解答一二？

title.title: CREO EN LA REENCARNACIÓN/CONTENIDO ORIGINAL/@jpulido0306
title.body:
<center>
![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmVanfy2otG6VwcCEwsoR15ahcyHHTyp1vLnDVLCRV22ac/image.png)
[fuente](https://sobreleyendas.com/2022/04/02/el-sentido-de-la-reencarnacion/)

#

CREO EN LA REENCARNACIÓN

No hay que temer
todos somos parte
de un entarimado
donde la vida
puede costar mucho
o casi nada.

Lo bueno es que
si mil veces desencarnamos
mil veces encarnamos
para seguir buscando
la luz perpetua
que siempre está allí
esperando por nosotros.

Vivamos y aprendamos
a lidiar con lo que sea
porque la muerte no existe
solo la vida eterna
y continuada.

No creo
estoy convencido
en que la reencarnación
es el proceso espiritual
que nos lleva
a otros mundos
en nuestros sueños.

#

![CartoonMe_1653188958906[1].jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmcRWoRX3hE13wRd13QnrttNpkW3XcXaGdrLDSbL9b5254/CartoonMe_1653188958906[1].jpg)

#

I BELIEVE IN REINCARNATION

There's no need to fear; we are all part of a stage
where life
can cost a great deal
or almost nothing.

The good thing is that
if we die a thousand times, we will be reborn a thousand times
to continue searching for
the perpetual light
that is always there
waiting for us.

Let's live and learn
to deal with whatever comes
because death doesn't exist, only eternal
and continuous life.

I don't just believe, I'm convinced
that reincarnation
is the spiritual process
that takes us
to other worlds
in our dreams.
