title.title: Coffee Talk, a visual novel you must play if you want to spend some time in peace and quiet.
title.body:
https://shared.fastly.steamstatic.com/store_item_assets/steam/apps/914800/ss_fb39356fdb31c360f81598801f6398fcf83a6324.1920x1080.jpg?t=1768503373 [_Cover Image_](https://store.steampowered.com/app/914800/Coffee_Talk/?l=spanish)
VERSIÓN EN ESPAÑOL (click aquí)

Buenos días, buenas tardes o buenas noches, damas y caballeros. ¿Cómo están? ¿Cómo se encuentran el día de hoy? Espero que muy bien. Yo sigo acá, andando sin rumbo por la vida, con mucho sueño todos los días, ¿a qué se debe tanto sueño? No lo sé, simplemente me siento cansado. Igualmente eso no me impide en mis tiempos libres disfrutar de algunos videojuegos, más aún cuando la situación me fuerza a jugar, ya saben, esos momentos donde se te va la luz por 4 horas y no tienes nada que hacer, simplemente matar el rato con cualquier cosa hasta que vuelva. En varias de esas ocasiones me tocó jugar un juego que me llamó la atención principalmente por su estilo visual, donde nos encontramos con un pixel art bastante hermoso en todos los aspectos, yo hasta lo definiría como un total disfrute. Además de que también era una novela visual, lo cual era perfecto para relajarme en una situación donde pasaría más estrés que otra cosa, ya que es uno de mis géneros favoritos de videojuegos. Aunque sinceramente lo que más me hizo jugarlo es que se me hizo bastante similar a un clásico indie llamado Valhalla, sí, aquella novela visual cyberpunk acerca de atender un bar y hacer bebidas mientras hablas con la gente, la única gran diferencia es que acá, tal como el nombre del juego indica, llevaremos un café y prepararemos café a los clientes, lo más chistoso es que en algún punto hacen una referencia al juego del bar, no hay que ser muy avispado para notarla pero bueno, sin más dilación, hablemos un poco acerca de Coffee Talk.

Good morning, good afternoon, or good evening, ladies and gentlemen. How are you? How are you getting on today? I hope very well. I'm still here, wandering aimlessly through life, feeling very sleepy every day. What’s the reason for all this sleepiness? I don’t know, I just feel tired. Even so, that doesn’t stop me from enjoying some video games in my free time, even more so when the situation forces me to play, you know, those moments when the power goes out for four hours and you’ve got nothing to do, just killing time with whatever until it comes back. On several of those occasions I ended up playing a game that caught my attention mainly because of its visual style, where we come across some rather beautiful pixel art in every respect; I’d even describe it as a total delight. Besides, it was also a visual novel, which was perfect for relaxing in a situation where I would be under more stress than anything else, since it’s one of my favourite video game genres. Though, honestly, what most made me play it is that it seemed quite similar to a classic indie game called Valhalla — yes, that cyberpunk visual novel about running a bar and making drinks while chatting to people. The only big difference is that here, just as the name of the game suggests, we’ll be running a café and preparing coffee for the customers. The funniest thing is that at some point they make a reference to the bar game; you don’t have to be particularly sharp to spot it, but anyway, without further ado, let’s talk a bit about Coffee Talk.

https://shared.fastly.steamstatic.com/store_item_assets/steam/apps/914800/ss_c4253cfc283c92b932286b187ab342e4580bb055.1920x1080.jpg?t=1768503373 [_Source_](https://store.steampowered.com/app/914800/Coffee_Talk/?l=spanish)
VERSIÓN EN ESPAÑOL (click aquí)

La historia nos pone en la piel de nosotros mismos, llevamos un café en una ciudad distópica futurista donde los humanos conviven con una gran diversidad de especies, ya sean mitológicas o extraterrestres. El juego comienza con nuestra fiel cliente y amiga Freya, la cual es una periodista que se la pasa en nuestro café para recibir la suficiente inspiración para contar historias en su segmento del periódico, aunque ella quiere hacer algo más grande, una novela que la haga reconocida y salir hacia adelante con su futuro. Todo lo que viviremos a continuación en nuestro café es con el objetivo de que Freya tenga éxito con su libro, por lo cual seremos testigos de una gran serie de dramas y anécdotas bastante interesantes para ella y nosotros como baristas. No tendremos que hacer mucho, más que nada, dejar que las cosas fluyan y servir el café que nos pidan, que creo que es donde se encuentra la tarea difícil. Muy diferente a Valhalla, acá no tendremos una lista de tragos que nos sirvan como guía para preparar, en Coffee Talk, nosotros mismos deberemos descifrar cómo se preparan los cafés para poder tener éxito y avanzar de buena manera con la historia. Ya saben cómo es esto, si sirves todos los cafés que corresponden para la ocasión, tendrás el final verdadero. Y ya, no hay mucho más, busca tus papitas y relájate en este pequeño viaje que podrás terminar en unas horitas.

The story puts us in our own shoes — we run a café in a futuristic dystopian city where humans coexist with a huge diversity of species, be they mythological or extraterrestrial. The game begins with our loyal customer and friend Freya, a journalist who spends her time in our café looking for enough inspiration to tell stories in her newspaper column, although she wants to do something bigger: a novel that will make her well known and help her get ahead in life. Everything we go on to experience in our café is aimed at Freya succeeding with her book, which means we’ll witness quite a series of dramas and anecdotes that are rather interesting both for her and for us as baristas. We won’t have to do much — mostly just let things flow and serve the coffee we’re asked for, which I think is where the tricky task lies. Quite unlike Valhalla, here we won’t have a list of drinks to act as a guide for preparation. In Coffee Talk, we’ll have to figure out for ourselves how to make the coffees in order to succeed and make good progress through the story. You know how it goes: if you serve all the right coffees for each occasion, you’ll get the true ending. And that’s it, there’s not much more to it — grab your crisps, sit back and relax on this little journey you’ll be able to finish in just a few hours.

https://shared.fastly.steamstatic.com/store_item_assets/steam/apps/914800/ss_ec29b075105ed4b4432c8f97fba8d695b4aa00a9.1920x1080.jpg?t=1768503373 [_Source_](https://store.steampowered.com/app/914800/Coffee_Talk/?l=spanish)
VERSIÓN EN ESPAÑOL (click aquí)

No puedo decir mucho más al respecto, quizás unas pequeñas quejas donde es imposible adivinar la combinación de ingredientes para preparar el café que pide el cliente o que hay algunas mecánicas desaprovechadas como la de hacer dibujitos en el café. Eso puede ser lo único \

, pero el juego cumple con todo su objetivo de ser totalmente relajante y transmitir una vibra de tranquilidad, nada mejor que pasar la noche escuchando historias de desconocidos que próximamente serán amigos. Por cierto, el final de este juego es bastante, podríamos decir, \

, hay una especie de plot twist que sinceramente no te vas a esperar por nada del mundo, te deja fuera de base totalmente. Me quedé con ganas de mucho más y le tomé bastante cariño a los personajes, por ahí vi que hay una secuela, solo espero que ellos vuelvan a aparecer por lo menos como cameos. Si quieres una novela visual corta y pasar un tiempo de chill, esto sin dudas es para ti o quizás hasta sirve para que te adentres en el mundo de las novelas visuales, quién sabe, hay muy buenas historias por explorar en este género de videojuegos, fácilmente puedes encontrar algo ideal para ti. Sin más nada que añadir, me despido por el día de hoy.

I can't say much more about it, perhaps just a few small gripes — like it being impossible to guess the right combination of ingredients to make the coffee the customer asks for, or that there are some underused mechanics, such as making little drawings in the coffee. That might be the only \

thing, but the game fully achieves its aim of being completely relaxing and giving off a vibe of calmness. There's nothing better than spending the night listening to stories from strangers who will soon become friends. By the way, the ending of this game is rather \

, shall we say. There's a sort of plot twist that, honestly, you won't see coming for the world — it completely throws you off base. I was left wanting much more and I grew quite fond of the characters. I saw somewhere that there's a sequel; I just hope they show up again, at least as cameos. If you're after a short visual novel and fancy some chill time, this is undoubtedly for you, or perhaps it might even help you dip your toes into the world of visual novels — who knows? There are some really good stories to be explored in this video game genre, and you can easily find something that's just right for you. With nothing more to add, I'll say goodbye for today.

___
Traducido con DeepSeek / Translated with DeepSeek

title.title: ​¿Hablan lo mismo? Mi voz y mi cuerpo ante el desafío del NO [esp-eng]
title.body:
​
<center>![1000024549.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/issymarie2/23tHbYLE2fe5686kmpVNpjMMupwfUeFdQaaeoMnrahUC2fQttVjSRAgcdvjtWtGrzSxU8.jpg)</center>

Muchas veces la sincronía de las ideas aparece, y aquello que rondaba nuestra cabeza ve la luz en otro lado. Siento que, hoy en día, el respeto ha vuelto a emerger y se está dando a conocer mediante letras diversas, en estilos variados, pero con el mismo propósito.

​El amigo y Dr. @emiliorios publicó recientemente un trabajo reflexivo en el que alude al tema de la comunicación asertiva, titulado: [Reflexiones desde el respeto](https://peakd.com/hive-131951/@emiliorios/con-limites-y-con-las-cosas-claras-relacionarse-en-forma-armoniosa-y-responsable-reflexiones-desde-el-respeto-esen). Nada es más real que el respeto como unión de todo lo que está bien en un mundo que busca estar mal.

​Como le expresé en un comentario en su publicación:

***​“Hay una frase muy cierta: ‘el bueno se vuelve malo cuando comienza a decir que NO’. Esa es una verdad cruda y dolorosa, porque el acto de poner límites suele ser, precisamente, el punto que inicia los conflictos. Como usted expresa, tiene mucho que ver la manera en que emitimos el mensaje de forma verbal, pero a eso debemos incorporar el lenguaje corporal; debemos ser conscientes de que el cuerpo también habla, sobre todo nuestra cara. Sin duda, es un tema personal: reconocer si realmente somos asertivos o si lo que decimos se distorsiona con nuestros gestos”.***

<center>![1000024550.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/issymarie2/23xVPfRYZZDwiJTnSPCPzVfuMTmcMEAUthTPRwuChapbjDbYwhC2MzzVqwyfCs65KQMqG.png)</center> 

​Desde hace mucho tiempo, siento que el cuerpo funciona en dos polaridades distintas. Por ejemplo: cuando estamos ante eventos dolorosos, muchos tienden a expresar verbalmente una palabra de apoyo mientras sus ojos y labios sonríen. Es como si ambas partes pensaran y actuaran por separado.
​Ante este punto, podemos analizar los siguientes factores para encontrar una hipótesis real sobre lo que puede estar sucediendo:


<center>![1000024551.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/issymarie2/23xp8qKKk19nTw58S3DVNm7TcZZzBpCwh5gVyiyLispZhpNG1WjZjaPFraLJJBVN4YEVG.png)</center> 

-**​Mecanismo de defensa**: En ocasiones, el cerebro intenta calmar la tensión del momento; por ello, mediante un acto cotidiano, envía un mensaje contradictorio como la “sonrisa nerviosa”, la cual confunde al interlocutor.

-**​Máscara social**: La sociedad, mediante su inescrupuloso bombardeo de “rectitud”, nos ha inculcado a la fuerza que debemos ser “agradables” en cada instancia, sin diferenciar el escenario en el que estemos. Debido a esto, nuestro cuerpo actúa por reflejo, provocando que el acto en sí no encaje con el momento que se vive.

​-**Desalineación emocional**: El cuerpo actúa de forma distinta a lo que la mente intenta comunicar. Pareciera que ambos mensajes llegan por separado a distintas partes del cuerpo; el mensaje final carece de sincronía, y el receptor terminará poniendo más atención al lenguaje no verbal, provocando molestias y hasta enemistades.
***
Demasiadas veces, como sociedad, nos hemos visto expuestos a estos paradigmas. Decir que NO es un acto de valentía, amor y respeto hacia uno mismo, pero dicho acto es mal visto por quienes se han acostumbrado a recibir nuestro \
suele darse bajo presión psicológica y moral; caemos en una burbuja con la etiqueta de \
, y es ahí donde el respeto pareciera haberse alejado kilómetros hacia la ciudad del \

.\n\n​Sin embargo, no debemos caer en una sola cara de la moneda. Una cosa es quien ayuda y otra quien recibe la ayuda, pero ¿qué sucede ante aquella persona que busca ayudar sin que hayamos solicitado su intervención? Esta pregunta guarda una realidad que muchos pasamos por alto: el terreno de las personas \

.\n\n​La pieza clave que une estas dos caras de la moneda es el mismo NO. Porque así como uno debe ser valiente para decir que no quiere, no puede o no tiene tiempo para ayudar, también puede expresar ese mismo \

para rechazar una ayuda no solicitada, entendiendo que el aprendizaje derivado de enfrentar una tarea por cuenta propia será, a largo plazo, mucho más beneficioso para nuestro futuro.\n***\nNo obstante, existe una conexión mucho más poderosa donde entra nuevamente el \

. Para emitir un mensaje correctamente y que el receptor lo comprenda, debemos ser claros al hablar y coherentes con nuestras reacciones corporales.

<center>![1000024552.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/issymarie2/23xKzMZhv2qtBLz5kSQP7DTz5j7fV1q4dBZe28MtWhYXNEbenqm6okzfRgrwQMsNtpK8X.png)</center> 

​Si digo: \

con la voz, pero mis ojos reflejan lágrimas, el receptor sentirá que estoy mintiendo para no cargarle mis problemas y terminará ayudando de todos modos. Por el contrario, si digo que no puedo ayudar porque no tengo tiempo, mientras mis labios esbozan una sutil sonrisa, el receptor sentirá que estoy siendo sarcástica o burlona.

​Lamentablemente, este tipo de comunicación asertiva es cada vez menos visible, ya que los mensajes verbales que solemos expresar suelen saltar de un punto a otro, sin que seamos conscientes del verdadero motivo de nuestra disonancia.
***
Para finalizar: respetar nuestros tiempos y espacios mediante un NO concreto es la base; pero si nuestras palabras emergen de forma difusa, contradictoria, sarcástica o burlesca, estas no tendrán el propósito que teníamos en mente. Quizás solo hace falta ser más conscientes de lo que queremos expresar. Ante este acto de incongruencias verbales, siento que el uso indebido de internet provoca un retroceso en los seres humanos, donde muchos prefieren comunicarse solo por mensajes, dejando de lado la voz que nos ha acompañado desde que llegamos a este mundo.
***
### <center>English</center>
***
<center>![1000024549.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/issymarie2/23tHbYLE2fe5686kmpVNpjMMupwfUeFdQaaeoMnrahUC2fQttVjSRAgcdvjtWtGrzSxU8.jpg)</center>

It often happens that ideas come together, and what was on our minds sees the light of day elsewhere. I feel that, these days, respect has re-emerged and is making itself known through diverse writings, in varied styles, yet with the same purpose.

My friend and Dr @emiliorios recently published a reflective piece in which he addresses the topic of assertive communication, entitled: [Reflections from a place of respect](https://peakd.com/hive-131951/@emiliorios/con-limites-y-con-las-cosas-claras-relacionarse-en-forma-armoniosa-y-responsable-reflexiones-desde-el-respeto-esen). Nothing is more real than respect as the unifying force of all that is right in a world that seeks to be wrong.

​As I mentioned in a comment on your post:

***​“There is a very true saying: ‘the good person becomes bad when they start saying NO’. That is a harsh and painful truth, because the act of setting boundaries is often, precisely, the point that triggers conflicts. As you say, the way we convey the message verbally plays a major role, but we must also factor in body language; we must be aware that the body speaks too, especially our face. It is undoubtedly a personal matter: recognising whether we are truly assertive or whether what we say is distorted by our gestures.”***

<center>![1000024550.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/issymarie2/23xVPfRYZZDwiJTnSPCPzVfuMTmcMEAUthTPRwuChapbjDbYwhC2MzzVqwyfCs65KQMqG.png)</center> 

​For a long time, I have felt that the body operates along two distinct polarities. For example: when faced with painful events, many people tend to verbally express a word of support whilst their eyes and lips smile. It is as if both parts were thinking and acting separately.
​In light of this, we can analyse the following factors to form a realistic hypothesis about what might be happening:


<center>![1000024551.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/issymarie2/23xp8qKKk19nTw58S3DVNm7TcZZzBpCwh5gVyiyLispZhpNG1WjZjaPFraLJJBVN4YEVG.png)</center> 

-**​Defence mechanism**: Sometimes, the brain tries to ease the tension of the moment; therefore, through an everyday gesture, it sends a contradictory message such as a ‘nervous smile’, which confuses the person we are speaking to.

-**Social mask**: Society, through its relentless bombardment of ‘correctness’, has forcibly instilled in us the idea that we must be ‘pleasant’ at all times, regardless of the situation we find ourselves in. Because of this, our body reacts reflexively, causing the action itself to feel out of place with the moment we are experiencing.

​-**Emotional misalignment**: The body acts differently from what the mind is trying to communicate. It seems as though both messages reach different parts of the body separately; the final message lacks synchrony, and the recipient will end up paying more attention to non-verbal language, causing discomfort and even animosity.
***
All too often, as a society, we have been subjected to these patterns. Saying NO is an act of courage, love and self-respect, yet such an act is frowned upon by those who have grown accustomed to receiving our ‘service’. Sadly, this habit of ‘excessive help’ often arises under psychological and moral pressure; we find ourselves trapped in a bubble labelled ‘helpful or good person’, and that is where respect seems to have drifted miles away towards the city of ‘24/7 service’.

However, we must not focus on just one side of the coin. It is one thing to be the helper and another to be the recipient of help, but what happens when faced with someone who seeks to help without us having asked for their intervention? This question reveals a reality that many of us overlook: the realm of ‘meddlers’.

The key element that links these two sides of the coin is the very word ‘NO’. For just as one must be brave enough to say that one does not want to, cannot, or does not have time to help, one can also express that same ‘no’ to reject unsolicited help, understanding that the learning gained from tackling a task on one’s own will, in the long run, be far more beneficial for our future.
***
However, there is a much more powerful connection where the ‘assertive message’ comes into play once again. To convey a message correctly and ensure the recipient understands it, we must speak clearly and ensure our body language is consistent.

<center>![1000024552.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/issymarie2/23xKzMZhv2qtBLz5kSQP7DTz5j7fV1q4dBZe28MtWhYXNEbenqm6okzfRgrwQMsNtpK8X.png)</center>  

If I say, “I don’t need help” out loud, but my eyes are filled with tears, the listener will feel that I am lying so as not to burden them with my problems and will end up helping anyway. Conversely, if I say I cannot help because I don’t have time, whilst my lips form a subtle smile, the listener will feel that I am being sarcastic or mocking.

​Unfortunately, this type of assertive communication is becoming increasingly rare, as the verbal messages we tend to express often jump from one point to another, without us being aware of the true reason for our inconsistency.
***
To conclude: respecting our own time and space through a clear ‘NO’ is the foundation; but if our words come across as vague, contradictory, sarcastic or mocking, they will not serve the purpose we had in mind. Perhaps we simply need to be more aware of what we wish to express. Faced with this verbal inconsistency, I feel that the misuse of the internet is causing a regression in human beings, with many preferring to communicate solely through messages, setting aside the voice that has accompanied us since we came into this world.
***

title.title: Readings of poems and illustrated stories to highlight for students the importance of reading in the celebration of Book and Language Day.
title.body:
>
![GridArt_20260423_220214045.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cielitorojo/AKCHe7kKoifohBv5EABDoCxnt3uY7uq8kTxfsuwsCZH4RKXzNMPKxpp5W7WN4tX.jpg)
Feliz jueves mis queridísimos lectores y seguidores! Espero que todos se encuentren muy bien y estén realizando con éxito todas de cada una de las actividades y funciones en cada una de las áreas de su vida, noche de hoy aprovecho para compartirles otro contenido de las actividades que desempeño en mi lugar de trabajo diariamente, en esta ocasión, lecturas de poesías y cuento ilustrado para resaltar la importancia de la lectura en la celebración del día del libro y del idioma. Una fecha como hoy en el año 1995 la UNESCO consagró este día especial para celebrar el Día Mundial del libro y del idioma, esto se designó con la finalidad de resaltar la importancia de aprender a leer y de fomentar esta actividad como hábito diario en los niños y niñas de igual manera se debe respetar el derecho de autor de cada exponente de la literatura. Esta mañana en el colegio se llevó a cabo una actividad pedagógica significativa donde algunos niños recitaron poesías y también realizaron lectura de textos ilustrados además de una bonita exposición de libros elaborados por ellos mismos en apoyo de los representantes esto es de ellos con material de provecho, realmente fue una mañana muy nutrida donde se buscó impulsar motivar y resaltar a los estudiantes a que diariamente tienen que ejercitar la lectura para enriquecer su vocabulario conocer nuevos términos y aprender a comunicarse.
![GridArt_20260423_215832915.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cielitorojo/AKbFkA4UWUbvYUSuL25U3SZgjSiGUqxgND8nCPRx43RrSfzwabn7TJHy3w8DKcm.jpg)
![GridArt_20260423_215939409.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cielitorojo/AKFASTVdYYZRV7goZNvED2i2TwtqU2oqQKARKzKG7B3Rn7TmDeHZTt1ZtmoohsX.jpg)
![GridArt_20260423_220021565.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cielitorojo/AKpApFKePnBramkA6CbEssnUPBgJ3Z72F2edL6gUjCycmfBgdCFosMJYbv7raiX.jpg)
Gracias por acompañarme aquí y hasta otra oportunidad. Gracias por leerme y su valioso apoyo. Las fotos son mías @cielitorojo con mi Tecno Spark 10 Pro. Traducido con el traductor Deepl

This time, it's poetry readings and an illustrated story to highlight the importance of reading in celebration of World Book and Language Day. >On this day in 1995, UNESCO designated this special day to celebrate World Book and Language Day. This was established to emphasize the importance of learning to read and to foster this activity as a daily habit in children. title.title: The stars of the streets [Eng/Esp]
title.body:
>

The streets, as always, are full of the most spontaneous scenes, where you can encounter all kinds of people which is why I enjoy taking photos there so much, especially since there’s always something worth capturing. That’s why today I’m sharing these photos with you; I hope you enjoy them.

Las calles, como siempre, guardan escenarios de los más espontáneos en los que puedes encontrar distintos tipos de protagonistas, de ahí lo mucho que disfruto hacer fotografías allí, más tomando en cuenta que siempre hay algo para fotografiar. Por eso, el día de hoy les comparto estas fotografías que espero que disfruten.


https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/naitreart/23u5xwVYb2xDttweXbwdfvH7bRB3x98Gu3Gd9bomD5bXLoZZZnRqPETavnzwAXeyspnnh.jpg

https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/naitreart/23wC1BGsBoqpKpmjFKXsrsV1wG6wFshRACyPbNY8HLuUTVDBefe3q6wLUUnzZWcEVkRzL.jpg

https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/naitreart/23uFKEtYQEND5D3xyR68WFQx8fr4TpoEpAKr8EEU9XH6PyF59LTngsyMiXvJjaWX5MPQ4.jpg

>

When you take photos on the street, you don't always know exactly what you're going to photograph; at least I know I'll be looking for people walking from one street to another, but sometimes you come across people with their pets, which definitely adds a unique touch to those photos.

Cuando haces fotos en la calle, no siempre tienes algo claro de lo que vas a fotografiar; al menos yo soy consciente de que buscaré personas caminando de una calle a otra, pero a veces encuentras personajes junto a sus mascotas que sin duda le dan un toque distinto a hacer esas fotografías.


https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/naitreart/23u5bkA2YeyNmMb7kCLw7cW3LQfcXHv19TrrzaqXM6jLgotMSbrmByfwCHGgGD2HXsEMP.jpg

https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/naitreart/23wzzGnuebJtuZkwzCB1Z3yraF6JAcKy5v7c9PddUBqFcRqZzC1NWvSEQbZhmyhSYsjq9.jpg

https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/naitreart/23w2cX3Gz69KWs43vmZX2mtUGFrdiWSFhpoEWBFbejx9GW5o8UeTFQK5PnBwJnGn5wX5A.jpg

>

One thing that really stands out in my photos (at least when I take pictures in the same location) are the crosswalk stripes, which, if you know how to use them, can be a great way to draw the viewer’s eye to the main subjects, and I think I managed to make pretty good use of them in several of these photos.

Algo que se aprecia mucho en mis fotografías (al menos cuando hago fotos en el mismo lugar) son las franjas de cruce peatonal, las cuales, si sabes aprovechar, pueden ser un indicativo muy bueno para dirigir la vista hacia los protagonistas, y creo que varias de estas fotografías las supe aprovechar bastante bien.


https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/naitreart/23u5xa9MBkDtSbkJRUEA4U5aDkAzgyPGLQ8zZDM5ee58apLG2BBQsrSieLCdtwPm2r65G.jpg

https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/naitreart/23u5ZEcCn73T7egkDDDS8vW1bmS3AcG3kbAtDxYsJSRHviByQMrc5BppT84PRNoHSjuTK.jpg

https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/naitreart/23tbo36cm93P4xeVqBvCw48cfRYWGFACVuZKiC9KRravc7UXw8nk8kF2wGSoTGWqfyKqX.jpg

>

That's all for today; as always, I hope you enjoyed the photos and my little post. Thank you so much for stopping by again today; I hope you all have a wonderful day. See you next time, dear friends in the community and photography lovers!

Esto es todo por el día de hoy; como siempre, espero que disfrutaran de las fotos y de mi pequeño escrito. Muchas gracias por pasarse un día más por aquí; deseo que todos tengan un excelente día. ¡Hasta la próxima, queridos amigos de la comunidad y amantes de la fotografía!

/>

Today I am going to share with you my personal review and experience about **Kicking Roc** a great and unique card in the Splinterlands game. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmXDxDAi9LHiSYwHe3Xf8p83ew1kpG51wBTJFwJv2TDbeK/image.png) The Kicking Roc card is basically known as a flying type unit, which plays a special role in the battle field of the game. The most interesting aspect of this card is its speed and attack style. Being a flying unit, it is usually able to avoid the opponent's attacks many times, which makes it different from many other cards. Also, its attack power is designed in such a way that it can perform well in medium to long-term battles. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmVvamP7JnSUaKwBvyy92CdrVcsGKsLDcFDw5mybBunnVA/image.png) When talking about the good aspects of this card, the first thing to say is its speed and avoidance ability. Many times it is seen that the opponent's attacks are missed, which gives you a big advantage. It also works well in the backline or midline position, where it can continue to attack from safety. This card can be quite effective for those who play strategically and have long-term battle plans. However, this card is not equally strong in all situations. In some cases, when the opponent has a magic attack or a skill that can easily hit flying units, this card becomes a bit weak. Also, since its health is not very strong, it can quickly be out against high damage attacks. So, correct positioning and team combination are very important when using this card. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmRBQgAbXW9PJCLyhxHbukBLzPML9WcgKfKx7oAJWRXEvx/image.png) All in all, this card is a unique and strategic card, which can have a big impact on the match if used correctly. This is a card that will help you learn different strategies in the game and force you to think in new ways. I hope this review of mine will be useful for you and you can gain a better gameplay experience using this card.

title.title: The Second Chapter of Light / #monomad challenge / [ING/ESP]
title.body:
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYD2Y894vWwU5QHWXsmmuECdSjm5DSf33aNNAQtz8a3ts/_7504679_copia.jpg)

* * *

The photos 📸 are my entry to the #monomad contest from @monochromes and @brumest.

* * *

Greetings hivers.

Today I want to share some photos I took during a film developing workshop. Although some of us already had experience, it was truly amazing to see how young people with no prior contact with analog photography became excited the moment they saw their first images appear on film.

There were laughs, excitement, and even a few tears when they realized their rolls had been properly exposed. That instant when the image reveals itself never loses its magic.

Most of what we developed were 35mm rolls, with only a couple of 120 rolls that the instructor and I worked on. Even with experience, I had to refresh some knowledge that had faded over time.

In the next post I will show you the results. I hope you enjoy the images and the magic of film photography. I will be reading you in the comments.




![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmfAG2Xfey65NEZYN54xx4sZGDawE9dtdoeAmHPCywJP45/_7504616_copia.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZa5et4ABh96nWahHtGtQg8W66U2Ws72quNKUcW7Q9dU5/_7504644_copia.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmRVP3V4TvFdSupbkxNuZ71WdHrAWVFtt7eexiockVeWor/_7504648_copia.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmerRY3H7mx1C9ndQoQTh1qhbDMALQNJ7vu5CFuoHozsj9/_7504660_copia.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmbJWBdSbuJyyKjdyrp7veK68jnxfpFGoC5nUBkMFCoVut/_7504664_copia.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmWyed9fA2WjCujscE1gBDZzu9Wi7eR8qF6AeNwDwLv8YA/_7504687_copia.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQme4w8FPNWj2jTerTuho6nNyHFsJMVRyjaGrH95FxYMdZG/_7504689_copia.jpg)

Saludos hivers.

Hoy les voy a compartir algunas fotos que hice en el taller de revelado. Aunque algunos ya teníamos experiencia en el tema, fue maravilloso ver cómo jóvenes que nunca habían tenido contacto con la fotografía química se emocionaban al ver aparecer su primera imagen en el carrete.

Hubo risas, emoción y hasta alguna lágrima al comprobar que sus fotos habían quedado bien expuestas. Ese momento en que la imagen se revela nunca pierde su magia.

Casi todo lo que revelamos fueron carretes de 35mm, solo un par de 120 que hicimos el profe y yo. Y debo decir que, a pesar de la experiencia, tuve que refrescar algunos conocimientos que ya tenía algo olvidados.

En el próximo post les voy a enseñar los resultados. Espero que les gusten las fotos y la magia de la fotografía química. Los leo en los comentarios.

* * *

title.title: [ESP/ENG] Celebrando 5 años en hiveblog/Celebrating 5 years on hiveblog
title.body: > # 5 años en hiveblog Hola amigos, en el último párrafo de mi entrada anterior quise anexar mi agradecimiento por el apoyo en estos 5 años a mi blog. Sin embargo, considero que, 5 años es una cantidad de tiempo que debería ser celebrada con una entrada única. En estos 5 años, Hiveblog ha sido mi paño de lágrimas. Siiiii, y es que, esta plataforma no es solo un espacio virtual; es un refugio, un lugar donde me he abierto sin miedo a ser juzgada. Y se que muchas veces las palabras se quedan atrapadas en pensamientos, y Hiveblog es mi canal seguro para liberar esas emociones que nadie ha logrado entender o aliviar con solo escucharme. Nadie le quitara el valor a cada terapia a la que he logrado ir, pero, cada entrada, párrafo, línea y letra es una conversación conmigo misma y con quien me lee, palabras que al final han ayudado a mi proceso para sanar y transformarme en quien soy. Durante estos cinco años, han habido momentos muy difíciles en mi vida, y escribir fue para mi una necesidad, y mis emociones válidas. Así como también han habido momentos grandiosos que valen la pena dejar plasmados aquí en mi sitio seguro. Escribir se ha convertido en una actividad que me ha llevado a reflexionar, a celebrar mis avances, comprender mis propios sentimientos y confrontarme, lo cual ha sido fundamental para construir esta nueva versión que soy hoy. Para finalizar, nuevamente gracias a todo hive por ser mi paño de lágrimas digital, por leer y permitirme explotar mis palabras, que se que lucen mejor que en voz alta. Y sobre todo, gracias por el espacio donde soy genuina y ha crecido mi amor propio. _______ # 5 Years on Hiveblog Hello friends, in the last paragraph of my previous post, I wanted to add my thanks for the support of my blog over these 5 years. However, I believe that 5 years is a significant amount of time that deserves its own dedicated post. In these 5 years, Hiveblog has been my shoulder to cry on. Yes, this platform isn't just a virtual space; it's a refuge, a place where I've opened up without fear of judgment. I know that words often get trapped in thoughts, and Hiveblog is my safe channel for releasing those emotions that no one has been able to understand or alleviate simply by listening to me. No one can diminish the value of the therapy I've received, but every post, paragraph, line, and letter is a conversation with myself and with my readers—words that have ultimately helped my healing process and transformed me into who I am. During these five years, there have been very difficult moments in my life, and writing became a necessity for me, and my emotions were valid. There have also been wonderful moments worth sharing here in my safe space. Writing has become an activity that has led me to reflect, celebrate my progress, understand my own feelings, and accept myself, which has been fundamental in building this new version of myself that I am today. Finally, thank you again to everyone at Hive for being my digital shoulder to cry on, for reading and allowing me to express my words, which I know sound better than spoken aloud. And above all, thank you for the space where I can be my true self and where my self-love has grown. ______ Fotografía por | Photography by: @mairimmorales, HONOR MAGIC 7 LITE. title.title: Amor en la era digital [ESP/ENG]
title.body: >\nAhora que la tecnología nos arropa y debemos dejarnos llevar por ella, se me ocurrió que el novio le escribiera estos versos a su novia y ella perfectamente los entendería porque hablan el mismo \

de mi generación sería como un mensaje escrito en clave que necesita ser decodificado, de hecho para elaborarlos tuve que consultar con el diccionario de google para verificar realmente el significada de cada palabra. Asi que les dejo la tarea de tratar de entenderlo.

![digital.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gpache/23xerFo4jC9v6oXXdKawSp1kNbZg8FZ38K69Mqkn93Fj4v7eEyfucuYq3mpoKqh5mesmn.jpg)

[Pixabay](https://cdn.pixabay.com/photo/2018/01/20/23/10/communication-3095538_1280.jpg)

## Amor Digital

Pasaste con tu banda ancha orgullosa,
quedé como de malware invadido,
con tu outfit que atormenta mi sentido
y a mi humilde fibra óptica destroza

Expusiste mi código secreto,
colapsaste el sistema operativo,
de tus redes ahora soy cautivo,
descifrar tu algoritmo, qué gran reto!

Quisiera yo tu software conocer 
habitar  en el ram de tu memoria
tu data full de amor me da la gloria
es mi fuerza, mi fuente de poder


Tu voz: driver que nutre el pensamiento 
Tu pelo: archivos en dulce cascada 
Tu boca: clave de acceso privada 
Tu cuerpo: hardware, ritmo y movimiento 

Tu belleza sin igual desafía 
mi modesta inteligencia artificial
me pregunto mujer si eres real 
o producto de mi ágil fantasía 

Mis sistemas por tu causa afectados 
prisionero de tu chip ahora vengo
en tu nube en cada byte me sostengo
mis datos con los tuyos encriptados

Quisiera encontrar tu clave de acceso
unir mis canales con los tuyos
navegar entre suspiros y murmullos
amando sin hackear este  proceso.

No permitas que ni el  virus nos separe,
ni que el firewall detenga mi latido;
en la nube de tu luz me quedo unido
con el password que el destino nos depare

Expande tus archivos con mi amor
guarda mi backup muy dentro de tu alma
comparte información con toda calma
editemos nuestra historia a full color



![por-su-atención--¡muchas-gracias!-.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gpache/23u5taqyW6uQY3DH43A7wERRAaZuFK1yiTMxXsBz1DzBTEPeSaFFFTE4N2aft2gwdwXZC.jpeg)

* Imágenes tomadas de Pixabay
* Traductor de texto utilizado: Deepl

<div class=\

> # English Version # Love in the Digital Age Now that technology surrounds us and we have to go with the flow, it occurred to me that a boyfriend could write these verses to his girlfriend, and she would understand them perfectly because they speak the same “language.” For the “old-timers” of my generation, it would be like a coded message that needs to be decoded; in fact, to write them, I had to consult Google Translate to verify the actual meaning of each word. So I’ll leave it to you to try to figure it out. ![digital.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gpache/23xerFo4jC9v6oXXdKawSp1kNbZg8FZ38K69Mqkn93Fj4v7eEyfucuYq3mpoKqh5mesmn.jpg) [Pixabay](https://cdn.pixabay.com/photo/2018/01/20/23/10/communication-3095538_1280.jpg) ## Digital Love You passed by with your proud broadband, I was left as if invaded by malware, with your outfit that torments my senses and shatters my humble fiber optic cable You exposed my secret code, you crashed the operating system, I am now a captive of your networks, deciphering your algorithm—what a challenge! I wish I could know your software, dwell in the RAM of your memory; your data, full of love, gives me glory— it is my strength, my source of power Your voice: a driver that nourishes thought Your hair: files in a sweet cascade Your mouth: a private access code Your body: hardware, rhythm, and movement Your unparalleled beauty defies my modest artificial intelligence I wonder, woman, if you are real or a product of my vivid imagination My systems, affected by you, a prisoner of your chip, here I come, in your cloud, in every byte I hold on, my data encrypted with yours. I’d like to find your access code, to merge my channels with yours, to navigate through sighs and whispers, loving without hacking this process. Don’t let even a virus separate us, nor let the firewall stop my heartbeat; in the cloud of your light I remain united with the password that fate has in store for us Expand your files with my love keep my backup deep within your soul share information with complete calm let’s edit our story in full color ![thank-you-very-much! -.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gpache/23u5taqyW6uQY3DH43A7wERRAaZuFK1yiTMxXsBz1DzBTEPeSaFFFTE4N2aft2gwdwXZC.jpeg) * Images taken from Pixabay * Text translator used: Deepl

我报了一个268的团。其实本来有一个158的团可以对比。但是还是268的团设备专业，其实就是包出片的感觉。这个路程不是很远，因为是自驾就是268。如果是跟领队车就398。这种比之前的大巴车舒服多了。自驾坐着开开心心的， 一个多小时就到了。

下车后先进洞口。其实洞里面不是很远很长但是真的起伏很大，洞顶上也是一层一层的。光打上去非常好，有一点银河和星空的感觉。有些地方高度差让人觉得好害怕。洞里还有河，还好那些钟乳石都是有摩擦力的，里面空气不是很清新，因为有蝙蝠。不过蝙蝠盘旋在顶上，不攻击人离人很远。蝙蝠屎是有臭味的。还有就是通风口不多，有些时候空气有点浑浊。

领队找了好多拍照点给我们拍。我们都要都觉得返程路上都累了，领队还要想办法给我们拍。看来这是一个大型户外实景拍摄了。其实玩的话景致也就是那些，就是自然的溶洞和钟乳石，就看你不喜欢欣赏了。我觉得还行，图个新鲜感。最好的是有个拍照机位，领队带了无人机来拍。这个拍摄视角的确很好，他给视频加滤镜，就真的是人在星空的感觉。

但是一天下来，屁股是湿的，还有鞋子会比较脏。我跟对象回来后，直接点了一个非常好吃的北京烤鸭，才缓解了疲惫。但是也是真的出片。我后面对比了158那个团，他们的拍照更少更垃圾。虽然贵点，但是还是我报的这个吧。有的拍照机位确实很好。虽然可能没有拍到很好看的人脸，但是溶洞的美是拍出来了，剩下的修图吧。

title.title: How I Saved My Desert Rose Plant
title.body: >Greetings dear friends of Hive Garden, welcome to my blog. The cover photo for this post isn’t of my Desert Rose; I took it during one of my visits to the nursery specifically to buy this plant, which is absolutely beautiful and something I’d always wanted to have in my garden. It’s been quite a while now; when I bought it, it didn’t have any buds, and they couldn’t tell me what color the flowers would be, so it was a surprise to me when it finally bloomed.

>I’d never had this plant before, so I asked how to care for it, and they told me to water it sparingly and give it plenty of sun. They also confused me by saying, “As soon as you see the soil is dry, water it,” but only a little—almost like a light mist. However, the sun here in my city is so strong that the soil dries out quickly, which meant I’d have to water it every day, and I didn’t like that idea. I watered it every two days and then spaced it out to every four days. With this frequency and the sun it was exposed to, the plant, which had been sprouting new leaves, stopped growing, and the leaves began to turn yellow. I had to start removing them; it was a warning sign. My main concern was, “My Desert Rose is dying.” I immediately started researching and found a logical approach to saving my Adenium plant.
![1776975695045.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmYuTASWh5mED9rX5pgotnGdk4UjEUo6iLpbHhUzQ8yJm1/1776975695045.jpg)

>The solution was as simple as moving it into the shade and spacing out the watering cycles. It’s not an easy process; recovery can take a couple of months or more. My Adenium was suffering from sun stress; too much sun had dehydrated it. I began to notice that its caudex (the thick structure between the stem and the root) was soft; I also noticed a color change—it looked somewhat yellowish compared to the stem, which is green. This really scared me, and I even thought the roots might be rotting, which is serious. The first thing I did was move it into the shade—not total shade, though. The plant is still outdoors but under a roof, receiving light, but only indirectly and for a short time, just as long as the sun’s rays pass by. The important thing is that it was no longer getting that intense, extreme dose of sun that was dehydrating it.
### When I realized my plant was dehydrated

>As I explained, the caudex becomes wrinkled, takes on a soft texture, and the color can be whitish or slightly yellowish, just like my plant looks. I did another test to check the consistency of the stem, which is green; it’s soft too, but not as much as the caudex. Generally, the firmness of the caudex and stem is typical in this type of plant once they’ve been growing for a while and have matured. In young plants like mine, it’s normal for them to have a less solid consistency, so don’t panic if your Adenium, which is just starting to grow, has this condition. On the other hand, I continued checking the plant’s condition to make an accurate diagnosis. I uncovered its roots and could see healthy tissue—it looks white—which relieved me.
![1776975695115.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/hylene74/Eptcr9xjUMY6ChAfKBPekHSTqjP12sPKazEdpUZiXxtvYrWeys11QmkTeWakgDGAjnu.jpg)
![1776975695064.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmXjdf9rbR3cSECqAD9zbh88hj5wMKB5FdncfsFcD5fJC9/1776975695064.jpg)
![1776975695082.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmYr2nBhgjTSFiQTn3mD7QToGGweEmn9yAaGnecEpDo41X/1776975695082.jpg)

>Cases of dehydration are less serious and more easily treated than root rot. After I moved it, the yellowing of the leaves stopped and new ones began to grow. May is coming, my friends; I hope to see it bloom. That’s how my Adenium is doing—it’s recovering, but it’s a slow process and you have to be patient.
### Watering

>As for watering, I started doing it every 15 days. I don’t use just a little water; with Adenium, you have to water it generously, until water starts to drain out of the pot’s drainage holes. A friend taught me this, and I confirmed it through my own research. Make sure there is good drainage: water the plant and then lift the pot so that the water soaks the entire growing medium and the excess drains out through the holes.

>One thing I noticed—and which is part of the problem with dehydration—is that the roots of my Adenium are cramped in the pot, which means I need to repot it into a larger container; this will help it recover.
![1776975695099.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmedskjdjEYZe1sJ3TWDZYFjRjNCxekbAUxz4JvX7cdeeq/1776975695099.jpg)
![1776975694943.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmTsop7ycHZwhAPu38iCCvq86aeHT87mcMSjihtpt3jHX4/1776975694943.jpg)
![1776975694926.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmSGubAft1QRLp7aB9Q9Ls4iLN6ymJxPJbvVnUQSHVcaMT/1776975694926.jpg)
![1776975694910.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmVmnqmyTSE7hmaZgqveRGXSQVVLc3yVPhgehm6k1Sm3Tc/1776975694910.jpg)
![1776975695026.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmVWMRy7tb85TwztAJGLrK6s961iZXp9WFiqMPwegKYE5J/1776975695026.jpg)
### When Rot Occurs: Causes and What to Do

>Unlike dehydration, root rot is a much more serious problem in Adenium, and you must act quickly; the good news is that if treated in time, the plant can be saved. Root rot is caused by overwatering, poor drainage in the pots, and unsuitable potting mix. Root rot can be identified by a change in color of the caudex, a soft consistency, skin that peels off when touched, a brown color, and a foul odor.

>What should you do if the roots are rotting? Cut away the damaged part with a knife or razor blade—make sure they’re sterilized. Cut until you reach healthy tissue, which should look white or green, then let it dry in the shade for 3 to 4 days. You need to let the wound heal. After cutting, apply ground cinnamon, and once that time has passed, replant it. The soft texture and color change had me worried, as both rot and dehydration look similar, but I’ve cleared up the confusion. Identifying the problem leads us to the right solution.
### General Considerations
>- If there are yellow leaves, remove them and prevent them from falling into the soil. If these leaves are diseased, they will contaminate the soil. This applies to the care of any plant.
>- Keep the plant clean by wiping both sides of the leaves with a damp cloth to remove any dirt, and then wipe them with a dry cloth. This should be done very carefully.
>- Avoid cutting the plant when it is healthy, as these wounds can worsen and lead to rot when they come into contact with water.
>- Do not water the leaves, buds, or flowers; water only the soil. This helps prevent pests, mites, and fungi.
>- The best sunlight for Adenium is in the morning; afternoon sunlight is not beneficial at all and should be avoided, as it is one of the causes of dehydration.

>Me había habituado a tener plantas que no requiere mayores cuidados, no obstante, la variedades de estas nos enseñan cosas nuevas. De las plantas también obtenemos valiosas lecciones.
# Thank you for reading

title.title: I didn't expect anything from Wrestlemania 42 yet it managed to disappoint
title.body:
>

Hey hey everyone, like I said before WM was gonna be horrible but I never thought this bad. Not only the problem of zero stories done with dedication or art, but also bigger issues like the fact that WWE’s biggest event barely gathered 50k people in the stadium. Same city as last year, almost the same card, more expensive tickets than before, and the list goes on and on.

You’d think the whole route to this moment was badly planned so nothing took off in sales. They even reached 50k thanks to John Cena, who they had to bring almost forced. For what? Even he said it was all crap, but still let’s enjoy WM 😂

<table style=\

> The event doesn’t feel special since they made it 2 days. That magic of reaching the showcase of immortals is gone. Now thanks to TKO it feels so generic, just like they only want to exploit sales without caring about the product.

> The last-minute forced story of Roman vs Punk didn’t stand out much either. Slow fight—we know Roman can’t give more. Punk in his prime was agile, but at his age fast fights aren’t possible anymore. It had moments, but the result was another disaster. Just an acceptable match.

> Even the return of beloved Paige wasn’t left as a surprise. WWE announced a day before that she signed and would be at the event. What could’ve been the best surprise was ruined. Why couldn’t they keep it secret and announce it a minute before she appeared? That would’ve been the emotion of the night. Still, Paige is beautiful—when I was a kid I fell in love with her, though later Alexa stole that kid’s heart.

> From night 1 the best was the ladder match. They really shined—created a dangerous space with painful-looking moves and falls that hurt just watching. I can’t imagine falling from that height and continuing to fight like nothing happened. Respect to them. And Penta, WWE had him super underused but looks like they’ll finally give him the push he deserves with his talent.
> Even though Liv isn’t the best wrestler right now, she has something that gives chemistry every time she holds a championship. I really like her character—I adore her, though not as much as Alexa 😍

> I think the most awaited fight of the 2-night event was Oba vs The Beast, where Brock Lesnar had a short fight but retired, which was the best. Considering what WWE did with AJ Styles and John Cena—retired against Gunther to make him look like a threat—for nothing. He disappeared for months, then suddenly forced into a WM fight. Probably they wanted Gunther to retire Brock too. Better Brock retired in the main event so WWE and TKO wouldn’t ruin his retirement.

> The bad part of the event was the super short matches. How can a championship fight last 6 minutes? Crazy. Excessive commercials everywhere—Netflix, the ring, balloons in the stadium, the commentary table, the mat, the corners. 15-minute ads longer than the matches. Better call it COMMERCIAL-MANIA. Makes me wonder why pay for a service if they’ll give you thousands of ads. Better use a pirate app with 2 ads and watch the event. What benefit do streaming companies give you to watch legally?

> Raw didn’t escape either. They tried to patch WM’s errors. There were some entertaining moments, but it didn’t feel like a PPV. Just another Monday Raw show. As long as TKO keeps making creative decisions, it’ll be hard to see wrestling as a sport—it’ll all be commercial and generic. That’s what many feel on social media. As a sport it was totally weak, as a commercial event it was super good, which will make TKO keep giving the same for a long time. * * * **Follow me so you don't miss the next adventure!**

Documents and such needed to be signed, so we had a quick drive out of town yesterday afternoon. Well, the rains have come (with thunderstorms even), but the scorching heat, even at 3 pm, reminded us that it is still summer, and it is nice! And suddenly, it's Fri-yay in DD! I brought Yongi out for a wee sunbathing, and the generous sunshine had some cool displays in the yard; hence my *effortless shadow hunts* (as I didn't have to go looking for any). title.body:
> **Hola liketu lovers, ✨ espero estén súper bien.** Hoy se celebra el día mundial del libro, y hace unos días nos invitaron para una función en un colegio aquí en la ciudad así que hoy bien tempranito nos alistamos para ir a la escuela y presentar nuestro espectáculo de mimos, todo salió de maravilla, los niños estaban muy contentos y les gustó mucho la presentación, antes de ir a escena aproveché de tomar unas fotos generalmente se me olvida tomar fotos por qué estoy tan concentrada en que todo salga bien que lo olvido pero hoy tuvimos un momento antes de la función y mientras estábamos en el salón dw computación aproveché la iluminación y tome algunaa fotos, también en el patio de la escuela tenían una decoración muy linda con muchos libros hechos por los niños, la verdad estoy feliz porque todo salió muy bien. **Espero te haya gustado este post, sí llegaste hasta aquí gracias por estar y visitar mi blog ❤️ nos vemos pronto.** *** #
#### **ENGLISH**
# #

> *** **Hi liketu lovers, ✨ I hope you're doing great.** Today is World Book Day, and a few days ago we were invited to perform at a school here in town, so early this morning we got ready to go to the school and put on our mime show. Everything went wonderfully; the kids were very happy and really enjoyed the performance. Before going on stage, I took the opportunity to snap a few photos. I usually forget to take pictures because I’m so focused on making sure everything goes well that I lose track of it, but today we had a moment before the show, and while we were in the computer lab, I took advantage of the lighting and snapped a few shots. Also, in the schoolyard, they had a very nice display with lots of books made by the kids. Honestly, I’m happy because everything went so well. **I hope you liked this post, if you made it this far thank you for visiting my blog ❤️ see you soon.** *** # **¡Gracias por leerme, hasta luego!** > # **Thank you for reading me, see you later !** *** ![Azul y Amarillo Moderno Casero Fiestas y Celebraciones Marco en X Banner.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yulilemus/EpR24jokeEvQR3QUEz9X8rTnC3FcbrXuJJbxQMzyUMw4ZLHvL91hssCVdwhBH6md97z.gif) ![BackgroundEraser_20230622_211641066.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yulilemus/23tGXZimDv9p8VZsWTwB7zJNGd5212gYvw8Gofk6SDadE3eT2LzD8VoremgFJWy4Fjak5.png)

title.title: Magi lance Altera, le premier protocole cross-chain de finance décentralisée sur Hive.
title.body: /> [Magi](https://vsc.techcoderx.com/) (anciennement VSC), le réseau blockchain de niveau 2 et compatible EVM lance [**Altera**](https://vsc.techcoderx.com/) le premier protocole de finance décentralisée cross-chain qui intègre le bitcoin au réseau Hive de façon native. **Magi** vise à résoudre le problème de fragmentation dans le marché crypto en connectant plusieurs blockchain à Hive. C’est le 4ᵉ protocole au monde (après Thorchain, Chainflip et Maya Protocol) à réussir l'implémentation d'une garde native Bitcoin basée sur la technologie TSS pour des échanges inter-chaînes. Il résout le problème de l'absence de contrats intelligents sur Bitcoin grâce à une architecture inter-chaînes évoluée qui offre des caractéristiques suivantes: *

>Schémas de signature à seuil (TSS) : Gestion distribuée des clés où aucun validateur ne détient seul la clé privée complète

\n*

>Relais Bitcoin SPV (Simplified Payment Verification): Client léger intégré à la chaîne qui vérifie les transactions Bitcoin sans faire confiance à des tiers.

\n*

>Passerelle Hive : Multisig à rotation horaire pour des opérations sécurisées en HIVE/HBD.

\n\n
>Magi est sécurisé par un réseau de validateurs décentralisés qui déposent des jetons HIVE en garantie pour sécuriser les coffres inter-chaînes et traiter les transactions.

>Altera est la première application DeFi permettant d'échanger, de fournir de la liquidité et de gérer des actifs inter-chaînes sur Magi. Elle offre:

\n\n*

>Des échanges de BTC natifs : Les utilisateurs peuvent échanger du Bitcoin natif (et non des jetons encapsulés ou « wrapper ») contre du HIVE, du HBD (stablecoin du protocole Hive).

\n*

>Du HBD comme actif de règlement : Tous les pools de liquidité utilisent le HBD (Hive Backed Dollar) comme actif de base.

\n*

>Un modèle des frais réduits: Frais de base AMM de 0,08 % + frais de glissement dynamiques. Les transactions sont sans frais grâce au modèle de crédits de ressources de Hive.

Après cette première intégration réussie du Bitcoin, l’équipe de développement, largement soutenue par la communauté Hive a dans son plan de développement l’intégration de Dash, Litecoin, Ethereum.

>
Quels sont les avantages qu’offre la blockchain Magi?

Pour les utilisateurs, Magi permet d'échanger de manière native des BTC ↔ HIVE de manière fluide, sans KYC, sans jetons encapsulés et sans frais élevés.

Pour les développeurs, Magi permet de créer des apps inter-chaînes, accessibles aux utilisateurs depuis n'importe quelle blockchain. Grâce à son kit de développement, l’interface d’échange BTC/HBD peut être intégrée dans toutes applications web2 ou web3.

>https://magisdk.okinoko.io/

Pour la blockchain Hive (L1): Magi permet de générer une demande structurelle et externe pour les jetons HBD et HIVE grâce à un volume inter-chaînes réel, réduisant ainsi la dépendance aux plateformes d’échanges centralisés.


A propos de Magi:

Magi Network est un protocole d'interopérabilité de nouvelle génération construit sur la blockchain Hive. Il permet des échanges d'actifs natifs non-dépositaires et des interactions avec des contrats intelligents entre plusieurs blockchains — le tout depuis un seul portefeuille autogéré. Magi ne cherche pas à isoler Hive, mais à le connecter. En créant une infrastructure de liquidité décentralisée, résiliente et indépendante des décisions commerciales des plateformes centralisées, Hive devient autosuffisant tout en s'ouvrant à l'écosystème crypto mondial. [En savoir plus...](https://magi.eco/)

title.title: Dino king hunter where I have to hunt different dinosaurs🦖
title.body:
[![](https://images.3speak.tv/images/1776996353486-bccac84ed11b9b2a.webp)](https://3speak.tv/watch?v=gamingnature/2560f9ff)

▶️ [Watch on 3Speak](https://3speak.tv/watch?v=gamingnature/2560f9ff)


---

Hello gaming lovers, how are you all?Hey today I brought a new game.Maybe some of you have played the game before but I played it for the first time today so it is new to me.The name of the game is Dino King Hunter.This is a 3D action and simulation game where I have to hunt different dinosaurs.Arms can be easily fired here.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmbuJgKpo8r5GU8pgfVycz8Yq3cJEyVmQVB5z9R39RvCAE/1776993462227.jpg)

I sometimes try to play a little difference game that has something to do with history.For example if we talk about dinosaurs today, we can't finish talking.Because dinosaurs are animals that have a huge history.I was already interested in learning about dinosaurs and I learned a lot about them.But I still want to know a lot about dinosaurs.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmfV5NSHXHwJwpcANsk1HTgUGbZ347PVq4VujUN3kYEEYB/1776993475888.jpg)

History says that dinosaurs were the most dangerous animals on this planet.I am involved in everything related to dinosaurs, such as history, gaming, movies, etc.I love all the history related to dinosaurs and am very interested in learning about them.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmcVEZs6ChE9uLpQnwrbjQKGVBGf9t74KPrjRsLyDxdbQY/1776993493450.jpg)

I learned that dinosaurs once ruled the earth and that no humans lived on earth at that time.I heard that dinosaurs ruled the earth about 250 million years ago and they ruled the earth for several million years.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmPMbvEgLobsJzkqouwxxvDuCtVJeTcoWtgCMJtJRP4UTn/1776993505795.jpg)

History shows that they were fearsome and powerful creatures.Maybe they became extinct again by the will of God, because I think humans and dinosaurs could not have lived on the same planet.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmSRFUVRFv3N33F5SVEkYk2RuJroUbfjAwJ2ri3nxMTmxu/1776993521898.jpg)

I've seen a lot of dinosaur movies before.But in reality, they were wiped out by a huge meteorite.The meteorite at that time was so powerful that it almost destroyed the planet and killed large animals.Yes the dinosaurs died from that meteorite impact.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmTQvYcDHFpUvjbskkzayYDbSBVPfWanDvRnpZJedzDtzL/1776993558958.jpg)

Today I played the dinosaur killing game because I was thinking about dinosaurs today.But this game is very interesting and entertaining enough.In this game, wielding weapons is like being a real hunter.Hunting with this type of rifle is interesting.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmcVmFX7TVXkQRpv7RFzNN2LkcaDv4e8rAZEQKGosDdgtN/1776993574169.jpg)

Different types of mountains, jungles and deserts are available in this game and different types of dinosaurs are available.Dinosaurs can be killed simply by firing a weapon and shedding tears.Many types of dinosaurs can be found here and other predators can also be seen.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmc7sYxwpetXh1nVRcY5VNhGKNQE9fJ8YxEP19SyncjwDr/1776993584622.jpg)

First I killed the flying dinosaurs.Flying dinosaurs look scary, but I don't know what they were like in reality.There are some harmless animals in the jungle so you have to protect them and kill the dinosaurs.After killing the flying dinosaur, I killed the land dinosaur.Land dinosaurs 🦖 are big big.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmf9f7kLnR6uuBvoyQH2e1254csw9ZX3VtCQDCwwNHtMCf/1776993595979.jpg)

It is fully 3D and clear.Here I killed the dinosaur by zooming the weapon which is a very interesting game.This game was quite enough for entertainment.Interesting this game is related to history, so I played it.You can enjoy it by joining me.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQJrEXsQpF4tKktTfiFoSRFkLJNBGHhTX5K3zkJne6SaV/1776993605392.jpg)

I invite you to watch this interesting and entertaining gaming video today.

<center><sub>Thumbnail And Screenshot Source: Original screenshot captured during gameplay</sub></center>

Thank you...

title.title: GPT5.5来了
title.body:
早晨一打开电脑，发现GPT似乎有些变化，仔细看了下，果不其然，从昨天的GPT5.4升级到了最新的5.5,如下图，


![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmYrbzer5fmnvvoWeFPuHqyiYqejNvjpVUJZkHPWtJJczT/image.png)

看下5.5比之前的5.4做了哪些方面的改善，我们让它自己回答，


![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmNU4Zp5bEm8fHLs5CzwF7CSGJnf8FC7sNfzmrYiyoRjcm/image.png)



![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmQkXXwv4xFAVPiVtETbL11m8v8vp8xaXXdEapAENSeEpR/image.png)


从它自己给出的回答，可以看出，这次5.5的升级，主要体现在：

>GPT-5.5 的优势主要体现在“长链路技术分析 + 代码落地 + 多步骤排查”

这种升级，对于大多数普通使用用户来说，应该是很难觉察到。但对于我这类经常要进行长链路(较长任务)技术分析的用户来说，那可真是及时雨啊。

我之前用gpt5.4和opus4.6，但是上个月的时候，发现opus4.6忽然不给用了。没办法，只好切换到国产的kimi2.5,勉强可以用，但效果嘛，只能说一分价钱一分货，比上不足，比下有余。

后来为了方便，我干脆现在弄了台新加坡的远程服务器，这样opus就可以继续用了。之前我是在不同终端使用多个大模型，后来我一想这样太麻烦，有时候为了一个任务还需要文件多次来回拷贝，非常琐碎，干脆就在这同一台服务器上部署好多个大模型调用，包括kimi-cli、codex。

现在我的做法是，最复杂的任务交给opus(最新的4.7)，其次codex，日常的工作由kimi完成，毕竟kimi最便宜，一个任务跑十几甚至几十分钟，也不会心疼。


![76218fc6d028b3aca6d86bc6fd097805.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmdd7PJTz7aA1WkDMa6itWKJhznM8yDvWeUfwQL5Q42kYF/76218fc6d028b3aca6d86bc6fd097805.png)

人常说，“偏听则暗，兼听则明。” 同样，碰到复杂的、一时难以判断的问题，我会分别交给opus4.7和codex5.4,让他们分别给出自己的分析内容，然后我再把两者给出的分析综合再交由其中一个分析，这样得出来的分析结果就会较为全面，也尽可能避免了一些极端情况下的误判。


![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmNQpqfCQHoGMLXfJycvQ2AUjuurxthmevpNuaEkKa8sfv/image.png)

AI真是个好工具，用的好，真的对人工作的帮助和提升很大啊。

title.title: Movie Review: Ted Lasso
title.body:
![115.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/samostically/Ep5mdMZmpWWYYyyCWpzBDb32Nh47Subcmn9b72BCBReyFdDTetADvQbrhNgfvQiN7qv.jpg)
Hello there, and welcome to a movie review article on the latest comedy series I am watching. It is Ted Lasso, and it has more comedy than anyone would expect. It all started off as a means to sit back and relax while keeping my mind distracted from thinking about other things. Now it has turned into something I am glad I decided to watch. It is all about an American Football coach called Ted Lasso, who is given the job to coach a Premier League club in London. Given the distance and how different America is from London, and not to mention the differences between American football and soccer, Ted Lasso still takes up the challenge. Jason Sudeikis is the man playing this character called Ted Lasso.
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/samostically/23zbMzN7uxG6QLvMVGvzS13s3LUf3iTtRM652kXWMegarbna4yBpHKMRX2EyeFnyExbWv.png)
He comes into the club with all his strong will and relentless belief that things will work out for him due to his optimism. I have to admit that Ted Lasso's energy is truly contagious, right from how he interacts with the players and people, with warmth and interest. This makes him a man who has become difficult to root against. The genesis of his hire is on the basis that he will fail catastrophically, since he has zero experience in coaching a Premier League team. It was a reason out of spite from the owner of the club against her ex-husband. It becomes amusing how Ted Lasso comes in and starts making some changes by uplifting the spirit of the team through his belief mindset.
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/samostically/23tm7K1CT5hJGNCdgA4DEHo7pMFA2CtyWAMmMo7xGeX1k1EmrKKFff4edFN7KkQUA8YUZ.png)
What started as a simple sports comedy gradually develops into the growth of its characters in different ways, as they begin to work on their flaws towards being better people. You get starstruck by the characters and how funny they can be. It does not matter who the character is, but their perception is strongly admirable. The way they act and what makes them special. In no time, you will find yourself rooting for the club, AFC Richmond. Just like that, you are now a part of something big.
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/samostically/EoCaxJQdz5ScUaGBnjcwo7Gcbrxgk9dff8fUba2dte7jadaLF7aXvnGm4dTfSdafXAs.png)
More characters in the series will constantly keep you glued to your screen, but the best part is how they grow as individuals. There is Miss Welton, the owner of the club, who was rooting for the club's failure in the league, down to Roy Kent, the angry Captain turned mentor, who is just a big baby underneath the angry personality. Nobody has anything figured out as they all scale through their challenges and individual differences.
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/samostically/Eo6CkhbbykKabA1bdh4xJbhiquPLbbNAzNcj1js5pHKTBYRzVXwN7ZvHwGBvqvYEn6e.png)
A shock for me was how the movie got emotional as well, when I was expecting it to be all comedy with laughs and more laughs. I felt emotional when things began to get serious because I was not expecting that right away. You get to see that underneath these funny characters and their acting, they are also people who are trying to deal with life as well, and it is so relatable, no matter who you are.
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/samostically/23swg9pifFi4Bm9fBa8DGkKpyhTAUY9RwRtLknGuqGvauBqiAT2JKYnnnJgcgB7vekL5g.png)
Within the underlying comedy and emotions, there are vital lessons that can be learned from the movie, and that is to believe and support. This is one thing I actually noticed was predominant. There is a need for a support system for these characters as they go through things and face challenges. It is not all comedy but motivational as well. # My Rating: 8/10
___ ![samosti 2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/samostically/23t7DhyLBcxoXuUmgwLnZvioQ3v5QnMB9qFkMvfhpceXCucVBy9yV435N3hgNLQdeLYpm.png)
![Samostically Banner.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/samostically/Eo6Cie7XPvRCoFSbPcHCY2WLfe8w5upAP4o2FvnNPV8d52md62bx9Gg7vhkcHNi1hnr.png)
I am @samostically, a chess player and writer. I love to share the experience I have gained from different battles over the 64 squares and the knowledgeable insights from books I have read. But most importantly, [I am a Midnight Owl and I founded the community Midnight Letters.](https://peakd.com/c/hive-186424/about) ♟♟♟♟♟♟♟♟♟ ![samosti 2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/samostically/23t7DhyLBcxoXuUmgwLnZvioQ3v5QnMB9qFkMvfhpceXCucVBy9yV435N3hgNLQdeLYpm.png)

title.body: > Hello friends of the hive, it's a pleasure to greet you on this new occasion. I hope you've had a blessed day. Today is my second day of virtual classes for a unit pricing course. Although some people don't quite understand this format, during the pandemic I learned to develop the ability to understand by listening or through videos. In these classes, everything is done through texts, although today I struggled a bit to understand certain calculation exercises. I think overall I'm doing well. \n

> Hola amigos de la colmena es un placer saludarles en esta nueva oportunidad , espero hayan tenido un bendecido dia , hoy es mi segundo dia de clases virtuales de un curso de precios unitarios , aunque hay personas que no entienden mucho esta modalidad , en pademia yo aprendi a desarrollarla la habilidad de entender escuchando o mediante videos , en estas clases todo son mediante textos aunque hoy me costo un poco entender ciertos ejercicios de calculos creo en general me va bien ![IMG_7571.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ariannysg/23wMf2r95iV8UaMnB3b6LJBqre6dYUVms7K3hUMJPdPyHpYVJZUAiuF3S5r3gD7qnTcEf.jpeg)

> My first class was very theoretical, focusing on reading line items in contracts, calculating direct and indirect costs, logistics, and potential external factors on a construction site. Today's class was on materials, and it was a bit complicated regarding the specifications. Unit price analysts have to consider everything from the exact materials needed for mixing a wall to the square meters of paint, paint mixes, and many other things. I was very confused by the specifications for sand, cement, and water since my field isn't civil engineering. The professor explained that the line items specify many things about materials, but that technical committees with experts or engineers working on the construction site also need to review them. The materials can be sorted by weight, size, or number of pieces. The last exercise left me a little confused, but she also recommended a manual that makes the work much easier. I'm really enjoying this experience, even though it seems a bit complicated at the moment. \n

> Mi primera clase fue muy teorica sobre la lecturas de partidas en los contratos sacar los sueldo directo , los indirectos , logisticas y posibles factores externos en una obra , hoy fue materiales realmente estuvo un poquito complicado respecto a las especificaciones sobre estos , porque los analistas de precios unitarios tienes que tener en cuenta desde el material exacto para las mezclas por una pared , hasta los metros cuadrados con pinturas , mezclas de pintura y muchas cosas , en las especificaciones de arena , cemento , agua quede muy confundida ya que mi area no es la ingeneria civil , la profesora a cargo me explico en las partidas vienen especificadas muchas cosas , sobre materiales sino las mesas tecnicas con expertos o ingenieros que trabajan en la obra los materiales pueden ser por peso , tamaño o piezas , en el ultimo ejercicio me dejo algo confundida pero tambien nos recomendo un manual que facilita mucho con los trabajo , me esta gusta mucho esta experiencia aunque por el momento se vea un poco complicada ![photo-output.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ariannysg/AK81tGPzcT9FHHxfBdX6WuqRuL6T5PCohrGYuG3jbmtQpdJDceNbX6DzXgJnZFH.jpeg)

title.title: Letras Inspiradoras: Cuando el buen trato es la excepción [ESP/ENG]
title.body:
> 

En estos días me he dado cuenta de algo desconcertante: Me sorprende cuando alguien me atiende bien.

La atención al público en la región donde vivo, deja mucho que desear. 

Si voy a una consulta médica, puedo sentir cómo a los doctores poco les importa indagar más de lo estrictamente necesario, para recetar un tratamiento que mejores mis síntomas. 

Si voy a una tienda de lo que sea, tengo que casi rogar para que me atiendan. 

En líneas generales, aunque el cliente es la supervivencia de un negocio, observo que en mi entorno la competencia es tan poca, que el personal  no tiene que esforzarse ni un poquito en lograr un cliente satisfecho, porque aunque no quisiera regresar a ese sitio, no encuentro una mejor opción. 

Por eso la competencia es una buena aliada.

Bienvenidos a [\

>  

Lately, I've realized something puzzling: I'm actually surprised when someone treats me well.

Customer service in the region where I live leaves a lot to be desired. 

If I go to a doctor’s office, I can sense that the doctors don’t really care to ask more than what’s strictly necessary to prescribe a treatment that will alleviate my symptoms. 

If I go to any kind of store, I practically have to beg to be served. 

Generally speaking, even though customers are essential to a business’s survival, I’ve noticed that in my area there’s so little competition that customer service staff don’t have to make even the slightest effort to ensure a satisfied customer, because even if I didn’t want to return to that place, I can’t find a better option. 

That’s why competition is a good ally.

Welcome to [\

](https://ecency.com/hive-139925/@syllem/una-nueva-columna-ha-llegado), this welcoming space where we can share our experiences, perspectives, or visions in the form of initiatives, as a way to spark a dialogue that enriches us in some way. ***
https://images.ecency.com/DQmXX9KbHbdks7cRSdvsCRgQsWVVb4R5SS8fJ9pypQ2uYqL/20260423_203632.jpg ***

> Ayer fui al internista del hospital de la empresa donde trabajo y ¡BINGO! me trató tan bien que me sorprendió. Al menos una hora estuve en su consulta e intentó concientizarme de la importancia de la alimentación, el ejercicio y el manejo del estrés para la buena salud. Siento que se esforzó y me pareció algo tan extraño. Entonces me di cuenta de que no estaba acostumbrada a que me prestaran atención en una consulta médica y me sentí tan bien de ser escuchada.

> Yesterday I went to see the internist at the hospital affiliated with the company where I work, and BAM! He treated me so well that I was surprised. I was in his office for at least an hour, and he tried to make me aware of the importance of diet, exercise, and stress management for good health. I felt like he really made an effort, and it seemed so unusual to me. Then I realized that I wasn’t used to being given attention during a doctor’s appointment, and it felt so good to be listened to. ***
https://images.ecency.com/DQmfMeWBKhBBnnRZuJYoreiDCNUSCpHvG4EkkJpd6XypMxX/20260423_203929.jpg
***

> Otro sitio que nos cautivó por el buen trato, es la clínica odontológica en la que le están haciendo el tratamiento de ortodoncia a nuestros hijos. Recuerdo que primero fuimos a una que nos atendieron mal, con prisa, como por salir del paso; pero como en teoría era buena, insistimos para concertar la segunda cita y aún así, nunca nos llamaron. Y les estoy hablando de una clinica odontológica privada. Entonces conseguimos una recomendación de otra, que es mucho más cara, sin embargo, la atención fue tan buena, que allí nos quedamos. Aunque nuestro presupuesto es limitado, hacemos un esfuerzo para cubrir los costos, porque mis hijos son realmente muy bien atendidos allí.

> Another place that really won us over with its excellent service is the dental clinic where our children are receiving orthodontic treatment. I remember that we first went to one where they treated us poorly—they were rushed, as if they just wanted to get it over with. But since it was supposedly a good clinic, we insisted on scheduling a second appointment, and even then, they never called us back. And I’m talking about a private dental clinic. Then we got a recommendation for another one, which is much more expensive; however, the service was so good that we stayed there. Although our budget is limited, we make an effort to cover the costs, because my children are really well cared for there. ***
https://images.ecency.com/DQmYomAr4KTaKUNvoqYw7YNuw16xXJo4m6SUJh8Nj516BkV/20260423_203837.jpg
***
> Todo esto me puso a pensar, en que tendemos a normalizar lo común, aunque no esté bien y nos sorprendemos cuando alguien actúa como deberíamos actuar todos.

> All of this got me thinking: we tend to take the ordinary for granted, even when it’s not right, and we’re surprised when someone acts the way we all should. ***
https://images.ecency.com/DQmV5aqwDotWPNyfRBwhqag6hgrhzaHkjSP88MUzDJDMBGb/20260423_203911.jpg
https://images.ecency.com/DQmNV8QQAkMWAmKKDyAAHmtWrVmCNkRg42nDbZganUwz5ok/image.png

title.title: 「Vicky's Life」短剧｜《驯野》（杨鹏丞x王小亿）PART 1
title.body:
![IMG_4899](https://s1.img-e.com/20260403/69cf75f085387.jpeg)

如果说之前看《金屋藏娇》第一次直面姐弟恋的话，那么这部超火的《驯野》更是将姐弟恋具像化了。看完后最直接的感觉是果然要多赚钱，有颜有钱对象就还在念书:D

从剧情的角度来说，开篇就是女主发现相恋多年的未婚夫出轨，她开车散心却在山路上抛锚了。来给她修车的男主是山里考出来的大学生，他要勤工俭学照顾母亲和妹妹。

不知道是缘分、眼缘还是想放纵一把，在确定男主成年以后这个落魄少年成了女主的“金丝雀”。随着了解的加深女主发现男主的母亲是被拐卖的，她毫不犹豫拉了一把。

随着男主母亲回到京市继而恢复身份，男主从落魄少年摇身一变成了京圈贵公子。这种变化让两人悬殊的年龄差距和身份成了感情的巨大障碍，两人分手男主出国求学。

剧的后半段讲的是男主归国后对女主展开强烈攻势，这里面的拉扯感还是挺强的。女主不是恋爱脑她的阅历就意味着不会被轻易感动，在她最困难的时候男主不在身边。

脑补了下女主父亲破产她还挺个肚子的画面，太窒息了。


（本篇完）
